result.text: The purpose of this FOA is to develop and maintain Rapid Response Teams (RRTs) to facilitate long-term improvements and innovation to the national integrated food safety system by unifying and coordinating federal/state/local human and animal food (HAF) emergency response efforts including: 1) Strengthening the link among epidemiology, lab and environmental health/regulatory components; 2) Improving States' regulatory and surveillance HAF protection programs to include using Incident Command System (ICS)/National Incident Management System (NIMS) principles and a Unified Command structure to conduct integrated responses to all-hazards HAF emergencies, rapidly identifying and removing tainted food from commerce, and conducting root cause investigations to inform future prevention efforts; and 3) Addressing supporting components, such as training, data sharing, data analysis, communications, continuous process improvement, and development of best practices and other resources to support national response capacity/capability development.

result.text: The Göttinger Verkehrsbetriebe GmbH (GöVB) is a municipal transport company 100% owned by the City of Göttingen. It operates local public transport in the city of Göttingen and adjacent regions and ensures the daily mobility of residents and guests with its bus fleet. As a sectoral contracting authority within the meaning of § 100 of the Act against Restraints of Competition (GWB), GöVB is responsible for the procurement of services and systems that secure the operation and further development of local public transport. GöVB pursues the goal of gradually converting its bus fleet to alternative, in particular electric, drive systems. In doing so, it makes a significant contribution to sustainable mobility, the reduction of emissions, and the achievement of the climate targets of the City of Göttingen. The expansion of the e-bus fleet is accompanied by a considerable need for modern charging infrastructure that enables efficient, reliable, and economical operational management. To support this transformation, GöVB is planning the introduction of a charging and load management system (LLEMS). This system is intended to enable intelligent control and monitoring of all charging processes at the depot and, in the future, also in scheduled service. The focus is on ensuring vehicle availability, grid and load optimisation, and the safe and economical operation of electromobility in local public transport in Göttingen.

parts.source: Die Göttinger Verkehrsbetriebe GmbH (GöVB) ist ein kommunales Verkehrsunternehmen in 100%iger Trägerschaft der Stadt Göttingen. Sie betreibt den öffentlichen Personennahverkehr in der Stadt Göttingen und angrenzenden Regionen und gewährleistet mit ihrer Busflotte die tägliche Mobilität von Einwohnerinnen, Einwohnern und Gästen. Als Sektorenauftraggeber im Sinne von § 100 GWB ist die GöVB für die Beschaffung von Leistungen und Systemen verantwortlich, die den Betrieb und die Weiterentwicklung des ÖPNV sichern. Die GöVB verfolgt das Ziel, ihre Busflotte schrittweise auf alternative, insbesondere elektrische Antriebe umzustellen. Damit leistet sie einen wesentlichen Beitrag zur nachhaltigen Mobilität, zur Reduktion von Emissionen und zur Erreichung der Klimaziele der Stadt Göttingen. Mit dem Ausbau der E-Bus-Flotte geht ein erheblicher Bedarf an moderner Ladeinfrastruktur einher, die ein effizientes, zuverlässiges und wirtschaftliches Betriebsmanagement ermöglicht. Zur Unterstützung dieser Transformation plant die GöVB die Einführung eines Lade- und Lastmanagementsystems (LLEMS). Dieses System soll eine intelligente Steuerung und Überwachung aller Ladeprozesse auf dem Betriebshof und perspektivisch auch im Linienbetrieb ermöglichen. Im Mittelpunkt stehen die Gewährleistung der Fahrzeugverfügbarkeit, die Netz- und Lastoptimierung sowie der sichere und wirtschaftliche Betrieb der Elektromobilität im ÖPNV Göttingen.

result.text: The aim of the tender is to procure a powerful, scalable and user-friendly software solution that supports the contracting authority in efficient, quality-assured and data protection-compliant translation in customer contact. The contracting authority shall conclude a framework agreement with the contractor regarding the provision and management service of licences for cloud-based translation software - text/document translation and conversation mode/voice - over a period of 2 years and the option of extension by 2 x one further year. The aim of the tender is to procure a powerful, scalable and user-friendly software solution that supports the efficient, quality-assured and data protection-compliant translation of scientific, administrative and technical content. The solution must be suitable both for automated translations and for the integration of human translation services and, in particular, meet the requirements for multilingualism in customer communication. In addition, the subject matter of the contract includes the provision of a central licence and user administration service as well as the provision of support and maintenance services over the entire term of the framework agreement. The translation software to be offered must be provided as a cloud-based solution. Local installation on servers or end devices of the respective contracting authority is not planned and will not be accepted. An app is provided for mobile Apple end devices. The software must be usable via web-based access (e.g. via a common internet browser). The minimum requirements are specified in the service description.

parts.source: Ziel der Ausschreibung ist die Beschaffung einer leistungsfähigen, skalierbaren und benutzerfreundlichen Softwarelösung, die die Auftraggeberin bei der effizienten, qualitätsgesicherten und datenschutzkonformen Übersetzung im Kundenkontakt unterstützt. Die Auftraggeberin schließt mit dem Auftragnehmer eine Rahmenvereinbarung über die Überlassung und den Management Service von Lizenzen einer cloudbasierten Übersetzungssoftware - Text-/Dokumentenübersetzung und Konversationsmodus/Voice - über einen Zeitraum von 2 Jahren und der Option der Verlängerung um 2 x ein weiteres Jahr ab. Ziel der Ausschreibung ist die Beschaffung einer leistungsfähigen, skalierbaren und benutzerfreundlichen Softwarelösung, die bei der effizienten, qualitätsgesicherten und datenschutzkonformen Übersetzung wissenschaftlicher, administrativer und technischer Inhalte unterstützt. Die Lösung muss sowohl für automatisierte Übersetzungen als auch für die Einbindung menschlicher Übersetzungsleistungen geeignet sein und insbesondere den Anforderungen an Mehrsprachigkeit in der Kunden-Kommunikation gerecht werden. Darüber hinaus umfasst der Leistungsgegenstand die Bereitstellung eines zentralen Lizenz- und Benutzerverwaltungsdienstes sowie die Erbringung von Support- und Wartungsleistungen über die gesamte Laufzeit des Rahmenvertrags. Die anzubietende Übersetzungssoftware muss als cloudbasierte Lösung bereitgestellt werden. Eine lokale Installation auf Servern oder Endgeräten des jeweiligen Auftraggebers ist nicht vorgesehen und wird nicht akzeptiert. Für mobile Apple Endgeräte wird eine App bereitgestellt. Die Software muss über einen webbasierten Zugang (z. B. über einen gängigen Internetbrowser) nutzbar sein. Die Mindestanforderungen sind in der Leistungsbeschreibung benannt.

result.text: The subject of the procedure is the conclusion of framework agreements with several companies for the provision, introduction, operation, maintenance and further development of a network management system for low voltage (hereinafter NMS). The scope of services is described in full in the service description (Annex 03). General requirements. Overarching requirements for the NMS, in particular regarding architecture, data storage, interfaces, information security, scalability, as well as integration into the existing system and process landscape of the eligible company. Functional scope 1: Calculable low-voltage network model (digital twin) including integration into ERP, GIS and EDM systems as well as mapping of actual and target switching states. Functional scope 2: Integration of measurement data from local network stations and TAF values, network calculation, determination of network status as well as controllability checks. Functional scope 3: Network-oriented control in accordance with § 14a EnWG and § 9 EEG including verification and documentation. Extended functional scope: Network calculation for network planning, automated network connection testing as well as redispatch 2.0 and prospectively redispatch 3.0. The Thüga Aktiengesellschaft is procuring as a central purchasing body in accordance with § 4a SektVO in the name and on behalf of the participating affiliated companies (currently around 100 companies of the Thüga Group). On the basis of the contract terms negotiated in the procedure, the individual participating companies will conclude individual framework agreements based on the EVB-IT contracts.

parts.source: Gegenstand des Verfahrens ist der Abschluss von Rahmenvereinbarungen mit mehreren Unternehmen über die Bereitstellung, Einführung, den Betrieb, die Wartung und die Weiterentwicklung eines Netzmanagementsystems für die Niederspannung (nachfolgend NMS). Der Leistungsumfang ist in der Leistungsbeschreibung (Anlage 03) abschließend beschrieben. Allgemeine Anforderungen. Übergreifende Anforderungen an das NMS, insbesondere an Architektur, Datenhaltung, Schnittstellen, Informationssicherheit, Skalierbarkeit sowie an die Integration in die bestehende System- und Prozesslandschaft des bezugsberechtigten Unternehmens. Funktionsumfang 1: Rechenfähiges Niederspannungs-Netzmodell (digitaler Zwilling) einschließlich Integration in ERP-, GIS- und EDM-Systeme sowie Abbildung der Ist- und Soll-Schaltzustände. Funktionsumfang 2: Einbindung von Messdaten aus Ortsnetzstationen und TAF-Werten, Netzberechnung, Ermittlung des Netzzustands sowie Steuerbarkeitschecks. Funktionsumfang 3: Netzorientierte Steuerung gemäß § 14a EnWG und § 9 EEG einschließlich Nachweisführung und Dokumentation. Erweiterter Funktionsumfang: Netzberechnung für die Netzplanung, automatisierte Netzanschlussprüfung sowie Redispatch 2.0 und perspektivisch Redispatch 3.0. Die Thüga Aktiengesellschaft beschafft als zentrale Beschaffungsstelle gemäß § 4a SektVO im Namen und für Rechnung der teilnehmenden Beteiligungsunternehmen (derzeit rund 100 Unternehmen der Thüga-Gruppe). Auf Basis der im Verfahren verhandelten Vertragsbedingungen schließen die einzelnen Beteiligungsunternehmen individuelle Rahmenverträge auf Grundlage der EVB-IT Verträge.

result.text: The Authority intends to procure a modern Corporate Technology Platform (Ecosystem) to replace fragmented and ageing legacy corporate systems and provide an integrated digital platform supporting key enabling services across Police Scotland. The requirement is for an integrated Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) and Human Capital Management (HCM) Ecosystem, together with the associated hosting, integration, implementation, data migration, training, transition, support and professional services required to deliver and sustain the solution. The Contract is expected to be for a period of seven (7) years with options, exercisable solely at the Authority's discretion, to extend by up to three (3) further periods of twelve (12) months each, giving a maximum potential duration of ten (10) years. Lot 1: . The Authority intends to award a contract to a single service provider for the provision of a Corporate Technology Platform (EcoSystem). The requirement is for an integrated Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) and Human Capital Management (HCM) Ecosystem, together with the associated hosting, integration, implementation, data migration, training, transition, support, and professional services required to deliver and sustain the solution. The scope of the Ecosystem contract will cover the following elements: MVP / Minimum Commitment (This is the minimum the Authority will commit to purchase as part of this contract): - HR - Payroll - Duty Management - Common platform services Optional Requirements (May be procured as either: a) additional modules within the proposed Ecosystem that will replace the system/solution currently in place, or b) integrations between the Ecosystem and the existing system or service, enabling data exchange, reporting, workflow triggers, or other interoperability without necessarily replacing the existing system): - Estates - Fleet - Finance - Procurement Contract Duration & Value: The Contract is expected to be for an initial period of seven (7) years with options, exercisable solely at the Authority's discretion, to extend by up to three (3) further periods of twelve (12) months each, giving a maximum potential duration of ten (10) years (120 months). The estimated total value of the Contract is approximately 51,000,000 GBP over the maximum potential contract duration. This includes initial and ongoing software licensing, software support and maintenance, cloud hosting, implementation services, and system integration services. Procedure & Negotiation Parameters: This procurement is being conducted using the Competitive Procedure with Negotiation (CPN). The Authority intends to invite a minimum of 5 qualified candidates to participate in Stage 2 (Invitation to Tender), subject to a sufficient number of compliant Stage 1 SPD submissions being received. In order to identify the Most Economically Advantageous Tender (MEAT), the Authority reserves the right to either: 1. Evaluate all initial tenders and award the contract without entering into negotiations; or 2. Commence negotiations with Bidders who submit compliant initial tenders in order to improve tender content. Bidders should note that initial tenders should be fully compliant and capable of assessment on their own merits without relying on negotiation or clarification. The Authority also reserves the right to apply successive stages during negotiations to reduce the number of tenders to be negotiated. Note: The Authority's minimum requirements and final award criteria are non-negotiable. Candidates must refer to the Corporate Technology Platform (EcoSystem) Information and Instructions for Candidates document available on PCS-Tender for full procurement details and instructions.. Candidates must refer to the Corporate Technology Platform (EcoSystem) Information & Instructions for Candidates on PCS-Tender. Non-compliance may result in submission rejection. Economic operators may be excluded from this competition under Regulation 58 of the Public Contracts (Scotland) Regulations 2015.

result.text: The NSF State and Regional AI Infrastructure Hubs program aims to expand access to the compute required for AI-enabled scientific discovery and to transform the research, education, and training opportunities offered by institutions of higher education. AI Infrastructure Hubs will connect researchers to new compute infrastructure that leverages contributions from state governments, research institutions, industry, and philanthropy, accelerating AI-enabled discovery across science and engineering and developing a skilled technical workforce for AI use in the scientific enterprise. The program responds to a core tenet of Science: A New Golden Age to renew America’s research and development (R&D) for changes in today’s scientific enterprise, including the role of AI in laying the foundation for a new era of scientific discovery and the growing role of industry and philanthropy in funding R&D. In response, the Administration’s FY28 R&D Priorities Memorandum called for investing in AI for science as a national mission and expanding the scale of, and flexible access to, advanced compute and data infrastructure that researchers now require for frontier scientific discovery. Each AI Infrastructure Hub will be organized as a flexible state or regional consortium of state and local governments, research institutions, philanthropies, and the private sector. Consortia will be responsible for all funding for new or expanded computing, data, and AI resources, whether on-premises or cloud-based. NSF will fund each Hub’s consortium coordination, AI infrastructure workforce development, and faculty training and coursework development in leveraging AI for science.

result.text: The objective of the Energy Export Initiative (EIE) of the Federal Ministry for Economic Affairs and Energy (BMWE) is to support German companies offering climate-friendly energy solutions with market entry abroad and to position German products and services internationally. A fixed component of the funding offer is the energy business trip programme. The aim of the (digital) energy business trips is to prepare market entry for German SMEs through the building of sound market knowledge and targeted matchmaking with potential business partners in the respective target markets, and to further expand the existing foreign activities of German SMEs. The digital energy business trip (dGR) funding module consists of a travel profile, a target market analysis (ZMA), an online briefing and an online specialist conference. The central element of the measure is individual meetings of the German companies for targeted business initiation with potential business partners and interlocutors of the target country. Lot LOT-0000: Lot 1 - Fiji, Cook Islands, Samoa, Tonga Hybrid mini-grids (incl. small hydro and grid modernisation). Target country : Fiji, Cook Islands, Samoa, Tonga Application field : Energy generation Possible date : Q4 2027 Objective : The digitally conducted energy business trip is intended to make market development easier for German SMEs from the fields of hybrid mini-grids and grid modernisation. The focus of the virtually conducted business trip is targeted matchmaking and individual B2B meetings with potential clients, partners and relevant stakeholders from the target region. In particular, the target market of Fiji is to be brought into focus. The markets of Cook Islands, Samoa, Tonga can be incorporated into the dGR as additional sales markets. The measure is aimed at German SMEs with solutions in the areas of battery storage and energy management, SCADA/control technology and digitalisation, inverters/power electronics and protection technology, system design/hybrid optimisation, and O&M concepts/training. Note : A longer regional ZMA (special version) is to be written, covering Fiji, Cook Islands, Samoa and Tonga. The specifications described in the guidelines are to be applied during project implementation.

parts.source: Das Ziel der Exportinitiative Energie (EIE) des Bundesministeriums für Wirtschaft und Energie (BMWE) ist es, deutsche Unternehmen (UN), die klimafreundliche Energielösungen anbieten, beim Markteintritt im Ausland zu unterstützen und deutsche Produkte und Dienstleistungen international zu positionieren. Ein fester Bestandteil des Förderangebots ist das Energie-Geschäftsreiseprogramm. Ziel der (digitalen) Energie-Geschäftsreisen ist es, den Markteinstieg für deutsche KMU durch den Aufbau von fundierten Marktkenntnissen sowie die gezielte Kontaktvermittlung zu potenziellen Geschäftspartnern in den jeweiligen Zielmärkten vorzubereiten und bestehende Auslandsaktivitäten deutscher KMU weiter auszubauen. Das Fördermodul digitale Energie-Geschäftsreise (dGR) besteht aus einem Reisesteckbrief, einer Zielmarktanalyse (ZMA), einem Online-Briefing sowie einer online durchgeführten Fachkonferenz. Das zentrale Element der Maßnahme sind individuelle Gespräche der deutschen UN für eine gezielte Geschäftsanbahnung mit potenziellen Geschäftspartnerinnen und Gesprächspartnern des Ziellandes. Lot LOT-0000: Los 1 - Fidschi, Cookinseln, Samoa, Tonga Hybrid-Mini-Grids (inkl. Kleinwasser und Grid-Modernisierung). Zielland : Fidschi, Cookinseln, Samoa, Tonga Anwendungsfeld : Energieerzeugung Möglicher Termin : Q4 2027 Zielsetzung : Die digital durchgeführte Energie-Geschäftsreise soll deutschen KMU aus den Bereichen Hybrid-Mini-Grids sowie Grid-Modernisierung die Markterschließung erleichtern. Im Mittelpunkt der virtuell durchgeführten Geschäftsreise stehen die gezielte Kontaktvermittlung und individuelle B2B-Gespräche mit potenziellen Kunden, Partnern und relevanten Stakeholdern aus der Zielregion. Im Besonderen soll der Zielmarkt Fidschi in den Fokus gerückt werden. Die Märkte Cookinseln, Samoa, Tonga können als zusätzliche Absatzmärkte in die dGR mit einfließen. Die Maßnahme richtet sich an deutsche KMU mit Lösungen in den Bereichen Batteriespeicher und Energiemanagement, SCADA/Leittechnik und Digitalisierung, Wechselrichter/Power-Electronics und Schutztechnik, Systemdesign/Hybrid-Optimierung sowie O&M-Konzepte/Schulung. Hinweis : Es soll eine längere regionale ZMA verfasst werden (Sonderversion), die Fidschi, Cookinseln, Samoa und Tonga umfasst. Die im Leitfaden beschriebenen Vorgaben sind bei der Projektumsetzung anzuwenden.

The procurement consists of the following main components: • Recruitment system • Substitution recruitment system • Implementation project, including main user training & test plan • Support and maintenance services • Opportunity to use the training database • Integration opportunities The objective is to provide the city with a reliable and user-friendly recruitment system. The system must also provide a user-friendly and as automated as possible platform for the management and coordination of substitutes. The objective is a clear and easy-to-use tool for use by the entire organisation. The system must be up-to-date and renewable. The system must include the software supplier's support services and introductions to any new features for users. In addition, the system must have good and efficient reporting and analytics features. The contract period is intended to start in February 2028. parts.source: Salon kaupunki (jäljempänä hankintayksikkö/tilaaja) pyytää tarjouksia rekrytointijärjestelmän hankinnasta tämän tarjouspyynnön ja sen liitteiden mukaisesti. Hankinnan kohteena on selainkäyttöinen rekrytointijärjestelmä valmisratkaisuna ja ohjelmistopalveluna (SaaS) Salon kaupungille rekrytointiprosessin sekä sijaisvälityksen hallintaan ja koordinointiin. Valmisratkaisulla haetaan nopeasti käyttöönotettavaa ja jatkuvasti toimittajan puolesta kehittyvää ohjelmistopalvelua. Hankinta koostuu seuraavista pääkokonaisuuksista: • Rekrytointijärjestelmä • Sijaisrekrytointijärjestelmä • Käyttöönottoprojekti, ml. pääkäyttäjien koulutukset & testaussuunnitelma • Tuki- ja ylläpitopalvelut • Koulutuskannan käyttömahdollisuus • Integraatiomahdollisuudet Tavoitteena on saada kaupungille luotettava ja käyttäjäystävällinen rekrytointijärjestelmä. Järjestelmän tulee tarjota myös sijaisten hallintaan ja koordinointiin käyttäjäystävällinen ja mahdollisimman automatisoitu alusta. Tavoitteena on selkeä ja helppokäyttöinen työkalu koko organisaation käyttöön. Järjestelmän tulee olla ajantasainen ja uudistuva. Järjestelmään tulee sisältyä ohjelmantoimittajan tukipalvelut ja mahdollisten uusien ominaisuuksien perehdytykset käyttäjille. Lisäksi järjestelmässä tulee olla hyvät ja tehokkaat raportointi- ja analytiikkaominaisuudet. Sopimuskauden on tarkoitus alkaa helmikuusta 2028. Sopimus tehdään toistaiseksi voimassa olevana sopimuksena, jossa on kuuden kuukauden irtisanomisaika molemmin puolin. Hankinnan kohteen eli rekrytointijärjestelmän vaatimukset on kuvattu tarjouspyynnössä ja sen liitteissä.

result.text: This Expression of Interest (EOI) outlines Macmillan Cancer Support's request for agencies to collaborate on designing, testing and delivering a new cancer information and support offer(s). The project is part of Macmillan's 2025 strategy commitment to reach more people living with cancer and to improve the support we offer for people who experience inequitable access to cancer care and treatment. The design challenge for this project is "How Might We develop a scalable solution that helps people understand their rights, choices and influence in decisions about their care, irrespective of their confidence, self-advocacy skills or system knowledge?" This is an end-to-end Innovation project that we require to be delivered in its entirety by the supplier(s), with input and guidance from Macmillan. This includes insight development and analysis, solution development, prototyping and testing of a Minimum Viable Product (MVP). The solution should be scalable and likely be digital or include digital elements. The supplier must have extensive experience designing with communities and individuals that are marginalised. The supplier should be an expert in approaches including designing from the margins and embed meaningful and equitable participatory approaches into every phase of the project. Given the nature of the requirements, we are open to working with 2 suppliers who can deliver different elements or phases of the project. The agency must be able to recruit participants who reflect Macmillan's priority cancer support audiences to take part in user research, co-design and testing of solutions; people who have been diagnosed with cancer in the past 5 years. This includes people who are currently undergoing anti-cancer treatment (more details in attachment). Timelines • Expression of interest response deadline by 10/03/2026. • Selected agencies will receive the full RFP pack in March / April. • The anticipated project duration is 4-6 months from kick-off. The final timeline will be agreed with Macmillan during the tender process. Supplier Response Instructions Via email, interested suppliers should provide: (1) A brief outline of their research, design and innovation approach, including how they will use design from the margin approaches (see examples here); (2) evidence of prior engagement and participatory work with marginalised communities (3) evidence of developing and delivering scalable products and/or services (especially digital) (4) identification of gaps in their ability to meet the full requirements and if there are gaps (5) willingness to partner with another agency. Responses at this stage do not need to be extensive. Responses should be sent to procurement@macmillan.org.uk with the subject line EOI - Innovation Advocacy/Empowerment.

result.text: The subject of the procurement is high-level procurement expertise and legal expertise for various public procurements and public procurement tender assignments of different sizes, as well as consulting, development, training and legal representation related to the entire lifecycle of public procurements to support and provide additional resources for the contracting authority's own procurement organisation. In addition to good delivery reliability, the contract suppliers must have the ability, competence and resources to handle demanding and varied assignments within each area of expertise for the expert services. A framework arrangement will be formed from the procurement. The assignments covered by the procurement vary according to the current need. The procurement is divided into six areas as follows: • Area 1: Expert services for public procurements (goods and services) • Area 2: Expert services for public procurements (ICT procurements) • Area 3: Expert services for public procurements (construction) • Area 4: Expert services for public procurements (social and health services and other special service procurements) • Area 5: Expert services for public procurements (innovative procurements and procurement development) • Area 6: Legal services related to public procurements. For each area, 4 suppliers will be selected, unless there are fewer suppliers that meet the requirements. A separate priority order will be formed for each area. The maximum value of the procurement is 10,5 million euros (VAT 0 %). The estimated value includes the entire contract period, i.e. four (4) years, and it is estimated to be divided by area as follows: area 1: 2,8 million €, area 2: 2,65 million €, area 3: 1,65 million €, area 4: 700 000 €, area 5: 1 million €, area 6: 1,7 million €. The services of the area include goods and service procurements. There are separate areas for ICT procurements, construction-related procurements, social and health services and other special services, as well as innovative procurements. Assignments may include carrying out the entire procurement process or individual tasks related to the procurement process, participating in or leading working groups consisting of the contracting authority's experts and stakeholder representatives, and other expert tasks related to procurements. The subject of the procurement is defined in more detail in this invitation to tender and its appendices.; The services of the area include ICT procurements, which are typically various information system procurements of different scopes or other ICT equipment, goods, service or combination procurements. The area emphasises knowledge of the special features of ICT procurements and markets, their contract and pricing models, and other commercial aspects related to ICT procurements. Assignments may include carrying out the entire procurement process or individual tasks related to the procurement process, participating in or leading working groups consisting of the contracting authority's experts and stakeholder representatives, and other expert tasks related to procurements. The subject of the procurement is defined in more detail in this invitation to tender and its appendices.; The services of the area include construction-related procurements. The area emphasises special expertise related to construction projects, contract forms, YSE terms and conditions, and construction contract law. Assignments may include carrying out the entire procurement process or individual tasks related to the procurement process, participating in or leading working groups consisting of the contracting authority's experts and stakeholder representatives, and other expert tasks related to procurements. The subject of the procurement is defined in more detail in this invitation to tender and its appendices.; The services of the area include procurements according to social and health services and other special services, which belong to the procurements according to Appendix E of the Procurement Act. Assignments may include carrying out the entire procurement process or individual tasks related to the procurement process, participating in or leading working groups consisting of the contracting authority's experts and stakeholder representatives, and other expert tasks related to procurements. The subject of the procurement is defined in more detail in this invitation to tender and its appendices.; The services of the area include, in particular, innovative public procurements. By innovative procurements, we mean the procurement of a new or significantly improved product or service that aims to improve productivity, quality, sustainability and effectiveness. The area emphasises: - development of result- and effectiveness-based procurements and development/modelling of the earnings logic for related procurements, - definition of effectiveness targets and monitored impacts, as well as preparation of a measurement system. Assignments may include carrying out the entire procurement process or individual tasks related to the procurement process, participating in or leading working groups consisting of the contracting authority's experts and stakeholder representatives, and other expert tasks related to procurements. The subject of the procurement is defined in more detail in this invitation to tender and its appendices.; The services of the area do not include carrying out the entire procurement process, but the service focuses on legal advice related to public procurements and representation in courts regarding the Procurement Act (the Procurement Act refers to procurements falling within the scope of the Procurement Act and the Act on Public Procurement and Concession Contracts in the Utilities Sector; acts 1397/2016, 1398/2016). The subject of the procurement is defined in more detail in this invitation to tender and its appendices.

parts.source: Hankinnan kohteena on korkeatasoinen hankinta-asiantuntemus ja juridinen asiantuntemus erilaisiin ja eri kokoluokan julkisiin hankintoihin ja julkisten hankintojen kilpailutustoimeksiantoihin, sekä julkisten hankintojen koko elinkaareen liittyvään konsultointiin, kehittämiseen, kouluttamiseen sekä oikeudelliseen edustamiseen tilaajan oman hankintaorganisaation tueksi ja lisäresurssiksi. Sopimustoimittajilla tulee olla hyvän toimitusvarmuuden lisäksi kykyä, osaamista ja resursseja hoitaa vaativia ja vaihtelevia toimeksiantoja kunkin asiantuntijapalvelun osa-alueen sisällä. Hankinnasta muodostetaan puitejärjestely. Hankinnan piiriin kuuluvat toimeksiannot vaihtelevat kulloisenkin tarpeen mukaan. Hankinta on jaettu kuuteen osa-alueeseen seuraavasti: • Osa-alue 1: Julkisten hankintojen asiantuntijapalvelut (tavarat ja palvelut) • Osa-alue 2: Julkisten hankintojen asiantuntijapalvelut (ICT-hankinnat) • Osa-alue 3: Julkisten hankintojen asiantuntijapalvelut (rakentaminen) • Osa-alue 4: Julkisten hankintojen asiantuntijapalvelut (sote-palvelut ja muut erityiset palveluhankinnat) • Osa-alue 5: Julkisten hankintojen asiantuntijapalvelut (innovatiiviset hankinnat ja hankintojen kehittäminen) • Osa-alue 6: Julkisiin hankintoihin liittyvät juridiset palvelut Jokaiselle osa-alueelle valitaan 4 toimittajaa, ellei vaatimukset täyttäviä toimittajia ole vähemmän. Jokaiselle osa-alueelle muodostetaan oma etusijajärjestyksensä. Hankinnan enimmäisarvo on 10,5 milj. euroa (alv 0 %). Arvioitu arvo sisältää koko sopimuskauden eli neljä (4) vuotta ja sen arvioidaan jakautuvan osa-alueittain seuraavasti: osa-alue 1: 2,8 milj. €, osa-alue 2: 2,65 milj. €, osa-alue 3: 1,65 milj. €, osa-alue 4: 700 000 €, osa-alue 5: 1 milj. €, osa-alue 6: 1,7 milj. €. Osa-alueen palvelut sisältävät tavara- ja palveluhankintoja. ICT-hankintoihin, rakentamiseen liittyviin hankintoihin ja sosiaali- ja terveyspalvelujen sekä muiden erityisten palvelujen mukaisiin hankintoihin sekä innovatiivisiin hankintoihin on omat osa-alueensa. Toimeksiannot voivat sisältää koko hankintaprosessin läpiviemisen tai hankintaprosessiin liittyviä yksittäisiä tehtäviä, erilaisissa hankintayksikön asiantuntijoiden ja sidosryhmien edustajista koostuviin työryhmiin osallistumista tai työryhmien vetämistä sekä muita hankintoihin liittyviä asiantuntijatehtäviä. Hankinnan kohde on määritelty tarkemmin tässä tarjouspyynnössä ja sen liitteissä.; Osa-alueen palvelut sisältävät ICT-hankintoja, jotka ovat tyypillisesti erilaisia ja eri laajuisia tietojärjestelmähankintoja tai muita ICT-laite-, - tavara-, - palvelu- tai näiden yhdistelmien hankintoja. Osa-alueessa korostuu ICT-hankintojen ja -markkinoiden erityispiirteiden ja niiden sopimus- ja hinnoittelumallien sekä muiden ICT - hankintoihin liittyvien kaupallisten näkökohtien tuntemus. Toimeksiannot voivat sisältää koko hankintaprosessin läpiviemisen tai hankintaprosessiin liittyviä yksittäisiä tehtäviä, erilaisissa hankintayksikön asiantuntijoiden ja sidosryhmien edustajista koostuviin työryhmiin osallistumista tai työryhmien vetämistä sekä muita hankintoihin liittyviä asiantuntijatehtäviä. Hankinnan kohde on määritelty tarkemmin tässä tarjouspyynnössä ja sen liitteissä.; Osa-alueen palvelut sisältävät rakentamiseen liittyviä hankintoja. Osa-alueessa korostuvat rakennushankkeisiin, urakkamuotoihin, YSE-ehtoihin ja rakennuttamisen sopimusjuridiikkaan liittyvä erityisosaaminen. Toimeksiannot voivat sisältää koko hankintaprosessin läpiviemisen tai hankintaprosessiin liittyviä yksittäisiä tehtäviä, erilaisissa hankintayksikön asiantuntijoiden ja sidosryhmien edustajista koostuviin työryhmiin osallistumista tai työryhmien vetämistä sekä muita hankintoihin liittyviä asiantuntijatehtäviä. Hankinnan kohde on määritelty tarkemmin tässä tarjouspyynnössä ja sen liitteissä.; Osa-alueen palvelut sisältävät sosiaali- ja terveyspalvelujen sekä muiden erityisten palvelujen mukaisia hankintoja, jotka kuuluvat hankintalain liitteen E-mukaisiin hankintoihin. Toimeksiannot voivat sisältää koko hankintaprosessin läpiviemisen tai hankintaprosessiin liittyviä yksittäisiä tehtäviä, erilaisissa hankintayksikön asiantuntijoiden ja sidosryhmien edustajista koostuviin työryhmiin osallistumista tai työryhmien vetämistä sekä muita hankintoihin liittyviä asiantuntijatehtäviä. Hankinnan kohde on määritelty tarkemmin tässä tarjouspyynnössä ja sen liitteissä.; Osa-alueen palvelut sisältävät erityisesti innovatiivisia julkisia hankintoja. Innovatiivisilla hankinnoilla tarkoitamme uuden tai merkittävästi parannellun tuotteen tai palvelun hankintaa, jolla tavoitellaan tuottavuuden, laadun, kestävyyden ja vaikuttavuuden paranemista. Osa-alueessa korostuu: - tulos- ja vaikuttavuusperusteisten hankintojen kehittäminen sekä näihin liittyvien hankintojen ansaintalogiikan kehittäminen/mallintaminen, - vaikuttavuustavoitteiden ja seurattavien vaikutusten määrittely sekä mittariston laatiminen. Toimeksiannot voivat sisältää koko hankintaprosessin läpiviemisen tai hankintaprosessiin liittyviä yksittäisiä tehtäviä, erilaisissa hankintayksikön asiantuntijoiden ja sidosryhmien edustajista koostuviin työryhmiin osallistumista tai työryhmien vetämistä sekä muita hankintoihin liittyviä asiantuntijatehtäviä. Hankinnan kohde on määritelty tarkemmin tässä tarjouspyynnössä ja sen liitteissä.; Osa-alueen palvelut eivät sisällä koko hankintaprosessin läpivientiä, vaan palvelu keskittyy julkisiin hankintoihin liittyvään oikeudelliseen neuvontaan sekä edustamiseen tuomioistuimissa hankintalakiin liittyen (hankintalailla tarkoitetaan hankintalain ja erityisalojen hankintalain soveltamisalaan kuuluvia hankintoja; lait 1397/2016, 1398/2016). Hankinnan kohde on määritelty tarkemmin tässä tarjouspyynnössä ja sen liitteissä.

result.text: NOTE! This is not a call for tenders, procurement notice or prior information notice, but a notice on the initiation of a market dialogue as part of procurement planning. Espoon kaupunki has initiated the preparation for the procurement of a shared vehicle monitoring tool and is inviting suppliers to a market dialogue. The objective of the procurement of the shared vehicle management tool is to implement monitoring in accordance with the micro-mobility permit (18 section) referred to in the Act on Transport Services (3030/2025) within the area of the City of Espoo. The management tool is used to collect and monitor shared vehicle movement data and to set operating rules and restrictions for them. The tool aims to improve urban safety and facilitate urban planning based on shared vehicle usage and regulatory data. The subject of the procurement is a shared vehicle monitoring tool procured as a service as follows: - System as a software-as-a-service (SaaS) - Commissioning and customisation of the service for Espoo - Application maintenance services - Further development and expert services of the system according to Espoo's needs. The functionalities of the shared vehicle monitoring tool are aimed to cover the following: - Basic functions of the management tool, i.e. collecting and displaying usage data of approximately 6000 shared vehicles to the user. - Real-time and visual user interface for monitoring shared vehicles, i.e. displaying map-based information regarding shared vehicles and traffic operators based on the location data of the shared vehicles to the user. - Setting area- and shared-vehicle-operator-specific rules and restrictions for shared vehicles, as well as providing the user with notifications based on the rules and restrictions. - Analysis functions of the collected data as well as scenario analyses (proposals) on rules and measures to be set based on the collected data. - Reporting and statistical functionalities. - Management of user roles and access rights. The purpose of the market dialogue is to survey the market situation regarding the procurement of the shared vehicle monitoring tool. Espoon kaupunki wants to hear potential suppliers' thoughts on the implementation of the procurement procedure and the preparation of the call for tenders. SCHEDULE FOR THE MARKET DIALOGUE The market dialogue will tentatively be conducted in two phases: 1. Via Teams tentatively during week 51. The contracting authority reserves the right to invite 3-5 suppliers to the first phase of the dialogue based on the responses to the request for information. The objective of this first phase is to familiarise oneself with the products on the market, for example through supplier demos. 2. Tender documents will be sent to those who have registered for the market dialogue for comments approximately during weeks 51-2. The second phase of the market dialogue will be conducted electronically. Written material will be sent to all those who have registered for the market dialogue for review approximately during weeks 51-2. The dialogue of the second phase will cover the content of the preliminary call for tenders, the requirement specification and the contractual terms. The contracting authority reserves the right to additional dialogues as the market survey progresses. The contracting authority's objective is to launch the actual procurement procedure in the spring of 2026 and the implementation project by May 2026 at the latest, so that the new system can be taken into use in the summer of 2026. RESPONDING TO THE REQUEST FOR INFORMATION AND REGISTERING FOR THE MARKET DIALOGUE We kindly ask suppliers interested in participating in the market dialogue to register in writing by 10.12.2025 at 16.00 to the address hankinta@espoo.fi. Clearly title your registration message, e.g. "Market dialogue: Procurement of shared vehicle monitoring tool - registration [Company name]". Please provide the name of your contact person at the same time. The market dialogue and the information provided therein shall not bind any participating party, nor is it a prerequisite for participating in the subsequent actual tender contest. The official call for tenders will only be published after the market dialogues have ended. Responses will be handled confidentially.

parts.source: HUOM! Tämä ei ole tarjouspyyntö, hankintailmoitus tai ennakkoilmoitus vaan ilmoitus markkinavuoropuhelun käynnistämisestä osana hankinnan suunnittelua. Espoon kaupunki on käynnistänyt Yhteiskäyttöajoneuvojen seurantatyökalun hankinnan valmistelun ja kutsuu toimittajia markkinavuoropuheluun. Yhteiskäyttöajoneuvojen hallintatyökalun hankinnan tavoitteena on toteuttaa Liikenteen palveluista annetun lain (3030/2025) mukaisen mikroliikenneluvan (18 §) mukaista valvontaa Espoon kaupungin alueella. Hallintatyökalun avulla kerätään ja seurataan yhteiskäyttöajoneuvojen liikkumisdataa ja asetetaan niille käyttösääntöjä ja -rajoituksia. Työkalun avulla pyritään parantamaan kaupunkiturvallisuutta ja helpottamaan yhteiskäyttöajoneuvojen käyttö- ja sääntelydataan perustuvaa kaupunkisuunnittelua. Hankinnan kohteena on palveluna hankittava Yhteiskäyttöajoneuvojen seurantatyökalu seuraavan mukaisesti: - Järjestelmä ohjelmistopalveluna (SaaS) - Palvelun käyttöönotto ja sovitus Espoolle - Sovellusylläpitopalvelut - Järjestelmän jatkokehitys- ja asiantuntijapalvelut Espoon tarpeen mukaan. Yhteiskäyttöajoneuvojen seurantatyökalun toiminnallisuuksien tavoitellaan kattavan seuraavat: - Hallintatyökalun perustoiminnot eli noin 6000 yhteiskäyttöajoneuvon käyttödatan kerääminen ja näyttäminen käyttäjälle. - Reaaliaikainen ja visuaalinen käyttöliittymä yhteiskäyttöajoneuvojen seurantaan eli yhteiskäyttöajoneuvojen paikkatietoon perustuvan, karttapohjaisen yhteiskäyttöajoneuvojen ja liikenneoperaattoreita koskevan tiedon näyttäminen käyttäjälle. - Alue- ja yhteiskäyttöajoneuvo-operaattorikohtaisten sääntöjen ja rajoitusten asettaminen yhteiskäyttöajoneuvoille sekä sääntöihin ja rajoituksiin perustuvien notifikaatioiden antaminen käyttäjälle. - Kerätyn datan analyysitoiminnot sekä skenaarioanalyysit (ehdotukset) kerätyn datan perusteella asettavista säännöistä ja toimenpiteistä. - Raportointi- ja tilastointitoiminnallisuudet. - Käyttäjäroolien ja käyttöoikeuksien hallinta. Markkinavuoropuhelun tarkoituksena on kartoittaa Yhteiskäyttöajoneuvojen seurantatyökalun hankintaa koskevaa markkinatilannetta. Espoon kaupunki haluaa kuulla mahdollisten toimittajien ajatuksia kilpailutuksen toteutuksesta ja tarjouspyynnön valmistelusta. MARKKINAVUOROPUHELUN AIKATAULU Markkinavuoropuhelu käydään alustavasti kahdessa vaiheessa: 1. Teamsin välityksellä alustavasti viikolla 51. Hankintayksikkö varaa oikeuden kutsua tietopyyntövastausten perusteella 3-5 toimittajaa vuoropuhelun ensimmäiseen vaiheeseen. Tämän ensimmäisen vaiheen tavoitteena on tutustua markkinoilla oleviin tuotteisiin esimerkiksi toimittajien demojen avulla. 2. Markkinavuoropuheluun ilmoittautuneille lähetetään tarjousasiakirjoja kommentoitavaksi arviolta viikoilla 51-2. Markkinavuoropuhelun toinen vaihe käydään sähköisesti. Kirjallinen materiaali lähetetään kaikille markkinavuoropuheluun ilmoittautuneille tutustuttavaksi arviolta viikoilla 51-2. Toisen vaiheen vuoropuhelu käydään alustavan tarjouspyynnön sisällöstä, vaatimusmäärittelystä ja sopimusehdoista. Hankintayksikkö varaa oikeuden lisävuopuheluihin markkinakartoituksen edetessä. Hankintayksikön tavoitteena on käynnistää varsinainen kilpailutus keväällä 2026 ja käyttöönottoprojekti viimeistään toukokuussa 2026 siten, että uusi järjestelmä saadaan käyttöön kesällä 2026. TIETOPYYNTÖÖN VASTAAMINEN JA MARKKINAVUOROPUHELUUN ILMOITTAUTUMINEN Pyydämme markkinavuoropuheluun osallistumisesta kiinnostuneita toimittajia ilmoittautumaan kirjallisesti 10.12.2025 klo 16.00 mennessä osoitteeseen hankinta@espoo.fi. Otsikoikaa ilmoittautumisviestinne selkeästi esim. "Markkinavuoropuhelu: Yhteiskäyttöajoneuvojen seurantatyökalun hankinta - ilmoittautuminen [Yrityksen nimi]". Ilmoittakaa samalla yhteyshenkilönne nimi. Markkinavuoropuhelu ja siinä annetut tiedot eivät sido ketään siihen osallistuvaa tahoa, eikä myöskään ole edellytyksenä myöhemmin varsinaiseen tarjouskilpailuun osallistumiselle. Virallinen tarjouspyyntö julkaistaan vasta markkinavuoropuhelujen päätyttyä. Vastauksia käsitellään luottamuksellisesti.

result.text: The ESG data management system serves as a centrally controlled, specialised software-as-a-service platform (SaaS platform) for the integrative procurement, processing, quality assurance and provision of external ESG data for the KfW Group. The external ESG data supply route (hereinafter also referred to as "XEDALI") replaces the previous, decentralised and heterogeneous procurement and connection of external ESG data sources through a standardised ETL process (Extract - Transform - Load). The application will regularly query ESG data at the technical interfaces to various external data providers, transfer it into a uniform data model and provide it for use in subsequent processes. It thus provides buyers with a consistent data source for external ESG data. XEDALI thus makes an essential contribution to the technical support and fulfilment of new supervisory requirements (in particular the EBA Guidelines on ESG Risks (EBA/GL/2025/01), MaRisk as well as the VSME standard and the requirements from BCBS239)). For further details see "Leistungsbeschreibung".

parts.source: Das ESG-Datenmanagementsystem dient als zentral gesteuerte, spezialisierte Software-as-a-Service-Plattform (SaaS-Plattform) zur integrativen Beschaffung, Verarbeitung, Qualitätssicherung und Bereitstellung externer ESG-Daten für den KfW-Konzern. Die eXterne ESG-DAtenLIeferstrecke (im Folgenden auch „XEDALI“) ersetzt die bisherige, dezentrale und heterogene Beschaffung und Anbindung externer ESG-Datenquellen durch einen standardisierten ETL-Prozess (Extract – Transform – Load). Die Anwendung wird regelmäßig ESG-Daten an den technischen Schnittstellen zu diversen externen Datenanbietern abfragen, in ein einheitliches Datenmodell überführen und zur Verwendung für Folgeprozesse bereitstellen. Sie stellt damit Abnehmern eine konsistente Datenquelle für externe ESG-Daten bereit. XEDALI leistet somit einen wesentlichen Beitrag zur technischen Unterstützung und Erfüllung neuer aufsichtsrechtlicher Anforderungen (insbesondere der EBA-Leitlinie zu ESG-Risiken (EBA/GL/2025/01), MaRisk sowie des VSME-Standards und den Anforderungen aus BCBS239). Weitere Details s. "Leistungsbeschreibung".

result.text: Vanguard Learning Trust invites qualified suppliers to tender for the provision of a cloud-based human resources information system (HRIS) and a fully managed payroll service to support approximately 615 employees across 6 schools and a central Trust team. The solution must deliver secure, efficient HR and payroll processes, ensure statutory compliance with UK employment, pensions and HMRC regulations, and provide high-quality support to both Trust leaders and school-based staff. Objectives The Trust aims to procure a combined HRIS and payroll solution that: Provides a single source of truth for employee data across all schools and the Trust's central team. Reduces administrative workloads and manual processing. Ensures accurate, timely payroll with all third-party submissions completed by the provider, including HMRC, pension providers, and statutory bodies. Supports workforce planning, reporting, and strategic oversight at Trust level. Offers excellent employee and manager self-service. Ensures data security, GDPR compliance, and UK-based hosting. Scope of software and services The software will include: General HR system of record (SoR) Absence and attendance management functionality, which will link to occupational sickness scheme requirements Time and expenses (the functionality for employees to log additional hours and expenses, which would only be approved at managerial level) Organisation structure Employee Self Service Manager Self Service People Analytics A fully managed payroll and pension service The Trust would not be procuring the functionality below in the first instance but may consider doing at a later date. These are, therefore, 'desirable' rather than 'essential': Integrated applicant tracking and onboarding functionality Performance management and appraisal functionality Case management functionality The service provision will include: Fully managed payroll services Fully managed pensions services Solution hosting Requirements Our requirements (functional and non-functional) have been listed and are provided in an Excel sheet along with this document. Supplier Responses Suppliers are requested to complete the supplier response columns within the requirements document and to provide a commercial proposal using the template in the attached sheet. Additionally, please provide a high level project plan to demonstrate the timescales that your solution could be deployed in and a copy of your customer support service-level agreement (SLA). Finally, short-listed providers will be required to complete the Trust's data protection impact assessment (DPIA). Lot 1: .

result.text: The gkv informatik eGbR is a service provider for AOKs Nordost, AOK NordWest and AOK NordWest, Rheinland/Hamburg. It provides all necessary operational IT services for its shareholders, who have a total of approximately 20.000 employees. The subject of the tender is the service packages for Workplace, Service Desk and Service Management. The contract duration is a maximum of 120 months. 12 months are planned for the transition phase at the beginning of the contract period, followed by an operational period of at least 48 months. The client may extend the operational period twice by 24 months (a total of 48 months). After the operational period has expired, a so-called transition-out phase follows, which can last up to 12 months. The service consists of the service packages Workplace, Service Desk and Service Management. The central task of the Workplace service package is the operation of all end devices (clients) such as notebooks, including the required software, and the complete lifecycle of software management from certification and packaging to software distribution. Essentially, the following services are to be provided: - End device management: The contractor is responsible, in accordance with the client's specifications, for the design, engineering, continuous maintenance and further development, and the configuration of the hardware and software of a cross-platform client environment up to the top edge of the operating system. - Application and desktop environments: Provision of the centrally operated VDI infrastructure for the end devices at the user's workplace. - Software management: The software management service essentially consists of the components test, software packaging and software distribution. - Shopping cart services: As part of the shopping cart services, the contractor provides and maintains a comprehensive shopping cart in accordance with the client's specifications. The shopping cart includes hardware (IT workplace hardware, e.g. desktops, notebooks, monitors, etc.), software and services, which for hardware include the management of corresponding maintenance contracts (in particular warranty processing) and disposal. - Field services: Field services include the provision of services by the contractor that involve the installation, restoration or dismantling of systems, including patching network connections at the workplace. - Mobile device management: The subject of mobile device management (MDM) by the contractor is the administration of the mobile end devices such as tablets or smartphones in use by the client and the beneficiaries. - Print: As part of the print services, the contractor provides and operates a complete print environment for workplace printing for the client and the beneficiaries. - Collaboration services: The collaboration services package describes the provision and operation of a hybrid (on-premises and cloud) mail solution, including archiving, by the contractor. - M365: Parts of the organisation use M365 services. The contractor supports and advises the client on the operation and further development of the Microsoft M365 services within the framework of existing contractual relationships with Microsoft. - Disaster recovery: The conception and testing of so-called 'disaster recovery' precautions, planning and measures, which essentially have to ensure the defined maintenance of operations and restoration of IT services in the event of an emergency (crisis, disaster) as well as crisis management, must be ensured by the contractor on the basis of legal requirements and the client's requirements. The subject of the Service Desk service package is the provision of a service desk aligned with ITIL standards, which acts as a central point of contact (SPOC) for end users, internal organisational units and customers. Within the framework of the functional requirements, the Service Desk takes over the acceptance and processing of faults (incidents) and service requests (requests) during the entire term of the contract. The Service Management service package essentially includes the implementation of IT service management processes as well as the use of the client's ITSM tool or, alternatively, the establishment of an interface from the contractor's ITSM tool, as well as the transfer of process objects in real time. Service Management is to be regarded as a classic cross-sectional topic.

parts.source: Die gkv informatik eGbR ist ein Dienstleister der AOKs Nordost, AOK NordWest und AOK NordWest, Rheinland/Hamburg. Sie erbringt alle erforderlichen Leistungen des operativen IT-Betriebes für ihre Gesellschafter mit insgesamt ca. 20.000 Mitarbeitern. Gegenstand der Ausschreibung sind die Leistungspakete Arbeitsplatz, Service Desk und Service Management. Die Vertragslaufzeit beträgt maximal 120 Monate. Für die Transitionsphase zu Beginn der Vertragslaufzeit sind 12 Monate eingeplant, gefolgt von einem Betriebszeitraum von mindestens 48 Monaten. Der Auftraggeber kann den Betriebszeitraum zwei Mal um 24 Monate verlängern (insgesamt 48 Monate). Nach Ablauf des Betriebszeitraumes schließt sich eine sog. Transition-Out Phase an, die bis zu 12 Monate dauern kann. Die Leistung setzt sich zusammen aus den Leistungspaketen Arbeitsplatz, Service Desk und Service Management. Zentrale Aufgabe des Leistungspaketes Arbeitsplatz ist der Betrieb sämtlicher Endgeräte (Clients) wie zum Beispiel Notebooks inkl. der benötigten Software, der vollständige Lifecycle des Softwaremanagements von der Zertifizierung über die Paketierung bis hin zur Softwareverteilung. Es sind im Wesentlichen folgende Leistungen zu erbringen: - Endgerätemanagement: Der Auftragnehmer ist entsprechend der Vorgaben des Auftraggebers verantwortlich für das Design, das Engineering sowie die kontinuierliche Wartung und Weiterentwicklung und der Ausgestaltung der Hard- und Software einer plattformübergreifenden Clientumgebung bis Oberkante Betriebssystem. - Anwendungs- und Desktopumgebungen: Bereitstellung der zentral zu betreibenden VDI-Infrastruktur für die Endgeräte am Arbeitsplatz der Anwender - Softwaremanagement: Die Leistung Softwaremanagement setzt sich im Wesentlichen aus den Bestandteilen Test, Softwarepaketierung und Softwareverteilung zusammen. - Warenkorb Services: Im Rahmen der Warenkorb Services stellt der Auftragnehmer einen umfassenden Warenkorb gemäß Spezifikationen des Auftraggebers bereit und pflegt diesen. Der Warenkorb beinhaltet Hardware (IT-Arbeitsplatzhardware, z.B. Desktops, Notebooks, Monitore usw.), Software und Serviceleistungen, die bei der Hardware das Management entsprechender Wartungsverträge (insbesondere Garantieabwicklungen) und die Entsorgung umfassen. - Field Services: Die Field Services umfassen die Erbringung von Leistungen des Auftragnehmers, die eine Installation, Wiederherstellung oder den Abbau von Systemen inkl. Patchen der Netzwerkanschlüsse am Arbeitsplatz beinhalten. - Mobile Device Management: Gegenstand des Mobile Device Management (MDM) durch den Auftragnehmer ist die Verwal-tung der bei der Auftraggeberin und den Begünstigten im Einsatz befindlichen mobilen Endgeräte wie Tablets oder Smartphones. - Print: Im Rahmen der Print-Services stellt der Auftragnehmer der Aufraggeberin und den Begünstig-ten eine vollständige Printumgebung für den Arbeitsplatzdruck bereit und betreibt diese. - Collaboration Services: Das Leistungspaket Collaboration Services beschreibt die Bereitstellung und den Betrieb einer hybriden (on Premises und Cloud) Mail-Lösung inklusive Archivierung durch den Auftragnehmer. - M365: Teile der Organisation nutzen M365-Services. Der Auftragnehmer unterstützt und berät die Auftraggeberin beim Betrieb und der Weiterentwicklung der Microsoft M365 Services im Rahmen der bestehenden Vertragsbeziehungen mit Microsoft. - Disaster Recovery: Die Konzeption und Prüfung der so genannten "Disaster Recovery"-Vorsorge, -Planung und -Maßnahmen, die im Wesentlichen die definierte Aufrechterhaltung des Betriebs und Wieder-herstellung der IT Services im Falle eines Notfalls (Krise, Desaster) sowie Krisenmanagement zu gewährleisten haben, ist auf Basis der gesetzlichen Anforderungen und der Anforderungen der Auftraggeberin durch den Auftragnehmer sicherzustellen. Gegenstand des Leistungspaketes Service Desk ist die Bereitstellung eines nach ITIL Standards ausgerichteten Service Desks, der als zentrale Anlaufstelle (Single Point of Contact, SPOC) für Endanwender, interne Organisationseinheiten und Kunden fungiert. Im Rahmen der funktionalen Anforderungen übernimmt der Service Desk die Annahme und Bearbeitung von Störungen (Incidents) und Serviceanfragen (Requests) während der gesam-ten Laufzeit des Vertrages. Das Leistungspaket Service Management beinhaltet im Wesentlichen die Implementierung der IT-Service Management-Prozesse sowie die Nutzung des ITSM-Tools der Auftraggeberin oder alternativ den Aufbau einer Schnittstelle vom ITSM-Tool des Auftragnehmers, sowie die Übertragung der Prozessobjekte in Echtzeit. Das Service Management ist als klassisches Querschnittsthema zu betrachten.

result.text: Aarhus Vand is a utility group that manages water and wastewater activities. In this context, Aarhus Vand owns, operates, and maintains many kilometres of water and wastewater pipes distributed across the supply area. To ensure efficient operation of the pipes, Aarhus Vand requires accurate, updated, and accessible registration of the pipe network. For this purpose, Aarhus Vand needs a pipe registration system. Aarhus Vand wishes for a collective agreement comprising both the licences for the pipe registration system itself and consultancy services for ongoing development and maintenance of the system. Aarhus Vand hereby invites to a market dialogue regarding the above. The purpose of the market dialogue includes determining which systems are on the market that can fulfil Aarhus Vand's factual and objective needs. Aarhus Vand has identified the following requirements as being important in relation to a future pipe registration system. It is important to Aarhus Vand that these requirements can already be fulfilled now. The list is not considered exhaustive: 1. Full support for DANVA's latest models, currently: Dandas 3.1.2, TV inspection and manhole report 3.1.2, Danvand 2.1.2, cables, third-party pipes, and areas 1.1, burst registration 1.1.1. For all models, this applies to all concepts, attributes, codes, relations, and interfaces as well as DANVA's guidelines and data manuals. The system is configurable so that it can be easily and quickly adapted to changes in both the models and the user interface 2. All registrations are saved / data resides in one and the same database 3. The system must support data exchange in XML format. There must be an option for direct updating via e.g. SQL. There must be direct access to data, as well as the possibility of making direct integrations with other systems. 4. Quality assurance. XSD validation, predefined validations, etc., which support pipe registration and work with data, and thus ensure and maintain good data quality. 5. Possibility to work in "jobs" in connection with the digitalisation of an area / project / subject, which can subsequently be upgraded to be the master. That is, so that one does not work in the master until changes have been upgraded to the master. 6. The language in the system must be Danish. To a minor extent, it can be in English. 7. User interface. An intuitive and user-friendly user interface. Workflows must be supported by configurable templates/flows. Must contain a tool for replacing, splitting, and merging objects, e.g. pipes. Must have various construction tools. Must have 3D support. 8. User management via AD integration. Users must be able to have different roles/rights. 9. The solution must have stable and high performance 10. There must be an auto-save feature, or recovery of unsaved work or similar. All market operators who believe they can meet the above requirements are encouraged to register for the market dialogue. FRAMEWORK AND PARTICIPATION OF THE DIALOGUE As a general rule, the market dialogue will take place physically at Aarhus Vand, Hasselager Allé 29, 8260 Viby J. The dialogue is held individually per market operator. Interest in the market dialogue must be reported to Christoffer Larsen at christoffer.larsen@aarhusvand.dk or indkob@aarhusvand.dk no later than 20.10.2025. The dialogue meetings are held in the period from 21.10.2025 to 31.10.2025.

parts.source: Aarhus Vand er en koncern der håndterer vand- og spildevandaktiviteter. I den forbindelse ejer, driver og vedligeholder Aarhus Vand mange kilometer vand- og spildevandledninger fordelt over forsyningsområdet. For at sikre effektiv drift af ledningerne, kræver det at Aarhus Vand har nøjagtig, opdateret og tilgængelig registrering af ledningsnettet. Til dette har Aarhus Vand behov for et ledningsregistreringssystem. Aarhus Vand ønsker en samlet aftale omfattende både selve licenserne til ledningsregistrereringssystemet, samt konsulentydelser til løbende udvikling, vedligeholdelse af systemet. Aarhus Vand inviterer hermed til markedsdialog vedr. ovenstående. Formålet med markedsdialogen er bl.a. at afgøre hvilke systemer der er på markedet, der kan opfylde Aarhus Vand saglige og objektive behov. Aarhus Vand har identificeret følgende krav, som værende vigtige ift. et fremtidigt ledningsregistreringssystem. Det er vigtigt for Aarhus Vand at kravene allerede kan opfyldes nu. Listen anses ikke for udtømmende: 1. Fuld understøttelse af DANVAs seneste modeller, pt.: Dandas 3.1.2, TV-Inspektion og brøndrapport 3.1.2, Danvand 2.1.2, Kabler, Fremmedrør samt Flader 1.1, Brudregistrering 1.1.1. For alle modeller gælder det alle begreber, attributter, koder, relationer og snitflader samt Danva's vejledninger og datamanualer. Systemet er konfigurerbar, således at systemet nemt og hurtigt kan tilpasse ændringer i såvel modellerne som brugerflade 2. Alle registreringer gemmes/data ligger i én og samme database 3. Systemet skal understøtte dataudveksling i XML-format. Der skal være mulighed for direkte opdatering via f.eks. SQL. Der skal være direkte adgang til data, samt mulighed for at lave direkte integrationer til andre systemer. 4. Kvalitetssikring. XSD-validering, foruddefinerede valideringer mv., der understøtter ledningsregistring og arbejde med data, og dermed sikrer og fastholder en god datakvalitet. 5. Mulighed for at arbejde i "jobs" i forbindelse med digitalisering af et område/projekt/emne, som efterfølgende kan opgraderes til at være master. Altså således at man ikke arbejde i master, før man har opgradreret ændringer til master. 6. Sproget i systemet skal være på dansk. Kan i mindre omfang være på engelsk. 7. Brugerflade. En intuitiv og brugervenlig brugerflade. Arbejdsgange skal kunne understøttes af konfigurerbare skabeloner/flows. Skal indeholde et værktøj til erstat, delling og samling af objekter f.eks. Ledninger Skal have diverse konstruktionsværktøjer. Skal have 3D understøttelse. 8. Brugerstyring via AD integration. Brugerne skal kunne have forskellige roller/rettigheder. 9. Løsningen skal have stabil og høj performance 10. Der skal være en auto-gem feature, eller gendannelse af ikke gemt-arbejde eller lign. Alle markedsaktører der mener at kunne leve op til ovenstående krav, opfordres til at tilmelde sig markedsdialogen. DIALOGENS RAMMER OG DELTAGELSE Markedsdialogen vil som udgangspunkt ske fysisk ved Aarhus Vand, Hasselager Allé 29, 8260 Viby J. Dialogen afholdes individuelt pr. markedsaktør. Interesse i markedsdialogen meldes til Christoffer Larsen, på christoffer.larsen@aarhusvand.dk eller indkob@aarhusvand.dk senest d. 20.10.2025. Dialogmøderne afholdes i perioden 21.10.2025 til 31.10.2025.

result.text: 1 INTRODUCTION We kindly ask you to submit your response to this Request for Information concerning the planning of the procurement for a questionnaire and event management system. We greatly appreciate all responses received, and each of them will be taken into account in the preparation of any potential tendering process. With this Request for Information, we aim to map supplier offerings regarding systems that support and provide a smooth and appropriate user experience for the end user. More detailed information on the subject of the procurement can be found in appendix 1 "Request for Information Questions" of this Request for Information. The end user of the procurement is Istekki and its owner-customers. At the same time, we aim to familiarise ourselves with the market situation, products potentially related to the use of the system, and contractual and commercial terms, such as pricing. 2 ORGANISING MARKET DIALOGUE Based on the responses to the Request for Information, market dialogue sessions will be organised where suppliers can present their own services, products and options for implementing the subject of the procurement. Based on the responses to this Request for Information, Istekki will select an estimated approximately 3–5 tenderers for the market dialogue. Any market dialogue sessions will be organised at a time specified by 24.3.2025 the contracting authority. If market dialogue sessions are organised, they will be conducted in the Finnish language. Istekki will provide the companies selected for the sessions with more detailed schedules and a Teams meeting link at a later date. Additional information questions may also be posed to suppliers. Please note that the information, descriptions and estimates of the publication date of the actual tendering process presented in this Request for Information are preliminary and indicative. Final schedules will be refined as the preparation progresses. 3 RESPONDING TO THE REQUEST FOR INFORMATION We kindly ask you to submit your response by email to hankinnat@istekki.fi no later than 18.3.2026 at 12.00. The Request for Information is to be answered using the form "Request for Information Questions" attached to this Request for Information (appendix 1). Send the completed form to the specified email address by the deadline. All responses received to the Request for Information will be taken into account in the preparation of the invitation to tender, and they form an important part of understanding the overall picture. It is worth noting that this Request for Information does not oblige Istekki Oy to carry out the procurement in the manner presented in this document or its appendices. A potential tendering process may also be left unorganised. No separate compensation will be paid for responding to the Request for Information or participating in any presentation sessions. We would like to emphasise once again that this is a Request for Information, not a prior information notice, contract notice or invitation to tender. The purpose of the Request for Information is to familiarise with the market situation and gather information related to the subject of the procurement to support the planning of the future tendering process. Responding to the Request for Information is voluntary and is not a prerequisite for participating in a potential tendering process, nor does it bind Istekki to publish a tendering process. At the same time, we greatly appreciate the information provided by suppliers, as it helps us build the future tendering process into as functional and clear a whole as possible.

result.text: INTRODUCTION The Centre for Emergency Communication (CFB) of the Danish Emergency Management Agency is preparing a procurement procedure for a contract concerning the 112 solution. The contract will cover the operation, maintenance, support and further development of the existing 112 application. The existing 112 solution is described in the attached background note Annex A. Against this background, CFB is conducting a market dialogue with potential tenderers in two phases. In the first phase, CFB is asking tenderers to answer the questions set out in Annex B. In the second phase, CFB will invite up to five tenderers to a follow-up meeting in order to elaborate on the information. First of all, we therefore ask tenderers to answer the questions in the questionnaire and upload it in the ETHICS procurement system. TIMETABLE FOR THE MARKET DIALOGUE The market dialogue has been published in the Official Journal of the European Union in a prior information notice dispatched on 15 December 2025. We will receive answers to the questions no later than 12 January 2026 at 12:00, after which we will select tenderers for follow-up meetings, which we expect to hold on 27 and 28 January 2026. We expect the meetings to have a duration of 11⁄2-2 hours. If a tenderer is invited to market dialogue, the tenderer will be notified no later than 21 January 2026. The agenda for the meetings will be sent out with the invitation, and the agenda will be based on an elaboration of the questions that the tenderer has answered. We will select tenderers based on the submitted answers. The selection will be made based on, inter alia, an assessment of tenderers' relevant experience with similar tasks, tenderers' relevant considerations regarding the task's deliverables, including transition-in, as well as tenderer's answers regarding matters that the tenderer considers to be essential for tendering for the task. THE TENDER We expect to publish the tender in the second quarter of 2026. The procurement procedure will be a negotiated procedure in accordance with the provisions of the Defence and Security Directive. The tender documents will be drawn up in Danish, and answers in Danish will be required with the exception of system documentation and similar. ANSWERING THE QUESTIONS The questions appear in Annex B, and the answer must appear exclusively in the form and not in separate annexes. The questions can be answered in Danish or English. TIDSPLAN FOR MARKEDSDIALOGEN Markedsdialogen er offentliggjort i EU-Tidende i en forhåndsmeddelelse, der er afsendt den 15. december 2025. Vi modtager besvarelser af spørgsmålene senest den 12. januar 2026 kl. 12:00, hvorefter vil udvælge Tilbudsgivere til opfølgende møder, som vi forventer at afholde den 27. og 28. januar 2026. Vi forventer, at møderne vil have en varighed på 11⁄2-2 timer Såfremt Tilbudsgiver inviteres til markedsdialog, vil Tilbudsgiver få besked herom senest den 21. januar 2026. Dagsordenen for møderne udsendes sammen med invitationen, og dagsordenen vil tage afsæt i en uddybning af de spørgsmål, som Tilbudsgiver har besvaret. Vi vil udvælge Tilbudsgivere ud fra de indsendte besvarelser. Udvælgelsen sker bl.a. pba. en vurdering af Tilbudsgiveres relevante erfaring med lignende opgaver, Tilbudsgiveres relevante overvejelser om opgavens Leverancer, herunder Transition ind samt Tilbudsgivers besvarelser ift. forhold, som Tilbudsgiver vurderer som værende væsentligt for at byde på opgaven. UDBUDDET Udbuddet forventer vi at offentliggøre i andet kvartal 2026. Udbudsproceduren vil være udbud med forhandling efter bestemmelserne i forsvars- og sikkerhedsdirektivet. BESVARELSE AF SPØRGSMÅLENE Spørgsmålene fremgår af bilag B, og besvarelsen skal udelukkende fremgå af skemaet, og ikke i særskilte bilag. Spørgsmålene kan besvares på dansk eller engelsk. Det udfyldte skema skal uploades via udbudssystemet ETHICS senest den 12. januar 2026 kl. 12:00. Vi vil behandle den modtagne information som fortrolig, dog med de begrænsninger der følger af retten til aktindsigt, jf. lov om offentlighed i forvaltningen. SPØRGSMÅL Spørgsmål om markedsdialogen kan stilles i udbudssystemet ETHICS.

result.text: Consultancy services for the "Digi-Expert-kommunal" format for the Hessian Ministry for Digitalisation and Innovation in two lots. The Hessian municipalities are currently in very different phases of digital transformation. Municipalities have very varied consultancy needs in the course of digital transformation and in the planning and implementation of digitalisation projects. Projects with a high degree of innovation in particular bring withal a wide range of issues that must be answered promptly and individually for successful implementation. This can also be clearly observed in the digitalisation projects funded via the promotion of smart municipalities and regions under the "Starke Heimat Hessen" programme. The Smart Region office anchored in the Hessian Ministry for Digitalisation and Innovation (HMD) will therefore expand its consultancy services for municipalities. The new consultancy format "Digi-Expert-kommunal" is intended to offer Hessian municipalities individual, vendor- and product-neutral ad hoc consultancies on various topics: from digital strategy, change management and project management to specialist topics such as data platforms, open source, artificial intelligence (AI), digital twins and the digitalisation of services of general interest (smart city/smart region). The HMD will make available a pool of experts via the Smart Region office, from which municipalities can choose as required. They can book them for various occasions/settings via the Smart Region office. This is intended to provide an impetus for the digital transformation of municipalities and to dismantle barriers to digitalisation. From October to December 2025 the "Digi-Expert-kommunal" format was piloted with selected topics and a limited quota. A total of 52 advisory discussions were brokered in the three-month pilot phase. These were distributed across 40 municipalities. 26 municipalities were each brokered one advisory discussion, 14 municipalities were brokered two or three advisory discussions. The consultancy effort (= discussion duration + preparation and follow-up) per municipality was limited to ten hours. Each of the advised municipalities took up an average of 5,7 hours of consultancy effort from the following topics in the short pilot phase: AI in administration/AI in services of general interest, procurement consultancy (not the subject of this call for competition), digital strategy, digital services of general interest/smart region in general, change management/digital mindset, digital twin, project management/project control, open source/proprietary solutions. The format was very well received within a very short time and with minimal communication effort. The feedback from the municipalities was consistently positive and once again confirmed the demand for tailored and short-notice consultancy. The consultancy demand could not nearly be covered within the piloting. Within the evaluation, the municipalities expressed the desire for the consolidation and expansion of the offering. Lot 1 covers general consultancy topics surrounding digital transformation and thus creates the basis for municipalities to deal with technical implementation later (lot 2). In particular, consultancy on: • digital strategy, • project management, • change management, • digital services of general interest, • citizen participation. For this lot, based on figures from the pilot phase and an assumed number of 270 interested municipalities, a demand of 810 hours per year is estimated. This estimated quantity serves calculation purposes only. There is no entitlement to call off this quantity. parts.source: Beratungsleistungen für das Format "Digi-Expert-kommunal" für das Hessische Ministerium für Digitalisierung und Innovation in zwei Losen Die hessischen Kommunen befinden sich aktuell in sehr unterschiedlichen Phasen der digitalen Transformation. Das Feedback der Kommunen war durchweg positiv und hat den Bedarf nach passgenauer und kurzfristiger Beratung nochmals bestätigt. Der Beratungsbedarf konnte innerhalb der Pilotierung nicht annähernd abgedeckt werden. Die Kommunen wünschten sich im Rahmen der Evaluation eine Verstetigung und Ausweitung des Angebots. Für dieses Los wird auf Basis der Zahlen aus der Pilotphase und einer angenommenen Zahl von 270 interessierten Kommunen ein Bedarf von 810 Stunden pro Jahr geschätzt.
