result.text: The "Strengthening environmental and social governance in the extractive sector" component, co-financed by FONAREDD from CAFI (Central Africa Forest Initiative) resources and BMZ, will be implemented by GIZ for the Ministry of the Environment and Sustainable Development (MEDD) of the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). The project is being carried out by the Integrated Economic Development of the Mining Sector Project (DISM II), in partnership with the Congolese Environment Agency (ACE), which is responsible for environmental and social assessments and for monitoring and controlling the implementation of ESMPs at national level. Following a 1st Strategic Environmental and Social Study of the mining sector in the DRC in 2010, and in view of the changing international context, it is planned, in agreement with the donor and partners, to launch Strategic Environmental and Social Studies (SESES) for the key sector of mining and hydrocarbons, in order to analyse the expected positive and negative impacts of their development at national level. This work will make it possible to identify good and bad practices in the provinces affected; and in partnership with the various partners and civil society, to propose recommendations integrating REDD+ standards into the extractive sectors. Finally, best practice guides will also be drawn up, based on the experience gained with dialogue platforms in the extractive sector. Adaptations of the various texts relating to the legal and regulatory provisions linked to the environmental and social governance of the extractive sectors will also be proposed in order to be consistent with REDD+ standards and the principles of the Extractive Industries Transparency Initiative (EITI). An open international call for a tender is published for services to be provided for 12 months, requiring a total of 5 experts, including 2 experts with international experience, respectively head of mission and deputy head of mission, with skills in the environment, strategic studies, and knowledge of the hydrocarbon sector. The team will be backed up on site by 3 experts with national experience with skills in social responsibility and oil and gas sector law and public policy. The services to be provided under this contract include measures for human capacity development and organisational and strategy advice in the following thematic areas: 1. Identifying and increasing attention to potential environmental and social risks, direct and indirect impacts and concerns around the development of the oil and gas sector; 2. Identifying and strengthening environmental and social management approaches and practical tools for the Government to manage sectoral environmental and social governance 3. Identifying and strengthening instruments and approaches that can improve environmental and social accountability, including by increasing the transparency of processes in the oil and gas sector and establishing simple, safe and accessible feedback and/or complaint mechanisms. 4. Support strengthening actors" capacity relevant for the sector to manage environmental and social risks related to the development of the oil and gas sector according to the mitigation hierarchy (avoid, minimise, mitigate and offset). The Contractor is responsible for the performance of the services and the production of the following outputs: 1) Strategic environmental and social assessment (SESA) of the oil and gas sector in the DRC. 2) SWOT analysis and recommendations for the oil and gas sector. 3) Socio-environmental management standards for the DRC. 4) Guide to good environmental and social practices for the DRC 5) Draft implementing legislation for the DRC.

The contracting authority uses the expert service, for example, to support the strategic development of financial sustainability, effective and accessible services, and personnel competence and well-being. The expert services to be procured are mainly used by the wellbeing services county as an organiser in strategic development. The purpose of the expert service is to: • produce information, competence and support for identifying changes in the operating environment and implementing strategic changes • produce national and international comparative data and insights to support the contracting authority's strategic development • produce competence and support for change management • produce competence and support for the implementation of projects. Registration link (You can access the registration by copying the link below and pasting it into the browser's search field): https://forms.office.com/e/qr9g1TnYbg The contracting authority reserves the possibility to send draft documents for comments to all suppliers who have familiarised themselves with the TKIO procurement system. The contracting authority may also carry out the market survey at its discretion in other non-discriminatory ways, such as supplier meetings. Expressing interest and participating in the survey does not bind the supplier to submit an application to participate or to participate in the tendering process. It is also not a prerequisite for participating in the actual tendering process later.

result.text: Framework Agreement for the Call-Off Provision of Associate Trainers: Digital Skills, Management Skills, Marketing including digital marketing and social media, Communication and Soft Skills, Health and Safety, Construction and Trade, Training and Assessment, Care, Mindfulness and Wellbeing, HR Training, Procurement, Tendering and bid writing, Accountancy systems, Visual Merchandising, Customer Service and Retail Optimisation Lot 1: Digital Skills. Digital skills, Artificial intelligence (AI) and automation skills, data literacy and data management, digital transformation and innovation capability, cybersecurity skills, digital marketing and e-commerce. With the acceleration of digital, the following are also subject areas that are in high demand: Digital skills focus on strong digital communication and collaboration abilities alongside cloud and productivity fundamentals. Artificial intelligence (AI) and automation skills centre on understanding foundational and responsible AI principles as well as applying process automation tools. Data literacy and data management priorities include the ability to interpret and visualise data effectively and uphold good data governance and ethics. Digital transformation and innovation capability requires skills in digital strategy and change leadership, paired with service design and user centred design approaches. Cybersecurity skills focus on building strong cyber hygiene and user awareness, supported by basic risk management and incident response knowledge. Digital marketing and e commerce emphasise SEO and analytics, combined with content creation and digital advertising to drive engagement and growth. Accredited and non-accredited opportunities ranging from SCQF5 and above requested. Training in widely used, industry standard digital tools- such as Microsoft Teams, OneNote for collaborative working, and digital bookkeeping platforms - is also in high demand. Lot 2: Management Skills. Strategic leadership & future planning, workforce development & talent management, change management and digital adoption, people, leadership & wellbeing management, operational & performance management. Businesses require managers who can demonstrate strong strategic leadership and future planning, workforce development and talent management, change management and digital adoption, people focused leadership and wellbeing management, and effective operational and performance management. Building these capabilities ensures leaders can respond to rapid technological change, manage skills gaps, and support resilient, high performing teams. Training should develop practical management capabilities including project management, change management, managing through crisis situations, supervising hybrid or home based teams, leading and motivating others, and building strong supervisory skills. Programmes should also strengthen interpersonal and developmental capabilities such as assertiveness, change and recovery management, coaching skills, developing individuals, and Insights Discovery profiling to support self awareness and team effectiveness. These subject areas are designed for new supervisors, emerging managers, and those seeking to upskill for career progression. Both accredited and non accredited options should be available. Non accredited workshops can be delivered as half day or full day sessions and should be contextualised to the specific needs of the business, particularly for bespoke contracts or sector specific requirements. Lot 3: Marketing. Businesses require marketing training across a wide range of evolving subject areas, including AI enhanced marketing skills, agile and adaptive marketing capability, data driven marketing and analytics, search engine optimisation SEO, content strategy and digital advertising, customer engagement and trust building, omnichannel and customer experience design, and advanced digital platforms and mobile first technologies. Alongside these, there is growing demand for brand creation and management, communications and PR, marketing strategy development, crisis communications, and video production, as well as understanding the difference between amplification and publication as businesses seek growth, explore new markets, or reposition for new audiences. Practical creative skills such as graphic design — particularly 2D/3D animation and Photoshop/Illustrator upskilling to enhance in house capability and deliver more impactful digital content. Digital marketing and social media skills are increasingly essential, enabling businesses to build visibility, engage target audiences, and compete effectively across fast moving online platforms. Lot 4: Communication and Soft Skills. Communication & interpersonal skills, teamwork and collaboration, adaptability & resilience, emotional intelligence & people skills, leadership & soft aligned skills, customer focused skills. Strong communication and soft skill capabilities to help teams adapt to rapid technological, economic and workforce change, clear and confident workplace communication, active listening, teamwork, collaboration, resilience, adaptability and emotional intelligence, as well as core interpersonal skills such as delivering effective presentations, problem solving, assertiveness and customer service communication. Training to mitigate the widening internal skills gaps and meet the growing importance of adaptability, creativity and strong communication. Seeking non accredited, introductory to intermediate level training, typically delivered in half day or full day formats, allowing staff to quickly upskill in essential, business ready soft skills that support productivity and workforce effectiveness. Lot 5: Health and Safety. Practical, compliance focused health and safety training that ensures staff are competent, up to date and able to manage modern workplace risks. Address gaps in documentation, risk assessments and ongoing training.

Essential electrical safety and compliance training, including the City & Guilds 18th Edition Electrical Wiring Regulations (full qualification and industry update) and PAT Testing and Inspection & Testing Upskilling for renewable energy systems, EV charging installation, battery storage safety, Lock Out–Tag Out (LOTO) procedures and electrical diagnostics. Ensuring staff remain competent, compliant and able to work safely with modern technologies. These may be delivered through accredited qualifications or short, non accredited practical courses to support flexible, cost effective workforce development. Lot 7: Training and Assessing. Workforce development training that strengthens internal capability, particularly through Assessor and Verifier qualifications, Coaching and Mentoring, and Train the Trainer programmes, enabling businesses to build in house expertise, support staff progression and maintain quality assurance across learning and development activities. Lot 8: Care, Mindfulness and Wellbeing. Safeguarding, Child Protection and Adult Protection training to ensure staff can recognise, respond to and escalate concerns in line with current legislation and best practice. Autism training, including delivery aligned to D&A certificated programmes and SQA certificated courses, supporting organisations to work confidently and inclusively with neurodiverse individuals. Trauma Informed Practice, Mental Health First Aid, Equality, Diversity & Inclusion (EDI) awareness, De escalation and Behaviour Support, and Professional Boundaries & Safer Working Practices, reflecting an increased emphasis on safe, ethical and inclusive service delivery. All programmes can be offered as accredited or non accredited options, providing flexible, practical learning tailored to organisational and sector requirements. Lot 9: HR Training, Procurement, Tendering and Bid Writing. HR training to strengthens effective people management, support compliance and improve workplace capability. HR focused training in areas such as employment practice, performance management and fair work aligned people processes. Service excellence & personalisation- delivering tailored shopping experiences, a key differentiator in modern retail. Retail Optimisation Skills to improve store performance and operational efficiency, including retail operations management- record keeping, staffing, stock control and security procedures. Maximising retail profitability, including evaluating sales data, identifying improvement opportunities, and applying merchandising strategies.

result.text: THIS IS NOT A PROCUREMENT NOTICE OR A CALL FOR TENDERS, BUT A REQUEST FOR INFORMATION FOR MARKET RESEARCH AND TECHNICAL DIALOGUE. This request for information is used to survey the market and obtain information regarding the procurement. The contracting authority is not initiating a tendering procedure with the publication of the request for information; instead, any potential procurement notice and call for tenders will be published later. The request for information does not oblige the contracting authority to carry out the actual procurement. Responding to the request for information is not a precondition for participation in any subsequent tendering procedure that may be organised. Suppliers will not be paid compensation for responding to the request for information or for participating in the market dialogue. The responses provided to this request for information will be used in planning the procurement of a personnel planning system. The subject of the procurement is a personnel planning system which: - supports strategic personnel planning and takes into account the qualitative (incl. staff competency structure) and quantitative planning of personnel required for organising service operations - enables the planning of personnel resources at the supervisory level - operates in accordance with processes defined by labour legislation (takes into account the starts, changes, terminations, etc., of employment relationships) - takes into account that the volume of personnel resources is guided by the level of service operations (increases / decreases / remains the same), care intensity and the budget, rather than a static, administrative vacancy system - can be integrated into HUS's other systems - scales to HUS's current personnel and organisational structure and its potential future changes - is a ready-made overall solution / service package. Personnel planning has a close connection to financial planning / the planning system (personnel costs). BACKGROUND TO THE PROCUREMENT Personnel planning is based on HUS's strategy and objectives. Personnel planning is carried out in both the short and long term. Strategic personnel planning is the organisation's long-term personnel planning. It can be used to anticipate changes in the operating environment and evaluate cost impacts. Personnel planning supports the organisation in achieving its objectives by ensuring access to the right capabilities, in the right place and at the right time. The objectives of planning are: - To identify the required number and structure of personnel as well as competence - To define the measures needed to ensure the personnel in accordance with the objective. These may include: • structural solutions related to the organisation of work and divisions of labour • development of personnel competence • renewal of processes • utilisation of digitalisation / new technologies The purpose of the request for information is to survey suppliers on the market and their product and service ranges. parts.source: TÄMÄ EI OLE HANKINTAILMOITUS TAI TARJOUSPYYNTÖ VAAN TIETOPYYNTÖ MARKKINAKARTOITUSTA JA TEKNISTÄ VUOROPUHELUA VARTEN. Tämän tietopyynnön avulla kartoitetaan markkinoita ja saadaan hankintaa koskevaa tietoa. Hankintayksikkö ei aloita tietopyynnön julkaisulla tarjouskilpailua, vaan mahdollinen hankintailmoitus ja tarjouspyyntö julkaistaan myöhemmin. Tietopyyntö ei velvoita hankintayksikköä toteuttamaan varsinaista hankintaa. Tietopyyntöön vastaaminen ei ole edellytys myöhempään mahdollisesti järjestettävään tarjouskilpailuun osallistumiselle. Toimittajille ei makseta korvausta tietopyyntöön vastaamisesta tai markkinavuoropuheluun osallistumisesta. Tähän tietopyyntöön annettuja vastauksia käytetään suunniteltaessa henkilöstösuunnittelujärjestelmän hankintaa. Hankinnan kohteena on henkilöstösuunnittelujärjestelmä, joka: - tukee strategista henkilöstösuunnittelua sekä huomioi palvelutoiminnan järjestämiseksi tarvittavan henkilöstön laadullisen (ml. henkilöstön osaamisrakenne) ja määrällisen suunnittelun - mahdollistaa henkilöstöresurssien suunnittelua esihenkilötasolla - toimii työlainsäädännön määrittämien prosessien mukaisesti (huomioi palvelussuhteen aloitukset, muutokset, päättämiset ym.) - huomioi, että henkilöstöresurssien määrää ohjaa palvelutoiminnan taso (kasvaa / laskee / pysyy samana), hoitoisuus ja talousarvio, ei staattinen, hallinnollinen vakanssijärjestelmä - on integroitavissa HUSin muihin järjestelmiin - skaalautuu HUSin nykyiseen henkilöstö- ja organisaatiorakenteeseen ja sen mahdollisiin tuleviin muutoksiin - on valmis kokonaisratkaisu / palvelukokonaisuus. Henkilöstösuunnittelulla on tiivis yhteys talouden suunnitteluun/suunnittelujärjestelmään (henkilöstökustannukset). HANKINNAN TAUSTA Henkilöstösuunnittelu perustuu HUSin strategiaan ja tavoitteisiin. Henkilöstösuunnittelua tehdään niin lyhyellä kuin pitkällä aikavälillä. Strateginen henkilöstösuunnittelu on organisaation pitkän aikavälin henkilöstösuunnittelua. Sen avulla voidaan ennakoida toimintaympäristön muutoksia ja arvioida kustannusvaikutuksia. Henkilöstösuunnittelu tukee organisaatiota sen tavoitteiden saavuttamisessa varmistamalla pääsyn oikeisiin kyvykkyyksiin, oikeassa paikassa ja oikeaan aikaan. Suunnittelun tavoitteena on: - Tunnistaa tarvittava henkilöstömäärä ja -rakenne sekä osaaminen - Määritellä toimenpiteet, joita tarvitaan tavoitteen mukaisen henkilöstön varmistamiseksi. Näitä voivat olla: • rakenteelliset, töiden organisointiin ja työnjakoihin liittyvät ratkaisut • henkilöstön osaamisen kehittäminen • prosessien uudistaminen • digitalisaation/uusien teknologioiden hyödyntäminen Tietopyynnön tarkoituksena on kartoittaa markkinoilla olevia toimittajia sekä heidän tuote- ja palveluvalikoimaansa. Tarkoituksena on selvittää tekniset ratkaisut, hinnoitteluperiaatteet ja kustannustaso budjettia varten. HUS-yhtymä pyytää kirjallisia kommenttejanne erityisesti seuraaviin kysymyksiin: - Millaista järjestelmää/palvelukokonaisuutta tarjoatte (kuvaus toteutuksesta) ja millaisilla toiminnallisuuksilla ratkaisu vastaa tässä tietopyynnössä kuvattuihin hankintayksikön tarpeisiin? - Millaiset ovat tarjoamanne ratkaisun integrointimahdollisuudet? - Millainen on tarjoamanne ratkaisun hinnoittelumalli (esim. lisenssit, ylläpito ja tuki)? - Onko tarjoamanne järjestelmä-/palvelukokonaisuus käytössä muissa vastaavissa organisaatioissa (hyvinvointialueet, sote-toimijat)? Pyydämme huomioimaan, että kaikki materiaali on tarkoitettu ainoastaan tämän markkinavuoropuhelun käymiseen. Hankintayksikkö käsittelee vastauksenne luottamuksellisesti. Tietopyynnön vastausten perusteella saatetaan toimittajalle tarjota mahdollisuus esitellä ratkaisujaan myöhemmin ilmoitettavalla tavalla. Tietopyyntöön vastanneet toimittajat saavat mahdollisesti kommentoitavakseen alustavat tarjouspyyntöasiakirjat. Pyydämme toimittamaan vastaukset tietopyyntöön ja ilmoittamaan kiinnostuksestanne viimeistään 11.12.2025 klo 12:00 mennessä osoitteeseen kilpailutus.ict@hus.fi. Viestin aiheeksi maininta "HUS 495-2025 - Tietopyyntö: Henkilöstösuunnittelujärjestelmä".

result.text: In compliance with the principles of necessity, suitability and efficiency established in Article 28 of the LCSP, the nature and extent of the needs intended to be covered by the conclusion of this contract fall within the scope of the functions and powers attributed to this Management Centre, determining with precision the suitability of the object and content of the contract in the Specifications of Technical Requirements. The contract aims to respond to the need to comply with the provisions of Article 3.2.a of Royal Decree 1046/2022, of 27 December, which regulates the governance of the Strategic Plan of the Common Agricultural Policy in Spain and of the European agricultural funds EAGF and EAFRD (hereinafter, Royal Decree 1046/2022), which stipulates that the regional Management Authorities, responsible for the management and execution of the CSP in their territorial scope, shall participate in relation to the evaluation plan and ex-post evaluation, in the establishment of the CSP evaluation plan and in the monitoring and evaluation tasks corresponding to their sphere of competence, reporting on their development and outcome to the Strategic Plan Management Authority. Such an evaluation must necessarily be carried out by functionally independent experts, as required by Article 140 of Regulation (EU) 2021/2115 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 2 December 2021 laying down rules on support for strategic plans to be drawn up by Member States under the common agricultural policy (CAP strategic plans) and financed by the European Agricultural Guarantee Fund (EAGF) and by the European Agricultural Fund for Rural Development (EAFRD) and repealing Regulations (EU) No. 1305/2013 and (EU) No. 1307/2013. Therefore, the corresponding tender must be carried out by this Department so that a team of independent expert evaluators in the field—since the Department of Agriculture, Livestock and Rural Development currently lacks this type of human resource among its staff capable of carrying out the necessary functions to perform this type of work and with the necessary knowledge to be able to carry out thematic evaluations within the framework of the CSP Strategic Plan in the territorial scope of Castile and Leon—can carry it out. In compliance with the provisions of Article 3.2 of DECREE 23/2025, of 30 December, regulating the conditions for the extension of the General Budgets of the Community of Castile and Leon for 2024 in the 2026 financial year, it is noted that the contract proposed to be initiated is considered a continuation of the CAP Strategic Plan approved on 31 August 2022 by the European Commission.

parts.source: En cumplimiento de los principios de necesidad, idoneidad y eficiencia establecidos en el artículo 28 de la LCSP la naturaleza y extensión de las necesidades que pretenden cubrirse mediante la celebración del presente contrato, se encuadran dentro del ámbito de las funciones y competencias atribuidas a este Centro Directivo determinándose con precisión la idoneidad del objeto y contenido del contrato en el Pliego de Prescripciones Técnicas. El contrato pretende dar respuesta a la necesidad de cumplir con lo establecido en el artículo 3.2.a del Real Decreto 1046/2022, de 27 de diciembre, por el que se regula la gobernanza del Plan Estratégico de la Política Agrícola Común en España y de los fondos europeos agrícolas FEAGA y FEADER (en adelante, Real Decreto 1046/2022), que estipula que las Autoridades regionales de gestión, responsables de la gestión y ejecución del PEPAC en su ámbito territorial, participarán en lo relativo al plan de evaluación y la evaluación ex post, en el establecimiento del plan de evaluación del PEPAC y en las tareas de seguimiento y evaluación que correspondan a su ámbito de competencia, dando cuenta del desarrollo y del resultado de las mismas a la Autoridad de gestión del Plan Estratégico. Tal evaluación necesariamente ha de realizarse por expertos funcionalmente independientes, tal como exige el artículo 140 del Reglamento (UE) 2021/2115 del Parlamento Europeo y del Consejo de 2 de diciembre de 2021 por el que se establecen normas en relación con la ayuda a los planes estratégicos que deben elaborar los Estados miembros en el marco de la política agrícola común (planes estratégicos de la PAC), financiada con cargo al Fondo Europeo Agrícola de Garantía (FEAGA) y al Fondo Europeo Agrícola de Desarrollo Rural (Feader), y por el que se derogan los Reglamentos (UE) no. 1305/2013 y (UE) no. 1307/2013. Por lo tanto, se precisa realizar la correspondiente licitación por parte de esta Consejería para que por parte de un equipo de evaluadores independientes expertos en la materia, debido a que actualmente la Consejería de Agricultura, Ganadería y Desarrollo Rural carece de este tipo de medios humanos dentro de su personal, que pueda llevar a cabo las funciones necesarias para desempeñar este tipo de trabajo y con los conocimientos necesarios para poder llevar a cabo las evaluaciones temáticas en el marco del Plan Estratégico del PEPAC en el ámbito territorial de Castilla y León. En cumplimiento de lo previsto en el artículo 3.2 del DECRETO 23/2025, de 30 de diciembre, por el que se regulan las condiciones de la prórroga de los Presupuestos Generales de la Comunidad de Castilla y León para 2024 en el ejercicio de 2026, se hace constar que el contrato que se propone iniciar se considera continuación del Plan Estratégico de la PAC aprobado el 31 de agosto de 2022 por la Comisión Europea.

result.text: Region Midtjylland is planning to conduct a tender for a dose monitoring system for performing patient dosimetry within the specialties of conventional X-ray, mammography, interventional procedures, CT, fluoroscopy, DEXA and hybrid scanners in nuclear medicine, so that the region can comply with Executive Order No. 1387 of 18 November 2025 on patient dosimetry and diagnostic reference levels, which enters into force on 1 January 2026. In this context, the region wishes to conduct a market dialogue to gain insight into the market, so that a forthcoming tender best reflects the capabilities of the market in relation to the region's needs, while at the same time uncovering potential risks so they can be mitigated. The result of the market dialogue is to be used, amongst other things, to assess what is standard in the market, so that the region has the best possible basis on which to structure the tender and draw up the tender documents. Initially, the region wishes to invite potential tenderers to a dialogue meeting with the region. The region expects that the dialogue meetings will be used, partly for participants to demonstrate how their solutions support a number of cases, and partly to hear participants' views on a number of requirements, including security requirements, which the region intends to impose on the supplier. The region reserves the right to continue the market dialogue with participants after the dialogue meetings, including asking follow-up questions to participants and potentially sending parts of the tender documents out for consultation with participants. The dialogue meetings are expected to take place in week 5 in 2026 at the region's Department of Procurement and Medical Technology (Aarhus). The meetings will be held individually with each company and are expected to have a duration of a maximum of 2 hours. The meetings will be held in Danish or English at the company's request. In the event of high interest, the region reserves the right to invite only a limited number of companies. In that case, emphasis will be placed on achieving diversity in the types of products/services that the selected companies can offer. Emphasis will also be placed on the market penetration of the product/service among companies. Companies wishing to participate in the market dialogue are asked to send an email to thomas.krogh.larsen@stab.rm.dk and Laura.Brinch.Norregaard@stab.rm.dk no later than 12 January 2026, at 12 with information about their product and/or service. Once a participant has registered, the region will send the participant the material needed for the dialogue meetings as soon as possible, including the cases and requirements. However, if registration takes place after 19 December at 12, the region reserves the right to send the material to the participant only in week 2 2026. Region Midtjylland encourages potential tenderers to participate in the market dialogue.

parts.source: Region Midtjylland forventer at gennemføre et udbud af et dosismonitoreringssystem til udførelse af patientdosimetri inden for specialerne konventionel røntgen, mammografi, interventionsundersøgelser, CT, gennemlysning, DEXA samt hybridskannere inden for nuklearmedicin, således regionen kan imødekomme bekendtgørelse nr. 1387 af 18 november 2025 om patientdosimetri og diagnostiske referenceniveauer, som træder i kraft 1. januar 2026. Regionen ønsker i den sammenhæng at gennemføre en markedsdialog for at opnå kendskab til markedet, så et kommende udbud bedst muligt favner markedets formåen set i forhold til regionens behov, samtidig med at eventuelle risici bliver afdækket, så de kan mitigeres. Resultatet af markedsdialogen skal bl.a. bruges til at vurdere, hvad der er gængs i markedet, således at regionen har det bedst mulige grundlag at tilrettelægge udbuddet på samt udarbejde udbudsmaterialet på baggrund af. Indledningsvist ønsker regionen at invitere potentielle tilbudsgivere til dialogmøde med regionen. Regionen forventer, at dialogmøderne skal bruges til, dels at deltagerne kan demonstrere, hvordan deres løsninger understøtter en række cases, dels at høre deltagerne om en række krav, herunder sikkerhedsmæssige krav, som regionen påtænker at stille leverandøren. Regionen forbeholder sig retten til at fortsætte markedsdialogen med deltagerne efter dialogmøderne, herunder at stille opfølgende spørgsmål til deltagerne og eventuelt sende dele af udbudsmaterialet i høring hos deltagerne. Dialogmøderne forventes at ville finde sted i uge 5 i 2026 hos regionens afdeling for Indkøb og Medicoteknik (Aarhus). Møderne vil blive afholdt individuelt med den enkelte virksomhed og forventes at have en varighed på max 2 timer. Møderne vil blive afholdt på dansk eller engelsk efter virksomhedens ønske. I tilfælde af stor interesse forbeholder regionen sig retten til alene at invitere et begrænset antal virksomheder. I så fald vil der blive lagt vægt på at opnå en diversitet i de typer af produkter/ydelser, som de udvalgte virksomheder kan tilbyde. Der vil endvidere blive lagt vægt på produktets/ydelsens udbredelse blandt virksomheder. Virksomheder, der ønsker at deltage i markedsdialogen, bedes sende en mail til thomas.krogh.larsen@stab.rm.dk samt Laura.Brinch.Norregaard@stab.rm.dk senest den 12. januar 2026, kl. 12 med information om deres produkt og/eller ydelse. Når en deltager har tilmeldt sig, sender regionen hurtigst muligt deltageren det materiale, deltagerne skal bruge til dialogmøderne, herunder casene og kravene. Såfremt tilmeldingen sker efter 19. december kl. 12 forbeholder regionen sig dog først at sende deltageren materialet i uge 2 2026. Region Midtjylland opfordrer potentielle tilbudsgivere til at deltage i markedsdialogen.

result.text: The Messe Berlin GmbH, hereinafter also referred to as Messe Berlin (MB) and the Contracting Authority (CA), is issuing a call for tenders for the following service: IP Address Management (DDI), CP1-2025-0019. The subject of this procurement is the provision, implementation and operation of a physical appliance for DHCP/DNS/IP address management. With the appliance being tendered, the Messe Berlin GmbH intends to position itself for the future in the field of network technology. The Messe Berlin GmbH is therefore seeking a dedicated IP address management solution as a complete DDI system with which the administration of DHCP ranges and DNS management can be made simpler and clearer. Due to the group's goal of further expanding its cloud architecture, it will also be necessary at a later date to introduce a central IP address management system in order to improve the overall overview of assigned IP addresses and to standardise overall management. The following service items are involved: - Hardware: Complete solution incl. maintenance - Software: DDI - Application - Maintenance (servicing, inspection, repair): Incident management (3rd level) + request + change management - Consulting service: Further development of the application at the customer's request - Implementation service: Delivery, commissioning, individual adjustments according to requirements, handover to operations incl. complete documentation (technical + user)

parts.source: Die Messe Berlin GmbH, im Folgenden gleichbedeutend auch Messe Berlin (MB) und Auftraggeber (AG) genannt, schreibt folgende Leistung aus: IP-Adressmanagement (DDI), CP1-2025-0019. Gegenstand dieser Vergabe ist die Bereitstellung, die Implementierung und der Betrieb einer physikalischen Appliance für DHCP/DNS/IP-Adressmanagement. Mit der ausgeschriebenen Appliance möchte sich die Messe Berlin GmbH künftig weiter zukunftssi-cher im Bereich der Netzwerktechnik aufstellen. Die Messe Berlin GmbH sucht deshalb, eine dedi-zierte IP-Adressmanagement-Lösung als Komplettsystem DDI mit welcher die Verwaltung der DHCP-Bereiche, sowie die DNS-Verwaltung einfacher und übersichtlicher gestaltet werden soll. Auf-grund des Konzerns-Ziel des weiteren Ausbau der Cloudarchitektur ist es zu einem späteren Zeit-punkt auch notwendig ein zentrales IP-Adress-Management einzuführen, um den Gesamtüberblick der vergebenen IP-Adressen zu verbessern und das gesamtheitliche Management zu vereinheitlichen. Es handelt sich um folgende Leistungsgegenstände: - Hardware: Komplettlösung inkl. Maintenance - Software: DDI - Anwendung - Instandhaltung (Wartung, Inspektion, Instandsetzung): Incident-Management (3rd Lvl) + Request + Change-Management - Beratungsleistung: Weiterentwicklungen der Applikation auf Kundenwunsch - Implementierungsleistung: Lieferung, Inbetriebnahme, individuelle Anpassungen gemäß Anforderung, Übergabe in den Betrieb inkl. vollständiger Dokumentationen (technisch + Anwender)

rejected.text: This is a special Notice of Funding Opportunity Announcement (NOFO) sponsored by the Air Force Office of Scientific Research (AFOSR), which will hereafter generally be referred to as “we”, “us”, “our”, or “AFOSR.” The Fiscal Year 2027 Air Force Young Investigator Research Program (YIP) intends to support individual early career scientists and engineers who have received their Ph.D. or equivalent degrees by 01 April 2019 or later showing exceptional ability and promise for conducting basic research. The program objective is to foster creative basic research in science and engineering; enhance early career development of outstanding young investigators; and increase opportunities for the young investigators to recognise the Air Force and Space Force mission and related challenges in science and engineering. Individual awards are made to U.S. institutions of higher education, industrial laboratories, for-profit, or non-profit research organisations where the principal investigator (PI) is employed on a full-time basis and holds a regular, non-contractor position. A YIP PI must be a U.S. citizen, national, or permanent resident. Researchers working at a Federally Funded Research and Development Center (FFRDC), or a Department of War (DoW) Laboratory are not eligible for this competition. YIP awards are funded up to $150,000 per year for three years, for a total of $450,000. No single year may exceed $150,000. Please review the remainder of this announcement for additional information. Under this competition, an anticipated thirty-seven (37) traditionally funded YIPs and three (3) YIPs funded in partnership with the Laboratory for Physical Sciences (LPS) in the Quantum Information Sciences research discipline may be awarded. There may be potential for an additional 37 YIPs funded from other AFOSR research funding. All actions are based on the availability of funds. Proposers are encouraged to confer with the designated AFOSR Program Officer(s) prior to submitting a full proposal. We will evaluate proposals using an internal review panel. AFOSR reserves the right to select and fund all, some, or none of the proposals from any of the topics below. AFOSR provides no funding for direct reimbursement of proposal development costs. Technical and budget proposals (or any other material) submitted in response to this NOFO will not be returned. It is the policy of AFOSR to treat all white papers and proposals submitted under this NOFO as sensitive competitive information and to disclose their contents only for the purposes of evaluation. White papers briefly summarising the proposed institution’s ideas are required. Submit white papers to our whitepaper portal, which is linked below. The topic points of contact (POCs) will coordinate to provide feedback on the white papers. The proposals will need to include a data management plan, outlining how samples and data collected in the program will be stored and managed. This includes but is not restricted to issues such as standards for data and metadata collection, content and format, data archiving, database management, and data sharing within, outside the awardee and beyond the lifetime of the grant. This precondition is modelled on the National Science Foundation Data Management Plan requirement (e.g., https://www.nsf.gov/eng/data-management-plans). IMPORTANT NOTE: Applicants should be alert for any amendments that may modify the announcement. Amendments to the original Notice of Funding Opportunity (NOFO) will be posted to the Grants.gov Webpage: https://www.grants.gov/. IMPORTANT DATES: Pre-proposal inquiries and questions, regarding white papers and the submission of those white papers, must be received in writing by electronic mail to the address(es) of this NOFO not later than 17 September 2026 at 11:59 PM Eastern Time to be considered. The Government will respond to any pre-proposal inquiries or questions via public posting, or individual responses, no later than COB on 24 September 2026. Whitepapers must be received by 09 October 2026 at 11:59 PM Eastern Time via submission to https://afosr.gov1.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_eKuTqm9qezoDYep to be considered. White paper evaluation is meant to initially assess the capability of a proposed effort. White papers must be no more than five (5) pages in length. References and CV/bios will not count against the page limit. Please review this announcement in its entirety prior to submitting a white paper. The government will respond to the white paper determination before COB on 06 November 2026 . Proposals must be received electronically through Grants.gov by 04 December 2026 at 11:59 PM Eastern Time to be considered. We anticipate that we will notify proposers of selection or non-selection for award no later than 26 April 2027 . We anticipate awards to be made by 01 May 2027 , barring delays.

result.text: The "Strengthening environmental and social governance in the extractive sector" component, co-financed by FONAREDD from CAFI (Central Africa Forest Initiative) resources and BMZ, will be implemented by GIZ for the Ministry of the Environment and Sustainable Development (MEDD) of the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). The project is being carried out by the Integrated Economic Development of the Mining Sector Project (DISM II), in partnership with the Congolese Environment Agency (ACE), which is responsible for environmental and social assessments and for monitoring and controlling the implementation of ESMPs at national level. Following a 1st Strategic Environmental and Social Study of the mining sector in the DRC in 2010, and in view of the changing international context, it is planned, in agreement with the donor and partners, to launch Strategic Environmental and Social Studies (SESES) for the key sector of mining and hydrocarbons, in order to analyse the expected positive and negative impacts of their development at national level. This work will make it possible to identify good and bad practices in the provinces affected; and in partnership with the various partners and civil society, to propose recommendations integrating REDD+ standards into the extractive sectors. Finally, best practice guides will also be drawn up, based on the experience gained with dialogue platforms in the extractive sector. Adaptations of the various texts relating to the legal and regulatory provisions linked to the environmental and social governance of the extractive sectors will also be proposed in order to be consistent with REDD+ standards and the principles of the Extractive Industries Transparency Initiative (EITI). Lot LOT-0001: 10007377-Strategic Environmental and Social Assessment (SESA) of the oil and gas sector to be carried out in the DRC. An open international call for a tender is published for services to be provided for 12 months, requiring a total of 5 experts, including 2 experts with international experience, respectively head of mission and deputy head of mission, with skills in the environment, strategic studies, and knowledge of the hydrocarbon sector. The team will be backed up on site by 3 experts with national experience with skills in social responsibility and oil and gas sector law and public policy. The services to be provided under this contract include measures for human capacity development and organisational and strategy advice in the following thematic areas: 1. Identifying and increasing attention to potential environmental and social risks, direct and indirect impacts and concerns around the development of the oil and gas sector; 2. Identifying and strengthening environmental and social management approaches and practical tools for the Government to manage sectoral environmental and social governance 3. Identifying and strengthening instruments and approaches that can improve environmental and social accountability, including by increasing the transparency of processes in the oil and gas sector and establishing simple, safe and accessible feedback and/or complaint mechanisms. 4. Support strengthening actors" capacity relevant for the sector to manage environmental and social risks related to the development of the oil and gas sector according to the mitigation hierarchy (avoid, minimise, mitigate and offset). The Contractor is responsible for the performance of the services and the production of the following outputs: 1) Strategic environmental and social assessment (SESA) of the oil and gas sector in the DRC. 2) SWOT analysis and recommendations for the oil and gas sector. 3) Socio-environmental management standards for the DRC. 4) Guide to good environmental and social practices for the DRC 5) Draft implementing legislation for the DRC.

result.text: The Norwegian Defence Materiel Agency (FMA) is the contracting authority and responsible for implementing the procurement. FMA is a part of the defence sector, directly under the Ministry of Defence (FD). FMA shall ensure that the Norwegian Armed Forces and other entities in the defence sector have access to cost efficient and secure material and services in line with approved long-term plans. FMA ́s main assignments are planning, procurement, management and disposal of material for the Norwegian Armed Forces and other departments under FD. Organisational reasons can be required during the contract period to transfer the resource to Cyber Defence ́s IT Department (CIT) DRIV. DRIV is responsible for the technical operation and further development (DEVSECOPS) of the Joint Integrated Management System (FIF). FIF is a SAP ERP system integrated with a number of other different applications. Internal processes are based on flexible frameworks (Scrum, SAFE), the Security Act and different industry standards for safety and ITIL for operation. DRIV consists of approx. 150 persons, most of whom are located in Oslo. Both employees and consultants staff the organisation. The aim of this notice is to fill the role of solution expert SAP Basis in project P1160 'Critical Upgrading of ERP'. The consultant will be a part of the enabling team SAP-Basis in CIT DRIV AGM and shall take care of the role within the discipline SAP Basis. The role can involve cooperation with any other departments and/or projects in the Norwegian Armed Forces.

result.text: GENERAL Fimea has started preparing for the procurement of the Fimea.fi website renewal. Fimea is a central agency under the Ministry of Social Affairs and Health that acts as the licensing and supervisory authority for medicines, medical devices, blood and tissue products, biobanks, and operators in the pharmaceutical sector intended for humans or animals. As part of the preparation of the procurement, the contracting authority is conducting a market dialogue. The actual procurement will be implemented as an open procurement procedure. Please note that this is a market survey notice and not a call for tenders. This market survey notice does not yet request tenders. Participation in the market dialogue is completely voluntary. Participation or non-participation in the market dialogue does not affect a tenderer's opportunities to participate in the procurement procedure to be implemented later. The market dialogue does not oblige anyone to participate in the actual tendering, nor does it exclude anyone from it. PRELIMINARY DESCRIPTION OF THE PROCUREMENT The aim of the procurement is to renew the Fimea.fi website and content management system so that the public site is user-friendly, accessible and supports the management of up-to-date content. The procurement will preliminarily be implemented using a hybrid model consisting of three separate parts: 1. Service design service, expert work • Design of user journeys and concepts • Definition of user interface and information architecture • Visual plan • Architecture description and solution description • Accessibility plan 2. New content management system and website implementation • Ready-to-use content management system (using SaaS model) • Renewed site structure and user interface • Language versions (Finnish, Swedish and English) • Content management features (preview, scheduling, version history) • Integrations and technical interfaces • Accessibility and data protection • Commissioning, training and documentation 3. Maintenance and further development Fixed-price maintenance: • Includes continuous usability of the service, security updates, backups, monitoring and SLA services. • Fixed monthly price for the contract period Hourly-rate minor development: • Includes small changes and additional features according to the agile model. • Invoicing according to actual work at an hourly rate. Both parts will be implemented as a SaaS service, where the supplier is responsible for technical management and continuity. The service design and definition phase as well as the implementation project are preliminarily scheduled for the years Q2/2026 – Q2/2027 and the maintenance and further development phase from Q3/2027 onwards. The website will be renewed at the same time in terms of appearance and structure in a way that better serves users. The basic content of the website will publish text, images and attachments. Contents will also include embedded videos or audio files. Embedded audio/video files are hosted on other services. The contents (articles and podcasts) of the Sic web magazine are intended to be integrated as part of the Fimea.fi entity as part of the website implementation. However, the web magazine will not be brought to the Fimea.fi site as a separate entity. MARKET DIALOGUE The market dialogue is intended for companies interested in tendering, and it includes commenting on preliminary tender documents before the publication of the call for tenders. Written commenting on the tender documents is preliminarily planned to be organised around the turn of January and February 2026. The publication of the actual call for tenders is preliminarily planned for February 2026. The information provided in this notice and in the market dialogue itself is preliminary and may change as the preparation progresses. The announced schedule of the procurement is also preliminary and may change as the preparation of the procurement progresses. Please note that the market survey does not include a question & answer phase. Companies interested in the procurement are requested to register in accordance with the instructions described below. REGISTRATION FOR THE MARKET DIALOGUE Companies interested in the procurement are requested to report their contact details by email to the address kilpailutus@hansel.fi. The registration shall be headed as follows: "Fimea.fi verkkosivu-uudistus – Ilmoittautuminen markkinavuoropuheluun". State in the message the name of your organisation and the email address of the contact person to whom the draft tender documents will be delivered. We request registrations for the market dialogue no later than by 23.1.2026 at 12:00. Hansel Oy acts in a consulting role in the procurement.

parts.source: YLEISTÄ Fimea on käynnistänyt Fimea.fi verkkosivu-uudistuksen hankinnan valmistelun. Fimea on sosiaali- ja terveysministeriön alainen keskusvirasto, joka toimii ihmisille tai eläimille tarkoitettujen lääkkeiden, lääkinnällisten laitteiden, veri- ja kudosvalmisteiden, biopankkien sekä lääkealan toimijoiden lupa- ja valvontaviranomaisena. Osana kilpailutuksen valmistelua hankintayksikkö toteuttaa markkinavuoropuhelun. Varsinainen hankinta tullaan toteuttamaan avoimena hankintamenettelynä. Huomioittehan, että kyseessä on markkinakartoitusilmoitus, eikä tarjouspyyntö. Tällä markkinakartoitusilmoituksella ei vielä pyydetä tarjouksia. Markkinavuoropuheluun osallistuminen on täysin vapaaehtoista. Markkinavuoropuheluun osallistuminen tai osallistumatta jättäminen ei vaikuta tarjoajan mahdollisuuksiin osallistua myöhemmin toteutettavaan hankintamenettelyyn. Markkinavuoropuhelu ei velvoita ketään osallistumaan varsinaiseen kilpailutukseen, eikä myöskään sulje ketään sen ulkopuolelle. ALUSTAVA HANKINNAN KUVAUS Hankinnan tavoitteena on uudistaa Fimea.fi-verkkosivusto ja julkaisujärjestelmä siten, että julkinen sivusto on käyttäjäystävällinen, saavutettava ja tukee ajantasaisen sisällön hallintaa. Hankinta tullaan alustavasti toteuttamaan hybridimallilla, joka koostuu kolmesta erillisestä osasta: 1. Palvelumuotoilupalvelu, asiantuntijatyö • Käyttäjäpolkujen ja konseptien suunnittelu • Käyttöliittymä- ja informaatioarkkitehtuurin määrittely • Visuaalinen suunnitelma • Arkkitehtuurikuvaus ja ratkaisukuvaus • Saavutettavuussuunnitelma 2. Uusi julkaisujärjestelmä ja sivuston toteutus • Käyttövalmis julkaisujärjestelmä (SaaS-mallilla) • Uudistettu sivustorakenne ja käyttöliittymä • Kieliversiot (suomi, ruotsi ja englanti) • Sisällönhallinnan ominaisuudet (esikatselu, ajastus, versiohistoria) • Integraatiot ja tekniset rajapinnat • Saavutettavuus ja tietosuoja • Käyttöönotto, koulutus ja dokumentaatio 3. Ylläpito- ja jatkokehitys Kiinteähintainen ylläpito: • Sisältää palvelun jatkuvan käytettävyyden, tietoturvapäivitykset, varmistukset, monitoroinnin ja SLA-palvelut. • Kiinteä kuukausihinta sopimuskauden ajan Tuntihintainen pienkehitys: • Sisältää ketterän mallin mukaiset pienet muutokset ja lisäominaisuudet. • Laskutus toteuman mukaan tuntihinnalla. Molemmat osat toteutetaan SaaS-palveluna, joissa toimittaja vastaa teknisestä hallinnasta ja jatkuvuudesta. Palvelumuotoilu- ja määrittelyvaihe sekä toteutusprojekti ajoittuu alustavasti vuosille Q2/2026 – Q2/2027 ja ylläpito- ja jatkokehitysvaihe Q3/2027 eteenpäin. Verkkosivut uudistetaan samalla ulkonäön ja rakenteen suhteen tavalla, joka palvelee paremmin käyttäjiä. Verkkosivuston perussisältönä julkaistaan tekstiä, kuvia ja liitetiedostoja. Sisältöinä on myös upotettuja videoita tai äänitiedostoja. Upotetut audio-/videotiedostot sijaitsevat muissa palveluissa. Sic-verkkolehden sisällöt (artikkelit ja podcastit) on tarkoitus yhdistää osaksi Fimea.fi -kokonaisuutta osana verkkosivuston toteuttamista. Verkkolehteä ei kuitenkaan tuoda Fimea.fi-sivulle omana kokonaisuutenaan. MARKKINAVUOROPUHELU Markkinavuoropuhelu on tarkoitettu tarjoamisesta kiinnostuneille yrityksille, ja se sisältää alustavien tarjouspyyntömateriaalien kommentointia ennen tarjouspyynnön julkaisua. Tarjouspyyntömateriaalien kirjallinen kommentointi on alustavasti suunniteltu järjestettävän tammi-helmikuun vaihteessa 2026. Varsinaisen tarjouspyynnön julkaisu on alustavasti suunniteltu helmikuulle 2026. Tällä ilmoituksella, sekä itse markkinavuoropuhelussa annetut tiedot ovat alustavia, ja ne saattavat muuttua valmistelun edetessä. Myös hankinnan ilmoitettu aikataulu on alustava, ja se saattaa muuttua kilpailutuksen valmistelun edetessä. Huomioithan, että markkinakartoitus ei sisällä kysymys & vastaus -vaihetta. Hankinnasta kiinnostuneita yrityksiä pyydetään ilmoittautumaan alla kuvatun ohjeistuksen mukaisesti. MARKKINAVUOROPUHELUUN ILMOITTAUTUMINEN Hankinnasta kiinnostuneita yrityksiä pyydetään ilmoittamaan yhteystietonsa sähköpostitse osoitteeseen kilpailutus@hansel.fi. Ilmoittautuminen otsikoidaan seuraavasti: ”Fimea.fi verkkosivu-uudistus – Ilmoittautuminen markkinavuoropuheluun”. Ilmoita viestiin organisaatiosi nimi, sekä yhteyshenkilön sähköpostiosoite, johon tarjouspyynnön luonnosmateriaalit toimitetaan. Pyydämme ilmoittautumisia markkinavuoropuheluun viimeistään 23.1.2026 kello 12:00 mennessä. Hansel Oy toimii hankinnassa konsultoivassa roolissa.

result.text: The subject of the framework agreement for the procurement is the provision, implementation, and configuration of a web-based, audit-proof, and configurable specialist application for the funding management of Netzwerk Universitätsmedizin NUM GmbH (NUM). The scope of services comprises in particular software provision, hosting, and technical operation by the contractor, setup and customising, data migration, interfaces, and exports including system-neutral transfer to the financial software selected at a later date, a documented API, support, maintenance, training, and documentation. The subject of the framework agreement for the procurement is the provision, implementation, and configuration of a web-based, audit-proof, and configurable software solution for the funding management of Netzwerk Universitätsmedizin GmbH (NUM). The solution must digitally map the funding processes from application through review, approval, contract creation, payment request, and interim and final reports. NUM is in an organisational transition phase. Previous processes are partially connected to existing structures of Charité, external project management agency processes, SharePoint or file shares, Excel tables, PDF documents, and easyOnline/XML data. In future, the office is to establish its own structures for processing, reviewing, and documenting funding processes. The software must support both administrative processing and review (currently the Administration, Finance, and Controlling team) and specialist processing and review (currently the Science Management team). The respective reviews take place in parallel, sequentially, or consecutively depending on the process. Input masks, checklists, review notes, task lists, and status logic must therefore be able to traceably depict both review perspectives. The software does not execute the actual payment order, bank execution, or direct retrieval from the Federal Treasury. However, it must provide the data required for forwarding the funds in a structured and system-independent manner. Since the client's financial software will only be selected after this procurement, the technical transfer must be possible via at least a documented, configurable exchange format. The concrete target format and field assignment will be agreed upon in the implementation project after the financial software is selected. The actual retrieval of financial funds from the Federal Treasury and the bank execution take place outside the software. The provision of the retrieval data package and the technical implementation of the agreed data exchange are part of the scope of services. The subject of the tender is an integrated specialist application for funding management with which administrative and specialist review, processing, and decision-making processes can be fully digitally mapped. Document management is a central component of this specialist application and must ensure the process-related linking, structured storage, versioning, management, and retrievability of documents. What is being sought is therefore neither a pure document repository nor an isolated form system, but an end-to-end funding management solution. Insofar as products, procedures, or manufacturers are named in this specification of services, this is done exclusively to describe the required scope of services; equivalent solutions are permitted. Existing target systems of the client determined before publication, or those determined prior to publication, are clearly named in the procurement documents, including the required integration scope.

parts.source: Gegenstand des Rahmenvertrags der Beschaffung ist die Bereitstellung, Einführung und Konfiguration einer webbasierten, revisionssicheren und konfigurierbaren Fachanwendung für das Fördermittelmanagement des Netzwerk Universitätsmedizin NUM GmbH (NUM). Der Leistungsumfang umfasst insbesondere Softwarebereitstellung, Hosting und technischen Betrieb durch den Auftragnehmer, Einrichtung und Customizing, Datenmigration, Schnittstellen und Exporte einschließlich der systemneutralen Übergabe an die später ausgewählte Finanzsoftware, eine dokumentierte API, Support, Wartung, Schulung und Dokumentation. Gegenstand des Rahmenvertrags der Beschaffung ist die Bereitstellung, Einführung und Konfiguration einer webbasierten, revisionssicheren und konfigurierbaren Softwarelösung für das Fördermittelmanagement der Netzwerk Universitätsmedizin GmbH (NUM). Die Lösung soll die Förderprozesse vom Antrag über Prüfung, Bewilligung, Vertragserstellung, Zahlungsanforderung sowie Zwischen-und Verwendungsnachweis digital abbilden. Die NUM befindet sich in einer organisatorischen Übergangsphase. Bisherige Prozesse sind teilweise an bestehende Strukturen der Charité, externe Projektträgerprozesse, SharePointbzw. Dateiablagen, ExcelTabellen, PDFDokumente sowie easyOnline/XMLDaten angebunden. Künftig soll die Geschäftsstelle eigene Strukturen zur Bearbeitung, Prüfung und Dokumentation von Förderprozessen etablieren. Die Software muss sowohl die administrative Bearbeitung und Prüfung (derzeit Team Administration, Finanzen und Controlling) als auch die fachliche Bearbeitung und Prüfung (derzeit Team Wissenschaftsmanagement) unterstützen. Die jeweiligen Prüfungen erfolgen abhängig vom Prozess parallel, sequentiell oder aufeinander aufbauend. Eingabemasken, Checklisten, Prüfvermerke, Aufgabenlisten und Statuslogiken müssen daher beide Prüfperspektiven nachvollziehbar abbilden können. Die Software führt weder die tatsächliche Zahlungsanweisung noch die Bankausführung oder den unmittelbaren Abruf bei der Bundeskasse aus. Sie muss jedoch die für die Weiterleitung der Mittel erforderlichen Daten strukturiert und systemunabhängig bereitstellen. Da die Finanzsoftware des Auftraggebers erst nach dieser Vergabe ausgewählt wird, muss die technische Übergabe mindestens über ein dokumentiertes, konfigurierbares Austauschformat möglich sein. Das konkrete Zielformat und die Feldbelegung werden nach Auswahl der Finanzsoftware im Einführungsprojekt abgestimmt. Der tatsächliche Abruf von Finanzmitteln bei der Bundeskasse und die Bankausführung erfolgen außerhalb der Software. Die Bereitstellung des Abrufdatenpakets und die technische Umsetzung des abgestimmten Datenaustauschs sind Bestandteil des Leistungsumfangs. Gegenstand der Ausschreibung ist eine integrierte Fachanwendung für das Fördermittelmanagement, mit der die administrativen und fachlichen Prüf, Bearbeitungs- und Entscheidungsprozesse vollständig digital abgebildet werden können. Das Dokumentenmanagement ist zentraler Bestandteil dieser Fachanwendung und muss die vorgangsbezogene Verknüpfung, strukturierte Ablage, Versionierung, Verwaltung und Wiederauffindbarkeit von Dokumenten sicherstellen. Gesucht wird damit weder eine reine Dokumentenablage noch ein isoliertes Formularsystem, sondern eine durchgängige Fördermittelmanagementlösung. Soweit in dieser Leistungsbeschreibung Produkte, Verfahren oder Hersteller genannt werden, geschieht dies ausschließlich zur Beschreibung des geforderten Leistungsumfangs? gleichwertige Lösungen sind zugelassen. Bestehende beziehungsweise vor Veröffentlichung festgelegte Zielsysteme des Auftraggebers werden in den Vergabeunterlagen einschließlich des erforderlichen Integrationsumfangs eindeutig benannt.

rejected.text: Norddeutscher Rundfunk (NDR) intends to conclude a framework agreement for the following ARD broadcasting corporations and Deutschlandradio regarding services for online surveys for their market and media research, with an annual quota of online panel surveys. Lot LOT-0001: Large sample sizes. Lot 1 is intended for studies with large sample sizes and should therefore go to a contractor that can demonstrate a corresponding panel size and quality with regular master data maintenance. This primarily concerns studies that are conducted in an online-representative manner with at least n=1.000 respondents. The implementation of tracking studies is also conceivable here. The contractor must ensure that representative surveys are possible not only for Germany as a whole but also for the broadcasting areas of the ARD regional broadcasting corporations (at least the larger broadcasting areas: BR - Bavaria; hr - Hesse; MDR - Saxony-Anhalt, Saxony, Thuringia; NDR - Lower Saxony, Hamburg, Schleswig-Holstein, Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania; RBB - Berlin, Brandenburg; SWR - Baden-Württemberg, Rhineland-Palatinate; WDR - North Rhine-Westphalia). Lot LOT-0002: QuickSurveys. Lot 2 is intended for studies that require quick and uncomplicated implementation. This primarily concerns format and pilot tests in which stimuli are used. The target groups do not necessarily have to be online-representative, but the contractor must ensure that surveys are possible not only for Germany as a whole but also for the broadcasting areas of the ARD regional broadcasting corporations (at least the larger broadcasting areas: BR - Bavaria; hr - Hesse; MDR - Saxony-Anhalt, Saxony, Thuringia; NDR - Lower Saxony, Hamburg, Schleswig-Holstein, Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania; RBB - Berlin, Brandenburg; SWR - Baden-Württemberg, Rhineland-Palatinate; WDR - North Rhine-Westphalia). The surveys should not last longer than 15 minutes. The sample sizes will vary between n=100 and n=2.000. Decisive factors here are field times, stimuli integration, smooth programming, and data quality.

parts.source: Der Norddeutsche Rundfunk (NDR) beabsichtigt, für die nachfolgend genannten ARD-Rundfunkanstalten und Deutschlandradio eine Rahmenvereinbarung über Dienstleistungen für Onlineumfragen ihrer Markt- und Medienforschung mit einem jährlichen Kontingent an Onlinepanel-Befragungen abzuschließen. Lot LOT-0001: Große Fallzahlen. Los 1 ist für Studien mit großen Fallzahlen vorgesehen und sollte daher an einen Auftragnehmer gehen, der eine entsprechende Panel-Größe und -Qualität mit einer regelmäßigen Stammdatenpflege vorweisen kann. Hier geht es vorrangig um Studien, die online-repräsentativ mit mindestens n=1.000 Befragten durchgeführt werden. Vorstellbar ist hier auch die Durchführung von Tracking-Studien. Der Auftragnehmer muss sicherstellen, dass repräsentative Umfragen außer für Deutschland insgesamt auch für die Sendegebiete der ARD-Landesrundfunkanstalten (zumindest die größeren Sendegebiete: BR - Bayern; hr - Hessen; MDR - Sachsen-Anhalt, Sachsen, Thüringen; NDR - Niedersachsen, Hamburg, Schleswig-Holstein, Mecklenburg-Vorpommern; RBB - Berlin, Brandenburg; SWR - Baden-Württemberg, Rheinland-Pfalz; WDR - Nordrhein-Westfalen) möglich sind. Lot LOT-0002: QuickSurveys. Los 2 ist für Studien vorgesehen, die einer schnellen und unkomplizierten Umsetzung bedürfen. Hier geht es vorrangig um Format- und Pilottests, in denen Stimuli eingesetzt werden. Die Zielgruppen müssen nicht zwingend online-repräsentativ sein, aber der Auftragnehmer muss sicherstellen, dass Umfragen außer für Deutschland insgesamt auch für die Sendegebiete der ARD-Landesrundfunkanstalten (zumindest die größeren Sendegebiete BR -Bayern; hr - Hessen; MDR - Sachsen-Anhalt, Sachsen, Thüringen; NDR - Niedersachsen, Hamburg, Schleswig-Holstein, Mecklenburg-Vorpommern; RBB - Berlin, Brandenburg; SWR - Baden-Württemberg, Rheinland-Pfalz; WDR - Nordrhein-Westfalen) möglich sind. Die Befragungen sollen nicht länger als 15 Minuten dauern. Die Stichprobengrößen werden zwischen n=100 und n=2.000 variieren. Entscheidende Faktoren sind hier Feldzeiten, Stimuli-Einbindung, reibungslose Programmierung und Datenqualität.

result.text: The purpose of the contract is to guarantee the continuity of the corporate data analytics services currently implemented in an on-premise model, as well as their modernisation and technological evolution through their transition to a managed cloud model. The supply in cloud mode that is the subject of this contract includes, within the price of the right to use the licences, the provision of the infrastructure necessary for the operation of the platform in separate production and development environments, the comprehensive management service, corrective and evolutionary maintenance, periodic software updates, the third-party software necessary for its operation, specialised technical support, continuous monitoring of the service and the application of appropriate security measures, as well as the definition and compliance of service levels (SLAs). Likewise, the contract comprises the planning and execution of the migration from the current on-premise environment to the cloud model, including configuration, parametrisation, testing and commissioning tasks, as well as the provision of specialised technical and functional support consulting services during the transition process. The contract is structured through unit prices per licence typology, establishing a minimum number of licences to be supplied during the term of the contract, and the number of licences may be increased, depending on needs, up to the maximum contract amount envisaged.

parts.source: La contratación tiene por finalidad garantizar la continuidad de los servicios corporativos de analítica de datos actualmente implantados en modalidad on-premise, así como su modernización y evolución tecnológica mediante su transición a una modalidad cloud gestionada. El suministro en modalidad cloud objeto de esta contratación, incluye, dentro del precio del derecho de uso de las licencias, la provisión de la infraestructura necesaria para el funcionamiento de la plataforma en entornos diferenciados de producción y desarrollo, el servicio de gestión integral, el mantenimiento correctivo y evolutivo, las actualizaciones periódicas de software, el software de terceros necesario para su operación, el soporte técnico especializado, la monitorización continua del servicio y la aplicación de medidas de seguridad adecuadas, así como la definición y cumplimiento de niveles de servicio (SLA). Asimismo, el contrato comprende la planificación y ejecución de la migración desde el entorno on-premise actual a la modalidad cloud, incluyendo las tareas de configuración, parametrización, pruebas y puesta en producción, así como la prestación de servicios de consultoría especializada de apoyo técnico y funcional durante el proceso de transición. El contrato se articula mediante precios unitarios por tipología de licencia, estableciéndose un número mínimo de licencias a suministrar durante la vigencia del contrato, pudiendo ampliarse el número de licencias, en función de las necesidades, hasta el importe máximo de contratación previsto.

result.text: Bergen municipality shall procure a new financial system, delivered as a cloud service. The new system shall replace the current financial system (UNIT4 ERP, UBW Economy), which the municipality has used since 2003. The contract also includes operation/management, further development and user support. The new financial system shall cover the municipality ́s need for finance, accounts, incoming and outgoing invoices and project accounts. Areas that the financial system shall support are: Accounts, including registration and bookkeeping, remittance, asset management and duty management. Outgoing invoices, including invoicing, income management and follow-up of payment. Incoming invoices, including invoice receipt, invoice processing, invoice matching, processing deviations and following-up payments. Project accounts, including hourly registration, administration and follow-up of projects and the generation of the invoice basis. Performance management and reporting, as well as financial insight and control. Register and master data, such as, for example, the customer register, supplier register and site register. Integrations and exchange of data between different systems. A change of system involves a great opportunity for Bergen municipality to get an ICT system, which not only covers basic functionality for the financial area, but supports modern and efficient financial processes and that ensures the best possible utilisation of the resources. Tenderers shall offer services and systems/cloud services that cover the needs and requirements stated in the SSA-Cloud agreement with annexes and annexes. Bergen municipality would also like additional services such as consultancy services/consultancy services, training services beyond the need for establishing the service and options for expanded user support. The contracting authority for the procurement is Bergen municipality, c/o the City Council Department for Finance.

result.text: Police Scotland wishes to engage potential Suppliers to obtain appropriate information in advance of an Invitation to Tender being issued. The replacement solution will allow for the recording, management, understanding, and development of intelligence and should be modern, stable and future proof. This procurement will include all required software, project management, installation, testing, test reporting, migration data, licensing, support & maintenance, training and any other associated goods or services required to deliver the solution. Further information is contained within a Request for Information document which will be made available to Suppliers on request. The current estimated timescale for an ITT being issued is January 2027. This will be confirmed following the supplier engagement stage and assessment of Request for Information responses received from participating suppliers.

result.text: GENERAL This document is not a procurement announcement, not an Call for tenders, nor will its publication start a Tender Procurement Process. The purpose of this Pre-market consultation notice is to identify potential suppliers operating in the market and their offerings. Responding or not responding to this Pre-market consultation notice does not prevent participation in a possible future tender. This Pre-market consultation notice does not obligate the contracting authority to carry out an actual procurement procedure. All information presented in this Pre-market consultation notice is preliminary and indicative. Laurea University of Applied Sciences operates in five locations in the Uusimaa region in Finland. Laurea offers both bachelor’s and master’s degree studies but also open university studies, specialisation education and continuing education. The fields of study are Business Management, Information technology, Service business, Social Services, Nursing, Health Care and Hospitality Management. Laurea has approximately 9,900-degree students and approximately 13,000 Open UAS students per year as well as about 670 employees. PRELIMINARY SCOPE OF THE PROCUREMENT The scope of the procurement is a Software as a Service (SaaS) online exam proctoring system for Laurea UAS. The system must integrate with Laurea's learning platform (Canvas) and provide video and audio-based proctoring recorded and stored by the system. The procurement does not include a personal live monitoring service by the supplier or the use of artificial intelligence to monitor/check and identify suspected fraud. The procurement includes the deployment of the software service and support and maintenance services separately for each higher education institution. MARKET DIALOGUE The contracting authority reserves the right to engage in market dialogue with the responding companies regarding the planned procurement and the tender documents. In addition, the contracting authority reserves the right to conduct the potential market dialogue either in the form of written comments on the draft tender documents or through one-on-one meetings (via Teams or in person). The possibility to comment on the draft tender documents is preliminary planned to be arranged once before the publication of the final Call for tenders, regardless of the format. Any potential market dialogue will be conducted in English, and all related materials will be provided only in English. No compensation will be paid for participation in the market dialogue. Hansel Oy will act in a consultative role in the procurement process. REGISTRATION FOR THE MARKET DIALOGUE Potential service providers interested in participating in the dialogue are kindly asked to register via email as soon as possible and at the latest by 6 February 2026. Send the name and contact details of the interested service provider to maritta.riskila@laurea.fi. Use a reference "TD for an Online exam proctoring system" and the company name as the subject of the email. The service providers may register in Finnish or English.

Responding or not responding to this Pre-market consultation notice does not prevent participation in a possible future tender. This Pre-market consultation notice does not obligate the contracting authority to carry out an actual procurement procedure. All information presented in this Pre-market consultation notice is preliminary and indicative. Laurea University of Applied Sciences operates in five locations in the Uusimaa region in Finland. Laurea offers both bachelor’s and master’s degree studies but also open university studies, specialisation education and continuing education. The fields of study are Business Management, Information technology, Service business, Social Services, Nursing, Health Care and Hospitality Management. Laurea has approximately 9,900-degree students and approximately 13,000 Open UAS students per year as well as about 670 employees. PRELIMINARY SCOPE OF THE PROCUREMENT The scope of the procurement is a Software as a Service (SaaS) online exam proctoring system for Laurea UAS. The system must integrate with Laurea's learning platform (Canvas) and provide video and audio-based proctoring recorded and stored by the system. The procurement does not include a personal live monitoring service by the supplier or the use of artificial intelligence to monitor/check and identify suspected fraud. The procurement includes the deployment of the software service and support and maintenance services separately for each higher education institution. MARKET DIALOGUE The contracting authority reserves the right to engage in market dialogue with the responding companies regarding the planned procurement and the tender documents. In addition, the contracting authority reserves the right to conduct the potential market dialogue either in the form of written comments on the draft tender documents or through one-on-one meetings (via Teams or in person). The possibility to comment on the draft tender documents is preliminary planned to be arranged once before the publication of the final Call for tenders, regardless of the format. Any potential market dialogue will be conducted in English, and all related materials will be provided only in English. No compensation will be paid for participation in the market dialogue. Hansel Oy will act in a consultative role in the procurement process. REGISTRATION FOR THE MARKET DIALOGUE Potential service providers interested in participating in the dialogue are kindly asked to register via email as soon as possible and at the latest by 6 February 2026. Send the name and contact details of the interested service provider to maritta.riskila@laurea.fi. Use a reference "TD for an Online exam proctoring system" and the company name as the subject of the email. The service providers may register in Finnish or English.
