result.text: Hanover Housing Association has been providing housing and support services across Scotland for over forty years. Managing approximately 150 homes with an aspect of care, predominantly for older people, Hanover is committed to enabling tenants to live independently within their communities. Hanover provides housing with care and very sheltered housing services which can range from light touch interventions such as reminding tenants to take medication to helping tenants with daily tasks such as personal care. Lot 1: . Hanover has initiated a Care and Support Systems Review at senior management level to address challenges caused by varied case management practices, inefficient data handling, and outdated digital tools. Two critical areas of improvement have been identified: - Care Scheduling/Planning – modernising currently paper-based processes, ensuring person-centred care and real-time updates. Although a full eMAR system is not required, medication management is a large area requiring support. - Rota Management – replacing fragmented manual scheduling with a centralised, digital platform. Through this forthcoming procurement, Hanover aims to secure a solution that will: - Improve service quality and tenant engagement through modern, digital care planning. - Increase operational efficiency and staff satisfaction via streamlined rota management. - Enhance safety, compliance, and oversight of medication management. - Provide integrated reporting, dashboards, and mobile accessibility. - Support compliance with relevant regulatory frameworks. The service will operate within a framework of continuous improvement with which the service provider will be required to engage; bringing innovation, sharing ideas, and implementing improvement measures to increase operational effectiveness/efficiency and drive out waste.

result.text: One or more companies (bidding consortia) are being sought that, against the background of current social and political discussions, are capable of advising and supporting the UBSKM and the Abarbeitungskommission in all their thematic fields in a manner that is sensitive to communication and effective. Contract commencement is planned from 01. July 2027. The framework agreement is initially to be concluded until 30. June 2029. There is an option - subject to the availability of corresponding budgetary funds - to extend the agreement by a maximum until 30. June 2031. The budget framework is approx. 400.000 euros gross annually, accordingly the estimated purchase quantity for the planned contract duration is 1.600.000 euros gross. The maximum purchase limit is 1.800.000 euros gross. Upon reaching the maximum purchase limit, the framework agreement expires automatically. Central tasks: • Hosting of all websites of UBSKM and Commission, unless agreed otherwise (purchase quantity: approx. nine websites) • Editorial, content-related and technical support while ensuring ongoing topicality of the content and, where applicable, expansion to include relevant new content (purchase quantity: approx. nine websites) • Where applicable, setting up of satellite pages/microsites for individual projects (purchase quantity: one to three optional) • Revision of websites and their meaningful linking with the integration of online features, moving image and social media (purchase quantity: approx. nine websites) • Where applicable, creation of new websites or relaunch of the aforementioned websites taking into existing CDs into account (purchase quantity: one to two optional) • Consultancy with a view to the continuous further development of the websites taking modern usability standards into account (purchase quantity: approx. nine websites) • Implementation of multilingualism (foreign language, plain and/or easy language), ongoing maintenance in accordance with existing areas; translation work can be performed by external service providers (purchase quantity: two to three websites) • Development of interactive elements as well as various features (such as the setting up of chats, galleries, interactive participatory offerings, etc.) (purchase quantity: approx. nine websites) • Tracking of visitor numbers, where applicable access figures/downloads of documents, building upon this, consultancy for the optimisation of the websites (purchase quantity: approx. nine websites) • Measures from the SEO, SEA and GEO areas (purchase quantity: approx. nine websites) • In-depth knowledge regarding accessibility (in accordance with BITV) and data protection (GDPR) is required; the steering and implementation of accessibility can be performed by external service providers (purchase quantity: approx. nine websites) • Implementation and integration of live streams (purchase quantity: approx. once to twice per year on one website) • Implementation and hosting of survey tools such as LimeSurvey (purchase quantity: one account)

parts.source: Gesucht wird/werden ein oder mehrere Unternehmen (Bietergemeinschaften), die vor dem Hintergrund tagesaktueller gesellschaftlicher und politischer Diskussionen in der Lage ist/sind, die UBSKM und die Aufarbeitungskommission in allen ihren Themenfeldern kommunikativ sensibel und effektiv zu beraten und zu unterstützen. Der Auftragsbeginn ist ab 01. Juli 2027 geplant. Die Rahmenvereinbarung soll zunächst bis 30. Juni 2029 geschlossen werden. Es besteht - vorbehaltlich der Verfügbarkeit entsprechender Haushaltsmittel - die Option, die Vereinbarung maximal bis zum 30. Juni 2031 zu verlängern. result.text: The Universitätsklinikum Heidelberg (UKHD) is one of the largest and most renowned medical centres in Germany. Every year, approximately 80.000 patients receive inpatient and semi-inpatient treatment in its specialist clinics, and more than 1.000.000 patients are cared for on an outpatient basis. The Heidelberg campus unites scientific institutes and clinics of the UKHD, offers rich opportunities for cooperation with the life science and humanities faculties of the University, and simultaneously maintains established co-operations with internationally renowned non-university large-scale research institutions. The increasing complexity of and growing demands on the IT infrastructure in healthcare require reliable and efficient management of the IT landscape. In the context of the UKHD, it is of decisive importance that operational and clinical applications run constantly available and without faults in order to ensure optimal patient care and smooth operation. Lot LOT-0001: Provision of implementation, project and operational services for IT applications in the hospital environment. As part of this procurement procedure, the University Hospital is issuing a framework agreement for the provision of support services in IT application management (anticipated) from 1 February 2027 for the following 4 years (planned) incl. extension options. A transition that is as gradual as possible to transfer the services from operations outsourced from the existing provider to an external service provider is planned for the period Q1/Q2 2027. The complete takeover of the provision of all contractual services into regular operations is to take place by 01.07.2027 at the latest. The Centre for Digitalisation and Information Technology (ZDI) of the Universitätsklinikum Heidelberg is operationally divided into individual areas. Supported by contractors as external service providers, they assume end-to-end responsibility regarding the IT of the respective core processes of the contracting authority in order to be able to ensure secure and stable operation, but also the further development of IT performance. Directly affected by the tender and the procurement subject are the areas for Operational Information Systems (BIS), for Hospital Information Systems (KIS), for Integration, Special Systems and Archiving (ISA) as well as directly the ZDI itself. The scope of the tender covers the service requirements of the client for operational services in application management. This includes, in particular, smooth application operation, the rapid and permanent rectification of incidents and problems, as well as releases, upgrades and updates in coordination with the client. Furthermore, this encompasses other supportive project services that are in a direct or close substantive connection with the aforementioned operational services. The future contractor is expected to provide comprehensive and holistic services within the framework of a managed service in order to implement the client's requirements regarding IT architecture, IT security and IT service integration. The integration of IT services based on the ITIL v4 framework must be provided holistically for all specialist areas. In this context, the client will manage the contractor(s) and provide the IT hardware required at the client's locations as well as some of the required software licences.

parts.source: Das Universitätsklinikum Heidelberg (UKHD) gehört zu den größten und renommiertesten medizinischen Zentren in Deutschland. Jedes Jahr werden in dessen Fachkliniken circa 80.000 Patienten voll- und teilstationär behandelt und mehr als 1.000.000 Patienten ambulant betreut. Der Heidelberger Campus vereint wissenschaftliche Institute und Kliniken des UKHD, bietet reichhaltige Möglichkeiten der Zusammenarbeit mit lebens- und geisteswissenschaftlichen Fakultäten der Universität und hält gleichzeitig etablierte Kooperationen mit international renommierten außeruniversitären Großforschungseinrichtungen bereit. Die zunehmende Komplexität und die steigenden Anforderungen an die IT-Infrastruktur im Gesundheitswesen erfordern eine zuverlässige und effiziente Verwaltung der IT-Landschaft. Im Kontext des UKHD ist es von entscheidender Bedeutung, dass die betrieblichen und klinischen Anwendungen stets verfügbar und störungsfrei laufen, um eine optimale Patientenversorgung und einen reibungslosen Betrieb zu gewährleisten. Lot LOT-0001: Erbringung von Implementierungs-, Projekt- und Betriebsleistungen für IT-Anwendungen im Krankenhausumfeld. Im Rahmen dieses Vergabeverfahrens schreibt das Universitätsklinikum einen Rahmenvertrag zur Erbringung von Unterstützungsleistungen im IT-Applikationsmanagement (voraussichtlich) ab dem 1. Februar 2027 für die folgenden 4 Jahren (geplant) inkl. Verlängerungsoptionen aus. Eine möglichst schrittweise Transition zur Überführung der Leistungen aus dem bestehenden an einen externen Dienstleister ausgelagerten Betrieb ist für den Zeitraum Q1/Q2 2027 geplant. Die vollständige Übernahme der Erbringung aller vertragsgegenständlichen Leistungen in den Regelbetrieb soll spätestens zum 01.07.2027. Das Zentrum für Digitalisierung und Informationstechnologie (ZDI) der Universitätsklinikum Heidelberg wird operativ in einzelne Bereiche unterteilt. Sie übernehmen unterstützt durch Auftragnehmer als externe Dienstleistungserbringer die Ende-zu-Ende-Verantwortung in Bezug auf die IT der jeweiligen Kernprozesse des Auftraggebers, um einen sicheren und stabilen Betrieb, aber auch die Weiterentwicklung der IT-Leistung sicherstellen zu können. Direkt von der Ausschreibung und dem Vergabegegenstand betroffen sind die Bereiche für Betriebliche Informationssysteme (BIS), für Krankenhaus-Informationssysteme (KIS), für Integration, Spezialsysteme und Archivierung (ISA) sowie direkt das ZDI selbst. Mit dem Ausschreibungsumfang wird der Servicebedarf des Auftraggebers von Betriebsleistungen im Applikationsmanagement abgedeckt. Dies beinhaltet insbesondere den reibungslosen Applikationsbetrieb, das schnelle und dauerhafte Beheben von Incidents und Problems sowie Releases, Upgrades und Updates in Abstimmung mit dem Auftraggeber. Außerdem umfasst dieser weitere unterstützende Projektleistungen, welche im direkten oder nahen inhaltlichen Zusammenhang mit den vorgenannten Betriebsleistungen stehen. Dabei wird von dem zukünftigen Auftragnehmer eine umfassende und ganzheitliche Erbringung der Leistungen im Rahmen eines Managed Service erwartet, um die Anforderungen des Auftraggebers hinsichtlich der IT-Architektur, IT-Sicherheit und IT-Service Integration umzusetzen. Die Integration der IT-Services auf Basis des ITIL v4-Frameworks müssen ganzheitlich für alle Fachbereiche bereitgestellt werden. Der Auftraggeber wird in diesem Zusammenhang den bzw. die Auftragnehmer steuern und die an den Standorten des Auftraggebers benötigte IT-Hardware sowie einen Teil der benötigten Softwarelizenzen beistellen.

result.text: The aim of the project is to obtain an overall overview of the embedded operating systems used in the vehicle (including virtualisation environments) and an assessment of their cybersecurity properties. This is to include the operating conditions (hardware platforms, access options to control units, etc.) and the interaction of the operating systems within the overall vehicle architecture. In addition to examining the systems currently on the market and relevant standards, an outlook on future developments is also to be provided. Requirements for vehicle operating systems from a cybersecurity perspective are to be derived from applicable regulations and standards. This includes requirements for testing within the scope of type approval and market surveillance. In addition to a literature search for the market overview, practical analyses are also to be carried out on various operating systems. These are to be performed as part of work package 5 (WP 5). The test catalogue to be drawn up must be practically verifiable here. The result of the project is a study comprising the aforementioned contents.

parts.source: Ziel des Projektes ist es, einen Gesamtüberblick über die im Fahrzeug eingesetzten eingebetteten Betriebssysteme (einschließlich Virtualisierungsumgebungen) und eine Bewertung der Cybersicherheitseigenschaften zu erhalten. Es sollen dabei die Einsatzbedingungen (Hardwareplattformen, Zugriffsmöglichkeiten auf Steuereinheiten usw.) und das Zusammenspiel der Betriebssysteme im Rahmen der Gesamtfahrzeugarchitektur einbezogen werden. Neben der Betrachtung der aktuell auf dem Markt befindlichen Systeme und einschlägiger Standards soll auch ein Ausblick auf die zukünftigen Entwicklungen gegeben werden. Anforderungen an Fahrzeug-Betriebssysteme aus Cybersicherheitssicht sollen aus den gültigen Regulierungen und Standards abgeleitet werden. Dies schließt Anforderungen an Prüfungen im Rahmen der Typgenehmigung und Marktüberwachung ein. Neben einer Quellenrecherche für den Marktüberblick sollen auch praktische Analysen an verschiedenen Betriebssystemen durchgeführt werden. Diese sollen im Rahmen des Arbeitspakets 5 (AP 5) durchgeführt werden. Der zu erstellende Prüfkatalog soll hier praktisch verifiziert werden können. Ergebnis des Projekts ist eine Studie, die die oben genannten Inhalte umfasst.

result.text: As part of the "C-Roads" project (CRG-3), a replacement for the analogue-radio-based public transport priority system for motor omnibuses is to be tested. Unlike the predecessor project "LOGIN" (Optimal traffic signal control in local public transport), in which a proof of concept for C-ITS-based public transport priority could be provided with the participation of various research partners, C-Roads relies on production-ready hardware available on the market. In addition, integration into the existing ITCS/control system of IVU Traffic Technologies AG (IVU) is to take place, for example for the visualisation of signal timing forecasts. ÜSTRA has applied for grants for this from the European Climate, Infrastructure and Environment Executive Agency (CINEA), which were approved by a grant notification dated 16 October 2024. result.text: The European Centre for Medium Range Weather Forecasts (ECMWF) invites Tenders for the future acquisition of an Advanced Hierarchical Data Storage Management System. The ITT seeks proposals from Tenderers for licensing and support services for an advanced hierarchical data storage management system and related consultancy services. The aim is to enter into a long-term contract for the procurement of these services, include commissioning, training of ECMWF staff and supporting the solution over the lifetime of the contract. Full information is available on ECMWF’s eProcurement Portal which will is accessible via https://procurement.ecmwf.int/. Further details of the scope and overview of the procurement are provided below: ECMWF’s data archive is based on HPSS (High Performance Storage System) software and underpinned by large capacity disk and automated tape library infrastructure. Overall HPSS holds 1.5 Exabytes of data and the expectation is that by the end of 2032 they will have grown to hold well over 4 Exabytes and by the end of 2035, well over 8 Exabytes. HPSS is primarily used by two applications, both developed at ECMWF; MARS and ECFS: MARS, the Meteorological Archival and Retrieval System, provides access to a powerful abstraction engine that allows the thousands of registered users to access the meteorological data that has been collected or generated at ECMWF for more than 40 years. ECFS, the ECMWF Common File System, provides users with a logical view of a seemingly very large file system and is used for data in formats that are not suitable for storing in MARS. The archives are very busy, most of their activity is responding to read workloads from the HPC systems. However, around 620TB of new data is being added every day, and it is expected that daily growth will be close to 1.5PB following the introduction of the new HPC in 2027. Further details on activity and existing equipment will be provided in the ITT. The intention is to determine whether to remain with HPSS or to migrate to a new storage solution, whichever provides the most compelling case based on long-term growth potential, stability and pricing. ECMWF is seeking to enter a long-term relationship with a vendor to supply a license and provide 24/7 support for the software. The initial installation will be at the Centre's Bologna data centre in Italy. If there are optimisation benefits, it will be possible to supply hardware in this tender, however the main intention is for this to be predominantly a software solution, with commodity hardware being purchased elsewhere. The ITT has an estimated value exceeding 3 million EUR. Further details are available in the ITT volumes accessible via the ECMWF procurement portal. The closing date for the Tender, as indicated in Volume IA is Thursday, 05 March 2026, 15:00 (UK Local time).

result.text: Region Syddanmark is facing the acquisition of a new solution regarding Speech to Text. The project is in an early start-up phase, and Region Syddanmark wishes to conduct a market dialogue to gain knowledge of the market, so that a future tender best possible embraces the market's capabilities seen in relation to Region Syddanmark's needs, while at the same time any risks are uncovered so that they can be mitigated. The result of the market dialogue is to be used, among other things, to assess what is common practice in the market, so that Region Syddanmark has the best possible basis to structure the tender on and prepare the tender documents on the basis of. Initially, Region Syddanmark wants a written response to a number of questions. These can be found on Ethics via the link in this notice. Based on the responses received, Region Syddanmark expects to conduct a further round of market dialogue either on a written basis or by holding meetings. This will be notified in more detail. Region Syddanmark encourages potential suppliers to participate in the market dialogue. Answers to the market dialogue must be submitted via Ethics no later than 5 January 2026, at 12.00. The response must be submitted in Danish, but any other documents, e.g. product descriptions or similar, can be submitted in English.

parts.source: Region Syddanmark står over for at skulle anskaffe en ny løsning vedrørende Tale til Tekst. Projektet er tidligt i opstartsfasen, og Region Syddanmark ønsker at gennemføre en markedsdialog for at opnå kendskab til markedet, så et kommende udbud bedst muligt favner markedets formåen set i forhold til Region Syddanmarks behov, samtidig med at eventuelle risici bliver afdækket, så de kan mitigeres. Resultatet af markedsdialogen skal bl.a. bruges til at vurdere, hvad der er gængs i markedet, således at Region Syddanmark har det bedst mulige grundlag at tilrettelægge udbuddet på samt udarbejde udbudsmaterialet på baggrund af. Indledningsvist ønsker Region Syddanmark en skriftlig besvarelse af en række spørgsmål. Disse findes på Ethics via linket i denne bekendtgørelse. På baggrund de indkomne svar forventer Region Syddanmark at gennemføre en yderligere markedsdialogrunde på enten et skriftligt grundlag eller ved afholdelse af møder. Dette vil varsles nærmere. Region Syddanmark opfordrer potentielle leverandører til at deltage i markedsdialogen. Besvarelser af markedsdialogen bedes afleveret via Ethics senest den 5. januar 2026, kl. 12.00. Besvarelsen bedes afleveres på dansk, men eventuelle øvrige dokumenter, f.eks. produktbeskrivelse eller lignende, kan afleveres på engelsk.

result.text: NOTE! This is not a call for tenders, procurement notice or prior information notice, but a notice of the initiation of market dialogue as part of procurement planning. Espoon kaupunki has initiated the preparation of a local detailed planning software procurement and invites suppliers to a market dialogue. The subject of the procurement is a CAD software solution compliant with the Act on the Built Environment Information System (431/2023) and the requirements of the Ryhti system for the production of data model-based local detailed plans. The local detailed planning software solution is used for the design and drawing of local detailed plans at various stages of the planning process together with other systems in use within the Urban Environment sector of the City of Espoo. In addition to this, the software solution is used for traffic planning and making 3D models. In traffic planning, precise street geometries are drawn up and it is ensured that sufficient space is reserved for traffic arrangements and intra-block functions, such as parking and service traffic. Traffic planning carries out general planning, street maps and cross-sections, among other things, as well as the design of street grading, in connection with which longitudinal and cross-section profiles are produced. The drawing up of a local detailed plan is a long-standing process lasting an estimated 2-5 years. Fewer than 100 local detailed plans are completed in Espoo per year, and approximately 90% of them also include traffic plans. In a single local detailed planning project, there are on average approx. 100 documents related to local detailed planning and traffic planning, which are stored mainly in the document management system. The local detailed planning and traffic planning software solution has a total of approximately 65 users. Currently, local detailed planning and traffic planning at the City of Espoo is carried out mainly using Bentley design software. In addition to this, local detailed planning data is managed in the Trimble Locus municipal information system and the document management system. In the future, the permanent plan identifier will be obtained from the Ryhti system into Trimble Locus's plan register, from where it is copied into the local detailed plan drawing software. Local detailed plans are transferred as a JSON file transfer to Trimble Locus Cloud for export to the Ryhti system. Plans are transferred to the Ryhti system from Trimble Locus, where the management of plan objects and plan amendments as well as the transfer of plan attachments to the Ryhti system also take place. The management of reference data utilised in the drawing up of traffic plans will continue to take place in the document management system. The resulting street maps and other material supporting planning will be attached as part of the local detailed plan description annex material and transferred to the Ryhti system. Swept path analyses are carried out using AutoTURN software. The subject of the procurement is a system to be procured as a service, provisionally in accordance with the following: - Ready-to-use CAD software with user licenses - Local detailed plan Ryhti objects database - Service deployment and customisation for Espoo - Application maintenance services - Additional procurement opportunities related to the subject of the procurement - System further development and expert services according to Espoo's needs. The functionalities of the local detailed planning and traffic planning software solution are aimed to cover, among other things, the following: - Tasks related to local detailed planning design - Production of data model-based local detailed plans - Traffic planning - Making 3D models illustrating plans - Making 3D models of traffic planning streets - Ryhti objects database - File-based transfer of plan data to the Ryhti system via the Trimble Locus municipal information system - Reporting - Management of user roles and user rights. The purpose of the market dialogue is to survey the market situation concerning the local detailed planning software procurement. Espoon kaupunki wants to hear potential suppliers' thoughts on the implementation of the procurement procedure and the preparation of the invitation to tender. MARKET DIALOGUE SCHEDULE The market dialogue will provisionally take place in two phases: 1. Via Teams provisionally during weeks 43-44. The contracting authority reserves the right to invite a maximum of 4 suppliers to the first phase of the dialogue based on the request for information responses. The aim of this first phase is to familiarise oneself with companies and products on the market, for example, through suppliers' company and product presentations and demos. 2. Tender documents will be sent to those who registered for the market dialogue for commenting during an estimated period between November 2026 and January 2027. The second phase of the market dialogue will take place electronically. Written material will be sent to all those registered for the market dialogue for review. The dialogue of the second phase will cover the content of the preliminary invitation to tender, requirement specifications and contractual terms. The contracting authority reserves the right to hold additional dialogues as the market survey progresses. The contracting authority's aim is to launch the actual procurement procedure in the spring of 2027 and the implementation project provisionally in the autumn of 2027, such that the new system can be put into use in the spring of 2028.

parts.source: HUOM! Tämä ei ole tarjouspyyntö, hankintailmoitus tai ennakkoilmoitus vaan ilmoitus markkinavuoropuhelun käynnistämisestä osana hankinnan suunnittelua. Espoon kaupunki on käynnistänyt asemakaavoituksen ohjelmistohankinnan valmistelun ja kutsuu toimittajia markkinavuoropuheluun. Hankinnan kohteena on rakennetun ympäristön tietojärjestelmästä annetun lain (431/2023) ja Ryhti-järjestelmän vaatimusten mukainen cad-ohjelmistoratkaisu tietomallipohjaisten asemakaavojen tuotantoon. Asemakaavoituksen ohjelmistoratkaisua käytetään asemakaavojen suunnitteluun ja piirtämiseen kaavoitusprosessin eri vaiheissa yhdessä muiden Espoon kaupungin Kaupunkiympäristön toimialalla käytössä olevien järjestelmien kanssa. Tämän lisäksi ohjelmistoratkaisua käytetään liikennesuunnitteluun ja 3D-mallinnusten tekemiseen. Liikennesuunnittelussa laaditaan tarkkoja katugeometrioita ja varmistetaan, että liikennejärjestelyille sekä korttelin sisäisille toiminnoille, kuten pysäköinnille ja huoltoliikenteelle, on varattu riittävästi tilaa. Liikennesuunnittelu tekee mm. yleissuunnittelua, katukarttoja ja poikkileikkauksia sekä katujen tasauksen suunnittelun, jonka yhteydessä tehdään pituus- ja paalupoikkileikkaukset. Asemakaavan laadinta on pitkään kestävä prosessi, joka kestää arviolta 2-5 vuotta. Asemakaavoja valmistuu Espoossa alle 100 kpl vuodessa, ja niistä noin 90% sisältää myös liikennesuunnitelmia. Yhdessä asemakaavaprojektissa asemakaavoituksen ja liikennesuunnittelun dokumentteja on keskimäärin n. 100 kpl ja ne on tallennettu pääosin dokumentinhallintajärjestelmään. Asemakaavoituksen ja liikennesuunnittelun ohjelmistoratkaisulla on yhteensä noin 65 käyttäjää. Tällä hetkellä asemakaavoitusta ja liikennesuunnittelua tehdään Espoon kaupungilla pääosin Bentleyn suunnitteluohjelmistoilla. Asemakaavoituksen tietoja hallitaan tämän lisäksi myös Trimble Locus-kuntatietojärjestelmässä sekä dokumentinhallintajärjestelmässä. Jatkossa pysyvä kaavatunnus saadaan Ryhti-järjestelmästä Trimble Locuksen kaavarekisteriin, josta se kopioidaan asemakaavan piirto-ohjelmaan. Asemakaavat siirretään json-tiedostosiirtona Trimblen Locus Cloudiin Ryhti-järjestelmään vientiä varten. Kaavat siirretään Ryhti-järjestelmään Trimble Locuksesta, jossa tapahtuu myös kaavakohteiden ja kaavamuutosten hallinta sekä kaavojen liitetiedostojen siirto Ryhti-järjestelmään. Liikennesuunnitelmien laadinnassa hyödynnettävien referenssiaineistojen hallinta tapahtuu jatkossakin dokumentinhallintajärjestelmässä. Tuotoksena syntyvät katukartat ja muu kaavoitusta tukeva aineisto liitetään osaksi asemakaavan selostuksen liiteaineistoa ja siirretään Ryhti-järjestelmään. Ajouratarkastelut tehdään AutoTURN-ohjelmistolla. Hankinnan kohteena on palveluna hankittava järjestelmä alustavasti seuraavan mukaisesti: - CAD-valmisohjelmistot käyttöoikeuksineen - Asemakaavan Ryhti-kohteiden tietokanta - Palvelun käyttöönotto ja sovitus Espoolle - Sovellusylläpitopalvelut - Hankinnan kohteeseen liittyvät lisähankintamahdollisuudet - Järjestelmän jatkokehitys- ja asiantuntijapalvelut Espoon tarpeen mukaan. Asemakaavoituksen ja liikennesuunnittelun ohjelmistoratkaisun toiminnallisuuksien tavoitellaan kattavan mm. seuraavat: - Asemakaavoituksen suunnitteluun liittyvät tehtävät - Tietomallipohjaisen asemakaavan tuotanto - Liikennesuunnittelu - Kaavoja havainnollistavien 3D-mallinnusten tekeminen - Liikennesuunnittelun katujen 3D-mallinnusten tekeminen - Ryhti-kohteiden tietokanta - Kaavatietojen tiedostopohjainen siirto Ryhti-järjestelmään Trimble Locus-kuntatietojärjestelmän kautta - Raportointi - Käyttäjäroolien ja käyttöoikeuksien hallinta. Markkinavuoropuhelun tarkoituksena on kartoittaa asemakaavoituksen ohjelmistohankintaa koskevaa markkinatilannetta. Espoon kaupunki haluaa kuulla mahdollisten toimittajien ajatuksia kilpailutuksen toteutuksesta ja tarjouspyynnön valmistelusta. MARKKINAVUOROPUHELUN AIKATAULU Markkinavuoropuhelu käydään alustavasti kahdessa vaiheessa: 1. Teamsin välityksellä alustavasti viikoilla 43-44. Hankintayksikkö varaa oikeuden kutsua tietopyyntövastausten perusteella enintään 4 toimittajaa vuoropuhelun ensimmäiseen vaiheeseen. Tämän ensimmäisen vaiheen tavoitteena on tutustua markkinoilla oleviin yrityksiin sekä tuotteisiin esimerkiksi toimittajien yritys- ja tuote-esittelyjen sekä demojen avulla. 2. Markkinavuoropuheluun ilmoittautuneille lähetetään tarjousasiakirjoja kommentoitavaksi arviolta marraskuun 2026 ja tammikuun 2027 välisenä aikana. Markkinavuoropuhelun toinen vaihe käydään sähköisesti. Kirjallinen materiaali lähetetään kaikille markkinavuoropuheluun ilmoittautuneille tutustuttavaksi. Toisen vaiheen vuoropuhelu käydään alustavan tarjouspyynnön sisällöstä, vaatimusmäärittelystä ja sopimusehdoista. Hankintayksikkö varaa oikeuden lisävuoropuheluihin markkinakartoituksen edetessä. Hankintayksikön tavoitteena on käynnistää varsinainen kilpailutus keväällä 2027 ja käyttöönottoprojekti arviolta syksyllä 2027 siten, että uusi järjestelmä saadaan käyttöön keväällä 2028.

result.text: KS Digital has, on behalf of the Committee Council, established a work group that shall review how the municipal sector can cooperate on the future childhood and school administration systems (OAS/SAS), digital ecosystems and possibilities for future joint procurements. The work includes both education and school administrative systems (OAS/SAS), the digital eco-system included in them, and how the municipal sector can strengthen coordination, standardisation and any future joint procurements. As a part of this work, we invite the supplier market to a dialogue. We want insight into how the market assesses developments in the area, what technological and organisational possibilities exist, and how the municipal sector and the supplier market together can contribute to a more open, coherent and future orientated digital ecosystem for the education sector. The work is anchored in a reported need from the municipalities for stronger coordination in relation to requirements, standardisation, architecture, data sharing, procurements and further development of digital systems in the area of adolescence. The aim is not to define a new system, but to assess how the municipal sector together can contribute to a more coherent, open and future orientated digital ecosystem for children, youths, guardians, employees, managers, owners and associated services. An important goal is also to contribute to a supplier market that supports this development, through clear common needs, standards and framework conditions that stimulate innovation and sustainable development of the systems. The work includes both education and school administrative systems (OAS/SAS), the digital eco-system included in them, and how the municipal sector can strengthen coordination, standardisation and any future joint procurements. As a part of this work, we invite the supplier market to a dialogue. We want insight into how the market assesses developments in the area, what technological and organisational possibilities exist, and how the municipal sector and the supplier market together can contribute to a more open, coherent and future orientated digital ecosystem for the education sector. The work is anchored in a reported need from the municipalities for stronger coordination in relation to requirements, standardisation, architecture, data sharing, procurements and further development of digital systems in the area of adolescence. The aim is not to define a new system, but to assess how the municipal sector together can contribute to a more coherent, open and future orientated digital ecosystem for children, youths, guardians, employees, managers, owners and associated services. An important goal is also to contribute to a supplier market that supports this development, through clear common needs, standards and framework conditions that stimulate innovation and sustainable development of the systems. Information on the market dialogue including registration will be in the tender https://ksdigital.no/markedsdialoger-og-anskaffelser/

result.text: This notice is a prior information notice regarding a forthcoming procurement of service design expert services by the City of Tampere. The purpose of the notice is to inform the market of the upcoming procurement and to invite operators to participate in market consultation. This notice does not constitute a call for tenders. The City of Tampere has had framework arrangements for service design expert services in place during 2014–2017, 2018–2022 and 2023–2026. The city plans to establish a new framework arrangement for the years 2027–2030 upon the expiry of the current contract period on 12/2026. The City of Tampere has a need for service design expert services across many different development targets. The contract will be widely used by almost all city units. In the years 2023-2025 the combined annual value of orders has been approximately 400 000 €. We invite operators interested in the procurement to participate in market consultation, the purpose of which is to discuss the procurement object, its definition and preliminary plans. The views of potential tenderers are very important to us in preparing the procurement, and we are happy to hear new ideas regarding both the content of the procurement and its implementation method. We welcome views on, among other things: • preliminary lot division • service description • minimum requirements • quality evaluation criteria Companies registered for the market consultation will be invited to an event held via Teams on Wednesday 11.3.2026 at 13:30-14:50, where plans related to the procurement will be presented. Questions and comments concerning the procurement may also be raised at the event. Operators interested in the procurement are requested to register by Mon 9.3 at 16:00. Registration takes place via the City of Tampere Supplier Service at https://toimittaja-asiointi.tampere.fi/. Participation in the event requires registration in the service in question. There are a few questions during registration which we ask you to answer.

parts.source: Tämä ilmoitus on ennakkotietoilmoitus tulevasta Tampereen kaupungin palvelumuotoilun asiantuntijapalveluiden hankinnasta. Ilmoituksen tarkoituksena on informoida markkinoita tulevasta hankinnasta sekä kutsua toimijoita osallistumaan markkinakartoitukseen. Tällä ilmoituksella ei pyydetä tarjouksia. Tampereen kaupungilla on ollut käytössä palvelumuotoilun asiantuntijapalveluiden puitejärjestelyt vuosina 2014–2017, 2018–2022 ja 2023–2026. Kaupunki suunnittelee uuden puitejärjestelyn perustamista vuosille 2027–2030 nykyisen sopimuskauden päättyessä 12/2026. Palvelumuotoilun asiantuntijapalveluille on Tampereen kaupungilla tarvetta monissa erilaisissa kehittämiskohteissa. Sopimusta käyttävät laajasti lähes kaikki kaupungin yksiköt. Vuosina 2023-2025 tilausten yhteenlaskettu vuosittainen arvo on ollut noin 400 000 €. Kutsumme hankinnasta kiinnostuneet toimijat osallistumaan markkinakartoitukseen, jonka tarkoituksena on käydä keskustelua hankinnan kohteesta, sen määrittämisestä ja alustavista suunnitelmista. Hankinnan valmistelussa mahdollisten tarjoajien näkemykset ovat meille hyvin tärkeitä ja kuulemme mieluusti uusia ideoita niin hankinnan sisältöön kuin toteutustapaankin liittyen. Toivomme näkemyksiä muun muassa: • alustavaan osakokonaisuusjakoon • palvelukuvaukseen • vähimmäisvaatimuksiin • laadun vertailuperusteisiin Markkinakartoitukseen ilmoittautuneet yritykset kutsutaan keskiviikkona 11.3.2026 klo 13:30-14:50 Teamsin välityksellä järjestettävään tilaisuuteen, jossa hankintaan liittyviä suunnitelmia esitellään. Tilaisuudessa voi myös esittää kysymyksiä ja kommentteja hankintaan liittyen. Hankinnasta kiinnostuneita toimijoita pyydetään ilmoittautumaan viimeistään ma 9.3. klo 16:00. Ilmoittautuminen tapahtuu Tampereen kaupungin Toimittajapalvelun kautta osoitteesta https://toimittaja-asiointi.tampere.fi/. Tapahtumaan osallistuminen vaatii rekisteröitymisen kyseiseen palveluun. Ilmoittautumisen yhteydessä on muutama kysymys, joihin toivomme teidän vastaavan.

result.text: Caledonian Sleeper Limited (CSL) is seeking to establish a multi-supplier Operational Support Engineering Framework to provide a compliant, agile and cost-effective route for the procurement of reactive, planned and minor engineering and operational support services required across CSL operations. Lot 1: MECHANICAL AND GENERAL ENGINEERING. This lot covers mechanical and general engineering support services required to support CSL operations, including: mechanical fitting and repair light fabrication welding, including coded welding where relevant ancillary equipment repair temporary mechanical arrangements repair or modification of non-integrated mechanical systems basic plant and equipment support where within CSL-controlled scope non-OEM HVAC mechanical support metalwork, brackets, supports and local fabricated solutions mechanical support to temporary operational fixes. Exclusions Specific to Lot 1 rolling stock mechanical systems covered under TSSSA depot mechanical systems owned by Alstom or site owner safety-critical traction, brake or other OEM systems Lot 2: ELECTRICAL AND CONTROLS. This lot covers electrical and controls support services, including: low voltage electrical works temporary electrical arrangements non-integrated lighting systems control panel works on non-OEM assets fault finding on approved systems cable routing and connection for temporary arrangements temporary power distribution arrangements minor electrical support to CSL-controlled ancillary assets non-integrated controls support local system modifications outside OEM scope. Exclusions Specific to Lot 2: OEM-controlled rolling stock electrical systems depot fixed electrical infrastructure HV systems unless expressly stated and properly authorised works already within Alstom or CAF responsibility Lot 3: PLUMBING AND WELFARE. This lot covers plumbing and welfare-related operational support, including: plumbing repairs to CSL-controlled systems minor drainage support leak response welfare facility supports where within CSL commissioning authority temporary water arrangements repair or replacement of localised pipework or fittings in approved scope response to water ingress or similar operational issues temporary welfare service continuity arrangements hygiene related support associated with welfare systems. Exclusions Specific to Lot 3: depot-wide plumbing infrastructure owned by site owner integrated train plumbing systems under TSSSA major building services works Lot 4: SPECIALIST ENGINEERING SERVICES. This lot covers specialist support services, including: non-destructive testing specialist inspections corrosion treatment or assessment temporary works design engineering assessment services lifting support and related specialist advice specialist technical investigations reporting and assurance support on defined interventions specialist measurement and testing services local engineering assurance where required. Exclusions Specific to Lot 5: OEM certification work beyond supplier competence or authority services reserved to another contract or statutory body services requiring a separate regulated procurement due to value or strategic nature Lot 5: DIGITAL AND DATA SUPPORT. This lot covers digital and data support services, including: data extraction from approved sources data cleansing and transformation creation of structured datasets support to predictive maintenance initiatives support to condition monitoring initiatives support to third party analytics providers engaged by CSL set up of non-integrated monitoring devices or sensors dashboard or reporting support directly related to operational use cases data handling support linked to engineering or operational investigations technical support to improve data usability for CSL decision making. Exclusions Specific to Lot 6: unauthorised access to OEM restricted systems modification of CAF or Alstom systems without approval large-scale software development or enterprise platforms not suited to this Framework Lot 6: EMERGENCY RESPONSE SERVICES. This lot covers emergency response and incident support services, including: 24/7 call-out support urgent operational interventions rapid deployment to stabilise or mitigate service-affecting issues emergency temporary works immediate support to restore operational continuity urgent attendance for fault investigation outside restricted scope emergency logistics and mobilisation provision of on-call resources to support operational continuity urgent support to containment, isolation or temporary workaround activity. Exclusions Specific to Lot 6: emergency works falling wholly within CAF or Alstom contractual responsibility blue light or statutory emergency services functions uncontrolled instruction of works without CSL authorisation

result.text: The objective of the procurement is a framework agreement concerning the supply (purchase, rental, or subscription) of standard software, the maintenance associated with the standard software, and related services for Dataport's own/internal requirements and the requirements for customers/sponsors of Dataport within the scope of commercial transactions. Standard software is software that has already been developed and not programmed for an individual customer. In contrast, custom software, which is not part of this procurement, is software specially developed or programmed for a specific customer. The contract period of this framework agreement begins on 01.01.2027 and has a duration of up to 4 years (2 years with a twice-renewable option for 12 months each). The execution of the procurement procedure is carried out by Dataport in order to meet its own and customer requirements. The maximum value that must already be stated in the EU notice for framework agreements is 150 % of the awarded contract value. I.e. the contracting authority will call off services from this framework agreement up to a maximum value of 150% of the total tender sum.

parts.source: Ziel der Vergabe ist eine Rahmenvereinbarung über die Beschaffung (Kauf, Miete oder Subscription) von Standardsoftware, die zur Standardsoftware dazugehörige Pflege und damit zusammenhängende Leistungen für Dataport eigene/interne Bedarfe und die Bedarfe für Kunden/Träger von Dataport im Rahmen des Handelsgeschäfts. Bei Standardsoftware handelt es sich um bereits entwickelte und nicht für einen einzelnen Kunden programmierte Software. Im Gegensatz dazu handelt es sich bei Individualsoftware, die nicht Bestandteil dieser Vergabe ist, um speziell für einen bestimmten Kunden zu entwickelnde bzw. zu programmierende Software. Die Vertragslaufzeit dieses Rahmenvertrages beginnt am 01.01.2027 und hat eine Laufzeit von bis zu 4 Jahren (2 Jahre mit zweimaliger Verlängerungsoption um jeweils 12 Monate). result.text: The subject matter of the procurement is the procurement and implementation of an Extended Detection & Response (XDR) solution, with the aim of significantly increasing IT security through modern detection and response mechanisms and, in particular, identifying advanced threats early and addressing them effectively. Lot LOT-0001: Extended Detection & Response (XDR) solution. Klinikum Esslingen operates an extensive IT infrastructure with numerous IT endpoints, including PCs, thin clients and servers. In addition, there are networked medical devices (IoMT) and building management systems (BMS), which are not, however, the subject of this tender. The endpoint security currently in use is based on a signature-based basic solution (Sophos) that does not provide advanced functions such as behavioural analysis or Endpoint Detection & Response (EDR). The project pursues the following strategic and operative goals: • Replacement of the existing signature-based endpoint security with an XDR solution featuring behavioural analysis, machine learning and forensic analysis capability in accordance with the state of the art • Establishment of complete endpoint visibility and control for all IT endpoints (clients and servers) of Klinikum Esslingen • Activation of Sophos Synchronized Security: real-time communication between endpoint agents and the existing Sophos XGS Firewall for automated network isolation of compromised endpoints • Creation of forensic analysis capabilities: continuous endpoint telemetry recording, root-cause analysis and threat hunting across all endpoints • Activation of cross-domain correlation (XDR): linking endpoint events with firewall, email, cloud and identity data sources as well as preparing the MDR service connection • Fulfilment of regulatory requirements from NIS-2 and GDPR regarding endpoint security as well as orientation towards the state of the art (B3S Gesundheit) • Support for vulnerability management through endpoint-based vulnerability visibility

parts.source: Gegenstand der Vergabe ist die Beschaffung und Implementierung einer Extended Detection & Response (XDR)‐Lösung, mit dem Ziel, die IT‐Sicherheit durch moderne Erkennungs‐ und Reaktionsmechanismen signifikant zu erhöhen und insbesondere fortschrittliche Bedrohungen frühzeitig zu identifizieren sowie effektiv zu behandeln. Lot LOT-0001: Extended Detection & Response (XDR) – Lösung. Das Klinikum Esslingen betreibt eine umfangreiche IT‐Infrastruktur mit zahlreichen IT‐Endpunkten, darunter PCs, Thin Clients und Server. Ergänzend bestehen vernetzte Medizinprodukte (IoMT) sowie Systeme der Gebäudeleittechnik (GLT), die jedoch nicht Gegenstand dieser Ausschreibung sind. Die derzeit eingesetzte Endpoint‐Security basiert auf einer signaturbasierten Basislösung (Sophos), die keine erweiterten Funktionen wie Verhaltensanalyse oder Endpoint Detection & Response (EDR) bereitstellt. Das Projekt verfolgt folgende strategische und operative Ziele: • Ablösung der bestehenden signaturbasierten Endpoint-Security durch eine XDR-Lösung mit Verhaltensanalyse, Machine Learning und forensischer Analysefähigkeit gemäß dem Stand der Technik • Herstellung vollständiger Endpoint-Sichtbarkeit und -Kontrolle für alle IT-Endpunkte (Clients und Server) des Klinikums Esslingen • Aktivierung von Sophos Synchronized Security: Echtzeit-Kommunikation zwischen Endpoint-Agents und der bestehenden Sophos XGS Firewall zur automatisierten Netzwerkisolierung kompromittierter Endpunkte • Schaffung forensischer Analysefähigkeiten: kontinuierliches Endpoint-Telemetrie-Recording, Root-Cause-Analyse und Threat Hunting über alle Endpunkte hinweg • Aktivierung der Cross-Domain-Korrelation (XDR): Verknüpfung von Endpoint-Events mit Firewall-, E-Mail-, Cloud- und Identity-Datenquellen sowie Vorbereitung der MDR-Service-Anbindung • Erfüllung der regulatorischen Anforderungen aus NIS-2 und DSGVO hinsichtlich Endpoint-Security sowie Orientierung am Stand der Technik (B3S Gesundheit) • Unterstützung des Schwachstellenmanagements durch Endpoint-basierte Vulnerability-Sichtbarkeit

result.text: Statped requires assistance to develop a new web-based version of the ICT learning tool Sarepta. The assistance includes the development of functionality that is currently located in the Text and Picture Book modules of the existing Sarepta. The new solution shall carry forward central functionality and pedagogical principles from the current Sarepta, while being established on a modern and future-oriented technical platform. The solution shall be a web application and published as open source. It shall be facilitated so that the solution can be managed and further developed by Statped after the assistance has been completed. Statped intends to enter into a contract with one supplier. A more detailed description of the assistance and the requirements for the new solution follows from SSA-B Appendix 1 ("The Customer's description of the assistance"), with a comprehensive description of Sarepta in the appendix's Attachment 1 ("Sarepta User Manual"). The procurement of assistance for the development of a new web-based version of Sarepta (base delivery) has an estimated maximum limit of 2,0 million NOK excl. VAT. The estimate is not to be considered binding for Statped. Statped reserves the right, in the event of any later needs, to order additional deliveries in the form of further development or new modules and functions during the project. Such deliveries will in that case be in addition to the base delivery and can be agreed upon via a change agreement.

parts.source: Statped har behov for bistand til å utvikle en ny webbasert versjon av IKT-læremiddelet Sarepta. Bistanden omfatter utvikling av funksjonalitet som i dagens Sarepta ligger i modulene Tekst og Billedbok. Den nye løsningen skal videreføre sentral funksjonalitet og pedagogiske prinsipper fra dagens Sarepta, samtidig som den etableres på en moderne og fremtidsrettet teknisk plattform. Løsningen skal være en webapplikasjon og publiseres som åpen kildekode. Det skal legges til rette for at løsningen kan forvaltes og videreutvikles av Statped etter at bistanden er avsluttet. Statped har til hensikt å inngå kontrakt med én leverandør. Nærmere beskrivelse av bistanden og kravene til den nye løsningen følger av SSA-B Bilag 1 («Kundens beskrivelse av bistanden»), med utfyllende beskrivelse av Sarepta i bilagets Vedlegg 1 («Bruksanvisning Sarepta»). Anskaffelsen av bistand til utvikling av ny webbasert versjon av Sarepta (grunnleveransen) har en estimert maksimalramme på 2,0 millioner kroner ekskl. mva. Anslaget er ikke å anse som forpliktende for Statped. Statped forbeholder seg samtidig retten til, ved eventuelle senere behov, å bestille tilleggsleveranser i form av videreutvikling eller nye moduler og funksjoner underveis i prosjektet. Slike leveranser vil i så fall komme i tillegg til grunnleveransen og kan avtales ved endringsavtale.

result.text: The Foundation Bergwerk Rammelsberg, Old Town of Goslar and Upper Harz Water Management, in short Foundation UNESCO World Heritage in the Harz is responsible for the promotion, communication, conservation and coordination of the UNESCO World Cultural Heritage in the Western Harz and was founded 2012 on the initiative of the contracting authority. In order to increase the effectiveness, efficiency and transparency of operational work and to position the foundation for the future in harmony with its shareholders, a comprehensive reorganising and strategic realignment is to take place. Taking into account the proper and economical use of public funds, the primary objective is to remain the reliable fulfilment of the foundation's tasks - the promotion, communication, conservation and coordination of the UNESCO World Cultural Heritage in the Western Harz. It is intended to have the ongoing business of the Harz Heritage Foundation, which is already largely geared towards the upcoming reorganization and is ready, comprehensively reviewed regarding its existing strategy, task distribution and working method, organizational structure and processes. The goal is to increase the effectiveness, efficiency and transparency of operational work and to position the foundation for the future in harmony with its shareholders. In addition, there is a discussion as to whether the existing legal form, the applicable statutes and the foundation's purpose are still appropriate or should be adapted in the course of the strategic realignment.

parts.source: Die Stiftung Bergwerk Rammelsberg, Altstadt von Goslar und Oberharzer Wasserwirtschaft", kurz Stiftung UNESCO-Welterbe im Harz ist verantwortlich für die Förderung, Vermittlung, Erhaltung und Koordination des UNESCO-Weltkulturerbes im Westharz und wurde 2012 auf Initiative des Auftraggebers gegründet. Um die Wirksamkeit, Effizienz und Transparenz der operativen Arbeit zu erhöhen und die Stiftung im Einklang mit ihren Gesellschaftern zukunftsfähig aufzustellen soll eine umfassende Umorganisation und strategische Neuausrichtung erfolgen. Unter Berücksichtigung der ordnungsgemäßen und wirtschaftlichen Verwendung der öffentlichen Mittel soll oberstes Ziel die verlässliche Erfüllung der Stiftungsaufgaben - die Förderung, Vermittlung, Erhaltung und Koordination des UNESCO-Weltkulturerbes im Westharz bleiben. Es ist beabsichtigt, das laufende Geschäft der Stiftung Welterbe Harz, welches bereits weitestgehend auf die anstehende Reorganisation ausgerichtet und bereit ist, ihre bestehende Strategie, Aufgabenverteilung und Arbeitsweise, Organisationsstruktur und Prozesse umfassend überprüfen zu lassen. Ziel ist es, Wirksamkeit, Effizienz und Transparenz der operativen Arbeit zu erhöhen und die Stiftung im Einklang mit ihren Gesellschaftern zukunftsfähig aufzustellen. Darüber hinaus steht zur Diskussion, ob die bestehende Rechtsform, die geltende Satzung und der Stiftungszweck noch angemessen sind oder im Zuge der strategischen Neuausrichtung angepasst werden sollten.

result.text: NIS-2-compliant transformation of OT systems cooling supply area Lot LOT-0001: Modernisation of automation and network technology water treatment works.. The subject of the tender is the renewal and modernisation of the automation, visualisation and network technology in two water treatment works and one elevated reservoir. The aim of the measure is to upgrade the systems to the state of the art, taking into account the requirements for cybersecurity, network segmentation, availability and operational reliability in the environment of NIS-2 requirements. The scope of services includes the planning, supply, installation, parametrisation, programming, migration, commissioning and documentation of the automation technology, including the replacement of existing PLC systems, decentralised automation components and the required communication and telecontrol interfaces. The replacement of the automation technology will take place on the basis of the Siemens system platform using current SIMATIC S7-1500 controllers, including engineering in the TIA Portal. The central process visualisation is to be supplied, configured and put into operation ready for use on the basis of Siemens WinCC Unified. The visualisation is to be integrated with the automation systems to be newly constructed and the existing technical equipment. Furthermore, the service includes the renewal and expansion of the industrial network infrastructure, including active network components, network segmentation, secure communication connections, remote access solutions and the components required to implement a modern IT/OT security concept. The service also includes the migration of existing functions and process data, the execution of factory, function and data point tests, commissioning during ongoing plant operation, training of operating personnel and the handover of complete as-built and inventory documentation. The specification of the Siemens system platform is intended to ensure a uniform system architecture within the client's facilities, guarantee compatibility with existing standards, secure the ability of operating personnel to perform their own maintenance, and avoid additional training, licensing and interface expenses. The targeted system continuity serves in particular to ensure long-term operational and investment security as well as the implementation of a consistent cybersecurity concept. Special requirements arise from the maintenance of the water supply during the conversion measures. The contractor must plan and execute the work in such a way that necessary operational interruptions are limited to the technically necessary minimum. Comparable references from water treatment works, wastewater facilities or other critical infrastructure facilities are required.

parts.source: NIS-2-konforme Transformation der OT-Systeme Versorgungsbereich Kühlung Lot LOT-0001: Modernisierung der Automatisierungs- und Netzwerktechnik Wasserwerke.. Gegenstand der Ausschreibung ist die Erneuerung und Modernisierung der Automatisierungs-, Visualisierungs- und Netzwerktechnik in zwei Wasserwerken sowie einem Hochbehälter. Ziel der Maßnahme ist die Ertüchtigung der Anlagen auf den aktuellen Stand der Technik unter Berücksichtigung der Anforderungen an Cybersecurity, Netzwerksegmentierung, Verfügbarkeit und Betriebssicherheit im Umfeld der NIS-2-Anforderungen. Der Leistungsumfang umfasst die Planung, Lieferung, Montage, Parametrierung, Programmierung, Migration, Inbetriebnahme und Dokumentation der Automatisierungstechnik einschließlich der Erneuerung vorhandener SPS-Systeme, dezentraler Automatisierungskomponenten sowie der erforderlichen Kommunikations- und Fernwirkschnittstellen. Die Erneuerung der Automatisierungstechnik erfolgt auf Basis der Siemens-Systemplattform unter Verwendung aktueller SIMATIC S7-1500 Steuerungen einschließlich Engineering im TIA Portal. Die zentrale Prozessvisualisierung ist auf Basis Siemens WinCC Unified zu liefern, zu projektieren und betriebsfertig in Betrieb zu nehmen. Die Visualisierung ist mit den neu zu errichtenden Automatisierungssystemen sowie den vorhandenen technischen Einrichtungen zu integrieren. Weiterhin umfasst die Leistung die Erneuerung und Erweiterung der industriellen Netzwerkinfrastruktur einschließlich aktiver Netzwerkkomponenten, Netzwerksegmentierung, sicherer Kommunikationsverbindungen, Fernzugriffslösungen sowie der zur Umsetzung eines zeitgemäßen IT-/OT-Sicherheitskonzeptes erforderlichen Komponenten. Die Leistung beinhaltet ferner die Migration bestehender Funktionen und Prozessdaten, die Durchführung von Werks-, Funktions- und Datenpunkttests, die Inbetriebnahme unter laufendem Anlagenbetrieb, die Schulung des Betriebspersonals sowie die Übergabe einer vollständigen Revisions- und Bestandsdokumentation. Die Vorgabe der Siemens-Systemplattform erfolgt zur Sicherstellung einer einheitlichen Systemarchitektur innerhalb der Anlagen des Auftraggebers, zur Gewährleistung der Kompatibilität mit bestehenden Standards, zur Sicherung der Eigenwartungsfähigkeit durch das Betriebspersonal sowie zur Vermeidung zusätzlicher Schulungs-, Lizenz- und Schnittstellenaufwände. Die angestrebte Systemkontinuität dient insbesondere der langfristigen Betriebs- und Investitionssicherheit sowie der Umsetzung eines durchgängigen Cybersecurity-Konzeptes. Besondere Anforderungen ergeben sich aus der Aufrechterhaltung der Wasserversorgung während der Umbaumaßnahmen. Der Auftragnehmer hat die Arbeiten so zu planen und auszuführen, dass notwendige Betriebsunterbrechungen auf das technisch erforderliche Mindestmaß beschränkt werden. Vergleichbare Referenzen aus Wasserwerken, Abwasseranlagen oder sonstigen Anlagen der kritischen Infrastruktur werden vorausgesetzt.

result.text: Greater London government (the GLA Group) is accelerating AI adoption through a common approach to governance, capability and usage​. AI tools are already in use across the GLA group. We are looking to standardise our approach, guidance and governance. ​Our goal is to create the conditions for a well-governed and responsible adoption at scale The GLA Group is exploring the market for an external partner to work with us to shape our AI Adoption Programme cohesively ahead of delivery, in areas where external expertise would add great value to align our policies and co-design training, to responsibly support AI pilots and scale successful pilots across departments and organisations. ​ The requirement is expected to include: Develop and embed London AI principles in organisational policy:​ Develop London-specific AI principles common for the entire GLA Group based on the UK Government's AI Playbook. Embed these principles in each organisation's policies, (incl. those which are not AI-specific and in procurement standards) and operationalise these principles in our culture and practice to ensure responsible and innovative AI use.​ Envision and validate a 'to-be' position on AI best practice ensuring we lead by example on the recommendations in the London AI and Jobs Taskforce report (incl. using our role as an employer and procurer to shape AI adoption and workforce transition in London). Design and deliver a practical tiered training offer:​ For all staff, on what AI can do well, risks and responsibilities, everyday productivity uses and improving prompting.​ For specific teams targeted for having tasks apt for simplification from AI, tailored training on role-specific use cases, practical exercises, measuring benefits and feeding back potential projects and pilots.​ For leadership, organisational changes, strategic opportunities, governance and risk management. Support us in co-designing an operating model for the future of AI Adoption​: Co-design an evaluation framework to confirm which opportunities to pilot and which successful use cases to scale within and across organisations Lot 1: .

result.text: The objectives of this contract are: conversion of licences to S/4HANA; technical assessment, which allows for the definition of the provisioning of environments on the SAP RISE platform for the hosting of the various services that will be migrated to S/4HANA; support service for the licences migrated to S/4HANA. Licences that are not migrated will fall outside the scope of this contract; adoption of satellite cloud services, offered in SaaS mode, according to the needs of our users; establishment of a channel for the management of incidents and service requests in direct relation, that is, without intermediaries, with SAP as the infrastructure provider, whether on the RISE platform or the SaaS platform. The DGITC will be the owner of that channel with SAP. Expressly excluded from the scope of this contract is: the management of incidents and service requests by the contractor through the channel established with SAP, since they will be managed directly by the DGITC and its collaborators.

result.text: The U.S. Embassy Riyadh Public Diplomacy Section is accepting applications for a cooperative agreement to run the University-led Networks for Innovation, Technology, and Expertise (UNITE) program. UNITE will support approximately four to five applied project teams — university-industry partnerships between U.S. universities, U.S. companies or technical partners, and Saudi institutions — through project seed awards of up to $25,000 each to solve specific Saudi workforce and development gaps in high-demand strategic sectors, including Artificial Intelligence, critical minerals, cybersecurity, emerging technologies, and workforce development. Each project team will produce a U.S.-linked deliverable — such as a curriculum, module, technical roadmap, or standards briefs — that creates durable pathways for Saudi investment in American academic, workforce, and industry collaboration. Mission KSA will award a cooperative agreement to a single U.S. academic implementing partner to manage the portfolio. Each participating project team must provide a 1:1 cost-share match to ensure genuine institutional commitment and long-term viability.

The aim is to expand relations between Thuringia and Poland as well as to establish new and maintain existing business contacts with the country and the partner region of Malopolska. The conception of the trip and the programme will be carried out in coordination with the client, taking into account the following key data: a) Date of travel: CW 47, 17.-19.November 2026 b) Location: Krakow c) Objectives of the trip: Participants should be given the opportunity to identify new business opportunities and expand their activities on site. parts.source: Thüringen International plant eine Delegationsreise unter Leitung des Thüringer Ministerpräsidenten, Mario Voigt nach Polen. Die Delegation wird aus Vertretern der Politik sowie von Thüringer Unternehmen, Forschungseinrichtungen sowie anderen wirtschaftlichen Multiplikatoren bestehen. Ziel ist der Ausbau der Beziehungen zwischen Thüringen und Polen sowie die Etablierung neuer und die Pflege bestehender Wirtschaftskontakte zum Land und zur Partnerregion Malopolska. Die Konzeption der Reise und des Programms erfolgt in Abstimmung mit dem Auftraggeber unter Berücksichtigung folgender Eckdaten: a) Reisedatum: KW 47, 17.-19.November 2026 b) Durchführungsort: Krakau c) Ziele der Reise: Die Teilnehmer sollen die Gelegenheit erhalten, neue Geschäftschancen zu identifizieren und ihre Aktivitäten vor Ort auszubauen. Thüringer Unternehmern wird die Möglichkeit gegeben, bestehende und potenzielle Geschäftspartner und Multiplikatoren vor Ort zu treffen sowie in Polen ansässige Unternehmen kennenzulernen. Dabei sollen diese bei gemeinsamen Aktivitäten zur Kontaktanbahnung und -vertiefung unterstützt werden. d) Dauer des Aufenthalts: 2 Tage vor Ort (17. und 18.November 2026) e) Teilnehmer: Als Kalkulationsgrundlage für die Angebotserstellung ist von einer Teilnehmerzahl von 15 Personen für die Wirtschaftsdelegation und 10 Personen für die offizielle Delegation auszugehen. Die Teilnehmerakquise wird vom Auftraggeber (TI) durchgeführt. Es sollen überwiegend wirtschaftsnahe Forschungseinrichtungen und Unternehmen aus zu identifizierenden Schwerpunktbranchen eingeladen werden. Hinweis: Die angegebene Menge in der Anlage Preisblatt dient lediglich der Vergleichbarkeit der Kostenangebote. Ein Rechtsanspruch des Bieters auf die dort genannte Menge entsteht dadurch nicht. Der tatsächliche Umfang ist von der Anmeldung der zu akquirierenden Unternehmen abhängig und wird dem Auftragnehmer rechtzeitig mitgeteilt. Die o.g. Vorgaben entsprechen dem derzeitigen Planungsstand. Änderungen der Daten unter a), b) und e) sind vorbehalten. Vom Auftragnehmer wird erwartet, den Auftraggeber in Bezug auf alle nachfolgend aufgeführten Punkte zu beraten, das Programm im Einklang mit den Erfordernissen der Teilnehmenden und den Erwartungen des Auftraggebers zu konzipieren und umzusetzen. Weitere Informationen sind dem Dokument "Leistungsbeschreibung" zu entnehmen Lot LOT-0000: Inhaltliche Organisation und Durchführung der Delegationsreise nach Polen. THIS IS NOT A CONTRACT NOTICE OR A CALL FOR TENDERS BUT A REQUEST FOR INFORMATION FOR MARKET RESEARCH AND TECHNICAL DIALOGUE: Simulation system Subject and purpose of the request for information: The purpose of the request for information is to survey solutions available on the market and, in particular, companies that have the capability to design and implement a large-scale simulation system for the Contracting Authority's needs. The request for information is used to gather information for procurement planning. The Hippos area being built in Jyväskylä offers an international-level complex for physical activity, hobbies and sport. The area strengthens Jyväskylä's position as a centre for physical activity, elite sports, research and education. The Hippos Centre consists of four entities: Sports Centre, Competence Centre, Ice Sports Centre and the HipposPark car park. The Welfare Unit of Jyväskylä University of Applied Sciences is relocating to the 5 and 6 floors of the Competence Centre. Construction will begin in January 2026 and will be completed in late 2027. The commissioning of the premises is planned for August 2027. The subject of the procurement is a simulation system (AV system), which covers the simulation premises and learning premises on two floors as well as control rooms from which simulation situations and connections to various teaching premises are controlled. The simulation system is used to create simulation exercises resembling genuine interaction and customer situations for teaching purposes. The system enables the recording, saving and real-time control of situations. The objective of the request for information is to obtain information so that the planned procurement can be implemented as purposefully as possible. Responding to the request for information is not a prerequisite for participation in the subsequent procurement procedure and does not affect the tenderer's position in the procurement procedure. The matters presented in the request for information are preliminary and may change as the procurement preparations progress. This notice is a market survey used in the preparation of the procurement by Jyväskylä University of Applied Sciences. The contracting authority requests potential suppliers to respond through this request for information and to participate in one-to-one market dialogues. Participation is voluntary and no remuneration is paid for participating. The responses given and discussions held will be treated with complete confidentiality.

result.text: Heka is extensively renewing its information systems in the coming years. The most central objectives for all system development are improving the customer experience, digitising operating methods, and improving the quality of information supporting decision-making. The subject of this procurement is accounting and internal accounting, as well as accounts payable solutions, the related implementation project, and ongoing maintenance service. In addition, a budgeting system may be added to the procurement later based on a framework agreement. The solution package will be implemented at Heka and Heka's subsidiary, Kiinteistö Oy Laivalahdentori. The goal is a so-called off-the-shelf software solution that covers Heka's needs. The primary objective is to procure the solution as a cloud or SaaS service. The solution must enable flexible integrations with systems outside the procured solution. Systems already in use and the renewing solutions must function side-by-side as a whole, relying on the existing technical environment where necessary. It must be possible to transfer the data required in the solution from source systems and to source systems via a data warehouse. Some data may be transferred directly between the source system and the procured solution. The procured solution must enable the transfer of master data with a master data system outside the procurement in both directions. With this request for information, suppliers are invited to a market dialogue regarding questions related to the procurement. The goal of the request for information is to obtain comprehensive information regarding the procurement so that a potential call for tenders can be carried out as appropriately as possible. This request for information is not a call for tenders, and it does not bind Heka to publish a call for tenders later. The contracting authority does not commit to carrying out the call for tenders in the described manner. All information and requirements presented in the request for information and its attached materials regarding the planned procurement are still preliminary at this stage and may change. Responding to the request for information does not bind the supplier, and responding to the request for information is not a prerequisite for participating in a potential call for tenders to be published later. The contracting authority may use the information received through the request for information in the planning of the procurement. The information collected through the request for information will remain confidential. The goal is to launch the procurement procedure during the spring of 2026. A contract notice will be published regarding the procurement. We ask you to familiarise yourself with the attached appendices (01-02) and to respond to the questions presented in the "Questions" document (appendix 03). Please also indicate in the document whether you would be willing to present the solution you are offering via Teams. We ask you to send the completed "Questions" appendix 03 as well as the "Requirements" appendix 02 by 7.1.2026 at 15.00 by email to hankinnat@hekaoy.fi.

parts.source: Heka on lähivuosina uudistamassa tietojärjestelmiään laaja-alaisesti. Keskeisimmät tavoitteet kaikelle järjestelmäkehitykselle ovat asiakaskokemuksen parantaminen, toimintatapojen sähköistäminen ja päätöksentekoa tukevan informaation laadun parantaminen. Tämän hankinnan kohteena on kirjanpito ja sisäinen laskenta - sekä ostoreskontra -ratkaisut, niihin liittyvä käyttöönottoprojekti ja jatkuva ylläpitopalvelu. Lisäksi hankintaan voidaan myöhemmin liittää puitesopimuksen perusteella budjetointijärjestelmä. Ratkaisukokonaisuus otetaan käyttöön Hekassa ja Hekan tyttärellä Kiinteistö Oy Laivalahdentorilla. Tavoitteena on niin sanottu valmisohjelmisto-ratkaisu, joka kattaa Hekan tarpeet. Ensisijainen tavoite on hankkia ratkaisu pilvi- tai Saas-palveluna. Ratkaisun tulee mahdollistaa joustavat integraatiot hankittavan ratkaisun ulkopuolisiin järjestelmiin. Jo käytössä olevien järjestelmien ja uudistuvien ratkaisujen tulee toimia rinnakkain kokonaisuutena tukeutuen tarvittaessa olemassa olevaan tekniseen ympäristöön. Ratkaisussa tarvittavat tiedot lähdejärjestelmistä ja lähdejärjestelmiin tulee olla mahdollista siirtää tietovaraston kautta. Osa tiedoista saatetaan siirtää suoraan lähdejärjestelmän ja hankittavan ratkaisun välillä. Hankittavan ratkaisun tulee mahdollistaa perustietojen siirto hankinnan ulkopuolisen master data - järjestelmän kanssa molempiin suuntiin. Tällä tietopyynnöllä kutsutaan toimittajia markkinavuoropuheluun hankintaan liittyvistä kysymyksistä. Tietopyynnön tavoitteena on saada kattavasti hankintaa koskevaa tietoa, jotta mahdollinen tarjouskilpailu voidaan toteuttaa mahdollisimman tarkoituksenmukaisesti. Tämä tietopyyntö ei ole tarjouspyyntö, eikä se sido Hekaa julkaisemaan myöhemmin tarjouspyyntöä. Hankintayksikkö ei sitoudu toteuttamaan tarjouspyyntöä kuvatulla tavalla. Kaikki tietopyynnössä ja sen liitemateriaaleissa esitetyt suunnitteilla olevaa hankintaa koskevat tiedot ja vaatimukset ovat vielä tässä vaiheessa alustavia ja ne voivat muuttua. Tietopyyntöön vastaaminen ei sido toimittajaa, eikä tietopyyntöön vastaaminen ole edellytys mahdolliseen myöhemmin julkaistavaan tarjouskilpailuun osallistumiselle. Hankintayksikkö voi käyttää tietopyynnön kautta saamiaan tietoja hankinnan suunnittelussa. Tietopyynnöllä kerätyt tiedot säilyvät luottamuksellisina. Tavoitteena on käynnistää hankintamenettely kevään 2026 aikana. Hankinnasta tullaan julkaisemaan hankintailmoitus. Pyydämme tutustumaan oheisiin liitteisiin (01-02) ja vastaamaan "Kysymykset" -dokumentilla (liite 03) esitettyihin kysymyksiin. Ilmoittakaa dokumentille myös olisitteko halukkaita esittelemään tarjoamaanne ratkaisua Teamsin välityksellä. Pyydämme lähettämään liitteen 03 "Kysymykset" täytettynä sekä liitteen 02 "Vaatimukset" 7.1.2026 klo 15.00 mennessä sähköpostilla hankinnat@hekaoy.fi.
