result.text: A total of three lots are sought in the area of support - technical system administration. Lot 1: SAP Basis Support, Lot 2: Software Development Support, and Lot 3: Risk/Cont Software Development Support. Taking into account that LfA has outsourced the SAP operation of its ERP and BW systems to the SAP Cloud, SAP Basis Administration is responsible for the smooth operation of our SAP systems in close cooperation with SAP. Central tasks in the SAP Basis environment include the daily monitoring of the SAP landscape to ensure high-performance and error-free operation. Standard basis transactions are regularly checked for error messages - both directly in the relevant SAP transactions and on the basis of incoming system messages via email, or via active evaluation of reports in SAP for Me. Another essential component is the importation of hotfixes as well as SAP and LfA specialist releases to keep the systems constantly up to date and secure. This also includes the analysis, assessment, and processing of vulnerabilities in the Baramundi system to ensure sustainable IT security. Tasks in SAP Basis also include the operation and maintenance of SAP Solution Manager (e.g. importing security patches, creating new change cycles, analysing transport problems). New incoming tickets (incident, problem, and change management) are continuously processed. System and client copies are performed quarterly in cooperation with SAP, with the focus of LfA's activities being, on the one hand, the coordination of individual work packages, including the involvement of SAP peripheral systems, and, on the other hand, the follow-up work in the SAP systems.; - Analysis of requirements - Support of productive operations / support (error analysis and resolution) - Creation of IT concepts and test concepts - Implementation of customer-specific developments o Open Text Team Developer development o ABAP development o Pl/Sql developments o C# developments o Interfaces - Maintenance of the data model - Testing; - Software development for the RISK/CONT system - Interface programming for data provision for RISK/CONT from operational systems and data delivery from RISK/CONT to other dispositive systems - Creation of functional, IT, and test concepts - Clarification and coordination of functional requirements with the specialist department - Effort estimation for implementations resulting from functional requirements - Testing - Support of productive operations / support (error analysis and resolution) in the RISK/CONT system. - Creation and maintenance of documentation of technical systems and processes for the RISK/CONT system.

parts.source: Es werden insgesamt drei Lose im Bereich der Unterstützung - technische Systemadministration gesucht. Los 1: SAP Basis Unterstützung, Los 2: Unterstützung Softwareentwicklung und Los 3: Unterstützung Softwareentwicklung Risk/Cont Die SAP-Basis Administration verantwortet, unter der Beachtung, dass die LfA den SAP-Betrieb ihres ERP- sowie ihres BW-Systems in die SAP-Cloud ausgelagert hat, den reibungslosen Betrieb unserer SAP-Systeme in enger Zusammenarbeit mit der SAP. Zu den zentralen Aufgaben im SAP-Basis-Umfeld gehört die tägliche Überwachung der SAP-Systemlandschaft, um einen performanten und fehlerfreien Betrieb sicherzustellen. Dabei werden regelmäßig die Standard-Basis-Transaktionen auf Fehlermeldungen geprüft - sowohl direkt in den relevanten SAP-Transaktionen als auch anhand eingehender Systemmeldungen per E-Mail, bzw. über ein aktives Auswerten der Reports in SAP for Me. Ein weiterer wesentlicher Bestandteil ist das Einspielen von Hotfixes sowie SAP- und LfA-Fach-Releases, um die Systeme stets auf dem aktuellen und sicheren Stand zu halten. Dazu zählt auch die Analyse, Bewertung und das Abarbeiten von Schwachstellen im Baramundi-System, um die IT-Sicherheit nachhaltig zu gewährleisten. Zu den Aufgaben in der SAP Basis gehören zudem Betrieb und Wartung des SAP Solution Managers (z.B. Einspielen von Security-Patches, Anlage neuer Änderungszyklen, Analyse von Transportproblemen). Neue eingehende Tickets (Incident-, Problem- und Change-Management) werden kontinuierlich bearbeitet. result.text: The purpose of this RFI is to gather information on market capabilities and solutions for a forthcoming procurement exercise, to supply a Digital Telephony Service to Scottish General Practitioner (GP) Practices. This RFI is not a call for competition and does not form part of any evaluation or award process. Lot 1: . Thank you for registering an interest in this exercise. We are exploring options for digital telephony across all Scottish GP Practices. The Scottish Government's Primary Care Directorate is seeking to support General Practices across Scotland in the adoption of advanced cloud-based telephony solutions. This will improve patient access, enhance practice resilience and support modern ways of working, including remote and flexible service delivery. Suppliers are invited to demonstrate how their solutions can meet the needs of General Practice, align with the requirements set out in the Advanced Telephony Guidance, and support the transition from legacy analogue services ahead of the UK-wide PSTN switch-off in January 2027. We are asking all interested suppliers to complete this RFI questionnaire with responses to the requirements outlined below. The instructions for completing the surveys and the questions can be found below. This will help us to understand the market in terms of capabilities and technology, and potential approaches to delivering a digital telephony solution.

result.text: In the autumn of 2023, the HL Center decided to work towards a new permanent exhibition on the Holocaust. The new permanent exhibition will build upon and enhance the unique national responsibility that the HL Center holds for the dissemination of the history of the Holocaust and related themes. The HL Center has prepared an exhibition brief for the new exhibition. This document defines the overarching goals, principles for the development of the concept and thematic content, as well as the framework for the organisation and implementation of the project. It is intended to serve as the cornerstone for the realisation of the main project. A prequalification process will now be carried out, followed by a tender competition in the form of a competitive dialogue to select the exhibition provider who will collaborate with the centre in realising the new permanent exhibition. The main project is planned to begin in 2026, and the new exhibition is scheduled to open to the public in the autumn of 2028.

result.text: Maximus is undertaking a procurement exercise to identify a strategic Source-to-Pay (S2P) platform to support the ongoing transformation of procurement processes across the organisation. The solution will be expected to support an integrated procurement lifecycle, including: • Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) • Strategic Sourcing • Supplier Management • Procure-to-Pay (P2P) • Invoice Automation • Spend Analytics & Reporting SAP will remain the organisation's finance platform and system of record. The primary objectives of this procurement are to improve procurement governance, contract visibility, supplier management, user experience, process compliance and reporting capabilities while maintaining seamless integration with SAP. Key Evaluation Priorities The evaluation will place particular emphasis on: 1. SAP Integration Capability (Critical) 2. Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) 3. User Experience and Adoption 4. End-to-End Source-to-Pay Functionality 5. Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) Mandatory Requirements: Suppliers will be required to confirm compliance with all of the following mandatory requirements. Failure to meet any of these criteria may result in exclusion from the next stage of the procurement process. SAP Integration (Critical) • Proven, standard integration capability with SAP ECC and/or SAP S/4HANA, SAP by Design. • Ability to integrate core procurement and financial data. • Demonstrable customer references utilising SAP-integrated deployments. Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) • Provision of a mature Contract Lifecycle Management capability. • Support for contract repository, metadata management, approval workflows, version control and contract renewal management. • Ability to link contracts with suppliers, sourcing events and procurement activity. 3. Global Operating Model • Ability to support multiple countries, currencies, languages and tax jurisdictions. • Experience supporting global or multi-region organisations. 4. Security & Compliance • ISO 27001 certification / Cyber Essentials Plus • GDPR compliance. • Role-based access controls. • Audit logging and traceability of user activity. • Appropriate business continuity and disaster recovery arrangements. 5. Enterprise-Scale Experience • Demonstrated experience delivering S2P and/or P2P solutions for large enterprise organisations. • Ability to provide relevant customer references for organisations of comparable size and complexity. 6. Delivery & Support Capability • Availability of UK-based implementation and support resources. • Ability to provide ongoing support for global business operations. • Proven implementation methodology and support model. Supplier Response Suppliers are requested to confirm whether they meet each of the mandatory requirements outlined above and provide a brief summary of their relevant experience and capabilities.

result.text: Sensor-based route optimisation in waste disposal in the State Capital of Magdeburg Implementation and operation of an IT system Funded in the course of the Infrastructure Special Assets Act - Infra-SVG of the State of Saxony-Anhalt As public-law waste disposal authorities, municipalities and districts are responsible for efficient and resource-conserving processes in municipal waste management. To meet this responsibility even in times of staff shortages, the State Capital of Magdeburg is relying on the use of information and communication technology. Basic scope of tasks In the centre and the old town of Magdeburg, 436 litter bins are to be equipped with IoT sensors for fill-level monitoring. In addition to the procurement and installation of hardware to upgrade existing municipal litter bins, the operation and maintenance of an energy-efficient network infrastructure and the implementation of a software solution for route optimisation of waste collection rounds are also required. Dashboards or map views are to be provided to assist drivers during their waste collection round by showing how full a specific bin is. A flexible, web-based data interface of the software is also required, which enables future further development and integration with third-party systems and municipal smart city infrastructure. Es sollen Dashboards oder Kartenansichten bereitgestellt werden, die den Fahrern während ihrer Abfalltour eine Unterstützung bieten, indem angezeigt wird, wie voll eine bestimmte Tonne ist. Sensorgestützte Routenoptimierung in der Abfallentsorgung in der Landeshauptstadt Magdeburg Implementierung und Betrieb eines IT-Systems Gefördert im Zuge des Infrastruktur-Sondervermögensgesetztes - Infra-SVG des Landes Sachsen-Anhalts Als öffentlich-rechtliche Entsorgungsträger verantworten Kommunen und Landkreise effiziente und ressourcenschonende Prozesse in der Siedlungsabfallwirtschaft. Um dieser Verantwortung auch in Zeiten von Personalknappheit nachzukommen, setzt die Landeshauptstadt Magdeburg auf den Einsatz von Information- und Kommunikationstechnologie. Grundsätzlicher Aufgabenumfang Im Zentrum und der Altstadt Magdeburg sollen 436 Papierkörbe mit IoT-Sensorik zur Füllstandserfassung ausgestattet werden. Neben der Beschaffung und Installation von Hardware zur Aufrüstung bestehender, städtischer Papierkörbe, ist auch der Betrieb und Wartung einer energieeffizienten Netzinfrastruktur sowie die Implementierung einer Softwarelösung für die Routenoptimierung der Abfalltouren gefragt. Es sollen Dashboards oder Kartenansichten bereitgestellt werden, die den Fahrern während ihrer Abfalltour eine Unterstützung bieten, indem angezeigt wird, wie voll eine bestimmte Tonne ist. Ebenso ist eine flexible, webbasierte Datenschnittstelle der Software gefordert, die eine zukünftige Weiterentwicklung und eine Integration mit Drittsystemen und städtischer Smart City Infrastruktur ermöglicht.

result.text: Kent Fire and Rescue Service (KFRS) is exploring options for a Project Portfolio Management (PPM) solution to support the planning, management, oversight and reporting of projects and programmes across the organisation. KFRS is open to different solution and delivery models, including established Software as a Service (SaaS) products and Microsoft/Power Platform-based solutions. Please note: For the purposes of this market engagement, KFRS is only seeking responses in respect of solutions which are currently available for procurement through an existing Government Commercial Agency (GCA) framework (formerly CCS). Suppliers should identify the relevant framework, Lot (where applicable) and service/solution listing within their response. The purpose of this exercise is to undertake a short and proportionate test of the market before KFRS determines its procurement strategy and route to market. In particular, KFRS wishes to understand: •what potentially suitable solutions are available within or around the stated affordability envelope; •the broad alignment of available products with KFRS's functional and technical requirements; •the different solution and service models available and the respective responsibilities of KFRS and the supplier; •indicative licensing/subscription, implementation, support and ongoing configuration/development costs; •the extent to which solutions allow KFRS to retain appropriate control and portability of its organisational data; •any observations from the market which may help KFRS refine its requirements; and •the specific GCA/CCS framework, Lot and/or service listing through which the proposed solution can be procured. Nature of this Exercise This is a preliminary market engagement exercise and not a competitive procurement or invitation to tender. The functional and technical requirements provided with this brief represent KFRS's current understanding of its needs. They are being provided to give suppliers sufficient information to determine whether they have a product or solution that could potentially meet the requirement. Suppliers are not required to provide a detailed response against each individual requirement or complete the requirements schedules on a line-by-line basis. Responses will not be evaluated or scored as tender submissions. Instead, KFRS is seeking a brief, high-level response that will enable us to understand whether a proposed solution appears sufficiently aligned with our needs to warrant further exploration. KFRS would also welcome constructive feedback on the requirements themselves. This may include identifying areas which would benefit from clarification, or alternative approaches or current market capabilities which KFRS should consider. Please respond via the Kent Business Portal. Additional information: The contracting authority considers that this contract may be suitable for economic operators that are small or medium enterprises (SMEs). However, any selection of tenderers will be based solely on the criteria set out for the procurement.

rejected.text: The Norwegian Correctional Service shall procure parallel framework agreements for consultancy services. Consultants with experience within strategic consultancy, but not limited to: a) Strategy: scenario methodology and foresight, outside world analyses and strategy development b) Change management: Structured approach to leading individuals, teams and organisations from a current condition to a desired future condition. c) Performance management – some key words (not limited to, but relevant topics: process improvement, management tool/management system, target and result management, risk analyses and internal control. d) Reviews, analyses and evaluations: evaluation methodology and effect analyses. The Norwegian Correctional Service shall be more data driven and it needs more advanced analyses, predictive models, risk profile, prognoses etc., therefore there is a need for competence in data modelling and advanced analyses. e) Socio-economic analysis: methods for assessing and comparing the total costs and benefits of a measure for society as a whole. f) Cost estimation and uncertainty analysis: The process of calculating what a measure or project will cost, as well as assessing how secure or uncertain these estimates are and what factors can affect them. g) Profit planning/follow-up: Identifying, planning and ensuring that the expected gains from a measure or project are actually realised and measured over time. h) Innovation, design and service development: Need for competence in system design/management design in addition to service design i) AI: this means competence in AI and how the organisation can use this in an appropriate way. This also includes competence and experience on prerequisites and other consequences connected to implementation, from the technical to the more organisational sides. Competence/certification within recognised methods will be relevant. The sub-area covers the business perspective, and in some cases may overlap sub-area 2A.; Consultants with experience within operative management and consultancy services. The consultants shall contribute to the execution of deliveries in the form of, but not limited to: a) Project management: planning, organising, implementing and following-up a project in order to achieve defined goals within given frameworks for time, cost and quality. b) Management of development projects - competence in flexible methodology c) Alteration projects: manage and coordinate activities that shall carry out a planned change, with a focus on both technical deliveries and human factors such as involvement, communication and anchoring. d) Implementation project: ensure new systems, systems or processes in an organisation and ensure that they are implemented, anchored and used as planned. e) Digitalisation projects - The Norwegian Correctional Service shall digitalise several internal work processes and externally between actors in the criminal case chain as well as management cooperation partners. f) Preliminary projects and concept reviews: reviews the needs, assesses alternative solutions and recommends the most appropriate concept before the main project starts. g) Test management: Planning, managing and following-up test activities to ensure that a system or product fulfils the requirements and functions as expected. The Norwegian Correctional Service has started extensive work of renewing the ICT system and as a result of this need, both top competence and the capacity to carry out small and large projects. Competence/certification within recognised project implementation methods (e.g. the Project Wizard, Prince2 and/or other methods/framework) and flexible methods will be relevant.; Consultants with technical and developer competence, including, but not limited to: a) Architecture (business, business, security, information, application architecture) b) Development, further development and maintenance c) Utilisation of large data, advanced analysis and AI/machine learning. d) Integrations, data exchange, machine interface, API e) Design and user friendliness f) Technical assistance for infrastructure g) IT security and privacy h) Cloud journey - The Norwegian Correctional Service needs expertise in cloud architecture and specifically the Microsoft Cloud Technology platform It is important to ensure the correct architecture and sufficient security as an important part of the renewal of ICT systems in progress. This must be taken care of in the development as well as in the management of new and old ICT systems. Consultants shall have competence and experience within the use of tools and methods within DevOps, including: Automation, continual integration and delivery (CI/CD), version control, infrastructure such as code, continuous monitoring, configuration of cloud services etc. Particularly important for the customer ́s existing systems is competence within the Microsoft platform in its entirety, where the majority of all development and maintenance is based on .Net.; The Norwegian Correctional Service shall enter into parallel framework agreements for the procurement of consultancy services as stated in the tender documentation. Examples of competence areas: a) project management b) flexible management and management of development projects c) Process Management d) alteration management e) introduction projects and digitalisation projects. f) preliminary project and concept reviews g) test management; Examples of competence areas a) performance, information, application and security architecture b) system development, further development and maintenance c) service design, system design and management design d) integrations, APIs and data exchange e) data analysis, big data, AI and machine learning. f) design and user friendliness g) DevOps, CI/CD, automation and infrastructure as code h) cloud architecture and cloud journey i) Microsoft platform and .NET j) AI-consultancy for the implementation, management and consequences.;

rejected.text: Hazard Management System [HMS] The Fraport AG, headquartered in Frankfurt am Main, is a leading global airport operator. The company was founded in 1924 and operates Frankfurt Airport, one of the world's most significant air transport hubs. Furthermore, Fraport is involved in the management and operation of several other airports worldwide. At the Frankfurt am Main site, Fraport currently operates the software (SW) ELDIS III from the company eurofunk as a KRITIS and LuftSIG-relevant system in the security control centre, serving as an operational command system for the works fire brigade, emergency medical services, and security, as well as a workflow system in the integrated passenger flow control centre. The system currently in use is foreseeably reaching its technical limits, making a replacement necessary. The functions to be replaced by new systems include operational command and resource deployment, hazard management, and the provision of geoinformation in the form of a geoproxy. Maintenance, servicing, service, and support are also required for all new systems. Applicants must sign a confidentiality agreement provided by Fraport (see information documents) and submit it together with the application to participate. Following the competition, an indicative tender round will be conducted as part of the tender phase, which will then be followed by one or more binding tender rounds. Within the indicative tender round, bidders may propose changes to the contract, the service description, and the annexes. Fraport will decide on their acceptance or rejection. The contracting authority hereby gives notice that, in the event of being invited to submit a binding tender, the contractor must mandatorily provide the following evidence: 1. All personnel deployed in the project and for all maintenance, service, and support activities must be German-speaking at least at level B2 according to the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR) and must be provided from a time zone of UTC +0 to +3. 2. Proof of full access to the control of development resources and unrestricted authority to modify and expand the offered software and hardware. Due to the importance of the overall system to be procured for maintaining flight operations and the strictly mandatory framework schedule, Fraport may withdraw from the entire contract if the contractor culpably fails to provide, or fails to provide in accordance with the contract, services marked as "already available" in terms of hardware and software functions after the conclusion of the contract. The scope includes the delivery, agile (additional) development, commissioning with migration of legacy systems for a new hazard management system, training of the staff of the Fraport AG, as well as maintenance, service, and support services. The contracting authority hereby gives notice that, in the event of being invited to submit a binding tender, the contractor must mandatorily provide proof of a certificate for the hazard management system according to VdS 3534 and, furthermore, provide a concept demonstrating that the system is capable of handling at least 450.000 detector groups and an average of 96.000 messages to be processed per day.

parts.source: Gefahrenmanagementsystem [GMS] Die Fraport AG, mit Hauptsitz in Frankfurt am Main, ist ein weltweit führender Flughafenbetreiber. Das Unternehmen wurde 1924 gegründet und betreibt den Flughafen Frankfurt, eines der bedeutendsten Luftverkehrsdrehkreuze der Welt. Darüber hinaus ist Fraport an der Verwaltung und dem Betrieb von mehreren anderen Flughäfen weltweit beteiligt. Der Fraport betreibt am Standort Frankfurt am Main aktuell die Software (SW) ELDIS III der Fa. eurofunk als KRITIS und LuftSIG relevantes System in der Sicherheitsleitstelle mit den Dienstbereichen Werksfeuerwehr, Rettungsdienst sowie Security als Einsatzleitsystem und in der Integrierten Passagierflußleitstelle als Workflowsystem. Das aktuell im Einsatz befindliche System stößt absehbar an seine technischen Grenzen, so dass eine Ablösung notwendig ist. Die mit neuen Systemen abzulösenden Funktionen umfassen dabei die Einsatzleit- und Kräftedisposition, das Gefahrenmeldermanagement und die Bereitstellung von Geoinformationen in Form eines Geoproxy. Für alle neuen Systeme wird auch Wartung, Instandhaltung, Service und Support gefordert. Die Bewerber müssen eine von Fraport bereitgestellte Vertraulichkeitsvereinbarung (siehe informatorische Unterlagen) unterzeichnen und zusammen mit dem Teilnahmeantrag einreichen. Nach dem Teilnahmewettbewerb wird im Rahmen der Angebotsphase zunächst eine indikative Angebotsrunde durchgeführt, auf die dann eine oder mehrere verbindliche Angebotsrunden folgen. Innerhalb der indikativen Angebotsrunde können Änderungsvorschläge an Vertrag, Leistungsbeschreibung und Anhängen durch die Bieter angebracht werden. Fraport entscheidet über deren Annahme oder Ablehnung. Der Auftraggeber weist schon jetzt darauf hin, dass der Auftragnehmer im Falle der Aufforderung zur Abgabe eines verbindlichen Angebots zwingend die folgenden Nachweise zu erbringen hat: 1. Alle im Projekt und allen Wartung, Service und Supportleistung eingesetzte Personen sind deutschsprachig mindestens auf dem Niveau B2 gem. des europäischen Referenzrahmens für Sprachen (GER) und werden aus einer Zeitzone UTC +0 bis +3 zur Verfügung gestellt. 2. Nachweis eines vollumfänglichen Zugriff auf die Steuerung der Entwicklungsressourcen und uneingeschränkte Berechtigung zur Veränderung und Erweiterung der angebotenen Soft- und Hardware. Aufgrund der Bedeutung des vorliegend zu beschaffenden Gesamtsystems für die Aufrechterhaltung des Flugbetriebs zwingend notwendig einzuhaltenden Rahmenterminplan, kann Fraport vom gesamten Vertrag zurückzutreten, wenn der Auftragnehmer zum Vertragsschluss als "bereits verfügbar" gekennzeichnete Leistungen im Sinne von Hard- und Softwarefunktionen schuldhaft nach Vertragsschluss nicht oder nicht vertragsgemäß erbringt. Der Umfang umfasst die Lieferung, agile (Zusatz-)entwicklung, Inbetriebnahme mit Migration der Altsysteme eines neuen Gefahrenmanagementsystem, die Schulung der Mitarbeiter der Fraport AG sowie Wartungs-, Service- und Supportleistungen. Der Auftraggeber weist schon jetzt darauf hin, dass der Auftragnehmer im Falle der Aufforderung zur Abgabe eines verbindlichen Angebots zwingend den Nachweis eines Zertifikates des Gefahrenmanagementsystem nach VdS 3534 zu erbringen hat und darüber hinaus ein Konzept zu liefern, dass das System in der Lage ist, mindestens 450.000 Meldergruppen und durchschnittlich 96.000 zu verarbeitende Meldungen am Tag bewältigen kann.

result.text: Type 1 diabetes (T1D) is a complex disease involving interactions among many different cell types, tissues, organs and biological processes. Genetics, the environment, and lifestyle all play a role in disease development and progression. Over the past two decades, the National Institute of Diabetes and Digestive and Kidney Diseases (NIDDK) has supported major T1D research consortia covering basic, translational, and clinical research. Each consortium has focused on different aspects of T1D, such as specific organs, stages of disease or clinical outcomes. Together, these consortia have collected large longitudinal and multimodal datasets using standardized protocols and coordinated studies. While individual consortia have improved our understanding of specific areas, combining their work offers a rare opportunity to see how different biological processes interact to drive T1D development and progression. This integrated view can answer fundamental questions about T1D biology that cannot be answered using individual datasets or studies alone. Recent advances in artificial intelligence (AI) now make it possible to integrate these complementary datasets and study T1D across various tissues, disease stages, and biological levels. Building on these resources, NIDDK will support a coordinated, milestone-driven research project to answer fundamental questions about T1D biology and accelerate the development of personalized medicine. The project will combine multimodal human pancreas and clinical datasets to better understand how biological processes interact as T1D develops and progresses. The research will generate new insights into T1D biology, help us understand the different forms and stages of T1D, identify biomarkers, and inform new approaches for disease prevention, intervention, and treatment. To support the research, the project will develop and test advanced multimodal AI models. It will also develop AI-enabled research workflows, new methods to integrate data, and privacy-preserving synthetic datasets.

result.text: The subject of the contract is operational IT consultancy services; these include, in particular, advice, assessment, investigation and support for the conceptual design of the following topic areas: • Automation at the Federal Employment Agency • Human Friendly Automation at the Federal Employment Agency • Enabling the organisation for automation topics • The BA's IT in the hybrid multicloud • Reorganisation • Agile collaboration • HR digitalisation and transformation of HR IT systems and processes Lot LOT-0000: IT_TeTraoBe_2026. The subject of the procurement is a quota of consultancy support, without an obligation to purchase, within the framework of projects and line activities with an IT focus. The operational consultancy services to be provided are intended to support the ability to react quickly and effectively to short-term requirements with an IT focus that arise from new or changed business processes. Strategic consultancy services are not to be provided within the scope of this contract. However, strategic consultancy services may form the basis for the operational consultancy services to be provided here. The subject of the contract includes, in particular, advice, assessment, investigation and support for the conceptual design of the following topic areas: 1. Automation at the Federal Employment Agency 2. Human Friendly Automation at the Federal Employment Agency 3. Enabling the organisation for automation topics 4. The BA's IT in the hybrid multicloud 5. Reorganisation 6. Agile collaboration 7. HR digitalisation and transformation of HR IT systems and processes The consultancy service is divided into the subject areas of HR transformation, automation and cloud. The HR transformation consultant is primarily responsible for the topic areas 5, 6 and 7, the automation consultant primarily for the topic areas 1, 2 and 3, and the cloud consultant primarily for the topic area 4. The aim of the tender is a framework agreement with the three most economically advantageous tenderers. The three tenderers with the best performance/price ratio will be awarded the contract. The contract term begins with the award of the contract. The performance period also begins with the award of the contract, but no earlier than 08.12.2026, and ends after the expiry of 36 calendar months, simultaneously with the contract term, without the need for termination. The estimated call-off volume over the entire performance period amounts to approx. 39.000 person-hours (PH), which is 3.900 (person-days - PD). One PD corresponds to 10 PH. The estimated call-off volume may be exceeded or fallen short of, depending on technical requirements and budgetary circumstances, and may fluctuate over the course of the year. There is no call-off obligation on the part of the BA. Billing is based on actual expenditure. The maximum quantity for this procurement amounts to 4680 PD. This value represents the upper limit under procurement law for the use of the framework agreement and has no connection with the estimated quantities assumed by the BA or the budgetary funds provided by the BA.

result.text: The London Violence Reduction Unit (VRU) is undertaking a virtual market engagement exercise Wednesday 5th August 2026 @ 10am , via MS Teams, to inform the commissioning of the Online Harms Digital Youth Work Pilot Programme. The London Violence Reduction Unit (VRU) is committed to understanding the factors that place children and young people at risk of violence, exploitation and harm, and to working collaboratively with partners to deliver long-term, sustainable solutions. We work across communities and sectors, including youth services, local government, education, health, policing and the voluntary and community sector, championing a public health approach that combines prevention, early intervention and effective support for those experiencing the greatest levels of risk and vulnerability. At the heart of our approach is the belief that violence is preventable, not inevitable. We recognise, however, that many children and young people are already navigating the impacts of trauma, exploitation, abuse and complex community dynamics. As such, our work seeks not only to prevent harm before it occurs, but also to strengthen the systems, services and trusted adults responsible for safeguarding, supporting and intervening with those most affected. Central to this approach is a commitment to partnership working, evidence-informed practice and ensuring that the voices, experiences and expertise of young people and communities shape the solutions designed to support them. The Mayor's Violence Reduction Unit (VRU) is seeking to engage with the market in advance of a forthcoming procurement opportunity relating to the delivery of its flagship Digital Youth Work Pilot Programme. The programme forms part of the VRU's wider public health approach to violence reduction and sits within a London-wide model developed following extensive consultation with young people, practitioners, safeguarding professionals, academics and sector experts. Digital life brings clear benefits for many children. Ofcom found that 99% of 13–17-year-olds see at least one benefit to being online, including help with schoolwork, learning new skills and maintaining social connections. 93% of children in the UK play video games, and children report that gaming helps them socialise with friends, learn new skills and have fun, with most online interactions taking place with friends they already know offline. At the same time, the VRU is concerned that these same digital environments expose children and young people to a wide range of harms and risks. Digital safety is increasingly a public safety and public health concern. Children and young people are navigating identity, relationships, influence, exploitation and conflict across interconnected online and offline environments. However, systems, services and safeguarding responses have often struggled to keep pace with the rapidly evolving nature of digital spaces. This matters for the VRU because online harms do not sit separately from wider concerns about violence, vulnerability, exploitation and safeguarding. The VRU is seeking delivery partners to pilot innovative Digital Youth Work (DYW) approaches across London that drive new models of engagement with young people and promote safeguarding in digital spaces. The VRU is seeking approaches that: Design, deliver and test new or existing digital youth work models Extend trusted, relationship-based youth work into digital environments Strengthen early intervention, prevention and safeguarding online Generate learning, insight and practical outputs to strengthen future activity The programme aims not only to deliver effective pilot activity, but also to contribute to sector-wide innovation and the development of scalable models of digital youth work across London. Scope of delivery The programme will be structured into three complementary lots: Lot 1: Supporting High-Need and Digitally Dependent Young People Testing approaches that improve accessibility and engagement for young people who face barriers to traditional provision, including SEND. Lot 2: Early Intervention and Prevention of Online Harms Testing models that enable early identification, prevention and response to online risks, with a focus on safeguarding and preventative practice of deterring online to offline violence. Lot 3: Universal Digital Youth Work and Positive Opportunities Exploring how digital youth work can foster connection, creativity, play, participation and digital citizenship for all young people. Bidders may apply for one, two or all three lots. Applications may be submitted by individual organisations or as partnerships/consortia.

result.text: Target Audience The programme will focus on delivering digital youth work to children and young people aged 11–25 across London, including but not limited to: Young people at higher risk of being impacted by online harms Those facing barriers to traditional youth provision, including SEND and young people who may be more digitally dependent and/or digitally excluded Young people experiencing vulnerability linked to violence, exploitation or disadvantage Young people with caring responsibilities Young people in the care system Young people affected by Violence Against Women and Girls (VAWG) The wider youth population through universal provision Potential delivery settings and workforces may include, but are not limited to: Community-based youth organisations and youth services Detached, outreach and neighbourhood-based provision Faith and community organisations SEND and disability-focused youth provision Organisations supporting young people experiencing vulnerability, exclusion or barriers to traditional youth provision Specialist services working with young people affected by violence, exploitation or online harms Informal education, mentoring and participation-based youth provision Indicative Outcomes The programme is expected to contribute to: Increased engagement of young people in safe, supportive digital environments Improved accessibility of youth work for young people who do not traditionally engage with youth work and are digitally dependent and/or digitally excluded) Strengthened early identification and prevention of online harms in the digital space Increased use of technology to foster positive opportunities Strengthen young people’s digital citizenship Increased workforce confidence and capability in incorporating digital youth work into traditional practice and safeguarding policy Development of scalable models, guidance and practical tools A stronger London-wide evidence base on digital youth work and online safety Timeframe and Budget The maximum estimated budget for this programme is up to £650,000 excl. VAT over a full contract period from November 2026 – March 2029, subject to confirmation of funding, internal governance and relevant approvals. This comprises: £390,000 core funding across the 2026/27 and 2027/28 financial years from November 2026 to March 2028 An extension option of up to £260,000 for a further 12 months from April 2028 The VRU welcomes bids from individual organisations as well as collaborative partnerships and consortia. We recognise that expertise may be distributed across different organisations, and we encourage applications that bring together complementary skills, knowledge and experience. Providers do not need to demonstrate strength across every area independently, provided that the partnership as a whole can evidence the required expertise and capacity to deliver the programme. This may include, for example, combining specialist knowledge in DYW, supporting SEND or neurodiverse children, digital safety, contextual safeguarding, fostering positive digital opportunities, and preventative violence reduction approaches. Market Engagement / Response The VRU welcomes engagement from organisations with expertise in: Youth work and youth engagement Digital youth work Gaming, AI, technology Safeguarding and contextual safeguarding Online harms, exploitation and violence prevention Working with vulnerable and hard-to-reach young people Youth participation and co-production Learning, evaluation and evidence generation If you are interested in the opportunity and meet the core capabilities as set out above, then please join us for our early market warming event on Wednesday 5th August 2026 at 10:00AM. Attending the early market warming session does not constitute a commitment to participate in any future procurement process. The Eventbrite link for market warming session can be found here - https://www.eventbrite.co.uk/e/london-vru-online-harms-digital-youth-work-pilot-market-warming-session-tickets-1994744836503?aff=oddtdtcreator Please note that this exercise is in no way a call for competition and will not result in the award of a contract to any respondents to this notice. If have any further questions about this opportunity, please contact: vruprocurement@london.gov.uk For more information about this opportunity, please visit the eSourcing portal at: https://www.delta-esourcing.com/tenders/UK-UK-London:-Digital-mapping-services./5SJUMP2G3Z To respond to this opportunity, please click here: https://www.delta-esourcing.com/respond/5SJUMP2G3Z Lot 1: Supporting high-need and digitally dependent young people. Test and develop Digital Youth Work approaches that improve accessibility, inclusion and engagement for young people who face barriers to traditional provision, particularly those with SEND, neurodiverse needs or higher levels of digital dependency. Lot 2: Early intervention and prevention of online harms. Test Digital Youth Work approaches that strengthen early identification, prevention and safeguarding responses to online harms, vulnerabilities and online-to-offline risks. Lot 3: Universal digital youth work and positive opportunities. Explore how Digital Youth Work can foster connection, belonging, creativity, participation and positive opportunities for children and young people through universal and strengths-based approaches.

result.text: Fife Council intends to notify the market of a forthcoming procurement for a software solution to manage public access computers across council libraries and facilities. The solution will deliver end‐to‐end functionality for PC booking/sessions, print/copy/scan management, user authentication, and secure payments, with hosting, support, and maintenance services. Lot 1: . The product that will be procured will need to cover the following. PC Booking The system must support booking of public PCs. PC bookings must be configurable by location to reflect site‐specific arrangements. Self‐Service and Staff‐Assisted Booking Members of the public must be able to make PC bookings independently. Staff must be able to create or manage PC bookings on behalf of members of the public. Ability for patrons to book PCs in advance (online, kiosk, staff-assisted). Walk-up access with immediate log-on if PCs are available. Integration with Printing Services The solution must integrate with the existing printing system. It must provide print release functionality and support payments for printing. Library Management System Integration The solution must link to the Spydus Library Management System using LCF protocol for providing borrower authentication. Authentication must ensure only eligible borrowers can access PCs and services. Browsing History Reporting The system must provide reporting on user browsing session history to meet MAPPA agreement requirements. Borrower Type Management & Internet Restrictions The system must manage borrower types to enforce restrictions on internet browsing sessions. Renewal and extension of support licences (Firmware Updates, Enhanced Support and Phone Support) for the FortiAuthenticator system of the Secure Transmission System (STS) infrastructure, with a total estimated value of 140.300,00€ excluding (without) VAT 24% or 173.972,00€ including VAT 24%. Lot 1 : Supply of SIEM/SOAR system software licence (Security Information and Event Management – SIEM, Security Orchestration, Automation, and Response - SOAR). The requested supply concerns the need to adopt modern security solutions for the Ministry of Education, Religious Affairs and Sports. In this context, it is necessary to procure a SIEM/SOAR system software licence (Security Information and Event Management – SIEM, Security Orchestration, Automation, and Response - SOAR), which will detect threats and automate the response to them, supplementing the technical measures already maintained by the Agency. In detail, a SIEM/SOAR system allows for the centralised collection and analysis of logs from multiple sources, facilitating the timely detection of and immediate response to security incidents. At the same time, it strengthens compliance with regulatory frameworks and supports effective risk management. The installation of such a system in our organisation will provide better oversight of all critical systems, more effective management of security incidents and greater compliance with legal requirements.; Lot 2 : Renewal of the Software Assurance (SA) Programme for the Ministry's Microsoft software licences. The requested service provision concerns the renewal of the Software Assurance (SA) programme for the Microsoft software licences held by the Service. It is noted that, following a tender procedure for the conclusion of a contract by the competent financial services, its procurement was carried out, valid until October 2026 (31-10-2026). However, as the programme in question is considered essential for the smooth operation, security and continuous support of the Ministry's information systems, its renewal for three (3) years is deemed necessary.; Lot 3 : Renewal and extension of support licences (Firmware Updates, Enhanced Support and Phone Support) for the FortiAuthenticator system of the Secure Transmission System (STS) infrastructure. The requested service provision concerns the support of firmware upgrade licences (firmware and general updates), enhanced technical support, as well as phone support for the FortiAuthenticator system of the Secure Transmission System (STS) infrastructure, which is expected to expire on 23-10-2026. Taking into account the criticality of the system in question for the smooth operation of the STS, the renewal and extension of the above support licences up to and including 23-02-2030 is deemed necessary.

parts.source: Ανοικτός, Ηλεκτρονικός Διαγωνισμός, άνω των ορίων για τη σύναψη σύμβασης για την προμήθεια: 1. Προμήθεια Άδειας λογισμικού συστήματος SIEM/SOAR (Security Information and Event Management – SIEM, Security Orchestration, Automation, and Response -SOAR), 2. Ανανέωση του Προγράμματος Συντήρησης και Υποστήριξης (Software Assurance - SA) των Αδειών Λογισμικού Microsoft του Υπουργείου 3. Ανανέωση και Επέκταση των Αδειών Υποστήριξης (Firmware Updates, Enhanced Support και Phone Support) του Συστήματος FortiAuthenticator της Υποδομής του Συστήματος Ασφαλούς Μετάδοσης (ΣΑΜ), συνολικής προϋπολογισθείσας αξίας140.300,00€ πλέον (χωρίς) Φ.Π.Α. 24% ή 173.972,00€ συμπεριλαμβανομένου Φ.Π.Α. 24%. Τμήμα 1 : Προμήθεια Άδειας λογισμικού συστήματος SIEM/SOAR (Security Information and Event Management – SIEM, Security Orchestration, Automation, and Response -SOAR), Η ζητούμενη προμήθεια αφορά στην ανάγκη υιοθέτησης σύγχρονων λύσεων ασφάλειας του Υ.ΠΑΙ.Θ.Α.. Στο πλαίσιο αυτό απαιτείται η προμήθεια άδειας λογισμικού συστήματος SIEM/SOAR (Security Information and Event Management – SIEM, Security Orchestration, Automation, and Response -SOAR), το οποίο θα εντοπίζει απειλές και θα αυτοματοποιεί την απόκριση σε αυτές, συμπληρώνοντας τα τεχνικά μέτρα που ήδη τηρούνται στον Φορέα. Αναλυτικά, ένα σύστημα SIEM/SOAR επιτρέπει την κεντρική συλλογή και ανάλυση καταγραφών από πολλαπλές πηγές, διευκολύνοντας τον έγκαιρο εντοπισμό και την άμεση ανταπόκριση σε περιστατικά ασφάλειας. Παράλληλα ενισχύει τη συμμόρφωση με κανονιστικά πλαίσια και υποστηρίζει την αποτελεσματική διαχείριση κινδύνων. Η εγκατάσταση ενός τέτοιου συστήματος στον οργανισμό μας θα προσφέρει καλύτερη εποπτεία του συνόλου των κρίσιμων συστημάτων, αποτελεσματικότερη διαχείριση περιστατικών ασφάλειας και μεγαλύτερη συμμόρφωση με τις νομικές απαιτήσεις.; Τμήμα 2 : Ανανέωση του Προγράμματος Συντήρησης και Υποστήριξης (Software Assurance - SA) των Αδειών Λογισμικού Microsoft του Υπουργείου Η ζητούμενη παροχή υπηρεσιών αφορά στην ανανέωση του προγράμματος συντήρησης και υποστήριξης (Software Assurance - SA) των αδειών λογισμικού της εταιρείας Microsoft που διαθέτει η Υπηρεσία. Επισημαίνεται ότι, κατόπιν διαγωνιστικής διαδικασίας σύναψης σύμβασης από τις αρμόδιες οικονομικές υπηρεσίες, πραγματοποιήθηκε η προμήθειά του, με ισχύ έως τον Οκτώβριο του 2026 (31-10-2026). Ωστόσο, καθώς το εν λόγω πρόγραμμα θεωρείται απαραίτητο για την απρόσκοπτη λειτουργία, την ασφάλεια και τη συνεχή υποστήριξη των πληροφοριακών συστημάτων του Υπουργείου, κρίνεται απαραίτητη η ανανέωση του για τρία (3) έτη.; Τμήμα 3 : Ανανέωση και Επέκταση των Αδειών Υποστήριξης (Firmware Updates, Enhanced Support και Phone Support) του Συστήματος FortiAuthenticator της Υποδομής του Συστήματος Ασφαλούς Μετάδοσης (ΣΑΜ)».Η ζητούμενη παροχή υπηρεσιών αφορά την υποστήριξη των αδειών αναβάθμισης υλικολογισμικού (firmware και general updates), της διευρυμένης τεχνικής υποστήριξης (enhanced support), καθώς και της τηλεφωνικής υποστήριξης (phone support) του συστήματος Forti Authenticator της υποδομής του Συστήματος Ασφαλούς Μετάδοσης (ΣΑΜ), η οποία αναμένεται να λήξει στις 23-10-2026. Λαμβάνοντας υπόψη την κρισιμότητα του εν λόγω συστήματος για την απρόσκοπτη λειτουργία του ΣΑΜ, κρίνεται απαραίτητη η ανανέωση και επέκταση των ανωτέρω αδειών υποστήριξης έως και την 23-02-2030.

rejected.text: Society relies on chemical processes to turn raw materials into useful products. The Chemical Process Systems (CPS) programme invests in fundamental research on chemical and biochemical processes to make them more efficient, sustainable, and resilient. New CPS technologies for manufacturing, biotechnology, critical minerals, energy, food, and other national priorities will help make the U.S. more competitive and secure. Research supported by the CPS programme covers the full breadth of chemical and biochemical process innovation. It spans reaction engineering and molecular thermodynamics; reactor design; catalysis; electrochemical systems; separations; and process design. The programme encourages proposals that connect the molecular scale to process and plant scales. The CPS programme explores active-site structure and function, reaction mechanisms, in situ and operando characterisation, durability, and device-level integration. Microreactors, membrane and catalytic reactors, atmospheric plasmas, and other novel configurations are of interest. The programme supports research in catalysis and electrochemical systems to produce, use, and store energy, to reduce waste, to process polymers, and to synthesise fuels and chemicals. This includes process and materials innovation to support the nuclear fuel cycle. The CPS programme also targets chemical and biological separations that are efficient and scalable. Research includes the design of membranes, sorbents, and specialised interfaces. Advances can be used in gas separations, the recovery of critical minerals, bioprocessing, and protein and water purification. The programme supports research in process design and optimisation that uses tools such as artificial intelligence, machine learning, and uncertainty quantification. CPS research also explores quantum information science and engineering; quantum simulation and sensing, for example, may accelerate the discovery of materials and improve process models. Partnerships: To speed discovery and innovation, NSF partners with federal agencies, industry, international groups, and others. Current opportunities are at NSF ENG Partnerships.

result.text: In the field of traditional software, Software Bills of Materials (SBOMs) – that is, parts lists containing information about software components and their dependencies – have long been in use and are even required by the Cyber Resilience Act (CRA). This requirement also applies to AI systems, yet the idea of an SBOM specific to AI systems is relatively new. Initial approaches therefore carry the risk that they do not cover all necessary aspects with regard to the transparency of the AI supply chain. In this project, the concept "SBOM for AI - Minimum Elements" published within the G7 framework is to be put into practice and a technical implementation of the defined criteria developed for this purpose. The SBOM for AI is to be generated automatically and output in a suitable format. The developed implementation is subsequently to be made available to all stakeholders in order to make an important contribution to the cybersecurity of AI systems.

parts.source: Im Bereich der klassischen Software finden Software Bills of Materials (SBOMs) – also Stücklisten, die Informationen über Softwarekomponenten und deren Abhängigkeiten beinhalten – schon lange Anwendung und werden vom Cyber Resilience Act (CRA) sogar gefordert. Diese Forderung gilt auch für KI-Systeme, jedoch ist die Idee einer SBOM spezifisch für KI-Systeme relativ neu. Erste Ansätze bergen daher die Gefahr, dass sie nicht alle notwendigen Aspekte im Hinblick auf die Transparenz der KI-Lieferkette abdecken. In diesem Projekt soll das im G7-Rahmen veröffentlichte Konzept "SBOM for AI - Minimum Elements" in die Praxis überführt und dafür eine technische Umsetzung der definierten Kriterien erarbeitet werden. Die SBOM für KI soll automatisiert erstellt und in einem geeigneten Format ausgegeben werden. Die erarbeitete Umsetzung soll anschließend allen Interessenträgern zur Verfügung gestellt werden, um so einen wichtigen Beitrag zur Cybersicherheit von KI-Systemen leisten zu können.

result.text: The Bars of Admission (RAKs) in Germany are corporations under public law and currently represent over 160.000 admitted lawyers. Their legal basis is formed by the Federal Lawyers' Act (BRAO). There are a total of 27 Bars of Admission in Germany. The 11 Bars of Admission issuing the tender here are actively involved in the project and contribute their professional, organisational and technical requirements to the design. The participating chambers exhibit varying organisational structures, member numbers and IT landscapes, which underlines the need for a flexible and scalable solution. However, the various Bars of Admission are essentially subject to the same legal requirements, which are primarily dictated by the Federal Lawyers' Act (BRAO). In total, the eleven participating chambers currently look after around 132.000 members, who are administered and supported by approximately 370 employees. To support their tasks, 22 chambers currently use a software solution from DATEV eG. This solution covers core administrative processes, particularly in the areas of personnel administration, billing and complaint or case management. DATEV eG has terminated the existing software solution effective 31.12.2027. This decision makes timely planning and procurement of a suitable successor solution necessary. Against this background, the eleven local Bars of Admission have joined forces with the objective of replacing the currently used software solution, procuring a suitable successor solution and successfully introducing it. The project group is led and coordinated by five Bars of Admission (Frankfurt am Main, Hamburg, Hamm, Munich and Stuttgart). The aim is to procure a modern, high-performance and future-proof software solution that meets the specific requirements of the chambers and completely or with enhancements maps the previous functionalities of the DATEV software. In advance, a structured survey of the technical and functional requirements was conducted. This forms the basis for the drawn-up requirements catalogue. The DATEV software currently in use and to be replaced is utilised in the chambers for the following task areas: (1) Personnel administration: Administration of master data of natural and legal persons, admissions, status changes, specialist lawyer designations, training systems, resignations and reactivations. (2) Billing: Administration and billing of membership fees, charges, credit notes, etc. (3) Complaint management: Administration of professional law procedures, in particular complaints (4) Archiving and deletion: Archiving and deletion of data records from personnel and complaint management The software is deeply integrated into the work processes of users and forms a central basis for daily administrative work. Currently, the eleven participating Bars of Admission each operate independent instances of the DATEV software. While the basic functionalities are comparable in all chambers, differences exist in the specific configuration, particularly with regard to individually defined data fields, differing data structures and chamber-individual usage concepts. The project pursues the overarching objective of identifying a suitable successor solution for the discontinued DATEV software and procuring it within the framework of a structured, voluntary tender procedure.

parts.source: Die Rechtsanwaltskammern (RAKs) in Deutschland sind Körperschaften des öffentlichen Rechts und vertreten derzeit über 160.000 zugelassene Rechtsanwältinnen und Rechtsanwälte. Ihre rechtliche Grundlage bildet die Bundesrechtsanwaltsordnung (BRAO). Insgesamt gibt es 27 Rechtsanwaltskammern in Deutschland. Die hier ausschreibenden 11 Rechtsanwaltskammern sind aktiv in das Projekt eingebunden und bringen ihre fachlichen, organisatorischen und technischen Anforderungen in die Konzeption ein. Die beteiligten Kammern weisen unterschiedliche organisatorische Strukturen, Mitgliederzahlen und IT-Landschaften auf, was die Notwendigkeit einer flexiblen und skalierbaren Lösung unterstreicht. Die verschiedenen Rechtsanwaltskammern unterliegen allerdings im Wesentlichen den gleichen rechtlichen Anforderungen, welche vor allem durch die Bundesrechtsanwaltsordnung (BRAO) vorgegeben sind. Insgesamt betreuen die elf beteiligten Kammern derzeit rund 132.000 Mitglieder, die von etwa 370 Mitarbeitenden verwaltet und unterstützt werden. Zur Unterstützung Ihrer Aufgaben setzen derzeit 22 Kammern eine Softwarelösung der DATEV eG ein. Diese Lösung deckt zentrale Verwaltungsprozesse ab, insbesondere in den Bereichen Personenverwaltung, Abrechnung und Beschwerde- bzw. Vorgangsverwaltung. Die DATEV eG hat die bestehende Softwarelösung zum 31.12.2027 gekündigt. Diese Entscheidung macht eine rechtzeitige Planung und Beschaffung einer geeigneten Nachfolgelösung erforderlich. Vor diesem Hintergrund haben sich die hiesigen elf Rechtsanwaltskammern zusammengeschlossen, mit dem Ziel, die derzeit verwendete Softwarelösung abzulösen, eine geeignete Nachfolgelösung zu beschaffen und erfolgreich einzuführen. Die Projektgruppe wird von fünf Rechtsanwaltskammern (Frankfurt am Main, Hamburg, Hamm, München und Stuttgart) geleitet und koordiniert. Ziel ist die Beschaffung einer modernen, leistungsfähigen und zukunftssicheren Softwarelösung, die die spezifischen Anforderungen der Kammern erfüllt und die bisherigen Funktionalitäten der DATEV-Software vollständig oder erweitert abbildet. Im Vorfeld wurde eine strukturierte Erhebung der fachlichen und technischen Anforderungen durchgeführt. Diese bildet die Grundlage für den erstellten Anforderungskatalog. Die derzeit eingesetzte und abzulösende DATEV-Software wird in den Kammern für folgende Aufgabenbereiche genutzt: (1) Personenverwaltung: Verwaltung von Stammdaten natürlicher und juristischer Personen, Zulassungen, Statusänderungen, Fachanwaltsbezeichnungen, Ausbildungswesen, Austritten und Reaktivierungen. (2) Abrechnung: Verwaltung und Abrechnung von Mitgliedsbeiträgen, Gebühren, Gutschriften, etc. (3) Beschwerdeverwaltung: Verwaltung von berufsrechtlichen Vorgängen, insbesondere Beschwerden (4) Archivierung und Löschung: Archivierung und Löschung von Datensätzen der Personen- und Beschwerdeverwaltung Die Software ist tief in die Arbeitsprozesse der Benutzer:innen integriert und bildet eine zentrale Grundlage für die tägliche Verwaltungsarbeit. Aktuell betreiben die elf beteiligten Rechtsanwaltskammern jeweils eigenständige Instanzen der DATEV-Software. Während die grundlegenden Funktionalitäten in allen Kammern vergleichbar sind, bestehen Unterschiede in der konkreten Ausgestaltung, insbesondere hinsichtlich individuell definierter Datenfelder, abweichender Datenstrukturen und kammerindividueller Nutzungskonzepte. Das Projekt verfolgt das übergeordnete Ziel, eine geeignete Nachfolgelösung für die abgekündigte DATEV-Software zu identifizieren und im Rahmen eines strukturierten, freiwilligen Ausschreibungsverfahren zu beschaffen.

result.text: The purpose of this RFI is to gather information on market capabilities and solutions for a forthcoming procurement exercise, to supply Scottish Government with a new digital learning platform. result.text: The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention's (CDC) National Center for Injury Prevention and Control (NCIPC) is soliciting investigator-initiated gold standard research proposals to rigorously evaluate programs and policies for their impact on primary prevention of child sexual abuse (CSA) or problematic sexual behavior (PSB) among youth. For the purposes of this NOFO: CSA is defined as sexual victimization during childhood (younger than 18 years of age) perpetrated by an adult. PSB is defined as sexual behaviors among children (younger than 18 years of age) that are not developmentally appropriate and have the potential to cause harm to the child or children involved (including behaviors that are unintentionally harmful or inappropriate as well as behaviors intended to cause harm). Research funded under this announcement will strengthen the evidence base for primary prevention of CSA and PSB. Applicants must propose to rigorously evaluate a program or policy for primary prevention of CSA or PSB that addresses one of the following three research priorities: Programs or policies focused on primary prevention of CSA or PSB in digital spaces (e.g., downloading or possession of illegal images of children, nonconsensual image sharing, use of artificial intelligence to create fake explicit images of children); Programs or policies addressing the use of digital spaces for commercial sexual exploitation of children (CSEC) or sex trafficking (e.g., online recruitment of minors for sexual content creation, online advertisements soliciting minors for commercial sex acts, using technology to facilitate in-person meetings with minors for the purpose of sex); Organizational policy approaches focused on primary prevention of CSA or PSB in youth-serving organizations (e.g., community centers, youth development organizations, juvenile residential care facilities, faith-based organizations, group foster care).

result.text: Description: The State of Saxony-Anhalt has its own state data network, which is currently operated technically by an IT service provider. The state data network was set up by this IT service provider. The intention now is to retender the operation of the state data network as a high-performance and integrated state data network (LAN/WAN) as well as all measures and services necessary for this. The operation of the operations centre with, among other things, network-related services, the operation of components and systems within a data centre and necessary operational and technical tools are also to be awarded. To prepare for this retender, the MID as the responsible authority for the State of Saxony-Anhalt is conducting a market exploration in accordance with § 28 of the VgV. The aim is in particular to explore what organisational, technical and economic solutions are available on the market to ensure operation on a permanent, secure, reliable and scalable basis, as well as the conditions that may be necessary for this and the general time schedule. This is expressly not a call for competition or any other bidding procedure, but rather a non-binding market analysis for orientation and as a basis for decision-making for the preparation of any subsequent procurement procedure. Companies that wish to participate in the market exploration will be provided with further documents in the market exploration procedure. In order to gain access to these documents, an expression of interest and the submission of a non-disclosure agreement are required to protect sensitive data regarding critical infrastructure. Interested parties are therefore requested to express their interest in participating in the present market exploration procedure by 28.11.2025 at the latest by sending an email with the subject 'Market exploration procedure state data network' to the following email address: lnstender@sachsen-anhalt.de and stating the necessary contact details (name of the company, registered office of the company, address of the company and email address). You will then receive a draft non-disclosure agreement, which must then be completed and returned signed. Upon receipt of the non-disclosure agreement, the further documents for the market exploration will be sent to the interested parties concerned. These contain further information and documents. It is planned to conduct online market exploration discussions with the interested parties. These are expected to be scheduled in the four calendar weeks following the above-mentioned deadline. To prepare for the discussions, participants are asked to complete and submit a prepared questionnaire. Further information on this can be found in the market exploration documents, which will be made available after the submission of the non-disclosure agreement.

parts.source: Beschreibung: Das Land Sachsen-Anhalt verfügt über ein landeseigenes Landesdatennetz, das derzeit durch einen IT-Dienstleister technisch betrieben wird. Der Aufbau des Landesdatennetzes erfolgte durch diesen IT-Dienstleister. Beabsichtigt ist nunmehr die Neuvergabe des Betriebes des Landesdatennetzes als leistungsfähiges und integriertes Landesdatennetzes (LAN/WAN) sowie aller dafür notwendigen Maßnahmen und Leistungen. Vergeben werden sollen auch der Betrieb des Betriebszentrums mit u. a. netznahen Diensten, der Betrieb von Komponenten und Systemen innerhalb eines Rechenzentrums und notwendige operative und technische Tools. Zur Vorbereitung dieser Neuvergabe führt das MID als zuständige Behörde für das Land Sachsen-Anhalt eine Markterkundung gem.§ 28 VgV durch. Ziel ist insbesondere die Erkundung, welche organisatorischen, technischen und wirtschaftlichen Lösungen am Markt vorhanden sind, um den Betrieb dauerhaft sicher, zuverlässig und skalierbar sicherzustellen, sowie die dafür ggf. notwendigen Voraussetzungen und die zeitlichen Rahmenbedingungen. Es handelt sich hierbei ausdrücklich nicht um eine Ausschreibung oder ein sonstiges Bieterverfahren, sondern um eine unverbindliche Marktanalyse zur Orientierung und als Entscheidungsgrundlage für die Vorbereitung eines etwaigen späteren Vergabeverfahrens. Unternehmen, die sich an der Markterkundung beteiligen möchten, werden im Markterkundungsverfahren weitere Unterlagen zur Verfügung gestellt. Um Zugang zu diesen Unterlagen zu erhalten, ist zum Schutz sensibler Daten über kritische Infrastruktur eine Interessenbekundung und die Abgabe einer Verschwiegenheitserklärung erforderlich. Interessenten werden daher gebeten, ihr Interesse an der Teilnahme am vorliegenden Markterkundungsverfahren bis spätestens 28.11.2025 an durch E-Mail mit dem Betreff Markterkundungsverfahren Landesdatennetz an folgende E-Mail-Adresse zu bekunden: lnstender@sachsen-anhalt.de und darin die notwendigen Kontaktdaten (Name des Unternehmens, Sitz des Unternehmens, Anschrift des Unternehmens und E-Mail-Adresse) anzugeben. Sie erhalten daraufhin den Vordruck einer Verschwiegenheitserklärung, der anschließend ausgefüllt und unterzeichnet zurückzusenden ist. Nach Eingang der Verschwiegenheitserklärung werden den betreffenden Interessenten die weiteren Unterlagen zur Markterkundung übersandt. Diese enthalten weitergehende Informationen und Unterlagen. Es ist vorgesehen, mit den Interessenten online stattfindende Markterkundungsgespräche zu führen. Diese werden voraussichtlich in den auf die o.g. Frist nachfolgenden vier Kalenderwochen vorgesehen. Zur Vorbereitung der Gespräche werden die Teilnehmer gebeten, einen vorbereiteten Fragebogen auszufüllen und einzureichen. Weitere Informationen hierzu sind den Markterkundungsunterlagen zu entnehmen, die nach Abgabe der Verschwiegenheitserklärung zur Verfügung gestellt werden.

result.text: For this project We have 6 modules. Each module is made up of 3 stages. These stages are (1) an x-y stage, (2) a tilt goniometric stage, and (3) rotational stage. The links to these stages and the control box can be seen in the attached supporting document. The difference between our stages and the COTS stages is that each stage has a different motor to the COTS item (integrated 485 bus-type closed-loop stepper driver, IRS42E-K02, manual available). All modules are controlled via a single controller box. The controller box has power and user instructions from control software (via RS232 to USB cable) as inputs and has six output cables, each connected to one of the modules (RS232 to RS232). Each output cable is limited to 2m length. The cable from the controller connects to the bottom most stage of the module, that is the x-stage. The x-stage is then connected to the y-stage via a RS232 cable. The y-stage is connected to the goniometric stage via a RS232 cable. Finally, the goniometric stage is connected to the rotational stage via a RS232 cable. In this way, a controller with 6 outputs controls 6x4=24 motors. This setup is shown in the diagram and a picture of a single module is also provided on the attached supporting document. The control signal is sent via the control box to the desired module. If the control signal is not for the x-stage, the control signal is passed up the chain, and so on. We need the control software to interface with our existing hardware to control the 6 modules. The solution could interface with the existing control box, or alternatively provide a new controller to interface with the 6 modules. The requirements above are for the software/control of the 6 modules. Lot LOT-0000: . None

result.text: The BMWE intends to tender a contract for the office (GS) of "FRAUEN unternehmen". The office is to shape the content of the new priorities specified by the BMWE and develop new measures in order to sensitise girls and women to professional self-employment together with the "role model female entrepreneurs" (VUs). In order to prevent or counteract social conditioning and promote a cliché-free career choice, targeted outreach should be directed – alongside vocational schools and universities – increasingly also towards general education schools. It is in the interest of the contracting authority (AG) to cooperate with other programmes/projects funded by the BMWE, such as the SCHULEWIRTSCHAFT-PREIS or the BMWE initiative circle "Gründung in school", and, where sensible and possible, to develop proposals for cooperation in order to tap into potential synergies. Furthermore, the "FRAUEN unternehmen" initiative is also a measure from the joint action plan "More female entrepreneurs for SMEs". As part of the action plan, the office also actively participates as a member of the network. Through suitable measures, the topic of "female entrepreneurship" is to be positioned more strongly in the public eye. To this end, a greater reach in social media is also to be achieved. Furthermore, a targeted expansion of the circle of active VUs is expected, in particular by female entrepreneurs from the fields of trade, MINT (STEM), AI and digitalisation, from the East German federal lands and rural areas, as well as by those female entrepreneurs who have themselves taken over a business succession. The core tasks of the contract include in particular the provision of personnel, basic equipment for carrying out network coordination and project management, travel activities as well as internal and external communication including the annual preparation of a media concept (details in the respective work package). The following services are to be taken into account: - WP 1: Central contact point for VUs and all those interested in the initiative - WP 2: Matching of VUs with the target group - WP 3: Establishment and expansion of the external network / addressing multipliers and network partners - WP 4: External communication – strengthening the general visibility of the "FRAUEN unternehmen" initiative as well as the commitment of the VUs within the framework of the initiative - WP 5: Internal communication – strengthening the internal network of VUs and supporting the exchange of experience among VUs - WP 6: Monitoring, evaluation of the initiative and preparation of results - WP 7: Targeted expansion of the circle of VUs

parts.source: Das BMWE beabsichtigt, einen Vertrag über die Geschäftsstelle (GS) „FRAUEN unternehmen“ auszuschreiben. Die Geschäftsstelle soll die vom BMWE vorgegebenen neuen Schwerpunkte inhaltlich ausgestalten und neue Maßnahmen entwickeln, um gemeinsam mit den "Vorbild-Unternehmerinnen“ (VUs) Mädchen und Frauen für die berufliche Selbstständigkeit zu sensibilisieren. Um gesellschaftlichen Prägungen vorzubeugen bzw. diesen entgegenzuwirken und eine klischeefreie Berufswahl zu fördern, sollen dabei – neben Berufs- und Hochschulen – verstärkt auch allgemeinbildende Schulen angesprochen werden. Dabei liegt es im Interesse des Auftraggebers (AG), mit weiteren vom BMWE geförderten Programmen/Projekten wie z. B. SCHULEWIRTSCHAFT-PREIS oder dem BMWE-Initiativkreis „Gründung in school“ zu kooperieren und, wo sinnvoll und möglich, Vorschläge für eine Zusammenarbeit zu entwickeln, um mögliche Synergien zu erschließen. Des Weiteren ist die Initiative „FRAUEN unternehmen“ auch eine Maßnahme aus dem gemeinsamen Aktionsplan „Mehr Unternehmerinnen für den Mittelstand“. Im Rahmen des Aktionsplans beteiligt sich die GS auch aktiv als Mitglied des Netzwerks. Durch geeignete Maßnahmen soll das Thema „weibliches Unternehmertum“ stärker in der Öffentlichkeit platziert werden. Dazu soll auch eine höhere Reichweite in den Sozialen Medien erreicht werden. Erwartet wird darüber hinaus eine gezielte Erweiterung des Kreises der aktiven VU, insbesondere um Unternehmerinnen aus den Bereichen Handwerk, MINT, KI und Digitalisierung, aus den ostdeutschen Bundesländern und dem ländlichen Raum sowie um solche Unternehmerinnen, die selbst eine Unternehmensnachfolge angetreten haben. Zu den Kernaufgaben des Auftrags gehören insbesondere die Bereitstellung von Personal, eine Basisausstattung zur Wahrnehmung der Netzwerkkoordinierung und des Projektmanagements, Reisetätigkeiten sowie die interne und externe Kommunikation einschließlich der jährlichen Erstellung eines Medienkonzepts (Details im jeweiligen Arbeitspaket). Dabei sind folgende Leistungen zur berücksichtigen: - AP 1: Zentrale Kontaktstelle für VU und alle an der Initiative Interessierten - AP 2: Matching der VU mit der Zielgruppe - AP 3: Aufbau und Erweiterung des externen Netzwerkes/ Ansprache von Multiplikatoren und Netzwerkpartnern - AP 4: Externe Kommunikation – Stärkung der allgemeinen Sichtbarkeit der Initiative „FRAUEN unternehmen“ sowie des Engagements der VU im Rahmen der Initiative - AP 5: Interne Kommunikation – Stärkung des internen Netzwerkes der VU und Unterstützung des Erfahrungsaustausches unter den VU - AP 6: Monitoring, Auswertung der Initiative und Aufbereitung von Ergebnissen - AP 7: Gezielte Erweiterung des Kreises der VU

Due to the very close interaction, both functionally and data-related, the aforementioned application areas/functional units are to be considered as a single unit. Standard software is being tendered (no custom development) that implements the client's requirements or is to be adapted through appropriate configuration/parametrisation. Furthermore, the consolidation and standardization of the processes supported by the offered rostering solution are the subject of the tendered service; this must take place in close coordination with the client. The contractor shall ensure the proper operation as well as the care and maintenance of the SaaS system during the contract term to the extent necessary to comply with the agreed SLAs. The rostering solution must be seamlessly integrated into the IT environment of UKHD via interfaces. The integration of the rostering solution ensures smooth data exchange without media breaks. In addition, supplementary services listed in this specification (e.g. training) are an integral part of the bid and the total price.
