result.text: The integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Biological Research has the potential to pave the way for breakthroughs in biotechnology and bio-system design that will create innovations, new industries, and jobs. To capitalize on this promise, the Directorate for Biological Sciences (BIO) will make awards for Postdoctoral Research Fellowships in Biology (PRFB) to recent doctoral degree recipients, for proposals with a research and training focus at the Intersection of Artificial Intelligence and Biological Sciences to Strengthen and Safeguard Biotechnology Innovations. Applying AI to highly complex biological systems will reveal unknown mechanisms in the natural world that hold promise for technological developments. Candidates with AI and/or biology experience will develop deep expertise in both by proposing additional training in both areas. These combinations of current expertise and new cross-training will produce scientists who work seamlessly at the intersection of AI and biology. The fellows are expected to become field leaders who use AI capabilities to extrapolate from biological data to technological advances. Proposers are encouraged to consider how to leverage the nation’s diversity of existing biological data, and biological infrastructure, such as Biofoundries, Programmable Cloud Labs, Manufacturing USA Institutes, and NEON, to accelerate discovery, innovation and the biotechnology that improves human lives, promotes the U.S. economy, and benefits the nation.

result.text: BARMER is planning to transition its electronic patient record (ePA) to a future-proof, modular digital platform ("eCare App") and to make existing services as well as gematik-certified components flexibly integrable. The planned app architecture provides for decoupling central functionalities - app framework, gematik modules, insured persons' frontend as well as value-added services and TI components - from one another and providing them in a modular manner via standardised interfaces. The focus is on the development of an app framework with plug-in technology and the step-by-step integration of existing modules and services (e.g. laboratory values, medication lists, e-prescription, record management). The goal is to ensure both compliance with legal requirements and comprehensive scalability, innovation-friendliness, and the best possible service for BARMER's insured persons.

parts.source: Die BARMER plant ihre elektronische Patientenakte (ePA) auf eine zukunftssichere, modulare digitale Plattform ("eCare App") umzustellen und bestehende Services sowie gematik-zertifizierte Komponenten flexibel integrierbar zu gestalten. Die geplante App-Architektur sieht vor, zentrale Funktionalitäten - App-Rahmen, gematik-Module, Frontend der Versicherten sowie Mehrwertservices und TI-Komponenten - voneinander zu entkoppeln und über standardisierte Schnittstellen modular bereitzustellen. Im Mittelpunkt steht die Entwicklung eines App-Rahmens mit Plug-In-Technologie und die schrittweise Integration bestehender Module und Services (z. B. Laborwerte, Medikationslisten, E-Rezept, Aktenverwaltung). Ziel ist es, sowohl Compliance mit gesetzlichen Vorgaben als auch eine umfassende Skalierbarkeit, Innovationsfreundlichkeit und bestmöglichen Service für die Versicherten der BARMER sicherzustellen.

result.text: The Directorate of DigitalIsation (Digdir) invites tenderers to give input on collaboration models for issuing a digital wallet in Norway. This request for information is related to the ongoing work with a CONCEPT CHOICE assessment (KVU) for issuing a digital wallet in accordance with the eIDAS2.0 regulation. This has been efficient and given us rapid and high spreading of eID in the population, and thus contributed to the fact that public and private actors have been able to digitalise a great many services. The national eID strategy has, however, pointed to some challenges with the current model, i.a. connected to not everyone having access to eID "High" within the current market-based systems. The eIDAS2.0 Regulation requires Norway to offer inhabitants and residents a free digital wallet at a security level "High". The regulation also requires most social sectors, both public and private, to accept the wallet for log-in, identification and different areas of use. This also applies across EU/EEA countries, which means that Norway be required to accept the digital wallets of others in norway. In addition to this, we see the introduction of digital wallets in the work with the KVU in connection with the challenges and needs described in the national eID strategy. Reply This is an open invitation to market participants, and there are no special form requirements for the feedback. Each market participant is free to emphasise what they find most relevant in their responses. However, we have prepared an overview of questions that can function as a guide, which gives an indication of which areas we would like feedback on. Response to this RFI (both questions and input) is sent via the communication module in Mercell.Deadline for written responses: 18 December 2025Se attached documents for further information.

rejected.text: The goal is to manage user identities, roles, and permissions centrally, automatically, and in an audit-proof manner in the future. The scope of services includes the provision of the IAM software, full implementation and integration into the existing IT infrastructure, migration of existing data, comprehensive testing, and ongoing German-language support. The solution must be operated entirely within the ALDB infrastructure. The licences are to be provided for a minimum term of two years, up to a maximum of four years. Functionally required are, in particular, joiner, mover, and leaver processes, role and permission management, access requests, approval workflows, identity governance, administration, reporting, audit logging, and interfaces to existing systems such as Active Directory, HR systems, databases, and Kubernetes environments. In addition, a secure backup and recovery concept, a minimum availability of 95 % per month, and regulated training and acceptance processes are planned. The go-live should take place after a successful test and acceptance phase, at the latest by 01.12.2026. An exit concept must be provided for the end of the contract. The project includes the following service components: a) Provision of the IAM software solution (on-premise) The contractor must provide the offered Identity & Access Management (IAM) solution as an on-premise solution. This includes all software licences, including all modules and functionalities required to fulfil the professional, technical, and security-related requirements defined in this service description. The licensing must enable the management of the intended number of user identities, roles, permissions, target systems, and applications, and ensure demand-oriented scaling to support future expansions of the ALDB IT landscape. b) Consulting services, implementation, and integration The contractor is responsible for the complete planning, implementation, configuration, parameterisation, integration, commissioning, test support, and professional and technical support throughout the entire project duration. The scope of services includes, in particular, the integration of the IAM solution into the existing ALDB IT infrastructure, including the connection of all agreed source and target systems, Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Kubernetes environments, and other business-critical applications. Furthermore, the organisational structure, the role and permission concept, identity lifecycle management, provisioning and de-provisioning processes, approval workflows, access requests, recertification processes, and audit and reporting functions must be implemented and configured. All implementation and integration work must be carried out in such a way that the ongoing business operations of the ALDB are not impaired. c) Test After the contract is awarded and before the go-live, a test environment must be provided that largely corresponds to the subsequent production environment. Before the go-live, comprehensive functional, technical, integrative, security-related, and professional acceptance tests must be carried out. The go-live may only take place after the successful completion of all tests and written approval by the ALDB. d) Migration The contractor is responsible for the complete planning, execution, and documentation of the migration in coordination with the client. As part of the migration, all user identities, roles, permissions, organisational structures, configurations, and all data required for the operation of the IAM solution must be transferred to the new system completely, consistently, and without data loss. The migration must be carried out in such a way that interruptions to production operations are reduced to a minimum and the integrity of all data remains guaranteed at all times. e) Customer Support The IAM Customer Service to be provided by the contractor includes technical support, operation, maintenance, and continuous further development of the implemented Identity & Access Management solution in accordance with the professional and technical requirements of the ALDB. The service meets the requirements for KRITIS requirements and is German-language support. The scope of services includes, in particular, incident and problem management, error analysis and troubleshooting, software updates, hotfixes, patches, and security-related updates, as well as support for configuration changes, change requests, extensions, and the integration of additional source and target systems. In addition, the contractor supports the ALDB in the optimisation of existing identity and access management processes, the further development of the role and permission concept, and the implementation of new professional and regulatory requirements.

parts.source: Ziel ist es, Benutzeridentitäten, Rollen und Berechtigungen künftig zentral, automatisiert und revisionssicher zu verwalten. Der Leistungsumfang umfasst die Bereitstellung der IAM-Software, die vollständige Implementierung und Integration in die bestehende IT-Infrastruktur, die Migration vorhandener Daten, umfassende Tests sowie den laufenden deutschsprachigen Support. Die Lösung muss vollständig innerhalb der ALDB-Infrastruktur betrieben werden. Die Lizenzen sollen über eine MIndeslaufzeit von zwei Jahren, maximal vier Jahren, bereitgestellt werden. Funktional gefordert sind insbesondere Joiner-, Mover- und Leaver-Prozesse, Rollen- und Berechtigungsmanagement, Access Requests, Genehmigungsworkflows, Identity Governance, Administration, Reporting, Audit-Logging sowie Schnittstellen zu bestehenden Systemen wie Active Directory, HR-Systemen, Datenbanken und Kubernetes-Umgebungen. Zusätzlich sind ein sicheres Backup- und Wiederherstellungskonzept, eine Mindestverfügbarkeit von 95 % pro Monat sowie geregelte Schulungs- und Abnahmeprozesse vorgesehen. Die Produktivsetzung soll nach erfolgreicher Test- und Abnahmephase spätestens zum 01.12.2026 erfolgen. Für das Vertragsende ist ein Exit-Konzept vorzusehen. Das Projekt umfasst folgende Leistungsbestandteile: a) Bereitstellung der IAM-Softwarelösung (On-Premise) Der Auftragnehmer hat die angebotene Identity & Access Management (IAM)-Lösung als On-Premise-Lösung bereitzustellen. Hierzu gehören sämtliche Softwarelizenzen einschließlich aller Module und Funktionalitäten, die zur Erfüllung der in dieser Leistungsbeschreibung definierten, fachlichen, technischen und sicherheitsrelevanten Anforderungen erforderlich sind. Die Lizenzierung muss die Verwaltung der vorgesehenen Anzahl von Benutzeridentitäten, Rollen, Berechtigungen, Zielsystemen und Anwendungen ermöglichen sowie eine bedarfsgerechte Skalierung zur Unterstützung zukünftiger Erweiterungen der IT-Landschaft der ALDB gewährleisten. b) Beratungsleistungen, Implementierung und Integration Der Auftragnehmer ist für die vollständige Planung, Implementierung, Konfiguration, Parametrisierung, Integration, Inbetriebnahme, Testunterstützung sowie die fachliche und technische Begleitung während der gesamten Projektlaufzeit verantwortlich. Der Leistungsumfang umfasst insbesondere die Integration der IAM-Lösung in die bestehende IT-Infrastruktur der ALDB einschließlich der Anbindung aller vereinbarten Quell- und Zielsysteme, Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Kubernetes-Umgebungen sowie weiterer geschäftskritischer Anwendungen. Darüber hinaus sind die Organisationsstruktur, das Rollen- und Berechtigungskonzept, Identity Lifecycle Management, Provisionierung- und Deprovisionierungsprozesse, Genehmigungsworkflows, Access Requests, Rezertifizierungsprozesse sowie Audit- und Reportingfunktionen zu implementieren und zu konfigurieren. Alle Implementierungs- und Integrationsarbeiten sind so durchzuführen, dass der laufende Geschäftsbetrieb der ALDB nicht beeinträchtigt wird. c) Test Nach der Zuschlagserteilung und vor der Produktivsetzung ist eine Testumgebung bereitzustellen, die der späteren Produktivumgebung weitestgehend entspricht. Vor dem Go-Live sind umfassende funktionale, technische, integrative, sicherheitsrelevante sowie fachliche Abnahmetests durchzuführen. Erst nach erfolgreichem Abschluss sämtlicher Tests und der schriftlichen Freigabe durch die ALDB darf die Produktivsetzung erfolgen. d) Migration Der Auftragnehmer ist für die vollständige Planung, Durchführung und Dokumentation der Migration verantwortlich in Abstimmung mit der Auftraggeberin. Im Rahmen der Migration sind sämtliche Benutzeridentitäten, Rollen, Berechtigungen, Organisationsstrukturen, Konfigurationen sowie alle für den Betrieb der IAM-Lösung erforderlichen Daten vollständig, konsistent und ohne Datenverlust in das neue System zu übernehmen. Die Migration ist so durchzuführen, dass Unterbrechungen des Produktivbetriebs auf ein Minimum reduziert werden und die Integrität aller Daten jederzeit gewährleistet bleibt. e) Customer Support Der vom Auftragnehmer zu erbringende IAM Customer Service umfasst den technischen Support, den Betrieb, die Wartung sowie die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung der implementierten Identity & Access Management-Lösung entsprechend den fachlichen und technischen Anforderungen der ALDB. Der Service erfüllt die Anforderung an KRITIS Anforderungen und ist deutschsprachigen Support. Der Leistungsumfang umfasst insbesondere Incident- und Problem-Management, Fehleranalyse und Fehlerbehebung, Software-Updates, Hotfixes, Patches und sicherheitsrelevante Aktualisierungen sowie Unterstützung bei Konfigurationsänderungen, Change Requests, Erweiterungen und der Integration zusätzlicher Quell- und Zielsysteme. Darüber hinaus unterstützt der Auftragnehmer die ALDB bei der Optimierung bestehender Identity- und Access-Management-Prozesse, der Weiterentwicklung des Rollen- und Berechtigungskonzeptes sowie bei der Umsetzung neuer fachlicher und regulatorischer Anforderungen.

The information provided on the procurement and the procurement procedure is preliminary, and the final contract notice and the invitation to tender may differ from that information. Responding to the market dialogue is not a prerequisite for participation in any subsequent competitive tendering, and it is not binding on the parties participating in it. The contracting entity does not pay any compensation for participation in the market dialogue.

result.text: The ekom21 - Kommunales Gebietsrechenzentrum Hessen (hereinafter: ekom21) is a public-law corporation under the Hessian Data Processing Association Act (DV-VerbundG). It is a central IT service provider for Hessian municipalities and their facilities. From its locations in Giessen, Darmstadt, Kassel and Fulda, it comprehensively supplies its end customers with modern information and communications services (ICT) of all kinds. Its approximately 500 members in Hesse and other customers nationwide include approx. 29.000 end users from municipal administrations and other public institutions, such as districts, cities, municipalities, municipal eigenbetriebs, special-purpose associations, institutions, hospitals and care homes. In the governmental sector, ekom21 serves numerous state associations, ministries and regional administrative authorities. In total, ekom21 thus provides services for six million citizens. The range of tasks of ekom21 is constantly growing and changing, which goes hand in hand with a steady expansion of its customer base. To respond to our customers' requests for a data protection management system (DPMS), a corresponding partner must be commissioned. For this reason, ekom21 is tendering a DPMS for its customers. The primary aim is to procure a cloud-based data protection management system (SaaS) that supports, documents and controls all processing activities in accordance with Art. 5 30 of the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), the Federal Data Protection Act (BDSG) and the Hessian Data Protection and Freedom of Information Act (HDSIG). The goal is to reduce the effort required for risk and impact analyses, the record of processing activities (RoPA), data subject requests, contract and sales management as well as audit evidence, while simultaneously increasing compliance quality. The procurement procedure aims at the conclusion of a framework agreement with a single economic operator. The framework agreement is intended - without establishing any obligation to purchase - to enable the demand-driven provision, introduction and long-term support of a "data protection management system" as well as associated services for customers of ekom21. The maximum value of the framework agreement amounts to 1.000.000,00 million EUR (net). Further details can be found in the procurement documents.

parts.source: Die ekom21 - Kommunales Gebietsrechenzentrum Hessen (nachfolgend: ekom21) ist eine Körperschaft des öffentlichen Rechts nach dem Hessischen Datenverarbeitungsverbundgesetz (DV-VerbundG). Sie ist zentraler IT-Dienstleister für die hessischen Kommunen und ihre Einrichtungen. Von den Standorten in Gießen, Darmstadt Kassel und Fulda versorgt sie ihre Endkunden umfassend mit modernen Informations- und Kommunikationsdienstleistungen (IuK) aller Art. Zu den rund 500 Mitgliedern in Hessen und weiteren Kunden bundesweit gehören ca. 29.000 Endanwender*innen aus Kommunalverwaltungen und anderen öffentlichen Einrichtungen, wie z. B. Landkreise, Städte, Gemeinden, kommunale Eigenbetriebe, Zweckverbände, Anstalten, Krankenhäuser und Heime. Im staatlichen Bereich betreut die ekom21 zahlreiche Landesverbände, Ministerien und Regierungspräsidien. Insgesamt erbringt die ekom21 damit Services für sechs Millionen Bürger. Das Aufgabenspektrum der ekom21 wächst und verändert sich kontinuierlich, womit eine stetige Erweiterung des Kundenkreises einhergeht. Um den Anfragen unserer Kunden nach einem Datenschutzmanagement System (DSMS) Rechnung zu tragen, muss ein entsprechender Partner beauftragt werden Die ekom21 schreibt aus diesem Grund für ihre Kunden ein DSMS aus. Es soll primär ein cloud basiertes Datenschutz Management System (SaaS) beschafft werden, das die gesamte Verarbeitungstätigkeit nach Art. 5 30 Datenschutz-Grundverordnung (DSGVO), dem Bundesdatenschutzgesetz (BDSG) sowie dem Hessischen Datenschutz- und Informationsfreiheitsgesetz (HDSIG) unterstützt, dokumentiert und kontrolliert. Ziel ist es, den Aufwand für Risiko und Impact Analysen, das Verzeichnis von Verarbeitungstätigkeiten (VVT), Betroffenen Anfragen, Auftrags und Vertriebsmanagement sowie Audit Nachweise zu reduzieren und gleichzeitig die Compliance Qualität zu erhöhen. Das Vergabeverfahren zielt auf den Abschluss einer Rahmenvereinbarung mit einem Wirtschaftsteilnehmer. Die Rahmenvereinbarung soll - ohne Begründung einer Abnahmeverpflichtung - die bedarfsgerechte Bereitstellung, Einführung und langfristige Betreuung eines "Datenschutzmanagementsystems" sowie dazugehörige Dienstleistungen für Kunden der ekom21 zu ermöglichen. Der Höchstwert der Rahmenvereinbarung beträgt 1.000.000,00 Mio. € (netto). Näheres ist den Vergabeunterlagen zu entnehmen.

result.text: Description of the procurement: The Danish Agency for Digital Government (Digitaliseringsstyrelsen) operates on behalf of the Danish State a national qualified trust service for the management of qualified electronic signature creation devices under Regulation (EU) No 910/2014 as amended by Regulation (EU) 2024/1183 (eIDAS2). As part of modernising the signing service to meet the requirements of eIDAS2, the Agency is procuring a Qualified Signature Creation Devices (QSCD) to be installed and operated within the Agency's data centers (currently two). The Contract includes an Option to upgrade the throughput capacity of the QSCD and an Option to extend the deployment to a third data centre. The Contract covers the Initial Delivery of the certified QSCD in accordance with eIDAS2. The Initial Delivery includes all Licences, Documentation, and support necessary for the Agency to install and operate the QSCD as part of its qualified trust service. The QSCD must integrate with the Agency's existing infrastructure, including the Agency's certificate authority, authorisation server, and signing components. The Supplier's principal obligations comprise: (a) the Initial Delivery of certified QSCD Hardware sized and configured for operation across two data centres with redundant active/active configurations with a defined minimum production throughput per second, measured in RSA 4K operations equivalent; (b) Ongoing Services, including support and maintenance of the Hardware, security patching, and up to two replacements of Hardware during the contract term to maintain valid certifications; (c) Ordered Services, comprising Time-Based Services (services for installation, configuration, key ceremonies, and similar tasks) and Options; and (d) Cross-cutting Services, comprising Documentation and security, provided as an integral part of the Ongoing Services and Ordered Services throughout the term of the Contract.

rejected.text: The U.S. Military Academy at West Point's mission is "to educate, train, and inspire the Corps of Cadets so that each graduate is a commissioned leader of character committed to the values of Duty, Honor, Country and prepared for a career of professional excellence and service to the Nation as an officer in the United States Army." The United States Military Academy is located at West Point, New York. USMA executes research to enhance the education of cadets, develop the faculty professionally, and address important issues facing the Army and the Nation. In addition, the Academy conducts research and analysis in emerging fields that may realise novel or vastly improved Army capabilities. At West Point, research is organised and administered through centres and institutes, most of which reside within academic departments. These centres and institutes, affiliated with each other through the Academy Research Council (ARC), coordinated and supported by the Academic Research Division (ARD), provide the infrastructure necessary to tackle the nation’s and the world’s most challenging problems. Our research centres and institutes bring context to the classroom, are central to our vibrant and pioneering faculty, and are one way West Point connects to the Army and to the Nation. Our students are driven, our faculty is world-class, and through our centres, scholars and scientists thrive and produce their best work. Cadets regularly win Best Paper Awards at national and international graduate-level conferences, our faculty hold fellowships and chairmanships in their discipline's national organisations and our products are deployed to the soldier. In addition to applied research, there are centres and institutes at West Point that focus on other aspects of the USMA mission. The USMA BAA identifies topics of interest to the USMA departments, directorates, and research centres and institutes. These groups focus on executing in-house research programmes, with a significant emphasis on collaborative research with other organisations. The groups fund a modest amount of extramural research in certain specific areas, and those areas are described in this BAA. The USMA BAA seeks proposals from institutions of higher education, nonprofit organisations, state and local governments, foreign organisations, foreign public entities, and for-profit organisations (i.e., large and small businesses) for research based on the following campaigns: Socio-Cultural; Information Technology; Ballistics, Weapons, and Protections; Energy and Sustainability; Materials, Measurements, and Facilities; Unmanned Systems and Space; Human Support Systems; and Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Quantum Technologies. Proposals are sought for cutting-edge innovative research that could produce discoveries with a significant impact to enable new and improved Army technologies and related operational capabilities and related technologies. The specific research areas and topics of interest described in this document should be viewed as suggestive, rather than limiting.

result.text: The Universitätsklinikum Münster (UKM) is conducting a market exploration for the introduction of a digital mailroom. The aim is to obtain information on available solutions, technical procedures, price levels and supplier structures. The survey is conducted in a technology- and process-open manner. The processing of incoming and outgoing mail is currently largely manual. External mail is sorted centrally, distributed and then re-sorted within the buildings. This process is time- and resource-intensive. Outgoing mail comprises both bulk and individual mailings. Providers who can already demonstrate successfully implemented solutions and present them as part of a system presentation are invited. Particular areas of focus are: - OCR/AI-supported text recognition in the scanning process - Handling of mail marked personal/confidential - Integration of the special electronic authority mailbox (beBPo) - Digitalisation of internal mail distribution The market exploration serves exclusively to gather information. This is not associated with a procurement decision. Interested providers are requested to submit proposed solutions and references for comparable projects to Universitätsklinikum Münster. Subsequently, the University Hospital will contact applicants it deems suitable.

parts.source: Das Universitätsklinikum Münster (UKM) führt eine Markterkundung zur Einführung einer digitalen Poststelle durch. Ziel ist es, Informationen über verfügbare Lösungen, technische Verfahren, Preisniveaus und Anbieterstrukturen zu erhalten. Die Erhebung erfolgt technologie- und prozessoffen. Die Abwicklung der Ein- und Ausgangspost erfolgt derzeit weitgehend manuell. Externe Sendungen werden zentral sortiert, verteilt und anschließend in den Gebäuden erneut feinsortiert. Dieser Prozess ist zeit- und ressourcenintensiv. Der Postausgang umfasst sowohl Massen- als auch Individualsendungen. Eingeladen sind Anbieter, die bereits erfolgreich implementierte Lösungen vorweisen können und diese im Rahmen einer Systempräsentation vorstellen. Besondere Schwerpunkte sind: - OCR-/KI-gestützte Texterkennung im Scanprozess - Behandlung von persönlich/vertraulich gekennzeichneten Sendungen - Integration des besonderen elektronischen Behördenpostfachs (beBPo) - Digitalisierung der internen Postverteilung Die Markterkundung dient ausschließlich der Informationsgewinnung. Eine Vergabeentscheidung ist damit nicht verbunden. Interessierte Anbieter werden gebeten, Lösungsvorschläge und Referenzen vergleichbarer Projekte an das Universitätsklinikum Münster zu übermitteln. Anschließend meldet sich das Universitätsklinikum bei aus seiner Sicht geeigneten Bewerbern.

result.text: Väylävirasto is preparing a procurement, the subject of which is the operating services for the road information systems of Väylävirasto, which suppliers will produce with the help of expert teams. The expert service to be procured includes operator services for six different information systems of Väylävirasto. The procurement is divided into the following four sub-areas. - Sub-area 1 Operation of Tievelho; - Sub-area 2 Operation of the Structural Register; - Sub-area 3 Operation of maintenance and - Sub-area 4 Location reference operation. The goal of the procurement is to ensure the smooth use of information system data from the perspective of data utilisation and updating, and to support the development of information systems. The expert teams will consist of road data experts, structural experts, operators, and technical experts. The roles include both senior and junior-level professionals. The length of the contract has been tentatively set at three years, plus an option of up to two years. Companies interested in the procurement are requested to register for the market survey in accordance with the registration instructions presented below. In the call for tenders, the tenderer may submit a tender for one or more sub-areas. A tender may be submitted independently, together with subcontractors, or as a consortium. Companies interested in the market survey are requested to notify as soon as possible, but no later than 30.9.2026 at 23.00 by filling out the electronic registration form: https://forms.cloud.microsoft/e/ErRyRq6yXZ The market survey consists of the opportunity to comment on the draft material of the tender before the publication of the call for tenders. Please note that this is a market survey notice and this notice does not yet request tenders. Failure to respond to the market survey notice does not prevent participation in a potential call for tenders. The information presented in this market survey notice and the estimated publication date of the call for tenders are preliminary and indicative advance information, which does not bind Väylävirasto to any kind of decision. The preliminary goal of Väylävirasto is to publish the contract notice in January 2027. The market survey notice does not oblige Väylävirasto to carry out the actual procurement procedure. The procurement will form an expert team to support system development, maintenance, and specification, which will be responsible for user support, training, supporting data production processes, data processing and updating, quality management, information services, and documentation and communication related to operation. The experts will identify development needs that arise during operation and convey them to the client and to the separately procured development task specification service. The experts will act at the interface between Väylävirasto, system users, data producers, and maintenance, specification, and further development suppliers. The planned expert team will consist of road data experts, operating service experts, technical data management experts, and project data management experts. The expert team will have both junior and senior-level professionals. A short description of the information system that the supplier's expert team will operate: Basic data repository for road information (Tievelho): Basic data repository for road network infrastructure, condition and measurement data, restrictions, decisions, and classification data.; The procurement will form an expert team, whose tasks include, among others, quality assurance of the Structural Register data, checking and updating data, checking data to correspond to prevailing guidelines, checking data content and quality assurance, checking and updating process diagrams, and specifying data content. The planned expert team will consist of structural experts who have experience in using the Structural Register. A security clearance will be conducted on the experts. A short description of the information system that the supplier's expert team will operate: Structural Register: The Structural Register is a basic data repository for structures and an asset management system. In addition to administrative and structural data, it contains, for example, damage and condition data on structures such as bridges, tunnels, and fixed sea marks. In addition to objects owned by Väylävirasto, the register also contains data on structures owned by municipalities and cities. The Structural Register serves, for example, the experts and service providers of Väylävirasto, Centres for Economic Development, Transport and the Environment, as well as municipalities and cities. The system is being developed and the data content is being expanded continuously.; The procurement will form an expert team, whose tasks include ensuring the smooth use of maintenance information system data from the perspective of data utilisation and updating. A key goal is to ensure that maintenance information systems contain and are provided with up-to-date, high-quality, and structurally uniform data. The background is an identified need to: • Develop and implement quality control of data in maintenance information systems. • Maintain data in maintenance systems. • Produce data and materials for the needs of experts. • Develop and implement a uniform way of data management • Support data production processes in the production and utilisation of road data and maintenance data. • Develop, support, and supervise the data management related to road maintenance of Väylävirasto and Centres for Economic Development, Transport and the Environment • Develop and maintain instructions and documentation related to the utilisation and updating of maintenance data • Support Väylävirasto in development projects related to maintenance and road data management. The planned expert team will consist of operating service experts. The expert team will have both junior and senior-level professionals. result.text: The Bundesbank manages four staff canteens under its own management. The management of a further eight Bundesbank canteens is carried out by external caterers under contract management. For the canteens under its own management, the Bundesbank uses an inventory management system and a checkout/payment system on its own infrastructure (cash or direct debit for internal employees; cash for external employees and guests). The checkout/payment system is integrated into the Bundesbank's SAP landscape. Orders to suppliers are placed by PDF/email; a B2B connection is not available. In daily operations, many steps are currently carried out manually or twice due to a lack of integrations. The same checkout/payment system is used in the contract-managed canteens (including integration into SAP), but inventory management is carried out independently by the caterers outside the Bundesbank's IT landscape. The inventory management system and checkout/payment system are outdated, meaning that the Bundesbank has initiated a project to replace these systems with a SaaS solution. With this new SaaS solution, which is then to be introduced in the following one to two years, modern payment methods (cards, mobile end devices, digital euro) are to be introduced alongside cash and direct debit. In addition, the solution is to be B2B-capable in order to enable a B2B connection of suppliers. Further focus is placed on automation and digitalisation in order to significantly reduce manual effort, e.g. during stocktaking, and the associated sources of error. In the course of this strategic alignment, Deutsche Bundesbank is initiating a structured market exploration. The aim of this measure is to systematically determine the performance and suitability of the SaaS-based gastro-system platforms available on the market (inventory management with checkout and payment system). In particular, it is to be examined to what extent the existing service portfolios of the providers meet the technical, legal, organisational and security requirements of Deutsche Bundesbank. A key focus is inter alia on: - Support for modern payment methods (cash, direct debit, cards, mobile end devices, digital euro) - B2B capability including connection of suppliers - Integration capability into the Bundesbank's SAP landscape - Functions for automation and digitalisation (e.g. for stocktaking) - Operation as SaaS in a BSI C5-certified cloud - Use both in canteens under own management and contract management - German-language project management, support and documentation This market exploration also serves to involve the market at an early stage in a potentially upcoming EU-wide procurement procedure by Deutsche Bundesbank for the procurement of the described services and forms, amongst other things, a basis for decision-making for its technical design. This market exploration is not a procurement procedure directed at the award of a public contract and constitutes neither an offer nor an invitation to conclude a contract. The execution of a procurement procedure, including with a different service scope, remains reserved. Participation in this market exploration has no consequences for the participating company (neither preference nor disadvantage) in the context of a potential future procurement process. Participants in this market exploration have no entitlement to the acquisition of knowledge from the results of the market exploration. Further details on Deutsche Bundesbank's requirements for the SaaS solution described above are available exclusively upon request to the stored e-mail address: Projekt-GastroSys@bundesbank.de

parts.source: Die Bundesbank bewirtschaftet vier Kasinos im Eigenbetrieb. Die Bewirtschaftung von weiteren acht Bundesbank-Kasinos wird von externen Caterern im Fremdbetrieb durchgeführt. Für die Kasinos im Eigenbetrieb hat die Bundesbank auf eigener Infrastruktur ein Warenwirtschaftssystem und ein Kassen-/Bezahlsystem (Bargeld oder Lastschrifteinzug für interne Mitarbeiter; Bargeld für externe Mitarbeiter und Gäste) im Einsatz. Das Kassen-/Bezahlsystem ist in die SAP-Landschaft der Bundesbank integriert. Bestellungen bei Lieferanten erfolgen per PDF/e-mail, eine B2B Anbindung ist nicht vorhanden. Im täglichen Betrieb werden viele Schritte heute manuell bzw. doppelt durchgeführt, da Integrationen fehlen. In den Kasinos im Fremdbetrieb wird dasselbe Kassen-/Bezahlsystem eingesetzt (inklusive Integration nach SAP), die Warenwirtschaft erfolgt jedoch durch die Caterer in Eigenregie außerhalb der IT-Landschaft der Bundesbank. Warenwirtschaftssystem und Kassen-/Bezahlsystem sind in die Jahre gekommen, so dass die Bundesbank ein Projekt für den Austausch dieser Systeme durch eine SaaS Lösung initiiert hat. Mit dieser neuen SaaS Lösung, die dann in den folgenden ein bis zwei Jahren eingeführt werden soll, sollen neben Bargeld und Lastschrifteinzug moderne Bezahlmethoden (Karten, mobile Endgeräte, Digitaler Euro) Einzug halten. Außerdem soll die Lösung B2B-fähig sein, um eine B2B-Anbindung der Lieferanten zu ermöglichen. Weiterer Fokus liegt auf der Automatisierung und Digitalisierung, um manuellen Aufwand z.B. bei der Inventur und die damit verbundenen Fehlerquellen deutlich zu reduzieren. Im Zuge dieser strategischen Ausrichtung initiiert die Deutsche Bundesbank eine strukturierte Markterkundung. Ziel dieser Maßnahme ist es, die Leistungsfähigkeit und Eignung der am Markt verfügbaren SaaS-basierten Gastro-Systemplattformen (Warenwirtschaft mit Kassen- und Bezahlsystem) systematisch zu ermitteln. Dabei soll insbesondere geprüft werden, inwieweit die bestehenden Service-Portfolios der Anbieter den technischen, rechtlichen, organisatorischen und sicherheitstechnischen Anforderungen der Deutschen Bundesbank entsprechen. Ein Schwerpunkt liegt u. a. auf: - Unterstützung moderner Bezahlmethoden (Bargeld, Lastschrift, Karten, mobile Endgeräte, Digitaler Euro) - B2B-Fähigkeit inkl. Anbindung von Lieferanten - Integrationsfähigkeit in die SAP-Landschaft der Bundesbank - Funktionen zur Automatisierung und Digitalisierung (z. B. zur Inventur) - Betrieb als SaaS in einer BSI C5-zertifizierten Cloud - Einsatz sowohl in Kasinos im Eigenbetrieb als auch im Fremdbetrieb - Deutschsprachige Projektabwicklung, Support und Dokumentation Diese Markterkundung dient zugleich dazu, den Markt frühzeitig zu einem potenziell anstehenden EU-weiten Vergabeverfahren der Deutschen Bundesbank zum Bezug der beschriebenen Leistungen einzubinden und bildet u. a. eine Entscheidungsgrundlage für dessen fachliche Ausgestaltung. Diese Markterkundung ist kein auf die Vergabe eines öffentlichen Auftrags gerichtetes Vergabeverfahren und stellt weder ein Angebot noch eine Aufforderung zum Vertragsabschluss dar. Die Durchführung eines Vergabeverfahrens, auch mit anderem Leistungszuschnitt, bleibt vorbehalten. Die Teilnahme an dieser Markterkundung hat für das teilnehmende Unternehmen keine Konsequenzen (weder Bevorzugung noch Benachteiligung) im Rahmen eines potenziellen zukünftigen Beschaffungsprozesses. Teilnehmende an dieser Markterkundung haben keinen Anspruch auf die Erlangung von Kenntnissen aus den Ergebnissen der Markterkundung. Weitere Details zu den Anforderungen der Deutschen Bundesbank an die oben beschriebene SaaS-Lösung erhalten Sie ausschließlich auf Anfrage an die hinterlegte E-Mail-Adresse: Projekt-GastroSys@bundesbank.de

result.text: The State Enterprise Sächsische Informatik Dienste ("SID") is the central IT service provider for the Saxon State Administration. The SID supports the performance of administrative tasks through the use of state-of-the-art information technology and is a competent and collegial IT partner for the Saxon State Administration. As part of its tasks, the SID is responsible for the further development of the Saxon Administrative Network ("SVN"). KDN Kommunale DatenNetz GmbH ("KDN GmbH") operates and manages the Municipal Data Network ("KDN") for the Saxon municipalities. With today's Saxon Administrative Network 2.0 ("SVN 2.0") and the Municipal Data Network III ("KDN III"), the state administration and the municipalities possess a highly powerful and flexible communication and IT infrastructure. The contracts for SVN 2.0 and KDN III end on 31 March 2028. With SVN Next Generation ("SVN NG") and the Municipal Data Network IV ("KDN IV") to be provided on this platform, the communication and IT infrastructure for the state administration and municipalities is being retendered for the period following the termination of the aforementioned contracts. Lot 1: Services Infrastructure: Provision and operation of a secure, efficient and scalable IT infrastructure for SVN NG, based on virtualisation and Kubernetes, as well as housing. Lot 2: Services Operation: Provision and operation of central services within the SVN as well as operation or operational support for central e-government components, specialist applications and other services. Lot 3: Networks: Provision and operation of a core network and network connections for SVN locations, gateways to the internet, the public telephone network and other networks. Lot 4: Unified Communications: Provision and operation of a Unified Communications solution for telephony, video and web conferences as well as other services. Lot 5: Mobile Communications: Provision and operation of mobile voice and data communication. Lot 6: Site Network Management: Operation of LAN, decentralised telecommunication systems, DECT and a WLAN service for employees and guests, as well as provision of selected infrastructure components at SVN locations. Lot 7: SVN Service Desk: Provision and operation of the central service desk in SVN NG. Lot 8: SVN Coordination: Temporal, technical and organisational coordination of the services provided by the contractor and client, as well as security within SVN NG. The subject of the lot-based procurement procedure opened with this contract notice is Lot 6. This is the seventh procurement project within the SVN NG project. The aim is to successively announce the further lot-based procurement procedures for the implementation of SVN NG as follows: Lot 1 (Services Infrastructure): published on 02.09.2024 under notice number 525071-2024 (OJ EU S 170/2024) Lot 2 (Services Operation): published on 09.12.2024 under notice number 748812-2024 (OJ EU S 239/2024) Lot 3 (Networks): published on 16.09.2024 under notice number 560341-2024 (OJ EU S 182/2024) Lot 4 (Unified Communications): published on 16.10.2024 under notice number 624863-2024 (OJ EU S 202/2024) Lot 5 (Mobile Communications): 2025 Lot 7 (SVN Service Desk): published on 18.11.2024 under notice number 700689-2024 (OJ EU S 224/2024) Lot 8 (SVN Coordination): published on 18.11.2024 under notice number 700141-2024 (OJ EU S 224/2024) The exact content of the requested services and the contractual framework conditions will emerge in detail from the procurement documents of the respective lot. Lot 6 comprises services at selected locations of the state administration in the areas of LAN, WLAN, decentralised telecommunication systems and DECT. For this purpose, the client provides the contractor with the required network components in the areas of LAN, WLAN, decentralised telecommunication systems and DECT. Delivery services are to be provided by the contractor for certain components. The lot comprises in particular commissioning services (incl. warehousing of the provided network components and installation) and operation services (incl. configuration, maintenance, on-site fault clearance and hardware replacement of end-of-life components). Two WLANs are to be operated by the contractor: firstly, an SVN WLAN that enables employees of the state administration to access resources within the SVN. For this purpose, the contractor must use the central components from Lot 2 for authentication in accordance with 802.1X. In addition, the use of the SVN WLAN must also be possible for selected end devices without 802.1X support. Secondly, a free WLAN is to be operated by the contractor of Lot 6, which enables employees and guests to access the internet via the contractor's IP addresses. As the operator, the contractor must assume all statutory operator obligations for the free WLAN. In addition, the contractor must provide a software solution for use in the Saxon correctional facilities, which restricts communication options in the LAN and on the respective decentralised telecommunication system if necessary (emergency shutdown). To integrate the SVN WLAN into the SVN NG, coordination with the client and the contractor of Lot 3 is required, among other things.

parts.source: Der Staatsbetrieb Sächsische Informatik Dienste ("SID") ist der zentrale IT-Dienstleister für die sächsische Staatsverwaltung. Der SID unterstützt die Erledigung von Verwaltungsaufgaben durch den Einsatz modernster Informationstechnik und ist kompetenter und kollegialer IT-Partner für die sächsische Staatsverwaltung. Im Rahmen seiner Aufgaben ist der SID für die Fortentwicklung des Sächsischen Verwaltungsnetzes ("SVN") zuständig. Die KDN Kommunale DatenNetz GmbH ("KDN GmbH") betreibt und verwaltet das Kommunale Datennetz ("KDN") für die sächsischen Kommunen. Mit dem heutigen Sächsischen Verwaltungsnetz 2.0 ("SVN 2.0") und dem Kommunalen Datennetz III ("KDN III") besitzen die Staatsverwaltung und die Kommunen eine sehr leistungsfähige und flexible Kommunikations- und IT-Infrastruktur. Die Verträge zum SVN 2.0 und zum KDN III enden am 31. März 2028. Mit dem SVN Next Generation ("SVN NG") und dem auf dieser Plattform bereitzustellenden Kommunalen Datennetz IV ("KDN IV") werden für den Zeitraum nach Beendigung der genannten Verträge die Kommunikations- und IT-Infrastruktur für die Staatsverwaltung und die Kommunen neu ausgeschrieben. Los 1: Dienste-Infrastruktur: Bereitstellung und Betrieb einer sicheren, effizienten und skalierbaren IT-Infrastruktur für SVN NG, basierend auf Virtualisierung und Kubernetes, sowie Housing. Los 2: Dienste-Betrieb: Bereitstellung und Betrieb von zentralen Diensten im SVN sowie Betrieb bzw. Betriebsunterstützung für zentrale E-Government-Komponenten, Fachverfahren und weitere Dienste. Los 3: Netze: Bereitstellung und Betrieb eines Kernnetzes und von Netzanbindungen der SVN-Standorte, von Übergängen in das Internet, das öffentliche Fernsprechnetz und weitere Netze. Los 4: Unified Communications: Bereitstellung und Betrieb einer Unified Communications-Lösung für Telefonie, Video- und Webkonferenzen sowie weitere Dienste. Los 5: Mobilfunk: Bereitstellung und Betrieb mobiler Sprach- und Datenkommunikation. Los 6: Standort-Netzwerkmanagement: Betrieb von LAN, dezentralen TK-Anlagen, DECT und eines WLAN-Dienstes für Beschäftigte und Gäste sowie Bereitstellung ausgewählter Infrastrukturkomponenten an SVN-Standorten. Los 7: SVN Service Desk: Bereitstellung und Betrieb des zentralen Service Desks im SVN NG. Los 8: SVN-Koordination: Zeitliche, fachliche und organisatorische Koordination der auftragnehmer- und auftraggeberseitigen Leistungen sowie der Sicherheit im SVN NG. Gegenstand des mit der vorliegenden Auftragsbekanntmachung eröffneten losweisen Vergabeverfahrens ist das Los 6. Es handelt sich um das siebte Beschaffungsvorhaben im Rahmen des Projektes SVN NG. Es wird angestrebt, die weiteren losweisen Vergabeverfahren über die Realisierung des SVN NG sukzessive wie folgt bekannt zu machen: Los 1 (Dienste-Infrastruktur): am 02.09.2024 veröffentlicht unter Bekanntmachungsnummer 525071-2024 (ABl. EU S 170/2024) Los 2 (Dienste-Betrieb): am 09.12.2024 veröffentlicht unter Bekanntmachungsnummer 748812-2024 (ABl. EU S 239/2024) Los 3 (Netze): am 16.09.2024 veröffentlicht unter Bekanntmachungsnummer 560341-2024 (ABl. EU S 182/2024) Los 4 (Unified Communications): am 16.10.2024 veröffentlicht unter Bekanntmachungsnummer 624863-2024 (ABl. EU S 202/2024) Los 5 (Mobilfunk): 2025 Los 7 (SVN Service Desk): am 18.11.2024 veröffentlicht unter Bekanntmachungsnummer 700689-2024 (ABl. EU S 224/2024) Los 8 (SVN-Koordination): am 18.11.2024 veröffentlicht unter Bekanntmachungsnummer 700141-2024 (ABl. EU S 224/2024) Der genaue Inhalt der geforderten Leistungen und die vertraglichen Rahmenbedingungen werden sich im Einzelnen aus den Vergabeunterlagen des jeweiligen Loses ergeben. Das Los 6 umfasst Leistungen an ausgewählten Standorten der Staatsverwaltung im Bereich LAN, WLAN, dezentrale TK-Anlagen und DECT. Der Auftraggeber stellt hierfür dem Auftragnehmer die benötigten Netzwerkkomponenten im Bereich LAN, WLAN, dezentrale TK-Anlagen und DECT bei. Für bestimmte Komponenten sind durch den Auftragnehmer Lieferleistungen zu erbringen. Das Los umfasst insbesondere Leistungen der Inbetriebnahme (inkl. Lagerhaltung der beigestellten Netzwerkkomponenten und Montage) und des Betriebs (inkl. Konfiguration, Wartung, Vor-Ort Störungsbeseitigung und Hardware-Tausch von End of Life-Komponenten). Vom Auftragnehmer sind zwei WLANs zu betreiben: zum einen ein SVN WLAN, das den Bediensteten der Staatsverwaltung den Zugriff auf die Ressourcen innerhalb des SVN ermöglicht. Hierzu sind vom Auftragnehmer die zentralen Komponenten aus Los 2 für die Authentifizierung gemäß 802.1X zu nutzen. Zudem muss die Nutzung des SVN WLANs auch für ausgewählte Endgeräte ohne 802.1X Unterstützung möglich sein. Zum anderen ist vom Auftragnehmer von Los 6 ein freies WLAN zu betreiben, das Bediensteten und Gästen Zugriff auf das Internet über IP-Adressen des Auftragnehmers ermöglicht. Für das freie WLAN hat der Auftragnehmer als Betreiber sämtliche gesetzliche Betreiberpflichten zu übernehmen. Zudem ist vom Auftragnehmer eine Softwarelösung für den Einsatz in den sächsischen Justizvollzugsanstalten bereitzustellen, die im Bedarfsfall die Kommunikationsmöglichkeiten im LAN und auf der jeweiligen dezentralen TK-Anlage einschränkt (Notabschaltung). Zur Integration des SVN WLANs in das SVN NG sind unter anderem Abstimmungen mit dem Auftraggeber und dem Auftragnehmer des Loses 3 nötig.

result.text: Dundee City Council intends to procure a construction consultant resource and project management system to improve the planning, allocation and monitoring of architectural, engineering and specialist consultancy resources across its capital and housing programmes. The system will complement existing corporate and client-side systems, including Civica, by providing enhanced resource planning, capacity forecasting, workload visibility, timesheet reporting and management information. The objective is to improve service efficiency, strengthen forward planning, support evidence-based resource decisions and provide greater assurance over programme delivery, capacity utilisation and value for money. Lot 1: . Dundee City Council is undertaking this Prior Information Notice (PIN) and market engagement exercise to better understand the solutions currently available within the market for construction consultant resource and project management software. The information gathered will assist the Council in developing its procurement strategy, refining its requirements and determining the most appropriate route to market. As part of this exercise, the Council intends to invite selected suppliers to participate in product demonstrations, currently anticipated to take place during early October 2026 (please note, these dates are indicative only). These demonstrations will provide an opportunity for the Council to gain a greater understanding of available solutions, functionality, implementation approaches and delivery models. Suppliers wishing to be considered for participation in the demonstration stage are requested to complete and return the attached questionnaire. The information provided will be used solely for market engagement purposes and to assist the Council in identifying suppliers whose solutions appear capable of meeting the Council's requirements. Completed questionnaires should be submitted by 12 Noon on 25 September 2026 to trina.forbes@dundeecity.gov.uk. Suppliers who do not submit a completed questionnaire will not be considered for participation in the demonstration stage. The Council reserves the right to limit the number of demonstrations undertaken and participation in this market engagement exercise will not confer any advantage or disadvantage in any subsequent procurement process. Additional information: This PIN is issued for market engagement purposes only and will not be used to evaluate, select or exclude suppliers in any future procurement process. Information received will help Dundee City Council understand the market, develop its requirements and determine the most appropriate procurement approach. Participation is voluntary and does not commit the Council to proceed.

result.text: The existing building was constructed 1911 in solid construction with a hipped roof. The last general refurbishment was carried out in 1986, alongside smaller refurbishment measures in recent years. The site has a gradient from east to west. The playground located to the south of the existing building is available as the construction site for the extension of the Erich Kästner School. The new "glass joint" or intermediate building connects the existing school with the planned extension and provides a new second structural escape route including a lift for barrier-free access. The new four-storey school building was designed in solid construction with a punched window façade. Structurally, each storey contains up to 3 classrooms, depending on the requirements of the room schedule, which are separated by a group room. In the north-east of the extension, directly next to the new stairwell, there is a ancillary room zone spanning all floors, which contains sanitary, storage and technical rooms. Construction work, floor covering work, screed work, façade work, floor and tiling work, landscaping construction services for green spaces, metalworking work, plastering work, carpentry and joinery work, construction work for steel structures, painting work, metalworking work, installation of doors and windows as well as accessories, woodwork, installation of fitted furniture, installation of partitions, flat-screen monitors, information systems, electronic display boards, switch or router software package, kitchen furniture

result.text: The Association of North East Councils Trading as the North East Procurement Organisation (NEPO) is seeking to establish a multi-supplier, multi-lot Framework for Building Materials and Managed Stores. NEPO intends to publish an Invitation to Tender via the Open eTendering system. Suppliers wishing to be considered for this Framework Agreement must register their expression of interest and submit a tender through the NEPO eTendering system. If not already registered, candidates should register on the Open eTender system at: https://open-uk.org/ Tenders must be submitted using the link above. Tenders submitted via post or email methods will not be accepted. Guidance for how to create an account, search for opportunities and respond is included within the Supplier's hub. If you require further support please email open.support@nepo.org Lot 1: Integrated Materials Management Solutions and Managed Stores. Lot 1 covers the provision of integrated materials management solutions, managed stores, and associated materials management services to support the operational requirements of Contracting Authorities. The Lot is intended to provide Contracting Authorities with access to integrated materials management solutions and managed stores environments that improve the availability, control and distribution of materials, products and consumables required to support responsive repairs, planned maintenance, asset management, facilities management and construction activities. The primary service available under this Lot is an Integrated Materials Management Solution designed to support the efficient sourcing, control, distribution and management of materials, products and consumables. Suppliers shall be capable of delivering integrated materials management solutions designed to provide Contracting Authorities with efficient access to the materials, products and consumables required to support service delivery through one or more coordinated supply channels. Such solutions may incorporate multiple supply chain partners, manufacturers, merchants, distributors and specialist providers operating through a coordinated stores environment or other integrated materials management solution. Integrated materials management solutions may include: Consolidated materials supply arrangements; Multi-source inventory management; Coordinated replenishment services; Centralised issue and distribution points; Integrated ordering solutions; Supply chain coordination; Data analytics and management reporting; Consolidated reporting arrangements; and Demand planning and forecasting The Supplier may deliver these services independently or in collaboration with manufacturers, merchants, distributors, specialist providers or other supply chain organisations. Such arrangements may include the coordination of multiple merchants and specialist suppliers operating through a single managed store or integrated materials management solution where this provides operational or commercial benefit to the Contracting Authority. Integrated materials management solutions and managed stores solutions may be delivered from Contracting Authority premises, Supplier premises or other agreed locations and may include permanent, temporary or mobile facilities. The services available under this Lot include, but are not limited to: Managed stores operations; Customer-site stores; Merchant counter solutions; Satellite stores; Mobile and temporary stores; Inventory management services; Materials management services; Stock replenishment services; Vendor managed inventory solutions; Consignment stock arrangements; Van stock management services; Automated dispensing and vending solutions; Supply chain management services; Product standardisation and rationalisation; Electronic ordering and materials management platforms; Digital materials management solutions; Technical support services; and Management information and reporting services. Lot 2: General Materials. Lot 2 covers the supply of general building, construction, maintenance and repair materials to support the delivery of responsive repairs, planned maintenance, asset management, facilities management, capital works, construction projects, highways maintenance and civil engineering activities. The Lot is intended to provide Contracting Authorities with access to a comprehensive range of building materials and associated products required for the construction, maintenance, repair, refurbishment and improvement of residential, commercial, industrial and public sector assets, together with highways, civil engineering and infrastructure projects. The products available under this Lot include, but are not limited to: Building materials; Bricks, blocks and masonry products; Cement, aggregates and associated products; Concrete and precast products; Timber and timber products; Sheet materials; Roofing materials and accessories; Insulation products; Drylining systems; Plaster and plasterboard products; Drainage products; Landscaping materials; Fencing products; Highways and civil engineering materials; Kerbs, channels, paving and block products, including alternative material products (e.g. rubber); Street works and infrastructure materials; Ducting and utility protection products Doors, windows and joinery products; Ironmongery and architectural hardware; Fixings, fasteners and adhesives; Sealants and building chemicals; Decorating materials; Hand tools; Workwear and personal protective equipment (PPE); Site safety products; Construction consumables; and Associated accessories and ancillary products. Products supplied under this Lot may be utilised across a broad range of maintenance, construction, highways, public realm, infrastructure and asset improvement projects.

result.text: The overarching goal of this notice of funding opportunity (NOFO) and its companion opportunities is to establish the Precision Medicine with AI: Integrating Imaging with Multimodal Data (PRIMED-AI) Program to support development of innovative, reliable, cost-effective, and sustainable multimodal AI-based clinical decision support (CDS) tools. PRIMED-AI CDS tools are based on the integration of clinical imaging with other types of multimodal health data to enhance care for patients with a wide range of health conditions. The PRIMED-AI Program seeks to catalyze the adoption of AI-based CDS tools into clinical workflows to enable novel personalized medicine strategies that address significant health challenges. The purpose of this NOFO is to solicit applications for the creation of a Validation Center to serve as a dedicated hub for the comprehensive evaluation and characterization of AI-enabled, image-based, multimodal CDS tools developed by the PRIMED-AI Consortium, to ensure these tools are reliable, reproducible, and generalizable. The Validation Center will focus on verification, validation, interoperability, and uncertainty quantification to comprehensively characterize performance of the CDS tools developed by the program. The core functions of the Validation Center will involve the systematic validation of PRIMED-AI Consortium deliverables, including those emerging from award recipients under the Playbook, Data-to-Model Academic-Industrial Partnerships, and Model-to-Clinic NOFOs.

result.text: The ekom21 - Kommunales Gebietsrechenzentrum Hessen (ekom21) is a body governed by public law pursuant to the Hessian Data Processing Association Act (DV-VerbundG). In the fields of digitalisation and eGovernment, ekom21 assumes a pioneering role and uses innovative technologies to ensure greater efficiency in administration as well as progress and user-friendliness. For these end customers, ekom21 provides digital services in its data centres and offers access to various product ranges in the field of IT services. The contractor must be able to provide the required usage profiles of the site connections for all customers of ekom21 in the federal state of Hesse and nationwide, as well as at the locations of ekom21. The subjects of the tender are the following lots: - Lot 1: Site networking - Lot 2: DDoS mitigation solution - Lot 3: Satellite internet. It is planned to conclude a framework agreement with one economic operator per lot. In a parallel framework agreement, ekom21 procures a managed SD-WAN from a service provider as an overlay network. SD-WAN and the overlay network are not the subject of this procurement. The subject of the tender for lot 1 comprises site networking based on a carrier Ethernet service. For further information, see the specification of services for specific technical requirements of lot 1. The maximum value for this lot is set at a total of 3.000.000,00 euros (net).; The subject of the tender for lot 2 comprises a DDoS mitigation solution. The CLIENT requires a solution for protection against volume-based attacks such as denial-of-service (DoS) or distributed denial-of-service (DDoS) in combination with a redundant and high-performance internet connection based on a transit service. The required provision of the handover routers (as the service handover point) as well as the corresponding management and monitoring of the solution also belong to the required scope of services. For further information, see the specification of services for specific technical requirements of lot 2. The maximum value for this lot is set at a total of 3.000.000,00 euros (net).; The subject of the tender for lot 3 comprises satellite internet. The client does not currently have any locations connected to the public internet via satellite. However, there are enquiries from the client's end customers that require corresponding equipment. For further information, see the specification of services for specific technical requirements of lot 3. The maximum value for this lot is set at a total of 300.000,00 euros (net).

parts.source: Die ekom21 - Kommunales Gebietsrechenzentrum Hessen (ekom21) ist eine Körperschaft des öffentlichen Rechts nach dem Hessischen Datenverarbeitungsverbundgesetz (DV-VerbundG). In den Bereichen Digitalisierung und eGovernment nimmt die ekom21 eine Vorreiterrolle ein und sorgt mit innovativen Technologien für mehr Effizienz in der Verwaltung und für Fortschritt sowie Bürgerfreundlichkeit. Für diese Endkunden stellt die ekom21 digitale Dienstleistungen in seinen Rechenzentren bereit und bietet Zugang zu verschiedenen Warenkörben im Bereich der IT-Dienstleistungen. Der Auftragnehmer muss für alle Kunden der ekom21 im Bundesland Hessen und deutschlandweit sowie an den Standorten der ekom21 die geforderten Nutzungsprofile der Standortanbindungen bereitstellen können. Ausschreibungsgegenstand sind folgende Lose: - Los 1: Standortvernetzung - Los 2: DDoS-Mitigation-Lösung - Los 3: Satelliteninternet Geplant ist eine Rahmenvereinbarung mit einem Wirtschaftsteilnehmer je Los abzuschließen. In einem parallelen Rahmenvertrag bezieht die ekom21 ein Managed SD-WAN von einem Dienstleister als Overlay-Netzwerk. SD-WAN bzw. das Overlay-Netzwerk sind nicht Gegenstand dieser Vergabe. Der Ausschreibungsgegenstand des Loses 1 umfasst die Standortvernetzung basierend auf einem Carrier-Ethernet-Service. Nähere Informationen siehe Leistungsbeschreibung zur fachspezifische Anforderungen Los 1. Der Höchstwert für dieses Loses ist auf insgesamt 3.000.000,00 Euro (netto) festgelegt.; Der Ausschreibungsgegenstand des Loses 2 umfasst eine DDoS-Mitigation-Lösung. Der AUFTRAGGEBER benötigt eine Lösung zum Schutz gegen volumenbasierte Angriffe wie Denial-of-Service (DoS) oder Distributed-Denial-of-Service (DDoS) in Kombination mit einer redundanten und performanten Internetanbindung auf Basis eines Transit-Services. Die erforderliche Bereitstellung der Übergaberouter (als Leistungsübergabepunkt) sowie das entsprechende Management bzw. die Überwachung der Lösung gehören ebenfalls zum benötigten Leistungsumfang. Nähere Informationen siehe Leistungsbeschreibung zur fachspezifische Anforderungen Los 2. Der Höchstwert für dieses Loses ist auf insgesamt 3.000.000,00 Euro (netto) festgelegt.; Der Ausschreibungsgegenstand des Loses 3 umfasst das Satelliteninternet. Der Auftraggeber verfügt heute noch nicht über Standorte, die per Satellit an das öffentliche Internet angebunden sind. Es gibt jedoch von den Endkunden des Auftraggebers Anfragen, die eine entsprechende Ausstattung erfordern. Nähere Informationen siehe Leistungsbeschreibung zur fachspezifische Anforderungen Los 3. Der Höchstwert für dieses Loses ist auf insgesamt 300.000,00 Euro (netto) festgelegt.

result.text: The purpose of this prior information notice is to inform about and prepare the market for a coming competition. This prior information notice is not intended to shorten the tender deadline in accordance with the Public Procurement Regulations §20-2 (2). NHN wants to start a procurement process for broadband access for small and medium sized locations. The accesses are used by members in the health network, service providers and entities in the central health management. The accesses represent an important part of a robust and secure infrastructure for transporting digital services for the entire health and welfare sector. Limitations: Accesses to large locations such as hospitals, computer centres etc. are not a part of this procurement. The aim is to enter into an agreement with one or several tenderers. Furthermore, we see great opportunities in further developing digital interaction systems that make NHNs and the supplier's work processes more efficient for the establishment, operation and termination of accesses. The Contracting Authority intends to sign a contract by the end of 2026, starting the agreement from January 2027. About NHN: NHN is a government company owned by the Ministry of Health and Care Services. Our task is to develop, administer and operate national e-health systems and infrastructure. We are responsible for national e-health services such as e-prescription, helsenorge.no, core journal and basic data. We also provide services within ICT, procurements and archives for the health administration agencies. NHN operates 80 national ICT systems and has 1,000 capable employees distributed across offices in Trondheim, Oslo, Tromsø, Moss and Svalbard. Read more at the https://www.nhn.no. At the time of the prior information notice, NHN plans to conduct the procurement in accordance with the Norwegian Public Procurement Act and Regulations, based on the procedure competitive procedure with negotiation after prior publication above the EU/EEA threshold (1.49 MNOK) pursuant to FOA Parts I and III. To further strengthen the market’s ability to participate in the competition, and to facilitate a well‐executed procurement process, NHN is considering market research and supplier dialogue in accordance with FOA §§12‐1 and 12‐2. Any supplier dialogue will be announced via Mercell and Doffin/TED as a follow-up to this prior information notice. We intend to engage in dialogue with the market to obtain additional information and insights related to our needs.

rejected.text: REQUEST FOR INFORMATION / MARKET CONSULTATION Procurement Lifecycle Management Solution Senate Properties (“Senate”) is a state enterprise responsible for managing the Finnish government’s real estate assets and providing workplace and facility services. As part of the development of its procurement function, Senate initiates a market consultation to explore system solutions supporting procurement lifecycle management. The objective is to develop the overall procurement framework and improve its governance, transparency and data-driven management. The preliminary review will focus on the following areas: • Supplier Management • Procurement Management (Sourcing Pipeline) • Tender and eTendering Management • Procure-to-Pay (P2P), including invoice automation • Contract Lifecycle Management The solution is reviewed as a modular entity. Suppliers may respond to the RFI for the entire scope or for one or more individual modules. A potential future procurement may be conducted as an EU-threshold public procurement. This RFI does not constitute a contract notice or an invitation to tender. Responses are non-binding and will not be used for supplier selection. Senate will not compensate suppliers for any costs incurred in responding to this RFI or participating in the market consultation. Senate reserves the right to suspend, modify or discontinue any potential procurement in whole or in part. This market consultation is conducted in accordance with the Finnish Act on Public Procurement and Concession Contracts and Article 40 of Directive 2014/24/EU. Further details, questions and response instructions are provided in the attached RFI document. Responses must be submitted by 11.03.2026 at 16:00 (EET) to antti@zealsourcing.fi. Senate may publish anonymised questions and answers to all parties that have reviewed the RFI and may organise supplier-specific discussions or system demonstrations based on the responses received. Please see attachments 1 and 2.

result.text: The purpose of this Notice is to invite market operators to a Market Engagement Event for the potential future exercise to procure services supporting the development of an innovative obesity pathway in North East and North Cumbria on Thursday 8th January at 10:45 via Teams Integrated Care Board (NENC ICB) is developing a new, community-first obesity pathway as part of the Obesity Pathway Innovation Programme (OPIP). The pathway will support adults with obesity who are waiting lists or at risk of economic activity due to obesity and related long-term conditions. To enable this at scale, NENC ICB is exploring options to procure a digital partner to provide an integrated platform that will act as the digital "spine" for the pathway. The intended service is expected to support the following: 1. Identification and invitation of eligible patients (for example via population-health tools and waiting-list data) 2. Digital referral, consent and triage 3. Patient-facing tools for self-assessment, remote monitoring and behavioural support (including AI meal planning) 4. Role based portals for community pharmacies, specialist teams and programme staff. The platform will need to integrate with existing NHS systems (for example NHS App, GP clinical systems and provider electronic patient records), support high standards of clinical safety, information governance and cybersecurity, and generate data and dashboards required for independent evaluation of outcomes, equity and value for money. This Market Engagement Event is intended to help NENC ICB understand the capabilities, innovations and constraints within the digital health market, and to test our emerging requirements and delivery approach. Feedback from suppliers will be used to refine any future specification and procurement strategy for these services. Additional information: To attend this event please register on Eventbrite using this link: https://www.eventbrite.co.uk/e/market-engagement-event-innovative-obesity-pathway-nenc-tickets-1978132080302?aff=oddtdtcreator This notice is for information and engaging with the supply market only. It is not a binding statement of intent or call for competition. HI NENC reserves the right not to enter a formal process and not award a contract. The information contained in this notice, including information relating to the nature and scope of the requirements, the service classification of this requirement from the list of CPV codes, is only indicative of the HI NENC's current thinking and is neither exhaustive nor binding.
