result.text: New establishment of a digital alerting system in the POCSAG standard (2m band) for non-police emergency response in the Landkreis Emmendingen to replace the analogue 5-tone alerting. The subject of the procurement is the supply, installation and commissioning of a area-wide digital alerting system complying with the POCSAG standard in the 2m band for emergency services organisations in the Landkreis Emmendingen, including migration from the existing analogue 5-tone alerting, the supply of end-user devices as well as maintenance and service provisions. The procurement procedure in question comprises the establishment of 37 digital alerting repeater sites within the district area including antenna and lightning protection technology as well as the electrotechnical upgrading of the structures for these sites. Furthermore, a total of four digital alerters (two fixed installations and two mobile emergency alerters) as well as network and IT technology for the central system technology will be installed at the site of the Integrated Control Centre Emmendingen. The contract is divided into four lots. Lot 1 comprises the digital alerting system technology, in particular the supply, assembly, commissioning and configuration of the digital alerting repeaters and digital alerters with subsequent services on the basis of an EVB-IT service contract with a fixed term of 24 months. Lot 2 includes antenna technology and mast construction, meaning in particular the supply and assembly of antenna masts and lightning protection as well as earthing components. Lot 3 describes the necessary electrical work. Lot 4 comprises the procurement of end-user devices using a shopping-basket principle with call-offs by the respective authorised municipalities or relief organisations. Supply, installation, and commissioning of the central and decentralised system technology of the digital alerting system (including digital alerters, digital alerting repeaters, switches, software), including system integration, tests, training as well as the conclusion of an EVB-IT service contract limited to the first 24 months.; Supply, assembly and commissioning of antenna systems (2m, GPS, LTE), antenna carriers and mast structures including lightning protection and earthing measures and structural analyses, as well as coordination with property owners.; Execution of all electrical connection and installation work at transmitter and technical sites, including power supply as well as documentation in accordance with DIN VDE 0100-600.; Supply, installation, configuration and commissioning of end-user devices for receiving the alarm messages transmitted via the components of lot 1 and of components for remote programming of these end-user devices (server-client structure) and central components for implementing a call-back functionality from and additional alarm information to the end-user devices via the mobile communications network. The procurement of the end-user devices takes place via a framework agreement according to the shopping-basket principle with call-offs by the authorised municipalities and relief organisations.

parts.source: Neu-Errichtung eines Digitalen Alarmierungssystems im POCSAG-Standard (2m Band) für die nichtpolizeiliche Gefahrenabwehr im Landkreis Emmendingen zur Ablösung der analogen 5-Ton-Alarmierung. Gegenstand der Beschaffung ist die Lieferung, Errichtung und Inbetriebnahme eines flächendeckenden Digitalen Alarmierungssystems nach POCSAG Standard im 2m-Band für BOS Organisationen im Landkreis Emmendingen, einschließlich Migration von der bestehenden analogen 5 Ton Alarmierung, der Lieferung von Endgeräten sowie Wartungs- und Serviceleistungen. Das gegenständliche Vergabeverfahren umfasst die Errichtung von 37 Digitalen-Alarmumsetzer-Standorten im Kreisgebiet inkl. Antennen- und Blitzschutztechnik sowie die elektrotechnische Ertüchtigung der Bauwerke für diese Standorte. Des Weiteren werden insgesamt vier Digitale Alarmgeber (zwei Festeinbauten und zwei mobile Notfallalarmgeber) sowie Netzwerk- und IT-Technik für die zentrale Systemtechnik am Standort der Integrierte Leitstelle Emmendingen installiert. Der Auftrag ist in vier Fachlose aufgeteilt. Los 1 umfasst die DA-Systemtechnik, insbesondere die Lieferung, Montage, Inbetriebnahme und Konfiguration der Digitalen Alarmumsetzer und Digitalen Alarmgeber mit einem anschließenden Serviceleistungen auf der Grundlage eines EVB-IT Servicevertrags mit fester Laufzeit von 24 Monaten. Los 2 beinhaltet Antennentechnik und Mastbau, also insbesondere die Lieferung und Montage von Antennenmasten und Blitzschutz- sowie Erdungskomponenten. Los 3 beschreibt die erforderlichen die Elektroarbeiten. Los 4 umfasst die Beschaffung von Endgeräten in Form eines Warenkorb-Prinzips mit Abruf durch die jeweils berechtigten Kommunen bzw. Hilfsorganisationen. Lieferung, Aufbau, und Inbetriebnahme der zentralen und dezentralen Systemtechnik des Digitalen Alarmierungssystems (u.a. DAG, DAU, Switche, Software), einschließlich Systemintegration, Tests, Schulung sowie Abschluss eines EVB-IT Servicevertrags befristet für die ersten 24 Monate.; Lieferung, Montage und Inbetriebnahme von Antennensystemen (2m, GPS, LTE) Antennenträgern und Mastkonstruktionen einschließlich Blitzschutz- und Erdungsmaßnahmen und statischer Nachweise, sowie Abstimmung mit Grundstückseigentümern.; Durchführung sämtlicher elektrischer Anschluss- und Installationsarbeiten an Sender- und Technikstandorten, einschließlich Stromversorgung sowie Dokumentation gemäß DIN VDE 0100-600.; Lieferung, Installation, Konfiguration und Inbetriebnahme von Endgeräten zum Empfang der über die Komponenten des Loses 1 ausgesendeten Alarmmeldungen sowie von Komponenten zur Fernprogrammierung dieser Endgeräte (Server-Client-Struktur) und zentralen Komponenten zur Realisierung einer Rückmeldefunktionalität von und einer zusätzlichen Alarminformation an die Endgeräte über das Mobilfunknetz. Die Beschaffung der Endgeräte erfolgt über eine Rahmenvereinbarung nach dem Warenkorb-Prinzip mit einem Abruf durch die berechtigten Kommunen und Hilfsorganisationen.

In order to increase the effectiveness, efficiency and transparency of the operational work and to position the foundation for the future in harmony with its shareholders, a comprehensive reorganisation and strategic realignment is to take place. Lot LOT-0001: TNW_Reorganisation of the Stiftung Welterbe im Harz. It is intended that the ongoing business of the Harz Heritage Foundation, which is already largely geared towards the pending reorganisation and ready to have its existing strategy, task distribution and working method, organisational structure and processes comprehensively reviewed. The aim is to increase the effectiveness, efficiency and transparency of the operational work and to position the foundation for the future in harmony with its shareholders. Beyond this, it is under discussion whether the existing legal form, the applicable statutes and the foundation purpose are still appropriate or should be adapted in the course of the strategic realignment.

parts.source: Die Stiftung Bergwerk Rammelsberg, Altstadt von Goslar und Oberharzer Wasserwirtschaft", kurz Stiftung UNESCO-Welterbe im Harz ist verantwortlich für die Förderung, Vermittlung, Erhaltung und Koordination des UNESCO-Weltkulturerbes im Westharz und wurde 2012 auf Initiative des Auftraggebers gegründet. Um die Wirksamkeit, Effizienz und Transparenz der operativen Arbeit zu erhöhen und die Stiftung im Einklang mit ihren Gesellschaftern zukunftsfähig aufzustellen soll eine umfassende Umorganisation und strategische Neuausrichtung erfolgen. Unter Berücksichtigung der ordnungsgemäßen und wirtschaftlichen Verwendung der öffentlichen Mittel soll oberstes Ziel die verlässliche Erfüllung der Stiftungsaufgaben - die Förderung, Vermittlung, Erhaltung und Koordination des UNESCO-Weltkulturerbes im Westharz bleiben. Es ist beabsichtigt, das laufende Geschäft der Stiftung Welterbe Harz, welches bereits weitestgehend auf die anstehende Reorganisation ausgerichtet und bereit ist, ihre bestehende Strategie, Aufgabenverteilung und Arbeitsweise, Organisationsstruktur und Prozesse umfassend überprüfen zu lassen. Ziel ist es, Wirksamkeit, Effizienz und Transparenz der operativen Arbeit zu erhöhen und die Stiftung im Einklang mit ihren Gesellschaftern zukunftsfähig aufzustellen. Darüber hinaus steht zur Diskussion, ob die bestehende Rechtsform, die geltende Satzung und der Stiftungszweck noch angemessen sind oder im Zuge der strategischen Neuausrichtung angepasst werden sollten.

result.text: UPDATED NOTICE - PLEASE READ: April 6, 2023 EDA is excited to announce the launch of its new grants management platform: the Economic Development Grants Experience (EDGE). EDGE was developed to streamline the application and grants management process by implementing a single platform with increased transparency, improved user experience, higher data quality, and more efficiency throughout the entire grant lifecycle. As of April 6th, 2023, applications can no longer be submitted on Grants.gov, and will ONLY be accepted through EDGE. To apply in EDGE, please go to: sfgrants.eda.gov . More information on how to apply is provided in the full NOFO. Please note that the above does not apply for Partnership Planning applications . For more information, please reach out to your point of contact. Program Description: EDA makes planning and local technical assistance investments to support economic development, foster job creation, and attract private investment in economically distressed areas of the United States. Under the Planning program, EDA makes Partnership Planning, Short-Term Planning, and State Planning awards to eligible recipients to create and implement regional economic development plans designed to build capacity and guide the economic prosperity and resiliency of an area or region. More specifically, EDA makes Partnership Planning investments to designated planning organizations (i.e., District Organizations) serving EDA-designated Economic Development Districts and to Indian Tribes to facilitate the development, implementation, revision, or replacement of Comprehensive Economic Development Strategies (CEDS), which articulate and prioritize the strategic economic goals of recipients’ respective regions. EDA also makes Short-Term and State Planning awards for economic development planning activities that guide the eventual creation and retention of high-quality jobs, particularly for the unemployed and underemployed in the Nation’s most economically distressed regions. Under the Local Technical Assistance program, EDA makes awards to strengthen the capacity of local or State organizations, institutions of higher education, and other eligible entities to undertake and promote effective economic development programs through projects such as feasibility studies, impact analyses, disaster resiliency plans, and project planning. *Please note: While the published Notice of Funding Opportunity (available under "Related Documents") states that the ED900A form and the SF424B form are both required for a complete application, these forms are no longer required and have therefore been removed from the package template.

result.text: Dear Sir or Madam, Heidelberg University Hospital (UKHD) currently uses a self-developed ABAP-based add-on called BISI for electronic demand notification. As part of the SAP S/4 migration, this demand notification system is to be replaced by a long-term future-proof and modern solution. From a prospective perspective, the demand notification system is intended to support the entire Heidelberg-Mannheim hospital network with all subsidiaries and holdings. UKHD manages 2589 beds. With 87.441 inpatient patients and 1.275.241 outpatient treatment cases, it is the largest employer in the region. 14544 employees from 133 nations are employed at UKHD. The Faculty of Medicine trains 4.750 students. The Corporate Purchasing and Logistics Management division and the pharmacy supply the entire UKHD corporate group including subsidiaries and holdings and also supply external hospitals in the surrounding area. The newly procured tool for demand requests must be intuitive and easy for end users to operate and be based on the look and feel of modern, future-proof, efficient request platforms. This requires that end customers can record and request any demands during demand requests regardless of the product group, article group, purchasing organisation or financing type in the sense of a mixed shopping basket. The tool takes over the routing of requirements into the correct demand channels and controls the follow-on documents. The tool to be procured must be able to be connected to both SAP ECC and S/4 HANA. In this market exploration, UKHD therefore wishes to examine what options the relevant market currently offers for this contract subject, what empirical values can be contributed and what price range these services fall within.

parts.source: Sehr geehrte Damen und Herren, das Universitätsklinikum Heidelberg (UKHD) nutzt aktuell zur elektronischen Bedarfsmeldung ein eigenentwickeltes AddOn auf ABAP-Basis namens BISI. Dieses Bedarfsmeldesystem soll im Rahmen der SAP S/4- Migration durch eine langfristig zukunftssichere und moderne Lösung ersetzt werden. Perspektivisch soll das Bedarfsmeldesystem den gesamten Klinikverbund Heidelberg-Mannheim mit allen Töchtern und Beteiligungen unterstützen. Das UKHD bewirtschaftet 2589 Betten. Mit 87.441 vollstationären Patienten und 1.275.241 ambulanten Behandlungsfällen ist es der größte Arbeitgeber der Region. 14544 Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter aus 133 Nationen sind am UKHD beschäftigt. In der Medizinischen Fakultät werden 4.750 Studierende ausgebildet. Der Geschäftsbereich Konzerneinkauf und Logistikmanagement und die Apotheke versorgen den gesamten Konzern des UKHD inklusive Töchter und Beteiligungen und beliefern auch Externe Krankenhäuser der Umgebung. Das neu zu beschaffende Tool zur Bedarfsanmeldung soll intuitiv und einfach für die Endanwender bedienbar sein und sich am Look and Feel moderner zukunftsfähiger, effizienter Anforderungsplattformen orientieren. Dies bedingt, dass die Endkunden bei der Bedarfsanmeldung jegliche Bedarfe unabhängig von der Warengruppe, der Artikelgruppe, der Einkaufsorganisation oder der Finanzierungsart im Sinne eines gemischten Einkaufswagens erfassen und anfordern können. Das Tool übernimmt die Steuerung der Anforderungen in die richtigen Bedarfskanäle und steuert die Folgebelege. Das zu beschaffende Tool soll sowohl an SAP-ECC wie auch an S/4 HANA angebunden werden können. In der vorliegenden Markterkundung möchte das UKHD daher prüfen, welche Möglichkeiten der einschlägige Markt gegenwärtig für diesen Auftragsgegenstand bietet, welche Erfahrungswerte eingebracht werden können und in welchem preislichen Rahmen sich diese Leistungen bewegen.

result.text: The overarching goal of this notice of funding opportunity (NOFO) and its companion opportunities is to establish the Precision Medicine with AI: Integrating Imaging with Multimodal Data (PRIMED-AI) Program to support development of innovative, reliable, cost-effective, and sustainable multimodal AI-based clinical decision support (CDS) tools. PRIMED-AI CDS tools are based on the integration of clinical imaging with other types of multimodal health data to enhance care for patients with a wide range of health conditions. The PRIMED-AI Program seeks to catalyze the adoption of AI-based CDS tools into clinical workflows to enable novel personalized medicine strategies that address significant health challenges. The purpose of this Notice of Funding Opportunity (NOFO) is to catalyze the development and testing of Artificial Intelligence (AI)-enabled, image-centered, multimodal Clinical Decision Support (CDS) tools, developed in pursuance as Software as a Medical Device (SaMD). These projects are expected to have high potential for demonstrable, positive impact on patient outcomes and/or healthcare processes.

rejected.text: Hereon requires external support for the migration of its SAP ERP system to S/4. The brownfield approach is to be used. This involves a technical migration; any potential improvements or optimisations will be carried out subsequently, independently of the migration. The subject of lot 1 is the provision of comprehensive consultancy services for the planning, execution and documentation of the migration of the existing SAP ERP system to SAP S/4HANA. The services are to be performed in close coordination with the client's specialist departments. The contractor shall undertake the following tasks: 3.1. Project planning and conception - Creation of a project schedule and content plan in close coordination with hereon - Development of a migration concept including test conception, definition of responsibilities and accompanying documentation 3.2. System analysis and process assessment - Review of the existing SAP ERP systems with regard to the S/4HANA migration - Identification and assessment of correction requirements in the implemented business processes - Communication of correction requirements to the specialist departments and verification of implementation 3.3. Archiving and system preparation - Archiving of FI and MM documents from completed financial years 2014-2019 - Setting up a sandbox system - Execution of necessary system copies from production to test systems 3.4. Migration and customising - Execution of the necessary customising - Execution and testing of the S/4HANA migration on sandbox, test and production systems - Review and adjustment of structural authorisations in connection with the Cross-Application Time Sheet (CATS) - Analysis of existing roles and authorisations in the SAP ERP system as well as assessment and application of new authorisation objects in the context of S/4HANA - Execution of the H4S4 conversion - Review and migration of the personnel cost commitment processor, ensuring functionality and data integrity in personnel cost planning - Connection of the SAP Enterprise Portal and support for the integration of the aforementioned NON-SAP products 3.5. Documentation and quality assurance - Creation of audit-compliant final documentation of the migration - Support for the testing of NON-SAP software - Support for an internal security check (SAP Basis) 3.6. Training and hypercare - Creation of (delta) training materials - Delivery of training for involved staff and key users - Provision of life support (hypercare) after the migration 3.7. Cooperation with the client - All services are to be performed in close coordination with the responsible specialist departments - Tasks that can reasonably be undertaken by hereon itself (e.g. NON-SAP software, authorisation roles) will be processed internally accordingly 3.8. Period and scope - The consultancy service is to be provided over a period from the beginning of 2026 to the middle of 2027.; As part of an ongoing SAP migration project, an external service provider will be commissioned under lot 2 to provide professional support and assessment for the project phases of concept review, test preparation and test execution, as well as final documentation. The objective is quality assurance and risk minimisation in the migration process, as well as ensuring audit-compliant documentation. The contract includes, in particular, the following services: 4.1. Review of the migration concept - Analysis of the migration concept for completeness, consistency and feasibility - with a particular focus on ensuring that the planned documentation meets the requirements of an audit - Identification of potential risks and weaknesses, particularly with regard to the traceability and verifiability of the migration steps - Creation of an assessment with recommendations for action to ensure audit-compliant documentation 4.2. Support for test preparation and test execution - Advice on the planning and organisation of test activities (e.g. system, integration and acceptance tests) - Support in the definition of test cases and test data so that traceability and verifiability for an audit are guaranteed at all times - Quality assurance during test execution with particular attention to complete and audit-compliant logging - Assessment of test results and derivation of measures 4.3. Review of final documentation - Assessment of project documentation with regard to traceability, completeness and conformity with project objectives - Support in the creation of handover documents so that all necessary evidence for a subsequent audit is available 4.4. Conditions for participation - Verifiable experience in supporting SAP migration projects - Specialist knowledge of SAP ERP and SAP S/4HANA - Experience in test management and quality assurance - Knowledge of common project management and IT service management standards (e.g. PRINCE2, ITIL) 4.5. Period and scope The consultancy service is to be provided throughout the project over a period from the beginning of 2026 to the middle of 2027. The exact scope will be agreed upon during the commissioning process.

parts.source: Das Hereon benötigt externe Unterstützung für die Migration seines SAP-ERP-Systems nach S/4. Es soll der Brownfield-Ansatz verwendet werden. Dabei handelt es sich um eine technische Migration, mögliche Verbesserungen oder Optimierungen werden anschließend losgelöst von der Migration durchgeführt. Gegenstand des Loses 1 ist die Erbringung einer umfassenden Beratungsleistung zur Planung, Durchführung und Dokumentation der Migration des bestehenden SAP ERP-Systems auf SAP S/4HANA. Die Leistungen erfolgen in enger Abstimmung mit den Fachbereichen des Auftraggebers. Der Auftragnehmer übernimmt folgende Aufgaben: 3.1. Projektplanung und Konzeption - Erstellung einer zeitlichen und inhaltlichen Projektplanung in enger Abstimmung mit hereon - Entwicklung eines Migrationskonzepts einschließlich Testkonzeption, Festlegung der Verantwortlichkeiten und begleitender Dokumentation 3.2. Systemanalyse und Prozessbewertung - Überprüfung der bestehenden SAP ERP-Systeme im Hinblick auf die S/4HANA-Migration - Identifikation und Bewertung von Korrekturbedarfen in den implementierten Geschäftsprozessen - Kommunikation der Korrekturbedarfe mit den Fachabteilungen und Prüfung der Umsetzung 3.3. Archivierung und Systemvorbereitung - Archivierung von FI- und MM-Belegen der abgeschlossenen Geschäftsjahre 2014-2019 - Einrichtung eines Sandbox-Systems - Durchführung erforderlicher Systemkopien von Produktions- zu Testsystemen 3.4. Migration und Customizing - Durchführung des erforderlichen Customizings - Durchführung und Test der S/4HANA-Migration auf Sandbox-, Test- und Produktionssystemen - Prüfung und Anpassung der strukturellen Berechtigungen im Zusammenhang mit dem Cross-Application Time Sheet (CATS) - Analyse bestehender Rollen und Berechtigungen im SAP ERP-System sowie Bewertung und Anwendung neuer Berechtigungsobjekte im Kontext von S/4HANA - Durchführung der H4S4-Conversion - Prüfung und Migration des Personalkosten-Obligoprozessors, Sicherstellung der Funktionalität und Datenintegrität in der Personalkostenplanung - Anschluss des SAP Enterprise Portals und Unterstützung bei der Anbindung der oben genannten NON-SAP-Produkten 3.5. Dokumentation und Qualitätssicherung - Erstellung einer wirtschaftsprüfungskonformen Abschlussdokumentation der Migration - Unterstützung bei der Prüfung von NON-SAP-Software - Begleitung eines internen Security-Checks (SAP-Basis) 3.6. Schulung und Hypercare - Erstellung von (Delta-)Schulungsunterlagen - Durchführung von Schulungen für beteiligte Mitarbeitende und Key-User - Bereitstellung von Life-Support (Hypercare) nach der Migration 3.7. Zusammenarbeit mit dem Auftraggeber - Alle Leistungen erfolgen in enger Abstimmung mit den zuständigen Fachbereichen - Aufgaben, die sinnvollerweise durch hereon selbst übernommen werden können (z.?B. NON-SAP-Software, Berechtigungsrollen), werden entsprechend intern bearbeitet 3.8. Zeitraum und Umfang - Die Beratungsleistung ist über einen Zeitraum von Anfang 2026 bis Mitte 2027 zu erbringen.; Im Rahmen eines laufenden SAP-Migrationsprojekts wird mit Los 2 ein externer Dienstleister beauftragt, die Projektphasen Konzeptprüfung, Testvorbereitung und Testdurchführung sowie die Abschlussdokumentation fachlich zu begleiten und zu bewerten. Ziel ist die Qualitätssicherung und Risikominimierung im Migrationsprozess sowie die Sicherung einer Wirtschaftsprüfungskonformen Dokumentation. Der Auftrag umfasst insbesondere folgende Leistungen: 4.1. Prüfung des Migrationskonzepts - Analyse des Migrationskonzepts auf Vollständigkeit, Konsistenz und Umsetzbarkeit - mit besonderem Fokus darauf, dass die geplante Dokumentation den Anforderungen einer Wirtschaftsprüfung genügt - Identifikation potenzieller Risiken und Schwachstellen insbesondere im Hinblick auf die Nachvollziehbarkeit und Prüfbarkeit der Migrationsschritte - Erstellung einer Bewertung mit Handlungsempfehlungen zur Sicherstellung einer wirtschaftsprüfungskonformen Dokumentation 4.2. Begleitung der Testvorbereitung und Testdurchführung - Beratung bei der Planung und Organisation von Testaktivitäten (z.?B. System-, Integrations- und Abnahmetests) - Unterstützung bei der Definition von Testfällen und Testdaten sodass die Nachvollziehbarkeit und Prüfbarkeit für eine Wirtschaftsprüfung jederzeit gewährleistet ist - Qualitätssicherung während der Testdurchführung mit besonderem Augenmerk auf eine lückenlose und prüfungskonforme Protokollierung - Bewertung der Testergebnisse und Ableitung von Maßnahmen 4.3. Prüfung der Abschlussdokumentation - Bewertung der Projektdokumentation hinsichtlich Nachvollziehbarkeit, Vollständigkeit und Konformität mit den Projektzielen - Unterstützung bei der Erstellung der Übergabedokumenten, damit alle erforderlichen Nachweise für eine spätere Wirtschaftsprüfung vorliegen 4.4. Teilnahmebedingungen - Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Begleitung von SAP-Migrationsprojekten - Fachkenntnisse in SAP ERP und SAP S/4HANA - Erfahrung im Testmanagement und in der Qualitätssicherung - Kenntnisse gängiger Projektmanagement- und IT-Service-Management-Standards (z.?B. result.text: The Landesverband Lippe, a public law corporation, intends to modernise the Externsteine information centre and digitally stage the surrounding area in Horn-Bad Meinberg as a holistic "Externsteine Experience World". The Externsteine, with around 600.000 visitors annually, are to be further developed into a future-proof, interactive, and accessible place of experience. The previously inaccessible and technically outdated visitor centre forms the central starting and experience point. The subject of the procurement is the modernisation of the Externsteine information centre and the digital staging of the surrounding area into a holistic "Externsteine Experience World". What is being procured is a concept including its implementation, i.e., on the one hand, the conceptualisation including all planning services and official approval and permit procedures, and on the other hand, the complete implementation including any construction work, IT services, and other services (such as support and training). The contract is awarded as a stage-based contract: With the award, only stage 1 (creation of the concepts) is commissioned, while the implementation services (stage 2) as well as licence granting, technical support, and training (stage 3) are tendered as options, the call-off of which the contracting authority shall decide within five months after acceptance of stage 1. The concept, the planning of the implementation, and the implementation itself are to be designed freely by the contractor, but must meet certain minimum requirements due to the actual situation coupled with the available budget and legal requirements. General requirements: - The Externsteine and the entire surrounding area are subject to nature conservation; all services to be designed must be in accordance with the requirements resulting from this. The contractor must ensure that both the concept and the complete implementation comply with all nature conservation requirements. This also includes all necessary measures taken for concept implementation. - The historical documents and data on the Externsteine will be provided by the Landesverband Lippe and the Externsteine Protection Association and are not to be compiled by the contractor, but are to be prepared didactically and scenographically, and digitised and compiled depending on the type of use. - This project is partially financed by a grant from the State of North Rhine-Westphalia and must therefore be designed and implemented in such a way that all funding regulations are fully complied with. - A Progressive Web App or a mobile app for iOS and Android is to be designed, programmed, and made available for download in the common app stores, which contains natural history, geological, and historical information about the Externsteine and depicts the area including paths and sights; furthermore, the app must contain a link to the homepage so that current information can be accessed directly. Further content is to be designed and implemented by the contractor. Further functions that allow the visitor to actively experience the site must be present - a WhatsApp scavenger hunt is to be co-designed - Every piece of software must be compatible with at least ChromeOS and Windows 11 or higher, if available at the time of provision - every piece of hardware must be compatible with at least ChromeOS; additional compatibility with Microsoft Windows 11 or higher, if available at the time of provision, is desirable. Information centre requirements: - Installation of inspection openings wherever information technology is and/or will be installed - Replacement of outdated hardware - Use of existing screen openings in the walls and the central X made of painted wood - No structural changes to the basic structure of the rooms - Preservation of the analogue stations in the display cases - Installation (indoor) including setup with software, licences, and a moderation dashboard of a social wall; the moderation will be taken over by the Landesverband Lippe - At least production and installation of a tactile relief of the Externsteine formation and the Descent from the Cross relief as a 3D print - Revision and modernisation as well as new creation of digital content including didactic aspects - Expansion of the use of the cinema - Digital content must be provided on physical data carriers (USB sticks, locally on a PC) in order to enable easy exchange and to be able to offer a holistic visitor experience even in the event of an internet failure; the file formats must be playable independently of the operating system - Excluded from this are contents whose existence is purely online (SocialWall, App) - Creation of accessible access to content - Reliable and easily evaluable visitor counter - Sign stating that the measure is funded according to the requirement from the grant notification. Further concrete requirements can be found in sections V and VI of the service description (Annex B01). The project is partially financed from public funds. Binding under funding law are a total budget of 620.000 EUR (of which 372.000 EUR is funded, distributed over the financial years 2026 and 2027) as well as a cost breakdown of 255.000 EUR for equipment/scenography, 25.000 EUR for construction costs, and 340.000 EUR for technical costs. All services are to be provided by the end of the calendar year 2027. The contractual basis is an EVB-IT cloud contract and an EVB-IT system contract.

parts.source: Der Landesverband Lippe, eine Körperschaft des öffentlichen Rechts, beabsichtigt die Modernisierung des Infozentrums Externsteine und die digitale Inszenierung des umgebenden Areals in Horn-Bad Meinberg als ganzheitliche "Erlebniswelt Externsteine". Die Externsteine mit jährlich rund 600.000 Besuchern sollen zu einem zukunftsfähigen, interaktiven und barrierearmen Erlebnisort weiterentwickelt werden. Das bislang nicht barrierefreie und technisch veraltete Besucherzentrum bildet dabei den zentralen Start- und Erlebnispunkt. Gegenstand der Beschaffung ist die Modernisierung des Infozentrums Externsteine und die digitale Inszenierung des umgebenden Areals zu einer ganzheitlichen "Erlebniswelt Externsteine". Beschafft wird ein Konzept samt dessen Umsetzung, das heißt zum einen die Konzeptionierung einschließlich aller Planungsleistungen und behördlichen Genehmigungs- und Erlaubnisverfahren, zum anderen die komplette Umsetzung inklusive etwaiger Bauleistungen, IT-Dienstleistungen sowie weiterer Dienstleistungen (wie z.B. Support und Schulungen). Die Vergabe erfolgt als Stufenvertrag: Mit dem Zuschlag wird allein Stufe 1 (Erstellung der Konzepte) beauftragt, während die Umsetzungsleistungen (Stufe 2) sowie Lizenzeinräumung, technischer Support und Schulungen (Stufe 3) als Optionen ausgeschrieben sind, über deren Abruf der Auftraggeber binnen fünf Monaten nach Abnahme der Stufe 1 entscheidet. Das Konzept, die Planung der Umsetzung und die Umsetzung selbst sind vom Auftragnehmer frei zu gestalten, müssen jedoch aufgrund der Ist-Situation gepaart mit dem zur Verfügung stehenden Budget und den gesetzlichen Vorgaben bestimmte Mindestanforderungen erfüllen Anforderungen allgemein: - Die Externsteine und das gesamte umgebende Areal unterliegen dem Naturschutz, alle zu konzipierenden Leistungen müssen mit den Vorgaben, die sich daraus ergeben, in Einklang stehen. Der Auftragnehmer hat dafür Sorge zu tragen, dass sowohl bereits das Konzept als auch die komplette Umsetzung alle naturschutzrechtlichen Vorgaben einhält. Das umfasst auch alle nötigen Maßnahmen, die zur Konzeptumsetzung getroffen werden. - Die historischen Dokumente und Daten zu den Externsteinen werden vom Landesverband Lippe und der Schutzgemeinschaft Externsteine zur Verfügung gestellt und sollen nicht vom Auftragnehmer zusammengetragen werden, wohl aber didaktisch und szenographisch aufbereitet, je nach Einsatzart digitalisiert und zusammengestellt werden. - Dieses Projekt wird zum Teil durch eine Förderung des Landes NRW finanziert und ist und ist deshalb so zu konzipieren und umzusetzen, dass alle förderrechtlichen Bestimmungen vollumfänglich eingehalten werden. - Es soll eine Progressive Web App, bzw. eine mobile App für iOS und Android konzipiert, programmiert und in den gängigen App-Stores zum Download bereitgestellt werden, welche naturkundliche, geologische und historische Informationen zu den Externsteinen enthalten und das Areal samt Wegen und Sehenswürdigkeiten darstellt, außerdem soll in der App der Link zur Homepage enthalten sein, so dass direkt auf aktuelle Informationen zugegriffen werden kann. Weitere Inhalte sind vom Auftragnehmer zu konzipieren und umzusetzen. Weitere Funktionen, die den Besucher das Gelände aktiv erleben lassen, müssen vorhanden sein - eine Whats App Schnitzeljagd soll mit konzipiert werden - Jede Software muss mindestens mit ChromeOS und Windows 11 oder höher, falls zum Zeitpunkt der Erbringung vorhanden, kompatibel sein - jede Hardware muss mindestens mit ChromeOS kompatibel sein, eine zusätzliche Kompatibilität mit Microsoft Windows 11 oder höher, falls zum Zeitpunkt der Erbringung vorhanden, ist wünschenswert Anforderungen Infozentrum: - Einlassen von Revisionsöffnungen überall dort, wo Informationstechnik verbaut ist und/oder wird - Austausch der veralteten Hardware - Nutzung der vorhandenen Bildschirmöffnungen in den Wänden und dem zentralen, aus lackiertem Holz bestehenden X - keine baulichen Veränderungen der Grundstruktur der Räume - Erhalt der analogen Stationen in den Vitrinen - Installation (indoor) samt Einrichtung mit Software, Lizenzen und Moderationsdashboard einer Social Wall; die Moderation wird vom Landesverband Lippe übernommen - mindestens Herstellung und Installation eines Tastreliefs der Externsteinformation und des Kreuzabnahmereliefs als 3D-Druck - Überarbeitung und Modernisierung sowie Neuerstellung digitaler Inhalte inklusive didaktischer Aspekte - Erweiterung der Nutzung des Kinos - digitale Inhalte müssen auf physischen Datenträgern bereitgestellt werden (USB-Sticks, lokal auf einem PC), um einen einfachen Austausch zu ermöglichen und auch bei Internetausfall ein ganzheitliches Besuchererlebnis bieten zu können, die Dateiformate müssen sich betriebssystemunabhängig abspielen lassen - Ausgenommen hiervon sind Inhalte, deren Bestehen rein online gegeben ist (SocialWall, App) - Schaffen von barrierefreien Zugängen zu Inhalten - zuverlässiger und leicht auswertbarer Besucherzähler - Schild, dass die Maßnahme gefördert ist laut Vorgabe aus dem Bewilligungsbescheid Die weiteren konkreten Anforderungen sind Ziffer V und VI. der Leistungsbeschreibung (Anlage B01) zu entnehmen. Das Projekt wird anteilig aus öffentlichen Fördermitteln finanziert. Förderrechtlich verbindlich sind ein Gesamtbudget von 620.000 EUR (davon 372.000 EUR gefördert, verteilt auf die Haushaltsjahre 2026 und 2027) sowie eine Kostenaufteilung von 255.000 EUR Einrichtung/Szenografie, 25.000 EUR Baukosten und 340.000 EUR Technikkosten. Alle Leistungen sind bis zum Ablauf des Kalenderjahres 2027 zu erbringen. Vertragsgrundlage sind ein EVB-IT-Cloudvertrag und ein EVB-IT-Systemvertrag.

result.text: Bournemouth University ("BU" or the "University") is exploring options for the provision of a co-managed Security Operations Centre (SOC) service to enhance and future-proof its cyber security operations capability. The University is seeking market feedback from experienced Managed Security Service Providers to better understand available service models, implementation approaches, commercial arrangements and indicative costs. BU has invested significantly in its internal cyber security capability and Microsoft security technologies, including Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender XDR, Entra ID Protection, Security Copilot and related services. The University is now considering how external specialist support could complement its in-house team through a co-managed SOC operating model. The key objectives of a future service are expected to include: - Enhancing monitoring, detection and response capabilities through either 24/7 or out-of-hours SOC coverage. - Improving threat detection, triage, false-positive reduction and incident response effectiveness. - Providing additional specialist expertise, operational resilience and surge capacity during major incidents or periods of heightened risk. - Maintaining and continuously improving detection rules, playbooks, automation and security monitoring capabilities. - Leveraging threat intelligence, sector insight, automation and AI-enabled capabilities to strengthen cyber resilience and operational effectiveness. - Establishing a robust governance, reporting and service management framework with clear responsibilities between BU and the supplier. - Maximising the value of the University's existing Microsoft security investments while minimising the need for additional tooling wherever appropriate. The University wishes to understand how the market can support these objectives, together with the costs, benefits, risks and implementation considerations associated with different service models. Supplier feedback received through this Preliminary Market Engagement exercise will help inform the University's future requirements, budget planning and procurement strategy. Lot 1: .

Omnia invites interested suppliers to participate in a market information session and technical dialogue regarding Omnia's future procurements of financial and HR solutions. MARKET INFORMATION SESSION The market information session will be held on 1.10.2026 at 15.00–16.00 as a remote event via Teams. The session will present: - the current preparation status of the procurements - preliminary objectives and schedules - the planned procurement model - key procurement subjects and scope TECHNICAL DIALOGUE After the market information session, Omnia offers interested suppliers the opportunity to participate in a technical dialogue to support the preparation of the procurements. Technical dialogues will be carried out primarily in writing and on a procurement-specific basis, such that the procurements for financial management and HR solutions are handled as separate entities. The purpose of the technical dialogues is to gather market insights to support the preparation of the procurement and to enable commenting on preliminary procurement documents before the actual tendering processes are launched. The material to be commented on may include, for example, preliminary requirement specifications, draft contracts and evaluation models. Suppliers participating in the technical dialogue will be provided with the material to be commented on, as well as more detailed instructions and a schedule, separately. It is possible to participate in the technical dialogue even if one does not attend the market information session. In connection with the technical dialogue, the contracting authority may also request preliminary estimates of solution cost levels from suppliers to support the estimation of the anticipated value of the procurement. REGISTRATION Registration for the market information session and/or technical dialogue no later than 30.9.2026 at 16.00: https://forms.cloud.microsoft/e/TU1Wnxnscg

parts.source: Espoon seudun koulutuskuntayhtymä Omnia (hankintayksikkö) suunnittelee talous- ja HR-järjestelmiensä ja -palveluiden kilpailutusta. Omnia kutsuu kiinnostuneita toimittajia osallistumaan markkinainfotilaisuuteen ja tekniseen vuoropuheluun koskien Omnian tulevia talous- ja HR-ratkaisujen hankintoja. MARKKINAINFOTILAISUUS Markkinainfo järjestetään 1.10.2026 klo 15.00–16.00 etätilaisuutena Teamsillä. Tilaisuudessa esitellään: - hankintojen nykyinen valmistelutilanne - alustavat tavoitteet ja aikataulut - suunniteltu kilpailutusmalli - keskeiset hankinnan kohteet ja rajaukset TEKNINEN VUOROPUHELU Markkinainfon jälkeen Omnia tarjoaa halukkaille toimittajille mahdollisuuden osallistua hankintojen valmistelua tukevaan tekniseen vuoropuheluun. Tekniset vuoropuhelut toteutetaan ensisijaisesti kirjallisesti ja hankintakohtaisesti siten, että taloushallinnon ja HR-ratkaisujen hankinnat käsitellään erillisinä kokonaisuuksina. Teknisten vuoropuhelujen tarkoituksena on kerätä markkinoiden näkemyksiä hankinnan valmistelun tueksi sekä mahdollistaa alustavien hankinta-asiakirjojen kommentointi ennen varsinaisten kilpailutusten käynnistämistä. Kommentoitava aineisto voi sisältää esimerkiksi alustavia vaatimusmäärittelyjä, sopimusluonnoksia ja arviointimalleja. Tekniseen vuoropuheluun osallistuville toimittajille toimitetaan erikseen kommentoitava aineisto sekä tarkemmat ohjeet ja aikataulu. Tekniseen vuoropuheluun on mahdollista osallistua, vaikka ei osallistuisi markkinainfotilaisuuteen. Hankintayksikkö voi pyytää teknisen vuoropuhelun yhteydessä toimittajilta myös alustavia arvioita ratkaisujen kustannustasoista hankinnan ennakoidun arvon arvioinnin tueksi. ILMOITTAUTUMINEN Ilmoittautuminen markkinainfoon ja/tai tekniseen vuoropuheluun viimeistään 30.9.2026 klo 16.00: https://forms.cloud.microsoft/e/TU1Wnxnscg

result.text: Enhanced Information Service for Emergency Calls (EISEC) or caller line identification (CLI) enables fire control room operators to confirm the caller's location swiftly. This is a critical first step in the call handling process, since the line could be 'cut', leaving the location unknown. EISEC technology provided by call handling agencies allows the billing address of the phone from which emergency calls are being made to be displayed to the control room operator. This speeds up the information process. This technology can also be used to locate the whereabouts of mobile phone callers, identifying the cell network from which they are calling. Additional information: Provides Location of caller on emergency lines

result.text: The HUS Group (also "the contracting entity", "the Client" or “HUS”) requests tenders for a large cancer panel test for HUS Diagnostic Center. The procurement includes also data analysis software for reporting clinically significant variants, copy number alterations and gene fusions. The software can be offered by the same provider as the large cancer panel test or from a partner company (offer as a group or appeal to a subcontractor's resources), but it needs to be included in the same tender. The software will be procured for the entire lifecycle of the assay. The procurement consist of gene panels and reagents (also "products") and data analysis software (also "services", e.g. information system provided as Software as a Service). Laboratory of Genetics at HUS (Helsinki University Hospital) Diagnostic Center is an SFS-EN ISO 15189:2022 accredited laboratory providing diagnostic genetic testing services to all patients at Helsinki and Uusimaa Hospital District. The laboratory operates as a health institution capable of validating in-house developed tests as required by the CE-IVD regulation. The services include analysis of both constitutional samples and malignancies. The laboratory provides sequencing services mainly using local sequencing capacity (Illumina NovaSeq 6000, NovaSeq X Plus, Ion GeneStudio S5 Prime equipment). The large cancer panel test is intended for detection of small nucleotide variants (SNVs), indels, gene fusions, copy number variations (CNVs), microsatellite instability (MSI), homologous recombination deficiency (HRD), and tumor mutation burden (TMB) relevant for the genetic profiling of solid tumor samples and/or hematological malignancies as well as plasma samples for cfDNA analysis. Sequencing of the samples is carried out using Illumina NovaSeq sequencers (Illumina NovaSeq 6000 and NovaSeq X Plus). The number of cancer panel tests performed annually is estimated to be between 2500-3000. The procurement is divided into LOT A and LOT B: LOT A - This lot includes gene panel solutions for in-house NGS testing of solid tumors and hematological malignancies, including library preparation reagents, target enrichment reagents defining the panel content, panel-specific reagents, data analysis software, and instructions for use. Sequencing reagents, flow cells, sequencing instruments, and testing services are not included in this procurement. - This test is based on analysis of total nucleic acids (RNA and/or DNA) extracted from paraffin embedded specimens and/or fresh-frozen specimens - This lot includes an option for special gene panel and reagents for salivary gland tumors with data analysis software - This lot includes an an option for a custom gene panel and reagents with data analysis software - The HUS Group will decide separately on the use of the options LOT B Important Information Concerning Lot B of the Procurement Procedure The Contracting Authority has decided to discontinue Lot B of the procurement procedure.During the procurement procedure, it became apparent that substantial amendments are required to the subject matter of Lot B and the related procurement documents. As these amendments cannot be implemented through a corrigendum without jeopardising the equal and non-discriminatory treatment of tenderers, the Contracting Authority has decided to discontinue Lot B.Lot B will be re-tendered through a separate procurement procedure. A new contract notice and new procurement documents for Lot B will be published separately.Please note that LOT A is still continuing the tendering process. - This lot includes gene panel solutions for in-house NGS testing of cell-free DNA, including library preparation reagents, target enrichment reagents defining the panel content, panel-specific reagents, data analysis software, and instructions for use. Sequencing reagents, flow cells, sequencing instruments, and testing services are not included in this procurement - This test is based on analysis of cell-free DNA from plasma samples NOTE: For LOT A, the tenderer may offer a catalog panel, a combination of catalog panels, or a custom solution to meet the DNA and RNA requirements. For hematological malignancies, only a panel for DNA is requested. Panel for salivary gland tumors and custom panel are requested as an option. NOTE: FOR LOT A and LOT B, the tender needs to include all the reagents required to perform the assay, including library preparation reagents, indexing adapters and target enrichment reagents (or equivalent). Nucleic acid extraction reagents, library quantification reagents and sequencer reagents are excluded from the tender. The subject of the procurement and its requirements are described in more detail in the call for tender and its appendices. The tenderer can submit a tender to either one or both of the LOTS A and LOT B. The tenderer can be awarded the contract to either one or both tendered lots. The contrcting entity selects one (1) supplier for each lot and will enter into an agreement with the winning supplier. The estimated start for the contract period is autumn-winter 2026. The contracting entity recieves a right to test use tendered panels and softwares after the deadline for receiving the tenders. The procurement volumes presented in the call for tenders are estimates, and the contract does not constitute a mandatory purchase obligation for the contrcting entity or an exclusive right for the supplier to provide the product. The subject of the procurement and its requirements are described in more detail in the call for tender and its appendices.; Important Information Concerning Lot B of the Procurement Procedure The Contracting Authority has decided to discontinue Lot B of the procurement procedure.During the procurement procedure, it became apparent that substantial amendments are required to the subject matter of Lot B and the related procurement documents.

result.text: This notice (PIN) announces a public market consultation and provides information on a planned pre-commercial procurement (PCP) on the subject of the "Low-Voltage Toolkit". The project responds to the need for a cost-effective, scalable, platform-independent and user-friendly toolkit for active distribution network management in low-voltage networks – particularly for small and medium-sized distribution network operators and municipal utilities. The toolkit is intended to include the following core functions: (1) Visualisation of the low-voltage network through automated data integration, processing and modelling, which brings together measurement data, network documentation and external information (e.g. weather and market data). (2) Reliable low-voltage state estimation (LV DSSE), which delivers robust statements on voltages, currents and loads even with low measurement density and in near real time. (3) Automated topology detection, which detects and corrects erroneous or incomplete network diagrams and also correctly maps complex urban structures. (4) Forecasting models that identify bottlenecks and voltage violations at an early stage and incorporate external information (e.g. weather and market data). (5) Comprehensible decision support for network operators, including via user-friendly visualisations, recommendations for action and warnings that can be integrated into existing workflows. (6) Semi-automated congestion management with transparent workflows ("Suggest – Evaluate – Confirm – Execute") instead of fully automated network operation. (7) Plug-and-play approach for integration into a large proportion of existing infrastructures at distribution network operators; the tools are intended to be modularly introduceable (e.g. initially only a topology detection module or state estimator), in contrast to current solutions which often require extensive hardware conversions and high investments. Those addressed are in particular small and medium-sized distribution network operators, municipal utilities, manufacturers of network control and planning software, data platform providers as well as research institutions with relevant expertise. Further information on the upcoming public market consultation and the planned PCP can be found here http://go.fzj.de/2eVf9 in the German language.

parts.source: Diese Bekanntmachung (PIN) kündigt eine öffentliche Marktkonsultation an und gibt Informationen zu einem geplanten vorkommerziellen Auftragsvergabe (PCP) zum Thema "Toolkit Niederspannung". Das Projekt reagiert auf den Bedarf nach einem kostengünstigen, skalierbaren, plattformunabhängigen und benutzerfreundlichen Werkzeugkasten für ein aktives Verteilnetzmanagement in Niederspannungsnetzen – insbesondere für kleine und mittlere Verteilnetzbetreiber und Stadtwerke. Das Toolkit soll folgende Kernfunktionen beinhalten: (1) Sichtbarmachung des Niederspannungsnetzes durch automatisierte Datenintegration, aufbereitung und modellierung, die Messdaten, Netzdokumentation und externe Informationen (z. B. Wetter und Marktdaten) zusammenführt. (2) Zuverlässige Niederspannung Zustandsschätzung (LV DSSE), die auch bei geringer Messdichte und in nahezu Echtzeit belastbare Aussagen zu Spannungen, Strömen und Auslastungen liefert. (3) Automatisierte Topologie Erkennung, die fehlerhafte oder lückenhafte Netzpläne erkennt und korrigiert und auch komplexe städtische Strukturen korrekt abbildet. (4) Prognosemodelle, die Engpässe und Spannungsverletzungen frühzeitig identifizieren und externe Informationen (z. B. Wetter und Marktdaten) einbeziehen. (5) Nachvollziehbare Entscheidungsunterstützung für Netzbetreiberinnen und Netzbetreiber, u. a. über benutzerfreundliche Visualisierungen, Handlungsempfehlungen und Warnungen, die sich in bestehende Arbeitsabläufe integrieren lassen. (6) Teilautomatisiertes Engpassmanagement mit transparenten Workflows („Vorschlagen – Bewerten – Bestätigen – Ausführen“) statt vollautomatischem Netzbetrieb. (7) Plug and Play Ansatz zur Integration in einen Großteil der bestehenden Infrastrukturen bei Verteilnetzbetreibern; die Werkzeuge sollen modular einführbar sein (z. B. zunächst nur Topologie Erkennungsmodul oder Zustandsschätzer), im Gegensatz zu heutigen Lösungen, die häufig umfangreiche Hardware Umstellungen und hohe Investitionen erfordern. Adressiert werden insbesondere kleine und mittlere Verteilnetzbetreiber, Stadtwerke, Hersteller von Netzführungsund Planungssoftware, Datenplattformanbieter sowie Forschungseinrichtungen mit einschlägiger Expertise. Weitere Informationen zur anstehenden öffentlichen Marktkonsultation und zum geplanten PCP finden Sie hier http://go.fzj.de/2eVf9 in deutscher Sprache.

result.text: The City of Helsinki Urban Environment Division is establishing a dynamic purchasing system within which design and technical services for snow management solutions will be tendered. The dynamic purchasing system will remain valid until the end of 2033, unless the contracting entity shortens or extends the duration of the dynamic purchasing system. During the duration of the dynamic purchasing system, all interested candidates may submit a request for participation. The operation and scope of the dynamic purchasing system are described in more detail in the invitation to participate and its attachments. According to the preliminary estimate, dozens of procurements will be carried out within the dynamic purchasing system over the coming years. The total value of the procurements is estimated to be 6 500 000 euros during the entire duration of the DPS for comprehensive service procurements. The dynamic purchasing system is designed to address procurement needs in the coming years, with a sufficient amount to achieve the objectives. This is an estimate, and the contracting authority is not committed to any specific procurement quantities. The number of procurements may be significantly lower than estimated if the objectives of the snow management system are met through other means. Dynaaminen hankintajärjestelmä on voimassa vuoden 2033 loppuun saakka, ellei hankintayksikkö lyhennä tai pidennä dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän kestoa. Dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän keston aikana kaikki kiinnostuneet ehdokkaat voivat tehdä siihen osallistumishakemuksen. Dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän toiminta ja kohde on kuvattu tarkemmin osallistumispyynnössä ja sen liitteissä. Alustavan arvion mukaan dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän sisällä toteutetaan kymmeniä hankintoja tulevien vuosien aikana. Hankintojen kokonaisarvo on koko kokonaispalveluhankintojen DPS:n voimassaolon aikana yhteensä arviolta 6 500 000 euroa. Dynaamisella hankintajärjestelmällä varaudutaan tulevien vuosien hankintatarpeisiin, joita toteutetaan tavoitteiden saavuttamiseksi riittävä määrä. Kyseessä on arvio, eikä tilaaja sitoudu mihinkään hankintamääriin. Hankintojen määrä voi olla merkittävästi arvioitua pienempi, mikäli lumenhallinnan kokonaisuuden tavoitteet täyttyvät muilla keinoin. IN ENGLISH The City of Helsinki Urban Environment Division will establish a dynamic purchasing system within which Design and Technical Services for snow management solutions will be tendered. The dynamic purchasing system will remain valid until the end of 2033, unless the contracting entity shortens or extends the duration of the system. During the duration of the dynamic purchasing system, all interested candidates may submit a request for participation. The operation and scope of the dynamic purchasing system are described in more detail in the invitation to participate and its attachments. According to the preliminary estimate, dozens of procurements will be carried out within the dynamic purchasing system over the coming years. The total value of the procurements is estimated to be 6 500 000 EUR during the entire duration of the DPS for comprehensive service procurements. The dynamic purchasing system is designed to address procurement needs in the coming years, with a sufficient amount to achieve the objectives. This is an estimate, and the contracting authority is not committed to any specific procurement quantities. The number of procurements may be significantly lower than estimated if the objectives of the snow management system are met through other means.

result.text: The purpose of this combined Broad Agency Announcement (BAA) under Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) Part 35 and Funding Opportunity Announcement (FOA) under 2 Code of Federal Regulations (CFR) 200.204 (henceforth referred to as “BAA”) is to solicit research proposals for submission to the U.S. Army Artificial Intelligence Integration Center (AI2C) for funding consideration. This Broad Agency Announcement (BAA), for the Army Artificial Intelligence Integration Center (AI2C), is issued under the provisions of paragraph 6.102(d)(2) and 35.016 of the Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR), which provides for the acquisition of basic, applied, and advanced research and that part of development not related to the development of a specific system or hardware procurement. This will be done through the competitive selection of proposals, and 10 U.S.C. 4001, 10 U.S.C. 4021, and 10 U.S.C. 4022, which provide the authorities for issuing awards under this announcement for basic, applied, and advanced research. The definitions of basic and applied research may be found at 32 CFR 22.105. Proposals submitted in response to this BAA and selected for award are considered to be the result of full and open competition and in full compliance with the provisions of Public Law 98-369, "The Competition in Contracting Act of 1984" and subsequent amendments. The Army Artificial Intelligence Integration Center (AI2C) is seeking artificial intelligence research and development whitepapers and proposals in support of new technologies and translational research-based approaches that support the identification, alignment, and exploitation of basic, applied, and advanced research. AI2C’s foundational research mission spans basic research (budget activity 6.1) and applied research (budget activity 6.2) as defined by 32 CFR 22.105 but may include advanced technology development (budget activity 6.3) and advanced component development and prototypes (budget activity 6.4) when opportunities arise to directly or indirectly help achieve AI2C’s mission. This publication constitutes a BAA for awards as contemplated in FAR 6.102(d)(2) and 35.016 as well as a merit-based, competitive procedure in accordance with the Department of Defense Grant and Agreement Regulations (DoDGARS) at 32 CFR 22.315(a) and the Office of the Under Secretary of Defense for Acquisition and Sustainment Other Transaction Guide version 2.0 dated July 2023.

result.text: Tenderers are hereby invited to a market dialogue for the procurement of Licences for reference works and learning platforms for radiology, Helse Nord. The market dialogue is a part of the preliminary work for the procurement and is being carried out as the contracting authority would like input for the procurement from potential suppliers, possibly also from other interested parties. As a part of this process, tenderers of relevant electronic reference systems and learning platforms are invited to decision support within radiology to provide input for the procurement. The radiologic departments in Helse Nord currently have different access to reference systems, clinical decision support and learning platforms. There is a need for a combined, regional agreement that ensures equal access to digital resources across the enterprises. Such a system will contribute to better quality of the service, establish a common standard for education and strengthen the professional environment - which can also promote recruitment. The licences are intended to be used in clinical practice and for specialist education. The need is mainly aimed at radiologists, but it is also useful for descriptive radiographers and others who work with image diagnostics. Joint access will give the radiology subject in Helse Nord a solid foundation for quality, learning and collaboration - for the best interests of patients in the entire region.

rejected.text: The City of Helsinki Employment Services public utility provides employment services to, among others, foreign-language clients who do not have Finnish or Swedish language skills or whose skills are weak. Therefore, effective interpretation solutions are needed that support communication between the client and the employee guiding the client, ensuring that foreign-language clients receive the full benefit of employment services. The City has valid interpretation service contracts in place for on-site and remote interpretation with the assistance of an interpreter. Thus, the City of Helsinki Employment Services public utility is procuring an AI-assisted interpretation service. The interpretation service must be able to offer interpretation in several languages. The service must utilise AI to provide real-time interpretation. The interpretation service must be confidential and protect privacy (the City of Helsinki's data protection requirements must be met and will be delivered separately later). The service must be easy to use for both clients and service providers, and the user interface must be accessible on various devices (computer, smartphone, tablet, etc.). The subject of the procurement is described in more detail in the appendices 1 Service description of the subject of the procurement and 2 Requirements list.

result.text: The tender process comprises the conclusion of one (1) contract regarding the Contracting Authority's procurement of the development of an AI-based simulation tool for training child interviews. Based on this tender, one (1) joint contract will be concluded between the supplier and the Responsible Contracting Authority, cf. point 1.2 of the tender conditions, which acts on behalf of all participating contracting authorities. The Responsible Contracting Authority is Professionshøjskolen Absalon, which is authorised to manage all rights and obligations under the contract and acts as the contracting party towards the supplier. The supplier may therefore only direct claims against the Responsible Contracting Authority. Other participating contracting authorities are not direct contracting parties and are not liable either individually or jointly for the performance of the contract. Professionshøjskolen Absalon, in collaboration with the other university colleges, Red Barnet, Barndom Uden Vold and Ole Kirk’s Fond, is offering a contract for the development of an AI-based simulation tool, which is referred to in the tender documentation as the Solution. The purpose is to strengthen the competencies of social workers and social work students to conduct interviews with children in vulnerable situations, including children who may have been exposed to violence or abuse. The Solution must create a realistic, safe and learning-oriented training environment where users can prepare for child interviews, conduct interviews with digital avatars, receive guidance and feedback from a Tutor and subsequently analyse their interviews for the purpose of learning and reflection. It must be capable of being used in social work education, in continuing and further education programmes and in municipal practice. The first version, which this tender covers, must provide the possibility for speech- and text-based interaction with four avatars aged 9–11 years, representing different backgrounds and case types. In addition, there is a Tutor who supports the user before, during and after the interview through preparatory information, ongoing professional hints and subsequent debriefing. The Solution must accommodate both full interview processes and shorter modules where individual interview techniques can be trained in isolation. In the long term, the ambition is to expand the solution with more advanced modalities such as facial expressions and body language as well as real-time analysis of non-verbal communication. The Contracting Authority therefore wishes to attract suppliers who can not only deliver the tendered solution but can also think visionarily in terms of creating a future-proof and innovative platform. The Responsible Contracting Authority provides an extensive knowledge base in the form of practice-oriented cases, anonymised child interviews and the expertise of professionals, and will also contribute actively with professional sparring during development. The tenders will be evaluated on feasibility and risk assessment, functionality and security, the realism of the avatars, the professional quality of the tutor as well as the overall user experience and technical robustness. The Responsible Contracting Authority is entitled to terminate the contract at Partial Delivery Day 1 (POC), solely for the purpose of bringing the project to an end, if it turns out during Partial Delivery 1 - POC that there are technical challenges which make it impossible to develop a suitable and usable Solution for the purpose that the contract supports, cf. point 31.2.1 of the Contract. However, it is the clear intention of the Responsible Contracting Authority to complete the development of a complete Solution that functions according to its purpose. Due to the established budget, the Contracting Authority has set a price ceiling for the Delivery Consideration. The Delivery Consideration, including the price for the Clarification Phase and the Delivery, cf. Contract Annex 01 – Schedule, must thus be a maximum of five (5) million DKK excl. VAT. Within the established price ceiling of five (5) million DKK excl. VAT, the Contracting Authority wishes to promote solutions that combine high technical quality and a high level of innovation. With this tender, the Contracting Authority aims to support a competition that is not only based on price, but also on the Tenderers' ability to think long-term and visionarily. The Contracting Authority therefore explains the strategic and technological ambitions for the Solution in order to encourage tenderers to present proposals that reflect a future-proof and technologically advanced approach. At the same time, it is important for the Contracting Authority that the Solution can be operated sustainably within the financial frameworks that apply to the joint operations of the university colleges. The Contracting Authority therefore wishes to enter into a contract with a Supplier who can ensure creativity and technical ingenuity in relation to developing a Solution that meets the desired needs, but which can at the same time be operated by the university colleges jointly - where interview flow is weighted higher than visualisation of the child's non-verbal language.

parts.source: Udbudsprocessen omfatter indgåelse af én (1) kontrakt vedrørende Ordregivers anskaffelse af udvikling af et AI-baseret simulationsredskab til træning af børnesamtaler. På baggrund af nærværende udbud vil der blive indgået én (1) fælles kontrakt mellem leverandøren og den Ansvarlige Ordregiver, jf. udbudsbetingelsernes punkt 1.2, som handler på vegne af samtlige deltagende ordregivere. Den Ansvarlige Ordregiver er Professionshøjskolen Absalon, som er bemyndiget til at varetage samtlige rettigheder og forpligtelserne i henhold til kontrakten og optræder som kontraktpart over for leverandøren. Leverandøren kan således alene rette krav mod den Ansvarlige Ordregiver. Øvrige deltagende ordregivere er ikke direkte kontraktparter og hæfter hverken individuelt eller solidarisk for opfyldelsen af kontrakten. Professionshøjskolen Absalon udbyder i samarbejde med de øvrige professionshøjskoler, Red Barnet, Barndom Uden Vold og Ole Kirk’s Fond en opgave om udvikling af et AI-baseret simulationsredskab, som i udbudsmaterialet betegnes Løsningen. Formålet er at styrke socialrådgiveres og socialrådgiverstuderendes kompetencer til at gennemføre samtaler med børn i sårbare situationer, herunder børn der kan have været udsat for vold eller overgreb. Løsningen skal skabe et realistisk, trygt og læringsorienteret træningsmiljø, hvor brugerne kan forberede sig på børnesamtaler, gennemføre samtaler med digitale avatarer, få vejledning og feedback fra en Tutor og efterfølgende analysere deres samtaler med henblik på læring og refleksion. Den skal både kunne anvendes i socialrådgiveruddannelsen, i efter- og videreuddannelsesforløb og i den kommunale praksis. Den første version, som dette udbud omfatter, skal give mulighed for tale- og tekstbaseret interaktion med fire avatarer i alderen 9–11 år, som repræsenterer forskellige baggrunde og sagstyper. Hertil kommer en Tutor, der understøtter brugeren før, under og efter samtalen gennem forberedende information, løbende faglige hints og efterfølgende debriefing. Løsningen skal rumme både fulde samtaleforløb og kortere moduler, hvor enkelte samtaleteknikker kan trænes isoleret. På længere sigt er ambitionen at udvide løsningen med mere avancerede modaliteter såsom mimik og kropssprog samt realtidsanalyse af nonverbal kommunikation. Ordregiver ønsker derfor at tiltrække leverandører, som ikke alene kan levere den udbudte løsning, men også kan tænke visionært i forhold til at skabe en fremtidssikret og innovativ platform. Den Ansvarlige Ordregiver stiller et omfattende vidensgrundlag til rådighed i form af praksisnære cases, anonymiserede børnesamtaler og fagpersoners ekspertise, og vil desuden bidrage aktivt med faglig sparring under udviklingen. Tilbuddene vil blive vurderet på realiserbarhed og risikovurdering, funktionalitet og sikkerhed, realismen i avatarerne, tutorens faglige kvalitet samt den samlede brugeroplevelse og tekniske robusthed. Den Ansvarlige Ordregiver er berettiget til at opsige kontrakten ved Delleverancedag 1 (POC), udelukkende med henblik på at kunne bringe projektet til ophør, såfremt det under Delleverance 1 - POC viser sig, at der foreligger tekniske udfordringer, som gør det umuligt at udvikle en egnet og anvendelig Løsning til det formål, som kontrakten understøtter, jf. Kontraktens punkt 31.2.1. Det er dog den Ansvarlige Ordregivers klare hensigt at gennemføre udviklingen af en fuldstændig Løsning, der fungerer efter sit formål. Af hensyn til fastlagt budget har Ordregiver fastlagt et prisloft for Leverancevederlaget. Leverancevederlaget, herunder prisen for Afklaringsfasen og Leverancen, jf. Kontraktbilag 01 – Tidsplan, må således maksimalt være fem (5) mio. DKK ekskl. moms. Inden for det fastlagte prisloft på fem (5) mio. DKK ekskl. moms ønsker Ordregiver at fremme løsninger, der kombinerer høj teknisk kvalitet og innovationshøjde. Med dette udbud tilstræber Ordregiver at understøtte en konkurrence, der ikke alene baseres på pris, men også på Tilbudsgivernes evne til at tænke langsigtet og visionært. Ordregiver redegør derfor for de strategiske og teknologiske ambitioner for Løsningen med henblik på at opfordre tilbudsgivere til at præsentere forslag, der afspejler en fremtidssikret og teknologisk avanceret tilgang. Samtidig er det vigtigt for Ordregiver, at Løsningen kan driftes bæredygtigt inden for de økonomiske rammer, der gælder for professionshøjskolernes fælles drift. Ordregiver ønsker derfor at indgå kontrakt med en Leverandør, der kan sikre iderigdom og teknisk snilde i forhold til at udvikle en Løsning, der opfylder de ønskede behov, men som samtidig kan driftes af professionshøjskolerne i fællesskab - hvor samtaleflow vægtes højere end visualisering af barnets nonverbale sprog.

result.text: This is an information request, which is not a procurement notice or call for tenders. The purpose of the information request is to gather information concerning the subject of the procurement for a future tender process. Responding to the information request is not a precondition for participating in any possible subsequent tender process. To ensure the success of the future tender process, however, it would be important that tenderers provide the contracting authority with the requested information as comprehensively as possible. Respondents to the information request will not be paid compensation for preparing the information request or participating in any presentation meetings related to the information request. The subject of the information request is a remote dialysis comprehensive platform solution (home dialysis). The subject and objectives of the procurement are described in more detail in the attached document. Based on the responses to the information request, market dialogue sessions may be organised where suppliers can present their own services, products and alternatives for the implementation of the procurement subject. If market dialogue sessions are organised, they will be conducted in the Finnish language. Istekki will notify the companies participating in the sessions of the exact schedules later. Istekki will select and invite the participants to the dialogues. If necessary, multiple dialogue sessions may be organised, and the participants may also include the contracting authority's end customers. Responses to the information request must be submitted by 3.2.2026 at the latest by 14.00. parts.source: Tämä on tietopyyntö, joka ei ole hankintailmoitus tai tarjouspyyntö. Tietopyynnön tarkoituksena on kerätä hankinnan kohdetta koskevaa tietoa tulevaa kilpailutusta varten. Tietopyyntöön vastaaminen ei ole edellytys mahdolliseen myöhempään kilpailutukseen osallistumiselle. Tulevan kilpailutuksen onnistumisen varmistamiseksi olisi kuitenkin tärkeää, että tarjoajat antaisivat hankintayksikölle mahdollisimman laajasti pyydettyjä tietoja. Tietopyyntö ei velvoita Istekki Oy:tä toteuttamaan hankintaa tietopyynnössä tai sen liitteissä kuvatulla tavalla ja tarjouskilpailu voidaan myös jättää toteuttamatta. Tällä tietopyynnöllä selvitetään etädialyysijärjestelmän markkinatilannetta, toiminnallisia ja teknisiä ominaisuuksia, toimittajien hinnoitteluperiaatteita sekä hintatasoa. Tietopyyntöön vastanneille ei makseta korvausta tietopyynnön tekemisestä tai mahdollisiin tietopyyntöön liittyviin esittelytilaisuuksiin osallistumisesta. Tietopyynnön kohteena on etädialyysin kokonaisalustaratkaisun (kotidialyysi). Hankinnan kohde ja tavoitteet on kuvattu laajemmin liitteenä olevassa asiakirjassa. Tietopyynnön vastauksien perusteella voidaan järjestää markkinavuoropuhelutilaisuuksia, joissa toimittajat voivat esitellä omia palveluita, tuotteita ja vaihtoehtojaan kilpailutuksen kohteen toteutumiselle. Jos markkinavuoropuhelutilaisuuksia järjestetään, ne toteutetaan suomen kielellä. Istekki ilmoittaa tilaisuuksiin osallistuville yrityksille tarkemmat aikataulut myöhemmin. Istekki valitsee ja kutsuu vuoropuheluihin osallistujat. Tarpeen mukaan vuoropuhelutilaisuuksia voidaan järjestää useampia ja osallistujina saattavat olla myös Tilaajan loppuasiakkaat. Tilaaja varaa oikeuden järjestää myös kirjallisia vuoropuhelukierroksia ja luonnostilaisten tarjouspyyntömateriaalien kommentointikierroksia. Tietopyyntöön tulee vastata viimeistään 3.2.2026 klo 14.00 mennessä. Kysymykset, joihin tulee vastata ja ohjeet tietopyyntöön vastaamiseen ovat liitteessä.
