result.text: The Landesverband Lippe, a public-law body, intends to modernise the Externsteine information centre and stage the surrounding area in Horn-Bad Meinberg digitally as an integrated "Externsteine Experience World". The Externsteine, which attract around 600.000 visitors per year, are to be further developed into a sustainable, interactive and low-barrier experience venue. The visitor centre, which is currently not accessible and technically obsolete, forms the central starting and experience point. Lot LOT-0001: LVL Externsteine. The subject of the procurement is the modernisation of the Externsteine information centre and the digital staging of the surrounding area into an integrated "Externsteine Experience World". What is being procured is a concept together with its implementation, meaning on the one hand the conceptualisation including all planning services and official approval and authorisation procedures, and on the other hand the complete implementation including any construction services, IT services and further services (such as support and training). The contract is awarded as a staged contract: Upon the award of contract, solely stage 1 (drawing up of the concepts) is commissioned, whereas the implementation services (stage 2) as well as the granting of licences, technical support and training (stage 3) are tendered as options, on the calling-off of which the contracting authority decides within five months after acceptance of stage 1. The concept, the planning of the implementation and the implementation itself are to be designed freely by the contractor, but must meet certain minimum requirements based on the actual situation coupled with the available budget and the statutory provisions. General requirements: - The Externsteine and the entire surrounding area are subject to nature conservation, and all services to be conceptualised must be consistent with the requirements arising therefrom. The contractor must ensure that both the concept already and the complete implementation comply with all nature conservation law requirements. This also includes all necessary measures taken for the implementation of the concept. - The historical documents and data on the Externsteine are provided by the Landesverband Lippe and the Externsteine Conservation Association and are not to be compiled by the contractor, but are to be prepared didactically and scenographically, digitalised and compiled depending on the type of use. - This project is funded in part by a subsidy from the State of NRW and is therefore to be conceptualised and implemented in such a way that all funding law provisions are fully complied with. - A Progressive Web App or a mobile app for iOS and Android is to be conceptualised, programmed and made available for download in the common app stores, which contains natural history, geological and historical information on the Externsteine and depicts the area including paths and sights, and the app must also contain the link to the homepage so that current information can be accessed directly. Further content is to be conceptualised and implemented by the contractor. Further functions that allow visitors to experience the site actively must be present - a WhatsApp scavenger hunt is to be conceptualised as well - Every software must be compatible at least with ChromeOS and Windows 11 or higher, if available at the time of performance - every hardware must be compatible at least with ChromeOS, additional compatibility with Microsoft Windows 11 or higher, if available at the time of performance, is desirable. Information centre requirements: - Insertion of inspection openings everywhere where information technology is installed and/or will be installed - Replacement of obsolete hardware - Utilisation of the existing screen openings in the walls and the central X made of painted wood - No structural changes to the basic structure of the rooms - Preservation of the analogue stations in the display cases - Installation (indoor) including furnishing with software, licences and a moderation dashboard of a social wall; the moderation is taken over by the Landesverband Lippe - At least production and installation of a tactile relief of the Externsteine formation and the Descent from the Cross relief as a 3D print - Revision and modernisation as well as new creation of digital content including didactic aspects - Expansion of the use of the cinema - Digital content must be provided on physical data carriers (USB sticks, locally on a PC) in order to enable simple exchange and to be able to offer an integrated visitor experience even in the event of an internet outage; the file formats must be playable independently of the operating system - Excluded from this are contents whose existence is purely online (SocialWall, App) - Creation of barrier-free access to contents - Reliable and easily analysable visitor counter - Sign stating that the measure is subsidised according to the specification from the approval notice. Further specific requirements can be found in sections V and VI of the specification of services (Appendix B01). The project is financed in part from public subsidy funds. Binding under funding law are a total budget of 620.000 EUR (thereof 372.000 EUR subsidised, distributed across financial years 2026 and 2027) as well as a cost breakdown of 255.000 EUR furnishings/scenography, 25.000 EUR construction costs and 340.000 EUR technology costs. All services are to be rendered by the end of calendar year 2027. The basis of the contract is an EVB-IT cloud contract and an EVB-IT system contract.

parts.source: Der Landesverband Lippe, eine Körperschaft des öffentlichen Rechts, beabsichtigt die Modernisierung des Infozentrums Externsteine und die digitale Inszenierung des umgebenden Areals in Horn-Bad Meinberg als ganzheitliche "Erlebniswelt Externsteine". Die Externsteine mit jährlich rund 600.000 Besuchern sollen zu einem zukunftsfähigen, interaktiven und barrierearmen Erlebnisort weiterentwickelt werden. Das bislang nicht barrierefreie und technisch veraltete Besucherzentrum bildet dabei den zentralen Start- und Erlebnispunkt. Lot LOT-0001: LVL Externsteine. Gegenstand der Beschaffung ist die Modernisierung des Infozentrums Externsteine und die digitale Inszenierung des umgebenden Areals zu einer ganzheitlichen "Erlebniswelt Externsteine". Beschafft wird ein Konzept samt dessen Umsetzung, das heißt zum einen die Konzeptionierung einschließlich aller Planungsleistungen und behördlichen Genehmigungs- und Erlaubnisverfahren, zum anderen die komplette Umsetzung inklusive etwaiger Bauleistungen, IT-Dienstleistungen sowie weiterer Dienstleistungen (wie z.B. Support und Schulungen). Die Vergabe erfolgt als Stufenvertrag: Mit dem Zuschlag wird allein Stufe 1 (Erstellung der Konzepte) beauftragt, während die Umsetzungsleistungen (Stufe 2) sowie Lizenzeinräumung, technischer Support und Schulungen (Stufe 3) als Optionen ausgeschrieben sind, über deren Abruf der Auftraggeber binnen fünf Monaten nach Abnahme der Stufe 1 entscheidet. Das Konzept, die Planung der Umsetzung und die Umsetzung selbst sind vom Auftragnehmer frei zu gestalten, müssen jedoch aufgrund der Ist-Situation gepaart mit dem zur Verfügung stehenden Budget und den gesetzlichen Vorgaben bestimmte Mindestanforderungen erfüllen Anforderungen allgemein: - Die Externsteine und das gesamte umgebende Areal unterliegen dem Naturschutz, alle zu konzipierenden Leistungen müssen mit den Vorgaben, die sich daraus ergeben, in Einklang stehen. Der Auftragnehmer hat dafür Sorge zu tragen, dass sowohl bereits das Konzept als auch die komplette Umsetzung alle naturschutzrechtlichen Vorgaben einhält. Das umfasst auch alle nötigen Maßnahmen, die zur Konzeptumsetzung getroffen werden. - Die historischen Dokumente und Daten zu den Externsteinen werden vom Landesverband Lippe und der Schutzgemeinschaft Externsteine zur Verfügung gestellt und sollen nicht vom Auftragnehmer zusammengetragen werden, wohl aber didaktisch und szenographisch aufbereitet, je nach Einsatzart digitalisiert und zusammengestellt werden. - Dieses Projekt wird zum Teil durch eine Förderung des Landes NRW finanziert und ist und ist deshalb so zu konzipieren und umzusetzen, dass alle förderrechtlichen Bestimmungen vollumfänglich eingehalten werden. - Es soll eine Progressive Web App, bzw. eine mobile App für iOS und Android konzipiert, programmiert und in den gängigen App-Stores zum Download bereitgestellt werden, welche naturkundliche, geologische und historische Informationen zu den Externsteinen enthalten und das Areal samt Wegen und Sehenswürdigkeiten darstellt, außerdem soll in der App der Link zur Homepage enthalten sein, so dass direkt auf aktuelle Informationen zugegriffen werden kann. Weitere Inhalte sind vom Auftragnehmer zu konzipieren und umzusetzen. Weitere Funktionen, die den Besucher das Gelände aktiv erleben lassen, müssen vorhanden sein - eine Whats App Schnitzeljagd soll mit konzipiert werden - Jede Software muss mindestens mit ChromeOS und Windows 11 oder höher, falls zum Zeitpunkt der Erbringung vorhanden, kompatibel sein - jede Hardware muss mindestens mit ChromeOS kompatibel sein, eine zusätzliche Kompatibilität mit Microsoft Windows 11 oder höher, falls zum Zeitpunkt der Erbringung vorhanden, ist wünschenswert Anforderungen Infozentrum: - Einlassen von Revisionsöffnungen überall dort, wo Informationstechnik verbaut ist und/oder wird - Austausch der veralteten Hardware - Nutzung der vorhandenen Bildschirmöffnungen in den Wänden und dem zentralen, aus lackiertem Holz bestehenden X - keine baulichen Veränderungen der Grundstruktur der Räume - Erhalt der analogen Stationen in den Vitrinen - Installation (indoor) samt Einrichtung mit Software, Lizenzen und Moderationsdashboard einer Social Wall; die Moderation wird vom Landesverband Lippe übernommen - mindestens Herstellung und Installation eines Tastreliefs der Externsteinformation und des Kreuzabnahmereliefs als 3D-Druck - Überarbeitung und Modernisierung sowie Neuerstellung digitaler Inhalte inklusive didaktischer Aspekte - Erweiterung der Nutzung des Kinos - digitale Inhalte müssen auf physischen Datenträgern bereitgestellt werden (USB-Sticks, lokal auf einem PC), um einen einfachen Austausch zu ermöglichen und auch bei Internetausfall ein ganzheitliches Besuchererlebnis bieten zu können, die Dateiformate müssen sich betriebssystemunabhängig abspielen lassen - Ausgenommen hiervon sind Inhalte, deren Bestehen rein online gegeben ist (SocialWall, App) - Schaffen von barrierefreien Zugängen zu Inhalten - zuverlässiger und leicht auswertbarer Besucherzähler - Schild, dass die Maßnahme gefördert ist laut Vorgabe aus dem Bewilligungsbescheid Die weiteren konkreten Anforderungen sind Ziffer V und VI. der Leistungsbeschreibung (Anlage B01) zu entnehmen. Das Projekt wird anteilig aus öffentlichen Fördermitteln finanziert. Förderrechtlich verbindlich sind ein Gesamtbudget von 620.000 EUR (davon 372.000 EUR gefördert, verteilt auf die Haushaltsjahre 2026 und 2027) sowie eine Kostenaufteilung von 255.000 EUR Einrichtung/Szenografie, 25.000 EUR Baukosten und 340.000 EUR Technikkosten. Alle Leistungen sind bis zum Ablauf des Kalenderjahres 2027 zu erbringen. Vertragsgrundlage sind ein EVB-IT-Cloudvertrag und ein EVB-IT-Systemvertrag.

The system must be capable of being implemented by 1.4.2027 and operational use will be started 1.5.2027. The subject of the procurement and the requirements concerning it are described in detail in Appendix 1 (Naantalin kaupunki_Payroll and HR system requirements), all tabs of which must be filled in. The comparison of tenders is based on the total comparison price from the price appendix of Appendix 1.

result.text: Bærum municipality would like to invite the market to a dialogue in connection with a coming procurement in order to cover the municipality ́s need for digital joint user equipment/AV equipment (DFB) with the accompanying services. This market dialogue is a replacement/update of previously completed market dialogues. See previously completed market dialogue: https://doffin.no/notices/2023-653193 Invitation to market dialogue - Framework agreement for the procurement of digital joint user equipment/AV equipment and the accompanying services Bærum municipality invites tenderers to a market dialogue with suppliers for a framework agreement for the procurement of digital joint user equipment/AV equipment and accompanying services. The aim of the procurement is to replace the current framework agreement for the procurement of "Digital joint user equipment - meeting room equipment and infotainment". The new agreement will cover an equivalent area and the need for digital joint user equipment (DFB) for all entities and buildings where Bærum municipality is responsible for such joint equipment. The municipality has separate agreements for client control and user-related equipment. Bærum municipality would like to invite the market to a dialogue in connection with a coming procurement in order to cover the municipality ́s need for digital joint user equipment/AV with the accompanying services. The intention is that the agreement shall cover Bærum municipality ́s total need for digital joint user equipment/AV equipment, entertainment, meeting room equipment, accessories and accompanying services in the contract period. The contract shall ensure that digital joint user equipment/AV equipment for Bærum municipality ́s entities and buildings always has access to updated equipment/products and services with modern and good quality. The aim is not to replace the existing equipment that covers the current user need. In addition to the delivery and operation of new equipment, we would like a new supplier to provide support and service for the current equipment. The consultancy services will be strengthened in the contract and the tenderer must reckon on assisting the Contracting Authority as needed, both as regards assessment/supplementation of equipment, support and maintenance. Expanded support and assistance can be required at major events and video conferences. The aim of the market dialogue is to gain insight into the market now and forward, establish increased knowledge on the supplier market, inform about the coming planned procurement and get any feedback on the planned procurement before the announcement. Bærum municipality is one of Norway's largest municipalities. Both inhabitants and employees have high expectations for the municipality ́s IT systems, both in regard to response, availability, information security, cost efficiency as well as the ability to implement new functions quickly and efficiently. According to Bærum municipality ́s digitalisation strategy, the municipality ́s employees and inhabitants shall experience "One Bærum - digital first choice" via, among other things, access to best and correct practices in service deliveries, access to process support and technology to simplify our own everyday lives and get a better tool for interaction, case processing and service production. The procurement is planned to be carried out as a tender contest with notice before summer 2026. Tenderers are invited to a joint card information meeting in Kommunegården in Sandvika for orientation of the upcoming planned procurement friday 13.03.2026, 09:00 – 10.00. Tenderers who are interested in a short 1:1 meeting with Bærum municipality if the procurement can register their interest.1:1 meetings will be held on the same day (13.03.2026) (up to 30 minutes for each tenderer) – if there are more registered participants than we have set aside, an extra day will be set aside for 1:1 meetings. Tenderers can inform and/or ask questions to the Customer at the 1:1 meeting. Tenderers who register for the market dialogue will be sent parts of the tender documentation draft for a planned competition, so that they can provide input on the tender documentation before the competition is announced. The aim of the written input is to get a general description of the tenderer ́s system and feedback sent out documentation and a planned procurement. The meetings will be confidential and only for internal use by the work group in the municipality. Input from the dialogue can be used in the subsequent competition. Written input shall only be relevant for the competition. A template will be sent out to provide feedback to suppliers who register for the dialogue conference. The deadline for registering for the Dialogue conference and 1:1 meetings is 09.03.2026, 16:00. Enrolments are to be sent as a notification on the case in Mercell. The Contracting Authority would like feedback from tenderers for the planned procurement and draft of competition documents by: Thursday 09.04.2026, 16:00. Emphasis is put on the fact that participation in the dialogue meetings is neither necessary nor required to participate in the subsequent competition. Communication will take place through Mercell.For further information about Bærum municipality, see www.baerum.kommune.no The meetings will be held in Kommunegården in SandvikaAdresse: Arnold Haukelands plass 10, 1338 Sandvika

result.text: Numera Palvelut Oy (hereinafter Numera or Contracting Authority) requests your tender for a joint procurement concerning Printing and information services (Multifunction devices and related services) in accordance with the call for tender documents. The procurement is not divided into lots; instead, a single supplier will be selected, with whom Numera will draw up mutual procurement contracts.: The competitive tendering is conducted via an open procedure. The selection criterion used for the competitive tendering is the most economically advantageous tender, and the comparison criterion is [the best price-quality ratio]. Detailed information on scoring and comparison criteria is presented in the section Criteria for the subject of the procurement of the call for tender. If several tenderers achieve the exact same score with their tender, the Contracting Authority will draw lots to determine the winner. Drawing lots is an accepted method in procurement law case law. Parallel tenders and alternative tenders are not accepted. The procurement contract shall be valid for a fixed term of two (2) years. Thereafter, the contract shall continue until further notice. Numera's customer communities using the joint procurement and potentially joining it during the contract period are stated in appendix one (1) of the draft agreement. The procurement contract shall enter into force once the procurement decision has become legally binding or the Market Court has granted an enforcement permit for the procurement decision, and both contracting parties have signed a written procurement contract. The notice period for terminating the contract is six (6) months for both contracting parties. A customer participating in the contract may terminate the contract in respect of itself with a notice period of 6 months. By submitting a tender, the tenderer undertakes to comply with all conditions in the call for tender documents and any additional information provided during the procurement procedure. The Contracting Authority has the right to verify the information provided by the tenderer in its tender documents before making the procurement decision. If the information provided is incorrect, the tenderer may be excluded from the procurement procedure. The main subject of the procurement is multifunction devices for uniform use (emphasising A4-sized devices) for printing and scanning, document workflow management, and support and additional services related to the aforementioned devices and their services (e.g. secure printing, management solutions, toner and supply solutions, ordering system, etc.). The focus of the procurement is on cost-effective devices supporting A4 printing, X-archive scanning (healthcare XDS solutions) individual devices agreed on a case-by-case basis, taking GDPR into account in operations, support and maintenance services, and other additional printing services in accordance with the documents. This procurement does not include the procurement of printing paper, printing work, or printing services (e.g. digital and offset printing). It is possible to expand the procurement during the negotiation procedure as an option regarding printers connected to workstations via USB. Numera decides on the implementation of the option. In questions and problem situations related to the use of the tendering service, the tenderer must contact the service provider's (Cloudia Oy / Tarjouspalvelu.fi) Helpdesk: tel. 020 766 1075, tuki@cloudia.fi.

Hankintaa ei ole jaettu osakokonaisuuksiin, vaan valitaan yksi toimittaja, jonka kanssa Numera laatii keskinäiset hankintasopimukset.: Kilpailutus suoritetaan avoimella menettelyllä. Kilpailutuksen valintaperusteena käytetään kokonaistaloudellista edullisuutta ja vertailuperusteena [parasta hinta-laatusuhdetta]. Tarkemmat tiedot pisteytyksestä ja vertailuperusteista on esitetty tarjouspyynnön osiossa Hankinnan kohteen kriteerit. Mikäli useampi tarjoaja ansaitsee tarjouksellaan täsmälleen saman pistemäärän, Hankintayksikkö arpoo voittajan. Arvonta on hankitalain oikeuskäytännössä hyväksytty tapa. Rinnakkaisia tarjouksia, vaihtoehtoisia tarjouksia ei hyväksytä. Hankintasopimus on voimassa määräaikaisena kaksi (2) vuotta. Sen jälkeen sopimus jatkuu toistaiseksi voimassa olevana. result.text: The district administration of the Oberhavel district (contracting authority) intends to award the supply of CAFM software as well as its maintenance and support (including configuration/implementation) with effect presumably from 01.05.2026. Following the competition for participation, at least three and at most five suitable candidates will be admitted to the 2 stage of the procurement procedure - the tender phase. Details of the procurement procedure can be found in the procedural conditions. The district administers a comprehensive range of properties, both in its own use and rented out. In order to efficiently fulfil the necessary facility management processes, the Landkreis Oberhavel plans to implement a professional CAFM system that offers a user-friendly software interface and effective process structures. This is intended to optimise workflows, better manage resources and improve the quality of services for the citizens of the district. The software must be purely web-based and provided as an on-premise solution. The software must essentially map the following processes: - Business planning, budget planning and budget control, maintenance, inspection, testing - Contract management - Letting management - Ticketing and complaint management - Special cleaning - Locking management - Cleaning and winter service - Invoice management - Service charge settlement including energy management - Vacancy management - Inventory management - Grounds maintenance - Warranty tracking - Space management including relocation management - in particular relocation variant planning - Master data maintenance / documentation and reporting The following processes are also desirable (better evaluated - see procurement documents), but not mandatory: - Sale / award of hereditary building right - Commissioning / commissioning management Service provision - Incl. installation, customisation, interfaces - Incl. documentation, training and training materials The technical requirements for each process are described in detail in Appendix 01 - LK Oberhavel process requirements. Further criteria to be met are provided by the specifications and performance sheets A / B / I, as well as the agenda with the S-criteria, which are evaluated in the course of the presentation.

parts.source: Die Kreisverwaltung des Landkreises Oberhavel (Auftraggeber) beabsichtigt, mit Wirkung voraussichtlich zum 01.05.2026 die Lieferung einer CAFM-Software sowie deren Pflege und Support (einschließlich Konfiguration/Implementierung) zu vergeben. Im Anschluss an den Teilnahmewettbewerb werden mindestens drei und höchstens fünf geeignete Bewerber zur 2. Stufe des Vergabeverfahrens - Angebotsphase zugelassen. Die Einzelheiten des Vergabeverfahrens sind den Verfahrensbedingungen zu entnehmen. Der Landkreis verwaltet eine umfangreiche Palette an Liegenschaften, sowohl in eigener Nutzung als auch vermietet. Um die notwendigen Facility Management-Prozesse effizient zu erfüllen, plant der Landkreis Oberhavel die Implementierung eines professionellen CAFM-Systems, das eine benutzerfreundliche Oberfläche und effektive Prozessstrukturen bietet. Dadurch sollen die Arbeitsabläufe optimiert, die Ressourcen besser verwaltet und die Qualität der Dienstleistungen für die Bürgerinnen und Bürger des Landkreises verbessert werden. Die Software ist rein webbasiert und als On-Premise Lösung zur Verfügung zu stellen. Im Wesentlichen sind folgende Prozesse durch die Software abzubilden: - Wirtschaftsplanung, Budgetplanung und Budgetsteuerung Wartung, Inspektion, Prüfungen - Vertragsmanagement - Vermietungsmanagement - Ticketing und Beschwerdemanagement - Sonderreinigung - Schließmanagement - Reinigung und Winterdienst - Rechnungsmanagement - Nebenkostenabrechnung inkl. Energiemanagement - Leerstandsmanagement - Inventarmanagement - Grünpflege - Gewährleitungsverfolgung - Flächenmanagement inkl. Umzugsmanagement-insbesondere Umzugsvariantenplanung - Stammdatenpflege / Dokumentation und Berichtswesen Wünschenswert (besser bewertet- siehe Vergabeunterlagen), aber nicht zwingend gefordert sind außerdem folgende Prozesse: - Verkauf / Vergabe Erbbaurecht - Inbetriebnahme / Inbetriebnahmemanagement Leistungserbringung - Inkl. Installation, Anpassung, Schnittstellen - inkl. Dokumentationen, Schulungen und Schulungsunterlagen Die technischen Anforderungen je Prozess werden in Anlage 01 - LK Oberhavel Prozessanforderungen detailliert beschrieben, Über die weiteren zu erfüllenden Kriterien geben das Lastenheft und die Leistungsblätter A / B / I Aufschluss, sowie die Agenda mit den S-Kriterien, die im Zuge der Präsentation bewertet werden.

rejected.text: The Republic of Moldova is undergoing an accelerated and complex European Union accession process following the opening of accession negotiations with the EU in 2024. The accession process requires comprehensive alignment of Moldova's legal, institutional and policy framework with the EU acquis, as well as strengthened governance structures, institutional coordination mechanisms and implementation capacities at national and local level. In September 2025, Moldova successfully completed the screening process for all chapters of the EU acquis, enabling the transition to structured technical negotiations and implementation of opening benchmarks and subsequent requirements identified during the screening process. These developments generate increasing demand for specialised expertise, institutional capacity development and practical support for the implementation of EU-related reforms. Particular importance is attached to reforms related to rule of law, democratic governance, public administration, justice and internal security, especially under Cluster I "Fundamentals", including Chapter 23 (Judiciary and Fundamental Rights) and Chapter 24 (Justice, Freedom and Security). At the same time, Moldova's EU accession process also requires stronger local governance capacities, improved multi-level coordination and increased participation of civil society, diaspora organisations and other stakeholders in EU-related reform processes. In this context, Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit (GIZ) GmbH implements the projects "EU Integration Support Project" (EUISP), financed by the German Federal Foreign Office (FFO), and "Facilitating the EU Accession process through Coordination and Engagement in Moldova" (FACE), financed by the German Federal Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development (BMZ). To support the implementation of these projects, GIZ foresees the establishment of a comprehensive Short-Term Expert Pool (STEP), enabling flexible and demand-driven mobilisation of national and international expertise. The STEP will support activities related to legislative and policy approximation to the EU acquis, negotiation preparation and benchmark fulfilment, institutional and organisational capacity development, strategic planning and coordination, strengthening local governance capacities, facilitation of international cooperation and peer-to-peer exchange, as well as structured stakeholder engagement and support for local initiatives. The contractor implementing the STEP will provide technical advisory services, analytical support, capacity development measures, international exchange formats and implementation support in close cooperation with GIZ and Moldovan partner institutions. The overall objective is to strengthen the capacities of national and local actors to effectively coordinate, implement and support Moldova's EU accession and alignment process. The procurement concerns the establishment and operation of a comprehensive Short-Term Expert Pool (STEP) supporting the implementation of activities under the GIZ projects "EU Integration Support Project" (EUISP) and "Facilitating the EU Accession process through Coordination and Engagement in Moldova" (FACE), both contributing to the Republic of Moldova's EU accession and alignment process. The contractor will provide flexible, demand-driven and results-oriented consultancy and implementation support services aimed at strengthening the capacities of national and local actors involved in Moldova's EU accession process. The services will combine technical advisory support, institutional and organisational capacity development, international experience exchange, stakeholder engagement and support for local initiatives. The contractor will be responsible for identifying, mobilising, coordinating and managing national and international experts and support measures in close cooperation with GIZ and Moldovan partner institutions. The assignment may include the following services and activities: - technical, legal and methodological advisory services related to EU acquis alignment, policy development and implementation of EU-related reforms; - preparation and revision of draft laws, regulations, strategies, methodologies, guidelines and analytical documents; - institutional, legislative and implementation gap analyses, including assessment of institutional capacities and implementation readiness; - support for negotiation process, fulfilment of opening and closing benchmarks and related monitoring and reporting processes; - development and strengthening of strategic planning, coordination, monitoring and reporting mechanisms related to EU accession and EU-aligned reforms; - provision of thematic expertise related to rule of law, democratic governance, justice, internal security, public administration reform and local governance; - design and delivery of trainings, workshops, mentoring, coaching and institutional learning activities for representatives of public institutions and other stakeholders; - organisation and facilitation of international peer-to-peer exchange, study visits, policy dialogues, expert discussions and cooperation formats involving EU Member States, accession countries and international experts; - support for strengthening coordination, cooperation and communication mechanisms between national institutions, local public authorities and other stakeholders involved in the accession process; - support for participatory and stakeholder engagement processes involving civil society organisations, diaspora representatives, women's organisations and organisations representing vulnerable groups; - support for strengthening local governance capacities and practical application of EU-related planning, implementation and monitoring approaches at local level;

The contractor will be responsible for identifying, mobilising, coordinating and managing national and international experts and support measures in close cooperation with GIZ and Moldovan partner institutions. The assignment may include the following services and activities: - technical, legal and methodological advisory services related to EU acquis alignment, policy development and implementation of EU-related reforms; - preparation and revision of draft laws, regulations, strategies, methodologies, guidelines and analytical documents; - institutional, legislative and implementation gap analyses, including assessment of institutional capacities and implementation readiness; - support for negotiation process, fulfilment of opening and closing benchmarks and related monitoring and reporting processes; - development and strengthening of strategic planning, coordination, monitoring and reporting mechanisms related to EU accession and EU-aligned reforms; - provision of thematic expertise related to rule of law, democratic governance, justice, internal security, public administration reform and local governance; - design and delivery of trainings, workshops, mentoring, coaching and institutional learning activities for representatives of public institutions and other stakeholders; - organisation and facilitation of international peer-to-peer exchange, study visits, policy dialogues, expert discussions and cooperation formats involving EU Member States, accession countries and international experts; - support for strengthening coordination, cooperation and communication mechanisms between national institutions, local public authorities and other stakeholders involved in the accession process; - support for participatory and stakeholder engagement processes involving civil society organisations, diaspora representatives, women"s organisations and organisations representing vulnerable groups; - support for strengthening local governance capacities and practical application of EU-related planning, implementation and monitoring approaches at local level;

result.text: - support for the conceptualisation, management and implementation of small-scale support initiatives and local contributions linked to EU accession-related objectives; - facilitation of innovative cooperation, consultation and policy development formats, including policy labs, simulation exercises and practical learning approaches; - monitoring, reporting, documentation and knowledge management activities related to the implementation of the assignment. The contractor will ensure process-oriented and implementation-oriented delivery of services, including quality assurance, operational coordination, backstopping and effective mobilisation of expertise throughout the contract period. Particular emphasis will be placed on ensuring the practical applicability of delivered support, strengthening institutional ownership and supporting sustainable implementation of EU-related reforms at both national and local level. Services will be implemented in close coordination with GIZ and relevant Moldovan partner institutions, including the Bureau for European Integration within the State Chancellery, line ministries, local public authorities, civil society organisations and other relevant stakeholders. Given the dynamic nature of the EU accession process, the assignment requires a high degree of flexibility and responsiveness in order to address evolving priorities, reform needs and operational requirements related to Moldova's EU accession and alignment process.

result.text: With this procurement procedure, the contracting authority intends to conclude a framework agreement with two economic operators for the provision of PaaS services for AI applications on a high-performance, secure, and sovereign cloud platform. The subject of the service is the provision of a cloud-agnostic AI platform as a Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS), which serves as a building block of a modular, cross-cloud infrastructure. The services include the provision and operation of a high-performance, secure, and DVC-oriented cloud platform, particularly with regard to the appropriate use of open standards, open interfaces, or open-source components. The platform provides a uniform operating environment for containerised applications and AI workloads and supports multi-cloud and hybrid deployment scenarios. It must ensure the secure and reproducible operation of AI applications, provide GPU-supported computing environments, and support MLOps pipelines. In this context, the integration of existing on-premises systems that are managed centrally must be enabled. The first applications to be operated on the platform are the KIPITZ solutions and the AI application for accelerating planning and approval procedures. Further applications may be added during the contract term. The platform must provide uniform mechanisms for identity and role management, encryption (e.g., BYOK/HYOK), logging, auditing, as well as for change and exit processes. Further information on the subject of the contract can be found in the procurement documents, in particular in the description of services and the draft contract. ESTIMATED VALUE, MAXIMUM VALUE, FINANCIAL RESOURCES The estimated contract volume of this framework agreement is EUR 208,00 million net over the maximum contract term of four years. The maximum value of the framework agreement is EUR 249,60 million net over the maximum contract term of four years. Financial resources in the amount of EUR 200 million net are secured, of which there is a justified expectation in the amount of EUR 195 million net that the financing can be ensured. Financing in the amount of EUR 49,5 million is still uncertain. There is no entitlement to the award of individual contracts to a specific extent. The information is provided exclusively for procurement law purposes of transparency. Bidders must take this into account in their calculation. ENTITIES ENTITLED TO CALL OFF AND ENTITLED TO RECEIVE SERVICES The Bundesrepublik Deutschland, vertreten durch das Bundesministerium für Digitales und Staatsmodernisierung is both the contracting authority and the entity entitled to call off and receive services. It may award individual contracts for itself as well as for the entities entitled to receive services within the federal administration. This includes all parts of the federal administration, including the ITZBund. Individual call-offs are issued by the Federal Ministry for Digital and Transport for these entities entitled to receive services, which are entitled and obliged exclusively through the individual contract declared for them. In addition, govdigital eG is entitled to call off and receive services. It may award individual contracts for itself and for its members. Individual call-offs are carried out by govdigital eG for its members, which are entitled and obliged exclusively through the individual contract declared for them. NOTE ON ELIGIBILITY TO PARTICIPATE Economic operators from third countries that are not covered by an international agreement with the European Union guaranteeing equal and reciprocal access to public procurement ("non-covered countries") may be excluded from participation in this procurement procedure. The decision on the admission of such economic operators is made on a case-by-case basis by the contracting authority and is based on the case law of the European Court of Justice (in particular the judgment in case C-652/22 - Kolin). Requests to participate and tenders that include subcontractors or members of a bidding consortium from non-covered countries are also subject to a separate review and may be excluded or adjusted in the evaluation.

parts.source: Mit diesem Vergabeverfahren beabsichtigt die Auftraggeberin eine Rahmenvereinbarung über die Bereitstellung von PaaS-Diensten für KI-Anwendungen auf einer leistungsfähigen, sicheren und souveränen Cloud-Plattform mit zwei Wirtschaftsteilnehmern abzuschließen. Leistungsgegenstand ist die Bereitstellung einer cloud-agnostischen KI-Plattform als Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS), die als ein Baustein einer modularen, cloudübergreifenden Infrastruktur dient. Die Leistungen umfassen die Bereitstellung und den Betrieb einer leistungsfähigen, sicheren und DVC-orientierten Cloud-Plattform, insbesondere mit Blick auf die angemessene Verwendung von offenen Standards, offenen Schnittstellen oder Open-Source-Komponenten. Die Plattform stellt eine einheitliche Betriebsumgebung für containerisierte Anwendungen und KI-Workloads bereit und unterstützt Multi-Cloud- sowie hybride Einsatzszenarien. Sie muss den sicheren und reproduzierbaren Betrieb von KI-Anwendungen gewährleisten, GPU-gestützte Rechenumgebungen bereitstellen und MLOps-Pipelines unterstützen. Dabei ist eine Integration bestehender On-Premises-Systeme zu ermöglichen, die zentral verwaltet werden. Als erste Anwendungen sind die Lösungen KIPITZ und die KI-Anwendung zur Beschleunigung von Planungs- und Genehmigungsverfahren auf der Plattform zu betreiben. Weitere Anwendungen können während der Vertragslaufzeit ergänzt werden. Die Plattform hat einheitliche Mechanismen zur Identitäts- und Rollenverwaltung, Verschlüsselung (z. B. BYOK/HYOK), Protokollierung, Auditierung sowie für Change- und Exit-Prozesse bereitzustellen. Weitere Informationen zum Auftragsgegenstand ergeben sich aus den Vergabeunterlagen, insbesondere aus der Leistungsbeschreibung und dem Vertragsentwurf. SCHÄTZWERT, HÖCHSTWERT, FINANZIERUNGSMITTEL Das geschätzte Auftragsvolumen dieser Rahmenvereinbarung beträgt EUR 208,00 Mio. netto über die maximale Vertragslaufzeit von vier Jahren. Der Höchstwert der Rahmenvereinbarung beträgt EUR 249,60 Mio. netto über die maximale Vertragslaufzeit von vier Jahren. Die Finanzmittel sind in Höhe von EUR 200 Mio. netto gesichert, davon besteht in Höhe von EUR 195 Mio. netto eine begründete Erwartung, dass die Finanzierung sichergestellt werden kann. In Höhe von EUR 49,5 Mio. ist die Finanzierung noch ungewiss. Es besteht kein Anspruch auf die Erteilung von Einzelaufträgen in einem bestimmten Umfang. Die Angaben dienen ausschließlich vergaberechtlichen Zwecken der Transparenz. Die Bieter haben dies bei der Kalkulation zu berücksichtigen. ABRUFBERECHTIGTE UND BEZUGSBERECHTIGTE STELLEN Die Bundesrepublik Deutschland, vertreten durch das Bundesministerium für Digitales und Staatsmodernisierung, ist sowohl Auftraggeberin als auch Abruf- und Bezugsberechtigte. Sie kann Einzelaufträge für sich selbst sowie für die Bezugsberechtigten innerhalb der Bundesverwaltung erteilen. Dazu gehören alle Teile der Bundesverwaltung, einschließlich des ITZBund. Die Einzelabrufe werden durch das Bundesministerium für Digitales und Staatsmodernisierung für diese Bezugsberechtigten erteilt, die ausschließlich durch den für sie erklärten Einzelauftrag berechtigt und verpflichtet sind. Zusätzlich ist die govdigital eG abruf- und bezugsberechtigt. Sie kann Einzelaufträge für sich und für ihre Mitglieder erteilen. Die Einzelabrufe erfolgen durch die govdigital eG für ihre Mitglieder, die ausschließlich durch den für sie erklärten Einzelauftrag berechtigt und verpflichtet sind. HINWEIS ZUR TEILNAHMEBERECHTIGUNG Wirtschaftsteilnehmer aus Drittstaaten, die nicht durch ein internationales Abkommen mit der Europäischen Union abgedeckt sind, welches einen gleichberechtigten und gegenseitigen Zugang zum öffentlichen Beschaffungswesen garantiert ("nicht abgedeckte Länder"), können von der Teilnahme an diesem Vergabeverfahren ausgeschlossen werden. Die Entscheidung über die Zulassung solcher Wirtschaftsteilnehmer erfolgt im Einzelfall durch die Auftraggeberin und basiert auf der Rechtsprechung des Europäischen Gerichtshofs (insbesondere Urteil in der Rechtssache C-652/22 - Kolin). Teilnahmeanträge und Angebote, die Unterauftragnehmer oder Bietergemeinschaftsmitglieder aus nicht abgedeckten Ländern einbeziehen, unterliegen ebenfalls einer gesonderten Prüfung und können ausgeschlossen oder in der Bewertung angepasst werden.

result.text: The aim of this project is to provide tools in the form of a guideline and a tool for public administration, industry and security research alike, which make it possible to increase the resilience, in particular of cloud applications, against microarchitectural attacks such as Spectre and Meltdown and newer variants. The focus is to be on defensive programming countermeasures at the application level. In this way, the security of the software used is to be made more independent of the cloud provider's countermeasures. In order to reach as large a target group as possible, the results are to be written in English. The guideline is to describe concrete, practical and easily applicable measures, and the developed tool is to identify vulnerabilities automatically and, where applicable, remediate them.

parts.source: Ziel dieses Projektes ist es, Werkzeuge in Form eines Leitfadens und eines Tools sowohl für die öffentliche Verwaltung, die Industrie und die Sicherheitsforschung zur Verfügung zu stellen, die es ermöglichen, die Resilienz insbesondere von Cloud-Anwendungen gegen mikroarchitekturelle Angriffe wie z.B. Spectre und Meltdown und neuere Vertreter zu erhöhen. Dabei sollen Gegenmaßnahmen des defensiven Programmierens auf Anwendungsebene im Vordergrund stehen. So soll die Sicherheit der verwendeten Software unabhängiger von den Gegenmaßnahmen des Cloud- Anbieters gemacht werden. Um eine möglichst große Zielgruppe zu erreichen, sollen die Ergebnisse in englischer Sprache verfasst werden. Der Leitfaden soll konkrete, praxisnahe und leicht anwendbare Maßnahmen beschreiben und das entwickelte Tool soll Schwachstellen automatisiert identifizieren und ggf. mittigeren.

result.text: The subject of the tender is the conclusion of a framework agreement on the provision of specialist consulting for an identity and access management project of Municipal Utilities Bielefeld. The aim of the project is the further development of IAM processes, the design of role and permission models as well as the introduction of a central technical IAM solution. Lot LOT-0001: Procurement of a consulting service for specialist consulting within the scope of an identity and access management (IAM) project for Municipal Utilities Bielefeld (SWB). Municipal Utilities Bielefeld operate a heterogeneous IT landscape with a multitude of applications and systems. The management of user identities and access rights is currently carried out partly in a decentralised and system-related manner. To improve the control of identities and permissions, a central structure for managing digital identities is being established as part of an IAM project. The aim of the IAM project is the introduction of a central IAM service for managing digital identities as well as for the structured and role-based allocation of permissions for applications and systems. For this purpose, an IAM governance structure is to be established as well as a technical IAM solution introduced and rolled out. Specifically, this means the further development of IAM processes, the design of a role and permission model, the introduction of a central IAM solution as well as integration of applications (from Q3 2027) and the preparation of organisational structures for the future operation of the IAM service. The project is managed by an external project management in close cooperation with the IP business division of Municipal Utilities Bielefeld. In the course of the project, the achievement of the following milestones is generally envisaged: • Elaboration and coordination of an IAM governance structure • Elaboration of a role-rights structure for SWB • Introduction of a technical IAM solution incl. implementation of a pilot • Successive rollout of the technical IAM solution to the entire SWB The subject of the tender is the provision of external specialist consulting to support the IAM project of Municipal Utilities Bielefeld. The consulting service comprises support for the implementation phase of the IAM project through two roles. 1. IAM management consulting 2. IAM process consulting Exactly one person is provided for each role. IAM management consulting supports the IP business division with organisational and strategic issues in connection with the introduction of the IAM service. Core tasks of IAM management consulting are: • Support with the organisational classification of IAM within the IT organisation • Further development of governance structures in the IAM environment • Support with the definition and staffing of roles and responsibilities • Evaluation of organisational impacts of IAM structures and processes • Support with the integration of IAM into existing security and governance structures • Elaboration of decision-making bases for management and project control • Support with coordination with relevant stakeholders • Support with the further development of the organisational operating model for the IAM service • Consulting on covering relevant regulatory requirements • Developing an implementation strategy on guidelines, processes and the tool solution • Coordinating content-related dependencies with other projects and line initiatives • Support with the manufacturer-independent selection of an IAM tool solution IAM process consulting supports the functional design of the processes for managing digital identities and permissions. Core tasks of IAM process consulting are: • Analysis of existing processes for managing identities and permissions • Elaboration of processes for the lifecycle of digital identities • Support with the design of joiner-mover-leaver processes • Development and structuring of a role and permission model • Structuring of processes for granting and changing access rights • Support with the integration of applications into IAM processes • Design of processes for recertification of permissions • Analysis of existing permission structures in applications • Creation of functional concepts and process documentation in the IAM environment • Support with the introduction of the processes and the tool solution • Technical support with required provided services and contribution obligations for the implementation of the tool solution • Elaboration of test cases based on the process descriptions and requirements for the tool solution For IAM management consulting, there is a maximum quantity of 440 person-days or 3.520 hours. For IAM process consulting, there is a maximum quantity of a total of 385 person-days or 3.080 hours Hybrid service provision is generally permissible. A binding ratio between remote and on-site deployments cannot currently be specified. The contracting authority determines the project-related required presence demand. On-site deployments in Bielefeld may be required in particular for project kick-off, workshops, steering committees, coordination meetings with central stakeholders and other appointments with presence requirements. The contractor must ensure that corresponding on-site appointments can also be attended with a reasonably short lead time. The concrete scope of presence services is determined by the contracting authority in accordance with the requirements of the project progress The framework agreement does not establish any minimum purchase obligation on the part of the contracting authority. The quantities, hourly rates, reference quantities, demand values and maximum quantities specified in the procurement documents serve exclusively to determine the contract value, the comparability of bids and the award evaluation.

parts.source: Gegenstand der Ausschreibung ist der Abschluss einer Rahmenvereinbarung über die Bereitstellung einer Fachberatung für ein Identity and Access Management Projekt der Stadtwerke Bielefeld. Ziel des Projektes ist die Weiterentwicklung von IAM-Prozessen, die Ausgestaltung von Rollen- und Berechtigungsmodellen sowie die Einführung einer zentralen technischen IAM-Lösung. Lot LOT-0001: Beschaffung einer Beratungsdienstleistung zur Fachberatung im Rahmen eines Identity and Access Management (IAM) Projektes für die Stadtwerke Bielefeld (SWB). Die Stadtwerke Bielefeld betreiben eine heterogene IT-Landschaft mit einer Vielzahl von Anwendungen und Systemen. Die Verwaltung von Benutzeridentitäten und Zugriffsrechten erfolgt derzeit teilweise dezentral und systembezogen. Zur Verbesserung der Steuerung von Identitäten und Berechtigungen wird im Rahmen eines IAM-Projektes eine zentrale Struktur zur Verwaltung digitaler Identitäten aufgebaut. Ziel des IAM-Projektes ist die Einführung eines zentralen IAM-Services zur Verwaltung digitaler Identitäten sowie zur strukturierten und rollenbasierten Vergabe von Berechtigungen auf Anwendungen und Systeme. Dazu soll eine IAM-Governance Struktur aufgebaut sowie eine technische IAM-Lösung eingeführt und ausgerollt werden Konkret bedeutet dies die Weiterentwicklung von IAM-Prozessen, die Ausgestaltung eines Rollen- und Berechtigungsmodells, die Einführung einer zentralen IAM-Lösung sowie Integration von Anwendungen (ab Q3 2027) und die Vorbereitung organisatorischer Strukturen für den zukünftigen Betrieb des IAM-Services. Das Projekt wird von einer externen Projektleitung in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Geschäftsbereich IP der Stadtwerke Bielefeld geleitet. Im Laufe des Projektes ist grundsätzlich die Erreichung folgender Meilensteine vorgesehen: • Erarbeitung und Abstimmung einer IAM Governance-Struktur • Erarbeitung einer Rolle-Rechte Struktur für die SWB • Einführung einer technischen IAM-Lösung inkl. Durchführung eines Piloten • Sukzessiver Rollout der technischen IAM-Lösung auf die gesamte SWB Gegenstand der Ausschreibung ist die Bereitstellung externer Fachberatung zur Unterstützung des IAM Projektes der Stadtwerke Bielefeld. Die Beratungsleistung umfasst die Unterstützung der Umsetzungsphase des IAM-Projektes durch zwei Rollen. 1. IAM Managementberatung 2. IAM Prozessberatung Für jede Rolle ist jeweils eine Person vorgesehen. Die IAM-Managementberatung unterstützt den Geschäftsbereich IP bei organisatorischen und strategischen Fragestellungen im Zusammenhang mit der Einführung des IAM Services. Kernaufgaben der IAM-Managementberatung sind: • Unterstützung bei der organisatorischen Einordnung des IAM innerhalb der IT-Organisation • Weiterentwicklung von Governance Strukturen im IAM-Umfeld • Unterstützung bei der Definition und Besetzung von Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten • Bewertung organisatorischer Auswirkungen von IAM-Strukturen und Prozessen • Unterstützung bei der Einbindung des IAM in bestehende Sicherheits- und Governance Strukturen • Erarbeitung von Entscheidungsgrundlagen für Management und Projektsteuerung • Unterstützung bei der Abstimmung mit relevanten Stakeholdern • Unterstützung bei der Weiterentwicklung des organisatorischen Betriebsmodells für den IAM-Service • Beratung zur Abdeckung von relevanten regulatorischen Anforderungen • Entwickeln einer Einführungsstrategie zu Richtlinien, Prozessen und der Werkzeuglösung • Abstimmen von inhaltlichen Abhängigkeiten zu anderen Projekten und Linienvorhaben • Unterstützung bei der herstellerunabhängigen Auswahl einer IAM-Werkzeuglösung Die IAM-Prozessberatung unterstützt die fachliche Ausgestaltung der Prozesse zur Verwaltung digitaler Identitäten und Berechtigungen. Kernaufgaben der IAM-Prozessberatung sind: • Analyse bestehender Prozesse zur Verwaltung von Identitäten und Berechtigungen • Ausarbeitung von Prozessen für den Lebenszyklus digitaler Identitäten • Unterstützung bei der Gestaltung von Joiner Mover Leaver Prozessen • Entwicklung und Strukturierung eines Rollen und Berechtigungsmodells • Strukturierung von Prozessen zur Vergabe und Änderung von Zugriffsrechten • Unterstützung bei der Integration von Anwendungen in IAM-Prozesse • Ausgestaltung von Prozessen zur Rezertifizierung von Berechtigungen • Analyse bestehender Berechtigungsstrukturen in Anwendungen • Erstellung fachlicher Konzepte und Prozessdokumentationen im IAM-Umfeld • Unterstützung bei der Einführung der Prozesse und der Werkzeuglösung • Fachliche Unterstützung bei erforderlichen Beistellleistungen und Mitwirkungspflichten für die Implementierung der Werkzeuglösung • Ausarbeiten von Testfällen auf Basis der Prozessbeschreibungen und Anforderungen an die Werkzeuglösung Für die IAM-Managementberatung besteht eine Höchstmenge von 440 Personentagen bzw. 3.520 Stunden. Für die IAM-Prozessberatung besteht eine Höchstmenge von insgesamt 385 Personentagen bzw. 3.080 Stunden Eine hybride Leistungserbringung ist grundsätzlich zulässig. Ein verbindliches Verhältnis zwischen Remote- und Vor-Ort-Einsätzen kann aktuell nicht vorgegeben werden. Der Auftraggeber legt den projektbezogen erforderlichen Präsenzbedarf fest. Vor-Ort-Einsätze in Bielefeld können insbesondere für Projektauftakt, Workshops, Lenkungsausschüsse, Abstimmungen mit zentralen Stakeholdern sowie sonstige Termine mit Präsenzbedarf erforderlich werden. Der Auftragnehmer hat sicherzustellen, dass entsprechende Vor-Ort-Termine auch mit angemessen kurzer Vorlaufzeit wahrgenommen werden können. Der konkrete Umfang der Präsenzleistungen wird durch den Auftraggeber entsprechend den Erfordernissen des Projektverlaufs festgelegt Die Rahmenvereinbarung begründet keine Mindestabnahmeverpflichtung des Auftraggebers. Die in den Vergabeunterlagen angegebenen Mengen, Stundenansätze, Referenzmengen, Bedarfswerte und Höchstmengen dienen ausschließlich der Ermittlung des Auftragswertes, der Vergleichbarkeit der Angebote sowie der Zuschlagswertung.

result.text: Forestry and Land Scotland (FLS) have a requirement to procure Soil Surveys to meet our requirement to manage the National Forest Estate. Survey requirements under this Framework Agreement may include: - Standard Surveys including Site/Soil/Peat Depth Surveys of afforested, clear felled, open land and ex-agricultural land (please note a very large proportion will be either afforested or clear-fell); - Non-Standard Surveys including, but not limited to: * Bespoke type of soil survey e.g. peat depth probing; or * Assessment of newly acquired land including possibly reclaimed land such as old mine works. For each survey, you will be required to: - Record the site/soil patterns and associated specific data, using the FC soil classification; - Map Soil Polygons and associated linear and point data in a digital format; - Peat Depths to be recorded in the Peat Depth layer via supplied digital layer (currently via ESRI Fieldmaps). Access to which, plus any necessary training to use the app, will be provided by FLS. - Deliver all data outputs from the survey, as specific digital GIS format directly into Foresterweb (a bespoke version of GIS Forester), together with associated attribute; and - Producing written reports for each site. rejected.text: The Pathways to Enable Secure Open-Source Ecosystems (PESOSE) programme supports the translation of open-source science and engineering-focused research products into safe and sustainable ecosystems that address national and societal challenges. Open-source tools such as software, hardware, machine learning models, languages, and data platforms are designed to be shared as they are publicly-accessible and modifiable. These tools spark innovation in critical fields as varied as artificial intelligence (AI) and cloud computing, banking, healthcare, research, education, next-gen manufacturing, mobility, and National security (including cybersecurity). PESOSE supports the creation of managing organisations for these ecosystems, ensuring strong governance, distributed development, and broad user communities across academia, industry, and government. PESOSE also supports enhancements to the safety, security, and privacy of Open-Source Ecosystems (OSE) by addressing significant vulnerabilities, both technical and socio-technical, to improve the resistance of the ecosystem against threats. This solicitation seeks three types of proposals, allowing teams to propose specific activities to: 1) scope and plan the establishment of an OSE, 2) establish and expand a sustainable OSE based on a robust, promising open-source product that meets an emergent societal or national need, and 3) improve the safety, security, and privacy of an existing OSE and its products.

result.text: Above-threshold open electronic tender entitled "Procurement and installation of underground temporary waste storage systems for the pilot implementation of PAY AS YOU THROW (PAYT) programmes in the Municipality of Florina", with an estimated expenditure of 1.331.120,16€ including VAT of 24%, with sealed bids and with the award criterion being the most economically advantageous tender based on the best price-quality ratio Procurement and installation of fifty (50) "smart" underground waste collection bins (with a capacity of approximately 3m3 each), which will replace in volume approximately three (3) existing plastic bins. The bins shall be equipped with: 1) Access control and user identification system. 2) Weighing system for the discarded waste in each use.; In order for the Municipality to be able to monitor the conditions of use of the said underground bins and to develop an incentive policy towards users, it is necessary for the underground bins to be equipped with an access control and user registration system. The controlled access and disposal registration system must consist of: • User identification devices installed on the input "hoppers". • Security locks that restrict use only to certified users. • Deposit weighing system. • Controlled access via "smart" cards or mobile phones. • User management and event logging software.; The weighing system must be suitable for use in high humidity conditions and resistant to corrosive agents. The weighing system must be able to record the maximum possible and minimum possible weighing weight of individual discarded waste per user and the total temporarily stored waste. The weighing system must have the capability for automatic internal calibration and shall be accompanied by a calibration certificate at least for two indicative weights from a calibrated body/laboratory according to ISO 17025.; As part of this procurement, the contractor shall deliver to the Municipality a quantity of 2000 pcs. of RFID-type "smart" cards fully compatible with the offered controlled access system, which will be distributed to users/citizens. In their financial tender, tenderers must provide a separate unit price for the offered "smart" cards.; For their more efficient operation, the underground bins shall bear an attached fullness monitoring system, consisting of sensors to be placed at a suitable point, accompanied by a measurement transmission system application and software for data management, accessible via the internet (web based system).; Purchase of Software as a Service (SaaS) platform usage rights on a server of the Municipality. Monitoring of controlled access and fullness of underground bins with connection to a telemetry management platform. The required functionality shall be provided by the contractor for a period of twelve (12) months from the commissioning of the controlled access systems, in the form of Software as a Service (SaaS). Support, reporting and results compilation services are included for a period of (24) months.

parts.source: Ανοικτός ηλεκτρονικός διαγωνισμός άνω των ορίων με τίτλο «Προμήθεια και τοποθέτηση υπόγειων συστημάτων προσωρινής αποθήκευσης απορριμμάτων, για την πιλοτική εφαρμογή προγραμμάτων ΠΛΗΡΩΝΩ ΟΣΟ ΠΕΤΑΩ (ΠΟΠ), στο δήμο Φλώρινας», προεκτιμημένης δαπάνης 1.331.120,16€ συμπεριλαμβανομένου του ΦΠΑ 24%, με σφραγισμένες προσφορές και με κριτήριο κατακύρωσης την πλέον συμφέρουσα από οικονομική άποψη προσφορά με βάση τη βέλτιστη σχέση ποιότητας - τιμής Προμήθεια και εγκατάσταση πενήντα (50) «έξυπνων» υπογειοποιημένων κάδων συλλογής απορριμμάτων (χωρητικότητας περίπου 3m3 έκαστος), οι οποίοι θα αντικαταστήσουν σε όγκο περίπου τρείς (3) υφιστάμενους πλαστικούς κάδους Οι κάδοι θα είναι εξοπλισμένοι με: 1) Σύστημα ελέγχου πρόσβασης και αναγνώρισης χρήστη. 2) Σύστημα ζύγισης των απορριπτόμενων απορριμμάτων σε κάθε χρήση.; Προκειμένου ο Δήμος να μπορεί να επιτηρεί τις συνθήκες χρήσης των εν λόγω υπόγειων κάδων και να αναπτύξει μια πολιτική κινήτρων προς τους χρήστες, είναι απαραίτητο οι υπόγειοι κάδοι να εφοδιαστούν με σύστημα ελέγχου πρόσβασης και καταγραφής των χρηστών. Το σύστημα ελεγχόμενης πρόσβασης και καταγραφής απόρριψης θα πρέπει να αποτελείται από: • Διατάξεις ταυτοποίησης χρηστών εγκατεστημένες επί των “χοανών” εισαγωγής. • Κλειδαριές ασφαλείας που περιορίζουν τη χρήση μόνο σε πιστοποιημένους χρήστες. • Σύστημα ζύγισης των αποθέσεων. • Ελεγχόμενη πρόσβαση μέσω “έξυπνων” καρτών ή κινητών τηλεφώνων. • Λογισμικό διαχείρισης χρηστών και καταγραφής συμβάντων.; Το σύστημα ζύγισης θα πρέπει να είναι κατάλληλο για χρήση σε συνθήκες υψηλής υγρασίας και ανθεκτικό στους διαβρωτικούς παράγοντες. Το σύστημα ζύγισης θα πρέπει να μπορεί να καταγράψει το μέγιστο δυνατό και ελάχιστο δυνατό βάρος ζύγισης, των μεμονωμένων απορριπτόμενων απορριμμάτων ανά χρήστη και το σύνολο των προσωρινά αποθηκευμένων απορριμμάτων. Το σύστημα ζύγισης θα πρέπει να έχει τη δυνατότητα αυτόματου εσωτερικού καλιμπραρίσματος και θα συνοδεύεται από πιστοποιητικό διακρίβωσης σε τουλάχιστον δύο ενδεικτικά βάρη από διακριβωμένο φορέα/εργαστήριο κατά ISO 17025.; Στα πλαίσια της παρούσας προμήθειας ο ανάδοχος θα παραδώσει στον Δήμο μια ποσότητα 2000 τεμ. “έξυπνων” καρτών τύπου RFID πλήρως συμβατών με το προσφερόμενο σύστημα ελεγχόμενης πρόσβασης και οι οποίες θα διανεμηθούν στους χρήστες/δημότες. Στην οικονομική τους προσφορά, οι διαγωνιζόμενοι οφείλουν να δώσουν χωριστή τιμή μονάδος για τις προσφερόμενες “έξυπνες” κάρτες.; Για την αποτελεσματικότερη λειτουργία τους, οι υπόγειοι κάδοι θα φέρουν προσαρτημένο σύστημα επιτήρησης της πληρότητας τους, αποτελούμενο από αισθητήρες που θα τοποθετηθούν σε πρόσφορο σημείο, συνοδευόμενο από εφαρμογή συστήματος μετάδοσης μετρήσεων και λογισμικού (software) για την διαχείριση των δεδομένων, προσβάσιμο από το διαδίκτυο (web based system).; Αγορά Δικαιωμάτων παραχώρησης πλατφόρμας Υπηρεσίας Software as a Service (SaaS) σε server του Δήμου. Παρακολούθηση ελεγχόμενης πρόσβασης και πληρότητας υπόγειων κάδων με σύνδεση σε πλατφόρμα τηλεματικής διαχείρισης. result.text: This requirement is for the development of computer vision (AI) tools for pelagic fisheries CCTV. The project will consider the development of an automated image analysis system to isolate (and quantify) activities (and animals) associated with pelagic fisheries, with a focus on the capture of UCB species in CCTV-observed fishing events of a given subset of vessels subject to mandatory Remote Electronic Monitoring (REM). The project will focus initially on counts of UCB events, but the intention would be to gather biological data on the individual animals caught e.g. classification to the finest possible level and estimates of size. The results will be used by Scottish Government Marine Directorate (SGMD) Compliance (for regulation infringement detection) and SGMD Science for bycatch rate estimation, as part of wider observer programmes, and to inform future revisions to REM technical specifications. The ultimate goal of this development work is to design, implement and test a UCB detection and classification system, including the supply of relevant CCTV footage from vessels in Scottish Waters. Lot 1: . This system should be capable of being integrated into REM review software to automatically process and analyse video sequences from fishing trips to identify relevant events, count UCB events, and subsequently identify, count and measure all UCB individuals. It is important to point out that such a system should also be able to handle a realistic range of environmental noise such as variability of the location within the field of view, due to differing vessel layouts, in which events / animals have been detected, occlusions, pose variations, and lighting conditions. It is envisaged that this will be done in a probabilistic way, and that human intervention and further analysis will be suggested when the uncertainty exceeds a preset threshold (as there will be sections of footage in which identification will be very difficult due to occlusion). The system should be easily maintained and upgraded and will remain the property of the Scottish Government. This project will consider the development of interim stages towards fully automated image analysis tools for identifying and characterising atypical fishing activity events indicative of UCB species presence. In addition, the AI tools will subsequently determine the number (and, potentially, the size) of a subset of UCB observations via cameras as part of the mandated REM of eligible pelagic fishing vessels in Scottish waters. Attention would focus initially on the recorded numbers of UCB events as well as counts and size measurements for sea mammals (inc. cetaceans, seals), sharks / skates / rays, seabirds, and non-target bony fish. The results / products will be used by SGMD scientists to increase the efficiency of video review tasks, optimise the technical specifications of electronic monitoring systems for this fishery, estimate bycatch mortality rates, and identify fishing practices where mitigation measures may be required to protect vulnerable species. Specifically, this study will aim to: a) Develop a graphical user interface (GUI) to facilitate the viewing, sharing, collation, analysis and annotation of CCTV video footage from pelagic fishing vessels; b) Instruct and assist with the calibration of camera systems (if required) to ensure field-of-view and lens distortion correction in length measurements; c) Develop detection algorithms to detect, classify (to the most detailed taxonomic level feasible), and measure individuals of UCB species passing through the dewatering separator from representative video footage; d) Develop detection algorithms to determine when activity is taking place on-deck or in-water in relation to catch handling and apply facial recognition to anonymise the recorded footage; e) Develop detection algorithms to detect, classify (at the minimum level of mammals, elasmobranchs, non-target fish, and seabirds) and measure (inter alia) individuals of ETP species on deck or in-water from representative video footage. Suppliers should provide imagery from a minimum of 3 vessels. However, it is desirable that imagery is inclusive of both freezer vessels and refrigerated / chilled water vessels, vessels with differing deck layouts and catch handling configurations; and vessels from multiple flag states. Imagery provided to Scottish Government for annotation within the GUI must be anonymised regarding its metadata and have had facial recognition blurring methods applied. Suppliers must arrange to have access to suitable CCTV footage from Scottish Waters, either within their own data storage architecture (if they are an REM service provider) or via partnership with an REM service provider / pelagic fishing boats. It is anticipated that the project will be entirely computer lab-based, as all required video footage is being collected on an on-going basis as a matter of routine.

result.text: The Norwegian Public Roads Administration invites contractors and suppliers to a market meeting 20 October 2026 at 9:30 a.m. at the Quality Airport Hotel Stavanger. Register via KGV by 30.09.2026 with information on how many participants from the contractor/consultant, their position and contact information (Name, email). The aim of the project E39 Smiene – Harestad is to build a new four-lane road that connects the E39 Rogfast tunnels with the existing E39 at Smiene (north of the Eiganes tunnel) and thereby contribute to a continuous four-lane and high standard road from Sandnes to Bokn. E39 Smiene-Harestad, includes i.a.: • 4.7 km of open air four lane roads, • Connection to the Smiene junction • New two-level crossings o Tasta junction o Finnestad junction and o Harestad junction • Three bridges of 98 m, 90m and 24m respectively. • Foot and cycle path • 400m Environment culvert • and related technical installations. The E39 Smiene-Harestad shall open at the same time as the E39 Rogfast. The project, together with E39 Rogfast, will be able to connect Western Norway in a new way. Western Norway and Norway are in an increasingly tough national and international competition situation for people and resources. E39 Smiene-Harestad together with E39 Rogfast will open to greater synergy, freedom and expanded living and labour market area for the population. This can contribute to increased business growth in the area. The project notice is expected to be published in 2027. One-to-one meetings can be held for a period after the market meeting.

result.text: This competition replaces the previously announced competition 2026/2237, which was cancelled 14.08.2026. The system shall contribute to strengthening situational comprehension in Norwegian sea areas by using image forming sensors (optical and SAR – Synthetic Aperture Radar). This shall enable: verification of AIS data detection of vessels that do not send AIS (so-called "dark vessels") improved situation understanding and decision support in the operative contexts The coastal system has tested the use of non-cooperative sensor data from satellites in the summer and autumn 2025 through the company Vake AS's presentation and analysis system (vake.ai.). The testing of data in Vake is based on optical and SAR sensor data from Sentinel-1 and 2 satellites in the EU's Copernicus programme and on AIS data from the Norwegian Coastal Administration. Developments in this procurement cannot be included. Tenderers shall document that the offered system was established and operative at the tender deadline. The documentation shall, at a minimum, consist of: A technical description of the offered system, including main functionality, used data sources and central analysing functions. Screen images showing central functions in the system, including visualisation of satellite data, object detection and analysis functionality. Information on the date of production of the system to the customer. Description of the system's operative use for at least one customer or final user. Documentation that substantiates actual operative operations before the tender deadline expiry, e.g. customer confirmation, operational reports, uptime reports, user statistics or equivalent. The contract will be valid for one (1) year, with an option for an extension.

Zu den Kernaufgaben des Auftrags gehören insbesondere die Bereitstellung von Personal, eine Basisausstattung zur Wahrnehmung der Netzwerkkoordinierung und des Projektmanagements, Reisetätigkeiten sowie die interne und externe Kommunikation einschließlich der jährlichen Erstellung eines Medienkonzepts (Details im jeweiligen Arbeitspaket). result.text: The BMWE intends to tender a contract for the "FRAUEN unternehmen" (WOMEN in business) office. The office is to develop the content of the new priorities specified by the BMWE and develop new measures to sensitise girls and women to professional self-employment together with the "role model entrepreneurs" (VUs). In order to prevent or counteract social conditioning and to promote a cliché-free choice of career, the intention is to increasingly address general education schools in addition to vocational schools and universities. It is in the interest of the contracting authority (CA) to cooperate with other programmes/projects funded by the BMWE, such as the SCHULEWIRTSCHAFT-PREIS or the BMWE initiative group "Gründung in school" (Founding in school), and, where sensible and possible, to develop proposals for cooperation in order to exploit potential synergies. Furthermore, the "FRAUEN unternehmen" initiative is also a measure from the joint action plan "More female entrepreneurs for the SME sector". As part of the action plan, the office also participates actively as a member of the network. Through suitable measures, the topic of "female entrepreneurship" is to be placed more strongly in the public eye. To this end, a greater reach in social media is also to be achieved. Furthermore, a targeted expansion of the circle of active VUs is expected, in particular to include female entrepreneurs from the fields of skilled crafts, STEM, AI and digitalisation, from the East German federal states and rural areas, as well as those female entrepreneurs who have themselves taken over a business. The core tasks of the contract include, in particular, the provision of personnel, basic equipment for carrying out network coordination and project management, travel activities, and internal and external communication, including the annual preparation of a media concept (details in the respective work package). The following services are to be taken into account: - AP 1: Central contact point for VUs and all those interested in the initiative - AP 2: Matching of VUs with the target group - AP 3: Development and expansion of the external network/addressing multipliers and network partners - AP 4: External communication – strengthening the general visibility of the "FRAUEN unternehmen" initiative as well as the commitment of the VUs within the framework of the initiative - AP 5: Internal communication – strengthening the internal network of VUs and supporting the exchange of experience among VUs - AP 6: Monitoring, evaluation of the initiative and preparation of results - AP 7: Targeted expansion of the circle of VUs Lot LOT-0000: Office of the BMWE initiative "FRAUEN unternehmen".
