result.text: Provision of website hosting, maintenance and support services. Lot 1: . South of Scotland Enterprise (SOSE) are notifying the market of a potential market opportunity for a supplier to provide comprehensive hosting, maintenance, development and support services for its website, www.southofscotlandenterprise.com, currently on Umbraco version 13.10.1. with requirement to support any future upgrades to newer versions of Umbraco as required. The hosting must be delivered via Microsoft Azure infrastructure. The appointed supplier will also be required to support the multi-site set-up within the same instance of Umbraco CMS which includes the hosting, support and maintenance of the following additional websites: - www.southofscotlandrep.com - www.investinsouthofscotland.com Key requirements include: - Provision of unlimited bandwidth and storage for all hosted websites. - Commercially reasonable efforts to achieve a Monthly Uptime Percentage of at least 99.95% throughout the contract period. - Proactive monitoring and maintenance to ensure optimal uptime and performance. - Ability to connect to each hosting environment regularly to verify connectivity - Technical capability to support the existing integrations that are in place - Implementation and management of SSL certificates for the duration of the contract, covering both the website and the CMS. - Provision of an efficient online support system and email option for raising critical issues, including service availability. - Critical issues must be responded to promptly. - Must take Business continuity and security very seriously and have measures built in to ensure our applications run with as little disruption as possible. - All environments must be backed up and be able to be rebuilt at any time. - Must be Cyber Essentials Plus certified, or suitable equivalent e.g. ISO 27001. - Must be able to provide block hours of support and work closely with the team on ongoing improvement plan which includes ongoing accessibility reviews and testing. Interested parties are invited to express their interest in delivering these services. Expressions of interest should be submitted via Public Contracts Scotland. The Invitations to Tender are expected to be issued at the end of January 2026.

result.text: The Public Diplomacy Section (PDS) at U.S. Embassy Tunis invites results-oriented proposals for programs that foster economic opportunities for U.S. businesses and investors, innovation collaboration, showcase American leadership and excellence in science, technology, culture, the arts, sports, education, and English language, and strengthen ties between the United States and Tunisia in ways that make America safer, stronger, and more prosperous as we commemorate the 250 th anniversary of U.S. independence (2026) and 230 years of U.S.-Tunisian friendship (2027). All proposed programs must include an American element or a connection with American expert(s), organization(s), or institutions in ways that promote increased understanding of U.S. policies, perspectives, and society and/or celebrate U.S. culture and values. Proposals that include programming outside Greater Tunis or across multiple governorates and/or promote increased collaboration and networking among alumni of U.S. government programs are encouraged. Examples of possible PD small grant proposals include, but are not limited to: • Subject-matter expert, academic, and professional lectures, seminars, and speaker programs that include U.S. speakers/experts. • Programs that connect U.S. companies with Tunisian partners, suppliers, and market opportunities, facilitate business-to-business networking and investment matchmaking, prepare Tunisian startups and established businesses to meet U.S. market standards, enter U.S. markets, and partner with U.S. investors. • Sports diplomacy, culinary diplomacy, art exhibitions, film festivals, theater, musical theater, musical performances and master classes. • Cultural heritage conservation and preservation programs, including through use of new and immersive technologies, such as virtual reality (VR) or augmented reality (AR) technology. • U.S.-Tunisian University-industry partnerships, including with research or technology parks, that generate mutually beneficial commercialization projects or that create opportunities for U.S. companies in STEM fields and emerging technologies and innovation. • Hackathons, STEM or Maker Space camps/competitions, or other related hands-on activities that showcase American leadership and excellence in innovation and STEM fields, including but not limited to space exploration, technologies with beneficial applications to daily life developed as a result of NASA initiatives, or that foster target audiences’ artificial intelligence (AI) adoption and readiness. • University and cultural institution linkages programs that include but are not limited to development and implementation of a course, joint PhD advising, or joint degree program, or the design and teaching of a jointly-led course that includes virtual or in-person instruction from a U.S. professor/expert in fields outlined under Excellence in Education and English Teaching priority outlined in this APS. • English language programs, including but not limited to teacher training and programs that share innovative American English teaching methodologies, specialized English courses to improve business opportunities and innovation collaboration with U.S. companies, investors, U.S.-Tunisian university-industry partnerships, and foster economic self-reliance among target audiences. • Podcasts. • Professional and academic exchanges and programs. (Note: This funding cannot be used to support construction-related activities. End note.) Priority Program Areas and Strategic Themes: Proposals must focus on one of the five priority areas outlined below: ECONOMIC PROSPERITY AND ENTREPRENEURSHIP: Initiatives that expand U.S. commercial and investment opportunities; strengthen U.S. ties with Tunisia’s entrepreneurship ecosystem; promote U.S. entrepreneurial values and practices; and/or share best practices of successful U.S. business partnerships, startups, and investors with the aim of creating economic opportunities for U.S. and Tunisian businesses and investors. CELEBRATING AMERICA’S 250thANNIVERSARY AND U.S.-TUNISIAN ENDURING PARTNERSHIP: Initiatives, including innovative, small-scale programming and programming at our American Corners, that: 1) celebrate U.S. scientific breakthroughs, innovation, economic dynamism, sport prowess, agricultural strength, national parks, tourism, public service, freedom of speech or press, and other ideas and partnerships that shaped America’s development during the 250th anniversary year of U.S. Independence (2026) and in honor of the 230th anniversary year of the 1797 treaty of friendship between the U.S. and Tunisia (2027); 2) showcase and share American excellence in visual and performing arts, music, theater, film, and cultural heritage protection, including through artistic and cultural workshops, performances, exhibitions, or other activities, including community service initiatives that bring together Americans and Tunisians during the 250th anniversary year of U.S. Independence (2026) and the 230th anniversary year of the 1797 treaty of friendship between the U.S. and Tunisia (2027); 3) leverage people-to-people or institutional ties through sports or cultural diplomacy initiatives to increase the Tunisian public’s awareness and understanding of the history and benefits of the over two centuries of U.S.-Tunisian friendship, trade, and security cooperation. INNOVATION AND COLLABORATION IN SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY: Initiatives that encourage artificial intelligence (AI) adoption and readiness in Tunisia through use of U.S. AI platforms and technologies; raise awareness and promote collaboration on projects related to the 2027 solar eclipse; and expand U.S. ties to Tunisia’s innovation ecosystem through research collaboration and university-industry partnerships, including research and technology parks, to generate mutually beneficial commercialization projects that create opportunities for U.S.

result.text: We operate a network of around 300 automatic weather stations (AWS), mostly in the UK, but also a small number overseas. The weather observation data collected at these sites is collated on a logger at site and then communicated every minute to our central cloud based system in real time. Some sites have mains power, some operate on a 50W solar panel. The majority of sites have 4G connectivity, but there are a subset that only have 2G connectivity at present. We are looking for a supplier to provide a communications solution to allow for the real time transfer of our land surface observation data to our central cloud based collection system every minute in real time.

result.text: Revenue Scotland is seeking information from the market in relation to the next version of / replacement for its existing tax administration platform, SETS. The current platform supports the collection and operational management of devolved Scottish taxes. It enables taxpayers and their agents to submit tax returns and make payments to Revenue Scotland, and enables staff to process returns, manage taxpayer records through a number of statutory processes, reconcile inbound & outbound payments with tax declared, and undertake tax compliance activity and operational casework. Lot 1: . Revenue Scotland is seeking a strategic partner to help it deliver and support a cloud-hosted tax administration and case management platform for the collection and operational management of devolved taxes in Scotland. The system will manage tax data, support staff in administering tax returns and taxpayer records, and enable efficient case management of statutory tax management processes, workflow automation, and integration with external systems. Additionally, the solution needs to provide reporting capabilities in terms of management information and data export to our own analytics platform. We anticipate additional taxes and legislative change being introduced over the lifetime of the contract, and so the solution should be flexible enough to easily accommodate new functionality. Through this Prior Information Notice, Revenue Scotland wishes to consider the fullest range of modern, UK-based cloud-based solutions which support: - A portal for taxpayers and agents to view, edit and submit tax information - case management - workflow automation - operational processing - integration with other corporate systems such as our finance (general ledger) systems, contact management (telephony), and third-party print and post solutions. The next version of SETS will support at least five taxes and must provide a highly configurable and scalable platform capable of supporting evolving tax policy and operational requirements. Currently up to 80 back-office staff users across a range of different functional teams use the platform. Revenue Scotland welcomes engagement from suppliers with experience of delivering platforms capable of supporting complex administration and case management.. This contract may be split into lots, where market intelligence has suggested this to be viable and beneficial

result.text: Following an analysis of existing systems that revealed functional gaps related to reporting, early warning and funding tracking, the contracting authority has determined that the complexity of the Merheim campus project and the requirements of the funding providers necessitate an effective and transparent controlling and communication system. For this purpose, the contracting authority wishes to commission the implementation of an IT-supported system for construction and project controlling for the compliant and auditable management of all projects and sub-projects of the new health campus at the Merheim site, whereby transparency, traceability and early warning in particular must be ensured on all levels via system support. It must be ensured that the integration of existing systems and the connection of relevant interfaces take place smoothly. This includes the transfer and exchange of cost and financial data, the transmission of procurement information and contract award statuses, as well as the provision of structured, role-based access to relevant project data, plans and approvals for external service providers and suppliers. Furthermore, internal audit must be enabled through read-based access rights to ensure the traceability and documentation of internal audits.

parts.source: Nachdem eine Analyse der bestehenden Systeme funktionale Lücken im Zusammenhang mit Berichten, Frühwarnung und Fördermittel-Tracking aufgezeigt hat, hat der Auftraggeber festgestellt, dass die Komplexität des Campus-Projektes Merheim sowie die Anforderungen der Fördermittelgeber ein effektives und transparentes Controlling- und Kommunikationssystem erforderlich machen. Zu diesem Zweck möchte die Auftraggeberin die Implementierung eines IT-gestützten Systems für das Bau- und Projektcontrolling zur regelkonformen und prüfbaren Steuerung aller Projekte und Teilprojekte des neuen Gesundheitscampus am Standort Merheim beauftragen, wobei insbesondere Transparenz, Nachvollziehbarkeit und Frühwarnung systemgestützt auf allen Ebenen gewährleistet sein müssen. Dabei ist sicherzustellen, dass die Integration bestehender Systeme und die Anbindung relevanter Schnittstellen reibungslos erfolgt. Dies umfasst die Übergabe und den Austausch von Kosten- und Finanzdaten, die Übermittlung von Vergabeinformationen und Beauftragungs-ständen sowie die Bereitstellung eines strukturierten, rollenbasierten Zugriffs auf relevante Projektdaten, Pläne und Freigaben für externe Dienstleister und Lieferanten. Zudem muss die Innenrevision durch lesebasierte Zugriffsrechte in die Lage versetzt werden, die Nachvollziehbarkeit und Dokumentation interner Prüfungen sicherzustellen.

result.text: The subject of the tender is the conclusion of a discount framework agreement for the supply of hardware including support (maintenance) as well as accessories for the following HPE components for a maximum of three years (01.January 2027 - 31.December 2029). Furthermore, the maintenance of existing HPE systems for a maximum of four years (01.January 2027 - 31.December 2030), divided into the following lots: Lot 1: Blade/hyperconverged servers as well as special servers including maintenance (HPE Tech Care up to 5 years) Lot 2: Storage including maintenance (HPE Tech Care up to 5 years) Lot 3: SAN switches including maintenance (HPE Tech Care up to 5 years) Lot 4: HPE maintenance/support (HPE Tech Care until the end of the framework agreement) Lot LOT-0001: Blade/hyperconverged servers as well as special servers including maintenance (HPE Tech Care up to 5 years). The division into lots is necessary to separate the different trades for which, based on experience, widely differing discount rates are granted. result.text: The Council is inviting suppliers to participate in preliminary engagement to gain insight from the market with the purpose of making any potential future exercise, well framed, feasible, focused and of likely interest to the market. Durham County Council (DCC) is looking to explore the market options for Virtual Reality (VR) headsets suitable for use in a range of care settings. Scope • Provision of standalone virtual reality headsets suitable for use in a range of care settings, including all required accessories and chargers • The solution must provide immersive 360-degree experiences that can be delivered safely in seated, supervised one-to-one or small group sessions. • Content should support reminiscence, relaxation, wellbeing, social interaction and meaningful activity primarily for older people, including people living with dementia and other adult service user groups as appropriate. • The supplier should provide local content relevant to County Durham and the North East where available, with the option to develop or commission new experiences linked to local places, history, culture and service-user interests. • Content should be refreshed regularly so the service has access to new experiences over time and can maintain interest for repeat users. • The specification should support both individual personalised use and planned group activity sessions within a range of care settings. • The solution must be suitable for social staff to operate following training, with clear guidance on when VR may or may not be appropriate for an individual. Written response questionnaires ca Lot 1: .

result.text: The National Violent Death Reporting System (NVDRS) is CDC's state-based surveillance system for violent deaths and suicides. NVDRS combines information from death certificates, coroner or medical examiner reports, including toxicology reports, and law enforcement reports to provide comprehensive, incident-level data on the circumstances surrounding violent deaths. Through this Notice of Funding Opportunity, CDC will support eligible state, territorial, and local government entities, or their bona fide agents, in operating and modernizing NVDRS. Recipients will conduct statewide or territory-wide surveillance by collecting, linking, managing, analyzing, and submitting high-quality data on violent deaths and suicides. A central focus of this NOFO is timely and complete data reporting through two coordinated reporting processes: quarterly provisional data pulls and annual data closeout. Beginning in Year 1, recipients will prepare data for CDC's quarterly provisional data pulls to support earlier access to preliminary, actionable information. Recipients will progressively update case records as additional source documents and information become available. Annual data closeout is the primary process for producing the complete, finalized, and validated NVDRS dataset for each data year. Recipients must ensure that all eligible cases are fully abstracted, updated, validated, and completed using all required and available data sources by the annual closeout deadline. The finalized annual dataset supports national reporting, analysis, dissemination, and public health action. This NOFO also emphasizes modernization of data systems and workflows to increase efficiency, reduce reporting burden, improve data quality and timeliness, and enhance data usability. All recipients will complete a modernization readiness assessment within six months of award and implement at least one modernization pilot during the period of performance. Pilot activities may include automated data import and extraction, electronic data exchange and interoperability, workflow automation, data-quality tools, and enhanced data analysis and visualization. With CDC approval, recipients may also participate in optional activities that link NVDRS data with other relevant data systems to improve surveillance and expand public health insights. The intended outcome is a sustainable, modernized national surveillance system that produces timely provisional data and complete, reliable, high-quality annual data to inform violence and suicide prevention and support public health action.

result.text: The Trust is seeking a single strategic partner to deliver an integrated suite of corporate and professional services that enable school leaders to focus on educational outcomes while ensuring the Trust operates efficiently, safely, compliantly and sustainably. The successful supplier will provide integrated professional support services that are reliable, compliant, responsive and strategically aligned to the Trust’s objectives, through a single accountable management structure combining strategic advice, operational delivery, performance management, continuous improvement and innovation. The Services comprise the following ten service areas, described in full in the Specification: Financial Services- Operational and transactional financial management, management accounts, 5-year planning, VAT/ONS returns and audit liaison (Sage 200; circa 20,000 transactions per year). Payroll Services - Payroll processing and system for circa 200 staff (pay date 15th), RTI/HMRC, Teachers’ Pension and Local Government Pension Scheme administration. Human Resources Services - Operational HR, recruitment, employee relations, policy development, TUPE advice and the staff wellbeing offer. Staff Training & Development - Mandatory and wider training (safeguarding, cyber, H&S and more), CPD support and maintenance of Trust accreditations. Legal Services (incl. employment) - Operational and strategic legal support on contracts, employment and H&S matters, from suitably regulated advisers. Managed ICT Services- Secure, resilient network, servers, connectivity, filtering, cyber security, helpdesk, backup and device management across both schools and the nursery. Estates Management Services - Strategic and operational facilities and estates management, statutory compliance, estates/asset/carbon strategy and H&S support. Communications, Marketing & PR - Brand and reputation management, media and PR, website and social media, prospectus and admissions materials, internal communications. Governance Support Services - Company secretarial and governance support, clerking and minutes (Convene), statutory filings and governance advice. Managed Procurement Services - Procurement advice, tendering and quotations, contracts register, supplier management and Procurement Act 2023 compliance. The full Specification, including service-level agreements, key performance indicators and technical standards for each area, is available to download via the Delta eSourcing website. This procurement is being conducted under the Open Procedure pursuant to section 20(2)(a) of the Act — a single-stage procedure with no restriction on who may submit a tender and no separate shortlisting stage. All compliant tenders received by the deadline will be assessed against the Conditions of Participation, the exclusion grounds and the award criteria in this ITT, and the Contract will be awarded to the Most Advantageous Tender under section 19 of the Act. The deadline for the submission of tenders via the Delta eSourcing portal is 12noon 7 October 2026 For more information about this opportunity, please visit the eSourcing portal at: https://www.delta-esourcing.com/tenders/UK-UK-Manchester:-Financial-consultancy-services./X7SY8A5TKF To respond to this opportunity, please click here: https://www.delta-esourcing.com/respond/X7SY8A5TKF

result.text: As part of the re-tendering process for TenneT’s Content Collaboration Platform, Lot 2 encompasses a multi-vendor framework agreement focused on the integration, implementation, configuration, migration, and support of platform functionalities tailored to TenneT’s infrastructure project needs. The present tender focuses primarily on TenneT’s German operations. As beneficiaries under the SaaS Agreement, Dutch TenneT operations may optionally draw from the services that are subject hereof. With the re-tendering of the current Content Collaboration Platform, TenneT is aiming to continue achieving a single source of information for all documents generated in infrastructure projects and managing the supplier collaboration (external collaboration) regarding the exchange and management of documents and additional data. The targeted system is facilitating and capturing the complete project lifecycle in addition to providing auditable documentation and information throughout the organization. The tender procedure is divided into two lots, which will be tendered in sequence in two different tenders: Tender 1 [Lot 1] "CDE - Collaboration-Platform for Document and Data Exchange": includes the platform provisioning, development, deployment (Implementation), initial customization and configuration, platform interfaces as well as maintenance and support of the platform and – as a proof of concept and for purposes of a successful transition – the migration of TenneT metadata as well as existing construction projects from the current to the new platform. This tender has been completed. The awarded solution is provided by ThinkProject. Tender 2 [Lot 2]: "CDE – Multi-Contractor Integration": includes intergration and implementation services associated with the platform and comprises subsequent configuration, customization and consulting services in relation to the Content Collaboration Platform. The Lot 1 Provider must always collaborate pro-actively and in a constructive manner with any Lot 2 Contractor(s), e.g. providing access, support and knowledge transfer regarding the platform and implementing technically necessary changes within Lot 1 where mutually agreed with or commissioned by TenneT. Lot 2 will be tendered subsequent to the award of Lot 1. Performance Scope Lot 2 The Lot 2 providers selected during the selection phase must be qualified for the following service areas within the framework of the mini competitions and be able to obtain contracts in these areas: Business Support for CDE Initiatives and Projects The contractor shall provide advisory and operational support for departments and project teams in the context of CDE utilization, in particular: Advising on methodological and operational use of CDE platforms in project environments Supporting data migration processes (e.g., from legacy systems) Assisting with platform configuration and workflow optimization Developing and maintaining structured knowledge management tools (e.g., CDE user guides, training materials, FAQs) Facilitating workshops to gather and refine user requirements Design, Development, and Implementation of Non-Standard Changes This service domain includes support in extending the functional scope of the CDE platform beyond its standard features: Designing and specifying customized solutions (e.g., plug-ins, tailored workflows) Developing enhancements, interfaces, and automation features Supporting innovation initiatives, e.g., through prototyping of new digital tools Providing comprehensive technical and user documentation Performing quality assurance and testing of developed components Integration support for non-standard changes The contractor will provide technical and conceptual support for integrating enhancements into the existing CDE ecosystem: Designing and executing system integration concepts (e.g., CDE ↔ third-party systems) Developing and maintaining interfaces (e.g., REST, SOAP, file-based) Conducting system, integration, and regression testing Monitoring and issue resolution during and after go-live Preparing technical operations documentation (e.g., monitoring and handover guides) Project execution The contractor shall support the delivery of CDE-related (sub-)projects, including: result.text: A national programme is being established to encourage increased levels of physical activity and sustained participation in movement across England. The programme comprises a number of complementary workstreams, including marketing and communications, partnerships and engagement, rewards and recognition, educational content, and a digital component intended to support participation, engagement and long-term habit formation. The contracting authority is considering the future procurement of a supplier to design, build, operate and support the digital elements of the programme. A digital discovery exercise is currently underway and will provide an evidence-based recommendation for the future digital service, including user needs, service design, delivery approach and implementation roadmap. Whilst the final solution has not yet been determined, the discovery is expected to narrow the scope significantly and provide sufficient detail to support rapid delivery. The digital service may comprise a digital product, web-based service, social and community capability, AI-enabled engagement service, integration with existing consumer platforms, or a combination of these approaches. The successful supplier will be expected to take the outputs of the discovery phase through detailed design, build, deployment and live operation. The appointed supplier will work alongside other specialist partners responsible for marketing, communications, partnerships, rewards and wider programme delivery. The role of the digital supplier will be to translate programme objectives into effective digital services and experiences rather than duplicate functions delivered elsewhere within the programme. The programme is operating to ambitious timescales, with an initial digital capability expected to be launched before the end of 2026 and subsequently enhanced through live operation. The authority is therefore interested in engaging with suppliers who can demonstrate experience of delivering, operating and evolving user-centred digital services at pace. Additional information: HI NENC would like to invite potential providers of Digital services to apply to our Dynamic Purchasing System (DPS) DN670401 as a supplier. If your company is not registered with the Proactis (ProContract) Due North Portal, click on this link Supplier registration (due-north.com) and complete your organisation name and email address and continue your registration. If you are already registered on the portal, log in as normal. In the "search" box in upper right-hand corner, type in DN670401 (this is the HI NENC DPS reference number). This opportunity will be developed as a further competition under Lot 5 of our DPS. You should therefore ensure you apply to Lot 5 to be able to bid to provide this service. You are also welcome to apply for any other Lots on our DPS that you feel are relevant to your organisation. Should we decide to proceed to procurement, we are expecting to publish the Invitation to Quote to our Lot 5 suppliers towards the end of July 2026. This timeline is subject to change. Interested suppliers are advised to apply to the DPS promptly to ensure they have been accepted to the framework and receive the competition notification. This notice is for information and engaging with the supply market only. It is not a binding statement of intent or call for competition. HI NENC reserves the right not to enter a formal procurement process and not award a contract. The information contained in this notice, including information relating to the nature and scope of the requirements, the service classification of this requirement from the list of CPV codes, is only indicative of the HI NENC's current thinking and is neither exhaustive nor binding. HI NENC reserves the right at its absolute discretion to amend it at the time of issue of any further notices or at any other time. HI NENC will not be liable for any bid cost, expenditure, work or effort incurred by a potential supplier in acting on the basis of this PIN

result.text: The Home Office seeks to engage suppliers for the provision of healthcare services at short-term holding facilities and ports of entry across the UK. These services will support individuals whilst detained for short periods of time including in, but not limited to, short-term holding facilities as defined under the Short-Term Holding Facilities Rules 2018 (as amended), where individuals can be held up to 24 hours. The Authority is seeking a flexible, responsive and value for money healthcare solution that meets the basic needs of individuals and can be flexible to different service environments; the short-term holding facilities are located at different location types across the UK which include Airports, Seaports, and Reporting Centres. Remote Healthcare Services: This market engagement aims to understand supplier capabilities and appetite, to further refine the Authority’s specification and gather feedback on the proposed approach of remote healthcare services. This includes gaining further understanding of both the provision of Clinicians to undertake remote consultations and the provision of IT infrastructure required to deliver a remote only healthcare service. The content of this Notice, including the nature of services and the start date of the contract, is subject to change. The contract is expected to commence in early 2028. The length of contract has not been confirmed yet. For the purposes of this Preliminary Market Engagement Notice, the estimated contract value has been listed as £0. This figure does not reflect the expected final value of the contract. The actual estimated value is currently being finalised and will be shared later.

result.text: UPDATED NOTICE - PLEASE READ: April 6, 2023 EDA is excited to announce the launch of its new grants management platform: the Economic Development Grants Experience (EDGE). EDGE was developed to streamline the application and grants management process by implementing a single platform with increased transparency, improved user experience, higher data quality, and more efficiency throughout the entire grant lifecycle. As of April 6th, 2023, applications can no longer be submitted on Grants.gov, and will ONLY be accepted through EDGE. To apply in EDGE, please go to: sfgrants.eda.gov . More information on how to apply is provided in the full NOFO. PARTNERSHIP PLANNING program instructions: Please note that applicants will be invited to submit applications through EDGE for the Partnership Planning program. For more information, please reach out to your EDA point of contact. Program Description: EDA makes planning and local technical assistance investments to support economic development, foster job creation, and attract private investment in economically distressed areas of the United States. Under the Planning program, EDA makes Partnership Planning, Short-Term Planning, and State Planning awards to eligible recipients to create and implement regional economic development plans designed to build capacity and guide the economic prosperity and resiliency of an area or region. More specifically, EDA makes Partnership Planning investments to designated planning organizations (i.e., District Organizations) serving EDA-designated Economic Development Districts and to Indian Tribes to facilitate the development, implementation, revision, or replacement of Comprehensive Economic Development Strategies (CEDS), which articulate and prioritize the strategic economic goals of recipients’ respective regions. EDA also makes Short-Term and State Planning awards for economic development planning activities that guide the eventual creation and retention of high-quality jobs, particularly for the unemployed and underemployed in the Nation’s most economically distressed regions. Under the Local Technical Assistance program, EDA makes awards to strengthen the capacity of local or State organizations, institutions of higher education, and other eligible entities to undertake and promote effective economic development programs through projects such as feasibility studies, impact analyses, disaster resiliency plans, and project planning. **Please note: While the published Notice of Funding Opportunity (available under "Related Documents") states that the ED900A form and the SF424B form are both required for a complete application, these forms are no longer required and have therefore been removed from the package template.

rejected.text: The Public Affairs Section (PAS) at U.S. Embassy Tunis invites creative and engaging proposals for programmes that strengthen ties between the United States and Tunisia, highlight shared values, and promote bilateral cooperation in ways that make America safer, stronger, and more prosperous. Please see Section C. Programme Description for more information. This Annual Programme Statement (APS) outlines our funding priorities and the strategic themes we will focus on in FY2025, and the procedures for submitting requests for funding. Based on availability of funding, PAS Tunis will award grants, fixed amount awards, or cooperative agreements between a minimum of $10,000 and up to a maximum of $200,000 (U.S. dollars) each for projects that advance the priorities outlined in this APS. Please carefully follow all instructions in the full announcement. Proposals that fail to conform to the requirements outlined in this APS will not be considered. All proposed programmes must include an American element or a connection with American expert(s), organisation(s), or institutions in ways that promote increased understanding of U.S. policies, perspectives, and society and/or celebrate U.S. culture and values. Proposals that include programming outside Greater Tunis or across multiple governorates and/or promote increased collaboration and networking among alumni of U.S. government programmes are encouraged. PAS Tunis invites creative and engaging proposals for programmes that strengthen cultural, educational, professional, scientific, and business ties between the United States and Tunisia through programming that highlights shared values, strengthens people-to-people ties and institutional linkages, and promotes bilateral cooperation, and makes America safer, stronger, and more prosperous. Competitive proposals must focus on at least one grant priority area outlined below. Examples of possible PD small grant proposals include, but are not limited to: · Subject-matter expert, academic, and professional lectures, seminars, and speaker programmes that include U.S. speakers/experts. · Programmes that strengthen relationships and linkages between U.S. and Tunisian higher education and cultural institutions. · Educational, artistic, and cultural programmes, including programmes that strengthen English language teaching and learning, music, musical theatre, dance workshops, master classes, and performances, live theatre performances, art exhibitions, and sports and culinary diplomacy initiatives that increase mutual understanding between the people of the United States and Tunisia. · Programmes, including podcasts, that promote economic empowerment, entrepreneurship, or that share U.S. experiences related to addressing community challenges, including the management of water or energy resources, waste management, urban design and planning, and preparing for and mitigating natural or human-caused disasters. · Cultural heritage conservation and preservation programming, including through the use new and immersive technologies, such as VR technology. (Note: This funding cannot be used to support construction-related activities. End note.) Priority Programme Areas and Strategic Themes: Proposals must address at least one of the six priority areas outlined below: · Economic Prosperity and Entrepreneurship: Initiatives that prioritise mutual prosperity, expand economic and commercial links between the United States and Tunisia, promote U.S. entrepreneurial values and practices, and that share best practices of successful U.S. business partnerships, startups, and investors with the aim of increasing economic opportunities for U.S. and Tunisian businesses and investors. · INNOVATION and Collaboration in science and technology: Initiatives that promote collaboration and academic partnerships in STEM fields (science, technology, engineering, and mathematics), including cybersecurity, space, energy, water security, food security, smart agriculture, health technology, and artificial intelligence (AI) between U.S. and Tunisian academic and research institutions, non-governmental organisations, and private companies, as well as programmes that promote interest in STEM education among young people. · EDUCATIONAL LINKAGES AND ENGLISH LANGUAGE : Initiatives that expand collaboration and partnerships between U.S. and Tunisian higher education and research institutions through programmes and professional and academic exchanges; programmes to strengthen English language instruction in Tunisian universities and colleges; programmes to expand the teaching of English in sign language and braille; and other programmes that support and promote English language learning among Tunisian youth. · LEADERSHIP: Initiatives that provide leadership training inspired by U.S. experiences, models, and best practices to Tunisian young people (high school and university students and young professionals) to help them become effective leaders in their communities and professional field of choice. Such training may include English language, public speaking and interpersonal communication, emotional intelligence, critical thinking and problem solving, financial literacy, goal-setting, and mental health management strategies. · MEGA DECADE OF SPORTS: Programmes that leverage the “Mega-Decade in Sports” in North America (2023-2034) when the United States will host the 2025 FIFA World Club Cup, the 2026 FIFA Men’s World Cup, the 2028 Summer Olympics and Paralympics in Los Angeles, and the 2034 Winter Olympics and Paralympics in Salt Lake City, in ways that strengthen people-to-people ties between the United States and Tunisia, promote American values and demonstrate American excellence and leadership in sports and tourism. · Celebrating American Excellence AND U.S.-Tunisian Enduring Partnership: Programmes that 1) celebrate U.S. scientific or sport prowess, innovation, economic dynamism, agricultural strength, and national parks and tourism during the 250th anniversary year of U.S.

Lot LOT-0000: Analysis and modelling of energy system scenarios for Germany. The contract is intended to provide a well-founded basis for energy policy decisions. To this end, on the one hand, an analysis is to be made of which developments in relevant climate neutrality scenarios present a particular challenge, taking into account the resources required for this (e.g. financial resources, skilled labour, land, raw materials, technical components). On the other hand, trend scenarios are to be modelled which project the development of the energy system along achievable paths into the future.

parts.source: Der Auftrag soll eine fundierte Basis für energiepolitische Entscheidungen liefern. Hierfür soll zum einen analysiert werden, welche Entwicklungen in einschlägigen Klimaneutralitätsszenarien unter Beachtung der hierfür erforderlichen Ressourcen (z.B. Finanzmittel, Fachkräfte, Flächen, Rohstoffe, technische Komponenten) eine besondere Herausforderung darstellen. Zum anderen sollen Trendszenarien modelliert werden, welche die Entwicklung des Energiesystems entlang erreichbarer Pfade in die Zukunft fortschreiben. result.text: The tender aims to achieve and promote the stable and future-proof operation of the "Schleupen.CS" ERP system on a highly available and secure infrastructure for use by the client's employees and external service providers, including migration, SaaS operation, interfaces, administration, and support. The SWH is tendering for the provision of a highly available cloud infrastructure in the contractor's data centre. The service consists not only of providing data centre capacity but, due to the intended role as a solution provider, encompasses holistic responsibility for the stable and future-proof operation of Schleupen.CS. The services to be provided include, in particular: - the provision of the necessary hardware and data centre infrastructure, - the provision of software necessary for the operation of the systems (including current versions of Microsoft Windows Server, Microsoft SQL Server, Remote Desktop Services, and Citrix if applicable for the publication of remote apps, as approved by Schleupen SE), - the takeover or migration of the existing system (including the sub-systems necessary for operation) into the data centre environment, - the takeover of existing interfaces to third-party service providers (mandatory requirements: SMGWA, ticket system, customer portal), - the operation of the Schleupen.CS system (including sub-systems) in the data centre: production and test systems with the existing tenants, - the sufficiently performant - at least with symmetrical 200 Mbit/s - internet connection of the client to the contractor's data centre. Connection must be established via an encrypted VPN tunnel or by providing the service provider's own hardware, which is integrated into the contractor's internal network, - the takeover of support services within the scope of data centre operations, - the takeover of support services for the Schleupen.CS system, in particular holistic, independent communication with Schleupen SE in the event of application and problem cases, - the provision and maintenance of current hardware and software (operating system software, database software, application software), which are operated with active maintenance contracts / software assurance, - the monitoring of systems and applications, - immediate error detection, communication to the client in the event of an error, and error rectification, - the maintenance of highly available system operation (24 h/ 7 days a week) throughout the entire contract term. It is mandatory that strict, logical isolation from the contractor's other customers is maintained. The precise details regarding the subject matter of the contract can be found in the specifications (Annex B of the procedural letter).

parts.source: Mit der Ausschreibung soll der stabile und zukunftsfähige Betrieb des ERP-Systems "Schleupen.CS" auf einer hochverfügbaren und sicheren Infrastruktur für die Nutzung durch die Mitarbeitenden und externen Dienstleister des Auftraggebers einschließlich Migration, SaaS-Betrieb, Schnittstellen, Administration und Support erreicht und gefördert werden. Die SWH schreibt die Bereitstellung einer hochverfügbaren Cloud-Infrastruktur im Rechenzentrum des Auftragnehmers aus. Die Leistung besteht nicht nur aus der Bereitstellung der Rechenzentrumsleistung, sondern umfasst, aufgrund der beabsichtigten Stellung als Lösungsanbieter, die ganzheitliche Verantwortung für den stabilen und zukunftssicheren Betrieb von Schleupen.CS. Zu den dabei zu erbringenden Leistungen gehören insbesondere: - die Bereitstellung der notwendigen Hardware und Rechenzentrumsinfrastruktur, - die Bereitstellung von zum Betrieb der Systeme notwendiger Software (u.a. aktuelle und von der Schleupen SE freigegebene Versionen von Microsoft Windows Server, Microsoft SQL Server, Remote Desktop Services, ggfs. Citrix zur Veröffentlichung von Remote-Apps), - die Übernahme bzw. Migration des bestehenden Systems (inkl. der für den Betrieb notwendigen Sub-Systeme) in den Rechenzentrumsbetrieb, - die Übernahme der bestehenden Schnittstellen zu Drittdienstleistern (zwingend erforderlich SMGWA, Ticketsystem, Kundenportal), - der Betrieb des Schleupen.CS-Systems (inklusive der Sub-Systeme) im Rechenzentrum: Produktiv- und Testsysteme mit den bestehenden Mandanten, - die ausreichend performante - mindestens mit symmetrisch 200 Mbit/s - Internet-Anbindung des Auftraggebers an das Rechenzentrum des Auftragnehmers. Es muss mittels eines verschlüsselten VPN-Tunnels oder durch Bereitstellung von eigener Hardware des Dienstleister, welche in das interne Netzwerk des Auftragnehmers eingebunden wird, eine Anbindung erfolgen, - die Übernahme von Support-Dienstleistungen im Rahmen des Rechenzentrumsbetriebs, - die Übernahme von Support-Dienstleistungen für das Schleupen.CS-System, insbesondere die ganzheitliche, selbstständige Kommunikation mit der Schleupen SE bei Anwendungs- und Problemfällen, - die Bereitstellung und -haltung von aktueller Hardware und Software (Betriebssystemsoftware, Datenbanksoftware, Anwendersoftware), welche mit aktiven Wartungsverträgen / Software-Assurance betrieben werden, - das Monitoring der Systeme und Anwendungen, - die unverzügliche Fehlererkennung, Kommunikation im Fehlerfall an den Auftraggeber, sowie die Fehlerbehebung, - die Aufrechterhaltung eines hochverfügbaren Systembetriebs (24 h/ 7 Tage in der Woche) während der gesamten Vertragslaufzeit. Dabei ist zwingend erforderlich, dass eine strikte, logische Isolation zu anderen Kunden des Auftragnehmers gegeben ist. Die genauen Angaben zum Auftragsgegenstand können dem Leistungsverzeichnis (Anlage B des Verfahrensbriefes) entnommen werden.

rejected.text: La Regione Piemonte, nell’ambito del Fascicolo Sanitario Elettronico (FSE), gestisce le immagini radiologiche tramite sistemi PACS locali e regionali, ma l’attuale architettura è frammentata e poco omogenea tra le diverse Aziende Sanitarie. Questa situazione genera inefficienze, difficoltà di aggiornamento e accesso non ottimale alle immagini, soprattutto in contesti clinici dove la tempestività è cruciale. Inoltre, le funzionalità di visualizzazione sono limitate e non pienamente integrate con i servizi digitali regionali e la telemedicina. Per rispondere alle nuove esigenze di interoperabilità, continuità assistenziale e telemedicina, è necessario evolvere verso una piattaforma federata, scalabile e centrata sull’utente, in grado di garantire accesso immediato, sicuro e integrato alle immagini radiologiche. Con la presente indagine il CSI-Piemonte intende quindi verificare la presenza sul mercato di soluzioni che rispondano ai requisiti tecnico-funzionali e organizzativi sopracitati.

result.text: The Piedmont Region, within the scope of the Electronic Health Record (EHR), manages radiological images through local and regional PACS systems, but the current architecture is fragmented and poorly standardised across the various Healthcare Authorities. This situation generates inefficiencies, difficulties with updates and suboptimal access to images, especially in clinical contexts where timeliness is crucial. Furthermore, viewing functionalities are limited and not fully integrated with regional digital services and telemedicine. To respond to the new requirements of interoperability, continuity of care and telemedicine, it is necessary to evolve towards a federated, scalable and user-centred platform capable of guaranteeing immediate, secure and integrated access to radiological images. With this market sounding, CSI-Piemonte therefore intends to verify the presence on the market of solutions that meet the aforementioned technical-functional and organisational requirements.

rejected.text: DSB wishes to become better informed about SAP RISE, therefore an invitation is extended to a market dialogue regarding this. Background: DSB currently uses an SAP S/4HANA solution, which supports a large number of administrative business processes in the company. S/4HANA runs on-premises via an infrastructure and operations agreement with fa. TCS. This agreement expires in the summer of 2028, which is why DSB must conduct an EU tender, presumably in 2027. Against this background, DSB is considering whether the tender should include either: - Infrastructure and operations services regarding SAP S/4HANA based on on-premises or, - migration of DSB’s SAP S/4HANA solution to a SaaS solution in private cloud – which is currently marketed under the name SAP RISE. Therefore, DSB wishes, via market dialogue, to gain insight into what suppliers in the market offer related to SAP RISE. DSB expects the individual supplier to provide a total overview of deliveries and commercial terms. DSB wishes, among other things, for answers to: 1) Description of the current market. 2) Description of the supplier's footprint in the market. Generally and regarding SAP RISE. 3) Contract set-up including interfaces to fa. SAP SE. 4) Listing of services linked to the service: 4.1) Which services are delivered as standard? 4.2) Which services can be purchased additionally? 4.3) How are these services designed with regard to SLAs? 5) Description of collaboration model. 6) How and according to what structure does the settlement of ongoing operations take place? 7) Description of model for transition and settlement of this. Preferably with TCO assessments. 8) Description of hardware used, data centres and geography. 9) Description of IT security model and IT security management. DSB expects to conduct conversations with a selection of suppliers in December 2025 and January 2026. The purpose of the conversations is to gather information about which solutions and services are offered in the market. DSB plans to conduct market dialogue meetings with a maximum of six suppliers. If more than six suppliers come forward, DSB will make a representative selection among the received expressions of interest.

parts.source: DSB ønsker at bliver klogere på SAP RISE, derfor inviteres der til markedsdialog herom. Baggrund: DSB anvender i dag en SAP S/4HANA-løsning, som supporterer et stort antal administrative forretningsprocesser i virksomheden. S/4HANA kører on-premises via en infrastruktur- og driftsaftale med fa. TCS. Denne aftale udløber sommeren 2028, hvorfor DSB skal gennemføre et EU-udbud formentlig i 2027. På denne baggrund overvejer DSB, om udbuddet skal omfatte enten: - Infrastruktur- og drift-services vedrørende SAP S/4HANA baseret på on-premises eller, - migrering af DSB’s SAP S/4HANA-løsning til SaaS-løsning i private cloud – som p.t. markedsføres under navnet SAP RISE. Derfor ønsker DSB via markedsdialog at få indsigt i, hvad leverandørerne i markedet tilbyder relateret til SAP RISE. DSB forventer, at den enkelte leverandør giver et samlet overblik over leverancer og kommercielle vilkår. DSB ønsker bl.a. svar på: 1) Beskrivelse af det aktuelle marked. 2) Beskrivelse af leverandørens footprint i markedet. Generelt og vedrørende SAP RISE. 3) Kontraktset-up inklusive grænseflader til fa. SAP SE. 4) Oplistning af services knyttet til ydelsen: 4.1) Hvilke services leveres som standard? 4.2) Hvilke services kan tilkøbes? 4.3) Hvordan er disse services designet m.h.t. SLAer? 5) Beskrivelse af samarbejdsmodel. 6) Hvordan og efter hvilken struktur finder afregning af den løbende drift sted? 7) Beskrivelse af model for transition og afregning af denne. Gerne med TCO-vurderinger. 8) Beskrivelse af anvendte hardware, datacentre og geografi. 9) Beskrivelse af IT-sikkerhedsmodel og IT-sikkerhedsstyring. DSB forventer at gennemføre samtaler med et udvalg af leverandører i december 2025 og januar 2026. Formålet med samtalerne er at samle information om hvilke løsninger og services, som der tilbydes i markedet. DSB planlægger med at gennemføre markedsdialogmøder med maksimalt seks leverandører. Hvis flere end de seks leverandører melder sig, vil DSB foretage et repræsentativt udvalg blandt de modtagne tilkendegivelser.

result.text: The objective is an economical and future-oriented provision based on current tariff models and technologies (incl. use of 5G). The assignment of the individual mobile phone connections (sub-contracts of the framework agreement) takes place in two different usage profiles for data communication and a telephony flat rate & SMS flat rate for the country group 1. The subject matter of the service to be provided is the provision and activation of 2.230 (as of 01.04.2026) mobile phone connections (the number may deviate downwards or upwards depending on the requirements of the contracting authority) in various tariffs and with various options. The provision of subsidised or unsubsidised mobile phones as well as other hardware is not the subject matter of the service to be provided. The subject matter of the service to be provided is: - Provision and activation of 2.230 (as of 01.04.2026) mobile phone connections (the number may deviate downwards or upwards depending on the requirements of the contracting authority) in various tariffs and with various options, - Provision and dispatch of the necessary SIM cards with up to four cards per mobile phone connection to the contracting authority in the course of a rollout, - Pre-configuration of the SIM cards (hardware) and the individual connections (network-side), - e-SIM integration in accordance with the available hardware with up to four eSIMs per mobile phone connection (service portal etc.), - Dispatch of information material to the employees of the contracting authority, - Porting of the contracting authority's existing mobile phone numbers from the previous provider to the contractor, - Activation of further mobile phone connections with new phone numbers as required by the contracting authority, - Provision of a business app for the users of the mobile phone connections, - Provision of a service portal for administration for individual users of the contracting authority, - Provision of an evaluation and analysis tool by means of which the contracting authority can run evaluations on the consumption volume (minute consumption or data volume) at any time for freely selectable periods and in any level of detail, - Carrying out a one-day user training session for the service portal for a maximum of eight participants, - Free-of-charge invoicing with itemised bills in electronic form and, if desired by the client, in paper form, - Free-of-charge business customer hotline for all users (7/24), - Provision of a contact person (key account service manager) and a user help desk for individual employees of the contracting authority, as well as - other services in the course of general customer service. The contracting authority may terminate up to 10 percent of the mobile phone connections per contract year without giving reasons on a date determined by it. In the event of major restructuring measures, up to 25 percent of the mobile phone connections may be terminated by the contracting authority. However, a minimum number of 1.500 mobile phone connections remaining activated until the end of the framework agreement is guaranteed by the contracting authority.

result.text: This procurement process is being advertised and run by First Greater Western limited on its own behalf and on behalf of the successor operator of the rail passenger transport services in respect of Great Western Railway (GWR). That successor operator will be a public sector company, is expected to be a wholly owned subsidiary of DfT OLR Holdings Limited and will be ultimately owned by the Secretary of State for Transport. The date for transfer of the current operations to the successor operator is not yet confirmed. Where the transfer is completed before contract award under this procurement process, the successor operator may elect (but will not be obliged) to carry on with this procurement process in place of GWR, by taking on the role of contracting entity from the date of completion of the transfer (with this notice and all other procurement documents to be interpreted accordingly). Where the transfer is not yet completed by the time of contract award, contractual rights may be included in the contractual arrangements to enable transfer to the successor operator. Bidders should note that this procurement process (if ongoing), or any awarded contract, may be included in a transfer scheme made by the Secretary of State under section 12 of the Railways Act 2005, or the transfer may be effected outside of, or separate from, such a scheme. If transfer takes place before the contract award the successor operator shall assume all the rights of the Client set out in this document. result.text: The subject of the procurement is a work ability management system as a SaaS service. The procurement includes the delivery of the system, planning and implementation of the deployment, execution of necessary integrations, and ongoing maintenance and support services. In addition, the contracting authority has the option to procure separately agreed minor development during the contract period. The supplier is responsible for ensuring that the system can be deployed in a controlled manner and that it is integrated into the contracting authority's key back-end systems, such as HR and identity management systems. The migration of legacy data can be carried out as expert work as a separately ordered option in accordance with the hourly rate for expert work stated in the price appendix. The contracting authority shall decide on the implementation of the option at its own discretion during the contract period, and the contracting authority is under no obligation to implement the option or order related services. The system must support the contracting authority's work ability management operating models and processes, in particular early support practices, management of sickness absences, identification and prevention of work ability risks, and support for return to work. The objective of the solution is to improve the timeliness of work ability measures, increase operational transparency, and strengthen data-driven management at all levels of the organisation. The system must provide an up-to-date overall picture of the work ability situation at the employee, unit, and organisational level. It must form a clear, user-friendly, and intuitive whole regarding work ability management processes and offer views and access rights according to user roles. User groups include at least line managers, HR work ability specialists, management, and system administrators. Line managers must be able to utilise the system in their daily work ability management work, while for management, the system must offer summary views, reporting, and analytics to support strategic decision-making. The system must enable versatile reporting for different time periods and organisational levels and offer visual views, such as trends, comparisons, and key performance indicators to support decision-making. The supplier must carry out the deployment in cooperation with the contracting authority so that the solution meets the contracting authority's functional needs and the deployment supports a smooth transition to production use. The objective of the procurement is to improve the effectiveness of work ability management, reduce costs caused by sickness absences, strengthen proactive management, and support the staff's work ability, performance at work, and continuation in work. The system must be a modern, secure, scalable, and easy-to-use solution that supports the long-term development of the contracting authority's operations.

parts.source: Hankinnan kohteena on työkykyjohtamisen järjestelmä SaaS-palveluna. Hankintaan sisältyvät järjestelmän toimitus, käyttöönoton suunnittelu ja toteutus, tarvittavien integraatioiden toteuttaminen sekä jatkuvat ylläpito- ja tukipalvelut. Lisäksi tilaajalla on mahdollisuus hankkia erikseen sovittavaa pienkehitystä sopimuskauden aikana. Toimittaja vastaa siitä, että järjestelmä voidaan ottaa käyttöön hallitusti ja että se integroidaan tilaajan keskeisiin taustajärjestelmiin, kuten henkilöstö- ja identiteetinhallintajärjestelmiin. Vanhojen tietojen siirto voidaan toteuttaa asiantuntijatyönä hintaliitteessä ilmoitetun asiantuntijatyön tuntihinnan mukaisesti erikseen tilattavana optiona. Tilaaja päättää option käyttöönotosta oman harkintansa mukaan sopimuskauden aikana, eikä tilaajalla ole velvollisuutta ottaa optiota käyttöön tai tilata siihen liittyviä palveluita. Järjestelmän tulee tukea tilaajan työkykyjohtamisen toimintamalleja ja prosesseja, erityisesti varhaisen tuen käytäntöjä, sairauspoissaolojen hallintaa, työkykyriskien tunnistamista ja ennaltaehkäisyä sekä työhön paluun tukemista. Ratkaisun tavoitteena on parantaa työkykytoimenpiteiden oikea-aikaisuutta, lisätä toiminnan läpinäkyvyyttä sekä vahvistaa tiedolla johtamista organisaation kaikilla tasoilla. Järjestelmän tulee tarjota ajantasainen kokonaiskuva työkykytilanteesta työntekijä-, yksikkö- ja organisaatiotasolla. Sen on muodostettava selkeä, käyttäjäystävällinen ja intuitiivinen kokonaisuus työkykyjohtamisen prosesseista sekä tarjottava käyttäjäroolien mukaiset näkymät ja käyttöoikeudet. Käyttäjäryhmiä ovat vähintään esihenkilöt, HR:n työkykyasiantuntijat, johto sekä järjestelmän pääkäyttäjät. Esihenkilöiden tulee voida hyödyntää järjestelmää päivittäisessä työkykyjohtamisen työssä, kun taas johdolle järjestelmän tulee tarjota koontinäkymiä, raportointia ja analytiikkaa strategisen päätöksenteon tueksi. Järjestelmän tulee mahdollistaa monipuolinen raportointi eri aikajaksoille ja organisaatiotasoille sekä tarjota visuaalisia näkymiä, kuten kehityssuuntia, vertailuja ja tunnuslukuja päätöksenteon tueksi. Toimittajan tulee toteuttaa käyttöönotto yhteistyössä tilaajan kanssa siten, että ratkaisu vastaa tilaajan toiminnallisia tarpeita ja käyttöönotto tukee sujuvaa siirtymistä tuotantokäyttöön. Hankinnan tavoitteena on parantaa työkykyjohtamisen vaikuttavuutta, vähentää sairauspoissaoloista aiheutuvia kustannuksia, vahvistaa ennakoivaa johtamista sekä tukea henkilöstön työkykyä, työssä suoriutumista ja työssä jatkamista. Järjestelmän tulee olla moderni, tietoturvallinen, skaalautuva ja helppokäyttöinen ratkaisu, joka tukee tilaajan toiminnan pitkäjänteistä kehittämistä.

rejected.text: Complex generic drug products represent an increasing share of the generic marketplace and may have distinct user interface differences compared to reference listed drug (RLD) products. A modernised post-market surveillance approach is needed to compare clinical outcomes between complex generic products and their corresponding RLD products to monitor for potential issues with therapeutic equivalence and to inform regulatory decision making. Real-world data (RWD) combined with machine learning (ML) and/or artificial intelligence (AI) could help to identify post-market signals efficiently in an automated and repeatable fashion, facilitating timely regulatory action. The purpose of this funding opportunity is to develop and test an AI- or ML-based algorithmic RWD model for post-market surveillance of complex generic drug products.

result.text: With this notice, Istekki announces the organisation of market dialogues for a service voucher and purchased service system. The purpose of the dialogue is to ensure that those preparing the procurement have access to as comprehensive and up-to-date a picture of the market and available solutions as possible. The subject of the procurement is the service voucher and purchased service system entity and its interfaces with other systems, the delivery project (including e.g. migrations, conversions), maintenance and support of off-the-shelf software, support services, separately ordered expert services, as well as customer service. Further development may be carried out on the procured system during the contract period. The service voucher and purchased service system is used for granting service vouchers and payment commitments and for purchasing services from private service providers or other public actors. Through the system, it is necessary to centralise the creation and use of service vouchers and purchased service orders (payment commitment) and the settlement of accounts for rendered services to private service providers or other public actors. The service voucher and purchased service system must take into account needs from the perspectives of the service organiser, the service producer and the customer using the service. Through the system, the service organiser must have the option to manage service provider agreements, plan service provision, grant service vouchers and payment commitments, allocate payments, handle correction requests and monitor various report views. The service provider must have the option to apply to become a service provider through the system. In addition, the service provider must be able to record the service received by the customer in the system and thereby handle settlement based on approved transaction entries. The customer must receive the granted service voucher / payment commitment for use via the system. The service voucher customer must have the option to compare or view service providers, monitor the execution of the service from the system and provide feedback on the service. The contracting authority will organise the market dialogues either as remote meetings or in writing, or utilising both methods. The market dialogues will be held in Finnish. Istekki will notify the companies participating in the dialogue of more detailed schedules and instructions later. Please note that the information, descriptions and estimates of the publication date of the tendering procedure presented in this notice are merely preliminary and indicative. Final schedules will become more precise as preparation progresses. If you are interested in participating in the market dialogue, please notify us of your interest no later than 11.09.2026 at 14.00 to hankinnat@istekki.fi. If you wish, you can also attach Finnish-language brochures or other material regarding your own service. It is worth noting that this notice does not oblige Istekki Oy to carry out the procurement in the manner presented in this document or its appendices. A potential tendering procedure may also be omitted. No separate remuneration is paid for responding to the dialogue or participating in any presentation events. We would like to mention again that this is not a contract notice or call for tenders. The purpose is to familiarise oneself with the market situation and gather information related to the subject of the procurement to support the planning of the upcoming tendering procedure. Responding to the request for information is voluntary and is not a prerequisite for participating in a potential tendering procedure or bind Istekki to publish a tendering procedure. At the same time, however, we greatly appreciate suppliers' participation, as it helps us build the upcoming tendering procedure into as functional and clear an entity as possible.

parts.source: Tällä ilmoituksella Istekki ilmoittaa palveluseteli- ja ostopalvelujärjestelmän markkinavuoropuheluiden järjestämisestä. Vuoropuhelun tarkoituksena on varmistaa, että kilpailutuksen valmistelijoilla on käytössään mahdollisimman kattava ja ajantasainen kuva markkinoista ja tarjolla olevista ratkaisuista. Hankinnan kohteena on palveluseteli- ja ostopalvelujärjestelmäkokonaisuus ja sen liittymät muihin järjestelmiin, toimitusprojekti (sisältäen mm. migraatiot, konversiot), valmisohjelmistojen ylläpito ja tuki, tukipalvelu, erikseen tilattavat asiantuntijapalvelut sekä asiakaspalvelu. Hankittavaan järjestelmään voidaan tehdä jatkokehitystä sopimuskauden aikana. Palveluseteli- ja ostopalvelujärjestelmää käytetään palveluseteleiden ja maksusitoumusten myöntämiseen ja palvelujen ostamiseen yksityisiltä palveluntuottajilta tai muilta julkisilta toimijoilta. Järjestelmän kautta on tarpeen saada keskitettyä palvelusetelien ja ostopalvelutilausten (maksusitoumus) luominen, käyttäminen ja annetuista palveluista tilitysten tekeminen yksityisille palveluntuottajille tai muille julkisille toimijoille. Palveluseteli- ja ostopalvelujärjestelmässä tulee huomioida tarpeet sekä palvelun järjestäjän, - tuottajan että palvelua käyttävän asiakkaan näkökulmista. Palvelun järjestäjällä tulee olla järjestelmän kautta mahdollisuus palveluntuottajasopimusten hallintaan, palveluntarjonnan suunnitteluun, palvelusetelien ja maksusitoumuksien myöntämiseen, maksujen tiliöintiin, korjauspyyntöihin ja erilaisten raporttinäkymien seuraamiseen. Palveluntuottajalla tulee olla mahdollisuus hakeutua palveluntuottajaksi järjestelmän kautta. Lisäksi palveluntuottajan tulee pystyä kirjaamaan järjestelmään asiakkaan saama palvelu ja sitä kautta tilitys hyväksyttyjen tapahtumakirjausten perusteella. Asiakkaan tulee saada myönnetty palveluseteli / maksusitoumus käyttöönsä järjestelmän kautta. Palveluseteliasiakkaalla tulee olla mahdollisuus verrata tai tarkastella palveluntuottajia, seurata järjestelmästä palvelun toteutumista ja antaa palautetta palvelusta. Hankintayksikkö järjestää markkinavuoropuhelut joko etätapaamisina tai kirjallisesti tai molempia keinoja hyödyntäen. Markkinavuoropuhelut järjestetään suomen kielellä. Istekki ilmoittaa vuoropuheluun osallistuville yrityksille tarkemmat aikataulut sekä ohjeet myöhemmin. Huomioithan, että tässä ilmoituksessa esitetyt tiedot, kuvaukset ja arviot kilpailutuksen julkaisuajankohdasta ovat vasta alustavia ja suuntaa antavia. Lopulliset aikataulut tarkentuvat valmistelun edetessä. Mikäli olette kiinnostuneita osallistumaan markkinavuoropuheluun, pyydämme ilmoittamaan kiinnostuksenne viimeistään 11.09.2026 klo 14.00 osoitteeseen hankinnat@istekki.fi. Halutessanne voitte liittää mukaan myös suomenkielisiä esitteitä tai muuta materiaalia omasta palvelustanne. On hyvä huomioida, että tämä ilmoitus ei velvoita Istekki Oy:tä toteuttamaan hankintaa tässä asiakirjassa tai sen liitteissä esitetyllä tavalla. Mahdollinen tarjouskilpailu voidaan myös jättää järjestämättä. Vuoropuheluun vastaamisesta tai mahdollisiin esittelytilaisuuksiin osallistumisesta ei makseta erillistä korvausta. Haluamme vielä mainita, että kyseessä ei ole hankintailmoitus tai tarjouspyyntö. Tarkoituksena on tutustua markkinatilanteeseen ja kerätä hankinnan kohteeseen liittyvää tietoa tulevan kilpailutuksen suunnittelun tueksi. Tietopyyntöön vastaaminen on vapaaehtoista, eikä se ole edellytys mahdolliseen tarjouskilpailuun osallistumiselle tai sido Istekkiä julkaisemaan tarjouskilpailua. Samalla kuitenkin arvostamme suuresti toimittajien osallistumista, sillä se auttaa meitä rakentamaan tulevasta kilpailutuksesta mahdollisimman toimivan ja selkeän kokonaisuuden.

result.text: Transparency notice within the meaning of § 135 para. 3 of the Act against Restraints of Competition (GWB) Measure: Acquisition of the software OK.Verkehr for vehicle registration and operation in the data centre for vehicle registration and driving licences Information on review periods: Regarding the deadlines for filing legal remedies, reference is made to § 160 para. 3 of the Act against Restraints of Competition (GWB). § 160 GWB reads as follows: (1) The Public Procurement Chamber shall initiate a review procedure only upon application. (2) Any undertaking that has an interest in the public contract or concession and claims an infringement of its rights under § 97 para. 6 due to non-compliance with procurement regulations is entitled to file an application. In doing so, it must be demonstrated that the undertaking has suffered or is threatened with damage as a result of the alleged infringement of procurement regulations. (3) The application is inadmissible if: 1) the applicant has recognised the alleged infringement of procurement regulations before submitting the application for review and has not complained about it to the contracting authority within a period of 10 calendar days; the expiry of the period according to § 134 paragraph 2 remains unaffected, 2) infringements of procurement regulations that are recognisable from the notice are not complained about to the contracting authority by the expiry of the deadline for application or submission of tenders specified in the notice, 3) infringements of procurement regulations that only become recognisable in the procurement documents are not complained about to the contracting authority by the expiry of the deadline for application or submission of tenders, 4) more than 15 calendar days have passed since receipt of the notification from the contracting authority that it does not intend to remedy a complaint. Sentence 1 does not apply to an application for a declaration of the ineffectiveness of the contract pursuant to § 135 para. 1 no. 2. § 134 para. 1 sentence 2 remains unaffected. The contract can only be executed by a specific economic operator, as here, pursuant to § 14 para. 4 no. 2b of the Public Procurement Ordinance (VgV), only one company can be considered for the contract for technical reasons.

parts.source: Transparenzbekanntmachung im Sinne des § 135 Abs. 3 GWB Maßnahme: Anschaffung der Software OK. Verkehr für die Fahrzeugzulassung und Betrieb im Rechenzentrum für Fahrzeugzulassung und Fahrerlaubnis Informationen über die Überprüfungsfristen: Hinsichtlich der Fristen zur Einlegung von Rechtsbehelfen wird auf § 160 Abs. 3 des Gesetzes gegen Wettbewerbsbeschränkungen (GWB) verwiesen. § 160 GWB lautet wie folgt: (1) Die Vergabekammer leitet ein Nachprüfungsverfahren nur auf Antrag ein. (2) Antragsbefugt ist jedes Unternehmen, das ein Interesse an dem öffentlichen Auftrag oder der Konzession hat und eine Verletzung in seinen Rechten nach § 97 Abs. 6 durch Nichtbeachtung von Vergabevorschriften geltend macht. Dabei ist darzulegen, dass dem Unternehmen durch die behauptete Verletzung der Vergabevorschriften einSchaden entstanden ist oder zu entstehen droht. (3) Der Antrag ist unzulässig, soweit: 1) der Antragsteller den geltend gemachten Verstoß gegen Vergabevorschriften vor Einreichen des Nachprüfungsantrags erkannt und gegenüber dem Auftraggeber nicht innerhalb einer Frist von 10 Kalendertagen gerügt hat; der Ablauf der Frist nach § 134 Absatz 2 bleibt unberührt, 2) Verstöße gegen Vergabevorschriften, die aufgrund der Bekanntmachung erkennbar sind, nicht spätestens bis zum Ablauf der in der Bekanntmachung benannten Frist zur Bewerbung oder Angebotsabgabe gegenüber dem Auftraggeber gerügt werden, 3)Verstöße gegen Vergabevorschriften, die erst in den Vergabeunterlagen erkennbar sind, nicht spätestens bis zum Ablauf der Frist zur Bewerbung oder zur Angebotsabgabe gegenüber dem Auftraggeber gerügt werden, 4) mehr als 15 Kalendertage nach Eingang der Mitteilung des Auftraggebers, einer Rüge nicht abhelfen zu wollen, vergangen sind. Satz 1 gilt nicht bei einem Antrag auf Feststellung der Unwirksamkeit des Vertrages nach § 135 Abs. 1 Nr. 2. §134 Abs. 1 Satz 2 bleibt unberührt. Der Auftrag kann nur von einem bestimmten Wirtschaftsteilnehmer ausgeführt werden, da hier gem. §14 Abs. 4 Nr. 2b VgV aus technischen Gründen nur ein Unternehmen für den Auftrag in Betracht kommt.

The purpose of the project is to deliver fit for purpose premises that are modern, accessible, have sufficient space for current and future provision, utilise digital and AI technology, are well located to deliver care closer to home, meet the health and care needs of local people including unmet need I.E residential EMI provision and supports service delivery both building based and within the local community Currently Dolwen has the following issues that need to be addressed - Small rooms which limit the service providers to meet the needs of the residents, for example there are rooms which can accommodate hoists however not throughout the facility.
