result.text: Digital Payments & Associated Data Services Summary This framework will give the public sector access to various innovative digital payment and data services. These services include merchant acquiring and gateway services. They also include Bacs, Direct Debit, open banking payments, and account information services. RM6411 is let under the Procurement Act 2023. Description RM6411 Digital Payments & Associated Data Services will replace RM6325 Payment Acceptance 2 . It will provide the public sector with a compliant and cost-effective way to access: transactional payment services advanced financial data services This enables the movement of funds in and out of government. Let under the Procurement Act 2023, this agreement aims to: drive payments and financial data innovation simplify and speed up access to financial solutions and data provide a compliant route to market that offers good value for money open up financial data to provide actionable intelligence. The framework will cover a range of digital payments and associated data services. It focuses on these key areas: digital payment management: handling both incoming and outgoing digital payments high-volume transaction capabilities: facilitating the execution of large-scale, bulk payments enhanced security and data insights: using financial data to: provide operational transparency minimise processing errors reduce fraud Benefits: range of payment methods: buyers can choose familiar options like credit/debit cards and direct debits lower transaction costs : open banking infrastructure allows buyers to bypass some card network fees accelerated fund settlement: improving cash flow through near-real-time fund availability paperless financial data verification: instantly verify a citizen’s income or expenditure advanced identity fraud prevention: using secure, real-time bank account ownership verification frictionless user experience: users can authorise payments using their own banking apps Product types: The agreement plans to deliver a wide range of financial capabilities, including: card processing: enabling the acceptance of credit and debit card payments through: online portals phone systems physical terminals bacs & direct debit payments: access to established “bulk” payment rails, including: direct debit for recurring collections faster payments for near-instant transfers CHAPS (clearing house automated payment system) for high-value, same-day transactions open banking payments: allows citizens to pay using their own banking app open banking data services: provide authorised access to a user’s real-time financial data Customer engagement Engagement sessions started in April 2026. They will continue to run until November 2026. If you would like to speak to us about the proposed agreement, please email: digitalpayments@gcagov.uk . Supplier engagement We held supplier engagement sessions in March, April, May and July 2026. If you wish to join future sessions, contact digitalpayments@gca.gov.uk . Include “RM6411 Digital Payments & Associated Data Services Supplier Engagement” in the subject line. If you missed the sessions, you can download the presentations: RM6411 Pre-market engagement slides: kick off webinar RM6411 Industry market engagement update: framework design RM6411 Market engagement clarification log v1.0 Important links Pipeline notice Read pipeline notice Preliminary market engagement notice Read preliminary market engagement notice Planned procurement notice Not available yet Contract notice in Find a Tender (FTS) Not available yet Tender documents Not available yet Timeline Activity Estimated dates Pre-market engagement March 2026 Drafting of procurement documentation TBC Publication of find a tender (FTS) notice March 2027 Framework award December 2027 Print this page

result.text: This is a request for information, which is not a procurement notice or a call for tenders. The purpose of the request for information is to collect information regarding the object of the procurement for a future competitive tendering process. Responding to the request for information is not a prerequisite for participating in any potential subsequent competitive tendering process. To ensure the success of the future competitive tendering process, however, it would be important for tenderers to provide the contracting authority with the requested information as extensively as possible. The request for information does not oblige Istekki Oy to carry out the procurement in the manner described in the request for information or its appendices, and the competitive tendering process may also be left unimplemented. This request for information is used to clarify the supply on the market for Atlassian systems, including the market situation, products, contract terms and supplier pricing for Atlassian environment licences and expert services, as well as additional services related to the systems. No compensation will be paid to those who have responded to the request for information for responding to the request for information or for participating in a potential market dialogue. result.text: WISTA stands for Wissenschafts- und Wirtschaftsstandort Adlershof and is a state-of-the-art technology park in the Adlershof district of Berlin (Treptow-Köpenick borough). It is considered one of the most advanced high-tech parks in Europe and is a central hub for science, business, and start-ups. WISTA Adlershof is a location with an area of approx. 4,2 km2, approx. 1.300 companies, research institutions, and university institutes with 28.000 employees. The WISTA Management GmbH acts as a site developer, service provider, and economic promoter. It supports companies, research institutions, and start-ups at the site and fosters innovation and growth in the region. In addition to its real estate portfolio, WISTA possesses its own campus network, which consists of a high-performance cable network as well as a 5G infrastructure. The network has been continuously expanded and technologically developed since 1998 – from classic telephony and data services to Gigabit and 10G connections, cloud and UCC integration, campus-wide Wi-Fi and IoT applications, through to local 5G and current network 4.0 topics. It thus forms an essential digital infrastructure of the campus and is the subject of the expression of interest procedure. The attractiveness of the campus network stems from its established telecommunications infrastructure at a dynamically growing high-tech location. The network has an existing customer base, established line routes and network nodes, as well as redundant carrier connections. Additional development prospects arise from the continuous expansion of the campus through new buildings, the expansion potential for cloud, security, and UCC services, as well as the addition of a local 5G campus network. The campus network thus offers a resilient infrastructural foundation with further economic and technological growth potential. The reasons for the sale by WISTA are a strategic further development of the campus network by a specialised provider with qualified personnel and the necessary expertise. Subject of sale: Passive infrastructure (fibre optic, copper, conduits, manholes, cable distribution cabinets, building connections) Active infrastructure (switches, routers, servers, telecommunications system) Customer contracts (insofar as transferable, consent/transfers still to be checked) Frequency allocation 5G (not alienable, subsequent use/transfer still to be checked from a regulatory perspective, application for own allocation required) Land/line rights (insofar as transferable, easements/permissions still to be checked) Software/licences (insofar as transferable, licence terms still to be checked) Cable network: The WISTA campus network at the science and business location Adlershof forms the central communication infrastructure for voice and data services in the core area of the technology park. It currently serves around 400 customers as well as approx. 4.400 participants in the voice sector and is therefore an essential location factor for Germany's largest science and technology park. The existing infrastructure includes a high-performance cable duct system, a line network based on copper and fibre optics with a total length of almost 20 kilometres, as well as a Gigabit Ethernet backbone. Technically, fibre optic backbone connections, single-mode and multi-mode fibre optic cables, copper cables, copper cross-cables, and FM cables with 100 double cores are used in particular. At the active network and services level, the campus network includes transmission and switching equipment for voice and data communication, routing/switching components, data core and access areas, network gateways to wide area networks, as well as a communication network consisting of communication systems from the manufacturer Unify. The users' existing voice and data infrastructure is connected to the network; some users are connected via LAN ports under 100 Mbit/s or VDSL, while other users have connections from 100 Mbit/s. The WAN connection is designed to be redundant with at least two external carriers and has two redundant gateways with 100 Gbit/s. The campus network is particularly interesting as an established, operator-capable infrastructure with an existing customer base, available line routes, documented network gateways, and development potential. The future operator is to operate, maintain, further develop, and actively market the network to users on their own responsibility. In addition to the existing copper, fibre optic, and fibre infrastructure, the existing customers, the available telecommunications and data network components, the expansion potential at the growing Adlershof location, and the possibility of introducing new cloud, security, VoIP, and UCC services are of value. 5G network: The WISTA 5G campus network is designed as a local private 5G campus network at the science and business location Adlershof. It serves as a supplement to the existing cable infrastructure and is to be gradually expanded at outdoor and indoor locations. Initial expansion has been carried out in the area of Albert-Einstein-Straße 16 (central outdoor location) as well as in the showroom/a:head context (indoor location). The regulatory basis for the 5G infrastructure is a local frequency allocation by the Federal Network Agency for the frequency range 3.700–3.800 MHz. The allocation holder is WISTA Management GmbH. The allocated bandwidth is 100 MHz; the frequency allocation is limited until 20.02.2030. The allocation area covers an area of approx. 0,873273 km2. Technologically, the 5G infrastructure is based on a Nokia DAC/NDAC Medium+ environment with 5G standalone architecture, Edge Core, NDAC manager, Nokia AirScale components, HPE Edge servers, router and switching components, and SIM kit. WISTA Management GmbH intends to sell its cable network and 5G campus network at the science and business location Adlershof.

parts.source: WISTA steht für Wissenschafts- und Wirtschaftsstandort Adlershof und ist ein hochmoderner Technologiepark im Berliner Ortsteil Adlershof (Bezirk Treptow-Köpenick). Er gilt als einer der fortschrittlichsten Hochtechnologieparks Europas und ist ein zentraler Ort für Wissenschaft, Wirtschaft und Gründungen. WISTA Adlershof als Standort mit ca. 4,2 km2 Fläche, ca. 1.300 Unternehmen, Forschungseinrichtungen und Hochschulinstituten mit 28.000 Mitarbeitenden, Die WISTA Management GmbH agiert als Standortentwickler, Dienstleister und Wirtschaftsförderer. Sie unterstützt Unternehmen, Forschungseinrichtungen und Start-ups am Standort und fördert Innovation und Wachstum in der Region. Neben ihrem Immobilienbestand verfügt WISTA über ein eigenes Campusnetz, das aus einem leistungsfähigen Kabelnetz sowie einer 5G-Infrastruktur besteht. Das Netz wurde seit 1998 kontinuierlich ausgebaut und technologisch weiterentwickelt – von klassischen Telefonie- und Datendiensten über Gigabit- und 10G-Anbindungen, Cloud- und UCC-Integration, campusweites WLAN und IoT-Anwendungen bis hin zu lokalem 5G und aktuellen Netzwerk-4.0-Themen. Es bildet damit eine wesentliche digitale Infrastruktur des Campus und ist Gegenstand des Interessenbekundungsverfahrens. Die Attraktivität des Campusnetzes ergibt sich aus seiner etablierten Telekommunikationsinfrastruktur an einem dynamisch wachsenden Hochtechnologiestandort. Das Netz verfügt über eine bestehende Kundenbasis, gewachsene Leitungswege und Netzknoten sowie redundante Carrier-Anbindungen. Zusätzliche Entwicklungsperspektiven ergeben sich aus der fortlaufenden Erweiterung des Campus durch neue Gebäude, dem Ausbaupotenzial für Cloud-, Security- und UCC-Dienste sowie der Ergänzung durch ein lokales 5G-Campusnetz. Damit bietet das Campusnetz eine belastbare infrastrukturelle Grundlage mit weiterem wirtschaftlichem und technologischem Wachstumspotenzial. Die Beweggründe für den Verkauf durch die WISTA sind eine strategische Weiterentwicklung des Campusnetzes durch einen spezialisierten Provider, mit qualifiziertem Personal und dem notwendigen Knowhow. Verkaufsgegenstand: Passive Infrastruktur (LWL, Kupfer, Rohre, Schächte, Kabelverzweiger, Hausanschlüsse) Aktive Infrastruktur (Switche, Router, Server, TK-System) Kundenverträge (soweit übertragbar, Zustimmung/ Überleitungen müssen noch geprüft werden) Frequenzzuteilung 5G (nicht veräußerbar, Nachnutzung/ Übertragung noch regulatorisch zu prüfen, Beantragung eigener Zuteilung erforderlich) Grundstücks-/Leitungsrechte (soweit übertragbar, Dienstbarkeiten/Gestattungen noch zu prüfen) Software/Lizenzen (soweit übertragbar, Lizenzbedingungen noch zu prüfen) Kabelnetz: Das WISTA-Campusnetz am Wissenschafts- und Wirtschaftsstandort Adlershof bildet die zentrale Kommunikationsinfrastruktur für Sprach- und Datendienste im Kerngebiet des Technologieparks. Es versorgt derzeit rund 400 Kunden sowie ca. 4.400 Teilnehmer im Voice-Bereich und ist damit ein wesentlicher Standortfaktor für Deutschlands größten Wissenschafts- und Technologiepark. Die vorhandene Infrastruktur umfasst eine leistungsfähige Kabelkanalanlage, ein Leitungsnetz auf Kupfer- und Glasfaserbasis, mit einer Gesamtlänge von knapp 20 Kilometern, sowie ein Gigabit-Ethernet-Backbone. Technisch genutzt werden insbesondere LWL-Backbone-Verbindungen, Monomode- und Multimode-Glasfaserkabel, Kupferkabel, Kupfer-Querkabel sowie FM-Kabel mit 100 Doppeladern. Auf der aktiven Netz- und Dienste Ebene umfasst das Campusnetz Übertragungs- und Vermittlungseinrichtungen für Sprach- und Datenkommunikation, Routing-/Switching-Komponenten, Datencore- und Accessbereiche, Netzübergänge in Weitverkehrsnetze sowie einen Kommunikationsverbund aus Kommunikationssystemen des Herstellers Unify. Die vorhandene Sprach- und Dateninfrastruktur der Nutzer ist an das Netz angeschlossen; ein Teil der Nutzer ist über LAN-Anschlüsse unter 100 Mbit/s bzw. VDSL angebunden, weitere Nutzer verfügen über Anschlüsse ab 100 Mbit/s. Die WAN-Anbindung ist redundant mit mindestens zwei externen Carriern ausgelegt und verfügt über zwei redundante Übergänge mit 100 Gbit/s. Das Campusnetz ist insbesondere als etablierte, betreiberfähige Infrastruktur mit bestehender Kundenbasis, vorhandenen Leitungswegen, dokumentierten Netzübergängen und Entwicklungspotenzial interessant. Der künftige Betreiber soll das Netz eigenverantwortlich betreiben, instand halten, fortentwickeln und gegenüber den Nutzern aktiv vermarkten. Wertrelevant sind neben der bestehenden Kupfer-, LWL- und Glasfaserinfrastruktur insbesondere die Bestandskunden, die vorhandenen TK- und Datennetzkomponenten, die Ausbaupotenziale am wachsenden Standort Adlershof sowie die Möglichkeit zur Einführung neuer Cloud-, Security-, VoIP- und UCC-Dienste. 5G-Netz: Das WISTA 5G-Campusnetz ist als lokales privates 5G-Campusnetz am Wissenschafts- und Wirtschaftsstandort Adlershof konzipiert. Es dient als Ergänzung der bestehenden Kabelinfrastruktur und soll sukzessive an Outdoor- und Indoor-Standorten ausgebaut werden. Ein initialer Ausbau ist im Bereich Albert-Einstein-Straße 16 (zentraler Outdoor-Standort) sowie im Showroom/a:head-Kontext (Indoor-Standort) vorgenommen worden. Regulatorische Grundlage der 5G-Infrastruktur ist eine lokale Frequenzzuteilung der Bundesnetzagentur für den Frequenzbereich 3.700–3.800 MHz. Zuteilungsinhaberin ist die WISTA Management GmbH. Die zugeteilte Bandbreite beträgt 100 MHz; die Frequenzzuteilung ist bis zum 20.02.2030 befristet. Das Zuteilungsgebiet umfasst eine Fläche von ca. 0,873273 km2. Technologisch basiert die 5G-Infrastruktur auf einer Nokia DAC/NDAC Medium+ Umgebung mit 5G Standalone-Architektur, Edge Core, NDAC-Manager, Nokia AirScale-Komponenten, HPE Edge Servern, Router- und Switching-Komponenten sowie SIM-Kit. WISTA Management GmbH beabsichtigt den Verkauf ihres Kabelnetzes und 5G-Campusnetzes am Wissenschafts- und Wirtschaftsstandort Adlershof.

These similar services are multiple surveys (telephone, online or written) which are carried out in several survey waves for a period of twelve months. Technical features - What is the technical architecture of the solution like? - How has information security been ensured? - What language options does the system support? The contracting authority reserves the right to hold presentation sessions organised via Teams among those who responded to the information request/market dialogue, if the contracting authority considers it necessary to obtain further information. Responses are requested to be sent to the address hankinnat@ekhva.fi.Viestin with the subject: Market Survey: Customer Feedback System This information request/market survey does not request tenders to be submitted nor are tenders submitted in response to this information request, but it requests ONLY information related to the procurement. Participants in the market survey shall not be entitled to compensation for their participation. The contracting authority does not commit to carrying out the procurement in question. Decisions on initiating a potential procurement process will be made after the market survey. The submitted material will be treated as confidential in accordance with section 24, subsection 1, paragraph 20 of the Act on the Openness of Government Activities. Markkinakartoituksen avulla hyvinvointialue pyrkii: 1. Saamaan tietoa markkinoiden tarjonnasta ja eri toimittajien ratkaisuista 2. Mahdolliset integraatioiden toteutus eri alustoille tai järjestelmiin 3. Arvioimaan tietoturvan ja tietosuojan toteutusta 4. Saamaan yleiskuvan hinnoittelumalleista ja kustannusrakenteista (ei yksittäisiä tarjouksia) 5. Kartoittamaan toimitus- ja palvelumalleja Markkinavuoropuhelu on avoin kaikille toimittajille, joilla on tarjota tämän ratkaisukokonaisuuden piiriin kuuluvia ratkaisuista. Vuoropuhelun painopisteenä ovat ratkaisut, jotka ovat jo tuotannossa. Toimittajia pyydetään esittelemään palveluita, jotka ovat käytettävissä ja joissa keskeiset toiminnallisuudet ovat valmiiksi toteutettuja. Kehitteillä olevien tai vasta konseptitasolla olevien ratkaisujen esittelyistä Toimittajan on erikseen mainittava toimittamassaan esitteessä sekä annettava arvio mahdollisesta toteutuksen ajankohdasta. Etelä-Karjalan hyvinvointialue toivoo esityksiä seuraavista ratkaisuista: Käyttötarkoitus ja -ympäristö Järjestelmän tulee soveltua hyvinvointialueen käyttöön seuraavien sote-, pela-palveluiden palautteiden keräämiseen ja hallintaan. - Puhelinpalvelu - Palvelupisteessä asiointi - Sähköinen asiointi Järjestelmän tulee myös mahdollistaa kansallisen asiakaspalautteen keruu Terveyden ja hyvinvoinnin laitoksen (THL) määrittelyjen mukaisesti. Käyttäjäryhmiä ovat: - Hyvinvointialueen työntekijät (johtajat, esihenkilöt) Keskeiset toiminnallisuudet Asianhallinta - Palautetiedon käsittely - Vastaaminen palautteeseen järjestelmän kautta Tekstiviestipalaute - Kahdensuuntainen tekstiviesti - Selainpohjainen tekstiviestikysely - Kyselyn lähetyksen esto henkilöille, jotka ovat kieltäneet viestin lähettämisen Verkkopalaute - Selainpohjainen kysely Koosteet/raportit - Automatisoidut koosteet luvitetuille henkilöille Palautelaitteet - fyysiset palaute laitteet Tekoäly - Palautedatan analysointi, nostojen ja trendien muodostaminen - Interaktiivinen palaute Integraatiot - Tietojen vienti ja raportointi (Tietoallas) - Käyttäjätunnusten hallinnointi Entra ID:n kautta (hyvinvointialueen työntekijät, jotka käsittelevät palautteita) - Mahdolliset integraatiot potilas- ja asiakastietotietojärjestelmä Tekniset vaatimukset - Pilvipohjainen SaaS-ratkaisu - Suomenkielinen käyttöliittymä - Saavutettavuusdirektiivin mukainen toteutus - Jatkuva ylläpito ja päivitykset - Käyttötuki suomeksi Pyydämme teitä vastaamaan seuraaviin kysymyksiin: Ratkaisun yleiskuvaus - Onko teillä tarjolla yllä kuvattuja toiminnallisuuksia sisältävä järjestelmäratkaisu? - Mikä on ratkaisunne nimi ja lyhyt kuvaus? - Mitkä ovat ratkaisunne keskeiset vahvuudet? Toiminnallisuudet - Miten ratkaisunne täyttää kuvatut toiminnallisuudet? Tekniset ominaisuudet - Millainen on ratkaisun tekninen arkkitehtuuri? - Miten tietoturva on varmistettu? - Mitä kielivaihtoehtoja järjestelmä tukee? Kokemukset ja referenssit - Onko hyvinvointialueilla/kunnissa ratkaisuanne käytössä? - Miten järjestelmän suoriutuu suuren organisaation palautevolyymista? - Voitteko toimittaa referenssitietoja järjestelmä asiakkaista? Lisätiedot - Mitä muita oleellisia ominaisuuksia ratkaisunne sisältää? - Miten järjestelmän käyttöönotto tyypillisesti toteutetaan? - Millaista tukea ja koulutusta tarjoatte? rejected.text: The Norwegian Defence Materiel Agency (FMA) is the contracting authority and responsible for implementing the procurement. FMA is a part of the defence sector, directly under the Ministry of Defence (FD). FMA shall ensure that the Norwegian Armed Forces and other entities in the defence sector have access to cost efficient and secure material and services in line with approved long-term plans. FMA's main assignments are planning, procurement, management and disposal of material for the Norwegian Armed Forces and other departments under FD. Organisational reasons can be required during the contract period to transfer the resource to Cyber Defence's IT Department (CIT) DRIV. DRIV is responsible for the technical operation and further development (DEVSECOPS) of the Joint Integrated Management System (FIF). FIF is a SAP ERP system integrated with a number of other different applications. Internal processes are based on flexible frameworks (Scrum, SAFE), the Security Act and different industry standards for safety and ITIL for operation. DRIV consists of approx. 150 persons, most of whom are located in Oslo. Both employees and consultants staff the organisation. The aim of this notice is to fill the role of solution expert in Project P1160 'Critical Upgrade of ERP' and DRIV. The consultant shall take care of the role within the discipline SAP Defense and Security (D&S). The role can involve cooperation with other departments and/or projects in the Norwegian Armed Forces.

result.text: The employee counselling offering for the employees of Stadt Koblenz comprises a counselling offering with regard to the counselling occasions named below under 1.3.1 and the extended services under 1.3.2. Lot LOT-0001: Koblenz City Administration_Provision of Employee Counselling / Health Management. 1.3.1 The services named below relate to the following counselling occasions: - Conflict identification - Stress situations (workplace, personal) - Psychological and psychosomatic problems - Substance abuse problems and dependency - Crisis management following extreme experiences (e.g. death, suicide, accident, violent attacks in a professional environment) - Emergency situations, in particular where there is a danger to life and limb - Advising management staff of the contracting authority on dealing with employees who have developed conspicuous health issues - Specialist referral and appointment service 1.3.2. In addition, the contractor's extended service relates to: - Participation in company health management: The service to be provided by the contractor comprises active participation within the scope of company health management and the associated participation in relevant working groups. The contractual service comprises the participation of 4 hours per calendar year. Any additional support requirements requested by the contracting authority in this regard shall be invoiced separately by the contractor using an hourly rate established as an ancillary service. - Preparation of annual reports detailing the scope and occasions of the counselling sessions as well as recommendations for company health management and the department management: Comprehensive documentation shall be prepared by the contractor annually - by 02.01 each year - and submitted to the contracting authority unsolicited. This shall contain the actual scope of utilisation - in particular the number of telephone and personal contacts - as well as anonymised contents of the counselling service including a specification of the health-related issues. Furthermore, a professionally sound assessment of the evaluation is expected. In addition, a recommendation for the development of action strategies at the behavioural and situational level. This shall be explained comprehensively in a personal review meeting at the department management level with a duration of 2 hours. - Support in publicising the external employee counselling and public relations work: The counselling centre actively supports the process of internal communication regarding employee counselling. This includes in particular participation in the development of an internal company information brochure as well as accompanying info stands/presentations at events (health campaigns, staff assemblies or similar). Furthermore, it is expected that the contractor supports publications (for example on the intranet page) with specialist articles. - Independently of the occasion-related counselling, telephone support regarding urgently required appointment scheduling or referral to/for medical specialists and psychological psychotherapists is requested upon request. - It is guaranteed that, within the applicable opening hours, a meaningful drug check via urine and breath analysis can be carried out. This service shall be commissioned separately in individual cases and billed separately. - It is desired by the contracting authority that the application for rehabilitation is provided upon request or within the framework of an existing counselling process in a psychosomatic context. Billing shall take place directly with the applicant. - It is desired that, within the framework of case counselling, necessary cooperation with the contracting authority as well as external specialist centres (e.g. therapy practices, clinics, specialist services, rehabilitation facilities) takes place. - Cooperation with therapy practices, clinics, specialist services and rehabilitation facilities is welcomed. If such cooperation exists, evidence of this must be provided.

parts.source: Das Angebot der Mitarbeiterberatung für die Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter der Stadt Koblenz umfasst ein Beratungsangebot in Bezug auf die nachgenannten Beratungsanlässe unter 1.3.1 und die erweiterten Leistungen unter 1.3.2. Lot LOT-0001: Stadtverwaltung Koblenz_Bereitstellung Mitarbeiterberatung/Gesundheitsmanagement. 1.3.1 Die nachgenannten Leistungen beziehen sich auf folgende Beratungsanlässe: - Konfliktidentifikation - Belastungssituationen (Arbeitsplatz, persönliche) - Psychische und psychosomatische Probleme - Suchtmittelprobleme und Abhängigkeit - Krisenbewältigung nach Extremerfahrungen (z.B. Tod, Suizid, Unfall, gewalttätige Übergriffe im beruflichen Umfeld) - Notfallsituationen, insbesondere bei Gefahr für Leib und Leben - Beratung von Führungskräften des AG im Umgang mit Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeitern die gesundheitlich auffällig geworden sind - Facharztvermittlung und Terminservice 1.3.2. Darüber hinaus bezieht sich die erweiterte Leistung des AN auf: - Mitarbeit im Betrieblichen Gesundheitsmanagement: Die vom AN zu erbringende Leistung umfasst eine aktive Mitarbeit im Rahmen des betrieblichen Gesundheitsmanagements und die damit verbundene Teilnahme an entsprechenden Arbeitsgruppen. Die vertragliche Leistung umfasst die Teilnahme von 4 Stunden pro Kalenderjahr. Darüberhinausgehender vom AG diesbezüglich geforderter Unterstützungsbedarf wird mit einem im Rahmen der Nebenleistung festgelegten Stundensatz vom AN gesondert in Rechnung gestellt. - Erstellung jährlicher Berichte zur Schilderung des Umfangs und Anlässe der Beratungen sowie Empfehlungen für das betriebliche Gesundheitsmanagement und die Dienststellenleitung: Es wird jährlich - jeweils zum 02.01. - vonseiten des AN eine aussagekräftige Dokumentation erstellt und unaufgefordert dem AG vorgelegt. Diese enthält den tatsächlichen Umfang der Inanspruchnahme - insbesondere Anzahl der Kontakte telefonisch und persönlich - sowie anonymisierte Inhalte der Beratungsleistung einschließlich einer Spezifizierung der gesundheitlichen Problemstellungen. Ferner wird eine fachlich fundierte Einschätzung der Auswertung erwartet. Darüber hinaus eine Empfehlung zur Entwicklung von Handlungsstrategien auf der Verhaltens- und Verhältnisebene. Dies wird in einem persönlichen Bilanzierungsgespräch auf der Ebene der Dienststellenleitung mit einem zeitlichen Umfang von 2 Zeitstunden umfassend erläutert. - Unterstützung bei Bekanntmachung der externen Mitarbeiterberatung und Öffentlichkeitsarbeit: Die Beratungsstelle unterstützt aktiv den Prozess der internen Kommunikation zur Mitarbeiterberatung. Hierzu zählt insbesondere die Mitarbeit bei der Entwicklung einer innerbetrieblichen Informationsbroschüre sowie Begleitung von Infoständen/Präsentation bei Veranstaltungen (Gesundheitsaktionen, Personalversammlung o.ä). Ferner wird erwartet, dass der AN Veröffentlichungen (beispielsweise auf der Intranetseite) mit Fachbeiträgen unterstützt. - Unabhängig von der anlassbezogenen Beratung wird eine telefonische Unterstützung hinsichtlich dringend notwendiger Terminvereinbarungen bzw. Vermittlung bei/zu Fachärzten und psychologischen Psychotherapeuten auf Anfrage gewünscht. - Es wird zugesichert, dass im Rahmen der geltenden Öffnungszeiten ein aussagefähiger Drogencheck über Urin und Atemluftkontrolle erfolgen kann. Diese Leistung wird im Einzelfall gesondert beauftragt und gesondert abgerechnet. - Es wird seitens des AG gewünscht, dass die Beantragung einer Reha auf Anfrage oder im Rahmen eines bestehenden Beratungsprozesses im psychosomatischen Kontext geleistet wird. Die Abrechnung erfolgt unmittelbar mit dem Antragsteller. - Es wird gewünscht, dass im Rahmen der Fallberatung eine notwendige Zusammenarbeit mit dem AG sowie externen Fachstellen (z.B. Therapiepraxen, Kliniken, Fachdiensten, Reha-Einrichtungen) erfolgt. - Kooperationen mit Therapiepraxen, Kliniken, Fachdiensten und Reha-Einrichtungen werden begrüßt. Falls solche Kooperationen bestehen, sind diese nachzuweisen.

result.text: Attention! This is a request for information, which is not a prior information notice, contract notice or call for tenders. The purpose of the request for information is to survey the market and gather information regarding the subject of the contract for the future establishment of a dynamic purchasing system. Responding to the request for information is not a prerequisite for participating in the procurement procedure. To ensure the successful establishment of the future dynamic purchasing system and its internal competitions, it is important that tenderers provide the contracting authority with the requested information as broadly as possible. Istekki Oy is preparing a dynamic purchasing system (DPS) for Secure Communication Services 2025 - 2032. Istekki Oy invites market operators interested in Secure Communication Services (DPS) to declare their interest in commenting on the draft documents of the DPS request to participate for Secure Communication Services (2025 - 2032). Responses to the request for information must be submitted no later than Friday 17.10 by 12.00. Responses shall be sent by email to hankinnat@istekki.fi. Please title your message as follows: "Request for information: Secure Communication Services DPS". We will contact those who have responded to the request for information and send the draft documents of the DPS request to participate for comment. The information provided will be treated confidentially. DYNAMIC PURCHASING SYSTEM / SUBJECT OF THE CONTRACT The dynamic purchasing system is divided into 12 different categories (lots): 1: Secure mail 2: Inbound spam filtering 3: DMARC reporting 4: Email protection 5. Secure forms 6. Secure workspace 7. Secure instant messaging 8. Secure file transfer 9. Critical communication 10. Undefined procurement category - to be specified later 11. Undefined procurement category - to be specified later 12. Undefined procurement category - to be specified later Candidates may apply to categories 1-9 during the establishment phase. Candidates may not apply to categories 10-12 during the establishment phase. Istekki Oy reserves the option to establish categories 10-12 during the period of validity of the dynamic purchasing system. All candidates who meet the suitability requirements stated in the ESPD form and the request to participate may apply as tenderers for the dynamic purchasing system. All candidates who meet the set suitability requirements shall be admitted to the dynamic purchasing system. All interested candidates may request the right to participate in the dynamic purchasing system throughout the entire duration of the dynamic purchasing system. The number of candidates to be admitted to the dynamic purchasing system is not limited. A candidate applies to join the dynamic purchasing system by submitting an application to participate.

parts.source: Huomio! Tämä on tietopyyntö, joka ei ole ennakkoilmoitus, hankintailmoitus tai tarjouspyyntö. Tietopyynnön tarkoituksena on kartoittaa markkinoita ja kerätä hankinnan kohdetta koskevaa tietoa tulevaa dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän perustamista varten. Tietopyyntöön vastaaminen ei ole edellytys kilpailutukseen osallistumiselle. Tulevan dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän perustamisen ja sen sisäisten kilpailutuksien onnistumisen varmistamiseksi on tärkeää, että tarjoajat antavat hankintayksikölle mahdollisimman laajasti pyydettyjä tietoja. Istekki Oy:llä on valmistelussa dynaaminen hankintajärjestelmä (DPS) Turvallisen viestinnän palvelut 2025 - 2032. Istekki Oy pyytää Turvallisen viestinnän palveluista (DPS) kiinnostuneita markkinatoimijoita ilmoittamaan kiinnostuksensa kommentoida Turvallisen viestinnän palveluiden (2025 - 2032) DPS:n osallistumispyynnön luonnosasiakirjoja. Tietopyyntöön tulee vastata viimeistään pe 17.10. klo 12.00 mennessä. Vastaaminen tapahtuu sähköpostitse osoitteeseen hankinnat@istekki.fi. Otsikoikaa viestinne seuraavasti: "Tietopyyntö: Turvallisen viestinnän palvelut DPS". Olemme yhteydessä tietopyyntöön vastanneisiin ja lähetämme DPS:n osallistumispyynnön luonnosasiakirjat kommentointia varten. Annetut tiedot käsitellään luottamuksellisesti. result.text: The Salvation Army is seeking expressions of interest from established providers for the provision of comprehensive fulfilment services to support our fundraising campaigns. Scope of Services We require a partner capable of delivering the following core services to high standards: • Postal Response Handling: Receive, sort, and process up to 30,000 donations per day, including all payment types (cash, credit/debit cards, cheques). • Financial Processing: Ensure all donations are processed and banked within strict timeframes (non-cash within 1 day, cash within 2 days). • Banking Accuracy: Achieve 100% accuracy in banking and processing of credit/debit card donations. • Data Processing & Downloads: Provide accurate banking data and images by noon on day 3, with daily downloads available via secure platforms. • Secure Banking Collection: Daily collections during campaign peaks, with flexibility based on volume. • Exception & Query Handling: Timely management of whitemail, query letters, and exception items, with daily returns and fulfilment within 3 business days. • Reporting: Deliver accurate campaign, media, and finance reports daily and weekly as required. • Archiving: Secure storage of hard copies of processed response forms in line with our archiving requirements. • Client Query Handling: Respond to all queries within 24 hours, with prompt handling of emails and calls. • Account & Project Management: Provide daily updates, weekly project calls, and end-of-campaign reviews, ensuring transparent communication and invoicing. • Telephone Response Handling: Answer all calls live, maintain high data and donation processing accuracy, and provide call recordings as specified. • Campaign Set-Up & Management: Adhere to agreed procedures and supporter care protocols. Service Level Expectations Providers must demonstrate the ability to meet or exceed the following targets: • Daily processing and reporting deadlines • Minimum 99% data accuracy • 100% accuracy in donation processing and query letter fulfilment • Rapid response times for client queries and call-backs • Secure handling and transfer of sensitive data and images Who Should Apply: We invite expressions of interest from established fulfilment service providers with proven experience in high-volume donation processing, secure data management, and campaign support for charitable organisations.

The Energy, Power, Control, and Learning (EPCL) program supports foundational research on systems and control, learning, optimization, artificial intelligence, and networked multi-agent systems, and their applications, with emphasis on power and energy systems. NSF ENG anticipates a portfolio of ENG: Electrical, Communications, and Computing Systems (ECCS) awards with a range of budgets and durations. Estimated program budget, number of awards, and average award size/duration are subject to the availability of funds. NSF ENG is particularly interested in intellectually ambitious and potentially transformative foundational research. Proposals need not promise a near-term product, deployment, or commercial outcome, nor need they address later-stage development to be competitive.

result.text: The aim of the procurement is to establish a framework agreement for the delivery of equipment, consumables and production services for the production of standardised brands for locations and equipment in Helse Sør-Øst. The procurement shall support the implementation and use of uniform physical and digital identification of locations and equipment based on international GS1 standards. Locations shall be able to be identified by use of GS1 GLN and the equipment shall be able to be identified by use of GS1 GIAI, in the form of GS1 Digital Link and other standardised GS1 syntaxes. Through the use of international standards, marks shall be able to be used by digital systems in Helse Sør-Øst, e.g. systems for Facility Management (FM)/property management, clinical logistics, medical engineering, ERP, etc. The procurement shall result in: - Standardised types of brands for locations and equipment. - Support for multiple information carriers on brands - Support for local production of brands - Support for production of large volumes of brands as external services. - Standardised production basis. - Secure management of business critical information. The procurement includes systems for both local production of brands in the health companies, and production of large volumes of brands. The system for local production can include production equipment, necessary software and/or integration components, consumables, equipment for encoding/programming NFC and UHF RFID, training, support, maintenance and documentation. The contracting authority will, together with the chosen supplier, establish a set of standardised brand types that will be used for the production of labels for locations and equipment. A tag type is a documented specification that specifies how a brand should be designed and produced.

result.text: Micro, small and medium-sized enterprises (MSMEs) constitute the overwhelming majority of economic activity in Jordan. MSMEs account for over 99% of all enterprises, employ around 60% of the formal private-sector workforce, and contribute 40% of Jordan Gross Domestic Product (GDP), making them crucial for economic growth, resilience, and job creation. Despite this importance, MSMEs still face obstacles in accessing appropriate and diversified financial products. Access to formal credit remains limited for many MSMEs. According to the Central Bank of Jordan (CBJ) National Financial Inclusion Strategy (NFIS) 2023-2028, only 28.3% of formal MSMEs had a loan or line of credit from a financial institution, highlighting a significant financing gap for smaller firms in Jordan. Financial exclusion is especially pronounced for underserved segments such as informal and women-led enterprises, which often face higher collateral requirements, limited credit histories, and lower formal borrowing rates. Financial inclusion, defined as access to and use of appropriate, affordable, and sustainable financial products and services, remains a priority in Jordan. The CBJ is pursuing ambitious targets to increase overall financial inclusion, reduce gender gaps, and enhance MSME access to finance, including through digital channels and tailored products. The NFIS aims, for example, to increase MSMEs access to formal lending at an average annual rate of 4% for four years. In a similar vein, Jordan"s Green Finance Strategy 2023-2028 aims to mobilize green investments and position the financial sector as a regional leader in sustainable finance. The strategy highlights that a 92.5% of the Jordan National Determined Contribution (NDC) target cost is to be financed by international support and mobilized private capital. As Jordan advances its Green Finance Strategy, a central priority was establishing clear and credible standards for what qualifies as "green" across the financial system. The Jordan National Green Taxonomy, published in February 2026, provides this clarity by offering a common language for the financial system to classify sustainable economic activities in a transparent and consistent way. By anchoring investment decisions to science-based criteria, the taxonomy helps ensure that future capital flows genuinely support Jordan"s low-carbon, climate-resilient transition. Against this backdrop, the Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit GIZ-implemented project, Innovative Approaches for the Financial Inclusion of MSMEs in Jordan (I-FIN), takes a holistic, market-driven approach to strengthening inclusive green finance in the country. The project operates across the policy, institutional, and market levels, helping to improve the broader enabling environment, upgrade the technical and operational capacities of financial service providers, and ensure that enterprises can confidently access and benefit from green finance solutions. The overall objective of the project is to ensure that MSMEs in Jordan benefit from a more inclusive financial system that enables inclusive access to green finance and supports environmentally sustainable and resilient business growth, also with a focus on women-led enterprises. The assignment is structured around four interrelated work packages, 5 key experts, complemented by two pools of experts. Work Package 1: Planning and Inception: aims to review, research, and analyse all relevant information to ensure a comprehensive understanding of the assignment and to refine the implementation approach. Work Package 2: Capacity Development and Technical Assistance for Inclusive Green Credit Guarantees and Risk-Sharing Mechanisms: strengthens the staff and institutional capacities of the Jordan Loan Guarantee Corporation (JLGC) in the area of MSMEs inclusive green finance, through tailored staff capacity development and institutional advisory services across seven operational areas: product development and/or adaptation, risk documentation and/or management, strategy development, monitoring, reporting, setting up of an operational unit, and cooperation with Fintechs. Work Package 3: Capacity Development and Technical Assistance for Financial Services Providers: strengthens the institutional capacities of 5 financial services providers across the same seven operational areas and builds the capacities of at least 120 employees (50 of which are women) in the financial service sector. This work package may target public and private financial services providers, while Activity 3.7 targets financial sector associations, training providers, and academic institutions. The Contractor is expected to ensure strong coordination and alignment with a parallel complementary intervention delivering sector-level standardized training, including regular information exchange, harmonization of approaches, and avoidance of duplication. Work Package 4: Advancing Financial Service Providers' Capacity to Access and Mobilize International Climate Finance: supports financial services providers in submitting at least 3 project outlines (1 of which related to the water sector) for mobilising international climate finance in relation to MSMEs to relevant national actors, in close coordination with the CBJ, Ministry of Environment, and industry associations. All support under this assignment shall be aligned with international best practices and relevant national frameworks, including, but not limited to, the Jordan National Green Taxonomy, ensuring consistency with evolving regulatory and policy developments in the green finance landscape.

result.text: The GB IT of the UKJ commits itself at the current point in time to the manufacturer Hewlett-Packard Enterprise (HPE) as the outfitter for extensions and substitutions of the existing IT infrastructure and therefore intends to conclude a framework agreement for the procurement of HPE system components. This is due to the fact that a comprehensive and almost complete data centre infrastructure of the manufacturer HPE exists, which must be permanently expanded and partially or substantially renewed within the scope of lifecycle management. A change of manufacturer would be associated with very high effort and high switching costs. Lot LOT-0001: FA HPE server, SAN and storage infrastructure. The tendering of the framework agreement pursues the objective of enabling an expansion of the existing IT infrastructure during the contract period, replacing components within the scope of lifecycle management that are technically or economically obsolete, and furthermore the delivery of original HPE products. The services comprise the delivery, consultation and maintenance of HPE products in the fields of IT infrastructure, servers, storage, cloud or the provision of HPE software (incl. rental software) as well as associated services. Installation and configuration services as well as measures to establish operational readiness do not explicitly form part of the content of the tender, unless they are listed in the price sheet or are a component of the items in the price sheet or of the included maintenance service. These measures are commissioned separately by the contracting authority as required.

parts.source: Der GB IT des UKJ legt sich zum aktuellen Zeitpunkt auf den Hersteller Hewlett-Packard Enterprise (HPE) als Ausstatter für Erweiterungen und Substitutionen der bestehenden IT-Infrastruktur fest und beabsichtigt daher den Abschluss einer Rahmenvereinbarung zur Beschaffung von HPE-Systemkomponenten. Dies ist darin begründet, dass eine flächendeckende und nahezu vollständige RZ-Infrastruktur des Herstellers HPE existiert, welche permanent erweitert und im Rahmen eines Lifecycle-Managements partiell oder substantiell erneuert werden muss. Ein Herstellerwechsel wäre mit sehr hohem Aufwand und hohen Wechselkosten verbunden. Lot LOT-0001: RV HPE-Server-, SAN- und Speicherinfrastruktur. result.text: Procurement of a software solution The Institute of the Fire Brigade of North Rhine-Westphalia (IdF NRW) is the state fire service school of the State of North Rhine-Westphalia. For the efficient planning, organisation, and documentation of the approximately 500 to 850 seminars per year with around 17.000 to 18.000 participants, the IdF NRW intends to procure new educational management software that supports in particular course administration, participant organisation, as well as evaluation and reporting functions. As part of the IT project, an overall works contract will be concluded, specifically using the "EVB-IT Systemvertrag" form with various adjustments, which are highlighted accordingly. Within this overall service, the purchase of standard software (No. 4.3 EVB-IT Systemvertrag), the creation of the overall system with the establishment of operational readiness, incl. customising and integration as well as interfaces (Nos. 4.5, 4.7 and 4.10 EVB-IT Systemvertrag) as well as - after acceptance of the overall system - system service, including restoration and maintenance of operational readiness as well as the delivery of new program versions (No. 5.1 EVB-IT Systemvertrag) and further development (No. 6.1 EVB-IT Systemvertrag), including training and documentation, shall take place; these services are largely remunerated on a lump-sum basis (see price sheet). Furthermore, optionally retrievable services are offered by the tenderer, such as migration and other services before and after acceptance, which are generally remunerated on a time-and-materials basis (No. 7 EVB-IT Systemvertrag) (see also price sheet). Mandatory A criteria (must criteria), the complete fulfilment of which in the operational overall system is owed, follow from the criteria catalogue, as well as additionally scored, non-mandatory B criteria, which are to be provided insofar as they were indicated as offered by the tenderer in the procurement procedure. Regarding the contract term: For the system service services, the provision of services begins contractually on the day after successful acceptance; a minimum contract duration of 84 months is envisaged. Ordinary termination of the system service is possible for the first time at the end of the minimum contract duration with a notice period of 24 months; without timely termination, the contractual relationship continues for an indefinite duration. Regardless of this, the entire EVB-IT Systemvertrag (as a works contract) can be terminated pursuant to section 648 BGB; the consequences of termination result from No. 18.7 EVB-IT Systemvertrag. Note on differing contract lengths: While the software purchase is designed for the long term, the system service runs for at least 84 months and can be terminated ordinarily thereafter. This textual summary serves for the rough classification of the contract structure (overall works contract, software purchase, services, price logic, criteria binding, term and termination) and does not replace an independent, complete, final review and legal or economic evaluation of the contract documents.

Customizing und Integration sowie Schnittstellen (Nr. 4.5, 4.7 und 4.10 EVB-IT Systemvertrag) sowie - nach Abnahme des Gesamtsystems - Systemservice, einschließlich Wiederherstellung und Aufrechterhaltung der Betriebsbereitschaft sowie der Lieferung neuer Programmstände (Nr. 5.1 EVB-IT Systemvertrag) und der Weiterentwicklung (Nr. 6.1 EVB-IT Systemvertrag), einschließlich Schulungen und Dokumentation; diese Leistungen werden weitgehend pauschal vergütet (siehe Preisblatt). Ferner werden vom Bieter optional abrufbare Leistungen angeboten, wie Migration und sonstige Leistungen vor und nach Abnahme, welche grundsätzlich nach Aufwand (Nr. 7 EVB IT Systemvertrag) vergütet werden (siehe auch Preisblatt). Aus dem Kriterienkatalog folgen zwingende A Kriterien (Muss Kriterien), deren vollständige Erfüllung im betriebsbereiten Gesamtsystem geschuldet ist, sowie zusätzlich bepunktete, nicht zwingende B Kriterien, die zu leisten sind, soweit sie im Vergabeverfahren vom Bieter als angeboten ausgewiesen wurden. Zur Laufzeit: Für die Systemserviceleistungen beginnt die Leistungserbringung vertraglich mit dem Tag nach der erfolgreichen Abnahme; vorgesehen ist eine Mindestvertragsdauer von 84 Monaten. Die ordentliche Kündigung des Systemservice ist erstmals zum Ablauf der Mindestvertragsdauer mit einer Frist von 24 Monaten möglich; ohne fristgerechte Kündigung läuft das Vertragsverhältnis auf unbestimmte Dauer fort. Unabhängig davon kann der gesamte EVB-IT Systemvertrag (als Werkvertrag) nach § 648 BGB gekündigt werden; die Kündigungsfolgen ergeben sich aus Nr. 18.7 EVB-IT Systemvertrag. Hinweis auf abweichende Vertragslängen: Während der Softwarekauf auf Dauer angelegt ist, läuft der Systemservice mindestens 84 Monate und ist danach ordentlich kündbar. Diese textliche Kurzfassung dient der groben Einordnung der Vertragsstruktur (Gesamtwerkvertrag, Softwarekauf, Services, Preislogik, Kriterienbindung, Laufzeit und Kündigung) und ersetzt keine eigene, vollständige, abschließende Sichtung und rechtliche bzw. wirtschaftliche Bewertung der Vertragsunterlagen.

result.text: This procurement process is being advertised and run by First Greater Western limited on its own behalf and on behalf of the successor operator of the rail passenger transport services in respect of Great Western Railway (GWR). That successor operator will be a public sector company, is expected to be a wholly owned subsidiary of DfT OLR Holdings Limited and will be ultimately owned by the Secretary of State for Transport. The date for transfer of the current operations to the successor operator is not yet confirmed. Where the transfer is completed before contract award under this procurement process, the successor operator may elect (but will not be obliged) to carry on with this procurement process in place of GWR, by taking on the role of contracting entity from the date of completion of the transfer (with this notice and all other procurement documents to be interpreted accordingly). Where the transfer is not yet completed by the time of contract award, contractual rights may be included in the contractual arrangements to enable transfer to the successor operator. Bidders should note that this procurement process (if ongoing), or any awarded contract, may be included in a transfer scheme made by the Secretary of State under section 12 of the Railways Act 2005, or the transfer may be effected outside of, or separate from, such a scheme. If transfer takes place before the contract award the successor operator shall assume all the rights of the Client set out in this document. All references to the Client shall be deemed to refer to the successor operator for the purposes of this procurement and the successor operator shall be entitled to continue or terminate this procurement as if it was involved. This Preliminary Market Engagement will help GWR understand capability in the market and lead to GWR procuring and implementing a new integrated Time & Attendance (T&A) solution that meets GWR’s operational, HR, safety, payroll, and organisational requirements. The overall objective of the procurement is to provide GWR a modern, integrated T&A capability with standardised processes, clear governance, seamless system integration, and improved workforce reporting and analytics. GWR currently operates 3 different Time and Attendance systems in different business areas. Proposed system Capabilities must include: o Rostering & scheduling o Time capture (mobile, geofencing, clock-in/out) o Leave & absence management o Fatigue management & compliance o Workflow automation (approvals) Lot 1: .

Tarjoaja osallistuu markkinakartoitukseen tutustumalla markkinakartoituksen liitteeseen ja vastaamalla esitettyihin kysymyksiin. Valmistelun tarkoituksena on tarkentaa hankinnan laajuus ja päättää hankintaprosessista sekä määritellä alustavat käyttötapaukset, joita palvelun tulee tukea. Osallistuneille palveluntuottajille ei makseta korvausta osallistumisesta Ulkoisen liikennetiedon hankinnan kohteeseen tutustumisesta. rejected.text: Nordværk I/S is tendering for the acquisition, implementation and subsequent operation and maintenance of a new specialist system for the administration and support of waste collection, hereinafter referred to as the Solution. The acquisition is being carried out with the aim of replacing the current system support for Nordværk's waste management area and establishing a comprehensive, modern and future-proof Solution that can support the business processes associated with the administration, planning, case processing, execution, registration, follow-up and documentation of waste collection. The acquisition includes the delivery and implementation of the Solution as well as the services necessary to establish and put the Solution into use. This includes, among other things, clarification and configuration, migration and establishment of relevant data, establishment and adaptation of integrations, testing, training, documentation, commissioning as well as subsequent operation, support, maintenance and further development in accordance with the Contract and the Contract's annexes. The Solution must support Nordværk's entire value chain in the waste management area from a citizen's or customer's arrangement, enquiry or order to the planning and execution of the specific waste management task as well as subsequent registration, case processing, follow-up, controlling, documentation and basis for billing. The acquisition is part of Nordværk's work to ensure efficient, coherent and data-driven administration and operation of waste collection. The Solution must support standardised and controllable workflows, high data quality, reduced need for manual processes as well as better opportunities for management, follow-up and ongoing development of the waste management area. At the same time, the Solution must be able to be appropriately integrated into Nordværk's other system landscape and support organisational, operational and technological changes over the term of the Contract. The overall purpose of the Solution is in particular: i) to support coherent and efficient workflows within customer administration, case processing, operational planning, task execution, registration, controlling and follow-up, ii) to support operational waste collection for both Nordværk's own and external waste collectors, including planning, routes, navigation, registration of completed tasks, handling of deviations and operational follow-up, and iii) to establish a flexible and future-proof system basis with high data quality and good opportunities for integration, configuration, automation, reporting and ongoing further development. The business processes and functionality that apply to the Solution are described in more detail in Annex 3 of the tender material – Delivery Description. The Solution is expected to support several different internal and external user groups. This includes, among others, approx. 186-200 internal waste management employees, 55-65 administrative employees, 10-20 administrators/superusers, 40-50 administrative users at external waste collectors and 100-110 waste management employees at external waste collectors. The user groups will have different roles and access needs in the Solution. The Solution must be established on a technical platform that supports the requirements for accessibility, security, integration, scalability, operation and further development that appear in the Contract and the Contract's annexes. The more detailed technical requirements for the Solution and its establishment appear in the relevant annexes of the tender material. The Solution must have an open, transparent and well-documented architecture and must be able to be integrated into Nordværk's overall system landscape. The Supplier must deliver and maintain the documentation necessary for, among other things, operation, administration, integrations, configuration, troubleshooting and further development of the Solution, in accordance with the requirements in the Contract and the Contract's annexes. The Solution supports business-critical processes in connection with the daily administration and execution of waste collection. Requirements are therefore set for, among other things, the Solution's accessibility, stability, security, traceability and data integrity, so that data and registrations can be used reliably in operational operation, customer service, case processing, controlling, documentation and as a basis for billing. The Solution must be integrated with a number of Nordværk's other systems and technical solutions. This includes, among other things, relevant software interfaces to the billing system, GIS and data basis, self-service solutions, registration equipment, weighing systems and other third-party solutions where data exchange is necessary to support coherent workflows. The specific requirements for integrations and software interfaces appear in the relevant annexes of the tender material. The tender also contains a number of options for additional functionality and deliveries, which Nordværk may choose to make use of in accordance with the Contract. The specific options and the terms for these appear in the Contract and the Contract's annexes, including Annex 3 – Delivery Description. Commissioning of the Solution must take place after completion of the agreed activities regarding, among other things, clarification, configuration, data migration, integrations, testing, training and approval. The more detailed procedure and schedule for implementation and commissioning are determined in accordance with the Contract and the relevant annexes. The Contract thus contains an implementation period of up to 12 months as well as, after commissioning, an operational period of 6 years with the possibility of extension for 2 times 12 months. Nordværk I/S is tendering for the acquisition, implementation and subsequent operation and maintenance of a new specialist system for the administration and support of waste collection, hereinafter referred to as the Solution.

parts.source: Nordværk I/S udbyder anskaffelse, implementering og efterfølgende drift og vedligeholdelse af et nyt fagsystem til administration og understøttelse af affaldsindsamlingen, herefter benævnt Løsningen. Anskaffelsen gennemføres med henblik på at erstatte den nuværende systemunderstøttelse af Nordværks renovationsområde og etablere en samlet, tidssvarende og fremtidssikret Løsning, der kan understøtte de forretningsprocesser, som knytter sig til administration, planlægning, sagsbehandling, udførelse, registrering, opfølgning og dokumentation af affaldsindsamlingen. Anskaffelsen omfatter levering og implementering af Løsningen samt de ydelser, der er nødvendige for at etablere og tage Løsningen i brug. Dette omfatter blandt andet afklaring og konfiguration, migrering og etablering af relevante data, etablering og tilpasning af Integrationer, test, uddannelse, dokumentation, idriftsættelse samt efterfølgende drift, support, vedligeholdelse og videreudvikling i overensstemmelse med Kontrakten og Kontraktens bilag. Løsningen skal understøtte Nordværks samlede værdikæde på renovationsområdet fra en borgers eller kundes ordning, henvendelse eller bestilling til planlægning og udførelse af den konkrete renovationsopgave samt efterfølgende registrering, sagsbehandling, opfølgning, controlling, dokumentation og grundlag for afregning. Anskaffelsen indgår i Nordværks arbejde med at sikre en effektiv, sammenhængende og datadrevet administration og drift af affaldsindsamlingen. Løsningen skal understøtte standardiserede og kontrollerbare arbejdsgange, høj datakvalitet, reduceret behov for manuelle processer samt bedre muligheder for styring, opfølgning og løbende udvikling af renovationsområdet. Løsningen skal samtidig kunne indgå hensigtsmæssigt i Nordværks øvrige systemlandskab og understøtte organisatoriske, driftsmæssige og teknologiske ændringer over Kontraktens løbetid. Løsningens overordnede formål er navnlig: i) at understøtte sammenhængende og effektive arbejdsgange inden for kundeadministration, sagsbehandling, driftsplanlægning, opgaveudførelse, registrering, controlling og opfølgning, ii) at understøtte den operationelle affaldsindsamling for både Nordværks egne og eksterne renovatører, herunder planlægning, ruter, Navigation, registrering af udførte opgaver, håndtering af afvigelser og driftsmæssig opfølgning, og iii) at etablere et fleksibelt og fremtidssikret systemgrundlag med høj datakvalitet og gode muligheder for integration, konfiguration, automatisering, rapportering og løbende videreudvikling. De forretningsprocesser og den funktionalitet, der er gældende for Løsningen, er nærmere beskrevet i udbudsmaterialets Bilag 3 – Leverancebeskrivelse. Løsningen forventes at skulle understøtte flere forskellige interne og eksterne brugergrupper. Dette omfatter blandt andet ca. 186-200 interne renovationsmedarbejdere, 55-65 administrative medarbejdere, 10-20 administratorer/superbrugere, 40-50 administrative brugere hos eksterne renovatører samt 100-110 renovationsmedarbejdere hos eksterne renovatører. Brugergrupperne vil have forskellige roller og adgangsbehov i Løsningen. Løsningen skal etableres på en teknisk platform, der understøtter de krav til tilgængelighed, sikkerhed, integration, skalerbarhed, drift og videreudvikling, der fremgår af Kontrakten og Kontraktens bilag. De nærmere tekniske krav til Løsningen og dens etablering fremgår af udbudsmaterialets relevante bilag. Løsningen skal have en åben, gennemsigtig og veldokumenteret arkitektur og skal kunne indgå i Nordværks samlede systemlandskab. Leverandøren skal levere og vedligeholde den Dokumentation, der er nødvendig for blandt andet drift, administration, Integrationer, konfiguration, fejlsøgning og videreudvikling af Løsningen, i overensstemmelse med kravene i Kontrakten og Kontraktens bilag. Løsningen understøtter forretningskritiske processer i forbindelse med den daglige administration og udførelse af affaldsindsamlingen. Der stilles derfor krav til blandt andet Løsningens tilgængelighed, stabilitet, sikkerhed, sporbarhed og dataintegritet, således at data og registreringer kan anvendes pålideligt i den operationelle drift, kundebetjening, sagsbehandling, controlling, dokumentation og som grundlag for afregning. Løsningen skal integreres med en række af Nordværks øvrige systemer og tekniske løsninger. Dette omfatter blandt andet relevante snitflader til afregningssystem, GIS- og datagrundlag, selvbetjeningsløsninger, registreringsudstyr, vejesystemer og øvrige tredjepartsløsninger, hvor dataudveksling er nødvendig for at understøtte sammenhængende arbejdsgange. De konkrete krav til Integrationer og snitflader fremgår af udbudsmaterialets relevante bilag. Udbuddet indeholder endvidere en række optioner på yderligere funktionalitet og leverancer, som Nordværk kan vælge at gøre brug af i overensstemmelse med Kontrakten. De konkrete optioner og vilkårene herfor fremgår af Kontrakten og Kontraktens bilag, herunder Bilag 3 – Leverancebeskrivelse. Ibrugtagning af Løsningen skal ske efter gennemførelse af de aftalte aktiviteter vedrørende blandt andet afklaring, konfiguration, datamigrering, Integrationer, test, uddannelse og godkendelse. Den nærmere fremgangsmåde og tidsplan for implementering og Ibrugtagning fastlægges i overensstemmelse med Kontrakten og de relevante bilag. Kontrakten indeholder således en implementeringsperiode på op til 12 måneder samt efter Ibrugtagning en driftsperiode på 6 år med mulighed for forlængelse på 2 gange 12 måneder. Nordværk I/S udbyder anskaffelse, implementering og efterfølgende drift og vedligeholdelse af et nyt fagsystem til administration og understøttelse af affaldsindsamlingen, herefter benævnt Løsningen.

result.text: This program will advance scientific community datasets to enable scientific discovery and innovation using artificial intelligence (AI) and other methods. Its goal is to increase the value that can be derived from existing scientific datasets by leveraging novel methods and artificial intelligence (AI). This will unlock new AI-driven insights. It can enable interdisciplinary research. It also enables investigations outside of the original motivation for data collection and analysis. The program seeks to 1) apply AI-based capabilities to feature extraction and metadata generation, and the integration of multiple datasets. 2) Develop robust data pipelines necessary for automated analysis of existing datasets and similar use-cases by AI tools and systems. 3) Augment and/or harmonize existing datasets to better enable use by AI data pipelines and automated analysis. Proposals should address dataset security and integrity. Governance and the process for scientific communities to contribute to the datasets should also be addressed. Proposals are encouraged to leverage existing resources. These may include NSF data platforms , the NSF Integrated Data Systems and Services program , the NSF-led National AI Research Resource , the Genesis Mission platform , or other national infrastructure. NSF is open to exploring partnerships with philanthropy, private industry, or the non-profit sector to support additional proposals or collaborative opportunities that will advance AI-driven scientific discovery through unlocking the value of high-impact scientific datasets. Expanding Participation in STEM, NSF Priorities, and Gold Standard Science: NSF prioritizes cutting-edge discovery science and engineering research, advancing technology and innovation, and creating opportunities for all Americans. NSF has established priorities set forth by Congress, the administration and the NSF director to promote NSF's mission . Proposers should review the list of NSF priorities and are encouraged to align their proposals with them, where appropriate. NSF also expects the highest standards of scientific rigor, integrity and adherence tenets of Gold Standard Science in proposals, as appropriate for the field of science and research modality.

result.text: The purpose of the contract is the implementation of an integral platform that allows the complete data lifecycle to be managed efficiently and securely, as well as an inter-administrative data space that facilitates sharing and exchanging information reliably. Furthermore, the contract comprises the provision of services necessary for its customisation, commissioning, operational support and evolution. This includes the implementation, configuration, integration, commissioning and support of an Integral Data Governance Platform and an Inter-administrative Data Space for the Junta de Communities of Castilla-La Mancha in an on-premise modality, intended to provide the functional and technological capabilities necessary for the deployment of the Data Governance System (as established in article 15 of Decree 12/2026, of 31 March, regulating Data Governance in the Junta de Communities of Castilla-La Mancha) and to enable the sharing, management, cataloguing, governance and interoperability of data between the various units of the regional Administration, other public administrations and, where applicable, the remaining agents of the data ecosystem, under principles of security, sovereignty, trust, traceability and regulatory compliance. The platform must provide, amongst others, capabilities for cataloguing and metadata management, data governance and quality, lineage, semantic management, inventory of data sets and products, policy management, discovery and consumption of data, interoperability, secure information sharing and support for the creation of a data market (Data Marketplace), allowing progressive evolution towards an inter-administrative data space aligned with the Data Union Strategy and the Data Strategic Plan of Castilla-La Mancha 2026-2030. In addition, support services aimed at increasing and promoting a data culture within the Administration are considered, as well as all those that provide support and serve to drive the corporate strategy regarding data, including those for support and assistance in the drafting of data-related policies, instructions and procedures.

parts.source: El objeto del contrato es la implantación de una plataforma integral que permita gestionar de forma eficiente y segura el ciclo de vida completo del dato, así como un espacio de datos interadministrativo que facilite compartir e intercambiar información de manera confiable. Asimismo, el contrato comprende la prestación de los servicios necesarios para su personalización, puesta en servicio, apoyo a la operación y evolución. Esto incluye la implantación, configuración, integración, puesta en funcionamiento y soporte de una Plataforma Integral de Gobierno del Dato y un Espacio de Datos Interadministrativo para la Junta de Comunidades de Castilla-La Mancha en modalidad on-premise, destinada a proporcionar las capacidades funcionales y tecnológicas necesarias para el despliegue del Sistema de Gobierno del Dato (según se establece en el artículo 15 del Decreto 12/2026, de 31 de marzo, por el que se regula el Gobierno del Dato en la Junta de Comunidades de Castilla-La Mancha) y para habilitar la compartición, gestión, catalogación, gobierno e interoperabilidad de los datos entre las distintas unidades de la Administración regional, otras administraciones públicas y, cuando proceda, los restantes agentes del ecosistema del dato, bajo principios de seguridad, soberanía, confianza, trazabilidad y cumplimiento normativo. La plataforma deberá proporcionar, entre otras, capacidades de catalogación y gestión de metadatos, gobierno y calidad del dato, linaje, gestión semántica, inventario de conjuntos y productos de datos, gestión de políticas, descubrimiento y consumo de datos, interoperabilidad, compartición segura de información y soporte a la creación de un mercado de datos (Data Marketplace), permitiendo evolucionar progresivamente hacia un espacio de datos interadministrativo alineado con la Data Union Strategy y el Plan Estratégico del Dato de Castilla-La Mancha 2026-2030. Además, se consideran los servicios de apoyo destinados a aumentar y promocionar la cultura del dato dentro de la Administración, así como todos aquellos que den soporte, apoyo y sirvan para el impulso a la estrategia corporativa en materia de datos, incluyendo los de apoyo y soporte a la elaboración de políticas, instrucciones y procedimientos en materia de datos.

rejected.text: Reasoning Background With the entry into force of the amended Federal Nature Conservation Act (BNatSchG) on 01.03.2010, monitoring in accordance with EU Directive 2009/147/EC ("Birds Directive") was incorporated into Section 6 of the BNatSchG. This includes, in particular, the observation of the conservation status of European bird species and their habitats. In accordance with Section 7 ( 2) no. 12 of the BNatSchG, all bird species occurring naturally in Europe are considered "European bird species". According to Article 9 of the Habitats Directive (92/43/EEC), the EU Commission assesses at regular intervals the contribution of Natura 2000 to the realisation of the objectives of the Habitats and Birds Directives. This requires the content of the standard data forms (SDF) to be updated at regular intervals based on information available for each site in the network (Commission Implementing Decision 2011/484/EU). For this purpose, information on populations, population trends and habitats of the species relevant according to Article 4 paragraphs (1) and (2) of EU Directive 2009/147/EC is required. Monitoring in EU Special Protection Areas (SPAs) as part of the European Natura 2000 network is part of the monitoring of European bird species and their habitats in accordance with Section 6 of the BNatSchG. As a sub-programme, it serves (in accordance with Directives or Regulations 92/43/EEC, 2009/147/EC and 2019/1010) - the determination of populations of relevant bird species at least once in the six-year reporting cycle for each SPA, - the continuous determination of population trends and site-related conservation statuses of significant breeding bird species, - the continuous determination of population trends and site-related conservation statuses of significant migratory and wintering bird species, and - the standardised recording of habitat information, impairments and threats across the entire area of the SPAs for a comprehensive assessment of the conservation status of relevant bird species and their habitats. Standardised monitoring in the SPAs in Rhineland-Palatinate began with a pilot project 2025/2026 in ten selected SPAs (in accordance with the coalition agreement for Rhineland-Palatinate in the period 2021-2026). Therefore, the site-specific data foundations and qualities are currently often still unsatisfactory, and the state data do not allow for the determination of statistically robust population trends and conservation statuses for the significant bird species in the Rhineland-Palatinate SPAs. This prevents, in particular, appropriate priority and target planning by nature conservation authorities for measures to achieve good conservation status for the relevant species, where this is not already the case. The task package tendered here serves the supplementary recording in further SPAs with a view to the next bird protection report in the year 2031 (data period 2023-2028). The expected data serve to fulfil the reporting obligations to the EU under Article 12 of Directive 2009/147/EC and Regulation 2019/1010. Prospectively (ideally from 2029), all Rhineland-Palatinate SPAs are to be recorded in a six-year reporting cycle in accordance with a standardised monitoring concept (not part of this contract). Monitoring in EU Special Protection Areas 2011 the State Working Group of Bird Protection Stations (LAG VSW), together with the Umbrella Organisation of German Avifaunists (DDA) and the Federal Agency for Nature Conservation (BfN), has presented recommendations for the monitoring of European bird species and their habitats (LAG VSW et al., 2011). These pursue the goal of formulating a nationwide uniform standard for data collection. In this context, the principles mentioned for monitoring in SPAs leave sufficient room for state-specific adjustments. The results of the monitoring form the basis for site management against the background of the respective conservation objectives and for the reporting obligation under Art. 12 of Directive 2009/147/EC. Furthermore, they serve as a reference for decisions in preliminary and compatibility assessments. For the purpose of collecting baseline data in EU Special Protection Areas to improve data quality for the next bird protection report (reporting period 2023-2028) and for the efficient planning of future SPA monitoring, the implementation of the "Greece ruling" (ECJ in a request for a preliminary ruling from a Greek court under Art. 267 TFEU, 12.9.2024 - C-66/23) as well as the implementation of the "Nature Restoration Regulation" (EU Regulation 2024/1991), this procurement procedure is intended to provide baseline data on the occurrence and distribution of relevant species in accordance with Article 4 paragraphs (1) and (2) of EU Directive 2009/147/EC in as many Rhineland-Palatinate SPAs as possible.
