result.text: The project comprises the planning and execution of internal audits and security revisions in the area of information security to maintain the information network of the EU Paying Agency Brandenburg-Berlin, which is certified based on BSI IT-Grundschutz in accordance with ISO 27001. The ISO 27001 certification is proof of the Union law eligibility criterion of "security of information systems" of the EU paying agency (Article 1 in conjunction with Annex I point 3 letter B of Delegated Regulation (EU) No 2022/127) and requires the regular execution of internal audits and security revisions in accordance with BSI IT-Grundschutz. Internal personnel resources and competencies for carrying out internal audits are not available, which is why, in accordance with chapter 8.3, BSI standard 200-1, it has been decided to award the execution of the audits to external experts. The previously awarded project with the same project content expires in the year 2026, which is why a multi-year follow-up project is being awarded to ensure continuous and long-term internal auditing until 2030. The subject matter of the project shall be flexibly retrievable auditing services for the information network of the EU paying agency, which consists of the organisational units of the Ministry for Agriculture and Nutrition, Environment and Consumer Protection Brandenburg (MLEUV) and the directly subordinate State Office for Rural Development, Agriculture and Land Consolidation (LELF), as well as the other bodies involved in the paying agency procedure (districts, state forestry enterprise, investment bank and technical service providers), which as outsourcing partners or the components outsourced to them, shall represent the essential audit subjects of the audits. Based on an jointly prepared audit schedule, four audits per year are planned. The project is to be awarded to demonstrably experienced experts in the field of information security revision or ISMS auditing in accordance with BSI IT-Grundschutz. Lot LOT-0001: Internal audits and security revisions to maintain the information security of the EU paying agency in the MLEUV. The contract subject matter comprises the planning and execution of internal audits and security revisions for an information network certified on the basis of BSI IT-Grundschutz in accordance with ISO 27001 and its participating outsourcing partners. The information network to be audited "Operational running of the EU Paying Agency Brandenburg-Berlin" consists of the organisational units of the Ministry for Agriculture and Nutrition, Environment and Consumer Protection of the State of Brandenburg (MLEUV) and the directly subordinate State Office for Rural Development, Agriculture and Land Consolidation (LELF), which perform the professional tasks of approval, control, disbursement, accounting and administration of arrears of subsidy funds of the European Agricultural Guarantee Fund (EAGF), the European Agricultural Fund for Rural Development (EAFRD) and the European Maritime, Fisheries and Aquaculture Fund (EMFAF), as well as the other bodies involved in the paying agency procedure (districts, state forestry enterprise, investment bank and technical service providers), which are treated as outsourcing partners. The essential audit activities are to be carried out for the outsourced components of the information network at the outsourcing partners. With these institutions, a transfer of paying agency tasks has been agreed on the basis of responsibilities ordinances, transfer ordinances or other regulations. Based on a federal-state interface model for EU paying agencies coordinated with the Federal Office for Information Security (BSI for short), the outsourcing relationships are essentially differentiated into: 1. Organisational interfaces (S-O): Institutions that perform transferred tasks of approval and control within the business processes of the paying agency and use central paying agency specialist applications within the information network to fulfil tasks, as they do not provide central paying agency specialist applications themselves and do not operate any specific application environments. In Brandenburg, this currently affects: - 14 approval offices (offices for agriculture) in the districts, - the State Forestry Enterprise (LFB), - the Investment Bank of the State of Brandenburg (ILB). 2. Technical interfaces (S-T): Institutions of the technical operation of the central paying agency specialist applications and systems as well as data storage. In Brandenburg, this currently affects: - the central Brandenburg IT service provider (ZIT-BB), - Land Surveying and Basic Geographic Information Brandenburg (LGB) - init AG for the operation of an application procedure. A medium three-digit number of persons work in the information network. Every year, several million euros in a three-digit amount of EU, federal and state funds are administered. The paying agency specialist applications essentially comprise client/server and web applications, for which an IT system landscape consisting of terminal, web, application and database servers is deployed. Use is made by administrative units using virtual clients via the state administration network of the State of Brandenburg. Applicants access the online application systems operated in a demilitarised zone (DMZ) via the internet. In coordination with the client and based on the documentation of the ISMS, the contractor shall draw up and carry out a multi-year audit schedule. The planning and execution of the audits takes place with the participation of the information security officer of the EU paying agency. Based on empirical values, four audits per year are to be carried out with different procedure participants respectively, which should be flexibly retrievable.

parts.source: Das Vorhaben umfasst die Planung und Durchführung von internen Audits und Sicherheitsrevisionen im Bereich der Informationssicherheit zur Aufrechterhaltung des auf Basis vom BSI IT-Grundschutz nach ISO 27001 zertifizierten Informationsverbunds der EU-Zahlstelle Brandenburg-Berlin. Die ISO 27001 Zertifizierung ist ein Nachweis für das unionsrechtliche Zulassungskriterium der "Sicherheit der Informationssysteme" der EU-Zahlstelle (Artikel 1 i.V.m An-hang I Ziffer 3. Buchstabe B der Delegierten Verordnung (EU) Nr. 2022/127) und setzt nach BSI IT-Grundschutz die regelmäßige Durchführung von internen Audits und Sicherheitsrevisionen voraus. Eigene Personalressourcen und Kompetenzen zur Durchführung interner Audits stehen nicht zur Verfügung, weshalb sich gemäß Kapitel 8.3, BSI-Standard 200-1 dazu entschlossen wurde, die Durchführung der Prüfungen an externe Experten zu vergeben. Das zuvor bereits vergebene Vorhaben mit gleichem Projektinhalt läuft im Jahr 2026 aus, weshalb ein mehrjähriges Anschlussvorhaben vergeben wird, um eine kontinuierliche und langfristige interne Auditierung bis 2030 sicherzustellen. Gegenstand des Vorhabens sollen flexibel abrufbare Prüfungsleistungen für den Informationsverbund der EU-Zahlstelle sein, welcher aus den Organisationseinheiten des Ministeriums für Land- und Ernährungswirtschaft, Umwelt und Verbraucherschutz Brandenburg (MLEUV) und dem direkt nachgeordneten Landesamt für Ländliche Entwicklung, Landwirtschaft und Flurneuordnung (LELF) besteht, sowie den weiteren am Zahlstellenverfahren beteiligten Stellen (Landkreise, Landesforstbetrieb, Investitionsbank und technische Dienstleister), welche als Outsourcing-Partner bzw. die dorthin ausgelagerten Bestandteile, die wesentlichen Prüfgegenstände der Prüfungen darstellen sollen. Ausgehend von einer gemeinsam erstellten Prüfplanung sind voraussichtlich vier Prüfungen pro Jahr geplant. Das Vorhaben soll an nachweislich erfahrene Experten im Bereich der Informationssicherheitsrevision oder ISMS-Auditierung nach BSI IT-Grundschutz vergeben werden. Lot LOT-0001: Interne Audits und Sicherheitsrevisionen zur Aufrechterhaltung der Informationssicherheit der EU-Zahlstelle im MLEUV. Der Auftragsgegenstand umfasst die Planung und Durchführung interner Audits und Sicherheitsrevisionen für einen auf Basis von BSI IT-Grundschutz nach ISO 27001 zertifizierten Informationsverbund und dessen beteiligte Outsourcing-Partner. Der zu prüfende Informationsverbund "Operativer Betrieb der EU-Zahlstelle Brandenburg-Berlin" besteht aus den Organisationseinheiten des Ministeriums für Land- und Ernährungswirtschaft, Umwelt und Verbraucherschutz des Landes Brandenburg (MLEUV) und dem direkt nachgeordneten Landesamt für Ländliche Entwicklung, Landwirtschaft und Flurneuordnung (LELF), die die Fachaufgaben der Bewilligung, Kontrolle, Auszahlung, Verbuchung sowie Verwaltung der Außenstände von Fördergeldern des Europäischen Garantiefonds für die Landwirtschaft (EGFL), des Europäischen Landwirtschaftsfonds für die Entwicklung des ländlichen Raums (ELER) und des Europäischen Meeres-, Fischerei- und Aquakulturfonds (EMFAF) wahrnehmen, sowie den weiteren am Zahlstellenverfahren beteiligten Stellen (Landkreise, Landesforstbetrieb, Investitionsbank und technische Dienstleister), welche als Outsourcing-Partner behandelt werden. Die wesentlichen Prüfungshandlungen sind für die ausgelagerten Bestandteile des Informationsverbunds bei den Outsourcing-Partnern durchzuführen. Mit diesen Einrichtungen wurde eine Übertragung von Zahlstellenaufgaben auf Grundlage von Zuständigkeitsverordnungen, Überleitungsverordnungen oder andere Regelungen vereinbart. Die Outsourcing-Beziehungen werden auf Grundlage eines mit dem Bundesamt für Sicherheit in der Informationstechnik (kurz BSI) abgestimmten Bund-Länder-Schnittstellen-Modells für EU-Zahlstellen im Wesentlichen unterschieden in: 1. Organisatorische Schnittstellen (S-O): Einrichtungen, welche übertragene Aufgaben der Bewilligung und Kontrolle innerhalb der Geschäftsprozesse der Zahlstelle wahrnehmen und zur Aufgabenerfüllung zentrale Zahlstellen-Fachanwendungen innerhalb des Informationsverbundes nutzen, da sie selbst keine zentralen Zahlstellen-Fachanwendungen bereitstellen und keine spezifischen Anwendungsumgebungen betreiben. Dies betrifft in Brandenburg aktuell: - 14 Bewilligungsstellen (Ämter für Landwirtschaft) in den Landkreisen, - den Landesbetrieb Forst (LFB), - die Investitionsbank des Landes Brandenburg (ILB). 2. Technische Schnittstellen (S-T): Einrichtungen des technischen Betriebs der zentralen Zahlstelle-Fachanwendungen und Systeme sowie der Datenhaltung. Dies betrifft in Brandenburg aktuell: - den zentralen Brandenburgischen IT-Dienstleister (ZIT-BB), - die Landesvermessung und Geobasisinformation Brandenburg (LGB) - die init AG für den Betrieb eines Antragsverfahrens. Im Informationsverbund sind eine mittlere dreistellige Anzahl an Personen tätig. Jährlich werden mehrere Millionen Euro in dreistelliger Höhe an EU-, Bundes- und Landesmitteln verwaltet. Die Zahlstellen-Fachanwendungen umfassen im Wesentlichen Client/Server- und Webanwendungen, wofür eine die IT-Systemlandschaft bestehend aus Terminal-, Web-, Applikations- und Datenbankserver zum Einsatz kommt. Die Nutzung erfolgt für Verwaltungseinheiten mittels virtueller Clients über das Landesverwaltungsnetz des Landes Brandenburg. Antragsteller greifen auf die in einer demilitarisierten Zone (DMZ) betriebenen Onlineantragssysteme über das Internet zu. Der Aufragnehmer soll in Abstimmung mit dem Aufraggeber und auf Grundlage der Dokumentation des ISMS, eine mehrjährige Prüfplanung vornehmen und durchführen. Die Planung und Durchführung der Prüfungen erfolgt unter Beteiligung des Informationssicherheitsbeauftragen der EU-Zahlstelle. Ausgehend von Erfahrungswerten sind voraussichtlich pro Jahr vier Prüfungen bei jeweils unterschiedlichen Verfahrensbeteiligten durchzuführen, die flexibel aufrufbar sein sollen.

result.text: Fintraffic Tie Oy has previously put out to tender the procurement of VMware software licences via a notice sent for publication on 21.4.2026. Following the tendering process, circumstances have emerged that require the procurement to be re-tendered. This notice re-tenders the procurement of VMware software licences. The subject of the procurement is the VMware licences required by Fintraffic Tie Oy's (hereinafter also "Contracting Authority" and "Subscriber") server virtualisation system run on top of the current roadside technology capacity platform service. The virtualisation system is procured for the virtualised running of traffic management workloads. The licences are used in an environment administered by the Contracting Authority itself in the Contracting Authority's own server rooms. The need for the procurement stems from the fact that the Contracting Authority's entire server virtualisation is based on VMware technology. Approximately 95 % of the Subscriber's servers have been virtualised. The Contracting Authority's current licensing for VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF) has ended upon the expiry of the 02/2026 procurement channel. A condition of the procurement is that the Contracting Authority manages its VMware environment itself from its own server rooms. The Contracting Authority must also have the opportunity to open support requests directly with Broadcom and to use the technical online courses and training materials provided by Broadcom to maintain the expertise of its experts. The aim of the procurement is to procure a partner for the intermediation of licences. The core quantities of the licences to be ordered are stated in Appendix 3 Price Form. The subject of the procurement and its minimum requirements are described in more detail in the appendices of the tender request. Based on the tendering process, the Contracting Authority will select the tenderer that has submitted the most economically advantageous tender, from which orders will be placed. The most economically advantageous tender is considered to be the one with the lowest comparison price. How the comparison price is formed is described in more detail later in the tender request with its appendices. The contract period is fixed-term for a duration of three (3) or five (5) years, after which it will continue until further notice. The maximum value of the contract is 4.000.000 euros. The duration of the fixed-term contract period is determined by which licence package the Contracting Authority decides to choose. See in more detail the section of the tender request "Other information - Grounds for decision-making". The procurement includes, as an additional procurement option, the Contracting Authority's right to procure, if necessary, additional licences mentioned in the licence packages as well as other licences related to Broadcom's products during the contract period at the so-called daily price. The Contracting Authority does not commit to any procurement quantities. The Contracting Authority has the right to change the number of licences to be procured during the contract period.

parts.source: Fintraffic Tie Oy on aiemmin 21.4.2026 julkaistavaksi lähetetyllä ilmoituksella kilpailuttanut VMware-ohjelmistolisenssien hankinnan. Kilpailutuksen jälkeen on ilmennyt seikkoja, jotka edellyttävät hankinnan kilpailuttamista uudelleen. Tällä ilmoituksella kilpailutetaan uudelleen VMware-ohjelmistolisenssien hankinta. Hankinnan kohteena ovat Fintraffic Tie Oy:n (jäljempänä myös "Hankintayksikkö" ja "Tilaaja") nykyisen tienvarsiteknologian kapasiteettialustapalvelun päällä ajettavan palvelinvirtualisaatiojärjestelmän tarvitsemat VMware-lisenssit. Virtualisaatiojärjestelmä hankitaan liikenteenhallinnan työkuormien virtualisoituun ajoon. Lisenssejä käytetään Hankintayksikön itse hallinnoimassa ympäristössä Hankintayksikön omissa konesaleissa. Hankinnan tarve johtuu siitä, että Hankintayksikön koko palvelinvirtualisoinnit perustuvat VMwaren tekniikkaan. Tilaajan palvelimista on virtualisoitu noin 95 %. Hankintayksikön nykyinen lisensiointi VMware Cloud Foundationista (VCF) on päättynyt 02/2026 hankintakanavan umpeutuessa. Hankinnan ehtona on, että Hankintayksikkö hallitsee VMware-ympäristönsä itse omista konesaleistaan käsin. Hankintayksiköllä tulee olla myös mahdollisuus avata tukipyyntöjä suoraan Broadcomille sekä käyttää Broadcomin tarjoamia teknisiä verkkokursseja ja koulutusmateriaaleja asiantuntijoidensa osaamisen ylläpitämiseksi. Hankinnan tavoitteena on hankkia kumppani lisenssien välittämiseen. Tilattavien lisenssien coremäärät on ilmoitettu liitteessä 3 Hintalomake. Hankinnan kohde ja niiden vähimmäisvaatimukset on kuvattu tarkemmin tarjouspyynnön liitteissä. Hankintayksikkö valitsee kilpailutuksen perusteella kokonaistaloudellisesti edullisimman tarjouksen tehneen tarjoajan, jolta tilaukset tehdään. Kokonaistaloudellisesti edullisimpana pidetään tarjousta, joka on vertailuhinnaltaan halvin. Vertailuhinnan muodostuminen on kuvattu tarkemmin jäljempänä tarjouspyynnössä liitteineen. Sopimuskausi on määräaikainen kolmen (3) tai viiden (5) vuoden ajan, jonka jälkeen se jatkuu toistaiseksi voimassa olevana. Sopimuksen enimmäisarvo on 4.000.000 euroa. Määräaikaisen sopimuskauden kesto määräytyy sen mukaan, minkä lisenssipaketin Hankintayksikkö päättää valita. Ks. tarkemmin tarjouspyynnön osio "Muut tiedot - Päätöksenteon perusteet". Hankintaan sisältyy lisähankintamahdollisuutena Hankintayksikön oikeus hankkia tarpeen vaatiessa lisää lisenssipaketeissa mainittuja lisenssejä sekä muita Broadcomin tuotteisiin liittyviä lisenssejä sopimuskauden aikana ns. päivän hinnalla. Hankintayksikkö ei sitoudu mihinkään hankintamääriin. Hankintayksiköllä on oikeus muuttaa hankittavien lisenssien määrää sopimuskauden aikana.

result.text: THIS IS NOT A CONTRACT NOTICE OR A CALL FOR COMPETITION BUT A REQUEST FOR INFORMATION FOR MARKET RESEARCH AND TECHNICAL DIALOGUE. This request for information is used to survey the market and obtain information regarding the procurement. The contracting authority is not initiating a tendering procedure by publishing the request for information; instead, any procurement notice and call for competition will be published later. The request for information does not oblige the contracting authority to carry out the actual procurement. Responding to the request for information is not a prerequisite for participation in a possible later tendering procedure. Suppliers will not be paid compensation for responding to the request for information or participating in market dialogue. Responses given to this request for information will be used in planning the procurement of expert services to support the management of software assets (licence management). Expert assistance is needed flexibly across several different areas. The main user of HUS's centralised licence management system and product responsible persons for different areas maintain information on the most important software rights in a centralised system (Matrix42, SAM tool). In addition, supplier-specific portals are in use. In the planned procurement, the licence experts of the supplier to be procured would analyse and report quarterly on the current situation regarding agreed software rights (e.g. Microsoft, Oracle, Adobe and IBM manufacturers). They would compare information from different supplier portals with information in the centralised SAM tool, observe deficiencies and provide HUS with recommendations related to optimisation and compliance. The supplier should provide SAM Manager expertise, helping to manage valid software contracts. The supplier should advise on products, contract models, software lifecycles and usage rights. In addition, the supplier is hoped to provide support in building the management model for licence management. It is planned to include as an option in the procurement the entry of licence, cost and contract information into the SAM tool by the supplier instead of HUS personnel. HUS-yhtymä is renewing its ITSM system. In connection with this, the integration of licence management as part of this entity will also be evaluated. External expertise will also be needed for this. The purpose of the request for information is to survey suppliers available on the market and their service range. The purpose is to clarify service solutions, pricing principles and the cost level for the budget. HUS-yhtymä requests suppliers interested in the procurement described above to notify the contracting authority of their interest and attach to the response a general description/brochure of the service solution you offer for the need described above. Please note that all material is intended solely for conducting this market dialogue. The contracting authority will treat your response confidentially. Based on the responses to the request for information, clarifying questions may be presented to the supplier and/or an opportunity offered to present their solutions in a manner to be notified later. Suppliers that have responded to the request for information may possibly receive preliminary call for competition documents for comment. Responding or failing to respond to the request for information does not affect the supplier's position in a potential tendering procedure. We ask that responses to the request for information and notifications of interest be submitted no later than 20.3.2026 at 12:00 to the address kilpailutus.ict@hus.fi. The subject of the message should state "HUS 090-2026 - Lisenssienhallinnan asiantuntijapalvelut".

parts.source: TÄMÄ EI OLE HANKINTAILMOITUS TAI TARJOUSPYYNTÖ VAAN TIETOPYYNTÖ MARKKINAKARTOITUSTA JA TEKNISTÄ VUOROPUHELUA VARTEN. Tämän tietopyynnön avulla kartoitetaan markkinoita ja saadaan hankintaa koskevaa tietoa. Hankintayksikkö ei aloita tietopyynnön julkaisulla tarjouskilpailua, vaan mahdollinen hankintailmoitus ja tarjouspyyntö julkaistaan myöhemmin. Tietopyyntö ei velvoita hankintayksikköä toteuttamaan varsinaista hankintaa. Tietopyyntöön vastaaminen ei ole edellytys myöhempään mahdollisesti järjestettävään tarjouskilpailuun osallistumiselle. Toimittajille ei makseta korvausta tietopyyntöön vastaamisesta tai markkinavuoropuheluun osallistumisesta. Tähän tietopyyntöön annettuja vastauksia käytetään suunniteltaessa asiantuntijapalvelun hankintaa ohjelmisto-omaisuuden (lisenssienhallinta) hallinnan tueksi. Asiantuntija-apua tarvitaan joustavasti usealla eri osa-alueella. HUSin keskitetyn lisenssienhallinnan järjestelmän pääkäyttäjä ja eri osa-alueiden tuotevastaavat ylläpitävät tärkeimpien ohjelmisto-oikeuksien tietoja keskitetyssä järjestelmässä (Matrix42, SAM-työkalu). Lisäksi käytössä on toimittajakohtaisia portaaleja. Suunnitellussa hankinnassa kilpailutettavan toimittajan lisenssiasiantuntijat tulisivat analysoimaan ja raportoimaan kvartaaleittain nykytilanteen sovittujen ohjelmisto-oikeuksien osalta (esim. Microsoft, Oracle, Adobe ja IBM –valmistajat). He vertailisivat eri toimittajaportaalien tietoja keskitetyn SAM-työkalun tietoihin, havainnoisivat puutteita ja toimittaisivat HUSille optimointiin ja vaatimuksenmukaisuuteen liittyviä suosituksia. Toimittajan tulisi antaa SAM Manager -osaamista auttaen hallitsemaan voimassa olevia ohjelmistosopimuksia. Toimittajan tulisi neuvoa tuotteissa, sopimusmalleissa, ohjelmistojen elinkaarissa ja käyttöoikeuksissa. Lisäksi toimittajan toivotaan antavan tukeaan lisenssienhallinnan hallintamallin rakentamisessa. Hankintaan on suunniteltu sisällytettävän optiona myös lisenssitietojen lisenssi-, kustannus- ja sopimustietojen syöttö SAM-työkaluun HUSlaisten sijasta. HUS-yhtymä on uusimassa ITSM-järjestelmäänsä. Siihen liittyen tulee arvioitavaksi myös lisenssienhallinnan liittäminen osaksi tätä kokonaisuutta. Tähän tullaan tarvitsemaan myös ulkopuolista asiantuntemusta. Tietopyynnön tarkoituksena on kartoittaa markkinoilla olevia toimittajia sekä heidän palveluvalikoimaansa. Tarkoituksena on selvittää palveluratkaisuja, hinnoitteluperiaatteita ja kustannustasoa budjettia varten. HUS-yhtymä pyytää edellä kuvatusta hankinnasta kiinnostuneita toimittajia ilmoittamaan kiinnostuksensa hankintayksikölle sekä liittämään vastaukseen yleisluontoisen kuvauksen/esitteen tarjoamastanne palveluratkaisusta edellä kuvattuun tarpeeseen. Pyydämme huomioimaan, että kaikki materiaali on tarkoitettu ainoastaan tämän markkinavuoropuhelun käymiseen. Hankintayksikkö käsittelee vastauksenne luottamuksellisesti. Tietopyynnön vastausten perusteella saatetaan toimittajalle esittää tarkentavia kysymyksiä ja/tai tarjota mahdollisuus esitellä ratkaisujaan myöhemmin ilmoitettavalla tavalla. Tietopyyntöön vastanneet toimittajat saavat mahdollisesti kommentoitavakseen alustavat tarjouspyyntöasiakirjat. Tietopyyntöön vastaaminen tai vastaamatta jättäminen ei vaikuta toimittajan asemaan mahdollisessa tarjouskilpailussa. Pyydämme toimittamaan vastaukset tietopyyntöön ja ilmoittamaan kiinnostuksestanne viimeistään 20.3.2026 klo 12:00 mennessä osoitteeseen kilpailutus.ict@hus.fi. Viestin aiheeksi maininta "HUS 090-2026 - Lisenssienhallinnan asiantuntijapalvelut".

result.text: Intro and purpose: The European Free Trade Association (EFTA) is issuing this Request for Information (RFI) to identify potential technology vendors and solutions for replacing the current Case, Records, and Document Management system. This RFI is intended to gather information about available solutions and suppliers to inform the development of a Request for Proposal (RFP) expected to launch in March 2026. We invite technology vendors with relevant expertise to provide information about their solutions, implementation approaches, and experience with similar organizations. Responses to this RFI will help EFTA better understand the current market landscape and refine our requirements for the formal procurement process. This RFI is for informational purposes only and does not constitute a commitment by EFTA to issue an RFP or award a contract. About EFTA: The European Free Trade Association is an intergovernmental organization established in 1960 to promote free trade and economic integration between its member states: Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway, and Switzerland. EFTA manages various trade agreements, including the European Economic Area (EEA) Agreement, which allows three of its members to participate in the EU's single market. The EFTA Secretariat operates across three locations: Geneva (headquarters), Brussels, and Luxembourg. With approximately [staff number] personnel, the Secretariat supports Member States in promoting free trade and economic integration through six operational divisions. Our work requires comprehensive document, records, and case management capabilities to support trade facilitation, legal, and administrative functions across multiple duty stations and in collaboration with external stakeholders in Member State ministries.

result.text: Fife Council requires a modern, accessible, and user-friendly website to serve as a central hub for communication, information sharing, and engagement with our stakeholders, including residents, businesses, and visitors. The existing website is due for replacement, and we are seeking a new supplier to work alongside Fife Council’s internal web team to design and build, as well as host and support, a high-quality, secure, and scalable website. result.text: The subject of the contract is a research and development project for the investigation and further development of AI-supported methods for side-channel analysis of cryptographic implementations. The focus is in particular on post-quantum cryptographic procedures as well as, as a reference, symmetric procedures (e.g. AES) on microcontroller and FPGA platforms. The contractor shall set up a measurement/test environment, select or generate data sets (current/EM, where applicable multimodal) and investigate robust model architectures, trace compression, test-time tuning as well as suitable evaluation metrics and workflows for reproducible evaluations. Optionally, approaches for the auto-formalisation of selected security proofs are examined as examples. Deliverables include reports and presentations, executive summaries, a practice-oriented guide, data sets, source code as well as an extended software toolbox incl. installation instructions, user manual and a short quick-start tutorial. result.text: Making available to the Department of Health of a telephone customer service platform using intelligent virtual assistants, with certification as a medical device complying with European MDR class IIb regulations. Making the platform available will include implementation services, platform configuration, integration with the necessary information systems of the CS, configuration and commissioning of the three use cases (demand management in primary care, chronic patient monitoring and discharged patient monitoring), scaled deployment across all sites and maintenance of the supplied platform. The telephone customer service platform using intelligent virtual assistants must include: Initial platform configuration services (implementation and technical and functional commissioning), including parameterisation of conversational protocols, integration with the corporate information systems of the Department of Health and technical validation of the care flows for the three included use cases: attending to demand management in primary care, carrying out complex chronic patient monitoring and carrying out discharged patient monitoring. Services for the progressive deployment of the platform's call coverage in all primary care centres and hospitals dependent on the CS that are operational on the contract start date, as well as in those that are incorporated during the execution period thereof, without this implying any variation in the offered price. Corrective, evolutionary and adaptive support and maintenance services throughout the term of the contract. Technical support shall be 24x7 for the resolution of priority 1 incidents.

parts.source: Puesta a disposición de la Conselleria de Sanidad de una plataforma de atención telefónica mediante asistentes virtuales inteligentes, con certificación como dispositivo médico cumpliendo con la normativa europea MDR clase IIb. La puesta a disposición de la plataforma incluirá servicios de implantación, configuración de la plataforma, integración con los sistemas de información necesarios de la CS, configuración y puesta en marcha de los tres casos de uso (gestión de la demanda en atención primaria, seguimiento de crónicos y seguimiento de pacientes al alta), despliegue escalado en todas las sedes y mantenimiento de la plataforma suministrada. La plataforma de atención telefónica mediante asistentes virtuales inteligentes deberá incluir: Servicios de configuración inicial de la plataforma (implantación y puesta en marcha técnica y funcional), incluyendo parametrización de protocolos conversacionales, integración con los sistemas de información corporativos de la Conselleria de Sanidad y validación técnica de los flujos asistenciales para los tres casos de uso incluidos: atender la gestión de la demanda en atención primaria, realizar el seguimiento de pacientes crónicos complejos y realizar el seguimiento de pacientes al alta. Servicios de despliegue progresivo de cobertura de llamadas de la plataforma en todos los centros de atención primaria y hospitales dependientes de la CS que se encuentren en funcionamiento en la fecha de inicio del contrato, así como en aquellos que se incorporen durante el período de ejecución del mismo, sin que ello suponga variación del precio ofertado. Servicios de soporte y mantenimiento correctivo, evolutivo y adaptativo durante toda la vigencia del contrato. El soporte técnico será 24x7 para la resolución de incidencias de prioridad 1.

The arrangement of these individual call-offs is regulated in Appendix 3 framework agreement (see section 2 of the framework agreement). --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- A framework agreement is to be concluded between IB.SH and three service companies. The framework agreement regulates commissions placed on the one hand by IB.SH and comprising the following services: ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Description of activities: • Support for the client in technical and technical-organisational matters of IT security / cyber security based on the strategies, policies, roles and responsibilities specified by the client; the list of services is not exhaustive. • Elaboration, concretisation, updating and monitoring of technical IT security standards, technical specifications, operating processes, runbooks and implementation guidelines within the framework of existing internal specifications. • Risk-based assessment, classification and implementation support of technical IT security requirements from operations, change management, projects, architecture, service provider management, regulatory requirements and internal guidelines. • Support for technical IT security, digital operational resilience, recovery and restoration capability and continuity of critical IT services, including technical preparatory work for scenario analyses, emergency exercises, alternative procedures, fallback/exit scenarios and measure tracking. • Initiation, evaluation, implementation and tracking of operational security measures for IT infrastructures, applications, platforms, end devices and operating environments, including on-premises, private cloud, public cloud, hybrid cloud, multi-cloud as well as SaaS/PaaS/IaaS environments. • Coordination, evaluation and further development of technical security architectures, inter alia network and zone concepts, segmentation, firewalling, encryption, PKI, DNSSEC, proxy/gateway services, IAM/PAM, endpoint security, server/client hardening, cloud, container/Kubernetes and API security as well as secure administration models. • Initiation, support, evaluation and tracking of vulnerability analyses, penetration tests, technical security reviews, configuration and hardening checks, readiness checks as well as red/purple team or comparable technical security exercises. • Monitoring and evaluation of external reports on vulnerabilities, threats, attack patterns and security-relevant industry developments as well as derivation, support and documentation of technical measures. • Support with security monitoring, logging, detection and response, in particular for SIEM/SOC requirements, log source onboarding, use case design, alert tuning, detection engineering, SOC provider management, triage processes, playbooks, escalation paths and security-related reporting. • Technical support for handling, containment, analysis, documentation and follow-up of IT security incidents including interfaces to incident, problem, change, emergency and service provider management. • Technical-professional control, evaluation and tracking of service provider reports, security proofs, action plans, audit findings and audit points. • Maintenance, updating and quality assurance of technical IT security documentation, runbooks, control descriptions, verification documentation and technical security concepts. • Technical-professional preparatory work for inspections, audits, revisions and regulatory proofs; the performance of original inspection, audit or control functions is not covered by this. • Support for the data protection officer in technical questions as well as coordination and cooperation with the information security officer / information security management • Carrying out awareness-raising measures for employees on the subject of IT security • Proactive identification, evaluation and target-group-oriented preparation of technical IT security topics within the client's area of responsibility. --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- The support services specifically required by IB.SH will be called off taking into account the work and project situation, qualification and availability in the context of mini-competitions. The arrangement of these individual call-offs is regulated in the framework agreement (see section 2 of the framework agreement).

parts.source: Die Investitionsbank Schleswig-Holstein (IB.SH) das zentrale Förderinstitut des Landes mit derzeit knapp 900 Mitarbeitern und Mitarbeiterinnen sucht drei Rahmenvertragspartner als IT-Dienstleister für die Erbringung von IT-Unterstützungsleistungen im Bereich der IT-Security. --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Es ist der Abschluss, der in den Unterlagen als Anlage 1 beigefügten Rahmenvereinbarung, der Vereinbarung zur Auftragsverarbeitung mit den drei Bietern, die die Mindestkriterien erfüllen und Plätze 1-3 belegen, beabsichtigt. --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Die von der IB.SH konkret benötigten Unterstützungsleistungen werden unter Berücksichtigung der Arbeits- und Projektsituation, Qualifikation, Verfügbarkeit im Rahmen von Mini- Wettbewerben abgerufen. Die Gestaltung dieser Einzelabrufe ist in der Anlage 3 Rahmenvereinbarung geregelt (s. § 2 der Rahmenvereinbarung). --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Zwischen der IB.SH und drei Dienstleistungsunternehmen soll eine Rahmenvereinbarung geschlossen werden. Die Rahmenvereinbarung regelt Beauftragungen, die einerseits durch die IB.SH erfolgen und die folgenden Leistungen umfassen: ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Tätigkeitsbeschreibung: • Unterstützung des Auftraggebers in technischen und technisch-organisatorischen Belangen der IT-Security / Cyber Security auf Grundlage der durch den Auftraggeber vorgegebenen Strategien, Policies, Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten; die Aufzählung der Leistungen ist nicht abschließend. • Erarbeitung, Konkretisierung, Aktualisierung und Überwachung technischer IT-Security-Standards, technischer Vorgaben, Betriebsprozesse, Runbooks und Umsetzungsrichtlinien im Rahmen bestehender interner Vorgaben. • Risikobasierte Bewertung, Klassifizierung und Umsetzungsbegleitung technischer IT-Security-Anforderungen aus Betrieb, Change Management, Projekten, Architektur, Dienstleistersteuerung, regulatorischen Anforderungen und internen Richtlinien. • Unterstützung bei technischer IT-Sicherheit, digitaler operationaler Resilienz, Wiederanlauf- und Wiederherstellungsfähigkeit sowie Fortführbarkeit kritischer IT-Services, einschließlich technischer Zuarbeit zu Szenarioanalysen, Notfallübungen, Ersatzverfahren, Fallback-/Exit-Szenarien und Maßnahmen-Tracking. • Initiierung, Bewertung, Umsetzung und Nachverfolgung betrieblicher Sicherheitsmaßnahmen für IT-Infrastrukturen, Anwendungen, Plattformen, Endgeräte und Betriebsumgebungen, einschließlich On-Premises-, Private-Cloud-, Public-Cloud-, Hybrid-Cloud-, Multi-Cloud- sowie SaaS-/PaaS-/IaaS-Umgebungen. • Abstimmung, Bewertung und Weiterentwicklung technischer Sicherheitsarchitekturen, u. a. Netzwerk- und Zonenkonzepte, Segmentierung, Firewalling, Verschlüsselung, PKI, DNSSEC, Proxy-/Gateway-Dienste, IAM/PAM, Endpoint Security, Server-/Client-Härtung, Cloud-, Container-/Kubernetes- und API-Security sowie sichere Administrationsmodelle. • Veranlassung, Begleitung, Bewertung und Nachverfolgung von Schwachstellenanalysen, Penetrationstests, technischen Security Reviews, Konfigurations- und Härtungsprüfungen, Readiness Checks sowie Red-/Purple-Team- oder vergleichbaren technischen Sicherheitsübungen. • Beobachtung und Bewertung externer Meldungen zu Schwachstellen, Bedrohungen, Angriffsmustern und sicherheitsrelevanten Branchenentwicklungen sowie Ableitung, Begleitung und Dokumentation technischer Maßnahmen. • Unterstützung bei Security Monitoring, Logging, Detection und Response, insbesondere bei SIEM-/SOC-Anforderungen, Log-Source-Onboarding, Use-Case-Design, Alert-Tuning, Detection Engineering, SOC-Provider-Steuerung, Triage-Prozessen, Playbooks, Eskalationswegen und sicherheitsbezogenem Reporting. • Technische Unterstützung bei Behandlung, Eindämmung, Analyse, Dokumentation und Nachbereitung von IT-Sicherheitsvorfällen einschließlich Schnittstellen zu Incident-, Problem-, Change-, Notfall- und Dienstleistermanagement. • Fachlich-technische Kontrolle, Bewertung und Nachverfolgung von Dienstleisterreports, Sicherheitsnachweisen, Maßnahmenplänen, Prüfungsfeststellungen und Revisionspunkten. • Pflege, Aktualisierung und Qualitätssicherung technischer IT-Security-Dokumentationen, Runbooks, Kontrollbeschreibungen, Nachweisdokumentationen und technischen Sicherheitskonzepten. • Fachlich-technische Zuarbeit bei Prüfungen, Audits, Revisionen und regulatorischen Nachweisen; die Durchführung originärer Prüfungs-, Revisions- oder Kontrollfunktionen ist hiervon nicht umfasst. • Unterstützung des Datenschutzbeauftragten in technischen Fragestellungen sowie Abstimmung und Zusammenarbeit mit dem Informationssicherheitsbeauftragten / Informationssicherheitsmanagement • Durchführung von Sensibilisierungsmaßnahmen für Mitarbeiter zum Thema IT-Sicherheit • Proaktive Identifikation, Bewertung und adressatengerechte Aufbereitung technischer IT-Security-Themen im Zuständigkeitsbereich des Auftraggebers. --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Die von der IB.SH konkret benötigten Unterstützungsleistungen werden unter Berücksichtigung der Arbeits- und Projektsituation, Qualifikation, Verfügbarkeit im Rahmen von Mini- Wettbewerben abgerufen. Die Gestaltung dieser Einzelabrufe ist in der Rahmenvereinbarung geregelt (s. § 2 der Rahmenvereinbarung).

result.text: As part of a market survey, BGB-Gesellschaft der Rechtsanwaltskammern Berlin, Bremen, Düsseldorf, Frankfurt am Main, Hamburg, Hamm, Köln, München, Nürnberg, Sachsen und Stuttgart (hereinafter the Purchaser) wishes to enquire about current providers on the market and available solutions for a new management system. After completion of the market survey, the results will be evaluated for the next project steps and for a potentially intended procurement procedure. As part of the market survey, interested companies are invited to participate in discussions and present their solution portfolio. The procedure can be found in the following explanations. The subject of the market survey is the evaluation of possible solutions for a new management system. The sought-after management system should cover the following rough functional modules and exemplary use cases: 1. Personnel management o Management of natural and legal persons (different person types) o Manage training occupations o Manage trainees o Manage reference relationships between persons 2. Billing o Record and calculate membership fee data o Carry out membership fee billing o Create new fees/credits o Bill fees/credits o Manage outgoing invoice ledger 3. Complaint management / Case management o Create complaint/case o Manage complaint/case o Manage complaint/case overview 4. Archiving and deletion o Archive and delete data records o Search archived data records 5. Administration o Manage roles and permissions Participation in the market survey: 1. To participate in the market survey, we ask you to send us appointment proposals (approx. 1 hour) by email to florian.blauensteiner@reqpool.com or to markus.mycinski@reqpool.com by 26.09.2025 at 13:00. For appointment proposals received later, we cannot guarantee that participation is still possible. 2. During the appointment, we would like to talk about your solution portfolio. In addition, you can send us a presentation of your existing solution. The following three aspects are particularly important to us: • Price structure / licensing model • Expandability or possibility for software adjustments • Existing references 3. It is expressly emphasised that, beyond the publication of this preliminary information, companies will also be invited independently to participate in the market survey. This enables the implementation of a broad and transparent market survey and does not prevent other interested parties from participating in this market research. 4. The Purchaser reserves the right not to invite all companies to market survey discussions. In this case, there is the possibility to participate in the market survey in text form. Notes on the procedure: 1. The market survey discussions will be conducted in German. 2. There are no costs associated with your participation in this market survey. No costs will be reimbursed for your expenses incurred. 3. It is expressly pointed out that this is a preparatory market survey and not the award of a public contract. 4. The legal recourse to review bodies is not available within the framework of this procedure. 5. Participation in the market survey does not constitute a prerequisite for later participation in a possible procurement procedure. 6. The Purchaser reserves the right to change or adapt the performance requirements discussed in the market survey in a potentially later procurement procedure. 7. Participation in the market survey does not give rise to any claim for the implementation of a procurement procedure or the award of a public contract. 8. It cannot yet be communicated whether and when a tender will be initiated. Furthermore, no statement can yet be made about possible types of procedure.

parts.source: Im Rahmen einer Markterkundung möchte sich die BGB-Gesellschaft der Rechtsanwaltskammern Berlin, Bremen, Düsseldorf, Frankfurt am Main, Hamburg, Hamm, Köln, München, Nürnberg, Sachsen und Stuttgart (im Folgenden Beschaffer) über aktuelle Anbieter am Markt und verfügbare Lösungen für ein neues Verwaltungssystem erkundigen. Nach Abschluss der Markterkundung werden die Ergebnisse für die nächsten Projektschritte und für ein ggfs. beabsichtigtes Vergabeverfahren evaluiert. Im Rahmen der Markterkundung sind interessierte Unternehmen eingeladen, an Gesprächen teilzunehmen und ihr Lösungsportfolio vorzustellen. Der Ablauf kann den folgenden Ausführungen entnommen werden. Gegenstand der Markterkundung ist die Evaluierung möglicher Lösungen für ein neues Verwaltungssystem. Das gesuchte Verwaltungssystem soll folgende grobe Funktionsmodule und beispielhafte Anwendungsfälle abdecken: 1. Personenverwaltung o Verwaltung natürlicher und juristischer Personen (verschiedene Personentypen) o Ausbildungsberufe verwalten o Auszubildende verwalten o Referenzbeziehungen zwischen Personen verwalten 2. Abrechnung o Mitgliedsbeitragsdaten erfassen und berechnen o Mitgliedsbeitragsabrechnung durchführen o Neue Gebühren/Gutschriften anlegen o Gebühren/Gutschriften abrechnen o Rechnungsausgangsbuch verwalten 3. Beschwerdeverwaltung / Vorgangsverwaltung o Beschwerde/Vorgang anlegen o Beschwerde/Vorgang verwalten o Beschwerde-/Vorgangsübersicht verwalten 4. Archivierung und Löschung o Datensätze archivieren und löschen o Archivierte Datensätze durchsuchen 5. Administration o Rollen und Berechtigungen verwalten Teilnahme an der Markterkundung: 1. Um an der Markterkundung teilzunehmen, bitten wir Sie, uns Terminvorschläge (ca. 1 Stunde) per Mail an florian.blauensteiner@reqpool.com oder an markus.mycinski@reqpool.com bis zum 26.09.2025 um 13:00 Uhr zukommen zu lassen. Bei später eingehenden Terminvorschlägen können wir nicht zusichern, dass eine Teilnahme noch möglich ist. 2. Im Rahmen des Termins möchten wir über Ihr Lösungsportfolio sprechen. Zusätzlich können Sie uns eine Präsentation Ihrer bestehenden Lösung zukommen lassen. Insbesondere folgende drei Aspekte sind für uns wichtig: • Preisstruktur / Lizenzmodell • Erweiterbarkeit bzw. Möglichkeit für Anpassungen der Software • Vorhandene Referenzen 3. Es wird ausdrücklich hervorgehoben, dass über die Veröffentlichung der gegenständlichen Vorinformation hinaus auch eigenständig Unternehmen zur Teilnahme an der Markterkundung einladen werden. Dies ermöglicht die Umsetzung einer breiten und transparenten Markterkundung und hindert aber nicht, weitere Interessenten an dieser Marktrecherche teilzunehmen. 4. Der Beschaffer behält sich vor, nicht alle Unternehmen zu Markterkundungsgesprächen einzuladen. In diesem Fall besteht die Möglichkeit, sich in Textform an der Markterkundung zu beteiligen. Hinweise zum Ablauf: 1. Die Markterkundungsgespräche werden in deutscher Sprache durchgeführt. 2. Mit der Teilnahme an dieser Markterkundung sind für Sie keine Kosten verbunden. Für Ihre entstehenden Aufwände werden keine Kosten erstattet. 3. Es wird ausdrücklich darauf hingewiesen, dass es sich hierbei um eine vorbereitende Markterkundung und nicht um die Vergabe eines öffentlichen Auftrags handelt. 4. Der Rechtsweg zu den Nachprüfungsinstanzen ist im Rahmen dieses Verfahrens nicht eröffnet. 5. Die Teilnahme an der Markterkundung stellt keine Voraussetzung für eine spätere Teilnahme an einem möglichen Vergabeverfahren dar. 6. Der Beschaffer behält sich vor, die in der Markterkundung diskutierten Leistungsanforderungen bei einem ggfs. späteren Vergabeverfahren zu ändern oder anzupassen. 7. Es entsteht durch die Teilnahme an der Markterkundung kein Anspruch auf die Durchführung eines Vergabeverfahrens oder die Erteilung eines öffentlichen Auftrags. 8. Es kann noch nicht mitgeteilt werden, ob und wann eine Ausschreibung eingeleitet wird. Zudem kann noch keine Aussage über mögliche Verfahrensarten getroffen werden.

result.text: The Maritime and Coastguard Agency (MCA) intends to undertake preliminary market engagement (PME) to consult with suppliers in relation to the MCA’s next generation procurement of its Command and Control Programme (C2P). The C2P aims to improve resilience, interoperability, situational awareness, and support for maritime incident management, pollution response and front-line search and rescue operations. The MCA’s vision is to create a modern, resilient and insight led capability that harnesses technology, improves decision making, strengthens operational performance, and delivers better outcomes for those we serve. The MCA’s objectives for the PME are: • help shape its requirements and specification; • understand available solutions and potential delivery approaches; • understand opportunities and innovation opportunities; • understand perceived risks and constraints; • alert the market of the upcoming opportunity and provide the likely role and responsibilities of the next generation C2P partner(s); • develop its approach to the procurement; • identify suppliers that may be able to deliver the C2P and understand capacity in the market; • gauge the level of market interest; • elicit feedback on the MCA’s objectives and programme to assist the MCA to refine its approach. The MCA reserves the right to amend any of the information contained within any of the PME materials and documents prior to the publication of the Tender Notice and commencement of any procurement process. result.text: The Management Directorate of WDR intends to conclude a framework agreement for consultancy, design and technical support services for the "Business Warehouse" project. The project is designed as a multi-year transformation and implementation project. The aim of the project is the functional design and gradual introduction of an integrated management model that combines strategic planning, resource allocation, portfolio and performance assessment, and transparency regarding resources, costs and impact. The project thus serves to further develop WDR's company-wide management capability. The contractor shall support the project from detailed design through the implementation phase to going live and the transition to regular operations. The subject matter of this call for competition is exclusively consultancy services, functional design and the technical support of the project across all project phases. The functional design and support of the technical implementation as well as the translation of functional requirements into implementable process, data and system requirements are also expected. Technical implementation and software development itself are not the subject of this call for competition. The contract is tendered as a framework agreement without an obligation to purchase. The contract term is 27 months from the start of services; WDR receives the option to extend the contract once by a further year. The estimated call-off volume is approx. 350 person-days; the maximum volume is 400 person-days. Upon reaching the maximum volume, the possibility of further call-offs from the framework agreement ends. The estimated call-off volume does not entail any obligation on the part of WDR to call off services to this extent.

parts.source: Die Verwaltungsdirektion des WDR beabsichtigt, einen Rahmenvertrag über Beratungs-, Konzeptions- und fachliche Begleitleistungen für das Projekt "Business Warehouse" abzuschließen. Das Vorhaben ist als mehrjähriges Transformations- und Umsetzungsprojekt angelegt. Ziel des Projekts ist die fachliche Konzeption und schrittweise Einführung eines integrierten Steuerungsmodells, das strategische Planung, Mittelallokation, Portfolio- und Performancebetrachtung sowie Transparenz über Ressourcen, Kosten und Wirkung miteinander verknüpft. Das Vorhaben dient damit der Weiterentwicklung der unternehmensweiten Steuerungsfähigkeit des WDR. Der Auftragnehmer begleitet das Vorhaben von der Feinkonzeption über die Umsetzungsphase bis zur Produktivsetzung und dem Übergang in den Regelbetrieb. Gegenstand dieser Ausschreibung sind ausschließlich Beratungsleistungen, die fachliche Konzeption sowie die fachliche Begleitung des Projekts über alle Projektphasen hinweg. Erwartet wird auch die fachliche Konzeption und Begleitung der technischen Umsetzung sowie die Übersetzung fachlicher Anforderungen in umsetzbare Prozess-, Daten- und Systemanforderungen. Die technische Implementierung und Softwareentwicklung selbst sind nicht Gegenstand dieser Ausschreibung. Der Auftrag wird als Rahmenvertrag ohne Abnahmeverpflichtung ausgeschrieben. Die Vertragslaufzeit beträgt 27 Monate ab Leistungsbeginn; der WDR erhält die Option, den Ver-trag einmalig um ein weiteres Jahr zu verlängern. Die geschätzte Abrufmenge beträgt ca. 350 Personentage; die Höchstmenge beträgt 400 Personentage. Mit Erreichen der Höchstmenge endet die Möglichkeit weiterer Abrufe aus dem Rahmenvertrag. Aus der geschätzten Abrufmenge folgt keine Verpflichtung des WDR, Leistungen in diesem Umfang abzurufen.

result.text: DESCRIPTION OF THE PROCUREMENT VR-Group Plc (“VR” or the “Contracting Entity”) is procuring a modern, SaaS-based HR solution to replace its current HRM systems in Finland and Sweden. The solution must provide a secure, reliable, and scalable platform for more than 10 000 employees globally, support country-specific requirements, and enable expansion into additional countries if needed, without major customization. VR is seeking a robust, scalable, and future-ready HR solution delivered as a single, integrated product. The solution will serve as VR’s central employment management platform and provide a reliable, secure, and consistent source of personnel and employment information throughout the employee lifecycle. The solution must enable VR to standardize and streamline core HR processes, reduce fragmented systems and manual work, improve data quality, and support efficient collaboration between HR, payroll, managers, employees, and other relevant stakeholders. The scope of this procurement is limited to the acquisition of the technology, including the HR SaaS solution and the necessary user licences. The implementation of the solution and the related support and maintenance services will be subject to a separate procurement procedure to be conducted after the technology provider has been selected. Thus, the selected HR technology must have a strong partner ecosystem in Finland and Sweden to enable competitive procurement. The new SaaS-based HR solution must include secure, enterprise-grade AI capabilities with appropriate governance and human oversight. The provider must also demonstrate continuous and substantial annual investment in product development. OBJECTIVES OF THE MARKET DIALOGUE VR is conducting a market dialogue to obtain specific, substantiated, and commercially relevant input on the planned procurement scope, requirements and delivery model. VR also seeks verifiable evidence of the solution’s impact on employee experience and customer satisfaction, supported by clearly defined metrics, comparable customer results, and independent research or third-party assessments. Participants must provide concrete, evidence-based responses and clearly distinguish between: - Standard, generally available product capabilities - Configurable functionality - AI capabilities currently in production - AI capabilities planned on the committed product roadmap - Partner-delivered services - Functionality requiring customization The purpose is to ensure that the procurement reflects proven market capabilities, supports VR’s strategic objectives, and enables genuine and effective competition. VR may use the results to refine the procurement scope, mandatory requirements, evaluation criteria, contractual framework, and subsequent tendering process. PRELIMINARY SCHEDULE - Market dialogue in September-October 2026 - Publication of the invitation to tender in November-December 2026 - Evaluation of the tenders and contract award in December 2026 - February 2027 - Contract period starts in November 2027 ADDITIONAL INFORMATION This notice is a request for information. It is not a contract notice or a call for tenders. The request for information includes an invitation to participate in a market dialogue. All interested suppliers are invited to participate in technical discussions with the Contracting Entity concerning the planned procurement. The purpose of the dialogue is to discuss the procurement at a general level and to obtain market feedback on the proposed scope and definition of the procurement. Discussion are held mainly as a written market dialogue rounds. Interested suppliers will be provided with preliminary procurement materials and/or questions for review and comments. The Contracting Entity may organize also joint market dialogue sessions and individual meetings with interested suppliers. Suppliers interested in participating in the market dialogue are requested to submit their expression of interest via the link:https://forms.cloud.microsoft/e/ZSEbHcb4b6 no later than 30th of September 2026 at 12:00 noon (Finnish time). Participation in the market dialogue does not oblige the Contracting Entity to proceed with the procurement, nor does it oblige suppliers to participate in any subsequent tendering procedure. Non-participation in the market dialogue does not prohibit supplier to submit a tender in the subsequent tendering procedure. The Contracting Entity reserves the right to amend the scope, content, procurement model, schedule and market dialogue process during the preparation of the procurement. No compensation will be paid to suppliers for participating in the market dialogue or for providing comments.

result.text: RVK is a modern transport company that has been under municipal ownership since 1996. The company was formed in 1976 from a merger of the railway and postal bus services. The transport area extends across the Rheinisch-Bergischer district, the left-bank Rhein-Sieg district, the Euskirchen district and the cities of Cologne, Bonn, Leverkusen, Hürth, Brühl and Wesseling. RVK thus connects urban conurbations with sparsely populated, more rural areas. With capacity, competence and many years of experience, RVK ensures that people in the region are on the move reliably and safely – and in an environmentally friendly, sustainable and innovative way. The RVK bus fleet comprises over 600 vehicles, some of which are operated by the company itself and some of which operate on behalf of RVK. The transport network comprises 132 lines with a total length of 2.595 km. In addition, 58 lines are operated by RVK for other transport companies. In total, RVK provides a mileage of approx. 22,6 million km with approx. 23 million passengers annually. Most of the RVK buses are already equipped with TFT interior displays. However, as not all buses have TFT monitors, RVK is procuring at least 100 additional 29 inch TFT interior displays (and up to a total of 350 TFT interior displays) for use in public transport vehicles via a framework agreement. Das Verkehrsgebiet erstreckt sich über den Rheinisch-Bergischen Kreis, den linksrheinischer Rhein-Sieg-Kreis, den Kreis Euskirchen und die Städte Köln, Bonn, Leverkusen, Hürth, Brühl und Wesseling. Mit Kapazität, Kompetenz und langjähriger Erfahrung sorgt die RVK dafür, dass die Menschen in der Region zuverlässig und sicher unterwegs sind – und das umweltschonend, nachhaltig und innovativ. result.text: The tender process comprises a contract for the contracting authority's procurement of the supply, implementation, operation, maintenance and support of an enterprise resource planning (ERP) system. The procurement of an enterprise resource planning system is part of the contracting authority's new strategy to create a greater degree of uniformity in the IT area across the contracting authority's organisation with a view to realising both financial and quality benefits. "Uniformity" does not mean that all units in the organisation must use identical solutions, but that IT decisions are made on the basis of common principles, procedures and guidelines. In this way, coherence, standardisation where possible, and flexibility where necessary are ensured. The purpose of procuring a new ERP system is thus to achieve a higher degree of standardisation and harmonisation of processes across the organisation. This is intended to ensure simpler workflows, reduced complexity and more cost-effective operation. The contracting authority wishes the new ERP system to offer modern technological capabilities, including support for machine learning (ML), artificial intelligence (AI) and other tools that can contribute to increased automation and decision support. Likewise, easy access to new functionality via ongoing upgrades is a central requirement, so that the organisation can quickly exploit new opportunities without extensive customisation. The ERP system must function as the central core of the organisation's transaction layer, where all significant data and processes are collected and handled. This is intended to ensure data consistency, transparency and support an integrated ecosystem of surrounding applications. The annual value of the contract is estimated at three (3) million DKK excl. VAT. In addition, there is a one-off implementation with an expected cost of three (3) million DKK excl. VAT. The duration of the contract is set at 10 years, which gives a total estimated contract value of 33 million DKK excl. VAT. The total volume is indicative only and based on historical data and can therefore not be considered a guarantee of future turnover.

parts.source: Udbudsprocessen omfatter en kontrakt til Ordregivers anskaffelse af levering, implementering, drift, vedligeholdelse og support af enterprise ressource planning (ERP) system. Anskaffelsen af et enterprise ressource planning system er et led i Ordregivers nye strategi om at skabe en større grad af ensartethed på it-området på tværs af Ordregivers organisation med henblik på at realisere både økonomiske og kvalitetsmæssige fordele. ”Ensartethed” betyder ikke, at alle enheder i organisationen skal anvende identiske løsninger, men at it-beslutninger træffes på baggrund af fælles principper, procedurer og retningslinjer. På den måde sikres sammenhæng, standardisering hvor det er muligt, og fleksibilitet hvor det er nødvendigt. Formålet med en anskaffelse af et nyt ERP-system er således at opnå en højere grad at standardisering og harmonisering af processer på tværs af organisationen. Dette skal sikre enklere arbejdsgange, reduceret kompleksitet og en mere omkostningseffektiv drift. Ordregiver ønsker, at det nye ERP-system tilbyder tidssvarende teknologiske muligheder, herunder understøttelse af maskinlæring (ML), kunstig intelligens (AI) og andre værktøjer, der kan bidrage til øget automatisering og beslutningsstøtte. Ligeledes er let adgang til ny funktionalitet via løbende opgraderinger et centralt ønske, så organisationen hurtigt kan udnytte nye muligheder uden omfattende tilpasninger. ERP-systemet skal fungere som den centrale kerne i organisationens transaktionslag, hvor alle væsentlige data og processer samles og håndteres. Dette skal sikre datakonsistens, transparens og understøtte et integreret økosystem af omkringliggende applikationer. Den årlige værdi af kontrakten er anslået til tre (3) millioner DKK ekskl. moms. Hertil kommer en engangsimplementering med en forventet omkostning på tre (3) millioner DKK ekskl. moms. result.text: Background Many developing countries and emerging economies are negatively impacted by trade constraints resulting from red tape in the form of complicated customs documents, import surveillance and border procedures that lack transparency. High transaction costs make it difficult for them to tap into global value chains and make their businesses less competitive. Many enterprises are thereby denied opportunities to grow through trade. In 2017, the World Trade Organization"s (WTO) Trade Facilitation Agreement (TFA) entered into force with the objective to simplify, modernize and harmonize export and import processes in order to facilitate the cross-border movements of goods. It also establishes measures for effective cooperation between customs and other relevant authorities on trade facilitation and customs compliance. Additionally, it contains provisions for technical assistance and capacity building. Measures to facilitate trade play an important role across a variety of policy areas and sectors. They have a positive effect on food security, rural development, consumer protection, investment promotion and good governance among others. Project rationale The GIZ global program "Partnerships for Sustainable Trade" (PST) has been commissioned by the German Federal Ministry of Economic Cooperation and Development (BMZ) to establish measures that facilitate trade and support environment and climate protection. Its duration is from 07/2024 to 12/2027. The program focuses on implementing the Trade Facilitation Agreement of the World Trade Organization (WTO) and promotes cooperation between companies, business and trade associations as well as state institutions. As an implementation partner of the Global Alliance for Trade Facilitation (the Alliance), it aligns development objectives with economic interests. The Alliance supports low and middle-income countries in streamlining trade-related processes to move goods across their borders as quickly, safely, and cost-effectively as possible. The Alliance is an initiative that puts public private partnership at the heart of its approach to trade reform, believing that governments and businesses of all sizes working together represents the best way of delivering transformative, positive change. The Alliance is jointly hosted by the World Economic Forum, the International Chamber of Commerce and the Center for International Private Enterprise and works in cooperation with the Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit (GIZ) GmbH. It is currently funded by the governments of Canada, Germany, Sweden, and the European Union (EU). Program measures include: - Planning and implementing trade facilitation measures in various countries in Africa, the Balkans, and Asia; - Increasing efficiency and reducing customs clearance costs by digitising processes and commercial documents; - Simplifying import and export procedures in developing and least developed countries (LDCs) through digital solutions and public-private partnerships; - Supporting developing countries in representing their interests in the multilateral trading system and in the WTO. The program is co-funded by different donors. At the beginning of 2025, the EU joined the Alliance as a new donor through co-funding the GIZ program. The EU contribution to the Alliance focusses on strengthening trade facilitation in least developed countries. Further co-financing comes from the World Trade Organisation (WTO) for the implementation of projects of the WTO Trade Facilitation Assistance Facility and by the EU Delegation to Madagascar for the implementation of an Alliance project in the country. Structure of the PST program The overall objective of the project is: In countries of the Global South, government, private actors or non-governmental organizations are equipped with improved instruments and competencies for the further development of the multilateral trading system for a Just Transition. The program is structured in 4 different Outputs: Output 1: Selected countries of the Global South are equipped with options for action for an inclusive, economic, and ecologically sustainable development of the multilateral trading system. Output 2: Proven trade facilitation instruments are embedded in selected countries of the Global South. Output 3: Innovative, climate and environmentally friendly approaches to trade facilitation have been further developed. Output 4: Trade facilitation instruments are embedded in selected LDCs. The project countries are specified in the Terms of Reference. The PST program seeks the services of a consulting firm to provide technical experts under different short-term expert (STE) pools, which can be deployed according to the project proposals and operational plans of each project country. The services will be delivered mainly by short-term experts in form of technical and administrative services for the development and implementation of specific trade facilitation measures in partner countries. The services also cover cross-cutting areas such as stakeholder engagement, workshop and training facilitation, and process management. Specifically, in the context of the respective in-country project workplans, the experts are foreseen to provide expertise in technical fields aimed at change management and capacity building of the respective identified border agencies.

result.text: The services to be delivered in the project countries include: - Conducting analyses and gap assessments on specific IT solutions or processes for Customs and other border agencies - Business process engineering of customs and logistics procedures - Technically oversee the implementation of IT solutions by IT solution providers - Support Customs and other partner agencies in developing and implementing change management plans - Developing and facilitating public-private dialogue formats - Developing training materials and conducting trainings (specifically train the trainer approaches) - Potentially, support for the scoping of Global Alliance for Trade Facilitation projects through fact finding missions and concept/proposal development[LL2.1]. Several new projects will be designed in the coming months. Potential countries for these new projects include Brazil, Cote d"Ivoire, Kenya, India, Indonesia, South Africa. Specifically, the following technical areas within respective work packages are covered through services provided by the STE pools: Work package 1. Customs modernisation and digitisation, including change management and process optimisation - Stabilizing and upgrading (ASYCUDA) and other customs management systems, - Reviewing customs management processes and drafting standard operating procedures (SOPs), - Supporting customs in piloting and rolling-out newly developed IT solutions or re-engineered processes; including specifically for airfreight and express clearance procedures. Work package 2. result.text: The Contracting Authority has launched the METKA project, which aims to replace the automatic train protection system of the Helsinki Metro with a radio-based Automatic Train Control (ATC) and Radio Network (RN) system. As part of the METKA project, the Contracting Authority is considering a procurement of “Work Train ATC Common Interface”, entailing the installation, testing and commissioning of the ATC and RN equipment on the Work Trains. The scope of the procurement is described in more detail in Annex 1 (Procurement description). This Request for Information must not be considered as a call for tenders. At this stage, the Contracting Authority requests information for preliminary market consultation prior to the official procurement procedure. The Contracting Authority will decide separately whether to proceed with the procurement. The purpose of the market consultation is to receive feedback on the intended scope of the procurement from potential service providers interested in the provision of the services and gather information on potential service providers, on their resources and capabilities. The information gathered through this Request for Information may be used to prepare the contract notice. The Respondent can participate in this market consultation by responding to the questions set out in the question form of this Request for Information (Annex 2 Question Form). Respondents are requested to answer as many questions as possible. The Contracting Authority reserves the right to request additional information and to discuss the Respondent’s response, if deemed necessary. The Contracting Authority welcomes all interested companies to actively participate in this Request for Information and to provide their feedback and proposals for ensuring the efficiency of the procurement process and for enhancing the service providers’ interest in participating in the procurement. The Contracting Authority will open the submitted answers and review the information at 11 December 2025, 12.01 pm. The contract notice is scheduled to be published in December 2025. Please note that taking part in the market discussion does not affect the participation of interested parties in the actual procurement procedure or the selection of the supplier. No compensation will be paid for responding to this Request for Information.
