result.text: To map various ticketing processes, the State Office for Finance (LfF) requires a new ticketing system, which must be operated in the state-owned data centre of LDI (on-premise or in the rlp-Cloud). The new procedure is intended to replace the previously used SAP SOLUTION MANAGER 7.2 with the SP stack 20 - as of 11/2025 - and the previously used ticketing procedure Zammad. The new procedure is also intended to map tickets from other, non-SAP-based areas. The complete implementation of the new ticketing system (including the necessary connection to downstream systems, acceptance testing and multiplier training) is to take place by 31.07.2027. Productive use of the new ticketing system must therefore be ensured for all connected users (including users from other authorities in the federal state of Rhineland-Palatinate) from 01.08.2027 at the latest. Further details can be found in the attached procurement documents, in particular the specification of services, system environment and contract. Lot LOT-0001: Ticketing system. The subject of the procurement is the creation of the overall system described in the procurement documents, including the establishment of operational readiness by the contractor on the basis of a works contract, as well as system service and the further development of the overall system. The overall system consists of a client-specifically adapted, standard ticketing system software (on-premise or in the rlp-Cloud of LDI / rental) that meets the requirements of modern ticket processing by the client, including associated client-specifically created or adapted integrations into the client's IT system in accordance with the further regulations, in particular in accordance with the functional and technical specifications of the client, cf. specification of services. This includes, inter alia, the integration of the ticketing system software into the SAP landscape operated by the client, inter alia connection to transport management, the mapping of various evaluations and reports, the establishment of knowledge bases and migrations from various source systems. To produce the overall system, the software must, inter alia, be set up and configured, in particular user accounts created and data imported in accordance with the specification of services or system environment, the software connected via interfaces to various tools of the client, the required automation established, high interoperability with the named third-party systems established, tested, test instances set up and operated, and the onboarding process successfully completed, including interface integration with the third-party systems and training courses. Productive use after acceptance of the overall system must be contractually possible for all connected users of the client, cf. specification of services, by 01.08.2027. Further details can be found in the attached procurement documents, in particular the specification of services, system environment and contract.

parts.source: Zur Abbildung verschiedener Ticketprozesse benötigt das Landesamt für Finanzen (LfF) ein neues Ticketsystem, welches im landeseigenen Rechenzentrum des LDI betrieben werden muss (On Premise oder in der rlp-Cloud). Mit dem neuen Verfahren soll der bisher eingesetzte SAP SOLUTION MANAGER 7.2 mit dem SP Stack 20 -Stand 11/2025- und das bisher eingesetzte Ticketverfahren Zammad abgelöst werden. In das neue Verfahren sollen zudem auch Tickets aus anderen, nicht SAP-basierenden Bereichen abgebildet werden. Die vollständige Einführung des neuen Ticketsystems (einschließlich der notwendigen Anbindung an Folgesysteme, Abnahmetest und Multiplikatorenschulung) soll dabei bis zum 31.07.2027 erfolgt sein. Eine produktive Nutzung des neuen Ticketsystems muss somit für alle angebundenen Nutzer (auch Nutzer anderer Behörden im Land Rheinland-Pfalz) spätestens ab dem 01.08.2027 gegeben sein. Nähere Einzelheiten können Sie den beigefügten Vergabeunterlagen, insbesondere der Leistungsbeschreibung, Systemumgebung und Vertrag, entnehmen. Lot LOT-0001: Ticketsystem. Gegenstand der Beschaffung ist die Erstellung des in den Vergabeunterlagen beschriebenen Gesamtsystems, einschließlich der Herbeiführung der Betriebsbereitschaft durch den Auftragnehmer auf der Grundlage eines Werkvertrages und der Systemservice und die Weiterentwicklung des Gesamtsystems. Das Gesamtsystem besteht aus einer auftraggeberspezifisch angepassten marktüblichen Ticketsystemsoftware (On Premise bzw. in der rlp-Cloud des LDI /Miete), die den Anforderungen der modernen Ticketbearbeitung durch den Auftraggeber gerecht wird, inklusive zugehöriger auftraggeberspezifisch erstellter bzw. angepasster Integrationen in das IT-System des Auftraggebers gemäß den weiteren Regelungen, insbesondere gemäß den funktionellen und technischen Spezifikationen des Auftraggebers, vgl. Leistungsbeschreibung. Hierzu gehört u.a. die Integration der Ticketsystemsoftware in die vom Auftraggeber betriebene SAP-Landschaft, u.a. Anbindung an das Transportmanagement, die Abbildung verschiedener Auswertungen und Berichte, der Aufbau von Wissensdatenbanken und Migrationen aus verschiedenen Quellsystemen. Zur Herstellung des Gesamtsystems ist die Software u.a. einzurichten und zu konfigurieren, insbesondere Nutzer-Accounts anzulegen und Daten gemäß Leistungsbeschreibung bzw. Systemumgebung zu importieren, die Software über Schnittstellen an verschiedene Tools des Auftraggebers anzubinden, die geforderte Automatisierung herzustellen, eine hohe Interoperabilität mit den benannten Drittsystemen herzustellen, zu testen, Testinstanzen einzurichten und zu betreiben, den Onboarding-Prozess erfolgreich inkl. Schnittstellenintegration zu den Drittsystemen und Schulungen abzuschließen. Eine produktive Nutzung nach Abnahme des Gesamtsystems muss für alle angebundenen Nutzer des Auftraggebers, vgl. Leistungsbeschreibung, zum 01.08.2027 vertragsgemäß möglich sein. Nähere Einzelheiten können Sie den beigefügten Vergabeunterlagen, insbesondere Leistungsbeschreibung, Systemumgebung und Vertrag, entnehmen.

result.text: Following a competitive procurement undertaken in 2019, a contract was awarded for the provision of the Apperta Foundation's OpenEyes Electronic Patient Record (EPR) solution for the management of ophthalmology services across NHS Wales. Digital Health and Care Wales (DHCW) is now undertaking an informal Preliminary Market Engagement (PME) exercise to better understand current market conditions and supplier capabilities in advance of any potential future procurement activity. This engagement relates solely to the hosting, support, maintenance, and ongoing development of the OpenEyes solution across NHS Wales. The scope includes support for implementations within secondary care ophthalmology departments and community optometric practices. Interested suppliers are invited to complete a Request for Information (RFI) questionnaire, available via the eTenderWales portal: https://etenderwales.bravosolution.co.uk/home.html Completed RFI responses must be submitted through the eTenderWales portal no later than 12:00 noon on 1 October 2026. This exercise is being undertaken for market research purposes only and does not constitute a procurement process, commitment to procure, or invitation to tender. DHCW has not yet determined whether a future procurement will be undertaken. Information gathered through this engagement will be used to inform future decision-making and procurement strategy development. Following review of the RFI responses, DHCW reserves the right to engage with respondents on an individual basis to clarify, verify, or supplement information provided. Lot 1: . None

result.text: Provision of an audio guide service, group guidance system and other accessible mobile devices to the Thyssen-Bornemisza Collection Foundation; all of these being resources that serve to support and complement the visit to the Museum.The implementation of audio guides in the museum is essential to enrich the visitor experience and fulfil foundational purposes. This service provides a detailed and accessible narrative, complementing the information of the physical exhibitions. However, the museum lacks specialised equipment and personnel to provide this service directly. Therefore, like many other public museums of our category and quality, we have relied on concessionaires for its provision. Audio guides, whether through device rental or digital solutions, not only improve the educational quality of the museum and raise awareness of our collections, but also promote accessibility and enjoyment for a diverse audience. This service is essential for managing visitor flow and enriching their experience in the museum

parts.source: Prestación de servicio a la Fundación Colección Thyssen-Bornemisza de audioguías, sistema de guiados de grupo y otros dispositivos móviles accesibles; todos ellos, recursos que sirvan de apoyo y complemento a la visita del Museo.La implementación de audioguías en el museo es fundamental para enriquecer la experiencia de los visitantes y cumplir con los fines fundacionales. Este servicio proporciona una narrativa detallada y accesible, complementando la información de las exhibiciones físicas. Sin embargo, el museo carece de equipos y personal especializados para prestar este servicio directamente. Por ello, al igual que muchos otros museos públicos de nuestra categoría y calidad, hemos confiado en concesionarios para su provisión. Las audioguías, ya sea a través del alquiler de dispositivos o soluciones digitales, no solo mejoran la calidad educativa del museo y dan a conocer nuestras colecciones, sino que también promueven la accesibilidad y el disfrute para una audiencia diversa. Este servicio es imprescindible para gestionar el flujo de visitantes y enriquecer su experiencia en el museo

result.text: Network Rail is looking to procure an end-to-end Virtual Accessibility Tours service for a baseline portfolio of 250 designated railway stations across Great Britain. The proposed service would include station surveys, LiDAR scanning, panoramic imagery, creation of accessible interactive virtual tours and supporting digital assets, publication support, testing, accessibility assurance, implementation, training, ongoing support and maintenance, content updates and future re-scanning services. The current delivery assumption is that, following a planned contract award in early February 2027, the first 100 station tours would be delivered, accepted and operational by June 2027, with the remaining 150 completed by October 2027. The purpose of this preliminary market engagement is to obtain supplier feedback on the draft requirements, the deliverability of the proposed timetable and the suitability of a fixed-price commercial model where the station composition and sequencing may change. Lot 1: . None

result.text: The Authority is seeking to appoint a suitably experienced and compliant Bidder to provide a secure, efficient and fully compliant electronic bulk ("e‐Bulk") solution for the end-to-end administration of DBS applications. The solution must support the Authority's Registered Body status and provide a fully hosted, cloud-based platform that enables the secure processing, tracking and management of DBS applications across multiple Council services and user groups. The Successful Provider must be an approved DBS e-Broker, authorised to submit applications on behalf of Registered Bodies. The Authority requires an accessible, bilingual in Welsh and English, compliant with Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WGAC) 2.2 AA accessibility standards, and capable of supporting multiple Council service areas and user roles. An optional Digital Identity Verification service may also be awarded as part of the contract, subject to the Authority's assessment of the Provider's data protection, information governance and security arrangements. The procurement process will be conducted in four (4) stages. Bidders must successfully meet the requirements of each stage before progressing to the next stage of evaluation. Where a stage is assessed on a pass/fail basis, bidders must achieve a "Pass" outcome in order to proceed. Where a stage is subject to scored evaluation, bidders must achieve the minimum threshold score specified within the tender documentation. Any bidder that fails a pass/fail requirement, receives a score below the minimum required threshold, or otherwise fails to satisfy the requirements of a stage, will be excluded from further consideration and their tender submission will not be evaluated in subsequent stages. The Council reserves the right to reject any tender that fails to meet the mandatory requirements of this procurement exercise. Full details can be found in the ITT.

result.text: Scottish Natural Heritage (hereafter referred to as NatureScot) is seeking to establish one or several contracts to deliver an Ancient Woodland Register (AWR). This project looks to develop an Ancient Woodland Register that meets the needs of users to support the protection and restoration of Scotland’s Ancient Woodlands and NatureScot anticipates that it may be delivered over three distinct stages. rejected.text: This is an invitation to a market survey and a supplier information session, not a contract notice or a call for tenders. Keski-Uudenmaan hyvinvointialue is preparing the establishment of a dynamic purchasing system (DPS) as a central part and procurement platform for research, development, innovation and competence development activities (RDI). The intention is to continue the activities started four years ago by re-establishing the purchasing system. The purchasing system forms the structure of the cooperation model regulated by the contracting authority's research, development and innovation partners' agreement. It produces research data, development services and innovations as a basis for the client's development activities and management. The subject of the purchasing system is: Innovation services, Development of service systems, Project services, Strategic development, Scientific communities. In addition, the subject of the procurement includes piloting and experimentation services as well as continuous development and management services for the client's use. The procurement of strategic development expert services is planned as the first internal competition of the purchasing system. The wellbeing services county invites suppliers to participate in the market survey regarding the preparation of the purchasing system and the first internal competition. The information session on the establishment of the purchasing system and the first internal competition will be held: Time: 6.10.2025 at 14 - 15 Place: Video connection via Microsoft Teams application Registration: by 3.10.2025 at 12 using the registration form. The registration form can be found and accessed by copying the link below and pasting it into the browser's search field: https://forms.office.com/pages/responsepage.aspx?id=zMQa0zMklUOHWD8aR-fN1lKrfd2M3JZEqmTZrGkxT_JUNVEwWDhTT0U5QVMxNlVKTzlWMklQRE03UC4u&route=shorturl The link to the video connection for joining the session and any advance material will be sent to those who have registered by email before the session. The wellbeing services county will also carry out the market survey at its discretion in other ways, such as by sending draft documents for suppliers to comment on and through separate meetings. The opportunity to comment on the documents will be offered to all suppliers who have registered for the information sessions in accordance with the instructions. The wellbeing services county will select participants for any separate meetings from among those who have registered, taking into account the requirements for equal and fair treatment of suppliers. Expressing interest and participating in the survey does not bind the supplier to submit a participation application or to participate in the tendering process. It is also not a prerequisite for participating in the actual tendering process later.

parts.source: Tämä on kutsu markkinakartoitukseen ja toimittajien info-tilaisuuteen, ei hankintailmoitus tai tarjouspyyntö. Keski-Uudenmaan hyvinvointialue valmistelee dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän (DPS) perustamista tutkimus-, kehitys-, innovaatio- ja osaamisen kehittämisen toiminnan (TKIO) keskeiseksi osaksi ja hankinta-alustaksi. Tarkoituksena on jatkaa neljä vuotta sitten käynnistettyä toimintaa perustamalla hankintajärjestelmän uudelleen. Hankintajärjestelmän muodostaa hankintayksikön tutkimus-, kehittämis- ja innovaatiokumppanien sopimuksella säädellyn yhteistyömallin rakenteen. Se tuottaa tutkimustietoa, kehittämispalveluita ja innovaatioita tilaajan kehittämistoiminnan ja johtamisen perustaksi. Hankintajärjestelmän kohteena ovat: Innovaatiopalvelut Palvelujärjestelmien kehittäminen Hankepalvelut Strateginen kehittäminen Tiedeyhteisöt Lisäksi hankinnan kohteena ovat pilotointi- ja kokeilupalvelut sekä jatkuvan kehittämisen ja hallinnoinnin palvelut tilaajan käyttöön. Ensimmäiseksi hankintajärjestelmän sisäiseksi kilpailutukseksi on suunniteltu strategisen kehittämisen asiantuntijapalvelujen hankintaa. Hyvinvointialue kutsuu toimittajia mukaan markkinakartoitukseen hankintajärjestelmän valmisteluun ja ensimmäiseen sisäiseen kilpailutukseen liittyen. Info-tilaisuus hankintajärjestelmän perustamisesta ja ensimmäisestä sisäisestä kilpailutuksesta järjestetään: Aika: 6.10.2025 klo 14 - 15 Paikka: Videoyhteys Microsoft Teams-sovelluksella Ilmoittautuminen: 3.10.2025 klo 12 mennessä ilmoittautumislomakkeella. Ilmoittautumislomake löytyy ja ilmoittautumaan pääsee kopioimalla alla olevan linkin ja liittämällä sen selaimen hakukenttään: https://forms.office.com/pages/responsepage.aspx?id=zMQa0zMklUOHWD8aR-fN1lKrfd2M3JZEqmTZrGkxT_JUNVEwWDhTT0U5QVMxNlVKTzlWMklQRE03UC4u&route=shorturl Videoyhteyden linkki tilaisuuteen liittymistä varten ja mahdollinen ennakkomateriaali lähetetään ilmoittautuneille sähköpostitse ennen tilaisuutta. Hyvinvointialue toteuttaa markkinakartoitusta harkintansa mukaan myös muilla tavoin, kuten lähettämällä luonnosasiakirjoja toimittajien kommentoitavaksi ja erillisillä tapaamisilla. Asiakirjojen kommentointimahdollisuus tarjotaan kaikille infotilaisuuksiin ilmoittautuneille toimittajille, jotka ovat ilmoittautuneet ohjeiden mukaisesti. Hyvinvointialue valitsee osallistujat mahdollisiin erillisiin tapaamisin ilmoittautuneiden joukosta, toimittajien yhdenvertaisen ja tasapuolisen kohtelun vaatimukset huomioiden. Kiinnostuksen ilmaiseminen ja osallistuminen kartoitukseen ei sido toimittajaa osallistumishakemuksen jättämiseen tai tarjouskilpailuun osallistumiseen. Se ei myöskään ole edellytyksenä myöhemmin varsinaiseen tarjouskilpailuun osallistumiselle.

result.text: Our Workplace Innovation Leadership Academy supports the ongoing development of business leaders at all levels and stages of experience. The Leadership Academy delivers programmes under a framework agreement with multiple suppliers across the Scottish Enterprise area, the programme plays a key role in cultivating leadership capability and innovation within businesses. The current framework expires early April 2026 and we anticipate commencing a new procurement process in December 2025. To inform this process, we are seeking to engage with the market to better understand current capabilities and approaches to delivering high-impact leadership development. We welcome expressions of interest from suppliers who possess specialist knowledge, proven experience, and the capacity to deliver innovative and effective leadership programmes tailored to diverse business needs. The Workplace Innovation Leadership Development Framework will consist of a series of one-day workshops, one-to-one coaching sessions, and topic specific diagnostic tools, delivered over a period of 2 - 6 months, depending on the Lot. Delivery will follow a hybrid model, combining online and face-to-face formats to maximise accessibility and impact. The Framework will deliver programmes across the Scottish Enterprise area, responding to demand. Where appropriate, programmes may also be delivered in collaboration with other enterprise agencies across Scotland. Lot 1: Transformational Leadership Programme. A cohesive leadership programme designed for both emerging and established leaders, with consistent core themes and tailored content to reflect each group's unique needs and experiences. Lot 2: Innovating Leadership: AI, Data & Emerging Tech. To empower leaders to embed AI, data, and emerging tech into strategy, foster ethical leadership, and drive internal innovation in a tech-enabled world. Lot 3: Growth Through Risk & Ambition. To support leaders in evaluating growth strategies, embracing risk as a catalyst for innovation, and exploring strategic options like investment, mergers, and ESG-aligned finance. Encourages a culture of learning through experimentation. Lot 4: Leadership in Times of Geopolitical & Economic Volatility. Helps leaders build resilience, agility, change capability and foresight to lead through uncertainty, global disruption, and change—while staying focused on long-term sustainability and stakeholder trust.

rejected.text: DYNAAMISEN HANKINTAJÄRJESTELMÄN KOHDE Tämän dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän (DPS) kohteena ovat pilvipalvelut sekä niihin liittyvät asiantuntijapalvelut Hansel Oy:n asiakkaille. DPS:n kohde on kuvattu tarkemmin osallistumispyynnössä ja sen liitteissä, erityisesti liitteessä "Dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän kohde". DPS:n keston aikana kaikki kiinnostuneet ehdokkaat voivat tehdä siihen osallistumishakemuksen. DPS on voimassa hankintailmoituksessa ilmoitettuun päivään asti, ellei sitä keskeytetä tai sen kestoa muuteta DPS:n voimassaollessa. Hansel Oy:n asiakkaat toteuttavat hankinnat DPS:ään hyväksyttyjen ehdokkaiden kesken DPS:n sisäisillä kilpailutuksilla, jotka voivat ajoittua DPS:n koko hankintavaiheen ajalle. DPS:n hankintavaihe alkaa perustamisvaiheen jälkeen 15.10.2026 ja päättyy DPS:n voimassaoloajan päättyessä. DPS:n perusteella asiakkaiden tekemät hankintasopimukset voivat olla voimassa enintään viisi (5) vuotta. DYNAAMISEN HANKINTAJÄRJESTELMÄN LAAJUUS Dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän ennakoitu kokonaisarvo on enintään 340 000 000 euroa (ilman arvonlisäveroa). Hankintailmoituksen kohdassa "Ennakoitu kokonaisarvo ilman arvonlisäveroa" (TED BT-27: Arvioitu arvo) ilmoitettu arvo on dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän arvioitu enimmäisarvo. SÄHKÖINEN HUUTOKAUPPA Asiakkaat voivat käyttää sisäisissä kilpailutuksissa sähköistä huutokauppaa.

result.text: SUBJECT OF THE DYNAMIC PURCHASING SYSTEM The subject of this dynamic purchasing system (DPS) is cloud services and related expert services for the customers of Hansel Oy. The subject of the DPS is described in more detail in the call for participation and its appendices, specifically in appendix "Subject of the dynamic purchasing system". During the validity of the DPS, all interested candidates may submit an application to participate in it. The DPS remains valid until the date stated in the contract notice, unless terminated or its duration is amended while the DPS is in force. Customers of Hansel Oy shall carry out procurements among the candidates accepted into the DPS via internal competitions within the DPS, which may take place throughout the entire procurement phase of the DPS. The procurement phase of the DPS begins after the establishment phase on 15.10.2026 and ends upon the expiry of the validity period of the DPS. Procurement contracts concluded by customers on the basis of the DPS may be valid for a maximum of five (5) years. SCOPE OF THE DYNAMIC PURCHASING SYSTEM The estimated total value of the dynamic purchasing system is a maximum of 340 000 000 euros (excluding value added tax). The value stated in the contract notice under "Estimated total value excluding VAT" (TED BT-27: Estimated value) is the estimated maximum value of the dynamic purchasing system. ELECTRONIC AUCTION Customers may use an electronic auction in internal competitions.

DPS:n keston aikana kaikki kiinnostuneet ehdokkaat voivat tehdä siihen osallistumishakemuksen. DPS on voimassa hankintailmoituksessa ilmoitettuun päivään asti, ellei sitä keskeytetä tai sen kestoa muuteta DPS:n voimassaollessa. Hansel Oy:n asiakkaat toteuttavat hankinnat DPS:ään hyväksyttyjen ehdokkaiden kesken DPS:n sisäisillä kilpailutuksilla, jotka voivat ajoittua DPS:n koko hankintavaiheen ajalle. DPS:n hankintavaihe alkaa perustamisvaiheen jälkeen 15.10.2026 ja päättyy DPS:n voimassaoloajan päättyessä. DPS:n perusteella asiakkaiden tekemät hankintasopimukset voivat olla voimassa enintään viisi (5) vuotta. DYNAAMISEN HANKINTAJÄRJESTELMÄN LAAJUUS Dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän ennakoitu kokonaisarvo on enintään 340 000 000 euroa (ilman arvonlisäveroa). Hankintailmoituksen kohdassa "Ennakoitu kokonaisarvo ilman arvonlisäveroa" (TED BT-27: Arvioitu arvo) ilmoitettu arvo on dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän arvioitu enimmäisarvo. result.text: Welcome to submit tenders for Migrationsverket. Migrationsverket hereby invites suppliers to submit tenders in this procurement of a contact centre. The procurement relates to a new contact centre platform (hereinafter referred to as the System). The System shall handle the answering of telephone calls and e-mail messages from the general public and manage the routing and follow-up of incoming cases (emails and incoming calls). The System shall provide functionality for Callback and a module for scheduling. Queue and individual statistics shall also be handled in the System. After the implementation of the System is completed, approximately 200 concurrent agents and 20 administrators are estimated to work in the System. Migrationsverket receives approximately 1 400 000 incoming calls and 400 000 emails per year in the current contact centre system. The System needs to be dimensioned to cope with the demand, which may vary over time. The System shall be hosted as a private cloud service. The core functions of the System – that is, the management of calls, e-mails and the scheduling module – shall be hosted in a server hall owned or exclusively rented by the supplier (or its subcontractor) and this shall have its physical location within the EU/EEA. The supplier shall have full technical and administrative control over the hardware, network and operating platform in the server hall. Migrationsverket will provide a separate service for encrypting free text in incoming e-mail messages before they reach the System. This encryption service shall be hosted locally by Migrationsverket. The technical design of the service is not yet fully defined, but will be developed in dialogue with the supplier during the implementation project. The System shall be able to handle e-mail flows where free text content is encrypted upon receipt and decrypted close to the client in the agent's web browser through a component provided by Migrationsverket. The supplier is not responsible for the development or operation of this encryption service, but shall ensure that the System is technically compatible with its mode of operation and supports secure handling of encrypted e-mail messages in accordance with the specification of requirements. Integrations with the Windows environment and Migrationsverket's telephony operator shall be included. In the procurement, the tenderer shall tender: A private cloud service that is complete and fulfils the mandatory requirements set out in the procurement and the evaluation requirements accepted by the supplier.An implementation project that includes planning, integrations, configuration of system settings, fine-tuning and testing of the System to a fully operational condition.The System shall be set up in a test and training environment, as well as a production environment.Integrations with Migrationsverket's system, which appear in the Specification of Requirements.Necessary documentation for the implementation of integration(s).Documentation.Training.Option regarding, inter alia, a screen sharing function (co-browsing) and chat functionConsultancy services in connection with the System.Services for support, fault clearance and further development of the System

parts.source: Välkomna att lämna anbud till Migrationsverket. Migrationsverket bjuder härmed in leverantörer att lämna anbud i denna upphandling av kontaktcenter. Upphandlingen avser en ny kontaktcenterplattform (vidare kallad Systemet). Systemet ska hantera besvarande av telefonsamtal och e-postmeddelanden från allmänheten och hantera styrning och uppföljning av inkomna ärenden (mail och inkomna samtal). Systemet ska tillhandahålla funktionalitet för Callback och en modul för schemaläggning. Kö- och individstatistik ska också hanteras i Systemet. Efter att införandet av Systemet är genomfört beräknas cirka 200 samtidiga Agenter och 20 Administratörer arbeta i Systemet. Migrationsverket tar emot cirka 1 400 000 inkommande samtal och 400 000 mail per år i nuvarande kontaktcentersystem. Systemet behöver vara dimensionerat för att klara av efterfrågan, som kan variera över tid. Systemet ska driftas som privat molntjänst. Systemets kärnfunktioner – det vill säga hantering av samtal, e-post och schemaläggningsmodul – ska driftas i en serverhall som ägs eller exklusivt hyrs av leverantören (eller dess underleverantör) och denna ska ha sin fysiska placering inom EU/EES. Leverantören ska ha full tekniskt och administrativ kontroll över hårdvara, nät och driftplattform i serverhallen. Migrationsverket kommer att tillhandahålla en separat tjänst för kryptering av fritext i inkommande e-postmeddelanden innan dessa når Systemet. Denna krypteringstjänst ska driftas lokalt av Migrationsverket. Den tekniska utformningen av tjänsten är ännu inte fullt definierad, utan kommer att utvecklas i dialog med leverantören under införandeprojektet. Systemet ska kunna hantera e-postflöden där fritextinnehåll är krypterat vid mottagande och dekrypteras klientnära i Agentens webbläsare genom en komponent som tillhandahålls av Migrationsverket. Leverantören ansvarar inte för utveckling eller drift av denna krypteringstjänst, men ska säkerställa att Systemet är tekniskt kompatibelt med dess funktionssätt och stödjer säker hantering av krypterade e-postmeddelanden i enlighet med kravspecifikationen. Integrationer mot Windowsmiljön och Migrationsverkets telefonioperatör ska ingå. Anbudsgivaren ska i upphandlingen offerera: Privat molntjänst som är komplett och uppfyller de i upphandlingen uppställda obligatoriska kraven och de utvärderingskrav som Leverantören accepterat.Införandeprojekt som inkluderar planering, Integrationer, Konfigurering av systeminställningar, intrimning och testning av Systemet till fullt driftfärdigt skick.Systemet ska bli uppsatt i en test- och utbildningsmiljö, samt produktionsmiljö.Integrationer mot Migrationsverkets System, vilka framgår av Kravspecifikationen.Nödvändig dokumentation för genomförande av Integration/er.Dokumentation.Utbildning.Option om bl.a. skärmspeglingsfunktion (co-browsing) och chattfunktionKonsulttjänster i anknytning till Systemet.Tjänster för support, felrättning och vidareutveckling av Systemet

result.text: The NHS Counter Fraud Authority (NHSCFA) is a health authority charged with identifying, investigating and preventing fraud and other economic crime within the NHS and the wider health group. As a health authority focused entirely on counter fraud work, the NHSCFA is independent from other NHS bodies and directly accountable to the Department of Health and Social Care (DHSC). THE NHSCFA currently operate two separate systems for the provision of an intelligence database and a case management system. The intention is to identify if there is a single solution that can replace the existing systems. If that is not possible then the aim would be to have two separate products that connect and align with each other to avoid duplication and operational inefficiencies. This market engagement exercise seeks the views and opinions of those organisations that may be interested in delivering the requirements. The scope of this market engagement covers is provided within the draft service specification. This exercise and any subsequent responses are in no way legally binding on any party. Participation in the engagement exercise is not a mandatory requirement for participating in any potential future procurement; however, responses received will assist to inform the Contracting Authority as to the level of interest from the market and will be used to evidence a decision as to whether or not to undertake a competitive procurement. The Market Engagement Questionnaire and current Service Specifications can be downloaded from SAP Ariba Portal at the below link: https://discovery.ariba.com/rfx/23496944 Please return your completed MEQ through the Portal no later than 5pm on 30 October 2025.

result.text: The Rheumazentrum Mittelhessen has decided to tender for a complete hospital information system for the site, which fulfils the KHZG funding requirements 3- 6 and which, furthermore, maps all administrative and clinical processes of an acute, AHB and (DRV) rehabilitation clinic. At the site in Bad Endbach, an acute clinic with 80 beds and an Anschlussheilbehandlung (AHB) and rehabilitation clinic with 36 beds are available for the holistic therapy of acute and chronic rheumatic diseases. The clinic complex also includes two practices with medical rheumatology consultations and an outpatient therapy facility for physiotherapy, physical therapy and occupational therapy. Over the years, the clinic area has been constantly modernised and the infrastructure expanded. The Rheumazentrum Mittelhessen has decided to tender for a complete hospital information system for the site, which fulfils the KHZG funding requirements 3- 6 and which, furthermore, maps all administrative and clinical processes of an acute, AHB and (DRV) rehabilitation clinic. The future HIS is to be set up in such a way that it is the patient-leading system in interaction with other subsystems/modules. The HIS is to be introduced on the basis of a "best practice" approach within the framework of joint project work. The contractor is accordingly expected to provide a consultative and optimising process approach within the framework of the software implementation. The software to be supplied must have the capabilities and instruments that, for example, enable users to manage the patient's treatment progress as efficiently as possible, as well as to document and bill services quickly, in a revenue-secure manner and in compliance with the KHZG (FTB 3-6). The providers are therefore requested to submit a tender for a complete KHZG-compliant HIS including all necessary services for implementation and maintenance/service, which fulfils the mandatory criteria of the KHZG funding requirements 2 - 6 (the mandatory criteria for the admission and treatment management of the FTB 2 are fulfilled via the portal solution of the company Samedi, the discharge and transfer management via the solution of the company Verbund Pflegehilfe (see "Interfaces" tab of Annex 1), the contractor only owes the connection in this area in accordance with the technical requirements and interoperability standards of the KHZG). The new HIS is intended to significantly support the digitalisation and efficiency of hospital processes and thus optimise patient care.

parts.source: Das Rheumazentrum Mittelhessen hat sich entschieden, ein komplettes Kranken-hausinformationssystem für den Standort auszuschreiben, welches die KHZG-Fördertatbestände 3- 6 erfüllt und welches darüber hinaus alle administrativen und klinischen Prozesse einer Akut-, AHB- und (DRV-) Rehaklinik abbildet. An dem Standort in Bad Endbach stehen zur ganzheitlichen Therapie akuter und chronischer rheumatischer Erkrankungen eine Akutklinik mit 80 Betten und eine An-schlussheilbehandlungs- (AHB) und Rehabilitationsklinik mit 36 Betten zur Verfü-gung. Zum Klinikkomplex gehören außerdem zwei Praxen mit ärztlicher Rheuma-sprechstunde und eine ambulante Therapieeinrichtung für Physiotherapie, physikali-sche Therapien und Ergotherapie. Im Laufe der Jahre wurde der Klinikbereich stän-dig modernisiert und die Infrastruktur ausgebaut. Das Rheumazentrum Mittelhessen hat sich entschieden, ein komplettes Kranken-hausinformationssystem für den Standort auszuschreiben, welches die KHZG-Fördertatbestände 3- 6 erfüllt und welches darüber hinaus alle administrativen und klinischen Prozesse einer Akut-, AHB- und (DRV-) Rehaklinik abbildet. Das künftige KIS ist dahingehend aufzusetzen, dass es im Zusammenspiel mit weiteren Subsys-temen/ Modulen das patientenführende System ist. Das KIS soll auf Basis eines "Best-Practice"-Ansatzes im Rahmen einer gemeinsamen Projektarbeit eingeführt werden. Vom Auftragnehmer wird entsprechend ein beratender und optimierender Prozessansatz im Rahmen der Softwareimplementierung erwartet. Die zu liefernde Software muss über die Möglichkeiten und Instrumente verfügen, die z.B. die Anwen-der in den Stand versetzen, den Behandlungsverlauf des Patienten so effizient wie möglich zu steuern, sowie die Leistungen schnell, erlössicher und KHZG-konform (FTB 3-6) zu dokumentieren und abzurechnen. Die Anbieter werden daher gebeten, ein Angebot über ein komplettes KHZG-konformes KIS inklusive aller notwendigen Dienstleistungen zur Implementierung und zur Wartung/ Service abzugeben, welches die Muss-Kriterien der KHZG-Fördertatbestände 2 - 6 erfüllt (die Muss-Kriterien für das Aufnahme- und Behandlungsmanagement des FTB 2 werden über die Portallö-sung der Fa. Samedi, das Entlass- und Überleitungsmanagement über die Lösung der Fa. Verbund Pflegehilfe erfüllt (s. Reiter "Schnittstellen" der Anlage 1), der Auf-tragnehmer schuldet in diesem Bereich entsprechend nur die Anbindung gemäß technischer Anforderungen und Interoperabilitätsstandards des KHZG). Das neue KIS soll die Digitalisierung und Effizienz der Krankenhausprozesse maßgeblich un-terstützen und damit die Patientenversorgung optimieren.

result.text: Stromnetz Berlin GmbH intends to carry out a structured rollout of a video monitoring system (VMS) across its technical sites, operational and administrative sites as well as defined special sites. The aim of the tender is the expansion and rolling implementation of an existing video management system (BVMS) from Bosch Sicherheitssysteme GmbH with the scope of services comprising planning, execution, commissioning, documentation as well as subsequent service and maintenance work. The rollout serves to strengthen the physical security of critical infrastructure installations and properties. The VMS is not intended merely for passive observation, but rather as an active component of the security architecture to detect events, visualise them, support rapid situational assessment and enable subsequent processes. The existing system landscape comprises a central video management system, decentralised video storage, camera technology in the properties, clients for authorised users as well as the client's monitoring and network components. The subject of the contract is divided into 4 lots. The lot structure separates planning and control, technical execution, civil engineering work and service operations, whilst simultaneously establishing a binding overall context. The services are to be coordinated with one another in such a way that planning, civil engineering, installation, commissioning, documentation and operation intermesh within a uniform rollout model. All contractors must take into account project-related interfaces, the client's specifications, the relevant technical regulations and requirements for information security, occupational health and safety, and documentation. The rollout covers all technical sites (substations, network nodes) and all operational and administrative sites of Stromnetz Berlin. The number of sites to be considered ranges from approx. 110 (estimated value) up to a max. of 130 properties (maximum value). Regardless of whether the contract is awarded for individual lots or a combination lot variant, the services offered must ensure a consistent, secure, interoperable and fully documented overall solution. The decisive factor is the complete fulfilment of all requirements set out in the tender documents. The contracts (Lot 1 to Lot 4) become effective upon award of contract and have an initial term for the provision of services from 01.08.2027 – 31.07.2033 (6 years). The client is entitled to extend the contracts by two years, i.e. up to a maximum of 31.07.2035. Lot LOT-0001: Planning services, control, construction supervision and construction management. Lot 1 forms the central control and integration function of the VMS rollout. The subject of the services for Lot 1 is project management and coordination over the entire project duration, the creation and updating of the project organisation, schedule and milestone planning, interface control as well as reporting on costs, schedules, quality, risks and opportunities. The contractor for Lot 1 draws up the detailed concept and the property-related execution and installation planning as a binding basis for the execution services of the further lots. This includes in particular specifications for camera planning, power supply, data supply, earthing and lightning protection, switchcabinet and connection box design, IT security, communication matrix as well as site-specific planning documents. Lot 1 monitors proper execution, coordinates handovers between civil engineering, installation and commissioning, documents defects, accompanies acceptances and ensures complete final documentation. Interface management with regard to Lot 2 and Lot 3 is of particular importance: execution services may only be carried out on the basis of coordinated planning documents; deviations must be recorded and approved via change management. Brief overview of services: - Project coordination and site management, - (Pre-)planning/design of the overall solution, - Object-specific execution and installation planning, - Route/cable planning, - Video storage planning, - Switchcabinet planning, - Documentation, - Condition assessment/commissioning/acceptance. Lot LOT-0002: Execution services, field technology and switchcabinet manufacturing. Lot 2 comprises technical implementation based on the planning and coordination specifications provided by Lot 1. The subject of the services includes the delivery, manufacture and installation of the cabling, field technology, connection boxes and switchcabinets required for the VMS. These include in particular cable routes, power and data cabling, splicing and termination services, installation of camera technology, manufacture of connection boxes and system technology cabinets as well as establishing accessibility to installation heights (greater than 4m). Lot 2 also carries out the dismantling of old components and the withdrawal of existing legacy cabling. It supports the configuration and parametrisation of the field technology and assists with commissioning and acceptances. Lot 2 has an obligation to cooperate in construction site documentation and change management. Implementation is entirely dependent on the approved planning documents. Brief overview of services: - Delivery and manufacture of cable routes and cabling, - Delivery and installation of field technology, - Dismantling of old components and third-party systems, as well as withdrawal of legacy cabling, - Manufacture of switchcabinets and connection boxes, - Configuration and parametrisation of field technology. Lot LOT-0003: Civil engineering and foundations. The contractor for Lot 3 establishes the civil engineering and infrastructural prerequisites for the subsequent installation and commissioning of the video camera technology at approx. 30 locations with corresponding video mast systems. The contractor for Lot 3 is responsible for civil engineering, foundation, earthing and video mast services.

parts.source: Die Stromnetz Berlin GmbH beabsichtigt den strukturierten Rollout eines Videokontrollsystems (VKS) über ihre technischen Standorte, Betriebs- und Verwaltungsstandorte sowie definierte Sonderstandorte. Ziel der Ausschreibung ist die Erweiterung und rollierende Umsetzung eines vorhandenen Videomanagementsystems (BVMS) der Firma Bosch Sicherheitssysteme GmbH mit dem Leistungsgegenstand Planung, Ausführung, Inbetriebnahme, Dokumentation sowie nachgelagerter Service- und Wartungsleistungen. Der Rollout dient der Stärkung der physischen Sicherheit von Anlagen und Liegenschaften der kritischen Infrastruktur. Das VKS soll nicht lediglich der passiven Beobachtung dienen, sondern als aktiver Bestandteil der Sicherheitsarchitektur Ereignisse detektieren, visualisieren, eine schnelle Lageeinschätzung unterstützen und Folgeprozesse ermöglichen. Die bestehende Systemlandschaft umfasst ein zentrales Videomanagementsystem, dezentrale Videospeicher, Kameratechnik in den Liegenschaften, Clients für berechtigte Nutzer sowie Monitoring- und Netzwerkkomponenten des Auftraggebers. Der Vergabegegenstand ist in 4 Lose untergliedert. Die Losstruktur trennt die Planung und Steuerung, die technische Ausführung, Tiefbauleistungen sowie den Servicebetrieb, stellt jedoch zugleich einen verbindlichen Gesamtkontext her. Die Leistungen sind so aufeinander abzustimmen, dass Planung, Tiefbau, Montage, Inbetriebnahme, Dokumentation und Betrieb innerhalb eines einheitlichen Rollout-Modells ineinandergreifen. Alle Auftragnehmer haben die projektbezogenen Schnittstellen, die Vorgaben des Auftraggebers, die einschlägigen technischen Regelwerke sowie die Anforderungen an Informationssicherheit, Arbeitsschutz und Dokumentation zu berücksichtigen. Der Rollout umfasst alle technischen Standorte (Umspannwerke, Netzknoten) sowie alle Betriebs- und Verwaltungsstandorte der Stromnetz Berlin. Die Anzahl der zu berücksichtigenden Standorte umfasst ca. 110 (Schätzwert) bis max. 130 Liegenschaften (Höchstwert). Unabhängig davon, ob der Zuschlag auf einzelne Lose oder ein Kombinationslosvariante erteilt wird, müssen die angebotenen Leistungen eine konsistente, sichere, interoperable und vollständig dokumentierte Gesamtlösung gewährleisten. Maßgeblich ist die vollständige Erfüllung sämtlicher in den Vergabeunterlagen festgelegten Anforderungen. Die Verträge (Los 1 bis Los 4) werden mit Zuschlagserteilung wirksam und haben hinsichtlich der Leistungserbringung eine Grundlaufzeit vom 01.08.2027 – 31.07.2033 (6 Jahre). Der Auftraggeber ist berechtigt, die Verträge um zwei Jahre, d.h. bis maximal 31.07.2035 zu verlängern. Lot LOT-0001: Planungsleistung, Steuerung, Bauüberwachung und Baubetreuung. Los 1 bildet die zentrale Steuerungs- und Integrationsfunktion des VKS-Rollouts. Der Leistungsgegenstand von Los 1 sind die Projektsteuerung und Koordination über die gesamte Projektlaufzeit, die Erstellung und Fortschreibung der Projektorganisation, Termin- und Meilensteinplanung, Schnittstellensteuerung sowie das Reporting zu Kosten, Terminen, Qualität, Risiken und Chancen. Der Auftragnehmer von Los 1 erstellt das Feinkonzept und die liegenschaftsbezogene Werk- und Montageplanung als verbindliche Grundlage für die Ausführungsleistungen der weiteren Lose. Dazu gehören insbesondere Vorgaben zur Kameraplanung, Stromversorgung, Datenversorgung, Erdung und Blitzschutz, Schaltschrank- und Anschlusskastenkonzeption, IT-Sicherheit, Kommunikationsmatrix sowie standortbezogene Planungsunterlagen. Los 1 überwacht die ordnungsgemäße Ausführung, koordiniert die Übergaben zwischen Tiefbau, Montage und Inbetriebnahme, dokumentiert Mängel, begleitet Abnahmen und stellt die vollständige Enddokumentation sicher. Eine besondere Bedeutung hat das Schnittstellenmanagement gegenüber Los 2 und Los 3: Ausführungsleistungen dürfen nur auf Basis der abgestimmten Planungsunterlagen erfolgen, Abweichungen sind über das Changemanagement zu erfassen und freizugeben. Kurzdarstellung der Leistungen: - Projektkoordination und Bauleitung, - (Vor)-Planung/ Konzeption der Gesamtlösung, - Objektspezifische Werk- und Montageplanung, - Trassen-/Kabelplanung, - Planung Videospeicher, - Schaltschrankplanung, - Dokumentation, - Zustandserfassung/Inbetriebsetzung/Abnahme. Lot LOT-0002: Ausführungsleistung, Feldtechnik und Schaltschrankfertigung. Los 2 umfasst die technische Realisierung auf Grundlage der durch Los 1 bereitgestellten Planungs- und Koordinationsvorgaben. Der Leistungsgegenstand beinhaltet die Lieferung, Herstellung und Montage der für das VKS erforderlichen Verkabelung, Feldtechnik, Anschlusskästen und Schaltschränke. Dazu zählen insbesondere Kabelwege, Strom- und Datenverkabelung, Spleiß- und Terminierungsleistungen, Montage von Kameratechnik, Fertigung von Anschlusskästen und Systemtechnikschränken sowie die Herstellung der Zugänglichkeit zu Montagehöhen (größer 4m). Los 2 führt zudem die Demontage von Alt-Komponenten und das Zurückziehen vorhandener Bestandsverdrahtung aus. Er unterstützt die Konfiguration und Parametrierung der Feldtechnik und wirkt bei Inbetriebnahmen und Abnahmen mit. Los 2 hat eine Mitwirkungspflicht bei Baustellendokumentation und Changemanagement. Die Umsetzung ist vollständig von den freigegebenen Planungsunterlagen abhängig. Kurzdarstellung der Leistungen: - Lieferung und Herstellung von Kabelwegen und Verkabelung, - Lieferung und Montage von Feldtechnik, - Demontage von Alt-Komponenten und Fremdsystemen, sowie Zurückziehen von Bestandsverdrahtung, - Fertigung Schaltschränke und Anschlusskästen, - Konfiguration und Parametrierung von Feldtechnik. Lot LOT-0003: Tiefbau und Fundamente. Der Auftragnehmer von Los 3 stellt an ca. 30 Standorten mit entsprechenden Videomast-Anlagen die tiefbaulichen und infrastrukturellen Voraussetzungen für die spätere Montage und Inbetriebnahme der Videokameratechnik her. Der Auftragnehmer von Los 3 ist für Tiefbau-, Fundament-, Erdungs- und Videomastleistungen verantwortlich.

result.text: The services shall be provided exclusively on the basis of the planning documents drawn up by Lot 1. The scope of services comprises in particular the creation and backfilling of cable trenches, the laying of ducting and micro-duct bundles, cable drawing chambers and transfer points, compliance with laying depths and protective distances, consideration of site-specific soil, environmental and water protection requirements as well as the restoration of affected surfaces. In addition, mast foundations, foundation and ring earthers as well as support mast systems must be erected and documented in accordance with structural and planning specifications. Lot 3 must execute and hand over its services in such a way that damage-free, standards-compliant and economical further processing by Lot 2 is possible. Brief overview of services: - Civil engineering, foundations and support mast system. Lot LOT-0004: Service and maintenance. Lot 4 comprises the service and maintenance services for the existing and newly commissioned VMS system components. The subject of the services comprises services for the overall VMS system forming the subject matter of the contract, both at the central head-end level and for decentralised hardware and software components at the field level. These include in particular change management, release management, system support, proactive maintenance of operational readiness, service desk as a central single point of contact, incident management, problem management, remote and on-site support, documentation maintenance, consulting, instruction and training, service level management as well as maintenance services. Lot 4 thus assumes structured operational safeguarding of the system after commissioning and supports the client with the stability, traceability, further development and fault clearance of the VMS. Brief overview of services: - Service and maintenance for the video management system and field technology.

parts.source: Die Leistungen erfolgen ausschließlich auf Grundlage der durch Los 1 erstellten Planungsunterlagen. Der Leistungsumfang umfasst insbesondere die Herstellung und Wiederverfüllung von Leitungsgräben, die Verlegung von Leerrohren und Mikrorohrverbänden, Kabelziehschächte und Übergabepunkte, die Einhaltung von Verlegetiefen und Schutzabstände, die Berücksichtigung standortspezifischer Boden-, Umwelt- und Wasserschutzanforderungen sowie die Wiederherstellung betroffener Oberflächen. Zusätzlich sind Mastfundamente, Fundament- und Ringerder sowie Tragmastanlagen nach statischen und planerischen Vorgaben zu errichten und zu dokumentieren. Los 3 muss seine Leistungen so ausführen und übergeben, dass eine schadensfreie, normkonforme und wirtschaftliche Weiterverarbeitung durch Los 2 möglich ist. Kurzdarstellung der Leistungen: - Tiefbau, Fundamente und Tragmastsystem. Lot LOT-0004: Service und Wartung. Los 4 umfasst die Service- und Wartungsleistungen für die bestehenden und neu in Betrieb genommenen VKS-Systembestandteile. Der Leistungsgegenstand umfasst Services für das vertragsgegenständliche Gesamtsystem VKS, sowohl auf der zentralen Kopfebene als auch für dezentrale Hard- und Softwarekomponenten der Feldebene. Dazu gehören insbesondere Change Management, Release Management, Systembetreuung, proaktive Aufrechterhaltung der Betriebsbereitschaft, Service Desk als zentraler Single Point of Contact, Incident Management, Problem Management, Remote- und Vor-Ort-Support, Dokumentationspflege, Beratung, Einweisung und Schulung, Service Level Management sowie Wartungsleistungen. Los 4 übernimmt damit die strukturierte betriebliche Absicherung des Systems nach Inbetriebnahme und unterstützt den Auftraggeber bei der Stabilität, Nachvollziehbarkeit, Weiterentwicklung und Entstörung des VKS. Kurzdarstellung der Leistungen: - Service und Wartung für das Videomanagementsystem und die Feldtechnik.

Lot LOT-0001: VMware Subscriptions. The aim of the procurement is to ensure the support-capable, highly available and licence-compliant continued operation of the existing virtualisation infrastructure as well as to obtain accompanying integration support. By providing modern VMware infrastructure components, specifically VMware vSphere Foundation (VVF), as well as commissioning specialist services, a stable, economical and future-proof further development of the central operating platform is guaranteed. In addition to the provision of the required software licences, this comprises in particular ensuring the central administration of all host systems as well as the continuous maintenance of mission-critical high-availability functions for the server infrastructures.

result.text: Further to the UK1 Pipeline Notice published on 19th November 2025 by BlueLight Commercial Limited (ref: 2025/S 000-077692) in relation to a Victim & Citizen Engagement Technology Solution which will be used by UK law enforcement agencies, this UK2 Preliminary Market Engagement Notice is issued to inform the market of a potential future opportunity. This Pre-Market Engagement Notice is issued solely for the purposes of information gathering and engagement with the market. It does not constitute a call for competition and create any obligation on the Authority to proceed with a procurement exercise, or enter into any commercial arrangement. Please note the procurement route and anticipated publication date for this opportunity are yet to be determined. These elements will be confirmed following completion of the market engagement process and development of the Authority’s commercial strategy. Any future procurement will be subject to separate formal notice and the publication of full procurement documentation via the Find a Tender Service (FTS). BlueLight Commercial Limited (BLC) are conducting Preliminary Market Engagement to gain a better understanding of the market, supplier appetite, capacity, and capability, as well as perceived risks and opportunities. Any learnings will be used to formulate the associated procurement strategy. BLC work in collaboration with blue light organisations to maximise commercial benefit to UK emergency services. The focus of this solution will be improving Victim & Citizen Engagement, building trust and confidence, reducing demand within control rooms, and reducing the costs of serving the public by using innovative software to keep both victims and citizens more engaged. The aim is to ensure all forces have access to the most effective, reliable, and innovative solutions available in the market. This Solution needs to facilitate the force contact engagement from first contact with a police force to final closure of the contact, and via integration with police systems, e.g. Command and Control, Records Management Systems providing contact and updates throughout the journey without the need to call the force contact centre. It seeks to further drive standardisation and consistency, whilst helping forces to develop capability and invest in technology which will not only improve the service at first point of contact but will improve the overall contact experience. This Solution must facilitate Victim & Citizen engagement to reduce failure demand whilst proactively engaging to ensure high levels of customer (internal and external) trust and confidence. The delivery of the desired solution may be considered to follow the same customer service path as an online application or ordering process. For example, acknowledgement of the initial contact, time appropriate follow up contacts at defined points within the communication journey, and a closure contact at the end of the process. All communication will be auditable and align with the Victims code as appropriate. We are looking for solutions that can meet individual force needs and achieve the following: *Improve experience of members of the public accessing the policing service *Provide the public with consistent updates in a timely manner, *Improve public trust, confidence, and satisfaction, *Reduce Contact Management demand, *Improve force's overall Contact Management performance. Lot 1: .

result.text: With this RFI Yle invites interested suppliers to participate in the market dialogue held prior publishing the call for tenders (RFQ). Supplier should provide real-time HTML5 based graphics solutions in following areas: A) On screen, i.e. “lower third” graphics B) Full screen graphics C) Background videowall graphics D) Graphics controller In this RFI, Yle is not looking for augmented reality or virtual reality production solutions, otherwise known as AR, XR or VR systems. Parts A, B, C, and D can be offered as a single solution or independently of each other. This means, Yle is not necessarily looking for a company-wide solution; a solution for a single part (A,B,C,D) may turn out to be a reasonable solution. If not all parts are offered, a recommendation of compatible other solutions / products that fill in the missing parts is required. The offered solution for parts A, B, C, or D should be capable of serving Yle’s production environment. The entirety of it consists of 12 tv studios, 3 OB trucks, 1 playout centre and roughly dozen cloud live streaming units. Current graphic device count is roughly 200 devices, 50 real-time rendering servers and 6 non linear editing (NLE) rendering servers. Content filling clients have around 1300 installations. In this RFI, Yle is looking to identify the solutions available in the market that could meet Yle’s needs. In the RFI process, Yle may schedule meetings with a few chosen suppliers. If possible, setting up a hands-on test environment with key features of the system, would be helpful for better understanding. Please find the list of basic components for each part A-D as well as the detailed description of the object of the procurement in the document "RFI - Real-time HTML5 Graphics System". You can find the document in tender portal (https://tarjouspalvelu.fi/yleisradiooy?id=585018&tpk=7d09db49-a4a7-443a-9948-ce0fb71ab59f) or contacting tarjoukset.yle(at)yle.fi. Kindly note that in this RFI, Yle has specified the need for real-time graphic system(s), as previously described in the RFI for Real-time Graphics Systems. INTERESTED? Interested suppliers are invited to take part in the market dialogue by sending a request to participate by email to tarjoukset.yle(at)yle.fi at latest by 5th of December 2025. In case you have any questions, please don’t hesitate to contact us. Please include a description or additional appendices covering the following topics in your email: 1) Description of the solution you provide, including a description of which key features are included in your solution 2) A short company presentation, including the size of the company in terms of revenue and number of employees. 3) Your previous experience and few appropriate reference cases. 4) Reference architecture view 5) Description of your licence and pricing model 6) Description of your cyber security policies and continuity planning 7) Description of your GDPR policies We look forward to your replies. We will review the answers as soon as they are received. In case Yle decides to have meetings or short discussions with a few suppliers, we’ll thrive to send the invitations during January 2026 at the latest. The agenda will focus on how your solution could fit our needs.

result.text: Quality Assurance and Testing for IT Systems 2 Independent quality assurance testing (QAT), including testing environments, specialists, automation and services, such as consultancy. Updates 13 June 2025: This framework agreement has been extended to expire 23 February 2029. New suppliers will still be able to join the DPS up until this date. Description The framework will use a dynamic purchasing system (DPS) to offer independent quality assurance testing (QAT) services for use by the whole of the public sector and their associated bodies and agencies. QAT is needed for new digital systems and services to make sure they are suitable for public launch. The agreement offers services such as: testing environments specialists automation services (such as consultancy) Benefits it complements our other digital agreements, such as Digital Outcomes and Specialists (DOS) and G-Cloud dynamic – buyers can create bespoke specifications (within the overall DPS scope), competitions and contracts state your requirements and suppliers tell you how they’ll deliver the service government owned Intellectual Property Rights (IPR), means that you can continue to develop a digital service yourself or with any third party, or share and reuse it Products and suppliers Please read the 'How to buy' tab below for detailed instructions on how to find out which suppliers are on this agreement. Lot 1: Quality Assurance and Testing for IT Systems 2 Expires: 23/02/2029 How to buy You must run a mini competition to select a supplier. There is no option for direct award. Before you run your mini competition, find out which suppliers could meet your requirements using the DPS marketplace. This DPS is organised into 4 categories: services location clearance scalability The steps below outline how to search for suppliers, create a shortlist and carry out a mini competition. Register as a buyer on the DPS marketplace. Although pages are headed ‘Supplier registration’ this is also where you can register as a buyer. Navigate to the Quality Assurance and Testing for IT Systems 2 DPS under Technology and choose the ‘Access as a buyer’ option and confirm your acceptance of the customer access agreement. On your ‘Manage your DPS Category Exports’ page you now have 2 options: view appointed suppliers click on the link to create a new category export This is how you filter the suppliers that can meet your requirements. when creating a new category use the filtering tool (select all that apply) to specify your requirements and create your supplier shortlist Save your filtered list of capable suppliers by clicking the ‘Save Category’ option and give the shortlist a unique name specific to your competition. From your ‘Manage your Category Exports’ page you can then export the list of suppliers and contact details (export is to an Excel spreadsheet). Quit the DPS. Use the list to run a further Competition. Invite the suppliers identified by the DPS to bid against your detailed specification, evaluation criteria and contract format. the list is valid for only 2 working days , from the date of its creation, because new suppliers may apply to join at any point. if your call for competition excludes eligible suppliers it potentially breaches procurement regulations you will need to get a fresh supplier list (steps 3.2 to 5) if you do not use your list within 2 working days by clicking the ‘Search Again’ option for your export you can use the our eSourcing tool to run a call for competition. The tool is free to use for public sector buyers, or you can use your organisation’s own procurement tool. Your tender process should be proportionate to the value and complexity of your requirement. Suppliers will need a reasonable period of time to review and prepare a response. This includes allowing sufficient time for suppliers to ask clarification questions and consider your answers before the deadline for written responses. Evaluate the responses. Request from winning supplier(s) any required evidence that they can meet your requirements. Set a 2-day deadline for submitting evidence . If you are satisfied with the evidence, award the contract Where appropriate, notify of the award on Contracts Finder . On your ‘Manage your DPS Category Exports’ page you now have 2 options: view appointed suppliers click on the link to create a new category export This is how you filter the suppliers that can meet your requirements. when creating a new category use the filtering tool (select all that apply) to specify your requirements and create your supplier shortlist Save your filtered list of capable suppliers by clicking the ‘Save Category’ option and give the shortlist a unique name specific to your competition. Use the list to run a further Competition. Invite the suppliers identified by the DPS to bid against your detailed specification, evaluation criteria and contract format. the list is valid for only 2 working days , from the date of its creation, because new suppliers may apply to join at any point. if your call for competition excludes eligible suppliers it potentially breaches procurement regulations you will need to get a fresh supplier list (steps 3.2 to 5) if you do not use your list within 2 working days by clicking the ‘Search Again’ option for your export you can use the our eSourcing tool to run a call for competition. The tool is free to use for public sector buyers, or you can use your organisation’s own procurement tool. Your tender process should be proportionate to the value and complexity of your requirement. Suppliers will need a reasonable period of time to review and prepare a response. This includes allowing sufficient time for suppliers to ask clarification questions and consider your answers before the deadline for written responses. Evaluate the responses. Request from winning supplier(s) any required evidence that they can meet your requirements. Set a 2-day deadline for submitting evidence . result.text: The Deutsche Nationalbibliothek has the statutory mandate to collect its holdings both physically and digitally and to make them available to the general public. In order to fulfil the associated tasks and objectives as efficiently and purposefully as possible, an enterprise architecture optimally aligned with business skills is required. The diversity and scope of the tasks necessitate an extensive and complex business, information and technology architecture. In order to make strategic decisions on a sound basis, the Deutsche Nationalbibliothek requires an IT system for the management, maintenance and flexible evaluation of the data underlying the enterprise architecture. The procurement procedure includes the procurement of an Enterprise Architecture Management System (EAM)

parts.source: Die Deutsche Nationalbibliothek hat den gesetzlichen Auftrag, ihre Bestände sowohl physisch als auch digital zu sammeln und der breiten Öffentlichkeit verfügbar zu machen. Um die hiermit verbundenen Aufgaben und Ziel möglichst effizient und zielgerichtet zu erfüllen bedarf es einer auf die Geschäftsfertigkeiten optimal ausgerichtet Unternehmensarchitektur. Die Vielfältigkeit und der Umfang der Aufgaben bedingen eine umfangreiche und komplexe Geschäfts-, Informations- und Technologiearchitektur. Um strategische Entscheidungen auf einer fundierten Grundlage zu treffen, benötigt die Deutsche Nationalbibliothek ein IT-System zur Verwaltung, Pflege und flexiblen Auswertung der der Unternehmensarchitektur zugrundeliegenden Daten. Das Vergabeverfahren umfasst die Beschaffung eines Enterprise Architecture Management Systems (EAM)

result.text: The subject of the procurement is an appointment booking and video conferencing system (hereinafter also the "System") for use by the City of Mikkeli's customer services. The System to be procured must enable the management of customer service appointments for the City of Mikkeli's employment services and customer meetings via video conferencing through a single system. The objective is to procure a SaaS ready-made solution that is easy to use, meets data protection and other legislative requirements, and can be implemented on a rapid schedule. The procurement seeks a comprehensive appointment booking and video conferencing system as a ready-made solution that offers pre-built functions for managing appointments and conducting video conferences. A ready-made solution refers to a finished end product that can be configured for the Subscriber's use without the procurement involving the development of a completely bespoke system. In the initial phase, the System will be for the use of the City of Mikkeli's employment services. Later, the City of Mikkeli must have the option to expand the use of the System to other units. The procurement seeks one (1) party with overall responsibility to supply the System as a SaaS service. The overall service must include the necessary software interfaces, programs, firmware, licences, and maintenance and support services in accordance with the call for tenders and its appendices. The contract period is estimated to begin in November 2026 and the contract is valid until further notice.

parts.source: Hankinnan kohteena on ajanvaraus- ja videoneuvottelujärjestelmä (myöhemmin myös ”Järjestelmä”) Mikkelin kaupungin asiakaspalveluiden käyttöön. Tavoitteena on hankkia SaaS valmisratkaisuna helppokäyttöinen, tietosuoja- ja muun lainsäädännön vaatimukset täyttävä kokonaisratkaisu, joka voidaan ottaa käyttöön nopeassa aikataulussa. Hankinnassa tavoitellaan kattavaa ajanvaraus- ja videoneuvottelujärjestelmää valmisratkaisuna, joka tarjoaa valmiit toiminnot ajanvarausten hallintaan ja videoneuvotteluiden toteuttamiseen. Valmisratkaisulla tarkoitetaan valmista päätuotetta, jota voidaan konfiguroida Tilaajan käyttöön ilman, että hankinnan kohteena on kokonaan räätälöidyn järjestelmän kehittäminen. Ensivaiheessa Järjestelmä tulee Mikkelin kaupungin työllisyyspalveluiden käyttöön. Myöhemmin Mikkelin kaupungilla tulee olla mahdollisuus laajentaa Järjestelmän käyttöä muihin yksiköihin. Hankinnalla haetaan yhtä (1) kokonaisvastuullista toimittajaa toimittamaan Järjestelmä SaaS palveluna. Kokonaispalvelun tulee sisältää tarvittavat käyttöliittymät, ohjelmat, varusohjelmistot, lisenssit ja ylläpito- tukipalvelut tarjouspyynnön ja sen liitteiden mukaisesti. result.text: The subject of the service is the design, development, implementation, commissioning and initial optimisation of an AI-supported, multimodal visitor guide for use in the tourist visitor operations of Westfälischer Zoologischer Garten Münster GmbH. The contractor's service covers the complete project lifecycle from conception through development, piloting and rollout to productive operation, including support, monitoring, security, optimisation and operational services. Lot LOT-0001: Development and implementation of an AI-supported visitor guide. The AI technology is the heart of the SKADI project. As a digital system, it is intended to include functions such as barrier-free communication and precise navigation in the smallest of spaces. In addition to strengthening accessibility and digitalisation, the system helps to convey important topics such as sustainability and species protection through its function as a digital learning offer - on a regional and international basis. Furthermore, the system uses artificial intelligence and machine learning algorithms to analyse user behaviour and suggests suitable experiences based on preferences and current location data. In addition, the system enables the networking of tourist / natural history offers through the integration of specifically named sources. Users can not only obtain individual information about animal species, habitats, protected areas and events, but can also design things themselves via the digital guide, for example.

parts.source: Gegenstand der Dienstleistung ist die Konzeption, Entwicklung, Implementierung, Inbetriebnahme sowie die Erstoptimierung eines KI-gestützten, multimodalen Besucher-Guides für den Einsatz im touristischen Besucherbetrieb der Westfälischer Zoologischer Garten Münster GmbH. Die Leistung des Auftragnehmers umfasst den vollständigen Projektlebenszyklus von der Konzeption über Entwicklung, Pilotierung und Rollout bis hin zum produktiven Betrieb einschließlich Support-, Monitoring-, Sicherheits-, Optimierungs- und Betriebsleistungen. Lot LOT-0001: Entwicklung und Implementierung KI-gestützter Besucherguide. Die KI-Technologie ist das Herzstück des Projektes SKADI. Sie soll als digitales System Funktionen wie barrierefreie Kommunikation und präzise Navigation auf kleinstem Raum beinhalten. Neben der Stärkung der Barrierefreiheit und Digitalisierung trägt das System durch seine Funktion als digitales Lernangebot dazu bei, wichtige Themen wie Nachhaltigkeit und Artenschutz zu vermitteln - auf regionaler und internationaler Basis. Des Weiteren analysiert das System mithilfe künstlicher Intelligenz und Machine-Learning-Algorithmen das Nutzerverhalten und schlägt basierend auf Vorlieben sowie aktuellen Standortdaten passende Erlebnisse vor. Außerdem ermöglicht das System durch die Integration der spezifisch genannten Quellen die Vernetzung von touristischen / naturkundlichen Angeboten. result.text: Scotland has the highest drug and alcohol related death rates in the UK and Europe. People with substance use issues (PWSUI) often need help outside normal 'office' hours or from a distance from offices, and support is not uniformly available throughout Scotland. The support landscape in Scotland is fragmented, hard to navigate, and varies by locality. When support isn’t readily available (or isn’t trusted), people and their families and friends often default to emergency services or remain unsupported. As a result, those who use substances often experience avoidable crisis escalation, or remain in extremely difficult situations, and support services miss opportunities for early, harm-reducing interventions. The Preventing Harm, Promoting Recovery: Scotland’s Alcohol & Drugs Strategic Plan 2026 – 2035 specifically addresses the crucial need to tackle early intervention and widen an individual’s ‘circle of support’. This ‘circle of support’ is at the heart of this Challenge, and a successful solution would enable people to access the right support sooner, regardless of locality. It should harness the power of existing trusted services, family and community to reduce avoidable demand on emergency and NHS services – and if possible, create a ‘feedback loop’ of learning, intelligence and insight so that the overall issue can be tackled in a continually improving manner.

result.text: Information and Communication Technologies (ICT) were developed at the end of the last century and have been widely used tools since 1995. In the university environment, it can be stated that they have been tools of global use (by all university members) since the late 90s of the last century. Since those dates, the activity of any university member (whether PDI, student or PTGAS) is no longer understood, nor can it be carried out normally, without using electronic mail or web-based information access, or teaching without the utilities of the virtual campus, etc. Day by day, new applications are incorporated that improve and facilitate the daily work of university members (videoconferencing, collaborative work tools, etc.). A direct consequence of this change in the working conditions of university members is that one of the basic tools (if not the first) of the workplace of any university member is their personal computer and mobile devices; machines through which these work tools can be used without which daily activity cannot be carried out. The University of Zaragoza therefore requires the acquisition of personal computers and mobile devices for use in all its areas of activity: teaching, research and university management. Within each of these areas (especially in teaching and research) needs are not uniform since working environments are very different (philosophy, law, computer science, etc.). On the other hand, it is very difficult (not to say impossible) to plan the needs of each group sufficiently in advance since funding sources are diverse and cannot be predicted in advance. The framework agreement is the ideal way to cover the university's needs since it allows purchases to be standardised, enabling each unit to make them when necessary. The procedure is subdivided into 2 lots: 1. Lot 1 dedicated to the acquisition of personal computers with macOS operating system, their peripherals and accessories. 2. Lot 2 includes tablets (tablets in English terminology) with IOS operating system, increasingly used due to their portability Lot 1: personal computers with macOS operating system; Lot 2: tablets with IOS operating system.

A robust and scalable architecture that ensures precise, reliable and stable handling of meter data - even under maximum load. A maintenance-friendly solution with high performance and flexibility in relation to future upgrades and expansions. In relation to the procurement, a consultation of documents for the tender material is being carried out on an ongoing basis.
