result.text: Background and problem statement: DEHSt has been operating end-to-end digitised specialist procedures for approximately 20 years. Central components of the IT landscape used by DEHSt are in a phase of renewal. The number of software artefacts to be developed by DEHSt is continuously increasing – as a result, schedules are constantly becoming tighter and the parallelisation and complexity are increasing. Furthermore, several legacy systems must be completely replaced. To remedy this, DEHSt has developed a software development kit (SDK) consisting of software and comprehensive documentation, for example for commissioning a test and integration environment. The aim of the SDK is, on the one hand, to carry out a technological renewal and, on the other hand, to significantly increase development speed while simultaneously maintaining standards. The SDK provides documentation, software libraries, several independent services for the centralised control (workflow control) of the specialist applications, as well as a base application and an example application that integrate into DEHSt's existing software and process landscape (e.g. addressing existing central services, the so-called "DEHSt platform"). The SDK and the DEHSt platform rely on a separation of frontend (AngularJS, NgRx, Material), backend (Spring-Boot), distributed web services and a build pipeline in GitLab, as well as scalable container-based operation (Docker images on RedHat OKD). . Aim and subject matter of the project: This procurement measure tenders a framework agreement with a term of 4 years. The framework agreement may be extended twice, by one year each time. The project is intended to encompass the development and maintenance of the entire software development kit (SDK) as well as the development of specialist applications built upon it. We distinguish between three related but parallel task areas: 1) Lot 1: SDK maintenance and management 2) Lot 2: New development of specialist applications 3) Lot 3: Migration and replacement of legacy systems For the SDK team, the goal is to increase the benefit for administrative staff, but equally to positively influence the development duration of the developer teams. For the developer teams, a goal must be to develop a high-quality application in the shortest possible time based on a detailed specification. Lot LOT-0001: Development and maintenance of the DEHSt software development kit for creating specialist applications for DEHSt enforcement procedures (Lot 1). Lot 1: SDK maintenance and management . According to current planning status, the contracting authority intends to commission tasks of up to 2.560 person days (PD) in the first four years. Subject to possible changes in the legal situation regarding European and national emissions trading, the contracting authority expects that at least 50% of the upper limit for person days stated here will be commissioned. Should the contract be extended by one year each time, the contracting authority expects tasks amounting to 640 PD per extension (up to 25% of the original scope). For the purpose of approximate capacity planning, we envisage a demand of approximately 960 PD in the first year and an average of 500 PD per subsequent year. It is assumed that the workload can be distributed relatively evenly across the months so that a constant utilisation of a development team can be achieved. Lot LOT-0002: Development and maintenance of specialist applications for DEHSt enforcement procedures based on the DEHSt software development kit with a focus on new developments (Lot 2). Lot 2: New development of specialist applications . According to current planning status, the contracting authority intends to commission tasks of up to 3.056 person days (PD) in the first four years. Subject to possible changes in the legal situation regarding European and national emissions trading, the contracting authority expects that at least 50% of the upper limit for person days stated here will be commissioned. Should the contract be extended by one year each time, the contracting authority expects tasks amounting to 764 PD per extension (up to 25% of the original scope). For the purpose of approximate capacity planning, we generally envisage a demand of 500 PD per year, but in each case in 2028 and 2029 an increased demand of approximately 1.000 PD. Utilisation over the course of the year can vary greatly. The provision of the specialist applications must in the vast majority of cases take place by fixed statutory deadlines. As a result, several development projects must be processed in parallel. This is accompanied by an increased personnel requirement that must be covered by the contractor (e.g. two to four development resources work on a specialist application, up to four specialist application projects must be processed simultaneously). Unfortunately, the statutory deadlines can generally not be influenced by the contracting authority. Lot LOT-0003: Development and maintenance of specialist applications for DEHSt enforcement procedures based on the DEHSt software development kit with a focus on migration of existing specialist applications (Lot 3). Lot 3: Migration and replacement of legacy systems . According to current planning status, the contracting authority intends to commission tasks of up to 4.472 (person days) PD in the first four years. Subject to possible changes in the legal situation regarding European and national emissions trading, the contracting authority expects that at least 50% of the upper limit for person days stated here will be commissioned. Should the contract be extended by one year each time, the contracting authority expects tasks amounting to 1.118 PD per extension (up to 25% of the original scope).

parts.source: Hintergrund und Problemstellung: Die DEHSt betreibt seit ca. 20 Jahren Ende-zu-Ende digitalisierte Fachverfahren. Zentrale Komponenten der eingesetzten IT-Landschaft der DEHSt befinden sich in einer Phase der Erneuerung. Die Anzahl der von der DEHSt zu entwickelnden Softwareartefakte wächst kontinuierlich an – Zeitpläne werden dadurch stetig enger und die Parallelisierung und Komplexität nimmt zu. Mehrere Altsysteme müssen zudem vollständig abgelöst werden. Um Abhilfe zu schaffen, hat die DEHSt ein Software-Development-Kit (SDK) entwickelt, das aus Software und einer umfangreichen Dokumentation etwa für die Inbetriebnahme einer Test- und Integrationsumgebung besteht. Ziel des SDK ist dabei einerseits eine technologische Erneuerung durchzuführen, andererseits die Entwicklungsgeschwindigkeit deutlich zu erhöhen bei gleichzeitiger Wahrung von Standards. Das SDK stellt dabei Dokumentation, Software-Bibliotheken, mehrere eigenständige Dienste für die zentralisierte Steuerung (Workflowsteuerung) der Fachanwendungen sowie eine Basis- und eine Beispielanwendung bereit, die sich in die bestehende Software- und Prozesslandschaft der DEHSt integriert (also etwa bestehende Zentrale Dienste anspricht, die sog. „DEHSt-Plattform“). Das SDK und die DEHSt-Plattform setzen auf eine Trennung von Frontend (AngularJS, NgRx, Material), Backend (Spring-Boot), verteilten Webservices und einer Build-Strecke in GitLab sowie einem skalierbaren Betrieb auf Containern-Basis (Docker Images auf RedHat OKD). . Für die Entwicklerteams muss es ein Ziel sein, basierend auf einer ausgearbeiteten Spezifikation, eine qualitativ hochwertige Anwendung in möglichst geringer Zeit zu entwickeln. result.text: The city of Bad Rappenau intends to comprehensively renew its IT infrastructure. The subject matter comprises in particular the server and storage components as well as the client environment at the locations of the municipal administration. The project encompasses the delivery, setup, configuration and commissioning of the intended IT components. Additionally, the existing virtualised server environment based on VMware is to be migrated to the new target environment. The procurement is structured as a rental model based on a BVB rental contract. A basic rental period of 60 months with optional extension possibilities is envisaged. In addition to the provision of the rental items, clearly defined service and support services are to be rendered for the contract term. Upon contract termination, the rental items including associated data carriers are to be taken back in an orderly manner and subjected to a qualified, verifiable data deletion. The concept for the take-back, inventorying and deletion forms part of the contractual performance. The focus of the project lies on establishing operational readiness in the server area and workstations, which are distributed across 15 locations. Rollouts, replacement measures and production-relevant switchovers are to be planned and carried out primarily in defined maintenance windows on Friday afternoons and at weekends in accordance with the logged key data. In addition to the new server and storage infrastructure, workstation components and monitors in relevant quantities also form part of the project, with the final quantities and device specifications being specified within the scope of the specification of requirements. The services form an objective, economic and legal unit. The contractor assumes responsibility as general contractor for establishing the agreed functionality of the overall system and for coordinating subcontractors and manufacturers. Insofar as the contractor deploys third parties to fulfil the rental model, they remain the sole contractual partner of the contracting authority. Essential to the contract is the establishment of operational readiness in the target environment as well as complete documentation including a reliable rollout concept as the basis for implementation and acceptance. The contracting authority places particular emphasis on an economical overall solution and on transparent follow-up costs. Above all, impacts on existing licence and subscription models are to be presented in a comprehensible manner.

parts.source: Die Stadt Bad Rappenau beabsichtigt, ihre IT-Infrastruktur ganzheitlich zu erneuern. Gegenstand sind insbesondere die Server und Storage Komponenten sowie das Clientumfeld an den Standorten der Stadtverwaltung. Das Projekt umfasst die Lieferung, den Aufbau, die Konfiguration und die Inbetriebnahme der vorgesehenen IT-Komponenten. Zusätzlich soll die Migration der bestehenden virtualisierten Serverumgebung auf Basis von VMware in die neue Zielumgebung migriert werden. Die Beschaffung wird als Mietmodell auf Basis eines BVB-Mietvertrags ausgestaltet. Vorgesehen ist eine Grundmietzeit von 60 Monaten mit optionalen Verlängerungsmöglichkeiten. Neben der Bereitstellung der Mietgegenstände sind für die Vertragslaufzeit klar abgegrenzte Service- und Supportleistungen zu erbringen. Nach Vertragsende sind die Mietgegenstände einschließlich zugehöriger Datenträger geordnet zurückzunehmen und einer qualifizierten, nachweisbaren Datenlöschung zuzuführen. Das Konzept zur Rücknahme, zur Inventarisierung und zur Löschung ist Bestandteil der vertraglichen Leistung. Der Schwerpunkt des Projektes liegt in der Herstellung der Betriebsbereitschaft im Serverbereich und den Arbeitsplätzen, die sich auf 15 Standorte verteilen . Rollouts, Austauschmaßnahmen und produktionsrelevante Umschaltungen sind nach den protokollierten Eckdaten vorrangig in definierten Wartungsfenstern am Freitagnachmittag und an Wochenenden zu planen und durchzuführen. Neben der neuen Server- und Storage Infrastruktur sind auch Arbeitsplatzkomponenten und Monitore in relevanter Stückzahl Bestandteil des Vorhabens, wobei die finalen Mengen und Geräteausprägungen im Rahmen des Leistungsverzeichnisses konkretisiert werden. Die Leistungen bilden eine sachliche, wirtschaftliche und rechtliche Einheit. Der Auftragnehmer übernimmt die Verantwortung als Generalunternehmer für die Herstellung der vereinbarten Funktionsfähigkeit des Gesamtsystems und für die Koordination von Nachunternehmern, Herstellern. Soweit der Auftragnehmer zur Erfüllung des Mietmodells Dritte einsetzt, bleibt er alleiniger Vertragspartner des Auftraggebers. Vertragswesentlich ist die Herstellung der Betriebsbereitschaft in der Zielumgebung sowie die vollständige Dokumentation einschließlich eines belastbaren Rolloutkonzepts als Grundlage der Durchführung und der Abnahme. Der Auftraggeber legt besonderen Wert auf eine wirtschaftliche Gesamtlösung und auf transparente Folgekosten. Vor allem Auswirkungen auf bestehende Lizenz und Subskriptionsmodelle sind nachvollziehbar darzustellen.

result.text: PURPOSE NIOSH intends to support the Centers of Excellence in Total Worker Health® (TWH). These Centers will conduct rigorous research and translation activities to prevent harmful exposures, improve working conditions, and advance worker well-being. The Centers will develop practical, scalable solutions for employers and workers. All projects must use the NIOSH Worker Well-Being Questionnaire (WellBQ) and share data with the HERO Worker Well-Being Clearinghouse. Large Research Projects require economic evaluation. PRIORITY AREAS • High-risk occupations: First responders, vehicle mechanics, and technicians, with emphasis on occupational exposures, related health risks, and prevention strategies • Young workers, SMEs • Chronic disease • Mental health, stress • Substance use disorder • Artificial intelligence (AI), digital technologies This is a multi-component NOFO. COMPONENT STRUCTURE Percentages indicate maximum share of total budget. Overall Component (Required) Provides Center leadership and integration. Applicants should show strong coordination, scientific direction, and alignment across projects. Administration, Evaluation, and Emerging Issues Core (Required; up to 15%) Supports management and Center-wide evaluation. Applicants should describe oversight, data governance, and quality assurance.Optional activities include emerging issues and shared research resources. Outreach, Dissemination, and Impact Core (Required; up to 15%) Supports communication, worker/employer engagement, training, translation, implementation, and dissemination strategies. Research Projects (Required; about 60 to 70%) Includes all research activities. Applicants may propose a mix of projects. Research project distinctions are based on scope and complexity rather than cost. Projects should demonstrate scientific rigor and potential for sustained impact. Small Research Projects (Required; at least one project; up to 3 years) Exploratory, feasibility, early-stage intervention, surveillance, or measurement studies. Priority areas: high-risk occupations, young workers, SMEs. Should show innovation and potential to expand. Large Research Projects (Required; at least one project; up to 5 years) Multiyear etiologic, mechanistic, intervention, or translational studies. Priority areas: chronic disease, mental health, substance use disorder. Economic evaluation is required. Projects should include strong design and analytic plans. Pilot/Feasibility Program (Optional; 12–18 months) Short-term studies generating preliminary data or testing AI/digital technology approaches.

result.text: NOW IS YOUR CHANCE TO INFLUENCE THE PROCUREMENT DURING THE MARKET CONSULTATION PHASE! The main applicant and administrator of the project is the Urban Environment Division of the City of Lappeenranta. In addition to the City of Lappeenranta, the project includes the cities of Turku, Vaasa, Kouvola, Oulu, Espoo, Kokkola, Tampere, Järvenpää and Helsinki. For the planning of this AI project, the municipalities have invited the Ministry of the Environment, Senate Properties, the Association of Finnish Cities and Municipalities (AFCM), universities, and other Finnish, European and international public organisations to participate in stakeholder cooperation. The main driving force behind the need for a new AI service is the national need for the use of data analysis models arising from the reform of the Building Act and Decree. In Finland, the new Building Act was adopted by the Parliament in February 2023. With this market survey, the Municipalities AI development project is identifying markets and potential suppliers to identify an AI service for automatic inspection and building control use cases for buildings, built environment and Geographic information. For a more detailed description of the requirements of the solution sought, please refer to the 'Description of the Acquisition' section of this notice. This notice does not call for tenders or requests for participation. Company-specific interviews via teams will be held via Teams during October – November 2026. The organizer reserves the right to record the event if needed. For companies who are interested in participating in the interviews and market dialogue please provide your answers to given pre-questions by latest by October 07, 2026. The contracting entity reserves the possibility of inviting the companies that have expressed interest to present their products or solutions at company-specific events and to send a possible draft invitation to tender for comments to interested companies before the possible publication of the actual contract notice or tender. The aim is to organize possible company-specific presentation events during October 2026 (in principle remotely). The timetables and other information provided in this notice, such as the planned market dialogue, are preliminary and indicative and may change as the preparation of the notification progresses. The information provided is not binding on the contracting entity. Failure to respond to the market survey will not prevent a supplier from participating in a potential tender and will not affect the supplier's position in the actual tender. This notice does not call for tenders or requests for participation. The market survey is accompanied by an invitation to a market survey, where the contracting entity can conduct a market dialogue with the operators that have expressed an interest. The outcome of this market survey will be used by the municipalities and stakeholders in Finland, such as ministries, to prepare a separate development project and a competitive tendering process for the procurement of suitable products according to the market. We warmly invite interested companies to participate in the market dialogue!

result.text: Instrument for particle size and shape characterisation of natural and industrial granular materials. Lot 1: . Instrument for particle size and shape characterisation of natural and industrial granular materials e.g.: -Volcanic flow particles (ash, lapilli, pumice, scoria etc.) derived from pyroclastic density currents, fallout deposits, lahars and debris flows. -Industrial particulate materials relevant to construction. -Soils -Construction materials (concretes, mortars, lightweight aggregates, composites) -Agricultural amendments and granules (including Biochar) -Polymer/composite additives -Energy storage materials (electrodes, conductive carbons) Materials will range from coarse granules to fine powders, typically irregular, porous, low-density and black. Essential requirements (minimum) Measurement capability -Measures both particle size distribution and particle shape in one instrument or tightly integrated system. -Image-based technique (e.g. dynamic image analysis or equivalent) suitable for irregular, opaque, carbonaceous particles. -Provides at least: -Size metrics: equivalent diameter, D10/D50/D90, full distribution. -Shape metrics: aspect ratio, circularity/roundness, and at least one compactness/solidity/convexity parameter. Size range and performance -Usable size range: -Lower limit ≤ 1μm -Upper limit ≥ 5 mm -Capable of analysing polydisperse samples in a single run. -At least 50,000 particles analysed per standard measurement (for powders). -Repeatability better than 3 % RSD on D10/D50/D90 for suitable reference materials. Sample handling and dispersion -Dry dispersion unit for low-density, porous, angular powders and granules: -Controlled feed (e.g. vibratory feeder or equivalent). -Adjustable dispersion energy/pressure. -Wet dispersion capability: -Recirculating wet cell for suspensions of soils, biochar and carbon powders. -Compatibility with at least water and common alcohols (e.g. ethanol or isopropanol). Shape analysis and classification -Shape parameters computed for all measured particles or size classes. -Ability to filter and analyse particles by size and/or shape (e.g. size range, aspect ratio range). -Display and export of representative particle images for documentation and publications. Software, data handling and reporting -Method/SOP editor for storing and recalling measurement conditions. -Export of size and shape data in standard formats (e.g. CSV, Excel). -Overlay and comparison of multiple measurements. -Configurable reports (number/area/volume distributions, cumulative and density plots, basic shape statistics). Calibration and practical aspects -Calibration/verification with traceable particle size standards in relevant ranges. -Documented traceability to relevant particle sizing standards (ISO/ASTM or equivalent). -Design suitable for dusty, abrasive, black powders, with straightforward cleaning of the dispersion path. -Enclosed optics and standard laser/electrical safety compliance. -Access to local service and technical support. 3. Desirable (nice-to-have) features Extended capabilities -Integrated laser diffraction module (wet and/or dry) using the same dispersion units, providing sub-micron coverage (≈0.1 μm or lower). -Dedicated fibre/rod analysis (length, width, L/W ratio) for fibrous chars/carbon fibres. -Extended upper size limit to ≥ 10 mm for large granules and aggregates. -Interchangeable optics/lenses to optimise measurements for fine powders vs coarse granules. Advanced dispersion and handling -Multiple dry disperser configurations (gentle and aggressive). -Integrated anti-static measures (e.g. ioniser) for very fine, low-density powders. -Low-volume wet cells (few mL) for expensive or low-yield materials. -Integrated, controllable ultrasonic dispersion (power and time) with logging. Automation and integration -Optional autosampler for unattended measurement of multiple samples. -API or scripting interface for method control and automated data extraction. -Database/LIMS connectivity for long-term storage and retrieval of results. Robustness -Wear-resistant materials in nozzles and flow paths. -Design that minimises cross-contamination.

result.text: Aberdeen City Council is seeking market engagement to inform the potential procurement of a city-focused Aberdeen Destination Marketing and Development Service, funded through the Aberdeen Visitor Levy, which is due to apply from 1 April 2027. The proposed service would support Aberdeen’s position as a leading visitor destination by delivering destination marketing, city promotion, market intelligence, business engagement, product development and visitor economy development activity. It would seek to increase awareness of Aberdeen, grow visitor numbers and length of stay, support accommodation demand, amplify the city’s cultural, events, heritage, hospitality, leisure and business tourism offer, and contribute to the city’s wider economic transition. The service is expected to focus on Aberdeen city while recognising that the wider regional offer — including landscapes, coastline, castles, golf, food and drink, outdoor activity and touring itineraries — forms an important part of the destination proposition. The Council is also interested in how the service should interface with convention bureau and business events activity where this supports additional visitors, bed nights and economic value for the city. This Prior Information Notice is for market engagement only. It is not a call for competition and does not commit the Council to a procurement, contract award or any particular delivery model. Lot 1: . Aberdeen City Council is considering the procurement of an Aberdeen Destination Marketing and Development Service to support the objectives of the Aberdeen Visitor Levy and the sustainable growth of the city’s visitor economy. The service is expected to be delivered as a city-focused programme for Aberdeen. Its purpose will be to promote Aberdeen as a distinctive destination for leisure and business visitors, encourage people to visit, stay longer and spend more, and support the development of a strong visitor offer across the city’s venues, events, festivals, culture, attractions, hospitality and tourism businesses. The anticipated scope may include destination marketing and communications, city promotion, business engagement, visitor economy development, product and itinerary development, travel trade support, market intelligence, performance evaluation and reporting. Where included within the final scope, the service may also interface with convention bureau and business events activity where this supports additional visitors, accommodation bed nights and economic value for Aberdeen. The service will be expected to complement, rather than duplicate, wider regional destination activity, while maintaining a clear focus on improving Aberdeen’s position as a visitor destination. It will also be expected to support transparent public reporting on the use and impact of Visitor Levy proceeds, including evidence of outputs, outcomes and performance against agreed indicators. This notice is intended to inform market engagement and procurement planning. Any future procurement will be subject to Council approvals, final service specification, available budget and the applicable procurement process.

result.text: The objective of this procurement is to establish a multi-supplier framework agreement for the provision of software development expertise for the entire VR Group. The framework covers development needs arising across VR Group companies, including but not limited to passenger services, logistics operations, infrastructure-related systems, commercial platforms, customer-facing digital services, and internal operational systems. The procurement covers Web Development (e.g. web based technologies such as modern frontend frameworks and standards). Experts are assigned to VR’s agile development teams, who operate according to VR’s technology choices and established models where VR acts as the Product Owner and oversees overall project and development management. Work is carried out in a hybrid model, both on-site at VR’s premises in Helsinki and remotely in accordance with VR’s working guidelines. The service also includes a Supplier-appointed Service Manager (for reporting, invoicing etc.). In accordance with Section 45(2) of the Act on Procurement in the Utilities Sectors, the maximum total value of contracts awarded under this Framework Agreement during the entire contract period shall be EUR 20 000 000 (VAT 0%). Tenderers are requested to note that the value stated above does not constitute the estimated value of the procurement, but the statutory maximum value as referred to in the Act. The maximum value also includes possible option periods of the procurement. VR Group does not commit to any minimum purchase volumes. Actual resource needs may increase or decrease during the contract period based on business requirements, technological development, and the lifecycle of projects and systems. The initial contract period is two (2) years, after which the Customer may extend the Agreement with four (4) optional periods of one (1) year each. This procurement will be carried out using an open procedure. The Finnish Act on Procurements and Concession Contracts of Entities Operating in the Water and Energy Supply, Transport and Postal Services Sector (Act 1398/2016, “Act on Public Contracts in the Utilities Sector”) applies to this procurement. Tenders must meet all suitability requirements set out in this notice and its appendices. The subject of the procurement is described in more detail in Appendix 2 (Procurement Description) to the Invitation to Tender. The suitability requirements for Tenderers are set out in the ESPD form.

result.text: IKT Agder IKS intends to enter into a contract with Visma Flyt AS for the trade system Visma Flyt PPT for the PP services included in the ICT Agder cooperation. The procurement includes user rights, establishment, operation, maintenance, upgrades, user support and necessary integrations. The system shall support the PP services professional and administrative case handling, document handling, archiving, communication, access management and processing of personal data. The contract ́s estimated total value is NOK 7,000,000 excluding VAT. The value is calculated for a combined contract period of eight years and it can be adjusted as a result of the final contract extent, agreed clarifications and price index regulation. The procurement shall be implemented pursuant to the Public Procurement Regulations § 13-4 letter b no. 2. The contracting authority requires a solution specifically designed for the Norwegian Educational and Psychological Counselling Service (PPT) and adapted to Norwegian legislation, administrative procedures, language requirements, national integrations and information management requirements. The required functionality is closely integrated with existing user management, role-based access control, data integrity controls and Norwegian public-sector digital services. Following a market assessment, no reasonable alternatives or substitutes have been identified that can satisfy the contracting authority's overall technical and operational requirements. The contract will be signed at the earliest when ten calendar days have passed, calculated from the day after the date of publication of the intention notice. Any objections received before the contract is signed will be considered before a final decision is made on signing the contract.

The communication services include, as services to be provided continuously, among other things, the project-accompanying management and coordination of public relations as well as the project-accompanying maintenance and support of PR instruments. In addition, the contract covers the optional call-off of further communication services, such as crisis communication and the organisation and implementation of events. Lot LOT-0000: Communication services during the implementation and subsequent commissioning phase (VE7007) for the infrastructure project extension of the U2 underground line to Bad Homburg station. The extension of the U2 underground line provides for the closing of the gap between the Bad Homburg v. d. Höhe station and the previous terminus of the U2 underground line. Previously, the U2 line ended at the Gonzenheim stop. The integration of the U2 line at Bad Homburg station takes place north of the existing S-Bahn tracks in the area of the former so-called Fürstengleis. The planned route requires the conversion of the technical equipment of the Deutsche Bahn infrastructure facilities, the planning of which is the subject of this tender. The planning of the new construction measure is already taking place. For the construction project, there is a planning approval decision dated 25.01.2016, which represents the basis for the planning services of the new construction measure and the adjustment measures. result.text: Framework agreement for support and development services for the IVZ and its cooperation partners as well as the (D)einSAP business process organisation in the SAP field. The award of the services takes the form of a framework agreement with a maximum of four framework contractors for lot 1 and 2 and a maximum of three framework contractors for lot 3. The subject of the tender is the conclusion of a framework agreement for support, development and consulting services in the environment of the existing SAP system landscape, in particular the SAP S/4 HANA solution. The main focus of the service provision is on supporting ongoing SAP operations as well as the continuous further development and optimisation of applications and processes. The services comprise in particular: - Implementation of customising as well as functional and technical extensions - Development, operation and further development of technical components and interfaces - Consulting and technical design in the respective SAP specialist domains - 2nd- and 3rd-level support: analysis and processing of incidents as well as processing of service requests - Implementation of changes (incl. tests, documentation and quality assurance) - Documentation and presentation of work results. The award of the services takes the form of a framework agreement with a maximum of four framework contractors for lot 1 and 2 and a maximum of three framework contractors for lot 3. The exact design of the service contents is determined with the respective individual call-offs. The persons designated for deployment by the contractor cover the requirements in accordance with the criteria catalogue. The following general conditions exist for the provision of services: - The contractor is deployed as needed upon call-off by the IVZ - The data and information controller is the respective organisation for its company code - The host within the meaning of operations is the IVZ for the client (all company codes) - It is necessary to make changes regarding customising in the individual company codes - The contracting authority does not provide any hardware to the service providers (PC, telephone or similar). result.text: Shropshire Council is undertaking Preliminary Market Engagement (PME) to understand the current market for digital solutions that support unpaid carers. This engagement will help inform the Council’s future commissioning approach before any decision is made about whether to tender, use an existing compliant route, develop an alternative model, or take no further procurement action. Shropshire Council has an established Unpaid Carer Support offer. Recently this has become an all-age offer supporting Young Carers and Parent Carers. The Unpaid Carers portal will be an online offer which will be available to Unpaid Carers 24/7 throughout the journey of their caring role. We are aware there are a large proportion of people who do not identify as an Unpaid Carer, we envisage the portal will support with that identification and will provide relevant up to date information to support families in a preventative manner. Any proposed solution should offer the following support: Increase the identification recognition and early interventions for unpaid Carers Delay and reduce the need to access high-cost statutory provision Improve accessibility to information, advice and guidance, improve links and signposting to services that are already available nationally, regionally and locally. Support Unpaid Carers to access self-help and self-management support to reduce the need for Unpaid Carers crisis interventions. Include access to Unpaid Carers 'self-assessment' focused on individualised outcomes The solution should have the capacity to collect and produce relative data regarding demographics, ethnicity, age range as well as information such as when and where the portal is accessed. Lot 1: . None

result.text: The DOE Office of Science (SC), Office of Critical Minerals and Energy Innovation (CMEI), Office of Environmental Management (EM), Office of Nuclear Energy (NE), Office of Electricity (OE), and Hydrocarbons and Geothermal Office (HGEO) hereby announce interest in receiving applications from interdisciplinary teams addressing the Genesis Mission National Science and Technology Challenges to accelerate scientific discovery and research and development (R&D) workflows using novel artificial intelligence (AI) models and frameworks. By achieving AI advantage, these teams will advance the DOE's mission and ensure America’s security and prosperity by addressing energy, environmental, and nuclear challenges through science and technology. Teams are encouraged to leverage the extensive scientific and data resources of the DOE/National Nuclear Security Administration (NNSA), the National Laboratories, U.S. industry, and academia. The resulting AI models and workflows, if successful, may be integrated into the American Science Cloud. DOE is soliciting new FY26 Phase I small team and Phase II large team applications in the following topic areas: advanced manufacturing, biotechnology, critical materials, nuclear fission, nuclear fusion, quantum information science, semiconductors and microelectronics, discovery science, and energy (see specific focus areas in Section III Program Descriptions). In addition, this RFA will remain available to allow the recipients of FY26 Phase I awards to apply for larger team Phase II awards. In a few weeks, DOE plans to amend the RFA to clarify the LOI and application guidelines for FY26 Phase II awards. In FY27, DOE plans to amend the RFA or to issue an alternative funding opportunity to update the topic and focus areas to allow a second competition of Phase I small team applications and Phase II large team applications.

result.text: Myndigheten för kulturanalys hereby invites suppliers to apply to submit tenders for the above-mentioned procurement in accordance with this document and the attached documents. The documentation is intended to provide information on the conditions for the procurement and the assignment. The procurement is conducted as a negotiated procedure. This is step 1, application invitation. Suppliers are given the opportunity through this invitation to apply to submit tenders in step 2. The procurement relates to a web-based survey tool to be used by Kulturanalys for data collection within certain of our statistical areas, by 20 regions for annual follow-up of cultural activities with regional grants, and by the Swedish Arts Council for annual follow-up of state grants within the cultural cooperative model.

parts.source: Myndigheten för kulturanalys inbjuder härmed leverantörer att ansöka om att få lämna anbud på rubricerad upphandling i enlighet med detta dokument och bifogade dokument. Underlaget avser att ge information om förutsättningarna för upphandlingen och uppdraget. Upphandlingen genomförs som förhandlat förfarande. Detta är steg 1, ansökansinbjudan. Leverantörer ges genom denna inbjudan möjlighet att ansöka om att få lämna anbud i steg 2. Upphandlingen avser ett webbaserat enkätverktyg som ska användas av Kulturanalys för datainsamling inom vissa av våra statistikområden, av 20 regioner för årlig uppföljning av kulturverksamheter med regionala bidrag och av Kulturrådet för årlig uppföljning av statliga bidrag inom kultursamverkansmodellen.

Entitled accession parties in the aforementioned sense are - other IT service providers in the AOK system whose shareholders are exclusively AOKs or their joint subsidiaries held exclusively by AOKs, - joint subsidiaries of all AOKs and - AOKs that are not the shareholders of ITSCare, and which are each to be given the opportunity to accede to the contracts (framework agreements) in order to be able to participate in the services agreed in the framework agreement. Following the standard term (extended if applicable by exercising the aforementioned options), a transition-out phase takes place, the duration of which is a maximum of 12 months. result.text: The Stadtwerke Ingolstadt Beteiligungen GmbH (SWI) is planning the transformation of the existing SAP R/3 landscape to SAP S/4HANA using the brownfield approach. The subject of the tender is the award of services in several lots. Providers can apply for individual lots or for several lots. Licence and hardware requirements (HANA sizing, DB, infrastructure) must be taken into account by the bidder. Sustainability aspects (energy-efficient data centres, minimisation of dual operation) must be presented. Management of the SAP S/4HANA migration project (brownfield approach) programme in the context of this tender. The contractor shall provide project management, taking into account the assurance of governance, planning and reporting obligations (see service description); introduction of New GL incl. ledger solution, document splitting, profit centre balance sheet and FI AA; technical conception of FI/CO as well as customising in terms of the target ledger structure; subject. Migration of debtors/creditors to the business partner model; harmonisation & cleansing as a prerequisite for S/4; subject. Creation of technical concepts for affected modules and cross-sectional topics; target architecture for migration & integration; subject. Harmonisation & implementation of workflows (incoming invoice, PR/order) and catalogue connection; use of SAP standard; integration of archive/output; subject. GDPR-compliant archiving and deletion concept; SAP ILM as reference, equivalent solutions permitted (fully SAP-integrated, audit-proof, GDPR-compliant).

parts.source: Die Stadtwerke Ingolstadt Beteiligungen GmbH (SWI) plant die Transformation der bestehenden SAP R/3-Landschaft auf SAP S/4HANA im Brownfield-Ansatz. Gegenstand der Ausschreibung ist die Vergabe von Leistungen in mehreren Losen. Anbieter können sich auf einzelne Lose oder auf mehrere Lose bewerben. Lizenz- und Hardware-Anforderungen (HANA Sizing, DB, Infrastruktur) sind vom Bieter zu berücksichtigen. Nachhaltigkeitsaspekte (energieeffiziente Rechenzentren, Minimierung Doppelbetrieb) sind darzustellen. Steuerung des SAP S/4HANA Migrationsprojekt (Brownfield-Ansatz) Programms im Kontext dieser Ausschreibung. Der Auftragnehmer erbringt die Projektleitung unter Berücksichtigung der Sicherstellung von Governance, Planungs- und Berichtspflichten (s. Leistungsbeschreibung); Einführung New GL inkl. Ledergerlösung, Belegsplitt, Profit Center Bilanz und FI AA; fachliche Konzeption FI/CO sowie Customizing im Sinne der Ziel Ledgerstruktur.; Gegenstand. Migration von Debitoren/Kreditoren in das Geschäftspartner Modell; Harmonisierung & Bereinigung als Voraussetzung für S/4.; Gegenstand. Erstellung fachlicher Konzepte für betroffene Module und Querschnittsthemen; Zielarchitektur für Migration & Integration.; Gegenstand. Harmonisierung & Implementierung von Workflows (Eingangsrechnung, BANF/Bestellung) und Katalog Anbindung; Nutzung SAP Standard; Integration Archiv/Output.; Gegenstand. DSGVO konformes Archivierungs und Löschkonzept; SAP ILM als Referenz, gleichwertige Lösungen zulässig (voll SAP integriert, prüfungssicher, DSGVO konform).

result.text: The subject of the tender is independent quality assurance services for the software solution AIS (Adaptive Intelligent System). The services serve the objective and comprehensible evaluation of the provided software with regard to the functional, technical and security-related requirements defined in the respective lots. The aim of the services is to determine and document the quality status of the software and to identify deviations, defects, risks and potential for improvement. The results produced as part of quality assurance form an essential basis for the client's decision on the acceptance of the software. Responsibility for the acceptance decision remains exclusively with the client. The advertised services are divided into three lots. Submission of tenders is possible for one lot, for several lots or for all lots. There is therefore no obligation to submit tenders for all lots. The lots are evaluated independently of one another. The contract can be awarded to different contractors per lot. The tender comprises the following lots: Lot 1: Acceptance tests Lot 2: Security tests Lot 3: Code reviews The contractor shall provide its services in a professionally independent manner and free of instructions with regard to the evaluation of the test results. The services shall be provided on the basis of the documents, information, software statuses, source codes, test environments, test data, accesses and other resources required for the respective service provided by the client. result.text: Dumfries and Galloway Council intend to commission an organisation to develop and implement the creation of a local Poverty dashboard, designed to provide a clear, accessible view of child poverty across Dumfries and Galloway. The dashboard should be accessible to partner organisations and any other interested party. Dumfries and Galloway Council serve a region of around 148,000 people across the South West of Scotland, stretching from Stranraer in the West, to Moffat and Annan in the East. We are the 3rd largest local authority by area in Scotland. The latest published statistics show that the rate of child poverty in Dumfries and Galloway is 22.7%. This equates to 5,672 children and young people living in poverty in the region. For example, there are some real challenges around improving health outcomes for those experiencing poverty in the early years and to ensure that all families eligible for free school meals are reached. Lot 1: . Dumfries and Galloway have received funding through the Scottish Governments Fairer Futures initiative. The project is early in its inception but has the long-term goal to deliver systematic change in the way public services support parents and families out of poverty. Our approach is to use existing principles and approaches to put families first, focusing on prevention rather than cure. To help achieve this, accurately measuring poverty and low income is crucial, and the availability of real-time data is vital for effective policy-making. The dashboard would have geographic layers, allowing users to explore poverty data at varying levels of granularity, offering insights into where support is most needed, with a particular focus on priority groups identified by the Scottish Government. These include lone-parent households, families with a disabled member, large families, and households with a mother under the age of 25. It is hoped that data can be gathered that will make meaningful impact to household income, targeting those who are not currently accessing all the additional help and support they can. In addition it’s important that we understand the landscape of our household in poverty, not in our dense areas of deprivation. It would be sage if this could also include pertinent health related data around missed appointments, or additional useful information which might allow for a targeted approach to reduce health inequality. The dashboard should; -Filter data by employment status, housing tenure, and age group, enabling a nuanced understanding of the different dimensions of poverty. -Be a dynamic platform with regularly updated data, that can be continually used to inform decision making. -Be publicly accessible, this openness is essential for building trust and ensuring that anti-poverty efforts are responsive to the lived experiences of families across the region. The purpose of the Poverty Dashboard is to make it easier for the Council and its partners, working with our families in poverty, to easily identify the areas of greatest need to support an evidence based and targeted approach when tackling poverty and inequality in the region.. It is anticipated that this procurement requirement will be conducted through Quick Quote portal as a non-regulated procedure, interested organisations are encouraged to express an interest to be added to the quick quote where this goes as planned.

result.text: The Organisation’s Department of Human Resources is responsible for payroll processing and the operation of the City’s human resources and payroll systems, including current time and attendance management system. The organisation is seeking information from the market regarding available system solutions that manages a modern, integrated time and attendance management system that is required to manage and calculate working hours as well as absence and leave for input into the organisations payroll system. The system should be able to track employees’ accrual of entitlements, including annual leave, sick leave, and overtime leave. The system must support a user base of up to approximately 12.000 users. Importantly, the proposed system must have the option to be integrated to other systems via the Organisation’s Integrations and API Management platform, webMethods, or by other means as proposed by bidder.

result.text: By & Havn is facing the task of transforming Levantkaj in Nordhavn from an existing container terminal into a modern city district. With the current local plan proposal, it is expected that approx. 350.000 square metres of floor space for housing, service businesses and public functions as well as approx. 50.000 square metres of parking distributed across two parking structures on Levantkaj can be established. The local plan will also enable the construction of an elevated metro line, a new metro station as well as pedestrian and cycle connections linked to the main connections in Nordhavn. The local plan proposal will designate the area as a mixed residential and commercial area with the character of a residential area with an expected distribution of housing and commerce of 75/25 with associated facilities such as a school and football pitch, day nurseries, church, sports hall complex, care centre, etc. The local plan proposal is expected to be politically approved in Q4 2026, and the final local plan is expected to be adopted in Q3 2027. By & Havn will be responsible for construction works, establishment of parking structures as well as the sale of building rights, and By & Havn has an ambition that all urban areas are DGNB-certified to a minimum of Platinum. In connection with By & Havn's upcoming sale of building rights, By & Havn wishes with this tender to conclude an agreement with an adviser on economic and commercial consultancy related to By & Havn's development of primarily ground floors containing retail and public-oriented service businesses at Levantkaj, which By & Havn will carry out in a joint venture with a collaboration partner/investor. The adviser's service relates to consultancy on, as a starting point, approx. 6.000 – 7.000 m2 retail and public-oriented functions on the ground floors - which is the area that the joint venture is to own and let out - and does not comprise assistance with the sale or development of other residential building rights or other properties on Levantkaj. However, By & Havn is considering the possibility of expanding the joint venture company's task to include parts of the commercial plots. The tendered agreement consists of two main parts (main tasks), which may overlap in time: • Business plan: Preparation of a detailed business plan for use in the process regarding finding a collaboration partner/investor. The business plan must describe how a company between the collaboration partner/investor and By & Havn is to be structured and describe at a detailed level, among other things, liquidity, ownership distribution, rent level, phasing in of rent and return requirements, etc. • Organisation and implementation of a process to find a collaboration partner/investor: With inspiration from the process during By & Havn's development of the Århusgadekvarteret in Nordhavn, By & Havn wishes to find a collaboration partner/investor who can enter into a joint venture with By & Havn to own ground floors containing retail and public-oriented service businesses at Levantkaj with a view to joint letting. The collaboration partner/investor must be the active party in locating the right tenants for these ground floors. The adviser must assist in organising and implementing a process to find the right collaboration partner/investor, including identifying potential candidates as well as conducting negotiations. In connection with the preparation of the business plan and through dialogue with potential collaboration partners/investors, the adviser must assess together with By & Havn whether some of the commercial plots are to be included in the joint venture collaboration, in order thereby to create a more attractive business case. The execution of the agreement is expected to be initiated immediately following the conclusion of the contract, which is planned to take place immediately before the Christmas holiday 2026. As a clear starting point, the agreement runs until the joint venture agreement with the collaboration partner/investor has been concluded. Based on the expectations for the adoption of the local plan for Levantkaj, it will be optimal for By & Havn if the contract with the collaboration partner/investor (the joint venture agreement) is in place before 1 August 2027 and preferably already before the industrial summer holiday starts. However, By & Havn acknowledges that a number of circumstances may lead to it not being possible to have the joint venture agreement in place within the desired timeframe. In any event, the adviser must anticipate that the work on both main tasks will be intense and require a competent and flexible project organisation. By & Havn has chosen to tender one single contract instead of dividing the contract into lots, as it is By & Havn's assessment that it is firstly necessary to have a joint business plan for the whole of Levantkaj, and secondly that it is clearly most appropriate in relation to interfaces and in relation to rapid execution that the same adviser performs both main tasks.

parts.source: By & Havn står over for at skulle transformere Levantkaj i Nordhavn fra en eksisterende containerterminal til et moderne bykvarter. Med det nuværende lokalplanforslag forventes det, at der vil kunne etableres ca. 350.000 etagemeter boliger, serviceerhverv og offentlige funktioner samt ca. 50.000 etagemeter parkering fordelt på to parkeringshuse på Levantkaj. Lokalplanen vil også muliggøre anlæg af en metrohøjbane, en ny metrostation samt gang- og cykelforbindelser, der kobles sammen med de overordnede forbindelser i Nordhavn. Lokalplanforslaget vil fastlægge området til et blandet bolig- og erhvervsområde med karakter af boligområde med en forventet fordeling på bolig og erhverv på 75/25 med tilhørende faciliteter som skole og fodboldbane, dag-institutioner, kirke, halkompleks for sport, plejecenter mv. Lokalplanforslaget forventes politisk godkendt i Q4 2026, og den endelige lokalplan forventes vedtaget i Q3 2027. By & Havn vil være ansvarlig for anlægsarbejder, etablering af p-huse samt salg af byggeretter, og By & Havn har en ambition om, at alle byområder DGNB-certificeres til minimum Platin. I forbindelse med By & Havns kommende salg af byggeretter, ønsker By & Havn med dette udbud at indgå aftale med en rådgiver om økonomisk og kommerciel rådgivning relateret til By & Havns udvikling af primært stueetager indeholdende detail- og publikumsorienterede serviceerhverv på Levantkaj, som By & Havn vil gennemføre i et joint venture med en samarbejdspartner/investor. Rådgiverens ydelse vedrører rådgivning om som udgangspunkt ca. 6.000 – 7.000 m2 detail- og publikumsorienterede funktioner i stueetagerne - hvilket er det areal, som joint venturet skal eje og udleje - og omfatter ikke bistand med salg eller udvikling af øvrige boligbyggeretter eller øvrige ejendomme på Levantkaj. By & Havn overvejer dog muligheden for at udvide joint venture-selskabets opgave med inkludering af dele af erhvervsfelterne. Den udbudte aftale består af to overordnede dele (hovedopgaver), som kan have et tidsmæssigt overlap: • Forretningsplan: Udarbejdelse af en detaljeret forretningsplan til brug for processen vedr. at finde en samarbejdspartner/investor. Forretningsplanen skal beskrive, hvordan et selskab mellem samarbejdspartner/investor og By & Havn skal sammensættes og på et detaljeret niveau beskrive bl.a. likviditet, ejerfordeling, lejeniveau, indfasning af leje og forrentningskrav, mv. • Tilrettelæggelse og gennemførelse af en proces til at finde en samarbejdspartner/investor: Med inspiration fra processen ved By & Havns udvikling af Århusgadekvarteret i Nordhavn, ønsker By & Havn at finde en samarbejdspartner/investor, der kan indgå i et joint venture med By & Havn om at eje stueetager indeholdende detail- og publikumsorienterede serviceerhverv på Levantkaj med henblik på fælles udleje. Samarbejdspartneren/investoren skal være den aktive part i at lokalisere de rette lejere til disse stueetager. Rådgiveren skal bistå med at tilrettelægge og gennemføre en proces med at finde den rette samarbejdspartner/investor, herunder at identificere mulige kandidater samt gennemføre forhandlinger. Rådgiveren skal i forbindelse med udarbejdelsen af forretningsplanen og ved dialog med potentielle samarbejdspartnere/investorer vurdere sammen med By & Havn, om nogle af erhvervsfelterne skal inkluderes i joint venture-samarbejdet, for derved at skabe en mere attraktiv business case. Udførelsen af aftalen forventes igangsat i umiddelbar forlængelse af kontraktindgåelsen, som er planlagt til at finde sted umiddelbart før juleferien 2026. Aftalen løber som det klare udgangspunkt frem til, at joint venture-aftalen med samarbejdspartneren/investoren er indgået. Ud fra forventningerne til vedtagelse af lokalplan for Levantkaj, vil det for By & Havn være optimalt, hvis kontrakten med samarbejdspartneren/investoren (joint venture-aftalen) er på plads før 1. august 2027 og helst allerede inden industrisommerferien starter. By & Havn anerkender dog, at en række forhold kan føre til, at det ikke vil være muligt at have joint venture-aftalen på plads inden for den ønskede tidsramme. Rådgiver må under alle omstændigheder påregne, at arbejdet med begge hovedopgaver vil være intenst og forudsætte en kompetent og fleksibel projektorganisation. By & Havn har valgt at udbyde én samlet kontrakt i stedet for at opdele kontrakten i delkontrakter, da det er By & Havns vurdering, at det dels er nødvendigt med en samlet forretningsplan for hele Levantkaj, dels at det er klart mest hensigtsmæssigt i forhold til snitflader og i forhold til en hurtig udførelse, at det er den samme rådgiver, der udfører begge hovedopgaver.

result.text: This notice serves exclusively to conduct a non-binding market consultation in accordance with section 28 paragraph 1 of the Ordinance on Public Procurement (VgV). The aim of the market consultation is to inform the market at an early stage about a potential future procurement requirement and to gather insights on technical, economic and organisational solution approaches, current market conditions, the competitive situation and the fundamental feasibility of the planned project. In particular, the market consultation serves to identify advantages and disadvantages of potential performance components, to record existing market experience and to examine whether and to what extent multiple companies can offer comparable services. In this way, a well-founded overview of market interest and the current competitive situation is to be obtained. The present notice is expressly neither a contract notice nor an invitation to submit tenders or requests to participate. No procurement procedure is initiated by conducting the market consultation. The contracting authority is not obliged to conduct a procurement procedure on the basis of the market consultation and is not bound by its results. Participation does not establish any legal claims whatsoever, in particular no claim to the conduct of a procurement procedure or to consideration in any potential subsequent procurement procedure. Participation in the market consultation is voluntary and free of charge. Participating companies will not be reimbursed for any costs incurred by them in connection with participation, the preparation of statements, concepts or the submission of documents. Participation in the market consultation is not a prerequisite for later participation in a procurement procedure and has no influence on a company's chances of being awarded the contract. The contracting authority requests interested market participants to provide meaningful, comprehensible and advanced feedback. In particular, comments on possible implementation variants, economic framework conditions, opportunities and risks, potential problems or obstacles in implementing the intended concept, as well as own ideas and suggestions for improvement are requested. Where possible, feedback should be provided in a structured format. Interested companies are requested to express their interest immediately and informally by email to ta-vergabestellevol@hu-berlin.de and to submit their statements, ideas, proposals for implementation and economic assessments. Following the evaluation of the submitted documents, selected interested parties may be invited to explain their concepts in more detail as part of a structured dialogue. This deepening can take place in the form of an on-site appointment or alternatively via video or telephone conference and serves to clarify open questions and to evaluate the impact of the proposed solution approaches on the requirements of the contracting authority. All documents submitted as part of the market consultation shall become the property of the contracting authority. By participating, interested parties agree that their submitted concepts, evaluations, proposals and other findings may be used to prepare a potential procurement and to develop implementation proposals and, to the extent necessary, may be passed on to the contracting authority, unless this is expressly objected to. Ideas and suggestions from market participants may, where applicable in anonymised form, become part of a later specification of requirements. The contracting authority guarantees the protection of business and trade secrets. Information obtained as part of the market consultation will not be passed on to third parties, with the exception of the contracting authority itself and, where applicable, consulting firms commissioned by it. The market consultation is to be carried out promptly and is expected to be concluded by February 2026. All submitted feedback will be evaluated and made available to the contracting authority in a consolidated form. Should the contracting authority initiate a procurement procedure based on the results of the market consultation, it will take appropriate measures to exclude any distortion of competition. These include in particular the equal treatment of all interested companies, the provision of relevant information to all applicants and tenderers, and the setting of appropriate deadlines. Anticipated schedule • Expression of interest to participate: immediately • Submission of initial concept: 30.01.2026 at 12.00 hours • Presentations and interviews: February 2026

parts.source: Diese Bekanntmachung dient ausschließlich der Durchführung einer unverbindlichen Markterkundung gemäß § 28 Absatz 1 der Vergabeverordnung (VgV). Ziel der Markterkundung ist es, den Markt frühzeitig über einen möglichen zukünftigen Beschaffungsbedarf zu informieren sowie Erkenntnisse zu technischen, wirtschaftlichen und organisatorischen Lösungsansätzen, zu aktuellen Marktbedingungen, zur Wettbewerbssituation sowie zur grundsätzlichen Machbarkeit des geplanten Vorhabens zu gewinnen. Die Markterkundung dient insbesondere dazu, Vor- und Nachteile möglicher Leistungsbestandteile zu identifizieren, bestehende Markterfahrungen zu erfassen und zu prüfen, ob und inwieweit mehrere Unternehmen vergleichbare Leistungen anbieten können. Auf diese Weise soll ein fundierter Überblick über das Marktinteresse und die aktuelle Wettbewerbssituation erlangt werden. Bei der vorliegenden Bekanntmachung handelt es sich ausdrücklich weder um eine Auftragsbekanntmachung noch um eine Aufforderung zur Abgabe von Angeboten oder Teilnahmeanträgen. Durch die Durchführung der Markterkundung wird kein Vergabeverfahren eingeleitet. Der Auftraggeber ist nicht verpflichtet, auf Grundlage der Markterkundung ein Vergabeverfahren durchzuführen, und ist an deren Ergebnisse nicht gebunden. Die Teilnahme begründet keinerlei Rechtsansprüche, insbesondere keinen Anspruch auf Durchführung eines Vergabeverfahrens oder auf Berücksichtigung in einem etwaigen späteren Vergabeverfahren. Die Teilnahme an der Markterkundung ist freiwillig und unentgeltlich. Den teilnehmenden Unternehmen werden keine Kosten erstattet, die ihnen im Zusammenhang mit der Teilnahme, der Ausarbeitung von Stellungnahmen, Konzepten oder der Übermittlung von Unterlagen entstehen. Die Teilnahme an der Markterkundung ist keine Voraussetzung für eine spätere Beteiligung an einem Vergabeverfahren und hat keinen Einfluss auf die Zuschlagschancen eines Unternehmens. Der Auftraggeber bittet interessierte Marktteilnehmer um aussagekräftige, nachvollziehbare und weiterführende Rückmeldungen. Insbesondere werden Hinweise zu möglichen Umsetzungsvarianten, wirtschaftlichen Rahmenbedingungen, Chancen und Risiken, potenziellen Problemen oder Hindernissen bei der Umsetzung des vorgesehenen Konzepts sowie eigene Ideen und Verbesserungsvorschläge erbeten. Die Rückmeldungen sollen nach Möglichkeit in strukturierter Form erfolgen. Interessierte Unternehmen werden gebeten, ihr Interesse unverzüglich und formlos per E-Mail an ta-vergabestellevol@hu-berlin.de zu bekunden und ihre Stellungnahmen, Ideen, Vorschläge zur Umsetzung sowie wirtschaftliche Einschätzungen zu übermitteln. Im Anschluss an die Auswertung der eingereichten Unterlagen können ausgewählte Interessenten eingeladen werden, ihre Konzepte im Rahmen eines strukturierten Dialogs näher zu erläutern. Diese Vertiefung kann in Form eines Vor-Ort-Termins oder ersatzweise per Video- oder Telefonkonferenz erfolgen und dient der Klärung offener Fragen sowie der Bewertung der Auswirkungen der vorgeschlagenen Lösungsansätze auf die Anforderungen des Auftraggebers. Sämtliche im Rahmen der Markterkundung übermittelten Unterlagen gehen in das Eigentum des Auftraggebers über. Mit der Teilnahme erklären sich die Interessenten damit einverstanden, dass ihre eingereichten Konzepte, Bewertungen, Vorschläge und sonstigen Erkenntnisse zur Vorbereitung einer möglichen Beschaffung sowie zur Erarbeitung von Umsetzungsvorschlägen genutzt und soweit erforderlich, an den Auftraggeber weitergegeben werden dürfen, sofern dem nicht ausdrücklich widersprochen wird. Ideen und Vorschläge der Marktteilnehmer können dabei ggf. anonymisiert Bestandteil einer späteren Leistungsbeschreibung werden. Der Auftraggeber gewährleistet den Schutz von Geschäfts- und Betriebsgeheimnissen. Eine Weitergabe von im Rahmen der Markterkundung erlangten Informationen an Dritte erfolgt nicht, mit Ausnahme des Auftraggebers selbst sowie ggf. von durch ihn beauftragten Beratungsunternehmen. Die Markterkundung soll zeitnah durchgeführt und voraussichtlich bis Februar 2026 abgeschlossen werden. Sämtliche eingereichten Rückmeldungen werden ausgewertet und dem Auftraggeber in konsolidierter Form zur Verfügung gestellt. Sofern der Auftraggeber auf Grundlage der Ergebnisse der Markterkundung ein Vergabeverfahren einleiten sollte, wird er geeignete Maßnahmen ergreifen, um eine Verfälschung des Wettbewerbs auszuschließen. Hierzu zählen insbesondere die Gleichbehandlung aller interessierten Unternehmen, die Bereitstellung relevanter Informationen für alle Bewerber und Bieter sowie die Festlegung angemessener Fristen. Voraussichtliche Zeitplanung • Interessenbekundung zur Teilnahme: unverzüglich • Einreichung der Erstkonzeption: 30.01.2026 um 12.00 Uhr • Präsentationen und Interviews: Februar 2026

result.text: Supply of thermal orthophotos for the area of Region Hannover 1. Background The Region Hannover has set itself the ambitious goal of being climate-neutral by the year 2035. The energy-efficient refurbishment of the building stock is a central component for achieving this goal. In particular, improving the thermal insulation of buildings offers considerable potential for reducing CO2 emissions and increasing energy efficiency. In order to raise awareness among owners of residential and non-residential buildings regarding potential heat losses and refurbishment needs, a comprehensive thermal imaging map is to be created. The aim is to create a low-threshold information basis through a visually prepared presentation of thermal radiation data. The interactive online map should make it possible to classify one's own building stock in a regional context and initiate further steps if necessary. By linking with the advisory services of the climate protection agency Region Hannover (KSA) as well as existing funding programmes, the project is intended to trigger concrete refurbishment measures. 2. Contents and procedure The subject of the contract is the supply of thermographic digital orthophotos (DOP), i.e., distortion-free and georeferenced thermography recordings, for the area of Region Hannover. The contractor's delivery service includes carrying out the flight including preparation as well as the transmission of the processed data.

parts.source: Lieferung von Thermalorthofotos für das Gebiet der Region Hannover 1. Hintergrund Die Region Hannover hat sich das ehrgeizige Ziel gesetzt, bis zum Jahr 2035 klimaneutral zu sein. Die energetische Sanierung des Gebäudebestandes ist ein zentraler Baustein zur Erreichung dieses Zieles. Besonders die Verbesserung der Wärmedämmung von Gebäuden bietet erhebliches Potential zur Reduzierung von CO2-Emissionen und zur Steigerung der Energieeffizienz. Um Eigentümerinnen und Eigentümer von Wohn- und Nichtwohngebäuden für mögliche Wärmeverluste und Sanierungsbedarfe zu sensibilisieren, soll eine flächendeckende Wärmebildkarte erstellt werden. Ziel ist es, durch eine visuell aufbereitete Darstellung von Wärmestrahlungsdaten eine niedrigschwellige Informationsgrundlage zu schaffen. Die interaktive Online-Karte soll es ermöglichen, den eigenen Gebäudebestand im regionalen Kontext einzuordnen und bei Bedarf weitere Schritte einzuleiten. Durch die Verknüpfung mit den Beratungsangeboten der Klimaschutzagentur Region Hannover (KSA) sowie bestehenden Förderprogrammen soll das Projekt konkrete Sanierungsmaßnahmen anstoßen. 2. Inhalte und Ablauf Gegenstand des Auftrags ist die Lieferung von thermografischen digitalen Orthophotos (DOP), also verzerrungsfreien und georeferenzierten Thermografieaufnahmen, für das Gebiet der Region Hannover. Die Lieferleistung des Auftragnehmers beinhaltet die Durchführung der Befliegung inkl. Vorbereitung sowie die Übermittlung der aufbereiteten Daten.

result.text: The National Audit Office (NAO) intends to procure an online subscription service that provides authoritative, current audit, accounting and financial-reporting information to support technical research, professional judgement and consistent audit delivery. The service is expected to support approximately 600 users across the Financial Audit Service Line. The required service is expected to include: • comprehensive access to relevant audit, accounting and financial-reporting standards, guidance, commentary and technical updates; • coverage of UK GAAP, IFRS, international auditing standards, corporate reporting requirements and relevant sustainability reporting standards; • prompt updates reflecting changes to standards, legislation, regulation and guidance; • effective online research functionality, including search, filtering, linking and document access; • an organisation-wide licensing model that supports the required user population without avoidable access barriers; • secure online or SaaS delivery compatible with the NAO's technology environment; • implementation support, user guidance, training and ongoing customer support; and • clear information about any AI-enabled functionality, controls, limitations, data use, optionality and pricing. The final scope, commercial model, contract value and procurement documents will be informed by market engagement and the subsequent competitive procurement exercise. This notice does not constitute a call for competition or a commitment to procure. Lot 1: .

result.text: Background Innovate UK Business Connect brings together businesses, researchers, investors and partners to accelerate innovation across the UK. As part of UK Research and Innovation (UKRI), and a strategic delivery partner to Innovate UK, we connect organisations to funding opportunities, partnerships and expertise to help ideas move from concept to scale. One of the key tools for making these connections is events. We deliver a diverse portfolio of in-person, virtual and hybrid events, ranging from webinars and workshops to large-scale conferences and exhibitions. To support the effective planning, delivery and evaluation of these events, we are seeking proposals from suppliers who can provide a modern event management system that streamlines event operations, enhances the participant experience and supports data-driven decision-making. Description of work Innovate UK Business Connect is seeking tenders from providers who can supply a single event management system that supports the end-to-end event lifecycle, including event creation, registration management, attendee communications, speaker and exhibitor management, networking, reporting and post-event evaluation. The system should integrate with existing business systems where required and provide a single source of truth for event delivery teams. This aligns with the organisation's wider objective of ensuring events are outcome-led, measurable and supported by efficient registration, communication and reporting processes. The event management system should: • Deliver an intuitive and user-friendly delegate journey from registration through to post-event follow-up • Improve the event experience for speakers and exhibitors • Reduce manual administration and improve operational efficiency • Provide real-time visibility of registrations, attendance, engagement and event performance • Support both virtual and in-person event delivery models • Enable consistent data capture and reporting to demonstrate event impact and ROI • Support accessibility, compliance and data protection requirements The platform must support multiple user roles and permission levels to reflect different operational needs across the organisation. As a minimum, the system should accommodate the following user groups: • Event Managers o Full end-to-end event management capabilities o Creation, configuration and administration of events o Management of registrations, attendee communications, speakers and exhibitors o Access to event-level reporting, analytics and post-event evaluation data • Marketing Managers o Access to update and manage event webpages and associated content o Access to registration, engagement and performance reporting • Integrated Systems o Administration of integrations between the event management platform and our CRM system (Workbooks) o Management of data flows, field mapping, data quality and synchronisation processes o Access to reporting, data exports and system configuration relating to integrations • System Administrators o A small number of designated super users (typically two to three individuals) o Full platform administration rights, including user management, permissions, integrations, security settings and system configuration We deliver a large and diverse portfolio of business-to-business events. Historically, this has included more than 300 events per year and generating approximately 60,000 delegate registrations annually. The event management platform must be capable of supporting a range of event formats, scales and audience sizes, including: • In person events: We deliver approximately 100 in-person events each year, typically attracting between 30 and 2,000 delegates to each. Most events are free to attend and may span one or more days. We do not require onsite event delivery support from the appointment supplier; however the platform must provide the functionality and tools to enable our team to manage attendee registration and onsite event operations, and provide a seamless and efficient onsite experience for attendees • Online Events: We deliver close to 200 fully online events annually. The majority are webinars, including webinar series and interactive workshops. We also run a small number of larger-scale virtual conferences and exhibitions, some of which take place over multiple days. The platform should provide a seamless user experience for both organisers and attendees and support the delivery of events of varying size and complexity. • Hybrid: A smaller proportion of our events are hybrid, combining in-person and virtual attendance. The platform should support hybrid event delivery and provide a consistent registration, communication and reporting experience across both audience groups. The proposed solution must be capable of supporting this volume of activity while providing robust registration management, attendee communications, data integration, reporting and analytics across all event formats. Timings This is a two-stage evaluation process. We will do an initially score of each supplier bid with the top two or three scoring suppliers invited to provide a demonstration. This will be the opportunity for the selected suppliers to demonstrate the setup of an event using a given scenario. Anticipated timeline: • October: demo • November: final evaluation • November - December: Contract is awarded • 1 April 2027: Contract starts • April - September: Onboarding, training, templates created and integrations built • September onwards: Events start to be managed from the platform Cost The maximum value of this requirement over the three-year period is a maximum of £600,000.00 excluding VAT. This contract is structured as an initial two-year period with a maximum budget of £400,000.00 excluding VAT with an optional 12-month extension valued at maximum £200,000.00 excluding VAT. Submission In response to this tender, please provide the information listed below.
