result.text: The Board of Trustees for the National Galleries of Scotland ("NGS") wish to award a Contract for the Provision of Audience Research Services. The Service Provider is required to conduct Audience Research to provide insight and analysis about our visitors in order to support the Organisation’s 2030 Strategy, Business Plan and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), special projects and inform organisation-wide strategic planning. The Service Provider shall be a member of, accredited by, or operate in accordance with the standards, codes of conduct and professional requirements of the Market Research Society (MRS) or an equivalent recognised professional body for market research, social research, insight or analytics. This Contract shall primarily provide Fieldwork Surveys and associated Project Management, Client Data Access, Analysis and Reporting for each of our four gallery sites. Services will be agreed to on an “as required” basis with no commitment to a minimum volume of work. NGS may, at its absolute discretion, require the Service Provider to provide Audience Research Services at this fifth site, currently under construction, at any time during the Contract term. If permitted by applicable procurement legislation, where additional audience research requirements arise during the Contract term that constitute an extension of the Services, NGS reserves the right to procure such additional services from the Service Provider. For full details of the Contract Requirements please refer to the associated Tender and Contract Documents. The Service Provider must have a clear understanding of the contract requirements and the organisational needs of NGS. As part of the tender exercise, the Service Provider must detail a robust and flexible methodology for conducting Audience Research Services that will meet all data capture requirements. There is no commitment to a minimum spend over the duration of the Contract. Under this Contract, no minimum spend is guaranteed. The agreement will be non-exclusive i.e. NGS reserves the right, in certain, circumstances, to procure out with the Contract Agreement, as and when required. In the event of unsatisfactory performance by the successful Service Provider and the termination of the contract by either party, NGS reserves the right to negotiate the continuance of the services with the second and third placed Service Providers. Lot 1: . The procurement will be conducted through the use of the Open Procedure. Service Providers must complete and submit both an SPD and Tender response. Economic Operators may be excluded from this competition if they are in any of the situations referred to in Regulation 58 of the Public Contracts (Scotland) Regulations 2015. Given the nature of the contract, Tenderers must comply with minimum security requirements. The Service Provider must obtain valid Cyber Essentials Basic (or equivalent) certification prior to the Contract Commencement Date and maintain throughout the Contract term including any extension periods. It is desirable that the Service Provider hold current ISO/IEC 27001 (or equivalent) certification or otherwise Tenderers must demonstrate equivalent information security management arrangements as part of the quality assessment. result.text: SKI hereby invites tenders for a dynamic purchasing system regarding the procurement of IT consultancy services within 14 service areas with associated sub-areas, sub-categories and services. Below are the 14 service areas with associated sub-areas indicated. The actual services that can be procured in the 14 service areas are described in detail in Appendix C. Subject of the system: Service area 1: IT-related strategies Sub-area: Preparation of IT-related strategies Sub-area: Implementation of IT-related strategies Sub-area: Evaluation and updating as well as impact assessment of strategies Service area 2: Business needs, business case and benefit realisation Sub-area: Identification of business needs and preparation of business cases Sub-area: Realisation of business cases Sub-area: Follow-up on business cases Service area 3: IT tendering Sub-area: Preparation of tenders Sub-area: Execution of tenders Service area 4: IT security, business continuity and IT compliance Sub-area: Establishment of IT security Sub-area: Crisis management, business continuity and disaster recovery Sub-area: IT compliance Service area 5: IT architecture Sub-area: Establishment of an IT architecture Sub-area: Review and adjustment of existing IT architecture Service area 6: IT governance Sub-area: Establishment of IT governance Sub-area: Organisation of system management Sub-area: Establishment of IT supplier management Service area 7: Project and programme management Sub-area: Project management – the traditional waterfall model Sub-area: Management of agile projects Sub-area: Programme management Service area 8: Data processing Sub-area: Data analysis and reporting Sub-area: Use of external data Sub-area: Conversion, cleaning and archiving of data Service area 9: Advice on software licences Sub-area: Open source software vs. closed source software Sub-area: Determination of the size of specific licences, as well as the conditions associated with the use Service area 10: Infrastructure and hardware Sub-area: Setup, configuration and operation of networks Sub-area: Setup, configuration and operation of servers Sub-area: Setup, configuration and operation of clients Service area 11: Test Sub-area: IT testing of development according to the traditional waterfall model Sub-area: Agile IT testing Service area 12: Development of new functionality Sub-area: IT development according to the traditional waterfall model Sub-area: Agile IT development Service area 13: Adaptation of existing IT systems Sub-area: IT development with a view to adapting existing IT systems Service area 14: IT system operation Sub-area: Operation of IT systems The system is divided into 2 categories: • Category 1 Competence purchase • Category 2 Task purchase The same services can be procured in both categories, but the categories differ in that the customer in category 1 must procure one or more specific competence(s), while the customer in category 2 must have a specific task solved. The customer's objective purchasing need thus dictates which category is to be used. • In category 1 the customer specifies their need for competencies within IT consultancy services and need for number of hours, after which the Tenderer offers competencies and prices. • In category 2 the customer defines the task, after which the tenderer offers a task solution in accordance with the customer's statement of requirements. It is voluntary for all SKI's customers, as stated in Appendix B, Customer List, to make use of the system when they need to procure IT consultancy services. Procurement of Competence purchase In category 1 customers can procure IT consultancy services within the 14 service areas described in Appendix C, to fulfil the customer's competence needs. The consultancy services can be procured in 2 ways. 1. Remuneration form 1: Purchase of consultancy hours (number of hours x hourly rate). 2. Remuneration form 2: Purchase of ongoing services (monthly remuneration x number of months + estimated number of hours (time spent) x hourly rate).; Procurement of IT consultancy services for task solution In category 2 the customers can procure IT consultancy services within the 14 service areas described in Appendix C, to fulfil a specific task. The consultancy services can be procured in 3 ways. 1. Remuneration form 1: Purchase of IT consultancy services for the solution of the described task (number x hourly rate). 2. Remuneration form 2: Purchase of ongoing services (monthly remuneration x number of months + estimated number of hours (time spent) x hourly rate). 3. Remuneration form 3: Purchase of task solution at a fixed price.

Konsulentydelserne kan anskaffes på 3 måder. 1. Vederlagsform 1: Køb af it-konsulentydelser til løsning af beskrevne opgave (antal x time-pris). 2. Vederlagsform 2: Køb af løbende ydelser (månedligt vederlag x antal måneder + estimeret antal timer (medgået tid) x timepris). 3. Vederlagsform 3: Køb af opgaveløsning til fast pris.

result.text: This is not a prior information notice, contract notice or call for tenders, but a notice on the initiation of a market dialogue as part of procurement planning and an invitation to participate in the market dialogue. Vantaan kaupunki and other municipalities are jointly planning a tender contest for a low-carbon assessment tool for detailed local planning, so the procurement will likely be carried out as a joint procurement group of several contracting authorities. The contracting authorities are surveying suppliers' interest in participating in the market dialogue for the low-carbon assessment tool for detailed local planning. The subject matter of the procurement is a browser-based software service delivered via the data network for assessing the climate impacts of land use plans, with which the contracting authority can assess and compare the climate impacts of detailed local plan level land use plans based on the carbon footprint and carbon handprint calculated by the tool. The subject matter of the procurement includes implementation projects for the low-carbon tool, rights of use, support and maintenance services, supplementary expert services ordered separately, and additional procurement opportunities. The aim is to obtain a solution that is suitable for the Finnish land use and construction context and for the evaluation of detailed local plan level land use plans. The solution is also intended to be further developed to improve the assessment of the climate impacts of urban land use planning. Commercial use of the low-carbon assessment tool for detailed local planning will start according to municipality-specific schedules estimated during Q2/2026-Q1/2027. The solution to be procured must preliminarily include the following key functionalities and features: - The solution is map- and GIS-based. - The evaluation method of the solution must take into account the entire life cycle of the land use plans being evaluated, including the climate impacts of the project before use, during use and after use, as well as impacts outside the life cycle and potential climate benefits. - The solution must be able to utilise national and city-specific parameters and data. - The evaluation method must comprehensively take into account the climate impacts of detailed local plan level land use projects, also considering climate impacts other than those produced by buildings, such as the climate impacts of transport or energy consumption. - The solution takes into account the Finnish Green Building Council's definition of a carbon-neutral built area. Operators participating in the market dialogue are requested to register for the market dialogue and provide answers to the preliminary questions presented in the market consultation notice by Friday 13.3.2026 by 12 to the following address: jonna.hirvonen@vantaa.fi. Registrations must be headed as follows: "Registration for market dialogue: Procurement of a low-carbon assessment tool for detailed local planning". Registrations must contain the following information: - Name of the participating company - Name, telephone number and email address of the contact person - Name of the solution offered by the company - Answers to preliminary questions

parts.source: Tämä ei ole ennakkoilmoitus, hankintailmoitus tai tarjouspyyntö vaan ilmoitus markkinavuoropuhelun käynnistämisestä osana hankinnan suunnittelua ja kutsu osallistua markkinavuoropuheluun. Vantaan kaupunki sekä muut kunnat suunnittelevat yhdessä asemakaavoituksen vähähiilisyyden arviointityökalun kilpailutusta, joten hankinta tullaan todennäköisesti toteuttamaan useamman hankintayksikön hankintarenkaana. Hankintayksiköt kartoittavat toimittajien kiinnostusta osallistua asemakaavoituksen vähähiilisyyden arviointityökalun markkinavuoropuheluun. Hankinnan kohteena on tietoverkon välityksellä toimitettava selainkäyttöinen ohjelmistopalvelu maankäytön suunnitelmien ilmastovaikutusten arviointia varten, jolla tilaaja voi arvioida ja vertailla asemakaavatason maankäyttösuunnitelmien ilmastovaikutuksia työkalun laskemaan hiilijalanjälkeen ja -kädenjälkeen perustuen. Hankinnan kohteeseen sisältyvät vähähiilisyystyökalun käyttöönottoprojektit, käyttöoikeudet, tuki- ja ylläpitopalvelut, erikseen tilattavat täydentävät asiantuntijapalvelut ja lisähankintamahdollisuudet. Tavoitteena on saada käyttöön ratkaisu, joka soveltuu Suomen maankäytön ja rakentamisen kontekstiin sekä asemakaavatasoisten maankäytön suunnitelmien arviointiin. Ratkaisua on myös tarkoitus jatkokehittää kaupunkien maankäytön suunnittelun ilmastovaikutusten arvioinnin parantamiseen. Asemakaavoituksen vähähiilisyyden arviointityökalun tuotantokäyttö aloitetaan kuntakohtaisten aikataulujen mukaisesti arviolta Q2/2026-Q1/2027 aikana. Hankittavan ratkaisun tulee sisältää alustavasti seuraavat keskeiset toiminnallisuudet ja ominaisuudet: - Ratkaisu on kartta- ja paikkatietopohjainen. - Ratkaisun arviointimenetelmän tulee huomioida arvioitavien maankäytön suunnitelmien koko elinkaari, sisältäen hankkeen ilmastovaikutukset ennen käyttöä, käytön aikana ja käytön jälkeen sekä elinkaaren ulkopuoliset vaikutukset ja mahdolliset ilmastohyödyt. - Ratkaisussa tulee voida hyödyntää valtakunnallisia ja kaupunkikohtaisia parametrejä ja aineistoa. - Arviointimenetelmän tulee huomioida asemakaavatasoisten maankäytön hankkeiden ilmastovaikutukset kokonaisvaltaisesti, huomioiden myös muut kuin rakennusten tuottamat ilmastovaikutukset, kuten mm. liikenteen tai energian kulutuksen ilmastovaikutukset. - Ratkaisu huomioi Finnish Green Building Councilin hiilineutraalin rakennetun alueen määritelmän. Markkinavuoropuheluun osallistuvia toimijoita pyydetään ilmoittautumaan markkinavuoropuheluun ja antamaan vastaukset markkinakartoitusilmoituksessa esitettyihin ennakkokysymyksiin perjantaihin 13.3.2026 klo 12 mennessä osoitteeseen: jonna.hirvonen@vantaa.fi. Ilmoittautuminen tulee otsikoida seuraavasti: “Ilmoittautuminen markkinavuoropuheluun: Asemakaavoituksen vähähiilisyyden arviointityökalun hankinta”. Ilmoittautumisessa tulee olla seuraavat tiedot: - Osallistuvan yrityksen nimi - Yhteyshenkilön nimi, puhelinnumero ja sähköpostiosoite - Yrityksen tarjoaman ratkaisun nimi - Vastaukset ennakkokysymyksiin

result.text: Fairhive Homes Limited intends to procure a contract for the supply, implementation, configuration, support, maintenance and continuous improvement of a Learning Management System. The procurement is intended to support Fairhive's requirement for an LMS platform that enables effective learning management, compliance training, reporting, user administration and integration with Fairhive's wider systems environment. The RFQ states that Fairhive wishes to appoint a single supplier to provide, implement, configure, support and maintain the LMS in accordance with the specification. The requirement is expected to include: 1. Supply of a hosted Learning Management System platform. 2. Configuration of workflows, roles, permissions, learning pathways, dashboards, notifications and branding. 3. Implementation support, including mobilisation, discovery, implementation planning, testing, user acceptance testing, go-live support and hypercare. 4. Data migration support, including extraction support, mapping, cleansing support, migration, reconciliation and validation. 5. Microsoft Entra ID Single Sign-On and user provisioning integration. 6. Microsoft 365 integrations, including Microsoft Teams and Outlook calendar integration. 7. Administrator, manager and end-user training, including materials and train-the-trainer or digital resources. 8. Initial content and SCORM set-up, including upload, configuration and validation of SCORM 1.2/2004 and other agreed content. 9. Ongoing hosting, storage, backups, disaster recovery, support, service levels, maintenance, updates, escalation and account management. 10. Reporting, dashboards and scheduled reporting. Suppliers will be expected to demonstrate: 1. Relevant experience implementing and supporting Learning Management Systems for a housing association, public sector organisation or similarly regulated environment. 2. A functional solution that supports learning pathways, compliance training management, reporting and dashboards, certification, SCORM compliance, accessibility, mobile functionality, workflow automation, manager functionality, learner experience and Microsoft 365 integration. 3. A clear implementation, data migration and training methodology, including project mobilisation, configuration, testing, user acceptance testing, data migration, training, go-live support and hypercare. 4. Robust information security, compliance and business continuity arrangements, including ISO27001, Cyber Essentials Plus, UK GDPR compliance, data hosting, resilience, disaster recovery, business continuity and incident management. 5. Effective support, service desk, account management, service level, escalation, reporting, quarterly review, product roadmap and continuous improvement arrangements. 6. Measurable social value and sustainability commitments, including community investment, skills and employment support, carbon reduction, digital inclusion, volunteering, equality, diversity and inclusion, supplier diversity and wider environmental sustainability initiatives. Fairhive intends to use the procurement documentation and evaluation process to assess the optimum combination of quality, social value and price. The RFQ defines Most Advantageous Tender as the tender offering the optimum combination of quality, social value and price in accordance with the evaluation methodology. Particular emphasis is expected to be placed on: 1. Functional LMS capability and user experience. 2. Compliance training management and reporting. 3. Data security, UK GDPR compliance and hosting arrangements. 4. Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Entra ID integration. 5. Implementation, data migration and training support. 6. Service desk, support, service levels and account management. 7. Social value, sustainability and measurable community benefits. Lot 1: .

The technology estate on which Social Security Scotland’s business operations run is critical to delivering the services offered to the people of Scotland. Day-to-day business operations both within Social Security Scotland, and those conducted with the support of its partners, are supported by an extensive enterprise architecture of business applications and underlying technologies. These applications and technologies operate in concert by means of an integration platform, which is responsible for exchanging data between internal solutions, and between Social Security Scotland and its external partners. The core business application currently used by Social Security Scotland to facilitate such integration is contracted until the end of 2026 (with the possibility to extend until the end of 2027). It is currently the strategic core platform providing API (application programming interface) lifecycle management and enabling integration with external services. Note that for the purposes of this exercise, the term “integration platform” should be interpreted to mean the systems by which integration and API management are fulfilled. We are developing a strategy of how this service will look moving forward and would like input from suppliers on this by means of a Request for Information.

result.text: The contracting authority for the services tendered here is the University Hospital of Cologne (AöR), one of the largest tertiary care centres in North Rhine-Westphalia with over 1.500 planned beds, around 60.000 inpatient cases and more than 350.000 outpatient cases annually. The contracting authority intends to commission an experienced management consultant specialising in the healthcare sector to support the hospital in overcoming its financial, organisational and structural challenges and to develop and implement a comprehensive transformation programme together with the commercial management. The aim of the services to be awarded is to sustainably improve the economic performance of the University Hospital of Cologne by identifying, prioritising and implementing revenue-increasing and cost-reducing measures, as well as adapting organisational structures and processes to future requirements. The programme is intended to achieve short-term liquidity and earnings contributions, while at the same time strengthening the hospital's strategic competitiveness in the medium and long term. As part of the contract performance, the contractor will record the existing potential, derive a robust portfolio of measures for all relevant service areas, manage the implementation of these measures in a structured programme and monitor them using key figure-based controlling. Furthermore, it is expected that the contractor will install an effective change management system that involves employees, the faculty and other stakeholders in the transformation process. The identified operational potential lies primarily in the medical service portfolio (optimisation of case mix, length of stay, operating theatre capacities and outpatient care), in material and non-personnel cost management, in the structures of subsidiaries and administrative areas, and in personnel requirements and shift planning. The contractor's services are expected to include in particular the following areas: - Analysis of the economic starting position, including benchmarking with comparable hospitals, uncovering earnings and efficiency potential, and deriving a robust business case. - Development, prioritisation and detailing of a catalogue of measures for revenue growth (e.g. operating theatre utilisation, expansion of highly specialised services) and for cost reduction (e.g. materials management, energy costs, process digitalisation, personnel structure). - Establishment and operation of a central Project Management Office (PMO) to manage all sub-projects, including change management, communication strategy and management training. - Conception and implementation of a key figure-based management and reporting system ("Performance Dashboard") as well as sustainable implementation controlling to ensure the permanent anchoring of the improvements achieved. In addition, the contractor must identify further potential for increasing economic performance, develop corresponding solution proposals and support their implementation. We are looking for a "driving force" that proactively contributes.

parts.source: Der Auftraggeber der hier ausgeschriebenen Leistungen ist das Universitätsklinikum Köln (AöR), eines der größten Häuser der Maximalversorgung in Nordrhein-Westfalen mit über 1.500 Planbetten, rund 60.000 stationären sowie mehr als 350.000 ambulanten Fällen jährlich. Der Auftraggeber beabsichtigt, einen erfahrenen, auf das Gesundheitswesen spezialisierten Unternehmensberater zu beauftragen, der das Klinikum in der Bewältigung seiner finanziellen, organisatorischen und strukturellen Herausforderungen unterstützt und gemeinsam mit der kaufmännischen Direktion ein umfassendes Transformationsprogramm entwickelt und umsetzt. Ziel der zu vergebenden Leistungen ist es, die wirtschaftliche Leistungsfähigkeit des Universitätsklinikums Köln nachhaltig zu verbessern, indem erlössteigernde und kostenreduzierende Maßnahmen identifiziert, priorisiert und implementiert sowie organisatorische Strukturen und Prozesse an die zukünftigen Anforderungen angepasst werden. Das Programm soll kurzfristige Liquiditäts- und Ergebnisbeiträge erzielen, zugleich aber mittel- und langfristig die strategische Wettbewerbsfähigkeit des Hauses stärken. Im Rahmen der Auftragserbringung wird der Auftragnehmer die vorhandenen Potenziale erfassen, daraus ein belastbares Maßnahmenportfolio für alle relevanten Leistungsbereiche ableiten, die Umsetzung dieser Maßnahmen in einem strukturierten Programm steuern und durch ein kennzahlenbasiertes Controlling überwachen. Darüber hinaus wird erwartet, dass der Auftragnehmer ein wirksames Change-Management installiert, das Mitarbeitende, Fakultät und weitere Stakeholder in den Transformationsprozess einbindet. Die identifizierten operativen Potenziale liegen vor allem im medizinischen Leistungsportfolio (Optimierung von Fallmix, Verweildauer, OP-Kapazitäten und Ambulantisierung), in der Material- und Sachkostenbewirtschaftung, in den Strukturen der Tochtergesellschaften und administrativen Bereichen sowie in der Personalbedarfs- und Schichtplanung. Die Leistungen des Auftragnehmers umfassen voraussichtlich insbesondere die folgenden Bereiche: - Analyse der wirtschaftlichen Ausgangslage, einschließlich Benchmarking mit Vergleichshäusern, Aufdeckung von Ergebnis- und Effizienzpotenzialen sowie Ableitung eines belastbaren Business-Case. - Entwicklung, Priorisierung und Detaillierung eines Maßnahmenkatalogs zur Erlössteigerung (z. B. OP-Auslastung, Ausbau hochspezialisierter Leistungen) sowie zur Kostenreduktion (z. B. Materialwirtschaft, Energiekosten, Prozessdigitalisierung, Personalstruktur). - Einrichtung und Betrieb eines zentralen Projektmanagement-Office (PMO) zur Steuerung aller Teilprojekte, einschließlich Change-Management, Kommunikationsstrategie und Schulung der Führungskräfte. - Konzeption und Implementierung eines kennzahlenbasierten Steuerungs- und Berichtssystems ("Performance Dashboard") sowie eines nachhaltigen Umsetzungscontrollings zur Sicherstellung der dauerhaften Verankerung der erzielten Verbesserungen. Darüber hinaus hat der Auftragnehmer weitere Potenziale zur Steigerung der wirtschaftlichen Leistungsfähigkeit zu identifizieren, entsprechende Lösungsvorschläge zu erarbeiten und die Umsetzung zu begleiten. Gesucht wird eine "treibende Kraft", die sich proaktiv einbringt.

result.text: Background Troms County (TFK) manages buildings of 218,000 m2, comprising i.a. schools, sports facilities, dental clinics, workplaces and other county buildings. The cleaning services are carried out by approx. 130 cleaners organised by teams, with a focus on flexible work forms, efficient use of resources and quality in the service delivery. The County municipality needs a more uniform, digital and documentable follow-up of cleaning across buildings, rooms and areas. The current systems do not provide sufficient support for registration and follow-up of work performed, deviations and quality measurements. Therefore there is a need for a system that makes it easy for cleaners to register work and register conditions that affect cleaning, for example rooms that cannot be cleaned, deviations or a lack of periodic cleaning. At the same time, the county needs a better overview and management information. Managers should be able to follow the status per building, area and room, identify areas that have not been cleaned and get a better basis for planning capacity, resource use and absence management. The cleaning quality shall be measured and documented in accordance with NS-INSTA 800. TFK would like systems that provide good support for quality follow-up, reporting and analysis, which contribute to increased user friendliness, better decision making and more efficient operation. The procurement is being made to establish a future orientated digital system that provides a better overview, more uniform practice, better documentation and more efficient management of deviations, quality follow-up and resource planning. Description of the assignment The assignment includes the delivery, establishment, operation and support of a digital cleaning system for Troms County. The system shall provide an overview of cleaning per building, room and area and it can be used by cleaners, substitutes, managers, administrators and operations managers where the work is carried out. The system shall support planning, implementation, documentation and follow-up of the cleaning services. The system shall, among other things: Give easy registration of completed cleaning, status and deviations. Support registration and follow-up of periodic cleaning. Give an overview of rooms and areas that have not been cleaned or where deviations are registered. Support quality measurements and documentation in accordance with NS-INSTA 800. Offer reports and management information that supports follow-up, documentation, analysis and resource planning. Support both short term and long term planning of assignments and resources. Be able to integrate with existing and future MOM systems, as well as facilitate future integrations with other support systems, including possibilities for future use of sensor technology, such as dispensers, waste handling, machines and robots. The delivery shall include the necessary establishment and configuration of the building and room structure, user roles and access management, as well as training, user support and administrative assistance in connection with the introduction and use of the system. TFK would like a user friendly and visually oriented system that facilitates efficient operation, good quality control and future development of the cleaning services. Further requirements for functionality, technical conditions, security, privacy, integrations and service level are stated in the requirement specification.

result.text: The objective of the procurement is to cover the OFA companies ́need for software and a system for secure printing and scanning for all users. The system shall contribute to standardising and making printing and scanning solutions more efficient in the OFA cooperation and supporting joint ICT strategy and security requirements. The software shall be easy to use for final users and easy to operate for key personnel, while facilitating resource and cost efficient operation. The system shall optimise the use of existing servers. There are requirements for cooperation between the software supplier, suppliers of multi-function machines (MFP) and the ICT departments in the OFA cooperation. The ICT operations are largely centralised, facilitating an efficient implementation and follow-up of the system. The procurement does not include physical hardware (MFP), but the software shall support existing and upcoming MFP deliveries through standardised interface and authentication systems. The system shall be flexible and adaptable to changes in the machinery, infrastructure and organisation of ICT services in the contract period. The aim is to establish a secure, user friendly, functional and cost efficient print system that requires minimal local administration and efficient interaction across the OFA companies.

result.text: The University of Edinburgh is undertaking preliminary market engagement to improve our understanding of current and emerging supplier capabilities, products and solutions for a Student Record Platform. The University is interested in student record systems that can integrate with its existing landscape, with the potential to rationalise and simplify the complexity of its current environment. This includes supporting areas such as exceptional circumstances, scholarships and assessment and progression,with the aim of delivering a more streamlined and effective solution. The University currently has contractual arrangements in place for its existing student record system. This engagement forms part of longer-term planning and is intended to improve understanding of how the market is evolving, inform the University's business requirements and support the development of its strategic planning and any future procurement strategy. Lot 1: . Please see the attached documentation for further information and details of the documents to be returned by interested suppliers. Responses will be reviewed by the University to inform its understanding of the current market, available technologies and delivery approaches. The information provided will support longer-term planning, strategic planning and, where appropriate, any future procurement strategy. This Prior Information Notice (PIN) is issued solely for the purpose of preliminary market engagement. It is not a call for competition and should not be interpreted as a commitment to undertake a procurement exercise or award any contract. Should a procurement be taken forward, it is anticipated that this could take place at any point within the next three to five years. The University welcome participation from all interested suppliers. Participation is voluntary, at each suppliers’ own cost and will not affect any future procurement process.. Interested suppliers should send the requested information to Suzanne Toole, Procurement Manager, suzie.toole@ed.ac.uk by 12 Noon (BST) on 04 September 2026. Suppliers should mark their email with ‘PIN Response “SUPPLIER NAME”– Student Record Platform’.

result.text: Torsås kommun (the Subscriber below) invites you to submit a tender for the service(s)/product(s) described below. Torsås kommun is conducting this procurement with the aim of acquiring an HCI solution that is a comprehensive solution regarding a datacentre in a server hall. We require a solution consisting of at least three nodes, including all hardware and software required to connect this to the existing environment. The agreement will be signed for five (5) years and all licences and support agreements must be included for the period. A time bank of 100 hours for implementation must also be offered in the tender. The supplier shall implement/commission the solution together with employees of the Torsås IT department. rejected.text: SDU is conduction a public consultation in relation to a forthcoming retender regarding a digital wayfinding solution for The University of Southern Denmark SDU hope all interested vendors will send feedback on the requirement specification for the tender. The purpose of the consultation is to seek the vendors assessment of whether our requirements specification calls for the best, appropriate and workable solution for a university with multiple campuses distributed across the Region of Southern Denmark. SDU occupies a large number of buildings in Denmark, approx. 360.000 square meters (gross area). SDU has the need for digital wayfinding covering a minimum of six locations, approx. 360.000 square meters (gross area): SDU Odense, SDU Kolding, SDU Esbjerg, SDU Copenhagen, SDU Sønderborg, and SDU Vejle. To facilitate the movement between and inside the university buildings for staff, students, and visitors, SDU intends to acquire a digital wayfinding system, which is to be based on SDU’s technical building plans. The digital wayfinding must work both indoors and outdoors for navigation, using smartphone, tablet, and computer. The idea is to provide the users with clear, simple navigation between A and B in our different campus areas. To further optimizing the use, the digital wayfinding system will also need to be able to integrate with other SDU systems.

result.text: This notice is a prior information notice concerning the procurement of Internet capacity. This notice does not constitute a request for tenders. The notice is accompanied by an invitation to a technical market dialogue, giving all suppliers interested in the procurement the opportunity to engage in dialogue regarding the procurement with Istekki Oy. The purpose of the notice is to survey the market regarding operators interested in the procurement and to initiate a dialogue with interested operators. The objective is to discuss the subject matter of the procurement and its specification at a general level, and to gather information concerning the subject matter of the procurement for future tendering. In particular, the aim is to examine the market situation of Internet capacity and telecommunications connections, functional and technical characteristics, suppliers' pricing principles and price level. Respondents to the notice will not be remunerated for participating in the technical market dialogue. Technical dialogue is not a prerequisite for participating in any subsequent tendering. Nor does the technical dialogue bind Istekki Oy to carry out the procurement. The technical dialogue will be conducted through commenting on draft versions of the tender documentation and answering questions from the Contracting Authority relating to the subject matter of the procurement. The subject matter of the dialogue and future procurement consists of telecommunications connections used to connect Istekki Oy's network to the public Internet. The overall scope consists of two redundant Internet capacity connections. The aim of the procurement is to ensure business continuity and efficiency for the organisation by procuring sufficient Internet capacity. The procurement is divided into two lots. The maximum number of lots awarded is restricted to one lot per tenderer. REGISTRATION: Suppliers must notify their interest in participating in the technical market dialogue no later than 19.01.2026 by 16:00 by sending an email to hankinnat@istekki.fi with the subject heading: "Internet capacity - registration for market dialogue". Suppliers are requested to provide the following information in the message: - supplier contact person's email address Istekki Oy reserves the right to invite registered suppliers also to bilateral negotiations, to organise an open market dialogue session with registered suppliers or to continue the technical dialogue in another manner specified separately. Participating companies will not be remunerated for responding or participating. The information provided will be treated confidentially.

parts.source: Tämä ilmoitus on ennakkoilmoitus hankinnasta Internet-kapasiteetti. Tällä ilmoituksella ei pyydetä tarjouksia. Ilmoitukseen liittyy kutsu tekniseen markkinavuoropuheluun, jolloin kaikilla hankinnasta kiinnostuneilla toimittajilla on mahdollisuus käydä hankintaa koskevaa vuoropuhelua Istekki Oy:n kanssa. Ilmoituksen tarkoituksena on kartoittaa markkinaa hankinnasta kiinnostuneiden toimijoiden osalta ja aloittaa vuoropuhelu kiinnostuneiden toimijoiden kanssa. Tavoitteena on käydä yleisellä tasolla vuoropuhelua hankinnan kohteesta ja sen määrittämisestä, sekä kerätä hankinnan kohdetta koskevaa tietoa tulevaa kilpailutusta varten. Erityisesti tarkoituksena on selvittää Internet-kapasiteetin ja tietoliikenneliittymien markkinatilannetta, toiminnallisia ja teknisiä ominaisuuksia, toimittajien hinnoitteluperiaatteita sekä hintatasoa. Ilmoitukseen vastanneille ei makseta korvausta tekniseen markkinavuoropuheluun osallistumisesta. Tekninen vuoropuhelu ei ole edellytys mahdolliseen myöhempään kilpailutukseen osallistumiselle. Tekninen vuoropuhelu ei myöskään sido Istekki Oy:tä toteuttamaan hankintaa. Tekninen vuoropuhelu järjestetään tarjouspyyntöaineiston luonnosversioiden kommentoinnin ja Hankintayksikön hankinnan kohteeseen liittyviin kysymyksiin vastaamisen kautta. Vuoropuhelun ja tulevan hankinnan kohteena ovat tietoliikenneliittymät, joilla Istekki Oy:n verkko liitetään julkiseen Internet-verkkoon. Kokonaisuus koostuu kahdesta kahdennetusta Internet-kapasiteettiliittymästä. Hankinnan tavoitteena on varmistaa organisaation liiketoiminnan jatkuvuus ja tehokkuus hankkimalla riittävä Internet-kapasiteetti. Hankinta on jaettu kahteen osaan. Myönnettävien osien enimmäismäärä on rajoitettu yhteen osaan per tarjoaja. ILMOITTAUTUMINEN: Toimittajan tulee ilmoittaa kiinnostuksensa osallistua tekniseen markkinavuoropuheluun viimeistään 19.01.2026 klo 16:00 mennessä lähettämällä sähköpostiviesti osoitteeseen hankinnat@istekki.fi otsikolla: "Internet-kapasiteetti - ilmoittautuminen markkinavuoropuheluun". Toimittajaa pyydetään ilmoittamaan viestissä seuraavat tiedot: - toimittajan yhteyshenkilön sähköpostiosoite Istekki Oy varaa oikeuden kutsua ilmoittautuneita toimittajia myös kahdenkeskisiin neuvotteluihin, järjestää avoimen markkinavuoropuhelutilaisuuden ilmoittautuneiden kanssa tai jatkaa teknistä vuoropuhelua muulla erikseen määrittelemällään tavalla. Osallistuneille yrityksille ei makseta korvausta vastaamisesta tai osallistumisesta. Annetut tiedot käsitellään luottamuksellisesti.

result.text: The purpose of this request for information is to clarify questions, obtain information and preliminary cost estimates related to a comprehensive digital pathology solution to be deployed by Fimlab Laboratoriot Oy (hereinafter “Fimlab” or "Contracting Entity"). This is not a Call for Tenders, but a market consultation; request of information. Fimlab invites interested suppliers to participate in the market consultation and requests their views regarding the planned procurement. The Contracting Entity is not committed to carrying out the procurement referred to in this request for information. Decisions on whether to initiate a possible procurement process will be made after the market consultation. SUBJECT OF THE PROCUREMENT The subject of the procurement is more detailed in annexes. Through this request for information, Fimlab seeks, among other things, to determine to assess the level of documentation and requirements, as well as market trends. RESPONDING TO THE REQUEST FOR INFORMATION Please respond to the questions and to submit the completed attachment via the Supplier Portal. The responses will be used in the preparation of the procurement and in the finalization of the Call for Tenders and its appendices. All responses will be treated confidentially. Information will not be disclosed to other suppliers without written consent for such disclosure. Responses may be submitted in Finnish or English in freeform written format. Respondents are requested to follow the numbering of the questions and to clearly indicate any trade secrets or confidential information. Responding to this request for information will not affect the position of a potential tenderer in any subsequent tender procedure. No remuneration will be paid for participation in the request for information. At this stage, the market consultation is being conducted solely through written submissions. However, the Contracting Entity may, at its discretion, invite participants to further discussions if clarification of the responses or additional information is considered necessary. In this case, the Contracting Entity, may continue supplier-specific discussions with a maximum of 3 suppliers.

result.text: The MoJ is currently exploring the future of intermediary services provision and conducting preliminary market engagement, prior to any procurement process. This notice is published for transparency purposes in accordance with the Procurement Act (2023) and does not constitute the commencement of a procurement. The MoJ is exploring how these services may be delivered across the Ministry and the wider justice sector. Services being considered include those currently provided under the HMCTS Appointed Intermediary Services Frameworks (HAIS) and the Witness Intermediary Scheme (WIS), in addition to ad hoc intermediary services provided to support His Majesty's Prison and Probation Service (HMPPS) and the Parole Board. You can find out more about the current HAIS arrangements at: https://www.gov.uk/guidance/hmcts-intermediary-services#about-hmcts-intermediary-services You can find out more about the current Witness Intermediary Scheme at: https://www.gov.uk/guidance/ministry-of-justice-witness-intermediary-scheme Intermediaries are impartial communication specialists whose primary responsibility is to enable complete, coherent and accurate communication with vulnerable witnesses, defendants and parties in the justice system, in order to improve the quality of evidence and facilitate the vulnerable person’s understanding and participation in the proceedings. As part of this process, suppliers are invited to provide input to the procurement prior to the announcement. What does the tenderer consider to be its core activity and main competence? Tenderers are requested to provide a short description of customers who currently use the system, including, if possible, which parts of the system are used and for which user groups. Points we would like feedback on: Provide a description of the tenderer's system and how this covers the needs/purposes described. What are the main features and advantages? What type of delivery model/operational model can be provided (SaaS, other)? Does the tenderer have input on how any environmental requirements can be set for the system? Price models: Which price models does the tenderer operate with and what price models does the supplier recommend? Can the supplier comply with other models if the Contracting Authority deems it appropriate? What factors affect the price of the tenderer's system? Quality and security: What requirements does the tenderer have in relation to the quality of the system? What measures does the tenderer have to ensure that information security and privacy are safeguarded, with particular focus on sensitive areas such as patient safety? Where is the solution installed? Where are the personnel operating and maintaining the system? What kind of support and training does the service provider offer to ensure users get the most out of their solution? Which support and maintenance services does the tenderer offer? Other: How does the supplier work on innovation and further development of the product? How does the supplier ensure that the systems remain relevant in line with technological developments in the market? Are there special developments in the market that the Contracting Authority ought to take into consideration in designing a future-oriented agreement? Which SSA templates does the tenderer think are best suited for the delivery and why? Are there any other elements that the Contracting Authority should pay particular attention to? What should, in the tenderer's view, be emphasised in any future procurement? Furthermore, it may be of interest, if relevant for the interested party, to hear about the tenderer's experience from similar public tenders, possibly in comparable countries (preferably countries within the EU). Deadline for written feedback from interested parties: 19.11.2025 This is only a prior information notice to obtain information on the market and to have a dialogue with relevant suppliers. The actual competition may be announced at a later date. Sykehusinnkjøp HF is assisting Sykehuspartner HF and HSØ with the implementation of the market dialogue. See www.sykehuspartner.no and www.helse-sorost.no. For further information about the Contracting Authority, please register or submit questions about the market survey in the Mercell communication module. After this market survey, the Contracting Authority will assess the need to hold meeting(s) with relevant interested parties.

result.text: Verkehrsgesellschaft Landkreis Gifhorn mbH (VLG) intends to gradually convert its bus fleet to electromobility within the framework of the requirements of the Clean Vehicles Procurement Act. For this purpose, electric buses and the charging infrastructure required for their operation are to be procured and integrated into operational processes. VLG plans to initially provide charging infrastructure for initially 11 vehicles by the year 2027. A charging and load management system is to be introduced for the centralised control and monitoring of charging processes, for limiting grid load as well as for supporting operational vehicle dispatching and vehicle stabling. With the introduction of electromobility, additional requirements arise for the planning and control of vehicle deployment, charging processes and available electrical power. Vehicle availability, battery charge state, energy demand, planned departure times, charging point occupancy and available grid capacity must in future be brought together and taken into account in a system-supported manner. The initial expansion stage comprises the charging infrastructure for 11 vehicles. The exact number and design of the charging points, their technical properties as well as the operational systems and data sources to be integrated are described in a binding manner in the quantity framework, in the interface descriptions and in the appendices to this specification. The increasing requirements in the course of the progressive electrification of the bus fleet as well as the expansion of the charging infrastructure require a high-performance charging, load and energy management system. With the introduction of an LMS, charging processes are to be controlled taking into account the boundary conditions from charging infrastructure, vehicle data, battery charge states and range requirements. The LMS must control the charging processes in such a way that the charge states required for the planned vehicle deployment are reached in good time. The charging infrastructure is to be integrated into the LMS so that the status of the charging units can be centrally monitored and controlled.

parts.source: Die Verkehrsgesellschaft Landkreis Gifhorn mbH (VLG) beabsichtigt, ihre Busflotte im Rahmen der Anforderungen des Saubere-Fahrzeuge-Beschaffungs-Gesetzes schrittweise auf Elektromobilität umzustellen. Hierzu sollen Elektrobusse sowie die für deren Betrieb erforderliche Ladeinfrastruktur beschafft und in die betrieblichen Abläufe integriert werden. Die VLG plant, bis zum Jahr 2027 zunächst Ladeinfrastruktur für zunächst 11 Fahrzeuge bereitzustellen. Zur zentralen Steuerung und Überwachung der Ladevorgänge, zur Begrenzung der Netzlast sowie zur Unterstützung der betrieblichen Fahrzeugdisposition und Fahrzeugaufstellung soll ein Lade- und Lastmanagementsystem eingeführt werden. Mit der Einführung der Elektromobilität entstehen zusätzliche Anforderungen an die Planung und Steuerung des Fahrzeugeinsatzes, der Ladevorgänge und der verfügbaren elektrischen Leistung. Fahrzeugverfügbarkeit, Batterieladezustand, Energiebedarf, geplante Abfahrtszeiten, Ladepunktbelegung und verfügbare Netzleistung müssen zukünftig systemgestützt zusammengeführt und berücksichtigt werden. Das initiale Ausbaustadium umfasst die Ladeinfrastruktur für 11 Fahrzeuge. Die genaue Anzahl und Ausprägung der Ladepunkte, deren technische Eigenschaften sowie die einzubindenden betrieblichen Systeme und Datenquellen werden im Mengengerüst, in den Schnittstellenbeschreibungen und in den Anlagen zu diesem Lastenheft verbindlich beschrieben. Die steigenden Anforderungen im Zuge der fortschreitenden Elektrifizierung der Busflotte sowie der Ausbau der Ladeinfrastruktur erfordern ein leistungsfähiges Lade-, Last- und Energiemanagement. Mit der Einführung eines LMS sollen die Ladeprozesse unter Berücksichtigung der Randbedingungen aus Ladeinfrastruktur, Fahrzeugdaten, Batterieladezuständen und Reichweitenanforderungen gesteuert werden. Das LMS muss die Ladevorgänge so steuern, dass die für den geplanten Fahrzeugeinsatz erforderlichen Ladezustände rechtzeitig erreicht werden. Die Ladeinfrastruktur ist in das LMS zu integrieren, sodass der Status der Ladeeinheiten zentral überwacht und gesteuert werden kann.

rejected.text: Consultants from COWI are currently conducting a feasibility study for Sporveien in Oslo. The purpose of this study is to define technology-independent and supplier-independent functional requirements for the future signalling system of the Oslo tram network, which consists of more than 130km of tracks with almost 100 stopping points. The tram infrastructure in Oslo has a history stretching back over 150 years, and has recently seen significant investment in modern rolling stock. This provides a unique opportunity to assess future solutions for a modern signalling system, and Sporveien has expressed a desire to invest in a future signalling system for the trams. As part of this project, we wish to gather information from suppliers of signalling and light rail systems. We therefore invite relevant suppliers to share information about your solutions, technologies, and experiences. We are particularly interested in systems that support safe, modern operation and that are adaptable to both the current and future needs of the Oslo tram network. Additionally, Sporveien AS and COWI AS are planning a dialogue conference with suppliers in Oslo on November 13th. This conference will provide an opportunity to discuss future collaborations and explore new opportunities for growth and development. We hope to see you at this conference. Once we have established contact with your organisation and received your company’s contact information we will send you a letter of invitation with the complete agenda. Please see https://www.sporveien.no/for-leverandorer/trikkens-fremtidige-signalsystem/dialogue-conference/ for more information.

result.text: Despite a grown awareness of the consequences of plastic pollution for the marine environment, there is a persistent threat from ALDFG which is newly introduced into the marine environment or has in some cases already been located there for decades. The aim of UNSEA is therefore to systematically prevent the further input of ALDFG into the North and Baltic Seas, to reduce the negative ecological and socio-economic impacts and to identify and salvage legacy waste, particularly in ecologically sensitive areas. Both commercial, sideline and recreational fishing in the North and Baltic Seas are to be addressed. Aquaculture and mariculture as well as inland fisheries are excluded from the project scope. Existing requirements and agreements of relevant national and international legal provisions are currently still fragmented, without financial backing and are partly up for debate for various reasons. UNSEA is therefore intended to bring together the various sub-aspects in a coherent framework for action, focusing on the implementation of cost-efficient and operational measures. In doing so, it is necessary to rethink the handling of waste fishing gear from the fishing industry in a new and holistic way, to anchor circular economy principles in the management of fishing gear and thereby also address specific findings such as dolly ropes (scuff protection threads on bottom trawls) and net sections from repair work that are frequently found in the marine environment. The project is intended to provide the necessary seed funding over its term and in parallel create long-term structures with clear responsibilities for perpetuation by the federal and state governments. For the first time, a cross-sectoral mechanism is to be established and implemented, which also includes the exchange of knowledge and information. The project can build on existing legal framework conditions, recommendations from research and politics, preliminary work within the framework of measure and action plans and voluntary industry initiatives. In particular, the 2016 established Round Table on Marine Litter (RTM, www.muell-im-meer.de), which is coordinated by the Umweltbundesamt and the State of Lower Saxony, has already carried out comprehensive conceptual preliminary work that can be used as a basis for work for UNSEA. Through this, insights into the dimension of the problem were gained and suitable methods as well as existing and missing elements in the chain from search to the most environmentally sound recycling possible of ALDFG were identified. Furthermore, the results and recommendations of two pilot projects for the implementation of the recovery of lost fishing gear in Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania (MV) and Schleswig-Holstein (SH) are to be taken into account. While the project in MV has already been completed (https://www.wwf.de/fileadmin/fm-wwf/Publikationen-PDF/Deutschland/WWF-Abschlussbericht-Landesprojekt-Verlorene-Fischereigeraete.pdf), the publication of the final report of the SH project is expected for August 2026 with planned follow-up activities for the mapping and recovery of fishing gear waste. The work under UNSEA is to be closely coordinated with these activities to avoid duplication of work. parts.source: Trotz eines gewachsenen Bewusstseins der Konsequenzen der Plastikverschmutzung für die marine Umwelt besteht eine anhaltende Bedrohung durch ALDFG, welches neu in die Meeresumwelt eingetragen wird oder sich dort teilweise bereits seit Jahrzehnten befindet. Ziel von UNSEA ist es daher, den weiteren Eintrag von ALDFG in die Nord- und Ostsee sys-tematisch zu verhindern, die negativen ökologischen und sozioökonomischen Auswirkungen zu reduzieren und Altlasten insbesondere in ökologisch sensiblen Gebieten zu identifizieren und zu bergen. Dabei sind sowohl die kommerzielle, die Nebenerwerbs- sowie die Sportfischerei in Nord- und Ostsee zu adressieren. Ausgenommen vom Projektumfang sind Aqua- und Marikulturen und die Binnenfischerei. Existierende Vorgaben und Vereinbarungen relevanter nationaler und internationaler Rechtsvorgaben sind momentan noch fragmentiert, ohne finanziellen Unterbau und stehen teilweise aus verschiedenen Gründen zur Disposition. UNSEA soll daher die verschiedenen Teilaspekte in einem kohä-renten Handlungsrahmen zusammenführen, wobei die Umsetzung kosteneffizienter und operationaler Maßnahmen im Fokus stehen. Dabei gilt es, den Umgang mit Fanggeräteabfällen aus der Fischerei neu und gesamtheitlich zu denken, Prinzipien der Kreislaufwirtschaft im Management von Fischfanggeräten zu verankern und dabei auch spezielle Befunde wie Dolly Ropes (Scheuerschutzfäden an Grundschleppnetzen) und Netzteile aus Reparaturarbeiten zu adressieren, die sich häufig in der Meeresumwelt finden. Das Projekt soll über die Laufzeit die dafür erforderliche Anschubfinanzierung leisten und parallel langfristige Strukturen mit klaren Verantwortlichkeiten für die Verstetigung durch Bund und Länder schaffen. Dabei soll erstmalig ein sek-torübergreifender Mechanismus festgelegt und umgesetzt werden, welcher auch Wissens- und Informationsaustausch beinhaltet. Das Projekt kann auf bestehende rechtliche Rahmenbedingungen, Empfehlungen aus For-schung und Politik, Vorarbeiten im Rahmen von Maßnahmen- und Aktionsplänen und freiwilligen Industrieinitiativen aufbauen. Hierüber wurden Erkenntnisse über die Dimension des Problems gewonnen und geeignete Methoden sowie vorhandene und fehlende Elemente in der Kette von der Suche bis zur möglichst um-weltgerechten Verwertung von ALDFG identifiziert. result.text: South Lanarkshire Council seeks a Creative Consultancy to deliver a Market Assessment, Branding Strategy, Website Development, Content Library and Wayfinding Strategy for the Douglas Valley Outdoor Recreation and Adventure Tourism initiative within the Hagshaw Energy Cluster. 1. Market Assessment Review existing project documentation and identify implications for branding, marketing and website development. Analyse visitor data, market trends and audience segmentation, including visitor case studies. Benchmark comparable projects and destinations. Provide recommendations to inform branding, website design, content and future marketing activity. 2. Branding Development Develop and consult on three branding concepts before producing a final identity. Create brand assets including logo, name, tagline, colours, fonts and digital/print applications. Produce brand guidelines covering signage, interpretation, promotional materials and integration with existing site branding. Include recommendations for social media and future marketing activity. 3. Website Design, Build and Launch Create a branded website promoting Douglas Valley as a destination to live, work, visit and enjoy, supporting ambitions to attract up to 100,000 annual visits by 2036. Develop a scalable, content-led website with a planned lifespan of ten years. Include six core pages: Home, About, Explore, See & Stay, News and Contact. The Explore section will feature an interactive map highlighting key recreational and active travel routes, points of interest and route information including distance, elevation, difficulty and duration. Build the site on an accessible CMS suitable for community and council users. Host on a secure UK-based platform with maintenance and support arrangements. Ensure accessibility compliance and provide flexible management of route information and temporary diversions. 4. Photography and Video Library Establish a copyright-cleared library of photography and short-form video content for web, social media and print use. Source content through community engagement, youth-focused workshops and professional photography where required. Content will reflect identified visitor segments and feature strong people-focused imagery. Coverage will include renewable energy, local communities, nature, heritage and identity, local economy and outdoor recreation. Key locations include Coalburn, Douglas, Glenbuck, Glespin, Lesmahagow, Mainshill, Muirkirk, Poneil, Rigside, Douglas Water and Spireslack, alongside significant natural, heritage and recreation assets. 5. Wayfinding Strategy and Design Guidance Develop a first-phase wayfinding strategy focused on Coalburn, Douglas, Glespin, Douglasdale Community Woodland and connecting active travel routes. Establish a hierarchy of signage including gateway signs, orientation panels, interpretation boards, directional signage and waymarkers. Produce a spatial strategy identifying suitable signage locations. Develop design guidance covering dimensions, materials, specification, siting and future rollout. Prepare detailed proposals for priority installations to support future procurement. Work with Community Action Lanarkshire on implementation of information signs, directional signage and waymarkers along the NCN-Coalburn-Douglas route. Ensure all strategy, design and implementation follow inclusive design principles. Lot 1: . result.text: The Contracting Authority is tendering a contract regarding a common Operating Platform for the Contracting Authority's IT system portfolio. After Transition In, where the Support Systems are transitioned to the Operating Platform, the Supplier shall be responsible for operation, including Data Centre operation/Hybrid Cloud Custom Services/Hybrid Cloud Standard Services and Infrastructure operation, as well as Support and maintenance of the Operating Platform. Furthermore, after Transition In, the Supplier must ensure Subsequent Transitions to and Transformations of the Operating Platform. The purpose of the common Operating Platform is, among other things, to obtain secure and stable operation with high availability as well as a modern technological platform with a high degree of scalability that supports the needs of the Customer and the municipalities. It is the Contracting Authority's business need that all Services are delivered with high delivery reliability and robustness, and that the Supplier demonstrates proactivity in the collaboration. In addition to the focus on secure and stable operation, the Supplier must ensure a successful Transition In of the Support Systems with the least possible disruption to the Contracting Authority's business, as well as Subsequent Transitions and ongoing Transformation, including a gradual transition to Hybrid Cloud Standard Services and, to the extent that it supports the needs of the Contracting Authority and the municipalities, Managed Public Cloud Services. In connection with Transition In, a high level of information security must be established, which must be continuously maintained and improved throughout the Contract. The contract has the following 4 main services: I. Transition In, where the Contracting Authority initially wishes for the establishment of and secure and stable transfer to an Operating Platform for the Support Systems, based on Hybrid Cloud Services, with the implementation of, for example, project management, transition organisation, building of operational capacity, transfer of Environments and data, and takeover of knowledge from the Outgoing Supplier. Subsequently, the Contracting Authority wishes to carry out successive Subsequent Transitions for a number of the Contracting Authority's other IT systems from the current operating models to the Operating Platform, based on Hybrid Cloud Services. II. Ongoing Services for the Operating Platform, including; a. Support; b. Hybrid Cloud Services, including Hybrid Cloud Standard Services and Hybrid Cloud Custom Services; c. Tools for supporting Application Suppliers; d. Governance, Operational Processes, security services, Documentation, and operational reporting. III. Service catalogue with the use of standardised methods, technologies, and services, through which the Contracting Authority wishes to be able to provision services on a cloud platform that; a) Offers a wide range of services; b) Is accessible via the public internet; c) Has a publicly available price structure with settlement of services according to consumption on subscription terms. IV. Methods and tools for supporting collaboration with the Contracting Authority and the Contracting Authority's application suppliers, where the Contracting Authority wishes for the delivery of the future operating platform to be supported by proactive collaboration across the Contracting Authority's IT system portfolio.

parts.source: Ordregiver udbyder kontrakt vedrørende en fælles Driftsplatform for ordregivers IT-systemportefølje. Efter Transition Ind, hvor Støttesystemerne transitioneres til Driftsplatformen, skal Leverandøren forestå drift, herunder Datacenterdrift/Hybrid Cloud Custom Services/Hybrid Cloud Standard Services og Infrastrukturdrift, samt Support og vedligeholdelse af Driftsplatformen. Desuden skal Leverandøren efter Transition Ind sikre Efterfølgende Transitioner til og Transformationer af Driftsplatformen. Formålet med den fælles Driftsplatform er blandt andet at få en sikker og stabil drift med en høj tilgængelighed samt en tidssvarende teknologisk platform med en høj grad af skalerbarhed, der understøtter Kundens og kommunernes behov. Det er ordregivers forretningsmæssige behov, at alle Ydelser leveres med høj leverancesikkerhed og robusthed, samt at Leverandøren udviser proaktivitet i samarbejdet. Ud over fokus på sikker og stabil drift, skal Leverandøren sikre en vellykket Transition Ind af Støttesystemerne med mindst mulig forstyrrelse af ordregivers forretning samt Efterfølgende Transitioner og løbende Transformation, herunder gradvis overgang til Hybrid Cloud Standard Services og i det omfang, det understøtter ordregivers og kommunernes behov, Managed Public Cloud Services. Der skal i forbindelse med Transition Ind etableres et højt informationssikkerhedsniveau, som løbende skal vedligeholdes og forbedres gennem hele Kontrakten. Kontrakten har følgende 4 hovedydelser: I. Transition Ind, hvor ordregiver i første omgang ønsker etablering af og sikker og stabil overflytning til en Driftsplatform for Støttesystemerne, baseret på Hybrid Cloud Services, med gennemførelse af fx projektstyring, transitionsorganisation, opbygning af driftskapacitet, overførsel af Miljøer og data og overtagelse af viden fra Afgivende Leverandør. Efterfølgende ønsker ordregiver at gennemføre successive Efterfølgende Transitioner for en række af ordregivers øvrige IT-systemer fra de nuværende driftsmodeller til Driftsplatformen, baseret på Hybrid Cloud Services. II. Løbende Ydelser til Driftsplatformen, herunder; a. Support; b. Hybrid Cloud Services, herunder Hybrid Cloud Standard Services og Hybrid Cloud Custom Services; c. Værktøjer til understøttelse af Applikationsleverandører; d. Governance, Operationelle Processer, sikkerhedsydelser, Dokumentation og driftsrapportering. III. Servicekatalog med anvendelse af standardiserede metoder, teknologier og services, hvorigennem ordregiver ønsker at kunne provisionere services på en cloudplatform der; a) Udbyder et bredt sortiment af services; b) Er tilgængelig via det offentlige internet; c) Har er en offentligt tilgængelig prisstruktur med afregning af services efter forbrug på abonnementsvilkår. IV. Metoder og værktøjer til understøttelse af samarbejde med Ordregiver og Ordregivers applikationsleverandører, hvor ordregiver ønsker at leverancen af den fremtidige driftsplatform er understøttet af et proaktivt samarbejde på tværs af ordregivers IT-systemportefølje.
