result.text: HUS requests your tender for a software service that manages HUS Pharmacy's enterprise resource planning, covering the operational areas described in the appendices. Processes and data concerning HUS Pharmacy's medication management will be configured into the software service to be procured. The software service must integrate with the systems used by HUS in its other enterprise resource planning (e.g. Oracle Fusion Cloud). The appendices to the call for tender (appendix 0 and appendices 1: Description of current operations) describe the scope of current operations through verbal descriptions by operational area. The purpose of the descriptions is to familiarise the tenderer with HUS Pharmacy's current operations. The appendices (appendices 2: Description of target state) describe the requirements set for the subject of the procurement by operational area using various process descriptions and listed requirements. The purpose of this is to express to tenderers the minimum requirements set for enterprise resource planning. In addition, objectives for developing current operations are described. Our intention is to replace the current system with a software service (SaaS) that enables process development and guarantees a qualitatively stable operation. HUS is seeking a SaaS-based software service, which must be based on software that is already in production use and ready-made, and a solution configured from it for the contracting authority. The project schedule is planned such that the software service will be implemented during the year 2028. The project will be initiated with a definition phase, in which the made descriptions are refined against the software service offered by the winning tenderer, thereby ensuring that the software service in question meets the set requirements and offers a clear development path. In this definition phase, the implementation project plan is also refined to such a level that the parties can commit to the execution of the project. The definition phase is invoiced on a time basis, for a maximum of 50 000 euros and for a duration of no more than four months. The appendix Description of the implementation project explains in more detail what must be produced during the definition phase. After the definition phase, both parties have the option, if they so wish, to withdraw from the project. Following the definition phase, the contracting authority and the tenderer will negotiate the target workload and price for the project in the manner presented in the call for tender. Other appendices to the call for tender describe requirements related to the implementation phase, ongoing services, and information security. The software service must be capable of being integrated in a conventional manner into various administrative systems. The interfaces of the software service are presented in the appendix "Integrations". Oracle FINA interfaces are individually described in more detail in appendix 2.9.3. The appendix "Draft Agreement" covers operations during both the implementation phase and ongoing services. The appendix "Price Form" describes the calculation of the comparative price of tenders and the procedures for establishing the target price.

parts.source: HUS pyytää tarjoustanne ohjelmistopalvelusta, jolla hoidetaan HUS Apteekin toiminnanohjausta kattaen liitteissä kuvatut toiminnan osa-alueet. Hankittavaan ohjelmistopalveluun konfiguroidaan HUS Apteekin lääkkeiden hallinnointia koskevia prosesseja ja tietoja. Ohjelmistopalvelun tulee integroitua HUSin muussa toiminnanohjauksessaan käyttämiin järjestelmiin (esim. Oracle Fusion Cloud). Tarjouspyynnön liitteissä (liite 0 ja liitteet 1: Nykytoiminnan kuvaus) on kuvattu nykytoiminnan laajuutta sanallisin kuvauksin eri toiminta-alueittain. Kuvauksien tarkoitus on perehdyttää tarjoajaa HUS Apteekin nykytoimintaan. Liitteissä (liitteet 2: Tavoitetilan kuvaus) on kuvattu hankinnan kohteelle asetettuja vaatimuksia toiminta-aluekohtaisesti erilaisin prosessikuvauksin ja listatuilla vaatimuksilla. Tämän tarkoituksena on ilmaista tarjoajille toiminnanohjaukselle asetettavia vähimmäisvaatimuksia. Lisäksi on kuvattu tavoitteita nykytoiminnan kehittämiseksi. Tarkoituksenamme on korvata nykyjärjestelmä ohjelmistopalvelulla (SaaS), joka mahdollistaa prosessien kehittämisen ja turvaa laadullisesti vakaan toiminnan. HUS hakee SaaS-pohjaista ohjelmistopalvelua, jonka tulee pohjautua tuotantokäytössä jo olevaan ja valmiiseen ohjelmistoon ja tilaajalle siitä konfiguroitavaan ratkaisuun. Hanke on suunniteltu aikataulultaan sellaiseksi, että ohjelmistopalvelu otetaan käyttöön vuoden 2028 aikana. Hanke käynnistetään määrittelyvaiheella, jossa tarkennetaan tehdyt kuvaukset voittaneen tarjoajan tarjoamaa ohjelmistopalvelua vasten ja näin varmistetaan, että kyseinen ohjelmistopalvelu täyttää asetetut vaatimukset ja tarjoaa selkeän kehityspolun. Tässä määrittelyvaiheessa myös tarkennetaan käyttöönottoprojektin suunnitelma sellaiselle tasolle, että osapuolet voivat sitoutua projektin toteutukseen. Määrittelyvaihe on aikaperusteisesti laskutettava, maksimissaan 50 000 euroa ja kestoltaan enintään neljä kuukautta. Liitteessä Käyttöönottoprojektin kuvaus on tarkemmin selostettu mitä määrittelyvaiheessa tulee tuottaa. Määrittelyvaiheen jälkeen molemmilla osapuolilla on, niin halutessaan, mahdollisuus luopua hankkeesta. Määrittelyvaiheen jälkeen tilaaja ja tarjoaja neuvottelevat tarjouspyynnössä esitetyllä tavoin hankkeelle tavoitetyömäärän ja -hinnan. result.text: The aim of this project is to provide tools in the form of a guideline and a tool for public administration, industry, and security research that make it possible to increase the resilience of cloud applications in particular against microarchitectural attacks such as Spectre and Meltdown and newer variants. The focus is to be on defensive programming countermeasures at the application level. In this way, the security of the software used is to be made more independent of the cloud provider's countermeasures. To reach as large a target group as possible, the results are to be written in English. The guideline is to describe concrete, practical, and easily applicable measures, and the developed tool is to automatically identify vulnerabilities and mitigate them if necessary. result.text: The client's IT encompasses a very wide range of services from merchandise management and billing systems such as SAP through control centre systems to apps, such as MVGO. IT demand sometimes grows faster than internal staff can be built up and should it decrease, reducing internal staff is sluggish. This scaling requirement is addressed by awarding services to external parties. One form of this is the external takeover of testing of software applications in a scope appropriate for each application (test concept, test management, test case definition, execution of functional and non-functional tests (e.g. L&P tests, regression tests, exploratory tests, ...), test automation). This support takes place in both traditional and agile environments. The client currently has 3 candidate groups of applications for which they wish to outsource testing. The known support effort is approx. 3 to 5 FTE. During the contract term, applications may be added, removed, or the annual effort for them may fluctuate. A framework agreement is being tendered. The individual applications are commissioned via call-off (possibly also with multiple call-offs). The client's experience shows that domain knowledge is essential for service delivery, especially when testing. The tender covers the following domains: • Public transport sales: Sales processes (app- and web-based sales channels, mass customer billing) • Purchasing and logistics (SAP MM/SD/CS) • Finance (SAP FI/CO) • Maintenance including mobile maintenance (SAP PM, app applications) There is no obligation for the client to exhaust the contract under this framework agreement. Services are fundamentally to be provided remotely. Exceptions that require on-site service delivery are workshops and, where applicable, tests in connection with hardware that is only available on-site at the client (e.g. a ticket vending machine). Other special conditions for contract performance: Contract execution in German, written and oral; within EU GDPR

parts.source: Die IT des Auftraggebers umfasst ein sehr großes Leistungsspektrum von Warenwirtschafts- und Abrechnungssystemen wie SAP über Leitstellensysteme bis hin zu Apps, wie der MVGO. Der IT-Bedarf wächst zeitweise schneller, als internes Personal aufgebaut werden kann und sollte er sinken, ist der Abbau von internem Personal träge. Dieser Skalierungsbedarf wird mit einer Vergabe von Leistungen an Extern beantwortet. Eine Form ist dabei die externe Übernahme des Tests von Software-Anwendungen in jeweils für die Anwendung geeignetem Umfang (Testkonzept, Teststeuerung, Testfalldefinition, Durchführung von funktionalen und nicht funktionalen Tests (z.B. L&P-Tests, Regressionstests, explorative Tests, ...), Testautomatisierung). Diese Betreuung findet sowohl im klassischen wie auch im agilen Umfeld statt. Derzeit hat der Auftraggeber 3 Kandidaten-Gruppen an Applikationen, zu denen er den Test extern vergeben möchte. Der bekannte Betreuungsaufwand liegt bei ca. 3 bis 5 FTE. Während der Laufzeit können Applikationen hinzukommen, wegfallen oder der jährliche Aufwand dazu schwanken. Es wird eine Rahmenvereinbarung ausgeschrieben. Die einzelnen Applikationen werden per Abruf (ggf. auch mit mehreren Abrufen) beauftragt. Die Erfahrungen des Auftraggebers zeigen, dass gerade beim Testen Domänenwissen die Leistungserbringung unumgänglich ist. Die Ausschreibung umfasst folgende Domänen: • ÖPNV-Vertrieb: Vertriebliche Prozesse (App- und Web-basierte Vertriebswege, Massenkundenabrechnung) • Einkauf und Logistik (SAP MM/SD/CS) • Finanzen (SAP FI/CO) • Instandhaltung inklusive mobile Instandhaltung (SAP PM, App-Anwendungen) Mit dieser Rahmenvereinbarung besteht keine Verpflichtung zur Ausschöpfung des Vertrages für den Auftraggeber. Die Leistungen sind grundsätzlich remote zu erbringen. Ausnahmen, die eine Leistungserbringung vor Ort bedürfen, sind Workshops und ggf. Tests im Zusammenhang mit Hardware, die nur beim AG vor Ort verfügbar ist (z.B. ein Fahrkartenautomat). Sonstige besondere Bedingungen für die Auftragsausführung: Auftragsabwicklung in deutscher Sprache, schriftlich und mündlich; innerhalb EU-DSGVO

result.text: Helse Nord IKT HF (Northern Norway Health ICT Trust) wants to investigate whether there are solutions in the market that can support management of vulnerabilities. Rapid changes in the digital landscape, combined with a continuous more complex threat landscape, require public sector organisations to maintain clear visibility into vulnerabilities across their systems, networks, and applications. Public digital infrastructure is built on intricate systems and interconnected environments that are constantly exposed to cyber risks. A vulnerability management service enables organisations to identify and assess these environments, detect security weaknesses, optimise remediation efforts, and optimise vulnerability management workflows. Conducting regular efforts to detect vulnerabilities reduces the likelihood of data breaches, service disruptions, and other expensive incidents, while supporting a more proactive and structured approach to information security.

result.text: 1. Objective and subject of the procurement The subject of the procurement is the co-creation and implementation of a gamified simulation or XR-based learning solution intended for upper secondary vocational education and training in the tourism sector. The solution must also be suitable, where appropriate, for university of applied sciences teaching. The procurement is implemented as part of the European Union co-funded Immersive Learning Ecosystem IMMO project in cooperation with Haaga-Helia University of Applied Sciences, the City of Helsinki and Laurea University of Applied Sciences. The objective is to produce an experiential and working-life-oriented learning experience suitable for the immersive room of the IMMO project, by means of which students can practise knowledge, skills and situations related to tourism degree modules and working life competence needs. The solution may relate to one or more tourism competence areas. The tenderer is not required to have ready-made learning content or a ready-made XR solution at the tender stage; instead, the final contents, learning objectives and use cases of the solution will be specified in co-creation. 2. Content of the delivery The procurement comprises the entire development process from design and conceptualisation to final implementation. The delivery includes at least: - requirement and content workshops as well as conceptualisation and scripting; - three co-creation workshops; - construction of learning and demonstration materials; - implementation of development versions and iterative development; - user testing in the IMMO space and utilisation of feedback; - finalisation of the solution and measures related to commissioning; - handover of source code, editable source files, documentation and other agreed materials; and - final reporting and preparation for open publishing. Tourism students, teachers, company representatives and project experts will participate in the co-creation. The supplier is responsible for the development and test environment it requires. Contract obligations shall be performed within the EU/EEA area. The supplier has the right to carry out the design, content production, development, programming, documentation and other implementation work of the solution independently of location in a suitable location of its choice suitable for information-secure work. Working on the customer's premises is required only to the extent that separately agreed meetings, tests, approval procedures or the use of the immersive room of the IMMO project so require. The customer has no obligation to arrange workspaces for the supplier. 3. Key requirements of the solution The solution must: - be gamified in such a way that gamification is a key design principle of the solution; - enable the user's active action, decision-making or problem-solving as well as feedback on the user's choices; - enable the completion of the learning experience multiple times in alternative ways; - support joint learning, teamwork, teacher-led guidance and the simultaneous participation of multiple users; - include a pedagogically justified progression model; - enable the maintenance, development and expansion of learning contents; - meet the technical requirements of the IMMO space described in the Q/A appendix; and - operate in normal use without continuous or in-use internet connectivity. The objective is an approximately 20–30 minute learning experience. The tenderer may utilise existing technologies, game engines, XR platforms and 360-degree contents if the entity meets the requirements set in the procurement documents. 4. Implementation and schedule The supplier must implement the solution in accordance with the principles of agile and iterative development. The supplier will participate in the kick-off meeting held in November 2026 and the first co-creation workshops held in November and December. Different versions of the solution will be tested with users in the IMMO space starting in January 2027. The supplier will participate in the interim review carried out in February 2027 and finalise the solution based on user feedback. The final solution with its contents must be delivered and approved no later than 28.2.2027. 5. Price and key contract terms The fixed total price of the procurement is 35 000 euros excluding value added tax. The price includes all costs arising from the fulfilment of the obligations according to the procurement contract and its appendices. The supplier may invoice the price only when the Customer has approved the final delivery in writing. A six-month warranty is granted for the delivery. A penalty for delay defined in the contract may be charged for a delay for which the supplier is responsible. The EUPL 1.2 licence or another pre-approved compatible open source licence shall in principle apply to the customer application included in the solution and its documentation. The rights, use, modification, sharing and possible open publishing of learning materials shall be resolved on a material-specific basis. The tenderer must attach to its tender a preliminary learning material rights and publishing list and supplement it during the project. The project output must not be published without the Customer's written approval. The draft contract, JIT 2025 Customer applications open source special terms and conditions and JIT 2025 General terms and conditions shall apply to the procurement contract in the order of precedence specified in the contract. More detailed minimum requirements, technical requirements, approval conditions, responsibilities and other contract terms are determined on the basis of the invitation to tender and its appendices.

Hankinta toteutetaan osana Euroopan unionin osarahoittamaa Immersiivisen oppimisen ekosysteemi IMMO-hanketta yhteistyössä Haaga-Helia ammattikorkeakoulun, Helsingin kaupungin ja Laurea-ammattikorkeakoulun kanssa. Tavoitteena on tuottaa IMMO-hankkeen immersiiviseen huonetilaan soveltuva, elämyksellinen ja työelämälähtöinen oppimiskokemus, jonka avulla opiskelijat voivat harjoitella matkailualan tutkinnon osiin ja työelämän osaamistarpeisiin liittyviä tietoja, taitoja ja tilanteita. Ratkaisu voi liittyä yhteen tai useampaan matkailualan osaamisalueeseen. Tarjoajalta ei edellytetä valmista oppimissisältöä tai valmista XR-ratkaisua tarjousvaiheessa, vaan ratkaisun lopulliset sisällöt, oppimistavoitteet ja käyttötapaukset täsmennetään yhteiskehittämisessä. 2. Toimituksen sisältö Hankinta käsittää koko kehitysprosessin suunnittelusta ja konseptoinnista lopulliseen toteutukseen. Toimitukseen sisältyvät vähintään: - vaatimus- ja sisältötyöpajat sekä konseptointi ja käsikirjoitus; - kolme yhteiskehittämistyöpajaa; - oppimis- ja demonstraatioaineistojen rakentaminen; - kehitysversioiden toteuttaminen ja iteratiivinen kehittäminen; - käyttäjätestaukset IMMO-tilassa ja palautteen hyödyntäminen; - ratkaisun viimeistely ja käyttöönottoon liittyvät toimenpiteet; - lähdekoodin, muokattavien lähdetiedostojen, dokumentaation ja muiden sovittujen aineistojen luovuttaminen; ja - loppuraportointi ja avoimen julkaisemisen valmistelu. Yhteiskehittämiseen osallistuu matkailualan opiskelijoita, opettajia, yritysten edustajia ja hankkeen asiantuntijoita. Toimittaja vastaa tarvitsemastaan kehitys- ja testiympäristöstä. Sopimusvelvoitteet suoritetaan EU/ETA-alueella. Toimittajalla on oikeus toteuttaa Ratkaisun suunnittelu, sisällöntuotanto, kehittäminen, ohjelmointi, dokumentointi ja muut toteutustyöt tilariippumattomasti valitsemassaan tarkoituksenmukaisessa ja tietoturvalliseen työskentelyyn soveltuvassa sijainnissa. Asiakkaan tiloissa työskentelyä edellytetään vain siltä osin kuin erikseen sovitut tapaamiset, testaukset, hyväksymismenettelyt tai IMMO-hankkeen immersiivisen huonetilan käyttö sitä edellyttävät. Asiakkaalla ei ole velvollisuutta järjestää Toimittajalle työtiloja. 3. Ratkaisun keskeiset vaatimukset Ratkaisun tulee: - olla pelillinen siten, että pelillisyys on ratkaisun keskeinen suunnitteluperiaate; - mahdollistaa käyttäjän aktiivinen toiminta, päätöksenteko tai ongelmanratkaisu sekä palaute käyttäjän valinnoista; - mahdollistaa oppimiskokemuksen suorittaminen useita kertoja vaihtoehtoisilla tavoilla; - tukea yhteistä oppimista, ryhmätyöskentelyä, opettajajohtoista ohjausta ja useiden käyttäjien samanaikaista osallistumista; - sisältää pedagogisesti perusteltu etenemismalli; - mahdollistaa oppimissisältöjen ylläpito, kehittäminen ja laajentaminen; - täyttää Q/A-liitteessä kuvatut IMMO-tilan tekniset vaatimukset; ja - toimia normaalissa käytössä ilman jatkuvaa tai käytönaikaista internet-yhteyttä. Tavoitteena on noin 20–30 minuutin oppimiskokemus. Tarjoaja voi hyödyntää olemassa olevia teknologioita, pelimoottoreita, XR-alustoja ja 360 asteen sisältöjä, jos kokonaisuus täyttää hankinta-asiakirjoissa asetetut vaatimukset. 4. Toteutus ja aikataulu Toimittajan tulee toteuttaa ratkaisu ketterän ja iteratiivisen kehittämisen periaatteiden mukaisesti. Toimittaja osallistuu marraskuussa 2026 järjestettävään aloituspalaveriin sekä marras- ja joulukuussa järjestettäviin ensimmäisiin yhteiskehittämistyöpajoihin. Ratkaisun eri versioita testataan käyttäjien kanssa IMMO-tilassa tammikuusta 2027 alkaen. Toimittaja osallistuu helmikuussa 2027 toteutettavaan väliarviointiin ja viimeistelee ratkaisun käyttäjäpalautteen perusteella. Lopullinen ratkaisu sisältöineen on toimitettava ja hyväksytettävä viimeistään 28.2.2027. 5. Hinta ja keskeiset sopimusehdot Hankinnan kiinteä kokonaishinta on 35 000 euroa ilman arvonlisäveroa. Hinta sisältää kaikki hankintasopimuksen ja sen liitteiden mukaisten velvoitteiden täyttämisestä aiheutuvat kustannukset. Toimittaja voi laskuttaa hinnan vasta, kun Asiakas on kirjallisesti hyväksynyt lopullisen toimituksen. Toimitukselle annetaan kuuden kuukauden takuu. Toimittajan vastuulla olevasta viivästyksestä voidaan periä sopimuksessa määritelty viivästyssakko. Ratkaisuun sisältyvään tilaajan sovellukseen ja sen dokumentaatioon sovelletaan lähtökohtaisesti EUPL 1.2 -lisenssiä tai muuta etukäteen hyväksyttyä yhteensopivaa avoimen lähdekoodin lisenssiä. Oppimateriaalien oikeudet, käyttö, muokkaaminen, jakaminen ja mahdollinen avoin julkaiseminen ratkaistaan aineistokohtaisesti. Tarjoajan tulee liittää tarjoukseensa alustava Oppimateriaalien oikeus- ja julkaisuluettelo sekä täydentää sitä projektin aikana. Hankkeen tuotosta ei saa julkaista ilman Asiakkaan kirjallista hyväksyntää. Hankintasopimukseen sovelletaan sopimusluonnosta, JIT 2025 Tilaajan sovellukset avoin lähdekoodi -erityisehtoja ja JIT 2025 Yleisiä ehtoja sopimuksessa määrätyssä soveltamisjärjestyksessä. Tarkemmat vähimmäisvaatimukset, tekniset vaatimukset, hyväksymisedellytykset, vastuut ja muut sopimusehdot määräytyvät tarjouspyynnön ja sen liitteiden perusteella.

Furthermore, the requirements listed in Annex 01 "Material Requirements" at quality level 5 apply. The contractor must declare all materials, products, secondary and auxiliary products as well as components intended for use with regard to their ingredients or properties. For this purpose, Annex 02 "Declaration Tables" must be completed in digital form (Excel file format) and the associated technical data sheets and safety data sheets in accordance with 1907/2006/EC (also in digital form) must be assigned and enclosed.

result.text: The subject of the procurement is the acquisition of the necessary licences as well as the introduction, configuration and maintenance of standard software (incl. technical and optional user support) for the determination procedure under SGB IX and the recognition of disability markers, including the issuing of ID cards in accordance with the Severely Disabled Persons' ID Card Ordinance, which is to be used at the State Office for Social Affairs, Youth and Family of Saxony-Anhalt. The contractor's services include initial setup with the hoster, legacy data migration, adaptation of the standard software to the specific requirements of the LAS, planning, organisation and evaluation of tests, commissioning of the production system with the hoster after acceptance, error rectification after acceptance during the start-up phase, as well as software maintenance with a fault hotline, updates and adaptation to current legal regulations and new operating system versions, as well as coordinated further development based on institutionalised management by the user authorities. Detailed information can be found in the attached specifications and the other tender documents.

parts.source: Gegenstand der Beschaffung ist die Beschaffung der erforderlichen Lizenzen sowie die Einführung, Konfiguration und Pflege einer Standardsoftware (inkl. technischem und optional Nutzersupport) für das Feststellungsverfahren nach dem SGB IX sowie Zuerkennung von Merkzeichen einschließlich der Ausstellung der Ausweise nach der Schwerbehindertenausweisverordnung, das im Landesamt für Soziales, Jugend und Gesundheit Sachsen-Anhalt zum Einsatz kommen soll. Die Leistung die Auftragnehmers beinhaltet Ersteinrichtung mit dem Hoster, Altdatenmigration, Anpassung der Standardsoftware an die spezifischen Anforderungen des LAS, Planung, Organisation und Auswertung der Tests, Inbetriebnahme des Produktivsystems mit dem Hoster nach Abnahme, Fehlerbeseitigung nach Abnahme in der Anlaufphase sowie eine Softwarepflege mit Störungshotline, Aktualisierung und Anpassung an jeweils aktuelle gesetzliche Regelungen und neue Betriebssystemversionen sowie abgestimmter Weiterentwicklung auf Basis einer institutionalisierten Steuerung durch die nutzenden Behörden. Ausführliche Informationen sind dem beigefügten Lastenheft sowie den weiteren Vergabeunterlagen zu entnehmen.

result.text: In the Ludwigshöhviertel district of Darmstadt, a new residential area for approximately 3.100 residents, plans are in place for the conversion and refurbishment of the former barracks building 4004 into a family centre, incorporating a youth centre and rooms for community work, as well as the design of new outdoor facilities. The building is part of the new education campus of the City of Science, Darmstadt. In the future, the education campus will consist of four buildings: the family centre in the south, the former barracks building 4001 (future use unknown) in the west, and the new buildings for the Ludwigshöhviertel day nursery and the Ludwigshöhviertel primary school. The listed existing building of the Ludwigshöhviertel family centre will be extensively converted and technically re-equipped as part of a core refurbishment. The subject of this tender is the new installation of building automation / BMS and MSR technology for the control, regulation, monitoring and operation of the building's central technical systems. For this purpose, a central automation hub ASP 01 will be established in room RLT UG_006 in the basement. The automation will be implemented on a manufacturer-neutral basis using BACnet/IP. Provision is made for an automation station with associated input and output modules, control cabinet technology and a local operation and monitoring level. The technical systems will be operated via a 21" panel PC / touch display integrated into the control cabinet door. The automation station will be operated as an independent system, is web-enabled and will be connected to the building network to allow remote access via IP. The following technical systems will essentially be integrated via the BMS/MSR: • the three central AHU systems, including the associated field devices, dampers, fans, heating coils and measuring, control and monitoring functions, • the heat generation and heating system, including heat pump, local heating transfer, heat exchanger, pump groups, control valves, and temperature and pressure recording, • the complete control-technical integration of the local heating transfer station, • the heat pump, including Modbus interface, potential-free signals and required control functions, • the central components of the sanitary technology, in particular lifting stations and hygienic flushing, • the intended energy and consumption meters via M-Bus or corresponding data interfaces. The BMS/MSR is limited to the central technical systems. Room automation or individual room control of the underfloor heating is not part of this tender. The scope of services includes the necessary field devices, including temperature, pressure and differential pressure sensors, frost protection monitors, control valves and other measuring, control and regulation components. The fire protection functions of the AHU systems will also be integrated into the building automation. This includes, in particular, the monitoring and control of fire dampers, the integration of duct smoke detectors and the shutdown of air-handling systems in the event of a fire. The joint fire control matrix test is part of the service. A local manual/emergency operation level is provided in the control cabinet for pumps, fans, dampers and valves, so that the essential system functions can also be operated manually independently of the automation station. In the event of hazard and fault signals, in particular fire alarm, duct smoke detector and high water alarm, an e-mail or SMS notification must be provided. The supply and laying of installation and control cables as well as cable trays will be carried out by the electrical engineering trade. The BMS/MSR contractor will prepare the necessary cable lists, floor plan entries and cable markings for this purpose and will take over the intended connection work as well as coordination with the electrical, heating, sanitary and ventilation trades. The scope of services also includes the complete programming, parameterisation, commissioning, functional testing, adjustment and documentation of the building automation as well as the handover of the required software and project data. Planned execution times (provisional, depending on preceding trades and tenders): Call-off order: Planning coordination 16.11.2026 Start of work on site 07.12.2026 (planned) Completion of BMS/MSR 20.01.2028 (planned - 370 days after start of execution) Execution must begin within 12 working days after receipt of the request by the client (§ 5 paragraph 2 sentence 2 VOB/B). The request is expected to reach you by 02.11.2026; your right to information pursuant to § 5 paragraph 2 sentence 1 VOB/B remains unaffected by this. The service must be completed (ready for acceptance) within 370 working days after the deadline for the start of execution checked above.

parts.source: Im Darmstädter Ludwigshöhviertel, einem neuen Wohngebiet für rund 3.100 Bewohner, sind der Umbau und die Sanierung des ehemaligen Kasernengebäudes 4004 zu einem Familienzentrum mit Integration eines Jugendzentrums und Räumen für die Gemeinwesenarbeit sowie die Gestaltung neuer Freianlagen im Außenbereich geplant. Das Gebäude ist Teil des neuen Bildungscampus der Wissenschaftsstadt Darmstadt. Der Bildungscampus wird in Zukunft aus vier Gebäuden bestehen: Aus dem Familienzentrum im Süden, dem ehemaligen Kasernengebäude 4001 (zukünftige Nutzung unbekannt) im Westen sowie den Neubauten der Kita Ludwigshöhviertel und der Grundschule Ludwigshöhviertel. Das denkmalgeschützte Bestandsgebäude des Familienzentrums Ludwigshöhviertel wird im Rahmen einer Kernsanierung umfassend umgebaut und technisch neu ausgestattet. Gegenstand dieser Ausschreibung ist die Neuerrichtung der Gebäudeautomation / GLT- und MSR-Technik zur Steuerung, Regelung, Überwachung und Bedienung der zentralen technischen Anlagen des Gebäudes. Hierfür wird ein zentraler Automationsschwerpunkt ASP 01 im Raum RLT UG_006 im Kellergeschoss errichtet. Die Automation wird herstellerneutral auf Basis von BACnet/IP ausgeführt. Vorgesehen ist eine Automationsstation mit zugehörigen Ein- und Ausgangsmodulen, Schaltschranktechnik sowie einer lokalen Bedien- und Beobachtungsebene. Die Bedienung der technischen Anlagen erfolgt über einen in die Schaltschranktür integrierten 21"-Panel-PC / Touchdisplay. Die Automationsstation wird als eigenständiges System betrieben, ist webfähig und wird an das Gebäudenetz angebunden, sodass ein Fernzugriff über IP ermöglicht wird. Über die GLT/MSR werden im Wesentlichen folgende technische Anlagen eingebunden: • die drei zentralen RLT-Anlagen einschließlich der zugehörigen Feldgeräte, Klappen, Ventilatoren, Heizregister sowie Mess-, Regel- und Überwachungsfunktionen, • die Wärmeerzeugungs- und Heizungsanlage einschließlich Wärmepumpe, Nahwärmeübergabe, Wärmetauscher, Pumpengruppen, Regelventile, Temperatur- und Druckerfassung, • die vollständige regelungstechnische Einbindung der Nahwärmeübergabestation, • die Wärmepumpe einschließlich Modbus-Schnittstelle, potenzialfreier Signale und erforderlicher Steuerfunktionen, • die zentralen Komponenten der Sanitärtechnik, insbesondere Hebeanlagen und Hygienespülungen, • die vorgesehenen Energie- und Verbrauchszähler über M-Bus bzw. entsprechende Datenschnittstellen. Die GLT/MSR beschränkt sich auf die zentralen technischen Anlagen. Eine Raumautomation bzw. Einzelraumregelung der Fußbodenheizung ist nicht Bestandteil dieser Ausschreibung. Zum Leistungsumfang gehören die erforderlichen Feldgeräte, unter anderem Temperatur-, Druck- und Differenzdruckfühler, Frostschutzwächter, Regelventile und weitere Mess-, Steuer- und Regelkomponenten. Die Brandschutzfunktionen der RLT-Anlagen werden ebenfalls in die Gebäudeautomation eingebunden. Hierzu gehören insbesondere die Überwachung und Ansteuerung der Brandschutzklappen, die Einbindung der Kanalrauchmelder sowie die Abschaltung der luftbewegenden Anlagen im Brandfall. Der gemeinsame Brandfallsteuermatrixtest ist Bestandteil der Leistung. Für Pumpen, Ventilatoren, Klappen und Ventile ist eine lokale Hand-/Notbedienebene im Schaltschrank vorgesehen, sodass die wesentlichen Anlagenfunktionen auch unabhängig von der Automationsstation manuell betrieben werden können. Bei Gefahren- und Störmeldungen, insbesondere Brandalarm, Kanalrauchmelder und Hochalarm Wasser, ist eine E-Mail- bzw. SMS-Benachrichtigung vorzusehen. Die Lieferung und Verlegung der Installations- und Steuerleitungen sowie der Kabeltrassen erfolgt durch das Gewerk Elektrotechnik. Der Auftragnehmer GLT/MSR erstellt hierfür die erforderlichen Kabellisten, Grundrisseinträge und Kabelkennzeichnungen und übernimmt die vorgesehenen Anschlussarbeiten sowie die Koordination mit den Gewerken Elektro, Heizung, Sanitär und Lüftung. Zum Leistungsumfang gehören weiterhin die vollständige Programmierung, Parametrierung, Inbetriebnahme, Funktionsprüfung, Einregulierung und Dokumentation der Gebäudeautomation sowie die Übergabe der erforderlichen Software und Projektdaten. Geplante Ausführungszeiten (vorläufig, abhängig von Vorgewerken und Ausschreibungen): Abrufauftrag: Abstimmung der Planung 16.11.2026 Leistungsbeginn Baustelle 07.12.2026 (geplant) Fertigstellung GLT/MSR 20.01.2028 (geplant - 370 Tage nach Ausführungsbeginn) Mit der Ausführung ist zu beginnen innerhalb von 12 Werktagen nach Zugang der Aufforderung durch den Auftraggeber (§ 5 Absatz 2 Satz 2 VOB/B). Die Aufforderung wird Ihnen voraussichtlich bis zum 02.11.2026 zugehen; Ihr Auskunftsrecht gemäß § 5 Absatz 2 Satz 1 VOB/B bleibt hiervon unberührt. Die Leistung ist zu vollenden (abnahmereif fertig zu stellen) innerhalb von 370 Werktagen nach vorstehend angekreuzter Frist für den Ausführungsbeginn.

result.text: This notice is not an official launch of our procurement(s), it is to alert the market to future opportunities and allow us to begin conversations that will shape plans for multiple future requirements. The Cabinet Office (Government Skills Group) is transforming the way learning and development (L&D) is designed, procured, and delivered across the Civil Service. Following the announcement by the Chief Secretary to the Prime Minister, the government is establishing the new National School of Government and Public Services (hereon The National School). The National School is tasked with delivering high-quality, targeted training to approximately 558,000 civil servants, developing executive leadership in the wider public sector, and to partner with public sector training bodies. The strategic goal of the National School is to shift away from the historically outsourced prime-supplier managed-service model. In its place, the Cabinet Office is building an insourced, hybrid capability. Under this new Future Operating Model (FOM), the Cabinet Office will directly manage core operations, standard curricula, and stakeholder engagement. However, expert external provision will remain a critical element of the programme. The National School transformation programme relies on three core, interdependent pillars to transition Civil Service training away from fully outsourced prime-supplier models toward an in-house, hybrid operating model by April 2028. Together, these pillars work to build direct relationships with suppliers, provide a modern digital learning infrastructure, and establish robust in-house operational workflows. Pillar 1: Future Supplier Partnerships (FSP) The FSP project serves as the commercial enabler of the new operating model, building the in-house capability required to buy learning services and manage supply chains directly. We aim to establish direct, value-driven contractual relationships with UK-based SMEs, universities, business schools, and niche providers. The project team have identified an indicative Three-Stage Roadmap to enable this delivery: Stage 1 (Immediate - April 2027): Procuring urgent digital and specialist training needs that cannot be fulfilled through existing frameworks. Stage 2 (April 2027-March 2028): Phased procurement for core, National School-sponsored curriculum, coaching, and talent programmes. Stage 3 (March 2028 onwards): On-going phased procurements falling out of Stages 1 and 2, depending on the length of contracts identified. The scope of the requirements will cover several key procurement categories, including, but not limited to, specialised coaching pools (including for neuro-diverse leaders), blended training delivery, learning design (retaining Crown Intellectual Property), access to subject matter experts including within academia, independent research and evaluation, helpdesk/admin surge, and off-the-shelf qualifications. Pillar 2: Future Technologies (FT) The Future Technologies project focuses on designing and implementing the digital architecture required to run a personalised training operation for approximately 558,000 civil servants. The core objective here is the setting up and integration of platforms to manage the access, booking, payments, and evaluation of learning materials. This involves transitioning away from heavy manual processes to maximise technological efficiencies. At this stage the project team has identified the central deliverable as a unified online portal allowing learners to access the full National School offering. Key technologies in scope for procurement include, but are not limited to, a new Learning Management System (LMS)/ Learning Experience Platform (LXP), Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems to centralise stakeholder engagement, and design/delivery tools. Pillar 3: Future Learning Operations (FLO) The Learning Operations project is responsible for building the actual systems, processes, and internal capabilities required to run the day-to-day training operations in-house. Their core objective is establishing an integrated operational function by April 2028 that supports over 558,000 civil servants in completing their learning journeys. It is highly dependent on the digital and commercial pillars to develop the underlying platforms that support operations. Market Involvement As part of the initial phases of the programme, the project teams are keen to connect with the market and gain insight into current trends, operations and barriers. With this in mind, Cabinet Office and the project team have planned the following Sector Connector events.

Pillar 1: Future Supplier Partnerships (FSP) The FSP project serves as the commercial enabler of the new operating model, building the in-house capability required to buy learning services and manage supply chains directly. We aim to establish direct, value-driven contractual relationships with UK-based SMEs, universities, business schools, and niche providers. The project team have identified an indicative Three-Stage Roadmap to enable this delivery: Stage 1 (Immediate - April 2027): Procuring urgent digital and specialist training needs that cannot be fulfilled through existing frameworks. Stage 2 (April 2027-March 2028): Phased procurement for core, National School-sponsored curriculum, coaching, and talent programmes. Stage 3 (March 2028 onwards): On-going phased procurements falling out of Stages 1 and 2, depending on the length of contracts identified. The scope of the requirements will cover several key procurement categories, including, but not limited to, specialised coaching pools (including for neuro-diverse leaders), blended training delivery, learning design (retaining Crown Intellectual Property), access to subject matter experts including within academia, independent research and evaluation, helpdesk/admin surge, and off-the-shelf qualifications. Pillar 2: Future Technologies (FT) The Future Technologies project focuses on designing and implementing the digital architecture required to run a personalised training operation for approximately 558,000 civil servants. The core objective here is the setting up and integration of platforms to manage the access, booking, payments, and evaluation of learning materials. This involves transitioning away from heavy manual processes to maximise technological efficiencies. At this stage the project team has identified the central deliverable as a unified online portal allowing learners to access the full National School offering. Key technologies in scope for procurement include, but are not limited to, a new Learning Management System (LMS)/ Learning Experience Platform (LXP), Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems to centralise stakeholder engagement, and design/delivery tools. Pillar 3: Future Learning Operations (FLO) The Learning Operations project is responsible for building the actual systems, processes, and internal capabilities required to run the day-to-day training operations in-house. Their core objective is establishing an integrated operational function by April 2028 that supports over 558,000 civil servants in completing their learning journeys. It is highly dependent on the digital and commercial pillars to develop the underlying platforms that support operations. rejected.text: Hintergrund und Problemstellung: Die DEHSt betreibt seit ca. 20 Jahren Ende-zu-Ende digitalisierte Fachverfahren. Zentrale Komponenten der eingesetzten IT-Landschaft der DEHSt befinden sich in einer Phase der Erneuerung. Die Anzahl der von der DEHSt zu entwickelnden Softwareartefakte wächst kontinuierlich an – Zeitpläne werden dadurch stetig enger und die Parallelisierung und Komplexität nimmt zu. Mehrere Altsysteme müssen zudem vollständig abgelöst werden. Um Abhilfe zu schaffen, hat die DEHSt ein Software-Development-Kit (SDK) entwickelt, das aus Software und einer umfangreichen Dokumentation etwa für die Inbetriebnahme einer Test- und Integrationsumgebung besteht. Ziel des SDK ist dabei einerseits eine technologische Erneuerung durchzuführen, andererseits die Entwicklungsgeschwindigkeit deutlich zu erhöhen bei gleichzeitiger Wahrung von Standards. Das SDK stellt dabei Dokumentation, Software-Bibliotheken, mehrere eigenständige Dienste für die zentralisierte Steuerung (Workflowsteuerung) der Fachanwendungen sowie eine Basis- und eine Beispielanwendung bereit, die sich in die bestehende Software- und Prozesslandschaft der DEHSt integriert (also etwa bestehende Zentrale Dienste anspricht, die sog. „DEHSt-Plattform“). Das SDK und die DEHSt-Plattform setzen auf eine Trennung von Frontend (AngularJS, NgRx, Material), Backend (Spring-Boot), verteilten Webservices und einer Build-Strecke in GitLab sowie einem skalierbaren Betrieb auf Containern-Basis (Docker Images auf RedHat OKD). . Ziel und Gegenstand des Projektes: Mit dieser Beschaffungsmaßnahme wird eine Rahmenvereinbarung ausgeschrieben, die eine Laufzeit von 4 Jahren umfasst. Die Rahmenvereinbarung kann zweimal um je ein Jahr verlängert werden. Das Projekt soll die Entwicklung und Pflege des gesamten Software Development Kits (SDK) sowie die Entwicklung von darauf aufbauenden Fachanwendungen umfassen. Dabei unterscheiden wir zwischen drei verwandten aber parallelen Aufgabenbereichen: 1) Los 1: SDK-Wartung und -Management 2) Los 2: Neuentwicklung von Fachanwendungen 3) Los 3: Migration und Ablösung von Altsystemen Für das SDK-Team gilt das Ziel, den Nutzen für die Sachbearbeitung zu Erhöhen aber genauso, die Entwicklungsdauer der Entwicklerteams positiv zu beeinflussen. Für die Entwicklerteams muss es ein Ziel sein, basierend auf einer ausgearbeiteten Spezifikation, eine qualitativ hochwertige Anwendung in möglichst geringer Zeit zu entwickeln. Los 1: SDK-Wartung und -Management . Nach dem aktuellen Planungsstand beabsichtigt der Auftraggeber in den ersten vier Jah-ren Aufgaben mit bis zu 2.560 Personentage (PT) zu beauftragen. Vorbehaltlich von möglichen Änderungen der Gesetzeslage rund um den europäischen und den nationalen Emis-sionshandel erwartet der Auftraggeber, dass mindestens 50% der hier genannten Obergrenze für Personentage beauftragt werden wird. Sollte der Vertrag um jeweils ein Jahr verlängert werden, erwartet der Auftraggeber Aufga-ben in der Höhe von 640 PT je Verlängerung (bis zu 25% des ursprünglichen Umfangs). Zum Zwecke einer ungefähren Kapazitätsplanung sehen wir in etwa einen Bedarf von 960 PT im ersten Jahr und durchschnittlich 500 PT je Folgejahr. Es wird davon ausgegangen, dass die Arbeitslast relativ gleichmäßig über die Monate verteilt werden kann, sodass eine konstante Auslastung eines Entwicklungsteams erreicht werden kann.; Los 2: Neuentwicklung von Fachanwendungen . Nach dem aktuellen Planungsstand beabsichtigt der Auftraggeber in den ersten vier Jahren Aufgaben mit bis zu 3.056 Personentage (PT) zu beauftragen. Vorbehaltlich von möglichen Änderungen der Gesetzeslage rund um den europäischen und den nationalen Emissionshandel erwartet der Auftraggeber, dass mindestens 50% der hier genannten Obergrenze für Personentage beauftragt werden wird. Zum Zwecke einer ungefähren Kapazitätsplanung sehen wir in der Regel einen Bedarf von 500 PT pro Jahr, aber jeweils in 2028 und 2029 einen erhöhten Bedarf von etwa 1.000 PT. result.text: Background and problem: The DEHSt has been operating end-to-end digitised specialist procedures for approx. 20 years. Central components of the IT landscape used by the DEHSt are in a phase of renewal. The number of software artefacts to be developed by the DEHSt is growing continuously – schedules are therefore becoming increasingly tight and parallelisation and complexity are increasing. Several legacy systems must also be completely replaced. To remedy this, the DEHSt has developed a Software Development Kit (SDK), which consists of software and extensive documentation, for example for commissioning a test and integration environment. The aim of the SDK is, on the one hand, to carry out a technological renewal and, on the other, to significantly increase development speed while maintaining standards. The SDK provides documentation, software libraries, several independent services for the centralised control (workflow control) of the specialist applications, as well as a base and an example application that integrates into the existing software and process landscape of the DEHSt (i.e. addresses existing central services, the so-called 'DEHSt platform'). The SDK and the DEHSt platform are based on a separation of frontend (AngularJS, NgRx, Material), backend (Spring-Boot), distributed web services and a build pipeline in GitLab as well as scalable operation on a container basis (Docker images on RedHat OKD). . Aim and subject of the project: This procurement measure is for a framework agreement with a term of 4 years. The framework agreement can be extended twice by one year each. The project is to include the development and maintenance of the entire Software Development Kit (SDK) as well as the development of specialist applications based on it. We distinguish between three related but parallel task areas: 1) Lot 1: SDK maintenance and management 2) Lot 2: New development of specialist applications 3) Lot 3: Migration and replacement of legacy systems For the SDK team, the goal is to increase the benefit for the administrative staff but also to positively influence the development time of the developer teams. For the developer teams, it must be a goal to develop a high-quality application in the shortest possible time based on an elaborated specification. Lot 1: SDK maintenance and management . According to the current planning status, the contracting authority intends to commission tasks with up to 2.560 person-days (PD) in the first four years. Subject to possible changes in the legal situation regarding European and national emissions trading, the contracting authority expects that at least 50% of the upper limit for person-days mentioned here will be commissioned. Should the contract be extended by one year each, the contracting authority expects tasks amounting to 640 PD per extension (up to 25% of the original scope). For the purpose of approximate capacity planning, we see a demand of approximately 960 PD in the first year and an average of 500 PD per subsequent year. Should the contract be extended by one year each, the contracting authority expects tasks amounting to 764 PD per extension (up to 25% of the original scope). result.text: LapIT Oy is an IT company owned by the municipalities, joint municipal authorities, and municipal limited companies of Lapland and Koillismaa, which provides comprehensive information management and IT services. Our company's head office is located in Rovaniemi. LapIT is considering putting the financial management system out to tender and offering it to its owner-customers. Currently, there are 10 municipal customers interested in the procurement. According to preliminary plans, the procurement would cover the following processes: - from financial planning to forecasting - from procurement to payment - from sales to debt collection - from bookkeeping to financial statements - authority reporting (municipal reporting) Based on preliminary information, the procurement would cover the financial management solution as a comprehensive service, including implementation and user training, migrations from old systems, and integrations. LapIT requests willing potential tenderers to participate in a dialogue. In principle, we will accept into the market dialogue those tenderers who meet at least the following criteria: - The supplier must have at least 2 references for the solution for municipal customers. The systems reported as references must have been in production use for at least 2 years. - The solution must comply with high data security and the data must be located in the EU/EEA area. - The tenderer must offer implementation support and continuous service support in the Finnish language. The tenderer must attach to their registration: - A description of their service in Finnish. - Presentations of at least two reference deliveries as stated above. - The description should show the lifecycle status and development roadmap of the system. Willing participants can register for the dialogue by notifying us by email at jasmine.suopanki@lapit.fi by 5.11.2025. The intention is to start the market dialogues as soon as possible. LapIT will select the suppliers it chooses for the market dialogue based on the descriptions. LapIT reserves the right to limit the number of those who have participated in the market dialogue. The implementation method of the market dialogue will be decided later (written/meetings). Participation in the market dialogue does not in any way affect the tenderer's position in a possible future tendering process. The market dialogue will be carried out in the Finnish language. Everything presented in the market dialogue and the discussions held during it are preliminary and do not bind LapIT Oy or the tenderer. No compensation will be paid to those who have participated in the market dialogue for their participation. This is not a procurement notice or a call for tenders but a request for information/invitation to a market dialogue. This preliminary information notice does not bind the client to the procurement; the actual procurement notice will possibly be published later. The decision on launching a possible procurement process will be made later.

result.text: The North East Mayoral Strategic Authority (North East MSA) seeks to commission an external consultant to undertake an independent programme level evaluation of the Child Poverty Action Plan 2025-2030. The evaluation will assess the design, implementation, and impact of a complex, multi-strand programme delivered between August 2025 and March 2030. This will include directly funded activities, wider activities mobilised through the programme and selected aligned activities where appropriate and supported by the available evidence. The commissioned evaluation is intended as a cross-cutting programme-level evaluation of the Child Poverty Action Plan as a whole. It is recognised that individual projects, interventions and delivery activity within the wider programme will be subject to separate monitoring, evaluation and research activity commissioned by the North East MSA or undertaken by delivery partners. The evaluation will synthesise evidence generated through proportionate project level evaluations (including light touch monitoring and in depth project deep dives) to provide a coherent, programme wide assessment and will not be responsible for conducting primary project-level evaluations, except where explicitly agreed. This will support strategic assurance, learning and decision making, and inform future iterations of the Action Plan and wider North East MSA and regional policy and investment decisions. The programme-level evaluation will therefore consider both the evidence relating to individual interventions and the combined contribution of the wider programme towards the intended outcomes of the Child Poverty Action Plan. The programme‐level evaluation will also seek to determine the degree to which reducing child poverty has been embedded as a cross-cutting theme across North East MSA activity, and that of partners. This will include examining how the Child Poverty Reduction Unit and the regional Child Poverty Action Plan have influenced strategic priorities, programme and project design, funding and delivery decisions, and whether they have contributed to changes in policies, practices and activities beyond those directly funded through the programme. Lot 1: .

result.text: We operate a network of around 300 automatic weather stations (AWS), mostly in the UK, but also a small number overseas. The weather observation data collected at these sites is collated on a logger at site and then communicated every minute to our central cloud based system in real time. Some sites have mains power, some operate on a 50W solar panel. The majority of sites have 4G connectivity, but there are a subset that only have 2G connectivity at present. We are looking for a supplier to provide a communications solution to allow for the real time transfer of our land surface observation data to our central cloud based collection system every minute in real time. result.text: The purpose of the procurement is to ensure access to external expertise in the form of IT consultancy services. Kriminalvården conducts extensive IT operations regarding development, operation and support. At the same time, Kriminalvården is in a digital transformation journey that places high demands on quality improvements, efficiencies and new ways of working, while a high level of security permeates everything the authority undertakes. Increased digitalisation, improved digital maturity and the use of new technology are prerequisites for sustainable efficiency and relief for the organisation so that the core business staff can focus on client-facing work. Kriminalvården shall also work for a digitalisation that increases the conditions for optimising existing expertise, improving the work environment and contributing to increased attractiveness and relevance as an employer. A contributing part in taking advantage of opportunities and successfully meeting challenges during this transformation journey is to strengthen the organisation through external expertise in the form of IT consultancy services. The need for external expertise ranges from deep specialist expertise in strategic areas to more general expertise such as IT technicians and developers (see Appendix "Competence areas and example roles"). To ensure that winning suppliers have sufficient breadth in their IT consultancy services, the need has, for evaluation purposes, been grouped into the following competence areas: Application, Infrastructure and IT Management & Architecture. Winning suppliers are expected to be able to deliver the requested expertise within all competence areas.

parts.source: Syftet med upphandlingen är att säkerställa tillgång till extern kompetens i form av IT-konsulttjänster. Kriminalvården bedriver en omfattande IT-verksamhet avseende utveckling, drift och support. Samtidigt befinner sig Kriminalvården i en digital förändringsresa som ställer höga krav på kvalitetshöjningar, effektiviseringar och nya sätt att arbeta samtidigt som ett högt säkerhetstänkande genomsyrar allt myndigheten tar sig an. En ökad digitalisering, förbättrad digital mognad samt användning av ny teknik är en av förutsättningarna för en hållbar effektivisering och avlastning av verksamheten så att kärnverksamhetens medarbetare kan fokusera på det klientnära arbetet. Kriminalvården ska också verka för en digitalisering som ökar förutsättningarna att optimera befintlig kompetens, förbättra arbetsmiljön samt bidra till en ökad attraktivitet och relevans som arbetsgivare. En bidragande del för i att tillvarata möjligheter och framgångsrikt möta utmaningar under denna förändringsresa är att stärka organisationen genom extern kompetens i form av IT-konsulttjänster. Behovet av extern kompetens sträcker sig från djup spetskompetens inom strategiska områden till mer generell kompetens som exempelvis IT-tekniker och utvecklare (se Bilaga ”Kompetensområden och exempelroller”). För att säkerställa att vinnande leverantörer har tillräcklig bredd på sina IT konsulttjänster har behovet, i utvärderingssyfte, grupperats i följande kompetensområden: Applikation, Infrastruktur och IT-ledning & Arkitektur. Vinnande leverantörer förväntas kunna leverera efterfrågad kompetens inom samtliga kompetensområden.

result.text: The Finnish Medicines Agency Fimea (later Fimea) is preparing the procurement of a system for receiving, validation and reviewing marketing authorisation applications for medicinal products and other regulatory submissions. Fimea is primarily looking for a software as a service (SaaS) off-the shelf solution that is provided from a public cloud. The system shall enable the necessary integrations with Fimea's other systems, which will be defined later. The procurement will also include the deployment, support and maintenance services for the system to be procured. Life cycles of the medicinal product dossiers (sequences and attributes) must be migrated to the system. Migration will be part of the procurement. The purpose of this request for information is to identify potential tenderers and to gather information on the solutions available on the market. Following the market dialogue, a call for tenders for the procurement will be prepared. DESCRIPTION The system to be procured shall support the receipt and validation of regulatory submissions, as well as the view and review of application materials. The system shall ensure a smooth and consistent user experience for the marketing authorisation specialists and to minimise manual steps through automated workflow functionalities. Preliminary requirements for the procurement are: - Data import functionalities: The solution shall support automated and manual import of regulatory submissions related to medicinal products. • Different types of submissions: o eCTD (electronic Common Technical Document, all formats), (v)NeeS (Non-eCTD electronic Submission), non-standard based submissions, ASMF (active substance master file), PSUR (Periodic Safety Update Report) • The sources of data: o Common European Submission Portal (CESP) o Other possible sources, e.g. EMA Common Repository (CR), Union Product Database (UPD), PSUR repository o Manual import of material (e.g. from email) to the system also enabled - The system sends a notification about a new submission and forms a job queue - Technical validation of regulatory submissions, including all versions of eCTD - Flexible dossier and sequence management for agency administrators - API capabilities: The system shall include flexible API capabilities to enable integrations with other relevant systems and repositories, such as case management systems and archiving solutions - User management: The system shall include advanced user management features, enabling the administration of access rights and roles for different user groups - View and review of the dossier in the system • Different view modes (single sequence vs. cumulative view of the application) • Advanced search functionalities • Possibility to use AI-assisted review: The system shall include or support the integration of AI#assisted tools - The location of the data needs to be in the EU region, and the cloud service provided by the service supplier

result.text: The subject matter of this call for competition comprises the procurement of a SaaS solution, which encompasses various functions and services. The focus is on the provision of an extensive digital communication solution based on OX 8. The MBJS is seeking an experienced contractor that is in a position to provide a corresponding solution based on OX 8 while meeting the specific requirements and needs of a state-wide solution for the Land of Brandenburg regarding high security standards (BSI IT-Grundschutz), data protection compliance (GDPR), integrity, flexibility and scalability. In the year 2019, on behalf of the Ministry of Education, Youth and Sport (hereinafter referred to as MBJS), a complex IT infrastructure was established based on the products Univention UCS and Univention UCS@School, consisting of a central identity management system, hereinafter referred to as IDM, and the groupware and email solution Open Xchange from the manufacturer of the same name, hereinafter referred to as OX. An extensive communication solution was created for 20.000 teaching staff at publicly maintained schools in the Land of Brandenburg. The schools mapped in UCS and UCS@School in the form of separate school OUs form the basis for the contexts set up in OX. Each school is thus assigned to a separate context in OX. The creation, modification and deletion of accounts in the IDM are carried out via the specialised procedures developed by the MBJS. After several years of operation, due to the lifecycle of OX, it is necessary to migrate to the current version 8. With the transition to OX 8, extensive changes to the UCS OX connector and the IT infrastructure are required. Version OX 8 requires Docker runtime environments, which are not provided by the existing IT infrastructure. It is not possible to simply update the software in the existing system. The MBJS therefore intends to have the groupware and email solution for teaching staff based on OX operated as a SaaS solution by a provider in future. In this context, user accounts in the existing IDM are to continue to form the basis for the email mailboxes and the existing provisioning processes are to be retained. Only the mail stack of the existing IT infrastructure is to be replaced by a SaaS solution.

parts.source: Der Gegenstand dieser Ausschreibung umfasst die Beschaffung einer SaaS-Lösung, welche verschiedene Funktionen und Leistungen umfasst. Dabei liegt der Schwerpunkt auf der Bereitstellung einer umfangreichen digitalen Kommunikationslösung auf Basis von OX 8. Das MBJS sucht nach einem erfahrenen Auftragnehmer, der in der Lage ist, eine entsprechende Lösung auf Basis von OX 8 bereitzustellen und dabei die spezifischen Anforderungen und Bedürfnisse einer Landeslösung für das Land Brandenburg in punkto hohe Sicherheitsstandards (BSI Grundschutz), Datenschutzkonformität (DSGVO), Integrität, Flexibilität und Skalierbarkeit zu erfüllen. Im Jahr 2019 wurde im Auftrag des Ministeriums für Bildung, Jugend und Sport (im Folgenden MBJS genannt) auf Basis der Produkte Univention UCS und Univention UCS@School eine komplexe IT-Infrastruktur aufgebaut, bestehend aus einem zentralen Identitätsmanagement-System, im Folgenden als IDM bezeichnet, und der Groupware- und E-Mail-Lösung Open Xchange vom gleichnamigen Hersteller, im Folgenden als OX bezeichnet. Es wurde eine umfangreiche Kommunikationslösung für 20.000 Lehrkräfte an Schulen in öffentlicher Trägerschaft im Land Brandenburg geschaffen. Die in UCS und UCS@School abgebildeten Schulen in Form von separaten Schul-OUs bilden die Grundlage für die in OX eingerichteten Contexte. Jede Schule ist somit einem separatem Context in OX zugewiesen. Das Anlegen, Ändern und Löschen von Accounts im IDM, erfolgt über die vom MBJS entwickelten Fachverfahren. Nach mehreren Jahren des Betriebs, ist es aufgrund des Lifecycles von OX erforderlich, dass auf die aktuelle Version 8 gewechselt werden muss. Mit dem Wechsel auf OX 8 bedarf es einer umfangreichen Änderungen am UCS OX Connector und an der IT-Infrastruktur. Die Version OX 8 setzt Docker-Laufzeitumgebungen voraus, die mit der bestehenden IT-Infrastruktur nicht gegeben sind. Es ist nicht möglich die Software im bestehenden System einfach zu aktualisieren. Das MBJS beabsichtigt deshalb die Groupware- und E-Mail-Lösung für Lehrkräfte auf Basis von OX zukünftig als SaaS-Lösung durch einen Anbieter betreiben zulassen. Dabei sollen die Nutzerkonten im vorhandenen IDM weiterhin die Grundlage für die E-Mail-Postfächer bilden und die bestehenden Prozesse zur Provisionierung beibehalten werden. Es soll lediglich der Mail-Stack der vorhandenen IT-Infrastruktur durch eine SaaS-Lösung ersetzt werden.

For the tendering of the VSw, the contractor is required to provide the following services: • Provision of the software/licences (applicants per year: 45.000, number of rental properties: 64.000, number of BImA users: 160 and number of new rentals per year: 4.500) in digital form (the number of licences must be adaptable over the term of the contract). • Provision of a test environment with 30 licences, inter alia for carrying out testing in accordance with chapter 2.1.3 and regression testing. The test environment must have the same interface connections as the productive system. • Provision of documentation. • Configuration of the software in accordance with the contracting authority's requirements and ensuring it is ready for operation. • Provision of a training environment and delivery of training to a total of approx. 60 employees from an anticipated 7 groups, including the provision of a training environment and training materials in an editable format. • Maintenance, support and further development of the software over the contract period. • Provision of services for, inter alia, operational support, consultancy services, and training during the term of the contract.

result.text: The market consultation for the above-mentioned title serves to test the market in preparation for a planned procurement project. It is to be examined whether the contracting authority's requirements can be fulfilled by multiple companies. Companies that consider themselves capable of fully fulfilling the requirements listed in section 3.1 of this notice must notify the contracting authority's IT purchasing department of this by e-mail no later than [10.04.2026] at: fu-zen-einkauf-it@autobahn.de With the aforementioned notification to the IT purchasing department, the company must state the name, registered office, and legal form of the company and submit a brief company description. Furthermore, the company must provide a contact person and an e-mail address for further contact. Following notification in due form and time, the respective company will promptly receive a questionnaire sent by e-mail to the specified contact point from the contracting authority's IT purchasing department, which the company must complete fully and truthfully and return to the contracting authority's IT purchasing department within 14 days. Responses submitted late may be disregarded. The contracting authority will examine the company's responses received in due time and, if necessary, invite them to market consultation discussions, which can take place online as a video conference or in person as an on-site appointment at the contracting authority's registered office. The contracting authority reserves the right, at its dutiful discretion and in compliance with the principles of transparency and equal treatment, to ask follow-up questions and to request clarifications and subsequent submissions. Upon completion of the market consultation, the results will be definitively evaluated by the contracting authority and taken into account within the scope of the intended award procedure. If it turns out after completion of the market consultation that the contracting authority's requirements can indeed only be fulfilled by a single company, a negotiated procedure without a call for competition pursuant to § 14 para. 4 no. 2 of the Public Procurement Ordinance (VgV) will be conducted with the affected company, otherwise a competitive award procedure.

parts.source: Die Markterkundung zum oben genannten Titel dient der Überprüfung des Marktes zur Vorbereitung eines geplanten Beschaffungsvorhabens. Geprüft werden soll, ob die Anforderungen der Auftraggeberin von mehreren Unternehmen erfüllt werden können. Unternehmen, welche sich in der Lage sehen, die im Abschnitt 3.1 der hiesigen Bekanntmachung angeführten Anforderungen vollständig zu erfüllen, haben dies bis spätestens [10.04.2026] per E-Mail dem IT-Einkauf der Auftraggeberin mitzuteilen: fu-zen-einkauf-it@autobahn.de Mit der vorgenannten Mitteilung an den IT-Einkauf hat das Unternehmen den Namen, Sitz und Rechtsform der Gesellschaft anzugeben sowie eine kurze Unternehmensbeschreibung einzureichen. Ferner hat das Unternehmen einen Ansprechpartner und eine E-Mail-Adresse für den weiteren Kontakt anzugeben. Nach form- und fristgemäß erfolgter Mitteilung erhält das entsprechende Unternehmen vom IT-Einkauf der Auftraggeberin umgehend an die angegebene Kontaktstelle per E-Mail einen Fragenkatalog übersandt, den das Unternehmen vollständig und wahrheitsgemäß ausgefüllt innerhalb von 14 Tagen an den IT-Einkauf der Auftraggeberin zurückzusenden hat. Verspätet übermittelte Antworten können unberücksichtigt bleiben. Die Auftraggeberin wird die fristgemäß eingegangenen Antworten des Unternehmens prüfen und bei Bedarf zu Markterkundungsgesprächen einladen, die online als Videokonferenz oder als Präsenztermin persönlich am Sitz der Auftraggeberin erfolgen können. Die Auftraggeberin behält sich nach pflichtgemäßem Ermessen sowie unter Einhaltung der Grundsätze von Transparenz und Gleichbehandlung vor, Rückfragen zu stellen, Aufklärungen und Nachforderungen vorzunehmen. Nach Abschluss der Markterkundung werden die Ergebnisse von der Auftraggeberin abschließend evaluiert und im Rahmen des beabsichtigten Vergabeverfahrens berücksichtigt. Stellt sich nach Abschluss der Markterkundung heraus, dass die Anforderungen der Auftraggeberin tatsächlich nur von einem Unternehmen erfüllt werden können, wird ein Verhandlungsverfahren ohne Teilnahmewettbewerb gemäß § 14 Abs. 4 Nr. 2 VgV mit dem betroffenen Unternehmen durchgeführt, andernfalls eine wettbewerbliche Vergabe.

result.text: The tender covers a contract for the supply and operation of a ticketing system. Musikhuset Aarhus wishes to acquire a system that can manage ticket sales for all performances in Musikhuset. Musikhuset wishes to acquire a standard solution, but also desires that the system constitutes a configurable standard/framework system that can support Musikhuset's requirements and needs. Overall, the system must support Musikhuset's continued digitalisation, streamlining, and optimisation of ticket sales. Musikhuset wishes to enter into an agreement with a tenderer who wishes to enter into a partnership with Musikhuset for the best possible utilisation of the system. This is primarily to take place through an implementation process where the system is configured with Musikhuset's business needs and work processes in mind. In addition, the tenderer must help deliver an improved perceived quality for users during the contract period.

parts.source: Udbuddet omfatter kontrakt på levering og drift af billetsystem. Musikhuset Aarhus ønsker at anskaffe et system, som kan varetage billetsalget til alle forestillinger i Musikhuset. Musikhuset ønsker at anskaffe en standardløsning, men har også et ønske om, at systemet udgør et konfigurerbart standard-/rammesystem, som kan understøtte Musikhusets krav og behov. Systemet skal overordnet set understøtte Musikhuset fortsatte digitalisering, effektivisering og optimering af billetsalg. Musikhuset ønsker at indgå aftale med en tilbudsgiver, der ønsker at indgå i et samarbejde med Musikhuset om bedst mulig udnyttelse af systemet. Det skal først og fremmest ske gennem et implementeringsforløb, hvor systemet konfigureres i et samspil med Musikhusets forretningsbehov og arbejdsprocesser for øje. Herudover skal tilbudsgiveren medvirke til at levere en bedre oplevet kvalitet hos brugerne i aftaleperioden.

result.text: The aim of the procurement is to get a system for digital home nursing and home visits. Digital home nursing/visits is an offer for residents who need home nursing/visits, but do not necessarily need anyone to show up physically in their homes. Health professionals and others will, via monitors/video, provide some of the same services as in traditional home nursing/visits, whether it's medical follow-up, giving a sense of safety in their home or other health guidance. Using this service, health personnel and others can detect early signs of deterioration, give advice and support, and contribute to ensuring the citizens' health and safety. The estimated value of the service agreement including hardware is approx. NOK 5 million excluding VAT per annum, which is approx. NOK 20 million excluding VAT for the contract period.

result.text: The purpose of the NOFO is to facilitate long-term improvements and innovation to the national integrated food safety system by unifying and coordinating federal/state/local human and animal food (HAF) emergency response efforts including: 1) Strengthening the link among epidemiology, lab, and environmental health/regulatory components; 2) Improving States' regulatory and surveillance HAF protection programs to include using Incident Command System (ICS)/National Incident Management System (NIMS) principles and a Unified Command structure to conduct integrated responses to all-hazards HAF emergencies, rapidly identifying and removing tainted food from commerce, and conducting root cause investigations to inform future prevention efforts; and 3) Addressing supporting components, such as training, data sharing, data analysis, communications, continuous process improvement, and development of best practices and other resources to support national capacity/capability development..

result.text: The Brandenburg IT Service Provider (ZIT-BB) is the central service provider for the direct state administration of Brandenburg for the provision of IT services. Its extensive portfolio of tasks includes, inter alia, the planning, provision and operation of the technical infrastructure as well as the coordination and support of both authority-specific and cross-authority as well as joint IT procedures. Its area of responsibility also includes IT security management for the IT infrastructure of the state administration and responsibility for the Computer Emergency Response Team (CERT). From its central location in Potsdam, ZIT-BB currently supports approx. 18.000 workstations in the Brandenburg state administration. The number of workstations to be supported will continue to rise in the coming years. With the centralisation of the state administration's IT, supporting the authorities and institutions of the State of Brandenburg in the planning, design and deployment of information technology as well as consulting on IT security issues has become an essential field of activity for the operations. Furthermore, ZIT-BB provides services pursuant to the Brandenburg E-Government Act, in particular for municipalities, administrative associations and municipal associations of the state. The main location of ZIT-BB is located at Steinstraße 104-106 in 14480 Potsdam. Due to its statewide remit, ZIT-BB has, inter alia, branch offices in Cottbus, Frankfurt (Oder), Wünsdorf, Gransee and Eberswalde. It operates its data centre in Berlin. By means of this procurement, an External Information Security Officer (ISB) is to be commissioned for the Brandenburg IT Service Provider. The described services are to be rendered immediately after contract award and shall end at the latest upon reaching the upper limits specified under section 4.1 in the EVB-IT service contract. The contracting authority assumes a scope of 700 person-days. Further details regarding the subject matter of the contract are governed in the specification of services part B.

parts.source: Der Brandenburgische IT-Dienstleister (ZIT-BB) ist der zentrale Dienstleister für die unmittelbare Landesverwaltung Brandenburg zur Bereitstellung von IT-Dienstleistungen. Zu seinem umfangreichen Aufgabenportfolio gehören u.a. die Planung, die Bereitstellung und der Betrieb der technischen Infrastruktur sowie die Koordination und die Betreuung sowohl von behördenspezifischen als auch behördenübergreifenden und gemeinsamen IT-Verfahren. In seinen Aufgabenbereich fallen auch das IT-Sicherheitsmanagement für die IT-Infrastruktur der Landesverwaltung und die Zuständigkeit für das Computer-Emergency-Response-Team (CERT). Der ZIT-BB betreut von seinem zentralen Standort Potsdam aus derzeit ca. 18.000 Arbeitsplätze in der Landesverwaltung Brandenburg. Die Anzahl der zu betreuenden Arbeitsplätze wird in den kommenden Jahren weiter ansteigen. Mit der Zentralisierung der IT der Landesverwaltung ist die Unterstützung der Behörden und Einrichtungen des Landes Brandenburg bei der Planung, der Gestaltung und dem Einsatz von Informationstechnik sowie die Beratung in Fragen der IT-Sicherheit zu einem wesentlichen Tätigkeitsfeld des Betriebs geworden. Ferner erbringt der ZIT-BB Leistungen nach dem Brandenburgischen E-Government-Gesetz insbesondere für Gemeinden, Ämter und Gemeindeverbände des Landes. Der Hauptstandort des ZIT-BB befindet sich in der Steinstraße 104-106 in 14480 Potsdam. Aufgrund seiner landesweiten Zuständigkeit hat der ZIT-BB u.a. Außenstandorte in Cottbus, Frankfurt (Oder), Wünsdorf, Gransee und Eberswalde. Sein Rechenzentrum betreibt er in Berlin. Mittels dieser Vergabe soll ein Externer Informationssicherheitsbeauftragter (ISB) für den Brandenburgischen IT-Dienstleister beauftragt werden. Die beschriebenen Leistungen sind sofort nach Zuschlagserteilung zu erbringen und enden spätestens nach Erreichen der unter Ziffer 4.1 festgelegten Obergrenzen im EVB-IT Dienstvertrag. Der Auftraggeber geht von einem Umfang von 700 Personentagen aus. Näheres zum Leistungsgegenstand ist in der Leistungsbeschreibung Teil B geregelt.
