result.text: The City of Helsinki's Culture and Leisure Division is developing data-driven management and, in connection with this, visitor counting for its locations and related solutions. Visitor data is one of the most important key performance indicators for operations: visitor data is used, among other things, for resource allocation, operational planning and development, and for assessing the impact of operations. The goal of the visitor counting service is to collect comparable and accurate visitor data from the division's locations as automatically as possible for analysis and reporting needs. The SaaS (Software as a Service) provided by the supplier includes at least: • production of visitor data from the counting target according to the needs defined by the division • transmission of visitor data by providing an interface (interface service) for transferring data to the division's data warehouse • transmission of visitor data by providing a user interface (user interface service) for viewing the data • collection of visitor data from devices, as well as monitoring and reporting of data accuracy and coverage (incl. verification counts for measurement at defined intervals) • devices used for visitor data collection as a lifecycle service (HaaS service, Hardware as a Service): - installation, commissioning, maintenance, servicing, functionality testing and calibration of devices - monitoring of device operation - removal and recycling of device installations. The contracting authority is currently surveying the procurement of a new data platform and will put it out to tender in approximately late 2026. By submitting a tender, the tenderer undertakes to assist with integrations and to provide an interface from the visitor counting service to the data platform. The estimated total value of the procurement excluding VAT is 1 680 000,00 euros. The estimated value includes the actual contract period of two (2) years and, in addition, one (1) two-year (2) option period. The procurement is divided into three (3) different lots: - lot 1: indoor locations - lot 2: outdoor locations - lot 3: multi-purpose outdoor locations. The tenderer may submit a tender for as many lots as they wish. Tenderers will be selected for the framework agreement based on the most economically advantageous tender. Qualitative requirements (quality criteria) have been set as minimum requirements for the devices and services to be procured, which the offered devices and services must meet. In addition, the price comparison will compare the maximum prices per lot (hereinafter ceiling price) from cheapest to most expensive. The supplier provides a ceiling price according to the most demanding example location of the lot defined by the contracting authority. Based on the tender competition, a framework agreement will be concluded for the subject of the procurement, to which five (5) contract suppliers who have submitted the lowest ceiling price per lot will be selected, unless there are fewer tenderers meeting the requirements. The suppliers selected for the framework agreement do not have exclusive rights to the procurements covered by the framework agreement, but the contracting authority has the right to procure the same subject of procurement also from outside this framework agreement. The contracting authority also does not commit to specific procurement volumes during the framework agreement. A more detailed description of the subject of the procurement is described in this invitation to tender and its appendices. The locations in the lot have one or more entrances to the site. There is a need for location-specific breakdown of visitor data for different indoor locations. Such locations include, for example, libraries, youth centres, cultural centres and sports halls. A more detailed description of the service and the minimum requirements are presented in the Description of the subject of the procurement, Requirement Specification, Service Levels appendix and other appendices of the invitation to tender attached to the invitation to tender. The contracting authority estimates that 80 such locations will be put out to tender during the framework agreement period. The amount is an estimate and does not bind the contracting authority.; The locations in the lot have one or more restricted or unrestricted entrances. parts.source: Helsingin kaupungin kulttuurin ja vapaa-ajan toimiala on kehittämässä tiedolla johtamista ja tähän liittyen toimipaikkojen käyntilaskentaa sekä siihen liittyviä ratkaisuja. Käyntitiedot ovat yksi toiminnan tärkeimmistä tunnusluvuista: käyntitietoja käytetään muun muassa resurssien kohdentamiseen, toiminnan suunnitteluun ja kehittämiseen sekä toiminnan vaikuttavuuden arviointiin. Käyntilaskentapalvelun tavoitteena on kerätä yhteismitallista ja oikeellista käyntitietoa toimialan toimipaikoista mahdollisimman automaattisesti analysoinnin ja raportoinnin tarpeisiin. Toimittajan toimittama SaaS-palvelu (Software as a Service) sisältää vähintään: • käyntitiedon tuottaminen laskentakohteesta toimialan määrittelemän tarpeen mukaisesti • käyntitiedon välittämisen tarjoamalla rajapinnan (rajapintapalvelu) tietojen siirtämiseksi toimialan tietovarantoon • käyntitiedon välittämisen tarjoamalla käyttöliittymän (käyttöliittymäpalvelu) tietojen tarkastelemiseksi • käyntitiedon keräämisen laitteista, sekä tiedon oikeellisuuden ja kattavuuden seurannan ja raportoinnin (sis. mittaamisen varmistuslaskennat määritellyin väliajoin) • käyntitiedon keruussa käytettävät laitteet elinkaaripalveluna (HaaS-palveluna, Hardware as a Service): - laitteiden asennukset, käyttöönotot, ylläpidon, huollon, toimivuuden testauksen ja kalibroinnit - laitteiden toiminnan seurannan - laitteiden asennusten poistamisen ja kierrättämisen. Tilaaja on parhaillaan kartoittamassa uuden tietoalustan hankintaa ja kilpailuttaa sen arviolta loppuvuodesta 2026. Tarjoaja sitoutuu jättämällä tarjouksen avustamaan integraatioissa sekä tarjoamaan rajapinnan käyntilaskentapalvelusta tietoalustaan. Hankinnan arvioitu arvonlisäveroton kokonaisarvo on 1 680 000,00 euroa. Arvioitu arvo sisältää varsinaisen sopimuskauden kaksi (2) vuotta sekä lisäksi yhden (1) kahden (2) vuoden optiokauden. Hankinta on jaettu kolmeen (3) eri osa-alueeseen: - osa-alue 1: sisäkohteet - osa-alue 2: ulkokohteet - osa-alue 3: monikäyttöiset ulkokohteet. Tarjoaja voi jättää tarjouksen niin moneen osa-alueeseen kuin haluaa. Tarjoajat valitaan puitejärjestelyyn kokonaistaloudellisen edullisuuden perusteella. Hankittaville laitteille ja palveluille on asetettu vähimmäisvaatimuksina laadullisia vaatimuksia (laatukriteereitä), jotka tarjottavien laitteiden ja palveluiden pitää täyttää. Lisäksi hintavertailussa vertaillaan osa-aluekohtaisia enimmäishintoja (jatkossa kattohinta) halvimmasta kalliimpaan. Toimittaja antaa kattohinnan Tilaajan määrittelemän osa-alueen vaativimman esimerkkikohteen mukaisesti. Tarjouskilpailun perusteella solmitaan hankinnan kohteesta puitejärjestely, johon valitaan viisi (5) halvimman kattohinnan jättänyttä sopimustoimittajaa per osa-alue, ellei vaatimukset täyttäviä tarjoajia ole vähemmän. Puitejärjestelyyn valituilla toimittajilla ei ole yksinoikeutta puitejärjestelyn kohteena oleviin hankintoihin, vaan tilaajalla on oikeus hankkia samaa hankinnan kohdetta myös tämän puitejärjestelyn ulkopuolelta. Tilaaja ei myöskään sitoudu tiettyihin hankintamääriin puitejärjestelyn aikana. Tarkempi kuvaus hankinnan kohteesta on kuvattu tässä tarjouspyynnössä ja sen liitteissä. Osa-alueen kohteissa on yksi tai useampi sisäänkäynti toimipisteeseen. Eri sisäkohteiden käyntitiedon erittelylle on kohdekohtaisesti tarvetta. Tällaisia kohteita ovat esimerkiksi kirjastot, nuorisotilat, kulttuurikeskukset ja liikuntahallit. result.text: Police Scotland wishes to engage potential Suppliers to obtain appropriate information in advance of an Invitation to Tender being issued. This will be confirmed following the supplier engagement stage and assessment of Request for Information responses received from participating suppliers.

result.text: NatureScot has a requirement to place a contract with an external service provider for the provision of Deer Vehicle Collision Data Collation and Analysis Project, 2025 – 2028. NatureScot, in conjunction with Transport Scotland (Scotland’s national transport agency) requires the collation, analysis and reporting of data relating to deer vehicle collisions (DVCs) in Scotland to help improve our knowledge of DVCs across the Scottish road network and to inform decision making regarding the implementation of DVC mitigation measures. Lot 1: . NatureScot, in partnership with Transport Scotland, has been running the Deer Vehicle Collision (DVC) Project since 2008. The previous phase incorporated data to the end of 2024. result.text: This Notice of Funding Opportunity (NOFO) invites a single cooperative agreement application for the Resource Center for the Cardiovascular Repository for Type 1 Diabetes (CaRe-T1D). The purpose of CaRe-T1D is to support innovative, discovery and mechanistic research through the study of human cardiovascular (CV) tissue. This research seeks to better understand cardiovascular disease (CVD) in type 1 diabetes, highlight differences compared to type 2 diabetes, and ultimately guide the development of therapies to treat this major cause of morbidity and mortality for individuals with type 1 diabetes. To achieve these goals, the Resource Center will expand the CaRe-T1D biorepository of human CV tissue, further develop the data commons for data sharing and for artificial intelligence (AI) tools, coordinate the research activities of the investigative teams in the CaRe-T1D consortium, and make CaRe-T1D resources accessible to the broader research community. This NOFO is associated with the Special Diabetes Program (https://www.niddk.nih.gov/about-niddk/research-areas/diabetes/type-1-diabetes-special-statutory-funding-program/about-special-diabetes-program) which funds research on the prevention, treatment, and cure of type 1 diabetes and its complications, including unique, innovative, and collaborative research consortia and clinical trials networks.This is a Notice of Funding Opportunity (NOFO) for a Single Source that will invite application(s) from eligible organization(s) to apply. Please see Section III. Eligibility for additional information. In accordance with NIH standard peer-review processes, the application(s) will be peer-reviewed, and only meritorious application(s) will be considered for funding.

result.text: The Havelland district intends to award external professional support for the following services: 1. Support and preparation of the next four emergency medical service fee calculations (planned cost accounting including operating cost accounting) 2. Analysis and processing of financial deficits from concluded inhibition agreements of the years 2021-2024 regarding the so-called misuse issue, including a clearance based on the judgement of the Higher Administrative Court of Berlin-Brandenburg (OVG 6 A 13/25) 3. Advice on a legally secure and sustainable fee structure The consultant will analyse the effects of the judgement of the Higher Administrative Court of Berlin-Brandenburg, 28.01.2026, ref. OVG 6 A 13/25 on the respective emergency medical service fee budget for the client and prepare a written statement on this. This also includes an analysis of the written grounds for the judgement. The consultant will implement all resulting work within the framework of a consensual solution with the GKV in the interest of the client. The required consulting services include, in particular, data procurement, the evaluation of all data as well as the adjustments of the relevant emergency medical service fee calculations and the support of the hearing procedure with the cost bearers. The goal is the retroactive resolution of the consequences of the OVG judgement and the elimination of the resulting financial risk of the years 2021-2024 as well as the year 2026 and the expert support until the year 2029. -2.1 Emergency medical service fee calculation -2.2 Processing of the concluded inhibition agreements (2021-2024) -2.3 Strategic consulting

OVG 6 A 13/25 auf den jeweiligen Rettungsdienstgebührenhaushalt analysieren und hierzu eine schriftliche Stellungnahme fertigen. Der Berater wird alle sich hieraus ergebenden Arbeiten im Rahmen einer einvernehmlichen Lösung mit der GKV im Sinne des Auftraggebers realisieren. result.text: Oslo municipality would like to map whether there are market participants who have systems that can or are able to meet the municipality's needs, which are summarised below and described in the attached document. The requested system shall as a starting point not be a pure development project for the municipality, and ought to as far as possible be based on adaptations to the existing system(s). Oslo municipality currently has an agreement for the area that expires in the first quarter of 2027 and the system ought to be in operation immediately after the contract expires. Interested tenderers are asked to register their interest through the KGV system by submitting a short presentation of their system as well as a short description of any adaptation needs that are necessary to meet the municipality's needs. Based on the interest, Oslo municipality can select suppliers for further market dialogue (expected week 41/42). SUMMARY OF THE CONTRACTING AUTHORITY'S NEEDS Oslo municipality needs a cloud-based (SaaS) system that can, to the greatest possible degree, contribute to complying with the legal and regulatory requirements related to the Norwegian model, including the requirements for an electronic crew list in the Construction Client Regulation § 15, as well as follow-up of the Oslo model's seriousness requirements, and other needs closely related to this type of follow-up. The system ought, for this reason, to be able to facilitate (the list is not exhaustive): 1) Overview of ongoing projects and assignments within, among other things, building, construction and cleaning contracts with information on suppliers and sub-suppliers. 2) Overview of crews who have signed in and out in ongoing projects and assignments in the municipality. 3) Analysis and compilation of relevant information for identifying risks connected to contractual relationships. 4) Control, follow-up and reporting of contractual relationships.

result.text: Broad Horizons Education Trust is currently exploring options for the future provision of its payroll services commencing in September 2027. The Trust currently has an estimated headcount of 1408 employees across 18 sites/academies, processed on a monthly pay cycle. The purpose of this Request for Information is to engage with potential suppliers prior to any formal procurement to: Inform our procurement strategy, scope, and specification. Gauge market interest, capacity, and capabilities. Understand standard market pricing models, implementation timelines, and risk mitigation strategies. The primary objectives of this engagement are to: Gauge current market interest, capacity, and capabilities across service delivery models Seek supplier feedback to refine and finalize the procurement strategy, technical specification, and performance KPIs. Understand commercial and pricing models. Inform system integration requirements to ensure a successful go-live for September 2027. Key operational requirements include: Full and seamless transition Full management processing of monthly payrolls. Comprehensive public sector pension scheme administration, returns, and compliance-specifically Teachers' Pensions Scheme (TPS) and Local Government Pension Scheme (LGPS) Pay scales - To be able to cope with Teaching pay scales, support staff pay scale, apprenticeships plus off-scale pay grades where needed Pay awards and increments To be able to apply pay awards to current staff automatically For back pay to be automatically calculated To be able to chose to backdated pay awards to some leavers To be able to apply increments at different dates for some staff To be able to apply 'No Increment' for specific contracts Integration capability with existing HR and Finance systems and simple data input Integration with MIS - currently Arbor - to provide a 'single source of truth' from which reports and data flows Access for Employees - To efficiently be able to download payslips, P60s etc. To efficiently be able to update personal details, including bank account details Knowledge and experience working with MATs in the education sector. rejected.text: The National Institute of Neurological Disorders and Stroke (NINDS), with other NIH Institutes and Centres (ICs), intends to publish a Notice of Funding Opportunity (NOFO) to investigate the mechanisms of action of therapeutic medical devices with the overall goal of improving clinical outcomes with device-based approaches. Medical devices are essential in managing health conditions, complementing drugs and behavioural interventions, and often offer unique benefits. Despite the commercial availability of numerous medical devices and ongoing development of new technologies, many have shown inconsistent results in preclinical studies, failed translation to humans, and exhibit varied patient outcomes. To overcome these challenges, it is crucial to understand the mechanisms by which medical devices produce a therapeutic effect, to identify physiological markers of neurological conditions, and to assess how device-based therapies influence these markers. Advancing this knowledge will improve device-based interventions, inspire new device designs, and optimise current clinical approaches. Applications will be invited from interdisciplinary teams pursuing innovative research on how medical devices produce a therapeutic effect. Applicant teams will likely exhibit expertise in areas such as engineering, biology, pathophysiology, surgery, clinical care, healthcare delivery, biostatistics, software development, computational modelling, artificial intelligence, regulatory science, and clinical trials. This program will accept projects on investigational devices and those already FDA-approved and in clinical use. Applications are expected to include strategies for developing or optimising therapies that could significantly improve patient care. Supported research may include mechanistic clinical trials, animal studies, and computational modelling or simulation. Applications are not being solicited at this time. Notice is being provided to allow potential applicants sufficient time to develop meaningful collaborations and responsive projects.

result.text: Procurement of a UCC solution for the State of Hesse The project comprises a modern and comprehensive communications solution that integrates numerous central components. The following expectations are placed on the tendered service: In the area of telephony and voice (formerly HessenVoice), contemporary voice communication is provided that replaces and expands existing systems. In addition, the softphone functionality enables telephony to be used directly via PC or mobile end devices without the need for additional hardware. Webex is currently used as the web conferencing solution (VKS); however, the solution should also support future developments and hybrid working forms in the best possible way. In addition, chat and messaging functions create a secure and efficient platform for text-based team communication. High requirements apply to security and data protection as well as accessibility in order to offer all employees secure and inclusive access to the solution. The operator model defines clear responsibilities and processes for operation, while accompanying training measures support the introduction and foster acceptance. The solution will be fully compatible with the HessenPC and enable secure, high-performance access via the HessenNetz connection. Another component is the provision as a price-per-port Full Managed Service, which impresses with transparent pricing and comprehensive service management. Manufacturer neutrality is respected in order to avoid dependencies and ensure long-term flexibility and openness to competition. The procurement and implementation of the tendered UCC solution takes place with special consideration of the requirements for information security, data protection and interoperability with existing authorities' infrastructures. For use in public administration, compliance with the compendium for internal organisational telecommunication systems with an increased protection requirement (KomTK ) published by the Federal Office for Information Security (BSI) must be ensured. This guideline defines binding security measures - including technical, organisational and infrastructural requirements - for telecommunication systems with an increased protection requirement and serves as a benchmark for the planning, operation and safeguarding of the offered solution. The protection of personal data is a central criterion in the selection and implementation of communication systems. The legal requirements of the General Data Protection Regulation ("GDPR") and the Hesse Data Protection Act ("HDSIG") provide for safeguarding the rights and freedoms of data subjects and consistently implementing data protection principles - such as lawfulness, purpose limitation, data minimisation, accuracy, storage limitation, integrity and confidentiality. While Unified Communications solutions are primarily designed for applications with a normal protection requirement in accordance with the specifications of the Federal Office for Information Security ("BSI") when using cloud components, there are scenarios in which a higher level of security is required. In cases where a higher level of security is required, an on-premise system is frequently used, which is operated entirely within the own IT infrastructure and can thus better meet the requirements for a high or very high protection requirement. By operating in a controlled environment, a higher degree of control over data flows, access protection, encryption as well as emergency and recovery measures can be ensured. Unified Communications and Collaboration (UCC) solutions represent a central component of modern IT infrastructures and serve the integrated networking of a wide variety of communication and collaboration services. In order to meet the operational requirements for reliability, security, scalability and interoperability, specific technical prerequisites are indispensable. These requirements form the basis for the selection, implementation and operation of a high-performance UCC solution that ensures efficient and uninterrupted cooperation within the organisation. In order to bring about rapid project success, close cooperation between the contractor and the contracting authority is necessary. The contractor MUST closely coordinate with internal and external stakeholders on the part of the contracting authority as part of the implementation in order to take account of necessary and inevitable interactions with other systems of the contracting authority (e.g. firewall, network, etc.) as early as possible in the implementation of the project and to implement necessary adjustments and interventions on these systems as smoothly and time-critically as possible. The service contents presented in this specification MUST be provided by the contractor for the contractually defined period in full and with ultimate responsibility for the outcome, flexibly according to the respective needs of the contracting authority in the form of a "Managed Service". Within the scope of this tender, special emphasis is placed on the accessibility of the Unified Communications and Collaboration (UCC) solution to be supplied. Accessibility means that the solution can be used unrestrictedly and equally by all users, regardless of individual impairments or restrictions. This includes in particular people with visual, hearing, motor or cognitive impairments. The detailed service requirements can be found in the respective chapters of the service specification (Chapters 1 - 7).

parts.source: Beschaffung einer UCC-Lösung für das Land Hessen Das Projekt umfasst eine moderne und umfassende Kommunikationslösung, die zahlreiche zentrale Bestandteile integriert. Folgende Erwartungen werden an die ausgeschriebene Leistung gestellt: Im Bereich Telefonie und Voice (ehemals HessenVoice) wird eine zeitgemäße Sprachkommunikation bereitgestellt, die bestehende Systeme ersetzt und erweitert. Ergänzend dazu ermöglicht die Softphone-Funktionalität die Nutzung der Telefonie direkt über PC oder mobile Endgeräte, ohne dass zusätzliche Hardware erforderlich ist. Als Webkonferenzlösung (VKS) wird aktuell auf Webex gesetzt; die Lösung soll jedoch auch künftige Weiterentwicklungen und hybride Arbeitsformen bestmöglich unterstützen. Darüber hinaus wird mit Chat- und Messaging-Funktionen eine sichere und effiziente Plattform für die schriftbasierte Teamkommunikation geschaffen. Hohe Anforderungen gelten für Sicherheit und Datenschutz sowie für die Barrierefreiheit, um allen Beschäftigten einen sicheren und inklusiven Zugang zur Lösung zu bieten. Das Betreibermodell definiert klare Verantwortlichkeiten und Prozesse für den Betrieb, während flankierende Schulungsmaßnahmen die Einführung begleiten und die Akzeptanzförderung unterstützen. Die Lösung wird vollständig mit dem HessenPC kompatibel sein und über die HessenNetz-Anbindung einen sicheren, performanten Zugriff ermöglichen. Ein weiterer Bestandteil ist die Bereitstellung als portpreisbezogener Full Managed Service, der durch transparente Preisgestaltung und umfassendes Service-Management überzeugt. Dabei wird auf Herstellerneutralität geachtet, um Abhängigkeiten zu vermeiden und langfristige Flexibilität sowie Wettbewerbsoffenheit zu gewährleisten. Die Beschaffung und Implementierung der ausgeschriebenen UCC-Lösung erfolgt unter besonderer Berücksichtigung der Anforderungen an Informationssicherheit, Datenschutz und Interoperabilität mit bestehenden behördlichen Infrastrukturen. Für den Einsatz in der öffentlichen Verwaltung ist die Einhaltung des vom Bundesamt für Sicherheit in der Informationstechnik (BSI) herausgegebenen Kompendiums für organisationsinterne Telekommunikationssysteme mit erhöhtem Schutzbedarf (KomTK ) sicherzustellen. Diese Richtlinie definiert verbindliche Sicherheitsmaßnahmen - einschließlich technischer, organisatorischer und infrastruktureller Anforderungen - für Telekommunikationssysteme mit erhöhtem Schutzbedarf und dient als Maßstab für Planung, Betrieb und Absicherung der angebotenen Lösung. Der Schutz personenbezogener Daten ist ein zentrales Kriterium bei der Auswahl und Implementierung von Kommunikationssystemen. Die rechtlichen Vorgaben der Datenschutz-Grundverordnung ("DS-GVO") und das Hessische Datenschutzgesetz ("HDSIG") sehen vor, die Rechte und Freiheiten der betroffenen Personen zu wahren und datenschutzrechtliche Grundprinzipien - wie Rechtmäßigkeit, Zweckbindung, Datenminimierung, Richtigkeit, Speicherbegrenzung, Integrität und Vertraulichkeit - konsequent umzusetzen. Während Unified-Communications-Lösungen vor allem bei Nutzung von Cloud-Anteilen für Anwendungen mit einem normalen Schutzbedarf gemäß den Vorgaben des Bundesamts für Sicherheit in der Informationstechnik ("BSI") konzipiert sind, gibt es Szenarien, in denen ein höheres Sicherheitsniveau erforderlich ist. In den Fällen, in denen ein höheres Sicherheitsniveau erforderlich ist, wird häufig auf ein On-Premise-System zurückgegriffen, das vollständig innerhalb der eigenen IT-Infrastruktur betrieben wird und damit den Anforderungen an einen hohen oder sehr hohen Schutzbedarf besser gerecht werden kann. Durch den Betrieb in einer kontrollierten Umgebung kann ein höheres Maß an Kontrolle über Datenflüsse, Zugriffsschutz, Verschlüsselung sowie Notfall- und Wiederherstellungsmaßnahmen sichergestellt werden. Unified Communications and Collaboration (UCC) Lösungen stellen eine zentrale Komponente moderner IT-Infrastrukturen dar und dienen der integrierten Vernetzung unterschiedlichster Kommunikations- und Kollaborationsdienste. Um den betrieblichen Anforderungen an Zuverlässigkeit, Sicherheit, Skalierbarkeit sowie Interoperabilität gerecht zu werden, sind spezifische technische Voraussetzungen unabdingbar. Diese Anforderungen bilden die Grundlage für die Auswahl, Implementierung und den Betrieb einer leistungsfähigen UCC-Lösung, die eine effiziente und unterbrechungsfreie Zusammenarbeit innerhalb der Organisation gewährleistet. Um einen schnellen Projekterfolg herbeiführen zu können, ist eine enge Zusammenarbeit zwischen dem AN und dem AG erforderlich. Der AN MUSS sich im Rahmen der Umsetzung eng mit internen und externen Verantwortlichen auf der Seite des AGs abstimmen, um erforderliche sowie zwangsläufige Wechselwirkungen mit weiteren Systemen des AGs (z.B. Firewall, Netzwerk etc.) möglichst früh in der Umsetzung des Projekts zu berücksichtigen und erforderliche Anpassungen und Eingriffe an diesen Systemen möglichst störungsfrei und zeitkritisch umzusetzen. Die in dieser Leistungsbeschreibung dargestellten Leistungsinhalte MÜSSEN vom AN für den vertraglich festgelegten Zeitraum vollumfänglich und in abschließender Ergebnisverantwortung, flexibel nach dem jeweiligen Bedarf des AGs in Form eines "Managed Service" erbracht werden. Im Rahmen dieser Ausschreibung wird besonderer Wert auf die Barrierefreiheit der zu liefernden Unified Communications and Collaboration (UCC)-Lösung gelegt. Barrierefreiheit bedeutet, dass die Lösung von allen Nutzenden, unabhängig von individuellen Beeinträchtigungen oder Einschränkungen, uneingeschränkt und gleichberechtigt genutzt werden kann. Dies umfasst insbesondere Menschen mit Seh-, Hör-, motorischen oder kognitiven Beeinträchtigungen. Die detailierten Leistungsanforderungen sind den jeweiligen Kapiteln der Leistungsbeschreibung (Kapitel 1 - 7) zu entnehmen.

result.text: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Denmark (MFA) is in the process of streamlining the management of its development cooperation. Part of this effort concerns the simplification of the procurement process of key consultancy services relating to development cooperation. Consultancy contracts are currently procured individually by the case worker responsible for the programme or project. Case workers are MFA staff from MFA services at home in Copenhagen and abroad. In the procurement of individual contracts, they are responsible for the choice of procurement modality, the planning, preparation and management of the tender and contracting process. This process is often lengthy, and can have implications on programme and project timelines. Moreover, the fragmentation of the process makes it difficult to use the feedback from case workers on the fulfilment of the assignments. This makes it challenging to harvest learning from past performance and ensure a sustained quality of services. It is in this context that the MFA wishes to consolidate the procurement of consultancy services through a framework agreement with multiple contractors. The streamlining of the management of Danish development cooperation entailed a revision of the Danida – Aid Management Guidelines (https://amg.um.dk/). This foresees a delegation of key tasks to external consultants, primarily appraisals, and thereby an expected rise in the number of consultancy services to be requested. It is therefore an opportune time to seek a more streamlined procurement process of consultancy services. AMGs contain the policies, guidelines, and tools for the MFA’s development cooperation assistance. They cover different forms of Danish development cooperation modalities. The AMG’s Bilateral Guidelines (https://amg.um.dk/bilateral-cooperation/guidelines-for-programmes-projects-country-strategic-frameworks-and-hard-earmarked-multilat-support) and Financial Management Guidelines (https://amg.um.dk/bilateral-cooperation/financial-management) constitute the basic set of procedures for all Danish bilateral development cooperation. The guidelines outline the processes and requirements for the preparation, formulation, quality assurance, approval, implementation, completion and closure of Danish bilateral programmes and projects. The framework agreement is expected to solely cover bilateral development cooperation programmes and projects designed and implemented by Denmark. Therefore, the expected scope of work of consultancy services solely pertains to Official Development Aid (ODA) funds. The framework agreement is also expected to be divided into two lots. Under each lot, the MFA expects to conclude a framework agreement with between three to seven contractor to establish the terms governing contracts to be awarded during the term of the framework agreement, specifically the terms for award of contracts with/without reopening of competition amongst the contractors on the framework agreement. The expected lots reflect the thematic areas and priorities of Denmark’s Strategy for Development Cooperation: Lot 1: Climate change, environment, private sector development, enabling environment and financing. Lot 2: Governance, response to conflicts, forced displacement, irregular migration, health and education. Each lot is expected to require the provision of the following services pertaining to the design and implementation phases of bilateral development cooperation programmes, namely: Formulation of bilateral programmes and projects. This may include preparatory work in the formulation process if and as needed. Appraisal of the design of bilateral programmes and projects as a quality assurance milestone prior to approval. This includes external appraisals and early appraisals of larger or high-risk programmes/projects. Review of bilateral programmes and projects under implementation. This can span inception, midterm and technical reviews as part of the MFA unit’s monitoring and reporting cycle. The estimated values of the procurement and the lots are preliminary estimates.

result.text: Bergen vann constructs and operates the water and sewage plant in Bergen municipality and is an agency with approx. 270 employees. We shall procure a notification system that sends SMS, email and any voice messages to relevant recipients. The primary need is map based notification of inhabitants and entities during operational episodes. The notification shall be sent to those who have registered for national addresses, or operate business activities within a given area. Operational events can be planned measures that result in a break in the delivery for technical work on the pipeline network, or in the event of pipeline breaks, leaks and other non-planned situations. For such events Bergen vann needs to be able to gather data for later reporting and statistics. This applies to both event and notification, duration and number of persons affected. The system shall also be used for notifying other municipal departments than Bergen water.

Tavoitteena onsaada tietoa uudenlaisista ja innovatiivisista ratkaisuista, jotka soveltuvat haastaviinkaupunkiympäristöihin sekä tukevat kaupungin palveluita, kunnossapitoa ja päätöksentekoa. Erityisenä tavoitteena on auttaa pieniä ja keskisuuria yrityksiä ratkaisemaanhaasteita, joille on akuutti tarve, ja kasvattaa niiden liiketoimintaa. Järjestelmä havaitsee riskit japoikkeamat ajoissa, seuraa uimareiden liikkeitä ja tunnistaa hätätilanteet reaaliajassa.Robotiikkaa voidaan hyödyntää myös pelastus- ja noutotehtävissä, vierasesineidentunnistamisessa ja väylien kunnon seurannassa. 2. Älykäs vedenlaadun seuranta ja hulevesien hallinta Vedenlaadun seuranta on nykyisin hidasta ja pistemäistä. Ratkaisu voi seurata sameutta,happipitoisuutta, lämpötilaa, sähkönjohtavuutta ja ravinnepitoisuuksia sekä ottaaautomaattisesti vesinäytteitä jatkoanalyysia varten. 3. Oma ratkaisu Yritykset voivat ehdottaa myös omaa, uutta vesiympäristöön liittyvää robotiikkaratkaisua,joka tuo lisäarvoa Helsingin kaupungille ja sen asukkaille. Se on kaupungin hermosto, joka ylläpitää elinvoimaa ja palvelujensujuvuutta ilman katkoksia. 1. Infran kunnon seuranta ja mallinnus Kaupungilla on tuhansia kilometrejä katuja, pyöräteitä ja tunneleita, joiden kunnontarkastaminen on työlästä ja hajanaista. Tavoitteena on kehittää ratkaisu, joka tarjoaajatkuvan, ajantasaisen ja automaattisesti päivittyvän näkymän kaupungin infrastruktuurintilaan. 2. Talvikunnossapidon automaatio ja logistiikka Vuonna 2028 lumen mereen kaataminen kielletään, mikä edellyttää uusia tapoja hallitalumen keruuta ja käsittelyä. Blue City – Digital and safe water city Helsinki can be the world's first city that continuously monitors, measures, and secures its water areas with the help of mobile robotics. The goal is to develop autonomous water robots and data solutions that monitor water quality, map the bottom, and support water and maritime safety. 1. Safe beaches and harbours The goal is to develop an automatic monitoring and tracking system that improves the safety of beaches, harbours, and sea areas. The system detects risks and anomalies in time, tracks the movements of swimmers, and identifies emergencies in real time. Robotics can also be utilised in rescue and retrieval tasks, identification of foreign objects, and monitoring the condition of channels. 2. Smart water quality monitoring and stormwater management Water quality monitoring is currently slow and point-based. The goal is to create a real-time water situational picture based on robotics and data analytics, which enables rapid reaction to anomalies. The solution can monitor turbidity, oxygen content, temperature, electrical conductivity, and nutrient concentrations, as well as automatically take water samples for further analysis. 3. Own solution Companies can also propose their own new robotics solution related to the water environment, which brings added value to the City of Helsinki and its residents. The solution must utilise ground, water, or air robotics and produce data that can be utilised in the city's various service areas, for example in the development of infrastructure, safety, or environmental management. Urban Sky – Smart and managed urban airspace Urban airspace is a new infrastructure where drones and sensors operate as part of the city's everyday life. The goal is to build a safe and coordinated airspace where mobile robotics supports monitoring, maintenance, and decision-making. 1. Smart construction site monitoring Monitoring and supervising construction sites takes a lot of resources and is often manual. The goal is to improve the safety, transparency, and productivity of construction sites by monitoring progress and anomalies in real time. 2. Predictive maintenance – detection of leaks and thermal anomalies The city loses significant amounts of energy and water every year due to unnoticed leaks and heat losses. The goal is to develop a system based on air robotics and thermal imaging that identifies leaks and anomalies at an early stage and supports predictive maintenance. 3. Own solution Companies can also propose their own robotics solution utilising airspace that supports the safety, monitoring, or energy use of the urban environment. The solution must utilise ground, water, or air robotics and produce data that supports the city's services and decision-making. Smart Ground – Functional and sustainable city all year round A functional and sustainable city utilises mobile robotics, data, and the circular economy so that the city's infrastructure, maintenance, and logistics work seamlessly every day of the year. It is the city's nervous system that maintains vitality and the smooth running of services without interruptions. 1. Infrastructure condition monitoring and modelling The city has thousands of kilometres of streets, cycle paths, and tunnels, the condition of which is laborious and fragmented to inspect. The goal is to develop a solution that provides a continuous, up-to-date, and automatically updating view of the state of the city's infrastructure. 2. Automation and logistics of winter maintenance In the year 2028 dumping snow into the sea will be prohibited, which requires new ways to manage snow collection and processing. The goal is to develop a predictive and data-driven robotics solution that supports snow collection, transport, storage, and melting in an environmentally friendly and cost-effective manner. 3. Own solution Companies can also propose their own robotics solution suitable for the ground environment, which improves the operation of the city's infrastructure, maintenance, or logistics. The solution can utilise ground, water, or air robotics and produce data beneficial to the city, for example about the environment, traffic, or energy use.

parts.source: Hankinnan kohde ja tavoiteHankinnan kohteena ovat kaupunkiympäristöön soveltuvat mobiilirobotiikanteknologiaratkaisut, jotka suorittavat tehtäviä ilmassa, maassa tai vedessä. Tällä avoimella tarjouspyynnöllä haetaan 6–9 kpl pilottia toteutettavaksi. Tavoitteena onsaada tietoa uudenlaisista ja innovatiivisista ratkaisuista, jotka soveltuvat haastaviinkaupunkiympäristöihin sekä tukevat kaupungin palveluita, kunnossapitoa ja päätöksentekoa. Erityisenä tavoitteena on auttaa pieniä ja keskisuuria yrityksiä ratkaisemaanhaasteita, joille on akuutti tarve, ja kasvattaa niiden liiketoimintaa. Blue City – Digitaalinen ja turvallinen vesikaupunki Helsinki voi olla maailman ensimmäinen kaupunki, joka valvoo, mittaa ja turvaavesialueitaan jatkuvasti mobiilirobotiikan avulla. Tavoitteena on kehittää autonomisiavesirobotteja ja dataratkaisuja, jotka seuraavat vedenlaatua, kartoittavat pohjaa ja tukevatvesi- ja meriturvallisuutta. 1. Turvalliset rannat ja satamat Tavoitteena on kehittää automaattinen valvonta- ja seurantajärjestelmä, joka parantaauimarantojen, satamien ja merialueiden turvallisuutta. Järjestelmä havaitsee riskit japoikkeamat ajoissa, seuraa uimareiden liikkeitä ja tunnistaa hätätilanteet reaaliajassa.Robotiikkaa voidaan hyödyntää myös pelastus- ja noutotehtävissä, vierasesineidentunnistamisessa ja väylien kunnon seurannassa. 2. Älykäs vedenlaadun seuranta ja hulevesien hallinta Vedenlaadun seuranta on nykyisin hidasta ja pistemäistä. Tavoitteena on luodareaaliaikainen, robotiikkaan ja data-analytiikkaan perustuva vesien tilannekuva, jokamahdollistaa nopean reagoinnin poikkeamiin. Ratkaisu voi seurata sameutta,happipitoisuutta, lämpötilaa, sähkönjohtavuutta ja ravinnepitoisuuksia sekä ottaaautomaattisesti vesinäytteitä jatkoanalyysia varten. 3. Oma ratkaisu Yritykset voivat ehdottaa myös omaa, uutta vesiympäristöön liittyvää robotiikkaratkaisua,joka tuo lisäarvoa Helsingin kaupungille ja sen asukkaille. Ratkaisun tulee hyödyntäämaa-, vesi- tai ilmarobotiikkaa ja tuottaa dataa, jota voidaan hyödyntää kaupungin eripalvelualueilla, esimerkiksi infrastruktuurin, turvallisuuden tai ympäristönhallinnankehittämisessä. Urban Sky – Älykäs ja hallittu kaupunki-ilmatila Kaupunki-ilmatila on uusi infrastruktuuri, jossa dronet ja sensorit toimivat osanakaupungin arkea. Tavoitteena on rakentaa turvallinen ja koordinoitu ilmatila, jossamobiilirobotiikka tukee valvontaa, kunnossapitoa ja päätöksentekoa. 1. Älykäs työmaavalvonta Rakennustyömaiden seuranta ja valvonta vievät paljon resursseja ja ovat useinmanuaalisia. Tavoitteena on parantaa työmaiden turvallisuutta, läpinäkyvyyttä jatuottavuutta seuraamalla etenemistä ja poikkeamia reaaliajassa. 2. Ennakoiva kunnossapito – vuotojen ja lämpöpoikkeamien havainnointi Kaupunki menettää vuosittain merkittäviä määriä energiaa ja vettä huomaamattomienvuotojen ja lämpöhäviöiden vuoksi. Tavoitteena on kehittää ilmarobotiikkaan jalämpökuvantamiseen perustuva järjestelmä, joka tunnistaa vuodot ja poikkeamatvarhaisessa vaiheessa ja tukee ennakoivaa huoltoa. 3. Oma ratkaisu Yritykset voivat ehdottaa omaa ilmatilaa hyödyntävää robotiikkaratkaisua, joka tukeekaupunkiympäristön turvallisuutta, valvontaa tai energiankäyttöä. Ratkaisun tuleehyödyntää maa-, vesi- tai ilmarobotiikkaa ja tuottaa dataa, joka tukee kaupunginpalveluita ja päätöksentekoa. Smart Ground – Toimiva ja kestävä kaupunki ympäri vuoden Toimiva ja kestävä kaupunki hyödyntää mobiilirobotiikkaa, dataa ja kiertotaloutta, jottakaupunkien infrastruktuuri, kunnossapito ja logistiikka toimivat saumattomasti vuodenjokaisena päivänä. Se on kaupungin hermosto, joka ylläpitää elinvoimaa ja palvelujensujuvuutta ilman katkoksia. 1. Infran kunnon seuranta ja mallinnus Kaupungilla on tuhansia kilometrejä katuja, pyöräteitä ja tunneleita, joiden kunnontarkastaminen on työlästä ja hajanaista. Tavoitteena on kehittää ratkaisu, joka tarjoaajatkuvan, ajantasaisen ja automaattisesti päivittyvän näkymän kaupungin infrastruktuurintilaan. 2. Talvikunnossapidon automaatio ja logistiikka Vuonna 2028 lumen mereen kaataminen kielletään, mikä edellyttää uusia tapoja hallitalumen keruuta ja käsittelyä. Tavoitteena on kehittää ennakoiva ja dataohjatturobotiikkaratkaisu, joka tukee lumen keräystä, kuljetusta, varastointia ja sulatustaympäristöystävällisesti ja kustannustehokkaasti. 3. Oma ratkaisu Yritykset voivat ehdottaa omaa, maaympäristöön soveltuvaa robotiikkaratkaisua, jokatehostaa kaupungin infrastruktuurin, kunnossapidon tai logistiikan toimintaa. Ratkaisu voihyödyntää maa-, vesi- tai ilmarobotiikkaa ja tuottaa kaupunkia hyödyttävää dataaesimerkiksi ympäristöstä, liikenteestä tai energiankäytöstä.

result.text: Essex County Council (ECC) is seeking information from suppliers who can provide an existing, fully developed, cloud based DBS processing platform to support its HR Shared Services Team. The team delivers recruitment and vetting services for ECC and external public sector customers. ECC is an established DBS Registered Body, Umbrella Organisation, & a Responsible Organisation and will continue operating in these capacities throughout the contract. All DBS applications must be submitted under ECC's Registered Body identity, with counter signatory duties remaining with ECC. The supplier will act solely as a processor and platform provider. The platform must support Basic, Standard and Enhanced DBS checks, provide comprehensive reporting to support invoicing and financial processes, offer customer self service capability, and operate with minimal impact on ECC's infrastructure. Suppliers must demonstrate appropriate business continuity arrangements (excluding any DBS initiated eBulk suspension) and provide training and knowledge transfer at mobilisation to enable ECC to train system users. ECC's current contract ends on 30 September 2026, and this early market engagement is being undertaken in preparation for that expiry. We aim to understand market capability, implementation timescales, indicative costs, and interest ahead of issuing our formal Request for Quotation (RFQ). We are keen to identify suppliers who wish to be included in the RFQ process. We look forward to hearing from interested suppliers as part of this early engagement exercise.

result.text: Gloucestershire ICB and Bristol, North Somerset and South Gloucestershire (BNSSG) ICB are merging to form a single integrated body in April 2027. Both organisations currently rely on external providers for the delivery of their IT services. A new, unified service model is required; one that supports the merged organisation from day one, is commercially sustainable, and is capable of evolving as the ICS matures. Six principles shape the design of the future service: 1. Cloud-first and 'secure by design'. All new and renewed services will be cloud-based wherever possible. On-premises infrastructure will be exited as part of transition. This is both a strategic choice and a compliance requirement under the Government Cloud First Policy and Technology Code of Practice. 2. Outcome-focused. The service is defined by what it must deliver, not how it must be delivered. The supplier is expected to bring expertise, innovation and accountability for outcomes, not simply execute a prescriptive technical specification. 3. Single point of accountability. The preferred model is a single managed service provider with end-to-end accountability for operational delivery. This avoids the fragmentation and unclear ownership that characterises the current multi-supplier landscape and reduces the management overhead on the ICB digital team. 4. Lean governance. The ICB digital team will provide strategic oversight, roadmap ownership and supplier governance. It will not carry operational delivery responsibilities. This reflects the lean, strategically focused character of the merged organisation and the direction set by the Model ICB Blueprint. 5. Interoperable by design. The service must integrate cleanly with nationally contracted NHS platforms, in particular NHS.net Connect, the Health and Social Care Network (HSCN) and NHS Secure Boundary Service, as well as local platforms, such as the Gloucestershire ICS WAN and into UHBW and Crown Datacentres in Corsham. Service interfaces with these platforms should be clearly defined before the procurement specification is finalised. 6. Sustainable. The ICB's carbon neutral commitments should be reflected in technology choices, including energy-efficient end-user devices, PoE-powered monitors and cloud-based infrastructure in preference to on-premises data centre equipment. The following service stacks are in scope for the new managed service, reflecting services currently provided across both incumbents, consolidated and extended to support the merged organisation: - Service desk. The primary user-facing support channel, available 08:00-18:00 Monday to Friday. - Desktop support. Onsite presence at both sites as and when required, including end-user support, moves, adds and changes to desktop arrangements, MFD, Audio Visual equipment, and Teams Room management. The onsite support model must include provision for routine physical tasks including WFH equipment management, peripheral replacement, cable and hardware swap-outs, and stock management. - End-user compute. Device lifecycle management including provisioning, refresh (five-year target cycle), configuration, and secure disposal. - Telephony and unified communications. Microsoft Teams Phone as the unified platform for the merged ICB. - Print. Cloud-managed secure print at both sites. - Meeting rooms. Physical teams Room management and audio-visual support at 2 locations with 15 meeting rooms at one and at Shire Hall, Gloucester and 9 at the second location. - Asset management. Asset tagging, recording, and lifecycle tracking for all ICB-owned IT equipment. - Supplier and procurement management. The supplier will assume management of all ongoing third-party technology relationships and will procure all IT equipment and recurring support contracts on behalf of the ICB. Licence management across the estate is required. - DSPT support. The supplier is expected to provide the ICB with the technical evidence and assurance data required to support annual DSPT submission, including patch management records, asset inventory, access control logs and incident reports. - Project, change and architecture. The supplier will own project and change management, problem management, and architecture design. - Digital signatures. Digital signature capability is required as part of the new service. Full details are provided in the service specification. The total maximum contract value for the initial 3-year Contract is £1,920,000 inclusive of VAT (where applicable). At the end of the initial contract term the Commissioner will have two, separate, consecutive one-year extension option periods that can be exercised at the discretion of the Commissioner, giving a maximum possible contract value of £2,700,000 inclusive of VAT (where applicable) over 5 years if the full contract term is fulfilled. The Commissioner is of the view that TUPE does not apply to this service. The Contracting Authority reserves the right to use the Direct Award procedure under the Procurement Act 2023 for any subsequent extensions or new contracts for similar requirements. The new contract will commence on 1st April 2027, although implementation of the services will start during January 2027. Lot 1: .

rejected.text: The project "Supporting a Just Transition in Mexico" aims to strengthen the capacities of key public, private and civil society actors to design and implement socially just decarbonisation processes in strategic sectors of the Mexican economy, with a particular focus in key industrial (incl. industrial parks) and the energy sector. The project is commissioned by the German Federal Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development (BMZ) and implemented by GIZ, with the Mexican Ministry of Economy (SE) as technical partner. It contributes to the BMZ core theme "Climate and energy", to Mexico's implementation of the Paris Agreement and Agenda 2030 SDGs 13, 9, 7, 5, 16 and 17. Mexico's export-oriented industrial model, the rapid expansion of industrial parks and rising energy demand create pressure and opportunities for low-carbon transformation. Building on the updated climate targets set out in Mexico's Nationally Determined Contribution (NDC), the country faces the challenge of turning these commitments into coherent implementation. Regulatory gaps, insufficient technical and financial capacities, and social and gender inequalities still limit progress towards a decarbonised economy. The project responds to these challenges by promoting an integrated approach that combines climate protection, industrial competitiveness and social justice. result.text: The contractor will support partners in assessing and designing regulatory and policy approaches to improve the business environment for low-carbon investments, and identifying opportunities where industrial decarbonisation can be aligned with energy transition planning, industrial policy, circular economy models and the use of green materials. All support is expected to systematically address social and gender dimensions, in line with the project's just transition approach. A second core area involves in-depth analytical work on mitigation potential and decarbonisation pathways for selected industrial parks and industrial clusters. This may include the development of emissions baselines and marginal abatement cost curves, scenario modelling for different technology and investment options, and the analysis of economic, social and environmental co-benefits under a just transition perspective. The contractor will work closely with GIZ and national partners to define the scope of these analyses and to translate findings into practical recommendations for policymakers, industrial park operators, companies and financial institutions. A third area of work is strategic communication and knowledge management. The contractor will support the development of narratives around just transition in the Mexican industrial sector and will produce communication and knowledge products such as policy briefs, reports, infographics, editorial and audiovisual materials. The services may also include conceptual and organisational support to events, dialogue formats and peer-learning activities, to disseminate lessons learned and good practices from pilot interventions in industrial parks and other industrial contexts. A fourth area focuses on capacity development. The contractor will design and implement training formats, workshops and other learning tools for key actors at national and subnational levels, including public institutions, industrial park operators, companies, financial institutions, academia and civil society. These activities aim to strengthen technical competencies and practical know-how on just transition, industrial decarbonisation, green and climate finance, circular economy and energy transition, with particular attention to the inclusion of women and groups in vulnerable situations. The contract is expected to run from February 2027 to August 2028. Primary target groups include key actors from the energy, industrial sectors and industrial park operators, as well as state-level economic and environmental authorities and relevant federal institutions. Secondary target groups comprise affected communities, labour representatives, civil society organisations and academic institutions. The assignment builds on and complements cooperation with national and international partners, including UNIDO, Mexican state-level associations such as AMSDE and ANAAE, and the Mexican Association of Private Industrial Parks (AMPIP). To deliver these services, the contractor is expected to provide a multidisciplinary expert team. This includes a team leader with strong experience in industrial decarbonisation and just transition, as well as experts in energy, industrial technologies and eco-industrial park developments, green and climate finance, social and gender impact analysis, strategic communication and capacity development. A pool of additional short-term specialists with national and international experience should be available to cover specific thematic and methodological needs. Bidders are expected to demonstrate substantial experience in climate change mitigation, industrial and energy transitions, and collaboration with public and private stakeholders, and previous work with international cooperation, preferably in Mexico or Latin America. The services will be delivered through a combination of on-demand support and the implementation of result-oriented activities and milestones agreed with GIZ. The assignment includes robust project and knowledge management, results-based monitoring and regular reporting, and must comply with GIZ requirements on data protection, information security, gender equality and environmental and climate safeguards.

result.text: Maintaining and rapidly enabling a digitally competent working society that contributes to a productive and competitive economy despite demographic change and skills shortages is in the strategic interest of the Federal Government. Securing the skills base is crucial, in particular, for the competitiveness of companies. In view of an ageing society, there is an urgent need for action to keep employees in companies under good and healthy working conditions for as long as possible, to tap into unused domestic potential, and to make the working world more inclusive and diverse. Digital technologies and, above all, Artificial Intelligence (AI) offer the opportunity to keep or integrate people with age-related, cognitive or mental impairments in the labour market for longer and in better health, and to create a work environment suitable for all ages and disabilities. The research contract to be awarded (performance period: 2027–2028) aims to identify the opportunities and needs of Small and Medium-sized Enterprises (SMEs) and employed persons with impairments regarding the use of technological support in the workplace, and thus to unlock workforce potentials with the aid of digitalisation and AI. Since there is as yet no systematic and comprehensive presentation of this, there is a need for practice-oriented and practicable scientific research into how SMEs can support employees with impairments through the deployment of new technologies (e.g. AI) in the workplace. A contribution is also to be made to safeguarding the experiential knowledge of employees and strengthening existing (advisory) structures by supporting overarching institutions (e.g. inclusion offices, chambers of industry and commerce, top-level business associations) in advising SMEs on issues relating to digital transformation. The research contract is being put out to tender across Europe as a Competitive Dialogue with a preceding call for competition. The services may be provided by a consortium. To achieve the set objectives, the contractors implementing the research project must perform at least the following work packages. The precise design is to be explained by the bidders within the framework of the Competitive Dialogue: 1. Basic research and needs analysis: o Conducting an empirical-exploratory study to identify and systematically present the needs of SMEs and their employees with impairments. o Creating an overview of suitable technological and AI-based solutions. o Suitability testing of AI technologies for specific fields of work; if suitability is lacking, the need for alternative solutions is to be demonstrated. 2. Implementation strategies and deployment: o Development of implementation proposals and assistance for the deployment and long-term use of the identified technologies. o Identification and creation of target-group-appropriate information media and channels. o Integration of feedback and evaluation through a co-creative approach. 3. Review and adjustment: o Review and testing of the developed information media and channels as well as their refinement and adjustment. o Testing the effectiveness of the (AI) support instruments. 4. Dissemination including a wide-reaching support offering across the board: o Continuous dissemination to reinforce the public impact of the project objectives and results. Addressees of the research contract: scientific institutions, universities and research institutions. Subject matter and addressees of the research measure: SMEs and overarching institutions, which are to be involved accordingly in the project implementation. The perspectives of affected employed persons, organisations and associations representing, advising and self-helping people with disabilities must also be taken into account.

parts.source: Der Erhalt und die zügige Befähigung einer digital kompetenten Arbeitsgesellschaft, die trotz demografischem Wandel und Fachkräftemangel zu einer produktiven und wettbewerbsfähigen Volkswirtschaft beiträgt, liegt im strategischen Interesse des Bundes. Für die Wettbewerbsfähigkeit von Unternehmen ist v.a. die Sicherung der Fachkräftebasis entscheidend. Angesichts einer alternden Gesellschaft besteht dringender Handlungsbedarf, die Beschäftigten möglichst lange unter guten und gesunden Arbeitsbedingungen in den Betrieben zu halten, ungenutzte inländische Potenziale zu erschließen und die Arbeitswelt inklusiver und diverser aufzustellen. Digitale Technologien und v.a. Künstliche Intelligenz (KI) bieten die Möglichkeit, Menschen mit altersbedingten, mit kognitiven oder mit psychischen Beeinträchtigungen länger und gesünder im Arbeitsmarkt zu halten oder zu integrieren und ein alters- und behinderungsgerechtes Arbeitsumfeld zu schaffen. Der zu vergebende Forschungsauftrag (Leistungszeitraum: 2027–2028) zielt auf die Identifikation der Möglichkeiten und Bedarfe von Kleinen und Mittleren Unternehmen (KMU) und Erwerbstätigen mit Beeinträchtigungen für die Nutzung technologischer Unterstützung im Betrieb und damit auf das Heben von Arbeitskräftepotenzialen mithilfe von Digitalisierung und KI. Da hierzu noch keine systematische und umfängliche Darstellung vorliegt, bedarf es der praxisorientierten und -tauglichen wissenschaftlichen Erforschung, wie KMU Beschäftigte mit Beeinträchtigungen durch den Einsatz neuer Technologien (z.B. KI) im Betrieb unterstützen können. Es soll auch ein Beitrag geleistet werden, das Erfahrungswissen der Beschäftigten zu sichern und bestehende (Beratungs-)Strukturen zu stärken, indem übergeordnete Institutionen (z.B. Inklusionsämter, Industrie- und Handelskammern, Wirtschafts-Spitzenverbände) unterstützt werden, KMU bei Fragen der digitalen Transformation zu beraten. Der Forschungsauftrag wird als Wettbewerblicher Dialog mit vorgeschaltetem Teilnahmewettbewerb europaweit ausgeschrieben. Die Leistungen können durch ein Konsortium erbracht werden. Um die gesetzten Ziele zu erreichen, sind durch die Auftragnehmenden, die das Forschungsvorhaben umsetzen, mind. folgende Arbeitspakete zu leisten. Die genaue Ausgestaltung soll durch die Bietenden im Rahmen des Wettbewerblichen Dialogs erläutert werden: 1. Grundlagenforschung und Bedarfsanalyse: o Durchführung einer empirisch-explorativen Studie zur Identifikation und systematischen Darstellung der Bedürfnisse von KMU und deren Beschäftigten mit Beeinträchtigungen. o Erstellung einer Übersicht geeigneter technologischer und KI-basierter Lösungen. o Eignungsprüfung von KI-Technologien für spezifische Arbeitsfelder; bei fehlender Eignung soll der Bedarf an alternativen Lösungen aufgezeigt werden. 2. Umsetzungsstrategien und Implementierung: o Erarbeitung von Umsetzungsvorschlägen und Hilfestellungen für die Implementierung und langfristige Nutzung der identifizierten Technologien. o Identifikation und Erstellung adressatengerechter Informationsmittel und -wege. o Einbindung von Feedback und Evaluation durch ko-kreativen Ansatz. 3. Überprüfung und Anpassung: o Überprüfung und Testung der entwickelten Informationsmittel und -wege sowie deren Präzisierung und Anpassung. o Prüfung der Wirksamkeit der (KI-)Unterstützungsinstrumente. 4. Dissemination inkl. eines breitenwirksamen Unterstützungsangebots in der Fläche: o Durchgängige Dissemination zur Verstärkung der Außenwirkung der Projektziele und -ergebnisse. Adressat*innen des Forschungsauftrags: Wissenschaftseinrichtungen, Hochschulen und Forschungsinstitutionen. Gegenstand und Adressat*innen der Forschungsmaßnahme: KMU und übergeordnete Institutionen, die entsprechend bei der Projektumsetzung einzubeziehen sind. Auch sind Perspektiven betroffener Erwerbstätiger, von Organisationen und Verbänden der Selbstvertretung, Beratung und Selbsthilfe von und für Menschen mit Behinderungen zu berücksichtigen.

result.text: The subject matter of the procurement under preparation provisionally comprises the following services: • Forwarding of e-invoices arriving for the Government • Digitisation of paper invoices and expense vouchers arriving for the Government • Forwarding of outgoing sales invoices, payment reminders and penalty interest invoices from the Government into digital channels (corporate e-invoice, consumer e-invoice, Suomi.fi messages service and other electronic mailbox services) • Forwarding of messages and direct payments relating to consumer e-invoicing (SI, RI and RP messages) • Forwarding of paper-format sales invoice materials departing from the Government to a printing, enveloping and distribution service (TKJ service of Suomi.fi messages) • Forwarding of procurement messages (forwarding of procurement messages arriving for and departing from the Government within the Peppol network) • Customer service relating to the service (service languages Finnish and Swedish), service level monitoring and reporting (e.g. daily confirmation reports for materials and monthly monitoring reports). Furthermore, the aim is that, where necessary during the contract period, the supplier also offers the following services: • forwarding of invoices to a mobile or other channel • forwarding of e-receipts During the preparation of the procurement, the intention is to survey the possibilities of including electronic mailboxes containing payment functionality in use as part of the procurement. Customers in the procurement are Finnish government agencies and institutions as well as extra-budgetary funds. The procurement under preparation does not plan to procure the following services: • Receivables monitoring (including the generation of payment reminders and penalty interest invoices) and debt collection services • Printing, enveloping and distribution of paper invoices sent from the Government This notice surveys operators in the field interested in tendering, with whom a market dialogue will be conducted. This notice does not invite tenders. Participation or non-participation in the market dialogue does not prevent participation in any potential competitive tendering. The prior information notice does not oblige the contracting entity to carry out the actual competitive tendering. Additional information Operators in the field interested in tendering are requested to register for the market dialogue no later than 15.1.2026 by filling in the contact details on the accompanying form: https://forms.office.com/e/k9w7btHubG The aim is that a market dialogue will be conducted with operators in the field interested in tendering who have reported their contact details between January 2026 and April 2026. More detailed information on the course of the market dialogue will be sent to those who have registered for the market dialogue during the market dialogue. The market dialogues will be conducted in Finnish. Hansel Oy acts in a consulting role in the procurement process.

Lisäksi tavoitteena on, että tarvittaessa sopimuskauden aikana toimittaja tarjoaa myös seuraavia palveluita: • laskujen välitys mobiili- tai muuhun kanavaan • e-Kuittien välitys Hankinnan valmistelun aikana on tarkoituksena kartoittaa mahdollisuudet käytettävien maksamisen toiminnallisuuden sisältävien sähköisten postilaatikoiden sisällyttämiseen osaksi hankintaa. Hankinnassa asiakkaita ovat Suomen valtion virastot ja laitokset sekä talousarvion ulkopuolella olevat rahastot. Valmisteilla olevalla hankinnalla ei ole suunnitteilla hankkia seuraavia palveluita: • Saatavien valvontaa (sisältäen maksukehotusten ja viivästyskorkolaskujen muodostamisen) ja perintäpalveluita • Valtiolta lähetettävien paperimuotoisten laskujen tulostusta, kuoritusta ja jakelua Tällä ilmoituksella kartoitetaan tarjoamisesta kiinnostuneita alan toimijoita, joiden kanssa tullaan käymään markkinavuoropuhelua. Ennakkotietoilmoitus ei velvoita hankintayksikköä toteuttamaan varsinaista tarjouskilpailua. Markkinavuoropuheluun ilmoittautuneille lähetetään tarkempaa tietoa markkinavuoropuhelun kulusta markkinavuoropuhelun aikana. Markkinavuoropuhelut käydään suomeksi. result.text: Provision, implementation, operation and maintenance of the complete technical infrastructure for the EUDI Wallet Support Organisation. Covers all systems from the self-service portal and ticket management to telephony, knowledge base and identity management. The subject of this tender is the award of services for the technical infrastructure of the EUDI Wallet Support Organisation (EWSO), known as tooling. The contractor shall implement, configure and commission: the ticket and CRM system, the knowledge base and FAQ portal, the in-app bot (or compatibility with the client's internal app bot solution), the telephony and IVR infrastructure, the connection and compatibility with the B2B portal: EUDI Hub, the IAM system, the central event log system and the redaction system. The contractor shall accompany the closed beta phase (Q4 2026) and the go-live phase (Q1 2027) with hypercare support and, following an orderly knowledge transfer, hand over operational system sovereignty to the client's internal team. The services comprise in particular EU-compliant infrastructure ((ISO 27001), no US CLOUD Act exposure), WCAG 21 compliance of all user front ends, a mandatory external penetration test prior to go-live as well as complete system documentation and training of the internal team.

Umfasst alle Systeme vom Self-Service-Portal über das Ticketmanagement bis hin zu Telefonie, Knowledge Base und Identity Management. Gegenstand dieser Ausschreibung ist die Vergabe von Leistungen für die Technische Infrastruktur der EUDI Wallet Support Organisation (EWSO), das sog. Tooling. Der Auftragnehmer implementiert, konfiguriert und nimmt in Betrieb: das Ticket- und CRM-System, die Knowledge Base und das FAQ-Portal, den In-App-Bot (oder die Kompatibilität zur Auftraggeber-internen App-Bot Lösung), die Telefonie- und IVR-Infrastruktur, die Anbindung und Kompatibilität zu dem B2B Portal: EUDI Hub, das IAM-System, das zentrale Event-Log-System und das Schwärzungssystem. Der Auftragnehmer begleitet die Closed-Beta-Phase (Q4 2026) und die Go-Live-Phase (Q1 2027) mit Hypercare-Support und übergibt nach geordnetem Wissenstransfer die operative Systemhoheit an das interne Team des Auftraggebers. Die Leistungen umfassen insbesondere die EU-konforme Infrastruktur ((ISO 27001), kein US-CLOUD-Act-Exposure), WCAG 21-Konformität aller Nutzer-Frontends, einen obligatorischen externen Penetrationstest vor Go-live sowie vollständige Systemdokumentation und Schulung des internen Teams.

result.text: Aarhus Universitet wishes to gain better knowledge of the market for procurement analysis and sustainability reporting systems and therefore invites suppliers and stakeholders to register their interest in participating in the market dialogue. The purpose of the market dialogue is to strengthen our knowledge base regarding existing solutions, technological possibilities and market players working with analysis and data support in the procurement area – with a particular focus on data quality and sustainability reporting. Our expectations for a procurement analysis system and sustainability solution are a system that, to the greatest extent possible, meets the attached use cases. result.text: Summary The Commonwealth War Graves Commission is preparing to tender for a comprehensive Facilities Management (FM) contract covering 37 sites across the United Kingdom. This contract will encompass a broad range of FM services to support operational efficiency, compliance, and sustainability across our estate. These sites can be from historic buildings, and cottages to container base sites. These sites may be owned or leased. We are seeking early engagement with the market to inform the development of our procurement strategy and ensure the opportunity is accessible, competitive, and aligned with industry best practices. Scope of Services The anticipated scope includes, but is not limited to: Hard FM Services: Planned and reactive maintenance, statutory compliance, building fabric repairs, electrical and mechanical services. Soft FM Services: Cleaning, waste management, pest control services. Helpdesk and CAFM Integration: Centralised helpdesk support and integration with Computer-Aided Facilities Management systems. Sustainability and Innovation: Support for energy efficiency, carbon reduction, and innovative service delivery models. Geographic Coverage The contract will cover sites located across England, Scotland, Wales, and Northern Ireland, with varying service requirements based on site type and usage. Market Engagement As part of our early market engagement, we are inviting potential suppliers to provide preliminary information to help shape the final procurement strategy. Interested parties are requested to submit details covering the following areas: Service Capabilities Overview of FM services offered (hard and soft services) Experience delivering multi-site contracts across varied sectors Innovation and sustainability initiatives within service delivery. Helpdesk and Portal Functionality Description of helpdesk operations (e.g., hours, staffing, escalation procedures) Overview of digital platforms or portals used for service requests, reporting, and performance tracking Integration capabilities with client CAFM systems or provision of proprietary systems. Geographical Coverage Regions currently serviced across the UK Ability to mobilise and support sites in remote or rural locations Subcontractor or partner network (if applicable) This information will be used to assess market capacity, inform the scope of the tender, and ensure alignment with operational needs across our UK estate. How to Participate Interested parties should register their interest via Contracts Finder and monitor updates for upcoming engagement events and documentation releases. Additional information: All expressions of Interest should be sent to the email address provided.
