result.text: In the field of road safety, the Safe System approach, recognised internationally and included in the “European Union Road Safety Policy 2021-2030” and the European Commission’s “Strategic Action Plan on Road Safety”, suggests acquiring greater knowledge about the different variables that influence road accidents —beyond the usual indicators, such as the number of accidents, deaths and serious injuries—, recommending the acquisition of other indicators, called Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), directly related to the prevention of deaths and injuries in traffic accidents. Among these indicators are the use of seat belts and child restraint systems, the use of helmets, vehicles travelling within the speed limit, drivers travelling within the legal blood alcohol limit, driver distractions and vehicle safety. These indicators constitute the object of this tender. parts.source: En el ámbito de la seguridad vial, el enfoque del Sistema Seguro, reconocido internacionalmente y recogido en la “Política de Seguridad Vial de la Unión Europea 2021-2030” y el “Plan de acción estratégico sobre seguridad vial” de la Comisión Europea, sugiere adquirir un mayor conocimiento sobre las distintas variables que influyen sobre la siniestralidad vial —más allá de los indicadores habituales, como el número de accidentes, fallecidos y heridos graves—, recomendando obtener otros indicadores, llamados Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), indicadores clave de rendimiento, directamente relacionados con la prevención de muertes y lesiones en accidentes de tráfico. Entre estos indicadores, se encuentran el uso del cinturón de seguridad y de sistemas de retención infantil, el uso del casco, los vehículos que circulan dentro del límite de velocidad, los conductores que circulan dentro del límite legal de tasa de alcohol en sangre, las distracciones al volante y la seguridad de los vehículos. Estos indicadores constituyen el objeto de la presente licitación. El objeto de este lote es el diseño de un muestreo para los lotes 2 y 3 y para el indicador de alcohol y Estudio EDAP, obtención de los KPI (salvo para el KPI 6, cuyos trabajos de cálculo quedan dentro del ámbito del lote 4), y elaboración del cuadro de mando.; El objetivo del lote 2 consiste en la realización de mediciones de la velocidad y otras características del flujo de vehículos en una muestra de 150 secciones de la red viaria española, con el fin de que sirvan de base para la elaboración y obtención del indicador KPI 1; Realización de trabajos de campo para la recogida de datos sobre el uso del cinturón de seguridad, sistemas de retención infantil (SRI), casco y conducción utilizando dispositivos móviles, mediante la realización de encuestas no participativas en una muestra de secciones de vías urbanas e interurbanas, que permitan al adjudicatario del lote 1 obtener estos indicadores (KPI 2, 3 y 5).; El objeto de este lote es la obtención del indicador de seguridad de los vehículos (KPI 6).; El objeto de este lote es la gestión y supervisión de trabajos de lotes 1,2,3 y 4.

rejected.text: The Eunice Kennedy Shriver National Institute of Child Health and Human Development (NICHD) intends to publish a Notice of Funding Opportunity (NOFO) to solicit applications for research on the impact of technology and digital media on children and adolescents. Technology and digital media (TDM) encompasses social media, applications, websites, television, motion pictures, artificial intelligence, mobile devices, computers, video games, virtual and augmented reality, and other content, networks, or platforms disseminated through the internet, broadcasted, or other media technologies, as applicable. Collectively, they have become an integral part of our children’s and families’ daily lives. Most children and adolescents now engage with TDM starting from an early age, often with high levels of exposure across multiple devices and contexts and involving a wide range of content. There is therefore an urgent need to understand how TDM use and exposure impacts children’s health and development, as well as how it alters the very nature of interactions between children and their family members, peers, and society at large. As TDM has evolved with breathtaking speed, our understanding of its impacts – whether positive, neutral, or negative – on children’s health and development has not kept pace. This initiative intends to address this expanding gap by inviting research proposals on the impact of TDM on children and adolescents, including potential broader effects on their families and communities. Please note that applications are not being solicited at this time . This notice is being provided to allow potential applicants sufficient time to develop meaningful collaborations and responsive projects. This NOFO will utilise a phased R61/R33 mechanism. Investigators with interests at the intersection of TDM and child/adolescent development are encouraged to apply. In addition, collaborative teams that combine expertise across domains such as behavioural sciences, cognition and learning, computational and statistical modelling, computer science, geographic information science, library and information sciences, neurodevelopment, paediatrics, social and affective development and social sciences will be encouraged, and these investigators should also consider applying for this opportunity.

rejected.text: Provision, implementation and operation of a cloud-based, SaaS-based data-centric security platform (DSP) for the analysis, monitoring and protection of data and access permissions in a hybrid IT environment (on-premises and cloud) of Stadtwerke Düsseldorf AG including affiliated companies. The objective of the procurement is to establish transparency regarding data holdings, access authorisations and security-relevant activities, as well as to support measures to increase information security and ensure compliance with regulatory requirements in the KRITIS environment. In addition to the provision of the platform, the service includes supporting services for the analysis, assessment and prioritisation of security-relevant events and for the derivation of appropriate measures. All data processing shall take place exclusively within the scope of the EU GDPR. An uninterrupted transition from an existing production-near operation must be ensured. Lot LOT-0001: Provision and operation of a SaaS-based data-centric security platform (DSP) for the analysis, monitoring and protection of data and access permissions. The objective is the conclusion of a contract for the provision, implementation and operation of a scalable, cloud-based data-centric security platform (DSP) for the analysis, monitoring and protection of data and access permissions in a hybrid IT environment (on-premises and cloud). The solution must cover the following functions and services in particular: - Analysis and assessment of data holdings, data access and permission structures, including the identification of potential security and data protection risks, - The solution shall have integrated functions for detecting anomalies in user and system behaviour (User and Entity Behaviour Analytics), - Establishment of transparency regarding effective access and permissions, - Detection and assessment of conspicuous, high-risk or security-relevant activities, - Provision of monitoring, reporting and evidence functions to support audit, compliance and security requirements, particularly in the regulated KRITIS environment, - Support in the derivation and implementation of appropriate measures for risk reduction (e.g. adjustment of permissions or restriction of access rights), - Integration into the client's existing hybrid system landscape (in particular identity services, file and cloud storage, and collaboration platforms) via standardised interfaces, - Provision and operation of the solution including maintenance, further development, updates and technical documentation in the SaaS model. Additionally, services are to be provided that support continuous evaluation, assessment and prioritisation (Managed Detection and Response) of security-relevant events and provide recommendations for action. If structured accordingly, these services may also include operational support services. Continued operation requirements: - Ensuring an uninterrupted transition from an existing production-near operation, including a suitable migration and transition concept, - Adoption of existing configurations, evaluations and settings as far as technically possible, - Guarantee of compatibility with existing system landscapes, role and permission models, - Minimisation of migration, integration and training efforts, taking into account cost-effectiveness over the entire life cycle, - Ensuring continuous operational capability during the transition phase. All services relating to the client's data or metadata must be provided exclusively within the scope of the EU GDPR.

parts.source: Bereitstellung, Implementierung und Betrieb einer cloudbasierten, SaaS-basierten Datenzentrierten Sicherheitsplattform (DSP) zur Analyse, Überwachung und zum Schutz von Daten und Zugriffsberechtigungen in einer hybriden IT-Umgebung (On-Premises und Cloud) der Stadtwerke Düsseldorf AG einschließlich verbundener Unternehmen. Ziel der Beschaffung ist die Herstellung von Transparenz über Datenbestände, Zugriffsbefugnisse und sicherheitsrelevante Aktivitäten sowie die Unterstützung von Maßnahmen zur Erhöhung der Informationssicherheit und zur Einhaltung regulatorischer Anforderungen im KRITIS-Umfeld. Die Leistung umfasst neben der Bereitstellung der Plattform auch unterstützende Leistungen zur Analyse, Bewertung und Priorisierung sicherheitsrelevanter Ereignisse sowie zur Ableitung geeigneter Maßnahmen. Die Verarbeitung sämtlicher Daten erfolgt ausschließlich im Geltungsbereich der EU-DSGVO. Ein unterbrechungsfreier Übergang aus einem bestehenden produktionsnahen Betrieb ist sicherzustellen. Lot LOT-0001: Bereitstellung und Betrieb einer SaaS-basierten Datenzentrierten Sicherheitsplattform (DSP) zur Analyse, Überwachung und zum Schutz von Daten und Zugriffsberechtigungen. Ziel ist der Abschluss eines Vertrages über die Bereitstellung, Implementierung und den Betrieb einer skalierbaren, cloudbasierten Datenzentrierten Sicherheitsplattform (DSP) zur Analyse, Überwachung und zum Schutz von Daten sowie Zugriffsberechtigungen in einer hybriden IT-Umgebung (On-Premises und Cloud). Die Lösung hat insbesondere folgende Funktionen und Leistungen abzudecken: - Analyse und Bewertung von Datenbeständen, Datenzugriffen und Berechtigungsstrukturen einschließlich der Identifikation potenzieller Sicherheits- und Datenschutzrisiken, - Die Lösung soll über integrierte Funktionen zur Erkennung von Anomalien im Nutzer- und Systemverhalten (User and Entity Behavior Analytics) verfügen - Herstellung von Transparenz über effektive Zugriffe und Berechtigungen, - Erkennung und Bewertung auffälliger, risikobehafteter oder sicherheitsrelevanter Aktivitäten, - Bereitstellung von Monitoring-, Reporting- und Nachweisfunktionen zur Unterstützung von Audit-, Compliance- und Sicherheitsanforderungen, insbesondere im regulierten KRITIS-Umfeld, - Unterstützung bei der Ableitung und Umsetzung geeigneter Maßnahmen zur Risikoreduzierung (z. B. Anpassung von Berechtigungen oder Einschränkung von Zugriffsrechten), - Integration in die bestehende hybride Systemlandschaft des Auftraggebers (insbesondere Identitätsdienste, Datei- und Cloudspeicher sowie Kollaborationsplattformen) über standardisierte Schnittstellen, - Bereitstellung und Betrieb der Lösung einschließlich Wartung, Weiterentwicklung, Updates und technischer Dokumentation im SaaS-Modell. Ergänzend sind Leistungen vorzusehen, die eine kontinuierliche Auswertung, Bewertung und Priorisierung (Managed Detection and Response) sicherheitsrelevanter Ereignisse unterstützen sowie Handlungsempfehlungen bereitstellen. Bei entsprechender Ausgestaltung können diese Leistungen auch operative Unterstützungsleistungen umfassen. Weiterbetriebsanforderungen: - Sicherstellung eines unterbrechungsfreien Übergangs aus einem bestehenden produktionsnahen Betrieb, einschließlich eines geeigneten Migrations- und Übergangskonzepts, - Übernahme vorhandener Konfigurationen, Auswertungen und Einstellungen soweit technisch möglich, - Gewährleistung der Kompatibilität mit bestehenden Systemlandschaften, Rollen- und Berechtigungsmodellen, - Minimierung von Migrations-, Integrations- und Schulungsaufwänden unter Berücksichtigung der Wirtschaftlichkeit über den gesamten Lebenszyklus, - Sicherstellung der kontinuierlichen Betriebsfähigkeit während der Übergangsphase. Sämtliche Leistungen mit Bezug zu Daten oder Metadaten des Auftraggebers sind ausschließlich im Geltungsbereich der EU-DSGVO zu erbringen.

result.text: The contracting authority is PD Berater der Öffentlichen Hand GmbH. A client of the contracting authority has established 2021 with the 'Quality Seal for Sustainable Buildings' (QNG), an umbrella brand for sustainable construction in Germany. The 'Quality Seal for Sustainable Buildings' (QNG) is intended to promote sustainable construction in Germany on a broad scale and to ensure a minimum quality for 'sustainable buildings'. Furthermore, it is intended to create a legally secure basis for the allocation of subsidies, which enables grants in the construction sector to be in accordance with social goals (sustainability goals). Since 2022 the contracting authority has been supporting the client with the development and establishment of a QNG office with all associated activities, such as a hotline, operation of a website and further development of the QNG requirements with the associated publications. In order to provide up-to-date information about the seal and the processes to be followed, the QNG website https://www.qng.info/ was developed and set up in the year 2022 with an external service provider. The QNG website represents a knowledge platform that processes ongoing developments and changes, and provides users with basic procedures, interfaces and assistance. The contract is awarded in two lots: - Lot 1: Hosting, further development and maintenance of the existing website - Lot 2: Technical support (expertise pool) for the 'Quality Seal for Sustainable Buildings' (QNG). The lot-specific tasks are described in more detail below. Bids may be submitted for one or both lots. Lot LOT-0001: Lot 1: Hosting, further development and maintenance of the existing website. The contractor shall undertake the continuous maintenance, operation, hosting, and provision of the server infrastructure for the operation of the already existing website. The services include: 1. Website maintenance, provision of licences 2. Website hosting and optimisation 3. Hosting and further development of an AI-based, self-learning chatbot. The contractor shall ensure a seamless transition from 01. January 2027. The contract has a term of 4 years. The basis for the commissioning in Lot 1 is an EVB-IT cloud contract. Lot LOT-0002: Lot 2: Technical support (expertise pool) for the 'Quality Seal for Sustainable Buildings' (QNG). The expertise pool is intended to provide support in advising on enquiries resulting from the application of the QNG in practice, as well as in the further development of the QNG requirements and the introduction and implementation phase of the revised requirements. The services include: • Support in the content-related further development of the quality seal • Support in the revision and quality assurance of the associated documents with regard to clarity and technical accuracy • Support in the creation or revision of accompanying materials such as FAQs and quick answers • Creation of training materials for certification bodies and auditors as part of the introduction of the revised requirements • Support in processing complex or technically demanding enquiries, if necessary support in the ongoing quality assurance of new FAQs and quick answers. The start of the service is 01.01.2027. The contract has a term of 4 years. The basis for the commissioning in Lot 2 is a service contract. There is no fixed acceptance quantity. The estimated volume is derived from the estimated quantity specified in the price sheet. The contract is limited to 280.000 euros.

parts.source: Auftraggeberin ist die PD Berater der Öffentlichen Hand GmbH. Eine Kundin der Auftraggeberin hat 2021 mit dem „Qualitätssiegel Nachhaltiges Gebäude“ (QNG) eine Dachmarke des nachhaltigen Bauens in Deutschland gegründet. Mit dem „Qualitätssiegel Nachhaltiges Gebäude“ (QNG) soll das nachhaltige Bauen in Deutschland in die Breite getragen werden und eine Mindestqualität für „nachhaltige Gebäude“ sichergestellt werden. Außerdem soll eine rechtssichere Grundlage für die Vergabe von Fördermitteln geschaffen werden, die Zuwendungen im Baubereich in Übereinstimmung mit gesellschaftlichen Zielen (Nachhaltigkeitszielen) ermöglicht. Seit 2022 unterstützt die Auftraggeberin die Kundin mit dem Aufbau und der Etablierung einer QNG Geschäftsstelle mit allen dazugehörigen Tätigkeiten, wie z.B. Hotline, Betrieb einer Website und Weiterentwicklung der QNG-Anforderungen mit den dazugehörigen Veröffentlichungen. Um aktuelle Informationen über das Siegel und den einzuhaltenden Prozessen zur Verfügung zu stellen, wurde im Jahr 2022 die QNG Website https://www.qng.info/ mit einem externen Dienstleister entwickelt und aufgebaut. Die QNG Website stellt eine Wissensplattform dar, die laufende Entwicklungen und Veränderungen aufarbeitet, grundsätzliche Abläufe, Schnittstellen sowie Hilfestelllungen den Nutzern bereit-stellt. Die Vergabe erfolgt in zwei Losen: - Los 1: Hosting, Weiterentwicklung und Betreuung der bestehenden Website - Los 2: Fachliche Unterstützung (Expertisepool) für das „Qualitätssiegel Nachhaltiges Gebäude“ (QNG). Die losspezifischen Aufgaben werden im Folgenden näher beschreiben. Geboten werden kann für ein oder für beide Lose. Lot LOT-0001: Los 1: Hosting, Weiterentwicklung und Betreuung der bestehenden Website. Der Auftragnehmer übernimmt das die kontinuierliche Betreuung, Betrieb, Hosting, Bereitstellung der Server-Infrastruktur für den Betrieb der bereits bestehenden Webseite. Zu den Leistungen gehören: 1. Website-Betreuung, Bereitstellung von Lizenzen 2. Website-Hosting und -Optimierung 3. Hosting und Weiterentwicklung eines KI-basierten, selbstlernenden Chatbots Der Auftragnehmer sorgt für einen nahtlosen Übergang ab dem 01. Januar 2027. Der Vertrag hat eine Laufzeit von 4 Jahren. Basis der Beauftragung in Los 1 ist ein EVB-IT Cloudvertrag. Lot LOT-0002: Los 2: Fachliche Unterstützung (Expertisepool) für das „Qualitätssiegel Nachhaltiges Gebäude“ (QNG). Der Expertisepool soll bei der Beratung zu Anfragen, die aus der Anwendung des QNG in der Praxis resultieren, unterstützen sowie bei der Weiterentwicklung der QNG-Anforderungen und der Einführungs- und Implementierungsphase der überarbeiteten Anforderungen. Zu den Leistungen gehören: • Unterstützung bei der inhaltlichen Weiterentwicklung des Qualitätssiegels • Unterstützung bei der Überarbeitung und Qualitätssicherung der zugehörigen Dokumente hinsichtl. Verständlichkeit und fachlicher Richtigkeit • Unterstützung bei der Erstellung bzw. Überarbeitung begleitender Materialien wie FAQ und Schnellantworten • Erstellung von Schulungsunterlagen für die Zertifizierungsstellen und Auditor:innen im Rahmen der Einführung der überarbeiteten Anforderungen • Unterstützung bei der Bearbeitung komplexer oder fachlich anspruchs- voller Anfragen, ggf. Unterstützung bei der fortlaufenden Qualitätssicherung von neuen FAQs und Schnellantworten Leistungsbeginn ist der 01.01.2027. Der Vertrag hat eine Laufzeit von 4 Jahren. Basis der Beauftragung in Los 2 ist ein Dienstvertrag. Es besteht keine feste Abnahmemenge. Das geschätzte Volumen ergibt sich aus der im Preisblatt angegebenen Schätzmenge. Der Vertrag ist begrenzt auf 280.000 Euro.

rejected.text: HUS (myöhemmin myös hankintayksikkö tai tilaaja) pyytää osallistumishakemuksia kuvantamisratkaisua ja siihen liittyviä palveluja koskevassa hankinnassa. Hankinta toteutetaan kilpailullisena neuvottelumenettelynä (ks. liite 1 Menettelyn kuvaus). Hankinnan kohteena on kuvantamisratkaisun ja siihen liittyvien palveluiden hankinta. Hankinta koskee kuvien arkistointi- ja viestintäjärjestelmää (PACS), joka on tarkoitus korvata uudella ratkaisulla. Järjestelmäkokonaisuuteen voi kuulua myös radiologian tietojärjestelmän toiminnallisuuksia (RIS), tavoitteiden täyttymistä edistävä tekoälyalusta (AI-platform), ajanvaraukseen liittyvät toiminnallisuudet sekä puheentunnistusratkaisu. Tavoitteena on, että palvelupolku ajanvarauksen, radiologisen tietojärjestelmän (RIS), sekä kuvien arkistointi- ja viestintäjärjestelmän (PACS) välillä toimii optimaalisella tavalla. Asiakaskokemusta on tarkoitus kehittää yhtenäisen palvelumallin pohjalta. Tavoitteena on, että potilaille pystytään tarjoamaan tehokkaampaa diagnostiikkaa sekä hyvää hoitoa myös tulevaisuudessa. Tavoitteena on myös vähentää manuaalista ja päällekkäistä työtä. Kuvantamisratkaisun tulee olla sellainen, että se mahdollistaa sujuvan työskentelyn kaikille käyttäjäryhmille ja prosessien kehittämisen tuottavuuden lisäämiseksi. Käyttöönottoprojektiin voi sisältyä kuvien, kuvien metadatan ja RIS-datan migraatio tilaajan nykyisestä PACS-järjestelmästä. Palveluun sisältyy tuki- ja ylläpitotoimintaa ja siihen voi sisältyä myös 1. tason tuki toimittajalta. Lisäksi tavoitteena on selvittää ratkaisuja skaalautuvuuden osalta myös digipatologian ja kuvantamisen yhteisestä arkistointiratkaisusta. Tarkempi kuvaus nykytilasta, hankittavasta kuvantamisratkaisusta sekä hankintaan sisältyvistä palveluista on nähtävissä liitteessä 2 Kuvantamisen järjestelmien nyky- ja tavoitetilakuvaus. Huomioittehan myös muut osallistumispyynnön liitteet (Liitteet 2.1–2.6, ja 4), joissa on kuvattu lisätietoa nyky- ja tavoitetilasta. Kyseiset liitteet eivät sido hankintayksikköä hankinnan myöhemmissä vaiheissa ja voivat muuttua neuvottelujen aikana. Jos asiakirjat on laadittu sekä suomeksi että englanniksi, tulkinnan ristiriitatilanteissa suomenkielinen teksti on ensisijainen. Osallistumishakemus sekä siihen liittyvä dokumentaatio ja tarkentavat kysymykset on toimitettava suomen tai englannin kielellä osallistumispyynnössä kuvattujen ohjeiden mukaisesti. English translation: HUS (hereinafter also referred to as the Contracting Authority or Client) requests to participate in the procurement of imaging solution and related services. The procurement will be carried out through a competitive dialogue procedure (see Annex 1: Description of the Procedure). The object of the procurement is imaging solution and related services. This procurement concerns the Picture Archiving and Communication System (PACS), which is intended to be replaced with a new solution. The solution entity may also include functionalities of a Radiology Information System (RIS), an artificial intelligence (AI) platform designed to support the achievement of the objectives, and functionalities related to appointment booking/scheduling, as well as a speech recognition solution. The objective is to ensure that the service path between appointment booking system, the radiological information system (RIS), and the picture archiving and communication system (PACS) operates optimally. The aim is to develop customer experience based on a unified service model. The objective is to provide patients with more efficient diagnostics and good care also in the future. In addition, the objective is to reduce the manual and overlapping work. The imaging solution must enable smooth workflows for all user groups and support the development of processes to improve productivity. The deployment project may include the migration of images, image metadata, and RIS data from the Client’s current PACS system. The service includes support and maintenance activities and may also include first-level support provided by the Supplier. The objective is also to explore solutions for scalability regarding a joint archiving solution for digital pathology and imaging. A more detailed description of the current state, the solution to be procured, and the services included in the procurement can be found in Annex 2: Current and target state description of imaging systems. Please also take into account the other annexes to the request to participate (Annexes 2.1–2.6 and 4), which provide additional information on the current and target state. parts.source: HUS (myöhemmin myös hankintayksikkö tai tilaaja) pyytää osallistumishakemuksia kuvantamisratkaisua ja siihen liittyviä palveluja koskevassa hankinnassa. Hankinta toteutetaan kilpailullisena neuvottelumenettelynä (ks. liite 1 Menettelyn kuvaus). Hankinnan kohteena on kuvantamisratkaisun ja siihen liittyvien palveluiden hankinta. Hankinta koskee kuvien arkistointi- ja viestintäjärjestelmää (PACS), joka on tarkoitus korvata uudella ratkaisulla. Järjestelmäkokonaisuuteen voi kuulua myös radiologian tietojärjestelmän toiminnallisuuksia (RIS), tavoitteiden täyttymistä edistävä tekoälyalusta (AI-platform), ajanvaraukseen liittyvät toiminnallisuudet sekä puheentunnistusratkaisu. Tavoitteena on, että palvelupolku ajanvarauksen, radiologisen tietojärjestelmän (RIS), sekä kuvien arkistointi- ja viestintäjärjestelmän (PACS) välillä toimii optimaalisella tavalla. Asiakaskokemusta on tarkoitus kehittää yhtenäisen palvelumallin pohjalta. Tavoitteena on, että potilaille pystytään tarjoamaan tehokkaampaa diagnostiikkaa sekä hyvää hoitoa myös tulevaisuudessa. Tavoitteena on myös vähentää manuaalista ja päällekkäistä työtä. Kuvantamisratkaisun tulee olla sellainen, että se mahdollistaa sujuvan työskentelyn kaikille käyttäjäryhmille ja prosessien kehittämisen tuottavuuden lisäämiseksi. Käyttöönottoprojektiin voi sisältyä kuvien, kuvien metadatan ja RIS-datan migraatio tilaajan nykyisestä PACS-järjestelmästä. Palveluun sisältyy tuki- ja ylläpitotoimintaa ja siihen voi sisältyä myös 1. tason tuki toimittajalta. Lisäksi tavoitteena on selvittää ratkaisuja skaalautuvuuden osalta myös digipatologian ja kuvantamisen yhteisestä arkistointiratkaisusta. Tarkempi kuvaus nykytilasta, hankittavasta kuvantamisratkaisusta sekä hankintaan sisältyvistä palveluista on nähtävissä liitteessä 2 Kuvantamisen järjestelmien nyky- ja tavoitetilakuvaus. Huomioittehan myös muut osallistumispyynnön liitteet (Liitteet 2.1–2.6, ja 4), joissa on kuvattu lisätietoa nyky- ja tavoitetilasta. Kyseiset liitteet eivät sido hankintayksikköä hankinnan myöhemmissä vaiheissa ja voivat muuttua neuvottelujen aikana. Jos asiakirjat on laadittu sekä suomeksi että englanniksi, tulkinnan ristiriitatilanteissa suomenkielinen teksti on ensisijainen. Osallistumishakemus sekä siihen liittyvä dokumentaatio ja tarkentavat kysymykset on toimitettava suomen tai englannin kielellä osallistumispyynnössä kuvattujen ohjeiden mukaisesti. result.text: SUBJECT OF PROCUREMENT Yleisradio Oy (hereinafter “Yle”) is preparing a tender process for basic IT services. The subject of procurement is a service package that includes - end-user support services, including Service Desk (SD) on-site and remote support services, a physical service desk known as a Walk-in Desk, and comprehensive end-device environment support, lifecycle and expert services - comprehensive operating and capacity as well as server room management services - information security services - cloud services and identity management - high-quality expert services. Yle is seeking a total supplier to act as an ICT partner both in the commissioning of new services and in the maintenance and development of existing services. As part of the preparation of the procurement, we are publishing this information request. Our objective is to improve understanding of the services available on the market before publishing the contract notice. The annexes to the information request can be found in the Cloudia tender service or by request: tarjoukset.yle@yle.fi. DESCRIPTION OF THE SUBJECT OF PROCUREMENT AND TECHNICAL QUESTIONS The subject of procurement is described in more detail in annex 1 of the information request (Description of the subject of procurement); annex 1 is confidential. Participants in the information request must sign the non-disclosure agreement appended to the information request in order to receive annex 1 of the information request and the question list regarding technical questions relating to the subject of procurement. Please note that annex 1 will be delivered only against a non-disclosure agreement and for the purpose of preparing responses to the information request. Send the signed non-disclosure agreement to tarjoukset.yle@yle.fi and mark the subject line of the message as "Non-disclosure agreement - your company name - YLE20250044". Yle has planned to carry out the procurement through a competitive dialogue, and the related call for participation is intended to be published in autumn 2026. GENERAL QUESTIONS We kindly ask you to submit your responses to the procurement-related questions by email by Monday 23.3.2026 at 12:00 to tarjoukset.yle@yle.fi. We ask you to answer the following procurement-related questions. Please keep the responses concise and succinct, while including the most essential information. Written responses should be kept concise, with a maximum length of four A4 pages. Responses to reference requirements are to be recorded in annex 2 (Reference requirements). Responses to technical questions are to be recorded in annex 3 (Technical questions, Information request); note that annex 3 is a confidential annex. 1) Your service and operating model a) Are you able to provide all the services that are the subject of the information request? b) How do you arrange on-site support services for the customer? c) How do you arrange the customer's server room management? d) What capability do you have to handle the management of Azure and Google cloud platforms, including information security, identity and access management? 2. Your experience and references a) Yle has drafted preliminary reference requirements in annex 2. Please comment on the reference requirements as described in the annex and attach annex 2 to your response. 3. Open floor. For example, you can highlight matters that you have noticed are important in similar procurements or assignments. GENERAL INFORMATION REGARDING THE INFORMATION REQUEST This document is not a procurement notice or call for tenders, but an information request published as part of a market survey. Yle will treat responses to the information request as confidential and will use them solely in preparing the call for tenders and the procurement process. Answering the questions does not oblige your company to participate in the actual tendering process. On the other hand, even if you do not answer these questions, you may participate in the tendering process at a later stage. Answering will not affect your company's position in the actual tendering process. The market survey does not oblige Yle to carry out the procurement in the manner described in the information request. Nor is Yle obliged to take account of responses received to the information request when drawing up the call for tenders. We may carry out the tendering process differently, postpone its schedule or decide not to carry it out at all. Decisions on launching a potential procurement process will be made only after the market survey. Those who have responded to the information request will not be paid any compensation for responding to the information request, nor will any costs possibly arising therefrom be reimbursed.

parts.source: HANKINNAN KOHTEESTA Yleisradio Oy (myöhemmin “Yle”) valmistelee perustietotekniikkapalveluiden kilpailutusta. result.text: The subject of the tender is the award of a concession for the planning, construction and operation of an ecologically sustainable, secure and high-performance Gigabit network in an FTTB/FTTH structure in the defined, underserved expansion area. The subject of the tender is the award of a concession for the planning, construction and operation of an ecologically sustainable, secure and high-performance Gigabit network in an FTTB/FTTH structure in the defined, underserved expansion area. The objective is the comprehensive provision of broadband telecommunications services, in particular telephony and high-bitrate internet access products, for both private and business customers. The scope of services also includes all necessary planning and coordination services. If an alternative, technologically equivalent network structure is intended, the equivalence must be demonstrated in a plausible and comprehensible manner as part of the bid. The planning, expansion and commissioning of the Gigabit network must be carried out in such a way that overall completion and operational readiness are achieved, if possible, by the end of 2027. Partial commissioning does not count as acceptance. Bidders must clearly and comprehensibly explain in their bids whether and how they will meet and implement the stated requirements for the operation of the Gigabit network. Full reference is made to the details in Annex 2 Description of Services. The project is funded as follows: - Directive 'Funding to support the Gigabit expansion of telecommunications networks in the Federal Republic of Germany' – in the amended version of 30.04.2024 (Gigabit Directive 2.0) - Directive on the co-financing of the funding of Gigabit expansion by the Federal Government in the Free State of Bavaria 2.0 (Bavarian Gigabit Co-financing Directive 2.0 – KofGibitR 2.0) of 20.07.2023 The contractor must comply with all requirements of the grant notifications underlying the project, including ancillary provisions, notices, conditions, leaflets and annexes, as well as the relevant funding programmes. It is pointed out that the so-called total project volume must not be exceeded. This means that, when submitting a bid, the maximum permissible economic gap must not exceed the 'Total Financing' amount shown in the associated grant notification. Exceeding this amount will lead to the exclusion of the bid from the further procedure.

parts.source: Gegenstand der Ausschreibung ist die Vergabe einer Konzession zur Planung, Errichtung und zum Betrieb eines ökologisch nachhaltigen, sicheren und hochleistungsfähigen Gigabit-Netzes in FTTB-/FTTH-Struktur im definierten, unterversorgten Ausbaugebiet. Gegenstand der Ausschreibung ist die Vergabe einer Konzession zur Planung, Errichtung und zum Betrieb eines ökologisch nachhaltigen, sicheren und hochleistungsfähigen Gigabit-Netzes in FTTB-/FTTH-Struktur im definierten, unterversorgten Ausbaugebiet. Ziel ist die flächendeckende Versorgung mit breitbandigen Telekommunikationsdiensten, insbesondere Telefonie- und hochbitratigen Internetzugangsprodukten, sowohl für Privat- als auch Geschäftskunden. Bestandteil der Leistung sind auch alle erforderlichen Planungs- und Abstimmungsleistungen. Sofern eine alternative, technologisch gleichwertige Netzstruktur vorgesehen ist, ist die Gleichwertigkeit im Rahmen des Angebots plausibel und nachvollziehbar darzulegen. Die Planung, der Ausbau und die Inbetriebnahme des Gigabit-Netzes müssen so erfolgen, dass die Gesamtfertigstellung und Betriebsbereitschaft möglichst bis spätestens Ende 2027 erreicht werden. Teilinbetriebnahmen gelten nicht als Abnahme. Die Bieter müssen in ihren Angeboten klar und nachvollziehbar erläutern, ob und wie sie die genannten Anforderungen an den Betrieb des Gigabit-Netzes erfüllen und umsetzen werden. Auf die Ausführungen in Anlage 2 Leistungsbeschreibung wird vollumfänglich verwiesen. Das Projekt wie folgt gefördert: - Richtlinie „Förderung zur Unterstützung des Gigabitausbaus der Telekommunikationsnetze in der Bundesrepublik Deutschland“ – in der Änderungsfassung vom 30.04.2024 (Gigabit-Richtlinie 2.0) - Richtlinie über die Kofinanzierung der Förderung des Gigabitausbaus durch den Bund im Freistaat Bayern 2.0 (Bayerische Kofinanzierungs-Gigabitrichtlinie 2.0 – KofGibitR 2.0) vom 20.07.2023 Vom Auftragnehmer sind sämtliche Vorgaben der dem Projekt zugrundeliegenden Zuwendungsbescheide mit Nebenbestimmungen, Hinweisen, Auflagen, Merkblättern und Anlagen sowie der einschlägigen Förderprogramme einzuhalten. Es wird darauf hingewiesen, dass das sogenannte Gesamtprojektvolumen nicht überschritten werden darf. Dies bedeutet, dass im Rahmen der Angebotsabgabe die maximal zulässige Wirtschaftlichkeitslücke den im zugehörigen Zuwendungsbescheid ausgewiesenen Betrag „Gesamtfinanzierung“ nicht überschreiten darf. Eine Überschreitung führt zum Ausschluss des Angebots vom weiteren Verfahren.

result.text: Modernisation of the central firewall system in Forschungsverbund Berlin e.V. The aim of the project is the modernisation of the overall firewall and security architecture, including next-generation endpoint protection for the research association. The future solution must meet current and future requirements for information security, availability, scalability, multi-tenancy, traceability of administrative activities and economical operation. General requirements for the new firewall structure: - Multi-tier firewall structure with centrally operated perimeter firewall cluster and segmentation firewall clusters per institute, whereby different manufacturers must be provided (dual-vendor strategy) B-criterion in BM - VLAN- and IP-based institute-related segmentation - Virtual domains for segmentation of the corporate IT perimeter firewall - At least two appliances per geographical location in active-passive operation - Expansion of backbone throughput to 10 gigabits per second with the option of expansion to 40 gigabits per second without replacing the hardware, as well as loop-free network design - Number of concurrent sessions: 20.000 to 65.000; number of VPN uses per institute: at least 40 to 70 users; maximum all employees in the FVB (1.600 employees) - Consideration of QoS mechanisms for VoIP and latency-sensitive applications - Granular, association-wide uniform role and authorisation concept for administrative access - Multi-factor authentication for users (native or via identity provider) and administrators (native) - NGFW functionalities: o IPS and IDS o Application IP o Geo-IP filter - Separation of networks (e.g. laboratory networks) via VLAN - Central DNS security service, DoS defence, content filtering and advanced threat protection as well as the integration of external blacklists at the perimeter level - Powerful and practicable DoS defence - Common, multi-tenant WAF service for web applications - Platform support for VPN access for Windows, Linux and MacOS - Compliance check for all operating systems - Central management for perimeter (mandatory) and segmentation firewalls (optional) - Tenant separation with granular graduation of administration rights - Open interfaces to support REST- or XML-based APIs, Syslog, Net-Flow/IPFIX, SAML, LDAP, RADIUS and other standard market integration interfaces - Remote access: the support of established procedures with split tunnelling and carrier-grade NAT must be provided - Identification of institute affiliation, for example via certificates or naming conventions - SSL interception (inbound for published services as well as outbound for critical servers/clients - Email security, multi-tenant, optionally acquirable per institute - Sandbox functions - Out-of-band management - At least an interface for the automatic integration of certificates - IPv6 future-proofing (a conversion to IPv6 is not planned within the scope of the project) - Central, multi-tenant log management with a retention period of at least three months, local buffering or short-term fallback retention and interfaces to a potential SIEM - Tenant-related and institute-specific logging Suitable support and service services must be offered for the procured hardware, software, subscriptions and management components. These include fault clearance, maintenance, software support, manufacturer and system house support, hardware replacement, patch and release management, operational support and a comprehensible escalation process. The availability of the future solution must be set at at least 99,9 % per year. The specific SLA design, in particular response times, recovery times, service times, scheduled change windows and emergency changes, will be discussed jointly in dialogue taking into account redundancy, cost-effectiveness and operational risk. In addition, NOC services with security analysis must be provided by the future service provider. Pure SOC services are to be treated as a supplementary option or add-on. For SOC-related services, in particular monitoring, triage, analysis, alarming, initial processing, incident response, reporting chains, on-call duty, multi-tenancy, SIEM/SOAR connection, log sources, sensor technology, reporting and communication channels must be considered.

parts.source: Modernisierung des zentralen Firewall-Systems im Forschungsverbund Berlin e.V. Ziel des Vorhabens ist die Modernisierung der Firewall- und Security-Gesamtarchitektur inkl. einer Next Generation Endpoint Protection des Forschungsverbundes. Die künftige Lösung muss den aktuellen und zukünftigen Anforderungen an Informationssicherheit, Verfügbarkeit, Skalierbarkeit, Mandantenfähigkeit, Nachvollziehbarkeit administrativer Tätigkeiten und einen wirtschaftlichen Betrieb entsprechen. Generelle Anforderungen an die neue Firewall-Struktur: - Mehrstufige Firewall-Struktur mit zentral betriebenem Perimeter-Firewall-Cluster und Segmentierungs-Firewall-Clustern je Institut, wobei unterschiedliche Hersteller vorgesehen werden müssen (Dual-Vendor-Strategie) B-Kriterium in BM - VLAN- und IP-basierte institutsbezogene Segmentierung - Virtuelle Domains für Segmentierung der Perimeter-Firewall der Corporate IT - Mindestens zwei Appliances pro geografischem Standort im Active-Passive-Betrieb - Ausbau des Backbone-Durchsatzes auf 10 Gigabit pro Sekunden mit Möglichkeit zur Erweiterung auf 40 Gigabit pro Sekunde ohne Austausch der Hardware sowie schleifenfreie Auslegung des Netzes - Anzahl gleichzeitiger Session: 20.000 bis 65.000; Anzahl VPN-Nutzung je Institut: mindestens 40 bis 70 Nutzer; maximal alle Mitarbeitenden im FVB (1.600 Mitarbeitenden) - Berücksichtigung von QoS-Mechanismen für VoIP und latenzsensible Anwendungen - Granulares, verbundweites einheitliches Rollen- und Berechtigungskonzept für administrative Zugriffe - Multifaktor-Authentifizierung für Benutzer (nativ oder über Identity-Provider) und Administratoren (nativ) - NGFW-Funktionalitäten: o IPS und IDS o Application IP o Geo-IP-Filter - Separierung von Netzen (z.B. Labornetze) via VLAN - Zentraler DNS-Security-Service, DoS-Abwehr, Content-Filterung und Advanced-Threat- Protection sowie die Einbindung externer Blacklists auf Perimeter-Ebene - Leistungsfähige und praktikable DoS-Abwehr - Gemeinsamer, mandantenfähiger WAF-Service für Web-Anwendungen - Plattformunterstützung beim VPN-Zugang für Windows, Linux und MacOS - Compliance-Prüfung für alle Betriebssysteme - Zentrales Management für Perimeter- (zwingend) und Segmentierungsfirewalls (optional) - Mandantentrennung mit granularer Abstufung von Administrationsrechten - Offene Schnittstellen zur Unterstützung von REST- oder XML-basierten APIs, Syslog, Net-Flow/IPFIX, SAML, LDAP, RADIUS und weiteren marktüblichen Integrationsschnittstellen - Remote Access: die Unterstützung etablierter Verfahren mit Split-Tunneling und Carrier-Grade-NAT ist vorzusehen - Identifikation der Institutszugehörigkeit, zum Beispiel über Zertifikate oder Namenskonventionen - SSL-Interception (Inbound für veröffentlichte Dienste sowie Outbound für kritische Server/Clients - E-Mail-Security, mandantenfähig, optional erwerbbar je Institut - Sandbox-Funktionen - Out-of-Band-Management - Mind. Schnittstelle zur automatischen Einbindung von Zertifikaten - IPv6-Zukunftsfähigkeit (eine Umstellung auf IPv6 im Rahmen des Projekts ist nicht geplant) - Zentrales, mandantenfähiges Log-Management mit mindestens dreimonatiger Vorhaltezeit, lokaler Pufferung beziehungsweise kurzzeitiger Fallback-Vorhaltung und Schnittstellen zu einem möglichen SIEM - Mandantenbezogenes und institutsspezifisches Logging Für die beschaffte Hardware, Software, Subskriptionen und Managementkomponenten sind geeignete Support- und Serviceleistungen anzubieten. Dazu gehören Störungsbeseitigung, Wartung, Softwarepflege, Hersteller- und Systemhaus-Support, Hardwaretausch, Patch- und Release-Management, Betriebsunterstützung sowie ein nachvollziehbarer Eskalationsprozess. Die Verfügbarkeit der künftigen Lösung ist mit mindestens 99,9 % pro Jahr anzusetzen. Die konkrete SLA-Ausgestaltung, insbesondere Reaktionszeiten, Wiederherstellungszeiten, Servicezeiten, planmäßige Änderungsfenster und Notfalländerungen, wird im Dialog unter Berücksichtigung von Redundanz, Wirtschaftlichkeit und Betriebsrisiko gemeinsam diskutiert. Darüber hinaus müssen NOC-Leistungen mit Security-Analyse vom zukünftigen Dienstleister erbracht werden. Reine SOC-Leistungen sind als ergänzende Option beziehungsweise Add-on zu behandeln. Für SOC-nahe Leistungen sind insbesondere Monitoring, Triage, Analyse, Alarmierung, Erstbearbeitung, Incident Response, Meldeketten, Rufbereitschaft, Mandantenfähigkeit, SIEM-/SOAR-Anbindung, Logquellen, Sensorik, Reporting und Kommunikationswege zu betrachten.

result.text: This invitation to tender ('ITT') relates to Lake District National Park Authority's (the 'Authority') procurement for a Countryside Land Management and Estate Maintenance Framework Agreement, for our Ranger Services Team and others. Successful Tenderers will be appointed onto a multi-supplier Framework Agreement divided into Lots. The Framework Agreement will be available for use by the Authority and by other bodies in the Authority's network by prior agreement. The Authority is seeking a mix of contractors to bid for a place on the Framework Agreement, including companies, consultants, sole traders, and Small and Medium Sized Enterprises. This procurement is divided into Lots (and sub-lots in the case of Lot 4). Suppliers may bid for one or more Lots/sub-lots provided that you can supply at least one of the services mentioned in the Lot Specification at Table A. Please note that you do not need to be able to provide all of the services listed in the Lot specification, provided you can supply at least one of the services mentioned in that Lot you may submit a tender. All Prices should be submitted as a maximum for provision of your goods/services and will be a commitment for the duration of the Framework Agreement, subject to the allowed increase in price annually. This Framework Agreement will allow for Direct Award and Further Competition of Call-off Contracts. Tenderers should read the instructions contained in this ITT carefully before submitting a response. Failure to comply with the requirements set out in this ITT may result in the rejection of the Tender. Tenderers are advised to acquaint themselves fully with the extent and nature of the goods and/or services in the Statement of Requirement and with the Terms and Conditions. Participation in this procurement automatically signals that the Tenderer accepts the Terms and Conditions contained in this ITT. If a Tenderer is awarded a place on any Lot of the Framework, a draft Framework Agreement will be provided after all awards have taken place (est. February - March 2027). Any award is not legally binding and subject-to-contract until the final Framework Agreement between the Authority and the Tenderer is signed. The Lake District National Park Authority looks after the Lake District National Park, encouraging people to enjoy and understand its beauty and supporting those who live and work here. Further information about the LDNPA, including our statutory functions, is available on our website. We are working towards making the Lake District an inspirational example of sustainable development in action. We want its prosperous economy, world class visitor experiences and vibrant communities to come together in sustaining the spectacular landscape, wildlife and cultural heritage here. Details of how we are doing this are outlined in our Vision: Our purpose and vision - Lake District National Park Our Ranger Services Team at LDNPA has a focus on maintaining and improving the Rights of Way and other access in the Lake District National Park, while encouraging and educating users in responsible outdoor recreation on accessible land and navigable lakes. They support visitor management and nature recovery initiatives, and the enhancement and maintenance of our rural properties, in line with our strategic priorities. They work closely with communities to help them meet their needs in ways that contribute to our Vision. The Ranger Team's workload includes project work, such as the Coast-to-Coast and Fix the Fells. The Historic Environment Team commissions specialist consultancy support to inform the conservation, management and enhancement of the National Park's historic environment. This may include heritage impact assessments, conservation area appraisals, historic building recording, conditions surveys, archaeological investigations, landscape and townscape character assessments, design advice, and other specialist heritage and built environment studies to support planning, conservation and place-shaping objectives. Our needs are specific and will vary. We are looking for Suppliers who understand the work we do and not only can provide exceptional services, but who can contribute to our wider Vision for the Lake District. Please note that the Lot Descriptions in section 2 are included to provide some background information on the work of the Authority. The following are examples of types of services which may be required by our Ranger Service. This is not exhaustive but is intended to demonstrate the breadth of the services which will be required: Providing services on a recurring and annual basis, such as our bridge maintenance responsibilities and sourcing of materials for daily use; Providing advice and practical work on specific public sector funded projects, such as the Coast-to-Coast project. Providing specific advice to our internal team of individuals and organisations with whom we operate, for internal projects involving our own land and property, and also to our partner organisations such as Fix the Fells. Lot 1: Bridges Supply, Repair and Maintenance. The Authority supplies, installs and maintains bridges on public rights of way throughout the National Park including bridleways and footpaths for use by horse riders, cyclists, mobility scooters and pedestrians. We are seeking suppliers who can assist with the following: • Supply bridge materials as component parts and/or complete structures in a variety of materials including recycled plastic, metal, timber, concrete, stone. These bridges will need to be to our specification or bespoke design in some cases. • Using the materials listed above, build and install those bridges in a wide variety of locations, including some remote and difficult to get to. This can include machine work, working with helicopter delivery companies, working with hand tools, demolition and construction of abutments.

The Authority requires qualified suppliers for the supply, delivery and installation of materials and services to support our countryside construction and maintenance projects. It aims to ensure high-quality, timely, and cost-effective delivery of materials and services while complying with health, safety, and environmental standards. It also aims to facilitate the provision of locally sourced materials to reduce transport mileage, to support the economic wellbeing of the National Park, and to showcase local products. Suppliers under this framework must demonstrate relevant experience, proven quality standards and the capacity to meet delivery schedules. Services and materials will be provided according to defined specifications, with monitoring of performance through key indicators such as timeliness, quality, and responsiveness. Suppliers must ensure that all materials supplied meet relevant British Standards or industry-recognised equivalents. Goods required: • Pipes/drains • Grass seed • Treated and some graded timber for fencing and the construction of timber boardwalks • Gates • Waymark roundels for Public Footpaths, Bridleways, Byways and permitted routes • Local stone (from the Lake District) for construction of unbound surface paths, stone for drainage works and dry-stone walling and bridge revetments • Plastic boardwalks from 1m to 3m width with non-slip finish • Metalwork (gate springs, gate hinges, catches screws, nuts, etc.) • Screened (inert) topsoil • Fingerposts and Waymarkers • Benches • Fencing wire • Metal fencing (i.e. Clipex) • Native tree species grown from seeds sourced in seed zone 301, or if unavailable, 302. This often requires working in remote locations with challenging access. All work standards and specifications will be set out in relevant documents. All work will need to be carried out to all relevant legislative requirements by appropriately trained and qualified staff. result.text: Organisational, professional and technical consultancy services for an omnichannel transformation project. The Audi BKK is planning to implement a future-proof omnichannel platform for customer advice in order to ensure consistent, seamless and personalised support across all relevant communication channels. In addition to connecting to existing systems of the Audi BKK, new digital contact channels for customer communication are to be provided, networked with one another and further optimised or automated. In future, customer advice is to be structured into first-level and second-level support. To prepare for the implementation of an omnichannel platform and to create the necessary organisational, professional and technical prerequisites, the contracting authority is hereby tendering for advisory support services to accompany and implement measures in the omnichannel context. Based on a completed as-is analysis and determination of the status quo, organisational, professional and technical measures and objectives have been derived. The results are documented in an omnichannel roadmap and are divided into a conception phase and a transformation phase (see attached annex). The concepts and optimisations developed (and potentially still emerging) during the conception phase are to be consolidated and driven forward by the contractor in their implementation and execution. The contractor shall effectively manage, methodically implement and document the omnichannel transformation process. The contractor shall support the technical and functional requirements for a suitable omnichannel platform during the derivation and survey phase in order to ensure a robust catalogue of requirements for the subsequent tendering and procurement of an omnichannel platform. The objective of this tender is to conclude a contract with a contractor for a period of two years, with planned contractual extension options. The contracting authority estimates the scope of the contract at approximately 800 consultant days.

parts.source: Organisatorische, fachliche und technische Beratungsleistungen zu einem Omnikanal-Transformationsprojekt Die Audi BKK plant, die Implementierung einer zukunftsfähigen Omnikanalplattform für die Kundenberatung einzuführen, um eine konsistente, medienbruchfreie und personalisierte Betreuung über alle relevanten Kommunikationskanäle hinweg zu gewährleisten. Neben der Anbindung an Bestandssysteme der Audi BKK sollen auch neue, digitale Kontaktkanäle für die Kundenkommunikation bereitgestellt, miteinander vernetzt und weiter optimiert bzw. automatisiert werden. Künftig soll die Kundenberatung differenziert nach First- und Second-Level ausgerichtet werden. Zur Vorbereitung der Implementierung einer Omnikanalplattform und Schaffung der dafür erforderlichen organisatorischen, fachlichen und technischen Voraussetzungen schreibt die Auftraggeberin vorliegend beratende Unterstützungsleistungen zur Begleitung und Umsetzung von Maßnahmen im Omnikanalkontext aus. Auf Grundlage einer bereits abgeschlossenen IST-Analyse und Ermittlung des Status quo wurden organisatorische, fachliche und technische Maßnahmen wie Zielsetzungen abgeleitet. Die Ergebnisse sind in einer Omnikanal-Roadmap dokumentiert und gliedern sich in eine Konzeptions- und Transformationsphase (siehe beigefügte Anlage). Die in der Konzeptionsphase erarbeiteten (und ggf. noch entstehenden) Konzepte und Optimierungen sind vom Auftragnehmer in ihrer Umsetzung und Implementierung zu konsolidieren und voranzutreiben. Der Auftragnehmer soll den Prozess der Omnikanaltransformation wirksam steuern, methodisch umsetzen und dokumentieren. Die technischen und funktionalen Anforde-rungen an eine geeignete Omnikanalplattform soll der Auftragnehmer während der Ableitungs- und Erhebungsphase begleiten, um einen belastbaren Anforderungskatalog zur späteren Ausschreibung und Beschaffung einer Omnikanalplattform sicher zu stellen. Ziel dieser Ausschreibung ist der Abschluss eines Vertrags mit einem Auftragnehmer für einen Zeitraum von zwei Jahren, wobei vertragliche Verlängerungsmöglichkeiten geplant sind. Die Auftraggeberin schätzt den Auftragsumfang auf etwa 800 Beratertage.

result.text: Avfall Sør would like to invite the market to a dialogue on the future solution for weighing residual waste at the recycling stations. The aim is to find a system with a high degree of automation/self-service, user friendliness and effective customer flow. It must take care of HSE considerations and be adapted to both the current and future needs for effective resource utilisation and sustainable operation. Avfall Sør has three recycling stations with high availability and access control. The residue waste is collected in large containers with compression; either closed compressor containers or open containers with rolling compressors. This can be changed, but a compressor system is wanted and protection from weather and wind. Key figures are given in the annex. We would like to charge for residual waste based on the weighted amount per customer, in order to comply with the polluter-payer principle and to ensure that sorting pays off. Avfall Sør has examined known systems in the market, but not found satisfactory systems. We would therefore like to have a dialogue with a tenderer who believes that they can offer this. The system must handle weighing and payment of residue waste in an efficient and user friendly way, without a requirement for dedicated manpower. Integration to established systems is not required, but we would like to present the possibilities. Tenderers are invited to submit a solution proposal with a description of relevant systems and price estimates, as well as a reference system. Deadline: 10.12.25, 16.00.Solution proposal can be sent in communication module in Mercell. Deadline for this: 03.12.25, 16:00.

result.text: We will commission projects which aim to increase democratic participation among groups who are less likely to be registered to vote and those who face other barriers. More information on these groups can be found in the attached EOI document. We will commission projects grouped under the following Lots: Lot 1: Action research projects, to pilot new and innovative approaches to democratic engagement in England Lot 2: Accessible voting projects, to support disabled and neurodivergent voters across the UK Lot 3: Digital engagement projects, to engage new and diverse audiences and explore the role that digital engagement can have in increasing participation We welcome a wide range of initiatives. We will encourage innovation and creativity from partners, while incorporating best practice in education and community engagement. Initiatives could include traditional education interventions, activities to upskill professionals and trusted community voices, initiatives to build capacity to deliver democratic engagement, events, tech-based solutions, and awareness raising activities. We will work in partnership with commissioned organisations to determine what success looks like and how we measure impact. Projects should explore a range of topics based on what is important to their audiences, such as: - Registering to vote - The voter ID requirement - Ways to vote - How to identify mis- and disinformation - What to expect at the polling station - Upcoming changes to elections This call is intended for organisations with a proven track record of delivering community or democratic engagement activities. While we welcome diverse expertise, applications from organisations whose primary focus is academic research, consultancy or market analysis are discouraged unless they are part of a joint bid led by an organisation with the required experience. Next steps If you are interested in applying for this tender, please register your interest. 1. Register on the portal The expected invitation to tender will be published on the Electoral Commission's Procurement Portal, please register as a supplier by following this link https://intendhost.co.uk/electoralcommission If you need help with registering, please may you contact the In-tend Technical Helpdesk on 0114 407 0065. 2. Contact procurement, register interest Once you have registered on the portal, please contact us stating which lot/s you intend on applying for. There is no need to formally respond to the tender at this stage with an application. To express interest, please: 1. Register on the Electoral Commission's In-Tend Procurement Portal 2. Email procurement@electoralcommission.org.uk with confirmation of interest. Please include 'WP132 Democratic Engagement Projects 2025-30' in the subject line. Contact details Name: The Electoral Commission - Procurement Team Email address: procurement@electoralcommission.org.uk

result.text: Patentti- ja rekisterihallitus (hereinafter PRH) has initiated procurement preparations for a new prh.fi website to be implemented using the WordPress content management system, according to a preliminary plan. The procurement includes the technical implementation of the website based on ready-made plans as well as ongoing support, maintenance and development services. The aim of the procurement is to create a modern, reliable and easily maintainable website that guides customer activities and transactions and serves as the main communication channel of the Finnish Patent and Registration Office. The objectives are a high-quality user experience, continuous functionality of the service and the future development of the website. The purpose of this market survey notice is to initiate market dialogue by inviting companies interested in the procurement to register for the market dialogue. MARKET DIALOGUE The market dialogue is intended for companies interested in the procurement. In the market dialogue, companies are given the opportunity to comment on draft materials related to the procurement in writing. Opportunities to comment on the draft materials are preliminarily planned to be organised during the year 2026. The contracting authority may also invite companies interested in the procurement to bilateral meetings if necessary. Any meetings will be held via Teams. REGISTRATION Companies interested in the procurement are requested to submit their contact details by email to kilpailutus@hansel.fi no later than 1.10.2026 with the subject line "PRH / verkkosivuston toteutus ja ylläpito". OTHER NOTABLE MATTERS Please note that this is a market survey notice and does not constitute a request to participate or a tender. The information presented in this notice is preliminary and may change as the procurement preparation progresses. Participation or non-participation in the market dialogue does not preclude participation in any subsequent procurement procedure. The contracting authority will not pay compensation for participation in the market dialogue. The personal data of registered persons will be used solely for contacts related to the preparation of this procurement. Hansel Oy acts in a consultative role in this procurement.

Hankintaan kuuluu sivuston tekninen toteutus valmiiden suunnitelmien pohjalta sekä jatkuvat tuki-, ylläpito-, ja kehittämispalvelut. Hankinnan tavoitteena on toteuttaa moderni, luotettava ja helposti ylläpidettävä verkkosivusto, joka ohjaa asiakkaiden toimintaa ja asiointia sekä toimii Patentti- ja rekisterihallituksen pääviestintäkanavana. Tavoitteena on laadukas käyttäjäkokemus, palvelun jatkuva toimivuus sekä verkkosivuston kehittäminen myös tulevaisuudessa. Tämän markkinakartoitusilmoituksen tarkoituksena on käynnistää markkinavuoropuhelu kutsumalla hankinnasta kiinnostuneet yritykset ilmoittautumaan markkinavuoropuheluun. Markkinavuoropuhelussa yrityksille varataan mahdollisuus kommentoida hankintaan liittyviä luonnosmateriaaleja kirjallisesti. Luonnosmateriaalien kommentointimahdollisuuksia on alustavasti suunniteltu järjestettäväksi vuoden 2026 aikana. Hankintayksikkö voi myös kutsua tarvittaessa hankinnasta kiinnostuneita yrityksiä kahdenvälisiin tapaamisiin. Mahdolliset tapaamiset järjestetään Teamsin välityksellä. ILMOITTAUTUMINEN Hankinnasta kiinnostuneita yrityksiä pyydetään ilmoittamaan viimeistään 1.10.2026 yhteystietonsa sähköpostitse osoitteeseen kilpailutus@hansel.fi ja otsikoimaan sähköpostiviesti "PRH / verkkosivuston toteutus ja ylläpito". MUUTA HUOMIOITAVAA Huomioittehan, että kyseessä on markkinakartoitusilmoitus, eikä tällä ilmoituksella pyydetä osallistumishakemuksia tai tarjouksia. Tässä ilmoituksessa esitetyt tiedot ovat alustavia ja saattavat muuttua hankinnan valmistelun edetessä. Markkinavuoropuheluun osallistuminen tai osallistumatta jättäminen ei estä mahdolliseen hankintamenettelyyn osallistumista. Hankintayksikkö ei maksa korvausta markkinavuoropuheluun osallistumisesta. result.text: David Ross Education Trust is inviting tenders for the implementation and ongoing provision of a secure, modern and user-friendly Human Resources Information System and payroll solution. The solution will support approximately 2,200 employees across the Trust's 36 academies and central functions. It must support the full employee lifecycle and the accurate, timely and compliant operation of payroll. The requirement includes: core HR and employee record management; payroll calculation, processing and statutory reporting, including Teachers' Pension Scheme and multiple Local Government Pension Scheme arrangements; employee and manager self-service; recruitment, onboarding and employee lifecycle processes; absence, leave and contractual change management; workflows, approvals, reporting and management information; integration and secure data exchange; data migration, configuration, testing, training and implementation; security, data protection, business continuity and disaster recovery; and ongoing support, maintenance, system updates and service management. The Trust will continue to operate payroll through its in-house payroll team. The contract will be for a maximum period of ten years, with break options available to the Trust at the end of years five and eight. Tenders will be evaluated on the basis of 60% quality and 40% price. The Trust may invite shortlisted bidders to participate in a supplier demonstration as part of the evaluation process. All tender documents, communications, clarification questions and submissions must be managed through the InTend portal. The deadline for tender submissions is 09:00 BST on 19 October 2026. Lot 1: .

result.text: Revolutionizing Engineering Departments (hereinafter referred to as RED) is designed to build upon previous efforts in engineering education research. Specifically, previous and ongoing evaluations of the NSF Engineering Education and Centers Division program and its predecessors, as well as those related programs in the Directorate for STEM Education, have shown that prior investments have significantly improved the first year of engineering students’ experiences, incorporating engineering material, active learning approaches, design instruction, and a broad introduction to professional skills and a sense of professional practice – giving students an idea of what it means to become an engineer. Similarly, the senior year has seen notable change through capstone design experiences, which ask students to synthesize the technical knowledge, skills, and abilities they have gained with professional capacities, using reflective judgment to make decisions and communicate these effectively. However, this ideal of the senior year has not yet been fully realized, because many of the competencies required in capstone design, or required of professional engineers, are only partially introduced in the first year and not carried forward with significant emphasis through the sophomore and junior years. The Directorates for Engineering (ENG) and STEM Education (EDU) are funding projects as part of the RED program, in alignment with the Improving Undergraduate STEM Education (IUSE) framework and Professional Formation of Engineers (PFE) initiative. These projects are designing revolutionary new approaches to engineering education, ranging from changing the canon of engineering to fundamentally altering the way courses are structured to creating new departmental structures and educational collaborations with industry. A common thread across these projects is a focus on organizational and cultural change within the departments, involving students, faculty, staff, and industry in rethinking what it means to provide an engineering program. In order to continue to catalyze revolutionary approaches, while expanding the reach of those that have proved efficacious in particular contexts, the RED program supports four tracks: RED Planning (Track 1), RED Adaptation and Implementation (Track 2), RED Innovation (Track 3), and RED Innovation Partnerships (Track 4). Two- and four-year institutions are encouraged to submit to any track as appropriate for their goals and context. RED Planning (Track 1) projects will support capacity-building activities at institutions of special interest to NSF’s mission, including two-year engineering-centered programs building transfer partnerships, two-year or four-year institutions in EPSCoR jurisdictions, Primarily Undergraduate Institutions (PUIs), and Institutions of Higher Education (IHEs) in order to create more opportunities in engineering for students in every part of the country. Planning projects should provide the support for such institutions to explore the development of a RED Projects in Tracks 2, 3, & 4. RED Adaptation and Implementation (Track 2) projects will adapt and implement evidence-based organizational change strategies and actions to the local context, which helps propagate this transformation of undergraduate engineering education. RED Innovation (Track 3) projects will develop new, revolutionary approaches and change strategies that enable the transformation of undergraduate engineering education. RED Innovation Partnerships (Track 4) projects will achieve the same goals as Track 3 projects across multiple institutions. Of particular interest to this track are projects partnering two-year institutions with other eligible institutions. Projects in tracks 2, 3, & 4 will include consideration of the cultural, organizational, structural, and pedagogical changes needed to transform one or more departments to ones in which students are engaged, develop their technical and professional skills, and establish identities as professional engineers or technologists. The focus of projects in these tracks should be on the department’s disciplinary courses and program. RED project initiatives are expected to be institutionalized at the end of the funding period. Proposals are especially encouraged that address areas of increased national interest including but not limited to advanced manufacturing, advanced wireless, artificial intelligence, biotechnology, microelectronics and semiconductors, net zero technologies, sustainability, systems engineering, and quantum engineering.

result.text: Scottish Government and NHSScotland are exploring options for a single national Infection Prevention Control eSurveillance solution that will ensure consistent application across all of NHSScotland. This will replace the existing disparate systems across Health Boards. The national solution will need to: - Integrate and be interoperable with some of the numerous NHS Scotland existing systems. - Provide efficient local and national reporting. - Provide real time data (e.g. providing alerts to flag identification of an infection, provide up to date reporting) - Be available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week and must have an extremely high degree of resilience in order to minimise any periods of scheduled or unscheduled downtime. Vendors of future solutions should note that this resilience should include but not be limited to Failover and Disaster Recovery of the system with limited technical intervention. This soft market test is being conducted to determine what solutions may be available, determine the scope of any future procurement to enable the delivery of a national solution, and to ascertain indicative costs. result.text: The National Institute on Aging intends to publish a Notice of Funding Opportunity (NOFO) to solicit applications for the Claude D. Pepper Older Americans Independence Centers (OAICs) award. The goal of the OAIC program is to establish centers of excellence in geriatrics research and research education to increase scientific knowledge leading to better ways to maintain or restore independence in older persons. OAIC awards are designed to develop or strengthen programs that focus on, and sustain progress in, a key area of aging research related to the mission of the OAIC program. Applicants should identify an area of focus in which progress could contribute to greater independence for substantial populations of older persons and offer opportunities for education in aging research. This area of focus should be a common theme around which all proposed OAIC activities are organized. Applications are not being solicited at this time. Notice is being provided to allow potential applicants sufficient time to develop meaningful collaborations and responsive projects. This NOFO will utilize the P30 activity code. Investigators with expertise and insights into this area of aging research are encouraged to begin to consider applying for this new NOFO.

result.text: With this market dialogue the Urban Environment Division of the City of Helsinki is exploring markets and potential suppliers to identify IFC file-based checking software for checking and reading. Use cases are for example national building control and for different phases of building / infra projects as well as facility management. The checking rules used also cover geometrical and different data calculation parts. For a more detailed description of the requirements of the solution sought, please refer to the Description of the Procurement section of this notice. This notice does not call for tenders or requests for participation. The market dialogue includes pre-interview questions and an interview with the operators that have expressed an interest. The outcome of this market dialogue will be used by the City of Helsinki and possibly other municipalities in Finland, for a competitive tendering process for the procurement of suitable products according to the market.

result.text: This Challenge presents an exciting opportunity to make a positive difference in protecting children in Scotland from harm, an area of the highest priority for the Scottish Cabinet and partners. Scotland’s child protection system relies on Inter-Agency Referral Discussions (IRDs) to make timely safeguarding decisions for children (over 17,000 IRDs took place during 2024-25). IRDs are effective and work well as a process, however they are currently supported by fragmented IT systems, manual processes and localised records. This results in duplication, delays, and barriers to information sharing across agencies and local authorities. These inefficiencies increase administrative burden, reducing time available for direct support to children and families. The Scottish Government, Police Scotland and the National Social Work Agency (TBC) are seeking innovative solutions that will enable secure streamlined multi-agency information sharing for the existing IRD process, as well as providing real-time local and national data to improve child protection outcomes across Scotland.
