result.text: Smart Applications Management Limited (SAM) is the trading name of South West Smart Applications Limited, a Membership based central purchasing body, which owns and runs the National Mobilities Procurement Hub for its Members. The Goods and Services will be supplied via Award Without Competition and by Competitive Selection Process. Lot 1 of this Framework is seeking the provision of On Vehicle Digital Technology (AVL, CCTV, APC, TLP, Comms, On Bus Destination, AVA, Bridge Strike Systems & Vehicle Compute Capability). Lot 1 - has 9 parts: Lot 1 - Part 1 - Automated Vehicle Location (AVL) Solution Provision of an integrated Automated Vehicle Location solution capable of accurately determining and communicating vehicle location in real time. The solution shall support route, journey and stop association, estimated arrival/departure information and integration with other onboard and back-office systems. Requirements include resilient positioning, industry-standard data interfaces, remote configuration, monitoring, diagnostics, reporting, security and ongoing support throughout the solution lifecycle. Lot 1 - Part 2 - Closed Circuit Television (CCTV) Solution Provision of a comprehensive onboard CCTV solution providing appropriate internal and external vehicle coverage for passenger safety, operational management and incident investigation. The solution shall support continuous high-quality recording, secure storage and retrieval, authorised access and evidential integrity. Requirements include integration with other onboard systems, equipment health monitoring, remote diagnostics, secure communications, configurable camera arrangements and enhanced analytics where required. Lot 1 - Part 3 - Automatic Passenger Counting (APC) Solution Provision of an Automatic Passenger Counting solution capable of accurately recording passenger boarding and alighting and determining vehicle occupancy without driver intervention. The solution shall provide reliable passenger-count data for operational, planning and passenger-information purposes and integrate with onboard and central systems. Requirements include appropriate counting accuracy, standardised interfaces, secure data transfer, reporting, monitoring, diagnostics, remote management and resilient operation. Lot 1 - Part 4 - Traffic Light Priority (TLP) Solution Provision of a Traffic Light Priority solution enabling suitably equipped vehicles to request priority at traffic signals based on vehicle location, route and operational circumstances. The solution shall support configurable and conditional priority strategies and integration with vehicle, roadside and central systems. Requirements include secure, low-latency communications, monitoring and reporting, remote configuration, interoperability, performance analysis, testing, cybersecurity and ongoing technical support. Lot 1 - Part 5 - Comms Tool (Radio) Solution Provision of an onboard communications solution enabling reliable and secure voice and data communication between drivers, vehicles and operational control functions. The solution shall support operational messaging, service information, alerts and emergency communications through an appropriate driver interface. Requirements include integration with other onboard systems, secure communications, operational logging, remote configuration, equipment monitoring, diagnostics and resilient operation across the vehicle fleet. Lot 1 - Part 6 - On-Bus Destination Solution Provision of integrated on-bus destination equipment capable of clearly displaying route and destination information to passengers and intending passengers. Solutions shall support appropriate front, side and rear displays, accessibility and visibility requirements and integration with onboard systems to automate displayed information. Requirements include remote configuration, operational overrides, equipment monitoring, diagnostics, secure communications, robust vehicle-grade equipment and ongoing maintenance and support. Lot 1 - Part 7 - Audio Visual Passenger Information (AVA) Solution Provision of an accessible onboard Audio Visual Passenger Information solution delivering automated visual and audible information concerning routes, destinations, next stops, disruptions and other relevant passenger messages. The solution shall integrate with vehicle location and onboard systems to trigger information accurately. Requirements include accessible presentation, remote and priority messaging, configurable content, secure communications, monitoring, diagnostics, resilient operation and ongoing system support. Lot 1 - Part 8 - Bridge Strike Prevention Solution Provision of an onboard Bridge Strike Prevention solution designed to reduce the risk of vehicles approaching or striking structures with insufficient clearance. The solution shall use vehicle dimensions together with accurate location, mapping and detection information to provide timely audible and visual driver warnings. Requirements include reliable hazard identification, minimisation of false alerts, offline resilience, secure updates, event logging, diagnostics and onboard-system integration. Lot 1 - Part 9 - Vehicle Compute Capability (VCC) Solution Provision of a robust onboard Vehicle Compute Capability providing a shared computing platform for hosting, integrating and managing multiple vehicle applications and data services. The solution shall provide sufficient processing capacity, storage and future scalability while supporting secure application separation and interoperability. Requirements include edge processing, secure communications, remote software management, monitoring and diagnostics, onboard-system integration and future expansion throughout its operational lifecycle. Lot 2 is for Franchising and Wider Transport Ticketing & Payment Consultancy Services.

Lot 2 - Part 5 - Entitlement (Concessionary) Travel Management Services The provision of management, policy and project support for entitlement and concessionary travel schemes, with particular emphasis on revenue reimbursement and apportionment. Services may include multi-operator and multimodal schemes, multiple ITSO HOPS and Customer Management Systems, and schemes operating across multiple ticketing channels, technologies and participating organisations. Lot 1 - Part 8 - Bridge Strike Prevention Solution Provision of an onboard Bridge Strike Prevention solution designed to reduce the risk of vehicles approaching or striking structures with insufficient clearance. The solution shall use vehicle dimensions together with accurate location, mapping and detection information to provide timely audible and visual driver warnings. Requirements include reliable hazard identification, minimisation of false alerts, offline resilience, secure updates, event logging, diagnostics and onboard-system integration. Lot 1 - Part 9 - Vehicle Compute Capability (VCC) Solution Provision of a robust onboard Vehicle Compute Capability providing a shared computing platform for hosting, integrating and managing multiple vehicle applications and data services. The solution shall provide sufficient processing capacity, storage and future scalability while supporting secure application separation and interoperability. Requirements include edge processing, secure communications, remote software management, monitoring and diagnostics, onboard-system integration and future expansion throughout its operational lifecycle. Lot 1 Goods and Services will be supplied via Award Without Competition and by Competitive Selection Process. Lot 2: Franchising and Wider Transport Ticketing & Payment Consultancy Services. Lot 2 is for Franchising and Wider Transport Ticketing & Payment Consultancy Services. It has 6 Parts: Lot 2 - Part 1 - Franchised Bus Scheme Development and Implementation Support The provision of specialist consultancy services to support the development, assessment and implementation of bus franchising schemes. Services may include business cases, network and commercial design, financial modelling, consultation, procurement, mobilisation, integrated fares and ticketing, assets and technology, contract management, service permits, independent assurance and stakeholder engagement. Lot 2 - Part 2 - Transport Ticketing Management Policy Advice The provision of strategic, policy and management consultancy relating to transport ticketing and payment systems. Services may encompass ITSO, Stored Value, contactless EMV, barcode and QR ticketing, Account Based and Multi-Token Ticketing, Mobility as a Service, and wider ticketing initiatives across public-sector authorities, transport operators and national organisations. Lot 2 - Part 3 - Transport Ticketing Technical & Revenue Scheme Delivery The provision of technical consultancy and delivery support for transport ticketing schemes, including development of technical specifications, implementation and integration of ITSO and other ticketing technologies, Electronic Ticket Machines and ticketing readers. Services may also include management of multi-platform implementations and development of technical solutions through engagement with relevant stakeholders. Lot 2 - Part 4 - Transport Ticketing Governance, Research and Competitive Bidding Services The provision of specialist support relating to transport ticketing governance, research, procurement and competitive funding or bidding activities. Services may include governance advice for public and commercial organisations, preparation of grant, tender and franchise submissions, support for public procurement exercises, and research activities contributing to sustainable transport policy and delivery. Lot 2 - Part 5 - Entitlement (Concessionary) Travel Management Services The provision of management, policy and project support for entitlement and concessionary travel schemes, with particular emphasis on revenue reimbursement and apportionment. Services may include multi-operator and multimodal schemes, multiple ITSO HOPS and Customer Management Systems, and schemes operating across multiple ticketing channels, technologies and participating organisations. Lot 2 - Part 6 - Technical Entitlement (Concessionary) Support Services The provision of specialist technical support for entitlement and concessionary travel schemes, including reimbursement implementation, revenue modelling and apportionment, ETM data analysis, national reimbursement guidance and alternative allocation methodologies. Services may also encompass auditable datasets, payment reporting, stakeholder-led revenue solutions and expert technical evidence supporting appeals, tribunals or legal proceedings. result.text: INVITATION TO MARKET DIALOGUE With this RFI Yle invites interested suppliers to participate in the market dialogue held prior publishing the call for tenders (RFP). With this RFI Yle gathers insights and proposals for solutions that will help us achieve a system (or systems), which meets all Yle's requirements as well as both the current and future production needs. The system and all of its components should create an environment, which workflows are easy for users, and which communicates flawlessly with other systems that Yle has. Yle is looking for either a) a single vendor system with all the features or; b) a modular solution from different vendors. The description and object of the RFI, as well as the schedule of the procurement process, are preliminary and Yle will specify the needs and objectives of the procurement in the final RFP. It may also be that no invitation to tender is published in case Yle decides not to proceed with the renewal. At this point Yle is looking to identify the solutions available in the market that could meet Yle’s needs. It is possible that there will be round 2 of RFI before publishing the final request for proposals (RFP). In case, at this point, Yle feels it is needed, we will schedule meetings with the few chosen suppliers. Please see the appendix of this RFI for further information. INTERESTED? Interested suppliers are invited to take part in the market dialogue by sending a request to participate by email to tarjoukset.yle(at)yle.fi at latest by 15th of November 2025. In case you have any questions, please don’t hesitate to contact us. Please include a description or additional appendices covering the following topics in your email: - Description of the solution you provide, including a description of which key features are included in your solution - A short company presentation, including the size of the company in terms of revenue and number of employees. - Your previous experience and few appropriate reference cases. - Reference architecture view - Description of your licence and pricing model - Description of your cyber security policies and continuity planning - Description of your GDPR policies - Your general agreement terms and conditions and description of SLA terms if possible We will review the answers as soon as they are received.

result.text: Project reason TenneT requires a portfolio management system (PMS) to support electricity trading in the short-term market (day-ahead and intraday) in Germany. Objective of the tender The objective is the procurement of a high-performance PMS to support electricity trading. In accordance with TenneT's architectural guidelines, the solution is to be cloud-based, preferably operated in the tenderer's cloud. In coordination with TenneT, deployment in a third-party provider's cloud (e.g. Azure) or at TenneT is also possible. The system must enable the management of multiple portfolios and support the processes for participating in day-ahead and intraday auctions as well as continuous intraday trading. The system will be used in the electricity trading sector and must cover the following main functions: - Portfolio management - Connection to power exchanges - Trading overviews & GUI - Algo-trader / trading support in continuous intraday trading - Data management - Reporting & analysis - Settlement - Schedule management Scope of services - Provision of a COTS software solution (licences) - Support & maintenance of this solution (maintenance) - Hosting of the solution - Application management services - Consulting and training services Procedural notice A detailed specification of services as well as other procedural-relevant documents will be provided after signing a non-disclosure agreement. Please send this to us completed and signed via the Mercell messaging function. The tender is being conducted in accordance with the SektVO (Sectoral Procurement Ordinance) via a negotiated procedure with a call for competition. Accordingly, TenneT is already bound to confidentiality pursuant to Section 15 SektVO. As things stand, the value of the tender cannot be reliably estimated.

parts.source: Projektanlass TenneT benötigt ein Portfoliomanagementsystem (PMS) zur Unterstützung des Stromhandels im Kurzfristmarkt (Day-Ahead und Intraday) in Deutschland. Ziel der Ausschreibung Ziel ist die Beschaffung eines leistungsfähigen PMS zur Unterstützung des Stromhandels. Entsprechend der architektonischen Vorgaben der TenneT soll die Lösung cloudbasiert, bevorzugt in der Cloud des Bieters betrieben werden. Abgestimmt mit TenneT ist auch eine Bereitstellung in der Cloud eines Drittanbieters (z.B. Azure) oder bei TenneT möglich. Das System muss die Verwaltung mehrerer Portfolien ermöglichen und die Prozesse für die Teilnahme an den Day-Ahead- und Intraday-Auktionen sowie dem kontinuierlichen Intradayhandel unterstützen. Das System wird im Bereich Stromhandel eingesetzt und hat folgende Hauptfunktionen abzudecken: - Portfoliomanagement - Anbindung an die Strombörsen - Handelsübersichten & GUI - Algo-Trader/Handelsunterstützung im kontinuierlichen Intraday-Handel - Datenmanagement - Reporting & Analyse - Abrechnung - Fahrplanmanagement Leistungsumfang - Zur-Verfügung-Stellung einer COTS Software Lösung (Lizenzen) - Support & Maintenance dieser Lösung (Wartung) - Hosting der Lösung - Application Management Services - Beratungs- und Schulungsleistungen Verfahrenshinweis Eine detaillierte Leistungsbeschreibung, sowie weitere Verfahrensrelevante Dokumente werden nach Unterzeichnung einer Geheimhaltungsvereinbarung bereitgestellt. Senden Sie uns diese bitte ausgefüllt und unterschrieben per Mercell Nachrichtenfunktion zu. Die Ausschreibung erfolgt gemäß SektVO im Verhandlungsverfahren mit Teilnahmewettbewerb. Demnach ist TenneT bereits gemäß §15 SektVO zur Vertraulichkeit verpflichtet. Der Ausschreibungswert kann, Stand jetzt, nicht belastbar geschätzt werden.

rejected.text: The employee survey in The Norwegian Defence Estates Agency is carried out annually, usually at the end of January/February. The Norwegian Defence Estates Agency has had a very high response percentage in recent years, between 82 % and 87%. In 2025, the survey was sent out to just over 2,000 respondents. The Norwegian Defence Estates Agency currently uses Rambøll as its supplier and they are responsible for the entire process - from dispatching and administration to analysing the results. The results will be presented in an insight report that will be presented to the management team. With new competence in the HR department, including HR analyst competence, Forsvarsbygg is now considering taking a greater degree of ownership of the survey. The Norwegian Defence Estates Agency is looking at an option to administer the survey itself and get access to raw data, so that own analyses can be carried out, etc. Practical aspects of the market dialogue: There is a form (Excel sheet) that can be answered and the deadline is set at 12:00 1 December 2025. Input and form are submitted by using the communication module in Mercell. Based on received responses, the Norwegian Defence Estates Agency will make an assessment and possibly call in some suppliers for 1:1 conversations - if the Norwegian Defence Estates Agency deems it appropriate. These 1:1 meetings are likely to take place via Teams (possibly physically at The Norwegian Defence Estates Agency at Grev Wedels plass 5).

result.text: In line with technological evolution and the principles established in the Digitalisation Plan for Public Administrations and the National Cybersecurity Strategy, the trend in public sector corporate networks is moving towards architectures based on separate and isolated networks, using protocols running over Layer-3, such as SD-WAN, to create convergent communications services that enable: - Operational efficiency to be increased and management costs to be reduced. - Intelligent and proactive traffic management to be incorporated, particularly through the application of advanced analytics and artificial intelligence techniques. - Native integration with perimeter security systems and operations centres (SOC) to be facilitated. - The use of hybrid links (fibre, 4G/5G, Internet, etc.) to be permitted, guaranteeing high availability of services. - Scalability and flexibility to be ensured when opening new offices or launching new municipal services. In the field of office interconnection, the City Council of Ávila aims for an even more advanced and robust approach, replacing SD-WAN-based networks with Layer-2 networks capable of transporting VLANs based on the 802.1Q protocol. One of the fundamentals of this requirement is not to lose performance, such as the extremely low latency currently enjoyed, which is characteristic of campus networks or metropolitan area networks, constituted by point-to-point circuits. The City Council of Ávila is promoting an evolution towards a communications model based on the principles of robustness, agility, security, integration and scalability, in order to guarantee a modern, efficient and resilient infrastructure that supports the institution's digital transformation and continuous improvement in the provision of services to citizens. Based on this, the telecommunications services of the City Council of Ávila are being tendered, covering the areas of fixed and mobile telephony, broadband Internet access, data transmission between offices and associated services, as well as the maintenance of the infrastructures necessary for their correct provision. The contract seeks the provision of the related services and the comprehensive maintenance of the equipment and infrastructures necessary to guarantee the correct provision of the services throughout their validity, including the essential LAN equipment to provide the VoIP service, understanding that these are essential services for the proper functioning of the City Council.

parts.source: En línea con la evolución tecnológica y los principios establecidos en el Plan de Digitalización de las Administraciones Públicas y la Estrategia Nacional de Ciberseguridad, la tendencia en las redes corporativas del sector público se orienta hacia arquitecturas basadas en redes separadas y aisladas, mediante protocolos que corren sobre Layer-3, como es el caso de SD-WAN, para crear servicios convergentes de comunicaciones que permitan: - Incrementar la eficiencia operativa y reducir los costes de gestión. - Incorporar una gestión inteligente y proactiva del tráfico, especialmente mediante la aplicación de técnicas de analítica avanzada e inteligencia artificial. - Facilitar la integración nativa con los sistemas de seguridad perimetral y centros de operaciones (SOC). - Permitir el uso de enlaces híbridos (fibra, 4G/5G, Internet, etc.) garantizando la alta disponibilidad de los servicios. - Asegurar la escalabilidad y flexibilidad ante la apertura de nuevas sedes o la puesta en marcha de nuevos servicios municipales. En el ámbito de interconexión de sedes el Ayuntamiento de Ávila pretende un planteamiento aún más evolucionado y robusto, sustituyendo las redes basadas en SD-WAN por redes Layer-2 con capacidad para transportar VLAN basándose en el protocolo 802.1Q. Uno de los fundamentos de esta exigencia es no perder prestaciones, como la extremadamente baja latencia de la que se disfruta en la actualidad, que caracteriza a las redes de campus o redes metropolitanas, constituidas por circuitos punto a punto. El Ayuntamiento de Ávila impulsa una evolución hacia un modelo de comunicaciones que se sustenta en los principios de robustez, agilidad, seguridad, integración y escalabilidad, con el fin de garantizar una infraestructura moderna, eficiente y resiliente que soporte la transformación digital de la institución y la mejora continua en la prestación de servicios al ciudadano. En base a ello se licitan los servicios de telecomunicaciones del Ayuntamiento de Ávila, comprendiendo los ámbitos de telefonía fija y móvil, acceso a Internet de banda ancha, transmisión de datos entre sedes y servicios asociados, así como el mantenimiento de las infraestructuras necesarias para su correcta prestación. El contrato procura la prestación de los servicios relacionados y el mantenimiento integral de los equipos e infraestructuras necesarios para garantizar la correcta prestación de los servicios durante toda su vigencia, incluyendo el equipamiento LAN imprescindible para proporcionar el servicio VoIP, entendiendo que se trata de servicios esenciales para el adecuado funcionamiento del Ayuntamiento

result.text: This notice serves exclusively to carry out a non-binding market consultation pursuant to Section 28 paragraph 1 of the Public Procurement Ordinance (VgV). The aim of the market consultation is to inform the market at an early stage about a potential future procurement requirement and to gather insights on technical, economic and organisational solution approaches, current market conditions, the competitive situation and the fundamental feasibility of the planned project. In particular, the market consultation serves to identify the pros and cons of potential performance components, to record existing market experience and to examine whether and to what extent several companies can offer comparable services. In this way, a well-founded overview of market interest and the current competitive situation is to be obtained. This notice is expressly neither a contract notice nor a call for tenders or requests to participate. No procurement procedure is initiated by carrying out the market consultation. The contracting authority is not obliged to carry out a procurement procedure on the basis of the market consultation and is not bound by its results. Participation does not establish any legal claims whatsoever, in particular no claim to the execution of a procurement procedure or to consideration in any subsequent procurement procedure. Participation in the market consultation is voluntary and free of charge. Participating companies will not be reimbursed for any costs incurred in connection with participation, the preparation of statements, concepts or the submission of documents. Participation in the market consultation is not a prerequisite for subsequent participation in a procurement procedure and has no influence on a company's chances of being awarded the contract. The contracting authority requests interested market participants to provide meaningful, comprehensible and substantive feedback. In particular, feedback is requested on potential implementation variants, economic framework conditions, opportunities and risks, potential problems or obstacles in the implementation of the envisaged concept, as well as own ideas and suggestions for improvement. Where possible, feedback should be provided in a structured format. Interested companies are requested to express their interest immediately and informally by email to ta-vergabestellevol@hu-berlin.de and to submit their statements, ideas, suggestions for implementation and economic assessments. Following the evaluation of the submitted documents, selected interested parties may be invited to explain their concepts in more detail within the framework of a structured dialogue. This deepening may take the form of an on-site appointment or alternatively via video or telephone conference and serves to clarify open questions and to evaluate the impact of the proposed solution approaches on the requirements of the contracting authority. All documents submitted as part of the market consultation shall become the property of the contracting authority. By participating, interested parties agree that their submitted concepts, evaluations, proposals and other findings may be used for the preparation of a possible procurement and for the development of implementation proposals and, where necessary, passed on to the contracting authority, unless this is explicitly objected to. Ideas and suggestions from market participants may, where applicable, become anonymised components of a subsequent specification. The contracting authority guarantees the protection of business and trade secrets. Information obtained during the market consultation will not be passed on to third parties, with the exception of the contracting authority itself and, where applicable, consultancy firms commissioned by it. The market consultation is to be carried out promptly and is expected to be concluded by the end of January 2026. All submitted feedback will be evaluated and made available to the contracting authority in consolidated form. If the contracting authority should initiate a procurement procedure on the basis of the results of the market consultation, it will take appropriate measures to exclude any distortion of competition. These include in particular the equal treatment of all interested companies, the provision of relevant information to all applicants and tenderers, and the setting of reasonable time limits. Anticipated schedule • Publication of the market consultation: 18.12.2025 • Declaration of interest in participation: immediately • Submission of the initial concept: January 2026 • Presentations and interviews: January 2026

parts.source: Diese Bekanntmachung dient ausschließlich der Durchführung einer unverbindlichen Markterkundung gemäß § 28 Absatz 1 der Vergabeverordnung (VgV). Ziel der Markterkundung ist es, den Markt frühzeitig über einen möglichen zukünftigen Beschaffungsbedarf zu informieren sowie Erkenntnisse zu technischen, wirtschaftlichen und organisatorischen Lösungsansätzen, zu aktuellen Marktbedingungen, zur Wettbewerbssituation sowie zur grundsätzlichen Machbarkeit des geplanten Vorhabens zu gewinnen. Die Markterkundung dient insbesondere dazu, Vor- und Nachteile möglicher Leistungsbestandteile zu identifizieren, bestehende Markterfahrungen zu erfassen und zu prüfen, ob und inwieweit mehrere Unternehmen vergleichbare Leistungen anbieten können. Auf diese Weise soll ein fundierter Überblick über das Marktinteresse und die aktuelle Wettbewerbssituation erlangt werden. Bei der vorliegenden Bekanntmachung handelt es sich ausdrücklich weder um eine Auftragsbekanntmachung noch um eine Aufforderung zur Abgabe von Angeboten oder Teilnahmeanträgen. Durch die Durchführung der Markterkundung wird kein Vergabeverfahren eingeleitet. Der Auftraggeber ist nicht verpflichtet, auf Grundlage der Markterkundung ein Vergabeverfahren durchzuführen, und ist an deren Ergebnisse nicht gebunden. Die Teilnahme begründet keinerlei Rechtsansprüche, insbesondere keinen Anspruch auf Durchführung eines Vergabeverfahrens oder auf Berücksichtigung in einem etwaigen späteren Vergabeverfahren. Die Teilnahme an der Markterkundung ist freiwillig und unentgeltlich. Den teilnehmenden Unternehmen werden keine Kosten erstattet, die ihnen im Zusammenhang mit der Teilnahme, der Ausarbeitung von Stellungnahmen, Konzepten oder der Übermittlung von Unterlagen entstehen. Die Teilnahme an der Markterkundung ist keine Voraussetzung für eine spätere Beteiligung an einem Vergabeverfahren und hat keinen Einfluss auf die Zuschlagschancen eines Unternehmens. Der Auftraggeber bittet interessierte Marktteilnehmer um aussagekräftige, nachvollziehbare und weiterführende Rückmeldungen. Insbesondere werden Hinweise zu möglichen Umsetzungsvarianten, wirtschaftlichen Rahmenbedingungen, Chancen und Risiken, potenziellen Problemen oder Hindernissen bei der Umsetzung des vorgesehenen Konzepts sowie eigene Ideen und Verbesserungsvorschläge erbeten. Die Rückmeldungen sollen nach Möglichkeit in strukturierter Form erfolgen. Interessierte Unternehmen werden gebeten, ihr Interesse unverzüglich und formlos per E-Mail an ta-vergabestellevol@hu-berlin.de zu bekunden und ihre Stellungnahmen, Ideen, Vorschläge zur Umsetzung sowie wirtschaftliche Einschätzungen zu übermitteln. Im Anschluss an die Auswertung der eingereichten Unterlagen können ausgewählte Interessenten eingeladen werden, ihre Konzepte im Rahmen eines strukturierten Dialogs näher zu erläutern. Diese Vertiefung kann in Form eines Vor-Ort-Termins oder ersatzweise per Video- oder Telefonkonferenz erfolgen und dient der Klärung offener Fragen sowie der Bewertung der Auswirkungen der vorgeschlagenen Lösungsansätze auf die Anforderungen des Auftraggebers. Sämtliche im Rahmen der Markterkundung übermittelten Unterlagen gehen in das Eigentum des Auftraggebers über. Mit der Teilnahme erklären sich die Interessenten damit einverstanden, dass ihre eingereichten Konzepte, Bewertungen, Vorschläge und sonstigen Erkenntnisse zur Vorbereitung einer möglichen Beschaffung sowie zur Erarbeitung von Umsetzungsvorschlägen genutzt und soweit erforderlich, an den Auftraggeber weitergegeben werden dürfen, sofern dem nicht ausdrücklich widersprochen wird. Ideen und Vorschläge der Marktteilnehmer können dabei ggf. anonymisiert Bestandteil einer späteren Leistungsbeschreibung werden. Der Auftraggeber gewährleistet den Schutz von Geschäfts- und Betriebsgeheimnissen. Eine Weitergabe von im Rahmen der Markterkundung erlangten Informationen an Dritte erfolgt nicht, mit Ausnahme des Auftraggebers selbst sowie ggf. von durch ihn beauftragten Beratungsunternehmen. Die Markterkundung soll zeitnah durchgeführt und voraussichtlich bis Ende Januar 2026 abgeschlossen werden. Sämtliche eingereichten Rückmeldungen werden ausgewertet und dem Auftraggeber in konsolidierter Form zur Verfügung gestellt. Sofern der Auftraggeber auf Grundlage der Ergebnisse der Markterkundung ein Vergabeverfahren einleiten sollte, wird er geeignete Maßnahmen ergreifen, um eine Verfälschung des Wettbewerbs auszuschließen. Hierzu zählen insbesondere die Gleichbehandlung aller interessierten Unternehmen, die Bereitstellung relevanter Informationen für alle Bewerber und Bieter sowie die Festlegung angemessener Fristen. Voraussichtliche Zeitplanung • Veröffentlichung der Markterkundung: 18.12.2025 • Interessenbekundung zur Teilnahme: unverzüglich • Einreichung der Erstkonzeption: Januar 2026 • Präsentationen und Interviews: Januar 2026

result.text: THIS IS NOT A PRIOR INFORMATION NOTICE, CONTRACT NOTICE OR CALL FOR COMPETITION, BUT A NOTICE OF THE LAUNCH OF MARKET DIALOGUE AS PART OF PROCUREMENT PLANNING. Länsi-Uudenmaan hyvinvointialue is surveying suppliers' interest in a tender concerning a recruitment system. Suppliers interested in the procurement are requested to express their interest in the procurement by email. Expressing interest in the request for information does not bind the service provider/supplier to participate in the tendering procedure, nor is it a prerequisite for participating in the actual tendering procedure later. The subject of the request for information is a recruitment system package that supports all stages of Länsi-Uudenmaan hyvinvointialue's recruitment process and enables the smooth execution of the process. The system must be flexible, user-friendly and easily developable according to future needs. With its help, routine tasks and the documentation of the recruitment process required by the Local Government Act can be largely automated, and it is possible to transfer data electronically between other systems from the system through integrations. The aim is to offer applicants a good applicant experience, and the system must adapt to various recruitment needs and clearly depict the progress of recruitments. Flexible functions are required for substitute recruitment, such as the automatic contacting of those registered in the substitute pool at the time of publishing the substitute need, as well as the possibility of automated applicant selection and information. 1. General description of the system, also in the role of a jobseeker. 2. Functional features: - Building the organisation in the system, user rights at different levels, creating user rights ("mass" creation in the implementation phase) - Stages of the recruitment process (permit processing, notices, applications, communication and message templates (applicants, line managers, main users), video interviews, comparisons, reporting/statistics, monitoring the progress of recruitments, "desktop" views of recruitments for line managers and main users, document templates (possibility to create various document templates)) - Stages and functionalities of substitute recruitment (is it possible to transfer data electronically for drawing up the employment contract) - Publishing interfaces (e.g. Job Market Finland, other channels) - Customisability of application forms - Booking interviews via the interview calendar, anonymous recruitment, video interview, artificial intelligence utilisation possibilities, social media - Co-operation tool / module, if the supplier's solution includes the functionality, functionality means the organisation and automation of obligations related to job offering, re-placement, re-engagement obligation and lay-offs - Artificial intelligence utilisation possibilities in different stages of the recruitment process 3. Technical requirements: - Browser and terminal device support (PC, tablet, mobile; Chrome, Firefox, Edge) - Multilingualism (Finnish, Swedish, English) - Ensuring usability and performance, fault tolerance 4. Delivery project and training: - Implementation schedule and project management model - Training package - Support and orientation for main users 5. Support and advisory services: - Support channels for users and jobseekers (telephone, email, chat) - Support for user management and permit processes - Service level reporting and incident management 6. Flexibility and extensibility: - Support for the further development of the system and integrations e.g. to the HR system, electronic archive and document management system. 7. References and user experiences: - Comparable implementations in the public sector - Success of implementations and customer satisfaction Länsi-Uudenmaan hyvinvointialue requests that responses to the request for information be submitted no later than 23.12 at 12 to the email address marja.ahola@luvn.fi. You may, if you wish, submit a brochure/presentation of your solution as an email attachment. Länsi-Uudenmaan hyvinvointialue will select 4 suppliers for further discussions. We will organise separate discussions with the selected suppliers in January 2026 during weeks 4-6 (the exact time will be specified later) via Teams.

Länsi-Uudenmaan hyvinvointialue kartoittaa Toimittajien kiinnostusta rekrytointijärjestelmää koskevaan kilpailutukseen. Hankinnasta kiinnostuneita Toimittajia pyydetään ilmoittamaan kiinnostuksensa hankintaa kohtaan sähköpostitse. Kiinnostuksen ilmaiseminen tietopyyntöä kohtaan ei sido palveluntuottajaa/Toimittajaa tarjouskilpailuun osallistumiseen, eikä myöskään ole edellytyksenä myöhemmin varsinaiseen tarjouskilpailuun osallistumiselle. Tietopyynnön kohteena on rekrytoinnin järjestelmäkokonaisuus, joka tukee Länsi-Uudenmaan hyvinvointialueen rekrytointiprosessin kaikkia vaiheita ja mahdollistaa prosessin sujuvan läpiviennin. Järjestelmän tulee olla joustava, käyttäjäystävällinen ja helposti kehitettävissä tulevien tarpeiden mukaan. Sen avulla rutiinitehtävät ja kuntalain edellyttämä rekrytointiprosessin dokumentointi voidaan pitkälti automatisoida, ja järjestelmästä on mahdollista integraatioiden kautta siirtää tietoa sähköisesti muiden järjestelmien välillä. Hakijoille halutaan tarjota hyvä hakijakokemus, ja järjestelmän tulee mukautua erilaisiin rekrytointitarpeisiin sekä kuvata rekrytointien eteneminen selkeästi. Sijaisrekrytointiin vaaditaan joustavat toiminnot, kuten sijaispooliin ilmoittautuneiden automaattinen kontaktointi sijaistarpeen julkaisuhetkellä sekä mahdollisuus automatisoituun hakijan valintaan ja informointiin. 1. Järjestelmän yleiskuvaus, myös työnhakijan roolissa. 2. Toiminnalliset ominaisuudet: - Organisaation rakentaminen järjestelmään, eri tasoiset käyttäjäoikeudet, käyttöoikeuksien luominen (käyttöönottovaiheessa ”massa” luonti) - Rekrytointiprosessin vaiheet (lupakäsittely, ilmoitukset, hakemukset, viestintä ja viestipohjat (hakijat, esihenkilöt, pääkäyttäjät), videohaastattelut, vertailut, raportointi/tilastointi, rekrytointien etenemisen seuraaminen, esihenkilöiden ja pääkäyttäjien ”työpöytä” näkymät rekrytointeihin, asiakirjapohjat (mahdollisuus luoda erilaisia asiakirjapohjia) - Sijaisrekrytoinnin vaiheet ja toiminnallisuudet (onko mahdollista siirtää tietoja sähköisesti työsopimuksen tekoa varten) - Julkaisurajapinnat (esim. Työmarkkinatori, muut kanavat) - Hakulomakkeiden muokattavuus - Haastattelukalenterin kautta haastattelujen ajanvaraus, anonyymi rekrytointi, videohaastattelu, tekoälyn käyttömahdollisuudet, some - YT-työkalu / moduuli, mikäli toimittajan ratkaisu toiminnallisuuden sisältää, toiminnallisuudella tarkoitetaan työn tarjoamiseen, uudelleen sijoittamiseen, takaisinottovelvollisuuteen ja lomautuksiin liittyvien velvollisuuksien organisointia ja automatisointia - Tekoälyn käyttömahdollisuudet rekrytointiprosessin eri vaiheissa 3. Tekniset vaatimukset: - Selain- ja päätelaitetuki (PC, tabletti, mobiili; Chrome, Firefox, Edge) - Monikielisyys (suomi, ruotsi, englanti) - Käytettävyyden ja suorituskyvyn varmistaminen, virheenkestävyys 4. Toimitusprojekti ja koulutus: - Toteutusaikataulu ja projektin hallintamalli - Koulutuskokonaisuus - Pääkäyttäjien tuki ja perehdytys 5. Tuki- ja neuvontapalvelut: - Käyttäjien ja työnhakijoiden tukikanavat (puhelin, sähköposti, chat) - Käyttäjähallinnan ja lupaprosessien tuki - Palvelutasoraportointi ja häiriötilanteiden hallinta 6. Joustavuus ja laajennettavuus: - Tuki järjestelmän jatkokehitykselle ja integraatioille esim. hr-järjestelmään, sähköiseen arkistoon ja asianhallintajärjestelmään. 7. Referenssit ja käyttökokemukset: -Vastaavat toteutukset julkisella sektorilla -Käyttöönottojen onnistuminen ja asiakastyytyväisyys Länsi-Uudenmaan hyvinvointialue pyytää vastaamaan tietopyyntöön viimeistään 23.12 klo 12 sähköpostiosoitteeseen marja.ahola@luvn.fi. result.text: To comply with its statutory obligations (section 146 of the German Fiscal Code (AO) and the Cash Register Security Ordinance (KassenSichV)), the BSI must update the protection profiles BSI-CC-PP-0104 Cryptographic Service Provider (CSP) and BSI-CC-PP-0111 CSPLight (CSPL). For this purpose, the project will also enhance the aforementioned protection profiles for broader use in the areas of eID / EUDI wallet, 5G and FIDO / passkeys. This also requires drawing up a standardised interface description for CSPLight products in central data centre operations in order to increase interoperability and minimise dependencies on proprietary architectures. The project is divided into three separate lots (professional lots within the meaning of section 97 subsection 4 of the Act against Restraints of Competition (GWB)): - Lot 1: Adaptation and update of the CSP protection profile and CSPL protection profile (Update-CSPL) - Lot 2: Evaluation of CSP-PP/CSPL-PP (Eval-CSPL) - Lot 3: Standardised interface description (API-CSPL) Lot 1 comprises the update and modularisation of the protection profiles PP-CSP and PP-CSPL. Building upon this, an evaluation of the CSP and CSPL protection profiles in accordance with EUCC will be carried out in lot 2. Finally, a uniform, standardised interface description for the CSP-Light will be drawn up in lot 3 on the basis of the protection profile created in lot 1. Details can be found in the specifications (see annexes). The aim of lot 1 is to adapt and update the protection profiles PP-CSP and PP-CSPL. In doing so, the two protection profiles are to be merged while pursuing the multi-assurance approach. The new protection profile is to be designed modularly so that it is possible to serve various application purposes and enable broad application. Here, the core of the PP is to be restricted to the minimum necessary functionality of the CSP(L). All functionalities that are only required for specific purposes are to be outsourced into modules. Dedicated PP configurations are to be drawn up for the individual application scenarios mentioned above, which may each contain suitable combinations of function modules. In this lot, a draft concept will first be drawn up together with the contracting authority, then the detailed architecture is to be described, and in a further work package the focus will lie on the actual creation of the PP. The aim of the lot is an updated and modularised protection profile as well as at least one associated PP configuration for the cash registers and eID application case.; The subject matter of the contract in lot 2 is the evaluation of the protection profile created in lot 1. The result of lot 2 is complete individual test reports, so that the available reports can be submitted for the certification of the protection profile and its configuration and all formal requirements are met.; The aim in lot 3 is the creation of a uniform, standardised interface description for the CSP, so that vendor-independent use of a CSP on a secure server architecture is enabled for external applications. The basis for the interface description is to be the updated and modularised protection profiles, or the merged protection profile from lot 1 as well as the current BSI TR-CSP2.

parts.source: Um seinen gesetzlichen Verpflichtungen (§146a AO und KassenSichV) nachzukommen muss das BSI die Schutzprofile BSI-CC-PP-0104 Cryptographic Service Provider (CSP) und BSI-CC-PP-0111 CSPLight (CSPL) aktualisieren. Hierzu sollen im Projekt die genannten Schutzprofile ebenfalls für eine breitere Verwendung im Bereich eID / EUDI-Wallet, 5G und FIDO / Passkeys ertüchtigt werden. Dafür notwendig ist auch die Erarbeitung einer standardisierte Schnittstellenbeschreibung für CSPLight Produkte im zentralen Rechenzentrumsbetrieb, um die Interoperabilität zu erhöhen und Abhängigkeiten zu proprietären Architekturen zu minimieren. Das Projekt gliedert sich in drei separate Lose (Fachlose im Sinne des § 97 Abs. 4 GWB): - Los 1: Anpassung und Aktualisierung des CSP-Schutzprofils und CSPL-Schutzprofils (Update-CSPL) - Los 2: Evaluierung CSP-PP/CSPL-PP (Eval-CSPL) - Los 3: Standardisierte Schnittestellenbeschreibung (API-CSPL) Los 1 beinhaltet die Aktualisierung und Modularisierung der Schutzprofile PP-CSP und PP-CSPL. Daran anknüpfend wird in Los 2 eine Evaluierung der Schutzprofile CSP und CSPL nach EUCC durchgeführt. Abschließend wird in Los 3 eine einheitliche, standardisierte Schnittstellenbeschreibung für den CSP-Light auf Basis des in Los 1 erstellten Schutzprofils erarbeitet. Details sind den Leistungsbeschreibungen (siehe Anlagen) zu entnehmen. Ziel in Los 1 ist die Anpassung und Aktualisierung der Schutzprofile PP-CSP und PP-CSPL. Dabei sollen die beiden Schutzprofile zusammengeführt werden und dabei der Multi-Assurance Ansatz verfolgt werden. Das neue Schutzprofil soll modular so gestaltet werden, dass es möglich ist verschiedene Einsatzzwecke zu bedienen und eine breite Anwendung zu ermöglichen. Hierbei soll der Kern des PPs auf die minimale notwendige Funktionalität des CSP(L) beschränkt werden. Alle Funktionalitäten, welche nur für bestimmte Zwecke benötigt werden, sollen in Module ausgelagert werden. Für die einzelnen oben genannten Anwendungsszenarien sollen dedizierte PP-Konfigurationen erarbeitet werden, die jeweils passende Kombinationen von Funktionsmodulen enthalten können. Im Los wird zunächst zusammen mit dem AG ein Konzeptentwurf erarbeitet, anschließend soll die detaillierte Architektur beschrieben werden und in einem weiterer AP liegt der Fokus auf der eigentlichen PP Erstellung. Ziel des Loses ist ein aktualisiertes und modularisiertes Schutzprofil sowie mindestens eine zugehörige PP-Konfiguration für den Anwendungsfall Registrierkassen und eID.; Auftragsgegenstand in Los 2 ist die Evaluierung des in Los 1 erstellten Schutzprofils. Ergebnis des Loses 2 sind vollständige Einzelprüfberichte, sodass die vorliegenden Berichte zur Zertifizierung des Schutzprofils und seiner Konfiguration eingereicht werden können und alle formalen Anforderungen erfüllt sind.; Ziel in Los 3 ist die Erstellung einer einheitlichen, standardisierten Schnittstellenbeschreibung für den CSP, sodass eine herstellerunabhängige Nutzung eines CSP auf einer sicheren Server-Architektur für externe Anwendungen ermöglicht wird. Die Grundlage für die Schnittstellenbeschreibung sollen die aktualisierten und modularisierten Schutzprofile, bzw. das zusammengeführte Schutzprofil aus Los 1 sein sowie die aktuelle BSI TR-CSP2.

result.text: 2M-IT Oy operates on an in-house principle and conducts competitive tendering for, as well as produces, ICT solutions and services for its owner-customers as their affiliated and joint procurement entity. The owner-customer, the Wellbeing Services County of Southwest Finland (the end customer of the procurement, “End Customer”), has, together with 2M-IT Oy, initiated a competitive dialogue procedure via a contract notice and invitation to participate, the subject of which is the licences and usage rights (“Technology Licences”) for an ERP entity (“Technology”) produced as a SaaS service, which concerns technology consisting of the functional areas of finance, logistics and procurement, as well as limited additional services directly related to the Technology that are specified during the procurement procedure, such as expert, support, product, interface, information security, access rights, technical environment or continuity assurance services, insofar as they relate directly to the use, management, maintenance or development of the offered SaaS technology during the contract period. 2M-IT Oy will, as the contracting authority, own the Technology Licences to be procured. Two procurements will be implemented in the TALOHA ERP programme: the procurement of technology licences and the procurement of a system integrator. The competitive tendering concerning this contract notice and invitation to participate will first implement the technology licence procurement, and it is aimed specifically at technology suppliers. The attached Project Description and its appendices contain more detailed preliminary information on, among other things, the procurement procedure, the description of the subject of the procurement, the progress of the procurement procedure, the application for participation and the selection of candidates, as well as the selection and award criteria.

Omistaja-asiakas Varsinais-Suomen hyvinvointialue (hankinnan loppuasiakas, ”Loppuasiakas”) on yhdessä 2M-IT Oy:n käynnistänyt hankintailmoituksella ja osallistumispyynnöllä kilpailullisen neuvottelumenettelyn, jonka kohteena ovat talouden, logistiikan ja hankinnan toiminnallisista osa-alueista muodostuvan teknologiaa koskevan SaaS-palveluna tuotettavan ERP-kokonaisuuden (”Teknologia”) lisenssit ja käyttöoikeudet (”Teknologialisenssit”) sekä Teknologiaan välittömästi liittyvät, hankintamenettelyn aikana täsmentyvät rajatut lisäpalvelut, kuten asiantuntija-, tuki-, tuote-, rajapinta-, tietoturva-, käyttöoikeus-, teknisen ympäristön tai jatkuvuuden varmistamiseen liittyvät palvelut siltä osin kuin ne liittyvät suoraan tarjottavan SaaS-teknologian käyttöön, hallintaan, ylläpitoon tai sopimuskauden aikaiseen kehittämiseen. 2M-IT Oy tulee hankintayksikkönä omistamaan hankittavat Teknologialisenssit. result.text: By the present procurement procedure, the EIT KIC Urban Mobility S.L. hereby being referred to as “EIT UM” or the “Company” is aiming to identify a provider (hereinafter, referred to as “Provider”) to support the Digital Platform for EIT Urban Mobility community, presently known as “Mobility Innovators”. This document, along with its annexes, constitute a Request for Proposal (RFP) issued by EIT Urban Mobility for a potential procurement of services in the field of online communities. EIT Urban Mobility community is made of over 270 partners and larger ecosystem of more than 1,200 stakeholders as we work together to make the transition to more sustainable urban mobility and liveable urban spaces. This community includes industry, including large enterprises, SMEs, and startups, universities and education institutions; students and alumni; research and technology organisations; governments at local, regional, national and EU-level; and non-governmental organisations (NGOs). Two years ago, EIT Urban Mobility launched its private digital community platform, Mobility Innovators, which brings together our vibrant community of innovators described above. The platform already has more than 1,500 active users and serves as the central platform for collaboration and engagement within our community. Mobility Innovators enables partners and stakeholders to access information, documents and opportunities shared by EIT Urban Mobility, register for events, and engage in discussions with peers across sectors. It connects organisations from industry, research, academia, and the public sector, fostering collaboration to advance the transition towards more sustainable and liveable urban mobility. Our goal in this next phase is to further grow and activate the community, expand platform functionalities, and enhance user experience to ensure Mobility Innovators continues to support EIT Urban Mobility’s role as Europe’s leading innovation community for urban mobility.

result.text: West Northamptonshire Council (WNC) is a relatively new Local Authority that has inherited a wide range of electronic document systems and storage methods from predecessor councils. These legacy solutions vary in functionality, levels of automation, and overall maturity, which often results in manual processes to meet compliance, retention, and operational needs. Key services such as Housing, Revenues & Benefits, Regulatory Services, the post room and Pensions and Payroll rely heavily on electronic document and records management to process and store critical information from residents, businesses, and other stakeholders. The Council uses several inherited systems for records management, each supporting different service areas. Additionally, WNC have an archive and heritage service that require archiving for long-term retention of digital materials. The project will consider opportunities to bring these capabilities together into a more consistent and modern corporate approach; in some cases, for archive data only.

result.text: Henneberg Clinics - Mobile Laboratory Automation and Robotics The subject matter is the planning, delivery, integration, conformity assessment, commissioning, acceptance and service of a fully mobile robotics/automation solution for barcode-supported sample flow between intake, pre-analytics, analysis systems, special dispensing, cooling and archiving. The solution must function as an overall system with laboratory equipment, LIS/middleware, building infrastructure and operator processes. Not the subject matter of this lot are medical laboratory services, the permanent provision of laboratory personnel, or the immediate procurement of transport or cleaning robots. Laboratory equipment and laboratory IT are procured separately. However, the robotics contractor remains responsible for the complete mechanical, electrical, software, control and safety engineering integration of the overall system they offer. Target image and functional equivalence: • Permanent robotics-supported in-house laboratory operations at the Hildburghausen site from 01.01.2027; no transitional supply. The first expansion stage is the mobile laboratory robotics system. • Documented peak intake: maximum approx. 30 samples per hour. The solution must not be unnecessarily oversized for this, but must demonstrate a comprehensible operational reserve. • Fully mobile, autonomously navigating robotics systems (AMR) or functionally equivalent mobile automation solutions are permitted. Stationary robot cells, linearly guided systems and permanently installed tracks do not meet the target image. • The solution offered is not an isolated robotics island: it is seamlessly integrated into order, sample, equipment, result, priority and error management and networked via a centrally provided orchestration and fleet management software. The software and platform architecture must be provably scalable for subsequent transport and cleaning robotics at two sites of the clinic association. A common or interoperable traffic logic, building and elevator interfaces, identity and certificate management, as well as a uniform operating and service concept must be provided. The initial procurement must not create unnecessary binding to proprietary laboratory equipment or closed building interfaces. Open, documented interface specifications that can be handed over to the contracting authority are a minimum requirement; a device-side extension to SiLA 2 or a functionally equivalent open standard must be presented. The contractor must describe the entry with a robust core workflow and the subsequent expansion with additional tasks, grippers, equipment, rooms and robotics domains in a technically and commercially comprehensible manner.

parts.source: Henneberg-Kliniken - Mobile Laborautomation und Robotik Gegenstand ist Planung, Lieferung, Integration, Konformitätsbewertung, Inbetriebnahme, Abnahme und Service einer vollständig mobilen Robotik-/Automationslösung für den barcodegestützten Probenfluss zwischen Eingang, Präanalytik, Analysesystemen, Sonderausgabe, Kühlung und Archiv. Die Lösung muss als Gesamtsystem mit Laborgeräten, LIS/Middleware, Gebäudeinfrastruktur und Betreiberprozessen funktionieren. Nicht Gegenstand dieses Loses sind die medizinische Laborleistung, die dauerhafte Gestellung des Laborpersonals sowie die sofortige Beschaffung von Transport- oder Reinigungsrobotern. Laborgeräte und Labor-IT werden gesondert beschafft. Der Auftragnehmer Robotik bleibt jedoch für die vollständige mechanische, elektrische, softwareseitige, steuerungs- und sicherheitstechnische Integration seines angebotenen Gesamtsystems verantwortlich. Zielbild und funktionale Gleichwertigkeit: • Dauerhafter robotikgestützter Eigenlaborbetrieb am Standort Hildburghausen ab 01.01.2027; keine Übergangsversorgung. Die erste Ausbaustufe ist das mobile Laborrobotiksystem. • Dokumentierte Spitzenannahme: maximal ca. 30 Proben je Stunde. Die Lösung darf dafür nicht unnötig überdimensioniert sein, muss aber eine nachvollziehbare Betriebsreserve ausweisen. • Zulässig sind vollständig mobile, autonom navigierende Robotiksysteme (AMR) oder funktional gleichwertige mobile Automationslösungen. Stationäre Roboterzellen, lineargeführte Systeme und fest installierte Fahrbahnen erfüllen das Zielbild nicht. • Die angebotene Lösung ist keine isolierte Robotikinsel: Sie wird durchgängig in Auftrags-, Proben-, Geräte-, Ergebnis-, Prioritäts- und Fehlermanagement integriert und über eine zentral bereitgestellte Orchestrierungs- und Flottenmanagementsoftware vernetzt. Die Software- und Plattformarchitektur muss nachweisbar für spätere Transport- und Reinigungsrobotik an zwei Standorten des Klinikverbunds skalierbar sein. Gemeinsame oder interoperable Verkehrslogik, Gebäude- und Aufzugsschnittstellen, Identitäts- und Zertifikatsverwaltung sowie ein einheitliches Betriebs- und Servicekonzept sind vorzusehen. Die Erstbeschaffung darf keine unnötige Bindung an proprietäre Laborgeräte oder geschlossene Gebäudeschnittstellen erzeugen. Offene, dokumentierte und an den Auftraggeber übergebbare Schnittstellenspezifikationen sind Mindestanforderung; eine geräteseitige Erweiterung auf SiLA 2 oder einen funktional gleichwertigen offenen Standard ist darzustellen. Der Auftragnehmer hat den Einstieg mit einem belastbaren Kernworkflow und die spätere Erweiterung um zusätzliche Aufgaben, Greifer, Geräte, Räume und Robotikdomänen technisch und kaufmännisch nachvollziehbar zu beschreiben.

rejected.text: Die Universität Hamburg (UHH) ist als Exzellenzuniversität mit rund 44.000 Studierenden nicht nur eine der forschungsstärksten und größten Universitäten Deutschlands – sie ist als Wirkungsstätte für Forschung, Lehre und Bildung vor allem auch eine moderne Wissensorganisation. result.text: The Universität Hamburg (UHH), as a University of Excellence with around 44.000 students, is not only one of Germany's largest and most research-intensive universities – as a centre for research, teaching and education, it is, above all, a modern knowledge organisation. Nowadays, this knowledge is primarily held in the form of digital information and processed and communicated with the help of digital tools. However, digitalisation goes far beyond the digital representation of information and its processing using digital methods: in the sense of a synergetic interaction between analogue and digital, digitality has long been an integral part of the reality of studying, research, teaching, learning, living and working at the UHH. The corresponding digital strategy of the UHH is intended as a university-wide orientation framework for a reflective approach to the opportunities and challenges of digital transformation, as well as for the successful implementation of digitalisation projects and initiatives. The project “Support by a Managed Security Service Provider (MSSP)” aims to cover the security requirements of the existing UHH IT infrastructure through a suitable service provider, provided this is not met by internal capacities. The subject of this procurement is the establishment and operation of a Security Operations Centre based at the UHH, funded by the BWFG: ▪ Universität Hamburg (UHH) ▪ Hamburg University of Applied Sciences (HAW) ▪ Hamburg University of Technology Universität Hamburg (TUHH) ▪ HafenCity University Universität Hamburg (HCU) ▪ Hamburg University of Fine Arts (HfBK) ▪ Hamburg University of Music and Theatre (HfMT). Essentially, the tender covers services in the following areas: ▪ Computer Emergency Response Team (CERT) services ▪ Threat Intelligence ▪ Security Operations Center (SOC) ▪ Automation of responses to security incidents ▪ Incident Response (IR) ▪ Operation of a Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) system ▪ Vulnerability scans and vulnerability management Overarching goals: ▪ Ensuring holistic operation, monitoring and continuous improvement of information security and proactive increase of the security level at Hamburg universities ▪ Early detection, assessment and appropriate handling of security incidents ▪ Sustainable reduction of risks to the IT systems, data and business processes of the UHH

result.text: The IT business division of UKJ has committed itself at the current time to the manufacturer Hewlett-Packard Enterprise (HPE) as the equipment supplier for extensions and substitutions of the existing IT infrastructure and therefore intends to conclude a framework agreement for the procurement of HPE system components. This is due to the fact that a comprehensive and almost complete data centre infrastructure from the manufacturer HPE exists, which must be permanently expanded and partially or substantially renewed as part of lifecycle management. Changing manufacturer would be associated with very high effort and high switching costs. The tender for the framework agreement pursues the objective of enabling an expansion of the existing IT infrastructure during the contract period, replacing components as part of lifecycle management that are technically or economically obsolete and, beyond that, the delivery of original HPE products. The services comprise the delivery, consultancy and maintenance of HPE products in the fields of IT infrastructure, servers, storage, cloud or the provision of HPE software (incl. rental software) as well as associated services. Installation and configuration services as well as measures to establish operational readiness are not explicitly part of the scope of the tender, unless they are listed in the price sheet or form part of the items in the price sheet or the included maintenance service. These measures will be commissioned separately by the contracting authority as needed.

parts.source: Der GB IT des UKJ legt sich zum aktuellen Zeitpunkt auf den Hersteller Hewlett-Packard Enterprise (HPE) als Ausstatter für Erweiterungen und Substitutionen der bestehenden IT-Infrastruktur fest und beabsichtigt daher den Abschluss einer Rahmenvereinbarung zur Beschaffung von HPE-Systemkomponenten. Dies ist darin begründet, dass eine flächendeckende und nahezu vollständige RZ-Infrastruktur des Herstellers HPE existiert, welche permanent erweitert und im Rahmen eines Lifecycle-Managements partiell oder substantiell erneuert werden muss. Ein Herstellerwechsel wäre mit sehr hohem Aufwand und hohen Wechselkosten verbunden. Die Ausschreibung der Rahmenvereinbarung verfolgt die Zielstellung, im Vertragszeitraum eine Erweiterung der bestehenden IT-Infrastruktur zu ermöglichen, im Rahmen des Lifecyclemanagements Komponenten zu ersetzen, welche technisch oder wirtschaftlich veraltet sind und darüber hinaus die Lieferung von Original HPE Produkten. Die Leistungen umfassen die Lieferung, Beratung und Wartung von HPE-Produkten im Bereich IT-Infrastruktur, Server, Speicher, Cloud- bzw. der Bereitstellung von HPE-Software (inkl. Mietsoftware) sowie dazugehöriger Dienstleistungen. Installations- und Konfigurationsdienstleistungen sowie Maßnahmen zur Herstellung der Betriebsbereitschaft gehören nicht explizit zum Inhalt der Ausschreibung, soweit sie nicht im Preisblatt aufgeführt oder Bestandteil der Positionen im Preisblatt oder der inkludierten Wartungsleistung sind. Diese Maßnahmen werden bei Bedarf durch den Auftraggeber separat beauftragt.

result.text: This request for information is intended to examine questions and price estimates related to the procurement of a dictation transcription service and speech recognition solution for use in pathology by Fimlab Laboratoriot Oy (hereinafter referred to as "Fimlab" or the "contracting authority"). This is not a contract notice or a call for competition, but rather a request for information for a market survey, the objective of which is to obtain comprehensive additional information regarding the planned procurement so that any future tendering procedure can be carried out as appropriately as possible, taking into account the latest technologies and market trends. Fimlab invites interested suppliers to participate in the market survey and requests your views regarding the planned procurement. Fimlab does not bind itself to carry out the procurement that is the subject of the request for information. Decisions on launching a potential procurement process will be made after the market survey. The procurement would potentially consist of the following parts: 1) Dictation transcription service 2) Speech recognition solution The contracting authority will evaluate the division of the procurement into parts based on suppliers' responses. Dictations for the dictation transcription service and the speech recognition solution are divided into three categories by length: Short: under 499 characters Medium: 500–1500 characters Long: over 1501 characters. DICTATION TRANSCRIPTION SERVICE In the dictation transcription service, a digital dictation recorded by a healthcare professional in audio file format in text format is transcribed into text format and saved in Fimlab's IT management systems using an encrypted remote connection. The dictation transcription service must include a cloud-based (SaaS) dictation management system and associated workstation and mobile applications used for recording dictation. The dictation transcription service will be integrated into Fimlab's LIS (Whitelake Software Point's LabVantage Medical Suite). The dictation transcription service must be provided in Finnish and Swedish. The dictation transcription service must recognise the medical terminology and vocabulary used in specialised medical care as well as foreign words related to the context. The dictation transcription service must be provided on weekdays (Mon-Fri) between 08:00-18:00 according to Fimlab's needs. The dictation system must be available 24/7. Users of the dictation transcription service are employees of the pathology unit, with pathology physicians as the primary users. Not all physicians may necessarily start using the service immediately at the deployment stage, but they must have the opportunity to join as users of the service later. The service must include maintenance, technical support, user support and a sufficient number of user licences related to the use of the dictation system and the provision of the transcription service. Approximately 50 000 - 60 000 reports are routed to the transcription service annually. SPEECH RECOGNITION SOLUTION The speech recognition solution is procured as a cloud service (SaaS service), and the procurement also includes deployment, user and support services. The speech recognition solution must include real-time direct speech recognition in Finnish and Swedish. The speech recognition application must produce text content that is easily transferable to the target system. The speech recognition application must have medical vocabulary capabilities. The application will not be integrated or connected to existing Fimlab IT systems. The speech recognition solution must operate as an application installed on users' desktops. RESPONDING TO THE REQUEST FOR INFORMATION Companies interested in the procurement are requested to answer the questions attached to the request for information ("Questions for the Request for Information") and submit the completed attachment via the Tender Service Portal. You may submit your response in Finnish or English in a free-form manner (in writing). Your responses will be utilised in the preparation of the procurement and in finalising the contract notice and its attachments. All responses will be treated confidentially. Information will not be shared with other suppliers without written consent to disclose the information. Please follow the numbering of the questions. Also clearly indicate trade secrets or confidential information. The procurement parts described above are Fimlab's preliminary views. We would gladly hear if you have alternative solutions to offer. Responding to the request for information does not affect a potential tenderer's position in the actual tendering procedure. No compensation is paid to those who responded to the request for information for their participation. If the contracting authority deems it necessary, it is possible that the contracting authority will continue supplier-specific discussions with a maximum of 5 suppliers.

parts.source: Tällä tietopyynnöllä on tarkoitus selvittää Fimlab Laboratoriot Oy:n (jäljempänä "Fimlab" tai "hankintayksikkö") patologian käyttöön tulevien sanelunpurkupalvelun ja puheentunnistusratkaisun hankintaan liittyviä kysymyksiä ja hinta-arvioita. Tämä ei ole hankintailmoitus tai tarjouspyyntö, vaan markkinakartoituksen tietopyyntö, jonka tavoitteena on saada kattavasti suunnitteilla olevaan hankintaan liittyen lisätietoa, jotta mahdollinen tuleva tarjouskilpailu voidaan toteuttaa mahdollisimman tarkoituksenmukaisesti huomioiden uusimmat teknologiat ja markkinasuuntaukset. Fimlab kutsuu kiinnostuneita toimittajia osallistumaan markkinakartoitukseen ja pyytää näkemyksiänne suunnitteilla olevaan hankintaan liittyen. Fimlab ei sitoudu toteuttamaan tietopyynnön kohteena olevaa hankintaa. Päätökset mahdollisen hankintaprosessin käynnistämisestä tehdään markkinakartoituksen jälkeen. Hankinta muodostuisi mahdollisesti seuraavista osa-alueista: 1) Sanelunpurkupalvelu 2) Puheentunnistusratkaisu Hankintayksikkö arvioi hankinnan jakamista osiin toimittajien vastausten perusteella. Sanelunpurkupalvelu ja puheentunnistusratkaisun sanelut jaetaan pituuden mukaan kolmeen luokkaan: Lyhyet: alle 499 merkkiä Keskipitkät: 500–1500 merkkiä Pitkät: yli 1501 merkkiä. SANELUNPURKUPALVELU Sanelunpurkupalvelussa terveydenhuollon ammattilaisen nauhoittama digitaalinen, äänitiedostomuotoon saneltu tekstimuotoinen sanelu puretaan tekstimuotoon ja tallennetaan Fimlabin tietohallintajärjestelmiin salattua etäyhteyttä käyttäen. Sanelunpurkupalvelussa tulee olla pilvipohjainen (SaaS) sanelunhallintajärjestelmä ja siihen liittyvät sanelun tallentamiseen käytettävät työasema- ja mobiilisovellukset. Sanelunpurkupalvelu integroidaan Fimlabin LISiin (Whitelake Software Pointin LabVantage Medical Suite). Sanelunpurkupalvelu tulee tuottaa suomen ja ruotsin kielellä. Sanelunpurkupalvelun tulee tunnistaa erikoissairaanhoidossa käytettävä lääketieteen termistö ja sanasto sekä asiayhteyteen liittyvät vierasperäiset sanat. Sanelunpurkupalvelua on tuotettava arkipäivisin (ma-pe) kello 08:00-18:00 välisenä aikana Fimlabin tarpeen mukaan. Sanelujärjestelmän tulee olla käytettävissä 24/7. Sanelunpurkupalvelun käyttäjiä ovat patologian yksikön työntekijät, pääasiallisina käyttäjinä patologian lääkärit. Kaikki lääkärit eivät välttämättä ota palvelua käyttöön heti käyttöönottovaiheessa, mutta heillä tulee olla mahdollisuus liittyä palvelun käyttäjiksi myöhemmin. Palvelun tulee sisältää sanelujärjestelmän käyttämiseen sekä purkupalvelun tuottamiseen liittyvän ylläpidon, teknisen tuen, käyttäjätuen ja riittävän määrän käyttöoikeuksia. Purkupalveluun ohjautuu vuodessa lausuntoja noin 50 000 - 60 000. PUHEENTUNNISTUSRATKAISU Puheentunnistusratkaisu hankitaan pilvipalveluna (SaaS-palveluna) ja hankintaan liittyvät myös käyttöönotto-, käyttö- ja tukipalvelut. Puheentunnistusratkaisun tulee sisältää reaaliaikainen suomen- ja ruotsinkielinen suorapuheentunnistus. Puheentunnistussovelluksen tulee tuottaa tekstimuotoista sisältöä, joka on helposti siirrettävissä kohdejärjestelmään. Puheentunnistussovelluksessa tulee olla lääketieteellinen sanastokyvykkyys. Sovellusta ei integroida eikä kytketä olemassa oleviin Fimlabin tietojärjestelmiin. Puheentunnistusratkaisu on toimittava sovelluksena, joka asennetaan käyttäjien työpöydälle. TIETOPYYNTÖÖN VASTAAMINEN Hankinnasta kiinnostuneita yrityksiä pyydetään vastaamaan tietopyynnön liitteenä ("Tietopyynnön kysymykset") oleviin kysymyksiin ja toimittamaan liitetiedosto täytettynä Tarjouspalveluportaalin kautta. Voitte toimittaa vastauksenne suomeksi tai englanniksi vapaamuotoisesti (kirjallisesti). Vastauksianne hyödynnetään hankinnan valmistelussa sekä tarjouspyynnön ja sen liitteiden viimeistelyssä. Kaikki vastaukset käsitellään luottamuksellisesti. Tietoja ei jaeta muille toimittajille ilman kirjallista suostumusta tiedon luovuttamiseen. Pyydämme noudattamaan kysymysten numerointia. Ilmaiskaa selkeästi myös liikesalaisuudet tai luottamukselliset tiedot. Edellä kuvatut hankinnan osa-alueet ovat Fimlabin alustavia näkemyksiä. Kuulisimme mielellään, jos teillä on tarjota vaihtoehtoisia ratkaisuja. Tietopyyntöön vastaaminen ei vaikuta mahdollisen tarjoajan asemaan varsinaisessa tarjouskilpailussa. Tietopyyntöön vastanneille ei makseta korvausta osallistumisesta. Mikäli hankintayksikkö katsoo tarpeelliseksi, on mahdollista, että hankintayksikkö jatkaa toimittajakohtaisia keskusteluita enintään 5 toimittajan kanssa.

result.text: The contracting authority is planning the supply of eligible connections in accordance with the Gigabit Directive 2.0 through a gigabit-capable network based on FTTB technology by means of awarding a grant to a network operator (funding gap). The aim is to eliminate still existing grey areas. The project is to be funded by means of a federal grant for a funding gap model pursuant to no. 3.1 of the directive "Funding to support the gigabit expansion of telecommunications networks in the Federal Republic of Germany" of 31.03.2023, in the amending version of 13.01.2025 (Gigabit Directive 2.0), as well as pursuant to the "Administrative regulation of the Ministry of the Interior on the co-financing of the federal directive "Funding to support the gigabit expansion of telecommunications networks in the Federal Republic of Germany" (VwV Gigabitmitfinanzierung)". Neuenstein is a town in the Hohenlohekreis district in the Franconian-characterised northeast of Baden-Württemberg. It belongs to the Heilbronn-Franken Regional Association. The town is divided into seven districts: Neuenstein, Kirchensall with Neureut, Kleinhirschbach, Obersöllbach, Eschelbach, Kesselfeld and Grünbühl. Neighbouring municipalities are Kupferzell, Waldenburg, Öhringen, Zweiflingen, Forchtenberg, Niedernhall and Künzelsau. These are (clockwise, starting in the west): Öhringen, Zweifingen, Forchtenberg, Niederhall, Künzelsau, Kupferzell, Waldenburg. For the Stadt Neuenstein, supplying citizens and commercial enterprises with high-performance and future-proof broadband services is an important task in the sense of services of general interest, economic promotion and securing the business location. With the requirement for high data rates and long transmission distances between networks, the expansion of fibre-optic technology in particular plays a decisive part. Parts of the municipal area of Neuenstein are still insufficiently supplied with broadband connections within the meaning of the Gigabit Directive 2.0. The project area was therefore analysed in advance regarding available bandwidths and any planned self-expansion by private-sector telecommunications companies by carrying out a market consultation procedure in order to determine the expansion area of eligible broadband expansion based on the Gigabit Directive 2.0. Here, the results of the conducted market consultation were taken into account in compliance with the provisions of European state aid law and published on the central online platform of the federal project sponsor. It became apparent that the gigabit capability of the network is not given in parts of the queried area and therefore eligible connections within the meaning of the Gigabit Directive 2.0 are present.

parts.source: Der Auftraggeber plant die Versorgung der förderfähigen Anschlüsse gemäß Gigabit-Richtlinie 2.0 durch ein gigabitfähiges Netz auf Basis der FTTB-Technologie mittels der Vergabe einer Zuwendung an einen Netzbetreiber (Wirtschaftlichkeitslücke). Ziel ist die Beseitigung noch vorhandener Grauer Flecken. Das Projekt soll mittels einer Zuwendung des Bundes für ein Wirtschaftlichkeitslückenmodell nach Nr. 3.1 der Richtlinie „Förderung zur Unterstützung des Gigabitausbaus der Telekommunikationsnetze in der Bundesrepublik Deutschland“ vom 31.03.2023, in der Änderungsfassung vom 13.01.2025 (Gigabit-Richtlinie 2.0), sowie nach der sowie nach der „Verwaltungsvorschrift des Innenministeriums zur Mitfinanzierung der Bundes-Richtlinie „Förderung zur Unterstützung des Gigabitausbaus der Telekommunikationsnetze in der Bundesrepublik Deutschland“ (VwV Gigabitmitfinanzierung)“ gefördert werden. Neuenstein ist eine Stadt im Hohenlohekreis im fränkisch geprägten Nordosten Baden-Württembergs. Sie gehört zum Regionalverband Heilbronn-Franken. Die Stadt gliedert sich in sieben Stadtteile: Neuenstein, Kirchensall mit Neureut, Kleinhirschbach, Obersöllbach, Eschelbach, Kesselfeld und Grünbühl. Nachbargemeinden sind Kupferzell, Waldenburg, Öhringen, Zweiflingen, Forchtenberg, Niedernhall und Künzelsau. Diese sind (im Uhrzeigersinn, beginnend im Westen): Öhringen, Zweifingen, Forchtenberg, Niederhall, Künzelsau, Kupferzell, Waldenburg. Für die Stadt Neuenstein ist die Versorgung der Bürgerinnen und Bürger sowie der Gewerbetreibenden mit leistungsfähigen und zukunftsträchtigen Breitbanddiensten ein wichtiger Auftrag im Sinne der Daseinsvorsorge, Wirtschaftsförderung sowie der Standortsicherung. Mit der Anforderung hoher Datenraten und langen Übertragungsstrecken zwischen Netzwerken spielt gerade der Ausbau der Glasfasertechnologie eine entscheidende Rolle. Teile des Stadtgebiets Neuenstein sind noch unzureichend mit Breitbandanschlüssen im Sinne der Gigabit-Richtlinie 2.0 versorgt. Das Projektgebiet wurde somit im Vorlauf hinsichtlich der verfügbaren Bandbreiten und evtl. geplanter Eigenausbauten der privatwirtschaftlichen TK-Unternehmen mittels der Durchführung eines Markterkundungsverfahrens analysiert, um das Ausbaugebiet des förderfähigen Breitbandausbaus auf Basis der Gigabit-Richtlinie 2.0 zu bestimmen. Hierbei wurden die Ergebnisse der durchgeführten Markterkundung unter Einhaltung der Vorschriften des europäischen Beihilferechts berücksichtigt und auf der zentralen Online-Plattform des Projektträgers des Bundes veröffentlicht. Es wurde deutlich, dass in Teilen des abgefragten Gebiets die Gigabit-Fähigkeit des Netzes nicht gegeben ist und somit förderfähige Anschlüsse im Sinne der Gigabit-Richtlinie 2.0 vorliegen.
