The London Borough of Croydon is undertaking preliminary market engagement in relation to the potential commissioning of an Erasmus+ teacher/educator training and international mobility programme for Croydon schools. The Council is seeking expressions of interest only from organisations with demonstrable previous experience of managing and delivering Erasmus+ projects and international education mobility programmes on behalf of schools or public-sector organisations. The appointed provider would be expected to provide end-to-end programme management, including: • Previous experience of successfully managing and delivering Erasmus+ projects, including details of the number and type of projects delivered • Management and coordination of international teacher training, CPD and school visits across European destinations, with destinations to be confirmed • Organisation and management of participant travel, accommodation, and associated logistics • Support with participant recruitment and selection, including ensuring appropriate eligibility and allocation processes • Management of Erasmus+ grant administration, financial monitoring, evidence, and reporting requirements • Support for safeguarding, risk management and participant welfare throughout the programme • Delivery or commissioning of high-quality teacher CPD and training aligned to the agreed programme objectives • Development and implementation of programme evaluation, impact measurement, and outcomes reporting • Monitoring and reporting on participant outcomes and the wider impact of the programme on participating schools; and • Effective stakeholder management and communication with the Council, schools, training providers, and international partners. The programme is intended to support Croydon schools in developing practice in areas including inclusion and SEND, digital and AI-enabled education, wellbeing, sustainability, innovation, and oracy/communication-rich learning, aligned with relevant Erasmus+ priorities. Providers should only register an interest where they can demonstrate the relevant specialist experience, capacity, international networks and organisational infrastructure required to manage an Erasmus+ mobility programme from participant selection through to final evaluation and grant reporting. This market engagement exercise is intended to inform the Council's understanding of the market and potential future commissioning arrangements. It does not constitute a procurement process, and participation does not provide any advantage in any future procurement activity. result.text: The BWI GmbH (hereinafter referred to as "BWI") is considering awarding a framework agreement for the continuation and scaling of internet transit access with up to 500 Gbit/s at the Bördeland site in the amount of up to 14.869.161,11 € Euros (net) up to 22.303.741,67 Euros (net) (upper limit) by means of a negotiated procedure with a call for competition pursuant to Section 11 paragraph 1 sentence 1 alternative 2 of the Ordinance on the Award of Public Contracts (VSVgV). The framework agreement will be concluded for a maximum term of 7 years (3 years initial term, with an option to extend 4 times by 12 months each). The contractor shall provide the BWI with an IP transit broadband line to the internet for the Bördeland data centre as a service. This includes the provision of a blackholing procedure as an ISP procedure (Internet Service Provider procedure) for protection against DDoS attacks. Blackholing refers to the automatic redirection of Denial of Service (DoS) and Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) attacks to a so-called black hole so that these attacks run into a void. This avoids any impact of such IT attacks on the internet lines and services as well as the connected DMZ (demilitarised zone as a security transition) and the downstream IT-SysBw network. The blackholing procedure is a provider procedure that is tied to the respective provider technology. The service itself is provided without exception in the IT infrastructure of the same ISP. result.text: The Region of Southern Denmark is facing the procurement of a new regional IT solution for the imaging diagnostics areas (hereinafter the "Solution"). The Solution must encompass RIS, PACS, VNA, Clinical Viewer as well as support for breast cancer screening and constitutes the central clinical tool for radiological and nuclear medicine departments at the Region of Southern Denmark. The Solution must be put into operation at 4 hospital units distributed across 12 radiological departments, 3 nuclear medicine departments as well as the regional breast cancer screening. The Region of Southern Denmark has several hundred imaging modalities and performs over 1 million examinations annually. The Solution must support an efficient clinical workflow in a patient-safe and user-friendly manner, as well as ensure the coherent patient pathway across hospital units, departments and specialties. The Solution must be a robust, stable and well-functioning tool in the clinicians' daily work while simultaneously possessing the flexibility necessary to accommodate future improvement initiatives and changed needs. The tendered procurement is described in further detail in Appendix-03 with sub-appendices. The procurement itself encompasses functionality to support workflows within radiology, nuclear medicine and mammography screening, as well as the storage of imaging diagnostics examinations. The procurement furthermore encompasses the implementation and maintenance of the new solution. BDSYD principles: The procurement is made on the basis of four overarching principles, which the Parties must correspondingly use as fundamental principles for the Solution and the collaboration: • Efficient support of the patients' journey: The Solution is patient-safe, labour-saving, intuitive and user-friendly. • Stable operation: The large volume of imaging diagnostics examinations can take place securely, unperturbed by downtime and operational stoppages to the benefit of patients, employees and efficiency. • Performance: Short system response times in the solution and good performance, which is important for patients, employees and efficiency. • Standard solution: The Solution is well-functioning and well-tested in a comparable setup and has open and well-defined interfaces. There is an option for the Central Denmark Region and the North Denmark Region for the procurement of a corresponding solution, cf. Appendix-19 with sub-appendices. The Region of Southern Denmark is conducting the procurement on behalf of all the regions, and separate contracts will subsequently be concluded between the chosen Supplier and the individual region. It is noted that the Region of Southern Denmark has geoblocking in relation to a number of countries as listed in Appendix-02.A. parts.source: Region Syddanmark står over for at skulle anskaffe en ny regional IT-løsning til de billeddiagnostiske områder (herefter "Løsningen"). Løsningen skal omfatte RIS, PACS, VNA, Klinisk Viewer samt understøttelse af brystkræftscreeningen og udgør det centrale kliniske værktøj for radiologiske og nuklearmedicinske afdelinger hos Region Syddanmark. Løsningen skal ibrugtages på 4 sygehusenheder fordelt på 12 radiologiske afdelinger, 3 nuklearmedicinske afdelinger samt den regionale brystkræftscreening. Region Syddanmark råder over flere hundrede billeddannende modaliteter og udfører over 1 mio. undersøgelser årligt. Løsningen skal patientsikkert og brugervenligt understøtte en effektiv klinisk arbejdsgang samt sikre det sammenhængende patientforløb på tværs af sygehusenheder, afdelinger og specialer. Løsningen skal være et robust, stabilt og velfungerende værktøj i klinikernes daglige arbejde og samtidig have den fleksibilitet, der er nødvendig for at imødekomme fremtidige forbedringstiltag og ændrede behov. Den udbudte anskaffelse er uddybende beskrevet i Bilag-03 med underbilag. Selve anskaffelsen omfatter funktionalitet til understøttelse af arbejdsgangene inden for radiologi, nuklearmedicin og mammografiscreening samt lagring af billeddiagnostiske undersøgelser. Anskaffelsen omfatter endvidere implementering og vedligeholdelse af den nye løsning. BDSYD-principper: Anskaffelsen foretages med grundlag i fire overordnede principper, som Parterne tilsvarende skal benytte som grundlæggende principper for Løsningen og samarbejdet: • Effektiv understøttelse af patienternes vej: Løsningen er patientsikker, arbejdskraftbesparende, intuitiv og brugervenlig. • Stabil drift: Den store produktion af billeddiagnostiske undersøgelser kan foregå sikkert, uforstyrret af nedetid og driftsstop til fordel for patienter, medarbejdere og effektivitet. • Performance: Korte system-svartider i løsningen og god performance, hvilket er vigtigt for patienter, medarbejdere og effektivitet. • Standardløsning: Løsningen er velfungerende og velafprøvet i et sammenligneligt setup samt har åbne og veldefinerede snitflader. Der er option til Region Midtjylland og Region Nordjylland om anskaffelse af tilsvarende løsning, jf. Bilag-19 med underbilag. Region Syddanmark gennemfører udbuddet på vegne af alle regionerne, og der indgås efterfølgende særskilte kontrakter mellem den valgte Leverandør og den enkelte region. Det bemærkes, at Region Syddanmark har geoblokering ift. en række lande som oplistet i Bilag-02.A. Listen kan rekvireres ved henvendelse via kommunikationsfanen på udbudssitet Ethics og kan modtages af interesserede leverandører mod en fortrolighedserklæring fra den rekvirerende part. Der er taget højde for dette i den fastlagt tilbudsfrist.

It can also be utilised in family law services for the compilation of maintenance payment calculations and potentially for other social welfare calculations. Through this request for information, the South Karelia and Päijät-Häme wellbeing services counties are surveying digital solutions for the compilation of income and asset assessments for client fee decisions using robotics. The client fee decision is made in connection with the client's service decision, and this has an impact on the management of the client's process as well as on the suspension and termination of invoicing. parts.source: Tämä ei ole hankintailmoitus eikä tarjouspyyntö, vaan tietopyyntö, jolla Etelä-Karjalan ja Päijät-Hämeen hyvinvointialueet pyytävät järjestelmätoimittajia ilmoittautumaan mahdollista kilpailutusta varten. Kyseessä on tietopyyntö/markkinavuoropuhelu, jolla Etelä-Karjalan ja Päijät-Hämeen hyvinvointialueet kartoittavat mahdollisia järjestelmä Toimittajia Tulo- ja varallisuusselvityspalvelu sosiaalihuollon kotihoidon ja asumispalveluiden (yhteisöllinen ja ympärivuorokautinen asumisen) asiakasmaksun määrittelyyn. Sekä perheoikeudellisissa palveluissa elatusapulaskelman koostamiseen ja mahdollisesti muihin sosiaalihuollon laskelmiin hyödynnettävissä. Tällä tietopyynnöllä Etelä-Karjalan ja Päijät-Hämeen hyvinvointialueet kartoittavat digitaalisia ratkaisuja asiamaksupäätösten tulo- ja varallisuusselvityksen koostamiseen robotiikalla. Asiakasmaksupäätös tehdään asiakkaan palvelupäätökseen liittyen ja tällä on vaikutus asiakkaan prosessin hallintaan sekä laskutuksen keskeytyksiin ja päättymisiin. Kartoituksen tavoitteena on selvittää, millaisia alla kuvattuja toiminnallisuuksia sisältäviä tuoteratkaisuja on saatavilla Suomen markkinoilla. Markkinavuoropuhelun avulla hyvinvointialueet pyrkivät: 1. Saamaan tietoa markkinoiden tarjonnasta ja eri toimittajien ratkaisuista 2. Mahdolliset integraatioiden toteutus eri alustoille tai järjestelmiin 3. Arvioimaan tietoturvan ja tietosuojan toteutusta 4. Saamaan yleiskuvan hinnoittelumalleista ja kustannusrakenteista (ei yksittäisiä tarjouksia) 5. Kartoittamaan toimitus- ja palvelumalleja Markkinavuoropuhelu on avoin kaikille toimittajille, joilla on tarjota tämän ratkaisukokonaisuuden piiriin kuuluvia tuoteratkaisuja. Vuoropuhelun painopisteenä ovat ratkaisut, jotka pohjautuvat tulo- ja varallisuusselvityksen automaattiseen koostamiseen asiakasmaksupäätöksen tueksi. Toimittajia pyydetään esittelemään palveluita, jotka ovat kehitteillä tai valmiita ratkaisuja. Vuoropuheluun osallistuvan toimittajan edellytetään esittävän tuotantoon käyttöönotettava toiminnallisuus ja tieto siitä, miten tulo- ja varallisuusselvityspalvelun valmistelussa on huomioitu yhteistyö tarvittavien toimijoiden kanssa integraatioiden toteuttamiseksi. Toiminnalla ei ole tarvetta prosessiohjaukseen perustuvalla järjestelmäratkaisulla, sillä se lisäisi ylimääräistä kirjaamista järjestelmämuutosten myötä. Keskeiset tietosisällöt muodostuvat mm. Verottajan tulorekisteristä ja verotuspäätöksistä, Kelan etuustiedoista. Ilmoittautumisen yhteydessä toimittajia pyydetään lyhyesti kuvaamaan: Käyttötarkoitus ja -ympäristö Järjestelmän tulee soveltua hyvinvointialueen käyttöön seuraavien palvelumuotojen hallintaan - kotihoidon tulo- ja varallisuusselvitys - yhteisöllisen asumisen tulo- ja varallisuusselvitys, - ympärivuorokautisen asumisen tulo- ja varallisuusselvitys - perheoikeudellisten palveluiden elatusapulaskelma, joka on osa vanhempien tekemää elatussopimusta. Elatusapulaskelmaan tarvitaan molempien vanhempien tiedot. - Kaikissa maksuissa on tarvittaessa huomioitava puolisoiden tulotiedot Käyttäjäryhmiä ovat - lastenvalvojat - hyvinvointialueiden asiamaksupäätösten tekijät Keskeiset toiminnallisuudet - tuottaa osana asiakasmaksujen määrittelyä tulo- ja varallisuustiedot, joiden perusteella muodostuu ehdotus asiakasmaksun suuruudesta tai maksuvalmiudesta - laskelma ei saa tallentua tulo- ja varallisuusselvityspalveluun, eli ei muodosta arkistointivelvoitetta. Asiakirjasta on kuitenkin voitava muodostaa PDF/PDF-A, jonka hyvinvointialue voi liittää osaksi päätöstä ja arkistoida katsomallaan tavalla. result.text: As part of the preparation for the upcoming tendering procedure regarding the destruction, recycling and resale of discarded IT equipment, Rigspolitiet wishes to conduct a market dialogue with relevant market operators. The purpose of the market dialogue is to understand how an upcoming tendering procedure can best be structured. For the purpose of the market dialogue, Rigspolitiet has prepared a short questionnaire for this prior information notice (see annex), which market operators are encouraged to answer and send to one of the email addresses below. Interested market operators are encouraged to answer all the questions in the questionnaire, but missing or only partial answers do not exclude them from participation in a subsequent dialogue. In addition to the written input, Rigspolitiet wishes to hold individual meetings with relevant market operators if this is assessed to be relevant. In that case, the dialogue meetings will take place in Danish. Any selection of operators will, among other things, take place on the basis of the written responses with a focus on having a representative cross-section of the market participate for Rigspolitiet. Requests to participate in the dialogue are made by expressing interest by email to the address: TOE008@POLITI.DK no later than 12 December at 11.00 along with the submission of answers to the written questions in the attached annex.

parts.source: Som del af forberedelsen af den kommende konkurrenceudsættelse vedrørende destruktion, genanvendelse og videresalg af kasseret it-udstyr, ønsker Rigspolitiet at gennemføre en markedsdialog med relevante markedsaktører. Formålet med markedsdialogen er at forstå, hvordan en kommende konkurrenceudsættelse bedst muligt kan tilrettelægges. Til brug for markedsdialogen har Rigspolitiet udarbejdet et kort spørgeskema til denne forhåndsmeddelse (se bilag), som markedsaktører opfordres til at besvare, og fremsende til en af nedenstående e-mailadresser. Interesserede markedsaktører opfordres til at besvare alle spørgsmålene i spørgeskemaet, men manglende eller kun delvis besvarelse udelukker ikke fra deltagelse i en efterfølgende dialog. Rigspolitiet ønsker foruden det skriftlige input at afholde individuelle møder med relevante markedsaktører, såfremt det vurderes relevant. Dialogmøderne vil i så tilfælde foregå på dansk. En eventuel udvælgelse af aktørerne vil bl.a. ske på baggrund af de skriftlige besvarelser med fokus på at få et for Rigspolitiet repræsentativt udsnit af markedet til at deltage. Anmodning om deltagelse i dialogen sker ved tilkendegivelse af interesse pr. mail til adressen: TOE008@POLITI.DK senest den 12. december kl. 11.00 sammen med indsendelse af svar på de skriftlige spørgsmål i vedlagte bilag.

result.text: United Utilities is seeking to establish a framework for the supply, storage, stock management, fulfilment and delivery of water efficiency devices and flow regulators. The framework will support United Utilities’ AMP8 and AMP9 water demand reduction commitments, including reductions in domestic Per Capita Consumption and non-household business demand. The requirement is divided into two lots: Lot 1 covers water efficiency devices, associated fulfilment services and a UU-branded customer water usage survey and ordering platform; Lot 2 covers flow regulators in agreed sizes, flow rates and specifications. Appointed supplier(s) must be able to provide compliant, reliable and scalable products and services that support planned programmes, customer campaigns, bulk orders and changes in operational demand. Suppliers must demonstrate product quality, regulatory compliance, supply chain resilience, accurate reporting, effective stock management and appropriate customer support. This includes relevant approvals and assurance evidence, secure handling of customer data where applicable, and the ability to respond flexibly as programme volumes and priorities evolve. The overall objective is to secure a robust, value-for-money supply arrangement that enables United Utilities to deliver water efficiency activity at scale, maintain continuity of supply, protect customer experience and contribute to measurable reductions in water consumption across the North West. Lot LOT-0001: PRO005128-Goods-Framework-Water Saving Devices - Lot 1. Supply, storage, stock management, picking, packing, fulfilment and delivery of water efficiency devices such as flow regulators, water butts, shower regulators, tap inserts, showerheads, cistern devices, toilet leak detection strips and other approved or innovative water saving products. Lot LOT-0002: PRO005128-Goods-Framework-Water Saving Devices - Lot 2. Supply, storage, stock management, fulfilment and delivery of flow regulators in a range of sizes, flow rates and specifications suitable for UU programmes. Devices must meet all applicable regulatory, quality and testing requirements, including WRAS and Regulation 31 approval where required.

result.text: The ITZBund requires services in the field of Software Lifecycle Management (SLM) for deployed software development and project management solutions. The aim of this tender is to conclude a framework agreement to ensure the operation as well as the maintenance and (further) development of the existing software development and project management platform Cloud and the specialist applications of the ITZBund based on it. In addition, sovereignty is to be strengthened by expanding the open source tools to be procured. By open source, the ITZBund means software whose source code is freely available. In principle, everyone is permitted to use, analyse, modify and pass on this software free of charge and without content-related restrictions in object and source code. Requirements of the respective relevant open source licence, in particular regarding licence texts, copyright notices or copyleft effects, remain unaffected. The tendered services include services along the entire software lifecycle, in particular operational services, maintenance and support services, support services in connection with releases and rollouts, as well as needs-based new and further developments of existing software and software-related tools. The contracting authority, which can call off services commissioned by its customers, is entitled to call off services. The operation of the procured software products generally takes place at the ITZBund; exceptions in special individual cases allow operation at the contracting authority's customers with their own licensing. The services mentioned at the beginning are tendered in five lots: - Lot 1: Ensuring the maintenance and (further) development of the deployed software development and project management platform Cloud - Lot 2: Ensuring the operation and automated rollout of releases of the deployed software development and project management platform Cloud - Lot 3: Provision of Sonatype software products - Lot 4: Provision of an open source issue tracker including, in particular, training, support, further development and migration services - Lot 5: Provision of an open source wiki including, in particular, training, support, further development and migration services This service description considers the subject matter of Lot 5: The subject of this lot is the provision of an open source wiki including associated training, support, further development and migration services. For the total contract term of 4 years, the estimated calculated costs result in an upper limit of 1.450 instances and 162.608 person-hours (PH) or 20.326 person-days (PD).

parts.source: Das ITZBund benötigt Dienstleistungen im Bereich des Software Lifecycle Managements (SLM) für eingesetzte Softwareentwicklungs- und Projektmanagementlösungen. Ziel dieser Ausschreibung ist der Abschluss eines Rahmenvertrages zur Sicherstellung des Betriebs sowie der Pflege und (Weiter-)Entwicklung der bestehenden Softwareentwicklungs- und Projektmanagementplattform Cloud sowie darauf aufbauender Fachanwendungen des ITZBund. Zudem soll die Souveränität durch die Erweiterung zu beschaffender Open Source Tools gestärkt werden. Unter Open Source versteht das ITZBund Software, deren Quellcode frei verfügbar ist. Grundsätzlich ist es jedermann gestattet, diese unentgeltlich und inhaltlich unbeschränkt im Objekt- und Quellcode zu benutzen, zu analysieren, zu verändern und weiterzugeben. Vorgaben der jeweils einschlägigen Open Source Lizenz, insbesondere zu Lizenztexten, Urhebervermerken oder Copyleft-Effekten, bleiben unberührt. Die ausgeschriebenen Leistungen umfassen Leistungen entlang des gesamten Software Lifecycle, insbesondere Betriebsleistungen, Pflege- und Supportleistungen, Unterstützungsleistungen im Zusammenhang mit Releases und Rollouts sowie bedarfsorientierte Neu- und Weiterentwicklungen bestehender Software und softwarebezogener Werkzeuge. Abrufberechtigt ist der Auftraggeber, der durch seine Kunden beauftragt Leistungen abrufen kann. Der Betrieb der bezogenen Softwareprodukte erfolgt grundsätzlich im ITZBund, Ausnahmen in besonderen Einzelfällen lassen einen Betrieb bei Kunden des Auftraggebers mit eigener Lizenzierung zu. Die eingangs genannten Leistungen werden in fünf Losen ausgeschrieben: - Los 1: Sicherstellung der Pflege und der (Weiter-)Entwicklung der eingesetzten Softwareentwicklungs- und Projektmanagementplattform Cloud - Los 2: Sicherstellung des Betriebs und des automatisierten Rollouts von Releases der eingesetzten Softwareentwicklungsund Projektmanagementplattform Cloud - Los 3: Bereitstellung Sonatype Softwareprodukte - Los 4: Bereitstellung eines Open Source Issue Tracker einschließlich insbesondere Schulungs-, Support-, Weiterentwicklungs- und Migrationsleistungen - Los 5: Bereitstellung eines Open Source Wikis einschließlich insbesondere Schulungs-, Support-, Weiterentwicklungs- und Migrationsleistungen Diese Leistungsbeschreibung betrachtet den Leistungsgegenstand des Los 5: Gegenstand dieses Loses ist die Bereitstellung eines Open Source Wikis einschließlich zugehöriger Schulungs-, Support-, Weiterentwicklungs- und Migrationsleistungen. Für die Vertragslaufzeit von insgesamt 4 Jahren ergibt sich für die geschätzten kalkulatorischen Kosten eine Obergrenze von 1.450 Instanzen und 162.608 Personenstunden (PS) bzw. 20.326 Personentage (PT).

rejected.text: The NSF Engineering Directorate (ENG) has launched a multi-year initiative, the Professional Formation of Engineers, to create and support an innovative and inclusive engineering profession for the 21 st century. Professional Formation of Engineers (PFE) refers to the formal and informal processes and value systems by which people become engineers. It also includes the ethical responsibility of practising engineers to sustain and grow the profession in order to improve quality of life for all peoples. The engineering profession must be responsive to national priorities, grand challenges, and dynamic workforce needs; it must be equally open and accessible to all. Professional Formation of Engineers includes, but is not limited, to: Introductions to the profession at any age; Development of deep technical and professional skills, knowledge, and abilities in both formal and informal settings/domains; Development of outlooks, perspectives, ways of thinking, knowing, and doing; Development of identity as an engineer and its intersection with other identities; and Acculturation to the profession, its standards, and norms. The goal of the Research in the Formation of Engineers (RFE) program is to advance our understanding of professional formation. It seeks both to deepen our fundamental understanding of the underlying processes and mechanisms that support professional formation and to demonstrate how professional formation is or can be accomplished. Ultimately RFE aims to transform the engineer-formation system, and thus the impact of proposed projects on this system must be described. Principal Investigators (PIs) should provide a roadmap detailing how they envision the proposed research will eventually broadly impact practice within the engineer-formation system, even if these activities are not within the scope of the submitted proposal. In order to accomplish its goals, RFE welcomes proposals in two categories: Research Projects, and Design and Development Projects. Research Projects address fundamental questions of professional formation, while Design and Development Projects provide new approaches to achieving professional formation. Additional details are provided below. Projects in both categories should address the iterative cycle in which research questions that advance understanding are informed by practice and the results of research are, in turn, translated into practice. In other words, proposals should explain how the research results will travel, translate, transfer, or scale. Successful projects identify specific target audiences, effective communication channels, and novel partnerships to ensure effective propagation and scaling. Proposal titles should begin with either “Research:” or “Design and Development:” as appropriate. Research Projects Research proposals are particularly welcome in the following areas: Research that addresses lifelong learning by the engineering workforce. Research on the impact of engineering education research. Proposals addressing this topic could investigate questions such as: How can we measure the impacts of engineering education research? What are effective strategies for scaling reforms? How can we translate knowledge from research to practice? What are the roles of technologies, networks and communities in achieving impact? RFE does not support efficacy, effectiveness, or scale-up studies for specific interventions. Research that addresses culture change in engineering education. Included in this topic are investigations of normative cultures of engineering at any level in the engineering education ecosystem and how these cultures may disadvantage certain groups. Research that addresses engineering formation at the two-year college level in both formal and informal settings. Research that addresses engineering formation at the graduate education level in both formal and informal settings. Research that investigates engineering in P-12 settings. Research in this area could include understanding of approaches to engineering in P-12, how to develop engineering ways of thinking, or the relationship between practices within the sciences and mathematics and engineering thinking. Research on the transitions between education levels, e.g., from high school to two-year college, high school to four-year college/university, two-year college to four-year college/university, undergraduate to graduate school, education settings to the workforce or professoriate, etc. Research that addresses the relationship between engineering and the public. Proposals addressing this topic could consider the social impact of engineering solutions, citizen engineering, education of an informed public, etc. Research that develops or adapts novel methodologies and frameworks appropriate for studying the professional formation of engineers, and especially minoritised, marginalised, or underserved populations. Research that addresses ways in which new technologies (such as artificial intelligence and machine learning) are changing engineering education. Research to transform engineering education so that all students encounter environmental and social sustainability principles as an integrated part of their education and are equipped with the tools needed to incorporate these principles into their future research, careers, and innovations. Proposals submitted to the Research Projects category should have clear research questions informed by an appropriate theoretical framework and a research design that includes sampling, data collection, and data analysis methods. This category will not support proposals that seek funding primarily to develop tools, curriculum, or laboratories, or that seek to implement classroom innovations that have already been shown to be effective in engineering. The program will evaluate the value of proposals by considering the impact and the cost. Research track projects that are small, exploratory, or speculative are especially encouraged.

result.text: Procurement of a software solution The Institute of Fire Service North Rhine-Westphalia (IdF NRW) is the state fire service school of the State of North Rhine-Westphalia. For the efficient planning, organisation and documentation of the approximately 500 to 850 seminars per year with about 17.000 to 18.000 participants, IdF NRW intends to procure new educational management software which in particular supports course administration, participant organisation as well as evaluation and reporting functions. Lot LOT-0001: Educational management software. As part of the IT project, an overall works contract is concluded, specifically using the "EVB-IT Systemvertrag" form with various adjustments which are highlighted accordingly. Within this overall service, standard software is purchased (no. 4.3 EVB-IT Systemvertrag), the overall system is created, bringing it to operational readiness, incl. customising and integration as well as interfaces (nos. 4.5, 4.7 and 4.10 EVB-IT Systemvertrag) and - following acceptance of the overall system - system service, including restoration and maintenance of operational readiness as well as the delivery of new program versions (no. 5.1 EVB-IT Systemvertrag) and further development (no. 6.1 EVB-IT Systemvertrag), including training and documentation; these services are largely remunerated on a lump-sum basis (see price sheet). Furthermore, optionally retrievable services are offered by the tenderer, such as migration and other services before and after acceptance, which are generally remunerated according to effort (no. 7 EVB-IT Systemvertrag) (see also price sheet). The criteria catalogue results in mandatory A criteria (must criteria), whose complete fulfilment in the ready-for-operation overall system is owed, as well as additionally scored, non-mandatory B criteria, which are to be provided insofar as they were indicated as offered by the tenderer in the procurement procedure. Regarding the term: For system service services, contract performance begins contractually on the day after successful acceptance; a minimum contract duration of 84 months is envisaged. Ordinary termination of the system service is possible for the first time at the end of the minimum contract duration with a notice period of 24 months; without timely termination, the contractual relationship continues for an indefinite duration. Regardless of this, the entire EVB-IT Systemvertrag (as a works contract) can be terminated pursuant to section 648 BGB; the consequences of termination result from no. 18.7 EVB-IT Systemvertrag. Note on differing contract lengths: While the software purchase is designed to be permanent, the system service runs for at least 84 months and can be terminated ordinarily thereafter. This textual summary serves for the rough classification of the contract structure (overall works contract, software purchase, services, price logic, criteria binding, term and termination) and does not replace an independent, complete, final review and legal or economic assessment of the procurement documents.

parts.source: Beschaffung einer Softwarelösung Das Institut der Feuerwehr Nordrhein-Westfalen (IdF NRW) ist die Landesfeuerwehrschule des Landes Nordrhein-Westfalen. Zur effizienten Planung, Organisation und Dokumentation der jährlich rund 500 bis 850 Seminare mit etwa 17.000 bis 18.000 Teilnehmenden beabsichtigt das IdF NRW die Beschaffung einer neuen Bildungsmanagementsoftware, die insbesondere die Kursverwaltung, die Teilnehmendenorganisation sowie Auswertungs- und Berichtsfunktionen unterstützt. Lot LOT-0001: Bildungsmanagementsoftware. Im Rahmen des IT-Projektes wird ein Gesamtwerkvertrag abgeschlossen, und zwar unter Verwendung des "EVB-IT Systemvertrag" Formulars mit diversen Anpassungen, welche entsprechend hervorgehoben sind. Innerhalb dieser Gesamtleistung erfolgt Kauf der Standardsoftware (Nr. 4.3 EVB IT Systemvertrag), die Erstellung des Gesamtsystems mit Herbeiführung der Betriebsbereitschaft, inkl. Customizing und Integration sowie Schnittstellen (Nr. 4.5, 4.7 und 4.10 EVB-IT Systemvertrag) sowie - nach Abnahme des Gesamtsystems - Systemservice, einschließlich Wiederherstellung und Aufrechterhaltung der Betriebsbereitschaft sowie der Lieferung neuer Programmstände (Nr. 5.1 EVB-IT Systemvertrag) und der Weiterentwicklung (Nr. 6.1 EVB-IT Systemvertrag), einschließlich Schulungen und Dokumentation; diese Leistungen werden weitgehend pauschal vergütet (siehe Preisblatt). Ferner werden vom Bieter optional abrufbare Leistungen angeboten, wie Migration und sonstige Leistungen vor und nach Abnahme, welche grundsätzlich nach Aufwand (Nr. 7 EVB IT Systemvertrag) vergütet werden (siehe auch Preisblatt). Aus dem Kriterienkatalog folgen zwingende A Kriterien (Muss Kriterien), deren vollständige Erfüllung im betriebsbereiten Gesamtsystem geschuldet ist, sowie zusätzlich bepunktete, nicht zwingende B Kriterien, die zu leisten sind, soweit sie im Vergabeverfahren vom Bieter als angeboten ausgewiesen wurden. Zur Laufzeit: Für die Systemserviceleistungen beginnt die Leistungserbringung vertraglich mit dem Tag nach der erfolgreichen Abnahme; vorgesehen ist eine Mindestvertragsdauer von 84 Monaten. Die ordentliche Kündigung des Systemservice ist erstmals zum Ablauf der Mindestvertragsdauer mit einer Frist von 24 Monaten möglich; ohne fristgerechte Kündigung läuft das Vertragsverhältnis auf unbestimmte Dauer fort. result.text: Work package "UDP Migration Support" as part of the Urban Data Management (UDM) project In September 2024, the implementation phase began in the project "Establishment of Urban Data Platform (UDP) and Migration of Geographic Information System (GIS)". The Federal City of Bonn is relying on the open source project Civitas Core for the establishment of the UDP. With the Universal Urban Data App addon, the basics are in place that allow applications from the old GIS to be migrated to the UDP. In the conception phase of the project, approx. 300 applications to be migrated were identified. 80 percent of these applications support the enforcement of statutory services. Since the previous GIS can no longer be operated, the migration must be completed as quickly as possible. A valid estimate determines a total effort of 5197 person-days (PD) here. This effort will mainly be provided by internal employees in the 3 areas of requirement clarification, development and support. Support services amounting to roughly 650 PD up to the year 2028 are to be procured in the tender. Due to advancing support by AI, the contracting authority assumes that the migration duration can be decisively reduced. The focus of the procurement is on support services to be provided using the existing platform tools of the UDP. The migration is to be provided in accordance with the respective trades' existing Bonn guidelines such as data modelling, Geoserver configuration, Universal Urban Data Addon configuration, Masterportal configuration. Independent development work on the tools of the platform itself is not planned within the scope of the contract, or only to a very small extent and after prior consultation.

parts.source: Arbeitspaket "Migrationsunterstützung UDP" im Rahmen des Projekts Urban Data Management (UDM) Im September 2024 hat die Umsetzungsphase im Projekt "Aufbau Urban Data Platform (UDP) und Migration Geoinformationssystem (GIS)" begonnen. Die Bundesstadt Bonn setzt beim Aufbau der UDP auf das Open Source Projekt Civitas Core. Mit dem Addon Universal Urban Data App liegen die Grundlagen vor, die es erlauben, Anwendungen des alten GIS in die UDP zu migrieren. In der Konzeptionsphase des Projekts wurden ca. 300 zu migrierende Anwendungen identifiziert. 80 Prozent dieser Anwendungen unterstützen den Vollzug gesetzlicher Leistungen. Da das bisherige GIS nicht mehr weiter betrieben werden kann, ist die Migration so schnell wie möglich zu vollziehen. Eine valide Schätzung ermittelt hier einen Gesamtaufwand von 5197 Personentagen (PT). Dieser Aufwand wird hauptsächlich von internen Mitarbeitenden in den 3 Bereichen Anforderungsklärung, Entwicklung und Support geleistet werden. In der Vergabe sollen Unterstützungsleistungen im Umfang von grob 650 PT bis zum Jahr 2028 eingekauft werden. Aufgrund der fortschreitenden Unterstützung durch KI geht der Auftraggeber davon aus, dass die Migrationsdauer entscheidend reduziert werden kann. Der Schwerpunkt der Vergabe liegt auf Unterstützungsdienstleistungen unter Nutzung der vorhandenen Plattform-Werkzeuge der UDP zu erbringen. Die Migration ist nach den bestehenden Bonner Guide Lines der jeweiligen Gewerke wie Datenmodellierung, Geoserver Konfiguration, Universal Urban Data Addon Konfiguration, Masterportal Konfiguration zu erbringen. Eigenständige Entwicklungsarbeiten an den Werkzeugen der Plattform selbst sind im Rahmen des Auftrages nicht oder nur in sehr geringem Umfang und nach vorheriger Absprache vorgesehen.

result.text: What is HUP? Born in Bradford’s Healthy Urban Places (HUP) is carrying out research to help understand what makes the places we live, work and socialise healthier places. HUP research is taking place in Bradford and Liverpool. In each city four areas have been chosen (8 in total) as centres for carrying out community-led research. In Bradford these 4 areas are: 1. Keighley Central (BD20, BD21, BD22) 2. Bolton Woods (BD2, BD18) 3. Barkerend and Bradford Moor (BD3) 4. Parkside (BD5) This tender only relates to the Parkside area of Bradford The focus of the research The research is about what makes a healthy urban place. We want to design research questions with the community in order to answer the following overarching themes: • What urban and environmental factors have an impact on wellbeing and which of these does the community prioritise? • How do healthy places develop over time? • How do different communities experience and benefit from different features of urban places over time? • How can we measure and track changes in urban places that are important for health and wellbeing? How will it work? By bringing together community members who live in and are impacted by changes in urban areas, and those responsible for decisions about them, we want to produce relevant and impactful research that can reduce unfair and avoidable differences in health (health inequalities) and improve health and wellbeing long-term. In order to do this HUP wants to work with community organisations with expertise in engagement of often marginalised groups and an underlying ethos of working in partnership. Together we will create a ‘Community Collaborative’ – a community-based research partnership – which will involve the HUP team, community organisations, and other stakeholders (such as residents, schools, places of faith, clubs, policy makers, council members and more). The Community Collaborative will work together to produce evidence on what makes a healthy urban place and explore how we can achieve healthier cities. We will share the findings and learning from the research within communities in creative ways, and develop community-led reports for policy makers and government to influence future positive changes in urban areas. What will a Community Collaborative involve? The HUP team are looking for community organisations in each site to join us in partnership over the lifetime of the HUP programme until spring 2027. As a partnership, we’ll all bring something to the table: • HUP will bring research skills, provide training for those in the local community (staff or service users), support local communities to get involved in and/or lead research, and help create opportunities for community members to meet with policy makers and implementors. • Community organisations will bring local knowledge and lived experiences, skills in community & participatory engagement, introductions to community members, and access to physical assets, such as rooms and buildings. Community organisations can apply to be a HUP partner to Bradford Teaching Hospitals Foundation Trust. Funding will be provided for core costs (e.g. staff time, use of building and for carrying out specific research projects. Organisations within one area can apply alone or in partnership, and at more than one site if they have required links to the community. What the research process will look like At each site, the organisations involved in the Community Collaborative will jointly organise some 'inception' workshops with the HUP team. Together, we'll decide how we want our partnership to run (e.g. our ways of working, etc). We’ll start to explore factors that have impacted on wellbeing in the local urban area over time. Jointly we’ll prioritise what we want to explore first and will decide how we want to learn about it. We might, for example, decide together to develop a series of fun, creative and engaging mini-projects in which community members can be trained as community researchers to find out about healthy urban places. The findings and learnings from these projects will be shared with our communities, the wider public and those involved in policy making locally, regionally and nationally. The allocation of funds for this will be jointly decided. The Collaboratives will run for 2 years, with most of the work being conducted in 2025 and 2026, and finalising the process in 2027. Funding will reflect this, with the bulk of funding being provided in 2025 and 2026. However, during the process, we’d hope to be able to identify further opportunities and funding to work together on research in the future. What is expected of a collaborative partner? Community organisations will have a range of responsibilities that are noted in more detail in the procurement specification. Briefly, they will be co-partners in the Community Collaborative, and over the length of the funded period will: • Contribute to the set up and development of the Community Collaborative • Attend and assist in organising, facilitating and hosting meetings & workshops in the local area • Connect the HUP team to community members and service users • Co-design community-based research with the HUP team and wider stakeholders • Co-design creative ways of engaging community members in finding out about healthy urban places • Co-design engaging ways of sharing the learning and findings of research • Distribute payments to community participants in the research – for example, any community researchers who get involved in finding out about healthy urban places • Attend city-wide Collaborative meetings in Bradford and with partners in Liverpool Lot 1: .

result.text: Gol municipality plans, on behalf of the municipalities in Hallingdal, to carry out a market survey on general documentation management in the region. 1.1.1 Background and purpose of the market survey The six municipalities in Hallingdal have started a preliminary study to look at a more comprehensive and future orientated documentation management, at the same time that we must continually deal with archival documentation in new trade systems. Our ongoing procurement of a new electronic patient journal (EPJ) has clarified the need for a total assessment of how archival documentation is handled across trade systems. The current systems are fragmented, with many archive cores and complex set-ups, and present challenges, among other things, for structure, work flow, quality and resource use. The six municipalities have joint ICT operations and cooperate on digitalisation projects and procurements of new digital systems with the accompanying joint contract management. In order to gain insight that can enable us to make good road choices further, we would like to carry out a market survey with potential suppliers. The main focus is the safeguarding of archival information generated in trade systems in accordance with laws and regulations, and it is especially important for us to see this in the light of changed laws, regulations and standards in the archive area, new technology and possibilities for a more comprehensive approach further.

result.text: The Norwegian Public Roads Administration would like to carry out a market survey to map which tenderers offer an analysis programme for running and resting time, beyond the current system. The programme shall support control of drivers who carry out transport in business activities, in accordance with the current EU rules and at the same time be adapted to Norwegian conditions and needs in the control business. The objective of the survey is to gain better insight into what systems are available in the market, how these are technically and functionally designed and which delivery models are offered. We would particularly like information on a technical platform (e.g. client-based, web-based or hybrid), functionality connected to regulation analysis and reporting, options for integration with internal systems, as well as price models and cost drivers. The market survey shall form the basis for any new procurement, and contribute to the Norwegian Public Roads Administration designing a competition that is well adapted to the market and at the same time meets the needs of Utekontroll in an efficient and future orientated manner.

result.text: The Energie Vorpommern GmbH (hereinafter: EVP) intends to re-award the commercial management for the sales division. The EVP is an energy supply company and supplies customers with electricity and natural gas in, among other places, the towns of Grimmen, Gützkow, Wolgast and the surrounding villages, as well as the island of Usedom. In the natural gas sector, the EVP is the basic supplier in the aforementioned region. The subject of this tender is the award of commercial services for energy operations. The contractor's activities include commercial management for the sales division. Details regarding the scope of services and the remuneration system can be found in the attached draft service contract (Annex A). The following points highlight essential key aspects. The individual service requirements arise in particular from the contract annexes (1a to 1h). The contractor's activities include the services described in more detail in contract annex 1: Description of Services, from the following areas: - Sales in general (cf. contract annex 1a: Sales) - Finance and accounting (cf. contract annex 1b: Finance and accounting) - Legal services (cf. contract annex 1c: Legal services) - Shared services sales (cf. contract annex 1d: Shared services) - Payroll accounting (cf. contract annex 1e: Payroll accounting) - Controlling and other services (cf. contract annex 1f: Controlling and other services) - Energy data management (cf. contract annex 1g: Energy data management) - IT infrastructure (cf. contract annex 1h: IT infrastructure) Furthermore, the contractor shall ensure the prior transfer of the EVP's digital data from the system of the previous service provider, SERVICE PLUS GMBH, to the new system. The EVP will inform the successful bidder upon award whether the data migration is to be carried out. The data migration must be completed by no later than 31.12.2027 in accordance with the concept to be created by the contractor (contract annex 5: Concept for data migration), so that the assumption of commercial management is possible for the contractor from this point in time. The EVP intends to award the services initially from 01.01.2027 to 31.12.2032, combined with the option of contract extension. The contract shall automatically extend by a further three years each time if the contract is not terminated by one of the contracting parties 18 months before the end of the term.

Im Bereich Erdgas ist die EVP Grundversorger in der v. g. Region. Gegenstand dieser Ausschreibung ist die Vergabe von kaufmännischen Dienstleistungen für den Energiebetrieb. Die Tätigkeit des Auftragnehmers umfasst die kaufmännische Betriebsführung für den Bereich Vertrieb. Die Einzelheiten zum Leistungsumfang sowie zur Vergütungssystematik sind dem beigefügten Entwurf des Dienstleistungsvertrages (Anlage A) zu entnehmen. Im Folgenden wird auf wesent-liche Eckpunkte hingewiesen. Die einzelnen Leistungsanforderungen ergeben sich insbesondere aus den Vertragsanlagen (1a bis 1h). result.text: The Espoo Region Joint Authority for Education (Omnia) is planning to put out to tender financial and payroll administration and HR systems and related services. The systems would be procured as a SaaS service, and for some areas of finance, payroll administration and HR, the procurement of the service is also being considered, whereby, for example, payroll would come to Omnia as a comprehensive service. The content emphasis and scope of the tender (only statutory services or broader, system procurement as a SaaS service or extensive comprehensive service procurement) will be specified further before the publication of the contract notice. Regarding statutory financial and payroll administration functionalities, Omnia's current goal is for the new solution (or comprehensive service) to be in use from 1.1.2027 onwards. Omnia invites suppliers to participate in a market dialogue, the goal of which is to obtain a comprehensive picture of the systems and services available on the market. With the help of the information obtained, Omnia will evaluate what kind of benefits they produce and how they would be suitable for Omnia's needs. The market survey is open to all suppliers that have systems or services belonging to this solution entity to offer. The focus of the market survey is on solutions that are already in production or available on the market. Suppliers are requested to present systems and services that are available and where the key functionalities are already implemented. The presentation of solutions under development or only at the concept level is not desired in this context. WRITTEN REQUEST FOR INFORMATION Omnia offers all suppliers an open opportunity to provide their comments in writing and to submit possible service descriptions and other attachments by email. Written observations are requested by Mon 13.10.2025 at 12.00 via the Forms form: https://forms.office.com/e/x36eWVynyU. Service descriptions and other attachments can be submitted on the same schedule by email to emma.strengell@kpmg.fi. Omnia may request a meeting or additional information from those participating in the request for information if it considers it necessary.

parts.source: Espoon seudun koulutuskuntayhtymä suunnittelee talous- ja palkkahallinnon sekä HR-järjestelmien ja niihin liittyvien palveluiden kilpailuttamista. Järjestelmät hankittaisiin SaaS-palveluna, ja joihinkin talous-, palkkahallinnon ja HR:n osa-alueisiin harkitaan myös palvelun hankkimista, jolloin esimerkiksi palkanlaskenta tulisi Omnialle kokonaispalveluna. Kilpailutuksen sisällöllistä painotusta ja laajuutta (vain lakisääteiset palvelut vai laveammin, järjestelmähankinta SaaS-palveluna vai laaja kokonaispalveluhankinta) täsmennetään vielä ennen hankintailmoituksen julkaisua. Lakisääteisten talous- ja palkkahallinnon toiminnallisuuksien osalta Omnian tämänhetkinen tavoite on, että uusi ratkaisu (tai kokonaispalvelu) olisi käytössä 1.1.2027 alkaen. Omnia kutsuu toimittajia osallistumaan markkinavuoropuheluun, jonka tavoitteena on saada kokonaiskuva markkinoilla olevista järjestelmistä ja palveluista. Saatavan tiedon avulla Omnia arvioi, millaisia hyötyjä ne tuottavat ja miten ne soveltuisivat Omnian tarpeisiin. Markkinakartoitus on avoin kaikille toimittajille, joilla on tarjota tämän ratkaisukokonaisuuden piiriin kuuluvia järjestelmiä tai palveluita. Markkinakartoituksen painopisteenä ovat ratkaisut, jotka ovat jo tuotannossa tai markkinoilla saatavilla. Toimittajia pyydetään esittelemään järjestelmiä ja palveluita, jotka ovat käytettävissä ja joissa keskeiset toiminnallisuudet ovat valmiiksi toteutettuja. Kehitteillä olevien tai vasta konseptitasolla olevien ratkaisujen esittelyä ei tässä yhteydessä toivota. KIRJALLINEN TIETOPYYNTÖ Omnia tarjoaa kaikille toimittajille avoimesti mahdollisuutta antaa kommenttejaan kirjallisesti sekä toimittaa mahdollisia palvelukuvauksia ja muita liitetiedostoja sähköpostitse. Kirjallisia huomioita pyydetään viimeistään ma 13.10.2025 klo 12.00 Forms-lomakkeella: https://forms.office.com/e/x36eWVynyU. Palvelukuvaukset ja muut liitetiedostot voi toimittaa samalla aikataululla sähköpostitse emma.strengell@kpmg.fi. Omnia voi pyytää tietopyyntöön osallistuvilta tapaamista tai lisätietoja, mikäli katsoo sen tarpeelliseksi.

result.text: The Legal AI Workspace software to be procured must serve as a specialised working environment to support legal professional work within the KfW Group using generative artificial intelligence. The software will be used in particular for legal research, analysis and the preparation of legal content, as well as for the (partially) automated creation, revision and structuring of documents and other legal work results. Users are personnel from the Legal department as well as other specialist departments and subsidiaries within the KfW Group. A Legal AI Workspace connects large language models with specialised processing layers that are optimised for working with legal content. It differs from general AI assistants in that it brings together legal professional processes in a unified working environment and employs mechanisms that are indispensable for professional legal practice. These include, in particular: the traceable anchoring of generated statements in verifiable sources, the structured processing of complex documents, and the rule-based review of contract content. The software must provide the following core functions. Legal research: The software must be able to answer complex legal questions based on relevant legal sources. Every generated statement must be traced back to concrete, verifiable sources (in particular statutes, case law, commentary literature) and made transparent for the users. KfW considers integrated access to curated legal databases to be a quality-enhancing feature. Furthermore, the software must be able to work with documents and internal knowledge databases provided by KfW. Document analysis and contract evaluation: The software must be able to process and evaluate the content of documents, including complexly structured contracts, tabular content and scanned documents, without essential structural information being lost. This includes the ability to systematically and completely compare contract content against specified review standards. Text creation and drafting support: The software must support the creation and revision of legal texts, in particular contract drafts, memoranda and opinions. Proposed changes must be able to be tracked directly in the document; the mere provision of generated text for manual adoption by the users does not meet the requirements. The software complements a general AI software already in use at KfW. The new software will be operated as an independent tool and will use a model infrastructure provided by the contractor. It is expected that the software will achieve significant increases in efficiency and quality in daily legal advice, document creation and review, and recurring standard legal tasks. Without prejudice to the provision of the software as a Service (SaaS) described in this document and the usage rights granted in connection therewith, the provision of the software must be carried out in such a way that it at least satisfies the intended purpose. KfW is entitled to at least the usage rights required to fulfil the intended purpose. The contractor is therefore liable for the following services: (a) provision of software with the functional scope, (b) execution of a project for the implementation of the software, (c) operation as SaaS, (d) provision of additional services as required, (e) termination support. Die Software wird insbesondere für juristische Recherche, Analyse und Aufbereitung von Rechtsinhalten sowie für die (teil-)automatisierte Erstellung, Überarbeitung und Strukturierung von Dokumenten und sonstigen juristischen Arbeitsergebnissen eingesetzt. Benutzer sind die Personen des Bereichs Recht sowie weiterer Fachbereiche und Töchter im KfW‐Konzern. Ein Legal AI Workspace verbindet große Sprachmodelle mit spezialisierten Verarbeitungsschichten, die für die Arbeit mit rechtlichen Inhalten optimiert sind. Er unterscheidet sich von allgemeinen KI‐Assistenten dadurch, dass er juristische Fachprozesse in einer einheitlichen Arbeitsumgebung zusammenführt und Mechanismen einsetzt, die für die professionelle Rechtsanwendung unabdingbar sind. Dazu zählen insbesondere: die nachvollziehbare Verankerung generierter Aussagen in überprüfbaren Quellen, die strukturierte Verarbeitung komplexer Dokumente sowie die regelbasierte Prüfung von Vertragsinhalten. result.text: EUROMOD is the tax-benefit microsimulation model of the European Union (EU), which covers in a consistent manner the tax-benefit systems of all EU Member States. The model allows to study the effects of taxes and social benefits on household incomes and work incentives for the population of each country and for the EU as a whole. EUROMOD is unique in its area as it features great flexibility in the scope of its simulation and ensures cross-country consistency of the modelling approach and comparability of the results. The model is widely used by the Commission services in the European Semester context and other EU policy initiatives. Additionally, the model represents a valuable research infrastructure for the academic community in the area of fiscal policy analysis, with highly cited research conducted using EUROMOD being published in top journals. The contracts are intended to provide the Commission with services that support the development and update of the microsimulation model EUROMOD for 26 EU country-specific modules. result.text: Organisations are invited to take part in the pre maket engagement seek input from market participants to inform and help Ofcom inform our procurement strategy for our employee voice programme. Ofcom currently relies on an annual colleague survey as the primary means of gathering measurable feedback on employee experience. This model does not provide sufficiently timely or agile insight into emerging colleague experience, culture, engagement and organisational challenges. As a result, there is a risk that feedback is gathered too infrequently to support timely action and evidence-based decision making. The opportunity is to explore how to procure a pulse survey tool that enables shorter, more frequent colleague surveys, as well as the ability to run multiple surveys in parallel across different populations and topics. This would support a more agile employee listening model, provide quicker insight into priority issues, and strengthen the link between colleague feedback and visible action. Lot 1: . None

result.text: Background Arendal municipality has an ongoing need for graphical services connected to information material and visual communication aimed at inhabitants and internal target groups. The municipality produces some material itself, but needs external assistance for assignments that are more complex, time consuming or require special professional competence. The procurement shall ensure access to capacity and relevant competence within graphical design, at the same time as the municipality takes care of the need for uniform visual communication and clear identity. The municipality shall be one sender. It is also important to ensure that material and visual deliveries fulfil the requirements for universal design and ensure accessible and understandable communication for different user groups. The municipality therefore needs to establish a new framework agreement that provides predictable access to graphical assistance as needed, both for smaller ongoing assignments and for major or more strategic deliveries. Description of the assignment The procurement is for graphic services for Arendal municipality. The delivery shall cover the development and production of various types of graphical material and visual elements, including information material, reports, presentations, templates, graphics for digital surfaces, infographics, illustrations and professional design consultancy services. The assignments will vary in extent and complexity. The municipality needs a tenderer who can assist with both smaller, limited assignments and large deliveries that require more planning and close cooperation with the contracting authority. Minor assignments means limited deliveries such as, for example, an ad, poster, presentation or simple illustration. Larger deliveries means assignments that include planning, coordination and multiple sub-services, such as a report or campaign material. The deliveries shall be able to be used further in the municipality ́s own channels and tools, and it is important that the deliveries can be further developed and adapted internally. The framework agreement shall also include the design of profile material and profile articles, as well as graphic materials connected to the use of, among other things, vehicles, buildings and work clothes. Web design for arendal.kommune.no is not included in the procurement. It is important to have clear contact points, effective clarifications and a good understanding of the municipality ́s graphical profile, communication needs and targets for clear, available and recognisable communication.

result.text: The Ministry of Defence (MOD), through the Defence AI Accelerator Task Force (TF RAID), intends to procure a secure, scalable capability to support operational planning across Defence. TF RAID exists to accelerate the responsible adoption of artificial intelligence (AI) and data-enabled capabilities in support of Defence outcomes, working with users, technical specialists and industry to identify, test and transition operationally relevant solutions. This requirement is expected to support operational planners by improving access to authorised planning information, enabling reusable machine-readable planning knowledge, orchestrating analytical services, and supporting the modelling, testing and comparison of alternative Courses of Action (COAs). The procurement will be structured as a single competition with 2 Lots: - Lot 1 will focus on planning data, knowledge and analytical orchestration services; and - Lot 2 will focus on COA testing, evaluation and adaptation services. Suppliers are invited to bid for 1 or both lots. Together, the Lots are intended to improve the speed, quality, traceability and robustness of operational planning while maintaining appropriate human oversight, governance, transparency, security and interoperability within Authority-approved environments, including those handling information up to SECRET UK EYES ONLY where required. MOD will be seeking to compete this requirement through the Government Commercial Agency Artificial Intelligence Dynamic Purchasing System (AI DPS/RM6200). Participation in any subsequent competition will therefore be limited to suppliers appointed to the relevant Lots of the AIDPS Framework who pass the shortlist filter exercise. Lot 1: Planning Data, Knowledge and Analytical Orchestration Services (PDKAOS). The requirement is expected to support operational planning activities through the integration of planning data, machine-readable planning knowledge and advanced analytical services. The Authority seeks a capability that improves the speed, quality and scale of operational planning whilst maintaining appropriate human oversight, governance, transparency and security. Requirement Summary: The Authority requires an initial capability to support operational planners by enabling them to: • Discover, access and exploit authorised planning information from multiple sources. • Create and maintain reusable representations of planning knowledge, expertise, assumptions, dependencies and relationships. • Assemble, configure and reuse analytical services in support of operational planning tasks. • Improve traceability between planning inputs, analytical activities and planning outputs. • Reduce dependency on fragmented information sources, manual processes and specialist knowledge bottlenecks. The capability is expected to support planning activity across multiple domains, operational functions and echelons of command rather than providing a single-purpose planning application. Lot 2: COA Testing, Evaluation and Adaptation Services for Operational Planning. The requirement is expected to support operational planning activities through the representation of operational environments, modelling of Courses of Action (COAs), evaluation of alternative scenarios and adversary responses, and generation of evidence-based insights to support planning and decision-making. The Authority seeks a capability that improves the speed, quality and robustness of operational planning whilst maintaining appropriate human oversight, governance, transparency and security. The Authority requires an initial capability to support operational planners by enabling them to: • Represent operational environments, actors, assumptions, constraints and dependencies in reusable and machine-readable forms. • Model, test and compare alternative Courses of Action. • Explore multiple operational scenarios, environmental conditions, assumptions and adversary responses. • Generate evidence-based insights to support adaptation and refinement of operational plans. • Improve traceability between planning inputs, analytical activities and planning outputs. • Reduce reliance on manual wargaming, fragmented information sources and time-intensive analytical processes. The capability is expected to support planning activity across multiple domains, operational functions and echelons of command rather than providing a single-purpose planning application.

result.text: THIS IS NOT A PROCUREMENT NOTICE OR A CALL FOR TENDERS BUT A REQUEST FOR INFORMATION FOR MARKET SURVEY AND TECHNICAL DIALOGUE. HUS-yhtymä (hereinafter also the contracting authority) is surveying the market with this request for information to support the planning of a potential procurement of a payment transaction, archiving and liquidity management system. The purpose of the request for information is to survey the suppliers on the market and their product and service range. The objective is to obtain information on, among other things, various technical solutions, functionalities and pricing models. The subject of the procurement is described in more detail in the attached document (available on the Tarjouspalvelu.fi portal via the adjacent link). We ask suppliers interested in the procurement to familiarise themselves with the preliminary requirements presented in the attached document and to describe your offered solutions taking the said requirements into account. You may, if you wish, also attach brochures or other information about your offered products and services to your response. We ask that responses to the request for information be submitted by 26.3.2026 to kilpailutus.ict@hus.fi. The subject line of the message should state "HUS 166-2026: Payment transaction, archiving and liquidity management system". The responses given to this request for information may be used in the planning of the procurement. The contracting authority may, at its discretion, suggest clarifying market dialogue discussions with those who have responded to this request for information. Please note that all material is intended solely for conducting this market dialogue. The contracting authority will treat your response confidentially. The contracting authority does not initiate a tendering procedure by publishing the request for information, but a potential procurement notice and call for tenders will be published later. The request for information does not oblige the contracting authority to carry out the actual procurement. Responding to the request for information is not a prerequisite for participation in a later tendering procedure that may be organised. Suppliers are not paid compensation for responding to the request for information or participating in the market dialogue.

Tietopyynnön tarkoituksena on kartoittaa markkinoilla olevia toimittajia sekä heidän tuote- ja palveluvalikoimaansa. Tavoitteena on saada tietoa mm. erilaisista teknisistä ratkaisuista, toiminnallisuuksista ja hinnoittelumalleista. Hankinnan kohdetta on kuvattu tarkemmin liitteenä olevassa asiakirjassa (saatavilla Tarjouspalvelu.fi-portaalista oheisen linkin kautta). Pyydämme hankinnasta kiinnostuneita toimittajia tutustumaan oheisessa liitteessä esitettyihin alustaviin vaatimuksiin ja kertomaan tarjoamistanne ratkaisuista mainitut vaatimukset huomioiden. Voitte halutessanne liittää vastaukseenne myös esitteitä tai muuta tietoa tarjoamistanne tuotteista ja palveluista. Pyydämme toimittamaan vastaukset tietopyyntöön 26.3.2026 mennessä osoitteeseen kilpailutus.ict@hus.fi. Viestin aiheeksi maininta "HUS 166-2026: Maksuliikenne-, arkistointi- ja likviditeetinhallintajärjestelmä". Tähän tietopyyntöön annettuja vastauksia voidaan käyttää hankinnan suunnittelussa. Hankintayksikkö voi harkintansa mukaan ehdottaa tarkentavia markkinavuoropuhelukeskusteluja tähän tietopyyntöön vastanneiden kanssa. result.text: The joint project Arna – Stanghelle (hereafter called "FAS") is a joint project between the Norwegian Public Roads Administration and Bane NOR. FAS is a part of the project portfolio for The Norwegian Public Roads Administration Development Area West and Bane NOR, Division Development, Development Unit Mega Projects. FAS would like, via this invitation, to have a dialogue with the supplier market. We would like the survey to give us information that makes the future tender documentation and a contract better and adapted to both the users and the market. FAS is planning a procurement process for an MWD interpretation program and a tunnel mapping program, with an expected contract length of up to eight years. A tentative progress plan has been set with possible contract signing in Q4 2026. As a part of the work, FAS is now going out with this market survey. This is to probe the market and relevant suppliers, systems and available systems. The objective of the market survey is to clarify which systems the market can offer for: • Mapping Program • MWD data, drilling parameter interpretation and any integration with a mapping program. • Capacity for the collection, transfer and management of MWD data. • Input for the set-up for the price form and price elements for such a long-term delivery.

result.text: The Sir John Brunner Foundation Multi-Academy Trust (Cheshire) is undertaking pre-market engagement in relation to a proposed procurement for the management of community lettings and facilities hire across part of its estate. The initial scope is expected to include Middlewich High School and Sir John Deane's Sixth Form College, with the possibility of future extension to other Trust sites, subject to suitability, value for money and operational requirements. The Trust's wider estate includes The County High School, Leftwich and (from November) primary academies in the Northwich area. The Trust is seeking to understand the market for managed lettings services and to inform the development of its final specification, procurement route and commercial model. The proposed requirement is expected to involve the management, marketing, booking, administration and operational delivery of lettings and community use of school and college facilities outside core educational hours. The Trust's objectives are to: increase utilisation of facilities outside normal school and college hours; improve and expand access for local clubs, voluntary organisations and community groups; support sustainable community use, particularly for local and regular users; ensure safeguarding, site security, supervision and operational control during lettings activity; reduce the administrative and operational burden on academy staff; protect the condition, readiness and availability of facilities for core educational use; increase income through improved utilisation and broader use of facilities, rather than relying solely on price increases; and establish a professional, compliant and scalable lettings model capable of operating across multiple academy sites where appropriate. The facilities potentially within scope include, but are not limited to, indoor sports halls, outdoor pitches, all-weather/3G or astro facilities, playing fields, performance and assembly spaces, classrooms, specialist teaching areas, changing rooms, car parking and ancillary facilities. The final list of facilities will be confirmed following engagement with the market. The Trust is particularly interested in engaging with providers able to deliver one or more of the following models: a fully managed lettings service, including marketing, bookings, customer management, income collection, staffing, supervision, safeguarding, compliance and reporting; a managed bookings and staffing model, including provider-led marketing, customer management and revenue administration, with operational delivery agreed between the provider and the Trust; and/or advice on appropriate commercial structures, including revenue share, guaranteed income, management fee or hybrid models. At this stage, the Trust does not intend to pursue a software-only booking platform as the primary solution, as the requirement includes a need for operational delivery, staffing and site supervision, particularly at Middlewich High School. However, the Trust welcomes feedback on systems and technology used to support managed lettings services. The Trust anticipates that any future contract would require the successful provider to demonstrate robust arrangements for: on-site staffing and supervision; safeguarding, site security and incident escalation; access control, opening, closing and site handover; cleaning, facility reset and reporting of damage or defects; customer service and complaints management; protection and transition of existing community users where possible; pricing strategy and affordability for local community users; financial reporting, reconciliation, VAT information and income remittance; performance reporting and attendance at formal contract review meetings; and orderly exit and transfer of booking/customer data at the end of the arrangement. The Trust is considering a phased implementation approach, with Sir John Deane's Sixth Form College and non-pitch lettings at Middlewich High School potentially commencing first, followed by Middlewich High School pitch or astro lettings at a later stage to allow appropriate transition and notice for existing users. The estimated value of the initial opportunity is currently expected to be in the region of £420,000 to £480,000 or more over an initial three-year period, based on estimated gross lettings income across the sites. This estimate is indicative only and will be reviewed as the commercial model, scope and contract structure are developed. The final classification and value of any subsequent procurement will be confirmed before the formal tender stage. The purpose of this pre-market engagement is to: understand supplier capability and capacity in the managed school and college lettings market; test the proposed scope, delivery model and phasing; understand appropriate commercial models and risk allocation; identify key operational, safeguarding, staffing and financial considerations; inform the Trust's final specification and procurement documents; and ensure that any subsequent procurement is proportionate, transparent and capable of delivering best value. Participation in this pre-market engagement will not confer any advantage in any subsequent procurement process. Information shared by the Trust will be made available on a consistent basis where appropriate, and any future competition will be conducted in accordance with the Trust's procurement obligations, including the principles of transparency, equal treatment and non-discrimination. Interested providers are invited to respond to this notice and may be invited to participate in a site visit. Any future procurement opportunity will be advertised separately, and the Trust reserves the right not to proceed to procurement following this engagement. Lot 1: .
