The facilities potentially within scope include, but are not limited to, indoor sports halls, outdoor pitches, all-weather/3G or astro facilities, playing fields, performance and assembly spaces, classrooms, specialist teaching areas, changing rooms, car parking and ancillary facilities. The final list of facilities will be confirmed following engagement with the market. The Trust is particularly interested in engaging with providers able to deliver one or more of the following models: a fully managed lettings service, including marketing, bookings, customer management, income collection, staffing, supervision, safeguarding, compliance and reporting; a managed bookings and staffing model, including provider-led marketing, customer management and revenue administration, with operational delivery agreed between the provider and the Trust; and/or advice on appropriate commercial structures, including revenue share, guaranteed income, management fee or hybrid models. At this stage, the Trust does not intend to pursue a software-only booking platform as the primary solution, as the requirement includes a need for operational delivery, staffing and site supervision, particularly at Middlewich High School. However, the Trust welcomes feedback on systems and technology used to support managed lettings services. The Trust anticipates that any future contract would require the successful provider to demonstrate robust arrangements for: on-site staffing and supervision; safeguarding, site security and incident escalation; access control, opening, closing and site handover; cleaning, facility reset and reporting of damage or defects; customer service and complaints management; protection and transition of existing community users where possible; pricing strategy and affordability for local community users; financial reporting, reconciliation, VAT information and income remittance; performance reporting and attendance at formal contract review meetings; and orderly exit and transfer of booking/customer data at the end of the arrangement. The Trust is considering a phased implementation approach, with Sir John Deane's Sixth Form College and non-pitch lettings at Middlewich High School potentially commencing first, followed by Middlewich High School pitch or astro lettings at a later stage to allow appropriate transition and notice for existing users. The estimated value of the initial opportunity is currently expected to be in the region of £420,000 to £480,000 or more over an initial three-year period, based on estimated gross lettings income across the sites. This estimate is indicative only and will be reviewed as the commercial model, scope and contract structure are developed. The final classification and value of any subsequent procurement will be confirmed before the formal tender stage. The purpose of this pre-market engagement is to: understand supplier capability and capacity in the managed school and college lettings market; test the proposed scope, delivery model and phasing; understand appropriate commercial models and risk allocation; identify key operational, safeguarding, staffing and financial considerations; inform the Trust's final specification and procurement documents; and ensure that any subsequent procurement is proportionate, transparent and capable of delivering best value. Participation in this pre-market engagement will not confer any advantage in any subsequent procurement process. Information shared by the Trust will be made available on a consistent basis where appropriate, and any future competition will be conducted in accordance with the Trust's procurement obligations, including the principles of transparency, equal treatment and non-discrimination. Interested providers are invited to respond to this notice and may be invited to participate in a site visit. Any future procurement opportunity will be advertised separately, and the Trust reserves the right not to proceed to procurement following this engagement. Lot 1: .

result.text: The aim of this tender is to conclude several framework agreements on the evaluation of communication measures by the Federal Government, federal ministries and subordinate or associated authorities ("Federal Government Alliance"). These framework agreements comprise in particular the advice, development, conception, implementation and evaluation of evaluations. For this purpose, future contractors shall propose and implement suitable evaluations in accordance with the topics, issues, objectives and target groups specified by the demand bearers. The awarding of these services takes place in two lots. A detailed description of the service to be provided can be found in the contracts and the specifications. Lot 1 of the framework agreement tendered here primarily comprises the evaluation of press and public relations (PR) measures of the Federal Government, the respective federal ministries and federal authorities including subordinate or associated authorities ("Federal Government Alliance"). In addition to the evaluation of this external communication, this lot also enables the evaluation of internal products of the demand bearers (e.g. intranet, newscenter, etc.) as well as internal processes by surveying the employees of the demand bearers (internal communication). It includes qualitative methods such as group discussions, qualitative workshops, insight communities, in-depth interviews as well as quantitative methods such as computer-assisted surveys (CATI, CAPI, CASI, CAWI), written postal interviews/push-to-web surveys, mixed-mode surveys, embedding questions in an omnibus survey and on-site surveys. In addition, usability tests are also possible (using qualitative or quantitative methods). A detailed description of the service to be provided can be found in the contract and the specification; Lot 2 of the framework agreement tendered here comprises media resonance analysis and the analysis of public relations in social media for the Federal Government, the respective federal ministries and federal authorities including subordinate or associated authorities ("Federal Government Alliance"). A detailed description of the service to be provided can be found in the contract and the specification.

The subject of this tender is the award of services for VoC / feedback & analytics of the EUDI Wallet Support Organisation (EWSO). result.text: NOTICE: PLEASE READ - April 6, 2023 EDA is excited to announce the launch of its new grants management platform: the Economic Development Grants Experience (EDGE). EDGE was developed to streamline the application and grants management process by implementing a single platform with increased transparency, improved user experience, higher data quality, and more efficiency throughout the entire grant lifecycle. As of April 6th , 2023, applications can no longer be submitted on Grants.gov, and will ONLY be accepted through EDGE. Once your concept proposal has been reviewed, you will receive an invitation to apply in EDGE. More information on how to apply is provided in the full NOFO. You must submit concept proposals to rnta@eda.gov. Program Description EDA provides strategic investments on a competitive merit basis to support economic development, foster job creation, and attract private investment in economically distressed areas of the United States. Under this NOFO, EDA solicits applications from applicants in order to provide investments that support research and technical assistance projects under EDA’s R&E and NTA programs. Grants and cooperative agreements made under these programs are designed to leverage existing regional assets and support the implementation of economic development strategies that advance new ideas and creative approaches to advance economic prosperity in distressed communities. This NOFO employs a two-step application process: (1) the Concept Proposal and (2) the Full Application. EDA will only review Full Applications submitted by applicants who first submitted a Concept Proposal. Any Full Application received from an applicant that did not submit a Concept Proposal will be deemed ineligible and not considered for funding. For the Concept Proposal, applicants may use the optional template available at https://eda.gov/programs/rnta/resources/. Full Applications must be submitted through Grants.gov using the link that EDA will provide with its response to the Concept Proposal. *Please note: While the published Notice of Funding Opportunity (available under "Related Documents") states that the ED900A form and the SF424B form are both required for a complete application, these forms are no longer required and have therefore been removed from the package template.

Grants and cooperative agreements made under these programs are designed to leverage existing regional assets and support the implementation of economic development strategies that advance new ideas and creative approaches to advance economic prosperity in distressed communities. This NOFO employs a two-step application process: (1) the Concept Proposal and (2) the Full Application. EDA will only review Full Applications submitted by applicants who first submitted a Concept Proposal. Any Full Application received from an applicant that did not submit a Concept Proposal will be deemed ineligible and not considered for funding. For the Concept Proposal, applicants may use the optional template available at https://eda.gov/programs/rnta/resources/. Full Applications must be submitted through Grants.gov using the link that EDA will provide with its response to the Concept Proposal. *Please note: While the published Notice of Funding Opportunity (available under "Related Documents") states that the ED900A form and the SF424B form are both required for a complete application, these forms are no longer required and have therefore been removed from the package template.

rejected.text: This is not a contract notice or a call for tenders, but an invitation to a market dialogue through which Kaarinan kaupunki is surveying the market for the tendering of implementation, maintenance, support and development services for the open-source eVaka system for early childhood education. INVITATION TO MARKET DIALOGUE The purpose of this market dialogue is to survey the operators in the market and to collect comments from suppliers. The aim is to obtain comprehensive information to support the implementation of a potential future tender. The subject and content of the procurement will be specified and defined in the final published call for tenders. With this invitation, we request tenderers interested in the procurement to register and participate in the dialogue concerning the procurement. The dialogue seeks information on tenderers operating in the market and the features of the services on offer in relation to the contracting authority's needs. The aim is to obtain feedback and potential development suggestions for the call for tenders package currently under preparation. Market dialogue Market dialogues will be held according to the preliminary schedule between Tue 22.9.2026 and 12-14 via remote connection as a Teams meeting. The discussion sessions will be organised with a maximum of three (3) suppliers. If there are more than three (3) companies registered for the market dialogue, the contracting authority will select the most suitable suppliers for the dialogue based on its own criteria. The purpose of the market dialogue is to inform the market about the upcoming tender, survey the market situation, enable the submission of comments on the future procurement and obtain information concerning the procurement so that the actual competitive tendering can be carried out in the most appropriate manner. In the market dialogue session, the purpose and objectives of the future procurement will be presented, as well as the procurement process in general with its schedule (non-binding). The contracting authority reserves the right to provide registered participants with preliminary questions and a draft of the tender documents before the session. These materials will be reviewed together during the session. Suppliers are requested to prepare for the session with a presentation of no more than 10 minutes, introducing the company's operations, key areas of expertise and services relevant to the procurement. During the session, suppliers will also have the opportunity to ask questions and make suggestions regarding the procurement. The market dialogue will be conducted in Finnish. No compensation will be paid for participating in the dialogue, and the contracting authority will not reimburse any costs incurred from participating in the market dialogue. REGISTRATION All interested operators in the field are requested to register for the market dialogue by 15.9.2026 at 11.00 at the address https://kaarina.toimittajapalvelu.fi/ Further information regarding registration: hankinnat@kaarina.fi ADDITIONAL INFORMATION ON THE NOTICE This notice is an invitation to a market dialogue. This notice does not request tenders. This notice does not oblige the contracting authority to carry out the actual procurement, nor does the contracting authority commit to making any purchases in accordance with this notice. The information provided about the procurement or the procurement procedure is not binding on the contracting authority in any potential subsequent procurement procedure. Refraining from participating in this market dialogue does not prevent participation in a potential call for tenders, and participation in the dialogue does not affect the tenderer's position in the actual call for tenders. Information that has emerged in the market dialogue will remain strictly confidential and will be used solely for the development and planning of the potential procurement. However, the contracting authority is not obliged to take into account the responses received in the market dialogue when drafting the call for tenders.

parts.source: Tämä ei ole hankintailmoitus eikä tarjouspyyntö, vaan kutsu markkinavuoropuheluun, jolla Kaarinan kaupunki kartoittaa markkinoita varhaiskasvatuksen avoimen lähdekoodin eVaka-järjestelmän käyttöönotto-, ylläpito-, tuki- ja kehityspalvelujen kilpailutusta varten. KUTSU MARKKINAVUOROPUHELUUN Tämän markkinavuoropuhelun tarkoituksena on kartoittaa markkinoilla olevia toimijoita sekä kerätä toimittajien kommentteja. Tavoitteena on saada kattavasti tietoa mahdollisen tulevan kilpailutuksen toteutuksen tueksi. Hankinnan kohde ja sisältö tarkentuu ja määritetään lopulliseen julkaistavaan tarjouspyyntöön. Tällä kutsulla pyydämme hankinnasta kiinnostuneita tarjoajia ilmoittautumaan ja osallistumaan hankintaa koskevaan vuoropuheluun. Vuoropuhelulla haetaan tietoa markkinoilla toimivista tarjoajista ja tarjolla olevien palveluiden ominaisuuksista suhteessa tilaajan tarpeisiin. Tavoitteena on saada palautetta sekä mahdollisia kehitysehdotuksia valmisteilla olevaan tarjouspyyntökokonaisuuteen. Markkinavuoropuhelu Markkinavuoropuhelut toteutetaan alustavan aikataulun mukaisesti ti 22.9.2026 klo 12-14 välisenä aikana etäyhteydellä Teams-kokouksena. Keskustelutilaisuudet järjestetään enintään kolmen (3) toimittajan kanssa. Mikäli markkinavuoropuheluun ilmoittautuneita yrityksiä on yli kolme (3), valitsee hankintayksikkö omista lähtökohdistaan sopivimmat toimittajat vuoropuheluun. Markkinavuoropuhelun tarkoituksena on tiedottaa markkinoita tulevasta kilpailutuksesta, kartoittaa markkinoiden tilannetta, mahdollistaa kommenttien esittäminen tulevasta hankinnasta sekä saada hankintaa koskevaa tietoa, jotta varsinainen tarjouskilpailu voidaan toteuttaa mahdollisimman tarkoituksenmukaisella tavalla. Markkinavuoropuhelutilaisuudessa esitellään tulevan hankinnan tarkoitus ja tavoitteet sekä yleisesti hankintaprosessi aikatauluineen (ei sitova). Hankintayksikkö varaa oikeuden toimittaa ilmoittautuneille ennakkokysymyksiä sekä luonnoksen tarjouspyyntöasiakirjoista ennen tilaisuutta. Nämä materiaalit käydään yhdessä läpi tilaisuuden aikana. Toimittajia pyydetään valmistautumaan tilaisuuteen enintään 10 minuutin esityksellä, jossa esitellään yrityksen toiminta, keskeiset osaamisalueet sekä hankinnan kannalta tarkoituksenmukaiset palvelut. Tilaisuudessa toimittajilla on myös mahdollisuus esittää kysymyksiä sekä tehdä ehdotuksia hankintaan liittyen. Markkinavuoropuhelu tullaan toteuttamaan suomen kielellä. Vuoropuheluun osallistumisesta ei makseta korvausta eikä hankintayksikkö korvaa markkinavuoropuheluun osallistumiseen aiheutuvista kustannuksista. ILMOITTAUTUMINEN Kaikkia kiinnostuneita alan toimijoita pyydetään ilmoittautumaan markkinavuoropuheluun viimeistään 15.9.2026 klo 11.00 mennessä osoitteessa https://kaarina.toimittajapalvelu.fi/ Ilmoittautumista koskevat lisätiedot: hankinnat@kaarina.fi ILMOITUKSEN LISÄTIEDOT Tämä ilmoitus on kutsu markkinavuoropuheluun. Tällä ilmoituksella ei pyydetä tarjouksia. Tämä ilmoitus ei velvoita hankintayksikköä toteuttamaan varsinaista hankintaa, eikä hankintayksikkö sitoudu tekemään tämän ilmoituksen mukaisia hankintoja. Ilmoitetut tiedot hankinnasta tai hankintamenettelystä eivät ole hankintayksikköä sitovia mahdollisessa myöhemmässä hankintamenettelyssä. Tähän markkinavuoropuheluun osallistumatta jättäminen ei estä mahdolliseen tarjouskilpailuun osallistumista, eikä vuoropuheluun osallistuminen vaikuta tarjoajan asemaan varsinaisessa tarjouskilpailussa. Markkinavuoropuhelussa esiin tulleet tiedot säilyvät täysin luottamuksellisina ja niitä tullaan käyttämään ainoastaan mahdollisen hankinnan kehittämiseen ja suunnitteluun. Hankintayksikkö ei kuitenkaan ole velvollinen ottamaan huomioon markkinavuoropuhelussa saatuja vastauksia tarjouspyynnön laadinnassa.

result.text: Artificial Intelligence (AI) Discovery and consultancy services for artificial intelligence (AI), implementation, support of AI systems, end-to-end partnerships, and access to a range of AI technologies. Updates 21 November 2025: We have extended this agreement until 23 February 2029. You will be able to buy and run tenders for services until the new expiry date. Description A Dynamic Purchasing System (DPS) that provides public sector organisations with access to a wide range of Artificial Intelligence (AI) services. What you can buy RM6200 Artificial Intelligence (AI) supports organisations at every stage of their AI journey. It supports: Users new to AI: you can purchase discovery services to help understand AI and its benefits. Established AI users: obtain licensing, customization, and support from suppliers. End-to-end support: choose comprehensive partnerships if you need both discovery and ongoing support. Available AI product types General AI applications, augmented decision making, data and analytics, and virtual assistants or chatbots. Medical AI Technology Health and social care bodies can specifically access applications such as: medical imaging software non-imaging diagnostic software symptom-based software. These applications support functions like screening, diagnosis, and improving system efficiency, in line with the AI in Health and Care Award. Contracts awarded under this agreement can last up to 4 years, based on how complex your project is. The DPS allows you to shortlist suppliers based on your needs using a range of filters. Once you have established your shortlist you can use this to run a further competition. Benefits complies with government standards, including the Data Ethics Framework and AI Procurement Guidelines reduces buying times through an easier route to market ensures ethical buying and supports strong ethics processes offers commercial flexibility to meet the public sector’s AI needs allows supplier shortlisting based on quality, price, and cultural fit (including social value ) provides a dynamic pool of suppliers that can evolve with the market includes bespoke Intellectual Property Rights (IPR) terms for the AI market promotes standards for AI and data-driven technology in healthcare Products and suppliers Please read the 'How to buy' tab below for detailed instructions on how to find out which suppliers are on this agreement. Lot 1: Artificial Intelligence (AI) Expires: 23/02/2029 How to buy Register as a buyer. Note: although pages are headed ‘Supplier registration’ this is also where you can register as a buyer Go to the Artificial Intelligence DPS and log in with your username and password. Click on ‘confirm’ at the bottom of the text, and agree to the terms of use. On your ‘Manage your DPS Category Exports’ page you now have 2 options (in the bottom right-hand corner of the page): view appointed suppliers Buyers are encouraged to conduct pre-market engagement before using the filters click on the link to create a new category export, this is how you filter the suppliers that can meet your needs Use the filtering tool to specify your needs, this will create a list of capable suppliers. Attach filters descriptions document in this section. save your filtered list of capable suppliers by clicking the ‘Save Category’ option shortlisted suppliers are a 100% match to the buyers selected filters from your ‘Manage your Category Exports’ page you can then export the list of suppliers and contact details (export is to an Excel spreadsheet) Log out of the DPS. Use the list to run a further competition. Invite the suppliers identified by the DPS to bid against your detailed specification and evaluation criteria. The list is valid for 2 working days only, from the date of its creation, because new suppliers may be applying to join at any point. if your further competition excludes eligible suppliers it could breach procurement regulations get a fresh supplier list (steps 3.2 to 5) if you do not use your list within 2 working days by clicking the ‘Search Again’ option for your export you can use your own eSourcing tool or the our eSourcing too l to run a further competition. Our eSourcing tool is free to use for public sector Evaluate responses and award the contract. Detailed buyer guidance is available in the documents section. You can watch the How to use the Artificial Intelligence Dynamic Purchasing System video. Documents Updates Crown Commercial Service (CCS) became Government Commercial Agency (GCA) on 1 April 2026. Documents published before this date may still refer to CCS. All contract documents remain valid for existing and new contracts, and there are no changes to how you work with us.

result.text: The Land Training Advisory Capability (LTAC) (formerly Land Training Test & Reference Centre (LTT&RC)) will provide independent testing, analysis and assurance to support confidence in the Army Collective Training Service (ACTS). It will ensure that the Land Warfare Centre (LWC) remains an intelligent customer, able to maintain technical coherence and keep services focused on training outcomes, underpinned by secure information and data. Drawing upon reference architecture, technical standards and a test-bed for evaluating integration compatibility, the LTAC will provide independent support to the acceptance of digital products and provide assurance support that solutions meet the Defence Modelling and Simulation Coherence and Secure by Design principles. The LTAC will maintain the ACTS architecture baseline and act as the architecture custodian, ensuring coherence, traceability and alignment with approved Defence standards. The Authority currently intends to procure this requirement through a competition conducted under the Crown Commercial Service Technology Services 4 (TS4) Framework. Lot 1: . None

result.text: The Havelland district intends to award external expert support for the following services: 1. Support with and preparation of the next four rescue service fee calculations (planned cost accounting including operating cost accounting) 2. Analysis and processing of financial deficits from concluded stay-of-enforcement agreements from the years 2021-2024 relating to the so-called false-call issue, including adjustment based on the judgment of the Higher Administrative Court of Berlin-Brandenburg (OVG 6 A 13/25) 3. Advice on a legally secure and sustainable fee structure Lot LOT-0001: Advisory and support services for fee calculation in the rescue service as well as for deficit processing (stay-of-enforcement agreements 2021-2024) in the Havelland district. The consultant shall analyse for the client the effects of the judgment of the OVG Berlin-Brandenburg, 28.01.2026, ref. OVG 6 A 13/25 on the respective rescue service fee budget and prepare a written opinion thereon. This also includes an analysis of the written grounds for the judgment. The consultant shall implement all work arising therefrom as part of an amicable solution with the statutory health insurance funds (GKV) in the interest of the client. The required advisory services include, in particular, data collection, the evaluation of all data as well as the adjustments of the relevant rescue service fee calculations and support for the hearing procedure with the cost bearers. The aim is the retroactive resolution of the consequences of the OVG judgment and the elimination of the resulting financial risk for the years 2021-2024 and the year 2026 and expert support up to the year 2029. -2.1 Rescue service fee calculation -2.2 Processing of the concluded stay-of-enforcement agreements (2021-2024) -2.3 Strategic advice

parts.source: Der Landkreis Havelland beabsichtigt, externe fachliche Unterstützung für folgende Leistungen zu vergeben: 1. Begleitung und Erstellung der nächsten vier Rettungsdienstgebührenkalkulationen (Plankostenrechnung inklusive Betriebskostenabrechnung) 2. Analyse und Aufarbeitung finanzieller Defizite aus geschlossenen Hemmungsvereinbarungen der Jahre 2021-2024 zur sogenannten Fehleinsatzthematik inklusive einer Bereinigung auf Grundlage des Urteils des Oberverwaltungsgerichtes Berlin-Brandenburg (OVG 6 A 13/25) 3. Beratung zur rechtssicheren und nachhaltigen Gebührenstruktur Lot LOT-0001: Beratungs- und Unterstützungsleistungen zur Gebührenkalkulation im Rettungsdienst sowie zur Defizitaufarbeitung (Hemmungsvereinbarungen 2021-2024) im Landkreis Havelland. Der Berater wird für den Auftraggeber die Auswirkungen des Urteils OVG Berlin-Brandenburg, 28.01.2026, Az. OVG 6 A 13/25 auf den jeweiligen Rettungsdienstgebührenhaushalt analysieren und hierzu eine schriftliche Stellungnahme fertigen. Dies beinhaltet auch eine Analyse der schriftli-chen Urteilsbegründung. Der Berater wird alle sich hieraus ergebenden Arbeiten im Rahmen einer einvernehmlichen Lösung mit der GKV im Sinne des Auftraggebers realisieren. Zu den erforderli-chen Beratungsleistungen gehören insbesondere die Datenbeschaffung, die Auswertung aller Da-ten sowie die Anpassungen der relevanten Rettungsdienstgebührenkalkulationen und die Beglei-tung des Anhörungsverfahrens mit den Kostenträgern. Ziel ist die rückwirkende Auflösung der Folgen des OVG Urteils und die Beseitigung des daraus folgenden finanziellen Risikos der Jahre 2021-2024 sowie des Jahres 2026 und die gutachterliche Begleitung bis zum Jahr 2029. -2.1 Gebührenkalkulation Rettungsdienst -2.2 Aufarbeitung der geschlossenen Hemmungsvereinbarungen (2021-2024) -2.3 Strategische Beratung

result.text: For many people, buses represent the most affordable and accessible mode of transport. Those on low or fixed incomes depend on them to access health, education and employment. But for some, there are barriers which make it more difficult to use public transport. These barriers can be physical (for example infrastructure) and access to information (for example timetables or journey planning information). For some groups, such barriers can reduce their travel horizons and lead them to spend more on alternative modes such as a taxi. One such group are the more than two million people living with sight loss in the UK. This number is estimated to double to 4 million people in the next 25 years by the Royal National Institute of Blind People (RNIB); with one person every six minutes starting to lose their sight. In this context, and with disabled people reporting up to three times more difficulties when travelling than non-disabled people, the Council has a need to make travel in Essex simpler, more inclusive and accessible for all. With the barriers for disabled people and those with sight loss clearly established in terms of travel, and the importance of digital technology in assisting to remove these barriers, the Council intends to source and implement a new digital tool across its bus infrastructure estate initially. The product will enable visually impaired people to be completely independent in the use of public transport, by means of an accessible digital solution, which enables the user to orient themselves in an unfamiliar environment and obtain accessible, contextualised information. It is proposed this will be via their smartphone device. ECC intend to utilise the Crown Commercial Services Spark Dynamic Purchasing System (DPS) RM6094 framework with the intention of procuring through this in early February 2026. To become a supplier on this commercial agreement please use the link below for more details. https://supplierregistration.cabinetoffice.gov.uk/organisation/register

Tietopyynnön tarkoituksena on kartoittaa markkinoita ja kerätä tietoa sekä toimittajien kommentteja, jotta myöhemmin tuleva tarjouskilpailu voitaisiin toteuttaa tarkoituksenmukaisella tavalla. Tietopyynnöllä ei pyydetä, eikä siihen anneta, tarjouksia. Hankinnan kohteena on taloushallinnon (kirjanpito, osto- ja myyntireskontra, raportointi) sekä palkkahallinnon (palkanmaksu, viranomaisvelvoitteet, matka- ja kululaskut) palveluiden tuottaminen, joka on kuvattu yksityiskohtaisemmin tässä tietopyynnössä ja sen liitteissä. Liitteessä kaksi on kuvattu tarkemmin välittävän toimielimen virantoimitustehtävät ja vastuunjako. Palvelukokonaisuuteen sisältyy tietojärjestelmät ja -ohjelmistot, ja siirtohankkeen organisointi ja toimeenpano. Lisäksi hankintaan voidaan sisällyttää optiona HR-palvelut henkilöstöhallinnon järjestelmä ja siihen liittyvät palvelut. Markkinavuoropuhelun tarkoituksena on selvittää, millaisella kokonaisuudella talous- ja palkkahallinnon sekä HR -palvelut voitaisiin Pohjanmaan liitossa jatkossa toteuttaa. Markkinavuoropuhelun tavoitteena on kartoittaa Pohjanmaan liiton tarpeeseen sopivia palveluntuottajia ja tietojärjestelmiä ohjelmistoineen. Hankittava kokoanaisuus sisältää TAVOITTEEN mukaan tämän kutsun (=tietopyynnön) mukaisia palveluja. Palvelukokonaisuuteen sisältyy tarjoajan tietojärjestelmät ja -ohjelmistot taloushallinnossa ja palkkahallinnossa tilaajan käyttöön. Lisäksi hankintaan voidaan sisällyttää optiona HR-palvelut henkilöstöhallinnon järjestelmä ja siihen liittyvät palvelut. KÄYTTÖÖNOTTOHANKKEEN ORGANISOINTI JA TOIMEENPANO Palvelukokonaisuuteen kuuluu myös siirtohankkeen organisointi ja toimeenpano. rejected.text: The Universitätsklinikum Heidelberg (UKHD) is one of the largest and most renowned medical centres in Germany. Every year, approximately 80.000 patients are treated on a full-time or part-time inpatient basis in its specialist clinics, and more than 1.000.000 patients are cared for on an outpatient basis. The Heidelberg campus brings together scientific institutes and clinics of the UKHD, offers extensive opportunities for collaboration with the life sciences and humanities faculties of the university, and simultaneously maintains established partnerships with internationally renowned non-university large-scale research institutions. The increasing complexity and rising demands on IT infrastructure in the healthcare sector require reliable and efficient management of the IT landscape. In the context of the UKHD, it is of crucial importance that operational and clinical applications run constantly and without disruption to ensure optimal patient care and smooth operations. As part of this procurement procedure, the University Hospital is issuing a framework agreement for the provision of support services in IT application management (expected) from 1. February 2027 for the following 4 years (planned) incl. extension options. A gradual transition to transfer the services from the existing operation, which is outsourced to an external service provider, is planned for the period Q1/Q2 2027. The full takeover of the provision of all contractual services into regular operation is to take place by no later than 01.07.2027. The Centre for Digitalisation and Information Technology (ZDI) of the Universitätsklinikum Heidelberg is operationally divided into individual areas. Supported by contractors as external service providers, they assume end-to-end responsibility regarding the IT of the respective core processes of the contracting authority in order to be able to ensure secure and stable operation, as well as the further development of IT services. Directly affected by the tender and the subject of the procurement are the areas for Operational Information Systems (BIS), for Hospital Information Systems (KIS), for Integration, Special Systems and Archiving (ISA), as well as the ZDI itself. The scope of the tender covers the contracting authority's service requirements for operational services in application management. This includes, in particular, smooth application operation, the rapid and permanent resolution of incidents and problems, as well as releases, upgrades and updates in coordination with the contracting authority. Furthermore, this includes other supporting project services that are in direct or close substantive connection with the aforementioned operational services. In this regard, the future contractor is expected to provide comprehensive and holistic services within the framework of a managed service in order to implement the requirements of the contracting authority regarding IT architecture, IT security and IT service integration. The integration of IT services based on the ITIL v4 framework must be provided holistically for all specialist departments. In this context, the contracting authority will manage the contractor(s) and provide the IT hardware required at the contracting authority's locations as well as a portion of the required software licences.

parts.source: Das Universitätsklinikum Heidelberg (UKHD) gehört zu den größten und renommiertesten medizinischen Zentren in Deutschland. Jedes Jahr werden in dessen Fachkliniken circa 80.000 Patienten voll- und teilstationär behandelt und mehr als 1.000.000 Patienten ambulant betreut. Der Heidelberger Campus vereint wissenschaftliche Institute und Kliniken des UKHD, bietet reichhaltige Möglichkeiten der Zusammenarbeit mit lebens- und geisteswissenschaftlichen Fakultäten der Universität und hält gleichzeitig etablierte Kooperationen mit international renommierten außeruniversitären Großforschungseinrichtungen bereit. Die zunehmende Komplexität und die steigenden Anforderungen an die IT-Infrastruktur im Gesundheitswesen erfordern eine zuverlässige und effiziente Verwaltung der IT-Landschaft. Im Kontext des UKHD ist es von entscheidender Bedeutung, dass die betrieblichen und klinischen Anwendungen stets verfügbar und störungsfrei laufen, um eine optimale Patientenversorgung und einen reibungslosen Betrieb zu gewährleisten. Im Rahmen dieses Vergabeverfahrens schreibt das Universitätsklinikum einen Rahmenvertrag zur Erbringung von Unterstützungsleistungen im IT-Applikationsmanagement (voraussichtlich) ab dem 1. Februar 2027 für die folgenden 4 Jahren (geplant) inkl. Verlängerungsoptionen aus. Eine möglichst schrittweise Transition zur Überführung der Leistungen aus dem bestehenden an einen externen Dienstleister ausgelagerten Betrieb ist für den Zeitraum Q1/Q2 2027 geplant. Die vollständige Übernahme der Erbringung aller vertragsgegenständlichen Leistungen in den Regelbetrieb soll spätestens zum 01.07.2027. Das Zentrum für Digitalisierung und Informationstechnologie (ZDI) der Universitätsklinikum Heidelberg wird operativ in einzelne Bereiche unterteilt. Sie übernehmen unterstützt durch Auftragnehmer als externe Dienstleistungserbringer die Ende-zu-Ende-Verantwortung in Bezug auf die IT der jeweiligen Kernprozesse des Auftraggebers, um einen sicheren und stabilen Betrieb, aber auch die Weiterentwicklung der IT-Leistung sicherstellen zu können. Direkt von der Ausschreibung und dem Vergabegegenstand betroffen sind die Bereiche für Betriebliche Informationssysteme (BIS), für Krankenhaus-Informationssysteme (KIS), für Integration, Spezialsysteme und Archivierung (ISA) sowie direkt das ZDI selbst. Mit dem Ausschreibungsumfang wird der Servicebedarf des Auftraggebers von Betriebsleistungen im Applikationsmanagement abgedeckt. Dies beinhaltet insbesondere den reibungslosen Applikationsbetrieb, das schnelle und dauerhafte Beheben von Incidents und Problems sowie Releases, Upgrades und Updates in Abstimmung mit dem Auftraggeber. Außerdem umfasst dieser weitere unterstützende Projektleistungen, welche im direkten oder nahen inhaltlichen Zusammenhang mit den vorgenannten Betriebsleistungen stehen. Dabei wird von dem zukünftigen Auftragnehmer eine umfassende und ganzheitliche Erbringung der Leistungen im Rahmen eines Managed Service erwartet, um die Anforderungen des Auftraggebers hinsichtlich der IT-Architektur, IT-Sicherheit und IT-Service Integration umzusetzen. Die Integration der IT-Services auf Basis des ITIL v4-Frameworks müssen ganzheitlich für alle Fachbereiche bereitgestellt werden. Der Auftraggeber wird in diesem Zusammenhang den bzw. die Auftragnehmer steuern und die an den Standorten des Auftraggebers benötigte IT-Hardware sowie einen Teil der benötigten Softwarelizenzen beistellen.

result.text: The subject matter of the service is the implementation of a production planning tool for capacity-oriented planning and control. The use of the software, including maintenance and support, is intended to amount to a total of four years. The subject matter of the tender is the commissioning of a qualified provider to implement an Advanced Planning and Scheduling (APS) system that enables very detailed scheduling of all required resources using finite resource planning. The primary objective of implementing the planning tool is to generate the most realistic and feasible planning possible through optimal scheduling of all resources, linked with feedback from operational units in SAP S/4HANA in almost real time. By mapping all weapon systems and equipment in the planning tool and providing a simulation capability, equipment availability is to be simulated and visualised with the planned measures directed towards the future. The focus is on conception, implementation, customising, licence provision, support, as well as the training and qualification of users and administrators. System provisioning and server operation are carried out by the contracting authority's existing IT service provider, Systembetrieb.

parts.source: Gegenstand der Leistung ist die Implementierung eines Produktionsplanungstools für eine kapazitätsorientierte Planung und Steuerung. Die Nutzung der Software, inkl. Wartung und Support, soll insgesamt vier Jahre betragen. Gegenstand der Ausschreibung ist die Beauftragung eines qualifizierten Anbieters zur Implementierung eines Advanced Planning and Scheduling-Systems (APS), das mit einer finiten Ressourcenplanung eine sehr feine Einplanung aller benötigten Ressourcen ermöglicht. Oberstes Ziel der Implementierung des Planungstools ist es, durch optimale Ausplanung aller Ressourcen, verknüpft mit den Rückmeldungen der operativen Einheiten in SAP S/4HANA nahezu in Echtzeit, eine maximal realistische und umsetzbare Planung zu erzeugen. Durch die Abbildung aller Waffensysteme und Geräte im Planungstool und einer Simulationsmöglichkeit soll die Geräte-Verfügbarkeit mit den geplanten Maßnahmen auch in die Zukunft gerichtet simuliert und visualisiert werden können. Der Fokus liegt auf der Konzeptionierung, Implementierung, dem Customizing, der Lizenzbereitstellung, dem Support sowie der Schulung und Qualifizierung der Anwender und Administratoren. Die Systembereitstellung und der Betrieb der Server erfolgen durch den bestehenden IT-Dienstleister Systembetrieb des AG.

result.text: Cold homes, damp, mould and fuel poverty are driving poor health outcomes, increasing pressure on healthcare services and deepening inequalities. While Registered Social Landlords are investing in warmer, more energy-efficient housing and responding to new regulatory requirements, fuel poverty means many vulnerable residents remain at risk, even in high-quality homes. Current approaches are often reactive and lack mechanisms to target support for those that might be the very most vulnerable, addressing issues only after harm has occurred. This Challenge seeks innovative solutions that can help registered social landlords identify where housing conditions, fuel poverty and individual vulnerability combine to create the greatest risk of harm, then translate that insight into practical, targeted action that combats these impacts, improves tenants’ health and wellbeing outcomes, protects homes and makes better use of limited housing and support resources. Solutions must be affordable at RSL scale, protect tenant privacy, and connect insight to action so that Cloch can complete investigation and repair work within statutory timescales.

result.text: Iraq faces a persistent gap between its people and the financial system. Banks have long leaned on large state-owned institutions, credit has flowed mainly to established borrowers, and micro and small businesses along with women entrepreneurs and displaced communities have been largely left out. ProDIGI project, full name Promoting Employment in the Digital and Green Economy in Iraq, is trying to change that in a practical, grounded way. ProDIGI is a multi-donor initiative commissioned by the German Federal Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development (BMZ), co-financed by the European Union, and implemented by the Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit (GIZ) GmbH. The project covers central and southern Iraq as well as the Kurdistan Region, with a focus on areas where joblessness, displacement, and limited access to services overlap. Within the project, Output 3 targets the financial inclusion side of the challenge. The starting point is a clear-eyed look at what the sector lacks: financial service providers that are capable, willing, and equipped to design products that fit the people they are supposed to serve. Banks and microfinance institutions in Iraq today mostly offer standardised products with high collateral requirements and limited digital capabilities. Reaching women led small businesses, rural communities, or young entrepreneurs running green or tech ventures requires a different kind of product, and often a different kind of institution. To bridge that gap, the project works directly with Iraqi financial service providers: banks, microfinance institutions, digital payment companies, fintechs, and government lending programmes. The approach combines needs assessments, hands-on advisory services, staff training, product design support, and pilot testing. The goal is not to deliver a finished product from outside, but to build the knowledge and process capacity within each institution so that change remains after the project ends. By the close of the assignment, at least three new or significantly adapted financial products must be in place, and these products must be actively reaching real users at a minimum of 950 individuals and 50 companies. The work also emphasises gender equality: women-led businesses are a priority target group, and all capacity-building activities must include a meaningful share of women participants. The broader context matters too. Iraq's Central Bank launched the national financial inclusion strategy that encourages digital payments, SME lending, and consumer protection improvements. ProDIGI project aligns directly with those priorities, making it both a practical intervention at the level of individual institutions and a contribution to the country's wider financial sector development. The selected firm will work directly with three to five financial service providers (FSPs) operating in Iraq. These may include commercial banks, microfinance institutions, digital payment providers, fintechs, and government lending schemes. GIZ will have pre-selected up to two FSPs before the contract starts, so work can begin without delay. The remaining FSPs will be selected by the contractor and GIZ jointly, based on agreed criteria. The assignment is structured around three work packages. The first covers the selection and appraisal of partner FSPs. The contractor will conduct an institutional diagnostic for each FSP, reviewing their current product offering, business model, lending processes, digital infrastructure, client outreach capacity, and staff skills. Based on that analysis, a cooperation agreement will be signed with each FSP, along with a detailed work plan laying out what the collaboration will achieve and by when. This phase should be completed within the first three months. The second work package is where the core technical work happens. The contractor will support FSPs in designing or adapting financial products that genuinely respond to the needs of target groups, particularly women-led businesses, rural borrowers, and MSME clients who currently lack access to suitable financing. The process follows a structured product development methodology: from prototype design, through pilot testing, to assessment and refinement, and finally roll-out. Alongside the product work, the contractor will help FSPs develop marketing materials and outreach strategies, adjust internal procedures and manuals, and train front-line staff such as loan officers and branch managers. At least three financial product prototypes must be developed by the fifth to seventh month, piloted by month eight, and formally adopted with updated manuals by month ten. The third work package covers cross-cutting contributions: occasional training inputs for financial sector stakeholders such as the Central Bank of Iraq and sector associations; support for GIZ's monitoring and evaluation activities; and at least three public communication outputs, case studies, blog posts, fact sheets, or similar, documenting the work done with each FSP.

rejected.text: The far-reaching impact and rate of innovation in the computer and information science and engineering fields has been remarkable, generating economic prosperity and enhancing the quality of life for people throughout the world. More than a decade ago, the National Science Foundation’s (NSF) Directorate for Computer and Information Science and Engineering (CISE) established the Expeditions in Computing (Expeditions) programme to build on past successes and provide the CISE research and education community with the opportunity to pursue ambitious, fundamental research agendas that promise to define the future of computing and information. In planning Expeditions projects, investigators are strongly encouraged to come together within or across departments or institutions to combine their creative talents in the identification of compelling, transformative research agendas that look ahead by at least a decade and promise disruptive innovations in computer and information science and engineering for many years to come. Now funded at levels up to $15,000,000 for seven years, Expeditions projects represent some of the largest single investments currently made by the CISE directorate. Together with the Science and Technology Centres and the National Artificial Intelligence Research Institutes that CISE supports, Expeditions projects form the centrepiece of the directorate's centre-scale award portfolio. With awards funded at levels that promote the formation of large research teams, CISE recognises that concurrent research advances in multiple fields or sub-fields are often necessary to stimulate deep and enduring outcomes. The awards made in this programme will complement research areas supported by other CISE programmes, which target particular computer and information science and engineering fields. Additionally, CISE offers Innovation Transition (InTrans) awards for teams nearing the end of their Expeditions as well as Secure and Trustworthy Cyberspace (SaTC) and Cyber-Physical Systems (CPS) Frontier projects. The goal of InTransis to continue the long-term vision and objectives of CISE’s centre-scale projects. Through InTrans awards, CISE will provide limited funds to match industry support.

In planning Expeditions projects, investigators are strongly encouraged to come together within or across departments or institutions to combine their creative talents in the identification of compelling, transformative research agendas that look ahead by at least a decade and promise disruptive innovations in computer and information science and engineering for many years to come. Now funded at levels up to $15,000,000 for seven years, Expeditions projects represent some of the largest single investments currently made by the CISE directorate. Together with the Science and Technology Centers and the National Artificial Intelligence Research Institutes that CISE supports, Expeditions projects form the centerpiece of the directorate's center-scale award portfolio. With awards funded at levels that promote the formation of large research teams, CISE recognizes that concurrent research advances in multiple fields or sub-fields are often necessary to stimulate deep and enduring outcomes. The awards made in this program will complement research areas supported by other CISE programs, which target particular computer and information science and engineering fields. Additionally, CISE offers Innovation Transition (InTrans) awards for teams nearing the end of their Expeditions as well as Secure and Trustworthy Cyberspace (SaTC) and Cyber-Physical Systems (CPS) Frontier projects. The goal of InTransis to continue the long-term vision and objectives of CISE’s center-scale projects. Through InTrans awards, CISE will provide limited funds to match industry support.

result.text: An IT application is to be procured as a SaaS cloud solution for the digitisation of processes relating to trichinella testing, the management of monitoring samples in the animal health sector, and management in the event of an outbreak of African Swine Fever (ASF). The IT application must be compatible with the hunting statistics application from Condition – Integrierte Softwarelösungen GmbH. This is used in the Free State of Thuringia to record bag data (data on wild animals killed by hunters). The IT application should be available both as a web application (usable in common browsers) and as a mobile app (iOS and Android operating systems). Within the scope of the tender, an app is defined as an application that must be installed on a mobile device before use by the user and can only be used there. As a rule, this takes place on a smartphone or tablet using a so-called app store. There will be two main user groups: a) administrative or laboratory staff b) non-administrative users (e.g. authorised hunters). The non-administrative users record data on killed or slaughtered animals. If necessary, they also submit applications for the testing of these animals for trichinella and/or certain wildlife diseases to the competent authorities or the competent testing facility of the Free State of Thuringia. The test results should be retrievable via the IT application. The competent authorities (veterinary and food monitoring offices of the districts and independent cities - veterinary authorities) operate the trichinella testing laboratories. These should be able to access the application data recorded by external users in the IT application via their own user interface and transmit the test results back to the applicants. In addition, laboratory software should be made available to the competent authorities, with the help of which testing activities can be documented on the basis of the application data. In the case of monitoring samples in the animal health sector, the client's laboratory at the Thuringian State Office for Consumer Protection is the competent testing facility. The laboratory software (LIMS) in use there should be able to access the information on the samples entered by the users via the HIT database. The IT application must therefore have an interface to the HIT database. A direct connection to the LIMS is not intended. The IT application is to be made available to administrative staff for mapping internal administrative processes, as well as to affected users outside the administration for data entry and application submission, and for receiving notifications from the competent authorities. While the use cases of trichinella testing, management of monitoring samples in the animal health sector, and the interface to the hunting statistics application are to be available permanently, the use case of management in the event of an outbreak of African Swine Fever (ASF) is only to be usable and available on an ad-hoc basis. Furthermore, introductory support and training for the staff of the competent authorities should be included in the offer as an initial service. The contract is concluded via an EVB-IT cloud contract. The procurement is carried out by the client for use by all districts and independent cities in Thuringia. The use of the IT application for the aforementioned purposes is mandatory for the districts and independent cities. For hunters, however, use is optional. This means they can refrain from using the IT application. The previous analogue system for sampling will continue to be used in parallel for the time being. The 21 veterinary and food monitoring offices of the 22 districts and independent cities in the Free State of Thuringia are, among other things, responsible for receiving and testing samples of slaughtered or killed animals intended for human consumption for Trichinella spp. Furthermore, there are responsibilities with regard to granting permission for the taking of samples intended for trichinella testing by non-administrative persons. Citizens who wish to make use of the aforementioned administrative services should be enabled to record the required application data digitally in accordance with the principles of the Online Access Act (OZG), to submit the application paperlessly to the respective competent veterinary and food monitoring office, and to receive the notifications from the competent authorities. In addition, the possibility should be created to comply with further reporting obligations (e.g. the recording of hunting bags by hunters) in digital form. The testing of wild boar for Trichinella spp. only takes place if the animal is to become food. Based on experience to date, this leads to the testing of up to 30.000 head of wild boar per year in Thuringia. These figures fluctuate. The recorded data should be transmitted via the application to the State Office for Consumer Protection responsible for testing the samples. parts.source: Es soll eine IT-Anwendung zur Digitalisierung der Vorgänge in Bezug auf die Trichinenuntersuchung, das Management von Monitoring-Proben im Tiergesundheitsbereich und das Management im Falle eines Ausbruches der Afrikanischen Schweinepest (ASP) als SaaS-Cloud-Lösung beschafft werden. Die IT-Anwendung muss kompatibel zur Jagdstatistik-Anwendung der Condition – Integrierte Softwarelösungen GmbH sein. Mit dieser werden im Freistaat Thüringen die Streckendaten (Daten der von Jägern erlegten Wildtiere) erfasst. Die IT-Anwendung soll sowohl als Web- (nutzbar in den gängigen Browsern) als auch Mobile App-Anwendung (Betriebssysteme iOS und Android) zur Verfügung stehen. Als App wird im Rahmen der Ausschreibung eine Anwendung definiert, die vor Verwendung durch den Nutzer auf einem mobilen Gerät installiert werden muss und auch nur dort genutzt werden kann. In der Regel erfolgt dies auf einem Smartphone oder Tablet mithilfe eines sogenannten App-Stores. Es wird zwei wesentliche Nutzergruppen geben: a) Verwaltungs- bzw. Labormitarbeiter b) verwaltungsexterne Nutzer (z. B. Jagdausübungsberechtigte) Die verwaltungsexternen Nutzer erfassen Daten zu erlegten bzw. geschlachteten Tieren. Erforderlichenfalls stellen diese zudem Anträge zur Untersuchung dieser Tiere auf Trichinen und/oder bestimmte Wildtierseuchen bei den zuständigen Behörden bzw. der zuständigen Untersuchungseinrichtung des Freistaates Thüringen. Die Untersuchungsergebnisse sollen über die IT-Anwendung abrufbar sein. Die zuständigen Behörden (Veterinär- und Lebensmittelüberwachungsämter der Landkreise und kreisfreie Städte - Veterinärbehörden) betreiben die Trichinenuntersuchungslabore. Diese sollen über eine eigene Nutzeroberfläche auf die durch die externen Nutzer in der IT-Anwendung erfassten Antragsdaten zugreifen und die Untersuchungsergebnisse an die Antragssteller zurück übermitteln können. Zudem soll für die zuständigen Behörden eine Laborsoftware zur Verfügung gestellt werden, mit Hilfe dieser auf Basis der Antragsdaten die Untersuchungstätigkeiten dokumentiert werden können. Im Falle der Monitoring-Proben im Tiergesundheitsbereich ist das Labor des Auftraggebers im Thüringer Landesamt für Verbraucherschutz die zuständige Untersuchungseinrichtung. Die dort in Nutzung befindliche Laborsoftware (LIMS) soll über die HIT-Datenbank auf die von den Nutzern eingegebenen Informationen zu den Proben zugreifen können. Die IT-Anwendung muss daher über eine Schnittstelle zur HIT-Datenbank verfügen. Eine direkte Verbindung zum LIMS ist nicht vorgesehen. Die IT-Anwendung soll den Verwaltungsmitarbeitenden zur Abbildung verwaltungsinterner Vorgänge sowie betroffenen Nutzern außerhalb der Verwaltung zur Datenerfassung und Antragsstellung gegenüber sowie dem Empfang von Bescheiden von den zuständigen Behörden zur Verfügung stehen. Während die Anwendungsfälle Trichinenuntersuchung, Management von Monitoring-Proben im Tiergesundheitsbereich sowie die Schnittstelle zur Jagdstatistikanwendung dauerhaft zur Verfügung stehen sollen, soll der Anwendungsfall des Managements im Falle eines Ausbruches der Afrikanischen Schweinepest (ASP) nur anlassbezogen nutz- und verfügbar sein. Darüber hinaus soll auch eine Einführungsunterstützung sowie Schulung der Mitarbeitenden der zuständigen Behörden im Angebot als initiale Leistung enthalten sein. Vertragsschluss erfolgt über einen EVB-IT Cloud-Vertrag. Die Beschaffung erfolgt durch den Auftraggeber zur Nutzung durch alle Landkreise und kreisfreien Städte in Thüringen. Die Verwendung der IT-Anwendung für die vorgenannten Zwecke ist für die Landkreisen und kreisfreien Städten verpflichtend. Den Jägern ist die Verwendung dagegen freigestellt. Das bedeutet, diese können von der Verwendung der IT-Anwendung absehen. Das bisherige analoge System zur Probenahme wird vorerst parallel weitergeführt. Die 21 Veterinär- und Lebensmittelüberwachungsämter der 22 Landkreise und kreisfreien Städte im Freistaat Thüringen sind unter anderem zuständig für die Entgegennahme und Untersuchung von Proben geschlachteter oder erlegter Tiere, die für den Verzehr durch den Menschen vorgesehen sind, auf Trichinella spp. Darüber hinaus bestehen Zuständigkeiten im Hinblick auf die Erlaubniserteilung zur Entnahme von Proben, die zur Untersuchung auf Trichinen vorgesehen sind, durch verwaltungsexterne Personen. Den Bürgerinnen und Bürgern, die die vorgenannten Verwaltungsleistungen in Anspruch nehmen möchten, soll ermöglicht werden, die erforderlichen Antragsdaten nach den Grundsätzen des Online-Zugangsgesetzes (OZG) digital zu erfassen, den Antrag papierlos dem jeweils zuständigen Veterinär- und Lebensmittelüberwachungsamt zu übermitteln und die Bescheide der zuständigen Behörden zu empfangen. Zudem soll die Möglichkeit geschaffen werden, weiteren Berichtspflichten (z. B. die Erfassung der Jagdstrecken durch Jägerinnen und Jäger) in digitaler Form nachzukommen. Die Untersuchung von Wildschweinen auf Trichinella spp. erfolgt nur dann, wenn das Tier zu einem Lebensmittel werden soll. Dies führt nach den bisherigen Erfahrungen pro Jahr zur Untersuchung von bis zu 30.000 Stück Schwarzwild in Thüringen. Diese Zahlen schwanken. Darüber hinaus sind die Behörden der Veterinärüberwachung für die Umsetzung eines regelmäßigen Monitorings von erlegten Wildtieren auf bestimmte Tierseuchenerreger verantwortlich. In Abhängigkeit vom aktuellen tierseuchenrechtlichen Status variiert die Probenzahl voraussichtlich zwischen ca. 5.000 und 30.000 Proben im Jahr. Die Datenerfassung und Antragsstellung sowie der Empfang der Bescheide sollen hier ebenso für die jeweils betroffenen Bürgerinnen und Bürger ermöglicht werden. Die erfassten Daten sollen über die Anwendung an das für die Untersuchung der Proben zuständige Landesamt für Verbraucherschutz übermittelt werden. result.text: DESCRIPTION OF THE SUBJECT The subject of the procurement currently being prepared is a company, credit and control information retrieval service for the use of Valtiokonttori. Valtiokonttori is an agency under the Ministry of Finance (VM), which is responsible for state debt management, investment and financial services, as well as the administration and supervision of state loans, guarantees, warranties and interest subsidies. In addition, it handles the state's central accounting and the preparation of financial statements, as well as compensation and benefit matters. Valtiokonttori maintains a financial information repository for municipalities and wellbeing services counties, produces analysis and reporting services for the state administration, manages the EU's Recovery and Resilience Facility, and maintains an electronic procurement notification system. Valtiokonttori manages loans, interest subsidies and state guarantees and warranties granted by the state. Up-to-date company, credit and control information is needed daily, e.g. in making payment and grant decisions and in risk management. The goal of Valtiokonttori is to renew the currently used - company and credit information retrieval service - control service - integration into the Microsoft Dynamics CRM system The service has approximately 40 users, of which 2 users act as main users. The subject of the procurement possibly also includes a sanctions list retrieval service. parts.source: KOHTEEN KUVAUS Valmisteilla olevan hankinnan kohteena on yritys-, luotto- ja valvomotietohakupalvelu Valtiokonttorin käyttöön. Valtiokonttori on valtiovarainministeriön (VM) hallinnon alainen virasto, joka vastaa valtion velanhoito-, sijoitus- ja rahoituspalveluista sekä valtion lainojen, takausten, takuiden ja korkotukien hallinnoinnista ja valvonnasta. Lisäksi se hoitaa valtion keskuskirjanpidon ja tilinpäätöksen valmistelun sekä vahingonkorvaus- ja etuusasiat. Valtiokonttori ylläpitää kuntien ja hyvinvointialueiden taloustietovarantoa, tuottaa valtionhallinnon analysointi- ja raportointipalveluja, hallinnoi EU:n elpymis- ja palautumistukivälinettä sekä ylläpitää sähköistä hankintailmoitusjärjestelmää Valtiokonttori hallinnoi valtion myöntämiä lainoja, korkotukia ja valtiontakauksia sekä -takuita. Ajantasaista yritys-, luotto-, ja valvomotietoa tarvitaan päivittäin mm. maksatus- ja avustuspäätösten teossa sekä riskienhallinnassa. Valtiokonttorin tavoite on uusia nykyisin käytössä olevan kaltaiset - yritys- ja luottotietohakupalvelu - valvomopalvelu - integraatio Microsoft Dynamics CRM järjestelmään Palvelulla on noin 40 käyttäjää, joista pääkäyttäjinä toimii 2 käyttäjää. Hankinnan kohteeseen sisältyy mahdollisesti myös pakotelistahakupalvelu. YLEISTÄ Huomioittehan, että kyseessä on ennakkoilmoitus (jäljempänä ilmoitus) eikä tällä ilmoituksella pyydetä vielä tarjouksia. Pyydämme tarjoamisesta kiinnostuneita yrityksiä ilmoittautumaan kilpailutusta koskevaan markkinavuoropuheluun. Ilmoittautumalla markkinavuoropuheluun tarjoamisesta kiinnostuneilla yrityksillä on mahdollisuus käydä hankintaa koskevaa vuoropuhelua hankintayksikön kanssa. Markkinavuoropuheluun osallistuminen tai osallistumatta jättäminen ei estä mahdolliseen hankintamenettelyyn osallistumista. Ilmoitus ei velvoita hankintayksikköä toteuttamaan varsinaista hankintamenettelyä. Kaikki tässä ilmoituksessa esitetyt tiedot ovat alustavia ja suuntaa-antavia ennakkotietoja. Tämä ilmoitus ei sido hankintayksikköä minkäänlaiseen ratkaisuun. Hansel Oy on tässä kilpailutuksessa konsultatiivisessa roolissa. MARKKINAVUOROPUHELU Markkinavuoropuhelu on tarkoitettu tarjoamisesta kiinnostuneille yrityksille ja se sisältää tarjouspyyntömateriaaliluonnosten kommentointia ennen lopullisen tarjouspyynnön julkaisua. result.text: The MSHIP Program is an initiative by TransnetBW aimed at supporting Germany's energy transition by developing a sustainable, scalable, and efficient grid management system. It focuses on modularity, automation, and simplicity to enhance operational security and reduce costs. The architecture is based on a self-hosted, cloud-native platform specifically designed for secure and data-driven operations. The MSHIP - LFC ensures continuous monitoring of the power balance and thus a stable energy supply. The controller detects deviations in the power balance or frequency and activates the appropriate secondary control power providers on a price-based basis to stabilize the balance and thus also the frequency. In addition, a controller is to be developed for special emergency situations in which no conventional control power market environment is available. The purpose of this RFI is to identify potential providers and solutions that can meet the requirements of the MSHIP - LFC. The RFI is intended to provide an initial market overview and to evaluate possible technological approaches and their ability to integrate into the existing MSHIP architecture. The aim is not to commit to a specific system, an architecture or provider in advance. Openness to different approaches remains the main guiding principle. The information gathered will serve as a basis for future decisions and possible tenders. Participation in this market exploration will not result in any advantages or disadvantages for the participants as potential bidders in a future - not yet binding - tender procedure. Please note that also responses are invited and will be considered that do not cover all listed functionalities.

result.text: This is an invitation/request for information for a market dialogue (not a prior information notice, contract notice or call for tenders). No tenders are submitted in response to the request for information; instead, by registering for the market dialogue, entities indicate their willingness to participate in the preparation of the procurement. SUBJECT: Kela is planning a competitive tendering process for a centralised printing and inserting line concerning A4 sheet printers and related software, peripherals, maintenance services, supplies and printing paper. The market dialogue will survey market solutions as well as technical and functional implementation alternatives, particularly regarding printing and software solutions. The procurement will replace the printing line reaching the end of its lifecycle with new A4 sheet printers suitable for continuous and heavy-duty use. The scope also includes print management software, a delivery and commissioning project, training as well as other services and supplies that ensure the uninterrupted continuation of letter production in Kela's production environment. Currently, the printing line processes over 20 million A4 sheets and several million letters annually. In addition, the procurement includes an inserting machine modification project and its maintenance services. In the inserting machine modification project, the inserting machine will be modified to receive finished A4 sheet stacks, or it can be replaced entirely with another device. Subdomains of the market dialogue: 1) A4 printers, software and maintenance services – Printing devices and related software – Maintenance and support services – Necessary peripherals and supplies 2) Inserting machine modification project and maintenance service – Inserting machine modification work – Device maintenance and support 3) Paper suppliers – Printing paper supply package Suppliers may register for one or more subdomains according to their offering. General material common to the dialogue will be provided to all participants. In addition, separate subdomain-specific questions and materials will be targeted to each subdomain. This ensures that operators can provide relevant and expert feedback regarding their specific subdomain. During the dialogue, subdomains may also be merged if necessary for the procurement. MARKET DIALOGUE: The aim of the market dialogue is to form as comprehensive a picture as possible of the solutions offered by the market and to ensure that the requirements of the tendering process are appropriate, feasible and treat the market equally. During the dialogue, participants are asked to, among other things: - present the offering available on the market - answer questions concerning the procurement - comment on preliminary minimum requirements, for example regarding conflicts of interest - present potential development proposals to improve the solution and the tendering process. The dialogue will be carried out in a versatile manner: partly through in-person meetings in Jyväskylä, partly by email and, if necessary, via remote connection using Kela's Microsoft Teams. The material related to the market dialogue is in Finnish. The market dialogue will be conducted principally in the Finnish language; if necessary, the dialogue can also be conducted partially in English. The contracting authority has no obligation to translate documents or other material related to the market dialogue unless the contracting authority specifically decides otherwise. A party participating in the market dialogue is responsible for obtaining any translations it needs and for their accuracy at its own expense. Preliminary schedule of the dialogue: - Familiarisation with the offering, defining the subject, familiarising with the subject: Until June 2026 - Finalisation of the call for tenders: July-September 2026 The schedule and the alignment of phases will be reviewed in more detail with tenderers during the dialogue. Participation: Interested participants are requested to declare their willingness to participate in the market survey by email to it.tarjouskilpailut@kela.fi by 25.3.2026. Example of message content: Message subject: Company xx participation in xxx market dialogue Message: It is advisable for the message to indicate the supplier's name, business ID and contact person through whom the dialogue will be conducted, as well as the subdomain being participated in. Confidential material may be handled during the dialogue and, consequently, all persons handling confidential material, location data and other confidential information must sign a non-disclosure agreement. Persons participating in the handling can be added during the dialogue if necessary. Kela will send the non-disclosure agreements electronically to the designated handlers for signature before handling begins. Other: The request for information does not oblige the contracting authority to carry out the actual procurement or to implement the procurement in the manner described in the request for information. The contracting authority is not obliged to take into account the responses received to the request for information when drawing up the call for tenders and the contract template. No compensation is paid to those who responded to the request for information for responding to it. Answering the request for information does not bind the supplier to participate in the tender contest, nor is it a prerequisite for participating in the actual tender contest later. Answering or failing to answer the request for information does not affect the tenderer's position in the actual tender contest. parts.source: Kyseessä on kutsu/tietopyyntö markkinavuoropuheluun (ei ennakkoilmoitus, hankintailmoitus tai tarjouspyyntö). Tietopyyntöön ei anneta tarjouksia vaan ilmoittautumalla markkinavuoropuheluun ilmoitetaan halukkuudesta osallistua hankinnan valmisteluun. KOHDE: Kela suunnittelee keskitetyn tulostus- ja kuorituslinjan kilpailutusta koskien A4-arkkitulostimia sekä niihin liittyviä ohjelmistoja, lisälaitteita, huoltopalveluja, tarvikkeita ja tulostuspaperia. Markkinavuoropuhelussa kartoitetaan markkinoiden ratkaisuja sekä teknisiä ja toiminnallisia toteutusvaihtoehtoja erityisesti tulostus- ja ohjelmistoratkaisujen osalta. Hankinnalla korvataan elinkaarensa päähän tuleva tulostuslinja uusilla, jatkuvaan ja kuormitettuun käyttöön soveltuvilla A4‐arkkitulostimilla. Kokonaisuuteen sisältyvät myös tulostuksenhallintaohjelmisto, toimitus- ja käyttöönottoprojekti, koulutus sekä muut palvelut ja tarvikkeet, jotka varmistavat kirjetuotannon häiriöttömän jatkumisen Kelan tuotantoympäristössä. Tällä hetkellä tulostuslinjalla käsitellään vuosittain yli 20 miljoonaa A4‐arkkia ja useita miljoonia kirjeitä. Lisäksi hankintaan sisältyy kuorituslaitteen muutosprojekti sekä sen huoltopalvelut. Kuorituslaitteen muutosprojektissa kuorituslaite muutetaan vastaanottamaan valmiita A4-arkkipinoja tai se voidaan korvata kokonaan toisella laitteella. Markkinavuoropuhelun osa-alueet: 1) A4-tulostimet, ohjelmistot ja huoltopalvelut – Tulostuslaitteet ja niihin liittyvät ohjelmistot – Huolto- ja ylläpitopalvelut – Tarvittavat lisälaitteet ja tarvikkeet 2) Kuorituslaitteen muutosprojekti ja huoltopalvelu – Kuorituslaitteen muutostyöt – Laitteen huolto ja ylläpito 3) Paperitoimittajat – Tulostuspaperin toimituskokonaisuus Toimittajat voivat ilmoittautua yhteen tai useampaan osa-alueeseen oman tarjontansa mukaan. Kaikille osallistujille toimitetaan vuoropuhelun yhteinen yleismateriaali. Sen lisäksi kullekin osa-alueelle kohdennetaan erilliset, osa-aluekohtaiset kysymykset ja materiaalit. Näin varmistetaan, että toimijat voivat antaa hankinnan kannalta olennaista ja asiantuntevaa palautetta juuri omaan osa-alueeseensa liittyen. Vuoropuhelun aikana voidaan myös tarpeen vaatiessa yhdistää osa-alueita, jos hankinta niin tarvitsee. MARKKINAVUOROPUHELU: Markkinavuoropuhelun tavoitteena on muodostaa mahdollisimman kattava kuva markkinoiden tarjoamista ratkaisuista ja varmistaa, että kilpailutuksen vaatimukset ovat tarkoituksenmukaisia, toteuttamiskelpoisia ja markkinoita tasapuolisesti kohtelevia. Vuoropuhelun aikana osallistujia pyydetään mm.: - esittelemään markkinoilla saatavilla olevaa tarjontaa - vastaamaan hankintaa koskeviin kysymyksiin - kommentoimaan alustavia vähimmäisvaatimuksia, esimerkiksi esteellisyyteen liittyen - esittämään mahdollisia kehitysehdotuksia ratkaisun ja kilpailutuksen parantamiseksi. Vuoropuhelu toteutetaan monimuotoisesti: osin lähitapaamisina Jyväskylässä, osin sähköpostitse ja tarvittaessa Kelan Microsoft Teamsin kautta etäyhteydellä. Markkinavuoropuheluun liittyvä materiaali on suomenkielistä. Markkinavuoropuhelu käydään pääsääntöisesti suomen kielellä; tarvittaessa vuoropuhelua voidaan käydä osittain myös englannin kielellä. Hankintayksiköllä ei ole velvollisuutta kääntää markkinavuoropuheluun liittyviä asiakirjoja tai muuta materiaalia, ellei hankintayksikkö nimenomaisesti päätä toisin. Markkinavuoropuheluun osallistuva taho vastaa itse tarvitsemiensa käännösten hankkimisesta sekä niiden oikeellisuudesta omalla kustannuksellaan. Vuoropuhelun alustava aikataulu: - Tutustuminen tarjontaan, kohteen määrittelyä, kohteeseen tutustumista: Kesäkuuhun 2026 asti - Tarjouspyynnön viimeistelyä: Heinäkuu-Syyskuu 2026 Tarkemmin aikataulua ja vaiheiden kohdistusta tarkastellaan tarjoajien kanssa vuoropuhelun aikana. Osallistuminen: Kiinnostuneita osallistujia pyydetään ilmoittamaan halukkuutensa osallistua markkinakartoitukseen sähköpostitse osoitteeseen it.tarjouskilpailut@kela.fi 25.3.2026 mennessä. Esimerkki viestin sisällöstä: Viestin otsikko: Yrityksen xx osallistuminen xxx markkinavuoropuheluun Viesti: Viestistä on hyvä käydä ilmi toimittajan nimi, y-tunnus ja yhteyshenkilö, jonka kautta vuoropuhelu käydään sekä osa-alue johon osallistutaan. Vuoropuhelussa saatetaan käsitellään salassa pidettävää aineistoa ja tästä johtuen kaikkien salassa pidettävään materiaaliin, sijaintitietoon ja muuta salassa pidettävää tietoa käsittelevien henkilöjen tulee allekirjoittaa vaitiolositoumus. Vuoropuhelun aikana käsittelyyn osallistuvia henkilöjä voidaan lisätä tarvittaessa. Kela lähettää vaitiolositoumukset allekirjoitettavaksi ilmoitetuille käsittelijöille sähköisesti ennen käsittelyn alkamista. Muuta: Tietopyyntö ei velvoita hankintayksikköä suorittamaan varsinaista hankintaa tai toteuttamaan hankintaa tietopyynnössä kuvatulla tavalla. Hankintayksikkö ei ole velvollinen ottamaan huomioon tietopyyntöön saatuja vastauksia tarjouspyynnön ja sopimuspohjan laadinnassa. Tietopyyntöön vastanneille ei makseta korvausta tietopyyntöön vastaamisesta. Tietopyyntöön vastaaminen ei sido toimittajaa tarjouskilpailuun osallistumiseen, eikä myöskään ole edellytyksenä myöhemmin varsinaiseen tarjouskilpailuun osallistumiselle. Tietopyyntöön vastaaminen tai vastaamatta jättäminen ei vaikuta tarjoajan asemaan varsinaisessa tarjouskilpailussa. Tietopyynnöllä saatuja tietoja käsitellään luottamuksellisesti.
