result.text: This document is not a procurement notice or invitation to tender, but a request for information. The Urban Environment Division of the City of Helsinki (hereinafter referred to as the contracting authority) is preparing the procurement of an application for infrastructure construction supervision and situational awareness. The objective of the procurement is to acquire and implement an infrastructure construction monitoring system that enables the management of infrastructure project contracts in field conditions using modern digital tools. The subject of the procurement is a monitoring system in which project-related data, documents, communication and monitoring take place centrally through a single system. The system will improve the situational awareness of contracts and information flow between different stakeholders, speed up reactions to identified shortcomings and reduce the nuisance caused to city residents by infrastructure projects. This is a new procurement and currently the City of Helsinki does not have a system intended for the management and monitoring of the implementation phase of infrastructure construction contracts. Currently, project-related data is scattered across different systems, operating models vary by contract and contractor, a large proportion of communication takes place by email, and entries related to contract management processes, such as reporting, site diaries and handling of shortcomings, are made manually and on paper. The Urban Environment Division has previously piloted and test-used digital tools intended for the management of infrastructure sites, and based on these, significant benefits have been observed, especially in the preparation of inspection reports and the sharing of information between various parties. The infrastructure construction monitoring system, which is the subject of the procurement, will be acquired as a ready-made software as a service (SaaS), including software licences, support and maintenance services, complementary expert services related to the software service including product consulting, customer-specific minor development and training services, as well as implementation in the contracting authority's operating environment. The implementation includes necessary definitions, configurations, development and integration measures, testing and user training. The objective is that the acquired system will be put into use in all new infrastructure construction contracts and selected ongoing projects based on project-specific assessment. The objective of the procurement is that the acquired monitoring system has been put into use by the end of June 2026. Further information on the subject of the procurement is described in the document Description of the subject of the procurement. The purpose of this request for information is to survey the market regarding the services in question and to obtain information concerning the procurement so that the procurement can be carried out appropriately. The contracting authority does not commit to carrying out this procurement. This is an enquiry/request for information concerning a planned procurement. We kindly ask you to notify us if, in your view, the response contains trade secrets or other confidential information. We kindly ask you to specify and clearly mark this information. Documents containing potential confidential information can be delivered securely via secure email at https://securemail.hel.fi Responses provided in the request for information are not binding on the supplier, and responding is not a prerequisite for participation in the subsequent actual tendering procedure. Responding or not responding to the request for information does not affect a potential supplier's position in the actual tendering procedure. No compensation is paid for responding to the request for information. We kindly ask you to answer the questions presented in the request for information Forms survey and the request for information attachment List of Requirements as comprehensively as possible. Responses are requested to be written in the fields provided alongside the questions. Responses (completed list of requirements) are requested to be returned by 17.11.2025 at 16.15 by email to kymp.icthankinnat@hel.fi The email subject line must be marked "Infrarakentamisen valvonnan ja tilannekuvan sovelluksen hankinta, vastaukset tietopyyntöön". Responses to the request for information Forms form are requested to be submitted by 17.11.2025 at 16.15 Link: https://forms.office.com/e/m2RFGkJH98

parts.source: Tämä asiakirja ei ole hankintailmoitus tai tarjouspyyntö vaan tietopyyntö. Helsingin kaupungin Kaupunkiympäristön toimiala (jäljempänä tilaaja) on valmistelemassa Infrarakentamisen valvonnan ja tilannekuvan sovelluksen hankintaa. Hankinnan tavoitteena on hankkia ja ottaa käyttöön infrarakentamisen seurantajärjestelmä, joka mahdollistaa infrahankkeiden urakoiden hallinnan kenttäolosuhteissä nykyaikaisilla, digitaalisilla työkaluilla. Hankinnan kohteena on seurantajärjestelmä, jossa urakkaan liittyvät tiedot, dokumentit, viestintä ja seuranta tapahtuvat keskitetysti yhden järjestelmän kautta. Järjestelmän avulla parannetaan urakoiden tilannekuvaa ja tiedonkulkua eri sidosryhmien välillä, nopeutetaan havaittuihin puutteisiin reagoimista ja vähennetään infrahankkeista kaupunkilaisille aiheutuvia haittoja. Kyseessä on uusi hankinta ja nykytilassa Helsingin kaupungilla ei ole käytössään infrarakennuttamisen urakoiden toteutusvaiheen hallintaan ja seurantaan tarkoitettua järjestelmää. Tällä hetkellä urakoihin liittyvät tiedot sijaitsevat hajallaan eri järjestelmissä, toimintamallit vaihtelevat urakoittain ja urakoitsijoittain, suuri osa viestinnästä tapahtuu sähköpostitse ja urakoiden hallintaprosesseihin, kuten raportointiin, työmaapäiväkirjoihin ja puutteiden käsittelyyn liittyvät kirjaukset tehdään manuaalisesti ja paperipohjaisesti. Kaupunkiympäristön toimiala on aiemmin pilotoinut ja koekäyttänyt infratyömaiden hallintaan tarkoitettuja digitaalisia työkaluja, ja näiden perusteella on havaittu merkittäviä hyötyjä erityisesti katselmusraporttien laadinnassa ja tiedon jakamisessa eri osapuolten kesken. Hankinnan kohteena oleva infrarakentamisen seurantajärjestelmä hankitaan valmiina ohjelmistopalveluna (SaaS) sisältäen ohjelmistojen käyttöoikeudet, tuki- ja ylläpitopalvelun, täydentävät ohjelmistopalveluun liittyvät asiantuntijapalvelut sisältäen tuotekonsultoinnin, asiakaskohtaisen pienkehittämisen sekä koulutuspalvelut sekä käyttöönotto Tilaajan toimintaympäristössä. Käyttöönotto sisältää tarvittavat määrittelyt, konfiguroinnit, kehittämis- ja integraatiotoimenpiteet, testauksen sekä käyttäjäkoulutukset. Tavoitteena on, että hankittava järjestelmä otetaan käyttöön kaikissa uusissa infrarakennuttamisen urakoissa sekä valituissa käynnissä olevissa hankkeissa hankekohtaisen harkinnan perusteella. Hankinnan tavoitteena on, että hankittava seurantajärjestelmä on otettu käyttöön kesäkuun 2026 loppuun mennessä. Lisätietoa hankinnan kohteesta kuvattu dokumentissa Hankinnan kohteen kuvaus. Tässä tietopyynnössä on tarkoitus selvittää markkinoita kyseisten palveluiden osalta ja saada hankintaa koskevaa tietoa, jotta hankinta voidaan toteuttaa tarkoituksenmukaisesti. Hankintayksikkö ei sitoudu toteuttamaan tätä hankintaa. Tämä on kysely/tietopyyntö liittyen suunnitelmissa olevaan hankintaan. Pyydämme ilmoittamaan, mikäli vastaus näkemyksenne mukaan sisältää liikesalaisuuksia tai muuta salassa pidettävää tietoa. Pyydämme yksilöimään ja merkitsemään nämä tiedot selvästi. Tietopyyntöön vastaaminen tai vastaamatta jättäminen ei vaikuta mahdollisen toimittajan asemaan varsinaisessa tarjouskilpailussa. Tietopyyntöön vastaamisesta ei makseta korvausta. result.text: The Department for Work and Pensions introduced the Crisis and Resilience Fund from 1 April 2026. The Fund provides local authorities with funding to support households experiencing financial hardship or an unexpected financial shock and to help residents build longer-term financial resilience. Southwark Council is developing a hub-and-spoke model to support the delivery of the Resilience Services and Community Coordination elements of the Fund. The Council is considering commissioning a Hub Delivery Organisation (HDO) to provide a central and accessible route into financial-resilience support for Southwark residents. The Council will retain responsibility for administering Council-managed crisis and housing-related payments, determining eligibility, making formal decisions on applications for financial assistance and submitting formal management-information returns to the Department for Work and Pensions. Further information about the emerging HDO service model, the areas being considered, local delivery and accessibility, case management, reporting, and the indicative contract value and duration is set out in the accompanying Draft Service Specification. The final scope and delivery model have not been determined. Therefore, the Council is carry out a Preliminary Market Engagement (PME) where respondents are invited to use the information provided via the portal, see engagement process description further down in this notice. Respondents are requested to use both documents when completing the questionnaire and should clearly state any assumptions made in their responses. Lot 1: . None

result.text: Durham County Council Pension Fund (the Fund) is exploring the market for a modern, secure and fully integrated Local Government Pension Scheme (LGPS) administration solution to support the delivery of pension services to members and participating employers. The Fund is seeking to understand the capabilities currently available within the market and how technology can support the administration of the LGPS, improve member and employer engagement, increase automation, enhance data quality and ensure ongoing compliance with legislative and regulatory requirements. This Preliminary Market Engagement exercise is intended to inform the Fund's future procurement strategy and help shape detailed requirements for any subsequent procurement exercise. Suppliers are invited to provide information on their solutions, implementation approaches, innovation, product roadmaps and experience within the LGPS sector. Interested providers can access the written response questions, free of charge, by registering on the Open Portal at www.open-uk.org The deadline for completed responses is Friday 2nd October 2026 at 12 noon. Lot 1: .

result.text: Carmarthenshire County Council is undertaking an Early Market Engagement exercise to better understand the care rostering, scheduling and workforce management solutions currently available within the market. The Council currently utilises a rostering and scheduling solution across its Residential and Domiciliary Care Services and wishes to engage with suppliers to understand available products, functionality, market developments and delivery models that may support future service requirements. This exercise is intended to inform future planning and does not represent a commitment to undertake a procurement process. The Council is particularly interested in solutions that support: • Domiciliary Care scheduling and visit management. • Residential Care rostering and workforce management. • Workforce resource teams and shared staffing models. • Mobile working for frontline care staff. • Leave, absence and availability management. • Skills, compliance and workforce competency management. • Payroll, travel and workforce payment processes. • Reporting, operational oversight and management information. • Continuity of care and workforce utilisation. • Integration with care management, HR, payroll, finance and identity management systems. The Council intends to provide a high-level requirements document to interested suppliers and may invite suppliers to demonstrate how their solution supports the functional areas identified. Participation in this engagement is for information and planning purposes only and does not commit the Council to any procurement or award. All interested parties are encouraged to register their interest by 22/09/26 to participate in the demonstration sessions which we are planning to hold in October. Details of any formal tender will be provided in due course. Lot 1: . None

result.text: The purpose of the contract is the provision of technical assistance and management services for the Technical Support Office for European Projects (OATPE) of the Provincial Council of Valencia. These services include specialised technical assistance and consultancy for the municipalities of the province, the Provincial Council of Valencia itself, as well as any public law entity in which a municipality participates where its role is relevant (hereinafter "key agents"). The projected contract is a service contract for the management and execution of a technical office dependent on the Provincial Council of Valencia, which will cover its need to assist and advise on the search, acquisition, and management of EU funds for local entities, promote the transfer of knowledge linked to European projects among technicians and elected officials of the province of Valencia, enable the submission of European projects in which the Provincial Council of Valencia is a partner or associate partner to the European Union, and bring Europe and funding programmes closer to and disseminate them to the local administration. The specialised technical assistance and consultancy service that is the subject of this contract will be carried out by the contractor from its own offices/facilities (by telephone, electronically, by email, and/or through the website of the Provincial Council of Valencia), and any member of the assigned technical team must also travel to the municipalities and territories that so require, as well as to the premises of the Provincial Council of Valencia.

parts.source: El contrato tiene por objeto la prestación del servicio de asistencia técnica y gestión de la Oficina de Ayuda Técnica para Proyectos Europeos (OATPE) de la Diputación de Valencia. Dichos servicios de asistencia técnica especializada y consultoría para los municipios de la provincia, la propia Diputación de Valencia, así como cualquier entidad de derecho público en la que participe un municipio donde su papel sea relevante (en adelante “agentes clave”). El contrato proyectado es un contrato de servicios para la gestión y ejecución de una oficina técnica dependiente de la Diputación de Valencia que cubrirá la necesidad que tiene la misma para asistir y asesorar en la búsqueda, captación y gestión de fondos comunitarios para entidades locales, promover la transferencia de conocimientos vinculados a los proyectos europeos entre los técnicos y cargos electos de la provincia de Valencia, posibilitar la presentación de proyectos europeos en el que la Diputación de Valencia sea socio, o socio asociado, a la Unión Europea, y acercar y difundir Europa y los programas de financiación a la administración local. El servicio de asistencia técnica especializada y consultoría objeto del presente contrato será realizado por el adjudicatario desde sus propias oficinas/ instalaciones (telefónico, telemático, por correo electrónico y/o a través de la web de la Diputación de Valencia) debiendo también desplazarse cualquier miembro del equipo técnico adscrito, tanto a los municipios y territorios que así lo requieran, como a las dependencias de la Diputación Provincial de Valencia.

result.text: The subject matter of this contract is the provision and subsequent support of the technological solution required by the Assembly of Madrid to have backups of its information systems in "Backup as a service" (hereinafter BaaS) mode, under the terms detailed in these Particular Technical Specifications. . rejected.text: TÄMÄ EI OLE HANKINTAILMOITUS TAI TARJOUSPYYNTÖ VAAN TIETOPYYNTÖ MARKKINAKARTOITUSTA JA TEKNISTÄ VUOROPUHELUA VARTEN: Tämän tietopyynnön avulla kartoitetaan markkinoita ja saadaan hankintaa koskevaa tietoa. Hankintayksikkö ei aloita tarjouskilpailua Tietopyynnön julkaisulla, vaan mahdollinen hankintailmoitus ja tarjouspyyntö julkaistaan myöhemmin. Tietopyyntö ei velvoita hankintayksikköä toteuttamaan varsinaista hankintaa. Tietopyyntöön vastaaminen ei ole edellytys myöhempään mahdollisesti järjestettävään tarjouskilpailuun osallistumiselle. Toimittajille ei makseta korvausta tietopyyntöön vastaamisesta, markkinavuoropuheluun tai toimittajatapaamisiin osallistumisesta. Tähän tietopyyntöön annettuja vastauksia käytetään suunniteltaessa kuljetusrobottien hankintaa. HUSin tarkoituksena on hankkia oheisessa liitteessä kuvatun laajuinen kuljetusrobottien kokonaisuus palveluineen. Tietopyynnön tarkoituksena on selvittää markkinatilannetta. Tarkoituksena on selvittää tekniset ratkaisut, järjestelmän tyypilliset keskeiset ominaisuudet ja hinnoitteluperiaatteet. HUS on kiinnostunut myös SOTE-referenssikohteista sekä toteuttamistanne ratkaisuista, joissa on toimitettu ja otettu käyttöön kuljetusrobotteja. HUS on kiinnostunut tämän toiminta-alueen ratkaisuvaihtoehdoista ja toivoo saavansa tekstimuotoisia kuvauksia ratkaisuistanne sekä vastauksia kysymyksiinsä. Lisäksi järjestetään toimittajavuopuhelutapaamiset halukkaiden toimittajien kanssa. HUS pyytää kiinnostuneita toimittajia: 1. Ilmoittautumaan määräaikaan mennessä toimittajavuoropuhelutapaamisiin, jotka järjestetään viikolla 6-7. Tapaamisia järjestetään yksi kunkin toimittajan kanssa. Ilmoittautumisen yhteydessä tulee kuvata perusteet, miten toimittaja täyttää edellytyksen osallistua toimittajavuoropuheluun. Toimittajavuoropuheluihin pyydetään toimittajia tuomaan oman kuljetusrobottinsa esittelyyn ja testattavaksi HUSin tiloihin (aikataulu ja osoite ilmoitetaan erikseen). Tämä ei kuitenkaan ole pakollista, vaan toimittajavuoropuheluun voi osallistua ilman robottiakin. Jotta toimittaja voi osallistua toimittajavuoropuhelutapaamisiin vähimmäisvaatimuksena on, että mobiilirobotti pystyy kuljettamaan ruokavaunuja. Toimittajavuorotapaamisiin otetaan maksimissaan viisi (5) tarjoajaa. Mikäli toimittajia olisi enemmän, otetaan mukaan ensisijaisesti ne viisi toimittajaa, joilla on kokemusta vähintään yhdestä toimitetusta kuljetusrobotista, joka on ollut EU/ETA-alueella käytössä asiakkaalla sairaalassa, terveydenhuollon tai sosiaalihuollon toimipisteessä vähintään kuuden kuukauden ajan. 2. Kommentoimaan tämän tietopyynnön liitteinä olevia asiakirjoja määräaikaan mennessä. Ks. myös liitteessä 1 ’’Hankinnan kuvaus’’ olevat kysymykset, joihin HUS pyytää vastaamaan. Ilmoittautumisen ja kommentoimisen määräajat: 1. HUS pyytää halukkaita ilmoittautumaan toimittajavuoropuhelutapaamisiin viimeistään 19.1.2026 klo 14.00 mennessä. 2. HUS pyytää kommentoimaan tietopyynnön liitteenä olevia asiakirjoja ja vastaamaan kysymyksiin 30.1.2026 klo 14.00 mennessä. Pyydämme teitä lähettämään vastauksenne ja ilmoittautumisenne liittyen tietopyyntöön sähköpostitse osoitteeseen susanna.pirila@kpmg.fi. Viestin aiheeksi maininta "HUS KULJETUSROBOTIT". result.text: The UK Government's Partnering for Accelerated Climate Transitions (UK PACT) programme is inviting proposals from qualified suppliers or consortia to deliver technical assistance to the government of Bangladesh. Bangladesh is establishing the foundations for participation in high-integrity carbon markets, including Article 6, CORSIA and voluntary carbon markets. While progress has been made through the establishment of a carbon market framework and supporting governance arrangements, further support is needed to operationalise these systems across government, strengthen institutional coordination, and enable Bangladesh to use carbon markets to support delivery of its NDC 3.0 unconditional mitigation targets. The assignment will provide targeted technical assistance and capacity building to strengthen Bangladesh's carbon market governance, authorisation processes, MRV, reporting and institutional readiness. Working with relevant government agencies, including MoEFCC, DoE, the Power Division, Ministry of Finance and other line ministries, the project will support practical implementation of carbon market rules, CORSIA readiness, UNFCCC reporting requirements, and inclusive, high-integrity market participation. Key outputs are expected to include governance and coordination tools, an authorisation and safeguards toolkit, CORSIA readiness and reporting support, a structured government capacity-building programme, and sector readiness briefs identifying future carbon market investment opportunities. The project aims to strengthen Bangladesh's ability to participate in high-integrity carbon markets, unlock climate finance, improve institutional capability, and support implementation of national climate targets. Interested suppliers are invited to review the documentation provided in this notice, and submit their applications to: targetedfund@ukpact.co.uk

result.text: The subject of the BR quotation study is the collection of data on the use and evaluation of BR services on radio, television and various digital platforms (BR's own platforms web/app, ARD Mediathek, ARD Sounds and other podcast platforms, YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, Twitch, Snapchat) among the Bavarian and German population. In order to be able to make statements both for BR services for a Bavarian audience and for BR services with a supra-regional focus (services in Das Erste, ARD Mediathek and ARD Sounds; various digital services), three survey waves per year are to be conducted, comprising one Bavaria-wide and one nationwide survey in each case. The contract begins on 01.01.2027 and has a term of 12 months until 31.12.2027 (= basic term). This contract shall automatically extend after the expiry of the basic term by up to three times for 12 months each time, unless either party terminates this contract in writing 4 months prior to expiry. The aim is to collect quantitative (awareness, reach, target group exhaustion) and qualitative key performance indicators (overall rating, missing, public value) for Bayerischer Rundfunk's services, in particular also for those that cannot be evaluated, or can only be evaluated in part, via the currency studies in the audio and video market.

parts.source: Gegenstand der BR-Angebotsstudie ist die Erhebung von Daten zu Nutzung und Bewertung von BR-Angeboten im Radio, Fernsehen und auf unterschiedlichen digitalen Plattformen (BR eigene Plattformen Web/App, ARD-Mediathek, ARD-Sounds und andere Podcast-Plattformen, YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, Tiktok, Twitch, Snapchat) in der bayerischen und deutschen Bevölkerung. Um sowohl für BR-Angebote für ein bayerisches Publikum als auch für BR-Angebote mit überregionalem Fokus (Angebote in Das Erste, ARD-Mediathek und ARD-Sounds; verschiedene Digitalangebote) Aussagen treffen zu können, soll in drei Erhebungswellen pro Jahr jeweils eine bayernweite und eine deutschlandweite Erhebung durchgeführt werden. Der Vertrag beginnt am 01.01.2027 und hat eine Laufzeit von 12 Monaten bis zum 31.12.2027.(=Grundlaufzeit). Dieser Vertrag verlängert sich nach Ablauf der Grundlaufzeit automatisch bis zu drei Mal um jeweils 12 Monate, wenn keine der beiden Parteien diesen Vertrag 4 Monate vor Ablauf schriftlich kündigt. Ziel ist die Erhebung quantitativer (Bekanntheit, Reichweiten, Zielgruppenausschöpfung) und qualitativer Kennzahlen (Globalurteil, Vermissen, Public Value) für die Angebote des Bayerischen Rundfunks, insbesondere auch für jene, die über die Währungsstudien im Audio- und Video-Markt nicht oder nur in Teilen auswertbar sind.

result.text: PSD Scotland intends to procure a Service Integration and Management contract for the transition, stabilisation and continued delivery of selected national digital services supporting health and care across Scotland. The successful supplier will act as prime contractor and provide a single point of accountability for end-to-end service delivery, integration and performance. The supplier will also be responsible for the management of any subcontractors and dependencies with other providers and Authority teams. The initial priority will be to maintain continuity and stabilise these business-critical services as they transition away from the existing National IT Contract, while establishing a strong foundation for subsequent improvement and modernisation. Lot 1: . PSD Scotland intends to procure a Service Integration and Management contract for selected national digital services supporting clinical, operational and administrative functions across NHS Scotland. The procurement will establish replacement arrangements for services currently delivered under the National IT Contract, which is due to expire on 31 March 2028. The principal objective is to maintain uninterrupted delivery of these business-critical services throughout transition and thereafter. The anticipated scope includes services and applications supporting Primary and Community Care, National Screening and Child Health, together with other services confirmed in the procurement documents. Depending on the requirements of each service, the contract may include application support, maintenance and development, as well as the associated infrastructure, platform, integrations and data services. IT Service Management capabilities are also required for end-to-end operation. The detailed application scope, service boundaries and allocation of responsibilities will be defined in the tender documentation. The successful supplier will act as the prime contractor, providing a single point of accountability for the contract. The supplier will be expected to coordinate its subcontractors and work effectively with the Authority’s retained teams and other internal and external providers. Service continuity will take precedence during the initial transition, followed by stabilisation to address supportability, resilience, cyber security, regulatory compliance and technical-debt risks. result.text: Open procedure, pursuant to Article 71 of Legislative Decree No 36/2023, for the award of development, maintenance and management services for the information system of Fondimpresa (FPF System). A contract concerning the following activities shall be concluded with the successful tenderer of this procedure: i) Software development and enhancement (MEV) ii) Corrective and adaptive maintenance (MAC/MAD) iii) Housing, operation and hardware/software maintenance iv) Helpdesk (hereinafter also referred to solely as "Service" or "Services"), as better defined, described and set out in the technical specification attached to the tender specifications. A handover period with the new successful tenderer taking over at the end of the contract must be guaranteed, lasting at least 2 (two) months. Regarding the procedures for executing the contractual relationship, please refer to the provisions in paragraph 9 of the technical specification, without prejudice to compliance with the service levels referred to in paragraph 10 of the technical specification, failing which the penalties established therein shall apply. In order to outline the background context, notwithstanding what is better established in the technical specification, it is specified that Fondimpresa has acquired an information system (named "FPF System") for managing the training plans of the Training Account and the System Account, for communication between Fondimpresa, its regional offices and the member companies, for acquiring and managing membership data and contributions transmitted by INPS, as well as monitoring information to be sent periodically to the Ministry of Labour and Social Policies and for registering state aid with the RNA. The development of the Fund's activities, the diversification of training financing measures made available to member companies (via public notices), the increase in financing granted and the number of training plans managed, the steady growth in memberships and the evolution of monitoring specifications required by the guidance and supervisory authority, entail the need to guarantee: • evolutionary maintenance (MEV) of the FPF system; • corrective and adaptive maintenance (MAC/MAD) of the FPF system; • management of housing and operation services with particular attention to system monitoring activities and security aspect verification (penetration tests, vulnerability assessments, etc.); • management of the first and second-level helpdesk service; • the development of new document flow management features with a view to continuous and progressive paperless operation of the Fund's activities; • the integration of new tools based on artificial intelligence to automate and optimise human operational workflows; • architectural developments and hardware/software infrastructure modernisation interventions to ensure appropriate levels of security, efficiency and service continuity; • application support for the disaster recovery system. The currently estimated user base is approximately 280.000 users against approximately 210.000 contributing positions affiliated with Fondimpresa. The contract shall have a duration of 60 natural and consecutive months, commencing from the start date of activities determined by the date of a specific record of commencement of activities. For all services described in the preceding article, no interfering risks are identifiable for which specific safety measures need to be adopted and, therefore, the preparation of the DUVRI is not required (pursuant to Article 26, paragraph 3-bis, of Legislative Decree No 81/2008). Consequently, there are no safety costs of an interfering nature, which are therefore quantified as € 0,00. Since the tender procedure has as its object services of an intellectual nature (as these primarily concern software development and the elaboration of customised solutions, functional analysis and governance of system evolution), tenderers are not required to indicate, pursuant to Article 108, paragraph 9, of the Code, the amount of labour costs and company costs for fulfilling provisions regarding health and safety in the workplace. Please refer to the Tender Specifications and its attached technical specification for tender particulars. The contract consists of a single lot as it is characterised by the functional unity of the service. Therefore, it is considered appropriate, both from the perspective of economic efficiency and optimal service execution, not to proceed with a division into lots. In any event, the tenderer's future bid shall be understood to refer overall to the entirety of the services forming the subject matter of the tender.

parts.source: Procedura aperta, ai sensi dell’art. 71 del D.Lgs. n. 36/2023, per l’affidamento dei servizi di sviluppo, manutenzione e gestione del sistema informativo di Fondimpresa (Sistema FPF) Con l’aggiudicatario della presente procedura verrà stipulato un Contratto avente ad oggetto le seguenti attività:i) Sviluppo software e MEV ii) Manutenzione Correttiva e Adeguativa (MAC/MAD) iii) Housing, conduzione e manutenzione HW/SW iv) Helpdesk (nel seguito anche solo “Servizio” o “Servizi”), così come meglio definiti, descritti ed articolati nel Capitolato tecnico allegato al Disciplinare di gara.Deve essere garantito un periodo di affiancamento al nuovo aggiudicatario che subentrerà a fine contratto, della durata di almeno di 2 (due) mesi. Per le modalità di svolgimento del rapporto contrattuale si veda quanto stabilito al paragrafo 9 del Capitolato tecnico, fermo restando il rispetto dei Livelli di servizio di cui al paragrafo 10 del Capitolato tecnico, pena l’applicazione delle penali ivi stabilite. Al fine di rappresentare il contesto di riferimento, fermo quanto meglio stabilito nel Capitolato tecnico, si precisa che Fondimpresa si è dotata di un Sistema Informativo (denominato “Sistema FPF”) per la gestione dei Piani formativi del Conto Formazione e del Conto di Sistema, per la comunicazione fra Fondimpresa, le proprie Articolazioni Territoriali e le aziende aderenti, per l'acquisizione e la gestione dei dati delle adesioni e dei contributi trasmessi dall'INPS, nonché delle informazioni di monitoraggio da inviare periodicamente al Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali e per la registrazione degli aiuti di stato presso l’RNA. Lo sviluppo delle attività del Fondo, la diversificazione delle misure di finanziamento della formazione messe a disposizione delle aziende aderenti (tramite avvisi pubblici), l'incremento dei finanziamenti concessi e del numero di Piani formativi gestiti, la crescita costante delle adesioni e l'evoluzione delle specifiche di monitoraggio richieste dall'Autorità di indirizzo e vigilanza, comportano la necessità di garantire: • la manutenzione evolutiva (MEV) del sistema FPF; • la manutenzione correttiva e adeguativa (MAC/MAD) del sistema FPF; • la gestione dei servizi di Housing e conduzione con particolare attenzione alle attività di monitoraggio dei sistemi e di verifica degli aspetti di sicurezza (penetration test, vulnerability assessment ecc.); • la gestione del servizio di Helpdesk di primo e secondo livello. • lo sviluppo di nuove funzionalità di gestione dei flussi documentali in ottica di una continua e progressiva attività di dematerializzazione delle attività del Fondo; • l’integrazione di nuovi strumenti basati sull’intelligenza artificiale per automatizzare e ottimizzare i flussi operativi umani; • le evoluzioni architetturali e interventi di modernizzazione dell’infrastruttura hardware/software per garantire idonei livelli di sicurezza, efficienza e continuità del servizio; • il supporto applicativo per il sistema di Disaster Recovery. La platea di utenti ad oggi stimata è di circa 280.000 utenti a fronte di circa 210.000 posizioni contributive aderenti a Fondimpresa.L’appalto avrà una durata di 60 mesi naturali e consecutivi, con decorrenza della data di inizio delle attività determinata dalla data di un apposito verbale di avvio delle attività. Per tutti i servizi descritti nel precedente articolo non sono rilevabili rischi interferenti per i quali sia necessario adottare specifiche misure di sicurezza e, pertanto, non risulta necessaria la predisposizione del DUVRI (ex art. 26, comma 3-bis, D.Lgs. n. 81/2008). Non sussistono, di conseguenza, costi della sicurezza di natura interferenziale che sono pertanto quantificati in € 0,00.Poiché la procedura di gara ha ad oggetto servizi di natura intellettuale (in quanto trattasi prevalentemente di sviluppo software ed elaborazione di soluzioni personalizzate, di analisi funzionali e governo dell’evoluzione del sistema), non viene richiesto ai concorrenti di indicare, ai sensi dell’art. 108, comma 9, del Codice, l’ammontare dei costi della manodopera e degli oneri aziendali per l’adempimento delle disposizioni in materia di salute e sicurezza sui luoghi di lavoro.Si rinvia al Disciplinare di Gara e al suo Capitolato tecnico allegato per le specifiche di gara.L’appalto è costituito da un unico lotto poiché è caratterizzato da unitarietà funzionale del servizio. Pertanto, si ritiene opportuno, sia sotto il profilo della convenienza economica sia sotto il profilo dell’ottimale esecuzione del servizio, non procedere alla suddivisione in lotti. In ogni caso la futura offerta del concorrente si intenderà riferita complessivamente alla globalità delle prestazioni oggetto di gara.

result.text: I. Solution regarding User and Access Management for the Capital Region of Denmark. The contracting authority is tendering a contract for a solution for User and Access Management for the future Capital Region of Denmark. At the time of tender, the contracting authority has different solutions in the Capital Region of Denmark and Region Zealand respectively. In connection with the establishment of the Capital Region of Denmark, the contracting authority requires a new standardised Identity Governance & Administration solution (hereinafter referred to as the solution). The solution is to be used across the contracting authority's organisation, platforms and systems. The solution must ensure that the contracting authority achieves standardised, automated and secure administration of and control over access to systems and data, as well as system support for management oversight, control of employee access, and other user- and access-management-related tasks. The solution must furthermore ensure mobility and flexibility for employees and effectively support organisational changes. The delivery and solution must support the contracting authority in achieving the following benefits: creating unique identities for all employees regardless of form of employment, replacing current solutions with 1 solution, ensuring 60% of all system access takes place via automated processes based on data standardization, and enabling the same ordering process to be used for all manually assigned system access. The solution must be delivered as a cloud-based service hosted by the supplier in a data centre. II. Main services: 1) The delivery. The delivery of the IGA solution is expected to consist of 3 partial deliveries, A-C. In partial delivery A, the supplier must establish the foundation of the solution, establish basic functionality, connect the solution to source data (including HR data systems), assist with data migration, and onboard technical applications (such as AD, ServiceNow, CyberArk, Beyond-Trust, Imprivata and EntraID). In addition, the supplier must assist the contracting authority with planning, designing business roles, developing integration concepts, and establishing the necessary processes for efficient onboarding of user systems (such as the health platform, diagnostic systems, administrative systems, etc.). The supplier must also assist the contracting authority with test activities, as well as training of the contracting authority's employees, partly in the use of the solution and partly in order to enable the contracting authority's employees to a large extent to carry out the onboarding of user systems themselves, including the establishment of the contracting authority's internal operational processes. Partial delivery B) The supplier must assist with the onboarding of the contracting authority's business-critical systems (including the health platform and central diagnostic systems), test activities, continued training of the contracting authority's employees, and the establishment of extended functionality (such as management oversight & delegation). Partial delivery C) The supplier must assist with the onboarding of a group of selected user systems with a focus on ensuring that all integration concepts have been tested. In addition, the supplier must continue to assist with test activities and final training of the contracting authority's employees so that they can stand on their own two feet. 2B) Ongoing services: The supplier must deliver the necessary software and be responsible for hosting, operation, support and maintenance of both standard software and any customer-specific software. The supplier must ensure efficient, secure and stable operation of the solution while complying with service targets for factors such as availability and response time. The supplier must make a professional IT Service Management function available to ensure that the supplier, in cooperation with the customer, can effectively handle incidents and other operational and business-continuity-oriented situations. 3) Ordering services: The supplier must continuously deliver consultancy services as needed, including ongoing support for the onboarding of user systems after the delivery has been completed, as well as any adaptations of the solution, such as connectors. In addition, the supplier must continuously provide training of the contracting authority's employees as needed.

parts.source: I. Løsning vedr. Bruger- og Adgangsstyring til Region Østdanmark. Ordregiver udbyder en kontrakt vedr. en løsning til Bruger- og Adgangsstyring til den fremtidige Region Østdanmark. På udbudstidspunktet har Ordregiver forskellige løsninger i hhv. Region Hovedstaden og Region Sjælland. I forbindelse med etableringen af Region Østdanmark har Ordregiver behov for en ny standardiseret Identity Governance & Administration-løsning (herefter benævnt løsningen). Løsningen skal anvendes på tværs af Ordregivers organisation, platforme og systemer. Løsningen skal sikre at Ordregiver opnår en standardiseret, automatiseret og sikker administration af og kontrol med adgange til systemer og data, samt systemunderstøttelse af ledelsestilsyn, kontrol med medarbejdernes adgange samt øvrige bruger- og adgangsstyringsrelaterede opgaver . Løsningen skal endvidere sikre mobilitet og fleksibilitet for med-arbejdere og effektivt understøtte organisationsændringer. Leverancen og løsningen skal understøtte Ordregiver i at opnå følgende gevinster: at få skabt unikke identiteter for alle med-arbejdere uanset ansættelsesform, at de nuværende løsninger erstattes med 1 løsning, at 60% af alle systemadgange sker via automatiserede processer på baggrund af datastandardisering, samt at der kan anvendes samme bestillingsproces for alle manuelt tildelte systemadgange. Løsningen skal leveres som en cloud-baseret tjeneste hostet af Leverandøren i et datacenter. II. Hovedydelser: 1) Leverancen. Levering af IGA-løsningen består forventeligt af 3 delleverancer, A-C. I delleverance A skal Leverandøren etablere løsningens fundament, etablere grundlæggende funktionalitet, forbinde løsningen til fødekildedata (herunder HR data-systemer), bistå med datamigrering samt onboarde tekniske applikationer (såsom AD, ServiceNow, CyberArk, Beyond-Trust, Imprivata og EntraID). Derudover skal Leverandøren bistå Ordregiver med planlægning, med at designe forretningsroller, udvikle integrationskoncepter, samt etablere de nødvendige processer for effektiv onboarding af anvendersystemer (såsom sundhedsplatfor-men, diagnostiske systemer, administrative systemer etc.). Leverandøren skal desuden bistå Ordregiver med testaktiviteter, samt uddannelse af Ordregivers medarbejdere, dels i anvendelsen af løsningen og dels i forhold til at gøre Ordregivers medarbejdere i stand til i vidt omfang selv at foretage onboarding af anvendersystemer, herunder opbygning af Ordregivers interne driftsprocesser. Delleverance B) Leverandøren skal bistå med onboarding af Ordregivers forretningskritiske systemer (herunder Sundhedsplatformen og centrale diagnostiske systemer), testaktiviteter, fortsat oplæring af Ordregivers medarbejdere samt etablering af udvidet funktionalitet (såsom ledelsestilsyn & delegering). Delleverance C) Leverandøren skal bistå med onboarding af en gruppe udvalgte anvender-systemer med fokus på at sikre at samtlige integrationskoncepter er afprøvet. Derudover skal Leverandøren fortsat bistå med testaktiviteter samt afsluttende oplæring af Ordregivers medarbejdere til at stå på egne ben. 2B) Løbende ydelser: Leverandøren skal levere den nødvendige software samt stå for hosting, drift, support og vedligeholdelse af såvel standardprogrammel samt evt. kundespecifikt programmel. Leverandøren skal sikre effektiv, sikker og stabil drift af løsningen under overholdelse af servicemål til bl.a. tilgængelighed og reaktionstid. Leverandøren skal stille en professionel lT Service Management funktion til rådighed, som sikrer at leverandøren i samarbejde med kunden effektivt kan håndtere incidents og øvrige drifts- og business con-tinuity orienterede situationer. 3) Bestillingsydelser: Leverandøren skal løbende levere konsulentydelser efter behov, bl.a. til fortsat støtte til onboarding af anvendersystemer efter Leverancen er gennemført, samt til evt. tilpasninger af løsningen, som f.eks. connectorer. Derudover skal Leverandøren løbende levere undervisning af Ordregivers medarbejdere efter behov.

result.text: Welcome to the Dynamic Purchasing System (DPS) for Expertise for the Control Room of the Future program and adjacent subjects. Note: This Dynamic Purchasing System is a continuation on the Mercell platform of the DPS that was previously operational on the Negometrix platform with Negometrix reference 159478 for which formal notice 2021/S 087-226573 was published on 5-May-2021 on the TED website. If your company was already qualified for participation on the Negometrix platform, a simplified procedure applies for re-establishing your qualification, see question 2.1 on the Mercell platform. TenneT will renew and innovate the (IT) systems that it uses for controlling and balancing its grids in the period 2021-2031. In connection with this, TenneT expects to be needing extensive external expertise, related to existing and new technologies and ways of working, in particular related to the challenges that TenneT faces in the energy transition. Compared to current ways of working, innovations will be needed to handle e.g. the increasing infeed of solar and wind energy that is far more difficult to predict and control than traditional generation. The subject of this tender procedure is a Dynamic Purchasing System (DPS) for expertise (including the development of algorithms and IT Tools) that TenneT needs in connection with the renewal of its (IT) systems related to the control and balancing of the electricity transmission grid. Initially, the DPS contains the following categories of expertise: 1. power system control and monitoring; 2. energy platforms and interconnected IT systems; 3. data analysis, artificial intelligence and machine learning; 4. system and process implementation. This Tender Dossier contains the rules for the Application by Economic operators for qualification under this DPS. In order to become qualified for one or more of the categories, the Economic operator has to fulfil all the requirements of this DPS. In addition, the Economic operator needs to the answer all Mercell questions, and submit the requested documents and-or evidence at the respective Mercell question with the submission of its Application. During the course of time, the specific assignments (contracts) under the DPS will be tendered for which all suppliers that have qualified for the particular category will be invited to submit an offer. Any interested supplier may at any moment during the lifetime of the DPS submit a request to be qualified for participating in the tender procedures for specific assignments within one or more of the categories of this DPS. Your request will be accepted if it satisfies the applicable requirements and if you accept the stated conditions. Once you have qualified, you will automatically receive a notification when TenneT publishes a request for proposal for a specific subject within a category for which you have qualified. TenneT emphasises that it would also like to attract small and medium sized companies to this DPS. Qualification requests will be processed by TenneT in the sequence of receipt. TenneT will inform you as soon as possible and endeavors to do so within 10 working days from the date of receipt about the acceptance or rejection of your qualification request. During the lifetime of the DPS, TenneT will be entitled to add new categories, to close existing categories, and to split-up existing categories in to one or more categories.

result.text: 1. Contracting Authority The EWE Group, headquartered in Oldenburg, is one of the large regional energy supply companies in Germany. EWE is active in various business areas, including energy (gas/electricity), telecommunications, information technology, mobility and hydrogen. With over 10.000 employees and a turnover of around 8,7 billion euros in the 2024 financial year, EWE is one of the significant players in the German energy industry. EWE pursues a clear strategy towards a sustainable, innovative and future-oriented energy supply - including through projects in the field of wind energy and the hydrogen economy. The EWE Group is predominantly in municipal hands and supplies around one million households in the electricity segment alone. 2. Subject of the tender The EWE Group as the contracting authority (CA) intends to procure a software solution for Business Process Management (BPM) that meets the company's specific professional and technical requirements. The subject of the tender is the acquisition, implementation and operation of BPM software, including initial user training and the migration of existing data and process models from the legacy system to the new system. The software should enable intuitive modelling of processes - with a focus on Business Process Model and Notation (BPMN). For this purpose, user-friendly drag-and-drop editors are required for the simple creation, adaptation and maintenance of process models. In addition, the following functionalities are required: - Independently configurable workflows, e.g. for the approval of process models - Extensive commenting and collaboration options for all user groups - Versioning of process models and the possibility to manage several variants of a process - Comprehensive reporting and analysis functions Also desired are: - A flexibly configurable authorisation and role concept - Interfaces to other IT systems to support import and export processes, in particular: * Import of data from IT systems (e.g. organisational units) * Export of data to third-party systems, such as analysis platforms like SAP Datasphere, Snowflake or Azure OneLake

parts.source: 1. Auftraggeber Der EWE-Konzern mit Hauptsitz in Oldenburg zählt zu den großen regionalen Energieversorgungsunternehmen in Deutschland. EWE ist in verschiedenen Geschäftsfeldern tätig, darunter Energie (Gas/Strom), Telekommunikation, Informationstechnologie, Mobilität und Wasserstoff. Mit über 10.000 Mitarbeitenden und einem Umsatz von rund 8,7 Milliarden Euro im Geschäftsjahr 2024 gehört EWE zu den bedeutenden Akteuren der deutschen Energiewirtschaft. EWE verfolgt eine klare Strategie hin zu einer nachhaltigen, innovativen und zukunftsorientierten Energieversorgung - unter anderem durch Projekte im Bereich Windenergie und Wasserstoffwirtschaft. Der EWE-Konzern befindet sich überwiegend in kommunaler Hand und versorgt allein im Stromsegment rund eine Million Haushalte. 2. Gegenstand der Ausschreibung Der EWE-Konzern als Auftraggeber (AG) beabsichtigt, für das Business Process Management (BPM) eine Softwarelösung zu beschaffen, die den spezifischen fachlichen und technischen Anforderungen des Unternehmens entspricht. Gegenstand der Ausschreibung sind der Erwerb, die Einführung und der Betrieb einer BPM-Software einschließlich der initialen Schulung der Anwenderinnen und Anwender sowie der Migration bestehender Daten- und Prozessmodelle vom Altsystem in das neue System. Die Software soll eine intuitive Modellierung von Prozessen ermöglichen - mit Schwerpunkt auf der Business Process Model and Notation (BPMN). Hierfür sind benutzerfreundliche Drag-and-drop-Editoren zur einfachen Erstellung, Anpassung und Pflege von Prozessmodellen erforderlich. Darüber hinaus werden folgende Funktionalitäten gefordert: - Eigenständig konfigurierbare Workflows, z. B. zur Freigabe von Prozessmodellen - Umfangreiche Kommentierungs- und Kollaborationsmöglichkeiten für alle Benutzergruppen - Versionierung von Prozessmodellen und die Möglichkeit, mehrere Varianten eines Prozesses zu verwalten - Umfassende Reporting- und Analysefunktionen Erwünscht sind zudem: - Ein flexibel konfigurierbares Berechtigungs- und Rollenkonzept - Schnittstellen zu anderen IT-Systemen zur Unterstützung von Import- und Exportprozessen, insbesondere: * Import von Daten aus IT-Systemen (z. B. Organisationseinheiten) * Export von Daten in Drittsysteme, etwa in Analyseplattformen wie SAP Datasphere, Snowflake oder Azure OneLake

result.text: The implementation and management of a self-examination system in two booths for the professional qualification test for VTC vehicle drivers, guaranteeing: • The identity and traceability of the candidate. • The individual execution of the test without assistance. • The periodic availability of the tests according to demand. The purpose of the contract is the procurement of the complete service which contemplates the creation, installation, development, implementation, configuration, maintenance, technical support and training of an comprehensive service that allows the Community of Madrid to have a complete technological solution for carrying out self-examinations comprising the tests for the exercise of the profession of driver of hire vehicles with driver (VTC) in the Community of Madrid. Project scope: The scope of the project consists of the provision of an comprehensive service, managed by a single contact person, which covers all the phases necessary to comply with the technical and functional requirements and compliance with the service levels described in this document. This service must contemplate the implementation and commissioning of the examination booths comprising the following work: 1. Analysis, construction, implementation, commissioning and supervision of the service. It will carry out the definition of processes and functional specifications, current situation analysis, functional design, documentation of requirements and modules, detailed technical design, system development, implementation, stabilization, knowledge management and supervision of the examination service. 2. Preventive Maintenance: Continuous improvement of the system through testing, updates and improvement proposals. Corrective: Resolution of functional and technical incidents, performance optimization and continuous support. Evolutionary: Incorporation of functional and technical improvements requested by managers. 3. Training Training plan and transfer of technical and functional knowledge for personnel of the Directorate General for Transport and Mobility and Madrid Digital. Includes personalized courses, pre-commissioning training, subsequent updates and annual refreshers. 4. Support and Incident Management Support service after entry into production, without changes in functionality. Resolution times and incident types (blocking, intermediate, low) are defined. Detailed resolution reports are generated.

result.text: Die Landesmesse Stuttgart GmbH & Co. KG (LMS) is advertising services of an external Information Security Officer (ISO). The LMS intends to commission services of an external Information Security Officer (ISO) in order to improve the level of security comprehensively and sustainably. The implementation of an internationally recognised standard for information security management systems is envisaged. The security level of the LMS is intended to be aligned with ISO 27001. Certification is not currently planned, but could become relevant from a perspective standpoint (e.g. due to customer requirements). The external Information Security Officer shall be assigned the following tasks in particular: - Development and implementation of security strategies: Creation of security concepts, policies and guidelines tailored to the specific needs of the LMS. This includes the further development of the Information Security Management System (ISMS). - Risk management: Implementation and continuous updating of risk analyses and business impact analyses (BIA) to identify and assess potential threats. - Reporting: Establishment of reporting processes as well as regular evaluation and presentation of security-related information to the specialist departments and management. - Continuous monitoring: Monitoring the effectiveness of the implemented security measures and, as required, adjustment of the implemented measures. - Compliance with statutory requirements: Ensuring that the LMS complies with all relevant laws, regulations and industry standards in the field of information security. - Security incidents: Investigation, processing and risk assessment of security incidents incl. taking measures for damage limitation - Collaboration: Close cooperation with the internal "Information Security Manager" as well as the other specialist departments (especially IT) as well as the Security Operations Center (SOC), the Data Protection Officer and management - Internal and external audits: Support in preparation for internal and external audits on information security - Technical security measures: Involvement in the conception, evaluation and decision on the introduction or modernisation of technologies (e.g. new EDR solution, network segmentation), which is why corresponding IT and IT security architecture know-how should be available with the contractor. The contractor does not have to be responsible for the decisions, but must be able to advise accordingly in the sense of an advisory function in accordance with their role. The subject matter of the procedure is now the Europe-wide procurement of services of an external Information Security Officer (ISO) by means of a negotiated procedure with a preceding call for competition. Further information on the content of the tender will be made available to the bidders who are invited to submit tenders. The services are to be awarded for a period of 24 months (2 years), provisionally commencing on 1 April 2026.

parts.source: Die Landesmesse Stuttgart GmbH & Co. KG (LMS) schreibt Leistungen eines externen Informationssicherheitsbeauftragten (ISB) aus. Die LMS beabsichtigt, Leistungen eines externen Informationssicherheitsbeauftragten (ISB) zu beauftragen, um das Sicherheitsniveau ganzheitlich und nachhaltig zu verbessern. Angedacht ist die Umsetzung eines international anerkannten Standards für Informationssicherheits-Managementsysteme. Das Sicherheitsniveau der LMS soll sich hierbei an der ISO 27001 anlehnen. Eine Zertifizierung ist aktuell nicht geplant, könnte aber perspektivisch relevant werden (z.B. aufgrund Kundenanforderungen). Folgende Aufgaben werden dem externen Informationssicherheitsbeauftragten insbesondere übertragen: - Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Sicherheitsstrategien: Erstellung von Sicherheitskonzepten, Policys Leitlinien, die auf die spezifischen Bedürfnisse der LMS zugeschnitten sind. Hierzu gehört die Weiterentwicklung des Informations-Sicherheits-Management-Systems (ISMS). - Risikomanagement: Durchführung und kontinuierliche Aktualisierung von Risikoanalysen und Business Impact Analysen (BIA) zur Identifikation und Bewertung potenzieller Gefährdungen. - Berichtswesen: Aufbau von Reporting-Prozessen sowie regelmäßige Auswertung und Präsentation sicherheitsrelevanter Informationen gegenüber den Fachbereichen und der Geschäftsführung. - Kontinuierliche Überwachung: Überwachung der Wirksamkeit der implementierten Sicherheitsmaßnahmen sowie bedarfsweise Anpassung der umgesetzten Maßnahmen. - Einhaltung gesetzlicher Anforderungen: Sicherstellung, dass die LMS alle relevanten Gesetze, Vorschriften und Industriestandards im Bereich Informationssicherheit einhält. - Sicherheitsvorfälle: Untersuchung, Bearbeitung und Risikobewertung von Sicherheitsvorfällen inkl. Ergreifen von Maßnahmen zur Schadensbegrenzung - Zusammenarbeit: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem internen "Manager Informationssicherheit" sowie den anderen Fachbereichen (insbesondere IT) sowie dem Security Operations Center (SOC), dem Datenschutzbeauftragten und der Geschäftsführung - Interne und externe Audits: Unterstützung bei der Vorbereitung auf interne und externe Audits zur Informationssicherheit - Technische Sicherheitsmaßnahmen: Einbindung in Konzeption, Bewertung und Entscheidung zur Einführung oder Modernisierung von Technologien (z.B. neue EDR-Lösung, Netzwerk-Segmentierung), weshalb entsprechendes IT- und IT-Sicherheits-Architektur Know-how beim Auftragnehmer vorhanden sein sollte. Der Auftragnehmer muss die Entscheidungen nicht verantworten, aber entsprechend im Sinne einer Advisory Funktion gemäß seiner Rolle beraten können. Gegenstand des Verfahrens ist nun die europaweite Vergabe von Leistungen eines externen Informationssicherheitsbeauftragten (ISB) im Wege eines Verhandlungsverfahrens mit vorgeschaltetem Teilnahmewettbewerb. Nähere Informationen zum Inhalt der Ausschreibung werden den Bietern zur Verfügung gestellt, die zur Angebotsabgabe aufgefordert werden. Die Leistungen sollen für einen Zeitraum von 24 Monaten (2 Jahre) vergeben werden, voraussichtlich beginnend am 1. April 2026.

result.text: The subject of this tender is the procurement of a highly available virtualization platform including the required hardware, software licences, manufacturer support and services to replace or modernise the existing virtualization infrastructure of the Gemeinschaftsklinikum Mittelrhein. The new solution must ensure the operation of currently around 300 virtual machines in an active-active data centre architecture and provide the essential functions of the existing VMware vSphere Enterprise Plus / VMware Cloud Foundation environment with functional equivalence. These include in particular high availability, automated load balancing, live migration of virtual machines, cross-location operation and central administration. The tender is designed to be open to all manufacturers and technologies. Solutions based on alternative virtualization platforms as well as concepts in which VMware continues to be used can be offered. The solution offered must meet the functional, technical and economic requirements defined in the tender documents. Bidders must submit an architecture and migration concept that provides either for the continued use of the existing Dell VxRail hardware or its complete replacement. The use of hyperconverged as well as classical 3-tier architectures is permitted. The use of VMware vSAN is not a prerequisite. The scope of services also includes the provision of all required hardware and software components, the integration of the existing Veeam Backup & Replication environment using agentless backup procedures, the implementation including knowledge transfer as well as support for the migration of all virtual machines. The existing VMware subscription ends on 30.03.2027. The solution offered must therefore be fully operational, migrated and accepted, including all productive workloads, by 15.03.2027 at the latest. The period between 15.03.2027 and the expiry of the existing VMware licensing serves as a risk buffer and stabilization phase. Lot LOT-0001: Renewal of virtualization environment. The detailed description of the procurement is described in the specification of services.

parts.source: Gegenstand dieser Ausschreibung ist die Beschaffung einer hochverfügbaren Virtualisierungsplattform einschließlich erforderlicher Hardware, Softwarelizenzen, Herstellersupport und Dienstleistungen zur Ablösung bzw. Modernisierung der bestehenden Virtualisierungsinfrastruktur des Gemeinschaftsklinikums Mittelrhein. Die neue Lösung muss den Betrieb von derzeit rund 300 virtuellen Maschinen in einer Active-Active-Rechenzentrumsarchitektur gewährleisten und die wesentlichen Funktionen der bestehenden VMware vSphere Enterprise Plus / VMware Cloud Foundation Umgebung funktional gleichwertig bereitstellen. Hierzu zählen insbesondere Hochverfügbarkeit, automatisierte Lastverteilung, Live-Migration virtueller Maschinen, standortübergreifender Betrieb sowie zentrale Administration. Die Ausschreibung ist hersteller- und technologieoffen gestaltet. Angeboten werden können sowohl Lösungen auf Basis alternativer Virtualisierungsplattformen als auch Konzepte, bei denen VMware weiterhin eingesetzt wird. Die angebotene Lösung muss die in den Vergabeunterlagen definierten funktionalen, technischen und wirtschaftlichen Anforderungen erfüllen. Die Bieter haben ein Architektur- und Migrationskonzept vorzulegen, das entweder die Weiterverwendung der bestehenden Dell-VxRail-Hardware oder deren vollständigen Austausch vorsieht. Der Einsatz hyperkonvergenter sowie klassischer 3-Tier-Architekturen ist zulässig. Eine Nutzung von VMware vSAN wird nicht vorausgesetzt. result.text: A standalone, cloud-based Data Governance and Data Intelligence platform that enables the Council to discover, index, catalogue and classify data held across its systems and data sources. The solution will provide improved visibility and understanding of organisational data, including metadata, data ownership, sensitivity and classification, supporting effective data governance, security, compliance and the responsible use of data. Lot 1: . Clackmannanshire Council seeks to procure a cloud-based Data Governance Platform and associated services to provide enterprise-wide visibility, classification, and lifecycle management of information assets across its digital estate. The solution must be capable of securely connecting to and analysing data held across multiple systems, including on-premise shared drives, Microsoft 365 (SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, and Outlook), legacy platforms such as Lotus Notes, and key line-of-business systems. It will be required to discover, index, and catalogue both structured and unstructured data, identify sensitive information (including personally identifiable information), and support the application of retention and disposal policies. The platform must also enhance the Authority’s ability to respond to statutory information requests by enabling efficient search, retrieval, review, redaction, and export of relevant data. In addition, it should provide risk insight, reporting, and automation capabilities to support ongoing data governance, reduce redundant and over-retained data, and improve compliance A detailed summary of requirements is included within the attached document

The contracting authority will later provide the registered suppliers with a draft contract for comment. This request for information is implemented as a technical dialogue. 3 OTHER MATTERS TO BE NOTED The request for information is not a contract notice, a call for tenders or an invitation to tender. Responding to the request for information does not bind the respondent or the contracting authority to a subsequent procurement procedure. The contracting authority will utilise the received responses in the planning of a possible future procurement and in the preparation of the call for tenders. It is good to note that this request for information does not oblige Istekki Oy to carry out the procurement in the manner presented in this document or its appendices. result.text: The Scottish Government is pursuing a comprehensive programme to reform and modernise Scotland’s compulsory purchase system. Lot 1: . The overall aim of this research is to provide information about the compensation received by those whose land is acquired under compulsory purchase powers. The evidence generated through the research is intended to inform decisions on potential future legislation by the Scottish Government and scrutiny of any such legislation by the Scottish Parliament. The objectives of the project are to address the following questions: a. How frequently and to what extent are compensation payments affected by the prospect of future planning permission (“hope value”)? b. In cases where hope value is a factor, to what extent are payments affected by the timing, costs and risks of implementing any such prospective planning permission? c. To what extent does the current condition of property affect the market value calculated for the purpose of compensation?

result.text: DCMS is seeking to commission a two-phase research project to investigate UK media consumption habits and public trust in media. Phase 1 would consist of a behavioural cohort study (or another appropriate methodology) to map the specific "user pathways" audiences take to find, consume, and value information across different media sources, such as traditional news broadcasts and social media, across different demographics. Building on these findings, Phase 2 would explore how individuals perceive trust in different media sources due to their own perception of mis/disinformation, assess the broader effects of these consumption pathways on factors such as viewer retention and wider social cohesion, as well as overall integrity of the UK's information ecosystem. This project will be commissioned either through a Competitive Flexible Procedure under the Procurement Act 2023, or through the RM6126 Research and Insights framework. This is part of the DCMS Science and Analysis R&D Programme, which supports R&D capability within the department. This project will run concurrently alongside three other large projects across 2027-2030; these include 'what works' research into AI adoption in DCMS sectors; a continuation of previous research to develop data-intensive approaches for capturing engagement at unticketed cultural, heritage, and sporting events/activities/locations, e.g. using mobile app data to model how people participate in our events; and a continuation of previous research to design and improve methods for holistically tracking the long-term impact of major events, tested on a major event. Lot 1: .

result.text: Dumfries & Galloway Council are seeking a suitably qualified and experienced organisation ideally with an engineering background to undertake a comprehensive crane condition / reliability survey. Dumfries and Galloway Council operate a Mechanical Biological Waste Treatment facility located in Dumfries. The plant operates with 2 overhead gantry cranes which are used to lift and transfer waste around the fully automated waste treatment facility which has been in situ since 2006. The completed survey is intended to inform the Council of the cranes current condition, any immediate remedial action necessary and set out the requirements for future annual maintenance and servicing. Lot 1: . Dumfries and Galloway Council operate a Mechanical Biological Waste Treatment facility located in Dumfries. Construction on the site started in 2004 and was completed in 2006. The plant operates with 2 overhead gantry cranes which are used to lift and transfer waste around the fully automated waste treatment facility The plant was designed and constructed by Italian company Systema Ecodeco and operates with 2 Demag waste handling cranes, overhead electric top-running crane with a single hoist trolley unit. Technical specification document can be provided, however, overview of the cranes is: Manufacturing year 2006 Date of commissioning 2006 Serial number GS1442 & GS1443 Customer’s crane identification CP1 & CP2 Rated load 6.3 t Span 20.05 m Length of the runway ?? m Lifting height 11.8 m Type of the crane - Double girder EOT with one trolley Location in the customer’s process - Waste Hall Type of control - Automated Operating method - VFD Hoist - VFD Trolley - VFD Bridge Weights Trolley weight - 4.0 t No. of trolleys -1 Bridge weight - 20.0 t Non-fixed LLA weight - 0 t Fixed LLA weight - 3.5 t Design standards, classifications and speeds Crane structures - FEM 1.001 -1987 Trolley structures - A8 Movements - A8 Hoisting - 30 m/min / 1.0 m/min – M8 Trolley - 70 m/min / 1.0 m/min – M8 Bridge - 120 m/min / 1.0 m/min – M7 We are seeking to engage with a suitably qualified engineering company to undertake a comprehensive crane reliability study for both cranes currently in operation. The scope of works should include, but not be limited to, the following: - Internal endoscopic inspection and vibration analysis of the hoist gearboxes. - Vibration analysis of the rope drum, trolley wheels, hoist motor, trolley motor/gearbox, bridge motors/gearboxes and bridge wheels to determine the level of internal component degradation. - Measurement of the bridge and trolley wheels and compare to OEM specification. - Insulation and winding resistance measurements on all motors. - Rope drum inspection using specialist tools to measure the amount of wear present in the contact surfaces. - Disassembly, thorough cleaning and measurement of the internal components of the hoist, trolley and bridge brake units and compare to OEM specification. - General crane control panel electrical component condition analysis to include thorough examination of the trolley festoon mechanics, power and control flatform cables and hoist encoder cable. - Carry out thermal imaging surveys in addition to the component condition analysis to further determine problematic areas prior to potential failure. - Provide a comprehensive Crane Reliability Study structured report detailing all recommendations, corrective actions and remedial repairs. - All/Any supporting documentation. - A Geometric Survey or equivalent to provide accurate information detailing the alignment and the square of a crane. The scope of the survey should include wheels, guide rollers, end trucks, girders, and other components of the crane. - A 3D Runway Survey or equivalent to deliver accurate information on the alignment of the crane runway and expert recommendations for any needed corrective actions.. The Council requests that only organisations with the relevant capability, experience and qualifications register interest in this notice. Any feedback that can be offered is welcomed.

result.text: Framework agreements for the provision and operation of an awareness platform along with supplementary services The State of Saarland and the Electronic Administration Zweckverband in Saarland (eGo-Saar) intend to award framework agreements for the provision and operation of an awareness platform along with supplementary services. The awareness platform serves to further raise employees' awareness of information security and the dangers of external cyber attacks. The platform is to consist of e-learning and phishing simulation modules and be provided as a SaaS solution. By means of corresponding reporting/analytics, data-driven, target group-appropriate measures are to be implemented and their success measured. The procurement procedure is being carried out by the Saarland IT Service Centre (IT-DLZ) for both contracting authorities.

parts.source: Rahmenverträge zur Bereitstellung und zum Betrieb einer Awareness-Plattform nebst ergänzender Dienstleistungen Das Land Saarland und der Zweckverband Elektronische Verwaltung im Saarland (eGo-Saar) beabsichtigen, Rahmenverträge zur Bereitstellung und zum Betrieb einer Awareness-Plattform nebst ergänzender Dienstleistungen zu vergeben. Die Awareness-Plattform dient dazu, Mitarbeiter für das Thema Informationssicherheit und die Gefahren externer Cyber-Angriffe verstärkt zu sensibilisieren. Die Plattform soll aus den Modulen E-Learnings und Phishingsimulation bestehen und als SaaS-Lösung bereitgestellt werden. Mittels dazugehörenden Reportings/Analytics, sollen datengesteuert zielgruppengerechte Maßnahmen durchgeführt und deren Erfolg gemessen werden. Das Vergabeverfahren wird durch das IT-Dienstleistungszentrum des Saarlandes (IT-DLZ) für beide Auftraggeber durchgeführt.

result.text: The subject of the procurement is a quality and monitoring information system for the use of Helsingin kaupungin sosiaali-, terveys- ja pelastustoimiala, which is provided as a comprehensive service by the supplier selected for the procurement. The objective of the procurement is to create a unified, user-oriented information system that supports the quality and monitoring of service production, serving employees, supervisors and management, as well as the support and maintenance services that serve the operations. The background to the need and objective is the need to develop a unified system that gathers scattered monitoring data together and supports its systematic utilisation in management and decision-making. Changed legislation, especially the Act on the Supervision of Social and Health Services (741/2023), requires the improvement of the quality, consistency and reporting of monitoring data. The system entity that is the subject of the procurement includes the following architectural, functional and supportable modules: -Quality and monitoring entity (Monitoring tool) -Reporting sections, including irregularities, adverse events and hazards, and the entity of serious adverse events -Entity related to the activities of social and patient ombudsmen -Management of medication administration permits. The subject and requirements of the procurement are described in more detail in the annexes to the call for tenders.

parts.source: Hankinnan kohteena on Helsingin kaupungin sosiaali-, terveys- ja pelastustoimialan käyttöön tuleva laadun ja valvonnan tietojärjestelmä, joka hankintaan valitun toimittajan tarjoamana kokonaispalveluna. Hankinnan tavoitteena on luoda yhtenäinen, käyttäjälähtöinen ja palvelutuotannon laatua sekä valvontaa tukeva tietojärjestelmä, joka palvelee työntekijöitä, esihenkilöitä ja johtoa, sekä toimintaa palvelevat tuki- ja ylläpitopalvelu. Tarpeen ja tavoitteen taustalla on tarve kehittää yhtenäinen järjestelmä, joka kokoaa hajallaan olevan valvontatiedon yhteen ja tukee sen systemaattista hyödyntämistä johtamisessa ja päätöksenteossa. Muuttunut lainsäädäntö, erityisesti laki sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon valvonnasta (741/2023), edellyttää valvontatiedon laadun, yhtenäisyyden ja raportoinnin parantamista. Hankinnan kohteena oleva järjestelmäkokonaisuus sisältää seuraavat arkkitehtuuriset, toiminnalliset ja tuetettavat moduulit: -Laadun ja valvonnan kokonaisuus (Valvontatyökalu) -Ilmoittamisen osiot, mukaan lukien epäkohdat, haitta- ja vaaratapahtumat sekä vakavien vaaratapahtumien kokonaisuus -Sosiaali- ja potilasasiavastaavien toimintaan liittyvä kokonaisuus -Lääkehoitolupien hallinta. Tarkemmin hankinnan kohde ja vaatimukset on kuvattu tarjouspyynnön liitteissä.
