result.text: The U.S. Embassy Athens Public Diplomacy Section (PDS Athens) of the U.S. Department of State is pleased to announce funding is available through its Public Diplomacy Grants Program in fiscal year 2025. This is an Annual Program Statement, outlining our funding priorities, the strategic themes we focus on, and the procedures for submitting requests for funding. Please carefully follow all instructions below. The deadline for grant applications is July 11, 2025. Funding decisions will be made on these applications on a rolling basis after this deadline, with a goal of informing all applicants of the final funding decision by September 30, 2025. Applicants may apply for funding between $25,000 and $100,000 . Please use the grant application documents and budget template found on the Embassy website https://gr.usembassy.gov/education/ . Purpose of Grants program: PDS Athens invites proposals for projects that strengthen ties between the United States and Greece through concrete demonstrations of cooperation between our two peoples, aiming at making America safer, stronger and more prosperous . All grant proposals must convey an element of American history, culture, or shared values. Competitive proposals should support a priority program area (see below). They should also include a connection with American expert/s, organization/s, or institution/s that will promote increased cooperation between the people of the United States and Greece even after the program has finished. Priority Program Areas: The Public Diplomacy Section is focused on the following priorities in the form of programs, exchanges, and media opportunities that: Promote American Excellence in Emerging Technologies Celebrate 250 Years of American Excellence: Spotlight on America’s Achievements, Innovation, and Leadership Promoting American Excellence in Emerging Technologies Greek students and professionals in emerging technologies have demonstrated a strong technical foundation that can be strategically leveraged to benefit U.S. technology firms and bolster American leadership in critical industries. By channeling this talent to serve the needs of American companies, we can reinforce U.S. technological dominance, strengthen innovation pipelines, and ensure that international engagement directly supports American economic and strategic priorities. We invite proposals aimed at enhancing U.S.-Greece technological cooperation in ways that clearly advance U.S. national interests. Proposals must focus on initiatives (not conferences) that help U.S. firms address critical workforce and skill shortages, expand the reach of American products and innovation standards, and create structured pathways for Greek talent to contribute to U.S.-driven innovation. Prioritized activities include, but are not limited to: Public-private partnerships that connect U.S. technology firms with high-potential Greek talent through American-led career readiness programs, skills development, and reskilling/upskilling initiatives tailored to U.S. industry standards and needs. Training modules designed for integration into Greek higher education or vocational curricula that: Align directly with the needs of U.S. employers; and Target high-demand fields such as artificial intelligence (AI), biotechnology, cybersecurity, data analytics, and cloud computing—strengthening the global competitiveness of U.S. firms. Innovation bootcamps that feature U.S. technologies, platforms, and products, familiarizing international talent with high-quality American tools and practices. Collaborative projects between U.S. technology companies and Greek educational institutions to promote the adoption and use of American-developed AI and other emerging technologies, reinforcing the global footprint of U.S. innovation. All proposals should demonstrate a clear benefit to the United States and prioritize American commercial and strategic interests, consistent with the principles of the America First policy. Celebrating 250 Years of American Excellence: Spotlight on America’s Achievements, Innovation, and Leadership On July 4, 2026, the United States will commemorate the 250th anniversary of the signing of the Declaration of Independence. This historic milestone presents a powerful opportunity to celebrate American excellence, leverage people-to-people ties, and highlight our achievements, legacies, and contributions as part of America’s story of excellence. We invite proposals that underscore American excellence and contribute to the celebration of America250 , highlighting this momentous occasion through impactful and engaging programs. We welcome submissions that promote U.S.-Greece bilateral engagement and spotlight American achievements, innovation, leadership, and the role of faith and religion in democratic societies. Proposals should feature initiatives (not conferences), and include activities such as (but not limited to): Podcasts and/or public lectures on U.S. history, its ties to Greece, democracy, and its global impact Roadshows showcasing 250 years of American innovation and U.S.-Greek cooperation Sports activities or themed games/events Secondary educational modules that will reach Greek classrooms and help to enhance Greek students’ and educators’ positive understanding of America All proposals should demonstrate a clear benefit to the United States and prioritize American strategic interests, consistent with the principles of the America First policy.

result.text: The contracting authority is establishing a dynamic purchasing system (DPS) for the procurement of expert services for rail traffic management product development. During the term of the dynamic purchasing system, all candidates interested in the procurement or groups formed by them may submit an application to participate in it. The DPS shall be valid until the date stated in the contract notice, unless it is terminated or amended while the DPS is valid. Assignments shall be put out to tender within the system among the suppliers accepted into the dynamic purchasing system, through separate DPS-internal tenders, which may be timed across the entire procurement phase of the DPS. The procurement phase of the DPS begins after the establishment phase 23.3.2026 and ends upon the expiry of the validity period of the dynamic purchasing system. A more detailed description of the subject matter of the dynamic purchasing system is presented in the invitation to participate and its annexes, in particular annexes 1 General description of the dynamic purchasing system and 2 Sub-areas of the dynamic purchasing system. SCOPE OF THE DYNAMIC PURCHASING SYSTEM The estimated total value of the dynamic purchasing system excluding value added tax is a maximum of 70 million euros. NOTE! This is a new contract notice which replaces the contract notice published with the same heading in Hilma and TED under 19.12.2025. The contracting authority also kindly requests suppliers who have submitted a participation application and received a decision in connection with the previous notice to apply to the dynamic purchasing system again. A participation application already submitted once may be used as a basis. Design services include the following services: - Service design - Operational safety and human factors - Product design The content of the services is described in annex 1 Sub-areas of the dynamic purchasing system of the invitation to participate.; Management services include the following services: - Agile development management services - Definition services The services are described in annex 1 Sub-areas of the dynamic purchasing system of the invitation to participate.; Application and software development services include the following services: - Application and software development - Architecture services The services are described in annex 1 Sub-areas of the dynamic purchasing system of the invitation to participate.

parts.source: Hankintayksikkö perustaa dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän (DPS) Raideliikenteenohjauksen tuotekehityksen asiantuntijapalveluiden hankinnassa. Dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän keston aikana kaikki hankinnasta kiinnostuneet ehdokkaat tai niiden muodostamat ryhmittymät voivat tehdä siihen osallistumishakemuksen. DPS on voimassa hankintailmoituksessa ilmoitettuun päivään asti, ellei sitä keskeytetä tai muuteta DPS:n voimassaollessa. Dynaamiseen hankintajärjestelmään hyväksyttyjen toimittajien kesken kilpailutetaan toimeksiantoja järjestelmän sisällä, erillisillä DPS:n sisäisillä kilpailutuksilla, jotka voivat ajoittua DPS:n koko hankintavaiheen ajalle. DPS:n hankintavaihe alkaa perustamisvaiheen jälkeen 23.3.2026 ja päättyy DPS:n voimassaoloajan päättyessä. Dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän kohteen tarkempi kuvaus on esitetty osallistumispyynnössä ja sen liitteissä, erityisesti liitteissä 1 Dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän yleiskuvaus ja 2 Dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän osa-alueet. DYNAAMISEN HANKINTAJÄRJESTELMÄN LAAJUUS Dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän ennakoitu arvonlisäveroton kokonaisarvo on enintään 70 miljoonaa euroa. HUOM! Tämä on uusi hankintailmoitus, joka korvaa 19.12.2025 Hilmassa ja TED:ssä samalla otsikolla julkaistun hankintailmoituksen. Hankintayksikkö pyytää pyytää ystävällisesti myös edellisen ilmoituksen myötä osallistumishakemuksen jättäneitä sekä päätöksen saaneita toimittajia hakeutumaan dynaamiseen hankintajärjestelmään uudelleen. Pohjana voi käyttää jo kertaalleen lähetettyä osallistumishakemusta. Suunnittelupalveluihin kuuluvat seuraavat palvelut: - Palvelumuotoilu - Käytön turvallisuus ja inhimilliset tekijät - Tuotemuotoilu Palveluiden sisältö on kuvattu osallistumispyynnön liitteessä 1 Dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän osa-alueet.; Hallintapalveluihin kuuluvat seuraavat palvelut: - Ketterän kehityksen hallintapalvelut - Määrittelypalvelut Palvelut on kuvattu osallistumispyynnön liitteessä 1 Dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän osa-alueet.; Sovellus- ja ohjelmistokehityspalveluihin kuuluvat seuraavat palvelut: - Sovellus- ja ohjelmistokehitys - Arkkitehtuuripalvelut Palvelut on kuvattu osallistumispyynnön liitteessä 1 Dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän osa-alueet.

result.text: Istekki Oy invites applications for participation in a dynamic purchasing system (DPS), the subject of which is a secure communication service. The subject of the DPS is described in more detail in the invitation to participate and its appendices, particularly in the appendix Subject of the dynamic purchasing system. The dynamic purchasing system is divided into 12 different categories (sub-areas): 1: Secure mail: technology, licences, platform services and ready-made solutions 2: Spam filtering: technology, licences, platform services and ready-made solutions 3: DMARC reporting: technology, licences, platform services and ready-made solutions 4: Email protection: technology, licences, platform services and ready-made solutions 5. Secure forms: technology, licences, platform services and ready-made solutions 6. Secure workspace: technology, licences, platform services and ready-made solutions 7. Secure instant messaging: technology, licences, platform services and ready-made solutions 8. Secure file transfer: technology, licences, platform services and ready-made solutions 9. Critical communication: technology, licences, platform services and ready-made solutions 10. Unspecified procurement category - to be specified later 11. Unspecified procurement category - to be specified later 12. Unspecified procurement category - to be specified later A candidate may apply for categories 1-9. It is not possible to apply for unspecified categories 10-12 at the establishment stage. Istekki Oy reserves the possibility to establish categories 10-12 during the validity period of the dynamic purchasing system. Categories 10-12 may include technologies, licences, platform services and ready-made solutions for the secure communication service. The purpose of categories 10-12 is to enable flexible response to market developments and technological changes in secure communication services. All candidates who meet the suitability requirements stated in the ESPD form and the invitation to participate may apply to become a tenderer for the dynamic purchasing system. All candidates who meet the set suitability requirements will be accepted into the dynamic purchasing system. All interested candidates may request the right to participate in the dynamic purchasing system for the entire duration of the dynamic purchasing system. The number of candidates to be accepted into the dynamic purchasing system is not limited. A candidate applies to the dynamic purchasing system by submitting an application for participation. Istekki Oy may, if it wishes, shorten or extend the duration of the dynamic purchasing system by publishing a contract notice to that effect. rejected.text: We invite forward-leaning tenderers to register for our market dialogue for a future procurement of a tender implementation tool (KGV), with the accompanying options. The County Municipalities would like a modern and user-friendly tool that helps both the contracting authority and the tenderer with implementation competitions in a flexible way. Simple process and user support should be available by phone and email. The tool shall contribute to increased efficiency in the procurement work and reduce complexity, so that several parts of the entities can use the tool in line with the organisations' maturity. The contracting authorities are looking for a tool that offers efficient workflow and automated processes. The use ought to contribute to reducing the organisation's use of resources in procurement processes and contract follow-up and that the company can more easily comply with the regulations. The contracting authorities want a robust, modern and cloud-based system that uses new technology to enable efficient data processing, automation of work processes and seamless integration with the existing infrastructure in the counties. The solution is expected to be maintained, upgraded and developed to support legislative changes, adopt new technology, improve the user experience, and provide continual value during the contract period. It is important that the procured system is developed in line with the market and contributes to strengthening the digitalisation work for the procurement discipline. The system shall assist with the transition to a data-driven everyday life for procurement consultants. In the future, it may be necessary to integrate artificial intelligence into your infrastructure, such as with Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Azure, to improve employee efficiency and provide access to verified information from trusted data sources, while maintaining security and data quality. The contracting authority wants a tool that, in the long term, can connect artificial intelligence to data in KGV/KAV and other parts of the system, so that employees can obtain reliable information through interaction with artificial intelligence, independent of client. The main goals are: Streamlining of the procurement work, reduced complexity in the processes. Automation and improved workflow. Better compliance with the rules. Support for digitalisation and transition to data-driven processes. Future integration of artificial intelligence, especially with Microsoft 365 and Azure. Need for integration with archive system FINT (Joint County InTegraions). What is GOOD? FINT Arkiv – Novari IKS. FINT is a common digital platform that is used by Norwegian counties to standardise and make information available through open APIs. This contributes to increased efficiency, better data quality and reduced costs by enabling real-time reuse of data. FINT Arkiv-integration shall be used by county entities included in this competition. Other affiliated entities may require integration in other ways, adapted to their system landscape. As the Contracting Authority consists of several entities, different archive systems are currently used. With FINT Arkiv, however, the underlying archive system does not function as the interface for the integration - FINT provides a common interface regardless of which archive system is used. Fint Arkiv is used by all of the counties in the country, byantikvaren and Bymiljøetaten in Oslo kommune as well as Sametinget. With FINT Arkiv the counties get an API with a joint information model for standardised exchange of archive information. The counties that currently participate in this competition use three different archive systems: Tieto Evry - Public 360 Sikri - Elements Acos - WebSak+ Overall Requirement - Integration-friendly and data-driven system. The contracting authority shall use systems with open and documented APIs that enable safe and efficient integration. With limited internal resources for development, the contracting authority needs assistance to extract more value from the existing data. The tenderer shall develop integrations that are easy to implement, maintain and reuse - and that can be shared with other public entities when relevant. The system shall be based on open standards and it shall provide sufficient documentation for both technical and functional understanding. The Contracting Authority strives to procure systems that shall offer an open and documented API with sufficient functionality for safe and efficient integration with other systems and data sources. The API shall support standardised protocols and formats and be available for integration without a need for comprehensive adaptations. The integrations shall be designed with modular architecture that enables reuse and sharing with other public entities. All the necessary documentation connected to the API, data flow and process design shall be provided and suitable for both technical and functional understanding. The tenderer shall assist in implementing value from existing data and contribute to a more data-driven and coherent public sector.

result.text: On behalf of the Danish Tax Administration, the Agency for Development and Simplification (UFST) would like to invite suppliers to a market dialogue on a new system for handling new EU legislation in relation to the FASTER directive, which is intended to ensure better, simpler, and more uniform procedures for the relief of excess withholding tax on cross-border investments. The directive is intended to ensure that EU countries have the necessary tools to effectively tackle tax fraud and abuse. The directive can be found here FASTER. With this market dialogue, UFST seeks to gain important knowledge from potential suppliers on the market who have experience from similar areas or solutions. UFST would also like to investigate whether there is a standard solution on the market already that can meet our needs or whether there are plans to develop a solution to support the FASTER directive. The market dialogue should provide insight into whether a standard solution exists or is planned to be developed that can support our needs in relation to: 1. Reporting of several detailed information on dividends from certified financial intermediaries 2. Digital tax certificate residences (eTRC), so that investors only need to obtain one digital certificate from their home country to document which EU country they are residents in 3. A system for ‘relief-at-source’ of dividend tax that will integrate with our existing system-portfolio Examples of business and technical needs (non-exhaustive): • The solution must exchange data to other relevant IT systems in UFST • The solution must integrate access to external foreign IT systems including, for example, a common EU portal • The solution must provide access and the possibility of approval and deregistration of Danish investors • The solution must enable automatic reporting of control data from the certified financial intermediaries • The solution must support case processing so that administrative users can handle situations where reported control data is deficient • The solution must enable the issuance and revocation of eTRCs • The solution must enable the approval and deregistration of certified financial intermediaries • The solution must issue and enforce powers of attorney • Handling of access control and compliance with logging and security requirements • Automatic control of submission data In addition, UFST is interested in what considerations the suppliers make in relation to which technologies and technology stacks the solution is expected to be built on, and whether the solution is implemented in Cloud or On Premise. In addition, it is particularly interesting to have solutions from suppliers that can document experience with larger common solutions in OECD and/or the EU. For the development of the standard solution and its ongoing maintenance, UFST would also like to clarify how the supplier generally intends to ensure: • Maximum automation of workflows • Full compliance with the FASTER directive and functional support of it • User-friendliness, overview (e.g. status), and reporting options • Compliance with existing legislation in the area.

result.text: This PIN provides early information about the expected starting date and purchase volume for a pre-commercial procurement (PCP) carried out by the THERESA PCP project and about the open market consultation (OMC) that is organised in preparation of this pre-commercial procurement (PCP). The THERESA Buyers Group of healthcare providers have identified a shared need for innovative and sustainable solutions to treat hospital wastewater (HWW) at the source, before it reaches the municipal network, to reduce environmental and health risks linked to pharmaceutical residues, antimicrobial-resistant microorganisms and genes, and other hazardous contaminants. The THERESA PCP aims to stimulate the development of environmentally sustainable, cost-effective, and scalable on-site HWW treatment systems capable of efficiently removing cytostatic drugs, X-ray contrast agents, antibiotics, antimicrobial-resistant bacteria (ARB) and genes (ARG), while minimising energy consumption, chemical use, and carbon footprint. The contract notice is expected to be published in May-2026 and phase 1 to be started in January 2027, following the PCP timeline. The procurement will take the form of a Pre-Commercial Procurement (PCP) awarding R&D service contracts to several providers in parallel, through a phased and competitive process comprising three stages: Solution design, prototyping, and original development and validation/testing of the first products in real hospital environments. After each phase, intermediate evaluations will down-select the best-performing and most innovative solutions. The contractors with the best-value-for-money solutions will be offered a specific contract for the next phase. The PCP is a joint cross-border initiative coordinated by Fundación Miguel Servet (Spain) as Lead Procurer, on behalf of a Buyers Group of hospitals and public health institutions from Spain, Estonia, Poland, Belgium and the Netherlands, supported by technical and innovation partners. Testing is expected to take place in Spain, Estonia, Poland and the Netherlands to ensure adaptability. Price is not the only award criterion, and all criteria are stated only in the procurement documents. The selected contractors will retain ownership of the Intellectual Property Rights (IPRs) generated during the PCP and will be able to commercially exploit the developed solutions beyond the scope of the procurement. The R&D services will be carried out primarily within the European Union and/or countries associated with the Horizon Europe Programme. At least 50% of the total value of R&D activities will take place within the EU or associated countries. In addition, contractors must ensure that none of the contracted services are performed in countries nor by entities that are subject to EU restrictive measures under Article 29 of the Treaty on the European Union (TEU) and Article 215 of the Treaty on the Functioning of the EU (TFEU)23 (sanctions). They must ensure that none of the goods procured or used for the procurement were developed, produced or supplied in countries or by entities that are subject to such restrictive measures. Duration of the contract in months: 30 months (January 27 to June 29). The duration covers all three PCP phases: Solution design, prototyping, and original development and validation/testing of the first products. The PCP is expected to start after the publication of the Contract Notice and to end upon completion of the validation phase. This contract is not subject to renewal.

result.text: This Notice of Funding Opportunity (NOFO) invites exploratory grant applications, hereafter referred to as the Novel Experiential Technologies Assisting Individual learning Hubs or NExT AI Hubs (formerly Learning Disabilities Innovation Hubs), to address the impact of Artificial Intelligence (AI) technologies on developmental outcomes in children diagnosed with or at risk for developing a specific learning disability (SLD) impacting reading, writing, and mathematics. NExT AI Hubs include a single Research Project and a Leadership Core that support the goals and aims of the Hub. This NOFO seeks to serve as a catalyst to 1) speed the maturation of nascent/novel, high-impact, high-risk research that advances understanding of the role AI technology plays in supporting, improving, or limiting the learning, cognitive, and socio-emotional needs of children at risk for or diagnosed with SLDs, 2) build an evidence base for the SLD community to inform policy or practice, and 3) provide project-embedded, career-enhancing research and professional development opportunities to support the next generation of transdisciplinary SLD scientists. This initiative provides opportunities to support planning and building a body of research and corresponding intellectual infrastructure to enable NExT AI investigators to compete for large research and program project opportunities in the future.This NOFO aims to integrate research topics that are of relevance to various research programs at the Eunice Kennedy Shriver National Institute of Child Health and Human Development (NICHD) and align with the NICHD Strategic Plan. The NOFO intends to build cross-programmatic, transdisciplinary and cross-cutting scientific research, and critically nurture the development of early career investigators capable of conducting this research.

result.text: Nest is seeking to appoint one supplier to provide, implement and support one hosted software-as-a-service solution for Nest Invest, comprising two mandatory capabilities: Asset Allocation and Total Portfolio View. The Asset Allocation capability must support Nest Invest’s multi-level fund-of-funds structure and its controlled, model-driven asset allocation process. This includes strategic and tactical asset allocation, portfolio modelling and optimisation, configurable targets, limits and tolerances, portfolio rebalancing, asset restrictions, workflow and approval controls, auditability, scenario analysis and the generation of implementation instructions or outputs for downstream parties. The Total Portfolio View capability must provide a consolidated view of Nest Invest’s portfolio across public and private assets, including positions, exposures, performance and look-through information where available. It must support aggregation and analysis across Nest Invest’s fund structure. The supplier will be required to provide software licensing or subscription services; implementation and configuration; integration with retained data sources and Nest Invest’s planned cloud data platform through appropriate data interfaces and APIs; transition and migration from the incumbent IRP solution; testing and user acceptance support; training and documentation; go-live and transition support; and ongoing hosting, maintenance, technical support and product-roadmap services. The solution must be configured for Nest Invest and supplied electronically as a hosted service. Investment and portfolio data will be received from retained sources, including the fund administrator and custodian, and the solution must generate the required information, reporting and implementation outputs for Nest Invest and its downstream processes. The contract will be awarded to one supplier for an initial term of five years. result.text: This is not a procurement notice nor a call for tenders, but a request for information through which Etelä-Karjalan hyvinvointialue is surveying system suppliers to register for a potential tendering procedure. The wellbeing services county is responsible for social welfare, healthcare and rescue services. It is the largest employer in the region, employing approximately 6 000 professionals from various fields. Our vision is to be a pioneering community where services are accessible, the wellbeing of our population is among the best in Finland, and the occupational wellbeing of our employees is high. Our mission is to increase the health, functional capacity and security of our residents throughout their lives. Our values are “Mie turvaan”, “Mie uskallan”, “Mie vastaan” and “Mie välitän”. Strategic priorities include investing in personnel, smooth processes and the gradation of services. The realisation of these requires efficient, safe and user-friendly digital solutions. The roster planning system plays a central role in supporting the smooth flow of everyday operations, the occupational wellbeing of the staff and cost-efficiency. The purpose of the market dialogue is to obtain a comprehensive overview of the roster planning systems and related services available on the market. The information obtained can be used to assess what kinds of solutions exist on the market, what benefits they generate and how they suit the needs of the wellbeing services county. Through the market dialogue, the wellbeing services county aims to: 1. Obtain information on the market offering and various suppliers' solutions 2. Understand the functionalities and key use cases of the systems 3. Explore integration possibilities with existing systems and platforms 4. Assess the implementation of information security and data protection 5. Gain an overview of pricing models and cost structures (no individual tenders) 6. Survey delivery and service models 7. Obtain concrete examples and demos from suppliers to illustrate the suitability of the solutions for the needs of the wellbeing services county. The market dialogue is open to all suppliers that can offer systems or services falling within the scope of this solution package. The focus of the dialogue is on solutions that are already in production or available on the market. Suppliers are requested to present systems and services that are available and where the key functionalities have already been implemented. The presentation of solutions under development or merely at the concept stage is not desired on this occasion. In connection with registration, suppliers are requested to briefly describe: • what ready-made solutions and services they offer • in what kinds of environments the solutions have been deployed (example descriptions, no mandatory references) • the key features of the solution that they wish to present in the market dialogue All participants are offered equal opportunities to obtain information regarding the market dialogue. The dialogue does not bind Etelä-Karjalan hyvinvointialue to initiate a procurement, nor are procurement decisions made on the basis of it. If there is a large number of registered suppliers, the wellbeing services county may hold both a joint information session and a limited number of individual meetings. The market dialogue focuses in particular on how solutions can support the key operations of the wellbeing services county. These are not procurement requirements, but thematic areas intended as a basis for discussion and illustration: • User management and information security • Working hours and shift management • Consideration of collective agreements and local agreements • Competence, qualifications and occupational health management • Usability and multi-user support • Reporting and information-driven management • Integrations with other systems • Mobile usage and employee services • Main administration, maintenance and support services • Intelligence and automation Pricing models and lifecycle services Participating suppliers have the opportunity to illustrate their solutions also through a demo or practical example scenarios. The wellbeing services county will provide a set of questions in advance to guide the discussion and ensure that the presentations of different suppliers can be compared on an equal basis. The market dialogue will be conducted as supplier-specific meetings via remote connection (Teams). The duration of an individual meeting is approximately 60 to 90 minutes. The supplier will have the opportunity to present their solution and its key features. The wellbeing services county will also ask pre-defined questions that support the equality and comparability of the discussion. Meetings will be held on the following days: 21.10., 22.10., 27.10., 28.10. and 29.10.2025. The exact time will be agreed with the registered suppliers based on the order of registration and schedule coordination. The language of potential presentations/meetings is Finnish. Registrations are requested to be sent by 3.10.2025 at 12:00. This request for information / market survey does not request tenders to be submitted nor are tenders given in response to this request for information; it requests ONLY procurement-related information. Participating or refraining from participating in the market survey / request for information does not affect the tenderer's position in any potential tendering procedure. The market dialogue invitation does not bind the respondent (supplier) to participate in the tendering procedure, nor is responding to this notice a precondition for participating in the actual tendering procedure later. Those participating in the market survey have no right to compensation for participation. The contracting authority does not undertake to carry out the procurement in question. Decisions on launching a potential procurement process will be made after the market survey. The submitted material will be handled as confidential in accordance with section 24, subsection 1, point 20 of the Act on the Openness of Government Activities.

parts.source: Tämä ei ole hankintailmoitus eikä tarjouspyyntö, vaan tietopyyntö, jolla Etelä-Karjalan hyvinvointialue kartoittaa järjestelmätoimittajia ilmoittautumaan mahdollista kilpailutusta varten. Hyvinvointialue vastaa sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon sekä pelastustoimen palveluista. Se on maakunnan suurin työnantaja, jossa työskentelee noin 6 000 eri alojen ammattilaista. Visiomme on olla edelläkävijäyhteisö, jossa palvelut ovat saavutettavia, väestömme hyvinvointi on Suomen huippua ja työntekijöidemme työhyvinvointi korkea. Missiomme on lisätä asukkaidemme terveyttä, toimintakykyä ja turvaa läpi elämän. Arvojamme ovat “Mie turvaan”, “Mie uskallan”, “Mie vastaan” ja “Mie välitän”. Strategisina painopisteinä ovat henkilöstöön panostaminen, prosessien sujuvuus ja palveluiden porrastus. Näiden toteutuminen edellyttää tehokkaita, turvallisia ja käyttäjäystävällisiä digitaalisia ratkaisuja. Työvuorosuunnittelujärjestelmällä on keskeinen rooli arjen toiminnan sujuvuuden, henkilöstön työhyvinvoinnin ja kustannustehokkuuden tukemisessa. Markkinavuoropuhelun tarkoituksena on saada kokonaiskuva markkinoilla olevista työvuorosuunnittelujärjestelmistä ja niihin liittyvistä palveluista. Saatavan tiedon avulla voidaan arvioida, millaisia ratkaisuja markkinoilla on, millaisia hyötyjä ne tuottavat ja miten ne soveltuvat hyvinvointialueen tarpeisiin. Markkinavuoropuhelun avulla hyvinvointialue pyrkii: 1. Saamaan tietoa markkinoiden tarjonnasta ja eri toimittajien ratkaisuista 2. Ymmärtämään järjestelmien toiminnallisuuksia ja keskeisiä käyttötapauksia 3. Selvittämään integraatiomahdollisuuksia olemassa oleviin järjestelmiin ja alustoihin 4. Arvioimaan tietoturvan ja tietosuojan toteutusta 5. Saamaan yleiskuvan hinnoittelumalleista ja kustannusrakenteista (ei yksittäisiä tarjouksia) 6. Kartoittamaan toimitus- ja palvelumalleja 7. Saamaan toimittajilta konkreettisia esimerkkejä ja demoja, joiden avulla voidaan havainnollistaa ratkaisujen soveltuvuutta hyvinvointialueen tarpeisiin Markkinavuoropuhelu on avoin kaikille toimittajille, joilla on tarjota tämän ratkaisukokonaisuuden piiriin kuuluvia järjestelmiä tai palveluita. Vuoropuhelun painopisteenä ovat ratkaisut, jotka ovat jo tuotannossa tai markkinoilla saatavilla. Toimittajia pyydetään esittelemään järjestelmiä ja palveluita, jotka ovat käytettävissä ja joissa keskeiset toiminnallisuudet ovat valmiiksi toteutettuja. Kehitteillä olevien tai vasta konseptitasolla olevien ratkaisujen esittelyä ei tässä yhteydessä toivota. Ilmoittautumisen yhteydessä toimittajia pyydetään lyhyesti kuvaamaan: • mitä valmiita ratkaisuja ja palveluja he tarjoavat • minkälaisissa ympäristöissä ratkaisuja on otettu käyttöön (esimerkkikuvauksia, ei pakollisia referenssejä) • ratkaisun keskeisiä ominaisuuksia, joita he haluavat esitellä markkinavuoropuhelussa Kaikille osallistujille tarjotaan yhdenvertaiset mahdollisuudet saada tietoa markkinavuoropuhelusta. Vuoropuhelu ei sido Etelä-Karjalan hyvinvointialuetta käynnistämään hankintaa eikä sen perusteella tehdä hankintapäätöksiä. Mikäli ilmoittautuneita toimittajia on runsaasti, hyvinvointialue voi toteuttaa sekä yhteisen infotilaisuuden että rajatun määrän yksilökohtaisia tapaamisia. Markkinavuoropuhelussa keskitytään erityisesti siihen, miten ratkaisut voivat tukea hyvinvointialueen keskeisiä toimintoja. Nämä eivät ole hankintavaatimuksia, vaan keskustelun ja havainnollistamisen pohjaksi tarkoitettuja aihealueita: • Käyttäjähallinta ja tietoturva • Työaikojen ja työvuorojen hallinta • TES- ja paikallisten sopimusten huomiointi • Osaamisen, pätevyyksien ja työterveyden hallinta • Käytettävyys ja monikäyttäjätuki • Raportointi ja tiedolla johtaminen • Integraatiot muihin järjestelmiin • Mobiilikäyttö ja työntekijäpalvelut • Pääkäyttäjyys, ylläpito ja tukipalvelut • Älykkyys ja automaatio • Hinnoittelumallit ja elinkaaripalvelut Osallistuvilla toimittajilla on mahdollisuus havainnollistaa ratkaisujaan myös demon tai käytännön esimerkkitilanteiden kautta. Hyvinvointialue toimittaa etukäteen kysymyspatteriston, joka ohjaa keskustelua ja varmistaa, että eri toimittajien esityksiä voidaan vertailla yhdenvertaisesti. Markkinavuoropuhelu toteutetaan toimittajakohtaisina tapaamisina etäyhteydellä (Teams). Yksittäisen tapaamisen kesto on noin 60–90 minuuttia. Toimittajalla on mahdollisuus esitellä ratkaisunsa sekä sen keskeiset ominaisuudet. Hyvinvointialue esittää lisäksi etukäteen määriteltyjä kysymyksiä, jotka tukevat keskustelun yhdenvertaisuutta ja vertailtavuutta. Tapaamisia järjestetään seuraavina päivinä: 21.10., 22.10., 27.10., 28.10. ja 29.10.2025. Tarkka ajankohta sovitaan ilmoittautuneiden toimittajien kanssa ilmoittautumisjärjestyksen ja aikataulujen yhteensovittamisen perusteella. Mahdollisten esittelyjen/tapaamisten kieli on Suomi. Ilmoittautumiset pyydetään lähettämään 3.10.2025 klo 12:00 mennessä. Tällä tietopyynnöllä/markkinakartoituksella ei pyydetä eikä tähän tietopyyntöön anneta tarjouksia, vaan tällä pyydetään VAIN hankintaan liittyviä tietoja. Markkinakartoitukseen/tietopyyntöön osallistuminen tai osallistumatta jättäminen ei vaikuta tarjoajan asemaan mahdollisessa tarjouskilpailussa. Markkinavuoropuhelukutsu ei sido vastaajaa (toimittajaa) tarjouskilpailuun osallistumiseen, eikä tähän ilmoitukseen vastaaminen ole edellytyksenä myöhemmin varsinaiseen tarjouskilpailuun osallistumiselle. Markkinakartoitukseen osallistuvilla ei ole oikeutta saada korvausta osallistumisesta. Hankintayksikkö ei sitoudu toteuttamaan asianomaista hankintaa. Päätökset mahdollisen hankintaprosessin käynnistämisestä tehdään markkinakartoituksen jälkeen. Toimitettu materiaali käsitellään luottamuksellisena julkisuuslain 24 §:n 1 momentin 20 kohdan mukaan.

result.text: DCMS are seeking to commission "what works" research into the impact and effectiveness of AI adoption interventions within DCMS sectors. We are interested in two broad sets of questions. The first is analysis of how businesses within DCMS sectors that are in the process of adopting AI achieve this, the challenges they face and the opportunities and benefits realised. We anticipate this will be explored through an ethnographic study that observes how individuals and teams actually use AI tools in their jobs. The second set of questions is what policy interventions work best to support businesses that wish to adopt AI, which we anticipate will be answered by testing hypothetical interventions through randomised control trials (RCTs). Bidders will be able to propose alternative methodologies if they think they suit these questions better; the core need for this project is to produce direct, robust evidence of what works, as opposed to what is self-reported (e.g. through interviews, focus groups, surveys, and similar) to work. This project will be commissioned either through a Competitive Flexible Procedure under the Procurement Act 2023, or through the RM6126 Research and Insights framework. This is part of the DCMS Science and Analysis R&D Programme, which supports R&D capability within the department. This project will run concurrently aside three other large projects across 2027-2030, these include; mapping the specific "user pathways" audiences take to find, consume, and value information; a continuation of previous research to develop data-intensive approaches for capturing engagement at unticketed cultural, heritage, and sporting events/activities/locations, e.g. using mobile app data to model how people participate in our events; and a continuation of previous research to design and improve methods for holistically tracking the long-term impact of major events, tested on a major event. Lot 1: .

result.text: Invitation to market dialogue. Sykehusinnkjøp HF hereby invites tenderers to a market dialogue for the procurement of a laboratory information system for the health companies in Helse Nord. The market dialogue is a part of the preliminary work for the procurement and is being carried out because the Contracting Authority would like input for the procurement from potential suppliers, possibly also from other interested parties. As a part of this process, suppliers are invited to provide input to the procurement prior to the announcement. The feedback makes it possible to make a decision about the type of procurement and procurement procedure. Based on input from the market dialogue, the Contracting Authority will, as needed, open to a closer dialogue with some of the suppliers for further details and discussions. The contracting authority would like input on the following points: Short presentation of the supplier/tendererWhich the specialist areas the system is meant to cover (see further information on all disciplines within the laboratory service in annex "Invitation to market dialogue") About the solution, including brief information on functionality, possibilities and limitations, and: Describe how the system is built up in the tender documentation. modules, and which advantages this provides. How the system is deployed to clients; web based and/or sw deployed on clients. By the latter; whether there are specific requirements for clients. How the system will be deployed back-end. Describe how the system supports portable devices (tablets etc.). References to customers where the system is in use (and possibly which parts of the system they use). The tenderer ́s thoughts on how the system will support future development within the disciplines, e.g. within AI, integrations (i.a. FHIR), personalised medicine, etc. Input for the procurement as regards the expected functionality described in chapter 5 (see annex "Invitation to Market Dialogue"):How does the system ensure user friendliness, intuitive user interface and training? How does the system cover the overall description and for each of the disciplines covered by the solution? If there is functionality that cannot be offered we would like to know this. Which disciplines the solution covers and whether it covers all disciplines within the laboratory service (note possible exceptions for transfusion medicine/blood bank). How the system supports decision support functionality. How the solution supports artificial intelligence. How the system supports personalised medicine. How does the system support different integration mechanisms with other systems (FHIR, message exchange in accordance with Norwegian requirements, etc.?) Delivery. Which factors affect delivery time and how do you handle risk? All the functionalities are ready developed and can be delivered. If there is functionality that needs to be developed, it is desirable to know. Delivery model: cloud and/or local installation. If the system is cloud compatible; about Norwegian requirements are complied with. Whether there are specific requirements for HW and underlying SW-platform for customers. Short proposals as to how the system will be implemented at Customer Provisions that the Customer is expected to fulfil. Frequency of release bicycles and response to new functionality and error recovery. Integrations: does this require assistance from customers? Describe the pricing model and what factors affect the total cost of ownership (TCO) Licenses Maintenance/support price driven factors. And input that the tenderer deems important. Deadline for written feedback on the above mentioned points from interested parties: 28.11.2025. This is only a prior information notice in order to get information on the market and to have a dialogue with relevant suppliers. The actual competition may be announced at a later date. Feedback on or questions to the market survey is done in the Mercell communication module. After this market survey, the contracting authority will assess the need to hold meetings(s) with relevant interested parties.

result.text: East Sussex Fire Authority (ESFA) on behalf of East Sussex Fire and Rescue Service require to replace their Live Fire Training Building situated on our Training Centre site in Maresfield East Sussex. This exercise is being created to replace the previous exercise called Live Fire Training Building (but with the same reference number) as we ran into portal constraints that blocked this being an open tender open to all new interested parties. To do so we had to cease the previous exercise and commence a new one. Our intention is to replace essentially what we have now on a like for like basis but taking into account some design changes identified that will improve both flexibility in use and reduce the impact we have on the environment. We have a fairly clear idea of what we want, and that we can afford it, and believe we have a basic understanding of who might be able to supply what we require in a fairly small niche market. However, the aim of this document is to allow the market to confirm, or otherwise, our assumptions and for us to gather some information that will allow us to prepare an equitable tender that any capable supplier could bid for. As well as establishing capable suppliers we are very keen to establish whether this can be achieved as a single supplier integrated project, or not. Whilst we may consider alternative innovative approaches, we believe that a steel framed metal structure or container-based solution is likely to be all that we can afford and of which, we have a lot of experience being the basis of the current unit. This Tender will be managed electronically via the In-Tend Portal. It can be reached via: https://sell2.in-tend.co.uk/blpd/home Contractors need to be registered to use the portal and registered against us as a Contracting Entity, but registration is free and further information on how this is achieved, can be found at: https://sell2.in-tend.co.uk/blpd/register If you are unsure about your company's registration status, or have problems accessing the tender on the portal, please contact In-Tend Portals support at: https://in-tend.co.uk/contact-us/ If you have any difficulties with the In-Tend Portal that you are unable to resolve through the Sell2UK helpdesk, please email procurement@esfrs.org. result.text: HTE is a field of chemistry that expanded exponentially in the past five years, and most pharmaceutical companies are currently using it in their workflows. This methodology allows multi-parameter optimisation of chemical reactions but also synthesis of multiple compounds (96 to 384) on a small-scale using plate chemistry. Combined with the implementation of Direct-to-Biology (D2B) approaches, which involves the direct testing of non-purified mixtures, biological data is obtained faster. The combination of these methods greatly improves the Design, Make, Test, and Analyse (DMTA) cycle. Lot 1: . The option is a cloud-based design platform, accessible via a secure web interface, offering enhanced scalability and reduced infrastructure overhead. The solution will integrate with a University of Dundee-hosted virtual machine to enable secure data exchange and computational workflows. Installation of server-side components will be managed by the DDU Data Management and Computational Chemistry teams, with network provisioning supported by DTS. Ongoing maintenance and updates will be provided by the vendor.

result.text: MARKET DIALOGUE The subject of the market dialogue is the procurement of a system for the remote monitoring and management service of maritime safety equipment currently under preparation for the needs of Väylävirasto. Väylävirasto is responsible for the maintenance, development and usability of maritime safety equipment in Finland as part of the authority's tasks in fairway management. The remote monitoring service is a key part of the operational reliability, situational awareness and remote management entity of safety equipment. BACKGROUND AND OBJECTIVES The subject of the procurement is the implementation, maintenance and ongoing development of a remote monitoring and remote management service for maritime safety equipment. The service receives status, fault and location data from safety equipment, processes and stores the data, and forwards it to the key systems of Väylävirasto, particularly Reimari and analytics solutions. There are approximately 1 800 pieces of remotely monitored safety equipment, some of which are fixed and some floating, and some of the equipment can also be managed remotely. The equipment communicates via a mobile network, and in the target state, message transmission is based on the LTE-M network and the MQTT protocol in accordance with IALA specifications, with secure encryption. In the target state, the remote monitoring and management service is located in Väylävirasto's cloud environment (AWS). The service is responsible for the processing of all received remote monitoring data, including raw data storage, data processing, the provision of interfaces and necessary calculation operations, such as post-calculation of position measurements. The remote monitoring service does not provide a separate user interface, but the data is viewed via Reimari. The procurement includes system maintenance to ensure that the service remains operationally reliable, secure and responsive to users' needs throughout the contract period. Maintenance covers, among other things, technical support, updates, bug fixes, and compatibility with safety equipment and integrations. Ongoing system development is also implemented as part of the procurement. The aim of ongoing development is to gradually enable new functionalities, interfaces and integrations, and to support changes in the operating environment, technology and legislation. The procurement also examines various architectural options for communication between safety equipment and the remote monitoring service. The procurement includes a cooperation model in which the contracting authority and the supplier develop the service in a planned and long-term manner. The objective is a comprehensive solution that supports the lifecycle management of safety equipment, the utilisation of data and the continuous improvement of the service. One (1) supplier will be selected as the service provider. The subject, scope and technical solutions of the procurement may be refined and/or modified as the preparation of the procurement and the market dialogue progress. PRELIMINARY SCHEDULE The contracting authority's target schedule for the implementation of the market dialogue and procurement is: - Market dialogue (technical dialogue), January-February 2026 - Publication of the call for tenders and calculation period, March-April 2026 - Evaluation of tenders and award decision, April-May 2026 - Contract entering into force and commencement of the development project, during the year 2026 ----- ADDITIONAL INFORMATION ON THE NOTICE This notice is a prior information notice. This notice does not constitute a request for tenders. The prior information notice includes an invitation to a market dialogue, whereby all suppliers interested in the procurement have the opportunity to engage in a technical dialogue concerning the procurement with Väylävirasto. The purpose of the technical dialogue is to discuss the subject of the procurement and its definition at a general level. The technical dialogue does not bind Väylävirasto to carry out the procurement. Nor does the technical dialogue bind the supplier to participate in a potential tendering procedure. The technical dialogue is organised through commenting on draft versions of the call for tenders documentation and answering the contracting authority's questions related to the subject of the procurement. Instructions for registration: Suppliers must express their interest in participating in the market dialogue by 11.2.2026 by 12.00 by sending a message to the address tommi.aarnio@vayla.fi with the subject: "Kaukovalvonta - markkinavuoropuhelu". Suppliers are requested to state the following information in the message: - the supplier's contact person's email address The contracting authority reserves the right to invite suppliers also to bilateral negotiations or to continue the technical dialogue in another manner to be announced separately, which will be notified later if necessary. The descriptions presented in this prior information notice and the estimated publication date of the contract notice, as well as the dialogue draft materials to be provided later, are preliminary and indicative prior information on the procurement. Participating companies will not be paid any compensation for responding or participating.

parts.source: MARKKINAVUOROPUHELU Markkinavuoropuhelun kohteena on valmistelussa oleva merenkulun turvalaitteiden kaukovalvonta- ja -hallintapalvelun järjestelmähankinta Väyläviraston tarpeisiin. Väylävirasto vastaa Suomessa merenkulun turvalaitteiden ylläpidosta, kehittämisestä ja käytettävyydestä osana väylänpidon viranomaistehtäviä. Kaukovalvontapalvelu on keskeinen osa turvalaitteiden toimintavarmuuden, tilannekuvan ja etähallinnan kokonaisuutta. TAUSTAA JA TAVOITTEET Hankinnan kohteena on merenkulun turvalaitteiden kaukovalvonta- ja kaukohallintapalvelun toteutus, ylläpito ja jatkokehitys. Palvelu vastaanottaa turvalaitteilta tila-, vika- ja sijaintitietoa, käsittelee ja tallentaa tiedon sekä tarjoaa sen edelleen Väyläviraston keskeisiin järjestelmiin, erityisesti Reimariin ja analytiikkaratkaisuihin. Kaukovalvottuja turvalaitteita on noin 1 800 kappaletta, joista osa on kiinteitä ja osa kelluvia, ja osa laitteista on myös etähallittavia. Laitteet kommunikoivat mobiiliverkon yli, ja tavoitetilassa viestinvälitys perustuu LTE-M-verkkoon ja MQTT-protokollaan IALAn spesifikaatioiden mukaisesti, tietoturvallisesti salattuna. Tavoitetilassa kaukovalvonta- ja hallintapalvelu sijaitsee Väyläviraston pilviympäristössä (AWS). Palvelu vastaa kaiken vastaanotetun kaukovalvontadatan käsittelystä, mukaan lukien raakadatan tallennus, tiedon jalostaminen, rajapintojen tarjoaminen sekä tarvittavat laskentaoperaatiot, kuten sijaintimittausten jälkilaskenta. Kaukovalvontapalvelu ei tarjoa erillistä käyttöliittymää, vaan tiedot tarkastellaan Reimarin kautta. Hankintaan sisältyy järjestelmän ylläpito, jotta palvelu pysyy toimintavarmana, tietoturvallisena ja käyttäjien tarpeita vastaavana koko sopimuskauden ajan. Ylläpito kattaa muun muassa teknisen tuen, päivitykset, virheenkorjaukset sekä yhteensopivuuden turvalaitteiden ja integraatioiden kanssa. Osana hankintaa toteutetaan myös järjestelmän jatkokehitystä. Jatkokehityksen tavoitteena on mahdollistaa vaiheittain uudet toiminnallisuudet, rajapinnat ja integraatiot sekä tukea toimintaympäristön, teknologian ja lainsäädännön muutoksia. Hankinnassa tarkastellaan myös erilaisia arkkitehtuurivaihtoehtoja turvalaitteiden ja kaukovalvontapalvelun väliselle kommunikoinnille. Hankintaan kuuluu yhteistyömalli, jossa tilaaja ja toimittaja kehittävät palvelua suunnitelmallisesti ja pitkäjänteisesti. Tavoitteena on kokonaisratkaisu, joka tukee turvalaitteiden elinkaaren hallintaa, tiedon hyödyntämistä ja palvelun jatkuvaa parantamista. Palveluntuottajaksi valitaan yksi (1) toimittaja. Hankinnan kohde, laajuus ja tekniset ratkaisut voivat täsmentyä ja/tai muuttua hankinnan valmistelun ja markkinavuoropuhelun edetessä. ALUSTAVA AIKATAULU Tilaajan tavoiteaikataulu markkinavuoropuhelun ja hankinnan toteuttamiselle on: - Markkinavuoropuhelu (tekninen vuoropuhelu), tammi-helmikuu 2026 - Tarjouspyynnön julkaisu ja laskenta-aika, maalis-huhtikuu 2026 - Tarjousten vertailu ja hankintapäätös, huhti-toukokuu 2026 - Sopimus voimaan ja kehitysprojektin aloitus, vuoden 2026 aikana ----- ILMOITUKSEN LISÄTIEDOT Tämä ilmoitus on ennakkoilmoitus. Tällä ilmoituksella ei pyydetä tarjouksia. Ennakkoilmoitukseen liittyy kutsu markkinavuoropuheluun, jolloin kaikilla hankinnasta kiinnostuneilla toimittajilla on mahdollisuus käydä hankintaa koskevaa teknistä vuoropuhelua Väyläviraston kanssa. Teknisen vuoropuhelun tarkoituksena on käydä yleisellä tasolla vuoropuhelua hankinnan kohteesta ja sen määrittämisestä. Tekninen vuoropuhelu ei sido Väylävirastoa toteuttamaan hankintaa. Tekninen vuoropuhelu ei myöskään sido toimittajaa mahdolliseen tarjouskilpailuun osallistumiseen. Tekninen vuoropuhelu järjestetään tarjouspyyntöaineiston luonnosversioiden kommentoinnin ja tilaajan hankinnan kohteeseen liittyviin kysymyksiin vastaamisen kautta. Ilmoittautumisohje: Toimittajan tulee ilmoittaa kiinnostuksensa osallistua markkinavuoropuheluun 11.2.2026 klo 12.00 mennessä lähettämällä viesti osoitteeseen tommi.aarnio@vayla.fi otsikolla: "Kaukovalvonta - markkinavuoropuhelu". Toimittajaa pyydetään ilmoittamaan viestissä seuraavat tiedot: - toimittajan yhteyshenkilön sähköpostiosoite Tilaaja varaa oikeuden kutsua toimittajia myös kahdenkeskisiin neuvotteluihin tai jatkaa teknistä vuoropuhelua muulla erikseen ilmoitettavalla tavalla, joista ilmoitetaan tarvittaessa myöhemmin. Tässä ennakkoilmoituksessa esitetyt kuvaukset ja hankintailmoituksen arvioitu julkaisupäivämäärä, kuten myös myöhemmin toimitettavat vuoropuhelun luonnosmateriaalit ovat alustavia ja suuntaa antavia hankinnan ennakkotietoja. Osallistuneille yrityksille ei makseta korvausta vastaamisesta tai osallistumisesta.

The Fraport AG Frankfurt Airport Services Worldwide ("Fraport") operates Frankfurt/Main Airport and, in addition, alone or together with third parties, several other airports, terminals and service companies worldwide. The subject matter of this procurement is the following services: -Software & system integration -Fuel dispenser procurement & integration (operational filling station, public filling station, mobile refuelling services) -IT security & operations -Training and documentation -System tests & quality assurance -User & rights management The subject matter of this tender is the supply, installation, commissioning and integration of a modern hardware and software solution for stationary and mobile fuel supply at Frankfurt Airport. The service comprises the equipment of several stationary refuelling systems - consisting of fuel dispensing systems, fuel containers and a staff filling station - with new hardware and software including all necessary components for controlling, monitoring and processing refuelling operations. In addition, the corresponding hardware and software technology is to be provided for five mobile refuelling vehicles to ensure continuous mobile refuelling at Frankfurt Airport. The solution offered must enable the operation of the stationary and mobile refuelling infrastructure in an integrated overall system. In addition, the necessary interfaces for data collection, administration and evaluation of the refuelling operations must be provided.

result.text: As part of the "C-Roads" project (CRG-3), a replacement of the analogue-radio-based public transport prioritisation for motor buses is to be trialled. Unlike in the predecessor project "LOGIN" (Lichtsignalanlagen optimal gesteuert im Nahverkehr - Optimally controlled traffic light systems in local transport), in which a proof of concept for C-ITS-based public transport prioritisation was successfully delivered with the participation of various research partners, C-Roads relies on production-ready hardware available on the market. In addition, integration into the existing IVU Traffic Technologies AG (IVU) ITCS/operations control system is to take place, for instance for the visualisation of signal timing forecasts. For this purpose, ÜSTRA has applied for funding from the European Climate, Infrastructure and Environment Executive Agency (CINEA), which was approved by the grant notification dated 16 October 2024. Co-financing has been approved. ÜSTRA aims to utilise the grants. ÜSTRA therefore expects timely completion of the tendered services. The subject of the tendered service is the delivery and operational provision of an on-board, C-ITS-based public transport prioritisation system, which includes all services for an integrated system. This includes, among other things, the delivery and installation of C-ITS OBUs, antennas as well as the integration between these components up to the interface with the ITCS on-board computer. The system to be tendered is to be implemented and verifiable as a permanently functioning overall system within 15 months of the award of contract. Through the use of a C-ITS-based public transport prioritisation system, a future-proof and standardised system is to be implemented that can be expanded flexibly and independently of manufacturers. The exchange of information with the infrastructure-side C-ITS Roadside Unit (RSU) must take place in accordance with the following standards: • C-Roads Specification Release 3.2.0 C-ITS Message Profiles • ISO 3833 Vehicle Type • ETSI TS 103 301 V2.2.2 • OCA-MAPEM Region-ID-Registry 02-00-01 The C-ITS messages to be used for communication between the C-ITS RSU and OBU are listed below: • CAM • MAPEM • SPAT • SREM • SSEM

parts.source: Im Zuge des Projektes „C-Roads“ (CRG-3), soll eine Ablösung der analogfunkbasierten ÖV-Beschleunigung für Kraftomnibusse erprobt werden. Anders als im Vorgängerprojekt „LOGIN“ (Lichtsignalanlagen optimal gesteuert im Nahverkehr), in welchem unter der Beteiligung von verschiedenen Forschungspartner ein Proof of Concept der C-ITS-basierten ÖV-Beschleunigung erbracht werden konnte, setzt C-Roads auf produktreife Hardware, die am Markt verfügbar ist. Zudem soll die Integration in das bestehende ITCS/Betriebsleitsystem der IVU Traffic Technologies AG (IVU) beispielweise für die Visualisierung von Schaltzeitprognosen erfolgen. Die ÜSTRA hat dazu Zuwendungen der European Climate, Infrastructure and Environment Executive Agency (CINEA) beantragt, die durch Zuwendungsbescheid vom 16. Oktober 2024 bewilligt wurden. Bewilligt wurde eine Anteilsfinanzierung. Die Inanspruchnahme der Zuwendungen wird von der ÜSTRA angestrebt. Daher erwartet die ÜSTRA eine termingerechte Fertigstellung der ausgeschriebenen Leistungen. Gegenstand der ausgeschriebenen Leistung ist die Lieferung und funktionsfähigen Bereitstellung einer fahrzeugseitigen C-ITS basierten ÖV-Beschleunigung, das sämtliche Leistungen für ein integriertes System beinhaltet. Hierzu gehören unter anderem die Lieferung und Installation von C-ITS OBUs, von Antennen als auch die Integration zwischen diesen Komponenten bis hin zur Schnittstelle zum ITCS-Bordrechner. Das anzubietende System soll als dauerhaft funktionierendes Gesamtsystem binnen 15 Monate nach Auftragserteilung implementiert und prüfbar abgerechnet werden. Durch den Einsatz einer C-ITS-basierten ÖV-Beschleunigung soll ein zukunftsfähiges und standardisiertes System umgesetzt werden, das flexibel und Hersteller unabhängig erweitert werden kann. Der Informationsaustausch mit der infrastrukturseitigen C-ITS Roadside Unit (RSU) muss nach den folgenden Standards erfolgen: • C-Roads Specification Release 3.2.0 C-ITS Message Profiles • ISO 3833 Vehicle Type • ETSI TS 103 301 V2.2.2 • OCA-MAPEM Region-ID-Registry 02-00-01 Die zu verwendenden C-ITS-Nachrichten für die Kommunikation zwischen C-ITS RSU und OBU sind folgend aufgelistet: • CAM • MAPEM • SPAT • SREM • SSEM

result.text: The overarching goal of this notice of funding opportunity (NOFO) and its companion opportunities is to establish the Precision Medicine with AI: Integrating Imaging with Multimodal Data (PRIMED-AI) Program to support development of innovative, reliable, cost-effective, and sustainable multimodal AI-based clinical decision support (CDS) tools. PRIMED-AI CDS tools are based on the integration of clinical imaging with other types of multimodal health data to enhance care for patients with a wide range of health conditions. The PRIMED-AI Program seeks to catalyze the adoption of AI-based CDS tools into clinical workflows to enable novel personalized medicine strategies that address significant health challenges.The purpose of this NOFO is to create a Logistics Center for the PRIMED-AI Program to facilitate and coordinate PRIMED-AI activities to maximize impact for the PRIMED-AI community. Within the Logistics Center, three integrated Cores will serve the functions of Administration, Evaluation, and Outreach for the PRIMED-AI Consortium. It is expected that the Logistics Center will work closely with other PRIMED-AI consortium members to collect, curate and disseminate information regarding tools developed by the PRIMED-AI award recipients, and will facilitate widespread access and awareness across the relevant scientific, patient, and clinical communities.

result.text: The subject of the planned procurement is a self-service and transaction system for waste reception and payment as a SaaS service, as well as related hardware to various units of Pirkanmaan jätehuolto Oy. Waste loads from small-scale depositors are received at waste stations and waste centres on a volume or weight basis. Up to now, customers at waste stations and waste centres have been received at a service counter, with the exception of the Vuores and Nekala waste stations, where self-service use has also been made possible. With the system that is the subject of the procurement, however, customers will in future be able to transact at the sites if they wish via a self-service till and/or in advance through the "webshop". The details of the waste loads received at the waste stations are recorded in the self-service and transaction system, into which the details are logged either via a self-service terminal, the webshop or the payment terminal till. The subject of the planned procurement is described in further detail in Annex 1 Description of the subject of the procurement Draft. This is a preliminary draft version, the information presented in which is not binding on the contracting authority. REGISTRATION FOR MARKET DIALOGUE / REQUEST FOR INFORMATION Please note that this notice does not request tenders, but is a notice / request for information concerning a market survey. During the market survey, suppliers interested in the procurement have the opportunity to engage in a market dialogue regarding the procurement with the contracting authority. The purpose of the market dialogue is to hold a general-level discussion on the subject of the procurement and its definition. The market dialogue does not bind the contracting authority to carry out the procurement. Nor does the market dialogue bind a supplier interested in the procurement to participation in any tendering procedure to be implemented later. Suppliers interested in the procurement are requested to communicate their interest in participating in the market dialogue in the Tender Service by 29.12.2025 at 12.00. In the same connection, suppliers are requested to answer the questions presented in the request for information. It is intended to deliver draft material related to the procurement in writing to suppliers interested in the procurement for commenting by email. In addition, the contracting authority may arrange meetings according to need and possibilities. Please note that the description of the procurement and other information presented in this notice / request for information are preliminary and indicative prior information. Those who have participated in the market survey will not be paid compensation for participating in the market dialogue. Hansel Oy acts in a consultative role in the procurement.

Samassa yhteydessä toimittajia pyydetään vastaamaan tietopyynnössä esitettyihin kysymyksiin. Hankinnasta kiinnostuneille toimittajille on tarkoitus toimittaa sähköpostitse hankintaan liittyvää luonnosmateriaalia kirjallisesti kommentoitavaksi. Lisäksi hankintayksikkö saattaa järjestää tapaamisia tarpeen ja mahdollisuuksien mukaan. Huomioittehan, että tässä ilmoituksessa / tietopyynnössä esitetty hankinnan kuvaus ja muut tiedot ovat alustavia ja suuntaa antavia ennakkotietoja. result.text: The Department for Work and Pensions (DWP) established a Dynamic Purchasing System (DPS) to procure Work Focused Activities for Jobcentre Plus Districts in England, Scotland and Wales via the previous DWP eProcurement Solution (ePS). DWP has now migrated to a new ePS, Atamis and DWP are therefore reissuing this notice via the Atamis portal. However, please note that 'online' applications to join the FSF DPS 2 via the Atamis Portal are currently suspended and a temporary 'offline' process is in place, further details are below. The DPS is for the procurement of social and other services referred to in Regulation 74 of the Public Contracts Regulations (2015) and as such, the intention is to use a light touch regime, rather than the full regime described in Regulation 34 (Dynamic Purchasing System). The DPS is for the sole use of DWP. The Flexible Support Fund Dynamic Purchasing System 2 - For the Provision of Work Focused Activities (FSF DPS 2) is the replacement for the DWP Dynamic Purchasing System for provision of work-focused activities known as the Flexible Support Fund DPS (FSF DPS). The FSF DPS expired on 31 October 2021 and was replaced by the FSF DPS 2 with effect from 1 November 2021. Currently the 'online' application process is suspended, and a temporary 'offline' process is in operation. Any new supplier wishing to apply to join the FSF DPS 2 should send an email to cdfsf.adhocprocurement@dwp.gov.uk requesting to apply to join the FSF DPS 2, and the relevant information will be sent to you via email. Although DWP are currently operating an 'offline' process to join the FSF DPS 2, suppliers will still be required to create an account on Atamis. Suppliers can do this via the link below, which will take you to the DWP Atamis landing page. To ensure that the page functions correctly, you must accept browser cookies https://dwp2.my.site.com/s/Welcome From this landing page, new suppliers will be able to create an Atamis account by selecting the "Supplier Registration Here" button and following the on screen instructions. The landing page also has a link to the Supplier Portal Help page, where you will find an article to help with registering for an account https://suppliersupport.atamis.co.uk/hc/en-gb/articles/4613254620319-Registering-with-a-Supplier-Portal Estimated overall value of this DPS will be £250,000,000.00

rejected.text: Following the acquisition of the Hachenburg hospital site by the Evangelisches Klinikum Westerwald, additional requirements have arisen for the existing IT infrastructure and the centrally provided IT services. The Hachenburg site must be integrated organisationally and technically into the client's existing IT landscape. To this end, existing infrastructure components, systems and licences must be expanded as required to enable secure, stable and uniformly administrable IT operations at the acquired site. Specifically, the acquisition of the Hachenburg hospital site leads to an additional requirement for infrastructure components and software licences in several central IT areas. The client's existing IT environment must be expanded accordingly so that the additional systems, end users and applications of the Hachenburg site can be fully integrated into the existing central operational, security, backup and administration structures. In the area of data backup, central backup infrastructures based on NetBackup and Veeam already exist. The integration of the Hachenburg site increases the volume of systems, applications and data sets to be backed up. For workplace provision, the Hachenburg site already has an existing thin-client infrastructure. These existing thin clients form the current technical and functional standard for the workplace environment. In the course of the integration, there is also an additional requirement for workplace systems, meaning the existing thin-client infrastructure must be supplemented with further devices. The additional number of end devices and servers also creates an increased requirement for IT security licences. The existing Sophos licences must be expanded accordingly so that the systems to be added to the central IT environment can be integrated into the existing security infrastructure and protected and centrally managed according to existing security standards. The existing Citrix infrastructure is also affected by the site integration. The additional end users and workplace systems at the Hachenburg site create an additional licence requirement. The existing Citrix licensing must therefore be expanded to ensure the necessary access to the centrally provided applications and desktops for the additional users and workplaces as well. Furthermore, the technical integration gives rise to additional requirements for Microsoft Windows Server licensing. The server resources required for the future operation of the site must be licensed accordingly to ensure a legally compliant and permanently operable state of the expanded server environment. The aim of the tender is the needs-based expansion of the existing IT infrastructure in connection with the acquisition of the Hachenburg hospital site. By procuring additional or to-be-expanded NetBackup components, Veeam licences, Sophos licences, Citrix licences, thin clients and Microsoft Windows Server licences, the technical prerequisites are to be created to integrate the acquired site into the existing IT operating environment in a secure, stable, high-performance and licence-compliant manner. A key objective is the expansion of the existing NetBackup infrastructure in order to reliably integrate the additional systems, applications and data sets of the Hachenburg hospital site into the central data backup and recovery strategy. This is intended to ensure the availability of IT systems, the recoverability of critical data and operational security in the event of faults, failures or data loss in the long term. The procurement includes - the expansion of the already existing Veeam infrastructure - the expansion of the thin-client workplace infrastructure already present at the site - the expansion of the existing Sophos licensing - the expansion of the existing Citrix licensing - the procurement of Microsoft Windows Server licences. The decision to expand the existing Veeam licensing is justified from a technical perspective compared to an additional backup system, as only an expansion of the already productively used Veeam infrastructure guarantees the seamless integration of additional systems into the existing, aligned backup and restore processes without creating incompatible parallel structures. Only by procuring further uniform thin-client software can the existing infrastructure be standardised and operated uniformly. Only thin clients compatible with the existing environment can be integrated into the existing central management, security and configuration mechanisms as well as workplace concepts without re-implementation; switching to a different end-device platform would trigger compatibility checks, adjustments to central applications and additional migration risks. The expansion of the existing Sophos licensing is technically mandatory, as only an expansion of the already implemented Sophos security architecture enables the uniform integration of additional systems into the existing endpoint, XDR/MDR and central monitoring and alerting processes without security gaps. The expansion of the existing Citrix licensing is technically mandatory, as only an expansion of the established Citrix infrastructure can integrate additional workplaces without breaking the existing homogeneous security and access architecture and without validation and adjustment effort for existing applications;
