parts.source: Im Zuge der Übernahme des Krankenhausstandortes Hachenburg durch das Evangelische Klinikum Westerwald ergeben sich zusätzliche Anforderungen an die bestehende IT-Infrastruktur sowie an die zentral bereitgestellten IT-Services. Der Standort Hachenburg ist organisatorisch und technisch in die bestehende IT-Landschaft des Auftraggebers zu integrieren. Hierzu müssen bestehende Infrastrukturkomponenten, Systeme und Lizenzen bedarfsgerecht erweitert werden, um einen sicheren, stabilen und einheitlich administrierbaren IT-Betrieb am übernommenen Standort zu ermöglichen. Konkret führt die Übernahme des Krankenhausstandortes Hachenburg zu einem zusätzlichen Bedarf an Infrastrukturkomponenten und Softwarelizenzen in mehreren zentralen Bereichen der IT. Die bestehende IT-Umgebung des Auftraggebers muss entsprechend erweitert werden, damit die zusätzlichen Systeme, Endanwender und Anwendungen des Standortes Hachenburg vollständig in die bestehenden zentralen Betriebs-, Sicherheits-, Backup- und Administrationsstrukturen integriert werden können. Im Bereich der Datensicherung bestehen bereits zentrale Backup-Infrastrukturen auf Basis von NetBackup und Veeam. Durch die Integration des Standortes Hachenburg steigt der Umfang der zu sichernden Systeme, Anwendungen und Datenbestände. Für die Arbeitsplatzversorgung verfügt der Standort Hachenburg bereits über eine bestehende Thin-Client-Infrastruktur. Diese vorhandenen Thin Clients bilden den bestehenden technischen und funktionalen Standard für die Arbeitsplatzumgebung. Im Zuge der Integration entsteht darüber hinaus ein zusätzlicher Bedarf an Arbeitsplatzsystemen, sodass die bestehende Thin-Client-Infrastruktur durch weitere Geräte ergänzt werden muss. Durch die zusätzliche Anzahl an Endgeräten und Servern entsteht zudem ein erhöhter Bedarf an IT-Sicherheitslizenzen. Die bestehenden Sophos-Lizenzen müssen entsprechend erweitert werden, damit die zusätzlich in die zentrale IT-Umgebung aufzunehmenden Systeme in die vorhandene Sicherheitsinfrastruktur integriert und nach den bestehenden Sicherheitsstandards geschützt und zentral verwaltet werden können. Auch die bestehende Citrix-Infrastruktur ist von der Standortintegration betroffen. Durch die zusätzlichen Endanwender und Arbeitsplatzsysteme des Standortes Hachenburg entsteht ein zusätzlicher Lizenzbedarf. Die bestehende Citrix-Lizenzierung muss daher erweitert werden, um den erforderlichen Zugriff auf die zentral bereitgestellten Anwendungen und Desktops auch für die zusätzlichen Benutzer und Arbeitsplätze sicherstellen zu können. Darüber hinaus entstehen im Rahmen der technischen Integration zusätzliche Anforderungen an die Microsoft Windows Server Lizenzierung. Die für den zukünftigen Betrieb des Standortes erforderlichen Serverressourcen müssen entsprechend lizenziert werden, um einen rechtskonformen und dauerhaft betreibbaren Betrieb der erweiterten Serverumgebung sicherzustellen. Ziel der Ausschreibung ist die bedarfsgerechte Erweiterung der bestehenden IT-Infrastruktur im Zusammenhang mit der Übernahme des Krankenhausstandortes Hachenburg. Durch die Beschaffung zusätzlicher bzw. zu erweiternder NetBackup-Komponenten, Veeam-Lizenzen, Sophos-Lizenzen, Citrix-Lizenzen, Thin Clients sowie Microsoft Windows Server Lizenzen sollen die technischen Voraussetzungen geschaffen werden, um den übernommenen Standort sicher, stabil, performant und lizenzkonform in die bestehende IT-Betriebsumgebung einzubinden. Ein wesentliches Ziel ist die Erweiterung der vorhandenen NetBackup-Infrastruktur, um die zusätzlichen Systeme, Anwendungen und Datenbestände des Krankenhausstandortes Hachenburg zuverlässig in die zentrale Datensicherungs- und Wiederherstellungsstrategie integrieren zu können. Hierdurch sollen die Verfügbarkeit der IT-Systeme, die Wiederherstellbarkeit kritischer Daten sowie die Betriebssicherheit im Falle von Störungen, Ausfällen oder Datenverlusten nachhaltig gewährleistet werden. Die Beschaffung umfasst - die Erweiterung der bereits vorhandenen Veeam-Infrastruktur - die Erweiterung der bereits am Standort vorhandenen Thin-Client-Arbeitsplatzinfrastruktur - die Erweiterung der bestehenden Sophos-Lizenzierung - die Erweiterung der bestehenden Citrix-Lizenzierung - die Beschaffung von Microsoft Windows Server Lizenzen Die Festlegung auf eine Erweiterung der bestehenden Veeam-Lizenzierung ist gegenüber einem zusätzlichen Backup-System aus technischer Sicht gerechtfertigt , da nur eine Erweiterung der bereits produktiv eingesetzten Veeam-Infrastruktur eine nahtlose Einbindung zusätzlicher Systeme in die bestehenden, hierauf abgestimmten Backup- und Restore-Prozesse gewährleistet, ohne inkompatible Parallelstrukturen zu schaffen Nur durch die Beschaffung weiterer einheitlicher ThinClients-Software kann die bestehende Infrastruktur standardisiert und einheitlich betrieben werden. Nur mit der vorhandenen Umgebung kompatible ThinClients können ohne Neuimplementierung in die bestehenden zentralen Management-, Sicherheits- und Konfigurationsmechanismen sowie Arbeitsplatzkonzepte eingebunden werden; ein Wechsel auf eine andere Endgeräteplattform würde Kompatibilitätsprüfungen, Anpassungen an zentrale Anwendungen und zusätzliche Migrationsrisiken auslösen. Die Erweiterung der bestehenden Sophos-Lizenzierung ist technisch zwingend erforderlich, da nur eine Erweiterung der bereits implementierten Sophos-Sicherheitsarchitektur eine einheitliche Einbindung zusätzlicher Systeme in die bestehenden Endpoint-, XDR-/MDR- und zentralen Überwachungs- und Alarmierungsprozesse ohne Sicherheitslücken ermöglicht. Die Erweiterung der bestehenden Citrix-Lizenzierung ist technisch zwingend erforderlich, da nur eine Erweiterung der etablierten Citrix-Infrastruktur zusätzliche Arbeitsplätze ohne Bruch der bestehenden homogenen Sicherheits- und Zugriffsarchitektur und ohne Validierungs- und Anpassungsaufwand für bestehende Anwendungen einbinden kann;

result.text: The provision of temporary and interim staff services to the Scottish Public Sector Lot 1: . The Scottish Procurement and Property Directorate (SPPD) is the organisation tasked with procuring requirements on behalf of Scottish Public Sector Bodies. The current Scottish Government collaborative Temporary and Interim Staff Services Frameworks are a suite of four individual multi supplier Framework Agreements which commenced on 13 April 2023 and are due to expire on 12 April 2027. They are all National Category A Frameworks which are open to all public sector organisations throughout Scotland. They are designed to provide the full range of commonly sought temporary and interim staff services required for daily business. These are national collaborative Frameworks, for commonly required, regularly sought temporary and interim staff services roles/assignments across the Scottish public sector. These Frameworks are intended solely for short term, gap filling purposes and are not intended as an alternative to permanent or fixed term appointment (FTA) recruitment. Work has commenced in developing the procurement strategy options including canvassing of stakeholders views. In order to complete and finalise the strategy, SPPD recognises the value of suppliers having the opportunity to contribute to this process on a non-competitive, non-judgemental basis. This request for information is aimed at collating those views from market participants. Framework participants will be expected to provide a range of Fair Work First measures. This information may be utilised in developing the procurement strategy to help deliver contractual arrangements for Temporary and Interim Staff Services requirements. This notice is issued for information only and does not constitute a call for competition. Scottish Government and the Scottish Ministers shall have no liability for any costs, however incurred, by those attending any information days, attendance at meetings, or involvement in the proposed procurement process. Suppliers and other interested parties should read and complete the following Request for Information Online Questionnaire using the link below. https://forms.office.com/e/cNzCefdZzU The questionnaire will be available for all interested parties until COP 3 March 2026.

result.text: 1 INTRODUCTION The subject matter of the procurement is procurement expert and legal services. This procurement is used to supplement Istekki's own resources in the competitive tendering of public procurements and versatile legal services. The subject matter of the procurement is described in more detail in the preliminary procurement materials, which will be delivered separately. We kindly ask you to submit your response to this request for information concerning the procurement of procurement expert and legal services. We greatly appreciate all the responses we receive, and each of them will be taken into account in the preparation of a potential competitive tendering procedure. The purpose of the request for information is to ensure that those preparing the competitive tendering have as comprehensive and up-to-date a picture of the market and available solutions as possible. With this request for information, we want to map out suppliers' offerings of procurement expert and legal services as well as the market situation for the services. In addition, the purpose is to ensure the appropriateness of the qualitative requirements used in the competitive tendering. At the same time, we aim to familiarise ourselves with products, contract terms and commercial terms, such as pricing, that may be related to the services. 2 ORGANISING THE MARKET DIALOGUE The market dialogue is provisionally to be organised in such a way that the publishable invitation to tender materials will be sent to the tenderers who have participated in the request for information for comments. Based on the responses to the request for information, market dialogue sessions may also be organised where suppliers can present their own services, products and alternative implementation models related to the implementation of the subject matter of the competitive tendering. If market dialogue sessions are organised, they will be conducted in the Finnish language. Istekki will notify the companies participating in the sessions of the more detailed schedules and the Teams meeting link at a later date. 3 RESPONDING TO THE REQUEST FOR INFORMATION We kindly ask you to submit your response by email to the address hankinnat@istekki.fi no later than 11.3.2026. We hope that the responses will be submitted using the separate form attached to this request for information (Appendix 1). It is worth noting that this request for information does not oblige Istekki Oy to carry out the procurement in the manner presented in this document or its appendices. A potential competitive tendering procedure may also not be organised. No separate compensation will be paid for responding to the request for information or participating in presentation sessions. This is a request for information, not a prior information notice, contract notice or invitation to tender. The purpose of the request for information is to familiarise oneself with the market situation and gather information related to the subject matter of the procurement to support the planning of future competitive tendering. Responding to the request for information is voluntary and is not a prerequisite for participation in a potential competitive tendering procedure, nor does it bind Istekki to publish a competitive tendering procedure. Please note that the information, descriptions and estimates of the schedule for the competitive tendering presented in this request for information are preliminary and indicative. The final schedules will be refined as the preparation progresses. We appreciate the information provided by suppliers, as it helps us build the future competitive tendering into as functional and clear a whole as possible.

parts.source: 1 JOHDANTO Hankinnan kohteena on hankinta-asiantuntijan ja juristipalvelut. Tätä hankintaa käytetään täydentämään Istekin omia resursseja julkisten hankintojen kilpailuttamisessa ja monipuolisissa juristipalveluissa. Tarkemmin hankinnan kohdetta kuvataan alustavissa hankintamateriaaleissa, jotka toimitetaan erikseen. Pyydämme teitä toimittamaan vastauksenne tähän hankinta‐asiantuntija- ja juristipalveluiden hankintaa koskevaan tietopyyntöön. Arvostamme suuresti kaikkia saamiamme vastauksia, ja jokainen niistä huomioidaan mahdollisen kilpailutuksen valmistelussa. Tietopyynnön tarkoituksena on varmistaa, että kilpailutuksen valmistelijoilla on käytössään mahdollisimman kattava ja ajantasainen kuva markkinoista sekä tarjolla olevista ratkaisuista. Tällä tietopyynnöllä haluamme kartoittaa toimittajien tarjontaa hankinta‐asiantuntija- ja juristipalveluista sekä palveluiden markkinatilannetta. Lisäksi tarkoituksena on varmistaa kilpailutuksessa käytettävien laadullisten vaatimusten asianmukaisuus. Samalla pyrimme tutustumaan palveluihin mahdollisesti liittyviin tuotteisiin, sopimusehtoihin sekä kaupallisiin ehtoihin, kuten hinnoitteluun. 2 MARKKINAVUOROPUHELUN JÄRJESTÄMINEN Markkinavuoropuhelu tullaan alustavasti järjestämään siten, että tietopyyntöön osallistuneille tarjoajille lähetetään julkaistavat tarjouspyyntömateriaalit kommentoitavaksi. Tietopyynnön vastausten perusteella voidaan järjestää myös markkinavuoropuhelutilaisuuksia, joissa toimittajat voivat esitellä omia palveluitaan, tuotteitaan ja vaihtoehtoisia toteutusmalleja kilpailutuksen kohteen toteutukseen liittyen. Mikäli markkinavuoropuhelutilaisuuksia järjestetään, ne toteutetaan suomen kielellä. Istekki ilmoittaa tilaisuuksiin osallistuville yrityksille tarkemmat aikataulut sekä Teams-kokouslinkin myöhemmin. 3 TIETOPYYNTÖÖN VASTAAMINEN Pyydämme toimittamaan vastauksenne sähköpostitse osoitteeseen hankinnat@istekki.fi viimeistään 11.3.2026. Toivomme, että vastaukset toimitetaan erillisellä lomakkeella, joka on tämän tietopyynnön liitteenä (Liite 1). On hyvä huomioida, että tämä tietopyyntö ei velvoita Istekki Oy:tä toteuttamaan hankintaa tässä asiakirjassa tai sen liitteissä esitetyllä tavalla. Mahdollinen tarjouskilpailu voidaan myös jättää järjestämättä. Tietopyyntöön vastaamisesta tai esittelytilaisuuksiin osallistumisesta ei makseta erillistä korvausta. Kyseessä on tietopyyntö, ei ennakkoilmoitus, hankintailmoitus tai tarjouspyyntö. Tietopyynnön tarkoituksena on tutustua markkinatilanteeseen ja kerätä hankinnan kohteeseen liittyvää tietoa tulevan kilpailutuksen suunnittelun tueksi. Tietopyyntöön vastaaminen on vapaaehtoista, eikä se ole edellytys mahdolliseen tarjouskilpailuun osallistumiselle eikä sido Istekkiä julkaisemaan tarjouskilpailua. Huomioithan, että tässä tietopyynnössä esitetyt tiedot, kuvaukset ja arviot kilpailutuksen aikataulusta ovat alustavia ja suuntaa antavia. Lopulliset aikataulut tarkentuvat valmistelun edetessä. Arvostamme toimittajien antamaa tietoa, sillä se auttaa meitä rakentamaan tulevasta kilpailutuksesta mahdollisimman toimivan ja selkeän kokonaisuuden.

rejected.text: The project "Supporting a Just Transition in Mexico" aims to strengthen the capacities of key public, private and civil society actors to design and implement socially just decarbonisation processes in strategic sectors of the Mexican economy, with a particular focus on key industrial (incl. industrial parks) and the energy sector. The project is commissioned by the German Federal Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development (BMZ) and implemented by GIZ, with the Mexican Ministry of Economy (SE) as technical partner. It contributes to the BMZ core theme "Climate and energy", to Mexico's implementation of the Paris Agreement and Agenda 2030 SDGs 13, 9, 7, 5, 16 and 17. Mexico's export-oriented industrial model, the rapid expansion of industrial parks and rising energy demand create pressure and opportunities for low-carbon transformation. Building on the updated climate targets set out in Mexico's Nationally Determined Contribution (NDC), the country faces the challenge of turning these commitments into coherent implementation. Regulatory gaps, insufficient technical and financial capacities, and social and gender inequalities still limit progress towards a decarbonised economy. The project responds to these challenges by promoting an integrated approach that combines climate protection, industrial competitiveness and social justice. The overall objective is to strengthen the capacities of key actors to implement just transition processes in strategic sectors of the Mexican economy. To achieve this, the project supports the development of participatory governance frameworks for a just transition. Multistakeholder dialogue formats will foster coordination between federal and subnational authorities, the private sector, financial institutions, workers' representatives and civil society organisations. At the meso and micro levels, the project aims to improve the enabling conditions for the adoption of green technologies by companies and industrial parks in selected sectors. This includes technical and economic feasibility studies, advisory services on energy-efficient and renewable energy solutions, and targeted capacity development for park operators, firms and service providers, with special attention to SMEs and the qualification of women and groups in vulnerable situations for future-oriented jobs. In addition, the project works with public development banks and other financial institutions to align their product portfolios with the needs of companies and park operators investing in green technologies and sustainable infrastructure. Together with public institutions, private sector actors and social partners, it will pilot mechanisms to identify and mitigate negative social impacts of industrial transformation, and to ensure that women and other groups in vulnerable situations benefit from new economic opportunities. result.text: All support is expected to systematically address social and gender dimensions, in line with the project's just transition approach. A second core area involves in-depth analytical work on mitigation potential and decarbonisation pathways for selected industrial parks and industrial clusters. This may include the development of emissions baselines and marginal abatement cost curves, scenario modelling for different technology and investment options, and the analysis of economic, social and environmental co-benefits under a just transition perspective. The contractor will work closely with GIZ and national partners to define the scope of these analyses and to translate findings into practical recommendations for policymakers, industrial park operators, companies and financial institutions. A third area of work is strategic communication and knowledge management. The contractor will support the development of narratives around just transition in the Mexican industrial sector and will produce communication and knowledge products such as policy briefs, reports, infographics, editorial and audiovisual materials. The services may also include conceptual and organisational support to events, dialogue formats and peer-learning activities, to disseminate lessons learned and good practices from pilot interventions in industrial parks and other industrial contexts. A fourth area focuses on capacity development. The contractor will design and implement training formats, workshops and other learning tools for key actors at national and subnational levels, including public institutions, industrial park operators, companies, financial institutions, academia and civil society. These activities aim to strengthen technical competencies and practical know-how on just transition, industrial decarbonisation, green and climate finance, circular economy and energy transition, with particular attention to the inclusion of women and groups in vulnerable situations. The contract is expected to run from February 2027 to August 2028. Primary target groups include key actors from the energy, industrial sectors and industrial park operators, as well as state-level economic and environmental authorities and relevant federal institutions. Secondary target groups comprise affected communities, labour representatives, civil society organisations and academic institutions. The assignment builds on and complements cooperation with national and international partners, including UNIDO, Mexican state-level associations such as AMSDE and ANAAE, and the Mexican Association of Private Industrial Parks (AMPIP). To deliver these services, the contractor is expected to provide a multidisciplinary expert team. This includes a team leader with strong experience in industrial decarbonisation and just transition, as well as experts in energy, industrial technologies and eco-industrial park developments, green and climate finance, social and gender impact analysis, strategic communication and capacity development. A pool of additional short-term specialists with national and international experience should be available to cover specific thematic and methodological needs. Bidders are expected to demonstrate substantial experience in climate change mitigation, industrial and energy transitions, and collaboration with public and private stakeholders, and previous work with international cooperation, preferably in Mexico or Latin America. The services will be delivered through a combination of on-demand support and the implementation of result-oriented activities and milestones agreed with GIZ. The assignment includes robust project and knowledge management, results-based monitoring and regular reporting, and must comply with GIZ requirements on data protection, information security, gender equality and environmental and climate safeguards.

result.text: The Norwegian Defence Materiel Agency (FMA) is the contracting authority and responsible for implementing the procurement. FMA is a part of the defence sector, directly under the Ministry of Defence (FD). FMA shall ensure that the Norwegian Armed Forces and other entities in the defence sector have access to cost efficient and secure material and services in line with approved long-term plans. FMA ́s main assignments are planning, procurement, management and disposal of material for the Norwegian Armed Forces and other departments under FD. Organisational reasons can be required during the contract period to transfer the resource to Cyber Defence ́s IT Department (CIT) DRIV. DRIV is responsible for the technical operation and further development (DEVSECOPS) of the Joint Integrated Management System (FIF). FIF is a SAP ERP system integrated with a number of other different applications. Internal processes are based on flexible frameworks (Scrum, SAFE), the Security Act and different industry standards for safety and ITIL for operation. DRIV consists of approx. 150 persons, most of whom are located in Oslo. Both employees and consultants staff the organisation. The aim of this notice is to fill the role of Process Consultant for Signavio modelling and integrations between SolutionManager 7.2 and Signavio in project P1160 "Critical Upgrade of ERP". The role shall contribute with competence in modelling in Signavio, assistance with the integration between Signavio and SolutionManager 7.2 and assist teams in process modelling. The role will work closely with the manager of Value Management Office, the solution architects and the different product teams. The role can involve cooperation with other departments and/or projects in the Norwegian Armed Forces.

result.text: The subject of this tender is the design, development and prototypical implementation of a system for the automated detection of dead branches within the infrastructure of Autobahn GmbH des Bundes. Functional specification: AI-based detection of dead branches 1. Introduction and objectives The subject of this tender is the design, development and prototypical implementation of a system for the automated detection of dead branches within the infrastructure of Autobahn GmbH des Bundes. The objective is to provide a digital tool that supports visual inspection through AI-based image analysis, thereby significantly increasing the efficiency and safety of maintenance measures. The specific technical implementation is at the discretion of the bidders. All relevant legal and regulatory requirements must be complied with during the design, development and implementation of the AI system. In particular, the contractor must ensure that the AI system to be developed is in accordance with the requirements of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 on Artificial Intelligence (AI Act), insofar as it is applicable.2. Functional requirements for the system (service programme) The service to be provided must fulfil the following core functions, which must be demonstrated in a proof-of-concept (PoC) and in a subsequent prototypical application. 2.1. Data acquisition The system must be capable of capturing visual data (images or video sequences) from a mobile unit (e.g. a vehicle) in a quality suitable for AI analysis. Function: Automated and continuous capture of image material of the surrounding tree landscape. 2.2. AI algorithm for image evaluation The core of the application is an AI algorithm that performs an automated analysis of the captured image data. Function: Automatic detection, classification and spatial localisation (positioning) of dead branches. Requirement: The algorithm must achieve a defined minimum hit rate and reliability under various environmental conditions (daylight, shadows, weather). The results must be clearly assignable and traceable. 2.3. Frontend application (user interface) The system must provide a user-friendly interface for displaying and managing the analysis results. Function: Graphical processing of the AI results for practical use. Requirement: The frontend must enable a clear display of the detected dead branches on a map. In addition, the frontend must contain functions for validation, commenting and approval of the results by the user. 2.4. Data management and interfaces Requirement: A self-sufficient system must be offered which enables data entry and data integration and whose results can be viewed. Integration into existing IT systems of Autobahn GmbH is not intended and is not required. The AI system will be operated entirely by the contractor. The contractor must provide the data and analysis results generated during the provision of the service in electronic form. Formats must be used that are both readable by the contracting authority and machine-processable. Further technical interfaces or system connections are not part of the service to be provided. 3. Non-functional requirements Beyond the functions mentioned, the following qualities of the system are important: Scalability: The system must be designed in such a way that it can be expanded to larger data volumes and further areas of application if required. IT security: The entire architecture and data processing must comply with current IT security standards, particularly with regard to the protection of data and systems in critical infrastructure. Maintainability: The system should be designed so that it can be easily maintained and further developed. The usage rights for the developed software (AI) remain exclusively with Autobahn GmbH des Bundes. 4. Project result Proof of functionality (PoC): After the first phase, a functional proof (PoC) must be provided that demonstrates the feasibility of the AI-based detection. Prototypical application: The final result is a fully functional, prototypical application that meets all the functional and non-functional requirements mentioned above and can be tested in practice. Note: The decision regarding the specific technical implementation (e.g. programming languages used, specific AI frameworks, etc.) is left to the bidders. The decisive factor is the fulfilment of the described functions and objectives. The contract duration is 24 months from the start of the contract. Within this period, the AI system must be fully developed and provided. The data deliveries in accordance with section 2.4 must also be provided regularly within this period.

parts.source: Gegenstand dieser Ausschreibung ist die Konzeption, Entwicklung und prototypische Umsetzung eines Systems zur automatisierten Detektion von Totästen innerhalb der Infrastruktur der Autobahn GmbH des Bundes Funktionale Leistungsbeschreibung: KI-basierte Detektion von Totästen 1. Einführung und Zielstellung Gegenstand dieser Ausschreibung ist die Konzeption, Entwicklung und prototypische Umsetzung eines Systems zur automatisierten Detektion von Totästen innerhalb der Infrastruktur der Autobahn GmbH des Bundes. Ziel ist, ein digitales Werkzeug bereitzustellen, das die visuelle Inspektion durch eine KI-basierte Bildanalyse unterstützt und somit die Effizienz und Sicherheit der Instandhaltungsmaßnahmen signifikant erhöht. Die konkrete technische Umsetzung liegt im Ermessen der Bieter. Bei der Konzeption, Entwicklung und Umsetzung des KI-Systems sind alle einschlägigen gesetzlichen und regulatorischen Vorgaben einzuhalten. Der Auftragnehmer hat insbesondere sicherzustellen, dass das zu entwickelnde KI-System im Einklang mit den Anforderungen der Verordnung (EU) 2024/1689 über Künstliche Intelligenz (KI-Verordnung - KI-VO) steht, soweit diese anwendbar ist.2. Funktionale Anforderungen an das System (Leistungsprogramm) Die zu erbringende Leistung muss folgende Kernfunktionen erfüllen, die in einem Proof-of-Concept /Machbarkeitsnachweis (PoC) und in einer darauf aufbauenden prototypischen Anwendung nachzuweisen sind. 2.1. Datenerfassung Das System muss in der Lage sein, visuelle Daten (Bilder oder Videosequenzen) aus einer mobilen Einheit (z. B. einem Fahrzeug) in einer für die KI-Analyse geeigneten Qualität zu erfassen. Funktion: Automatisierte und kontinuierliche Erfassung von Bildmaterial der umgebenden Baumlandschaft. 2.2. KI-Algorithmus zur Bildauswertung Das Herzstück der Anwendung ist ein KI-Algorithmus, der eine automatisierte Analyse der erfassten Bilddaten vornimmt. Funktion: Automatische Erkennung, Klassifizierung und räumliche Lokalisierung (Positionierung) von Totästen. Anforderung: Der Algorithmus muss eine definierte Mindesttrefferquote und Zuverlässigkeit in verschiedenen Umgebungsbedingungen (Tageslicht, Schattenwurf, Witterung) erreichen. Die Ergebnisse müssen eindeutig zuzuordnen und nachvollziehbar sein. 2.3. Frontend-Anwendung (Benutzeroberfläche) Das System muss eine benutzerfreundliche Schnittstelle zur Darstellung und Verwaltung der Analyseergebnisse bereitstellen. Funktion: Grafische Aufbereitung der KI-Ergebnisse für den Praxiseinsatz Anforderung: Das Frontend muss eine übersichtliche Darstellung der detektierten Totäste auf einer Karte ermöglichen. Zudem müssen im Frontend Funktionen zur Validierung, Kommentierung und Freigabe der Ergebnisse durch den Nutzer enthalten sein. 2.4. Datenmanagement und Schnittstellen Anforderung: Ein autarkes System muss angeboten werden, welches die Möglichkeit zur Datenbefüllung- und Datenintegration ermöglicht und dessen Ergebnisse einsehbar sind. Eine Integration in bestehende IT-Systeme der Autobahn GmbH ist nicht vorgesehen und nicht erforderlich. Das KI-System wird vollständig durch den Auftragnehmer betrieben. Der Auftragnehmer hat die im Rahmen der Leistungserbringung generierten Daten und Analyseergebnisse in elektronischer Form bereitzustellen. Dabei sind Formate zu verwenden, die sowohl für die Auftraggeberin lesbar als auch maschinell weiterverarbeitbar sind. Weitere technische Schnittstellen oder Systemanbindungen sind nicht Bestandteil der zu erbringenden Leistung. 3. Nicht-funktionale Anforderungen Über die genannten Funktionen hinaus, sind folgenden Qualitäten des Systems von Bedeutung: Skalierbarkeit: Das System muss so konzipiert sein, dass es bei Bedarf auf größere Datenmengen und weitere Einsatzgebiete ausgeweitet werden kann. IT-Sicherheit: Die gesamte Architektur und die Datenverarbeitung müssen den aktuellen IT-Sicherheitsstandards entsprechen, insbesondere in Bezug auf den Schutz von Daten und Systemen in kritischen Infrastrukturen. Wartbarkeit: Das System soll so konzipiert sein, dass es einfach gewartet und weiterentwickelt werden kann. Die Nutzungsrechte der entwickelten Software (KI) verbleiben ausschließlich bei der Autobahn GmbH des Bundes. 4. Projektergebnis Nachweis der Funktionsfähigkeit (PoC): Nach der ersten Phase ist ein funktionsfähiger Nachweis (PoC) zu erbringen, der die Machbarkeit der KI-basierten Detektion demonstriert. Prototypische Anwendung: Das finale Ergebnis ist eine voll funktionsfähige, prototypische Anwendung, die alle oben genannten funktionalen und nicht-funktionalen Anforderungen erfüllt und in der Praxis getestet werden kann. Hinweis: Die Entscheidung über die konkrete technische Umsetzung (z. B. verwendete Programmiersprachen, spezifische KI-Frameworks etc.) bleibt den Bietern überlassen. Entscheidend ist die Erfüllung der beschriebenen Funktionen und Ziele. Die Vertragslaufzeit beträgt 24 Monate ab Vertragsbeginn. Innerhalb dieses Zeitraums ist das KI-System vollständig zu entwickeln und bereitzustellen. Die Datenlieferungen gemäß Abschnitt 2.4 sind ebenfalls innerhalb dieses Zeitraums regelmäßig zu erbringen.

rejected.text: Diese Markterkundung erfolgt gemäß § 26 SektVO. Sie dient ausschließlich der Vorbereitung einer europaweiten Ausschreibung. Die Braunschweig Beteiligungen GmbH (BSBG) ist eine hundertprozentige Tochtergesellschaft der Stadt Braunschweig. result.text: The subject of the contract is the lot-by-lot supply, installation, integration and commissioning of software solutions for radiation therapy at St. Elisabethen-Klinikum Ravensburg, a site of Oberschwabenklinik gGmbH. Lot 1 comprises an SGRT system (Surface Guided Radiation Therapy) including all necessary software components for patient positioning and monitoring as well as integration into the existing IT and LINAC infrastructure. Lot 2 comprises the treatment planning software (Treatment Planning System, TPS) for irradiation planning for photons and electrons, including installation, data migration from the legacy system, training of operating personnel and maintenance/support. Both lots will be awarded under a negotiated procedure with a call for competition. Tenderers may apply for one or both lots. Contract execution will take place during ongoing clinical operations. The subject of this lot is the supply, installation, integration and commissioning of a system for surface-guided radiation therapy (Surface Guided Radiation Therapy, SGRT) including all necessary software and hardware components for patient positioning and monitoring. The service includes complete connection to the hospital's existing linear accelerator and IT infrastructure, training of operating personnel as well as maintenance and support over the envisaged period.; A treatment planning system (TPS) for the radiation therapy of Oberschwabenklinik gGmbH is being procured. The system is intended to enable the planning of photon-guided irradiations with the existing linear accelerators while supporting all relevant clinical workflows (3D-CRT, IMRT, VMAT). Complete integration into the existing IT and PACS environment is expected, including interfaces to the R&V system, DICOM-RT and archiving system. The service includes supply, installation, commissioning, validation, training of specialist personnel and maintenance.

result.text: The USAMRDC’s mission is to provide solutions to medical problems of importance to the American Service Member at home and abroad, as well as to the general public at large. The scope of this effort and the priorities attached to specific projects are influenced by changes in military and civilian medical science and technology (S&T), operational requirements, military threat assessments, and national defense strategies. Extramural research and development programs play a vital role in the fulfillment of the objectives established by the USAMRDC. General information on the USAMRDC can be obtained at https://mrdc.health.mil/. This BAA is intended to solicit extramural research and development ideas using the authority provided by 10 USC 4001. The BAA is issued under the provisions of the Competition in Contracting Act of 1984 (Public Law 98-369), as implemented in FAR 6.102(d)(2) and 35.016 and in Department of Defense Grant and Agreement Regulations (DoDGARs) 22.315. In accordance with FAR 35.016, projects funded under this BAA must be for basic and applied research to support scientific study and experimentation directed toward advancing the state-of-the-art or increasing knowledge or understanding rather than focusing on development of a specific system or hardware solution. Research and development funded through this BAA are intended and expected to benefit and inform both military and civilian medical practice and knowledge. This BAA utilizes competitive procedures in accordance with 10 USC 3012 for the selection for award of S&T proposals/applications. For the purposes of this BAA, S&T includes activities involving basic research, applied research, advanced technology development, and, under certain conditions, may include activities involving advanced component development and prototypes. The selection process is highly competitive, and the quantity of meaningful submissions (both pre-proposals/pre-applications and full proposals/applications) received typically exceeds the number of awards that available funding can support. This BAA provides a general description of USAMRDC’s research and development programs, including Research Areas of Interest, evaluation and selection criteria, pre-proposal/ pre-application and full proposal/application preparation instructions, and general administrative information. Specific submission information and additional administrative requirements can be found in the document titled, “General Submission Instructions,” which is available on Grants.gov along with this BAA. The FY23-FY27 USAMRDC BAA is continuously open for a 5-year period, from October 1, 2022 through September 30, 2027, at 11:59 p.m. Eastern Time. Submission of a pre-proposal/pre-application is required and must be submitted through the electronic Biomedical Research Application Portal (eBRAP) (https://eBRAP.org/). Pre-proposals/pre-applications may be submitted at any time throughout the 5-year period. If the USAMRDC is interested in receiving a full proposal/application, the Principal Investigator will be sent an invitation to submit via eBRAP. A full proposal/application must be submitted through Grants.gov (http://www.grants.gov/). Invited full proposals/applications can be submitted under this FY23-FY27 BAA through September 30, 2027.

parts.source: Tämä ei ole hankintailmoitus eikä tarjouspyyntö, vaan tietopyyntö, jolla Etelä-Karjalan hyvinvointialue kartoittaa digitaalisia kokonaisratkaisuja henkilökohtaisen avun työnantajamallin sijaismaksajuuden hallinnointiin ja toteuttamiseen sekä omaishoidon, perhehoidon ym. palkkioperusteisten sopimusten hallintaan ja palkkioiden sekä muiden kulujen yms. ja lakisääteisten viranomaismaksujen maksatukseen. Kartoituksen tavoitteena on selvittää, millaisia alla kuvattuja toiminnallisuuksia sisältäviä kokonaisratkaisuja on saatavilla Suomen markkinoilla. Markkinavuoropuhelun avulla hyvinvointialue pyrkii: 1. Saamaan tietoa markkinoiden tarjonnasta ja eri toimittajien ratkaisuista 2. Mahdolliset integraatioiden toteutus eri alustoille tai järjestelmiin 3. Arvioimaan tietoturvan ja tietosuojan toteutusta 4. Saamaan yleiskuvan hinnoittelumalleista ja kustannusrakenteista (ei yksittäisiä tarjouksia) 5. Kartoittamaan toimitus- ja palvelumalleja Markkinavuoropuhelu on avoin kaikille toimittajille, joilla on tarjota tämän ratkaisukokonaisuuden piiriin kuuluvia kokonaisratkaisuja. Vuoropuhelun painopisteenä ovat ratkaisut, jotka ovat jo tuotannossa. Toimittajia pyydetään esittelemään palveluita, jotka ovat käytettävissä ja joissa keskeiset toiminnallisuudet ovat valmiiksi toteutettuja. Kehitteillä olevien tai vasta konseptitasolla olevien ratkaisujen esittelyä ei tässä yhteydessä toivota. Ilmoittautumisen yhteydessä toimittajia pyydetään lyhyesti kuvaamaan: Käyttötarkoitus ja -ympäristö Järjestelmän tulee soveltua hyvinvointialueen käyttöön seuraavien palvelumuotojen hallintaan: - Omaishoidon tuki ja sopimusten hallinta - Perhehoidon toimeksiantosopimukset - Henkilökohtaisen avun työnantajamallin sijaismaksajuus - Tukiperheiden ja tukihenkilöiden sopimusten hallinta - Muut vastaavat toimeksiantosuhteet Käyttäjäryhmiä ovat: - Hyvinvointialueen työntekijät (sopimusten hallinta) - Omais- ja perhehoitajat (tietojen kirjaus) - Henkilökohtaiset avustajat ja heidän työnantajansa - Muut toimeksiantosuhteessa olevat henkilöt Keskeiset toiminnallisuudet Sopimusten hallinta: - Sähköinen toimeksiantosopimusten laatiminen ja ylläpito - Sopimusten elinkaaren hallinta - Hoitopäivien ja työaikojen kirjaaminen - Lakisääteisten vapaiden hallinnointi Palkkioiden ja palkkojen käsittely: - Palkkioiden laskenta hoitoisuusluokkien mukaisesti - Henkilökohtaisten avustajien palkanlaskenta - Lakisääteiset maksut ja pidätykset - Sijaishoitajien palkkioiden käsittely - Indeksikorotusten automaattinen huomiointi Maksunvälitys: - Finanssivalvonnan hyväksymä maksunvälitystoiminta - Automaattinen maksujen käsittely - Maksuaineistojen muodostaminen Integraatiot: - Suora tiedonsiirtoyhteys Verohallintoon - Mahdollisuus integroitua hyvinvointialueen muihin järjestelmiin, erityisesti liittymä kirjanpitojärjestelmään - Tietojen vienti ja raportointi (Tietoallas) - Käyttäjätunnusten hallinnointi Entra ID:n kautta Tekniset vaatimukset - Pilvipohjainen SaaS-ratkaisu - Tietoturva-auditoitu järjestelmä - Suomenkielinen käyttöliittymä - Saavutettavuusdirektiivin mukainen toteutus - Jatkuva ylläpito ja päivitykset - Käyttötuki suomeksi Pyydämme teitä vastaamaan seuraaviin kysymyksiin: Ratkaisun yleiskuvaus - Onko teillä tarjolla yllä kuvattuja toiminnallisuuksia sisältävä järjestelmäratkaisu? - Mikä on ratkaisunne nimi ja lyhyt kuvaus? - Mitkä ovat ratkaisunne keskeiset vahvuudet? Toiminnallisuudet - Miten ratkaisunne täyttää kuvatut sopimustenhallinnan tarpeet? - Millaisia palkkioiden ja palkkojen laskentaominaisuuksia järjestelmä sisältää? - Onko ratkaisullanne Finanssivalvonnan lupa maksunvälitykseen? - Miten Verohallinto-integraatio on toteutettu? Tekniset ominaisuudet - Millainen on ratkaisun tekninen arkkitehtuuri? - Miten tietoturva on varmistettu? - Mitä kielivaihtoehtoja järjestelmä tukee? Kokemukset ja referenssit - Missä hyvinvointialueilla/kunnissa ratkaisuanne on käytössä? - Kuinka monta käyttäjää järjestelmällä on? - Voitteko toimittaa referenssitietoja vastaavista toimituksista? Lisätiedot - Mitä muita oleellisia ominaisuuksia ratkaisunne sisältää? - Miten järjestelmän käyttöönotto tyypillisesti toteutetaan? - Millaista tukea ja koulutusta tarjoatte? Markkinavuoropuhelukutsu ei sido vastaajaa (Toimittajaa) tarjouskilpailuun osallistumiseen, eikä tähän ilmoitukseen vastaaminen ole edellytyksenä myöhemmin varsinaiseen tarjouskilpailuun osallistumiselle. Markkinakartoitukseen osallistuvilla ei ole oikeutta saada korvausta osallistumisesta. Hankintayksikkö ei sitoudu toteuttamaan asianomaista hankintaa. Päätökset mahdollisen hankintaprosessin käynnistämisestä tehdään markkinakartoituksen jälkeen. Toimitettu materiaali käsitellään luottamuksellisena julkisuuslain 24 §:n 1 momentin 20 kohdan mukaan. Etelä-Karjalan hyvinvointialue kiittää etukäteen vastauksistanne. Ne ovat arvokkaita järjestelmätarpeidemme määrittelyssä ja mahdollisen hankinnan valmistelussa.

result.text: BREPARK GmbH intends to introduce a central service portal for the digitisation and optimisation of customer management and the associated business processes. BREPARK GmbH intends to introduce a central service portal for the digitisation and optimisation of customer management and the associated business processes. The future system is intended to serve as a central platform for the management of customers, contracts, access media, billing and communication with customers. The planned scope of services comprises in particular the provision, setup, adaptation and operation of an integrated service portal with the following components: End customer portal (EKP): A digital portal through which customers can independently use services provided by BREPARK GmbH. These include in particular registration, management of customer data, conclusion and management of contracts, viewing of parking sessions and invoices as well as communication with BREPARK GmbH. Employee portal (MA portal): A central user interface for employees of BREPARK GmbH for the management and processing of customer cases. This includes in particular the maintenance of customer data, processing of contract enquiries, management of contracts and access media, execution of review and approval processes as well as support for internal administrative processes. Business customer portal (GKP): The solution must provide a business customer portal through which authorised business customers can independently manage their contract-related data and access permissions. BREPARK manages various parking facilities on behalf of third parties and manages, among other things, long-term parking permissions for business customers. Currently, around 7.000 access media for business customers are supported. The aim is to provide business customers with a digital option for independently managing their permissions and access media and thereby simplify administrative processes. The service portal is to be integrated into the existing system landscape of BREPARK GmbH. This includes in particular the connection to SAP Business ByDesign as the leading ERP system as well as the necessary interfaces to existing parking management and access systems. The contractor must provide an operational overall system which fulfils the requirements of this specification of services and enables the further development of the digital customer processes of BREPARK GmbH. In addition to the provision of the software, the scope of services includes the necessary configuration, customising, integration into the existing system landscape, data migration, execution of tests, commissioning as well as the necessary training, maintenance and support services for ongoing operation. Implementation takes place as an overall system. The contractor bears responsibility for the overall technical and functional integration of all necessary components and interfaces.

parts.source: Die BREPARK GmbH beabsichtigt die Einführung eines zentralen Serviceportals zur Digitalisie-rung und Optimierung der Kundenverwaltung sowie der damit verbundenen Geschäftsprozesse. Die BREPARK GmbH beabsichtigt die Einführung eines zentralen Serviceportals zur Digitalisie-rung und Optimierung der Kundenverwaltung sowie der damit verbundenen Geschäftsprozesse. Das zukünftige System soll als zentrale Plattform für die Verwaltung von Kund:innen, Verträgen, Zugangsmedien, Abrechnungen und der Kommunikation mit Kund:innen dienen. Der geplante Leistungsumfang umfasst insbesondere die Bereitstellung, Einrichtung, Anpassung und den Betrieb eines integrierten Serviceportals mit folgenden Komponenten: Endkundenportal (EKP): Ein digitales Portal, über das Kund:innen eigenständig Dienstleistungen der BREPARK GmbH nut-zen können. Hierzu gehören insbesondere die Registrierung, Verwaltung von Kundendaten, Ab-schluss und Verwaltung von Verträgen, Einsicht in Parkvorgänge und Rechnungen sowie die Kom-munikation mit der BREPARK GmbH. Mitarbeitenden-Portal (MA-Portal): Eine zentrale Arbeitsoberfläche für Mitarbeitende der BREPARK GmbH zur Verwaltung und Bear-beitung von Kundenvorgängen. Dies umfasst insbesondere die Pflege von Kundendaten, Bearbei-tung von Vertragsanfragen, Verwaltung von Verträgen und Zugangsmedien, Durchführung von Prüf- und Freigabeprozessen sowie die Unterstützung der internen Verwaltungsprozesse. Geschäftskundenportal (GKP): Die Lösung muss ein Geschäftskunden-Portal bereitstellen, über das berechtigte Geschäftskun-den ihre vertragsbezogenen Daten und Zugangsberechtigungen eigenständig verwalten können. BREPARK bewirtschaftet im Auftrag Dritter verschiedene Parkeinrichtungen und verwaltet dabei unter anderem Dauerparkberechtigungen für Geschäftskunden. Aktuell werden rund 7.000 Zu-gangsmedien für Geschäftskunden betreut. Ziel ist es, den Geschäftskunden eine digitale Möglichkeit zur eigenständigen Verwaltung ihrer Berechtigungen und Zugangsmedien bereitzustellen und dadurch administrative Prozesse zu ver-einfachen. Das Serviceportal ist in die bestehende Systemlandschaft der BREPARK GmbH zu integrieren. Hierzu gehören insbesondere die Anbindung an SAP Business ByDesign als führendes ERP-System sowie die erforderlichen Schnittstellen zu bestehenden Parkabfertigungs- und Zugangs-systemen. Der Auftragnehmer hat ein betriebsfähiges Gesamtsystem bereitzustellen, welches die Anforde-rungen dieser Leistungsbeschreibung erfüllt und die Weiterentwicklung der digitalen Kundenpro-zesse der BREPARK GmbH ermöglicht. Der Leistungsumfang umfasst neben der Bereitstellung der Software auch die erforderliche Konfiguration, das Customizing, die Integration in die beste-hende Systemlandschaft, die Datenmigration, die Durchführung von Tests, die Inbetriebnahme sowie die erforderlichen Schulungs-, Pflege- und Supportleistungen für den laufenden Betrieb. Die Umsetzung erfolgt als Gesamtsystem. Der Auftragnehmer trägt die Verantwortung für die technische und funktionale Gesamtintegration aller erforderlichen Komponenten und Schnittstellen.

result.text: Dumfries and Galloway Council – WEF Wanlock Water, Wanlockhead and WEF Nith Nature Reserve, Dumfries. The work is split across two Lots: Lot 1 Wanlock Water (RIBA1); Lot 2 Nith Nature Reserve, Dumfries(RIBA 1&2). Because of the multidisciplinary nature of the work, we would welcome either a single consultancy/ company that has all the skills in house or a consortium that can bring all of the skills required together. However, we appreciate it may be unlikely that a single consultancy has capacity and multiple disciplines. A detailed Description of Services for Lot 1 and 2 is currently being prepared. Lot 1: Wanlock Water Restoration Project- Indicative scope and outputs. The Contracting Authority intends to procure a feasibility study focusing on improving water quality and flows along with enhanced biodiversity, industrial heritage awareness and climate resilience for the Wanlock catchement and its communities. The commission is tasked to develop the project brief and test the feasibility of potential interventions, gathering information on constraints, risks, costs and potential delivery routes. The study is expected to be undertaken within the policy and funding context of the Scottish Environment Protection Agency’s (SEPA) Water Environment Fund (WEF), which supports the identification and delivery of measures to improve the ecological status of water bodies. As such, the feasibility work should consider the objectives of the Water Framework Directive (WFD) and identify opportunities for restoration and enhancement that may be eligible for future WEF support. The commission for the Wanlock Water is anticipated to require a minewater pollution reduction and treatment feasibility assessment, based on existing knowledge and characterisation of the problem, along with a scoping and feasibility study of wider opportunities and constraints to define future locations of works. Opportunities may exist to undertake treatment trials and to deliver multiple benefits within the riparian zone and floodplain and on the hill and moor landscape. The commission shall allow the project to complete Stage 1 of the framework of the Royal Institute of British Architects (RIBA) Plan of Work.. Scope TBC Review existing data and info - gap analysis. Targeted field surveys/assessments Delivery of opportunities & constraints mapping to assess feasibility. Baseline hydrological assessment of catchment. Outputs: project brief; feasibility report and high level summary; opportunity and constraints mapping; risk register; recommended next steps Lot 2: Lot 2 Nith Nature Reserve - Indicative scope and concept design outputs. The commission for the Nith Nature Reserve Project is to complete RIBA stages 1 and 2. This project aims to deliver a riverside nature reserve for people and wildlife by creating an enhanced natural setting for the Nith River. We will deliver significant ecological improvements, enhance the biodiversity and natural habitat and create a multiuse recreational area that is accessible to everyone in the community and provides multi-sensory experiences and educational opportunities. There are opportunities for improvements that would reduce morphological pressure capacity through habitat creation and could benefit flood risk and reduce sediment deposition further downstream. Dumfries and Galloway Council aim to deliver the drivers for biodiversity, climate resilience and better access to blue green infrastructure, access and amenity for local communities. The commission shall allow the project to complete Stage 1 and Stage 2 of the framework of the Royal Institute of British Architects (RIBA) Plan of Work.. TBC: Review existing data & gaps Field surveys/assessments Opportunities and constraints mapping to assess feasibility. RIBA Stage 1: project brief, geomorphological assessment, feasibility, constraints/risk register, next steps RIBA stage 2: preferred option report, concept designs informed by geomorphologist and landscape architect, visualisations and arcGIS style storyboard to present

result.text: Market consultation: The contracting authority intends to ascertain current market solutions for Special Protection Schemes (SpPS). To this end, it wishes to use this market consultation to test the feasibility of its own company requirements and the integrability of the market solutions. The contracting authority understands a Special Protection Scheme (SpPS) to be a special protection system used in power transmission grids to restore grid security in extraordinary or fault situations. The SpPS module monitors the transmission grid for limit violations and detects events that endanger the normal state of the transmission grid. It implements measures to mitigate the effects of limit violations and events and to return the transmission grid to a secure state. These may include measures such as disconnecting assets or changing the feed-in of generators. The SpPS module is designed to increase the reliability and security of the power grid through fast and coordinated responses. The purpose of the SpPS module is not to perform calculations, but rather to draw upon calculations and results from other systems.

parts.source: Markterkundung: Die Auftraggeberin beabsichtigt, aktuelle Marktlösungen für Special Protection Schemes (SpPS) zu eruieren. Dafür möchte sie diese Marktsondierung nutzen, um die Umsetzbarkeit unternehmenseigener Anforderungen sowie die Integrierbarkeit von der Marktlösungen zu prüfen. Die Auftraggeberin versteht unter einem Special Protection Scheme (SpPS) ein spezielles Schutzsystem, das in Stromübertragungsnetzen eingesetzt wird, um die Netzsicherheit in außergewöhnlichen oder Störungssituationen wiederherzustellen. Das SpPS-Modul überwacht das Übertragungsnetz auf Grenzwertverletzungen und erkennt Ereignisse, die den Normalzustand des Übertragungsnetzes gefährden. Es führt Maßnahmen durch, um die Auswirkungen von Grenzwertverletzungen und Ereignissen zu mindern und das Übertragungsnetz in einen sicheren Zustand zurückzuführen. Dies können Maßnahmen wie das Abschalten von Betriebsmitteln oder die Änderung der Einspeisung von Erzeugern umfassen. Das SpPS-Modul ist darauf ausgelegt, durch schnelle und koordinierte Reaktionen die Zuverlässigkeit und Sicherheit des Stromnetzes zu erhöhen. Das SpPS-Modul hat nicht zum Zweck, Berechnungen durchzuführen, sondern greift auf Berechnungen und Ergebnisse anderer Systeme zurück.

result.text: The Council is considering the future procurement of an independent assessment of the efficiency, effectiveness and long term sustainability of Housing Services and the HRA. While a robust 30 year HRA Business Plan is already in place, the Council wishes to obtain independent assurance on current arrangements and identify opportunities for improvement, innovation and value for money. This Prior Information Notice (PIN) is issued for the purpose of early market engagement only and is intended to inform the scope, approach and procurement strategy for any potential future tender exercise. Publication of this PIN does not constitute a commitment by East Renfrewshire Council to commence a procurement process. Lot 1: . East Renfrewshire Council manages a ring fenced Housing Revenue Account (HRA) which supports the delivery of social housing and associated landlord services. The Council is considering the future procurement of an independent assessment of the efficiency, effectiveness and long term sustainability of Housing Services and the HRA. While a robust 30 year HRA Business Plan is already in place, the Council wishes to obtain independent assurance on current arrangements and identify opportunities for improvement, innovation and value for money. This Prior Information Notice (PIN) is issued for the purpose of early market engagement only and is intended to inform the scope, approach and procurement strategy for any potential future tender exercise. Publication of this PIN does not constitute a commitment by East Renfrewshire Council to commence a procurement process. Indicative Scope of the Requirement: Should the Council proceed to a formal procurement exercise, it is anticipated that the scope of services may include, but would not be limited to, the following areas: - A strategic review of Housing Services, including performance, capacity and value for money. - Independent assessment of the robustness and long term sustainability of the HRA Business Plan. - Benchmarking and comparative analysis against Local Authorities of comparable size and stock profile and Registered Social Landlords with similar stock archetypes. - A detailed review of repairs and voids service delivery, including performance, cost control, productivity and customer experience. - Review of the factoring service, including financial performance, customer experience and options to move towards full cost recovery. - Review of stores and materials management arrangements within the context of a DLO led repairs model. - Review of sheltered housing provision, including revenue and capital costs and the relationship with the HRA. Across all areas, the Council anticipates a strong focus on evidence based analysis, benchmarking, customer feedback and elected member priorities, together with practical and deliverable recommendations. Information Sought from the Market - Economic operators are invited to provide non binding information to assist the Council in shaping any future procurement exercise. Responses may include information on: - Relevant organisational experience in delivering comparable Housing Services, HRA or landlord service reviews. - Experience working with Local Authorities and/or Registered Social Landlords of comparable scale and complexity. - Indicative approaches to delivering a commission of this nature, including benchmarking and stakeholder engagement. - Capacity to deliver the requirement and typical delivery models. - Innovative approaches or added value relevant to Housing Services. - Indicative commercial models and key cost drivers for similar commissions. This is not a tender or pre qualification exercise and no evaluation or scoring will take place at this stage. Submission of Expressions of Interest - This Prior Information Notice is issued for the purpose of market engagement only. Economic operators who wish to express an interest in this opportunity, or to provide information to assist the Council in shaping any future procurement exercise, are invited to submit a brief, non binding written response. Responses should be clearly marked “PIN Response – Housing Revenue Account Efficiency Review” and submitted to mary.harvey-welsh@eastrenfrewshire.gov.uk Responses should be limited to 4 x A4 and provided by 12 noon, 30th April 2026.. The Council reserves the right not to proceed to a formal procurement process and shall not be bound by any information received in response to this PIN.

result.text: With the ESF Federal Programme "Education, Economy, Work in the Quarter - BIWAQ", the Federal Ministry for Housing, Urban Development and Building (BMWSB) grants funds for projects that link labour market policy activities and approaches for strengthening the local economy with area-related integrated urban development. The aim of this call for tenders is to commission a management office for the technical and scientific support of BIWAQ from November 2026 up to and including March 2029 for 29 months. The tasks of the management office are summarised as follows: • Technical support and advice for the maximum of 52 BIWAQ VI projects • Monitoring and evaluation of the projects and analysis of programme implementation at overall programme level • Support in processing ad-hoc assignments • Preparation, implementation and follow-up of events • Accompanying public relations work • Coordination meetings with the contracting authority

result.text: Dumfries and Galloway Council has a requirement to progress the proposed 500km North Solway Coastal Path project to RIBA Stage 4 technical design. The project is part of the Solway Coast and Marine Project – landscape connections project, part funded through the National Lottery Heritage Fund (NLHF) Landscape Connections programme. Lot 1: . Dumfries and Galloway Council has a requirement to progress the proposed 500km North Solway Coastal Path project to RIBA Stage 4 technical design. The project is part of the Solway Coast and Marine Project – landscape connections project, part funded through the National Lottery Heritage Fund (NLHF) Landscape Connections programme. The project has been awarded a stage 1 development and the timescale for this element of the project is expected to include tender requests being issued in December 2025/ January 2026 with a delivery phase for this stage of 11-12 months ending in December 2026. It is anticipated that the construction phase will commence in late 2027, dependent on a successful stage 2 application to the NLHF Landscape Connections programme, with an 8-year implementation period. Many sections of the route are already designated core paths however there are gaps in the coast network, and the existing access infrastructure is variable in quality. The deliverables from the design phase will be based on an agreed physical sub-division of the route provided which is based on an initial business case proposal and will include: · Creation of a GIS digital mapping information layer to an agreed format · Detailed information on land ownerships derived from SCOTLIS, investigations, existing records and local knowledge. · Survey of agreed routes and existing route infrastructure including an audit of existing Core Path sections for current condition, useability and signage · Recommendations for upgrading of existing path sections to an agreed standard for a promoted route · Identification of potential candidate fully accessible route sections suitable for all abilities to viewpoints/ places of interest from access points and linking to coastal gateway sites and car parks. · Directional signage strategy and detailed recommendations for implementation · Detailed design access infrastructure proposals for existing Core Path sections · Options appraisal for new path section and initial discussions with landowners · Detailed design proposals for new path route sections including access infrastructure and surfacing types · Detailed costings and designs for proposed works for each route section and sub divided into each individual landholding · A full project delivery plan based on sections and schedule in both electronic and hard copy format · Proposals and recommendations for a phased delivery.

result.text: The subject matter of the service is the conception, development, implementation, commissioning and initial optimisation of an AI-supported, multimodal visitor guide for use in the tourist visitor operations of Westfälischer Zoologischer Garten Münster GmbH. The Contractor's service covers the complete project lifecycle from conception through development, piloting and rollout to productive operation, including support, monitoring, security, optimisation and operational services. AI technology is the heart of the SKADI project. As a digital system, it is intended to include functions such as barrier-free communication and precise navigation in the smallest of spaces. In addition to strengthening accessibility and digitalisation, the system helps to convey important topics such as sustainability and species conservation through its function as a digital learning offer - on a regional and international basis. Furthermore, the system uses artificial intelligence and machine learning algorithms to analyse user behaviour and suggests suitable experiences based on preferences and current location data. In addition, the system enables the networking of tourist/natural history offerings through the integration of specifically named sources. Users can not only obtain individual information about animal species, habitats, protected areas and events, but can also design it themselves using the digital guide, for example.

parts.source: Gegenstand der Dienstleistung ist die Konzeption, Entwicklung, Implementierung, Inbetriebnahme sowie die Erstoptimierung eines KI-gestützten, multimodalen Besucher-Guides für den Einsatz im touristischen Besucherbetrieb der Westfälischer Zoologischer Garten Münster GmbH. Die Leistung des Auftragnehmers umfasst den vollständigen Projektlebenszyklus von der Konzeption über Entwicklung, Pilotierung und Rollout bis hin zum produktiven Betrieb einschließlich Support-, Monitoring-, Sicherheits-, Optimierungs- und Betriebsleistungen. Die KI-Technologie ist das Herzstück des Projektes SKADI. Sie soll als digitales System Funktionen wie barrierefreie Kommunikation und präzise Navigation auf kleinstem Raum beinhalten. Neben der Stärkung der Barrierefreiheit und Digitalisierung trägt das System durch seine Funktion als digitales Lernangebot dazu bei, wichtige Themen wie Nachhaltigkeit und Artenschutz zu vermitteln - auf regionaler und internationaler Basis. Des Weiteren analysiert das System mithilfe künstlicher Intelligenz und Machine-Learning-Algorithmen das Nutzerverhalten und schlägt basierend auf Vorlieben sowie aktuellen Standortdaten passende Erlebnisse vor. Außerdem ermöglicht das System durch die Integration der spezifisch genannten Quellen die Vernetzung von touristischen / naturkundlichen Angeboten. NutzerInnen können nicht nur individuelle Informationen über Tierarten, Lebensräume, Schutzgebiete und Veranstaltungen erhalten, sondern z.B. auch selbst über den digitalen Guide gestalten.

rejected.text: Gegenstand der Vergabe ist die Beschaffung und Implementierung einer Extended Detection & Response (XDR)‐Lösung, mit dem Ziel, die IT‐Sicherheit durch moderne Erkennungs‐ und Reaktionsmechanismen signifikant zu erhöhen und insbesondere fortschrittliche Bedrohungen frühzeitig zu identifizieren sowie effektiv zu behandeln. Das Klinikum Esslingen betreibt eine umfangreiche IT‐Infrastruktur mit zahlreichen IT‐Endpunkten, darunter PCs, Thin Clients und Server. Ergänzend bestehen vernetzte Medizinprodukte (IoMT) sowie Systeme der Gebäudeleittechnik (GLT), die jedoch nicht Gegenstand dieser Ausschreibung sind. Die derzeit eingesetzte Endpoint‐Security basiert auf einer signaturbasierten Basislösung (Sophos), die keine erweiterten Funktionen wie Verhaltensanalyse oder Endpoint Detection & Response (EDR) bereitstellt. Das Projekt verfolgt folgende strategische und operative Ziele: • Ablösung der bestehenden signaturbasierten Endpoint-Security durch eine XDR-Lösung mit Verhaltensanalyse, Machine Learning und forensischer Analysefähigkeit gemäß dem Stand der Technik • Herstellung vollständiger Endpoint-Sichtbarkeit und -Kontrolle für alle IT-Endpunkte (Clients und Server) des Klinikums Esslingen • Aktivierung von Sophos Synchronized Security: Echtzeit-Kommunikation zwischen Endpoint-Agents und der bestehenden Sophos XGS Firewall zur automatisierten Netzwerkisolierung kompromittierter Endpunkte • Schaffung forensischer Analysefähigkeiten: kontinuierliches Endpoint-Telemetrie-Recording, Root-Cause-Analyse und Threat Hunting über alle Endpunkte hinweg • Aktivierung der Cross-Domain-Korrelation (XDR): Verknüpfung von Endpoint-Events mit Firewall-, E-Mail-, Cloud- und Identity-Datenquellen sowie Vorbereitung der MDR-Service-Anbindung • Erfüllung der regulatorischen Anforderungen aus NIS-2 und DSGVO hinsichtlich Endpoint-Security sowie Orientierung am Stand der Technik (B3S Gesundheit) • Unterstützung des Schwachstellenmanagements durch Endpoint-basierte Vulnerability-Sichtbarkeit

result.text: The subject of the contract is the procurement and implementation of an Extended Detection & Response (XDR) solution, with the aim of significantly increasing IT security through modern detection and response mechanisms and, in particular, identifying advanced threats early on and dealing with them effectively. Klinikum Esslingen operates an extensive IT infrastructure with numerous IT endpoints, including PCs, thin clients and servers. In addition, there are networked medical devices (IoMT) and building management systems (BMS), which are not, however, the subject of this call for competition. The endpoint security currently in use is based on a signature-based basic solution (Sophos) which does not provide any advanced functions such as behaviour analysis or Endpoint Detection & Response (EDR). The project pursues the following strategic and operative objectives: • Replacement of the existing signature-based endpoint security by an XDR solution with behaviour analysis, machine learning and forensic analysis capability in accordance with the state of the art • Establishment of complete endpoint visibility and control for all IT endpoints (clients and servers) of Klinikum Esslingen • Activation of Sophos Synchronized Security: real-time communication between endpoint agents and the existing Sophos XGS firewall for automated network isolation of compromised endpoints • Creation of forensic analysis capabilities: continuous endpoint telemetry recording, root cause analysis and threat hunting across all endpoints • Activation of cross-domain correlation (XDR): linking of endpoint events with firewall, email, cloud and identity data sources as well as preparation of the MDR service connection • Fulfilment of the regulatory requirements from NIS-2 and GDPR regarding endpoint security as well as orientation towards the state of the art (B3S Health) • Support for vulnerability management through endpoint-based vulnerability visibility

result.text: The use of (semi-)autonomous AI agents (Agentic AI) will lead to increasing automation of a wide range of tasks in the near future. Previous BSI test catalogues and standards do not yet take these novel applications of AI into account; the aim of the project is therefore to identify the most important use cases in the field of agentic AI, to develop testing requirements for them, and to work out a generalisation for other use cases based on these. The results of the project will flow directly into the "state-of-the-art" library, from which the new Grundschutz++ is fed/generated.

Die Ergebnisse des Projekts fließen direkt in die „Stand der Technik“-Bibliothek ein, aus der sich der neue Grundschutz++ speist/generiert.

rejected.text: School Attendance Monitoring of Children and Young People in Care and Children and Young People with an Education, Health & Care Plan (OOC). Wolverhampton City Council (the Council) has a statutory duty to monitor the school attendance of children and young people in care placed in out-of-city independent placements, and for children and young people with Education, Health and Care Plans (EHCPs) attending out-of-city education settings. This duty is primarily governed by the Education Act 1996 and relevant Department for Education (DfE) statutory guidance. To fulfil this responsibility, the Council requires a remote and secure system for collecting and monitoring attendance data for these two cohorts. The overarching aim is to improve school attendance among Wolverhampton pupils placed outside the city by delivering an effective, responsive, and informative service. This will enable the Council to identify and address poor attendance early, ensuring timely intervention in cases of unauthorised absence. The Provider will be expected to: • Contact selected schools attended by Wolverhampton pupils placed out of city. • Liaise with Council officers, parents, and carers when unauthorised absences occur. • Submit regular attendance reports within agreed timescales, using standardised DfE codes. • Provide business support and access to a secure online portal for Council officers and education settings. Lot 1: .

result.text: Background and Objectives of the Pathfinder Project: The Public Sector AI (PSAI) Directorate within the Department of Science, Innovation and Technology (DSIT) exists to help the government make brilliant public services that empower people in the UK. We work at the very centre of government to drive digital transformation focused on user needs and to reimagine how government uses AI to deliver public services and initiatives. The newly established Government Efficiency Accelerator (GEA) programme is a flagship initiative aimed at driving operational efficiencies across some of the government's key enabling functions (Finance, Policy, HR) through the safe and responsible adoption of AI. The GEA is working in collaboration with the GCF Commercial Innovation Hub (CIH) to better understand the availability of AI based solutions that can be used by teams across government departments to drive efficiency and increase productivity. The goal of this Pathfinder Project is to engage with the market to understand current capabilities, initially focusing on three core business areas: Finance, HR and policy (more details on a specific problem area below). Applicants should note that this engagement is not intended to lead to the procurement of a particular solution for DSIT or any other UK Government Department. Rather, we are looking to build a catalogue of tested and "kitemarked" products that will be made available to public sector organisations to consider procuring them in the knowledge that they have been tested and will meet requirements such as security, usability, transparency etc. We are interested in hearing from all types of suppliers and would particularly encourage SMEs and VCSEs to submit proposals. Challenge Summary: As noted above, the GEA and CIH are engaging with the market to build a deeper understanding of how AI based solutions and products can help make government departments more efficient and productive. We appreciate there are a multitude of potential use cases so for this initial engagement we have chosen to focus on problems relating to budgeting and workforce forecasting. We are inviting suppliers to submit proposals outlining how their products could be used by finance teams across UK government departments in a safe, transparent and unbiased way. We are keen to explore solutions which can reduce the level of repetitive tasks required specifically when budgeting and conducting workforce forecasting. Submissions should demonstrate how the solution can streamline tasks, improve accuracy, and shorten time spent on repetitive work in order to free colleagues up to complete higher-value work. There is no fixed scope, as we aim for platform-agnostic, AI driven and innovative tools that adapt to various organisational needs. Solution should be accessible to organisations of all sizes and is not dependent on any specific ERP platform.
