result.text: The subject of this tender is the procurement of a central, high-performance, scalable and highly available backup infrastructure for Magdeburg University Hospital. The aim of the tender is to provide a future-proof and demand-oriented expandable central backup solution that enables reliable backup as well as fast and reliable recovery of the business-critical and medically relevant data and IT systems arising at Magdeburg University Hospital. The solution to be procured must take into account the requirements for secure, highly available and permanently available operation in a KRITIS-relevant environment and thus make a significant contribution to the operational safety, fail-safe operation and resilience of the IT infrastructure of Magdeburg University Hospital. The overall solution to be procured is to consist of four coordinated system components: • a high-performance all-flash backup appliance for processing large amounts of data and a high number of parallel backup and restore processes, • a highly available backup storage system as the primary backup target with integrated deduplication function, • a high-performance enterprise rack server as a Veeam backup server as well as • two appropriately dimensioned enterprise rack servers as Veeam backup proxies. The backup infrastructure is to be designed in such a way that it takes into account the existing and foreseeable future requirements of Magdeburg University Hospital. In addition to the delivery of the required hardware and software, including all components and licences required for intended operation, the scope of services also includes the professional installation, configuration and integration of the overall solution into the existing IT infrastructure of Magdeburg University Hospital. Furthermore, the scope of services includes the commissioning of the overall solution as well as the execution of the required functional, performance and acceptance tests. The contractor must provide a fully functional and ready-for-operation overall solution that complies with the requirements laid down in the specification of services and the schedule of services. All services are to be provided in compliance with the legal, regulatory and technical requirements applicable at the time of service provision as well as the relevant norms and standards. Lot LOT-0000: Central backup system. Procurement of a central, high-performance, scalable and highly available backup infrastructure for Magdeburg University Hospital. The specific functional requirements result from the schedule of services.

parts.source: Gegenstand dieser Ausschreibung ist die Beschaffung einer zentralen, leistungsfähigen, skalierbaren und hochverfügbaren Backup-Infrastruktur für das Universitätsklinikum Magdeburg. Ziel der Ausschreibung ist es, eine zukunftsfähige und bedarfsgerecht erweiterbare zentrale Backup-Lösung bereitzustellen, die eine zuverlässige Sicherung sowie eine schnelle und zuverlässige Wiederherstellung der im Universitätsklinikum Magdeburg anfallenden geschäftskritischen und medizinisch relevanten Daten und IT-Systeme ermöglicht. Die zu beschaffende Lösung soll den Anforderungen an einen sicheren, hochverfügbaren und dauerhaft verfügbaren Betrieb in einer KRITIS-relevanten Umgebung Rechnung tragen und damit einen wesentlichen Beitrag zur Betriebssicherheit, Ausfallsicherheit und Resilienz der IT-Infrastruktur des Universitätsklinikums Magdeburg leisten. Die zu beschaffende Gesamtlösung soll aus vier aufeinander abgestimmten Systemkomponenten bestehen: • eine hochperformante All-Flash-Backup-Appliance zur Verarbeitung großer Datenmengen sowie einer hohen Anzahl paralleler Backup- und Restore-Prozesse, • ein hochverfügbares Backup-Speichersystem als primäres Backup-Target mit integrierter Deduplizierungsfunktion, • einen leistungsfähigen Enterprise-Rack-Server als Veeam Backup Server sowie • zwei entsprechend dimensionierte Enterprise-Rack-Server als Veeam Backup Proxy Die Backup-Infrastruktur ist so auszulegen, dass sie den bestehenden und absehbaren zukünftigen Anforderungen des Universitätsklinikums Magdeburg Rechnung trägt. Der Leistungsumfang umfasst neben der Lieferung der erforderlichen Hard- und Software einschließlich sämtlicher für den bestimmungsgemäßen Betrieb erforderlicher Komponenten und Lizenzen auch die fachgerechte Installation, Konfiguration und Integration der Gesamtlösung in die bestehende IT-Infrastruktur des Universitätsklinikums Magdeburg. Weiterhin umfasst der Leistungsumfang die Inbetriebnahme der Gesamtlösung sowie die Durchführung der erforderlichen Funktions-, Leistungs- und Abnahmetests. Der Auftragnehmer hat eine vollständig funktionsfähige und betriebsbereite Gesamtlösung bereitzustellen, die den in der Leistungsbeschreibung und dem Leistungsverzeichnis festgelegten Anforderungen entspricht. Sämtliche Leistungen sind unter Beachtung der zum Zeitpunkt der Leistungserbringung geltenden gesetzlichen, regulatorischen und technischen Vorgaben sowie der einschlägigen Normen und Standards zu erbringen. Lot LOT-0000: Zentrales Backup-System. Beschaffung einer zentralen, leistungsfähigen, skalierbaren und hochverfügbaren Backup-Infrastruktur für das Universitätsklinikum Magdeburg. Die konkreten funktionalen Anforderungen ergeben sich aus dem Leistungsverzeichnis.

result.text: Gloucestershire ICB and Bristol, North Somerset and South Gloucestershire (BNSSG) ICB are merging to form a single integrated body in April 2027. Both organisations currently rely on external providers for the delivery of their IT services. A new, unified service model is required; one that supports the merged organisation from day one, is commercially sustainable, and is capable of evolving as the ICS matures. Six principles shape the design of the future service: 1. Cloud-first and 'secure by design'. All new and renewed services will be cloud-based wherever possible. On-premises infrastructure will be exited as part of transition. This is both a strategic choice and a compliance requirement under the Government Cloud First Policy and Technology Code of Practice. 2. Outcome-focused. The service is defined by what it must deliver, not how it must be delivered. The supplier is expected to bring expertise, innovation and accountability for outcomes, not simply execute a prescriptive technical specification. 3. Single point of accountability. The preferred model is a single managed service provider with end-to-end accountability for operational delivery. This avoids the fragmentation and unclear ownership that characterises the current multi-supplier landscape and reduces the management overhead on the ICB digital team. 4. Lean governance. The ICB digital team will provide strategic oversight, roadmap ownership and supplier governance. It will not carry operational delivery responsibilities. This reflects the lean, strategically focused character of the merged organisation and the direction set by the Model ICB Blueprint. 5. Interoperable by design. The service must integrate cleanly with nationally contracted NHS platforms, in particular NHS.net Connect, the Health and Social Care Network (HSCN) and NHS Secure Boundary Service, as well as local platforms, such as the Gloucestershire ICS WAN and into UHBW and Crown Datacentres in Corsham. Service interfaces with these platforms should be clearly defined before the procurement specification is finalised. 6. Sustainable. The ICB's carbon neutral commitments should be reflected in technology choices, including energy-efficient end-user devices, PoE-powered monitors and cloud-based infrastructure in preference to on-premises data centre equipment. The following service stacks are in scope for the new managed service, reflecting services currently provided across both incumbents, consolidated and extended to support the merged organisation: - Service desk. The primary user-facing support channel, available 08:00-18:00 Monday to Friday. - Desktop support. Onsite presence at both sites as and when required, including end-user support, moves, adds and changes to desktop arrangements, MFD, Audio Visual equipment, and Teams Room management. The onsite support model must include provision for routine physical tasks including WFH equipment management, peripheral replacement, cable and hardware swap-outs, and stock management. - End-user compute. Device lifecycle management including provisioning, refresh (five-year target cycle), configuration, and secure disposal. - Telephony and unified communications. Microsoft Teams Phone as the unified platform for the merged ICB. - Print. Cloud-managed secure print at both sites. - Meeting rooms. Physical teams Room management and audio-visual support at 2 locations with 15 meeting rooms at one and at Shire Hall, Gloucester and 9 at the second location. - Asset management. Asset tagging, recording, and lifecycle tracking for all ICB-owned IT equipment. - Supplier and procurement management. The supplier will assume management of all ongoing third-party technology relationships and will procure all IT equipment and recurring support contracts on behalf of the ICB. Licence management across the estate is required. - DSPT support. The supplier is expected to provide the ICB with the technical evidence and assurance data required to support annual DSPT submission, including patch management records, asset inventory, access control logs and incident reports. - Project, change and architecture. The supplier will own project and change management, problem management, and architecture design. - Digital signatures. Digital signature capability is required as part of the new service. Full details are provided in the service specification. The total maximum contract value for the initial 3-year Contract is £1,920,000 inclusive of VAT (where applicable). At the end of the initial contract term the Commissioner will have two, separate, consecutive one-year extension option periods that can be exercised at the discretion of the Commissioner, giving a maximum possible contract value of £2,700,000 inclusive of VAT (where applicable) over 5 years if the full contract term is fulfilled. The Commissioner is of the view that TUPE does not apply to this service. The Contracting Authority reserves the right to use the Direct Award procedure under the Procurement Act 2023 for any subsequent extensions or new contracts for similar requirements. The new contract will commence on 1st April 2027, although implementation of the services will start during January 2026. Lot 1: .

result.text: Provision of a marketplace platform The advertised online portal is to be connected to SAP SRM as a catalogue via an interface based on the Open Catalog Interface (OCI) standard. In the intended process, the catalogue is called up by the user via a link from SAP SRM; it opens in a new browser window and is displayed there in a frame. In this catalogue, the user compiles a shopping basket from the required items. In the supplier's catalogue application, the user then completes the shopping basket after a verification step and initiates the transfer of the catalogue shopping basket to SAP SRM via the OCI interface. All items, quantities, and prices are transferred to the SRM shopping cart via the interface. The order is then completed by the user within the university according to a specified approval process and transmitted to the supplier. Direct order triggering from the supplier's online portal must not take place. The catalogue solution offered must therefore meet the conditions for connection from Appendix 5 "OCI Catalogue Performance Requirements" and for order transmission from Appendix 4 "IDOC Interface". SAP SRM is expected to be replaced by a successor product in the year 2026. Any necessary system adjustments to the marketplace connection will be supported by the contractor.

parts.source: Bereitstellung einer Marketplace-Plattform Das ausgeschriebene Online-Portal soll über eine Schnittstelle nach dem Open Catalog Interface (OCI)-Standard als Katalog an SAP SRM angebunden werden. Der Katalog wird im vorgesehenen Prozess über einen Link aus SAP SRM durch den Anwender aufgerufen, er öffnet sich in einem neuen Browserfenster und wird dort in einem Frame dargestellt. In diesem Katalog stellt der Anwender einen Warenkorb aus den benötigten Artikeln zusammen. In der Kataloganwendung des Lieferanten schließt der Anwender dann nach einem Prüfschritt den Warenkorb und stößt die Übertragung des Katalogwarenkorbs über die OCI-Schnittstelle an SAP SRM an. Über die Schnittstelle werden alle Artikel, Mengen und Preise in den SRM-Einkaufswagen übertragen. Die Bestellung wird dann durch den Anwender universitätsintern nach einem vorgegebenen Genehmigungsprozess abgeschlossen und an den Lieferanten übermittelt. Eine direkte Bestellauslösung aus dem Online-Portal des Lieferanten darf nicht erfolgen. Die angebotene Kataloglösung muss daher die Bedingungen für die Anbindung aus Anlage 5 "OCI-Katalog-Leistungsanforderungen" und für die Bestellübertragung aus Anlage 4 "IDOC-Schnittstelle" erfüllen. Das SAP SRM wird voraussichtlich im Jahr 2026 durch ein Nachfolgeprodukt ersetzt. Ggf. notwendige Systemanpassungen an der Marketplace-Anbindung werden vom Auftragnehmer begleitet.

result.text: The ekom21 - Kommunales Gebietsrechenzentrum Hessen (hereinafter: ekom21) is a body governed by public law pursuant to the Hessian Data Processing Association Act (DV-VerbundG). It is the central IT service provider for Hessian municipalities and their institutions. From locations in Giessen, Darmstadt, Kassel and Fulda, it comprehensively supplies its end customers with modern information and communication services (ICT) of all kinds. The approximately 500 members in Hesse and other customers nationwide include approx. 29.000 end users from local authorities and other public institutions, such as districts, cities, municipalities, municipal eigenbetriebs, special-purpose associations, institutions, hospitals and residential homes. In the governmental sector, ekom21 serves numerous state associations, ministries and regional administrative offices. In total, ekom21 thus provides services for six million citizens. The range of tasks of ekom21 is growing and changing continuously, which goes hand in hand with a steady expansion of the customer base. In order to accommodate the requests of our customers for a data protection management system (DPMS), a corresponding partner must be commissioned. For this reason, ekom21 is tendering a DPMS for its customers. Primarily, a cloud-based data protection management system (SaaS) is to be procured that supports, documents and controls all processing activities pursuant to Art. 5 30 General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), the Federal Data Protection Act (BDSG) as well as the Hessian Data Protection and Freedom of Information Act (HDSIG). The aim is to reduce the effort for risk and impact assessments, the register of processing activities (RoPA), data subject requests, contract and sales management as well as audit evidence, while simultaneously increasing compliance quality. Lot LOT-0000: Data protection management system. The procurement procedure aims at the conclusion of a framework agreement with an economic operator. The framework agreement is intended - without establishing an obligation to purchase - to enable the demand-driven provision, introduction and long-term support of a "data protection management system" as well as associated services for customers of ekom21. The maximum value of the framework agreement amounts to 1.000.000,00 million € (net). Further details can be found in the procurement documents.

parts.source: Die ekom21 - Kommunales Gebietsrechenzentrum Hessen (nachfolgend: ekom21) ist eine Körperschaft des öffentlichen Rechts nach dem Hessischen Datenverarbeitungsverbundgesetz (DV-VerbundG). Sie ist zentraler IT-Dienstleister für die hessischen Kommunen und ihre Einrichtungen. Von den Standorten in Gießen, Darmstadt Kassel und Fulda versorgt sie ihre Endkunden umfassend mit modernen Informations- und Kommunikationsdienstleistungen (IuK) aller Art. Zu den rund 500 Mitgliedern in Hessen und weiteren Kunden bundesweit gehören ca. 29.000 Endanwender*innen aus Kommunalverwaltungen und anderen öffentlichen Einrichtungen, wie z. B. Landkreise, Städte, Gemeinden, kommunale Eigenbetriebe, Zweckverbände, Anstalten, Krankenhäuser und Heime. Im staatlichen Bereich betreut die ekom21 zahlreiche Landesverbände, Ministerien und Regierungspräsidien. Insgesamt erbringt die ekom21 damit Services für sechs Millionen Bürger. Das Aufgabenspektrum der ekom21 wächst und verändert sich kontinuierlich, womit eine stetige Erweiterung des Kundenkreises einhergeht. Um den Anfragen unserer Kunden nach einem Datenschutzmanagement System (DSMS) Rechnung zu tragen, muss ein entsprechender Partner beauftragt werden Die ekom21 schreibt aus diesem Grund für ihre Kunden ein DSMS aus. Es soll primär ein cloud basiertes Datenschutz Management System (SaaS) beschafft werden, das die gesamte Verarbeitungstätigkeit nach Art. 5 30 Datenschutz-Grundverordnung (DSGVO), dem Bundesdatenschutzgesetz (BDSG) sowie dem Hessischen Datenschutz- und Informationsfreiheitsgesetz (HDSIG) unterstützt, dokumentiert und kontrolliert. Ziel ist es, den Aufwand für Risiko und Impact Analysen, das Verzeichnis von Verarbeitungstätigkeiten (VVT), Betroffenen Anfragen, Auftrags und Vertriebsmanagement sowie Audit Nachweise zu reduzieren und gleichzeitig die Compliance Qualität zu erhöhen. Lot LOT-0000: Datenschutzmanagementsystem. Das Vergabeverfahren zielt auf den Abschluss einer Rahmenvereinbarung mit einem Wirtschaftsteilnehmer. Die Rahmenvereinbarung soll - ohne Begründung einer Abnahmeverpflichtung - die bedarfsgerechte Bereitstellung, Einführung und langfristige Betreuung eines "Datenschutzmanagementsystems" sowie dazugehörige Dienstleistungen für Kunden der ekom21 zu ermöglichen. Der Höchstwert der Rahmenvereinbarung beträgt 1.000.000,00 Mio. € (netto). Näheres ist den Vergabeunterlagen zu entnehmen.

result.text: This is a negotiated procedure with a call for competition pursuant to Section 11 Paragraph 1 Sentence 1 Alt. 2 of the Ordinance on the Award of Public Contracts (VSVgV). The subject matter of the contract to be awarded is the procurement for the delivery and setup of software as an overall system a) for the analysis, IT-supported comparison, and research of mass data in a stock of several partly federated source databases as well as ad-hoc imported data, in particular from the backups of digital evidence by the police of Schleswig-Holstein, b) for the technical integration of existing data sources in a central data integration platform (data integration component). The license requirement initially comprises 30 concurrent users; the license quantity required for this is to be procured. Optionally, there shall be the possibility to expand the number to up to 75 concurrent users. This option must be included in the tender, but the actual uptake is optional. The contracting authority provides for a staggering of the additional licenses to be acquired optionally. The additional licenses are offered in stages: Option 1 enables the procurement of 20 additional licenses (a total of 50 users), Option 2 another 25 licenses each, so that a maximum number of users of 75 can be reached. The term of the license is three years from the award of contract. The contracting authority has the right to extend the term up to three times by twelve months each time. Licenses acquired within the framework of options 1 and 2 have a term of three years from their provision, which can also be extended three times by twelve months each time, but the licenses procured by exercising options shall end at the latest simultaneously with the term of the licenses initially procured as a base. The contracting authority uses an EVB-IT Transfer Agreement Type B, an EVB-IT Maintenance Agreement, and an EVB-IT Service Agreement as the basis for the contractual agreement. These will be made available together with the other documents in the bidding phase. This includes a productive, development, and test system which is to be integrated into the existing IT infrastructure of the police of Schleswig-Holstein. parts.source: Es handelt sich um ein Verhandlungsverfahren mit Teilnahmewettbewerb gem. § 11Abs.1 S. 1 Alt. 2 VSVgV. Gegenstand des zu vergebenden Auftrages ist die Beschaffung zur Lieferung und Einrichtung einer Software als Gesamtsystem a) zur Analyse, zum IT-gestützten Abgleich und zur Recherche von Massendaten in einem Bestand mehrerer teils föderierter Quelldatenbanken sowie anlassbezogen im-portierter Daten insbesondere aus den Sicherungen digitaler Beweismittel durch die Polizei SH, b) für die technische Integration bestehender Datenquellen in einer zentralen Datenintegrationsplattform (Datenintegrationskomponente). Der Lizenzbedarf umfasst zunächst 30 gleichzeitige Nutzer; die hierfür erforderliche Lizenzmenge ist zu beschaffen. Optional soll die Möglichkeit bestehen, für die Anzahl auf bis zu 75 gleichzeitige Nutzer auszuweiten. Diese Option muss zwingend im Angebot enthalten sein, die tatsächliche Inanspruchnahme ist jedoch optional. Der Auftraggeber sieht dabei eine Staffelung der weiteren optional zu erwerbenden Lizenzen vor. Die zusätzlichen Lizenzen werden gestaffelt angeboten: Option 1 ermöglicht die Beschaffung von 20 weiteren Lizenzen (insgesamt 50 Nutzer), Option 2 jeweils weitere 25 Lizenzen, sodass eine maximale Nutzerzahl von 75 erreicht werden kann. Die Laufzeit der Lizenz beträgt drei Jahre ab Zuschlag. Der Auftraggeber hat das Recht, die Laufzeit bis zu dreimal um jeweils zwölf Monate zu verlängern. Im Rahmen der Optionen 1 und 2 erworbene Lizenzen haben eine Laufzeit von drei Jahren ab deren Bereitstellung, die ebenfalls dreimal um jeweils zwölf Monate verlängert werden kann, die durch Optionsausübung beschafften Lizenzen enden aber spätestens gleichzeitig mit der Laufzeit der zuerst grundständig beschafften Lizenzen. Der Auftraggeber verwendet als Grundlage der vertraglichen Vereinbarung einen EVB-IT-Überlassungsvertrag Typ B, einen EVB-IT Pflegevertrag und einen EVB-IT Dienstleistungsvertrag. Diese werden gemeinsam mit den weiteren Unterlagen in der Angebotsphase zur Verfügung gestellt. Dies beinhaltet ein Produktiv-, Entwicklungs- und Testsystem, welches in die bestehende IT-Infrastruktur der Polizei SH eingebunden werden soll. Hinsichtlich der Abgrenzung der Datenintegration vom IT-gestützten Abgleich und der automatisierten Datenanalyse wird auf das beigefügte Dokument „Begriffsbestimmung Analyse und Datenintegration“ verwiesen. Description Instead of relying on card payments, open banking services provide citizens and businesses with an alternative method of paying and/or receiving money from the public sector. You will be able to access a range of open banking services including: payment initiation service providers (PISPs): let you pay companies directly from your bank account rather than using your debit or credit card through a third party, such as Visa or Mastercard account information service providers (AISPs): being an authorised AISP means that a company can access an individual’s bank account data from their financial institution with their explicit consent To help you find the services and suppliers to meet your needs you will be able to use the following filters: service type total contract value hosting and delivery capabilities This dynamic purchasing system (DPS) will run for 8 years. Benefits open banking will reduce customer transaction costs where card payments are the existing and only method of payment payments can be made directly from bank account to bank account without the need to repeatedly input details existing customers of the Payment Acceptance framework can transition to Open Banking includes real time bank account data to confirm payee account details reducing the risk of error payments and minimising losses due to fraud Products and suppliers Please read the 'How to buy' tab below for detailed instructions on how to find out which suppliers are on this agreement. Lot 1: Open Banking (Data, Digital Payments & Confirmation of Payee Services) DPS Expires: 07/12/2031 How to buy You can access the Open Banking DPS through the Dynamic Purchasing Marketplace. you will need to select the ‘financial services’ section, and scroll to ‘Open Banking’ Select the ‘access as a buyer’ link. you will then be asked to either sign into your Dynamic Purchasing Marketplace account or register for one Accept the terms and conditions of the DPS as a buyer. You can then view and manage your ‘DPS category exports’ page where you will have 2 options: view appointed suppliers click on the link to create a new category export (this is how you filter the suppliers to find those that can meet your needs) When creating a new category use the filtering tool to specify your needs and create your supplier shortlist. Save your filtered list of capable suppliers by clicking the ‘save category’ option and give the shortlist a unique name specific to your competition. From the ‘manage your category exports’ page you can then export the list of suppliers and contact details (the export is to an Excel spreadsheet). Close the DPS. Use your supplier shortlist to run a further competition. Invite the suppliers in your shortlist to bid against your detailed statement of requirements, evaluation criteria and contract format. Your supplier list is valid for 2 working days from the date of creation. If you do not use your list within 2 working days you will need to create a new supplier list (follow steps 6 to 10). You can use our eSourcing tool to run a competition or you can use your organisation’s own procurement tool. read guidance for our eSourcing tool Your tender process should be proportionate to the value and complexity of your needs. You should allow enough time for suppliers to review, prepare a response and ask clarification questions. Evaluate supplier responses. Award the contract. Put a notification of the award on Contracts Finder. Documents Updates Crown Commercial Service (CCS) became Government Commercial Agency (GCA) on 1 April 2026. Documents published before this date may still refer to CCS. All contract documents remain valid for existing and new contracts, and there are no changes to how you work with us.

result.text: The aim of Hansel Oy is to establish a dynamic purchasing system (DPS), the preliminary subject matter of which is software and ICT expert services. Joint procurement enables the procurement of the following services as needed, among others: 1. Software: The customer's procurement subject matter may be various software. In addition to software, expert work related to software can be procured, such as tailoring software to the customer's needs, configuration, further development, as well as support and maintenance. Both open source and closed source software are included in the subject matter of the DPS. The customer's procurement subject matter may also be a licence brokerage service (for example, resale). Software can be delivered on a licence basis, installed in the customer's own environment, or on a service basis as a SaaS implementation. 2. The following ICT expert services are included in the procurement subject matter: ICT management and service management services, ICT solution design, software development and quality assurance services, support and maintenance services, as well as IT asset management. The aim is for the establishment phase of the dynamic purchasing system to start in March-April 2026. *Read more about the dynamic purchasing system: https://www.hansel.fi/hankintatietoa/dynaaminen-hankintajarjestelma-dps/ GENERAL Please note that this is a market survey notice (hereinafter notice), and this notice does not yet request applications to participate. All information presented in this notice is preliminary and indicative prior information. The information provided in this notice is preliminary and may change as preparation progresses. REGISTRATION Companies interested in the dynamic purchasing system in question are requested to register for market dialogue no later than 6.2.2026 via this notice in the Hilma web service. The contracting authority will not respond at this stage to questions sent via the "Questions and Answers" section. MARKET DIALOGUE Draft material related to the dynamic purchasing system under preparation will be sent to registered companies for comments during approximately February-March 2026. Registered companies will be given the opportunity to comment on the draft material in writing. The market dialogue and materials will be in Finnish. Participating or not participating in the market dialogue does not prevent participation in a possible procurement procedure. No compensation will be paid to those who participated in the market dialogue for participation.

parts.source: Hansel Oy:n tavoitteena on perustaa dynaaminen hankintajärjestelmä (DPS), jonka alustavana kohteena ovat ohjelmistot ja ICT-asiantuntijapalvelut. Yhteishankinta mahdollistaa mm. seuraavien palveluiden hankinnan tarpeen mukaan: 1. Ohjelmistot: Asiakkaan hankinnan kohteena voivat olla erilaiset ohjelmistot. Ohjelmistojen lisäksi voidaan hankkia ohjelmistoihin liittyvää asiantuntijatyötä, kuten ohjelmiston sovittamista asiakkaan tarpeisiin, konfigurointia, jatkokehitystä sekä tukea ja ylläpitoa. DPS:n kohteeseen sisältyvät sekä avoimen että suljetun lähdekoodin ohjelmistot. Asiakkaan hankinnan kohteena voi olla myös käyttöoikeuksien välityspalvelu (esimerkiksi jälleenmyynti). Ohjelmistoja voidaan toimittaa lisenssipohjaisesti, Asiakkaan omaan ympäristöön asennettavana, tai palveluperusteisesti SaaS-toteutuksena. 2. Hankinnan kohteeseen sisältyvät seuraavat ICT-asiantuntijapalvelut: ICT-johtamisen ja palveluhallinnan palvelut, ICT-ratkaisujen suunnittelun, ohjelmistokehityksen ja laadunvarmistuksen palvelut, tuki- ja ylläpitopalvelut sekä IT-omaisuuden hallinnan. Tavoitteena on, että dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän perustamisvaihe käynnistyy maalis-huhtikuussa 2026. *Ks. lisää dynaamisesta hankintajärjestelmästä: https://www.hansel.fi/hankintatietoa/dynaaminen-hankintajarjestelma-dps/ YLEISTÄ Huomioittehan, että kyseessä on markkinakartoitusilmoitus (jäljempänä ilmoitus), eikä tällä ilmoituksella pyydetä vielä osallistumishakemuksia. Kaikki tässä ilmoituksessa esitetyt tiedot ovat alustavia ja suuntaa antavia ennakkotietoja. Tällä ilmoituksella annetut tiedot ovat alustavia ja saattavat muuttua valmistelun edetessä. ILMOITTAUTUMINEN Kyseessä olevasta dynaamisesta hankintajärjestelmästä kiinnostuneita yrityksiä pyydetään ilmoittautumaan mukaan markkinavuoropuheluun viimeistään 6.2.2026 tämän ilmoituksen kautta Hilma-verkkopalvelussa. Hankintayksikkö ei vastaa tässä vaiheessa "Kysymykset ja vastaukset" -osion kautta lähetettyihin kysymyksiin. MARKKINAVUOROPUHELU Ilmoittautuneille yrityksille tullaan lähettämään valmistelussa olevaan dynaamiseen hankintajärjestelmään liittyvää luonnosmateriaalia kommenteille arviolta helmi-maaliskuun 2026 aikana. Ilmoittautuneille varataan mahdollisuus kommentoida luonnosmateriaalia kirjallisesti. Markkinavuoropuhelu ja materiaalit tulevat olemaan suomen kielellä. Markkinavuoropuheluun osallistuminen tai osallistumatta jättäminen ei estä mahdolliseen hankintamenettelyyn osallistumista. Markkinavuoropuheluun osallistuneille ei makseta korvausta osallistumisesta.

result.text: CLARIFICATION: This is ONLY a market exploration procedure to determine whether and, if so, which companies can offer the service intended for procurement. This preliminary information does not serve the purposes of Section 38 of the Public Procurement Ordinance (VgV). ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- The Munich Fire Department is planning, in a lead management capacity for a nationwide joint procurement on a framework agreement basis with purchasing authorization for all operators of control centres for fire and rescue services in Germany, to tender and introduce an interface management system (≠ interface modelling system, see below) named "RESQON". RESQON is intended to make it possible to network all Integrated Control Centres (ILS) nationwide with one another and exchange data amongst each other. In addition, the system is to be used to connect external services with partly proprietary protocols to the various computer-aided dispatch systems of the respective control centre. RESQON consists of local instances at the control centres, which are to be combined into a network. This network is referred to as RESQON Mesh. Participating control centres can exchange incident data via RESQON Mesh. Within the RESQON Mesh there is a central instance, the so-called RESQON Core. RESQON Core provides external connections to standardised services such as, for example, AML and the nora emergency call app. Furthermore, connections to statutory health insurance control centres, to TPS service providers for eCall and police control centres are to be possible in the future. An elementary component of RESQON is an interface modelling system which allows various protocols and data to be transformed and, if necessary, process logic to be mapped using it. The interface modelling system is a component of every local RESQON instance. -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- PLEASE NOTE: The purpose of this market exploration is to evaluate the availability of such interface modelling systems. This is also in particular in preparation for a possible direct award - in a lead management capacity for a nationwide joint procurement on a framework agreement basis with purchasing authorization for all operators of control centres for fire and rescue services in Germany - in accordance with Section 14 Paragraph 4 No. 2 letter b) of the Public Procurement Ordinance (VgV), since the objective absence of competition for technical reasons must be demonstrated and, if necessary, proven by the contracting authority. This market exploration is therefore an essential part of the required comprehensive market analysis at European level. --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- See additionally the document "2025-11-25_Markterkundung_Schnittstellenmodellierungssystem.pdf". This can be requested from the contact point via the e-tendering system. ======================================================== PROCEDURE FOR INTERESTED COMPANIES: Interested companies that consider themselves in a position to offer a corresponding product are requested to contact the contact point by email at: info@mayburg.de (providing contact details, at least email and telephone) by no later than Thu., 08.01.2025. The LH Munich - Fire Department - will then be informed accordingly and will seek further contact for the continuation of the market exploration or the market exploration procedure.

parts.source: KLARSTELLUNG: Es handelt sich vorliegend NUR um ein MARKTERKUNGsverfahren zur Ermittlung, ob und ggf. welche Unternehmen die zur Beschaffung angedachte Leistung anbieten können. Diese Vorinformation dient nicht den Zwecken von § 38 VgV. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Die Branddirektion München plant in federführender Durchführung für eine bundesweite Sammelbeschaffung auf Rahmenvereinbarungs-Basis mit Bezugsberechtigung sämtlicher Träger von Leitstellen für Feuerwehr- und Rettungsdienst in Deutschland ein Schnittstellen-Management-System (≠ Schnittstellenmodellierungssystem, s.u.) mit der Bezeichnung "RESQON" auszuschreiben und einzuführen. RESQON soll es ermöglichen, bundesweit alle Integrierten Leitstellen (ILS) miteinander zu vernetzen und untereinander Daten auszutauschen. Darüber hinaus sollen über das System externe Dienste mit teils proprietären Protokollen an die unterschiedlichen Einsatzleitsysteme der jeweiligen Leitstelle angebunden werden. RESQON besteht aus lokalen Instanzen bei den Leitstellen, welche zu einem Verbund zusammengeschlossen werden sollen. Dieser Verbund wird als RESQON Mesh bezeichnet. Über RESQON Mesh können die teilnehmenden Leitstellen Einsatzdaten austauschen. Innerhalb des RESQON Mesh gibt es eine zentrale Instanz, den sog. RESQON Core. RESQON Core stellt externe Anbindungen zu standardisierten Diensten wie bspw. AML und nora-Notruf App zur Verfügung. Weiterhin sollen perspektivisch Anbindungen an die KV-Leitstellen, an TPS-Dienstleister für eCall und Polizei-Leistellen möglich sein. Ein elementarer Bestandteil von RESQON ist ein Schnittstellenmodellierungssystem, welches es erlaubt, verschiedene Protokolle und Daten zu transformieren und bei Bedarf darüber Prozesslogiken abzubilden. Das Schnittstellenmodellierungssystem ist Bestandteil jeder lokalen RESQON-Instanz. -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- BEACHTE: Die gegenständliche Markterkundung hat den Zweck, die Verfügbarkeit solcher Schnittstellenmodellierungssysteme zu evaluieren. Dies auch insbesondere in Vorbereitung einer etwaige Direktvergabe - in federführender Durchführung für eine bundesweite Sammelbeschaffung auf Rahmenvereinbarungs-Basis mit Bezugsberechtigung sämtlicher Träger von Leitstellen für Feuerwehr- und Rettungsdienst in Deutschland - gemäß § 14 Abs. 4 Nr. 2 lit. b) VgV, da das objektive Fehlen von Wettbewerb aus technischen Gründen vom öffentlichen Auftraggeber darzulegen und gegebenenfalls zu beweisen ist. Die gegenständliche Markterkundung ist daher wesentlicher Teil der erforderlichen umfassenden Marktanalyse auf europäischer Ebene. --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Siehe ergänzend das Dokument "2025-11-25_Markterkundung_Schnittstellenmodellierungssystem.pdf". Dieses kann über das eVergabe-System bei der Kontaktstelle angefordert werden. ======================================================== VORGEHEN FÜR INTERESSIERTE UNTERNEHMEN: Interessierte Unternehmen, die sich in der Lage sehen, ein entsprechendes Produkt anzubieten, werden gebeten sich per eMail an: info@mayburg.de bei der Kontaktstelle zu melden (unter Angabe von Kontaktdaten, mind. eMail und Telefon) bis längstens Do., 08.01.2025. Sodann wird die LH München - Branddirektion - entsprechend informiert und den weiteren Kontakt für die Fortsetzung der Markterkundung bzw. des Markterkundungsverfahrens suchen.

result.text: Implementation of a heavy rainfall early warning system (SRFAS) for the City of Science Darmstadt. A functional heavy rainfall early warning system has already been established in the Fulda district, which is now to be implemented in the City of Science Darmstadt and optimised with regard to the integration of soil moisture sensor technology. The aim of the SRFAS is to develop an early warning system by deploying city-wide measurement sensors (including precipitation gauges, soil moisture sensors, sewer monitors) and using external data (including precipitation products from the German Meteorological Service), as a mandatory foundation for early or timely action by authorities, emergency services, and citizens. To estimate the required number of sensors and their location (including outside the Darmstadt municipal area), a study is to be conducted at the beginning. The SRFAS is intended to be a uniform overall system whose components are technically, functionally, and temporally linked to one another. Therefore, the contract is to be awarded as a total contract. It is based on an overall concept that is described in detail in the bill of quantities and must be fulfilled in its entirety. 1

parts.source: Implementierung eines Starkregenfrühalarmsystems (SRFAS) für die Wissenschaftsstadt Darmstadt Im Landkreis Fulda wurde bereits ein funktionsfähiges Starkregenfrühalarmsystem aufgebaut, das nun auch in der Wissenschaftsstadt Darmstadt implementiert und hinsichtlich Einbindung von Bodenfeuchtesensorik optimiert werden soll. Ziel des SRFAS ist es, durch Ausbringen einer stadtweiten Messsensorik (u.a. Niederschlagsmesser, Bodenfeuchtesensoren, Kanalwächter) und Nutzung externer Daten (u.a. Niederschlagsprodukte des Deutschen Wetterdienstes) ein Frühwarnsystem zu entwickeln, als zwingend notwendige Grundlage für ein früh- bzw. rechtzeitiges Handeln von Behörden, Einsatzkräften und Bürgerinnen und Bürgern. Zur Schätzung der benötigten Sensorenanzahl und deren Verortung (auch außerhalb der Gemarkung Darmstadts) soll zu Beginn eine Studie durchgeführt werden. Beim SRFAS soll es sich um ein einheitliches Gesamtsystem, dessen Bestandteile technisch, funktional und zeitlich miteinander verknüpft sind, handeln. Daher ist der Auftrag als Gesamtauftrag zu vergeben. Es basiert auf einem Gesamtkonzept, das im Leistungsverzeichnis detailliert beschrieben ist und in seiner Gesamtheit zu erfüllen ist. 1

result.text: This is not a contract notice or a call for tenders, but a request for information with which the contracting authority is conducting a market survey of potential tenderers and solutions available on the market for its procurement need. The information obtained through the market survey will be used in the preparation of the future procurement. Länsi-Uudenmaan hyvinvointialue (LUVN) has a need to procure technology to be taken home for the use of the wellbeing services county's residents, as well as an alarm system that receives the alarms produced by the aforementioned technology. Länsi-Uudenmaan hyvinvointialue is assembling and launching as its own operation a so-called Safety Assistance Service, the goal of which is to enable and support customers' independent coping in their own homes around the clock. A central element in the Safety Assistance Service is the technology utilised in it that is taken to homes or home-like services, and the receiving system for the alarms produced by them. With this request for information, LUVN wants to survey the technology solutions available on the market that are suitable for social and health care, that ensure the customer's safety at home, and solutions suitable for receiving alarms related to these. Länsi-Uudenmaan hyvinvointialue estimates that the procurement entity according to its needs will consist of the following parts, but changes may occur in the entity: - Technology installed at home for the customer's safety (e.g. sensors, detectors, wristbands) as well as their maintenance and backup device services - Safety alarm centre system and mobile software possibly related to it - Service implementation project - Continuous services, support, maintenance and service of the technology and alarm centre system - Expert services related to the aforementioned technology and its utilisation and use during the contract period according to the subscriber's need. To support the specification of its procurement needs, the planning of the procurement and the preparation of the tendering documents, Länsi-Uudenmaan hyvinvointialue wants to engage in a market dialogue with suppliers offering solutions corresponding to the procurement need. Through the market dialogue, the wellbeing services county hopes to receive information generally about solutions on the market corresponding to the object of the procurement. We are interested in your solutions and services related to safety technology supporting living at home and how the solutions direct alarms to the safety alarm receiving system and what features the receiving system includes. We also want to know what kind of information your system produces to support the planning of services offered to the customer for the professional, in addition to alarm information. Suppliers are requested to register for the market dialogue by email to the address: hankinta@luvn.fi Registration is requested to be sent by 3.10.2025 at 12. The registration should be titled as follows: “Kodin turvapalvelulaitteet ja hälytysten vastaanottojärjestelmä” (Home safety service devices and alarm receiving system). The content of the email message is sufficient to be the supplier's name and the contact details of the supplier's contact person. LUVN will be in contact with the contact persons of the suppliers who have registered to agree on the implementation of the market dialogue. According to the wellbeing services county's plans, the market dialogue should include both discussion sessions and the exchange of written material, but the exact schedule of the dialogue will be specified later. The subscriber reserves the possibility to organise one-to-one market dialogue discussions in addition to commenting on written material. The subscriber reserves the right to select a suitable number of Suppliers for one-to-one discussions based on the written responses. The times for the one-to-one discussions will be agreed separately with the Suppliers. The market survey notice does not oblige the contracting authority to carry out the actual procurement procedure. The description of the procurement and the estimated schedule of the procurement procedure as well as other information presented in the market survey notice are preliminary and indicative advance information. Responding or not responding by companies does not prevent participation in a possible procurement procedure. No compensation is paid for participation. The contracting authority will treat the information provided by the registered companies confidentially, and the names of the companies or other information will not be published.

parts.source: Tämä ei ole hankintailmoitus tai tarjouspyyntö, vaan tietopyyntö, jolla hankintayksikkö tekee markkinakartoitusta potentiaalisista tarjoajista ja markkinoilla olevista ratkaisuista hankintatarvettaan varten. Markkinakartoituksella saatuja tietoja käytetään tulevan hankinnan valmistelussa. Länsi-Uudenmaan hyvinvointialueella (LUVN) on tarve hankkia hyvinvointialueen asukkaiden käyttöön kotiin vietävää teknologiaa sekä hälytysjärjestelmä, joka ottaa vastaan em. teknologian tuottamia hälytyksiä. Länsi-Uudenmaan hyvinvointialue on kokoamassa ja käynnistämässä omana toimintana ns. Turva-auttamispalvelua, jonka tavoitteena on mahdollistaa ja tukea asiakkaiden itsenäistä selviytymistä omassa kodissaan ympäri vuorokauden. Keskeisenä elementtinä Turva-auttamispalvelussa on siinä hyödynnettävät kotiin tai kodinomaisiin palveluihin vietävä teknologia, ja niiden tuottamien hälytysten vastaanottojärjestelmä. LUVN haluaa tällä tietopyynnöllä kartoittaa markkinoilla olevia, sosiaali- ja terveydenhuoltoon soveltuvia, kotiin vietäviä asiakkaan turvaa varmistavia teknologiaratkaisuja ja näihin liittyvien hälytysten vastaanottoon soveltuvia ratkaisuja. Länsi-Uudenmaan hyvinvointialue arvioi tarpeidensa mukaisen hankintakokonaisuuden muodostuvan seuraavista osista, mutta kokonaisuudessa voi tapahtua muutoksia: - Asiakkaan turvaksi kotiin asennettava teknologia (esim. sensorit, anturit, rannekkeet) sekä näiden huolto- ja varalaitepalvelut - Turvahälytyskeskusjärjestelmä ja siihen mahdollisesti liittyvät mobiiliohjelmistot - Palvelun käyttöönottoprojekti - Teknologian ja hälytyskeskusjärjestelmän jatkuvat palvelut, tuki ja ylläpito ja huoltopalvelut - Sopimuksenaikaiset, edellä mainittuun teknologiaan ja sen hyödyntämiseen sekä käyttöön liittyvät asiantuntijapalvelut tilaajan tarpeen mukaan Hankintatarpeidensa täsmentämisen, hankinnan suunnittelun ja kilpailutusasiakirjojen laadinnan tueksi Länsi-Uudenmaan hyvinvointialue haluaa käydä markkinavuoropuhelua hankintatarvetta vastaavia ratkaisuja tarjoavien toimittajien kanssa. Markkinavuoropuhelulla hyvinvointialue toivoo saavansa tietoa yleisesti markkinoilla olevista hankinnan kohteen mukaisista ratkaisuista. Olemme kiinnostuneita ratkaisuistanne ja palveluistanne liittyen kotona asumista tukevaan turvateknologiaan ja siitä, miten ratkaisut ohjaavat hälytykset turvahälytysten vastaanottojärjestelmään ja mitä ominaisuuksia vastaanottojärjestelmä sisältää. Haluamme myös tietää, millaista tietoa järjestelmänne tuottaa ammattilaiselle asiakkaalle tarjottavien palvelujen suunnittelun tueksi hälytystiedon lisäksi. Toimittajia pyydetään ilmoittautumaan mukaan markkinavuoropuheluun sähköpostilla osoitteeseen: hankinta@luvn.fi Ilmoittautuminen pyydetään lähettämään 3.10.2025 klo 12 mennessä. Ilmoittautuminen tulee otsikoida seuraavasti: “Kodin turvapalvelulaitteet ja hälytysten vastaanottojärjestelmä” Sähköpostiviestin sisällöksi riittää toimittajan nimi sekä toimittajan yhteyshenkilön yhteystiedot. LUVN on yhteydessä mukaan ilmoittautuneiden toimittajien yhteyshenkilöihin sopiakseen markkinavuoropuhelun toteuttamisesta. Hyvinvointialueen suunnitelmien mukaan markkinavuoropuheluun tulisi sisältymään sekä keskustelutilaisuuksia että kirjallisen materiaalin vaihtoa, mutta täsmällinen vuoropuhelun aikataulu täsmentyy myöhemmin. Tilaaja varaa itselleen mahdollisuuden järjestää kirjallisen materiaalin kommentoinnin lisäksi kahdenkeskisiä markkinavuoropuhelukeskusteluja. Tilaaja varaa oikeuden valita sopivan määrän Toimittajia kahdenkeskisiin keskusteluihin kirjallisten vastauksien perusteella. Kahdenkeskisten keskustelujen ajankohdista sovitaan erikseen Toimittajien kanssa. Markkinakartoitusilmoitus ei velvoita hankintayksikköä toteuttamaan varsinaista hankintamenettelyä. result.text: THIS IS NOT A PRIOR INFORMATION NOTICE, CONTRACT NOTICE OR CALL FOR TENDERS BUT A NOTICE OF THE COMMENCEMENT OF A MARKET DIALOGUE AS PART OF PROCUREMENT PLANNING. Länsi-Uudenmaan hyvinvointialue is planning a tender process where the subject of the procurement is an HR system package for payroll, employment relationship management, personnel development, and travel and expense claim management, including an outsourced payroll service and a travel and expense claim service. The package also potentially includes a statutory archiving solution. The subject of the procurement also includes system implementation and commissioning, support and maintenance services, operational services, and further development services. Länsi-Uudenmaan hyvinvointialue’s payroll and travel and expense claim services are currently outsourced to Sarastia Oy. The services are managed in systems administered by the service provider, S365 HR and M2. S365 HR acts as the master data for personal information. Supervisors, employees and HR have access to the current HR system, which is currently used for employment lifecycle functions - HRD functions are not in use. The new system and service to be procured will support Länsi-Uusimaa’s desire to facilitate and lighten the administrative work of supervisors and to develop the HR system towards a more modern solution that includes HRD functions such as development discussions and the management of permits and qualifications. The goal is not only to select systems but also to build a functional and sustainable partnership with the supplier. The procurement tentatively includes, among other things, the following functionalities and features: - Outsourced payroll service, which will be implemented for all Länsi-Uudenmaan hyvinvointialue personnel, excluding social benefits. The service includes customer service for supervisors and employees. - Payroll system as part of the outsourced payroll service solution. - HR system, which acts as the client’s HR master and covers employment lifecycle management as well as HRD functions such as development discussions, management of permits and qualifications, and support for on-boarding and off-boarding processes. The system must have an electronic signature capability. - Travel and expense claim system, which will be implemented for all Länsi-Uudenmaan hyvinvointialue personnel. - Outsourced travel and expense claim service, which includes, among other things, customer service, weekly payments, and the handling of official reports. - Integrations with the subscriber’s other systems via interfaces. - Advanced automation technologies, which can be used to automate, for example, tasks related to supervisory work and the delivery of data to payroll. The procurement will be carried out using a competitive dialogue procedure. The preliminary procurement schedule is: - Publication of the contract notice by the end of September. - Participation applications by the end of October. - Selection of tenderers by the end of October. - Preliminary call for tenders and sending of invitations to negotiate in November. - Two rounds of negotiations, which will take place in weeks 48 and 50. - Final call for tenders in week 2-3/2026. - Procurement decision in March 2026. - Estimated start time for implementation April 2026. - Services and systems into production use 1.4.2027. Companies interested in the procurement are requested to register by 19.9.2025 at 12.00 to the address: hankinta@luvn.fi. The registration must be titled as follows: “HR kokonaisratkaisun hankinta” (Procurement of HR overall solution). The registration must also contain the following information: - Name of the participating company - Name, telephone number and email address of the contact person - Name of the solution offered by the company. The market survey notice does not oblige the contracting authority to carry out the actual procurement procedure. The description of the procurement and the estimated schedule of the procurement procedure as well as other information presented in the market survey notice are preliminary and indicative advance information. result.text: Ambient Voice Technology (AVT) for Berkshire Healthcare NHS Foundation Trust Lot 1: . Berkshire Healthcare NHS Foundation Trust is seeking to procure an Ambient Voice Technology (AVT) solution to support clinical documentation across a range of services and care settings. The solution should enable clinicians to capture consultations and generate structured clinical outputs including but not limited to documentation, clinical record notes, summaries, and correspondence, while integrating seamlessly into existing clinical workflows and digital systems. The aim is to reduce administrative burden and support more meaningful patient interactions, improving the overall patient experience through more engaged consultations, higher quality documentation, reduced errors, improved continuity of care, and shorter turnaround times for clinic letters and updates. It should also enable clinicians to spend more time focusing on the patient, while maintaining high standards of clinical safety, transparency, and documentation quality. The solution must support use across a range of real-world clinical environments, including inpatient wards, outpatient clinics, and community settings, where factors such as background noise, shared spaces, and variable connectivity may impact performance. The solution must also support consultations involving third parties (e.g. carers, family members, or interpreters), ensuring accurate capture, speaker differentiation, and appropriate inclusion within the output. The contract will be for 2 years with optional extensions for two more years. The procurement will be undertaken using the Artificial Intelligence Dynamic Purchasing System (DPS) RM6200. If you wish to register on this DPS you can find out how to do so here: https://supplierregistration.cabinetoffice.gov.uk/dps/RM6200?nav=0 Please note that all bidders for this requirement must be certified under NHS England's Ambient Voice Technology Self-Certified Supplier Registry. Details can be found here: https://digital.nhs.uk/services/ambient-scribing/ambient-voice-technology-self-certified-supplier-registry. Additional information: Berkshire Healthcare NHS Foundation Trust intends to create a DPS supplier shortlist on 13th October 2026 with the intention of issuing a capability assessment on 14th October 2026, to be returned by 21st October 2026. The intention is for the tender documents to be issued on 10th November 2026 to those bidders who have met the capability assessment requirements. Berkshire Healthcare reserves the right to amend these dates.

result.text: New installation of a digital alerting system using the POCSAG standard (2 MHz band) for non-police emergency response in Landkreis Emmendingen to replace the analogue 5-tone alerting. The subject of the procurement is the supply, installation and commissioning of a network-wide digital alerting system to the POCSAG standard in the 2 MHz band for emergency services and disaster relief organisations in Landkreis Emmendingen, including migration from the existing analogue 5-tone alerting, the supply of end-user devices, and maintenance and service provision. The procurement procedure in question covers the installation of 37 digital alerting transmitter sites within the district area, including antenna and lightning protection engineering as well as the electrotechnical upgrading of the structures for these sites. Furthermore, a total of four digital tone generators (two fixed installations and two mobile emergency tone generators) as well as network and IT technology for the central system engineering at the location of the Emmendingen Integrated Control Centre will be installed. The contract is divided into four lots. Lot 1 covers the digital alerting system engineering, in particular the supply, assembly, commissioning and configuration of the digital alerting transmitters and digital tone generators with subsequent service provision on the basis of an EVB-IT service contract with a fixed term of 24 months. Lot 2 comprises antenna engineering and mast construction, specifically the supply and assembly of antenna masts and lightning protection and earthing components. Lot 3 describes the necessary electrical work. Lot 4 comprises the procurement of end-user devices based on a basket principle with call-offs by the respective authorised municipalities or relief organisations. Lot LOT-0001: Digital alerting system engineering. Supply, assembly and commissioning of the central and decentralised system technology of the digital alerting system (including digital tone generators, digital alerting transmitters, switches, software), including system integration, testing, training and the conclusion of an EVB-IT service contract limited to the first 24 months. Lot LOT-0002: Antenna engineering and mast construction. Supply, assembly and commissioning of antenna systems (2 MHz, GPS, LTE), antenna carriers and mast constructions, including lightning protection and earthing measures and structural verification, as well as coordination with property owners. Lot LOT-0003: Electrical work. Execution of all electrical connection and installation work at transmitter and technical sites, including power supply and documentation in accordance with DIN VDE 0100-600. Lot LOT-0004: End-user devices (basket principle). Supply, installation, configuration and commissioning of end-user devices for receiving the alarm messages transmitted via the components of lot 1, as well as components for the remote programming of these end-user devices (server-client structure) and central components for implementing a call-back functionality from and additional alarm information to the end-user devices via the mobile communications network. The procurement of the end-user devices takes place via a framework agreement based on the basket principle with call-offs by the authorised municipalities and relief organisations.

parts.source: Neu-Errichtung eines Digitalen Alarmierungssystems im POCSAG-Standard (2m Band) für die nichtpolizeiliche Gefahrenabwehr im Landkreis Emmendingen zur Ablösung der analogen 5-Ton-Alarmierung. Gegenstand der Beschaffung ist die Lieferung, Errichtung und Inbetriebnahme eines flächendeckenden Digitalen Alarmierungssystems nach POCSAG Standard im 2m-Band für BOS Organisationen im Landkreis Emmendingen, einschließlich Migration von der bestehenden analogen 5 Ton Alarmierung, der Lieferung von Endgeräten sowie Wartungs- und Serviceleistungen. Das gegenständliche Vergabeverfahren umfasst die Errichtung von 37 Digitalen-Alarmumsetzer-Standorten im Kreisgebiet inkl. Antennen- und Blitzschutztechnik sowie die elektrotechnische Ertüchtigung der Bauwerke für diese Standorte. Des Weiteren werden insgesamt vier Digitale Alarmgeber (zwei Festeinbauten und zwei mobile Notfallalarmgeber) sowie Netzwerk- und IT-Technik für die zentrale Systemtechnik am Standort der Integrierte Leitstelle Emmendingen installiert. Der Auftrag ist in vier Fachlose aufgeteilt. Los 1 umfasst die DA-Systemtechnik, insbesondere die Lieferung, Montage, Inbetriebnahme und Konfiguration der Digitalen Alarmumsetzer und Digitalen Alarmgeber mit einem anschließenden Serviceleistungen auf der Grundlage eines EVB-IT Servicevertrags mit fester Laufzeit von 24 Monaten. Los 2 beinhaltet Antennentechnik und Mastbau, also insbesondere die Lieferung und Montage von Antennenmasten und Blitzschutz- sowie Erdungskomponenten. Los 3 beschreibt die erforderlichen die Elektroarbeiten. Los 4 umfasst die Beschaffung von Endgeräten in Form eines Warenkorb-Prinzips mit Abruf durch die jeweils berechtigten Kommunen bzw. Hilfsorganisationen. Lot LOT-0001: DA Systemtechnik. Lieferung, Aufbau, und Inbetriebnahme der zentralen und dezentralen Systemtechnik des Digitalen Alarmierungssystems (u.a. DAG, DAU, Switche, Software), einschließlich Systemintegration, Tests, Schulung sowie Abschluss eines EVB-IT Servicevertrags befristet für die ersten 24 Monate. Lot LOT-0002: Antennentechnik und Mastbau. Lieferung, Montage und Inbetriebnahme von Antennensystemen (2m, GPS, LTE) Antennenträgern und Mastkonstruktionen einschließlich Blitzschutz- und Erdungsmaßnahmen und statischer Nachweise, sowie Abstimmung mit Grundstückseigentümern. Lot LOT-0003: Elektroarbeiten. Durchführung sämtlicher elektrischer Anschluss- und Installationsarbeiten an Sender- und Technikstandorten, einschließlich Stromversorgung sowie Dokumentation gemäß DIN VDE 0100-600. Lot LOT-0004: Endgeräte (Warenkorb-Prinzip). Lieferung, Installation, Konfiguration und Inbetriebnahme von Endgeräten zum Empfang der über die Komponenten des Loses 1 ausgesendeten Alarmmeldungen sowie von Komponenten zur Fernprogrammierung dieser Endgeräte (Server-Client-Struktur) und zentralen Komponenten zur Realisierung einer Rückmeldefunktionalität von und einer zusätzlichen Alarminformation an die Endgeräte über das Mobilfunknetz. Die Beschaffung der Endgeräte erfolgt über eine Rahmenvereinbarung nach dem Warenkorb-Prinzip mit einem Abruf durch die berechtigten Kommunen und Hilfsorganisationen.

result.text: The Scottish Government’s Directorate for Digital is seeking an innovative service management solution to support a growing portfolio of digital services, including ScotAccount, ScotPayments, mygov.scot, Cloud Platform Services, and more. As demand, complexity and user expectations increase, we require scalable, technology-enabled approaches that can grow as our services grow, while delivering value for money. A successful solution will help ensure resilient, secure and efficient service operations, reducing risks to service quality, productivity, revenue and public trust, while supporting the future development of Scotland’s digital public services. Lot 1: . CivTech’s mission is to drive daring and innovation in the public sector by collaboratively solving Challenges that make people’s lives better – and in doing so create generations of sustainable, high growth businesses. CivTech brings together public sector expertise and private sector innovation to solve real problems, develop new products, and deliver better, faster and easier services for everyone. Central to the approach is co-production with the citizen. Part of the Scottish Government’s Directorate for Digital, CivTech’s approach is helping transform public sector engagement with tech and innovation, delivering significant benefits to public services, producing genuine uplifts for the Scottish economy - and along the way, making lives better. Across the country there are problems public sector organisations would like to solve and in the current environment the need for smart, efficient and effective products has never been greater. The Scottish Government is aware innovation is a good way to create them and is committed to ensuring a large part of its tech spend goes to innovative businesses - whatever stage they’re at, or size they are. This is where CivTech comes in. The CivTech Innovation Flow is designed to create products as quickly and effectively as possible, and uses a true Accelerator model at the heart of its Innovation Flow model. For you – whether you’re an individual, team or company – it’s an opportunity to take on a Challenge, solve it, and win contracts with a blue-chip public sector organisation. You’ll build a product, and a business to take it as far as possible. Because here’s the kicker: the Challenges we issue aren’t ‘single organisation’ problems – most of the problems we are solving exist worldwide. In short: Open Challenges are set. Any organisation, team or individual can respond. Applications are assessed, and shortlisted proposals go into an Exploration Stage where they’re developed further together with the Challenge Sponsor and the CivTech [for which participating applicants are paid]. The best go through to the Accelerator – a period of intensive work to create the solution, and through CivTech’s unique business growth workshop system, a business capable of taking the product to the world. Please visit our website for information on CivTech and how to get involved https://www.civtech.scot/how-to-apply-civtech-12 https://www.civtech.scot/civtech-12-challenge-2-scaling-dynamically-service-management-capabilities

result.text: This is not a procurement notice or a request for tenders, but a market survey and request for information. The National ID forum (informal forum) has decided to organize a joint RFI event. The idea is to organize a single RFI involving several national agencies and ministries, which would maximize synergy benefits and be a cost-effective model. The ID Forum is a national informal cooperation forum that focuses on comprehensive identity management, its development, and creating a situational picture. The aim is to produce national services that develop capacity in identity management, coordinate training and information events, and improve the common situational awareness and ability to combat abuse. Identity is therefore at the heart of the forum and is dealt with within the remit of each member organization. The ID Forum consists of several Finnish agencies and ministries; Immigration Service (FIS), Border Guard Force (BGF), National Bureau of Investigations (NBI), National Police Board (NPB), Police departments, Customs, and Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MoFA). The subject of the RFI and information about the procedure are described in more detail in Appendix 1.

The aim is to produce national services that develop capacity in identity management, coordinate training and information events, and improve the common situational awareness and ability to combat abuse. Identity is therefore at the heart of the forum and is dealt with within the remit of each member organization. The ID Forum consists of several Finnish agencies and ministries; Immigration Service (FIS), Border Guard Force (BGF), National Bureau of Investigations (NBI), National Police Board (NPB), Police departments, Customs, and Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MoFA). The subject of the RFI and information about the procedure are described in more detail in Appendix 1.

Fintraffic Raide Oy (the "contracting authority") is preparing a dynamic purchasing system (DPS) for expert services for rail traffic control application development. The dynamic purchasing system is planned to be established during the end of 2025, and the first procurements within the DPS will be tendered in January 2026. The non-binding estimated value excluding VAT for the 15-year duration of the dynamic purchasing system is approximately 70 million euros. The contracting authority will organise an information session regarding the dynamic purchasing system to be established on Tuesday 25.11.2025 starting at 14:00. The duration of the session is approximately 2 hours. The contracting authority requests interested operators to register for the information session concerning the procurement in the Lyyti system at the address https://www.lyyti.fi/questions/997850cec4. The information session is open to all interested operators. The session will not be recorded. The language of the session is Finnish. The presentation material for the information session will be published openly available after the session at a web address to be announced separately. A summary of the content of the information session will also be published in English after the session. The contracting authority reserves the right to conduct bilateral market dialogue with selected operators after the information session. The contracting authority may also organise a separate technical dialogue, in which it requests selected operators to comment on the preparatory material concerning the procurement before the publication of the actual contract notice. The contracting authority will not pay any compensation to operators for participating in the information session, market dialogue or technical dialogue.

parts.source: Tämä on ennakkoilmoitus tulevasta hankinnasta sekä kutsu hankintaa koskevaan infotilaisuuteen. Kyseessä ei ole hankintailmoitus tai tarjouspyyntö. Fintraffic Raide Oy:n ("hankintayksikkö") valmistelee raideliikenteenohjauksen sovelluskehityksen asiantuntijapalveluiden dynaamista hankintajärjestelmää (DPS). Dynaaminen hankintajärjestelmä on suunniteltu perustettavaksi loppuvuoden 2025 aikana, ja ensimmäiset DPS:n sisäiset hankinnat tullaan kilpailuttamaan tammikuussa 2026. Sitoumukseton ennakoitu arvonlisäveroton arvo 15 vuoden kestoiselle dynaamiselle hankintajärjestelmälle on n. 70 miljoonaa euroa. Hankintayksikkö järjestää perustettavaa dynaamista hankintajärjestelmää koskevan infotilaisuuden tiistaina 25.11.2025 klo 14:00 alkaen. Tilaisuuden kesto on noin 2 tuntia. Hankintayksikkö pyytää kiinnostuneita toimijoita ilmoittautumaan hankintaa koskevaan infotilaisuuteen Lyyti-järjestelmässä osoitteessa https://www.lyyti.fi/questions/997850cec4. Lähetämme kalenterikutsun linkkeineen ilmoittautuneille viimeistään tapahtumapäivän aamuna. Infotilaisuudessa hankintayksikkö kertoo perustettavan dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän tavoitteista, sisällöstä sekä hankintajärjestelmän sisäisten hankintojen hankintasuunnitelmasta. Infotilaisuus on avoin kaikille kiinnostuneille toimijoille. Tilaisuutta ei tallenneta. Tilaisuuden kieli on suomi. Infotilaisuuden esitysmateriaali julkaistaan avoimesti saataville tilaisuuden jälkeen erikseen ilmoitettavaan verkko-osoitteeseen. Tiivistelmä infotilaisuuden sisällöstä julkaistaan tilaisuuden jälkeen myös englannin kielellä. Hankintayksikkö pidättää itsellään oikeuden käydä infotilaisuuden jälkeen kahdenvälistä markkinavuoropuhelua valitsemiensa toimijoiden kanssa. Hankintayksikkö voi lisäksi järjestää erillisen teknisen vuoropuhelun, jossa se pyytää valitsemiaan toimijoita kommentoimaan hankintaa koskevaa valmistelumateriaalia ennen varsinaisen hankintailmoituksen julkaisemista. Hankintayksikkö ei maksa toimijoille mitään korvausta infotilaisuuteen, markkinavuoropuheluun tai tekniseen vuoropuheluun osallistumisesta.

result.text: THIS IS NOT A CONTRACT NOTICE OR A REQUEST FOR TENDERS BUT AN INFORMATION REQUEST FOR MARKET CONSULTATION AND TECHNICAL DIALOGUE. The procurement entity HUS-yhtymä (hereinafter also referred to as the contracting authority) is using this information request to survey the market to support the planning of a potential readiness communication and alert system procurement carried out as a joint procurement (possibly on a Uusimaa regional co-operation area scale). The purpose of the information request is to survey suppliers on the market and their product and service ranges. The aim is to obtain information on, among other things, various solutions, functionalities, pricing models, and the boundary conditions for a potential joint procurement. The details of the joint procurement will be specified later as the procurement preparation progresses. Preliminary objectives of the procurement: The entity under review may consist of one or more parts. Potential use cases include, among others: - critical 2-way alerting and communication as well as video conferencing - regional communication crossing organisational boundaries - workstation messaging and operational communication - situational picture collection and reporting (collection also from actors outside the organisation) - call-outs for work and resource alerts - lone worker safety - browser-based notifications. The solution must take into account multiple communication channels (mobile, SMS, workstations), the information security and operational reliability requirements of the authorities' environment, and integration with other systems. Key themes of the market consultation: - operational reliability and usability in disruption situations - scalability of user numbers - suitability of the joint procurement model - pricing models and potential add-ons - integrations and interfaces - information security, data protection, and the location of the server infrastructure - key benefits and risks (e.g. vendor lock-in). RESPONDING TO THE INFORMATION REQUEST AND MARKET DIALOGUE We kindly ask suppliers interested in the procurement to describe the solutions you offer, taking into account the procurement objectives and themes mentioned above. If you wish, you can also attach brochures or other information about your offered products and services to your response. Please submit responses to the information request by 25.3.2026 to the address kilpailutus.ict@hus.fi. The subject line of the message should state "HUS 105-2026 - Readiness communication and alert system". The contracting authority may, at its discretion, propose clarifying market dialogue discussions with those who have responded to this information request. The responses provided may be utilised in the further preparation of the procurement, potential market dialogue, and requirement definition. Please note that all material is intended solely for conducting this market dialogue. The contracting authority will treat your response confidentially. INFORMATION ON THE PROCEDURE The contracting authority is not initiating a tendering procedure by publishing the information request; instead, a potential contract notice and request for tenders will be published later. The information request does not oblige the contracting authority to carry out the actual procurement. Responding to the information request is not a prerequisite for participating in a potential subsequent tendering procedure. Suppliers will not be paid compensation for responding to the information request or participating in the market dialogue. The contracting authority tentatively plans to publish the request for tenders during the year 2026.

parts.source: TÄMÄ EI OLE HANKINTAILMOITUS TAI TARJOUSPYYNTÖ VAAN TIETOPYYNTÖ MARKKINAKARTOITUSTA JA TEKNISTÄ VUOROPUHELUA VARTEN. HANKINNAN KOHDE HUS-yhtymä (jäljempänä myös hankintayksikkö) kartoittaa tämän tietopyynnön avulla markkinoita mahdollisen yhteishankintana (mahdollisesti YTA-laajuisesti) toteutettavan valmiusviestintä- ja hälytysjärjestelmähankinnan suunnittelun tueksi. Tietopyynnön tarkoituksena on kartoittaa markkinoilla olevia toimittajia sekä heidän tuote- ja palveluvalikoimaansa. Tavoitteena on saada tietoa mm. erilaisista ratkaisuista, toiminnallisuuksista, hinnoittelumalleista sekä mahdollisen yhteishankinnan reunaehdoista. Yhteishankinnan tiedot täsmentyvät myöhemmin hankinnan valmistelun edetessä. Hankinnan alustavia tavoitteita: Tarkasteltava kokonaisuus voi muodostua yhdestä tai useammasta osasta. Mahdollisia käyttötapauksia ovat mm.: - kriittinen 2-suuntainen hälyttäminen ja viestintä sekä videoneuvottelu - alueellinen ja organisaatiorajat ylittävä viestintä - työasematiedotus ja operatiivinen viestintä - tilannekuvan kerääminen ja raportointi (kerääminen myös organisaation ulkopuolisilta toimijoilta) - työhönkutsut ja resurssihälytykset - yksintyöskentelyn turvallisuus - selainpohjaiset ilmoitukset. Ratkaisussa tulee huomioida useat viestintäkanavat (mobiili, SMS, työasemat), viranomaisympäristön tietoturva- ja toimintavarmuusvaatimukset ja integraatio muihin järjestelmiin. Markkinakartoituksen keskeisiä teemoja: - toimintavarmuus ja käytettävyys häiriötilanteissa - skaalautuvuus käyttäjämäärissä - yhteishankintamallin soveltuvuus - hinnoittelumallit ja mahdolliset lisäosat - integraatiot ja rajapinnat - tietoturva, tietosuoja ja palvelininfrastruktuurin sijainti - keskeiset hyödyt ja riskit (esim. toimittajalukko). TIETOPYYNTÖÖN VASTAAMINEN JA MARKKINAVUOROPUHELU Pyydämme hankinnasta kiinnostuneita toimittajia kertomaan tarjoamistanne ratkaisuista huomioiden edellä mainitut hankinnan tavoitteet ja teemat. Voitte halutessanne liittää vastaukseenne myös esitteitä tai muuta tietoa tarjoamistanne tuotteista ja palveluista. Pyydämme toimittamaan vastaukset tietopyyntöön 25.3.2026 mennessä osoitteeseen kilpailutus.ict@hus.fi. Viestin aiheeksi maininta "HUS 105-2026 - Valmiusviestintä- ja hälytysjärjestelmä". Hankintayksikkö voi harkintansa mukaan ehdottaa tarkentavia markkinavuoropuhelukeskusteluja tähän tietopyyntöön vastanneiden kanssa. Annettuja vastauksia voidaan hyödyntää hankinnan jatkovalmistelussa, mahdollisessa markkinavuoropuhelussa sekä vaatimusmäärittelyssä. Pyydämme huomioimaan, että kaikki materiaali on tarkoitettu ainoastaan tämän markkinavuoropuhelun käymiseen. Hankintayksikkö käsittelee vastauksenne luottamuksellisesti. TIETOA MENETTELYSTÄ Hankintayksikkö ei aloita tietopyynnön julkaisulla tarjouskilpailua, vaan mahdollinen hankintailmoitus ja tarjouspyyntö julkaistaan myöhemmin. Tietopyyntö ei velvoita hankintayksikköä toteuttamaan varsinaista hankintaa. Tietopyyntöön vastaaminen ei ole edellytys myöhempään mahdollisesti järjestettävään tarjouskilpailuun osallistumiselle. Toimittajille ei makseta korvausta tietopyyntöön vastaamisesta tai markkinavuoropuheluun osallistumisesta. Hankintayksikkö suunnittelee alustavasti julkaisevansa tarjouspyynnön vuoden 2026 aikana.
