result.text: In order to protect Statens IT (Ordering Party) against current and future cyber threats, the Ordering Party uses a number of security technologies, including an Extended Detection and Response (XDR) platform. The XDR platform supports the collection, correlation and analysis of security-related incidents across the Ordering Party's IT environment in order to protect systems, services and data, as well as to ensure the confidentiality, integrity and availability of the data. In view of this, the Ordering Party is tendering a contract whose purpose is to support and strengthen the Ordering Party's own operational IT security through the provision of a Managed Detection and Response (MDR) service from a Security Operations Center (SOC). The MDR service must use and supplement the Ordering Party's XDR platform with round-the-clock monitoring, analysis, detection, validation, escalation and handling of security incidents. The service must be delivered 24 hours a day, 365 days a year, and contribute to the rapid identification, assessment and handling of cyber threats and security incidents. The services constitute an essential element in the Ordering Party's ongoing maturation and development process in the field of cybersecurity with a focus on technology, processes, competencies and collaboration across internal and external stakeholders. Through the procurement, the Ordering Party wishes to gain access to a professional MDR service that can meet the Ordering Party's high demands for quality, robustness and efficiency, as well as a supplier that can continuously engage in dialogue with the Ordering Party on developments within cybersecurity, including the threat picture, technological opportunities, automation, competence development and ongoing improvements to the security level. The supplier must carry out a technical, organisational and procedural Transition In, which ensures that the ongoing MDR services can be delivered from the transition to the operational phase. The Ordering Party draws attention to the fact that the Ordering Party has concluded a contract with two (2) suppliers to handle the Ordering Party's existing XDR platform, with whom the supplier must cooperate in connection with Transition In. As part of this, the supplier must establish and configure the necessary integrations between the Ordering Party's XDR platform and other relevant security sources, as well as the supplier's tools and platforms used for the fulfilment of the contract. The supplier must deliver Ongoing MDR Services; including continuous monitoring, analysis, correlation, validation and detection of alarms and security incidents. The supplier must carry out triage and qualification of alarms in order to identify actual security incidents and ensure timely escalation and notification in accordance with agreed processes and service levels. These ongoing MDR services include: • Continuous SOC monitoring of security-related incidents and alarms. • Analysis, correlation and qualification of incidents across relevant data sources. • Identification, detection and validation of security incidents. • Preparation, implementation and ongoing optimisation of detection rules, use cases and analysis models. • Application of relevant Threat Intelligence to support the detection and analysis work. • Ongoing assessment of the threat picture and its relevance to the Ordering Party's environment. • Proactive identification of potential security incidents and security risks, including through Threat Hunting activities. • Escalation, notification and reporting of security incidents in accordance with agreed processes and service levels. • Maintenance of existing integrations and establishment of new integrations as needed. • Optimisation and further development of the Ordering Party's XDR platform and other security solutions. • Advice regarding the development and maturation of the Ordering Party's security organisation, security processes and governance. • Execution of targeted Threat Hunting courses and analyses of suspicious activities. • Incident Response assistance in the event of security incidents upon requisition from the Ordering Party, including analysis, delimitation, handling, remediation and recovery. • Assistance during major security incidents, cyber crises and coordination with relevant stakeholders. • Security-related advice and strategic sparring on developments within cybersecurity. The contract also includes cross-cutting services, including documentation, reporting, governance, quality assurance and information security, which are delivered throughout the contract period. Furthermore, the contract includes obligations upon contract termination (Transition Out), which must ensure a controlled, secure and documented transfer of knowledge, data, processes, integrations and other contract-related deliverables to the Ordering Party or a subsequent supplier.

parts.source: Med henblik på at beskytte Statens IT (Ordregiver) mod aktuelle og fremtidige cybertrusler anvender Ordregiver en række sikkerhedsteknologier, herunder en Extended Detection and Response (XDR)-platform. XDR-platformen understøtter indsamling, korrelation og analyse af sikkerhedsrelaterede hændelser på tværs af Ordregivers it-miljø med henblik på at beskytte systemer, tjenester og data samt sikre dataenes fortrolighed, integritet og tilgængelighed. Henset hertil udbyder Ordregiver en kontrakt, hvis formål er at understøtte og styrke Ordregivers egen operative it-sikkerhed gennem levering af en Managed Detection and Response (MDR)-tjeneste fra et Security Operations Center (SOC). MDR-tjenesten skal anvende og supplere Ordregivers XDR-platform med døgnbemandet overvågning, analyse, detektion, validering, eskalering og håndtering af sikkerhedshændelser. Tjenesten skal leveres 24 timer i døgnet, 365 dage om året, og bidrage til hurtig identifikation, vurdering og håndtering af cybertrusler og sikkerhedshændelser. Tjenesteydelserne udgør et væsentligt element i Ordregivers fortsatte modnings- og udviklingsproces på cybersikkerhedsområdet med fokus på teknologi, processer, kompetencer og samarbejde på tværs af interne og eksterne interessenter. Med udbuddet ønsker Ordregiver adgang til en professionel MDR-tjeneste, der kan imødekomme Ordregivers høje krav til kvalitet, robusthed og effektivitet, samt en leverandør, der løbende kan indgå i dialog med Ordregiver om udviklingen inden for cybersikkerhed, herunder trusselsbilledet, teknologiske muligheder, automatisering, kompetenceudvikling og løbende forbedringer af sikkerhedsniveauet. Leverandøren skal gennemføre en teknisk, organisatorisk og processuel Transition Ind, der sikrer, at de løbende MDR-ydelser kan leveres fra overgang til driftsfasen. Ordregiver gør opmærksom på, at Ordregiver har indgået kontrakt med to (2) leverandører til varetagelse af Ordregivers eksisterende XDR-platform, som leverandøren skal samarbejde med i forbindelse med Transition Ind. Som led heri skal leverandøren etablere og konfigurere de nødvendige integrationer mellem Ordregivers XDR-platform og øvrige relevante sikkerhedskilder samt leverandørens værktøjer og platforme, der anvendes til kontraktens opfyldelse. Leverandøren skal levere Løbende MDR-ydelser; herunder kontinuerlig overvågning, analyse, korrelation, validering og detektion af alarmer og sikkerhedshændelser. Leverandøren skal foretage triagering og kvalificering af alarmer med henblik på at identificere reelle sikkerhedshændelser samt sikre rettidig eskalering og advisering i overensstemmelse med aftalte processer og serviceniveauer. Disse løbende MDR-ydelser omfatter herunder: • Kontinuerlig SOC-overvågning af sikkerhedsrelaterede hændelser og alarmer. • Analyse, korrelation og kvalificering af hændelser på tværs af relevante datakilder. • Identifikation, detektion og validering af sikkerhedshændelser. • Udarbejdelse, implementering og løbende optimering af detektionsregler, use cases og analysemodeller. • Anvendelse af relevant Threat Intelligence til understøttelse af detektions- og analysearbejdet. • Løbende vurdering af trusselsbilledet og dets relevans for Ordregivers miljø. • Proaktiv identifikation af potentielle sikkerhedshændelser og sikkerhedsrisici, herunder gennem Threat Hunting-aktiviteter. • Eskalering, advisering og rapportering af sikkerhedshændelser i henhold til aftalte processer og serviceniveauer. • Vedligeholdelse af eksisterende integrationer samt etablering af nye integrationer efter behov. • Optimering og videreudvikling af Ordregivers XDR-platform og øvrige sikkerhedsløsninger. • Rådgivning vedrørende udvikling og modning af Ordregivers sikkerhedsorganisation, sikkerhedsprocesser og governance. • Gennemførelse af målrettede Threat Hunting-forløb og analyser af mistænkelige aktiviteter. • Incident Response-bistand ved sikkerhedshændelser efter rekvisition fra Ordregiver, herunder analyse, afgrænsning, håndtering, afhjælpning og genopretning. • Bistand ved større sikkerhedshændelser, cyberkriser og koordination med relevante interessenter. • Sikkerhedsfaglig rådgivning og strategisk sparring om udviklingen inden for cybersikkerhed. Kontrakten omfatter desuden tværgående ydelser, herunder dokumentation, rapportering, governance, kvalitetssikring og informationssikkerhed, der leveres gennem hele kontraktperioden. Endvidere omfatter kontrakten forpligtelser ved kontraktophør (Transition Ud), der skal sikre en kontrolleret, sikker og dokumenteret overdragelse af viden, data, processer, integrationer og øvrige kontraktrelaterede leverancer til Ordregiver eller en efterfølgende leverandør.

result.text: Advisory services for the format "Digi-Expert-kommunal" for the Hessian Ministry for Digitalisation and Innovation in two lots Lot LOT-0001: Foundations of digital transformation. Hessian municipalities are currently in very different phases of digital transformation. Municipalities have very different advisory needs in the course of digital transformation and in the planning and implementation of digitalisation projects. Projects with a high degree of innovation in particular bring with them a wide range of issues that must be answered promptly and individually for successful implementation. This can also be clearly observed in the digitalisation projects funded via the promotion of smart municipalities and regions under the "Starke Heimat Hessen" programme. The Smart Region office anchored in the Hessian Ministry for Digitalisation and Innovation (HMD) will therefore expand its advisory services for municipalities. The new advisory format "Digi-Expert-kommunal" is intended to offer Hessian municipalities individual, provider- and product-neutral ad hoc advice on various topics: from digital strategy, change management, project management to specialist topics such as data platforms, open source, artificial intelligence (AI), digital twin, digitalisation of services of general interest (smart city/smart region). The HMD will make available a pool of experts via the Smart Region office, from which municipalities can choose as needed. They can book them for various occasions/settings via the Smart Region office. This is intended to provide an impetus for the digital transformation of the municipalities and to dismantle hurdles in digitalisation. From October to December 2025, the format "Digi-Expert-kommunal" was piloted with selected topics and a limited quota. In the three-month pilot phase, a total of 52 advisory discussions were brokered. These were accounted for by 40 municipalities. 26 municipalities were each brokered one advisory discussion, 14 municipalities were brokered two or three advisory discussions. The advisory effort (= duration of discussion + preparation and follow-up) per municipality was limited to ten hours. Each of the advised municipalities took up an average of 5,7 hours of advisory effort from the following topics in the short pilot phase: AI in administration/AI in services of general interest, procurement advice (not the subject of this call for competition), digital strategy, digital services of general interest/smart region in general, change management/digital mindset, digital twin, project management/project control, open source/proprietary solutions. The format was very well received within a very short time and with minimal communication effort. The feedback from the municipalities was consistently positive and once again confirmed the need for tailor-made and short-term advice. The advisory need could not be nearly covered within the pilot phase. During the evaluation, the municipalities wished for a continuation and expansion of the offer. Lot 1 comprises general advisory topics relating to digital transformation and thus creates the basis for municipalities to deal with technical implementation later (Lot 2). In particular advice on: • Digital strategy, • Project management, • Change management, • Digital services of general interest, • Citizen participation. For this lot, based on the figures from the pilot phase and an assumed number of 270 interested municipalities, a demand of 810 hours per year is estimated. This estimated quantity serves calculation purposes only. There is no entitlement to call off this quantity. Further details can be found in the specification of services. parts.source: Beratungsleistungen für das Format "Digi-Expert-kommunal" für das Hessische Ministerium für Digitalisierung und Innovation in zwei Losen Lot LOT-0001: Grundlagen der digitalen Transformation. Die hessischen Kommunen befinden sich aktuell in sehr unterschiedlichen Phasen der digitalen Transformation. Für Kommunen ergeben sich im Zuge der digitalen Transformation und bei der Planung und Umsetzung von Digitalisierungsvorhaben sehr unterschiedliche Beratungsbedarfe. Gerade Projekte mit hohem Innovationsgrad bringen vielfältige Fragestellungen mit sich, die für eine erfolgreiche Umsetzung zeitnah und individuell beantwortet werden müssen. Bei den über die Förderung smarter Kommunen und Regionen im Programm "Starke Heimat Hessen" geförderten Digitalisierungsvorhaben lässt sich dies ebenfalls deutlich beobachten. Die im Hessischen Ministerium für Digitalisierung und Innovation (HMD) verankerte Geschäftsstelle Smarte Region wird daher ihr Beratungsangebot für die Kommunen erweitern. Das neue Beratungsformat "Digi-Expert-kommunal" soll hessischen Kommunen individuelle, anbieter- und produktneutrale ad hoc-Beratungen zu verschiedenen Themen anbieten: von Digitalstrategie, Changemanagement, Projektmanagement bis zu fachspezifischen Themen wie Datenplattformen, Open Source, Künstliche Intelligenz (KI), Digitaler Zwilling, Digitalisierung der Daseinsvorsorge (Smart City-/Smart-Region). Das HMD wird über die Geschäftsstelle Smarte Region einen Pool an Expertinnen und Experten zur Verfügung stellen, aus dem Kommunen je nach Bedarf wählen können. Sie können diese für unterschiedliche Anlässe/Settings über die Geschäftsstelle Smarte Region buchen. Damit soll ein Impuls für die digitale Transformation der Kommunen gegeben und Hemmnisse bei der Digitalisierung abgebaut werden. Von Oktober bis Dezember 2025 wurde das Format "Digi-Expert-kommunal" mit ausgewählten Themen sowie einem begrenzten Kontingent pilotiert. In der dreimonatigen Pilotphase wurden insgesamt 52 Beratungsgespräche vermittelt. Diese entfielen auf 40 Kommunen. 26 Kommunen wurde je ein Beratungsgespräch vermittelt, 14 Kommunen wurden zwei oder drei Beratungsgespräche vermittelt. Der Beratungsaufwand (= Gesprächsdauer + Vor- und Nachbereitung) je Kommune war auf zehn Stunden begrenzt. Jede der beratenen Kommune nahm in der kurzen Pilotphase im Durchschnitt 5,7 Stunden Beratungsaufwand aus den folgenden Themen in Anspruch: KI in der Verwaltung/KI in der Daseinsvorsorge, Vergabeberatung (kein Beratungsgegenstand dieser Ausschreibung), Digitalstrategie, Digitale Daseinsvorsorge/Smart Region allgemein, Change-Management/Digital Mindset, Digitaler Zwilling, Projektmanagement/Projektsteuerung, Open Source/proprietäre Lösungen. Das Format wurde innerhalb kürzester Zeit und mit minimalem Kommunikationsaufwand sehr gut angenommen. Das Feedback der Kommunen war durchweg positiv und hat den Bedarf nach passgenauer und kurzfristiger Beratung nochmals bestätigt. Der Beratungsbedarf konnte innerhalb der Pilotierung nicht annähernd abgedeckt werden. Die Kommunen wünschten sich im Rahmen der Evaluation eine Verstetigung und Ausweitung des Angebots. Das Los 1 umfasst allgemeine Beratungsthemen rund um die digitale Transformation und schafft damit Grundlage für die Kommunen, um sich später mit der technischen Umsetzung (Los 2) zu befassen. Insbesondere Beratung: • Digitalstrategie, • Projektmanagement, • Changemanagement, • Digitale Daseinsvorsorge, • Bürgerbeteiligung. Für dieses Los wird auf Basis der Zahlen aus der Pilotphase und einer angenommenen Zahl von 270 interessierten Kommunen ein Bedarf von 810 Stunden pro Jahr geschätzt. Diese Schätzmenge dient nur der Kalkulation. Ein Anspruch auf Abruf dieser Menge besteht nicht. Weitere Details sind der Leistungsbeschreibung zu entnehmen. result.text: The human resources unit (subscriber) of the City of Kotka (procurement unit) invites tenders for a payroll services operator, human resources services and supporting IT systems (service entity) in accordance with the tender invitation and its appendices. The procurement contract will be concluded until further notice with a single tenderer that is most economically advantageous (in the procurement documents service provider, supplier). During the contract period, the service provider shall produce the payroll payment service and human resources services outsourced by the subscriber as a service entity in accordance with the appendices of the tender invitation. The production of the services shall comply with legislation in force at any given time, national decrees binding the service provider and the subscriber, statements, guidelines and good accounting practice. result.text: INTRODUCTION Mid Ulster District Council is preparing a procurement for the renewal, supply, management and optimisation of its Microsoft enterprise licensing, associated CSP services and specialist Microsoft expertise. This pre-market engagement exercise will help the Council understand available market models, risks, pricing approaches, support arrangements and proportionate requirements before any formal procurement is issued. PURPOSE AND OBJECTIVES OF THIS PRE-MARKET ENGAGEMENT EXERCISE The objectives are to confirm market interest, test the most suitable agreement route and service model, identify risks or dependencies, understand pricing and governance options, and inform the Council's procurement strategy. This is not a procurement process and responses will not be evaluated as part of any future tender. BACKGROUND INFORMATION The Council's Microsoft estate includes Microsoft 365, Dynamics 365, Teams, Power Platform, Azure, server licensing and associated Software Assurance requirements. Market input is sought on CSP, Enterprise Agreement or other Microsoft agreement routes, billing options, licence optimisation, tenant support, adoption, security and compliance support, escalation and access to qualified Microsoft expertise. STATEMENT OF REQUIREMENTS MUDC wishes to establish a contract with a suitably experienced Microsoft CSP partner to provide: • licensing renewal, supply and management through CSP, Enterprise Agreement or another suitable route; • licence optimisation, proof of licence, inventory records, renewal tracking and compliance reporting; • Microsoft 365, Azure, Dynamics 365, Teams, Power Platform, security, compliance, identity, endpoint and server licensing expertise; • support for billing, subscription changes, incidents, Microsoft escalation, account governance and roadmap advice; The Council also wishes to understand transparent pricing structures, including margins, discounts, billing models, separate professional services rates and how best to separate user subscriptions, device subscriptions, Azure consumption, server licensing, trial/free SKUs and advisory services. Responses should assist the Council in considering proportionate partner status, accreditations, insurance, service capability, support model and future evaluation balance between price, quality and added value. 5.0 PRE-MARKET ENGAGEMENT APPROACH INDICATIVE PROCUREMENT TIMEFRAME 7.0 Indicative milestones: PME published 10th September 2026 ; responses due via eTendersNI by 3.00 pm on 24th September 2026; procurement launch October , contract award December ; licensing renewal / contract commencement 31st January 2027. Lot 1: .

result.text: The UK Home Office (referred to hereafter as the Authority) is inviting prospective bidders to take part in a series of pre-market engagement activities for the Authority's planned QAT procurements. The Authority currently has a number of contracts for QAT capability, aligned to portfolios across the Home Office. The future commercial strategy is to consolidate these services into two core testing capability contracts by Autumn 2027. The exact scope, duration and values of the new contracts is still to be confirmed, however the current expectation is that each contract will have a minimum term of 3-years, with a maximum spend of £150m (including any extensions). The intention is to compete these contracts via the GCA Dynamic Purchasing System, RM6148, however the pre-market engagement is open to all suppliers. Before any tender activity is launched, the Authority wishes to invite feedback from prospective bidders on the proposed strategy and gather information that will help it to refine its procurement and contracting approach further. Key topics that the Authority wishes to explore include, but are not limited to: 1. Route to market 2. Transition approach 3. Key Performance Indicators & contractual incentives (i.e. Service Credits) 4. Cost drivers 5. The use of innovation and AI to drive efficiency 6. Roles and Capability 7. Tooling and hardware 8. Removing barriers for SMEs 9. Support in the transformation from a Programme SDLC to a Product SDLC, including using experience gained from other clients to help shape and drive the change 10. Support in the transformation from Quality Assurance to Quality Engineering, including using experience gained from other clients to help shape and drive the change This engagement shall start with an in-person event from 10:30 until 13:00 on Monday 27th July at the TechUK office in London; 10 Saint Bride St, London, EC4A 4AD. Each supplier may bring a maximum of 2 delegates to the day, and should confirm who these individuals are no later than 17:00 (BST) on Thursday 23rd July. Suppliers can register their interest for this event by registering an account on the Authority's eSourcing Portal (https://homeoffice.app.jaggaer.com) and navigating to the opportunity titled 'pqq_823 - Pre-Market Engagement for Home Office Quality Assurance & Test Engineering (QAT) Contracts'. Once registered against this opportunity, you should submit a response to the 'Qualification Envelope' with the names and email addresses for the 2 delegates who you plan to attend the event. NOTE: Expressions of interest for this opportunity should NOT be sent via email and must be done as instructed via the eSourcing Portal above. Following the event, a Request for Information questionnaire will be issued to all suppliers who have expressed an interest in the opportunity; attendance at the in-person event is not mandatory for this, but is encouraged to help your understanding.

result.text: The project "Integrated Territorial Development and Good Governance in Togo" is implemented by the Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit (GIZ) GmbH on behalf of the German Federal Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development (BMZ). It supports the Government of Togo in advancing decentralisation and territorial development in the regions of Kara and Savanes. Despite progress in decentralisation, regional and local authorities face persistent challenges in exercising transferred competences, delivering quality public services, mobilising local revenues and promoting inclusive local economic development. These constraints are compounded by poverty, climate change, demographic pressure and a fragile security context in northern Togo. The overall objective is to enable regional and local actors to harness the social and economic potential of their territories to improve living conditions in an equitable and sustainable manner. The project applies an integrated territorial development approach with capacity development at individual, organisational and institutional levels. It cooperates with national ministries (Ministry of Local Development, Ministry of Decentralisation, Ministry of Finance), regional councils and municipalities, the National Training Agency for Local Authorities (Agence nationale de formation des collectivités territoriales, ANFCT), the National Association of Municipalities (Faîtière des Communes du Togo, FCT), civil society organisations and private sector actors. To sustain decentralisation and territorialisation efforts, the project also aims at strengthening socio-economic resilience, in particular of communities in the Northen border regions, and provide economic perspectives, in particular for young people. Activities are structured around three complementary outputs: (1) Strengthening the capacities of regional and local authorities to implement transferred competences. (2) Improving collaboration between public institutions, local authorities, civil society and the private sector for inclusive and conflict-sensitive territorial development. (3) Strengthening transparent, participatory and accountable local public financial management. Innovative elements include municipal benchmarking, peer-to-peer learning, digital solutions for local governance, performance-based management and evidence-based decision-making. Gender equality, social inclusion (LNOB), climate resilience, conflict sensitivity and digitalisation are mainstreamed across all interventions to ensure sustainable and scalable results. The assignment targets 38 municipalities in Kara and Savanes through FCT and ANFCT, with a view to progressive replication towards all 117 municipalities. Benchmarking and peer learning will be designed, piloted and institutionalised to steer capacity development and foster continuous improvement. In addition, specialised technical assistance will complement these mechanisms across the three outputs, including support for implementing transferred competences, facilitating inclusive territorial collaboration and strengthening local public financial management (e. g. participatory budgeting, revenue mobilisation, transparency and anti-corruption), while ensuring digital solutions adhere to recognised standards and are interoperable with national ecosystems. The objective of the assignment is to provide comprehensive technical assistance supporting the implementation of the project "Integrated Territorial Development and Good Governance in Togo" through institutional development, digital transformation, municipal benchmarking, peer-to-peer learning and specialised technical expertise contributing to integrated territorial development and good local governance in northern Togo. GIZ seeks to contract a consultancy firm for an implementation period of 24 months. The contractor will provide technical services through two Key Experts and a pool of short-term experts with international, regional and national experience allowing demand-driven mobilisation of specialised expertise throughout project implementation. The overall contract is expected to require approximately 1.500 expert days, delivered through individual experts and expert pools. The assignment is organised around four complementary work packages: Work Package 1: Development and institutionalisation of municipal benchmarking The contractor will support the development and implementation of a harmonised benchmarking system for municipalities, including performance frameworks, indicators, data collection methodologies, digital data management solutions and institutional anchoring in close collaboration within the National Association of Municipalities of Togo (FCT). The performance assessment on key competences of municipalities through the benchmarking system will provide the basis for mutual learning by identifying individual strengths and weaknesses across municipalities. Work Package 2: Development and institutionalisation of peer-to-peer learning The contractor will support the National Training Agency for Local Authorities (ANFCT) in establishing sustainable peer-to-peer learning mechanisms based on the benchmarking results, including learning methodologies, training concepts, organisational arrangements and knowledge management. Work Package 3: Operational implementation The contractor will support the implementation of benchmarking and peer-to-peer learning in the target municipalities through data collection and analysis, facilitation of learning events, capacity development, capitalisation of experiences and gradual institutionalisation of the developed mechanisms.

result.text: The National Institute of Mental Health (NIMH) intends to issue a single-source cooperative agreement award to the University of California, Santa Cruz. The award will renew the Data Resource and Administrative Coordination Center (DRACC), a component of the Scalable and Systematic Neurobiology of Psychiatric and Neurodevelopmental Disorder Risk Genes (SSPsyGene) Consortium. The long-term goal of SSPsyGene is to systematically study how risk genes for neurodevelopmental and psychiatric disorders (NPDs) affect molecular, cellular, circuit, systems/organismal biology. The renewed DRACC will refine its focus on developing a sustainable knowledge base, with shared terms, definitions, and data standards that are interoperable with other knowledge platforms and will enable the use of artificial intelligence to accelerate research on brain function and NPDs. This resource will be made available for broad use by the biomedical community. Projects that propose to build on the DRACC's current role in refining methods and standards to harmonize data from the SSPsyGene Assay and Data Generation Centers and facilitate submission to data archives are encouraged. This is a forecast for a single source NOFO that will invite application(s) from eligible organization(s) to apply. Please see Section III. Eligibility for additional information. In accordance with NIH standard peer-review processes, the application(s) will be peer-reviewed, and only meritorious application(s) will be considered for funding.

result.text: This is a notice of a future procurement. This is not an actual contract notice or call for tenders, and it does not initiate a procurement procedure. The notice concerns a joint procurement planned by the wellbeing services counties of East Uusimaa, Central Uusimaa, and West Uusimaa, as well as Vantaa-Kerava, regarding a comprehensive service for medical devices. An information session has already been held previously regarding the procurement, where the planned content of the procurement was presented. However, the content has changed significantly from what was previously announced, so the contracting authorities wish to inform everyone of their new plans extensively. The purpose of this notice is to survey potential operators in the market and request their comments on the prepared procurement material drafts. The goal is to procure a comprehensive service for medical devices for all participating regions according to the individual needs of each region. The need is to procure all activities related to the lifecycle management of medical devices, such as: acquisition (survey of current devices), acceptance inspections and registrations, periodic maintenance, fault repairs and disposals, and a device register. The procurement materials will be sent to all interested parties. Interest in commenting on the materials should be notified by email to the address lisa.alho@keusote.fi by 27.11.2025. Comments on the materials are requested to be submitted to the same address by 1.12.2025. The procurement will be carried out as a negotiated procedure, and the first notice is intended to be published soon after receiving the suppliers' comments, during the latter part of the year 2025. With this market dialogue, we aim to ensure a competitive procurement that takes into account the operators' thoughts on the current state of the market and their capability to participate in the procurement procedure. Participating or not participating in this market dialogue does not exclude participation in the potential actual procurement. The market dialogue is an open exchange of information, and no view, opinion, statement, or document from this market dialogue binds or obligates either party to anything. Participating or not participating in this market dialogue does not exclude participation in the potential actual procurement. No fee is paid for participating in the market dialogue.

result.text: The project is aimed at potential international travellers and describes the possibility of active travel in Germany (focusing on hiking, cycling, and canoeing where applicable). The experience does not present individual destinations or tourism products, but rather conveys the characteristic qualities of Germany as a diverse active travel destination. The focus is on typical travel experiences and the combination of nature, physical activity, culture, culinary enjoyment, and relaxation that characterise active holidays in Germany. The project serves not only to impart knowledge, but the guest should be addressed, "taken by the hand", complete simple tasks, and be emotionally engaged. This has at least the same priority as the information. Objective: Extension of the length of stay. The project is to be developed for the output channels virtual reality (including inflight entertainment on aircraft with VR headsets), mobile, and web in order to generate the widest possible reach. This pilot project concerns a new type of destination marketing in which combinations of user engagement, user guidance, and content presentation from gaming, VR, artificial (AI-supported) content generation, and real content are combined. The bidder must combine these different skills and create an appealing, interactive product that fascinates customers with Germany as a travel destination. In addition to virtual environments, scenarios, and avatars (or digital entities/objects), the project should also incorporate existing media from the GNTB (photos, films, drone footage, 360-degree panoramas, etc.) and present them in an impressive, interactive form. Depending on the concept, further media may need to be digitally created, purchased, or shot. In addition, the use of (a few) Gaussian splats is planned for the first time, provided it makes sense in terms of content and technology. To our knowledge, the planned mix of (partially photorealistic) digitally created content and real images, panoramas, videos, and avatars is unprecedented in tourism marketing. Further information can be found in the service description in the tender document. Lot LOT-0000: Active travel in Germany. parts.source: Das Projekt richtet sich an potenzielle internationale Reisengäste und beschreibt die Möglichkeit von Aktivreisen in Deutschland (Fokus auf Wandern, Radfahren, ggf. Kanu).Die Experience präsentiert nicht einzelne Destinationen oder touristische Produkte, sondern vermittelt die charakteristischen Qualitäten Deutschlands als vielfältiges Aktivreiseziel. Im Mittelpunkt stehen typische Reiseerlebnisse und die Kombination aus Natur, Bewegung, Kultur, Genuss und Regeneration, die den Aktivurlaub in Deutschland auszeichnen. Das Projekt dient nicht nur der Wissensvermittlung, sondern der Gast soll an gesprochen, „an die Hand genommen“ werden, leichte Aufgaben erledigen und emotional eingebunden werden. Dies hat mindestens den gleichen Stellenwert wie die Information. Ziel: Verlängerung der Verweildauer. Das Projekt soll für die Ausgabekanäle Virtual Reality (inkl. Inflight Entertainment in Flugzeugen mit VR-Brillen), Mobile und Web entwickelt werden, um eine möglichst hohe Reichweite zu generieren.In diesem Pilotprojekt geht es um eine neue Art des Destinationsmarketings, bei dem Kombinationen der Nutzeransprache, Nutzerführung und Contentdar stellung aus Gaming, VR, künstlicher (KI-gestützter) Contentgenerierung und realem Content kombiniert werden. Der Bieter muss diese verschiedenen Skills vereinen und ein ansprechendes, interaktives Produkt erstellen, dass den Kunden vom Reiseland Deutschland fasziniert. Neben virtuellen Umgebungen, Szenerien und Avataren (bzw. digitalen Wesen/Objekten) soll das Projekt auch bestehende Medien der DZT (Fotos, Filme, Drohnenaufnahmen, 360-Grad-Panoramen etc.) beinhalten und diese in beeindruckender Form, interaktiv präsentieren. In Abhängigkeit vom Konzept müssen ggf. noch weitere Medien digital erstellt, gekauft oder geshootet werden. Zudem ist erstmalig der Einsatz von (wenigen) Gaussian Splats vorgesehen, sofern inhaltlich und technisch sinnvoll. Der geplante Mix aus (z.T. fotorealistisch) digital erstelltem Content und echten Bildern, Panoramen und Videos sowie Avataren ist im Tourismusmarketing nach unserer Kenntnis bisher einzigartig. Weitere Informationen entnehmen Sie bitte aus der Leistungsbeschreibung im Angebotsvordruck. Lot LOT-0000: Active travel in Germany. result.text: The London Borough of Newham is undertaking a comprehensive market intelligence and engagement exercise to inform the future design and delivery of its Housing Repairs, Maintenance, Compliance and Capital Investment Programme. The Authority is currently considering a long-term programme of works and services with an indicative value of between £288 million and £416 million over a potential ten-year period, covering a broad range of specialist housing services including compliance, building safety, planned investment, major repairs, adaptations, voids and asset improvement programmes. The proposals outlined within the accompanying draft specification are intended solely to support this engagement process and should be viewed as initial concepts that will be refined through consultation with the market. The purpose of this survey is to gather intelligence from organisations operating across the housing, construction, compliance, asset management and wider property sectors. The Authority is seeking views on market capacity, capability, commercial models, lot structures, delivery approaches, innovation, digital solutions, social value, sustainability and emerging legislative requirements. Feedback received will help shape future procurement, commercial and service delivery strategies, ensuring that any subsequent procurement exercise is informed by current market expertise and is structured to maximise value, resilience, competition, innovation and positive resident outcomes. The Authority welcomes responses from organisations of all sizes, including SMEs, specialist providers, consortiums, manufacturers, consultants and principal contractors. This exercise represents a unique opportunity for the market to help influence the future direction of one of London's largest housing investment and asset management programmes, and the Authority strongly encourages all interested organisations to participate For more information about this opportunity, please visit the eSourcing portal at: https://www.delta-esourcing.com/tenders/UK-UK-London:-Solar-installation./KAD82PW44U To respond to this opportunity, please click here: https://www.delta-esourcing.com/respond/KAD82PW44U Lot 1: . rejected.text: The National Institute on Aging (NIA) intends to publish a Notice of Funding Opportunity (NOFO) that builds upon its investment in data-driven approaches for the purpose of defining molecular mechanisms of resilience in the presence of various types of Alzheimer's disease (AD) and AD-related dementias (ADRD) risk. The goal of this NOFO is to build a robust program that integrates epidemiologic, genomic, and mechanistic research through the use of data driven, systems-based approaches (including the use of artificial intelligence and/or machine learning methods) to discover the molecular/cellular determinants of resilience to AD/ADRD risk across representative populations. The initiative will support the generation of high-dimensional molecular data from brain and peripheral tissues, including longitudinal data, to enable dynamic modelling of resilience mechanisms and to discover molecular predictors of resilience. Applications are not being solicited at this time. Notice is being provided to allow potential applicants sufficient time to develop meaningful collaborations and responsive projects. This NOFO intends to utilise the U01 activity code. Investigators with expertise and insights into this area of aging research are encouraged to begin to consider applying for this new NOFO.

result.text: NHSScotland is exploring options for the potential procurement of a multi-channel remote health monitoring and communication solution capable of supporting the delivery of enhanced care pathways, including home and mobile health monitoring. Remote health monitoring (RHM) is a digitally enabled model of care that allows people to record, submit and share clinically relevant health information from their home or community setting. This enables health and care teams to monitor health status, support self management and intervene proactively, reducing the need for routine face-to-face contact. RHM can support management of long term conditions to reduce escalation and prevent admissions and can also support earlier discharge and hospital at home models where appropriate. Connect Me is NHSScotland’s national remote health monitoring service, currently delivered using the Inhealthcare platform. The service supports the collection of measurements and patient reported information through a range of channels including automated telephone calls, SMS messages and digital access via web browser or mobile application. Lot 1: . This PIN serves as a soft market test to assess available options, continuity of key services, migration approaches and indicative costs. A Market Research Questionnaire can be downloaded from the Additional Documents area and returned as instructed within the document by noon on Monday, 25 May 2026. Suppliers are also invited to attend an online briefing session on 7 May 2026 at 2:30PM. Teams login details will be confirmed via this Public Contracts Scotland portal.

The integrated control system (iBS) is a subsystem of the integrated control and operating system (iLBS) and includes, amongst other things, the central services of the iBS (iBS-Z), integrated operator terminals (iBP) in accordance with the redundancy regulation 2, the reference image function (RBF), iBS communication (iBS-Kom) as well as the iBS-Z console. The iBS subsystem is connected to other iLBS subsystems via standardised interfaces, thereby enabling the operation of integrated sub-centres (iUZ) with electronic interlocking / digital interlocking (ESTW/DSTW). Lot LOT-0002: Transfer network router. The transfer network is a component of the iLBS system and implements communication between all transfer network participants (e.g. iBS-Z, iLBS-ZE and central directory service) in the overall iLBS system up to the network layer (OSI layer 3). This does not include: VPN LST gateway modules, all components of the transport network, the time standard receiver (e.g. DCF-77) or the middleware broker. (including all system components for redundancies). The components are thus used both at the interlocking location (TSO or existing interlocking) and at the locations of the individual iBS, the BSO. Lot LOT-0003: Broker and directory service. A component of the iLBS is a network of broker servers via which the components and subsystems communicate with each other (via Advanced Message Queuing Protocol (AMQP)). (including all system components for redundancies). The brokers are thus used at the iBS and LMC locations. A broker pair (redundant design) is always required at each location. The brokers use the AMQP protocol or Red Hat JBoss Enterprise Application Platform (JBoss EAP) as a platform. For the hardware, 2 HU per physical broker instance in the computer cabinet are provided in the 19 inch rack. The installation depth of 700 mm must not be exceeded. Cooling of the brokers must take place from the front. (see also system specifications requirements specification DiB-0454). The local directory service is a local replica of the central directory service, which is functionally restricted to read access; it serves as a central source of higher-level information such as network addresses, operating relations, user data and roles. (including all system components for redundancies). The local directory service is located at the iBS locations (BSO) and is connected via the transfer network to the central directory service in the LMC. The task of the ZVD is the management and regulation of access rights within the iLBS. Lot LOT-0004: Local routing plan management (LLPV). The local directory service is a local replica of the central directory service, which is functionally restricted to read access; it serves as a central source of higher-level information such as network addresses, operating relations, user data and roles. (including all system components for redundancies). The local directory service is located at the iBS locations (BSO) and is connected via the transfer network to the central directory service in the LMC. The task of the ZVD is the management and regulation of access rights within the iLBS. Lot LOT-0005: Operational management of the central directory service (ZVD) of the LMC and the transfer network of the iLBS . The operational management for the central directory service and the transfer network (transmission system consisting of transfer network router, broker, etc.) comprises organisational, technical and documenting activities required to keep the test systems usable for planned tests. These systems already exist in the ITU. Procurement of the components is not intended. Operational management of productive systems is excluded. Lot LOT-0006: Operational management of the central routing plan management (LPV) for the LMC . The operational management for the central routing plan management comprises organisational, technical and documenting activities required to keep the test systems usable for planned tests. This system already exists in the ITU. Procurement of the component is not intended. Operational management of productive systems is excluded.

parts.source: Rahmenvereinbarung iBS II Lot LOT-0001: Integriertes Bediensystem (iBS). Das integrierte Bediensystem (iBS) ist ein Teilsystem des integrierten Leit- und Bediensystems (iLBS) und beinhaltet u.a. die zentralen Dienste des iBS (iBS-Z), gemäß der Redundanzregelung 2 integrierte Bedienplätze (iBP), die Referenzbildfunktion (RBF), die iBS-Kommunikation (iBS-Kom) sowie die iBS-ZKonsole. Das Teilsystem iBS ist über standardisierte Schnittstellen mit anderen Teilsystemen des iLBS verbunden und ermöglicht dadurch die Bedienung von integrierten Unterzentralen (iUZ) mit ESTW/DSTW. Lot LOT-0002: Transfernetzrouter. Das Transfernetz ist Bestandteil des Systems iLBS und realisiert die Kommunikation zwischen sämtlichen Transfernetz-Teilnehmern (z. B. iBS-Z, iLBS-ZE und zentralem Verzeichnisdienst) im Gesamtsystem iLBS bis zur Vermittlungsschicht (Network Layer, OSI Schicht 3). Hierunter fallen nicht: VPN-LSTGateway-Module, sämtliche Bestandteile des Transportnetzes, der Empfänger des Zeitnormals (z. B. DCF-77) oder der Middleware-Broker. (einschließlich aller Systemkomponenten für Redundanzen). Die Komponenten werden somit sowohl am Standort des Stellwerks (TSO oder Bestandsstellwerk) als auch an den Standorten der einzelnen iBS, der BSO, eingesetzt. Lot LOT-0003: Broker und Verzeichnisdienst. Bestandteil des iLBS ist ein Netzwerk aus Broker-Servern, über das die Komponenten und Teilsysteme miteinander kommunizieren. (über Advanced Message Queuing Protocol (AMQP)). (einschließlich aller Systemkomponenten für Redundanzen). Die Broker kommen somit in den, Standorten iBS und LMC zum Einsatz. An jedem Standort wird immer ein Brokerpaar (redundante Ausführung) benötigt. Die Broker nutzen das Protokoll AMQP bzw.Red Hat JBoss Enterprise Application Plattform (JBoss EAP) als Plattform. Für die Hardware sind je physischer Broker-Instanz im Rechnerschrank je 2HE im 19 Zoll-Gestell vorgesehen. Die Einbautiefe von 700 mm darf nicht überschritten werden. Die Kühlung der Broker muss von der Frontseite erfolgen. (siehe auch Lastenheft Systemvorgaben DiB-0454). Bei dem lokalen Verzeichnisdienst handelt es sich um eine lokale Replik des Zentralen Verzeichnisdienstes, der funktional auf Lesezugriff beschränkt ist; dient als zentrale Quelle übergeordneter Informationen wie z.B. Netzwerkadressen, Bedienrelationen, Benutzerdaten und Rollen. (einschließlich aller Systemkomponenten für Redundanzen) Der lokale Verzeichnisdienst befindet sich an den iBSStandorten (BSO) und hat über das Transfernetz eine Verbindung zum zentralen Verzeichnisdienst im LMC. Aufgabe des ZVD ist die Verwaltung und Regelung von Zugriffsrechten innerhalb des iLBS. Lot LOT-0004: Lokale Lenkplanverwaltung (LLPV). Bei dem lokalen Verzeichnisdienst handelt es sich um eine lokale Replik des Zentralen Verzeichnisdienstes, der funktional auf Lesezugriff beschränkt ist; dient als zentrale Quelle übergeordneter Informationen wie z.B. Netzwerkadressen, Bedienrelationen, Benutzerdaten und Rollen. (einschließlich aller Systemkomponenten für Redundanzen) Der lokale Verzeichnisdienst befindet sich an den iBSStandorten (BSO) und hat über das Transfernetz eine Verbindung zum zentralen Verzeichnisdienst im LMC. Aufgabe des ZVD ist die Verwaltung und Regelung von Zugriffsrechten innerhalb des iLBS. Lot LOT-0005: Operative Betriebsführung des Zentralen Verzeichnisdienstes (ZVD) des LMCs und des Transfernetzes des iLBS . Die Betriebsführung für den Zentralen Verzeichnisdienst und das Transfernetz (Übertragungssystem bestehend aus Transfernetzrouter, Broker, etc.) umfasst organisatorische, technische und dokumentierende Tätigkeiten, die erforderlich sind, um die Testsysteme für geplante Tests nutzbar zu halten. Diese Systeme sind bereits in der ITU vorhanden. Eine Beschaffung der Komponenten ist nicht vorgesehen. Die Betriebsführung produktiver Systeme ist ausgeschlossen. Lot LOT-0006: Operative Betriebsführung der Zentralen Lenkplanverwaltung (LPV) für das LMC . Die Betriebsführung für die Zentrale Lenkplanverwaltung umfasst organisatorische, technische und dokumentierende Tätigkeiten, die erforderlich sind, um die Testsysteme für geplante Tests nutzbar zu halten. result.text: The ESG data management system serves as a centrally controlled, specialised Software-as-a-Service platform (SaaS platform) for the integrative procurement, processing, quality assurance and provision of external ESG data for the KfW Group. The external ESG data delivery route (hereinafter also referred to as "XEDALI") replaces the previous decentralised and heterogeneous procurement and connection of external ESG data sources through a standardised ETL process (Extract – Transform – Load). The application will regularly query ESG data at the software interfaces to various external data providers, transfer it into a uniform data model and provide it for use in subsequent processes. It thus provides users with a consistent data source for external ESG data. XEDALI thus makes a significant contribution to the technical support and fulfilment of new regulatory requirements (in particular the EBA Guidelines on ESG risks (EBA/GL/2025/01), MaRisk as well as the VSME standard and the requirements from BCBS239), further details see "Specification of Services". result.text: THIS IS NOT A PROCUREMENT NOTICE OR A CALL FOR TENDERS BUT A REQUEST FOR INFORMATION FOR MARKET RESEARCH AND TECHNICAL DIALOGUE: The dialogue of this request for information / notice surveys the market and obtains information regarding the procurement. The contracting authority does not initiate a competitive tendering procedure by publishing the request for information, but a possible procurement notice and call for tenders will be published later. The request for information does not oblige the contracting authority to carry out the actual procurement. Responding to the request for information is not a prerequisite for participation in a subsequent procurement that may be organized. Suppliers are not paid compensation for responding to the request for information or participating in the market dialogue. The responses given to this request for information will be used in planning the procurement of a radar-based remote sensing system and related services. The scope of the procurement may include, for example: 1. Radars to be installed in the care facilities of HUS and the City of Helsinki and an artificial intelligence solution utilizing these for detecting patient falls and monitoring condition. 2. Development work to develop new necessary features. 3. An application installed on a smartphone, to which information about the patient's condition is transmitted. 4. Possible integrations into already existing systems (e.g. nurse call system, AD.). The purpose of the request for information is to survey suppliers on the market and their product and service portfolios. The purpose is to ascertain technical solutions, pricing principles and cost levels for budgeting. We primarily request that a written report on the requested matters be submitted. Based on the responses to the request for information, suppliers may be offered the opportunity to present their solutions in a manner to be announced later. Suppliers that have responded to the request for information may possibly receive preliminary tender documents for comment. HUS-yhtymä and the City of Helsinki request the following information regarding the radar-based remote sensing system: • List of current capabilities and features of the system • Description from the user's perspective: possible functions, limitations, user interfaces for managing the system • Description from the service owner's perspective, management, maintenance, reports, analytics • Radar models suitable for the use of the system, and possible limitations • Average accuracy percentage of the system in detecting falls and other changes in the patient's condition or location, and average delay between the event and detection • Features and hardware requirements of the smartphone application • Implemented and planned integration possibilities • New features planned and under development • Delivery times for new orders • Warranty and maintenance, and resources available to the supplier • GDPR compliance • Previous references from the care sector • Cooperation and operating model that the supplier sees as appropriate. HUS-yhtymä and the City of Helsinki request the following price information for budgeting: • What the system's invoicing of the customer is based on and an example of pricing • Description of the pricing structure of the required software licences (licence policy) We kindly ask you to send your response to the request for information by 6.3.2026 at 12.00 by email to the address kilpailutus.ict@hus.fi. Mention "HUS Tutkapohjainen etäseuranta" as the subject of the message.

parts.source: TÄMÄ EI OLE HANKINTAILMOITUS TAI TARJOUSPYYNTÖ VAAN TIETOPYYNTÖ MARKKINAKARTOITUSTA JA TEKNISTÄ VUOROPUHELUA VARTEN: Tämän tietopyynnön/ilmoituksen vuoropuhelusta avulla kartoitetaan markkinoita ja saadaan hankintaa koskevaa tietoa. Hankintayksikkö ei aloita tarjouskilpailua Tietopyynnön julkaisulla, vaan mahdollinen hankintailmoitus ja tarjouspyyntö julkaistaan myöhemmin. Tietopyyntö ei velvoita hankintayksikköä toteuttamaan varsinaista hankintaa. Tietopyyntöön vastaaminen ei ole edellytys myöhempään mahdollisesti järjestettävään tarjouskilpailuun osallistumiselle. Toimittajille ei makseta korvausta tietopyyntöön vastaamisesta tai markkinavuoropuheluun osallistumisesta. Tähän tietopyyntöön annettuja vastauksia käytetään suunniteltaessa hankintaa tutkapohjaisen etähavainnoinnin järjestelmästä ja siihen liittyvistä palveluista. Hankinnan piiriin voivat kuulua esimerkiksi: 1. HUS:in ja Helsingin hoitotiloihin asennettavia tutkia ja näitä hyödyntävä tekoälyratkaisu potilaiden kaatumisen havainnointiin ja olotilan seurantaan. 2. Kehitystyötä uusien tarpeellisten ominaisuuksien kehittämiseksi. 3. Älypuhelimeen asennettu sovellus, johon välitetään tietoja potilaan tilasta. 4. Mahdolliset integraatiot jo olemassa oleviin järjestelmiin (esim. hoitajakutsujärjestelmä, AD.). Tietopyynnön tarkoituksena on kartoittaa markkinoilla olevia toimittajia sekä heidän tuote- ja palveluvalikoimaansa. Tarkoituksena on selvittää tekniset ratkaisut, hinnoitteluperiaatteet ja kustannustaso budjetointia varten. Pyydämme ensisijaisesti toimittamaan kirjallisena selvityksen pyydetyistä asioista. Tietopyynnön vastausten perusteella saatetaan toimittajalle tarjota mahdollisuus esitellä ratkaisujaan myöhemmin ilmoitettavalla tavalla. Tietopyyntöön vastanneet toimittajat saavat mahdollisesti kommentoitavakseen alustavat tarjouspyyntöasiakirjat. HUS-yhtymä ja Helsingin kaupunki pyytävät tutkapohjaisesta etähavainnointijärjestelmästä seuraavia tietoja: • Listaus järjestelmän nykyisistä kyvykkyyksistä ja ominaisuuksista • Kuvaus käyttäjän näkökulmasta: mahdolliset toiminnot, rajoitteet, käyttöliittymät järjestelmän hallintaan • Kuvaus palvelun omistajan näkökulmasta, hallinta, ylläpito, raportit, analytiikka • Järjestelmän käyttöön soveltuvat tutkamallit, sekä mahdolliset rajoitukset • Järjestelmän keskimääräinen tarkkuusprosentti kaatumisten havainnoinnissa ja muissa potilaan olotilan tai sijainnin muutoksissa, sekä keskimääräinen viive tapahtuman ja havainnoinnin välillä • Älypuhelimen sovelluksen ominaisuudet ja laitevaatimukset • Toteutetut sekä suunnitteilla olevat integraatiomahdollisuudet • Uudet suunnitteilla ja kehitteillä olevat ominaisuudet • Toimitusajat uusille tilauksille • Takuu ja ylläpito, sekä toimittajan käytössä olevat resurssit • GDPR-yhteensopivuus • Aiemmat referenssit hoivasektorilta • Yhteistyö- ja toimintamalli, minkä toimittaja näkee tarkoituksenmukaiseksi. HUS-yhtymä ja Helsingin kaupunki pyytää budjetointia varten seuraavia hintatietoja: • Mihin järjestelmän laskutus asiakkaalta perustuu ja esimerkin hinnoittelusta • Tarvittavien ohjelmistolisenssien hinnoittelurakenteen kuvaus (lisenssipolitiikka) Pyydämme teitä lähettämään vastauksenne tietopyyntöön 6.3.2026 klo 12.00 mennessä sähköpostitse osoitteeseen kilpailutus.ict@hus.fi. result.text: The Universität Hamburg (hereinafter 'UHH'), as a university of excellence with more than 43.000 students and approx. 6.000 employees, is one of the most research-intensive universities in Germany and at the same time one of the largest training institutions in Northern Germany. With its 'Flagship University' concept in the Hamburg metropolitan region, it maintains innovative and cooperative links with scientific and non-scientific partners. It produces future-oriented social goods for the location – but also nationally and internationally – namely education, knowledge and the exchange of knowledge, under the guiding principle of sustainability. The executive boards of the 6 Hamburg universities signed a Letter of Intent in April 2024 regarding the joint IT operation of the Hamburg universities. The aim here is to establish a joint organisation that is controlled by the universities and understands, bundles, and implements their needs, and provides high-quality IT services specifically for scientific institutions across the entire service spectrum. A service centre is to be built and established with the goal of creating synergies and thus providing digital services more efficiently, in a more targeted and user-centred manner, more comprehensively, and at the same time with better quality and protection against cyberattacks. In the course of this joint IT operation, it is necessary to create a joint, federated Identity and Access Management (IAM) structure for the Hamburg universities. The overarching goal is the provision of services for all Hamburg universities based on established federation technologies. Each university is to be equipped with a local IAM system, and the then technology-compatible systems are to be integrated into a joint, federated state identity and access infrastructure. The authoritative management of identities remains decentralised at the individual institutions. A central master directory is to be set up to hold the personal attributes necessary for joint operation. Such a federated infrastructure enables the universities to participate in jointly or centrally provided services (e.g. cloud, collaboration and e-learning services) and at the same time significantly increases the security of access, as modern, open standards such as SAML, OpenID Connect (OIDC), SCIM and FIDO2 are to be implemented throughout. For an organisation-independent, uniform and permanent identification of users, e.g. also when changing between universities, the nationwide federation service of the German National Research and Education Network (DFN-AAI), including the eduID service, is to be used as a basis. The joint state federation is intended as a sub-federation within the DFN-AAI in order to enable cross-university coordination beyond a uniform attribute set. The project aims to design, build and transfer this joint federated state IAM infrastructure into regular operation. A later inclusion of further scientific institutions in Hamburg is not excluded.

parts.source: Die Universität Hamburg (im Folgenden „UHH“) ist als Exzellenzuniversität mit mehr als 43.000 Studierenden und ca. 6.000 Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeitern eine der forschungsstärksten Universitäten Deutschlands und gleichzeitig eine der größten Ausbildungseinrichtungen Norddeutschlands. Mit ihrem Konzept der „Flagship University“ in der Metropolregion Hamburg pflegt sie innovative und kooperative Verbindungen zu wissenschaftlichen und außerwissenschaftlichen Partnern. Sie produziert für den Standort – aber auch national und international – die zukunftsgerichteten gesellschaftlichen Güter Bildung, Erkenntnis und Austausch von Wissen unter dem Leitziel der Nachhaltigkeit. Die Präsidien der 6 Hamburger Hochschulen haben im April 2024 einen Letter of Intent zu einem gemeinsamen IT-Betrieb der Hamburger Hochschulen gezeichnet. Ziel ist hierbei die Gründung einer gemeinsamen Organisation, die durch die Hochschulen gesteuert wird und ihre Bedürfnisse versteht, bündelt, implementiert und qualitativ hochwertige IT-Dienste spezifisch für Wissenschaftseinrichtungen im gesamten Dienste-Spektrum bereitstellt. Es soll ein Dienstleistungszentrum aufgebaut und etabliert werden, welches das Ziel hat, Synergien zu schaffen und somit die digitalen Services effizienter, zielgerichteter und nutzendenzentrierter, umfangreicher und gleichzeitig mit besser Qualität und Absicherung gegen Cyberangriffe zur Verfügung zu stellen. Im Zuge dieses gemeinsamen IT-Betriebs ist es notwendig, eine gemeinsame, föderierte Identity- und Access-Management-Struktur (IAM) für die Hamburger Hochschulen zu schaffen. Das übergreifende Ziel ist die Bereitstellung von Diensten für alle Hamburger Hochschulen auf Grundlage von etablierten Föderationstechnologien. Jede Hochschule soll mit einem lokalen IAM-System ausgestattet werden und die dann technologiekompatiblen Systeme in eine gemeinsame, föderierte Identity- und Access-Landesinfrastruktur integriert werden. Die autoritative Verwaltung der Identitäten verbleibt dabei dezentral bei den einzelnen Einrichtungen- Ein zentrales Gesamtverzeichnis soll aufgebaut werden, um für den gemeinsamen Betrieb notwendige Personenattribute vorzuhalten. Solch eine föderierte Infrastruktur ermöglicht den Hochschulen die Teilnahme an gemeinsam bzw. zentral erbrachten Diensten (z. B. Cloud-, Kollaborations- und E-Learning-Diensten) und zugleich eine signifikante Erhöhung der Sicherheit der Zugänge, da durchgängig moderne, offene Standards wie SAML, OpenID Connect (OIDC), SCIM und FIDO2 implementiert werden sollen. Für eine organisationsunabhängige, einheitliche und dauerhafte Identifikation der Nutzenden, z.B. auch bei einem Wechsel zwischen Hochschulen, soll der bundesweite Föderationsdienst des Deutschen Forschungsnetzes (DFN-AAI) einschließlich des Dienstes eduID zugrunde gelegt werden. Die gemeinsame Landesföderation ist dabei als Subföderation innerhalb der DFN-AAI angedacht, um über einen einheitlichen Attributsatz hinaus hochschulübergreifende Abstimmungen zu ermöglichen. Das Vorhaben hat das Ziel, diese gemeinsame föderierte IAM-Landesinfrastruktur zu konzipieren, aufzubauen und in den Regelbetrieb zu überführen. Eine spätere Einbeziehung weiterer wissenschaftlicher Einrichtungen in Hamburg ist dabei nicht ausgeschlossen.

Das ebenfalls auf dem Gelände geplante Zentrum für das Berufsvorbereitende Jahr ( BVJ ) ist nicht Gegenstand dieser Ausschreibung. Das Baufeld für den geplanten Campusneubau befindet sich östlich des Naumburger Zentrums im Geltungsbereich eines rechtsgültigen Bebauungsplanes ( B - Plan Nr . 62 “ Stadtquartier Schönburger Straße" ). Die ehemalige Bebauung sowie die Oberflächenbeläge wurden bereits zurückgebaut. Das Schulgrundstück selbst liegt an der südlich verlaufenden Schönburger Straße sowie an der östlich verlaufenden, im Zuge des B- Plan- Verfahrens neu geplanten und errichteten Dr. - Wilhelm- Kniest- Straße zwischen der Schönburger Straße und der Grochlitzer Straße an. Zum Campus gehört noch das Grundstück mit der Flurstücksnummer 692. Das Straßenquartier zwischen Schönburger- , Rosa-Luxemburg und Grochlitzer Straße ist gekennzeichnet durch eine weitgehend homogen wirkende Bebauung durch meist dreigeschossige Wohngebäude. Das Grundstück ist weitgehend eben und umfasst eine Fläche von 25.196m2. Die baulichen Anlagen des neuen Schulcampus werden auf drei Gebäudebereiche verteilt . In der Angebotsaufforderung sind die Gebäudeteile des Bauvorhabens wie folgt bezeichnet: Teilobjekt A Schulgebäude Das Gebäude, d as die Schulräume der Förderschule, d er Sekundarschule und Teile des BVJ beherbergt, bildet als größte Baumasse das Zentrum der Anlage und ist selbst in drei „ Gebäudekuben“ gegliedert, höhenmäßig gestaffelt zwischen zwei und vier Obergeschossen. result.text: The Burgenlandkreis acting as the client intends to construct a new school campus on the "Stadtquartier Schönburger Straße" site, consisting of a school building and a 3-field sports hall. The Centre for the Vocational Preparation Year (BVJ), which is also planned on the site, is not the subject of this tender. The construction site for the planned new campus building is located east of the Naumburg centre within the scope of a legally binding development plan (B-Plan No. 62 "Stadtquartier Schönburger Straße"). The former buildings and surface pavings have already been dismantled. The school property itself is situated on Schönburger Straße running to the south and on Dr-Wilhelm-Kniest-Straße, newly planned and constructed in the course of the development plan procedure, between Schönburger Straße and Grochlitzer Straße to the east. The campus also includes the plot with the plot number 692. The street quarter between Schönburger Straße, Rosa-Luxemburg-Straße and Grochlitzer Straße is characterised by largely homogeneous buildings consisting mostly of three-storey residential buildings. The plot is largely flat and covers an area of 25.196 m2. The structures of the new school campus are distributed across three building areas. In the invitation to tender, the building parts of the construction project are designated as follows: Sub-project A School building The building, which houses the school rooms of the special needs school, the secondary school and parts of the BVJ, forms the centre of the facility as the largest building mass and is itself structured into three "building cubes", staggered in height between two and four upper floors. The three building section areas are each structured around an inner courtyard core. The buildings are constructed using solid construction methods with load-bearing walls and columns made of reinforced concrete as well as reinforced concrete ceilings with a flat roof. The foundation is laid on reinforced concrete floor slabs. The middle building section (A 1) has a basement, while the northern and southern building sections (A2 and A3) do not have basements. Sub-project B Sports hall The three-field sports hall is arranged to the north adjacent to the school building. A two-storey functional wing adjoins the southern longitudinal side of the large hall room with DIN dimensions (4 5 x 2 7 m). The building foundation for the social wing is constructed as a slab foundation with reinforced concrete floor slabs, while the hall is founded on individual foundations and strip foundations beneath the external walls. The load-bearing walls, columns and floor slabs in the social wing are constructed in reinforced concrete. The hall roof is designed with glued laminated timber girders and a load-bearing shell made of trapezoidal profiled steel sheeting. result.text: The Digital and Population Data Services Agency (Digi- ja väestötietovirasto, DVV) is preparing a public procurement for Finland’s European Digital Identity Wallet. The procurement concerns a digital identity wallet solution provided as a software development kit (SDK), related backend services and certificate/attestation issuance. The wallet solution will be comprised of the wallet unit clients for both iOS and Android mobile operating systems as well as the related wallet back-end functionalities and will be available for certification using the NOBCCS (Nordic and Baltic Common Certification Scheme) by the end of Q3/2026. Also, other wallet-related functionalities, such as for example, but not limited to PID provisioning, identity matching service, or QEAA provisioning, may be part of the procurement. Suppliers interested in this planned procurement can contact DVV by email hankinnat@dvv.fi. DVV reserves the right to invite suppliers for further discussions regarding the planned procurement. This can be done to obtain information on market and suppliers providing relevant services, and to clarify any possible issues related to the object of the procurement. DVV may use the information it receives during these discussions for planning and preparation of the actual invitation to tender. NOTE For the sake of clarity, this is not a request for information or an invitation to market dialogue. The information provided by DVV is preliminary at this point and it is subject to change. Taking or not taking contact with DVV at this point does not change the standing or status of a supplier in the eventual procurement process.

result.text: Synchronicity Care Limited on behalf of Fresh and Balance are seeking a provider of PR Agency Services. Fresh and Balance is the North East's integrated programme for reducing tobacco and alcohol harm in the region. They are one single joint programme carrying out much of the public and partner facing work under the two separate, well recognised brands of Fresh and Balance. Fresh and Balance remit is to reduce smoking rates and the harm caused by tobacco and alcohol amongst the local population and key audiences using a multi-strand approach based on best national and international evidence. This includes mass media campaigns, campaigning and advocacy, effective internal communications, and making voices heard on the national stage to politicians and decision makers. A key element of their work and priority of local funders is the delivery of all year round news and social media reach/engagement to ensure issues and messages in the public eye all year round on the channels that people see, read and hear, providing a highly cost effective return on investment. This also involves working with a range of senior stakeholders for messengers and champions, building support for measures to reduce smoking and harmful drinking, motivating and triggering behaviour change, and engaging and motivating key partners to prioritise these agendas regionally and nationally. Communications cover three main strands: • Behaviour change - highlighting the risks and signposting positive behaviour change around quitting smoking, reducing second hand smoke and reducing drinking - via campaigns, socials and two key websites FreshQuit.co.uk and ReduceMyRisk.tv. • Highlighting the harm - the cost of tobacco and alcohol across the region and nationally to motivate regional stakeholders and the public • Campaigning for change - a strong policy focus to call for more action nationally on tobacco and alcohol, increasing public and partner support for this. This also includes an increasing focus on building partnerships across the health system, local communities and community and voluntary sector. Fresh and Balance are looking for a PR agency with the experience, skills and knowledge to develop communications across the increasing range of available media channels to secure content - both traditional and online. Since we are a joint programme, this will be one contract serving both campaign brands, while still requiring the insight and experience in social marketing approaches to plan campaigns and approaches around both tobacco and alcohol. The successful agency will be expected to provide PR support to support the programme from 1st April 2027 with the potential for contract extensions and subject to satisfactory performance and reviews and funding. Lot 1: .

result.text: This procurement covers the Population Health Management framework. The framework will cover population health management software solutions that enable analysis and management of health data from a variety of sources to improve healthcare delivery and decision-making. This will empower Approved Organisations and stakeholders to deliver proactive, personalised care while improving efficiency and supporting preventative health interventions. Also can support addressing health inequalities and the wider social determinants and support the decision-making process across the health and social care sector. The framework is divided into three lots: Lot 1: Population Health Management Digital Solutions Delivery of population health management systems that will support the NHS's and other public sector organisations desire to deliver population level health and care across whole, or large-scale areas of the population - for example, an integrated care system, a city or town, a health community, a large acute Trust or a local authority - or multiples of these. Lot 1 is suitable for solutions with the below characteristics: • Solutions that can address large scale populations, however defined. • Multiple features and functionality, covering a wide range of Population Health Management. • Typically draws data from a range of sources of other organisations. • Horizontal integration to provide large populations to manage. • May or may not include the features and functionality of more specialist solutions. Lot 2: Consultancy &Support Services The nature of services will be to address a variety of needs through providing information, advice, direction and potential solutions to customers. Suppliers will be expected to be able to assist customers to make more informed decisions surrounding their population health programme. • Support of the delivery of population health management to the NHS and broader public sector. • Consultancy services are about helping the NHS or other public sector organisations that may use this framework to implement and deliver population support for some or all of the people who live in the areas they either commission or provide health and care services to. • Consultancy could extend across the NHS, wider health, public health, local government, broader policy areas impacting on health (such as transportation policy, housing policy, employment, environmental - other areas of policy relating to population health management and social determinants of health. • Consultancy might also be more targeted, dealing with a more limited area of healthcare, such as risk stratification, social prescribing, medicines usage, etc. Lot 3: Combined Solutions This Lot covers the provision of Population Health Management solutions that deliver bundle services or comprehensive workflows. Population Health Management provided under this Lot should ensure a seamless, integrated approach, delivering all the necessary components required for Approved Organisations. Across all lots, suppliers must provide: • Software licences or subscriptions • Implementation, configuration, and integration services • Training, onboarding, and change management support • Ongoing maintenance, updates, and technical support • Clear service level agreements and performance reporting Lot 1: .
