result.text: The State of Saxony-Anhalt is planning the procurement of a state-wide Open Data Portal, which will enable central access to open administrative data and support the goals of the Digital Strategy Saxony-Anhalt 2030. The portal is intended to integrate existing state infrastructures, meet legal requirements and enable uniform data provision for state authorities and, in the long term, municipalities.

parts.source: Das Land Sachsen-Anhalt plant die Beschaffung eines landesweiten Open-Data-Portals, das den zentralen Zugang zu offenen Verwaltungsdaten ermöglicht und die Ziele der Digitalstrategie Sachsen-Anhalt 2030 unterstützt. Das Portal soll bestehende Landesinfrastrukturen integrieren, rechtliche Vorgaben erfüllen und eine einheitliche Datenbereitstellung für Landesbehörden sowie perspektivisch Kommunen ermöglichen.

result.text: The subject of the procurement is a rostering and time and attendance system (hereinafter also "the System") procured as SaaS off-the-shelf software for use by the Kainuu Wellbeing Services County. Kainuu HVA is putting out to tender SaaS off-the-shelf software that is easy to deploy and meets the contracting authority's needs without software development work. By procuring SaaS off-the-shelf software, the contracting authority ensures that the System can be put into production use reliably and that, with its ready-made functionalities, it supports the contracting authority's processes and operating models. The system is configured with the system's existing functionalities for the contracting authority's needs in the deployment project. The system must support the working hour forms in accordance with the various collective agreements (hereinafter VES/TES) (HYVTES, SOTE agreement, LS) applicable to the contracting authority, as well as the various ways of organising work, i.e. fixed and flexible working hours. The subject of the procurement includes the functionalities described in the tender request and the system modules required by them, as well as any new rostering and time and attendance features and functions coming to the System during the contract period. In the initial phase, the System will not be introduced in rescue services or emergency care, but the contracting authority's objective is for them to become System users later during the contract period. The contract period is estimated to begin in November 2026 and be indefinite.

parts.source: Hankinnan kohteena on SaaS-valmisohjelmistona hankittava työvuorosuunnittelu- ja työajan seurantajärjestelmä (myöhemmin myös ”Järjestelmä”) Kainuun Hyvinvointialueen käyttöön. Kainuun HVA kilpailuttaa SaaS-valmisohjelmistoa, joka on helposti käyttöönotettavissa ja täyttää Tilaajan tarpeet ilman ohjelmistokehitystyötä. SaaS-valmisohjelmiston hankkimalla Tilaaja varmistuu sillä, että Järjestelmä saadaan luotettavasti tuotantokäyttöön ja se tukee valmiilla toiminnallisuuksillaan Tilaajan prosesseja ja toimintamalleja. Järjestelmä konfiguroidaan Järjestelmän olemissa olevilla toiminnallisuuksilla Tilaajan tarpeisiin käyttöönottoprojektissa. Järjestelmän tulee tukea Tilaajaa koskevien eri työ- ja virkaehtosopimusten (myöh. VES/TES) (HYVTES, SOTE-sopimus, LS) mukaisia työaikamuotoja, sekä työn eri järjestämistapoja, eli kiinteää ja liukuvaa työaikaa. Hankinnan kohde sisältää tarjouspyynnössä kuvatut toiminnallisuudet ja niiden edellyttämät järjestelmämoduulit sekä mahdolliset sopimuskaudella Järjestelmään tulevat uudet työvuorosuunnittelun ja työajanseurannan ominaisuudet ja toiminnot. Ensivaiheessa Järjestelmää ei oteta käyttöön pelastustoimessa eikä ensihoidossa, mutta Tilaajan tavoitteena on, että ne tulevat Järjestelmän käyttäjiksi myöhemmin sopimuskaudella. Sopimuskauden on arvioitu alkavan marraskuussa 2026 ja olevan toistaiseksi voimassa oleva.

result.text: Award of services for the implementation of the Frankfurt Founders' Fund. We are looking for a contractor to take over the central management of the Frankfurt Founders' Fund and the numerous associated tasks. Background: The Founders' Fund, operated by Wirtschaftsförderung Frankfurt on behalf of the City of Frankfurt, has been a cornerstone of Frankfurt's start-up support since its introduction in 2010. The Frankfurt Founders' Fund has since established itself and is now an integral part of the start-up activities of the City of Frankfurt am Main, Wirtschaftsförderung Frankfurt and the Frankfurt-Rhine-Main ecosystem. In 2009, the foundation stone for the Frankfurt Founders' Fund was laid. The microfinance study commissioned at that time revealed that young companies were facing a financing gap for credit requirements. On this basis, the Frankfurt Founders' Fund was launched. The Frankfurt Founders' Fund project is currently being operated by an external contractor (hereinafter referred to as the Contractor) and is the responsibility of Wirtschaftsförderung Frankfurt GmbH as the contracting authority (hereinafter referred to as the Contracting Authority). In addition, professional administration is necessary to ensure transparency, efficiency and sustainability. The Contractor, who is commissioned with the administration and implementation of the fund, must therefore have sound experience in the field of start-up financing, project and portfolio management and, ideally, in working with public institutions. Furthermore, knowledge of risk management, supporting founders and developing suitable monitoring and evaluation instruments is required. The Contractor will work closely with the Bürgschaftsbank Hessen and partner banks and offer founders a proven financing and coaching model. An essential part of the success model is not just the financial support for start-ups, for which Wirtschaftsförderung Frankfurt assumes 80 % of the guarantee, but also extensive support included in the Founders' Fund programme in the form of coaching by the Contractor throughout the entire loan term. In summary, the Contracting Authority expects the following services from the new Contractor: - Organisational services - Information and enquiry management - Review and processing of financing enquiries - Support/accompaniment of financing projects - Measures for loan defaults, early warning system - Debt collection and processing - Reporting and monitoring - Marketing/communication - Cooperation and community network maintenance

parts.source: Vergabe von Dienstleistungen zur Umsetzung des Frankfurter Gründerfonds Gesucht wird ein Auftragnehmer der die zentrale Federführung des Frankfurter Gründerfonds übernimmt und die zahlreichen damit einhergehenden Aufgaben. Zum Hintergrund: Der von der Wirtschaftsförderung Frankfurt im Auftrag der Stadt Frankfurt betriebene Gründerfonds ist seit seiner Einführung im Jahr 2010 eine tragende Säule der Frankfurter Gründungsförderung. Der Frankfurter Gründerfonds hat sich seitdem etabliert und ist nun ein fester Bestandteil der Gründungs- und Startup-Aktivitäten der Stadt Frankfurt am Main, der Wirtschaftsförderung Frankfurt und des Ökosystems Frankfurt-Rhein-Main. Im Jahr 2009 wurde der Grundstein für den Frankfurter Gründerfonds gelegt. Die damals in Auftrag gegebene Mikrofinanzstudie ergab, dass junge Unternehmen mit einer Finanzierungslücke für Kreditbedarfe konfrontiert waren. Auf dieser Basis wurde der Frankfurter Gründerfonds ins Leben gerufen. Das Projekt Frankfurter Gründerfonds wird aktuell operativ von einem externen Auftragnehmer (nachfolgend AN) ausgeführt und von der Wirtschaftsförderung Frankfurt GmbH als Auftraggeber (nachfolgend AG) verantwortet. Zudem ist eine professionelle Verwaltung notwendig, um Transparenz, Effizienz und Nachhaltigkeit sicherzustellen. Der AN, der mit der Verwaltung und Umsetzung des Fonds beauftragt wird, muss daher über fundierte Erfahrung im Bereich Anschubfinanzierung, Projekt- und Portfoliomanagement und im Idealfall in der Zusammenarbeit mit öffentlichen Institutionen verfügen. Weiterhin sind Kenntnisse im Risikomanagement, in der Begleitung von Gründerinnen und Gründern sowie in der Entwicklung geeigneter Monitoring- und Evaluationsinstrumente erforderlich. Der AN wird eng mit der Bürgschaftsbank Hessen sowie Kooperationsbanken zusammenarbeiten und Gründerinnen und Gründern ein bewährtes Finanzierungs- und Coachingmodell bieten. Wesentlicher Teil des Erfolgsmodells ist nicht bloß die finanzielle Unterstützung der Gründungen, bei der die Wirtschaftsförderung Frankfurt 80 % der Bürgschaft übernimmt, sondern auch eine im Gründerfonds-Programm enthaltene umfangreiche Begleitung in Form von Coaching durch den Auftragnehmer während der gesamten Kreditlaufzeit. Zusammengefasst erwartet der Auftraggeber vom neuen AN folgende Leistungen: - Organisatorische Leistungen - Information und Anfragenmanagement- Prüfung und Bearbeitung der Finanzierungsanfragen - Betreuung/Begleitung Finanzierungsprojekte - Maßnahmen Kreditausfälle, Frühwarnsystem - Forderungseintreibung und Abwicklung- Reporting und Monitoring - Marketing/Kommunikation - Kooperation- und Community Netzwerkpflege

result.text: Framework agreement for the supply of conference, presentation and media technology including the provision of lot-related associated services for the purpose of holding video conferences as part of hybrid committee meetings of municipal call-off authorised entities in Schleswig-Holstein Lot LOT-0001: On-site advice Region North. Region North: District of Nordfriesland, District of Schleswig-Flensburg, City of Flensburg Lot LOT-0002: On-site advice Region Centre. Region Centre: District of Dithmarschen, District of Plön, District of Rendsburg-Eckernförde, District of Steinburg, City of Kiel, City of Neumünster Lot LOT-0003: On-site advice Region South. Region South: District of Ostholstein, District of Segeberg, District of Pinneberg, District of Stormarn, District of Herzogtum-Lauenburg, City of Lübeck Lot LOT-0004: Fixed projection screens. The subject matter of this lot is the delivery, assembly, commissioning and documentation of permanently installed projection screens for municipal meeting rooms (meeting rooms, conference rooms or similar) and service. The services comprise in particular: • On-site measurement • Delivery of the screens including all fastening materials • Dismantling and disposal of old screens (in individual cases) • Assembly and ready-for-operation installation • electrical connection for motor control • Functional testing • Instruction of the client (for retractable screens) • Handover of documentation • Disposal of packaging material Installation is generally carried out in existing buildings during ongoing operation. In individual cases, installation takes place as part of the redesign of a meeting or conference room. Lot LOT-0005: Mobile projection screens. The subject matter of this lot is the delivery of mobile projection screens including transport bags for flexible use in municipal meeting, conference and event rooms. The screens are used for changing locations within municipal properties and must be able to be transported, set up and operated by one person. The delivery includes: • Mobile projection screen • Stand or carrying system • Transport and protective bag • Operating instructions • Warranty certificates • Delivery to the place of performance Lot LOT-0006: Ultra-mobile media and presentation systems. The subject matter of this lot is the delivery of a fully integrated, ultra-mobile media trolley for the implementation of: • Council meetings • Committee meetings • Hybrid committee meetings • Hybrid citizen assemblies Operation is carried out by changing users without special media technology knowledge. The solution must be designed as a compact all-in-one unit and contain all components for image, sound and voice transmission. Lot LOT-0007: Permanently installed ceiling projectors (beamers). The subject matter of this lot is all services for the operational handover of a permanently installed projection system consisting of ceiling projector(s), ceiling mount(s), signal transmission, control technology, cabling and all accessories required for operation including planning, assembly, cabling, configuration, instruction and documentation as well as service. The system is used to display presentations, meeting documents, video conferences, live streams and other media content in council, committee, meeting and conference rooms. Lot LOT-0008: Mobile projectors (beamers). The subject matter of this lot is the delivery, setup and operational handover of mobile projection systems (beamers) including transport accessories, connection cables and all components required for operation as well as service. The devices are used for flexible use in council, committee, meeting, training and event rooms for displaying presentations, meeting documents, video conferences and multimedia content. The projectors must be usable at different locations within the administration without permanent installation. Lot LOT-0009: Smartboards (Interactive All-in-one Collaboration Boards). The subject matter of this lot is the delivery, assembly, commissioning and operational handover of interactive all-in-one collaboration boards with an integrated touch display, whiteboard function, video conferencing technology, loudspeaker system, microphone array and screen sharing as well as service. The systems are used to hold in-person, hybrid and video conferences as well as for the joint processing of documents, presentations and meeting documents. The contractor takes over delivery, assembly, configuration, commissioning, documentation, training and support. Lot LOT-0010: Permanently installed sound reinforcement. The subject matter of this lot is the delivery, assembly, commissioning and calibration of a permanently installed sound reinforcement system for voice transmission in committee, board and meeting rooms as well as service. The system is used to support in-person, hybrid and video conferences and is designed for continuous operation in municipal meeting rooms. The contractor assumes all services required for operational handover including an on-site appointment for inventory assessment, specialist planning, cabling, assembly, configuration, documentation, instruction and service. Lot LOT-0011: Mobile conference speakers. The subject matter of this lot is the delivery of mobile conference speakers (speakerphones/soundbars) for use in meeting, conference and committee rooms as well as service. The devices are used to hold in-person, hybrid and video conferences with multiple participants and must be compatible with common conference platforms. Lot LOT-0012: Conference microphones. The subject matter of this lot is the delivery, setup, commissioning and operational handover of a wireless digital conference microphone system for council, committee, advisory board and committee meetings.

Region Mitte: Kreis Dithmarschen, Kreis Plön, Kreis Rendsburg-Eckernförde, Kreis Steinburg, Stadt Kiel, Stadt Neumünster Lot LOT-0003: Vor-Ort-Beratung Region Süd. Region Süd: Kreis Ostholstein, Kreis Segeberg, Kreis Pinneberg, Kreis Stormarn, Kreis Herzogtum-Lauenburg, Stadt Lübeck Lot LOT-0004: Fest verbaute Projektionsleinwände. Gegenstand dieses Loses ist die Lieferung, Montage, Inbetriebnahme und Dokumentation von fest installierten Projektionsleinwänden für Räume für kommunale Sitzungen (Besprechungs-räume, Sitzungssäle oder ähnliche) und Service. In Einzelfällen erfolgt die Installation im Rahmen einer Neugestaltung eines Sitzungs- oder Be-sprechungsraumes. Lot LOT-0005: Mobile Projektionsleinwände. Gegenstand dieses Loses ist die Lieferung von mobilen Projektleinwänden einschließlich Transporttaschen für den flexiblen Einsatz in kommunalen Sitzungs-, Besprechungs- und Veranstaltungsräumen. Die Leinwände werden für wechselnde Einsatzorte innerhalb kommunaler Liegenschaften verwendet und müssen von einer Person transportiert, aufgebaut und betrieben werden können. Die Lieferung umfasst: • Mobile Projektionsleinwand • Stand- bzw. Tragesystem • Transport- und Schutztasche • Bedienungsanleitung • Garantienachweise • Lieferung an den Erfüllungsort Lot LOT-0006: Ultra-mobile Medien- und Präsentationssysteme. Gegenstand dieses Loses ist die Lieferung eines vollständig integrierten, ultra-mobilen Medienwagens zur Durchführung von: • Ratssitzungen • Ausschusssitzungen • Hybriden Gremiensitzungen • Hybriden Bürgerversammlungen Die Bedienung erfolgt durch wechselnde Nutzende ohne besondere medientechnische Kenntnisse. Die Lösung muss als kompakte All-in-one-Einheit ausgeführt sein und sämtliche Komponenten zur Bild-, Ton- und Sprachübertragung beinhalten. Lot LOT-0007: Fest installierte Deckenprojektoren (Beamer). Gegenstand dieses Loses sind sämtliche Leistungen zur betriebsbereiten Übergabe eines fest installierten Projektionssystems bestehend aus Deckenprojektor(en), Deckenhalterung(en), Signalübertragung, Steuerungstechnik, Verkabelung sowie sämtlichem für den Betrieb erforderlichen Zubehör einschließlich Planung, Montage, Verkabelung, Konfiguration, Einweisung und Dokumentation sowie Service. Das System dient der Darstellung von Präsentationen, Sitzungsunterlagen, Videokonferenzen, Livestreams und sonstigen medialen Inhalten in Rats-, Ausschuss-, Besprechungs- und Konferenzräumen. Lot LOT-0008: Mobile Projektoren (Beamer). Gegenstand dieses Loses sind Lieferung, Einrichtung und betriebsbereite Übergabe mobiler Projektionssysteme (Beamer) einschließlich Transportzubehör, Anschlusskabeln und aller für den Betrieb erforderlichen Komponenten sowie Service. Die Geräte dienen der flexiblen Nutzung in Rats-, Ausschuss-, Besprechungs-, Schulungs- und Veranstaltungsräumen zur Darstellung von Präsentationen, Sitzungsunterlagen, Videokonferenzen und multimedialen Inhalten. Die Projektoren müssen ohne feste Installation an unterschiedlichen Standorten innerhalb der Verwaltung einsetzbar sein. Lot LOT-0009: Smartboards (Interaktive All-in-one Collaboration Boards) . Gegenstand dieses Loses sind Lieferung, Montage, Inbetriebnahme und betriebsbereite Übergabe interaktiver All-in-one Collaboration Boards mit integriertem Touchdisplay, Whiteboard-Funktion, Videokonferenztechnik, Lautsprechersystem, Mikrofonarray und Bildschirmfreigabe sowie Service. Die Systeme dienen der Durchführung von Präsenz-, Hybrid- und Videokonferenzen sowie der gemeinsamen Bearbeitung von Dokumenten, Präsentationen und Sitzungs-unterlagen. Der Auftragnehmer übernimmt Lieferung, Montage, Konfiguration, Inbetriebnahme, Dokumentation, Schulung und Support. Lot LOT-0010: Fest installierte Beschallung. Gegenstand dieses Loses sind Lieferung, Montage, Inbetriebnahme und Einmessung eines fest installierten Beschallungssystems für die Sprachübertragung in Gremien-, Ausschuss- und Besprechungsräume sowie Service. Das System dient der Unterstützung von Präsenz-, Hybrid- und Videokonferenzen und ist für einen dauerhaften Betrieb in kommunalen Sitzungsräumen ausgelegt. Der Auftragnehmer übernimmt sämtliche zur betriebsbereiten Übergabe erforderlichen Leistungen einschließlich Vor-Ort-Termin zur Bestandsaufnahme, Fachplanung, Verkabelung, Montage, Konfiguration, Dokumentation, Einweisung und Service. Lot LOT-0011: Mobile Konferenzlautsprecher. Gegenstand dieses Loses ist die Lieferung von mobilen Konferenzlautsprechern (Speakerphones/Soundbar) zur Nutzung in Sitzungs-, Besprechungs- und Gremienräumen sowie Service. Die Geräte dienen der Durchführung von Präsenz-, Hybrid- und Videokonferenzen mit mehreren Teilnehmern und müssen mit gängigen Konferenzplattformen kompatibel sein. Lot LOT-0012: Konferenzmikrofone. Gegenstand dieses Loses sind Lieferung, Einrichtung, Inbetriebnahme und betriebsbereite Übergabe eines drahtlosen digitalen Konferenzmikrofonsystems für Rats-, Ausschuss-, Bei-rats- und Gremiensitzungen.

result.text: The system consists of member and presiding committee microphone stations including gooseneck microphones, integrated loudspeakers, battery systems, charging infrastructure, control unit, accessories and all components required for operation. The system must be suitable for face-to-face meetings, hybrid meetings, live streams, recordings and connection to video conferencing systems. The contractor shall undertake planning, delivery, configuration, commissioning, instruction, documentation and service. Lot LOT-0013: Handheld microphones with stand. The subject of this lot is the delivery, assembly, commissioning and operational handover of a professional wireless handheld microphone system including microphone stands, charging facilities, radio receivers, accessories and all components required for use. The system is used for speech transmission at council, committee, advisory board, meeting and hybrid events as well as public sessions. The contractor shall undertake all services required for operational handover including delivery, assembly, configuration, frequency planning, acoustic measurement, documentation and instruction as well as service. Lot LOT-0014: PTZ room camera systems. The subject of this lot is the delivery, installation, setup, commissioning and operational handover of professional PTZ room cameras (pan-tilt-zoom) for use in meeting, conference, committee and council halls. The cameras are used for high-quality video capture of sessions, meetings, video conferences, live streams and hybrid events. The contractor shall undertake all services including planning, on-site measurements, delivery, installation, cabling, configuration, commissioning, documentation and instruction as well as service. Lot LOT-0015: Mobile 360-degree conference camera systems. The subject of this lot is the delivery, setup and operational handover of mobile intelligent conference camera systems for council, committee, meeting, training and conference rooms as well as service. The systems must enable comprehensive audio and video capture of in-person participants and be suitable for hybrid meetings and video conferences. The systems shall consist at least of: • Camera system • Microphone array • Loudspeaker system • Power supply unit • Connection cables • Transport accessories (transport bag or transport case) • Required software Lot LOT-0016: Frontal video conference camera systems (videobars). The subject of this lot is the delivery, installation, setup, commissioning and operational handover of frontal video conference camera systems (videobars) for meeting, conference, committee, training and body rooms as well as service. The systems must integrate camera, microphone array and loudspeaker system into a single device and be suitable for hybrid meetings, video conferences, digital collaboration and presentations. The systems are intended in particular for mounting on or beneath interactive displays, smartboards or large screens. The contractor shall undertake delivery, documentation and support. Lot LOT-0017: Accessories for media, presentation and conference technology. The subject of this lot is the delivery, setup and operational handover of accessory components for media, presentation and conference technology as well as service. The components are used for signal transmission, connection of mobile terminal devices, expansion of presentation systems and management of multiple signal sources within meeting, training, conference and body rooms. The contractor shall supply all accessory components including necessary adapters, connecting cables and documentation.

result.text: Industrial biotechnology offers enormous potential for sustainable growth by replacing fossil raw materials with renewable biological resources, achieving climate targets and strengthening competitiveness. Germany is well positioned in the research and development of bioeconomic products and processes. Previous funding measures by other departments and the federal states show that bioeconomic products and processes can be implemented on a laboratory scale. However, there is a lack of broad implementation of bioeconomic products and processes on an industrial scale. Therefore, to support the transformation of the economy into a sustainable, climate-neutral economic model, the funding programme "Industrial Bioeconomy" was initiated, which started with the entry into force of the "Directive for funding the use and construction of demonstration plants for industrial biotechnology" of 16 December 2020 on 29 December 2020 (BAnz AT 28.12.2020 B2). This funding guideline was superseded by the "Funding guideline for the establishment of an industrial bioeconomy through the further development and scaling of bio-based processes and the establishment of regional innovation clusters" (BAnz AT 27.09.2024 B1), published in the Federal Law Gazette on 27 September 2024. The aim of the programme is to unlock the potential of new bio-based processes for industry and to transfer sustainable products into broad application. In order to reduce the economic and technical risks of development and market launch, the funding is intended to demonstrate the potential of bio-based products and processes at an early stage. Projects are funded that have a high potential for industrial application, the creation of new value creation and new jobs, strengthen the market position of the participating companies and make a relevant contribution to sustainability. parts.source: Die industrielle Bioökonomie bietet enormes Potenzial für nachhaltiges Wachstum, indem sie fossile Rohstoffe durch erneuerbare biologische Ressourcen ersetzt, Klimaziele erreicht und die Wettbewerbsfähigkeit stärkt. In der Forschung und Entwicklung bioökonomischer Produkte und Verfahren ist Deutschland gut aufgestellt. Die bisherigen Fördermaßnahmen anderer Ressorts sowie der Bundesländer zeigen, dass bioökonomische Produkte und Verfahren im Labormaßstab umsetzbar sind. Es mangelt jedoch an der breiten Umsetzung bioökonomischer Produkte und Verfahren im industriellen Maßstab. Daher wurde zur Unterstützung der Transformation der Wirtschaft zu einer nachhaltigen, klimaneutralen Wirtschaftsform das Förderprogramm „Industrielle Bioökonomie“ initiiert, das mit Inkrafttreten der „Richtlinie zur Förderung der Nutzung und des Baus von Demonstrationsanlagen für die industrielle Bioökonomie“ vom 16. Dezember 2020 am 29. Dezember 2020 (BAnz AT 28.12.2020 B2) startete. Diese Förderrichtlinie wurde durch die am 27. Ziel des Programms ist es, das Potenzial neuer biobasierter Verfahren für die Industrie zu erschließen und nachhaltige Produkte in die breite Anwendung zu transferieren. Um die wirtschaftlichen und technischen Risiken der Entwicklung und Markteinführung zu verringern, soll durch die Förderung frühzeitig das Potenzial biobasierter Produkte und Verfahren demonstriert werden. result.text: The Department for Science, Innovation and Technology (DSIT) intends to create a pathway to link problems identified by large organisations with solutions provided by innovative cyber small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) known as the Cyber Accelerator Programme. The Authority is seeking to engage the market to gather information, insights and feedback, while also providing an opportunity for Suppliers to better understand and discuss our requirements. This activity is not a procurement or a commitment to purchase goods or services. Its purpose is to facilitate open dialogue, improve our understanding of available solutions and supplier capabilities, and help shape the requirement and future approach, ensuring any subsequent procurement activity is informed, proportionate and delivers the best possible outcome. The principal objective of the programme is to create a credible pathway from agreed challenges facing the public sector to the commercial adoption of cyber innovation by public-sector buyers. It is intended to link problems identified by public-sector organisations with solutions provided by innovative cyber small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs). The programme will use structured, pro bono design partnerships between public-sector organisations with identified cyber challenges and innovative cyber SMEs capable of developing and testing solutions. Participation will not provide funding, an assurance of future work or preferential treatment in any subsequent procurement. result.text: HMLR has an exciting and ambitious vision to transform our data into interoperable, machine interpretable, geospatially enabled information to better serve our customers with digital services, expertise and accessible property information to unlock a better, faster, and less stressful property market. HMLR has improved the maturity of our data capabilities and we have a small team of data experts, but as we move forward with our transformational aims and as data usage grows, we need wider strategic guidance with particular focus on geospatial expertise, alongside the development of additional specialist capabilities-such as Data Governance, Data Ethics, Advanced Analytics, Data Science/AI and Data Engineering. Transformation activity is currently underway in the following areas: - Geospatial & Data Transformation - Digital Delivery - Local Land Charges - Integrated Analytics Capability These Change Programmes are delivering radical, permanent changes to the way we structure, store, extract and use data. How we transform and improve access to it will have profound enabling effects for internal, operational challenges; informed policymaking across Government; and unlocking wider economic growth and resilience. As we create more high-quality geospatial data, there will be greater benefits to overlap across the 4 programmes. HMLR is now seeking two new contracts to support with specialist data expertise and knowledge that will accelerate our Transformational Activity. To enable HMLR to understand the viability of this approach, we are conducting a round of preliminary market engagement and wish to hear from suppliers with specialist data knowledge and capability as follows: (1) A Strategic partnership for achieving shared goals, improving decisions, and maximising business opportunities. This partner will work collaboratively with us to support test & learn, design & vision, focusing specifically on data and geospatial challenges. The strategic relationship will support HMLR in delivering our data-centric objectives (2) A Delivery partnership to undertake statements of work to develop specific elements of a) our end state data architecture; b) our transition state preparation under the direction of our strategic end state team. To participate in the preliminary market engagement: 1: Go to https://atamis-3446.my.site.com/login - sign up if you don't have an account 2: Go to 'Find Opportunities' 3. Search for 'Strategic Data Support and Data Delivery Services' (C1431)' 4. Click 'Register Interest' Once you have registered, please refer to the PTME brief and questionnaire for full information. Lot 1: .

result.text: The purpose of this contract is a specialised technical assistance service intended to support the design, promotion and evaluation of the strategic and operational planning instruments of the Mental Health Commissioner. In particular, the purpose of the contract shall comprise the external evaluation of the current Mental Health Strategy of the National Health System 2022-2026, as well as the technical support necessary for the design and promotion of the new mental health strategy, with a horizon from 2027 onwards, involving all key stakeholders in the institutional sphere, especially the autonomous communities, and in the social sphere. Likewise, the purpose of the contract shall include the evaluation of the Mental Health Action Plan 2025-2027 and of the Action Plan for Suicide Prevention 2025-2027, contemplating both an interim evaluation and a final evaluation, in order to analyse their degree of implementation, results achieved and to guide the improvement of public policies in this area. Said actions shall be developed in accordance with the principles of the community mental health model, incorporating in a cross-cutting manner the human rights approach, the gender perspective, the consideration of the social determinants of health and the integration of mental health into all public policies, and shall take into account the principles and requirements established in Act 27/2022, of 20 December, on the institutionalisation of public policy evaluation in the General State Administration.

parts.source: El objeto del presente contrato es un servicio de asistencia técnica especializada destinado a apoyar el diseño, dinamización y evaluación de los instrumentos de planificación estratégica y operativa del Comisionado de Salud Mental. En particular, el objeto del contrato comprenderá la evaluación externa de la actual Estrategia de Salud Mental del Sistema Nacional de Salud 2022-2026, así como el apoyo técnico necesario para el diseño y dinamización de la nueva estrategia de salud mental, con horizonte a partir de 2027, involucrando a todos los agentes clave en el ámbito institucional, especialmente las comunidades autónomas, y en el ámbito social. Asimismo, el objeto del contrato incluirá la evaluación del Plan de Acción de Salud Mental 2025-2027 y del Plan de Acción para la Prevención del Suicidio 2025-2027, contemplando tanto una evaluación intermedia como una evaluación final, con el fin de analizar su grado de implementación, resultados alcanzados y orientar la mejora de las políticas públicas en esta materia. Dichas actuaciones se desarrollarán conforme a los principios del modelo comunitario en salud mental, incorporando de manera transversal el enfoque de derechos humanos, la perspectiva de género, la consideración de los determinantes sociales de la salud y la integración de la salud mental en el conjunto de las políticas públicas, y tendrán en cuenta los principios y requisitos establecidos en la Ley 27/2022, de 20 de diciembre, de institucionalización de la evaluación de políticas públicas en la Administración General del Estado.

result.text: UPDATED NOTICE - PLEASE READ: April 6, 2023 EDA is excited to announce the launch of its new grants management platform: the Economic Development Grants Experience (EDGE). EDGE was developed to streamline the application and grants management process by implementing a single platform with increased transparency, improved user experience, higher data quality, and more efficiency throughout the entire grant lifecycle. As of April 6th, 2023, applications can no longer be submitted on Grants.gov, and will ONLY be accepted through EDGE. To apply in EDGE, please go to: sfgrants.eda.gov. More information on how to apply is provided in the full NOFO. PARTNERSHIP PLANNING program instructions: Please note that applicants will be invited to submit applications through EDGE for the Partnership Planning program. For more information, please reach out to your EDA point of contact. Program Description: EDA makes planning and local technical assistance investments to support economic development, foster job creation, and attract private investment in economically distressed areas of the United States. Under the Planning program, EDA makes Partnership Planning, Short-Term Planning, and State Planning awards to eligible recipients to create and implement regional economic development plans designed to build capacity and guide the economic prosperity and resiliency of an area or region. More specifically, EDA makes Partnership Planning investments to designated planning organizations (i.e., District Organizations) serving EDA-designated Economic Development Districts and to Indian Tribes to facilitate the development, implementation, revision, or replacement of Comprehensive Economic Development Strategies (CEDS), which articulate and prioritize the strategic economic goals of recipients’ respective regions. EDA also makes Short-Term and State Planning awards for economic development planning activities that guide the eventual creation and retention of high-quality jobs, particularly for the unemployed and underemployed in the Nation’s most economically distressed regions. Under the Local Technical Assistance program, EDA makes awards to strengthen the capacity of local or State organizations, institutions of higher education, and other eligible entities to undertake and promote effective economic development programs through projects such as feasibility studies, impact analyses, disaster resiliency plans, and project planning. **Please note: While the published Notice of Funding Opportunity (available under "Related Documents") states that the ED900A form and the SF424B form are both required for a complete application, these forms are no longer required and have therefore been removed from the package template.

result.text: The Cairngorm National Park Authority (CNPA) Peatland ACTION team are commissioning pre-application surveys and protected species surveys for planned peatland restoration projects within its operational area. Pre-application surveys are used to quantify the peat resource where the restoration is to take place, determine eligibility for grant funding, and inform design of the restoration works. The surveys will also provide baseline data for future monitoring of restoration outcomes and habitat condition. The data derived from the surveys and subsequent design work may be used by the landowner or their representatives for the purposes of Peatland Code registration. Protected species surveys are required to provide data to inform restoration design and identify potential ecological constraints. Detailed methodologies are provided for both survey types alongside this SOR. Lot 1: . The detailed schedule relates to the site(s), listed in the table 1 in the tender documents. Where multiple sites are listed consultants can bid for individual Lots or all Lots. If an individual Lot is bid for, all surveys and sites listed under that that Lot must be included in the bid. Maps of the survey area(s) are provided at the end of this document. High resolution maps will be available for surveyors with spatial data including site outlines and grid survey points where applicable (100m, HIA and 50m). There are hill tracks that access most of the survey areas however the survey will involve covering large areas of exposed, upland terrain off-road. Monie Mhor, Glenfeshie, also requires a ford crossing which may be inaccessible following heavy rain. Estate staff need to be contacted prior to the survey to arrange specific dates for access and to confirm any constraints present for each survey area. Contacts will be available from the CNPA following the contract award.

result.text: Supply and implementation of a CRM system at the contracting authority as described in the specification of services and the requirements catalogue, together with system service services, training services, further developments and adaptation of the overall system after acceptance. Lot LOT-0001: Supply and implementation of a CRM system. The Universität Stuttgart intends to make a significant development step in the IT-supported support and administration of its diverse contact and relationship groups - particularly with regard to students, alumni, cooperation partners, sponsors and other stakeholders - and is striving to introduce a comprehensive customer relationship management (CRM) system. The aim is to systematically bundle, professionalise and digitise the communication and administration processes, which have previously been largely decentralised and heterogeneous, in a uniform, data protection-compliant infrastructure. To cover these needs, the contracting authority plans the procurement and introduction of a CRM system that digitally supports the entire process of strategic relationship maintenance in the relevant application fields. The procurement takes place as a SaaS solution in cloud operation. In addition to the provision of the service, the service also includes implementation based on defined application cases (workflows), the execution of training courses, the provision of system service services for the productive start as well as maintenance and support.

parts.source: Lieferung und Implementierung eines CRM-Systems bei der Auftraggeberin wie in der Leistungsbeschreibung und dem Anforderungskatalog beschrieben, nebst Systemserviceleistungen, Schulungsleistungen, Weiterentwicklungen sowie Anpassung des Gesamtsystems nach Abnahme. Lot LOT-0001: Lieferung und Implementierung eines CRM-Systems. Die Universität Stuttgart beabsichtigt in der IT-gestützten Betreuung und Verwaltung ihrer vielfältigen Kontakt- und Beziehungsgruppen - insbesondere mit Blick auf Studierende, Alumni, Kooperationspartner:innen, Fördernde und weitere Stakeholder - einen bedeutenden Entwicklungsschritt zu vollziehen und strebt die Einführung eines umfassenden Customer-Relationship-Managements (CRM)-Systems an. Ziel ist es, die bislang vielfach dezentral und heterogen durchgeführten Kommunikations- und Verwaltungsprozesse systematisch zu bündeln, zu professionalisieren und in einer einheitlichen, datenschutzkonformen Infrastruktur zu digitalisieren. Zur Deckung dieser Bedarfe plant die Auftraggeberin die Beschaffung und Einführung eines CRM-Systems, das den Gesamtprozess der strategischen Beziehungspflege in den relevanten Anwendungsfeldern digital unterstützt. Die Beschaffung erfolgt als SaaS-Lösung im Cloud-Betrieb. Neben der Bereitstellung des Systems umfasst die Leistung auch die Implementierung anhand definierter Anwendungsfälle (Workflows), die Durchführung von Schulungen, die Erbringung von Systemserviceleistungen für den Produktivstart sowie Wartung und Support.

result.text: The Scottish Government is looking to establish a Dynamic Purchasing System (DPS) for Fire Alarm Design, Installation & Associated Project Management Services. The DPS will be split into 2 Lots: Lot 1: Fire Alarm Design & Installation Lot 2: Associated Project Management Services Please Note: The value of call off- contracts will range from Thousands to Millions however no form of volume guarantee has been granted by the authority and therefore no commitment of spend is guarenteed through the DPS. Lot 2: Associated Project Management Services. Lot 2 of the DPS will comprise of suitably qualified and experienced suppliers to provide project management and contract administration services associated with the delivery of fire detection and fire alarm systems in residential buildings affected by cladding related fire risk across Scotland. Services may include: Coordination of surveys, investigations and technical assessments Preparation of specifications and procurement documentation Tender and contract management Coordination of contractors undertaking opening up, enabling and making good works associated with fire alarm installations Coordination and submission of Building Warrants, approvals, or any other statutory permissions or consents required for the works Resident and Factor liaison Coordination of installation works in occupied buildings Programme, cost and compliance monitoring Oversight of commissioning, testing and certification Coordination of handover documentation and project close out Services will support delivery of works in accordance with BS 5839 and relevant Scottish fire safety legislation, standards and guidance. Projects may include temporary or permanent systems, upgrades to existing installations, and works integrated with wider fire safety or cladding remediation programmes. Core Certification & Regulatory Compliance If asked at call-off contract stage and/or DPS example stage suppliers must demonstrate full compliance and provide certificates if applicable with the following: Relevant construction, engineering or building surveying qualification, such as a degree, HNC/HND, or equivalent in a related discipline (e.g. Building Surveying, Quantity Surveying, Civil Engineering, Architecture or similar) Membership of a relevant professional body, such as: RICS IFE CIOB APM ICE CIBSE RIBA/RIAS Personnel responsible for managing and delivering site based works must hold qualifications and training appropriate to their role when asked for within the call off contract, such as SMSTS, SSSTS, IOSH Managing Safely, CSCS/ECS cards or equivalent industry recognised qualifications. Lot 1: Fire Alarm Design and Installation. Lot 1 of DPS will provide for works in accordance with BS 5839-1:2025 and all relevant Scottish fire safety legislation, standards, and guidance, including requirements under the Fire (Scotland) Act 2005, and applicable Scottish Building Standards. Works may include the provision of new or enhanced fire detection and alarm systems comprising categories L1–L5, as identified through the Single Building Assessment (SBA). Requirements may include temporary or permanent fire alarm solutions, modifications to existing systems, associated enabling works, certification, compliance documentation, integration with wider fire safety strategies or cladding remediation activities and maintenance. Suppliers must be able demonstrate full compliance and provide certificates if applicable with the following if asked for at call off stage and/or within the SPD Example Section: Fire Detection and Alarm System (FD&AS) Standards BS 5839-1:2025 Fire detection and fire alarm systems for Buildings BAFE SP203 1 certification (modules: Design, Installation, Commissioning) Certification body must be UKAS accredited Commissioning shall be conducted in accordance BSRIA Application Guides and CIBSE Commissioning Codes Electrical Design & Installation (Mandatory) BS 7671:2018+A2:2022, Requirements for Electrical Installations BS 5839 1 interface requirements for fire alarm systems Electrical installation certification (EIC / Minor Works as applicable) Scottish Regulatory Compliance Compliance with Scottish Building Regulations, including the relevant provisions of the Building Standards Technical Handbooks (Fire and Electrical sections) Demonstrable understanding of: Fire detection and alarm requirements for domestic and non‐domestic buildings, including system selection and coverage in accordance with risk Applicable certification processes, including use of Approved Certifiers of Design and/or Construction where required under Scottish Building Regulations Legal Competency Confirmation that all works are delivered by “competent persons” under fire safety legislation Understanding of duties under: Fire (Scotland) Act Health and Safety: Personnel responsible for managing and delivering site based works must hold qualifications and training appropriate to their role, such as SMSTS, SSSTS, IOSH Managing Safely, CSCS/ECS cards or equivalent industry recognised qualifications.

Für die Durchführung des Projektvorhabens, bei dem neben dem Umstieg auf das MidPoint IDM auch konzeptionelle Änderungen an der Architektur und Infrastruktur vorgenommen werden müssen, beabsichtigt die TUDo Unterstützungsleistungen an einen externen Auftragnehmer zu vergeben. result.text: Kansaneläkelaitos (Kela) is surveying solutions available on the market for property management and maintenance software and a construction project bank. Kela's objective is to ensure that the management, development and maintenance of properties and work environments are implemented efficiently, economically and in a user-oriented manner. Future software must support comprehensive property management, the maintenance and development of system performance, and promote energy efficiency and responsibility. SaaS software must be suitable for versatile real estate portfolio management and offer flexible integration possibilities with other systems. In this way, we ensure that Kela can utilise data and processes seamlessly and meet future requirements. Software: 1. Property management software - Property data and documents - Reporting support - Efficient and responsible property management 2. Construction project bank - Project and construction document management 3. Property maintenance software - Maintenance and equipment management - Energy consumption and ESG monitoring - Comprehensive reporting and BI analytics - Monitoring of operating and maintenance costs The objective of the market dialogue is to: - Survey solutions and new operating models available on the market - Receive feedback on the subject matter and service content of the procurement - Gather insights on contract terms - Obtain information on pricing bases and responsibility criteria We particularly hope for insights on the following themes: - Versatile and customisable reporting capabilities - Project management and maintenance features - Access rights management and information security - Integrations with other systems (e.g. financial management, maintenance) - Usability and mobile usage solutions Procurement model: The software will be procured as a SaaS (Software as a Service) service, whereby the procurement contract includes full system maintenance and usage support in addition to the software licence. Registration for the market dialogue: Kela asks interested suppliers to register and submit a short preliminary presentation of their solution and a description of how the system would meet Kela's objectives. Market dialogue may also be conducted as Teams discussions, and the contracting authority may initiate dialogue before the registration period ends. Registration: Send the official name of the company and the contact person's email address to: it.tarjouskilpailut@kela.fi Subject in message: Work environment software, registration (sections 1–3) Deadline: By 31.12.2025.

parts.source: Kansaneläkelaitos (Kela) kartoittaa markkinoilla olevia ratkaisuja kiinteistöjohtamisen ja ylläpidon ohjelmistoihin sekä ja rakennuttamisen projektipankkiin. Kelan tavoitteena on varmistaa, että kiinteistöjen ja työympäristöjen hallinta, kehittäminen ja ylläpito toteutuvat tehokkaasti, taloudellisesti ja käyttäjälähtöisesti. Tulevien ohjelmistojen tulee tukea kokonaisvaltaista kiinteistöhallintaa, järjestelmien suorituskyvyn ylläpitoa ja kehittämistä sekä edistää energiatehokkuutta sekä vastuullisuutta. SaaS-ohjelmistojen tulee soveltua monipuoliseen kiinteistökannan hallintaan ja tarjota joustavat integraatiomahdollisuudet muihin järjestelmiin. Näin varmistamme, että Kela pystyy hyödyntämään dataa ja prosesseja saumattomasti sekä vastaamaan tulevaisuuden vaatimuksiin. Ohjelmistot: 1. Kiinteistöjohtamisen ohjelmisto - Kiinteistötiedot ja dokumentit - Raportoinnin tuki - Tehokas ja vastuullinen kiinteistöhallinta 2. Rakennuttamisen projektipankki - Projektin ja rakennusdokumenttien hallinta 3. Kiinteistöjen ylläpidon ohjelmisto - Huolto ja laitehallinta - Energiankulutuksen ja ESG-seuranta - Laaja raportointi ja BI-analytiikka - Käyttö- ja huoltokustannusten seuranta Markkinavuoropuhelun tavoitteena on: - Kartoittaa markkinoilla olevia ratkaisuja ja uusia toimintamalleja - Saada palautetta hankinnan kohteen ja palvelun sisällöstä - Kerätä näkemyksiä sopimusehdoista - Saada tietoa hinnoitteluperusteista ja vastuullisuuskriteereistä Toivomme erityisesti näkemyksiä seuraavista teemoista: - Monipuoliset ja muokattavat raportointimahdollisuudet - Projektinhallinnan ja ylläpidon ominaisuudet - Käyttöoikeuksien hallinta ja tietoturva - Integraatiot muihin järjestelmiin (esim. taloushallinto, ylläpito) - Käytettävyyden ja mobiilikäytön ratkaisut Hankintamalli: Ohjelmistot hankitaan SaaS-palveluna (Software as a Service), jolloin hankintasopimuksen piiriin kuuluu ohjelmiston käyttöoikeuden ohella järjestelmän täysi ylläpito ja käytön tuki. Ilmoittautuminen markkinavuoropuheluun: Kela pyytää kiinnostuneita toimittajia ilmoittautumaan ja toimittamaan lyhyen alustavan esityksen ratkaisustaan sekä kuvauksen siitä, miten järjestelmä vastaisi Kelan tavoitteisiin. Markkinavuoropuhelua voidaan käydä myös Teams-keskusteluina, ja tilaaja voi aloittaa vuoropuhelun ennen ilmoittautumisajan päättymistä. result.text: The Danish Agency for Digital Government (Digitaliseringsstyrelsen) operates on behalf of the Danish State a national qualified trust service for the management of qualified electronic signature creation devices under Regulation (EU) No 910/2014 as amended by Regulation (EU) 2024/1183 (eIDAS2). As part of securing and modernising the signing service to meet the requirements of eIDAS2, the Agency is procuring Data Diode solutions to be installed and operated within the Agency's data centres (currently two). The Contract includes an Option to extend the deployment to a third data centre and an Option to extend the Contract and replace the Data Diode Hardware. The Contract covers the Initial Delivery of certified Data Diode appliances, comprising dedicated Hardware and associated Software, certified in accordance with Common Criteria or EUCC at EAL4 or higher. The Initial Delivery includes all Licences, Documentation, and support necessary for the Agency to install and operate the Data Diode solutions as part of its trust service infrastructure. The Data Diode solutions must provide one way traffic from the Agency's isolated Root CA environment to other network zones, while preventing any data transfer in the reverse direction. The solutions must support integration with the Agency's existing infrastructure and the required protocols for transfer of files, time information, monitoring and logging data. The Supplier's principal obligations comprise: (a) the Initial Delivery of four Data Diode appliances for deployment across the Agency's production and staging environments in two data centers, together with the required Standard Software and deployment in the Agency's test and development environments; (b) Ongoing Services, including support and maintenance of the Standard Software and Hardware, security patching, product lifecycle management and hardware replacement; and (c)Ordered Services, comprising Time-Based Services (services for installation, configuration, key ceremonies, and similar tasks) and Options; and (d) Cross-cutting Services, comprising Documentation and security, provided as an integral part of the Ongoing Services and Ordered Services throughout the term of the Contract.

rejected.text: Udbuddet vedrører indkøb af en AI Mammografiløsning til henholdsvis Region Syddanmark og Region Midtjylland. Der er tale om et IT-system. For så vidt angår Region Midtjylland, er der alene tale om en option. Region Midtjylland kan således vælge eller undlade at udnytte optionen på indkøb af en AI Mammografiløsning. Som følge af et øget befolkningstal og stigende gennemsnitlig alder i befolkningen ses en stigning i forekomsten af brystkræft i Danmark. Der forventes en stigning fra ca. 4.800 i 2024 til ca. 5310 tilfælde af brystkræft i 2028. Tidlig opsporing med brystkræftscreening og behandling efter bedste praksis anses som afgørende elementer for at reducere brystkræftrelateret dødelighed og sygelighed hos kvinder. Screeningsprogrammet for brystkræft i Region Syddanmark foretager årligt ca. 70.000 screeninger. Derudover gennemføres der årligt ca. 17.000 kliniske mammografiundersøgelser. Det forventes, at ca. 10% af de kliniske mammografiundersøgelser udføres som tomosyntese. For Region Midtjyllands vedkommende bliver der årligt foretaget ca. 65.000 screeninger og ca. 15.000 kliniske mammografiundersøgelser. Hver screeningsundersøgelse består af 4 røntgenbilleder, 2 standardprojektioner pr. bryst. I tilfælde af tidligere brystkræft og brystbevarende operation suppleres med en 3. projektion. I dag bliver hver enkelt røntgenbillede gransket af to uafhængige mammaradiologer. Hvis der er uenighed, gennemgås billederne ved en 3. granskning. Der opleves generelt en stigende efterspørgsel på mammadiagnostik. Bl.a. henvises et stigende antal patienter til udredning i pakkeforløb for brystkræft som følge af en øgning i screeningspopulationen samt nye udrednings- og behandlingsmuligheder. Samtidig med det stigende behov for mammografiundersøgelser er der en landsdækkende udfordring med mangel på mammaradiologer. Kunstig intelligens (AI) løsninger baseret på deep learning-teknikken har i de seneste år vist store fremskridt inden for medicinsk billedanalyse, særlig med hensyn til påvisning af brystkræft på mammografier. Den udbudte AI-løsning skal implementeres på Region Syddanmarks fire sygehusenheder (Odense Universitetshospital. Sygehus Lillebælt, Sygehus Sønderjylland og Esbjerg/Grindsted Sygehus), der foretager mammografiundersøgelser. Formålet med anskaffelsen af en AI Mammografiløsning er dermed • at sikre at de nationale krav til brystkræftscreening kan opretholdes fremadrettet, og • at frigøre mammaradiolog-ressourcer til andre opgaver i forbindelse med opsporing af brystkræft. Løsningen skal således kunne aflaste ’1. granskeren’ i mammografi screeningsprogrammet samt yde beslutningsstøtte i den kliniske mammografi. Såfremt Region Midtjylland måtte udnytte optionen, vil løsningen hos Region Midtjylland skulle installeres på følgende sygehusenheder: Aarhus Universitetshospital, Regionshospitalet Viborg og Regionshospitalet Randers. Udbuddet omfatter overordnet følgende delydelser: • Selve AI-løsningen • Installation, opsætning, drift og kalibrering af systemet • Uddannelse af radiologer, systemforvaltning og driftspersonale • Vedligeholdelse og support af AI-løsningen Som en del af den udbudte Kontrakt udbydes endvidere følgende optioner for Ordregiver: • Mulighed for anvendelse af AI-løsningen i klinisk mammografi • Understøttelse af tomosyntese (3D) i mammografiscreening • Køb af yderligere screeninger jf. Bilag 3 For så vidt angår optioner henvises yderligere til Udkast til Kontrakt, pkt. 8, samt Bilag 2 og 3. Kontrakten, herunder Kravspecifikationen jf. Bilagene 1, 2 og 8, indeholder en uddybende beskrivelse af de udbudte produkter. Overtagelsesprøve i Region Syddanmark forventes godkendt primo juni 2026.

result.text: The tender concerns the procurement of an AI mammography solution for the Region of Southern Denmark and the Central Denmark Region, respectively. This is an IT system. As far as the Central Denmark Region is concerned, this is an option only. The Central Denmark Region may therefore choose to exercise or refrain from exercising the option to purchase an AI mammography solution. As a result of an increased population and an increasing average age in the population, an increase in the incidence of breast cancer is being seen in Denmark. An increase is expected from approx. 4.800 in 2024 to approx. 5310 cases of breast cancer in 2028. Early detection through breast cancer screening and best-practice treatment are considered crucial elements for reducing breast cancer-related mortality and morbidity in women. The breast cancer screening programme in the Region of Southern Denmark performs approx. 70.000 screenings annually. In addition, approx. 17.000 clinical mammography examinations are carried out annually. It is expected that approx. 10% of the clinical mammography examinations will be performed as tomosynthesis. For the Central Denmark Region, approx. 65.000 screenings and approx. 15.000 clinical mammography examinations are performed annually. Each screening examination consists of 4 X-ray images, 2 standard projections per breast. In cases of previous breast cancer and breast-conserving surgery, this is supplemented with a 3. projection. Today, each individual X-ray image is examined by two independent breast radiologists. If there is disagreement, the images are reviewed by a 3. examination. There is generally an increasing demand for breast diagnostics. Among other things, an increasing number of patients are being referred for investigation in fast-track breast cancer pathways as a result of an increase in the screening population as well as new investigation and treatment options. At the same time as the increasing need for mammography examinations, there is a nationwide challenge with a shortage of breast radiologists. Artificial intelligence (AI) solutions based on deep learning technology have in recent years shown great progress within medical image analysis, particularly with regard to the detection of breast cancer on mammograms. The tendered AI solution must be implemented at the Region of Southern Denmark's four hospital units (Odense University Hospital, Hospital Lillebælt, Hospital Sønderjylland and Esbjerg/Grindsted Hospital), which perform mammography examinations. The purpose of the acquisition of an AI mammography solution is therefore • to ensure that the national requirements for breast cancer screening can be maintained in the future, and • to free up breast radiologist resources for other tasks in connection with the detection of breast cancer. The solution must thus be able to relieve the "1. examiner" in the mammography screening programme as well as provide decision support in clinical mammography. Should the Central Denmark Region exercise the option, the solution for the Central Denmark Region will need to be installed at the following hospital units: Aarhus University Hospital, Regional Hospital Viborg and Regional Hospital Randers. The tender generally includes the following sub-services: • The AI solution itself • Installation, setup, operation and calibration of the system • Training of radiologists, system management and operating personnel • Maintenance and support of the AI solution As part of the tendered Contract, the following options are also offered for the Contracting Authority: • Possibility of using the AI solution in clinical mammography • Support for tomosynthesis (3D) in mammography screening • Purchase of additional screenings cf. Annex 3 Regarding options, reference is further made to the Draft Contract, clause 8, as well as Annex 2 and 3. The contract, including the Requirements Specification cf. Annexes 1, 2 and 8, contains a detailed description of the tendered products. The acceptance test in the Region of Southern Denmark is expected to be approved in early June 2026.

result.text: Migration of the OpenScape Voice telecommunications system including applications The contracting authority is tendering the procurement of server hardware, hypervisor, storage (vSAN), network switches and the execution of the software update of OpenScape Voice V10 to the current release V11 including all connected applications. As part of the migration, the VMware hypervisor is to be replaced with Proxmox. Since the existing OpenScape Contact Center cannot be virtualised on Proxmox and is no longer being further developed by the manufacturer Mitel, the migration is to take place to the Mitel CX Contact Center. In addition, the maintenance of the system including software maintenance is to be taken over. As part of the maintenance, the following services must be provided: - Maintenance, including software maintenance of the telecommunications systems, including DECT - Branches - Session Border Controllers - UC system with voicemail, CTI, One Number Service, web collaboration - Alarm server (newvoice) - Network components for connecting the telecommunications systems - Server and storage systems for the virtualisation and data backup of the telecommunications systems and applications - Operation of the server systems and storage, including operating system - Remote service 7x 24 x 365 - On-site service - Patch management and release management - Incident management In addition, services for the purchase, installation and maintenance for the expansion or replacement of telecommunications components are requested as a shopping basket over the term of the contract. The services must be provided by 01.04.2027 at the latest. Necessary measures for taking over the maintenance, e.g. - Migration of the existing systems - Familiarisation with the system documentation and systems - Onboarding of employees - Setup of remote accesses on the part of the contractor so that the remote maintenance accesses of the contracting authority can be used - Registration / re-registration of the service partner with the manufacturer must be carried out in full by the contractor prior to taking over the service. - The contractor shall supply a migration plan with milestones upon submission of the tender

Im Rahmen der Migration soll der Hypervisor VM-Ware gegen Proxmox ersetzt werden. result.text: The subject of the tender is the conclusion of a framework agreement for the development and provision of a modular kit system for elements of mobility stations in the area of the city and district of Heilbronn. The aim is the standardisation and unification of the stations - particularly with regard to design, equipment and digital accessibility. The framework agreement enables those entitled to order - the city and district of Heilbronn, the 46 municipalities in the district, the municipal utilities of Heilbronn or other municipal self-governing operations - to call off individual modules as needed at their own expense on the basis of individual contracts. The elements tendered include signposting and information signage, secure bicycle parking facilities with a digital access, booking and payment system, passenger and bicycle shelters, and street furniture.

result.text: Digital Care Hub is seeking an independent evaluation partner to assess the delivery, impact, sustainability and value for money of the Better Security, Better Care (BSBC) programme. Funded by the Department of Health and Social Care, BSBC supports approximately 28,000 CQC-registered adult social care locations in England to improve cyber security, data protection and information governance, including compliance with the Data Security and Protection Toolkit (DSPT). Delivery is led nationally by Digital Care Hub through more than 30 Local Support Organisations, combining central leadership, guidance, training, communications, data analysis and performance management with trusted local support. The supplier will design and deliver a proportionate mixed-method evaluation covering programme governance and delivery, stakeholder engagement, partner effectiveness, reach, changes in awareness and behaviour, adoption of good practice, DSPT outcomes, organisational resilience, wider benefits, cost effectiveness, return on investment and social and economic value. The work should identify lessons, good practice and evidence-based recommendations while providing ongoing insight to support continuous improvement. Key deliverables are an evaluation framework and inception report within three months; ongoing data collection, analysis and stakeholder engagement; monthly progress meetings; an interim report by September 2027; and a final evaluation report, shorter executive report, presentation and dissemination-ready outputs by October 2028. Close-down and dissemination support will continue to March 2029. The proposed contract runs from October 2026 to March 2029, with a maximum budget of £125,000 inclusive of VAT. Bidders must demonstrate strong experience in programme and economic evaluation, publicly funded programmes, mixed-method research, stakeholder engagement and report writing. Knowledge of adult social care, health and care systems, cyber security, digital transformation or information governance is required. Tender responses must include organisation and personnel details, methodology, data collection and analysis plans, delivery timetable, resourcing, quality assurance, risk management, up to three relevant examples, a full pricing schedule, assumptions and proposed social value. Evaluation weightings are: understanding 15%, methodology 35%, experience 20%, project management 10%, social value 10% and price 10%. The supplier must comply with UK GDPR, the Data Protection Act 2018, confidentiality, insurance, procurement, equality and safeguarding requirements. Clarification questions are due by 14 October 2026 and tenders by 18 October 2026. Please see attachment for full specifications.

result.text: This notice is not an official launch of our procurement(s), it is to alert the market to future opportunities and allow us to begin conversations that will shape plans for multiple future requirements. The Cabinet Office (Government Skills Group) is transforming the way learning and development (L&D) is designed, procured, and delivered across the Civil Service. Following the announcement by the Chief Secretary to the Prime Minister, the government is establishing the new National School of Government and Public Services (hereon The National School). The National School is tasked with delivering high-quality, targeted training to approximately 558,000 civil servants, developing executive leadership in the wider public sector, and to partner with public sector training bodies. The strategic goal of the National School is to shift away from the historically outsourced prime-supplier managed-service model. In its place, the Cabinet Office is building an insourced, hybrid capability. Under this new Future Operating Model (FOM), the Cabinet Office will directly manage core operations, standard curricula, and stakeholder engagement. However, expert external provision will remain a critical element of the programme. The National School transformation programme relies on three core, interdependent pillars to transition Civil Service training away from fully outsourced prime-supplier models toward an in-house, hybrid operating model by April 2028. Together, these pillars work to build direct relationships with suppliers, provide a modern digital learning infrastructure, and establish robust in-house operational workflows. Pillar 1: Future Supplier Partnerships (FSP) The FSP project serves as the commercial enabler of the new operating model, building the in-house capability required to buy learning services and manage supply chains directly. We aim to establish direct, value-driven contractual relationships with UK-based SMEs, universities, business schools, and niche providers. The project team have identified an indicative Three-Stage Roadmap to enable this delivery: Stage 1 (Immediate - April 2027): Procuring urgent digital and specialist training needs that cannot be fulfilled through existing frameworks. Stage 2 (April 2027-March 2028): Phased procurement for core, National School-sponsored curriculum, coaching, and talent programmes. Stage 3 (March 2028 onwards): On-going phased procurements falling out of Stages 1 and 2, depending on the length of contracts identified. The scope of the requirements will cover several key procurement categories, including, but not limited to, specialised coaching pools (including for neuro-diverse leaders), blended training delivery, learning design (retaining Crown Intellectual Property), access to subject matter experts including within academia, independent research and evaluation, helpdesk/admin surge, and off-the-shelf qualifications. Pillar 2: Future Technologies (FT) The Future Technologies project focuses on designing and implementing the digital architecture required to run a personalised training operation for approximately 558,000 civil servants. The core objective here is the setting up and integration of platforms to manage the access, booking, payments, and evaluation of learning materials. This involves transitioning away from heavy manual processes to maximise technological efficiencies. At this stage the project team has identified the central deliverable as a unified online portal allowing learners to access the full National School offering. Key technologies in scope for procurement include, but are not limited to, a new Learning Management System (LMS)/ Learning Experience Platform (LXP), Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems to centralise stakeholder engagement, and design/delivery tools. Pillar 3: Future Learning Operations (FLO) The Learning Operations project is responsible for building the actual systems, processes, and internal capabilities required to run the day-to-day training operations in-house. Their core objective is establishing an integrated operational function by April 2028 that supports over 558,000 civil servants in completing their learning journeys. It is highly dependent on the digital and commercial pillars to develop the underlying platforms that support operations. Market Involvement As part of the initial phases of the programme, the project teams are keen to connect with the market and gain insight into current trends, operations and barriers. With this in mind, Cabinet Office and the project team have planned the following Sector Connector events.

The scope of the requirements will cover several key procurement categories, including, but not limited to, specialised coaching pools (including for neuro-diverse leaders), blended training delivery, learning design (retaining Crown Intellectual Property), access to subject matter experts including within academia, independent research and evaluation, helpdesk/admin surge, and off-the-shelf qualifications. Pillar 2: Future Technologies (FT) The Future Technologies project focuses on designing and implementing the digital architecture required to run a personalised training operation for approximately 558,000 civil servants. The core objective here is the setting up and integration of platforms to manage the access, booking, payments, and evaluation of learning materials. This involves transitioning away from heavy manual processes to maximise technological efficiencies. At this stage the project team has identified the central deliverable as a unified online portal allowing learners to access the full National School offering. Key technologies in scope for procurement include, but are not limited to, a new Learning Management System (LMS)/ Learning Experience Platform (LXP), Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems to centralise stakeholder engagement, and design/delivery tools. Pillar 3: Future Learning Operations (FLO) The Learning Operations project is responsible for building the actual systems, processes, and internal capabilities required to run the day-to-day training operations in-house. Their core objective is establishing an integrated operational function by April 2028 that supports over 558,000 civil servants in completing their learning journeys. It is highly dependent on the digital and commercial pillars to develop the underlying platforms that support operations. Market Involvement As part of the initial phases of the programme, the project teams are keen to connect with the market and gain insight into current trends, operations and barriers. With this in mind, Cabinet Office and the project team have planned the following Sector Connector events.
