result.text: Cefas requires the provision of specialist marine geotechnical services to support two vibracoring surveys within the Irish Sea Firth of Clyde or North Sea. The Supplier is required to achieve sediment cores each with a target penetration of up to 3 m from pre-planned stations for the delivery of our environmental sampling programme. The Supplier is required to provide a 3 metre vibrocorer, complete with spares, coring consumables (coring liners etc) core splitting and core cutting equipment, and suitable individuals to undertake operations of the vibrocorer on a 24 hrs period (2 x 12 hrs shifts back-to-back) alongside deck crew. The Supplier’s personnel will be accommodated onboard the RV Cefas Endeavour for the duration of the survey. Cefas will provide suitable onboard cabin accommodation, bedding and welfare facilities, together with meals and refreshments as part of the vessel’s normal catering provision. The RV Cefas Endeavour has en-suite accommodation for scientific and technical personnel. The Supplier should therefore not include separate accommodation or subsistence costs for periods spent onboard the vessel. Any specific dietary requirements should be notified to Cefas in advance of mobilisation. The Supplier will remain responsible for all travel and associated costs required to mobilise and demobilise its personnel and equipment to/from the agreed port, unless otherwise stated. This should be reflected in the quote provided. The survey is scheduled for approximately ten to twelve days between the 1st to the 16th of November with the flexibility of +/- 5 days each side, with the availability to mobilise and demobilise equipment either in Lowestoft or a Port on the Southwest coast. The port will be confirmed by Cefas as soon as possible. Suppliers must be prepared to mobilise and demobilise from either location. Suppliers must provide evidence of valid and appropriate offshore survival training and medical certification, including BOSIET or STCW95 and a UK Offshore Operators Association-approved medical, or suitable equivalents. Original hard copies of all required certification and documentation will be required for inspection upon request at the time of vessel mobilisation. Please note general arrangement drawings of the RV Cefas Endeavour can be supplied upon Contract award for operational logistics if required. Requirement: The Supplier will liaise with Cefas before mobilisation to confirm the operational requirements, vessel interfaces, equipment layout, power supply, lifting arrangements, programme and health and safety requirements. A mobilisation plan shall be prepared and agreed by both parties in advance of installation. The Supplier will provide a fully maintained and function-tested 3 m high-powered vibrocorer spread, including its control system, constant-tension winch, core barrels, workshop container, essential spares and associated ancillary equipment. The proposed system shall be suitable for operations in water depths of approximately 150 m. The vibrocorer spread shall be delivered to the nominated mobilisation port and installed aboard the RV Cefas Endeavour. Following installation, the Supplier will complete appropriate equipment inspections, function tests and deployment checks, including a wet test where practicable. The Supplier will provide suitably trained and experienced equipment technicians to install, operate, maintain and demobilise the vibrocoring equipment. The base provision shall comprise of four technicians for operations of up to 24 hours per day (two technicians per 12-hour shift). The two technicians will be supported by RV Cefas Endeavour crew for the safe deployment and recovery of equipment. At each survey location, the vessel shall establish a safe and stable working position before the vibrocorer is deployed to the seabed using the vessel’s suitable crane or A-frame and lifting winch. Cefas shall provide the station position and water-depth information for each deployment. Once seabed conditions and the survey position have been confirmed, the vibrocorer shall be operated until either: • the full available barrel penetration is achieved; • refusal is encountered due to the ground conditions; or • the deployment is stopped for operational or safety reasons. Following each attempt, the vibrocorer shall be recovered to deck and the retained sediment core removed from the barrel, visually inspected, split and transferred to Cefas personnel. The Supplier will undertake the acquisition of the sediment cores and check the samples and associated acquisition information before handing them to Cefas. Unless otherwise agreed, laboratory testing, detailed data processing, interpretation, and reporting are outside the Suppliers scope. The Supplier will maintain the vibrocorer spread throughout the offshore programme and provide suitable spare parts for key components to minimise operational downtime. Any equipment defects shall be reported promptly to the Cefas Survey Lead, together with proposed corrective action and any expected effect on the programme. The proposed provision includes full spares coverage for key components. On completion of the offshore work, the Supplier will safely isolate, dismantle and remove its equipment from the vessel at the nominated demobilisation port. The work area shall be left in a safe and satisfactory condition. The Supplier will carry out the Services in accordance with its approved health and safety and quality-management procedures, Cefas vessel requirements and all applicable legislation, including the Lifting Operations and Lifting Equipment Regulations 1998 (LOLER), where applicable. All offshore activities shall be appropriately risk assessed, and suitable method statements, lifting plans and operational procedures shall be agreed before mobilisation.

result.text: Artificial Intelligence (AI) methods demonstrate astonishing performance in many application areas and are increasingly used in areas that affect daily life. The field of cybersecurity has not remained untouched by AI either. New AI tools are published almost daily in this context, and large AI language models (LLMs) in particular are already being used today for various application purposes. At the same time, the threat landscape is changing significantly as benignly intended models are misused for attack purposes (dual use). As a consequence, it must sometimes be assumed that vulnerabilities will be discovered and exploited ever faster in future with the increasing capabilities of AI. Against this background, the defensive side must also take action, which is why this project is intended to investigate how AI can be used profitably in the SSDLC and what effects ongoing developments have on the security of software. For this purpose, the project is divided into three parts, with related but distinct services: In work package 1-4 [HM1.1], a study on the current state of the art and science in the field of AI in the Secure Software Development Life Cycle is to be drawn up. In addition, best practices for the use of identified AI tools are to be developed. The results are to be published. In work package 5-6 [HM2.1], based on the study and in cooperation with the BSI, the contractor shall review the evaluation criteria for AVA scoring in Common Criteria certification and update them in view of new circumstances. In addition, an implementation plan for the use of AI tools for conformity assessment bodies is to be created. In work package 7, a reference architecture is created for the Open CoDE platform, which illustrates how AI tools can be integrated into the Secure Software Development Life Cycle and the software environment of Open CoDE. Suitable tools are to be proposed in this regard. Lot LOT-0000: KI im Secure Software Development Life Cycle (KISDL). parts.source: Methoden der Künstlichen Intelligenz (KI) zeigen in vielen Anwendungsbereichen erstaunliche Leistungen und werden zunehmend in Bereichen eingesetzt, die das tägliche Leben beeinflussen. Auch das Gebiet der Cybersicherheit ist von KI nicht unberührt geblieben. Neue KI-Tools werden in diesem Kontext beinahe täglich veröffentlicht, und vor allem Große KI-Sprachmodelle (LLMs) werden bereits heute zu diversen Anwendungszwecken eingesetzt. Zugleich verändert sich auch die Bedrohungslage stark, da gutartig intendierte Modelle missbräuchlich zu Angriffszwecken (Dual Use) verwendet werden. Infolgedessen muss mitunter angenommen werden, dass Schwachstellen mit den zunehmenden Fähigkeiten von KI zukünftig immer schneller entdeckt und ausgenutzt werden. Vor diesem Hintergrund muss auch die Verteidigungsseite aktiv werden, weswegen in diesem Projekt untersucht werden soll, wie KI im SSDLC gewinnbringend eingesetzt werden kann und welche Auswirkungen die fortschreitenden Entwicklungen auf die Sicherheit von Software haben. Dazu ist das Projekt in drei Teile gegliedert, mit zusammenhängenden, aber unterschiedlichen Leistungen: In den AP 1-4 [HM1.1]soll eine Studie über den aktuellen Stand der Technik und der Wissenschaft im Bereich KI im Secure Software Development Life Cycle erstellt werden. Dazu sollen des Weiteren Best Practices für den Einsatz identifizierter KI-Tools erarbeitet werden. Die Ergebnisse sollen veröffentlicht werden. In den AP 5-6 [HM2.1] soll der AN auf Grundlage der Studie in Zusammenarbeit mit dem BSI die Bewertungskriterien für die AVA Bepunktung in der Common Criteria Zertifizierung überprüfen und mit Blick auf die neuen Gegebenheiten aktualisieren. Zudem ist ein Umsetzungsplan für den Einsatz von KI-Tools für Prüfstellen zu erstellen. Im AP 7 wird für die Plattform Open CoDE eine Referenzarchitektur erstellt, die darstellt, wie KI-Tools in den Secure Software Development Life Cycle und die Softwareumgebung von Open CoDE integriert werden können. Es sind hierbei geeignete Tools vorzuschlagen. Lot LOT-0000: KI im Secure Software Development Life Cycle (KISDL). result.text: THIS IS NOT A CONTRACT NOTICE OR A CALL FOR TENDERS BUT AN INFORMATION REQUEST FOR MARKET RESEARCH AND TECHNICAL DIALOGUE. This information request is used to survey the market and obtain information regarding the procurement. The contracting authority is not initiating a procurement procedure with the publication of the information request; rather, a potential contract notice and call for tenders will be published later. The information request does not oblige the contracting authority to carry out the actual procurement. Answering the information request is not a prerequisite for participating in any later procurement procedure that may be organised. Suppliers will not be paid compensation for answering the information request or participating in the market dialogue. The responses provided to this information request will be used in planning the procurement of a medical device processing RFID system and related supplies for the needs of HUS-yhtymä. The system and supplies to be procured must be suitable for use in hospital sterile services environments. The purpose of the information request is to survey suppliers on the market as well as their product and service ranges. The purpose is to ascertain technical solutions, pricing principles and the cost level for budgeting purposes. HUS-yhtymä requests your written comments in particular on the following questions: 1. Durability and lifecycle of tags in a hospital environment 1.1. How do the RFID tags you offer withstand medical device processing sterilisation and washing processes? State the maximum temperature resistance of the tags (e.g. autoclave +134 °C), pressure resistance, and chemical tolerance (such as alkaline detergents). 1.2. What is the estimated lifecycle of the tags you offer (measured as operational reliability in washing and sterilisation cycles)? Do you offer a warranty for the durability of the tags in a sterile services environment? 2. Compatibility with existing automation and standards 2.1. Another unit of ours already uses RFID-controlled automation. What frequency bands and standards (e.g. UHF / RAIN RFID, HF, ISO 18000-63) does your system support to ensure seamless compatibility with existing equipment? 2.2. Does your system and readers support general global identification and data standards (such as GS1/EPC)? 2.3. Is your system "vendor-independent" (open standard) with regard to tags? Can we in future freely purchase tags that meet the requirements from third parties, or does the system require your own identifiers? 3. Reliability in a metal environment (On-Metal) 3.1. Medical device processing handles almost exclusively metal (baskets, containers, instruments). How are your system's reader devices and so-called on-metal tags optimised to operate in this environment without dead zones or signal reflection interference? 3.2. How reliably does your system perform bulk reading (e.g. a situation where an entire trolley of overlapping steel baskets is pushed through the reading area at once)? What is the tested margin of error in this scenario? 4. Software integrations and interfaces 4.1. What ready-made integrations or interface solutions (API) does your system have? HUS Sterile Services uses the Gemini production control system supplied by CGI. 4.2. How is data transferred from RFID reading to the main system: does the data transfer take place in real time and does it require the maintenance of a separate middleware? 5. Cost structure and implementation 5.1. What is the preliminary cost structure of your solution (one-off equipment and installation costs vs. recurring licence, maintenance and tag costs)? 5.2. According to the plan, the system is being procured for two sterile services centres (Jorvi and Meilahti). What is your preliminary estimate of the duration of the implementation project in units of this type? On what kind of schedule after signing the agreement would you be capable of starting/executing the implementation project? 6. Other 6.1 Would you like to raise any other aspects related to the subject of the procurement or the solution you offer? HUS-yhtymä requests suppliers interested in the procurement described above to notify the contracting authority of their interest and answer the questions presented above, and to attach to the response a general description/brochure of the solutions you offer for the need described above. Please note that all material is intended solely for conducting this market dialogue. The contracting authority will treat your responses confidentially. Based on the responses to the information request, clarifying questions may be posed to the supplier and/or an opportunity may be offered to present their solutions in a manner to be announced later. Suppliers that have responded to the information request may potentially receive preliminary call for tender documents for comment. We kindly ask you to submit your responses to the information request and notify your interest no later than 23.9.2026 at 12:00 to the address kilpailutus.ict@hus.fi. The subject line of the message must mention "HUS 578-2025 - Medical Device Processing RFID System".

parts.source: TÄMÄ EI OLE HANKINTAILMOITUS TAI TARJOUSPYYNTÖ VAAN TIETOPYYNTÖ MARKKINAKARTOITUSTA JA TEKNISTÄ VUOROPUHELUA VARTEN. Tämän tietopyynnön avulla kartoitetaan markkinoita ja saadaan hankintaa koskevaa tietoa. Hankintayksikkö ei aloita tietopyynnön julkaisulla tarjouskilpailua, vaan mahdollinen hankintailmoitus ja tarjouspyyntö julkaistaan myöhemmin. Tietopyyntö ei velvoita hankintayksikköä toteuttamaan varsinaista hankintaa. Tietopyyntöön vastaaminen ei ole edellytys myöhempään mahdollisesti järjestettävään tarjouskilpailuun osallistumiselle. Toimittajille ei makseta korvausta tietopyyntöön vastaamisesta tai markkinavuoropuheluun osallistumisesta. Tähän tietopyyntöön annettuja vastauksia käytetään suunniteltaessa välinehuollon RFID-järjestelmän ja siihen liittyvien tarvikkeiden hankintaa HUS-yhtymän tarpeisiin. Hankittavan järjestelmän ja tarvikkeiden tulee soveltua sairaaloiden välinehuollon ympäristöissä käytettäviksi. Tietopyynnön tarkoituksena on kartoittaa markkinoilla olevia toimittajia sekä heidän tuote- ja palveluvalikoimaansa. Tarkoituksena on selvittää teknisiä ratkaisuja, hinnoitteluperiaatteita ja kustannustasoa budjettia varten. HUS-yhtymä pyytää kirjallisia kommenttejanne erityisesti seuraaviin kysymyksiin: 1. Tagien kestävyys ja elinkaari sairaalaympäristössä 1.1. Miten tarjoamanne RFID-tagit kestävät välinehuollon sterilointi- ja pesuprosessit? Ilmoittakaa tagien maksimilämpötilan kesto (esim. autoklaavi +134 °C), paineenkesto sekä kemikaalien (kuten emäksisten pesuaineiden) sietokyky. 1.2. Mikä on tarjoamienne tagien arvioitu elinkaari (toimintavarmuus pesu- ja sterilointisykleissä mitattuna)? Tarjoatteko tagien kestävyydelle takuuta välinehuoltoympäristössä? 2. Yhteensopivuus nykyisen automaation ja standardien kanssa 2.1. Toisessa yksikössämme on jo käytössä RFID-ohjattua automaatiota. Mitä taajuusalueita ja standardeja (esim. UHF / RAIN RFID, HF, ISO 18000-63) järjestelmänne tukee varmistaakseen saumattoman yhteensopivuuden olemassa olevan laitteiston kanssa? 2.2. Tukeeko järjestelmänne ja lukijanne yleisiä globaaleja tunniste- ja tietostandardeja (kuten GS1/EPC)? 2.3. Onko järjestelmänne "toimittajariippumaton" (open standard) tagien suhteen? Voimmeko jatkossa ostaa vaatimukset täyttäviä tageja vapaasti kolmansilta osapuolilta, vai vaatiiko järjestelmä teidän omia tunnisteitanne? 3. Luotettavuus metalliympäristössä (On-Metal) 3.1. Välinehuollossa käsitellään lähes yksinomaan metallia (korit, kontit, instrumentit). Miten järjestelmänne lukijalaitteet ja ns. on-metal-tagit on optimoitu toimimaan tässä ympäristössä ilman katvealueita tai signaalin heijastushäiriöitä? 3.2. Miten luotettavasti järjestelmänne suorittaa massaluvun (esim. tilanne, jossa kokonainen kärryllinen päällekkäisiä teräskoreja työnnetään lukualueen läpi kerralla)? Mikä on testattu virhemarginaali tässä skenaariossa? 4. Ohjelmistointegraatiot ja rajapinnat 4.1. Millaiset valmiit integraatiot tai rajapintaratkaisut (API) järjestelmällänne on? HUS Välinehuollossa on käytössä CGI:n toimittama Gemini-tuotannonohjausjärjestelmä. 4.2. Miten tieto siirtyy RFID-luennasta pääjärjestelmään: tapahtuuko tiedonsiirto reaaliaikaisesti ja vaatiiko se erillisen väliohjelmiston (middleware) ylläpitoa? 5. Kustannusrakenne ja käyttöönotto 5.1. Mikä on ratkaisunne alustava kustannusrakenne (kertaluonteiset laite- ja asennuskustannukset vs. juoksevat lisenssi-, ylläpito- ja tagikustannukset)? 5.2. Järjestelmää ollaan suunnitelman mukaan hankkimassa kahteen välinehuoltokeskukseen (Jorvi ja Meilahti). Mikä on alustava arvionne käyttöönottoprojektin kestosta tämäntyyppisissä yksiköissä? Minkälaisella aikataululla sopimuksen allekirjoittamisen jälkeen olisitte kykenevä aloittamaan/toteuttamaan käyttöönottoprojektin? 6. Muuta 6.1 Haluatteko nostaa esiin joitain muita näkökohtia liittyen hankinnan kohteeseen tai tarjoamaanne ratkaisuun? HUS-yhtymä pyytää edellä kuvatusta hankinnasta kiinnostuneita toimittajia ilmoittamaan kiinnostuksensa hankintayksikölle ja vastaamaan edellä esitettyihin kysymyksiin sekä liittämään vastaukseen yleisluontoisen kuvauksen/esitteen tarjoamistanne ratkaisuista edellä kuvattuun tarpeeseen. Pyydämme huomioimaan, että kaikki materiaali on tarkoitettu ainoastaan tämän markkinavuoropuhelun käymiseen. Hankintayksikkö käsittelee vastauksenne luottamuksellisesti. Tietopyynnön vastausten perusteella saatetaan toimittajalle esittää tarkentavia kysymyksiä ja/tai tarjota mahdollisuus esitellä ratkaisujaan myöhemmin ilmoitettavalla tavalla. Tietopyyntöön vastanneet toimittajat saavat mahdollisesti kommentoitavakseen alustavat tarjouspyyntöasiakirjat. Pyydämme toimittamaan vastaukset tietopyyntöön ja ilmoittamaan kiinnostuksestanne viimeistään 23.9.2026 klo 12:00 mennessä osoitteeseen kilpailutus.ict@hus.fi. Viestin aiheeksi maininta "HUS 578-2025 - Välinehuollon RFID-järjestelmä".

result.text: Network Rail is seeking to engage the market regarding the future procurement of a Certificate Lifecycle Management (CLM) solution. This project is driven by significant industry changes, including the CA/Browser Forum’s decision to reduce the maximum lifespan of public SSL/TLS certificates over the coming years. By 2029, certificates will require renewal as frequently as every 47 days, and domain validation reuse will be limited to just 10 days. These changes are intended to enhance security but will introduce substantial operational overhead, making manual certificate management impractical and automation essential. Network Rail operates across a complex landscape of on-premises, cloud, and supplier-managed environments. A key challenge is the fragmented ownership and lack of central visibility over certificates, particularly those issued and managed by third-party suppliers. This fragmentation increases the risk of outages due to expired or misconfigured certificates and limits Network Rail’s ability to monitor, renew, or enforce compliance directly. The CLM project aims to address these challenges by implementing a solution that enables the centralised, automated management of certificates throughout their lifecycle, regardless of where they are issued or managed. The solution must provide comprehensive visibility across all environments, support robust automation for renewal and validation, and enable clear supplier accountability through contractual mechanisms. This includes the ability to track certificates managed by third parties, enforce renewal responsibilities, and ensure that incidents caused by supplier failures can be managed contractually. Network Rail is inviting suppliers to demonstrate how their solutions can meet these requirements, including the ability to: Centrally track and manage certificates across all environments and suppliers. Automate certificate renewal, validation, and compliance processes. Provide visibility and control over third-party issued certificates. Support supplier accountability and contractual enforcement. Align with upcoming industry standards and security requirements. Deliver proven solutions at scale, with references from similar large infrastructure organisations. This market engagement will inform Network Rail’s approach to the procurement of a CLM solution that ensures security, operational resilience, and compliance in a rapidly evolving digital landscape. Lot 1: .

result.text: This tender is for Phase 3 of the Helensburgh, Cardross and Dumbarton Cyclepath; linking the Helensburgh Waterfront segregated cycleway (OS Grid NS 29598 82259) to the existing section of the cyclepath adjacent to the A814 at the Red Burn (OS Grid NS 31655 81112), near the north-east corner of Morrisons Supermarket site, and will build upon the concept design developed for the majority of the route (Civic Engineers, 2025). Argyll & Bute Council wish to appoint an appropriately qualified and experienced design team to develop Phase 3 of the Helensburgh, Cardross and Dumbarton Cyclepath project from the current concept design through Developed (RIBA Stage 3) and Technical (RIBA Stage 4) Design, and to be Principal Designer during construction (RIBA Stage 5). The project will require the successful tenderer to complete a range of survey, design and in-depth engagement work, including in-depth community, stakeholder and landowner engagement, topographic and utilities surveys, equality impact assessment (EqIA) and Preliminary Environmental Assessment (PEA) to ensure route(s) identified have strong community, neighbour and landowner support and that the design drawings for the route(s) are robust, deliverable and of a high quality. These will all be subject to engagement with the community, businesses, landowners, neighbouring landowners, Argyll and Bute Council, Strathclyde Partnership for Transport (SPT) and Transport Scotland. rejected.text: Die HZD hat im Jahr 2022 das Test Center Hessen etabliert und betreibt dieses seitdem als zentrale Organisationseinheit für standardisierte Testdienstleistungen. Mit fortschreitender Digitalisierung in der Landesverwaltung steigen auch die Anforderungen an die Qualitätssicherung. Denn ohne ausreichend getestete - und damit qualitätsgesicherte - Lösungen ist ein stabiler IT-Betrieb nicht zu gewährleisten. Gesetzliche Vorgaben an die Sicherheit und die Barrierefreiheit der bereitgestellten Verfahren erhöhen die Anforderungen zusätzlich. Vor diesem Hintergrund hat die HZD im Jahr 2022 das Test Center Hessen (TCH) etabliert und betreibt dieses seitdem als zentrale Organisationseinheit für standardisierte Testdienstleistungen. Das Test Center Hessen fungiert als zentrale Organisationseinheit für standardisierte Testdienstleistungen und orientiert sich hierbei an etablierten Industrienormen und Best Practices, insbesondere an ISO/IEC 29119 sowie ISTQB. Das Test Center Hessen (TCH) der HZD bietet internen und externen Kunden maßgeschneiderten Service rund um das Thema Testen. Hinzu kommen umfassende Dienstleistungen in Form von individuell kombinierbaren Modulen. Die Module sind weitgehend standardisiert aufgebaut. Sie können je nach Bedarf zusammengestellt werden. Gegenstand der vorliegenden Ausschreibung ist die Unterstützung des bereits etablierten und operativ betriebenen Test Centers Hessen durch externe IT-Dienstleister. Ziel des Test Centers ist insbesondere die Erhöhung der Softwarequalität sowie die Reduzierung von Risiken im Softwarelebenszyklus. Zur Unterstützung dieser Ziele werden unter anderem folgende Leistungen benötigt: • Beratung rund um das Thema Test • Standardisierung und Automatisierung des Testvorgehens • Erbringung von Testserviceleistungen in unterschiedlichen Themengebieten (Testmanagement,Testautomatisierung,Testdatenmanagement, Last- und Performancetests, Funktionale (manuelle) Tests einschließlich fachlicher Qualitätssicherung sowie Barrierefreiheitstests, siehe Ziffer 4 der Leistungsbeschreibung) • Bereitstellung von Templates und Methoden Nach aktuellem Planungsstand sowie unter Berücksichtigung zusätzlicher Bedarfe weiterer Fachbereiche und Dienststellen wird für die maximale Vertragslaufzeit von bis zu 48 Monaten von einem Gesamtbedarf von ca. 37.730 Personentagen (PT) ausgegangen (unverbindliche Schätzmenge).

result.text: The HZD established the Hessen Test Centre in the year 2022 and has operated it since then as a central organisational unit for standardised test services. With advancing digitalisation in the state administration, the requirements for quality assurance are also increasing. For without sufficiently tested - and thus quality-assured - solutions, stable IT operations cannot be guaranteed. Statutory requirements regarding the security and accessibility of the provided procedures further increase the requirements. Against this background, the HZD established the Hessen Test Centre (TCH) in the year 2022 and has operated it since then as a central organisational unit for standardised test services. The Hessen Test Centre acts as a central organisational unit for standardised test services and is guided in this by established industry standards and best practices, in particular ISO/IEC 29119 as well as ISTQB. The Hessen Test Centre (TCH) of the HZD offers internal and external customers tailor-made service around the topic of testing. Added to this are comprehensive services in the form of individually combinable modules. The modules are structured in a largely standardised way. They can be put together according to requirements. The subject of this tender is the support of the already established and operationally run Hessen Test Centre by external IT service providers. The objective of the test centre is in particular the increase of software quality as well as the reduction of risks in the software lifecycle. To support these objectives, the following services are required, among others: • Consulting around the topic of testing • Standardisation and automation of the test procedure • Provision of test services in different subject areas (test management, test automation, test data management, load and performance tests, functional (manual) tests including technical quality assurance as well as accessibility tests, see section 4 of the specification of services) • Provision of templates and methods According to the current planning status and taking into account additional requirements of further specialist departments and offices, a total requirement of approx. 37.730 person-days (PD) is assumed for the maximum contract duration of up to 48 months (non-binding estimated quantity).

result.text: Tampereen Vesi Oy (3381716-4) is a wholly owned subsidiary of the City of Tampere. The company was established in 2023 and, at the beginning of 2024, operations were transferred from the City of Tampere's municipal enterprise to a corporate form. Tampereen Vesi Oy provides water utility services in its operating area. The operating area mainly covers the zoned area of the City of Tampere. Tampereen Vesi Oy is inviting tenders for total payroll services, a time and attendance system and an HR system. The procurement is divided into parts as follows: PROCUREMENT PART A: Total payroll services (incl. payroll accounting, salary payment and expert services, as well as the payroll system used by payroll clerks) and a time and attendance system (incl. time and attendance tracking and shift planning). OPTION IN PROCUREMENT PART A: Travel management services (incl. travel ledger and travel and expense claim system). PROCUREMENT PART B: HR system (incl. personal data system and HRD system). A candidate may participate in both or only one of parts A or B. The procurement parts are independent, and a contractor will be selected separately for each part. In both procurement parts, the language of service is Finnish. All systems must have a Finnish-language user interface and instructions. The systems must enable a multi-company environment. In both procurement parts, the systems used will process personal data extensively, so data protection requirements must be taken into account. The systems must also have the possibility to restrict access rights on a role-based basis. Both procurement parts also include the commissioning of services and systems, related advisory and expert services, and system support services. The subject of the procurement is described in more detail in Annex 1 Preliminary service description. Information may be clarified during the procurement procedure. parts.source: Tampereen Vesi Oy (3381716-4) on Tampereen kaupungin kokonaan omistama tytäryhtiö. Yhtiö on perustettu vuonna 2023 ja vuoden 2024 alusta toiminta siirtyi Tampereen kaupungin liikelaitoksesta yhtiömuotoon. Tampereen Vesi Oy tuottaa toiminta-alueensa vesihuoltopalvelut. Toiminta-alue kattaa pääosin Tampereen kaupungin asemakaavoitetun alueen. Tampereen Vesi Oy kilpailuttaa kokonaispalkkapalvelut, työajanseurantajärjestelmän sekä HR-järjestelmän. Hankinta on jaettu osiin seuraavasti: HANKINNAN OSA A: Kokonaispalkkapalvelut (sis. palkanlaskenta-, palkanmaksu- ja asiantuntijapalvelut sekä palkanlaskijoiden käyttämän palkanlaskentajärjestelmän) sekä työajanseurantajärjestelmä (sis. työajanseurannan ja työvuorosuunnittelun) OPTIONA HANKINNAN OSASSA A: Matkustuksen hallintapalvelut (sis. matkareskontran sekä matka- ja kululaskujärjestelmän) HANKINNAN OSA B: HR-järjestelmä (sis. henkilötietojärjestelmän ja HRD-järjestelmän) Ehdokas voi osallistua molempiin tai ainoastaan jompaankumpaan osaan A tai B. Hankinnan osat ovat itsenäisiä ja sopimuskumppani valitaan kummassakin osassa erikseen. Kummassakin hankinnan osassa palvelun kieli on suomi. Kaikissa järjestelmissä on oltava suomenkielinen käyttöliittymä ja ohjeet. Järjestelmien tulee mahdollistaa moniyritysympäristö. Molemmissa hankinnan osissa käytettävissä järjestelmissä käsitellään laajasti henkilötietoja, joten tietosuojavaatimukset on huomioitava. Järjestelmissä on oltava mahdollisuus myös rajata käyttöoikeuksia roolipohjaisesti. Molempiin hankinnan osiin sisältyy lisäksi palveluiden ja järjestelmien käyttöönotto, niihin liittyvät neuvonta- ja asiantuntijapalvelut sekä järjestelmien käytöntukipalvelut. Hankinnan kohde on kuvattu tarkemmin liitteessä 1 Alustava palvelukuvaus. Tietoja on mahdollista tarkentaa hankintamenettelyn aikana. Kaikissa järjestelmissä on oltava suomenkielinen käyttöliittymä ja ohjeet. Järjestelmien tulee mahdollistaa moniyritysympäristö. Hankinnan kohde on kuvattu tarkemmin liitteessä 1 Alustava palvelukuvaus. Tietoja on mahdollista tarkentaa hankintamenettelyn aikana.

result.text: BIM Berliner Immobilienmanagement GmbH (BIM) intends to procure and introduce a new document management system (DMS) for company-wide use. The aim of the project is to provide a central, secure and audit-proof platform for managing, processing and archiving documents and files. The DMS is intended to support cross-departmental collaboration, reduce existing media discontinuity and ensure compliance with statutory, data protection and organisational requirements. Operation will initially take place on-premises in the BIM data centre. In the long term, the solution is intended to technically support hybrid and cloud-based operating models respectively. The scope of services comprises in particular: - Provision, implementation and introduction of the DMS software including installation, configuration and training, - Integration into existing systems, in particular SAP S/4HANA, email and office environments, - Migration of existing documents and metadata, - Design and implementation of defined workflows, archiving and authorisation structures, - Ensuring information security, digital accessibility and GDPR compliance, - Operation, maintenance and software support (support S) including service level management. The project is part of BIM's digitalisation strategy and is closely linked to the parallel projects "BIM SAP 2028" and "BitX", in which core business processes and specialist procedures are modernised and integrated. The contract term is 48 months with the option for a one-time extension of up to 24 months. The basis for the provision of services is the EVB-IT system contract in its currently valid version.

parts.source: Die BIM Berliner Immobilienmanagement GmbH (BIM) beabsichtigt die Beschaffung und Einführung eines neuen Dokumentenmanagementsystems (DMS) für den unternehmensweiten Einsatz. Ziel des Projekts ist die Bereitstellung einer zentralen, sicheren und revisionssicheren Plattform zur Verwaltung, Bearbeitung und Archivierung von Dokumenten und Akten. Das DMS soll die fachbereichsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit unterstützen, bestehende Medienbrüche reduzieren und die Einhaltung gesetzlicher, datenschutzrechtlicher und organisatorischer Vorgaben sicherstellen. Der Betrieb erfolgt zunächst On-Premises im Rechenzentrum der BIM. Perspektivisch soll die Lösung hybride bzw. cloudbasierte Betriebsmodelle technisch unterstützen. Der Leistungsumfang umfasst insbesondere: - Bereitstellung, Implementierung und Einführung der DMS-Software einschließlich Installation, Konfiguration und Schulungen, - Integration in bestehende Systeme, insbesondere SAP S/4HANA, E-Mail- und Office-Umgebungen, - Migration bestehender Dokumente und Metadaten, - Konzeption und Umsetzung definierter Workflows, Archivierungs- und Berechtigungsstrukturen, - Sicherstellung der Informationssicherheit, digitalen Barrierefreiheit und DSGVO-Konformität, - Betrieb, Wartung und Softwarepflege (Pflege S) einschließlich Service-Level-Management. Das Vorhaben ist Bestandteil der Digitalisierungsstrategie der BIM und steht in engem Zusammenhang mit den parallel laufenden Projekten „BIM SAP 2028“ und „BitX“, in denen zentrale Geschäftsprozesse und Fachverfahren modernisiert und integriert werden. Die Vertragslaufzeit beträgt 48 Monate mit der Option auf eine einmalige Verlängerung um bis zu 24 Monate. Grundlage der Leistungserbringung ist der EVB-IT Systemvertrag in der jeweils gültigen Fassung.

result.text: Background: Although many of the world"s fastest-growing economies are in Africa, trade among African countries remains limited. The continent mostly exports raw materials and agricultural products, while it imports machinery, equipment, and food mainly from outside Africa. The African Continental Free Trade Area (AfCFTA), which is one of the African Union"s (AU) flagship projects for the implementation of its Agenda 2063, aims to change this. It is expected that, with the introduction of the free trade zone, intra- African trade will be 15% to 25% higher by 2040 (UNECA). The AfCFTA agreement has been signed by 54 of the 55 African Union Member States (MS) and became effective under international law in May 2019. The full implementation of the AfCFTA will lead to a continental single market of more than 1.4 billion people with an aggregate GDP exceeding USD 2 trillion. Our Approach: The GIZ implemented project "Support to the African Continental Free Trade Area (AfCFTA) II" cofinanced by the BMZ and the EU, seeks to improve framework conditions for the realisation of the AfCFTA and supports the outstanding negotiations and the implementation of the AfCFTA. For this, the programme supports the African Union, specifically the Department for Economic Development, Trade, Tourism, Industry, Minerals (ETTIM) and the AfCFTA Secretariat at the continental level in the coordination of AfCFTA implementation. On the regional level the programme cooperates with Regional Economic Communities (RECs), specifically EAC (East African Community), ECOWAS (Economic Community for West African States) and SADC (South African Development Community, plus additional RECs based on request). The programme also supports Member States (Ethiopia, Ghana, Ivory Coast, Kenya, Malawi, Rwanda, Tunisia, Zambia, plus additional Member States based on request) by working with national institutions, like trade ministries and customs, to implement the agreement. Lastly, the programme works closely with private sector and civil society actors to increase trade under the AfCFTA. Together with the named partners, the programme covers interventions across all technical areas of the AfCFTA. The EU co-financed part of the programme, the EU Technical Assistance Facility, operates as a multi-partner contribution agreement between the European Commission, GIZ (lead implementing agency), Expertise France, and FIAP. A Project Management Unit, which is housed in the AfCFTA Secretariat, oversees the implementation of the programme and the execution of activities. Lot LOT-0001: 10022598-Short-Term Expert Pools to support negotiations and implementation of the African Continental Free Trade Area (AfCFTA). The project seeks the services of a consulting firm to provide technical experts under different short-term expert (STE) pools, which can be deployed flexibly according to the specific demands of the project. The Contractor will contribute to the implementation of all BMZ and EU outputs of the project. The overall goal of this assignment is to support the implementation of the AfCFTA at the continental, regional, and national level by providing advisory services and capacity building for governmental as well as private sector and civil society stakeholders. When the need for support to the project"s partners within a particular thematic area is identified, experts shall be mobilised to provide demand-driven technical advisory services and/or capacity building to national, regional, and continental government partners and/or the project itself. The contract is for the provision of pools of qualified STE to cover a broad range of issues relating to AfCFTA negotiations and implementation in general and the programme objectives in particular. The services to be provided under the contract include measures for human capacity development and organisational and technical advice in the following thematic areas: - Removing barriers to Trade in Goods, Trade in Services and Digital Trade - Support for further AfCFTA negotiations (among others on Rules of Origin, Trade in Services) - Support for the ratification of the Phase II Protocols (Competition Policy, Intellectual Property Rights, Investment, Digital Trade, Women & Youth in Trade) - Implementation of AfCFTA regulations at the national and regional levels - Monitor and review the implementation of AfCFTA Protocols in African Union Member States (AU MS) - Improve access to trade information to relevant line ministries and to the private sector - Support the African private sector to trade under AfCFTA rules on the national and regional level - Support relevant authorities to setup inclusive policies for women & youth traders to participate in trade under AfCFTA The contractor will identify and manage pools of STE that will assist the initiatives in the programme"s areas of intervention. While the project operates Africa-wide, it focuses interventions at national level in 8 countries: Ethiopia, Ghana, Ivory Coast, Kenya, Malawi, Rwanda, Tunisia, and Zambia. At REC level it focuses at EAC, ECOWAS, and SADC. Interventions to additional AU MS and RECs will be implemented based on partner demand. parts.source: Background: Although many of the world"s fastest-growing economies are in Africa, trade among African countries remains limited. The continent mostly exports raw materials and agricultural products, while it imports machinery, equipment, and food mainly from outside Africa. The African Continental Free Trade Area (AfCFTA), which is one of the African Union"s (AU) flagship projects for the implementation of its Agenda 2063, aims to change this. It is expected that, with the introduction of the free trade zone, intra- African trade will be 15% to 25% higher by 2040 (UNECA). The AfCFTA agreement has been signed by 54 of the 55 African Union Member States (MS) and became effective under international law in May 2019. The full implementation of the AfCFTA will lead to a continental single market of more than 1.4 billion people with an aggregate GDP exceeding USD 2 trillion. Our Approach: The GIZ implemented project "Support to the African Continental Free Trade Area (AfCFTA) II" cofinanced by the BMZ and the EU, seeks to improve framework conditions for the realisation of the AfCFTA and supports the outstanding negotiations and the implementation of the AfCFTA. For this, the programme supports the African Union, specifically the Department for Economic Development, Trade, Tourism, Industry, Minerals (ETTIM) and the AfCFTA Secretariat at the continental level in the coordination of AfCFTA implementation. On the regional level the programme cooperates with Regional Economic Communities (RECs), specifically EAC (East African Community), ECOWAS (Economic Community for West African States) and SADC (South African Development Community, plus additional RECs based on request). The programme also supports Member States (Ethiopia, Ghana, Ivory Coast, Kenya, Malawi, Rwanda, Tunisia, Zambia, plus additional Member States based on request) by working with national institutions, like trade ministries and customs, to implement the agreement. Lastly, the programme works closely with private sector and civil society actors to increase trade under the AfCFTA. Together with the named partners, the programme covers interventions across all technical areas of the AfCFTA. The EU co-financed part of the programme, the EU Technical Assistance Facility, operates as a multi-partner contribution agreement between the European Commission, GIZ (lead implementing agency), Expertise France, and FIAP. A Project Management Unit, which is housed in the AfCFTA Secretariat, oversees the implementation of the programme and the execution of activities. Lot LOT-0001: 10022598-Short-Term Expert Pools to support negotiations and implementation of the African Continental Free Trade Area (AfCFTA). The project seeks the services of a consulting firm to provide technical experts under different short-term expert (STE) pools, which can be deployed flexibly according to the specific demands of the project. The Contractor will contribute to the implementation of all BMZ and EU outputs of the project. The overall goal of this assignment is to support the implementation of the AfCFTA at the continental, regional, and national level by providing advisory services and capacity building for governmental as well as private sector and civil society stakeholders. When the need for support to the project"s partners within a particular thematic area is identified, experts shall be mobilised to provide demand-driven technical advisory services and/or capacity building to national, regional, and continental government partners and/or the project itself. The contract is for the provision of pools of qualified STE to cover a broad range of issues relating to AfCFTA negotiations and implementation in general and the programme objectives in particular. The services to be provided under the contract include measures for human capacity development and organisational and technical advice in the following thematic areas: - Removing barriers to Trade in Goods, Trade in Services and Digital Trade - Support for further AfCFTA negotiations (among others on Rules of Origin, Trade in Services) - Support for the ratification of the Phase II Protocols (Competition Policy, Intellectual Property Rights, Investment, Digital Trade, Women & Youth in Trade) - Implementation of AfCFTA regulations at the national and regional levels - Monitor and review the implementation of AfCFTA Protocols in African Union Member States (AU MS) - Improve access to trade information to relevant line ministries and to the private sector - Support the African private sector to trade under AfCFTA rules on the national and regional level - Support relevant authorities to setup inclusive policies for women & youth traders to participate in trade under AfCFTA The contractor will identify and manage pools of STE that will assist the initiatives in the programme"s areas of intervention. While the project operates Africa-wide, it focuses interventions at national level in 8 countries: Ethiopia, Ghana, Ivory Coast, Kenya, Malawi, Rwanda, Tunisia, and Zambia. At REC level it focuses at EAC, ECOWAS, and SADC. Interventions to additional AU MS and RECs will be implemented based on partner demand. Across the work packages named below, the contractor is responsible for the following tasks: - Supporting the GIZ in defining the required expertise to reach the project objectives under the described outputs - Identifying and proposing suitable experts from the STE pool - Selecting experts together with the GIZ team - Managing the deployment of experts Expected services that may be included in the work packages are: - Technical, operational, and strategic policy advisory services in the thematic areas listed above - Support in developing, drafting and reviewing reports, studies, analyses, position papers, guidelines, action plans, strategies, implementation plans, legislation, regulations in the thematic areas listed above.

result.text: Provision, implementation and operation of a cloud-based, SaaS-based data-centric security platform (DSP) for the analysis, monitoring and protection of data and access permissions in a hybrid IT environment (on-premises and cloud) of the Stadtwerke Düsseldorf AG including affiliated companies. The aim of the procurement is to create transparency regarding data stocks, access authorizations and security-relevant activities, as well as to support measures to increase information security and comply with regulatory requirements in the KRITIS environment. In addition to the provision of the platform, the service also includes supportive services for the analysis, evaluation and prioritisation of security-relevant events as well as for the derivation of suitable measures. The processing of all data shall take place exclusively within the scope of the EU GDPR. An uninterrupted transition from existing near-production operations must be ensured. The aim is to conclude a contract for the provision, implementation and operation of a scalable, cloud-based data-centric security platform (DSP) for the analysis, monitoring and protection of data and access permissions in a hybrid IT environment (on-premises and cloud). The solution must cover the following functions and services in particular: - Analysis and evaluation of data stocks, data access and permission structures, including the identification of potential security and data protection risks, - The solution should have integrated functions for detecting anomalies in user and system behaviour (User and Entity Behavior Analytics) - Creation of transparency regarding effective accesses and permissions, - Detection and evaluation of conspicuous, risk-prone or security-relevant activities, - Provision of monitoring, reporting and verification functions to support audit, compliance and security requirements, particularly in the regulated KRITIS environment, - Support in deriving and implementing suitable measures for risk reduction (e.g. adjustment of permissions or restriction of access rights), - Integration into the client's existing hybrid system landscape (in particular identity services, file and cloud storage as well as collaboration platforms) via standardised interfaces, - Provision and operation of the solution including maintenance, ongoing development, updates and technical documentation in a SaaS model. In addition, services are to be provided that support continuous evaluation, assessment and prioritisation (managed detection and response) of security-relevant events and provide recommendations for action. If configured accordingly, these services may also include operational support services. Continued operation requirements: - Ensuring an uninterrupted transition from existing near-production operations, including a suitable migration and transition concept, - Taking over existing configurations, evaluations and settings as far as technically possible, - Guaranteeing compatibility with existing system landscapes, role and permission models, - Minimising migration, integration and training efforts while taking cost-effectiveness over the entire life cycle into account, - Ensuring continuous operational capability during the transition phase. All services relating to the client's data or metadata must be provided exclusively within the scope of the EU GDPR.

parts.source: Bereitstellung, Implementierung und Betrieb einer cloudbasierten, SaaS-basierten Datenzentrierten Sicherheitsplattform (DSP) zur Analyse, Überwachung und zum Schutz von Daten und Zugriffsberechtigungen in einer hybriden IT-Umgebung (On-Premises und Cloud) der Stadtwerke Düsseldorf AG einschließlich verbundener Unternehmen. Ziel der Beschaffung ist die Herstellung von Transparenz über Datenbestände, Zugriffsbefugnisse und sicherheitsrelevante Aktivitäten sowie die Unterstützung von Maßnahmen zur Erhöhung der Informationssicherheit und zur Einhaltung regulatorischer Anforderungen im KRITIS-Umfeld. Die Leistung umfasst neben der Bereitstellung der Plattform auch unterstützende Leistungen zur Analyse, Bewertung und Priorisierung sicherheitsrelevanter Ereignisse sowie zur Ableitung geeigneter Maßnahmen. Die Verarbeitung sämtlicher Daten erfolgt ausschließlich im Geltungsbereich der EU-DSGVO. Ein unterbrechungsfreier Übergang aus einem bestehenden produktionsnahen Betrieb ist sicherzustellen. Ziel ist der Abschluss eines Vertrages über die Bereitstellung, Implementierung und den Betrieb einer skalierbaren, cloudbasierten Datenzentrierten Sicherheitsplattform (DSP) zur Analyse, Überwachung und zum Schutz von Daten sowie Zugriffsberechtigungen in einer hybriden IT-Umgebung (On-Premises und Cloud). Die Lösung hat insbesondere folgende Funktionen und Leistungen abzudecken: - Analyse und Bewertung von Datenbeständen, Datenzugriffen und Berechtigungsstrukturen einschließlich der Identifikation potenzieller Sicherheits- und Datenschutzrisiken, - Die Lösung soll über integrierte Funktionen zur Erkennung von Anomalien im Nutzer- und Systemverhalten (User and Entity Behavior Analytics) verfügen - Herstellung von Transparenz über effektive Zugriffe und Berechtigungen, - Erkennung und Bewertung auffälliger, risikobehafteter oder sicherheitsrelevanter Aktivitäten, - Bereitstellung von Monitoring-, Reporting- und Nachweisfunktionen zur Unterstützung von Audit-, Compliance- und Sicherheitsanforderungen, insbesondere im regulierten KRITIS-Umfeld, - Unterstützung bei der Ableitung und Umsetzung geeigneter Maßnahmen zur Risikoreduzierung (z. B. Anpassung von Berechtigungen oder Einschränkung von Zugriffsrechten), - Integration in die bestehende hybride Systemlandschaft des Auftraggebers (insbesondere Identitätsdienste, Datei- und Cloudspeicher sowie Kollaborationsplattformen) über standardisierte Schnittstellen, - Bereitstellung und Betrieb der Lösung einschließlich Wartung, Weiterentwicklung, Updates und technischer Dokumentation im SaaS-Modell. Ergänzend sind Leistungen vorzusehen, die eine kontinuierliche Auswertung, Bewertung und Priorisierung (Managed Detection and Response) sicherheitsrelevanter Ereignisse unterstützen sowie Handlungsempfehlungen bereitstellen. Bei entsprechender Ausgestaltung können diese Leistungen auch operative Unterstützungsleistungen umfassen. Weiterbetriebsanforderungen: - Sicherstellung eines unterbrechungsfreien Übergangs aus einem bestehenden produktionsnahen Betrieb, einschließlich eines geeigneten Migrations- und Übergangskonzepts, - Übernahme vorhandener Konfigurationen, Auswertungen und Einstellungen soweit technisch möglich, - Gewährleistung der Kompatibilität mit bestehenden Systemlandschaften, Rollen- und Berechtigungsmodellen, - Minimierung von Migrations-, Integrations- und Schulungsaufwänden unter Berücksichtigung der Wirtschaftlichkeit über den gesamten Lebenszyklus, - Sicherstellung der kontinuierlichen Betriebsfähigkeit während der Übergangsphase. Sämtliche Leistungen mit Bezug zu Daten oder Metadaten des Auftraggebers sind ausschließlich im Geltungsbereich der EU-DSGVO zu erbringen.

result.text: ***PRE-MARKET ENGAGEMENT EXERCISE*** PLEASE NOTE: The Pre-Market Engagement Questionnaire can be accessed in the Cft Documents area. Fermanagh and Omagh District Council (FODC) is currently considering whether to initiate a procurement process to establish a contract with a Supplier to digitise and dispose of records. This would establish a contract with a supplier to collect, prepare, digitise and index hard copy planning records and safely dispose of the physical copies. This Pre Market Engagement exercise will also inform the Council of the availability of Frameworks when determining the final Procurement process. The Council is also wishing to explore a potential option for online access to the final digitised records for the public, which will generate revenue and overall enhance operational efficiencies, including cost reductions and ensuring the long-term integrity of historical records. The broad scope of the project is outlined in more detail in the Attached Questionnaire. Before commencing the procurement process, FODC is undertaking pre-market research and seeks to assess; • the level of market interest in participating, • the potential options available in the market, and • in particular the potential to make use of emerging technologies, including AI. No part of this process should be read as generating an expectation in relation to any future procurement process for this project. This market engagement exercise does not guarantee the commencement of a commercial competition resulting in monetary income or future outlay. **PLEASE NOTE: ALL COMPLETED QUESTIONNAIRES MUST BE SUBMITTED VIA THE eTendersNI PortaI.*** Respondees are not required to wait until the closing date to submit a response. PME QUESTIONNAIRE RESPONSES MAY BE SUBMITTED VIA THE ETENDERSNI CFT MESSAGING FACILITY AT ANY TIME UP TO Mid-Day 12:00 on 7th October 2025 Lot 1: .

result.text: In the past almost 20 years since the founding of the Federal Government's Cultural and Creative Industries (KKW) initiative, the framework conditions, market structures, value chains and challenges for the KKW have changed fundamentally. Hardly any sector has been as strongly affected by the effects of the change brought about by transformation, the platform economy, digitalisation and artificial intelligence as the KKW, with impacts including on creative production, distribution and the exploitation of rights. The coming years will be characterised by further profound technological, economic and social upheavals. Digitalisation (especially artificial intelligence), sustainability and new forms of audience engagement have become the central drivers of change. After almost 20 years, it is therefore time to take stock on the one hand, and to look ahead and create foundations for strategic options for action on the other. In order to be able to conduct the further strategy process on an evidence-based footing, a qualitative and quantitative baseline study on future projections for the KKW is to be commissioned. The last baseline study, 'Macroeconomic Perspectives of the Cultural and Creative Industries', also produced on behalf of the BMWE, dates from the year 2009. The study is intended to develop a projection for the coming decade in order to provide strategic responses to structural changes in the sector. The aim is to critically examine the future viability of the KKW, to identify risks and to develop a forecast of opportunities and trends. The study 'Cultural and Creative Industries 2037' (working title) is intended to provide a foundation for the long-term strategic orientation of political and economic steering instruments with the help of future-oriented and forecasted scenario analyses. For a future projection up to 2037, it is therefore crucial not only to extrapolate existing growth trajectories, but to systematically include structural breaks, new value creation logics and disruptive technological developments in the forecast. The Federal Government's projections on macroeconomic growth are to be appropriately taken into account as a basis here. The study is intended to create a scientific foundation for the strategic further development of the Federal Government's Cultural and Creative Industries initiative and, in doing so, to provide in particular a long-term strategic orientation for political and economic steering instruments. The strategy is aimed prospectively at decision-makers from politics, business and administration, as well as at the actors in the cultural and creative industries themselves, who want to jointly set the course for a sustainable, innovative and economically strong creative ecosystem for the next generation. parts.source: In den vergangenen fast 20 Jahren seit Gründung der Initiative Kultur- und Kreativwirtschaft (KKW) der Bundesregierung haben sich die Rahmenbedingungen, Marktstrukturen, Wertschöpfungsketten und Herausforderungen für die KKW grundlegend verändert. Kaum eine Branche ist von den Auswirkungen durch den Wandel von Transformation, Plattformökonomie, Digitalisierung und Künstliche Intelligenz so stark betroffen wie die KKW mit Auswirkungen u.a. auf kreative Produktion, Distribution und Rechteverwertung. Die kommenden Jahre werden durch weitere tiefgreifende technologische, wirtschaftliche und gesellschaftliche Umbrüche geprägt sein. Digitalisierung (insb. Künstliche Intelligenz), Nachhaltigkeit und neue Formen der Publikumseinbindung sind zu den zentralen Treibern der Veränderung geworden. Nach fast 20 Jahren ist es daher an der Zeit einerseits Bilanz zu ziehen, und andererseits den Blick nach vorne zu richten und Grundlagen für strategische Handlungsoptionen zu schaffen. Um den weiteren Strategieprozess evidenzbasiert führen zu können soll eine qualitative und quantitative Grundlagenstudie zur Zukunftsprojektion für die KKW in Auftrag gegeben werden. Die letzte Grundlagenstudie „Gesamtwirtschaftliche Perspektiven der Kultur und Kreativwirtschaft“, ebenfalls erstellt im Auftrag des BMWE, stammt aus dem Jahr 2009. Die Studie soll eine Projektion für die kommende Dekade entwickeln, um strategische Antworten auf strukturelle Veränderungen der Branche zu geben. Es geht darum, die Zukunftsfähigkeit der KKW kritisch zu beleuchten, Risiken zu identifizieren sowie eine Prognose zu Chancen und Trends zu entwickeln. Die Studie „Kultur und Kreativwirtschaft 2037“ (Arbeitstitel) soll mit Hilfe zukunftsorientierter und prognostizierter Szenario-Analysen ein Fundament für eine langfristige strategische Ausrichtung politischer und ökonomischer Steuerungsinstrumente liefern. Für eine Zukunftsprojektion bis 2037 ist daher entscheidend, nicht allein bestehende Wachstumsverläufe fortzuschreiben, sondern strukturelle Brüche, neue Wertschöpfungslogiken und disruptive technologische Entwicklungen systematisch in die Prognose einzubeziehen. Als Grundlagen sind hier die Projektionen der Bundesregierung zum gesamtwirtschaftlichen Wachstum angemessen zu berücksichtigen. Die Studie soll ein wissenschaftliches Fundament für die strategische Weiterentwicklung der Initiative Kultur- und Kreativwirtschaft der Bundesregierung schaffen und dabei insbesondere eine langfristige strategische Ausrichtung politischer und ökonomischer Steuerungsinstrumente liefern. Die Strategie richtet sich perspektivisch an Entscheidungsträgerinnen und -träger aus Politik, Wirtschaft, Verwaltung sowie an die Akteure der Kultur und Kreativwirtschaft selbst, die gemeinsam die Weichen für ein nachhaltiges, innovatives und wirtschaftlich starkes Kreativökosystem der nächsten Generation stellen wollen. rejected.text: Forsvarsministeriets Materiel- og Indkøbsstyrelse (FMI) wishes to enter into a contract regarding the delivery, operation, maintenance, support and further development of an internet-based booking system for the Danish Defence's pool vehicles. The existing system is to be replaced by a more modern, reliable and user-friendly solution that supports efficient booking, lending and returning of pool vehicles, and provides FMI with access to relevant operational and administrative data. The purpose of the contract is to ensure the Danish Defence has a comprehensive solution that, with a minimum of resource consumption from FMI, enables secure, flexible and efficient management of pool vehicles across the organisation. The solution must support both open and closed vehicle pools, be able to handle a large number of users and vehicles, and contribute to high availability and continuity in the Danish Defence's transport solutions. The contract includes the supplier's delivery, operation, maintenance, support and further development of the overall system, including both the application and the necessary infrastructure, for use by the Danish Defence's pool vehicles, as well as the delivery, installation and operation of electronic car-sharing equipment in the vehicles. The contract includes a start-up period consisting of a development period and an implementation period, during which the system is adapted, developed and commissioned in accordance with FMI's requirements. The supplier is responsible for the delivery of the application and for the necessary infrastructure, including hosting the system on servers located in Denmark. The system is delivered as an internet-based solution (SaaS), and the supplier is responsible for all operation of the underlying infrastructure. The supplier is responsible for the integration of existing data regarding users, pools, pool vehicles and bookings, as well as for any reuse of already installed electronic car-sharing equipment. The system must support self-service access for users, comprehensive administration and reporting functions for FMI, as well as technical support and a 24-hour helpdesk. The contract runs for 72 months from signature. The contract may be extended on the same terms up to 2 times for 24 months. It is a requirement that the development period must have a maximum duration of 6 months and that the implementation period must have a maximum duration of 6 months. The current system handles approx. 25.000 users and 2.800 pool vehicles. During the contract period, the solution is initially expected to be able to handle up to approx. 5.000 pool vehicles. Given the uncertain international security policy situation, however, the Danish Defence has a need for an option to scale the solution so that the application and the associated infrastructure can, at the Customer's request, be expanded to handle up to 10.000 pool vehicles without any degradation in functionality, response times, availability or the other requirements and service levels set out in the contract. Furthermore, the contract includes an option regarding the choice of access technology for the pool vehicles, whereby the Customer, instead of using the Danish Defence's existing access carriers (RFID etc.), may choose an access and locking system provided by the Supplier on the terms set out in the requirements specification and the contract.

parts.source: Forsvarsministeriets Materiel- og Indkøbsstyrelse (”FMI) ønsker at indgå en kontrakt vedrørende levering, drift, vedligeholdelse, support og videreudvikling af et internetbaseret bookingsystem til Forsvarets Puljekøretøjer. Det eksisterende system ønskes erstattet af en mere moderne, driftssikker og brugervenlig løsning, der understøtter effektiv booking, udlån og returnering af puljekøretøjer samt giver FMI adgang til relevante drifts- og administrationsdata. Formålet med kontrakten er at sikre Forsvaret en samlet løsning, der med et minimum af ressourceforbrug fra FMI muliggør en sikker, fleksibel og effektiv forvaltning af puljekøretøjer på tværs af organisationen. Løsningen skal understøtte både åbne og lukkede køretøjspuljer, kunne håndtere et stort antal brugere og køretøjer samt bidrage til høj tilgængelighed og kontinuitet i Forsvarets transportløsninger. Kontrakten omfatter leverandørens levering, drift, vedligeholdelse, support og videreudvikling af det samlede system, herunder såvel applikationen som den dertil nødvendige infrastruktur, til brug for Forsvarets puljekøretøjer samt levering, installation og drift af elektronisk delebiludstyr i køretøjerne. Kontrakten inkluderer en opstartsperiode bestående af en udviklingsperiode og en implementeringsperiode, hvor systemet tilpasses, udvikles og idriftsættes i overensstemmelse med FMI’s krav. Leverandøren er ansvarlig for levering af applikationen samt for den dertil nødvendige infrastruktur, herunder hosting af systemet på servere beliggende i Danmark. Systemet leveres som en internetbaseret løsning (SaaS), og leverandøren er ansvarlig for al drift af den bagvedliggende infrastruktur. Leverandøren er ansvarlig for integration af eksisterende data om brugere, puljer, puljekøretøjer og bookinger samt for eventuel genanvendelse af allerede installeret elektronisk delebiludstyr. Systemet skal understøtte selvbetjent adgang for brugere, omfattende administrations- og rapporteringsfunktioner for FMI samt teknisk support og døgnbemandet helpdesk. Kontrakten løber i 72 måneder fra underskrift. Kontrakten kan forlænges på samme vilkår med op til 2 gange 24 måneder. Det er et krav, at udviklingsperioden maksimalt må have en varighed på 6 måneder samt, at implementeringsperioden maksimalt må have en varighed på 6 måneder. Det nuværende system håndterer ca. 25.000 Brugere og 2.800 Puljekøretøjer. I kontraktperioden forventes løsningen som udgangspunkt at skulle kunne håndtere op til ca. 5.000 Puljekøretøjer. Henset til den usikre internationale sikkerhedspolitiske situation har Forsvaret imidlertid behov for en option på at kunne skalere løsningen, således at Applikationen og den tilhørende infrastruktur efter Kundens anmodning kan udbygges til at håndtere op mod 10.000 Puljekøretøjer uden forringelse af funktionalitet, svartider, tilgængelighed eller de øvrige i kontrakten fastsatte krav og servicemål. Herudover omfatter kontrakten en option vedrørende valg af adgangsteknologi til Puljekøretøjerne, hvorefter Kunden i stedet for at anvende Forsvarets eksisterende adgangsbærere (RFID mv.) kan vælge et adgangs- og låsesystem leveret af Leverandøren på de i kravspecifikationen og kontrakten fastsatte vilkår.

result.text: Die DAK-Gesundheit is the third-largest statutory health insurance fund. Around 5,5 million customers are served by approx. 10.700 employees. As part of the strategic further development of digital processes, DAK-Gesundheit is planning a market consultation procedure to identify innovative solutions for a high-performance case management and invoice verification system. The aim is to make the processing of hospital cases more efficient, transparent and economical through the use of modern technologies. As part of this market consultation, DAK-Gesundheit would like to gain an overview of the existing market situation. Should you be able to offer a product that corresponds to the following description, we would be pleased if you were willing to present it to us as part of a short presentation. If you are interested, please feel free to contact us informally by 30.11.2025 at markterkundung@dak.de

parts.source: Die DAK-Gesundheit ist die drittgrößte gesetzliche Krankenkasse. Rund 5,5 Millionen Kunden werden durch ca. 10.700 Mitarbeitende betreut. Im Rahmen der strategischen Weiterentwicklung digitaler Prozesse plant die DAK-Gesundheit ein Markterkundungsverfahren zur Identifikation innovativer Lösungen für ein leistungsfähiges Fallmanagement- und Rechnungsprüfungssystem. Ziel ist es, durch den Einsatz moderner Technologien die Bearbeitung von Krankenhausfällen effizienter, transparenter und wirtschaftlicher zu gestalten. Im Rahmen dieser Markterkundung möchte sich die DAK-Gesundheit einen Überblick über die bestehende Marktsituation verschaffen. Sollten sie ein Produkt anbieten können, welches der nachfolgenden Beschreibung entspricht, würden wir uns über Ihre Bereitschaft freuen, uns dieses im Rahmen einer kurzen Präsentation vorzustellen. result.text: The primary objective of this contract is to conduct a comprehensive, large-scale study on the current state and effectiveness of cocoa farmer cooperatives and farmer groups in Ghana and Côte d’Ivoire (incorporating but not limited to cooperative societies in Ghana and COOP CA and COOP simplifié in Côte d’Ivoire). This study will represent the first nationally representative analysis of cocoa cooperatives and farmer groups across the two countries. It will uniquely combine data collection at two levels: (1) the organizational governance and operational management of cooperatives and farmer groups, and (2) the individual farmer members, including their engagement, benefits, and challenges. By integrating insights from behavioural economics, collective action theory, organizational studies, and development economics, the study will adopt an interdisciplinary approach to evaluate how structural, managerial, and behavioural factors influence cooperative performance and farmer outcomes. The reason for purchasing this service is to generate actionable insights that enable stakeholders, including farmers, cooperatives, policymakers, and certification bodies, to enhance the effectiveness and sustainability of cocoa production systems in Ghana and Côte d’Ivoire. Specifically, the study aims to assess the readiness of cocoa cooperatives for ARS1000 certification, evaluate cooperative governance and member engagement, and investigate household-level investment strategies, including investments in sustainable agricultural practices or household assets. The ultimate goal is to identify critical barriers and opportunities to strengthen cooperative capacity, improve resource allocation, and reduce the financial and operational burdens of compliance with sustainability standards, thereby contributing to a more sustainable cocoa production system in the region.

Ennakkoilmoituksella täydennetään osaamista tarjouspyynnön laadintaan. Tietopyyntö ei velvoita hankintayksikköä toteuttamaan hankintaa tietopyynnössä kuvatulla tavalla, ja hankintayksikkö voi jättää tarjouskilpailun kokonaan toteuttamatta. Hankintayksikkö ei ole velvollinen ottamaan huomioon ennakkoilmoituksen perusteella saatuja vastauksia tarjouspyynnön laadinnassa. Ennakkoilmoitukseen vastaaminen ei sido toimittajaa tarjouskilpailuun osallistumiseen, eikä ole myöskään edellytyksenä myöhemmin varsinaiseen tarjouskilpailuun osallistumiselle. Ennakkoilmoitukseen vastaamatta jättäminen ei estä mahdolliseen tarjouskilpailuun osallistumista, eikä ennakkoilmoitukseen vastaaminen vaikuta toimittajan asemaan varsinaisessa tarjouskilpailussa. Tällä ennakkoilmoituksella kerätyt tiedot säilyvät täysin luottamuksellisina ja niitä tullaan käyttämään ainoastaan hankinnan suunnitteluun. result.text: Procurement of an operating environment for the Geoportal-Hessen Lot LOT-0000: Procurement of an operating environment for the Geoportal-Hessen. The Hessian State Office for Land Management and Geoinformation is an administrative unit of the Federal State of Hesse and houses, among other things, the central competence centre for geoinformation. In accordance with Section 3 Para. 2 No. 2 of the Ordinance for the Execution of the Hessian Surveying and Geoinformation Act (HVGGAusfVO), this centre is responsible for the operation, administration and further development of the Geoportal Hessen (Section 36 Para. 2 HVGG). The Geoportal Hessen (www.geoportal.hessen.de) is the central access node to the spatial data infrastructure Hesse (GDI-Hessen). It serves as a central platform for spatial data, spatial data services and the associated metadata provided by the state administration and municipal local authorities. For continued operation, the central competence centre for geoinformation is seeking an IT service provider to provide and operate the necessary infrastructure for the technical operation of the Geoportal Hessen. The frontend of the geoportal must be accessible via the internet. Secure remote access via the NdB (Network of the Federal Administration) is required for the maintenance and care of the software components used. The aim is to conclude an EVB-IT contract. All services must be provided by the contractor in close consultation with the client. The provision of the operating environment including all communication requirements in accordance with the migration roadmap stage 1 for the Geoportal Hessen must take place by 31.12.2026. The contractor's data centre must be designed for the highly secure and highly available operation of specialist applications, and the contractor must have sound experience in operating complex IT specialist procedures. The software to be used is fixed, does not form part of the tendered service and is based exclusively on open source components. These include in particular: • Linux operating system (currently Debian), • Mapbender 2.8 (<3), • PostgreSQL with PostGIS, • MapServer, • Django framework, • MediaWiki. The software can be viewed at: • https://github.com/GDI-HE/Mapbender2.8 and • https://github.com/GDI-HE/GeoPortal.rlp The software is based on the aforementioned open source components. The GitHub links serve to specify the software versions to be used and do not represent a product specification, but rather specify the functional requirements for the operating environment. Further details can be found in the specification of services.

parts.source: Beschaffung einer Betriebsumgebung für das Geoportal-Hessen Lot LOT-0000: Beschaffung einer Betriebsumgebung für das Geoportal-Hessen. Das Hessische Landesamt für Bodenmanagement und Geoinformation ist eine Dienststelle des Landes Hessen und beherbergt unter anderem die zentrale Kompetenzstelle für Geoinformation. Diese ist gemäß § 3 Abs. 2 Nr. 2 der Verordnung zur Ausführung des Hessischen Vermessungs- und Geoinformationsgesetzes (HVGGAusfVO) für den Betrieb, die Administration und die Weiterentwicklung des Geoportals Hessen verantwortlich (§ 36 Abs. 2 HVGG). Das Geoportal Hessen (www.geoportal.hessen.de) ist der zentrale Zugangsknoten zur Geodateninfrastruktur Hessen (GDI-Hessen). Es dient als zentrale Plattform für Geodaten, Geodatendienste und die dazugehörigen Metadaten, die von der Landesverwaltung sowie von kommunalen Gebietskörperschaften bereitgestellt werden. Für den weiteren Betrieb sucht die zentrale Kompetenzstelle für Geoinformation einen IT-Dienstleister, der die notwendige Infrastruktur für den technischen Betrieb des Geoportals Hessen bereitstellt und betreibt. Das Frontend des Geoportals muss über das Internet zugänglich sein. Für die Wartung und Pflege der eingesetzten Softwarekomponenten ist ein gesicherter Fernzugriff über das NdB (Netz des Bundes) erforderlich. Ziel ist der Abschluss eines EVB-IT Vertrages. Alle Leistungen haben durch den Auftragnehmer in enger Abstimmung mit dem Auftraggeber zu erfolgen. Die Bereitstellung der Betriebsumgebung einschließlich aller Kommunikationsanforderungen entsprechend des Migrationsfahrplans Stufe 1 für das Geoportals Hessen hat bis 31.12.2026 zu erfolgen. Das Rechenzentrum des Auftragnehmers muss für den hochsicheren und hochverfügbaren Betrieb von Fachanwendungen ausgelegt sein und der Auftragnehmer muss über fundierte Erfahrungen im Betrieb komplexer IT-Fachverfahren verfügen. Die einzusetzende Software ist festgelegt, nicht Bestandteil der ausgeschriebenen Leistung und basiert ausschließlich auf Open Source Komponenten. Dazu gehören insbesondere: • Linux Betriebssystem (derzeit Debian), • Mapbender 2.8 (<3), • PostgreSQL mit PostGIS, • MapServer, • Django Framework, • MediaWiki. Die Software ist einsehbar unter: • https://github.com/GDI-HE/Mapbender2.8 und • https://github.com/GDI-HE/GeoPortal.rlp Die Software basiert auf den genannten Open Source Komponenten. Die GitHub-Links dienen der Konkretisierung der einzusetzenden Softwareversionen und stellen keine Produktvorgabe dar, sondern spezifizieren die funktionalen Anforderungen an die Betriebsumgebung. Weitere Details sind der Leistungsbeschreibung zu entnehmen.
