result.text: Mobile operational data collection in road maintenance operations at Hessen Mobil for the East Hesse and West Hesse departments As part of this tender, road maintenance operations at Hessen Mobil for the 8 road maintenance depots of the Operations and Traffic Department East Hesse and the 8 road maintenance depots of the Operations and Traffic Department West Hesse are to be optimised through the deployment of a mobile operational management system (EMS). The main objectives of the new operational management system (EMS) in winter maintenance are legally secure verification of the operations carried out in the context of the duty to maintain road safety, operational evaluations, performance billing with external contractors and other road construction authorities, as well as efficient operational control using real-time monitoring. Furthermore, drivers are to be relieved of workload during winter maintenance by means of route guidance functions. The basis for the new operational management system of the Operations and Traffic Departments East and West Hesse is automated operational data collection in the approx. 140 winter maintenance vehicles (vehicles from Hessen Mobil and external contractors) that carry out winter maintenance within the area of responsibility of the 16 road maintenance depots. The contracting authority intends to conclude an EVB-IT service contract (with a system delivery contract) with up to 3 extension options of 12 months each.

parts.source: Mobile Einsatzdatenerfassung im Straßenbetriebsdienst bei Hessen Mobil für die Dezernate Osthessen und Westhessen Im Rahmen dieser Ausschreibung soll bei Hessen Mobil der Straßenbetriebsdienst für die 8 Straßenmeistereien des Dezernates Betrieb und Verkehr Osthessen sowie den 8 Straßenmeistereien des Dezernates Betrieb und Verkehr Westhessen durch Einsatz eines mobilen Einsatz-Management-Systems (EMS) optimiert werden. Die wesentlichen Ziele des neuen Einsatz-Management-Systems (EMS) im Winterdienst sind die gerichtsfeste Nachweisführung über die durchgeführten Einsätze im Rahmen der Verkehrssicherungspflicht, Einsatzauswertungen, die Leistungsabrechnung mit Fremdunternehmern und anderen Straßenbaulastträgern sowie eine effiziente Einsatzsteuerung mit Hilfe eines Echtzeit-Monitorings. Ferner sollen die Fahrer anhand von Routenführungsfunktionen im Winterdienst entlastet werden. Grundlage des neuen Einsatz-Management-Systems des Dezernates Betrieb und Verkehr Ost- und Westhessen ist die automatisierte Einsatzdatenerfassung in den ca. 140 Winterdienstfahrzeugen (Fahrzeuge von Hessen Mobil und Fremdunternehmer), die im Zuständigkeitsbereich der 16 Straßenmeistereien den Winterdienst durchführen. Der Auftraggeber beabsichtigt einen EVB-IT Servicevertrag (mit Systemlieferungsvertrag) mit bis zu 3 Verlängerungsoptionen à 12 Monate abzuschließen.

result.text: GIZ has been operating a document management system (DMS) based on OpenText Content Server since 2005. Most recently, an upgrade to version 23.3 took place. The DMS manages approx. 40 million objects, and it is used by approx. 25.300 users worldwide. Essentially, the DMS is used for - document filing in structured project files - document filing in folders of the organisational structure - linking of documents in the intranet (IDA) - collaboration between teams and external parties (Communities of Practice) The subject of this tender is the conclusion of a service contract for the provision of ongoing operational support services based on monthly flat rates as well as a framework agreement for the provision of IT services by individual order with a single contracting party (AN). The AN must conceptualise and implement optimal and economical IT solutions in close coordination with the DMS team of the IT Operations department in the DIGITS division and the GIZ specialist departments (services by individual order). In addition, the AN supports the DMS team with troubleshooting and incident processing at the 3rd level (operational support based on monthly flat rates). The services to be provided on the basis of monthly flat rates include the following services: - Support for Content Server - Support for OpenText Archive Server - Security patches as required - Support for scan workstations A framework agreement will be concluded for the provision of the following services by individual order: - Consulting services - Customising and programming services - System administration services

parts.source: Die GIZ betreibt seit 2005 ein Dokumentenmanagementsystem (DMS) auf Basis von OpenText Content Server. Zuletzt fand ein Upgrade auf die Version 23.3 statt. Das DMS verwaltet ca. 40 Mio. Objekte, und es wird von ca. 25.300 Usern weltweit genutzt. Im Wesentlichen wird das DMS genutzt zur - Dokumentenablage in strukturierten Projektakten - Dokumentenablage in Ordner der Organisationsstruktur - Verlinkung von Dokumenten im Intranet (IDA) - Zusammenarbeit von Teams und Externen (Communities of Practice) Gegenstand der vorliegenden Ausschreibung ist der Abschluss eines Dienstvertrags zur Erbringung von laufenden Betriebsunterstützungsleistungen auf Basis von monatlichen Pauschalen sowie einer Rahmenvereinbarung zur Erbringung von IT-Dienstleistungen per Einzelauftrag mit einer einzigen auftragnehmenden Partei (AN). Die AN hat in enger Abstimmung mit dem DMS-Team der Abteilung IT-Betrieb im Bereich DIGITS und den Fachbereichen der GIZ optimale und wirtschaftliche IT-Lösungen zu konzeptionieren und umzusetzen (Leistungen per Einzelauftrag). Zudem unterstützt die AN das DMS-Team bei Fehlerbehebung und Incidentbearbeitung im 3rd Level (Betriebsunterstützung auf Basis von monatlichen Pauschalen). Die zu erbringenden Dienstleistungen auf Basis monatlicher Pauschalen umfassen folgende Leistungen: - Support für Content Server - Support für OpenText Archiv Server -Security Patches bei Bedarf -Support für Scan-Arbeitsplätze Es wird eine Rahmenvereinbarung abgeschlossen zur Erbringung folgender Leistungen per Einzelauftrag: - Beratungsleistungen - Customzing- und Programmierleistungen - Systemadministrationsleistungen

result.text: This is a request for information and part of a market survey. The objective is to gather information from suppliers for the planning of the procurement of a workshop operation and production management system. The aim of the request for information is to obtain information from the market on the comprehensiveness of solutions, pricing models and implementation methods. In addition, the aim is to understand suppliers' capability to implement integrations and automation, and to utilise artificial intelligence. The request for information will also ascertain suppliers' references, particularly in workshop operations of a corresponding scale. Furthermore, suppliers' responsibility will be evaluated, for example with regard to energy efficiency and compliance with the ISO 14001 standard. KLOY needs a system to support track infrastructure maintenance that facilitates production planning, management and reporting. Approximately 30 people work in the workshop operations, and there are 28 workstations. Four computers and a few mobile devices are in use. KLOY is responsible for procuring the users' terminal equipment. Responses to the request for information questions shall be provided using the Forms form. A link to the form can be found in the links for this request for information. The information received through the request for information will be treated confidentially.

parts.source: Tämä on tietopyyntö ja osa markkinakartoitusta. Tavoitteena on kerätä toimittajilta tietoa konepajan toiminnan- ja tuotannonohjausjärjestelmän hankinnan suunnitteluun. result.text: A service partner is being sought to support the functional assurance of routine operations and the high availability of the SKSS terminal system with all its components. Services are expected for the further development of the software and for ensuring the high availability of the hardware used and the project-internal WLAN network. To maintain continuous and consistently high-quality service, as well as to minimise the effort required for induction and management, the staff deployed should remain the same for the duration of the contract. The objective is to conclude a framework agreement for IT services with a single business enterprise. IT services for the overall functional system, consisting of software, hardware and communication infrastructure, are being tendered as a framework agreement. All externally commissioned services for expansion and optimisation will take place in parallel with routine operations and must ensure the current project status. For data protection reasons, details of the content will only be disclosed after the contract has been awarded. Project management and coordination of all services under the framework agreement are the responsibility of the contracting authority. ROSTOCK PORT remains the owner and operator of the overall system, including the current and future source code.

parts.source: Zur Unterstützung bei der Funktionssicherung im Routinebetrieb und der Hochverfügbarkeit des Terminalsystems SKSS mit allen Komponenten wird ein Servicepartner gesucht. Erwartet werden Leistungen zur Weiterentwicklung der Software, Sicherstellung der Hochverfügbarkeit der eingesetzten Hardware und des projektinternen WLAN Netzes. Zur Aufrechterhaltung eines kontinuierlichen und qualitativ gleichbleibend guten Service, sowie zur Minimierung des Einweisungs- und Steuerungsaufwandes, sollen die eingesetzten Mitarbeiter für die Dauer der Beauftragung möglichst personenidentisch sein. Ziel ist der Abschluss einer Rahmenvereinbarung über IT-Serviceleistungen mit einem einzigen Wirtschaftsunternehmen. Ausgeschrieben werden IT Serviceleistungen für das funktionale Gesamtsystem bestehend aus Software, Hardware und Kommunikationsinfrastruktur als Rahmenvereinbarung. Alle extern beauftragten Leistungen zur Erweiterung und Optimierung erfolgen parallel zum Routinebetrieb und müssen den bisherigen Projektstand sicherstellen. Inhaltliche Details werden aus Datenschutzgründen erst nach Zuschlagserteilung bekannt gegeben. Projektmanagement und Koordination aller Leistungen der Rahmenvereinbarung obliegen dem Auftraggeber. ROSTOCK PORT bleibt Eigentümer und Betreiber des Gesamtsystems einschließlich des aktuellen und künftigen Quellcodes.

result.text: The National Library of Scotland (‘the Library’) is looking for a suitably qualified, experienced and knowledgeable Supplier to supply, deliver, install, support and maintain a film scanner able to create digital copies of original films in 16mm, standard 8mm, super 8mm and 9.5mm film gauges. result.text: Helse Nord-Trøndelag HF, St. Olavs Hospital HF and Helse Møre og Romsdal HF have, by their clinics for mental health care, drug treatment, rehabilitation and habilitation need to use digital, standardised and normed review and mapping tools. The tools shall be used in mapping, reviewing, diagnosing patients in all age groups. They shall be based on recognised, standardised and normed methods. For example, cognitive ability tests, mapping executive functions, symptom mapping, function mapping, mapping of quality of life and mapping of patient satisfaction. We would like the different tools to be included in a digital platform where we as a customer can choose between different tools. As a minimum the delivery must include cognitive ability tests. The ability tests ought to include an option to also map verbal and non-verbal abilities. We are also interested in deliveries that cover parts of the needs, if one delivery does not cover all of the needs described here. Requirements for a digital system. We need a digital system that covers the needs outlined above, which ensure uniform administration, automatic scoring and reporting, which provides safe processing of sensitive data. The solution must also provide an option to use the existing paper based test set where the scoring still occurs digitally.

result.text: This notice is to advise bidders this opportunity is live on e-Tender Wales until 10:00 on 12/10/2026. The Senedd requires software solutions to support media monitoring, press office management, social media management and social media listening activities. These services play an important role in helping the Senedd understand the reach, impact and effectiveness of its communications activity, monitor public and media discussion, and support engagement with people across Wales. The procurement has been structured into four separate lots to enable suppliers to bid for individual, multiple, or all lots with one or multiple systems. Lot 1: Media Monitoring. The software is required to monitor keywords on local, national and UK-wide media. This will include print, digital and broadcast media. The system must be able to monitor Welsh language media, and be able to collate coverage. Lot 2: Press Office Management. The Senedd's News Team requires a press office management system to support media relations, enquiry handling, contact management and media distribution activities. The system should help improve efficiency, strengthen relationships with journalists and ensure organisational knowledge is retained and shared across the team. Lot 3: Social Media Management. The software should enable the Senedd to efficiently plan, publish, manage, monitor and evaluate content across its official social media channels. It should support day-to-day communications activity, audience engagement, campaign delivery and performance reporting. Lot 4: Social Media Listening. The software should provide comprehensive monitoring, analysis and reporting of online conversations relevant to the Senedd, supporting proactive reputation management, audience insight, campaign evaluation and early identification of emerging issues. The Commission may purchase more user licences, credits or other consumables based on unforeseen demand and needs.

result.text: MARKET DIALOGUE The subject matter of the market dialogue is the expert services in information security and data protection under preparation as well as the assessment services of conformity assessment bodies for information security for the needs of Väylävirasto. BACKGROUND AND OBJECTIVES Väylävirasto is putting out to tender the following two expert service procurements: Expert services in information security and data protection This tender procures experts to support the safeguarding and development of information and cyber security, data protection and information management of Väylävirasto. Väylävirasto has several different administrative or technical projects and undertakings underway in which operations are developed and existing information systems are renewed or new ones are ordered. What all these projects and undertakings have in common is that they must implement information security and the fulfilment of central government information security requirements in a manner suitable for the organisation. The subject matter of the procurement is information and cybersecurity consulting and auditing services. The work takes place largely in a multi-supplier environment, but also as internal consulting for individual projects or undertakings. Information security audits are also carried out regularly in the supplier environment. In addition, an assessment is made of, among other things, the impact of information security instructions directed at central government on the projects and operations of Väylävirasto. In addition to the office environment, the subject matter of the procurement is the infrastructures managed by Väylävirasto (Finnish Transport Infrastructure Agency), i.e. state-owned road, rail and waterways. Each transport mode has its own cyber security development needs, which in certain respects may differ significantly from each other. The aim of the procurement is to obtain a partner for Väylävirasto with which the organisation's and the various transport modes' information and cybersecurity development can be carried out. Assessment services of conformity assessment bodies for information security This tender procures conformity assessment body services to support the safeguarding of the information and cybersecurity, data protection and information management of Väylävirasto. Within the scope of this contract, conformity assessment bodies will produce assessment services in the role of an information security conformity assessment body approved by the Finnish Transport and Communications Agency (Traficom). When offering and producing assessment services, the information security conformity assessment bodies must comply with the current legislation, official regulations, recommendations, guidelines and other obligations directed at conformity assessment bodies by the authorities concerning conformity assessment body activities. Particular attention must be paid to the instruction issued to conformity assessment bodies by the Finnish Transport and Communications Agency for information security conformity assessment bodies 210/2016 O. During the course of the dialogue, the contracting entity will separately assess the need for a market dialogue regarding the assessment services of conformity assessment bodies for information security. The following dynamic purchasing systems (DPS) of Hansel Oy will be used as the procurement procedure for both tenders: Expert services in cyber security and data protection 2025 Assessment services of conformity assessment bodies for information security 2021–2028 Hansel Oy's dynamic purchasing systems are open to all, and all companies meeting the suitability requirements may join them. Those interested in participating in the tenders are therefore requested to join the dynamic purchasing systems. PRELIMINARY SCHEDULE The contracting entity's target schedule for carrying out the market dialogue and the procurement is: - Market dialogue 12/2025-1/2026 - Publication of the invitation to tender 1/2026 - Calculation period 1-2/2026 - Comparison of tenders 2/2026 - Procurement decision and continuation 2-3/2026 ----- ADDITIONAL INFORMATION ON THE NOTICE This notice is a prior information notice. This notice does not request tenders. The prior information notice is accompanied by an invitation to a market dialogue, whereby all suppliers interested in the procurement have the opportunity to conduct a technical dialogue concerning the procurement with Väylävirasto. The purpose of the technical dialogue is to conduct a general-level dialogue on the subject matter of the procurement and its definition. The technical dialogue does not bind Väylävirasto to carry out the procurement. Nor does the technical dialogue bind the supplier to participate in any potential competitive tendering. The technical dialogue is organised through commenting on draft versions of the invitation to tender material and answering the contracting entity's questions related to the subject matter of the procurement. The preliminary date for submitting the draft versions of the invitation to tender material and questions is 12.12.2025. The contracting entity reserves suppliers approximately two weeks for commenting. Instructions for registration: The supplier must declare its interest in participating in the market dialogue by 10.12.2025 at 12.00 at the latest by sending a message to the addresses paul.kinnunen@vayla.fi, pirita.tuikka@vayla.fi and aino.mannikko@vayla.fi with the subject heading: "Tietoturvan hankinnat- markkinavuoropuhelu" (Information security procurements - market dialogue). The supplier is requested to state in the message to which email addresses the market dialogue material will be delivered. The supplier is requested to state the following information in the message: - email address of the supplier's contact person. The contracting entity reserves the right to also invite suppliers to bilateral negotiations or to continue the technical dialogue in another separately notified manner, which will be notified of later if necessary. The descriptions presented in this prior information notice and the estimated publication date of the procurement notice, as well as the draft materials of the dialogue to be delivered later, are preliminary and indicative prior procurement information. Participating companies will not be paid compensation for answering or participating.

parts.source: MARKKINAVUOROPUHELU Markkinavuoropuhelun kohteena ovat valmistelussa olevat Tietoturvan ja tietosuojan asiantuntijapalvelut sekä tietoturvallisuuden arviointilaitosten arviointipalvelut Väyläviraston tarpeisiin. TAUSTAA JA TAVOITTEET Väylävirasto kilpailuttaa seuraavat kaksi asiantuntijapalveluhankintaa: Tietoturvan ja tietosuojan asiantuntijapalvelut Tällä kilpailutuksella hankitaan asiantuntijoita tukemaan Väyläviraston tieto- ja kyberturvallisuuden, tietosuojan ja tiedonhallinnan varmistamista ja kehitystä. Väylävirastolla on meneillään useita eri hallinnollisia tai teknisiä projekteja ja hankkeita, joissa kehitetään toimintaa ja uudistetaan olemassa olevia tai tilataan uusia tietojärjestelmiä. Yhteistä näissä kaikissa projekteissa ja hankkeissa on, että niissä tulee toteuttaa tietoturva ja valtiohallinnon tietoturvavaatimusten täyttäminen organisaatiolle sopivalla tavalla. Hankinnan kohteena on tieto- ja kyberturvallisuusturvakonsultointi- ja auditointipalvelut. Työskentely tapahtuu suurelta osin monitoimittajaympäristössä, mutta myös yksittäisten projektien tai hankkeiden sisäisenä konsultointina. Tietoturva-auditointeja tehdään myös säännöllisesti toimittajaympäristöön. Lisäksi arvioidaan mm. valtionhallintoon kohdistuvien tietoturvaohjeiden vaikutusta Väyläviraston hankkeisiin ja toimintaan. Toimistoympäristön lisäksi hankinnan kohteena ovat Väylän hallinnoimat infrastruktuurit, eli valtion omistamat tie-, rata- ja vesiväylät. Kullakin väylämuodolla on omat kyberturvallisuuden kehitystarpeet, jotka tietyiltä osin voivat poiketa toisistaan merkittävästi. Hankinnan tavoitteena on saada Väylävirastolle yhteistyökumppani, jonka kanssa organisaation ja eri väylämuotojen tieto- ja kyberturvallisuuden kehittämistä voidaan toteuttaa. Tietoturvallisuuden arviointilaitosten arviointipalvelut Tällä kilpailutuksella hankitaan arviointilaitospalveluja tukemaan Väyläviraston tieto- ja kyberturvallisuuden, tietosuojan ja tiedonhallinnan varmistamista. Tämän sopimuksen piirissä arviointilaitokset tuottavat arviointipalveluja Liikenne- ja viestintäviraston hyväksymän tietoturvallisuuden arviointilaitoksen roolissa. Tietoturvallisuuden arviointilaitosten tulee arviointipalveluita tarjotessaan ja tuottaessaan noudattaa arviointilaitostoimintaa koskevaa voimassa olevaa lainsäädäntöä, viranomaismääräyksiä, suosituksia, ohjeistuksia ja muita viranomaisten arviointilaitoksille kohdistamia velvoitteita. Erityisesti tulee huomioida Liikenne- ja viestintäviraston arviointilaitoksille antama ohje tietoturvallisuuden arviointilaitoksille 210/2016 O. Tilaaja arvioi vuoropuhelun kuluessa erikseen tarvetta markkinavuoropuhelulle tietoturvallisuuden arviointilaitosten arviointipalveluiden osalta. Kummankin kilpailutuksen hankintamenettelynä käytetään seuraavia Hansel Oy:n dynaamisia hankintajärjestelmiä (DPS): Kyberturvan ja tietosuojan asiantuntijapalvelut 2025 Tietoturvallisuuden arviointilaitosten arviointipalvelut 2021–2028 Hansel Oy:n dynaamiset hankintajärjestelmät ovat kaikille avoimia, ja niihin voivat liittyä kaikki soveltuvuusvaatimukset täyttävät yritykset. Kilpailutuksiin osallistumisesta kiinnostuneita pyydetäänkin liittymään dynaamisiin hankintajärjestelmiin. ALUSTAVA AIKATAULU Tilaajan tavoiteaikataulu markkinavuoropuhelun ja hankinnan toteuttamiselle on: - Markkinavuoropuhelu 12/2025-1/2026 - Tarjouspyynnön julkaisu 1/2026 - Laskenta-aika 1-2/2026 - Tarjousten vertailu 2/2026 - Hankintapäätös ja jatko 2-3/2026 ----- ILMOITUKSEN LISÄTIEDOT Tämä ilmoitus on ennakkoilmoitus. Tällä ilmoituksella ei pyydetä tarjouksia. Ennakkoilmoitukseen liittyy kutsu markkinavuoropuheluun, jolloin kaikilla hankinnasta kiinnostuneilla toimittajilla on mahdollisuus käydä hankintaa koskevaa teknistä vuoropuhelua Väyläviraston kanssa. Teknisen vuoropuhelun tarkoituksena on käydä yleisellä tasolla vuoropuhelua hankinnan kohteesta ja sen määrittämisestä. Tekninen vuoropuhelu ei sido Väylävirastoa toteuttamaan hankintaa. Tekninen vuoropuhelu ei myöskään sido toimittajaa mahdolliseen tarjouskilpailuun osallistumiseen. Tekninen vuoropuhelu järjestetään tarjouspyyntöaineiston luonnosversioiden kommentoinnin ja tilaajan hankinnan kohteeseen liittyviin kysymyksiin vastaamisen kautta. Alustava ajankohta tarjouspyyntöaineiston luonnosversioiden ja kysymysten toimittamiselle on 12.12.2025. Tilaaja varaa toimittajille noin kahden viikon kommentointiajan. Ilmoittautumisohje: Toimittajan tulee ilmoittaa kiinnostuksensa osallistua markkinavuoropuheluun 10.12.2025 klo 12.00 mennessä lähettämällä osoitteisiin paul.kinnunen@vayla.fi, pirita.tuikka@vayla.fi ja aino.mannikko@vayla.fi viesti otsikolla: "Tietoturvan hankinnat- markkinavuoropuhelu". Toimittajaa pyydetään ilmoittamaan viestissä mihin sähköpostiosoitteisiin markkinavuoropuhelumateriaali toimitetaan. Toimittajaa pyydetään ilmoittamaan viestissä seuraavat tiedot: - toimittajan yhteyshenkilön sähköpostiosoite. Tilaaja varaa oikeuden kutsua toimittajia myös kahdenkeskisiin neuvotteluihin tai jatkaa teknistä vuoropuhelua muulla erikseen ilmoitettavalla tavalla, joista ilmoitetaan tarvittaessa myöhemmin. Tässä ennakkoilmoituksessa esitetyt kuvaukset ja hankintailmoituksen arvioitu julkaisupäivämäärä, kuten myös myöhemmin toimitettavat vuoropuhelun luonnosmateriaalit ovat alustavia ja suuntaa antavia hankinnan ennakkotietoja. Osallistuneille yrityksille ei makseta korvausta vastaamisesta tai osallistumisesta.

Hansel Oy's customers shall award contracts under the DPS among the candidates accepted into the DPS through mini-competitions within the DPS, which may take place throughout the entire procurement phase of the DPS. result.text: This is not a procurement notice or a call for tenders, but a Request for Information directed at potential Suppliers. Therefore, no tenders are requested or to be submitted in response to this request for information. No comments or questions received via the request for information will be answered. One of the tasks of the Finnish National Agency for Education is the publishing of learning materials and publications. Customers include both private individuals and organisations, in particular schools and educational institutions. Products are delivered to the customer either physically (e.g. textbooks) or digitally (e.g. electronic learning materials). We request up-to-date information on a comprehensive service encompassing product logistics, licensing, and online shop services. The service to be procured includes • a SaaS online shop solution where customers can purchase non-fiction books, textbooks, publications, and licences for digital learning materials published by the Finnish National Agency for Education, as well as downloadable files, using commonly used payment methods • a logistics and distribution service for textbooks and publications, including distribution to key resellers such as Library Service, bookshops, and learning material intermediaries • a digital product licence management service, and • a sales settlement service, including inventory value reporting. Service requirements • The online shop must serve our customers in Finnish, Swedish, and English. • The service must meet the accessibility requirements of the Act on the Provision of Digital Services. • It shall be possible to integrate the service with the Finnish National Agency for Education's digital learning platform (licence management) and product register. • The online shop solution must provide the capability for the Finnish National Agency for Education to edit the layout, texts, and settings of the online shop. In addition, it must be possible to add sample pages, reading samples, and promotional videos to the online shop. We request the following information 1. Does the Supplier have a comprehensive service meeting the above description to offer? 2. What pricing model does the Supplier use? 3. Based on the above description, does the Supplier have any comments on the potential requirement specification for the procurement? 4. Optional additional question: The Finnish National Agency for Education is exploring alternatives to replace its self-developed product information system and royalty register. Is it possible to tailor a product and royalty register into the Supplier's service that includes the necessary databases and user interface? The request for information does not oblige the contracting authority to carry out the actual procurement or to implement it in the manner described in the request for information. The contracting authority is not obliged to take account of responses received to the request for information when drawing up the call for tenders. Responding to the request for information does not bind the tenderer or affect the tenderer's position in any potential procurement procedure. No compensation will be paid for responding to the request for information or for any product demonstration.

result.text: This is a request for information, which is not a prior information notice, a contract notice or a call for tenders. The purpose of the request for information is to survey the market and collect information regarding the subject of the procurement for a future tendering process. Responding to the request for information is not a prerequisite for participating in the tendering process. To ensure the success of the future tendering process, it is important that tenderers provide the contracting authority with the requested information as extensively as possible. This request for information is used to clarify the supply available on the market regarding substitute management systems and suppliers. A substitute management system enables a single centralised service channel for the sudden substitute needs of professionals. With the help of a substitute management system, we want to streamline substitute management processes. The need is to find a modern and user-friendly, off-the-shelf SaaS system intended for the management and coordination of substitutes, as well as for the notification and booking of temporary work shifts. In addition, we want to improve and modernise the user experience of our substitute management systems so that the applicant experience and communication are improved. The systems must be integrable via standard interfaces with, among other things, the client organisation's user information and access rights management service. The objectives of the services are equal accessibility, timeliness and continuity. The goal of the procurement is to move from heavy services to proactive and preventive services, whereby the effectiveness of the services can be improved. We offer system solutions to our clients in the social and health care sector as well as the municipal sector. The scope of the future procurement, the procurement method and the parties will be specified as the preparation of the call for tenders progresses. DESCRIPTION OF THE PROCUREMENT The goal of the procurement is to find a system: - that is an easy-to-use, off-the-shelf SaaS solution - that can be integrated into the client organisation's AD and reporting environment via open interfaces - that is information secure and takes data protection into account - whose supplier has a clear implementation model that includes extensive documentation and guidance for the client and contracting organisation - that can be used on mobile devices and via a browser. In addition to the system procurement, the procurement includes connection interfaces to other systems, licences, a delivery project, maintenance and support for off-the-shelf software, as well as other separately ordered expert services, for example, the planning and implementation of system change and development needs and development projects. The solution must scale to the organisational structures of social and health service organisations and the municipal sector. The implementation of the solution must be based on generally used standards and system-independent interfaces. The solution to be procured must function as part of the existing technical and functional environment. The solution includes at least two separate environments in terms of its functions; production and test/training environments, which are identical in their basic structure. OPERATING ENVIRONMENT The following are descriptions of the operating environments of the organisations related to the request for information, which are requested to be used in describing the functionality and pricing model. Users of the data transmission system are, for example, users from wellbeing services counties and municipal organisations. Users of the information systems are also stakeholders and external users. RESPONDING TO THE REQUEST FOR INFORMATION The request for information must be answered by 25.9.2025 at 12:00. Responding takes place by email to the address hankinnat@istekki.fi. Please head your message as follows: "Markkinavuoropuhelu: Sijaisvälitysjärjestelmä" (Market dialogue: Substitute management system). Responses to the Questions attachment of the request for information must also be submitted with the response. You may also attach, for example, brochures to the response. Based on the responses received, Istekki Oy will select 3–5 suppliers to present their solutions in one-hour Teams meetings. The meeting between the selected respondent, Istekki and the representatives of the clients will be recorded. The information provided at the request for information stage will be treated as confidential. Please indicate in your request for information response which of the times below suit you best: Mon 29.9. at 10 – 11 Mon 29.9. at 13 – 14 Mon 29.9. at 14 – 15 Tue 30.9. at 11 – 12 Tue 30.9. at 12 – 13 Tue 30.9. at 13 – 14 The times will be confirmed supplier-specifically after the response time for the request for information. The tendering service automatically creates deadlines for submitting questions and responding to the request for information. Instead of these deadlines, the deadlines in the request for information document shall be followed.

parts.source: Tämä on tietopyyntö, joka ei ole ennakkoilmoitus, hankintailmoitus tai tarjouspyyntö. Tietopyynnön tarkoituksena on kartoittaa markkinoita ja kerätä hankinnan kohdetta koskevaa tietoa tulevaa kilpailutusta varten. Tietopyyntöön vastaaminen ei ole edellytys kilpailutukseen osallistumiselle. Tulevan kilpailutuksen onnistumisen varmistamiseksi on tärkeää, että tarjoajat antavat hankintayksikölle mahdollisimman laajasti pyydettyjä tietoja. Tällä tietopyynnöllä selvitetään markkinoilla olevaa tarjontaa sijaisvälitysjärjestelmistä ja toimittajista. Sijaisvälitysjärjestelmällä mahdollistetaan yksi keskitetty palvelukanava ammattilaisten äkillisiin sijaistustarpeisiin. Sijaisvälitysjärjestelmän avulla haluamme sujuvoittaa sijaisvälityksen prosesseja. Tarpeena on löytää sijaisten hallintaan ja koordinointiin, sekä keikkatyövuorojen ilmoittamiseen ja varaukseen tarkoitettu moderni ja käyttäjäystävällinen, valmistuotepohjainen SaaS-järjestelmä. Lisäksi haluamme parantaa sekä modernisoida sijaisvälitysjärjestelmiemme käyttökokemusta siten, että hakijakokemus ja -viestintä paranevat. Järjestelmien tulee olla integroitavissa standardeilla rajapinnoilla mm. asiakasorganisaation käyttäjätieto- ja käyttöoikeuksien hallintapalveluun. Palvelujen tavoitteina on yhdenvertainen saatavuus, oikea-aikaisuus ja jatkuvuus. Hankinnan tavoitteena on siirtyä raskaista palveluista ennakoiviin ja ennalta ehkäiseviin palveluihin, jolloin voidaan parantaa palveluiden vaikuttavuutta. Tarjoamme järjestelmäratkaisuja sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon toimialan sekä kuntasektorin asiakkaillemme. Tulevan hankinnan laajuus, hankintatapa sekä osapuolet täsmentyvät tarjouspyynnön valmistelun edetessä. HANKINNAN KUVAUS Hankinnan tavoitteena on löytää järjestelmä, - joka on helppokäyttöinen, valmistuotepohjainen SaaS-ratkaisu - joka on integroitavissa asiakasorganisaation AD- ja raportointiympäristöön avoimien rajapintojen kautta - joka on tietoturvallinen ja tietosuojan huomioiva - jonka toimittajalla on selkeä käyttöönottomalli, joka sisältää laajan dokumentaation ja ohjeistuksen asiakas- ja tilaajaorganisaatiolle - joka on käytettävissä mobiililaitteilla ja selaimella Hankintaan kuuluu järjestelmähankinnan lisäksi liittymärajapinnat muihin järjestelmiin, lisenssit, toimitusprojekti, valmisohjelmistojen ylläpito ja tuki, sekä muita erikseen tilattavia asiantuntijapalveluja, esimerkiksi järjestelmän muutos- ja kehittämistarpeiden sekä kehittämisprojektien suunnittelu ja toteuttaminen. Ratkaisun tulee skaalautua sosiaali- ja terveyspalveluorganisaatioiden sekä kuntasektorin organisaatiorakenteisiin. Ratkaisun toteutuksen tulee perustua yleisesti käytettyihin standardeihin ja järjestelmäriippumattomiin rajapintoihin. Hankittavan ratkaisun tulee toimia osana olemassa olevaa teknistä ja toiminnallista ympäristöä. Ratkaisu sisältää toiminnoiltaan vähintään kaksi erillistä ympäristöä; tuotanto sekä testi/koulutusympäristö, jotka ovat perusrakenteeltaan identtiset keskenään. KÄYTTÖYMPÄRISTÖ Tietopyyntöön liittyvien organisaatioiden käyttöympäristöistä on seuraavassa kuvauksia, joita pyydetään käyttämään toiminnallisuuden ja hinnoittelumallin kuvaamisessa. Tiedonsiirtojärjestelmän käyttäjiä ovat esimerkiksi hyvinvointialueiden sekä kuntaorganisaatioiden käyttäjät. Tietojärjestelmien käyttäjiä ovat myös sidosryhmät sekä ulkoiset käyttäjät. TIETOPYYNTÖÖN VASTAAMINEN Tietopyyntöön tulee vastata to 25.9.2025 klo 12:00 mennessä. Vastaaminen tapahtuu sähköpostitse osoitteeseen hankinnat@istekki.fi. Otsikoikaa viestinne seuraavasti: "Markkinavuoropuhelu: Sijaisvälitysjärjestelmä". Vastauksen mukana tulee toimittaa myös vastaukset tietopyynnön liitteeseen Kysymykset. Vastaukseen voi lisäksi liittää esimerkiksi esitteitä. Saatujen vastausten perusteella Istekki Oy valitsee 3–5 toimittajaa esittelemään ratkaisujaan yhden tunnin Teams-tapaamisiin. Valitun vastaajan, Istekin ja asiakkaiden edustajien välinen tapaaminen tallennetaan. Tietopyyntövaiheessa toimitetut tiedot käsitellään luottamuksellisena. Ilmoitattehan tietopyyntövastauksessanne alla olevista ajankohdista Teille parhaiten sopivat: Ma 29.9. klo 10 – 11 Ma 29.9. klo 13 – 14 Ma 29.9. klo 14 – 15 Ti 30.9. klo 11 – 12 Ti 30.9. klo 12 – 13 Ti 30.9. klo 13 – 14 Ajankohdat vahvistetaan toimittajakohtaisesti tietopyynnön vastausajankohdan jälkeen. Tarjouspalvelu luo automaattisesti määräajat kysymysten jätölle ja tietopyyntöön vastaamiselle. Kyseisten määräaikojen sijaan noudatetaan tietopyyntöasiakirjan määräaikoja.

result.text: The subject of this tender is a (framework) contract for the provision of communication services during the implementation and subsequent commissioning phases for the infrastructure project "Extension of city railway line U2 into Bad Homburg v. d. Höhe station" (SBHG) from the year 2026. The communication services comprise, as continuously provided services, among other things, the project-accompanying management and coordination of public relations as well as the project-accompanying maintenance and care of PR instruments. In addition, the contract covers the optional calling off of further communication services, such as crisis communication and the organisation and execution of events. The extension of city railway line U2 provides for closing the gap between Bad Homburg v. d. Höhe station and the previous terminal stop of city railway line U2. Previously, the route of the U2 ends at Gonzenheim stop. The integration of the U2 in Bad Homburg station takes place north of the existing S-Bahn tracks in the area of the former so-called prince's track (Fürstengleis). The planned route alignment necessitates the conversion of the technical equipment of Deutsche Bahn's infrastructure facilities, the planning of which is the subject of this tender. The planning of the new construction measure is already taking place. A plan approval decision dated 25.01.2016 is available for the construction project, which forms the basis of the planning services for the new construction measure and the adjustment measures. Höhe" (SBHG) ab dem Jahr 2026. Die Kommunikationsdienstleistungen umfassen als kontinuierlich zu erbringende Leistungen unter anderem die projektbegleitende Steuerung und Koordination der Public Relations sowie die projektbegleitende Pflege und Betreuung der PR-Instrumente. Daneben erfasst der Vertrag den optionalen Abruf weiterer Kommunikationsleistungen, wie etwa die Krisenkommunikation und die Organisation und Durchführung von Veranstaltungen. Die Verlängerung der Stadtbahnlinie U2 sieht den Lückenschluss zwischen dem Bahnhof Bad Homburg v. d. Höhe und der bisherigen Endhaltestelle der Stadtbahnlinie U2 vor. Bisher endet die Strecke der U2 an der Haltestelle Gonzenheim. Die Einbindung der U2 im Bad Homburger Bahnhof erfolgt nördlich der vorhandenen S-Bahn-Gleise im Bereich des ehemaligen sogenannten Fürstengleises. Die geplante Trassenführung bedingt den Umbau der Technischen Ausrüstung der Infrastrukturanlagen der Deutschen Bahn, dessen Planung Gegenstand dieser Ausschreibung ist. Die Planung der Neubaumaßnahme findet bereits statt. In addition it is planned that the procurement shall also give Oslo municipality access to the correct competence and capacity in order to digitise services of high quality. In order to get access to capacity and competence, it is planned to enter into parallel framework agreements with tenderers within several sub-areas. Call-offs will be made through direct call-offs via the fossefall method or by mini-competitions. The details of the agreement have not yet been defined. The contracting authority would therefore like to get input from the market in this market on how we ought to build a new contract by interested suppliers responding to the attached questions in the attached document.

result.text: Migration of OpenScape Voice communications system including applications Lot LOT-0001: Migration of OpenScape Voice communications system including applications for the City of Münster - citeq. The contracting authority is procuring the supply of server hardware, hypervisor, storage (vSAN), network switches, and the execution of the software update of OpenScape Voice V10 to the current release V11 including all connected applications. As part of the migration, the VMware hypervisor is to be replaced by Proxmox. Since the existing OpenScape Contact Center cannot be virtualised on Proxmox and is no longer being further developed by the manufacturer Mitel, the migration is to take place to the Mitel CX Contact Center. In addition, the maintenance of the system including software maintenance is to be taken over. As part of the maintenance, the following services must be provided: - Maintenance, including software maintenance of the communications systems, including DECT - Branches - Session Border Controllers - UC system with voicemail, CTI, one number service, web collaboration - Alarm server (newvoice) - Network components for connecting the communications systems - Server and storage systems for virtualisation and data backup of the communications systems and applications - Operation of the server systems and storage, including operating system - Remote service 7x 24 x 365 - On-site service - Patch management and release management - Incident management In addition, services for purchase, assembly, and maintenance for the expansion or replacement of communications components are requested as a shopping basket over the contract term. The services must be provided by 01.04.2027 at the latest. Necessary measures for taking over the maintenance, e.g. - Migration of existing systems - Familiarisation with system documentation and systems - Onboarding of employees - Setup of remote accesses on the contractor side so that the remote maintenance accesses of the contracting authority can be used - Registration / re-registration of the service partner with the manufacturer must be carried out in full by the contractor prior to service takeover. - The contractor shall provide a migration plan with milestones upon submission of the tender.

result.text: New operational control system [ELS] The Fraport AG, headquartered in Frankfurt am Main, is a world-leading airport operator. The company was founded in 1924 and operates Frankfurt Airport, one of the most significant air traffic hubs in the world. Furthermore, Fraport is involved in the management and operation of several other airports worldwide. Fraport currently operates the software (SW) ELDIS III from the company eurofunk at the Frankfurt am Main site as a KRITIS and LuftSIG-relevant system in the security control centre with the service areas of works fire brigade, rescue service and security as an operational control system, and in the integrated passenger flow control centre as a workflow system. The system currently in use is foreseeably reaching its technical limits, so that a replacement is necessary. The functions to be replaced by new systems include operational control and force deployment, hazard report management and the provision of geoinformation in the form of a geoproxy. Maintenance, servicing, service and support are also required for all new systems. Applicants must sign a confidentiality agreement provided by Fraport (see informational documents) and submit it together with the application to participate. After the call for competition, an indicative tender round will initially be carried out as part of the tender phase, which will then be followed by one or more binding tender rounds. Within the indicative tender round, the tenderers may propose changes to the contract, service description and annexes. Fraport will decide on their acceptance or rejection. The contracting authority points out now that the contractor must mandatorily provide the following evidence in the event of being requested to submit a binding tender: 1. All persons deployed in the project and in all maintenance, service and support services are German-speaking at least at level B2 according to the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR) and are provided from a time zone UTC +0 to +3. 2. Proof of full access to the control of development resources and unrestricted authorisation to modify and expand the offered software and hardware. Due to the importance of the overall system to be procured here for the maintenance of flight operations and the mandatory framework schedule to be adhered to, Fraport may withdraw from the entire contract if the contractor culpably fails to provide, or fails to provide in accordance with the contract, services marked as "already available" in terms of hardware and software functions at the time of contract conclusion. The scope includes the delivery, agile (additional) development, commissioning with migration of legacy systems of a new operational control system for the security control centre and the integrated control centre for operational control and force deployment, the training of the employees of the Fraport AG as well as maintenance, service and support services.

parts.source: Neues Einsatzleitsystem [ELS] Die Fraport AG, mit Hauptsitz in Frankfurt am Main, ist ein weltweit führender Flughafenbetreiber. Das Unternehmen wurde 1924 gegründet und betreibt den Flughafen Frankfurt, eines der bedeutendsten Luftverkehrsdrehkreuze der Welt. Darüber hinaus ist Fraport an der Verwaltung und dem Betrieb von mehreren anderen Flughäfen weltweit beteiligt. Der Fraport betreibt am Standort Frankfurt am Main aktuell die Software (SW) ELDIS III der Fa. eurofunk als KRITIS und LuftSIG relevantes System in der Sicherheitsleitstelle mit den Dienstbereichen Werksfeuerwehr, Rettungsdienst sowie Security als Einsatzleitsystem und in der Integrierten Passagierflußleitstelle als Workflowsystem. Das aktuell im Einsatz befindliche System stößt absehbar an seine technischen Grenzen, so dass eine Ablösung notwendig ist. Die mit neuen Systemen abzulösenden Funktionen umfassen dabei die Einsatzleit- und Kräftedisposition, das Gefahrenmeldermanagement und die Bereitstellung von Geoinformationen in Form eines Geoproxy. Für alle neuen Systeme wird auch Wartung, Instandhaltung, Service und Support gefordert. Die Bewerber müssen eine von Fraport bereitgestellte Vertraulichkeitsvereinbarung (siehe informatorische Unterlagen) unterzeichnen und zusammen mit dem Teilnahmeantrag einreichen. Nach dem Teilnahmewettbewerb wird im Rahmen der Angebotsphase zunächst eine indikative Angebotsrunde durchgeführt, auf die dann eine oder mehrere verbindliche Angebotsrunden folgen. Innerhalb der indikativen Angebotsrunde können Änderungsvorschläge an Vertrag, Leistungsbeschreibung und Anhängen durch die Bieter angebracht werden. Fraport entscheidet über deren Annahme oder Ablehnung. Der Auftraggeber weist schon jetzt darauf hin, dass der Auftragnehmer im Falle der Aufforderung zur Abgabe eines verbindlichen Angebots zwingend die folgenden Nachweise zu erbringen hat: 1. Alle im Projekt und allen Wartung, Service und Supportleistung eingesetzte Personen sind deutschsprachig mindestens auf dem Niveau B2 gem. des europäischen Referenzrahmens für Sprachen (GER) und werden aus einer Zeitzone UTC +0 bis +3 zur Verfügung gestellt. 2. Nachweis eines vollumfänglichen Zugriff auf die Steuerung der Entwicklungsressourcen und uneingeschränkte Berechtigung zur Veränderung und Erweiterung der angebotenen Soft- und Hardware. Aufgrund der Bedeutung des vorliegend zu beschaffenden Gesamtsystems für die Aufrechterhaltung des Flugbetriebs zwingend notwendig einzuhaltenden Rahmenterminplan, kann Fraport vom gesamten Vertrag zurückzutreten, wenn der Auftragnehmer zum Vertragsschluss als "bereits verfügbar" gekennzeichnete Leistungen im Sinne von Hard- und Softwarefunktionen schuldhaft nach Vertragsschluss nicht oder nicht vertragsgemäß erbringt. Der Umfang umfasst die Lieferung, agile (Zusatz-)entwicklung, Inbetriebnahme mit Migration der Altsysteme eines neuen Einsatzleitsystem für die Sicherheitsleitstelle und die Integrierte Leitstelle zur Einsatzleitung- und Kräftedisposition, die Schulung der Mitarbeiter der Fraport AG sowie Wartungs-, Service- und Supportleistungen.

result.text: The contracting authority is tendering a contract regarding Transition In, development of the Modernised Support Systems, application operation, application maintenance, support, ordering services, including further development of the Support Systems, as well as Transition Out. The contract consists of the following 3 main services: I. Transition In, including, among other things, a secure and stable takeover of the application responsibility for the Support Systems, implementation of, for example, project management, transition organisation, transfer of source code and documentation, implementation of technical transition and necessary transformation, takeover of knowledge from the outgoing supplier as well as establishment of the operations organisation, including establishment of the collaboration with the operations supplier. II. Ongoing services for the Support Systems, including; a. Support, including, among other things, responsibility for Service Desk, user administration, handling of incidents, problems, service requests, early life support, cf. the operational processes, with the aim of ensuring high availability for the users; b. Application operation, including, among other things, database operation, operation of middleware, backup, restore, monitoring and logging, 2. and 3. line support, configuration, patch, and release and deployment management, cf. the operational processes, and operational reporting with high requirements for uptime and response times; c. Application maintenance, including, among other things, ongoing and preventive maintenance of the IT systems, minor changes, new versions, bug fixes, release management, cf. the operational processes, with the aim of supporting high requirements for uptime and response times; d. Governance, including close collaboration with the operations supplier, operational processes, security services, documentation and operational reporting. III. Agile development, e.g. via a design and planning phase, including proof of concept, as well as a development phase based on the supplier's product vision and advice. Development of the Modernised Support Systems takes place agilely in close collaboration between the parties regarding support for the contracting authority's business goals and needs, so that the Modernised Support Systems can be implemented after a time-limited period. Development includes any new functionality as well as any re-implementation and reuse of parts of the current Support Systems. Further development of the Support Systems also takes place agilely in close collaboration between the parties. It is the contracting authority's business need that all services are delivered with high delivery reliability and robustness, and that the supplier demonstrates proactivity in the collaboration. In Transition In, the supplier must take over the application responsibility for the Support Systems and, from the transition day, deliver ongoing services, including, among other things, application operation, application maintenance and further development, to the Support Systems. The further development will take place in a close, agile collaboration with the contracting authority. The supplier must also, in a close, agile collaboration with the contracting authority, carry out a modernisation of the Support Systems based on the contracting authority's modernisation wishes. The Support Systems are part of the overall joint municipal infrastructure, and the supplier must therefore collaborate partly with the other suppliers, including the operations supplier as well as suppliers who deliver other parts of the joint municipal infrastructure, and partly with users of the infrastructure. It is the contracting authority's business goal and need, among other things, to give parts of the current Support Systems a quality boost in the form of a modernisation that supports the Modernised Support Systems appearing attractive, reliable, future-proof and secure, so that the municipalities also in the future have a strong foundation to deliver the best digital services to the citizens in an increasingly more coherent, efficient and modern public sector.

parts.source: Ordregiver udbyder Kontrakt vedrørende Transition Ind, udvikling af de Moderniserede Støttesystemer, Applikationsdrift, Applikationsvedligeholdelse, Support, Bestillingsydelser, herunder Videreudvikling af Støttesystemerne, samt Transition Ud. Kontrakten består af følgende 3 hovedydelser: I. Transition Ind, herunder bl.a. en sikker og stabil overtagelse af applikationsansvaret for Støttesystemerne, gennemførelse af fx projektstyring, transitionsorganisation, overførsel af kildekode og Dokumentation, gennemførelse af teknisk transition og nødvendig transformation, overtagelse af viden fra Afgivende Leverandør samt etablering af driftsorganisationen, herunder etablering af samarbejdet med Driftsleverandøren. II. Løbende Ydelser til Støttesystemerne, herunder; a. Support, herunder bl.a. ansvar for Service Desk, brugeradministration, håndtering af Incidents, Problems, Service Requests, Early Life Support, jf. de Operationelle Processer, mhp. at sikre høj tilgængelighed for Anvenderne; b. Applikationsdrift, herunder bl.a. databasedrift, drift af middleware, backup, restore, overvågning og logning, 2. og 3. line support, Configuration-, Patch-, og Release- og Deployment Management, jf. de Operationelle Processer, og driftsrapportering med høje krav til oppe- og svartider; c. Applikationsvedligeholdelse, herunder bl.a. løbende og forebyggende vedligeholdelse af IT-systemerne, mindre ændringer, nye Versioner, fejlrettelser, Release Management, jf. de Operationelle Processer, mhp. at understøtte høje krav til oppe- og svartider; d. Governance, herunder et tæt samarbejde med Driftsleverandøren, Operationelle Processer, sikkerhedsydelser, Dokumentation og driftsrapportering. III. Agil udvikling, bl.a. via en Design- og planlægningsfase, inkl. proof of concept, samt en udviklingsfase baseret på leverandørens produkt vision og rådgivning. Udvikling af de Moderniserede Støttesystemer sker agilt i tæt samarbejde mellem Parterne ift. understøttelse af ordregivers Forretningsmæssige Mål og Behov, således at de Moderniserede Støttesystemer kan implementeres efter en tidsbegrænset periode. Udvikling omfatter evt. ny funktionalitet samt evt. reimplementering og genbrug af dele af de Nuværende Støttesystemer. Videreudvikling af Støttesystemerne sker ligeledes agilt i tæt samarbejde mellem Parterne. Det er ordregivers forretningsmæssige behov, at alle Ydelser leveres med høj leverancesikkerhed og robusthed, samt at Leverandøren udviser proaktivitet i samarbejdet. Leverandøren skal i Transition Ind overtage applikationsansvaret for Støttesystemerne og fra Transitionsdagen levere Løbende Ydelser, herunder blandt andet Applikationsdrift, Applikationsvedligeholdelse og Videreudvikling, til Støttesystemerne. Videreudviklingen vil ske i et tæt, agilt samarbejde med ordregiver. Leverandøren skal ligeledes i et tæt, agilt samarbejde med ordregiver foretage en modernisering af Støttesystemerne ud fra ordregivers moderniseringsønsker. Støttesystemerne er en del af den samlede fælleskommunale infrastruktur, og Leverandøren skal derfor samarbejde dels med de Øvrige Leverandører, herunder Driftsleverandøren samt leverandører, der leverer øvrige dele af den fælleskommunale infrastruktur, dels med Anvendere af infrastrukturen. Det er ordregivers Forretningsmæssige Mål og Behov bl.a. at give dele af de Nuværende Støttesystemer et kvalitetsmæssigt løft i form af en modernisering, der understøtter, at de Moderniserede Støttesystemer fremstår attraktive, pålidelige, fremtidssikrede og sikre, så kommunerne også i fremtiden har et stærkt fundament til at levere de bedste digitale ydelser til borgerne i en tiltagende mere sammenhængende, effektiv og moderne offentlig sektor.

result.text: Fraunhofer IIS is seeking a contractor to provide software development, maintenance, documentation, support and commissioning services in connection with the products ISAR, aISAR and ISAR Statistics during the term of the contract. Lot LOT-0001: Framework agreement for software development and commissioning services for ISAR, aISAR and ISAR Statistics. Fraunhofer IIS is seeking a contractor to provide software development, maintenance, documentation, support and commissioning services in connection with the products ISAR, aISAR and ISAR Statistics during the term of the contract. The PMO department and the EZRT business unit have been continuously further developing the ISAR software for automated X-ray testing for over 25 years. Several system integrators use ISAR and, as partners, construct testing systems, commission them at end customers' sites and maintain them. Due to technological changes and ongoing functional enhancements, adaptations to the software system are required on a regular basis. The subject of the framework agreement is demand-led support for the further development, maintenance and extension of the software, for user interfaces, system and database connections, for support cases, as well as for the maintenance of end-user documentation and for on-site commissionings. The objective is the reliable availability of qualified development and commissioning capacities during the term of the contract. Further information can be found in the specifications.

result.text: The subject matter of the dynamic purchasing system (DPS) consists of knowledge management and artificial intelligence platforms, licences, and expert services. Actual procurements are made on the basis of separate requests for tenders through internal competitions within the DPS, in which the contracting authority specifies and describes its detailed procurement need. The subject matter of the procurement of platforms and licences may be, for example, a solution based on commercial off-the-shelf software for knowledge management, software usage rights, licences, and/or a software solution based on open source code. The subject matter may additionally include tools intended for, among other things, knowledge management administration, data warehouse automation, integration, analytics and reporting, as well as visualisation. The subject matter of the expert services can be specified in areas such as the following: • Knowledge management and AI consulting • Planning and management of data governance and management projects • Conceptual, data, and interface modelling as well as architecture definition • Development, testing, training, and planning of maintenance, administration, and monitoring for extract, transform, load (ETL) chains and integrations • Planning, development, testing, training, and planning of maintenance, administration, and monitoring for data warehouses, data cubes, and data lakes • Planning, development, testing, training, and planning of maintenance, administration, and monitoring for visualisations and reporting • Development of analytics, advanced analytics, machine learning, and robotics • User interface and application development (Chatbot, etc.) • Definition and development of cost accounting • Definition of services, processes, and governance models • Selection, consulting, and training of tools used in development The contracting authority does not commit to procuring any minimum quantity within the DPS. A procurement contract concluded within the DPS does not grant the supplier an exclusive right to provide the service. In internal competitions of the dynamic purchasing system, the contracting authority requests an assurance from the tenderer that the tenderer company, or those companies or persons in whose ownership, possession, or control the tenderer company is, or its subcontractor, is not burdened by sanctions imposed by the European Union or the United Nations (UN) or by sanctions or asset freezing decisions imposed by Finnish authorities. The contracting authority shall exclude from the internal tendering procedure of the purchasing system tenderers who do not meet the aforementioned requirement. The contracting authority also has the right to terminate the procurement contract with immediate effect if the supplier is burdened by any of the above-mentioned sanctions or asset freezing decisions.

parts.source: Dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän (DPS) kohteena ovat tiedolla johtamisen ja tekoälyn alustat, lisenssit sekä asiantuntijapalvelut. Varsinaiset hankinnat tehdään erillisten tarjouspyyntöjen perusteella DPS:n sisäisin kilpailutuksin, jossa hankintayksikkö täsmentää ja kuvaa yksityiskohtaisen hankintatarpeensa. Alustojen ja lisenssien hankinnan kohteena voi olla esim. tiedolla johtamisen kaupalliseen valmisohjelmistoon perustuva ratkaisu, ohjelmiston käyttöoikeus, lisenssit ja/tai avoimeen lähdekoodiin perustuva ohjelmistoratkaisu. Kohteeseen voi lisäksi kuulua mm. tiedolla johtamisen hallintaan, tietovarastoautomaatioon, integraatioon, analytiikkaan ja raportointiin sekä visualisointiin tarkoitetut työkalut. Asiantuntijapalvelujen kohdetta voidaan täsmentää mm. seuraavin osa-aluein: • Tiedolla johtamisen ja AI konsultointi • Tiedon hallinnan ja johtamisen projektien suunnittelu ja johtaminen • Käsite-, tieto- ja rajapintamallinnus sekä arkkitehtuurien määrittely • Latausketjujen (ETL) ja integraatioiden kehitys, testaus, koulutus sekä ylläpidon, hallinnan ja valvonnan suunnittelu • Tietovarastojen, tietokuutioiden ja tietoaltaiden suunnittelu, kehitys, testaus, koulutus sekä ylläpidon, hallinnan ja valvonnan suunnittelu • Visualisointien ja raportoinnin suunnittelu, kehitys, testaus, koulutus sekä ylläpidon, hallinnan ja valvonnan suunnittelu • Analytiikan, edistyneen analytiikan, koneoppimisen ja robotiikan kehittäminen • Käyttöliittymä- ja sovelluskehitys (Chatbot jne.) • Kustannuslaskennan määrittely ja kehittäminen • Palveluiden, prosessien ja governance-mallien määrittely • Kehittämisessä käytettävien työkalujen valinta, konsultointi ja koulutus Hankintayksikkö ei sitoudu hankkimaan DPS:ssä mitään vähimmäismäärää. DPS:n sisällä tehty hankintasopimus ei anna toimittajalle yksinoikeutta palvelun tuottamiseen. Dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän sisäisissä kilpailutuksissa hankintayksikkö pyytää tarjoajalta vakuutusta, että tarjoajayritystä, tai niitä yrityksiä tai henkilöitä, joiden omistuksessa, hallussa tai määräysvallassa tarjoajayritys on, tai tämän alihankkijaa ei rasita Euroopan unionin tai Yhdistyneiden kansakuntien (YK) kohdistama pakote taikka Suomen viranomaisten asettama pakote tai varojen jäädyttämispäätös. Hankintayksikkö sulkee hankintajärjestelmän sisäisestä tarjouskilpailusta pois tarjoajat, jotka eivät täytä edellä mainittua vaatimusta. Hankintayksiköllä on myös oikeus irtisanoa hankintasopimus päättymään välittömästi, jos toimittajaa rasittaa jokin yllä mainituista pakotteista tai varojen jäädyttämispäätös.

rejected.text: Short description The Landtag Brandenburg based in Potsdam is the parliament of the State of Brandenburg. The parliamentary administration acts as a service provider for the parliament and the citizens of the State of Brandenburg. The task of the parliamentary administration is to ensure the smoothest possible operation of parliamentary business and to create the organisational, personnel, technical and material conditions for the work of the members of the Landtag. Further information on the Landtag and the parliamentary administration can be found on the internet at: https://www.landtag.brandenburg.de/ In its activities, the parliamentary administration uses its own specialist IT procedure - the "Electronic Landtag Case Processing and Information System", or ELVIS for short. This supports parliamentary processes such as the preparation, implementation and follow-up of plenary and committee meetings as well as their corresponding record-keeping. It is currently used for daily work by around 60 of the 170 employees of the parliamentary administration. ELVIS no longer meets current technical and functional requirements. Therefore, this procurement procedure aims to find a provider for the introduction of a successor system. The new specialist IT procedure to be introduced bears the internal designation LISA.BB. The aim of the procurement procedure is the implementation of a modern, high-performance and future-proof system to succeed ELVIS, which supports the parliamentary work of the Landtag in a flexible and digital manner. LISA.BB is intended to map essential processes, in particular those of the plenary and committees, including record-keeping. The software-supported mapping of central workflows is intended to increase efficiency, transparency and traceability within the parliamentary administration. Seamless integration into existing and future third-party systems is intended to enable media-disruption-free end-to-end processes and avoid redundant data entry. The user interface should be designed to be user-friendly, accessible and intuitive, and the system architecture should be designed for extensibility, maintainability and adaptability to organisational and technical changes. Essential software components required for the operation of ELVIS will no longer be available in the foreseeable future. Therefore, the Landtag Brandenburg is aiming for the introduction of LISA.BB at the beginning of the year 2027. see short description

parts.source: Kurze Beschreibung Der Landtag Brandenburg mit Sitz in Potsdam ist das Parlament des Landes Brandenburg. Die Landtagsverwaltung ist Dienstleister für das Parlament und die Bürgerinnen und Bürger des Landes Brandenburg. Aufgabe der Landtagsverwaltung ist es, den möglichst reibungslosen Ablauf des parlamentarischen Betriebes sicherzustellen und die organisatorischen, personellen, technischen und materiellen Voraussetzungen für die Arbeit der Abgeordneten im Landtag zu schaffen. Mehr Informationen zum Landtag und zur Landtagsverwaltung finden sich im Internet unter: https://www.landtag.brandenburg.de/ Bei ihrer Tätigkeit nutzt die Landtagsverwaltung ein eigenes IT-Fachverfahren - das "Elektronische Landtags-Vorgangsbearbeitungs- und Informationssystem", kurz: ELVIS. Dieses unterstützt die parlamentarischen Abläufe wie die Vorbereitung, Durchführung und Nachbereitung der Sitzungen von Plenum und Ausschüssen sowie deren entsprechender Veraktung. Aktuell wird es von rund 60 der 170 Beschäftigten der Landtagsverwaltung für die tägliche Arbeit genutzt. ELVIS entspricht nicht mehr den aktuellen technischen und funktionalen Anforderungen. Daher soll mit dem vorliegenden Vergabeverfahren ein Anbieter für die Einführung eines Nachfolgesystems gefunden werden. Das neu einzuführende IT-Fachverfahren trägt die hausinterne Bezeichnung LISA.BB. Ziel des Vergabeverfahrens ist die Implementierung eines modernen, leistungsfähigen und zukunftsfähigen Systems als Nachfolge von ELVIS, das die parlamentarische Arbeit des Landtages flexibel und digital unterstützt. LISA.BB soll wesentliche Prozesse, insbesondere die des Plenums und der Ausschüsse inklusive der Veraktung abbilden. Die softwaregestützte Abbildung zentraler Arbeitsabläufe soll Effizienz, Transparenz und Nachvollziehbarkeit innerhalb der Landtagsverwaltung steigern. Eine nahtlose Integration in bestehende und künftige Drittsysteme soll medienbruchfreie End-to-End-Prozesse ermöglichen und redundante Dateneingaben vermeiden. Die Nutzeroberfläche soll benutzungsfreundlich, barrierearm und intuitiv gestaltet, die Architektur des Systems auf Erweiterbarkeit, Wartbarkeit und Anpassbarkeit an organisatorische und technische Veränderungen ausgelegt werden. Wesentliche für den Betrieb von ELVIS notwendige Softwarekomponenten werden in absehbarer Zeit nicht mehr zur Verfügung stehen. Daher strebt der Landtag Brandenburg eine Einführung von LISA.BB zu Beginn des Jahres 2027 an. siehe kurze Beschreibung

result.text: **UPDATE 5 APRIL 2024: The proposal submission date has been updated to 24 April 2024. The FOA has been amended to reflect this submission date and include a Question and Answer document based on questions received from interested applicants. Other than the updated proposal submission date in the FOA, the actual FOA Amendment has not been changed. However, the answers provided in the Q&A document are considered part of the FOA Amendment.** **CYCLE 2 UPDATE 20 MARCH 2024 - THE OPPORTUNITY WEBINAR FOR CYCLE 2 WILL BE HELD ONLINE VIA MS TEAMS AT 1500 EDT ON 22 MARCH 2024 AT THE FOLLOWING LINK: https://dod.teams.microsoft.us/l/meetup-join/19%3adod%3ameeting_5fa41fe6fa874484b473d8a6ba7921c6%40thread.v2/0?context=%7b%22Tid%22%3a%22fae6d70f-954b-4811-92b6-0530d6f84c43%22%2c%22Oid%22%3a%22e9f6fc39-8f22-44e5-8bd0-64f0cde32305%22%2c%22IsBroadcastMeeting%22%3atrue%7d **UPDATE 14 MARCH 2024 - CYCLE 2 HAS BEEN POSTED TO THE ANNOUNCEMENT. PLEASE REVIEW THE UPDATED ANNOUNCEMENT IN FULL FOR SUBMISSION TIME, UPDATED TOPIC, AND FUNDING AMOUNT AND SCHEDULE CHANGES FROM CYCLE 1** TACTICAL BEHAVIORS FOR AUTONOMOUS MANEUVER COLLABORATIVE RESEARCH PROGRAM (TBAM-CRP) Future Army forces will be called upon to operate and maneuver in multi-domain operations (MDO), against a modern and capable peer adversary. The battlefield of the future may impose additional constraints on maneuver forces such as disruption in communication as well as positioning services. To field a highly capable fighting force in this future battlefield, novel tactics and doctrines leveraging nascent technologies in robotics and autonomous systems (RAS) will need to be developed. Teams of RAS will serve an increasingly critical role in the future force to deliver situational awareness, defend key locations or positions, or take point in dynamic and hazardous situations. Resilience to disruptions, failures, or unexpected scenarios, is a key quality for teams of RAS to operate alongside other future Army forces. The US Army Combat Capabilities Development Command (DEVCOM) Army Research Laboratory (ARL) is focused on developing fundamental understanding and informing the art-of-the-possible for warfighter concepts through research to greatly improve the scope of mission capabilities of teams of RAS, develop robust and resilient approaches to plan under extreme conditions of uncertainty, to learn coordinated strategies for groups of agents to achieve a common objective, all within a complex maneuver environment including adversaries. The Tactical Behaviors for Autonomous Maneuver Collaborative Research Program (TBAM-CRP) is focused on developing and experimentally evaluating coordinated and individual behaviors for small groups of autonomous agents to learn doctrinal as well as novel tactics for maneuvering in military relevant environments. The TBAM-CRP will leverage developments in other internal and extramural programs as well as identify new research directions to find novel solutions to these maneuver problems in analogical simulations representing complex realistic terrain. The Tactical Behaviors for Autonomous Maneuver Collaborative Research Program (TBAM-CRP) will consist of a series of sprint efforts executed with annual program reviews. Each topic will be focused on addressing a different set of scientific areas which will support the research aims of an associated ARL researcher from a related internal essential research program (ERP) or mission-funded program. The TBAM-CRP has been developed in coordination with other related ARL-funded collaborative efforts (see descriptions of ARL collaborative alliances at https://www.arl.army.mil/business/collaborativealliances/) and shares a common vision of highly collaborative academia-industry-government partnerships; however, it will be executed with a program model adapted from the Scalable, Adaptive, and Resilient Autonomy (SARA), which established a new paradigm for collaborative research. Some key properties of this new approach are described below: • TBAM-CRP sprint topics will be offered on a two-year cycle. Proposals will be solicited for a possible two-year period structured as a first-year pilot followed by a second-year option where the option may be awarded based upon progress assessed at an annual review. The FOA will be amended annually to identify a specific problem statement and scope for that specific cycle. The topics for each cycle will be chosen to address the long-term program goal. • Five new topics (Cycles 1-5) are expected in FY22, 24, 26, 28, 30. Each topic will be carefully chosen based on the previous accomplishments in the prior cycle(s), the development of new technologies and capabilities in the broader research and development communities, and the Army’s evolving needs for future capabilities. • For each topic, funding will be provided to those Recipients selected under a cooperative agreement (CA). • Enhanced Research Program funding from ARL or Other Government Agencies (OGAs) may become available during a cycle which provides a mechanism for growth and enhancement within the TBAM-CRP. A proposal should not include any discussion of the Enhanced Research Program. Recipients receiving a CA will be notified and provided details if the opportunity for Enhanced Research Program funding becomes available during their award period of performance. • There is no limitation on the place of performance, although on-site collaboration at ARL facilities and with ARL researchers as well as with other Recipients are encouraged. Research outcomes in this program must, at the very least, be demonstrated in sophisticated simulations of relevant environments. Together with ARL collaborators, these results may be adapted for higher TRL experimentation on surrogate platforms at ARL test facilities such as the Robotics Research Collaboration Campus (R2C2) at Graces Quarters, Aberdeen Proving Ground, Maryland.

result.text: • Recipients will be furnished with access to the ARL Autonomy Stack software suite as well as all relevant simulation tools and multi-agent learning support. • Recipients will be provided with information about the current state of the Autonomous Systems Enterprise (ASE) with an overview of developments in the associated collaborative research alliances including Distributed and Collaborative Intelligent Systems and Technology (DCIST), Scalable, Adaptive, and Resilient Autonomy (SARA), as well as internal ARL essential research programs including the AI for Maneuver and Mobility (AIMM), Emerging Overmatch Technologies (EOT), and Versatile Tactical Power and Propulsion (VICTOR). Capabilities demonstrated in simulation should reflect significant appropriate developments. This midpoint review is expected to take place as a mini symposium where Recipients can share results with one another along with the ARL community to foster further collaboration. • At the end of the second year, a capstone demonstration will be executed by those Recipients receiving an option to their award in a set of simulated relevant environments, either those environment scenarios provided by the Government and other program performers, or optionally of a specific environment developed by the Recipient to exhibit their developed capability. Any system level capability demonstration that can be made with the internal ARL collaborator or description of capability development and program contribution can also be made at this time. These system demonstrations are expected to coincide to foster further integration and adoption with related internal research programs as well as partner organizations from within the DEVCOM, other Army and DoD service branches and agencies, in addition to other government agencies. Proposals that follow the requirements of the FOA will be evaluated in accordance with merit-based, competitive procedures. These procedures will include evaluation factors and an adjectival and color rating system. A review team, consisting of a qualified group of Government scientists and managers will evaluate the compliant proposals and provide the results of that evaluation to the decision-maker for the Government. Relevant internal research program materials approved for public release and contact information will be provided to potential proposers during introductory presentations to help facilitate identification of collaboration between proposers and individual ARL researchers or internal research programs. Additional connections to ARL programs can be identified during the proposal review process. Eligible applicants under this FOA include institutions of higher education, nonprofit organizations, and for-profit organizations (i.e., large and small businesses) for scientific research in the knowledge domains outlined throughout this Funding Opportunity. Federally Funded Research and Development Centers (FFRDC) may propose as well, with effort as allowed by their sponsoring agency and in accordance with their sponsoring agency policy.
