result.text: Novari IKS plans to implement a competition for the EPJ for the public dental health service. Background: The public dental health service (hereafter called DOT) needs better interaction and information exchange with other parts of the health service; municipal health and welfare services, the specialist health service, as well as in a private dental health sector. All counties have a need for new systems. A joint project called DigiDOT (digitalisation of the public dental health service) has therefore been established and a cooperation with the Supplier Development Programme (LUP) has been established, where the tenderers now wish to continue with dialogue activities with the suppliers. The project group has prepared a goal picture as well as a procurement and competition strategy that will enable tenders to be submitted for one or several areas. The intention of this dialogue is to clarify the process connected to the EPJ system for the dental health service. At the same time a plan has been prepared for the procurements that shall be implemented in the extension of the dialogue. Both the goal picture and the plan for a dialogue and procurement process are incorporated into the presentation that is attached to this notice (Basic Document). Furthermore, NOVARI IKS has announced an open tender contest for assistance with the development of a new joint information storage system. Information on the tender contest can be re-enquired when it is available if required. We would, thus, like feedback from relevant tenderers before the competition is announced through this RFI.

result.text: The subject of the procurement is Fingrid’s purchase order and invoice management system delivered as a SaaS service. The software service is intended to support the entire procure-to-pay process in the target state, including purchase requests (free text, catalog, punchout catalog), purchase orders, order confirmations, receipt of goods, invoice receipt and processing. As part of the invoice processing functionality, the system must also include e-invoicing operator capabilities, enabling the sending and receiving of electronic invoices in accordance with applicable standards and integration requirements. Additionally, the system must include functionalities for supplier management, contract management, and mini competitions. The procured SaaS service must include user licenses for all Fingrid employees. The procurement also includes an implementation project, which is preliminarily planned to start during the first half of 2026. The implementation is intended to proceed in phases and be completed by Q4/2026. The support and advisory service included in the procurement serves as a second-level support channel (2nd line support) for Fingrid’s key users/application owners in case of incidents. In addition, during the contract period, the Client may procure development work, project work, and extensions to expand and improve the subject of the procurement. A more detailed description of the procurement is provided in Annex 1 of the procurement notice, Project Description.

result.text: The procurement is being carried out as a procurement consortium involving the City of Helsinki and DigiHelsinki Oy (hereinafter the "Client"). The subject of the procurement is delivery and operational services for Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Power Platform systems and related technologies (hereinafter also "Applications"), as well as further development and other expert services included in this package. Services refer to both expert services during implementation projects and development projects, as well as continuous services after implementation, such as support and maintenance services, further development, processing of change requests, technical expert support, architecture and integration expertise, service management tasks, and training. The services may include the definition, design, implementation, testing, and deployment of the Applications, as well as operation, maintenance, support, and development services, architecture services, any data migrations and integrations included in the implementations, support for process harmonisation during deliveries, and assessment of licence needs, as well as training services and documentation. The Applications to be implemented on the basis of this procurement subject will be produced on the Microsoft Dynamics 365 or Power Platform. A framework arrangement will be formed from the procurement, from which three suppliers will be selected in order of priority. The tendering process will be carried out using an open procedure. Each participant in the procurement consortium will make its own procurement decision and contract with the tenderers selected for the framework arrangement. The maximum value of the procurement is nine (9) million euros (VAT 0 %). Based on the framework arrangement, the Client and the Client's sectors, agencies, public utility services, and DigiHelsinki Oy may procure the Services or Continuous services referred to in the framework arrangement through separate delivery contracts. Delivery contracts may also relate to Applications implemented by the Client itself or in cooperation with other contractual partners. If several suppliers participate in the implementation, maintenance, or further development of the same Application, the division of responsibilities and the suppliers' cooperation obligations will be defined in the delivery contract. Deliveries may also include components implemented with other technologies in connection with Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Power Platform implementations, such as integration into an external database, interface, or software component, etc. The subject and scope of the procurement are set out in more detail in the call for tenders and its appendices.

parts.source: Hankinta toteutetaan hankintarenkaana, jossa on mukana Helsingin kaupunki ja DigiHelsinki Oy (jäljempänä "Tilaaja"). Hankinnan kohteena on Microsoft Dynamics 365 ja Power Platform -järjestelmiin ja näihin liittyviin teknologioihin (jäljempänä myös ”Sovellukset”) toimitus- ja käytönaikaisia palveluita sekä jatkokehitystä ja muita tähän kokonaisuuteen sisältyviä asiantuntijapalveluita. Palveluilla tarkoitetaan sekä käyttöönottoprojektien ja kehittämishankkeiden aikaisia asiantuntijapalveluja että käyttöönoton jälkeisiä jatkuvia palveluja, kuten tuki- ja ylläpitopalveluja, jatkokehitystä, muutospyyntöjen käsittelyä, teknistä asiantuntijatukea, arkkitehtuuri- ja integraatio-osaamista, palvelunhallintaan liittyviä tehtäviä sekä koulutuksia. Palvelut voivat sisältää Sovellusten määrittelyä, suunnittelua, toteutusta, testaamista, käyttöönottoja, sekä käyttö-, ylläpito-, tuki- ja kehityspalveluita, arkkitehtuuripalveluita, mahdollisia toteutuksiin sisältyviä datamigraatioita ja integraatioita, toimitusten aikaista prosessien harmonisointitukea ja lisenssitarpeiden arviointia sekä koulutuspalveluita ja dokumentointia. Tämän hankinnan kohteen pohjalta toteutettavat Sovellukset tuotetaan Microsoft Dynamics 365- tai Power Platform -alustalle. Hankinnasta muodostetaan puitejärjestely, johon valitaan kolme toimittajaa etusijajärjestyksellä. Kilpailutus toteutetaan avoimella menettelyllä. Hankintarenkaaseen osallistuvat tekevät kumpikin oman hankintapäätöksen ja sopimuksen puitejärjestelyyn valittujen tarjoajien kanssa. Hankinnan enimmäisarvo on yhdeksän (9) miljoonaa euroa (alv 0 %). Puitejärjestelyn perusteella Tilaaja ja Tilaajan toimialat, virastot, liikelaitokset ja DigiHelsinki Oy voivat hankkia Puitejärjestelyn tarkoittamia Palveluita tai Jatkuvia palveluita erillisillä toimitussopimuksilla. Toimitussopimukset voivat liittyä myös Tilaajan itse toteuttamiin tai yhteistyössä muiden sopimuskumppanien kanssa toteutettuihin Sovelluksiin. Jos saman Sovelluksen toteuttamiseen, ylläpitoon tai jatkokehittämiseen osallistuu useita toimittajia, vastuunjako ja toimittajien yhteistyövelvoitteet määritellään toimitussopimuksessa. Toimitukset voivat sisältää Microsoft Dynamics 365- ja Power Platform -toteutusten yhteydessä myös muilla teknologioilla toteutettuja komponentteja, kuten esimerkiksi integraation ulkoiseen tietokantaan, rajapintaan, tai ohjelmistokomponenttiin tms. Hankinnan kohde ja laajuus käy ilmi tarkemmin tarjouspyynnöstä ja sen liitteistä.

result.text: Helsingin kaupungin asunnot Oy (Heka) requests tenders for a purchase invoice accounting and routing solution using artificial intelligence (SaaS service) and related implementation, training and expert services. The objective of the procurement is to streamline the processing of purchase invoices, reduce manual work, improve the quality of accounting entries and increase the level of automated processing. The solution to be offered must enable: - analysis and utilisation of purchase invoice data - generation of accounting forecasts at invoice and line level - automated routing of invoices - continuous learning of the solution and improvement of forecasts based on usage - utilisation of corrections made by users in the development of models - reporting and monitoring of service performance. The solution must integrate with Heka's current purchase invoice system via the interfaces of the DataCycle360 system. A 24-month fixed-term contract will be concluded for the procurement, after which the contract period will continue until further notice. The contract will enter into force when the procurement contract has been signed by both parties. The more detailed content of the procurement, functional requirements, integration requirements and service level requirements are presented in the appendices to the call for tenders.

parts.source: Helsingin kaupungin asunnot Oy (Heka) pyytää tarjouksia ostolaskujen tiliöinti- ja reititysratkaisusta tekoälyä hyödyntäen (SaaS-palvelu) sekä siihen liittyvistä käyttöönotto-, koulutus- ja asiantuntijapalveluista. Hankinnan tavoitteena on tehostaa ostolaskujen käsittelyä, vähentää manuaalista työtä, parantaa tiliöintien laatua sekä nostaa automaattisen käsittelyn astetta. Tarjottavan ratkaisun tulee mahdollistaa: - ostolaskudatan analysointi ja hyödyntäminen - tiliöintiennusteiden muodostaminen lasku- ja rivitasolla - laskujen automatisoitu reititys - ratkaisun jatkuva oppiminen ja ennusteiden parantaminen käytön perusteella - käyttäjien tekemien korjausten hyödyntäminen mallien kehittämisessä - raportointi ja seuranta palvelun suorituskyvystä. Ratkaisun tulee integroitua Hekan nykyiseen ostolaskujärjestelmään DataCycle360-järjestelmän rajapintojen kautta. Hankinnassa tehdään 24 kuukauden määräaikainen sopimus, jonka jälkeen sopimuskausi jatkuu toistaiseksi voimassa olevana. Sopimus tulee voimaan, kun hankintasopimus on allekirjoitettu molempien osapuolten toimesta. Hankinnan tarkempi sisältö, toiminnalliset vaatimukset, integraatiovaatimukset sekä palvelutasovaatimukset on esitetty tarjouspyynnön liitteissä.

Context and requirements Terms and acronyms GCP = Google Cloud Platform SOW = Statement of Work DAP = Data Action Plan Overview Summary of the work DfT requires a data delivery partner to support the central data team with GCP-based technical delivery and wider Chief Data Officer priorities. Work will be commissioned through individual SOWs, aligned to team business plans, internal governance, technical processes, GDS standards and accessibility requirements. Pricing model Capped time and materials Provide further information Other charging mechanisms may be used subject to agreement by both parties. Confirm if you require a contracted out service or supply of resource Contracted out service: the off-payroll rules do not apply Organisation the work is for The Department for Transport (DfT) works alongside our agencies and partners to support the transport network. DfT champions data and technology to drive the integrated, innovative and accessible transport system of the future. Latest start date 2026-12-14 Expected contract length 5-00-00 Expected contract structure 3+1+1 Estimated contract value (excl VAT) 8000000 Budget details DfT does not commit to spend the full contract value. About the work Why the work is being done The work is being done to support the growing demand for high-quality data both within the department and the wider sector. The work of the central data team support and range of activities across that provide data support across the department, ALBs and wider transport sector. This includes the delivery of the actions in the transport Data Action Plan (DAP) with an increased focus on how we can further support local authorities and transport organisations with greater devolution of the transport sector. This technical data work sits alongside research to support the DAP and our ambitious AI programme. The work is being specified as individual SOWs to ensure we align to the current priorities for government and to make the most of technology in a complex and evolving landscape. Problem to be solved Following on from the transport DAP we are looking to deliver improved capacity and maturity of data projects across the DfT and greater collaboration across the wider sector. With a focus on both enhanced governance and communication while continuing to innovate as new technology is developed. This contract is design to compliment some of the research being undertaken for the action plan and the AI Delivery, Development, Research and Evaluation Support contract. This contract is designed to allow us to move quickly when new areas of work are identified and to support data projects across the wider DfT. Who the users are and what they need to do The contract is to support analysts, engineers and data specialists in continuing to improve and modernise our internal data landscape. This is to support policy development, analysis and enhanced use of Google Cloud technology to meet our commitments in the transport Data Action Plan. Preliminary market engagement A pre-market engagement call took place on 26th August. The slides and Q&A document are attached. Work done so far We have existing data maturity assessments and governance but these need to evolve in light of changes in technology and the increased importance of data in the wider transport landscape. We have already undertaken a discovery on APIs for DfT which can be found here: Developing application programming interfaces at DfT - GOV.UK Following this, work has begun on building an API developer portal in Apigee to host and share the first wave of DfT APIs. Existing team The existing central data team sits with the Chief Data Office in the Analysis Directorate. The central data team (D:ETLA) is around 20 experts covering: data engineering, data policy (inc. governance, maturity and standards), data transformation (delivering on the data action plan) and a crisis data function. We sit alongside the advanced analytics team who lead our internal AI programme and data science functions and the central stats team who has responsibility for our geospatial data strategy. We work alongside colleagues in our digital service function on a range of technical projects using GCP. Incumbent supplier No Provide further information Linked projects Work setup Working arrangements We expect the supplier to work in a blended way alongside the DfT team to deliver the priorities. With suppliers providing the project management and overseeing the day-to-day delivery for the work. We expect the governance model for each project to be agreed as part of the SoW and that technical projects to be delivered in an agile way. Where possible we expect the lead for each project to engage face to face at least once a month with the DfT lead. We have staff based in London, Birmingham, Leeds and Hastings. We expect invoices on a monthly basis to manage the spend against the fixed price contracts. We request suppliers to model the behaviours expected of the civil service and work in an inclusive way with the DfT teams. Security clearance Security Check (SC) Additional information on security clearance We expect any suppliers doing technical work in our GCP environment or with access to the DfT systems (including SharePoint) to hold a minimum of SC clearance. For those undertaking more general data management work that does not require access to our GCP environment then BPSS is sufficient. Special terms and conditions 2.

result.text: Select group name Technical Capability Award criteria Enter your question Technical Questions 1 - Production data services on Google Cloud Platform Please describe how you would design, build, operate and support production data services on Google Cloud Platform for this requirement, supported by relevant delivery examples. Cover service selection, Cloud Workflows, Cloud Run and Eventarc, Apigee and Knowledge Catalogue where relevant, secure connectivity, identities and permissions, data protection, secrets, audit logging, monitoring, resilience, cost management and operational support. Select group name Technical Criteria Award criteria Enter your question Technical Question 2 - Infrastructure as Code Please describe how you would establish, maintain and govern Infrastructure as Code for this requirement, particularly Terraform, supported by relevant examples of comparable delivery. Cover code structure, reusable versioned modules, testing, documentation, environment promotion, CI/CD controls, failed deployment recovery and collaborative handover or operation. Select group name Technical Criteria Award criteria Enter your question Technical Question 3 - Identity and Access Management based on least privilege Please describe how you would design, implement, govern and assure Identity and Access Management for this requirement in accordance with least privilege, supported by relevant examples. Cover tightly scoped permissions, predefined or custom roles, user and service-account access, privileged access, separation of duties, environment controls and remediation of excessive permissions. Select group name Technical Criteria Award criteria Enter your question Technical Question 4 - Architectural patterns, constraints and approval Please describe how you would work within existing organisational architectural patterns and constraints for this requirement, and how you would develop, justify and secure approval for a new pattern where an existing approach does not meet the requirement. Cover options, trade-offs, risks, rationale, stakeholder communication, approval, adoption and maintainability. Select group name Technical Criteria Award criteria Enter your question Social Value Question 1 - Diverse SME supply chain and portfolio management Describe how you will engage, manage and maintain a diverse portfolio of SMEs during the contract where this supports effective delivery. Cover identification and engagement, meaningful SoW-aligned involvement, portfolio refresh, onboarding, quality, security, commercial and delivery risk, performance metrics, reporting and fair access to opportunities. result.text: Bodø municipality invites tenderers to a market dialogue for the planned procurement of one or several systems that shall cover the need for handling orders, contract follow-up, analysis and competition implementation. These processes make up central parts of the municipality's procurement, contract and financial flow, and include functionality for procurements based on contracts, administration of contracts, analysis of invoice and ordering data, as well as a tool for planning and holding procurements. The objective of the market dialogue is to gain better insight into what technical and functional possibilities the market can offer, and on this basis design one or several procurement(s) that are as relevant as possible. The dialogue shall give the municipality an understanding of how the needs can be solved, either through a comprehensive system, a module based approach and/or separate systems. It shall also contribute to highlighting dependencies, integration possibilities, technological maturity, future development direction in the market, as well as possible risks and possibilities that ought to be included in the evaluation.

result.text: The Neuruppiner Wohnungsbaugesellschaft mbH (contracting authority) is planning the retendering and implementation of a modern ERP software solution for managing its portfolio of around 5.000 economic units. Due to the anticipated contract value, the procurement will be carried out within the framework of an EU-wide negotiated procedure with a call for competition (above-threshold range). To prepare for this procurement procedure and to precisely determine the subject matter of the contract, the contracting authority is hereby conducting a market consultation pursuant to Section 28 VgV. The aim of this consultation is to examine the current state of the art and market availability of specific requirements and to incorporate them into the final specification. A non-binding product presentation is sought.

parts.source: Die Neuruppiner Wohnungsbaugesellschaft mbH (Auftraggeberin) plant die Neuausschreibung und Implementierung einer modernen ERP-Softwarelösung zur Verwaltung ihres Bestandes von rund 5.000 Wirtschaftseinheiten. Aufgrund des voraussichtlichen Auftragswerts wird die Beschaffung im Rahmen eines EU-weiten Verhandlungsverfahrens mit Teilnahmewettbewerb (Oberschwellenbereich) durchgeführt. Zur Vorbereitung dieses Vergabeverfahrens und zur präzisen Ermittlung des Leistungsgegenstandes führt die Auftraggeberin hiermit eine Markterkundung gemäß § 28 VgV durch. Ziel dieser Erkundung ist es, den aktuellen Stand der Technik sowie die Marktverfügbarkeit spezifischer Anforderungen zu prüfen und in die finale Leistungsbeschreibung einfließen zu lassen. Es wird eine unverbindliche Produktvorstellung angestrebt.

result.text: With this tender, University Medical Center Mainz intends to procure, implement and operate a new hospital information system. The subject of the contract is the implementation and operation of a hospital information system (HIS) for Universitätsmedizin der Johannes Gutenberg-Universität Mainz KöR (hereinafter referred to as "UM"). The project comprises the introduction of a hospital information system (HIS), which includes a clinical workstation system (CWS) with integrated patient administration and billing. The aim is to provide seamless, efficient and future-proof support for administrative and clinical processes and to ensure long-term operation. Further information on the subject of the tender can be found in the specification of services. This will be made available to all interested companies as part of the application procedure. Further information will be provided upon submission of a confidentiality agreement. Details can be found in Appendix 1 to these procurement documents.

parts.source: Die Universitätsmedizin Mainz beabsichtigt mit dieser Ausschreibung ein neues Krankenhausinformationssystem zu beschaffen, zu implementieren und zu betreiben. Gegenstand der Vergabe ist die Implementierung und der Betrieb eines Krankenhausinformationssystems (KIS) für die Universitätsmedizin der Johannes Gutenberg-Universität Mainz KöR (im Folgenden "UM"). Das Projekt umfasst die Einführung eines Krankenhausinformationssystems (KIS), welches ein klinisches Arbeitsplatzsystem (KAS) mit integrierter Patientenverwaltung und Abrechnung umfasst. Ziel ist es, eine durchgängige, effiziente und zukunftsfähige Unterstützung der administrativen und klinischen Prozesse bereitzustellen und den Betrieb langfristig sicherzustellen. Nähere Informationen zum Ausschreibungsgegenstand sind der Leistungsbeschreibung zu entnehmen. Diese wird im Rahmen des Teilnahmewettbewerbs allen interessierten Unternehmen bereitgestellt. Weitere Informationen werden gegen Abgabe einer Vertraulichkeitserklärung zur Verfügung gestellt. Die Einzelheiten sind der Anlage 1 zu diesen Vergabeunterlagen zu entnehmen.

result.text: MARKET DIALOGUE The subject of the market dialogue is the planned procurement of translation, language editing, subtitling and transcription services for the needs of Väylävirasto. Väylävirasto produces a wide range of official communications, expert content and stakeholder-targeted materials in multiple languages as part of its statutory duties. Translation and language editing services are a key part of the accessibility, quality, comprehensibility and consistency of official communications. BACKGROUND AND OBJECTIVES The subject of the procurement is a comprehensive service package for translation, language editing, subtitling and transcription services, through which subscribers can procure translation services for various language pairs, language editing for texts written in the target language, and subtitling and transcription services for video and audio materials. Service needs are focused in particular on the Swedish and English languages. The materials to be handled are principally factual texts, presentations, documents (e.g. call for tenders, contracts), speeches, brochures, articles and web content. Subtitling and transcription services relate, inter alia, to videos, online events and audio recordings, taking accessibility requirements into account. The aim of the procurement is to ensure a high-quality, cost-effective and reliable service package that supports subscribers' communications, information accessibility and the fulfilment of official obligations. The objective is a procurement model that enables smooth ordering, consistent end results and an administratively light operating method even in situations where the volume of assignments is large and the value of individual assignments is small. By means of the market dialogue, the contracting entity seeks to obtain information on service models existing in the market, pricing structures, quality assurance practices, and the utilisation of artificial intelligence and other automation as part of the production of translation and language editing services. The dialogue will also examine various contractual and supplier models, including the suitability of single-supplier and multi-supplier models. The procurement includes a cooperation model in which the subscriber and the supplier systematically develop the service throughout the contract period. The aim of the cooperation is the continuous improvement of the service, taking into account the subscriber's guidelines and terminology, and developing the service to meet changing needs and operating environments. The subject matter, scope and technical solutions of the procurement may be refined and/or changed as the procurement preparation and market dialogue progress. PRELIMINARY TIMETABLE The subscriber's target timetable for carrying out the market dialogue and procurement is: - Market dialogue (technical dialogue), February-March 2026 - Publication of the call for tenders and calculation period, March-April 2026 - Comparison of tenders and procurement decision, April-May 2026 - Contract entry into force and commencement of cooperation, May 2026 onwards ----- ADDITIONAL NOTICE DETAILS This notice is a prior information notice. This notice does not request tenders. The prior information notice is accompanied by an invitation to a market dialogue, whereby all suppliers interested in the procurement have the opportunity to engage in a technical dialogue concerning the procurement with Väylävirasto. The purpose of the technical dialogue is to discuss the subject of the procurement and its definition at a general level. The technical dialogue does not bind Väylävirasto to carry out the procurement. Nor does the technical dialogue bind the supplier to participate in a possible tendering procedure. The technical dialogue will be organised through commenting on draft versions of the call for tenders material and answering the subscriber's questions relating to the subject of the procurement. Instructions for registration: The supplier must notify its interest in participating in the market dialogue by 25.2.2026 at 12.00 by sending a message to tommi.aarnio@vayla.fi with the subject heading: "Käännöspalvelut - markkinavuoropuhelu" [Translation services - market dialogue]. The supplier is requested to provide the following information in the message: - the email address of the supplier's contact person The subscriber reserves the right to also invite suppliers to bilateral negotiations or to continue the technical dialogue in another manner to be announced separately, which will be notified later if necessary. The descriptions presented in this prior information notice and the estimated publication date of the procurement notice, as well as the draft dialogue materials to be provided later, are preliminary and indicative prior information regarding the procurement. Participating companies will not be paid compensation for responding or participating.

parts.source: MARKKINAVUOROPUHELU Markkinavuoropuhelun kohteena on valmistelussa oleva käännös-, kielenhuolto-, tekstitys- ja litterointipalveluiden hankinta Väyläviraston tarpeisiin. Väylävirasto tuottaa laajasti viranomaisviestintää, asiantuntijasisältöjä ja sidosryhmille suunnattuja materiaaleja useilla kielillä osana lakisääteisiä tehtäviään. Käännös- ja kielenhuoltopalvelut ovat keskeinen osa viranomaisviestinnän saavutettavuutta, laatua, ymmärrettävyyttä ja yhdenmukaisuutta. TAUSTAA JA TAVOITTEET Hankinnan kohteena on käännös-, kielenhuolto-, tekstitys- ja litterointipalveluiden kokonaispalvelu, jonka kautta tilaaja voivat hankkia eri kieliparien käännöspalveluita, kohdekielellä kirjoitettujen tekstien kielenhuoltoa sekä video- ja ääniaineistojen tekstitys- ja litterointipalveluita. Palvelutarpeet painottuvat erityisesti ruotsin ja englannin kieliin. Käsiteltävät aineistot ovat pääsääntöisesti asiatekstejä, esityksiä, dokumentteja (esim. tarjouspyynnöt, sopimukset), puheita, esitteitä, artikkeleita ja verkkosisältöjä. Tekstitys- ja litterointipalvelut liittyvät muun muassa videoihin, verkkotilaisuuksiin ja äänitallenteisiin, joissa huomioidaan saavutettavuusvaatimukset. Hankinnan tavoitteena on varmistaa laadukas, kustannustehokas ja toimintavarma palvelukokonaisuus, joka tukee tilaajien viestintää, tiedon saavutettavuutta ja viranomaisvelvoitteiden toteuttamista. Tavoitteena on hankintamalli, joka mahdollistaa sujuvan tilaamisen, tasalaatuisen lopputuloksen sekä hallinnollisesti kevyen toimintatavan myös tilanteissa, joissa toimeksiantojen määrä on suuri ja yksittäisten toimeksiantojen arvo pieni. Markkinavuoropuhelun avulla hankintayksikkö pyrkii saamaan tietoa markkinoilla olevista palvelumalleista, hinnoittelurakenteista, laadunvarmistuskäytännöistä sekä tekoälyn ja muun automaation hyödyntämisestä osana käännös- ja kielenhuoltopalveluiden tuotantoa. Vuoropuhelussa tarkastellaan myös erilaisia sopimus- ja toimittajamalleja, mukaan lukien yhden ja useamman toimittajan mallien soveltuvuutta. Hankintaan sisältyy yhteistyömalli, jossa tilaaja ja toimittaja kehittävät palvelua suunnitelmallisesti koko sopimuskauden ajan. Yhteistyön tavoitteena on palvelun jatkuva parantaminen, tilaajan ohjeistusten ja terminologian huomioiminen sekä palvelun kehittäminen vastaamaan muuttuvia tarpeita ja toimintaympäristöä. Hankinnan kohde, laajuus ja tekniset ratkaisut voivat täsmentyä ja/tai muuttua hankinnan valmistelun ja markkinavuoropuhelun edetessä. ALUSTAVA AIKATAULU Tilaajan tavoiteaikataulu markkinavuoropuhelun ja hankinnan toteuttamiselle on: - Markkinavuoropuhelu (tekninen vuoropuhelu), helmi-maaliskuu 2026 - Tarjouspyynnön julkaisu ja laskenta-aika, maalis-huhtikuu 2026 - Tarjousten vertailu ja hankintapäätös, huhti-toukokuu 2026 - Sopimus voimaan ja yhteistyön aloitus, toukokuu 2026 eteenpäin ----- ILMOITUKSEN LISÄTIEDOT Tämä ilmoitus on ennakkoilmoitus. Tällä ilmoituksella ei pyydetä tarjouksia. Ennakkoilmoitukseen liittyy kutsu markkinavuoropuheluun, jolloin kaikilla hankinnasta kiinnostuneilla toimittajilla on mahdollisuus käydä hankintaa koskevaa teknistä vuoropuhelua Väyläviraston kanssa. Teknisen vuoropuhelun tarkoituksena on käydä yleisellä tasolla vuoropuhelua hankinnan kohteesta ja sen määrittämisestä. Tekninen vuoropuhelu ei sido Väylävirastoa toteuttamaan hankintaa. Tekninen vuoropuhelu ei myöskään sido toimittajaa mahdolliseen tarjouskilpailuun osallistumiseen. Tekninen vuoropuhelu järjestetään tarjouspyyntöaineiston luonnosversioiden kommentoinnin ja tilaajan hankinnan kohteeseen liittyviin kysymyksiin vastaamisen kautta. Ilmoittautumisohje: Toimittajan tulee ilmoittaa kiinnostuksensa osallistua markkinavuoropuheluun 25.2.2026 klo 12.00 mennessä lähettämällä viesti osoitteeseen tommi.aarnio@vayla.fi otsikolla: "Käännöspalvelut - markkinavuoropuhelu". Toimittajaa pyydetään ilmoittamaan viestissä seuraavat tiedot: - toimittajan yhteyshenkilön sähköpostiosoite Tilaaja varaa oikeuden kutsua toimittajia myös kahdenkeskisiin neuvotteluihin tai jatkaa teknistä vuoropuhelua muulla erikseen ilmoitettavalla tavalla, joista ilmoitetaan tarvittaessa myöhemmin. Tässä ennakkoilmoituksessa esitetyt kuvaukset ja hankintailmoituksen arvioitu julkaisupäivämäärä, kuten myös myöhemmin toimitettavat vuoropuhelun luonnosmateriaalit ovat alustavia ja suuntaa antavia hankinnan ennakkotietoja. Osallistuneille yrityksille ei makseta korvausta vastaamisesta tai osallistumisesta.

result.text: South Lanarkshire Council are looking to notify the market of a potential future contract opportunity to deliver Sign In/Sign Out facilities for Operatives within Grounds Services and Waste Services, although it is possible that this may be extended to other Services within the Council in the future. This facility would initially be required for approximately 900 employees across 10 separate locations. Given the nature of the duties which these Operatives carry out, the use of cards, fobs, and lanyards is not practical for Health & Safety reasons. The preference would be to use fingerprint reader technology, although the facility to manually sign in or sign out using alternative methods, such as a username/password or PIN, would be required for both onsite and offsite use. As South Lanarkshire Council has recently implemented Oracle Fusion Cloud and uses the Oracle Time and Labour (OTL) module of that system within some Service Areas, it is a requirement that any Sign In/Sign Out System operates or integrates directly with the OTL module. The link between the two systems would allow for the transfer of sign in/sign out details, working patterns, annual leave, sickness absence, public holidays, season shutdowns, new starts, departures, etc. Grounds Services and Waste Services are looking to go out to tender in April 2026, with an award date of June 2026, and an implementation start date of September 2026. Please complete and return market engagement questionnaire to Georgie.Howley@southlanarkshire.gov.uk to register your interest. Lot 1: . Grounds Services and Waste Services are looking to go out to tender in April 2026, with an award date of June 2026, and an implementation start date of September 2026. Please complete and return market engagement questionnaire to Georgie.Howley@southlanarkshire.gov.uk to register your interest.

result.text: The subject of the tender is the commissioning of strategic and operational consulting services for the health and long-term care insurance fund KNAPPSCHAFT (incl. cross-sectional areas and regional directorates). The overarching objective is the stabilisation and, in the long term, the consolidation of the KNAPPSCHAFT within the KBS network system as well as the creation of an efficient and competitive organisational structure. The specific service requirements include, among other things, the optimisation of management capability and performance in the core service areas of the KNAPPSCHAFT, the optimisation of financial processes in the joint carrier DRV KBS, the improvement of processes and efficiency, particularly with regard to personnel deployment, as well as the derivation of possible organisational adjustments, the redefinition of the strategic orientation and market position after successful consolidation, and support for transformation processes, change management, empowerment and communication. This is a framework agreement. The services are to be provided upon call-off by the contractor. The maximum call-off volume of the framework agreement is 23 million euros incl. VAT. There is no obligation to call off and, accordingly, no entitlement to remuneration.

parts.source: Gegenstand der Ausschreibung ist die Beauftragung von strategischen und operativen Beratungsleistungen für die Kranken- und Pflegeversicherung KNAPPSCHAFT (inkl. Querschnittsbereichen und Regionaldirektionen). Die übergeordnete Zielsetzung ist die Stabilisierung und perspektivisch die Konsolidierung der KNAPPSCHAFT innerhalb des Verbundsystems der KBS sowie die Schaffung einer effizienten und wettbewerbsfähigen Organisationsstruktur. Zur konkreten Leistungsanforderung gehören u.a. die Optimierung der Steuerungsfähigkeit und Leistungsfähigkeit in den Kernleistungsbereichen der KNAPPSCHAFT, die Optimierung der Finanzprozesse im Verbundträger DRV KBS, die Verbesserung der Prozesse und der Effizienz insbesondere im Hinblick auf den Personaleinsatz sowie Ableitung möglicher Organisationsanpassungen, die Neufestlegung der strategischen Ausrichtung und Marktposition nach erfolgter Konsolidierung sowie Begleitung der Transformationsprozesse, Change Management, Befähigung und Kommunikation. Es handelt sich um einen Rahmenvertrag. Die Leistungen sind nach Abruf durch den Auftragnehmer zu erbringen. Die abrufbare Höchstmenge der Rahmenvereinbarung liegt bei 23 Mio. Euro inkl. result.text: As part of the FSA’s commitment to ensure food is safe and is what it says it is, the FSA undertakes food safety risk assessments which underpin these decisions in line with the internationally recognised ‘Codex Working Principles for Risk Analysis for Food Safety’. A key component of food safety risk assessment is exposure assessment, which estimates the amount of a hazard consumed through the diet. Exposure assessment combines food consumption data with information on the concentrations of substances such as contaminants, food additives or pesticide residues in food to estimate the levels consumers may be exposed to. To conduct UK dietary exposure assessments, the FSA uses consumption data in combination with occurrence data for hazards and other substances in food. UK consumption data is primarily obtained from the UK National Diet and Nutrition Survey (NDNS). The National Diet and Nutrition Survey (NDNS) is a co-funded programme between the Department of Health and Social Care (DHSC) Office for Health Improvement and Disparities (OHID) and FSA. NDNS is a rolling programme which assesses the diet, nutrient intake and nutritional status of the general population of the UK. Tenders are invited to carry out the recoding of NDNS consumption data to FoodEx2, a standardised system for classifying and describing food. Lot 1: . None

result.text: This notice is not an official launch of our procurement(s), it is to alert the market to future opportunities and allow us to begin conversations that will shape plans for multiple future requirements. The Cabinet Office (Government Skills Group) is transforming the way learning and development (L&D) is designed, procured, and delivered across the Civil Service. Following the announcement by the Chief Secretary to the Prime Minister, the government is establishing the new National School of Government and Public Services (hereon The National School). The National School is tasked with delivering high-quality, targeted training to approximately 558,000 civil servants, developing executive leadership in the wider public sector, and to partner with public sector training bodies. The strategic goal of the National School is to shift away from the historically outsourced prime-supplier managed-service model. In its place, the Cabinet Office is building an insourced, hybrid capability. Under this new Future Operating Model (FOM), the Cabinet Office will directly manage core operations, standard curricula, and stakeholder engagement. However, expert external provision will remain a critical element of the programme. The National School transformation programme relies on three core, interdependent pillars to transition Civil Service training away from fully outsourced prime-supplier models toward an in-house, hybrid operating model by April 2028. Together, these pillars work to build direct relationships with suppliers, provide a modern digital learning infrastructure, and establish robust in-house operational workflows. Pillar 1: Future Supplier Partnerships (FSP) The FSP project serves as the commercial enabler of the new operating model, building the in-house capability required to buy learning services and manage supply chains directly. We aim to establish direct, value-driven contractual relationships with UK-based SMEs, universities, business schools, and niche providers. The project team have identified an indicative Three-Stage Roadmap to enable this delivery: Stage 1 (Immediate - April 2027): Procuring urgent digital and specialist training needs that cannot be fulfilled through existing frameworks. Stage 2 (April 2027-March 2028): Phased procurement for core, National School-sponsored curriculum, coaching, and talent programmes. Stage 3 (March 2028 onwards): On-going phased procurements falling out of Stages 1 and 2, depending on the length of contracts identified. The scope of the requirements will cover several key procurement categories, including, but not limited to, specialised coaching pools (including for neuro-diverse leaders), blended training delivery, learning design (retaining Crown Intellectual Property), access to subject matter experts including within academia, independent research and evaluation, helpdesk/admin surge, and off-the-shelf qualifications. Pillar 2: Future Technologies (FT) The Future Technologies project focuses on designing and implementing the digital architecture required to run a personalised training operation for approximately 558,000 civil servants. The core objective here is the setting up and integration of platforms to manage the access, booking, payments, and evaluation of learning materials. This involves transitioning away from heavy manual processes to maximise technological efficiencies. At this stage the project team has identified the central deliverable as a unified online portal allowing learners to access the full National School offering. Key technologies in scope for procurement include, but are not limited to, a new Learning Management System (LMS)/ Learning Experience Platform (LXP), Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems to centralise stakeholder engagement, and design/delivery tools. Pillar 3: Future Learning Operations (FLO) The Learning Operations project is responsible for building the actual systems, processes, and internal capabilities required to run the day-to-day training operations in-house. Their core objective is establishing an integrated operational function by April 2028 that supports over 558,000 civil servants in completing their learning journeys. It is highly dependent on the digital and commercial pillars to develop the underlying platforms that support operations. Market Involvement As part of the initial phases of the programme, the project teams are keen to connect with the market and gain insight into current trends, operations and barriers. With this in mind, Cabinet Office and the project team have planned the following Sector Connector events.

result.text: The progressive digitalisation of core business processes, geopolitical developments and rising European requirements for data sovereignty and compliance require a future-proof and resilient IT infrastructure. As the independent central bank of the Federal Republic of Germany and part of the European System of Central Banks (ESCB), the Deutsche Bundesbank establishes the highest requirements for the autonomy, sovereignty and performance of its IT portfolio. To achieve the combination of these ambitious goals, the Deutsche Bundesbank requires reliable partners also for sovereign cloud services. With the strategic decision to use sovereign cloud services in addition to other public cloud services, the Deutsche Bundesbank pursues the goal of strengthening the digital sovereignty and security of its IT infrastructure without having to dispense with the innovative strength and scalability of modern public cloud offerings. In the course of this strategic orientation, the Deutsche Bundesbank is therefore initiating a structured market exploration. The aim of this measure is to systematically determine the performance and suitability of the sovereign cloud services available on the market. In doing so, it is to be examined in particular to what extent the existing service portfolios of the providers meet the technical, legal, organisational and security-related requirements of the Deutsche Bundesbank. This market exploration therefore focuses on cloud computing offerings that fulfil the European Commission's understanding of full digital sovereignty ("Technology and operations under complete EU control, subject only to EU law, with no critical non-EU dependencies", cf. EU Cloud Sovereignty Framework). The Deutsche Bundesbank reserves the right to define the concept of digital sovereignty more broadly and deviating from the aforementioned scope. Further details on the Deutsche Bundesbank's requirements for sovereign cloud services can be obtained exclusively upon request from the email address provided in the contact details. This market exploration also serves to involve the market at an early stage in a potentially pending EU-wide procurement procedure by the Deutsche Bundesbank for the procurement of cloud services and forms, among other things, a basis for decision-making for its technical design. This market exploration is not a procurement procedure directed at the award of a public contract and does not constitute either an offer or an invitation to conclude a contract. The implementation of a procurement procedure, including with a different service scope, remains reserved. Participation in this market exploration has no consequences (neither preferential treatment nor disadvantage) for the participating company within the framework of a potential future procurement process. Participants in this market exploration have no entitlement to the acquisition of knowledge from the results of the market exploration.

parts.source: Die fortschreitende Digitalisierung zentraler Geschäftsprozesse, geopolitische Entwicklungen sowie steigende europäische Anforderungen an Datenhoheit und Compliance erfordern eine zukunftsfähige und resiliente IT-Infrastruktur. Als unabhängige Zentralbank der Bundesrepublik Deutschland und Teil des Europäischen Systems der Zentralbanken (ESZB) stellt die Deutsche Bundesbank höchste Anforderungen an die Autonomie, Souveränität und Leistungsfähigkeit ihres IT-Portfolios. Um die Kombination dieser ambitionierten Ziele zu erreichen, benötigt die Deutsche Bundesbank verlässliche Partner auch für souveräne Cloud-Dienste. Mit der strategischen Entscheidung, zusätzlich zu anderen Public-Cloud-Diensten, souveräne Cloud-Dienste zu nutzen, verfolgt die Deutsche Bundesbank das Ziel, die digitale Souveränität und Sicherheit ihrer IT-Infrastruktur zu stärken, ohne aber auf die Innovationskraft und Skalierbarkeit moderner Public-Cloud-Angebote verzichten zu können. Im Zuge der strategischen Ausrichtung initiiert die Deutsche Bundesbank daher eine strukturierte Markterkundung. Ziel dieser Maßnahme ist es, die Leistungsfähigkeit und Eignung der am Markt verfügbaren souveränen Cloud-Dienste systematisch zu ermitteln. Dabei soll insbesondere geprüft werden, inwieweit die bestehenden Service-Portfolios der Anbieter den technischen, rechtlichen, organisatorischen und sicherheitstechnischen Anforderungen der Deutschen Bundesbank entsprechen. Diese Markterkundung fokussiert sich daher auf Cloud-Computing-Angebote, die das Verständnis der EU-Kommission an volle digitale Souveränität erfüllen ("Technology and operations under complete EU control, subject only to EU law, with no critical non-EU dependencies", vgl. EU Cloud Sovereignty Framework). Die Deutsche Bundesbank behält sich vor, den Begriff der digitalen Souveränität weiter und abweichend von dem vorstehend genannten Umfang zu definieren. Weitere Details zu den Anforderungen der Deutschen Bundesbank an souveräne Cloud-Dienste erhalten Sie ausschließlich auf Anfrage an die in den Kontaktdaten hinterlegte E-Mail-Adresse. Diese Markterkundung dient zugleich dazu, den Markt frühzeitig zu einem potenziell anstehenden EU-weiten Vergabeverfahren der Deutschen Bundesbank zum Bezug von Cloud-Diensten einzubinden und bildet u.a. eine Entscheidungsgrundlage für dessen fachliche Ausgestaltung. Diese Markterkundung ist kein auf die Vergabe eines öffentlichen Auftrags gerichtetes Vergabeverfahren und stellt weder ein Angebot noch eine Aufforderung zum Vertragsabschluss dar. Die Durchführung eines Vergabeverfahrens, auch mit anderem Leistungszuschnitt, bleibt vorbehalten. Die Teilnahme an dieser Markterkundung hat für das teilnehmende Unternehmen keine Konsequenzen (weder Bevorzugung noch Benachteiligung) im Rahmen eines potenziellen zukünftigen Beschaffungsprozesses. Teilnehmende an dieser Markterkundung haben keinen Anspruch auf die Erlangung von Kenntnissen aus den Ergebnissen der Markterkundung.

parts.source: Pyydämme teitä toimittamaan vastauksenne tähän biopankkiratkaisun hankintaa koskevaan tietopyyntöön. Arvostamme suuresti kaikkia saamiamme vastauksia, ja jokainen niistä huomioidaan mahdollisen kilpailutuksen valmistelussa. Tietopyynnön tarkoituksena on varmistaa, että kilpailutuksen valmistelijoilla on käytössään mahdollisimman kattava ja ajantasainen kuva markkinoista ja tarjolla olevista ratkaisuista. Tällä tietopyynnöllä haluamme kartoittaa toimittajien tarjontaa biopankkiratkaisuista. Samalla pyrimme tutustumaan ratkaisuun liittyvien lisäpalvelujen markkinatilanteeseen, tuotteisiin, sopimusehtoihin ja hinnoitteluun. Tietopyynnön vastauksien perusteella voidaan järjestää markkinavuoropuhelutilaisuuksia, joissa toimittajat voivat esitellä omia palveluita, tuotteita ja vaihtoehtojaan kilpailutuksen kohteen toteutumiselle. Jos markkinavuoropuhelutilaisuuksia järjestetään, ne toteutetaan suomen kielellä. Istekki ilmoittaa tilaisuuksiin osallistuville yrityksille tarkemmat aikataulut myöhemmin. Istekki valitsee ja kutsuu vuoropuheluihin osallistujat. Tarpeen mukaan vuoropuhelutilaisuuksia voidaan järjestää useampia ja osallistujina saattavat olla myös Tilaajan loppuasiakkaat. Tilaaja varaa oikeuden järjestää myös kirjallisia vuoropuhelukierroksia ja luonnostilaisten tarjouspyyntömateriaalien kommentointikierroksia. Huomioithan, että tässä tietopyynnössä esitetyt tiedot, kuvaukset ja arviot kilpailutuksen julkaisuajankohdasta ovat vasta alustavia ja suuntaa antavia. Lopulliset aikataulut tarkentuvat valmistelun edetessä. Lisätiedot ja ohjeet tietopyyntöön vastaamista varten löytyvät liitteestä. Tietopyyntöön vastaamisen määräaika on 04.02.2026 klo 14:00. Annetut tiedot käsitellään luottamuksellisesti. Tämä on tietopyyntö, joka ei ole hankintailmoitus tai tarjouspyyntö. Tietopyyntöön vastaaminen ei ole edellytys mahdolliseen myöhempään kilpailutukseen osallistumiselle. Tietopyyntöön vastanneille ei makseta korvausta tietopyynnön tekemisestä tai mahdollisiin tietopyyntöön liittyviin esittelytilaisuuksiin osallistumisesta. Tietopyyntö ei velvoita Istekki Oy:tä toteuttamaan hankintaa tietopyynnössä tai sen liitteissä kuvatulla tavalla ja tarjouskilpailu voidaan myös jättää toteuttamatta.

result.text: Background and purpose Arendal is located in the central part of Sørlandet. The municipality has approx. 46,000 inhabitants. Arendal municipality has a decentralised school structure with 16 municipal primary and secondary schools, organised as independent entities with separate rectors and management groups. The schools include both combined 1st - 10th schools and pure primary schools (1st - 7th years), as well as a resource centre with tenders across the stages. The municipality has a total of approx. 5,000 pupils in the primary and lower secondary schools. Arendal municipality is in an ongoing change of the school structure. Two primary schools (1st – 7th years) and the secondary school for one school have been decided to be folded. The changes are planned to be implemented from 01.01.2027. The overall responsibility for the school area is at the school office, which follows up on joint priorities, quality work and regulations, and acts as a link between the political level and the schools. The cooperation between the school office and the schools will take place, among other things, through fixed meeting points and joint development work, at the same time that each school adapts the work to local needs. The adult education is organised as a part of the municipality ́s training and is also a user of relevant digital services. Arendal municipality needs a joint system for the administration, distribution and access management of digital teaching aids in primary and secondary schools. The municipality has used a system for this purpose over time and has developed good experience with procurement, licence management and access management in this area. The procurement will be carried out as a result of the expiry of the existing agreement and shall ensure the continuation and further development of this work. Information on the procurement and process is in the document Konkurransegrunnlag_Digital Platform for schools. Scope The estimated annual scope is challenging to estimate. This is connected with the complexity, changes in the school structure and a market with different actors. We estimate that the annual turnover will be NOK 3.0 million excluding VAT, which over 8 years will be NOK 24 million excluding VAT. The contract will have a valid amount of NOK 30 million excluding VAT during the contract period. The estimated scope is based on experiences with the current supplier, market dialogue and indicative prices in the market. The estimated scope is not binding for the contracting authority. The following is not included in this procurement: - Learning platform (LMS) and educational follow-up. - functionality connected to artificial intelligence (KI) - other school administrative systems. The procurement is for the administration and distribution of digital teaching aids and a learning tool. Handling printed teaching aids is not included. The procurement does not include discipline specific teaching aids or individual applications. Reservations All conditions that the tenderer has for the tender shall be stated in the point conditions in the requirement specification document. Alternative tenders Alternative tenders cannot be submitted. Documents Please see the attached documents. Note that the tenderer shall fill in information in the attached documents.

The procurement is divided into two Lots: Lot 1: Technical Implementation Partner The Technical Implementation Partner will support the technical implementation of the selected CRM Platform and associated digital ecosystem. The scope includes solution design, configuration, integration, data migration, testing, deployment, transition, implementation governance, technical assurance and operational readiness. Suppliers tendering for Lot 1 must align their Tender Response to one of the eligible CRM Platforms identified in the Invitation to Tender documents. The proposed technical solution, implementation approach and associated commercial submissions must be prepared consistently on the basis of the selected CRM Platform. result.text: Supply and implementation of a CRM system at the contracting authority as described in the specification of services and the criteria catalogue, alongside system service services, training services, further developments and adaptation of the overall system after acceptance. The Universität Stuttgart intends to make a significant development step in the IT-supported care and management of its diverse contact and relationship groups - particularly with regard to students, alumni, cooperation partners, sponsors and other stakeholders - and strives for the introduction of a comprehensive customer relationship management (CRM) system. The aim is to systematically bundle, professionalise and digitise in a uniform, data-protection-compliant infrastructure the communication and management processes previously carried out largely in a decentralised and heterogeneous manner. To cover these needs, the contracting authority plans the procurement and introduction of a CRM system that digitally supports the overall process of strategic relationship management in the relevant application fields. The procurement takes place as a SaaS solution in cloud operation. In addition to the provision of the system, the service also includes implementation based on defined use cases (workflows), the performance of training courses, the provision of system service services for the go-live as well as maintenance and support.

parts.source: Lieferung und Implementierung eines CRM-Systems bei der Auftraggeberin wie in der Leistungsbeschreibung und dem Anforderungskatalog beschrieben, nebst Systemserviceleistungen, Schulungsleistungen, Weiterentwicklungen sowie Anpassung des Gesamtsystems nach Abnahme. Die Universität Stuttgart beabsichtigt in der IT-gestützten Betreuung und Verwaltung ihrer vielfältigen Kontakt- und Beziehungsgruppen - insbesondere mit Blick auf Studierende, Alumni, Kooperationspartner:innen, Fördernde und weitere Stakeholder - einen bedeutenden Entwicklungsschritt zu vollziehen und strebt die Einführung eines umfassenden Customer-Relationship-Managements (CRM)-Systems an. Ziel ist es, die bislang vielfach dezentral und heterogen durchgeführten Kommunikations- und Verwaltungsprozesse systematisch zu bündeln, zu professionalisieren und in einer einheitlichen, datenschutzkonformen Infrastruktur zu digitalisieren. Zur Deckung dieser Bedarfe plant die Auftraggeberin die Beschaffung und Einführung eines CRM-Systems, das den Gesamtprozess der strategischen Beziehungspflege in den relevanten Anwendungsfeldern digital unterstützt. Die Beschaffung erfolgt als SaaS-Lösung im Cloud-Betrieb. Neben der Bereitstellung des Systems umfasst die Leistung auch die Implementierung anhand definierter Anwendungsfälle (Workflows), die Durchführung von Schulungen, die Erbringung von Systemserviceleistungen für den Produktivstart sowie Wartung und Support.

result.text: Puolustusvoimien logistiikkalaitos (hereinafter the contracting authority) invites you to submit a request to participate in the Haapajärvi charging plant production line development project for the Finnish Defence Forces in accordance with this call for requests to participate and its annexes. Subject of the procurement: Planning and development site located in the production area of the Haapajärvi unit of the explosives centre. The main tasks are: The contracting authority wishes to develop the production line using automation and robotics. The aim is simultaneously to minimise the number of personnel. The candidate must state the number of personnel required for the modernised line at the stated capacities. The contracting authority has selected the following objects for automation: Renewal of the existing lower conveyor, including automation of the existing laboratory work (includes thread cleaning and inspection, attaching / installing the intermediate piece, and loading the upper conveyor), automation of the attachment of the existing cavity base and automation of the existing weighing operation. The procurement includes all necessary design work, dismantling of obsolete technology, and delivery and installation of new technology in the explosive premises (IP54 T4) as a turnkey delivery in accordance with the procurement documents. The selected supplier must design all possible operations of the procurement object to be automated and to operate automatically. Likewise, the machines and equipment to be modernised must be designed to function as independent parts of the rest of the existing production equipment. The modernised line must meet the ergonomics requirements and capacity needs with 81 VRTKR, 120 VRTKR and 155 TKR products. There are various versions of these products, and these versions are specified in separately delivered drawings. The main tasks included in the delivery are listed as follows: 1) Production capacity in accordance with requirements and minimisation of the number of personnel 2) Renewal of the existing lower conveyor 3) Automation of the operations of the existing laboratory work (including thread cleaning and inspection, installation of the detonator, attaching / installing the intermediate piece, and loading the upper conveyor) 4) Automation of the operations of the existing cavity base attachment 5) Automation of the existing weighing operation. Items 2 to 5 include design, dismantling of the existing redundant part, and necessary equipment deliveries and installations. The objective is to carry out the procurement (including the design phase) during the years 2026 to 2027, such that the timing of the installation of the new technology would be as follows: Working hours at the site are possible 19.07.2027 to 15.10.2027 (weeks 29 to 41). The delivery must be ready by 15.10.2027. Working on site is permitted during installations around the clock every day of the week, if necessary. Before starting the installations, the selected supplier must carry out all necessary design. The selected supplier must present (in written and oral form) the entire implementation proposal for the procurement (including necessary plans and capacity calculations) to the Customer in good time, i.e. when the necessary plans are, in the supplier's opinion, ready for presentation. The final implementation documentation is included in the delivery scope of the procurement. The contracting parties shall agree on the more precise installation schedule within the aforementioned delivery schedule in accordance with the terms of the procurement contract to be signed after the selection of the supplier. The final acceptance is preceded by trial runs (cold run / hot run), capacity runs, training, delivery of final documentation and official inspections. The new equipment must be fully ready for use and production by 15.10.2027. The contracting authority will send the invitation to tender and its annexes (incl. technical specification) on the basis of this call for requests to participate to the tenderers approved by the contracting authority.

parts.source: Puolustusvoimien logistiikkalaitos (jäljempänä hankintayksikkö) pyytää osallistumishakemustanne Haapajärven lataamon tuotantolinjaston kehittämishankintaan Puolustusvoimille tämän osallistumishakemuspyynnön ja sen liitteiden mukaisesti. Hankinnan kohde: Räjähdekeskuksen Haapajärven toimipisteen tuotantoalueella sijaitseva suunnittelu- ja kehittämiskohde Päätehtävät ovat: Hankintayksikkö haluaa kehittää tuotantolinjastoa automatisoinnin ja robotiikan avulla. Tavoitteena on samalla henkilömäärän minimointi. Ehdokkaan tulee ilmoittaa modernisoidulla linjastolla tarvittava henkilömäärä ilmoitetuilla kapasiteeteilla. Hankintayksikkö on valinnut automatisoinnin kohteiksi: Nykyisen alapuolisen kuljettimen uusinta, mukaan lukien nykyisen laboroinnin automatisoinnin (sisältää kierteen puhdistus ja tarkastus, välikappaleen kiinnittäminen / asentaminen, sekä yläpuolisen kuljettimen lastaus), nykyisen onteloperän kiinnityksen automatisointi ja nykyisen punnitustoiminnon automatisointi. Hankinta sisältää kaiken tarvittavan suunnittelutyön, vanhentuneen tekniikan purkamisen sekä uuden tekniikan toimittamisen ja asentamisen räjähdetiloihin (IP54 T4) hankinta-asiakirjojen mukaisena kokonaistoimituksena. Valittavan toimittajan tulee suunnitella hankinnan kohteen kaikki mahdolliset toiminnot automatisoitaviksi ja automaattisesti toimiviksi. Samoin tulee suunnitella modernisoitavat koneet ja laitteet itsenäisesti toimiviksi osiksi muuta olemassa olevaa tuotantolaitteistoa. Modernisoidun linjaston tulee täyttää ergonomiavaatimukset ja kapasiteettitarpeet 81 VRTKR, 120 VRTKR ja 155 TKR tuotteilla. Kyseisillä tuotteilla on eri versioita ja nämä versiot selviävät erikseen toimitettavista piirustuksista. Toimitukseen kuuluvat päätehtävät lueteltuna: 1) Vaatimusten mukainen tuotantokapasiteetti sekä henkilömäärän minimointi 2) Nykyisen alapuolisen kuljettimen uusinta 3) Nykyisen laboroinnin (sisältäen kierteen puhdistus ja tarkastus, räjäyttimen asentaminen, välikappaleen kiinnittäminen / asentaminen, sekä yläpuolisen kuljettimen lastaus) toimintojen automatisointi 4) Nykyisen onteloperän kiinnityksen toimintojen automatisointi 5) Nykyisen punnitustoiminnon automatisointi. Kohdat 2 - 5 sisältävät suunnittelun, nykyisen turhaksi jäävän osuuden purkamisen sekä tarvittavat laitteistotoimitukset ja asennukset. Tavoitteena on toteuttaa hankinta (mukaan lukien suunnitteluvaihe) vuosien 2026 - 2027 aikana, siten että uuden tekniikan asennusajankohta olisi seuraavan mukainen: Kohteessa työaika on mahdollista 19.07.2027 - 15.10.2027 (viikot 29 - 41). Toimituksen on oltava valmiina 15.10.2027 mennessä. Työskentely kohteessa sallittu asennuksien aikana tarvittaessa ympäri vuorokauden viikon jokaisen päivänä. Ennen asennusten aloittamista valittavan toimittajan on toteutettava kaikki tarvittava suunnittelu. Valittavan toimittajan tulee esitellä (kirjallisessa ja suullisessa muodossa) koko hankinnan toteutusehdotus (mukaan lukien tarvittavat suunnitelmat sekä kapasiteettilaskelmat) Asiakkaalle hyvissä ajoin, ts. kun tarvittavat suunnitelmat ovat toimittajan mielestä esittelyvalmiita. Lopullinen toteutusdokumentaatio sisältyy hankinnan toimitussisältöön. Sopijaosapuolet sopivat tarkemman asennusajankohdan edellä mainitussa toimitusaikataulussa allekirjoitettavan hankintasopimuksen ehtojen mukaisesti toimittajan valinnan jälkeen. Lopullista vastaanottoa edeltää koekäytöt (kylmäkoe- / kuumakoekäyttö), kapasiteettiajot, koulutukset, loppudokumentaation toimitus ja viranomaistarkastukset. Uusien laitteistojen tulee olla täysin käyttö- ja tuotantovalmiina 15.10.2027. Hankintayksikkö lähettää tarjouspyynnön ja sen liitteet (ml. tekninen määritelmä) tämän osallistumishakemuspyynnön perusteella hankintayksikön hyväksymille Tarjoajille.

The German flag state administration stands for high quality, safety and social standards as well as for effective promotional instruments, in particular in training promotion. At the same time, the financial and procedural framework conditions of other flag state administrations and registers frequently appear more attractive to shipping companies - inter alia due to greater service orientation, greater decision-making flexibility and in some cases pronounced economic advantages. The Federal Ministry for Digital and Transport (BMV) is therefore considering the award of a service concession to a so-called intermediary who is, inter alia, to acquire sea-going ships for the German flag, advise on re-flagging and de-flagging, look after existing shipping companies and promote the German flag. The target group comprises owners, contractual shipping companies, ship managers or similar with their registered office in Germany. From a prospective perspective, sea-going ships in foreign ship registers that are authorised to fly the German flag may also be covered by the intermediary. This market exploration is intended to examine whether there is market interest in the considered solution and whether, if applicable, proposed solutions can be made that would make participation more interesting for you. We therefore invite you to express your interest in this service concession. This is not a procurement procedure. It is a non-binding information request that serves solely for market exploration pursuant to Section 28 paragraph 1 of the VgV. --->You can request a product profile sheet at vergabestelle@bsh.de for further information. You can ask questions about this procedure or give comments to vergabestelle@bsh.de. And you can express your interest by submitting an informal letter to vergabestelle@bsh.de.<----

Die deutsche Flaggenstaatverwaltung steht für hohe Qualitäts-, Sicherheits- und Sozialstandards sowie für wirksame Förderinstrumente, insbesondere in der Ausbildungsförderung. Gleichwohl erscheinen die finanziellen und prozessualen Rahmenbedingungen anderer Flaggenstaatverwaltungen und Register für Reedereien häufig attraktiver – unter anderem aufgrund höherer Serviceorientierung, größerer Entscheidungsflexibilität und teilweise ausgeprägter wirtschaftlicher Vorteile. Das Bundesministerium für Verkehr (BMV) erwägt daher die Vergabe einer Dienstleistungskonzession an einen sog. Intermediär, der unter anderem Seeschiffe für die deutsche Flagge akquirieren, zu Ein- und Rückflaggung beraten, Bestandsreedereien betreuen und die deutsche Flag ge fördern soll. Zielgruppe sind Eigentümer, Vertragsreeder, Schiffsmanager, o.ä. mit Sitz in Deutschland. Perspektivisch können auch Seeschiffe in ausländischen Schiffsregistern, die berechtigt sind die deutsche Flagge zu führen vom Intermediär erfasst werden. Mit dieser Markterkundung soll untersucht werden, ob ein Marktinteresse an der erwogenen Lösung besteht und ob ggf. Options: Migration of historical data from KAV. Procurement analysis tool (Spend) with integration with source systems. Options can be made when the contract is signed or later in the contract period. It shall be possible to get out of options without terminating the main contract.

result.text: NatureScot is preparing to undertake a procurement exercise for the Provision of Off-Site Storage. As part of the development process for the procurement approach, NatureScot is seeking views and information from the marketplace in connection with the areas set out in this Prior Information Notice (PIN). NatureScot have included a questionnaire (which can be found here - https://www.cognitoforms.com/ScotlandExcel1/OnBehalfOfNatureScotScottishNaturalHeritageOffsiteStorageForNatureScotRecords) Lot 1: . NatureScot is preparing to undertake a procurement exercise for the Provision of Off-Site Storage. The future contract is expected to run for an initial five-year period, with the option to extend for up to two further years, providing a potential total duration of seven years. NatureScot currently stores approximately 5,743 cubic feet of records offsite, consisting of a wide range of formats including paper files, maps, photographs, slides, audiovisual materials, and digital media. These records require secure, environmentally controlled storage, robust inventory management and reliable retrieval and transport arrangements. In addition, the forthcoming requirement is expected to include scan on demand services, secure destruction, and the supply of associated materials such as boxes, barcodes and destruction sacks. The supplier will also need to ensure and maintain full system compatibility with NatureScot’s Electronic Records and Document Management System (eRDMS). Integration will be achieved through API-driven transmission of CSV metadata files from the eRDMS to the Contract’s inventory system. NatureScot requires that, in the event the incumbent supplier does not bid or is not awarded the contract, the successful supplier will be responsible for managing the full transfer of existing records from the incumbent’s facility to their own. This will include all planning, coordination, uplift, transport, and reconciliation of inventory data. Market consultation is an important part of the procurement process and gives us an opportunity to consider your specialist opinion and expertise. This engagement does not constitute the launch of a procurement process; however, responses will help shape the forthcoming Invitation to Tender.. NatureScot have included a questionnaire (which can be found here - https://www.cognitoforms.com/ScotlandExcel1/OnBehalfOfNatureScotScottishNaturalHeritageOffsiteStorageForNatureScotRecords) for interested suppliers and may invite further dialogue to explore delivery models and gather feedback.

result.text: The purpose of the tender is to contract operational services related to the crop monitoring and yield forecasting activities of the JRC.D.5 unit (MARSOP). Implementing Article 25 of the horizontal regulation of the Common Agricultural Policy REG (EU) 2021/2116 on Monitoring Agricultural Resources (MARS), JRC.D.5 provides DG AGRI with timely, independent, and high-quality information on crop state and development, including quantitative forecasts of agricultural yields and production in the EU and neighbouring countries. This information is used by DG AGRI to ensure food security and for decision-making in agricultural markets. The JRC provides matching staff for agricultural analysts and experts producing monthly JRC MARS Bulletins for Commission-internal and public use, which are well received by private sector stakeholders, academics and the general public. Such services have been outsourced since 2000 (MAROSP1-6), financed through a co-delegation with DG AGRI. The operational services sustain the operation and further development of the MARS Crop Yield Forecasting System (MCYFS) at the heart of the crop monitoring activities at D.5. For the current procurement, we plan to organize the operational services for the MARS System in three different lots: - Lot 1: Acquisition and processing of agro-meteorological information - Lot 2: Acquisition and processing of satellite data - Lot 3: Processing of agronomic information from crop models and statistics. Lot 1 - Acquisition and processing of agro-meteorological information: The objective of Lot 1 is to acquire and process in near real-time (NRT) agro-meteorological data for ingestion and use in the MARS System. The sources of meteorological data to be acquired and processed are basically two: observed weather data from meteorological stations in Europe, and modelled weather data generated at the European Centre for Medium-range Weather Forecasts (ECMWF) at various lead times. Data processing includes quality control, spatial and temporal aggregation, and NRT ingestion into the MARS System. Lot 2 - Acquisition and processing of satellite data: Lot 2 supports the remote sensing infrastructure of the MARS System for Europe and global coverage with specific, tailored products. The service comprises NRT data collection, pre-processing and computation of derived products for the remote sensing satellites MODIS/VIIRS as well as Copernicus products. Lot 3 - Processing of agronomic information from crop models and statistics: Services of this lot include the NRT execution of crop growth models over Europe driven by weather data for specific target crops as well as NRT processing of the Water Satisfaction Index at global level. The repeated collection and quality-control and processing of agricultural statistics, pheonological data, and other agronomic information is an intrinsic part of this lot.
