result.text: Der Landkreis Nienburg/Weser plans the new construction of a fire brigade technical centre (FTZ) in the commercial area of the town of Lemke, municipality of Marklohe. This is a replacement building for the existing FTZ in Verdener Landstraße in Nienburg. The room programme comprises approx. 8.200 m2 of usable space, as well as approx. 9.140 m2 of outdoor areas – movement and exercise areas. A building site with an area of approx. 3,4 ha is available for this purpose. As part of the project, the erection of a building automation system is planned. Building automation comprises the automation, room automation and management level for monitoring, control, regulation and visualisation of the technical systems. Two central automation focuses are planned in the project. In addition to this, automation focuses are located in the vehicle hall, workshop hall and logistics hall respectively. For room automation, room automation distributors are arranged in the respective sub-distribution areas of electrical engineering. These room automation distributors map the functions of room automation. The integration of sun protection actuators, window contacts and the valves of the underfloor heating is carried out via I/O modules, which are connected to the room automation distributors. Lighting is integrated via KNX-DALI actuators installed in the electrical engineering sub-distributions. The respective interfaces and communication paths are to be coordinated accordingly with the electrical engineering and building automation trades. For the system technology, approx. 500 physical data points and approx. 550 shared data points are planned in the project. In the area of room automation, approx. 700 physical data points and approx. 2.000 shared data points are present.

parts.source: Der Landkreis Nienburg/Weser plant den Neubau einer Feuerwehrtechnischen Zentrale (FTZ) im Gewerbegebiet des Ortes Lemke, Gemeinde Marklohe. Es handelt sich um einen Ersatzneubau für die bestehende FTZ in der Verdener Landstraße in Nienburg. Das Raumprogramm umfasst ca. 8.200 m2 Nutzflächen, sowie ca. 9.140 m2 Außenbereiche – Bewegungs- und Übungsflächen. Hierzu steht ein ca. 3,4 ha großes Baufeld zur Verfügung. Im Rahmen des Projektes ist die Errichtung einer Gebäudeautomationsanlage vorgesehen. Die Gebäudeautomation umfasst die Automations-, Raumautomations- und Managementebene zur Überwachung, Steuerung, Regelung und Visualisierung der technischen Anlagen. Im Projekt sind zwei zentrale Automationsschwerpunkte vorgesehen. Ergänzend hierzu werden jeweils Automationsschwerpunkte in der Fahrzeughalle, Werkstatthalle und Logistikhalle verortet. Für die Raumautomation werden in den jeweiligen Unterverteilungsbereichen der Elektrotechnik Raumautomationsverteiler angeordnet. Diese Raumautomationsverteiler bilden die Funktionen der Raumautomation ab. Die Einbindung der Sonnenschutzantriebe, Fensterkontakte sowie der Ventile der Fußbodenheizung erfolgt über I/O-Module, welche auf die Raumautomationsverteiler aufgeschaltet werden. Die Beleuchtung wird über KNX-DALI-Aktoren eingebunden, welche in den Unterverteilungen der Elektrotechnik installiert werden. Die jeweiligen Schnittstellen und Kommunikationswege sind mit den Gewerken Elektrotechnik und Gebäudeautomation entsprechend abzustimmen. Für die Anlagentechnik sind im Projekt ca. 500 physikalische Datenpunkte sowie ca. 550 gemeinsame Datenpunkte vorgesehen. Im Bereich der Raumautomation sind ca. 700 physikalische Datenpunkte sowie ca. 2.000 gemeinsame Datenpunkte vorhanden.

result.text: The purpose of this contract is the SERVICES FOR THE ANALYSIS, DESIGN, DEVELOPMENT AND IMPLEMENTATION OF A VIRTUAL AGENT COORDINATION SYSTEM (CoVA) APPLIED TO INTERGENERATIONAL ASSISTANCE FOR THE ADMINISTRATION OF THE PRINCIPALITY OF ASTURIAS which enables a proactive and efficient administration, covering both processes and people and the technology necessary for its proper use, security and management. This contract is part of Public Procurement of Innovative Technology (CPTI), its purpose has an innovative content and employs functional specifications, rather than technical requirements: It is aimed at the acquisition of a service that does not exist in the Principality of Asturias, but can be developed in a reasonable time, given that the technology is at a degree of development that allows it to do so. The main tasks included in this contract are the following: a. Implementation of a virtual agent coordination system based on artificial intelligence applied to intergenerational assistance for the Administration of the Principality of Asturias that allows the exploitation of the data generated and managed. b. All services necessary for the commissioning of the contracted elements, necessary subscriptions/licences, as well as their management and maintenance during the pilot demonstration phase. c. The exploitation of the potential of the data of the Administration of the Principality of Asturias (hereinafter, APA) to implement new forms of public management based on interoperability and data analytics. d. Establish the technological and procedural bases for the implementation of a proactive administration that allows the optimisation of public expenditure while maximising its performance. e. The development of techniques/rules for the automated management and classification of data, documents and files using advanced Artificial Intelligence techniques. f. The incorporation of deep learning techniques since these digitalisation processes can produce immense amounts of data for training and thus be able to provide processing that increases efficiency, effectiveness and intelligence in the processing of data in the processes of Public Administrations. g. The creation of a corporate data space that includes origin data, those that may have been inferred during the scope of use of the system, as well as facilitating interoperability and administrative processing circuits. h. Creation of a proactive care and assistance environment with citizens. i. Creation of a specialised sandbox that serves as an ideation and experimentation environment. j. Integration with the APA's electronic file processing system (SITE), and other applications and systems indicated in these specifications. k. Ensuring the artificial intelligence (AI) supply chain, for which measures will be implemented to guarantee the integrity and security of the artificial intelligence models at all stages, components and data used, with strict legal compliance with EU Regulation 2024/1689, and compliance with the decree 98/2025 regulating the use of artificial intelligence in the Administration of the Principality of Asturias.

parts.source: El objeto del presente contrato son los SERVICIOS DE ANÁLISIS, DISEÑO, DESARROLLO E IMPLANTACIÓN DE UN SISTEMA DE COORDINACIÓN VIRTUAL DE AGENTES (CoVA) APLICADOS A LA ASITENCIA INTERGENERACIONAL PARA LA ADMINISTRACIÓN DEL PRINCIPADO DE ASTURIAS que permita una administración proactiva y eficiente, abarcando tanto los procesos como las personas y la tecnología necesaria para un adecuado uso, seguridad y manejo de la misma. Este contrato se enmarca en la Compra Pública de Tecnología Innovadora, (CPTI), su objeto tiene un contenido innovador y emplea especificaciones funcionales, y no requisitos técnicos: Se orienta a la adquisición de un servicio que no existe en el Principado de Asturias, pero puede desarrollarse en un tiempo razonable, dado que la tecnología está en un grado de desarrollo que así lo permite. Las tareas principales incluidas en este contrato son las siguientes: a. Implementación de un sistema de coordinación virtual de agentes basados en inteligencia artificial aplicados a la asistencia intergeneracional para la Administración del Principado de Asturias que permita el aprovechamiento de los datos generados y gestionados. b. Todos los servicios necesarios para la puesta en marcha de los elementos contratados, suscripciones/licencias necesarias, así como su gestión y mantenimiento durante la fase piloto de demostración. c. El aprovechamiento del potencial de los datos de la Administración del Principado de Asturias (en adelante, APA) para implementar nuevas formas de gestión pública basada en la interoperabilidad y analítica de datos. d. Establecer las bases tecnológicas y procedimentales para la implantación de una Administración proactiva que permita la optimización del gasto público maximizando su rendimiento. e. El desarrollo de técnicas/reglas para la gestión automatizada y clasificación de datos, documentos y expedientes mediante técnicas avanzadas de Inteligencia Artificial. f. La incorporación de técnicas de aprendizaje profundo (Deep Learning) ya que en estos procesos de digitalización pueden producir inmensas cantidades de datos para el entrenamiento y así poder dar un procesamiento que incremente la eficiencia, la eficacia y la inteligencia en el tratamiento de los datos en los procesos de las Administraciones Públicas. g. La creación de un espacio de datos corporativo que incluya los datos en origen, aquellos que se hayan podido inferir durante en el ámbito de uso del sistema, así como facilitar la interoperabilidad y circuitos de tramitación administrativa. h. Creación de un entono de atención y asistencia proactiva con la ciudadanía. i. Creación de un sandbox especializado que sirva de entorno de ideación y para la experimentación. j. Integración con el sistema de tramitación electrónica de expedientes (SITE) de la APA, y otras aplicaciones y sistemas indicados en este pliego. k. Asegurar la cadena de suministro de la inteligencia artificial (IA), para lo que se implementarán las medidas para garantizar la integridad y seguridad de los modelos de inteligencia artificial en todas las etapas, componentes y datos utilizados, con estricto cumplimiento legal del Reglamento UE 2024/1689, y cumplimiento con el decreto 98/2025 que regula el uso de la inteligencia artificial en la Administración del Principado de Asturias.

result.text: As a university of excellence with around 44.000 students, Universität Hamburg (UHH) is not only one of Germany's strongest research universities and largest universities – as a venue for research, teaching and education, it is above all a modern knowledge organisation. Nowadays, this knowledge is primarily held in the form of digital information and processed and imparted using digital tools. However, digitalisation goes far beyond the digital representation of information and its processing using digital methods: In the sense of a synergetic interaction between analogue and digital, digitality has long been an integral part of the reality of studying, research, teaching, learning, life and work at UHH. The corresponding digitalisation strategy of UHH is understood as a university-wide frame of reference for a reflective approach to the opportunities and challenges of digital transformation as well as the successful implementation of digitalisation projects and undertakings. The project "Support by a Managed Security Service Provider (MSSP)" aims to cover the security requirements of UHH's existing IT through a suitable service provider, provided this is not met by internal capacities. The subject of this procurement is the establishment and operation of a Security Operations Centre based at UHH, funded by the BWFG: ▪ Universität Hamburg (UHH) ▪ Hamburg University of Applied Sciences (HAW) ▪ Hamburg University of Technology Universität Hamburg (TUHH) ▪ HafenCity University Hamburg Universität Hamburg (HCU) ▪ Hamburg University of Fine Arts (HfBK) ▪ Hamburg University of Music and Theatre (HfMT). result.text: Invitation to participation in the market dialogue. Asker, Bærum and Drammen municipalities plan to hold a competition for a new contract for the operation and development of websites on Optimizely DXP. Before the competition is announced, we would like a dialogue with the market in the form of one-to-one meetings with relevant tenderers, who can offer systems that cover the municipalities ́needs. The dialogue meetings will be held digitally during week 9. We would like to carry out a combined procurement process to enter into three separate contracts with the same tenderer. The municipalities have in common that we use the same CMS (Optimizely DXP) on version CMS12. The aim is that cooperation, development and sharing across the municipalities take place seamlessly between the three municipalities. Through new contracts a collaborating partner shall be able to support the operation and development of the websites in Asker, Bærum and Drammen municipalities. A collaborating partner must be able to contribute to and deliver the following (the list is not exhaustive): - Stable and safe operation - High competence in Optimizely DXP and resource robustness. - Continual improvement - Development and future orientated focus. - User-oriented focus - Consultancy and competence sharing. - Project management in development. System integration - Design and concept development Close dialogue in both daily operation and development. We would like tenderers to give a presentation of their service offer, which states something about how they can contribute to fulfil the municipalities ́needs. We would also like tenderers to have prepared answers to questions defined in annex 2. Tenderers wishing to participate can register their interest by sending an email to elfrid.nygaard.stabellini@asker.kommune.no, and at the same time state the preferred time for the meeting: - Monday 23.02: 10.00-11.30 - Monday 23.02, 12.30-14.00 - Monday 23.02, 14.30-16.00 - Tuesday 24.02, 08:30 - 10:00. - Tuesday 24.02, 10.30-12.00 - Tuesday 24.02, 13.00-14.30 The registration deadline is 19.02.2026. Annex 1 - Agenda Dialogue Meeting 1. Presentation of meeting participants and cards on the municipalities ́needs. 2. Presentation from the tenderer and review of questions and answers in Annex 2. Annex 2 - Questions and Answers The questions shall be reviewed in the dialogue meeting, and answered and returned in written form to the customer by 27.02.2026: 1.Technical operation and stability A. How do you ensure stable and secure operation of Optimizely DXP for customers with complex needs? B. How do you work with proactive operation and continual technical improvements? c. How will you describe your form of cooperation and dialogue with customers (response time, CRM, regular status meetings)? 2. Development and future oriented focus A. Can you describe how you internally ensure competence development and further development of your employees? B. Beside the main delivery covered by this agreement, assistance can be required for major development projects throughout the contract period. There may be a need for more capacity and special competence from the tenderer. Do you have the opportunity to carry out projects of a larger nature and set aside large amounts of resources in limited periods? Key competence in major projects may, for example, be linked to artificial intelligence in order to proactive information work on the websites and to make content available to target groups that can have challenges with using digital channels. c. How do you envisage that a municipal web will look like in 5 years? 3. Work across three municipalities A. What competence do you have in the municipal sector (or similar entities/organisations) Please give examples. B. How will you organise the cooperation so that development, operation and further development occur seamlessly across Asker, Bærum and Drammen municipalities? How can you facilitate re-use of systems across the municipalities? c. What experiences do you have with working with several customers in joint projects? d. How do you ensure good priorities when three municipalities shall share the same supplier? How do you ensure that there are enough resources with the right competence available? 4. User focus and availability A. How do you work with user testing and insight and how do you use this for continual improvement? 5. Design and concept development A. How do you work with design and concept development at Optimizely DXP, and what methods do you use to make systems uniform and user friendly? Describe how you involve ordering, handling design principles, and ensuring consistency in both visual and content design. 6. How do you share experiences, insight, and best practice with the customers you work with? Do you, for example, have forums or seminars that your customers can participate in for inspiration and competence development? 7. Can you discuss how your company currently works with environment and sustainability and what actions do you take to reduce damaging environmental impact? 8. Can you describe the price model you use? Annex 3 - Documentation that shall be submitted after the dialogue meeting. Deadline: 27.02.2026 1. Presentation from the dialogue meeting, including replies to the questions in annex 2. 3. Three reference customers with a comparable solution (with contact information). 4. Generic price list for their consultants based on seniority and competence.

result.text: The aim of the project is the implementation of the new Diavgeia taking into account modern institutional, operational and technological developments, the more correct implementation of the institutional framework with emphasis on the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the optimal utilisation of Diavgeia information with a data-based architecture and secondarily document-based. The project seeks to increase the efficiency and productivity of public services by enriching the applications of the Diavgeia Programme, supplementing functionality for the collaborative drafting and management of documents to be published based on standardised documents and data structures, and also to add value to the Programme by utilising and enriching the information gathered within it through the use of other information sources with the aim of creating a system of complex reports and other complementary application subsystems and solutions. The new system will allow the monitoring of the operation and organisational structure of public administration in combination with information related to the competences of bodies in the context of multi-level governance and also of personnel as recorded in the Human Resources Register of the Hellenic Republic. The aim is to provide objective evidence for the implementation of the National Administrative Procedures Policy and the prioritisation of the actions of the National Programme for Administrative Simplification. To this end, care has been taken to significantly enhance its interoperability with third-party public sector systems for the dissemination of information without necessarily requiring intervention from the end user. Additionally, through the expansion of information kept in a structured manner (metadata set), it will be possible to capture data groups with special characteristics that enhance transparency at the level of monitoring/evaluation by the general public of indicators related to, for example, the operation and structure of public administration and/or financial figures (public spending). For this purpose, data from other sources and publicly available data will also be utilised to support the monitoring of the operation and action of bodies and to support decision-making. The solution will include the creation of a system for the correct (and as complete as possible per sector) structured collection and processing of data from various public data sources and subsequently making them available to the general public. Illustrative examples of sources are data from systems under development for GOV ERP, HRMS, the Civil Society Organisations Register, ESIDIS, KHMDIS. A distinct subsystem will be developed for further utilisation and extraction of specialised reports with the aim of monitoring the structure, operation and action of public administration as well as monitoring expenditure and procurement and supporting the decision-making process. The system will be scalable for the addition of new sources arising from other actions. Also, within the framework of the action, improvements will be made in relation to identified problems associated with the management of the very large volume of documents collected by Diavgeia at a sharply increasing rate, which also led to the necessary migration of the infrastructure to public cloud services. In this context, advanced services provided by public clouds will be better utilised in order to ensure the uninterrupted provision of services and the monitoring of their provision at the lowest possible cost. The action, taking into account the life cycle of the administrative documents that are published, will address challenges such as the cleaning of multiple copies of the same documents, the extraction of all information in data format and the optimisation of the quality of Diavgeia metadata as well as the automatic publication of important data sets in the central open public data repository www.data.gov.gr. The project also aims to adopt a new architecture that will allow a drastic reduction, by at least 65%, of the required storage space and computational resources while ensuring the proper functioning of the system. To achieve the above goal, both emerging artificial intelligence and language model technologies and techniques for the correct entry of metadata into relevant information will be utilised to facilitate their search, categorisation and utilisation. This contract concerns a single subject matter and is not subdivided into lots due to the project's architecture, the strong interdependencies and complementarity of the individual services that compose it, as well as the high interoperability requirements that must be ensured on the one hand between the functional units (subsystems) to be developed within the framework of this project and on the other hand with third-party systems of Hellenic Republic bodies. The non-subdivision of the contract enhances the quality and security of the project, since unified management reduces the chances of security gaps or incompatibilities appearing between the different systems and facilitates the coordination of its implementation. The duration of the contract is set at thirty-two (32) months including the procedure for checking and acceptance of deliverables. The contract will be awarded on the basis of the most economically advantageous tender, based on the best price-quality ratio. [para. 1.3. & ANNEX I of the Call for Tenders]

parts.source: Στόχος του έργου είναι η υλοποίηση της νέας Δι@ύγειας λαμβάνοντας υπόψη τις σύγχρονες θεσμικές, επιχειρησιακές και τεχνολογικές εξελίξεις, την ορθότερη εφαρμογή του θεσμικού πλαισίου με έμφαση στον Γενικό Κανονισμό Προστασίας Δεδομένων (GDPR) και τη βέλτιστη αξιοποίηση της πληροφορίας του Δι@ύγεια με μία αρχιτεκτονική βασισμένη στα δεδομένα και δευτερευόντως εγγράφων.Το έργο επιδιώκει να αυξήσει την αποδοτικότητα και παραγωγικότητα των δημοσίων υπηρεσιών εμπλουτίζοντας τις εφαρμογές του Προγράμματος Δι@ύγεια, συμπληρώνοντας λειτουργικότητα συνεργατικής σύνταξης και διαχείρισης των προς ανάρτηση εγγράφων με βάση προτυποποιημένα έγγραφα και δομές δεδομένων αλλά και να αποδώσει προστιθέμενη αξία στο Πρόγραμμα αξιοποιώντας και εμπλουτίζοντας την πληροφορία που συγκεντρώνεται σε αυτό με αξιοποίηση και άλλων πηγών πληροφορίας με σκοπό την δημιουργία ενός συστήματος σύνθετων αναφορών (reporting) και άλλων συμπληρωματικών υποσυστημάτων εφαρμογών και λύσεων. Το νέο σύστημα θα επιτρέπει την παρακολούθηση της λειτουργίας και οργανωτικής δομής της δημόσιας διοίκησης σε συνδυασμό με πληροφορίες που σχετίζονται με τις αρμοδιότητες των φορέων στο πλαίσιο της πολυεπίπεδης διακυβέρνησης αλλά και του προσωπικού όπως αυτό καταγράφεται στο Μητρώο Ανθρώπινου Δυναμικού του Ελληνικού Δημοσίου. Στόχος είναι να παρέχονται αντικειμενικά στοιχεία για την εφαρμογή της Εθνικής Πολιτικής Διοικητικών Διαδικασιών και την προτεραιοποίηση των δράσεων του Εθνικού Προγράμματος Απλούστευσης Διαδικασιών. Για το σκοπό αυτό έχει ληφθεί μέριμνα ώστε να ενισχυθεί σημαντικά η διαλειτουργικότητά του με τρίτα συστήματα του Δημόσιου τομέα για την διάχυση της πληροφορίας χωρίς απαραίτητα παρέμβαση του τελικού χρήστη. Επιπρόσθετα μέσω της διεύρυνσης της πληροφορίας που θα κρατείται δομημένα (set μεταδεδομένων) θα είναι δυνατή η αποτύπωση ομάδων δεδομένων με ιδιαίτερα χαρακτηριστικά που ενισχύουν την διαφάνεια σε επίπεδο παρακολούθησης/ αξιολόγησης από το ευρύ κοινό δεικτών που σχετίζονται με πχ της λειτουργία και τη δομή της Δημόσιας διοίκησης ή/ και οικονομικών μεγεθών (public spending).Για το σκοπό αυτό θα αξιοποιούνται και από άλλες πηγές και δημόσια διαθέσιμα δεδομένα με σκοπό την υποστήριξη παρακολούθησης της λειτουργίας και δράσης των φορέων και την υποστήριξη της λήψης αποφάσεων. Η λύση θα περιλαμβάνει τη δημιουργία συστήματος ορθής (και όσο το δυνατόν πλήρους ανά τομέα) δομημένης συγκέντρωσης και επεξεργασίας δεδομένων από διάφορες πηγές δεδομένων του δημοσίου και στη συνέχεια διάθεσης αυτών προς το ευρύ κοινό. Ενδεικτικά παραδείγματα πηγών είναι τα δεδομένα των υπό ανάπτυξη συστημάτων για το GOV ERP, το HRMS, το Μητρώο Οργανώσεων της Κοινωνίας των Πολιτών, ΕΣΗΔΗΣ, ΚΗΜΔΗΣ. Θα αναπτυχθεί διακριτό υποσύστημα για περαιτέρω αξιοποίηση και εξαγωγή εξειδικευμένων αναφορών με σκοπό την παρακολούθηση της δομής, λειτουργίας και δράσης της δημόσιας διοίκησης καθώς και της παρακολούθησης των δαπανών και των προμηθειών και την υποστήριξη της διαδικασίας λήψης αποφάσεων. Το σύστημα θα είναι επεκτάσιμο για προσθήκη και νέων πηγών που θα προκύπτουν από άλλες δράσεις.Επίσης στο πλαίσιο της δράσης θα γίνουν βελτιώσεις σε σχέση με εντοπισμένα προβλήματα που σχετίζονται με τη διαχείριση του πολύ μεγάλου όγκου εγγράφων που συγκεντρώνει το Δι@ύγεια με έντονα αυξητικό ρυθμό ο οποίος οδήγησε και στην αναγκαία μετάπτωση της υποδομής σε υπηρεσίες δημόσιου υπολογιστικού νέφους. Στο πλαίσιο αυτό θα αξιοποιηθούν καλύτερα οι προηγμένες υπηρεσίες που παρέχονται από δημόσια υπολογιστικά νέφη προκειμένου να διασφαλίζεται η αδιάλειπτη παροχή των υπηρεσιών και η παρακολούθηση της παροχής αυτών με το μικρότερο δυνατό κόστος. Η δράση λαμβάνοντας υπόψη τον κύκλο ζωής των διοικητικών εγγράφων που αναρτώνται θα απαντήσει σε προκλήσεις όπως ο καθαρισμός πολλαπλών αντιγράφων των ίδιων εγγράφων, η εξαγωγή όλης της πληροφορίας σε μορφή δεδομένων και η βελτιστοποίηση της ποιότητας των μεταδεδομένων του Δι@ύγεια καθώς και η αυτόματη δημοσίευση σημαντικών συνόλων δεδομένων στο κεντρικό αποθετήριο ανοικτών δημόσιων δεδομένων www.data.gov.gr. Το έργο στοχεύει επίσης στην υιοθέτηση νέας αρχιτεκτονικής που θα επιτρέπει την δραστική μείωση, τουλάχιστον κατά 65%, του απαιτούμενου αποθηκευτικού χώρου και των υπολογιστικών πόρων διασφαλίζοντας παράλληλα την ορθή λειτουργία του συστήματος. Για την επίτευξη του ανωτέρω στόχου θα αξιοποιηθούν τόσο αναδυόμενες τεχνολογίες τεχνητής νοημοσύνης και γλωσσικών μοντέλων όσο και τεχνικές για την ορθή εισαγωγή μεταδεδομένων στις σχετικές πληροφορίες που θα διευκολύνουν την αναζήτηση, κατηγοριοποίηση και αξιοποίηση αυτών. Η παρούσα σύμβαση αφορά σε ένα ενιαίο αντικείμενο και δεν υποδιαιρείται σε τμήματα λόγω της αρχιτεκτονικής του έργου, των ισχυρών αλληλεξαρτήσεων και της συμπληρωματικότητας των επιμέρους υπηρεσιών που το συνθέτουν καθώς και των υψηλών απαιτήσεων διαλειτουργικότητας που είναι αναγκαίο να εξασφαλίζονται αφενός μεταξύ των λειτουργικών ενοτήτων (υποσυστημάτων) που θα αναπτυχθούν στο πλαίσιο του παρόντος έργου και αφετέρου με τρίτα συστήματα φορέων του Ελληνικού Δημοσίου. Η μη υποδιαίρεση της σύμβασης ενισχύει την ποιότητα και την ασφάλεια του έργου, αφού ενιαία διαχείριση μειώνει τις πιθανότητες εμφάνισης κενών ασφαλείας ή ασυμβατότητας μεταξύ των διαφορετικών συστημάτων και διευκολύνει τον συντονισμό της υλοποίησής της. Η διάρκεια της σύμβασης ορίζεται σε τριάντα δύο (32) μήνες συμπεριλαμβανομένης της διαδικασίας ελέγχου και παραλαβής παραδοτέων. Η σύμβαση θα ανατεθεί με το κριτήριο της πλέον συμφέρουσας από οικονομική άποψη προσφοράς, βάσει της βέλτιστης σχέσης ποιότητας – τιμής. [παρ. 1.3. & ΠΑΡΑΡΤΗΜΑ I της Διακήρυξης]

result.text: South Lanarkshire Council (SLC) Education Resources are looking to notify the market of a potential opportunity to deliver an Early Years Admissions Management Programme. The service will be delivered for the purposes of implementing a new automated admissions process for Early Year’s applications. This will involve the configuration and implementation of a current solution to meet the Councils requirement of a centralised early years application programme which will automate and streamline the application, evaluation and allocation process for places within South Lanarkshire’s Early years establishments. This exercise is intended to provide potential bidders with the opportunity to view and comment on SLC’s Education Resources requirements if they wish to do so. This builds on a commitment to engage with the market, by sharing information and seeking input from the market to enable us to develop the final requirements. Lot 1: . This PIN notice is being published to explore potential options for a Cloud Based Early Years application and allocation programme with the functional and technical ability to meet South Lanarkshire Councils requirements and the relevant regulatory and legislative requirements, to implement a new streamlined process for parents/carers and early years Support staff to manage more effectively the allocation of early years places within South Lanarkshire. An overview of the requirement along with a pre market engagement questionnaire is included to allow suppliers to provide feedback on potential solutions. Responses to the questionnaire will help South Lanarkshire Council inform their procurement strategy, develop the project scope, and finalise requirements. It is requested that completed questionnaires are submitted to Gayle Chilton by e-mail (e-mail address detailed on the attached questionnaire) no later than 12 noon on the 17th April 2026.. Please note there is no additional documentation available at this moment and South Lanarkshire Council do not intend on holding any Market Engagement events or individual meetings during this stage.

result.text: Cardiff Capital Region (CCR), is seeking to appoint a Lead Managing Agent (LMA) to manage and deliver Phase 1 of the Investment Zone Skills Programme. The successful contractor will act as the operational delivery partner responsible for programme management, employer engagement, workforce intelligence, partnership coordination, funding administration, performance management and skills delivery planning. The programme aims to support workforce growth, talent attraction, skills development and employer-led innovation across priority sectors including semiconductors, advanced manufacturing, artificial intelligence and enabling technologies. The initial contract value is up to £2.77 million over a 17-month period, with an option to extend and deploy a further £1.35 million to March 2029, subject to funding and approvals.

result.text: Oslo municipality c/o the Agency for DigitalIsation (DIG) invites actors within ICT operational services to a market dialogue connected to Oslo municipality ́s need for a new ICT operations contract. See the separate annex for further information on the invitation to the market dialogue and inputs for the market survey.

result.text: Procurement of a CRM portal To be procured is a web-based CRM portal solution (SaaS) including implementation, migration, programming, training, maintenance and support services for tenancy management as well as residential property management. The solution is in future to map the requirements of tenancy management as well as residential property management and serve as a central platform for digital customer communication. The functional and technical requirements for the tendered software solution arise from the criteria catalogue underlying this tender. This describes the essential requirements for the solution and contains both mandatory exclusion criteria and evaluation-relevant criteria. The requirements defined in the criteria catalogue are part of the scope of services and must be ensured by the contractor during the contract term.

parts.source: Beschaffung eines CRM-Portals Beschafft werden soll eine webbasierte CRM-Portallösung (SaaS) einschließlich Implementierungs-, Migrations-, Programmier-, Schulungs-, Wartungs- und Supportleistungen für die Mietverwaltung sowie der Wohnungseigentumsverwaltung. Die Lösung soll künftig die Anforderungen der Mietverwaltung sowie der Wohnungseigentumsverwaltung abbilden und als zentrale Plattform für die digitale Kundenkommunikation dienen. Die fachlichen und technischen Anforderungen an die ausgeschriebene Softwarelösung ergeben sich aus dem dieser Ausschreibung zugrunde liegenden Kriterienkatalog. Dieser beschreibt die wesentlichen Anforderungen an die Lösung und beinhaltet sowohl verbindliche Ausschlusskriterien als auch bewertungsrelevante Kriterien. Die im Kriterienkatalog definierten Anforderungen sind Bestandteil des Leistungsumfangs und durch den Auftragnehmer während der Vertragslaufzeit sicherzustellen.

result.text: NHS Scotland intends to establish a national Framework Agreement for the provision of a Digital Diabetes Prevention and Primary Hypertension Programme. The programme will support individuals identified as being at risk of developing Type 2 Diabetes and/or those diagnosed with primary hypertension, through the delivery of evidence-based, digitally enabled lifestyle and behaviour change interventions. The Authority intends to appoint a single supplier to a national Framework Agreement. The procurement will be conducted using a Restricted Procedure, comprising a Selection Stage and an Invitation to Tender (ITT) stage. Suppliers will be shortlisted following evaluation of their suitability, technical and professional capability, capacity and relevant experience, with a maximum of five suppliers invited to submit a tender. Lot 1: . NHS Scotland intends to establish a national Framework Agreement for the provision of a Digital Diabetes Prevention and Primary Hypertension Programme. The Framework will support NHS Scotland's strategic objectives to improve population health outcomes, reduce health inequalities and support the prevention and management of long-term conditions through evidence-based, digitally enabled interventions. The requirement comprises a single integrated service with two pathways: - Digital Diabetes Prevention Programme (DDPP) for individuals identified as being at increased risk of developing Type 2 Diabetes; and - Primary Hypertension Programme (PHP) for individuals diagnosed with primary hypertension, supported through lifestyle and behaviour change interventions designed to improve health outcomes and reduce cardiovascular risk. The appointed Framework Participant will be required to deliver evidence-based, digitally enabled lifestyle and behaviour change interventions designed to support participants in achieving sustainable improvements in health behaviours and clinical outcomes. The service will utilise a digital platform/application supported by appropriately trained personnel, including health coaching and clinical governance arrangements, to facilitate participant engagement, self-management, education, monitoring and behaviour change. The service is expected to support a range of participant needs and will include, as appropriate, digital onboarding, risk assessment, lifestyle intervention, coaching support, educational resources, progress monitoring, outcome reporting and onward referral or escalation processes where clinically indicated. The Authority seeks a solution that is accessible, inclusive and capable of supporting diverse populations across Scotland, including individuals who may experience barriers to participation arising from geography, deprivation, language, disability or digital exclusion. The Framework Participant will be expected to work collaboratively with NHS Scotland, NHS Boards, Primary Care and other relevant stakeholders to support the promotion of the programme, participant recruitment and self-registration, service mobilisation, programme delivery, performance monitoring and continuous improvement. Current funding has been identified to support approximately 15,000 participants through the Diabetes Prevention pathway during the initial three-year term of the Framework Agreement. The Hypertension pathway is anticipated to support approximately 500 participants per annum. These figures are provided for information only and do not constitute a guarantee of volumes. The Authority reserves the right, subject to future funding availability and service requirements, to increase participant volumes and/or expand the scope of the Framework to include additional prevention cohorts, pathways, clinical indicators or service requirements that are closely aligned to the subject matter of the Framework Agreement. The Authority intends to appoint a single supplier to a national Framework Agreement. The procurement will be conducted using a Restricted Procedure. Suppliers will first be assessed at Selection Stage through completion of the Single Procurement Document (SPD) and Pre-Qualification Questionnaire (PQQ), which will assess suitability, technical and professional capability, capacity and relevant experience. A maximum of five suppliers will be shortlisted and invited to participate in the Invitation to Tender stage.

result.text: The subject of the contract is cross-business-area strategy and management consulting for KfW and its subsidiaries IPEX, KfW Capital, and DEG (hereinafter also: individual clients). The consulting is provided within the framework of fixed-term individual contracts and supports the Board of Management/Executive Board and top management (in particular division or department heads who report directly to the Board of Management/Executive Board) with strategic and organisational issues in all business areas. The consulting services are expected to concern: - Development and review of business models, strategies, and target images, including promotional policy, banking, and regulatory aspects. - Analysis, optimisation, and redesign of organisational structures and business processes, particularly in the context of digital transformation. - Development and evaluation of fund solutions, public-private partnerships, and models for mobilising private capital. - Consulting on strategic and process-related issues in the field of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and generative AI (GenAI), particularly regarding governance, organisation, and best practices (no technical implementation). - Conducting market, competition, and impact analyses, including benchmarking, market trends, and best-practice comparisons. - Support in identifying and evaluating investment needs, regulatory hurdles, and other specific research questions. - Moderation of workshops, conducting interviews, and presentation of results. The estimated quantity is 4.200 consultant days over the entire term. Information on the lots: Within the framework of the agreement for the provision of consulting services, KfW will, in addition to strategy and management consulting (Lot 1), also tender a further lot (Lot 2) for specialist consulting. Lot 1 comprises consulting services for cross-business-area strategy and management consulting for the KfW Bankengruppe as well as its subsidiaries IPEX, KfW Capital, and DEG. Lot 2 comprises specialist, division-specific, and cross-business-area specialist consulting for KfW and its subsidiaries IPEX, KfW Capital, and DEG. An applicant or a consortium of applicants may only apply for one lot, § 30 para. 1 VgV. Multiple applications for both lots are inadmissible. The restriction serves the clear separation between the provision of strategic and specialist consulting services.

parts.source: Leistungsgegenstand ist die geschäftsfeldübergreifende Strategie- und Managementberatung der KfW und ihrer Tochtergesellschaften IPEX, KfW Capital und DEG (im Folgenden auch: Einzelauftraggeber). Die Beratung erfolgt im Rahmen befristeter Einzelaufträge und unterstützt jeweils den Vorstand/die Geschäftsführung und das Top-Management (insbesondere Bereichs- oder Abteilungsleiter, die direkt an den Vorstand/die Geschäftsführung berichten) bei strategischen und organisatorischen Fragestellungen in allen Geschäftsfeldern. Die Beratungsleistungen betreffen voraussichtlich: - Entwicklung und Überprüfung von Geschäftsmodellen, Strategien und Zielbildern, einschließlich förderpolitischer, bankfachlicher und regulatorischer Aspekte. - Analyse, Optimierung und Neugestaltung von Organisationsstrukturen und Geschäftsprozessen, insbesondere im Kontext der digitalen Transformation. - Entwicklung und Bewertung von Fondslösungen, öffentlich-privaten Partnerschaften und Modellen zur Mobilisierung von Privatkapital. - Beratung zu strategischen und prozessbezogenen Fragestellungen im Bereich Künstliche Intelligenz (KI) und generativer KI (GenAI), insbesondere zu Governance, Organisation und Best Practices (keine technische Umsetzung). - Durchführung von Markt-, Wettbewerbs- und Wirkungsanalysen, einschließlich Benchmarking, Markttrends und Best-Practice-Vergleichen. - Unterstützung bei der Identifikation und Bewertung von Investitionsbedarfen, regulatorischen Hürden und weiteren spezifischen Research-Fragestellungen. - Moderation von Workshops, Durchführung von Interviews und Präsentation von Ergebnissen. Die Schätzmenge beträgt 4.200 Beratertage über die gesamte Laufzeit. Information zu den Losen: Im Rahmen der Vereinbarung zur Bereitstellung von Beratungsdienstleistungen wird die KfW neben der Strategie- und Managementberatung (Los 1) auch ein weiteres Los (Los 2) für fachspezifische Beratung ausschreiben. Los 1 umfasst Beratungsleistungen für geschäftsfeldübergreifende Strategie- und Managementberatung für die KfW Bankengruppe sowie deren Tochtergesellschaften IPEX, KfW Capital und DEG. Los 2 umfasst die fach-, bereichs- sowie geschäftsfeldübergreifende Fachberatung der KfW und ihrer Tochtergesellschaften IPEX, KfW Capital und DEG. Ein Bewerber bzw. eine Bewerbergemeinschaft darf sich nur auf ein Los bewerben, § 30 Abs. 1 VgV. Mehrfachbewerbungen für beide Lose sind unzulässig. Die Beschränkung dient der klaren Trennung zwischen der Erbringung strategischer und fachlicher Beratungsleistungen.

rejected.text: This is a request for information, which is not a procurement notice or a call for tenders. The purpose of the request for information is to gather information concerning the subject of the procurement for a future tender process. Responding to the request for information is not a prerequisite for participating in any potential subsequent tender process. However, to ensure the success of the future tender process, it would be important for potential tenderers to provide the contracting authority with the requested information as comprehensively as possible. The request for information does not oblige Istekki Oy to carry out the procurement as described in the request for information or its appendices, and the tendering procedure may also not be carried out. The subject of this request for information is working life permit and card training courses, and the purpose is to examine the supply available on the market, for example regarding occupational safety, first aid and hot work training courses, as well as the market situation, products, contract terms and pricing of related additional services. In addition, we request answers to the questions we have presented, which are in the appendix "Tietopyyntö ja kysymykset" of this request for information. Currently, the annual need for training courses is 90–100 training courses, depending on the training required. The procurement includes the organisation of training courses as both online and classroom teaching. The training courses include e.g. the following qualifications: - Occupational Safety Card - Hot Work Card - Risk Assessment - Basic training course for chemical safety supervisors - Occupational health and safety responsibilities and cooperation at the workplace - Electrical safety card SFS 6002 - Electrical work emergency first aid (0,5 day training) - Emergency first aid course, incl. SPR® versions (0,5 and 1 day training courses) - SPR EA1® (2 day training) There is a need for training courses implemented as classroom teaching primarily in Mikkeli, Kuopio and Tampere. If necessary, training courses can also be arranged at Istekki's other locations, i.e. Oulu, Jyväskylä and Espoo. The response to the request for information must be submitted by email to the address hankinnat@istekki.fi no later than 30.9.2025 at 14.00. The information provided will be treated confidentially. In the request for information response, you are kindly requested to state your willingness to participate in a market dialogue meeting. Based on the responses received, Istekki will select at its own discretion 1-5 tenderers to present their services in an approximately one-hour meeting via Teams. More detailed information on responding and the market dialogue, as well as provisional dates for the meetings, are provided in the appendix "Tietopyyntö ja kysymykset". Respondents to the request for information will not be paid remuneration for making the request for information or for participating in any presentation events related to the request for information. The tender service automatically creates deadlines for submitting questions and responding to the request for information. Instead of these deadlines, the deadlines in the request for information document shall be observed. Any additional information questions should primarily be asked as part of the request for information responses. The contracting authority will not publish additional information questions submitted during the request for information phase.

parts.source: Tämä on tietopyyntö, joka ei ole hankintailmoitus tai tarjouspyyntö. Tietopyynnön tarkoituksena on kerätä hankinnan kohdetta koskevaa tietoa tulevaa kilpailutusta varten. Tietopyyntöön vastaaminen ei ole edellytys mahdolliseen myöhempään kilpailutukseen osallistumiselle. Tulevan kilpailutuksen onnistumisen varmistamiseksi olisi kuitenkin tärkeää, että potentiaaliset tarjoajat antaisivat hankintayksikölle mahdollisimman laajasti pyydettyjä tietoja. Tietopyyntö ei velvoita Istekki Oy:tä toteuttamaan hankintaa tietopyynnössä tai sen liitteissä kuvatulla tavalla ja tarjouskilpailu voidaan myös jättää toteuttamatta. Tämän tietopyynnön kohteena on työelämän lupa- ja korttikoulutukset ja tarkoituksena on selvittää markkinoilla olevaa tarjontaa, esimerkiksi työturvallisuus-, ensiapu- ja tulityökoulutuksista, sekä niihin liittyvien lisäpalvelujen markkinatilannetta, tuotteita, sopimusehtoja ja toimittajien hinnoittelua. Lisäksi pyydämme vastausta esittämiimme kysymyksiin, jotka ovat tämän tietopyynnön liitteessä "Tietopyyntö ja kysymykset". Tällä hetkellä koulutusten tarve vuositasolla on 90–100 koulutusta, riippuen tarvittavasta koulutuksesta. Hankintaan kuuluu koulutusten järjestäminen sekä verkko- että lähiopetuksena. Koulutukset sisältävät mm. seuraavat pätevyydet: - Työturvallisuuskortti - Tulityökortti - Riskien arviointi - Kemikaalien käytönvalvojan peruskoulutus - Työsuojeluvastuut ja -yhteistoiminta työpaikalla - Sähkötyöturvallisuuskortti SFS 6002 - Sähkötyön hätäensiapu (0,5 päivän koulutus) - Hätäensiapukurssi, sis. SPR®-versiot (0,5 ja 1 päivän koulutukset) - SPR EA1® (2 päivän koulutus) Lähiopetuksena toteutettaville koulutuksille on tarve ensisijaisesti Mikkelissä, Kuopiossa ja Tampereella. Koulutuksia voidaan tarvittaessa järjestää myös Istekin muilla toimipaikkakunnilla eli Oulussa, Jyväskylässä ja Espoossa. Tietopyyntöön tulee vastata viimeistään 30.9.2025 klo 14.00 mennessä sähköpostitse osoitteeseen hankinnat@istekki.fi. Annetut tiedot käsitellään luottamuksellisesti. Tietopyyntövastauksessa pyydetään ystävällisesti ilmoittamaan halukkuudesta osallistua markkinavuoropuhelutapaamiseen. Saatujen vastausten perusteella Istekki valitsee oman harkintansa mukaan 1-5 Tarjoajaa esittelemään palveluitaan noin tunnin tapaamisessa Teamsin välityksellä. Tarkemmat tiedot vastaamisesta ja markkinavuoropuhelusta, sekä alustavat ajankohdat tapaamisille on ilmoitettu liitteessä "Tietopyyntö ja kysymykset" Tietopyyntöön vastanneille ei makseta korvausta tietopyynnön tekemisestä tai mahdollisiin tietopyyntöön liittyviin esittelytilaisuuksiin osallistumisesta. Tarjouspalvelu luo automaattisesti määräajat kysymysten jätölle ja tietopyyntöön vastaamiselle. Kyseisten määräaikojen sijaan noudatetaan tietopyyntöasiakirjan määräaikoja. Mahdolliset lisätietokysymykset tulee lähtökohtaisesti esittää osana tietopyyntövastauksia. Hankintayksikkö ei julkaise tietopyyntövaiheessa jätettyjä lisätietokysymyksiä.

result.text: The Zero Waste Scotland Circular Economy Intern Programme was launched in 2020 to support businesses to identify, design and deliver circular economy practices by providing access to additional, resources for circular economy projects. The programme was developed in recognition of a key barrier faced by many organisations: limited internal capacity to explore and implement circular economy approaches alongside day-to-day operations. There remains a strong and ongoing role for an intern programme of this nature and Zero Waste Scotland would like to contract with a suitable organisation to recruit, manage and report on a series of internships to be placed within different enterprises in Scotland to support transition to circular business models Lot 1: . Zero Waste Scotland (the ‘Client’) requires the provision of technical support from a suitably skilled and experienced third-party organisation to recruit and manage a series of internships to be placed within different enterprises in Scotland to support transition to circular business models The Contractor shall work closely with the Client to provide recruitment services that facilitate the identification, recruitment and placement of suitably qualified candidates into internship placements within Client-approved host enterprises. Placements shall be offered on a call-off basis for a duration of up to 12 months, for a maximum of thirty-five (35) hours per week. The exact duration of each placement will vary depending on the agreed scope, objectives and requirements of the individual placement, as approved by the Client. The services to be provided by the Contractor may include, either individually or in combination, and with input from the Client and the host enterprise as appropriate, the following: -Development of a suitable job description for each placement, aligned with the agreed scope and objectives. -Advertisement of the internship opportunity through appropriate and agreed recruitment/ media channels. -Shortlisting of suitable candidates against agreed selection criteria. -Coordination and conduct of interviews with suitable shortlisted candidates, in collaboration with the Client and host enterprise. -Contract management of the intern for the duration of the placement. -Provision of all payroll requirements required for the placement, including statutory obligations. -Exit management of the intern at the end of the placement, including end of contract processes.

result.text: This notice is not a procurement notice or a call for tenders, and its publication does not initiate a tendering competition. This is a market survey and a request for information related to a preliminary study directed at potential suppliers. The purpose of the request for information is to survey the solutions available on the market and to obtain comprehensive information regarding them so that the procurement in preparation can be carried out as appropriately as possible. Responding to the request for information is not a prerequisite for participating in the competition and does not affect the tenderer's position in it. The matters presented in the request for information are preliminary and may change as the preparation of the procurement progresses. The feedback received in the request for information will potentially be utilised in the preparation of the call for tenders. The subject of the request for information is a document management and archiving service at various information security levels (SaaS and On-Premise) including electronic signature, the possibility of integrations and the utilisation of automation, as well as customer support. The customer support service hours are fundamentally during office hours 8-16.15, but it must be expandable according to customer needs (possibly also at weekends). Customer support is available in Finnish and Swedish, with good oral and written skills in Finnish as a requirement. The anticipated scope of the procurement in the initial phase is approximately 20 central government organisations of varying sizes, a small proportion of which require the On-Premise service. We kindly ask you to register for the market dialogue by responding to this request for information in Tarjouspalvelu by the deadline. The market dialogue is divided into two phases: 1. Written responses to the request for information electronically by 17.10.2025 2. Supplier meetings: a review of the supplier's solution and open questions concerning the subject of the procurement. The meetings will be held in weeks 45 and 46. We reserve the right to present additional questions to suppliers if it is deemed necessary for the advancement of the competition. Any additional questions will be presented electronically to those who have participated in the market dialogue. The contracting authority will select a maximum of 5 potential tenderers for the market dialogue that have the capability to produce the service in accordance with the subject of the procurement in its planned scope. The capability of potential tenderers will be assessed based on the responses given to the questions presented later in this request for information. An invitation to the meeting will be sent to the suppliers selected for the market dialogue by the end of week 43. Those who have responded to the request for information or participated in the market dialogue will not be paid any compensation for responding to the request for information or for costs arising from participation in the market dialogue. The information provided by suppliers will be treated confidentially.

parts.source: Tämä ilmoitus ei ole hankintailmoitus eikä tarjouspyyntö, eikä sen julkaisemisella aloiteta tarjouskilpailua. Kyseessä on markkinakartoitus ja esiselvitykseen liittyvä tietopyyntö mahdollisille toimittajille. Tietopyynnön tarkoituksena on kartoittaa markkinoilla olevia ratkaisuja ja saada kattavasti niitä koskevaa tietoa, että valmisteilla oleva kilpailutus voidaan toteuttaa mahdollisimman tarkoituksenmukaisesti. Tietopyyntöön vastaaminen ei ole edellytys kilpailutukseen osallistumiselle eikä vaikuta tarjoajan asemaan siinä. Tietopyynnössä esitetyt seikat ovat alustavia ja saattavat muuttua hankinnan valmistelun edetessä. Tietopyynnössä saatua palautetta hyödynnetään mahdollisesti tarjouspyynnön valmistelussa. Tieto-pyynnön kohteena on Asianhallinnan ja arkistoinnin palvelu eri tietoturvatasoilla (SaaS ja OnPremise) sisältäen sähköisen allekirjoituksen, mahdollisuuden integraatioihin ja automaation hyödyntämiseen sekä asiakastuen. Asiakastuen palveluaika lähtökohtaisesti virka-aikana klo 8-16.15, mutta se tulee olla laajennettavissa asiakastarpeiden mukaisesti (mahdollisesti myös viikonloppuisin). Asiakastuki on saatavilla suomeksi ja ruotsiksi, edellytyksenä hyvä suomen kielen suullinen ja kirjallinen taito. Hankinnan ennakoitu laajuus alkuvaiheessa on noin 20 valtionhallinnon eri kokoista organisaatiota, joista pieni osa tarvitsee OnPremise-palvelua. Pyydämme ilmoittautumaan markkinavuoropuheluun vastaamalla tähän tietopyyntöön Tarjouspalvelussa määräaikaan mennessä. Markkinavuoropuhelu jakautuu kahteen vaiheeseen: 1. Kirjalliset vastaukset tietopyyntöön sähköisesti 17.10.2025 mennessä 2. Toimittajatapaamiset: käydään läpi toimittajan ratkaisua sekä avoimia hankinnan kohdetta koskevia kysymyksiä. Tapaamiset pidetään viikoilla 45 ja 46. Varaamme oikeuden esittää lisäkysymyksiä toimittajille, mikäli se koetaan tarpeelliseksi kilpailutuksen edistämisen kannalta. Mahdolliset lisäkysymykset esitetään markkinavuoropuheluun osallistuneille sähköisesti. Hankintayksikkö valitsee markkinavuoropuheluun enintään 5 potentiaalista tarjoajaa, joilla on kyvykkyyttä tuottaa hankinnan kohteen mukaista palvelua sen suunnitellussa laajuudessa. Potentiaalisten tarjoajien kyvykkyyttä arvioidaan jäljempänä tässä tietopyynnössä esitettyihin kysymyksiin annettujen vastausten perusteella. Markkinavuoropuheluun valituille toimittajille lähetetään kutsu tapaamiseen viikon 43 loppuun mennessä. Tietopyyntöön vastanneille tai markkinavuoropuheluun osallistuneille ei makseta korvausta tietopyyntöön vastaamisesta, eikä markkinavuoropuheluun osallistumisesta aiheutuvista kustannuksista. Toimittajien antamat tiedot käsitellään luottamuksellisesti.

result.text: To create a uniform organisational and documentation structure for initial, further and advanced training that standardises internal operational processes, the exchange of relevant information and reporting obligations towards public authorities, UKA requires a system that combines both the requirements of a school and a seminar management programme. All information on the courses and seminars offered, participants, lecturers and resources is to be managed centrally. The initial and further training structure must be capable of clear course planning with timetable and room planning. Lot LOT-0001: School and seminar administration management. Subject of the procurement: - Licences for a software solution for managing initial and further training as well as seminars. A centralised solution that meets all requirements is explicitly requested - Installation of the software solution - Customising and other services for the commissioning of the software solution - Hosting and operation of the system in an ISO/IEC 27001:2013 certified data centre of the European Union - Maintenance and support for the software solution (levels with defined response times) - Training services, training materials, best-practice process model for the key users of the system - Implementation support (go-live support, after-go-live support) - Documentation of the system, manuals The term is initially 3 years with the option to extend twice by a further 12 months each time. The extension option is exercised unless the contracting authority terminates the contract within 3 months of the end of the contract.

parts.source: Zur Schaffung einer einheitlichen Organisations- und Dokumentationsstruktur für die Aus-, Fort- und Weiterbildung, welche die betriebsinternen Abläufe, den Austausch von relevanten Informationen sowie der Berichtspflicht gegenüber den öffentlichen Behörden vereinheitlicht, benötigt die UKA ein System, das sowohl die Anforderungen eines Schul- als auch die eines Seminarmanagementprogramms zusammenführt. result.text: Keski-Uudenmaan hyvinvointialueen TKIO procurement system (hereinafter procurement system) forms a central part of the contracting authority's research, development, innovation and competence development activities and procurement platform. It forms the structure of a cooperation model regulated by an agreement between the subscriber and the research, development and innovation partners. The purpose of the services to be competed in the procurement system is to produce research data, development services and innovations as a basis for the subscriber's development activities and management. The procurement system is divided into categories as follows: Category 1 Innovation services Category 2 Development of service systems Category 3 Project services Category 4 Strategic development Category 5 Scientific communities In addition, the subject matter of the procurement includes piloting and experimentation services as well as continuous development and management services for the subscriber's use. The subject matter of the procurement and the operation of the procurement system are described in more detail in the appendix "Principles of the TKIO dynamic purchasing system". The minimum requirements for each category and the competence requirements for applicants at the establishment stage are described in more detail in this call for participation. The subscriber shall define the subject matter and requirements of the assignments to be competed in the procurement system in more detail in each internal call for tenders of the procurement system. The procurement system shall be valid until 31.10.2029, during which time the internal call for tenders of the procurement system shall be carried out. The subscriber may extend the validity of the procurement system with a new contract notice. Suppliers may apply to join the procurement system at the establishment stage and later during its validity by submitting a request to participate in accordance with the call for participation. The procurement procedure is two-stage. To be able to submit tenders, a supplier must first submit a request to participate and be admitted to the procurement system. After this, the supplier may submit tenders by responding to the call for tenders sent by the contracting authority. The contracting authority shall carry out internal competitions within the procurement system in the future as needed. Requests to participate may be submitted to the dynamic purchasing system throughout its duration. All applicants meeting the suitability requirements shall be admitted to the dynamic purchasing system. Actual procurements shall be made through internal competitions of the dynamic purchasing system, in which the subject matter of the procurement is described and specified. Participation in the internal competitions of the DPS is not possible unless the supplier has been admitted to the procurement system. The submission of a request to participate and admission to the procurement system does not oblige the supplier to submit a tender, but suppliers may submit tenders at their discretion. The contracting authority estimates that the value excluding value added tax of the planned procurements covered by the dynamic purchasing system at the time of publication of the call for participation is 5,6 million euros, taking into account all procurements potentially made within the system. The estimate is preliminary and based on the procurement need known at this time. The contracting authority does not commit to any procurement quantities or minimum purchase obligations with this notice. Category 1 Innovation services includes the generation of innovations and futures research. The purpose of innovation services is to produce innovative solutions and new methods for the organisation and production of services in an impactful way. Innovation can also aim, for example, at anticipating the demand for services and substantive change needs. Innovations include, for example, digital operating models, solutions related to the innovative utilisation of technology, or the utilisation of robotics and artificial intelligence in social welfare and healthcare services. Central to innovations is the consideration of customer experience, quality, impact and cost perspectives. Innovations may also relate to operational monitoring models, measurement of results or strategic work. The result of an innovation may also be a commercialised product or service. Category 1 Innovation services additionally includes Piloting and experimentation services, the purpose of which is to test new innovations and services resulting from assignments or other cooperation in practice. Continuous development and management, the purpose of which is the implementation of new or redesigned services, systems or operations resulting from the results of assignments such that the implementation includes their continuous development as part of service production or other activities of the subscriber. See appendix "Principles of the TKIO dynamic purchasing system" for more details.; Category 2 Development of service systems is expert service, the purpose of which is the development of services, service processes, service networks and service systems. The development of service systems includes the collection and analysis of data on the current state, needs and impact of services. The data is utilised in development activities. The development of service systems may include the production of various methods and tools for the subscriber's needs to support the implementation of changes. The service may include the implementation of stakeholder involvement, for example through service design or equivalent means. The development of service systems may also include coaching service, the purpose of which is to support the subscriber in development activities and the consolidation of results. Category 2 Development of service systems additionally includes - Piloting and experimentation services, the purpose of which is to test new innovations and services resulting from assignments or other cooperation in practice. - Continuous development and management, the purpose of which is the implementation of new or redesigned services, systems or operations resulting from the results of assignments such that the implementation includes their continuous development as part of service production or other activities of the subscriber. See appendix "Principles of the TKIO dynamic purchasing system" for more details.;

parts.source: Keski-Uudenmaan hyvinvointialueen TKIO hankintajärjestelmä (jatkossa hankintajärjestelmä) muodostaa hankintayksikön tutkimus-, kehitys-, innovaatio- ja osaamisen kehittämisen toiminnan keskeisen osan ja hankinta-alustan. Se muodostaa tilaajan ja tutkimus-, kehittämis- ja innovaatiokumppanien sopimuksella säädellyn yhteistyömallin rakenteen. Hankintajärjestelmässä kilpailutettavien palvelujen tarkoituksena on tuottaa tuottavat tutkimustietoa, kehittämispalveluita ja innovaatioita tilaajan kehittämistoiminnan ja johtamisen perustaksi. Hankintajärjestelmä on jaettu luokkiin seuraavasti: Luokka 1 Innovaatiopalvelut Luokka 2 Palvelujärjestelmien kehittäminen Luokka 3 Hankepalvelut Luokka 4 Strateginen kehittäminen Luokka 5 Tiedeyhteisöt Lisäksi hankinnan kohteena ovat pilotointi- ja kokeilupalvelut sekä jatkuvan kehittämisen ja hallinnoinnin palvelut tilaajan käyttöön. Hankinnan kohde ja hankintajärjestelmän toiminta on kuvattu tarkemmin liitteessä ”TKIO dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän periaatteet”. Kunkin luokan vähimmäisvaatimukset sekä hakijoita koskevat perustamisvaiheen osaamisvaatimukset kuvataan tarkemmin tässä osallistumispyynnössä. Tilaaja määrittelee kussakin hankintajärjestelmän sisäisessä tarjouspyynnössä tarkemmin hankintajärjestelmässä kilpailutettavien toimeksiantojen kohteen ja vaatimukset. Hankintajärjestelmä on voimassa 31.10.2029 saakka, minä aikana hankintajärjestelmän sisäiset tarjouskilpailut tehdään. Tilaaja voi jatkaa hankintajärjestelmän voimassaoloa uudella hankintailmoituksella. Toimittajat voivat hakeutua hankintajärjestelmään perustamisvaiheessa ja myöhemmin sen voimassaoloaikana jättämällä osallistumishakemuksen osallistumispyynnön mukaisesti. Hankintamenettely on kaksivaiheinen. Päästäkseen jättämään tarjouksia toimittajan on ensin jätettävä osallistumishakemus ja tultava hyväksytyksi hankintajärjestelmään. Tämän jälkeen toimittaja voi tehdä tarjouksia vastaamalla hankintayksikön lähettämään tarjouspyyntöön. Hankintayksikkö toteuttaa jatkossa sisäisiä kilpailutuksia hankintajärjestelmässä tarpeen mukaan. Dynaamiseen hankintajärjestelmään voi jättää osallistumishakemuksia koko sen keston ajan. Dynaamiseen hankintajärjestelmään otetaan mukaan kaikki soveltuvuusvaatimukset täyttävät hakijat. Varsinaiset hankinnat tehdään dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän sisäisillä kilpailutuksilla, joissa kuvataan ja tarkennetaan hankinnan kohde. DPS:n sisäisiin tarjouskilpailuihin ei voi osallistua, ellei toimittajaa ole hyväksytty hankintajärjestelmään. Osallistumishakemuksen jättäminen ja hankintajärjestelmään hyväksyminen ei velvoita toimittajaa tekemään tarjousta, vaan toimittajat voivat tehdä tarjouksia harkintansa mukaan. Hankintayksikkö arvioi osallistumispyynnön julkaisuhetkellä dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän kohteena olevien suunniteltujen hankintojen arvonlisäverottomaksi arvioiduksi määräksi 5,6 miljoonaa euroa huomioiden kaikki järjestelmässä mahdollisesti tehdyt hankinnat. Arvio on alustava ja perustuu tällä hetkellä tiedossa olevaan hankintatarpeeseen. Hankintayksikkö ei sitoudu mihinkään hankintamääriin tai määräostovelvoitteisiin tällä ilmoituksella. Luokassa 1 Innovaatiopalveluihin kuuluu innovaatioiden tuottaminen ja tulevaisuustutkimus. Innovaatiopalveluiden tarkoituksena on tuottaa tilaajalle innovatiivisia ratkaisuja ja uusia menetelmiä palvelujen järjestämiseksi ja tuottamiseksi vaikuttavalla tavalla. Innovaatiolla voidaan myös pyrkiä esimerkiksi palveluiden kysynnän ja sisällöllisten muutostarpeiden ennakointiin. Innovaatioita ovat esimerkiksi digitaaliset toimintamallit, teknologian innovatiiviseen hyödyntämiseen liittyvät ratkaisut tai robotiikan ja tekoälyn hyödyntäminen sosiaali- ja terveyspalveluissa. Innovaatioissa keskeistä on asiakaskokemuksen, laadun, vaikuttavuuden ja kustannusten näkökulmien huomioiminen. Innovaatiot voivat liittyä myös toiminnan seurantamalleihin, tulosten mittaamiseen tai strategiseen työhön. Innovaation tuloksena voi syntyä myös kaupallistettava tuote tai palvelu. Luokan 1 Innovaatiopalveluihin sisältyy lisäksi Pilotointi- ja kokeilupalvelut, joiden tarkoituksena on kokeilla uusia, toimeksiantojen tai muun yhteistyön tuloksena syntyneitä innovaatioita ja palveluja käytännössä. Jatkuva kehittäminen ja hallinnointi, jonka tarkoituksena on toimeksiantojen tuloksena syntyneiden uusien tai uudelleen muotoiltujen palveluiden, järjestelmien tai toimintojen toteutus siten, että toteutukseen sisältyy niiden jatkuva kehittäminen osana palvelutuotantoa tai muuta tilaajan toimintaa. Katso tarkemmin liite ”TKIO dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän periaatteet”.; Luokassa 2 Palvelujärjestelmien kehittäminen on asiantuntijapalvelua, jonka tarkoituksena on palvelujen, palveluprosessien, palvelujen verkostojen ja palvelujärjestelmien kehittäminen. Palvelujärjestelmien kehittämiseen kuuluu tiedon kerääminen ja analyysi nykytilasta ja tarpeista ja palveluiden vaikuttavuudesta. Tietoa hyödynnetään kehittämistoiminnassa. Palvelujärjestelmien kehittämiseen voi kuulua erilaisten menetelmien ja työkalujen tuottaminen tilaajan tarpeisiin muutosten toteuttamisen tueksi. Palveluun voi sisältyä sidosryhmäosallisuuden toteuttamista esimerkiksi palvelumuotoilun tai vastaavin keinoin. Palvelujärjestelmien kehittämiseen voi sisältyä myös valmennuksellista palvelua, jonka tarkoituksena on tukea tilaajaa kehittämistoiminnassa ja tulosten vakiinnuttamisessa. Luokan 2 Palvelujärjestelmien kehittämiseen sisältyy lisäksi - Pilotointi- ja kokeilupalvelut, joiden tarkoituksena on kokeilla uusia, toimeksiantojen tai muun yhteistyön tuloksena syntyneitä innovaatioita ja palveluja käytännössä. - Jatkuva kehittäminen ja hallinnointi, jonka tarkoituksena on toimeksiantojen tuloksena syntyneiden uusien tai uudelleen muotoiltujen palveluiden, järjestelmien tai toimintojen toteutus siten, että toteutukseen sisältyy niiden jatkuva kehittäminen osana palvelutuotantoa tai muuta tilaajan toimintaa. result.text: Category 3 Project Services includes the entire project process management for the subscriber's research, development and innovation activities. Project services include project planning services, project management services and project services. Category 3 Project Services also includes: - Piloting and experimentation services, the purpose of which is to test new innovations and services resulting from assignments or other cooperation in practice. - Continuous development and management, the purpose of which is the implementation of new or redesigned services, systems or operations resulting from assignments, such that the implementation includes their continuous development as part of service production or other subscriber operations. See the appendix 'TKIO dynamic purchasing system principles' for more details.; Category 4 Strategic development consulting is an expert service intended to provide the subscriber with comprehensive support for development activities and change management, from the perspectives of organiser management and service production. Strategic development consulting produces versatile and comprehensive information, expertise and insights into the development of social and health services and specialised medical care, as well as large-scale integration projects. The consulting offers expert knowledge for promoting the effectiveness, customer-orientation and quality of innovation and development activities in social welfare, health services and specialised medical care, as well as for the design, analysis and implementation of new operating models and process complexes. The strategic development consulting expert service includes versatile expertise in improving the effectiveness and productivity of social and health services, financing systems, improving service accessibility, designing service systems and networks, developing data-driven management capabilities and future forecasting. Strategic development can also include service production management services, which can be used to achieve significant cost savings when service production and the producer field in accordance with procurement contracts can be managed more systematically and purposefully. The service production management service can also help the contracting authority to find consistent and replicable operating processes for managing service providers, with which better service effectiveness, customer satisfaction, quality and cost-efficiency can be achieved. Category 4 Strategic development also includes: - Piloting and experimentation services, the purpose of which is to test new innovations and services resulting from assignments or other cooperation in practice. - Continuous development and management, the purpose of which is the implementation of new or redesigned services, systems or operations resulting from assignments, such that the implementation includes their continuous development as part of service production or other subscriber operations. See the appendix 'TKIO dynamic purchasing system principles' for more details.; Category 5 For the scientific community, the procurement system acts as a cooperation platform and procurement channel towards the scientific community, such as universities, higher education institutions, educational institutions, centres of expertise and research institutes. Services procured from the scientific community in the procurement system may include services considered to be scientific activities, which in their content complement projects implemented within the framework of TKIO cooperation. Scientific activity may include any research activity and services in accordance with the subject of the procurement system, but a scientific and research perspective is always emphasised in these services. Services and research activities may be such that the benefit obtained accrues for use in operations other than those of the contracting authority. Services procured from the scientific community may also be research and development services where the benefit obtained accrues exclusively for use in the contracting authority's operations and the contracting authority compensates for the service performed in full. The nature of the service is specified in each call for tenders within the procurement system. Services can also be ordered from the scientific community directly without a call for tenders within the procurement system, if the conditions for the procurement act's scope exemption concerning research and development services (9 section 1 subsection 13 point) are met. Category 5 Scientific community also includes: - Piloting and experimentation services, the purpose of which is to test new innovations and services resulting from assignments or other cooperation in practice. See the appendix 'TKIO dynamic purchasing system principles' for more details.
