Hankepalveluihin kuuluvat hankesuunnittelupalvelut, hankejohtopalvelut ja projektipalvelut. Luokan 3 Hankepalveluihin sisältyy lisäksi - Pilotointi- ja kokeilupalvelut, joiden tarkoituksena on kokeilla uusia, toimeksiantojen tai muun yhteistyön tuloksena syntyneitä innovaatioita ja palveluja käytännössä. - Jatkuva kehittäminen ja hallinnointi, jonka tarkoituksena on toimeksiantojen tuloksena syntyneiden uusien tai uudelleen muotoiltujen palveluiden, järjestelmien tai toimintojen toteutus siten, että toteutukseen sisältyy niiden jatkuva kehittäminen osana palvelutuotantoa tai muuta tilaajan toimintaa. Katso tarkemmin liite ”TKIO dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän periaatteet”.; Luokan 4 Strategisen kehittämisen konsultointi on asiantuntijapalvelua, jonka tarkoituksena on mahdollistaa tilaajalle kokonaisvaltainen tuki kehittämistoimintaan ja muutoshallintaan, järjestäjäohjauksen ja palvelutuotannon näkökulmista. Strategisen kehittämisen konsultointi tuottaa monipuolista ja kokonaisvaltaista tietoa, osaamista ja näkemyksiä sosiaali- ja terveyspalveluiden sekä erikoissairaanhoidon kehittämisestä ja laajoista integrointihankkeista. Konsultointi tarjoaa asiantuntijaosaamista sosiaalihuollon, terveyspalveluiden ja erikoissairaanhoidon innovaatio- ja kehittämistoiminnan vaikuttavuuden, asiakaslähtöisyyden ja laadun edistämiseen sekä uusien toimintamallien ja prosessien kokonaisuuksien suunnitteluun, analysointiin ja käyttöönottoon. Strategisen kehittämisen konsultoinnin asiantuntijapalveluun kuuluu monipuolinen osaaminen sosiaali- ja terveyspalveluiden vaikuttavuuden ja tuottavuuden parantamisesta, rahoitusjärjestelmistä, palveluiden saavutettavuuden parantamisesta, palvelujärjestelmien ja verkostojen suunnittelusta, tiedolla johtamisen kyvykkyyden kehittämisestä ja tulevaisuuden ennakoinnista. Strateginen kehittäminen voi sisältää myös palvelutuotannon ohjauspalvelua, jonka avulla voidaan saavuttaa merkittäviä kustannussäästöjä, kun hankintasopimusten mukaista palvelutuotantoa ja tuottajakenttää saadaan ohjattua systemaattisemmin ja tavoitteellisemmin. Palvelutuotannon ohjauspalvelu voi myös auttaa hankintayksikköä löytämään palveluntuottajien johtamiseen johdonmukaiset ja monistettavissa olevat toimintaprosessit, joiden avulla voidaan saavuttaa palvelujen parempaa vaikuttavuutta, asiakastyytyväisyyttä, laatua ja kustannustehokkuutta. Luokan 4 Strategiseen kehittämiseen sisältyy lisäksi - Pilotointi- ja kokeilupalvelut, joiden tarkoituksena on kokeilla uusia, toimeksiantojen tai muun yhteistyön tuloksena syntyneitä innovaatioita ja palveluja käytännössä. - Jatkuva kehittäminen ja hallinnointi, jonka tarkoituksena on toimeksiantojen tuloksena syntyneiden uusien tai uudelleen muotoiltujen palveluiden, järjestelmien tai toimintojen toteutus siten, että toteutukseen sisältyy niiden jatkuva kehittäminen osana palvelutuotantoa tai muuta tilaajan toimintaa. Katso tarkemmin liite ”TKIO dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän periaatteet”.; Luokan 5 Tiedeyhteisöille hankintajärjestelmä toimii yhteistyöalustana ja hankintakanavana tiedeyhteisöihin, kuten yliopistoihin, korkeakouluihin, oppilaitoksiin, osaamiskeskuksiin ja tutkimuslaitoksiin päin. Hankintajärjestelmässä tiedeyhteisöiltä hankittava palvelu voi pitää sisällään tieteelliseksi toiminnaksi katsottavia palveluita, jotka sisällöltään täydentävät TKIO yhteistyön puitteissa toteutettavia hankkeita. Tieteellinen toiminta voi pitää sisällään mitä tahansa hankintajärjestelmän kohteen mukaista tutkimustoimintaa ja palveluita, mutta näissä palveluissa korostuu aina tieteellinen ja tutkimuksellinen näkökulma. Palvelut ja tutkimustoiminta voivat olla sellaisia, joista saatava hyöty koituu muidenkin kuin hankintayksikön toiminnassa käytettäväksi. Tiedeyhteisöiltä hankittavat palvelut voivat olla myös sellaisia tutkimus- ja kehittämispalveluita, joista saatava hyöty koituu yksinomaan hankintayksikön toiminnassa käytettäväksi ja hankintayksikkö korvaa suoritetun palvelun kokonaan. Palvelun luonne täsmennetään kussakin hankintajärjestelmän sisäisessä tarjouskilpailussa. Tiedeyhteisöiltä voidaan tilata palveluja myös suoraan ilman hankintajärjestelmän sisäistä kilpailutusta, mikäli hankintalain tutkimus- ja kehittämispalveluja koskevan soveltamisalapoikkeuksen (9 § 1 mom. 13-kohta) edellytykset täyttyvät. Luokkaan 5 Tiedeyhteisöt sisältyy lisäksi - Pilotointi- ja kokeilupalvelut, joiden tarkoituksena on kokeilla uusia, toimeksiantojen tai muun yhteistyön tuloksena syntyneitä innovaatioita ja palveluja käytännössä. Katso tarkemmin liite ”TKIO dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän periaatteet”.

rejected.text: The National Institute on Aging (NIA) intends to publish a Notice of Funding Opportunity (NOFO) to solicit applications that develop or incorporate novel, cutting-edge study designs/methods/analytic approaches through the use of machine learning, artificial intelligence, and adaptive designs to allow the discovery of health/function profiles at the level of the individual and that could lead to the implementation of personalised prevention plans/interventions for cognitive/brain health in older adults. The initiative would allow for both basic research in animal models, as well as the development of profiles for humans, which would span levels of analysis from cellular to societal. Applications are not being solicited at this time. Notice is being provided to allow potential applicants sufficient time to develop meaningful collaborations and responsive projects. This NOFO will utilise the R01 activity code. Investigators with expertise and insights into this area of aging research are encouraged to begin to consider applying for this new NOFO.

result.text: The objective of the Norwegian Agency for Public and Financial Management (DFØ) is to contribute to efficient use of resources in the government. With this as a background, DFØ is now working to make public procurements more efficient. DFØ shall enter into a contract for the delivery of professional and methodic assistance for this work, which shall provide a better knowledge and decision basis for further development of the discipline public procurements. The assistance includes, among other things, analysis and review work, strategic advice, development of management models, profit measurement and general support for the work. See the attached tender documentation for further information.

result.text: Background: Although many of the world"s fastest-growing economies are in Africa, trade among African countries remains limited. The continent mostly exports raw materials and agricultural products, while it imports machinery, equipment, and food mainly from outside Africa. The African Continental Free Trade Area (AfCFTA), which is one of the African Union"s (AU) flagship projects for the implementation of its Agenda 2063, aims to change this. It is expected that, with the introduction of the free trade zone, intra- African trade will be 15% to 25% higher by 2040 (UNECA). The AfCFTA agreement has been signed by 54 of the 55 African Union Member States (MS) and became effective under international law in May 2019. The full implementation of the AfCFTA will lead to a continental single market of more than 1.4 billion people with an aggregate GDP exceeding USD 2 trillion. Our Approach: The GIZ implemented project "Support to the African Continental Free Trade Area (AfCFTA) II" cofinanced by the BMZ and the EU, seeks to improve framework conditions for the realisation of the AfCFTA and supports the outstanding negotiations and the implementation of the AfCFTA. For this, the programme supports the African Union, specifically the Department for Economic Development, Trade, Tourism, Industry, Minerals (ETTIM) and the AfCFTA Secretariat at the continental level in the coordination of AfCFTA implementation. On the regional level the programme cooperates with Regional Economic Communities (RECs), specifically EAC (East African Community), ECOWAS (Economic Community for West African States) and SADC (South African Development Community, plus additional RECs based on request). The programme also supports Member States (Ethiopia, Ghana, Ivory Coast, Kenya, Malawi, Rwanda, Tunisia, Zambia, plus additional Member States based on request) by working with national institutions, like trade ministries and customs, to implement the agreement. Lastly, the programme works closely with private sector and civil society actors to increase trade under the AfCFTA. Together with the named partners, the programme covers interventions across all technical areas of the AfCFTA. The EU co-financed part of the programme, the EU Technical Assistance Facility, operates as a multi-partner contribution agreement between the European Commission, GIZ (lead implementing agency), Expertise France, and FIAP. A Project Management Unit, which is housed in the AfCFTA Secretariat, oversees the implementation of the programme and the execution of activities. The project seeks the services of a consulting firm to provide technical experts under different short-term expert (STE) pools, which can be deployed flexibly according to the specific demands of the project. The Contractor will contribute to the implementation of all BMZ and EU outputs of the project. The overall goal of this assignment is to support the implementation of the AfCFTA at the continental, regional, and national level by providing advisory services and capacity building for governmental as well as private sector and civil society stakeholders. When the need for support to the project"s partners within a particular thematic area is identified, experts shall be mobilised to provide demand-driven technical advisory services and/or capacity building to national, regional, and continental government partners and/or the project itself. The contract is for the provision of pools of qualified STE to cover a broad range of issues relating to AfCFTA negotiations and implementation in general and the programme objectives in particular. The services to be provided under the contract include measures for human capacity development and organisational and technical advice in the following thematic areas: - Removing barriers to Trade in Goods, Trade in Services and Digital Trade - Support for further AfCFTA negotiations (among others on Rules of Origin, Trade in Services) - Support for the ratification of the Phase II Protocols (Competition Policy, Intellectual Property Rights, Investment, Digital Trade, Women & Youth in Trade) - Implementation of AfCFTA regulations at the national and regional levels - Monitor and review the implementation of AfCFTA Protocols in African Union Member States (AU MS) - Improve access to trade information to relevant line ministries and to the private sector - Support the African private sector to trade under AfCFTA rules on the national and regional level - Support relevant authorities to setup inclusive policies for women & youth traders to participate in trade under AfCFTA The contractor will identify and manage pools of STE that will assist the initiatives in the programme"s areas of intervention. While the project operates Africa-wide, it focuses interventions at national level in 8 countries: Ethiopia, Ghana, Ivory Coast, Kenya, Malawi, Rwanda, Tunisia, and Zambia. At REC level it focuses at EAC, ECOWAS, and SADC. Interventions to additional AU MS and RECs will be implemented based on partner demand. Across the work packages named below, the contractor is responsible for the following tasks: - Supporting the GIZ in defining the required expertise to reach the project objectives under the described outputs - Identifying and proposing suitable experts from the STE pool - Selecting experts together with the GIZ team - Managing the deployment of experts Expected services that may be included in the work packages are: - Technical, operational, and strategic policy advisory services in the thematic areas listed above - Support in developing, drafting and reviewing reports, studies, analyses, position papers, guidelines, action plans, strategies, implementation plans, legislation, regulations in the thematic areas listed above. - Research and analysis, including diagnostic missions to assess implementation efforts of the AfCFTA protocols, identify obstacles and propose measures to advance implementation.

The aim is also to strengthen proactivity and continuous development and to ensure that the services take into account the special characteristics of the administrative network and educational network. The current state and objectives described above serve as the starting point for the service areas and requirements defined in more detail in the upcoming call for tenders.

Helsingin kaupunki valmistelee hankintaa tekoälyn hallinnan järjestelmästä, jonka tarkoituksena on mahdollistaa EU:n tekoälyasetuksen (AI Act) mukaisten velvoitteiden hallinta ja dokumentointi sekä tukea kaupungin kaikkien tekoälyjärjestelmien elinkaaren aikaista hallintaa. Tekoälyn hallinnan järjestelmä mahdollistaa EU:n tekoälyasetuksen tarjoajan ja käyttöönottajan velvoitteiden hallinnan, osoittamisen ja raportoimisen suuririskisten tekoälyjärjestelmien osalta sekä tukee kaupungin kaikkien tekoälyjärjestelmien hallintaa, tekoälyriskien tunnistamista ja hallintaa sekä viestintää tekoälystä. Järjestelmä toimii keskeisenä työkaluna riskien tunnistamisessa ja hallinnassa, dokumentoinnissa, viestinnän valmistelussa sekä käyttöönottoprosessien tukena. rejected.text: The project "Integrated Territorial Development and Good Governance in Togo" is implemented by the Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit (GIZ) GmbH on behalf of the German Federal Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development (BMZ). It supports the Government of Togo in advancing decentralisation and territorial development in the regions of Kara and Savanes. Despite progress in decentralisation, regional and local authorities face persistent challenges in exercising transferred competences, delivering quality public services, mobilising local revenues and promoting inclusive local economic development. These constraints are compounded by poverty, climate change, demographic pressure and a fragile security context in northern Togo. The overall objective is to enable regional and local actors to harness the social and economic potential of their territories to improve living conditions in an equitable and sustainable manner. The project applies an integrated territorial development approach with capacity development at individual, organisational and institutional levels. It cooperates with national ministries (Ministry of Local Development, Ministry of Decentralisation, Ministry of Finance), regional councils and municipalities, the National Training Agency for Local Authorities (Agence nationale de formation des collectivités territoriales, ANFCT), the National Association of Municipalities (Faîtière des Communes du Togo, FCT), civil society organisations and private sector actors. To sustain decentralisation and territorialisation efforts, the project also aims at strengthening socio-economic resilience, in particular of communities in the Northen border regions, and provide economic perspectives, in particular for young people. Activities are structured around three complementary outputs: (1) Strengthening the capacities of regional and local authorities to implement transferred competences. (2) Improving collaboration between public institutions, local authorities, civil society and the private sector for inclusive and conflict-sensitive territorial development. (3) Strengthening transparent, participatory and accountable local public financial management. Innovative elements include municipal benchmarking, peer-to-peer learning, digital solutions for local governance, performance-based management and evidence-based decision-making. Gender equality, social inclusion (LNOB), climate resilience, conflict sensitivity and digitalisation are mainstreamed across all interventions to ensure sustainable and scalable results. The assignment targets 38 municipalities in Kara and Savanes through FCT and ANFCT, with a view to progressive replication towards all 117 municipalities. Benchmarking and peer learning will be designed, piloted and institutionalised to steer capacity development and foster continuous improvement. In addition, specialised technical assistance will complement these mechanisms across the three outputs, including support for implementing transferred competences, facilitating inclusive territorial collaboration and strengthening local public financial management (e. g. participatory budgeting, revenue mobilisation, transparency and anti-corruption), while ensuring digital solutions adhere to recognised standards and are interoperable with national ecosystems. Lot LOT-0001: 10030260-Appui à la valorisation des potentiels territoriaux pour un développement local inclusif dans le nord du Togo. The objective of the assignment is to provide comprehensive technical assistance supporting the implementation of the project "Integrated Territorial Development and Good Governance in Togo" through institutional development, digital transformation, municipal benchmarking, peer-to-peer learning and specialised technical expertise contributing to integrated territorial development and good local governance in northern Togo. GIZ seeks to contract a consultancy firm for an implementation period of 24 months. The contractor will provide technical services through two Key Experts and a pool of short-term experts with international, regional and national experience allowing demand-driven mobilisation of specialised expertise throughout project implementation. The overall contract is expected to require approximately 1.500 expert days, delivered through individual experts and expert pools. The assignment is organised around four complementary work packages: Work Package 1: Development and institutionalisation of municipal benchmarking The contractor will support the development and implementation of a harmonised benchmarking system for municipalities, including performance frameworks, indicators, data collection methodologies, digital data management solutions and institutional anchoring in close collaboration within the National Association of Municipalities of Togo (FCT). The performance assessment on key competences of municipalities through the benchmarking system will provide the basis for mutual learning by identifying individual strengths and weaknesses across municipalities. Work Package 2: Development and institutionalisation of peer-to-peer learning The contractor will support the National Training Agency for Local Authorities (ANFCT) in establishing sustainable peer-to-peer learning mechanisms based on the benchmarking results, including learning methodologies, training concepts, organisational arrangements and knowledge management. Work Package 3: Operational implementation The contractor will support the implementation of benchmarking and peer-to-peer learning in the target municipalities through data collection and analysis, facilitation of learning events, capacity development, capitalisation of experiences and gradual institutionalisation of the developed mechanisms.

result.text: UHS is seeking to engage with interested parties to discuss and refine an opportunity to become a strategic endoscopy partner to the Trust. UHS provides a regional endoscopy service to a population of 3m+, offering a comprehensive range of diagnostic and therapeutic interventions. Following a fire earlier this year, UHS has reviewed its long-term endoscopy requirements and is considering a new purpose-built regional diagnostic endoscopy centre situated close to the main hospital. UHS has existing endoscopy equipment to the value of approximately £8-10m. This will need to be refreshed throughout this contract. UHS has an indicative budget of £20-25m for the design and construction of the new centre. This will be designed to meet current and projected future endoscopy and motility needs, 'a one-stop-shop' and be an important centre to both trial new technology and techniques and provide training for the next generation of the endoscopy workforce. This opportunity is to explore and discuss how a partnership approach may drive better outcomes for patients, for innovation, for UHS clinicians, and for the partner[S(1.1][L(1.2]. This opportunity may include, but not necessarily be limited to: 1: Provision of endoscopy equipment to a new offsite location, both for the use of clinicians undertaking NHS clinical activity, and for use as a test bed for innovation and new technique development, and for use within a training environment. 2: Regional Training Centre: The physical co-location of experienced UHS staff, clinicians, data, patients with an industry partner seeking to promote best practice and create future workforce. 3: Joint Innovation Deal & Test Bed: The provision of a live, data-rich NHS environment to validate new technology, and techniques, for example artificial intelligence (AI) diagnostic tools and ergonomic designs and potentially the exploitation of emerging shared Intellectual Property. This would also include SME and VCSE participation for research and innovation. 4: Commercial Sponsorship Opportunity with Associated Rights and Benefits: In addition to the core procurement opportunities above, there is potential to explore a complementary commercial sponsorship arrangement, which may include the provision of value-in-kind goods and/or services that support contract delivery. This strategic partnership approach would identify and agree a range of associated rights and benefits for suppliers who also become sponsors. These may include appropriate sponsor recognition, opportunities for collaboration and innovation, shared learning, thought leadership engagement, and other mutually agreed activities that support the objectives of all parties. UHS, with support from the Department of Health and Social Care (DHSC), is trialling the integration of commercial sponsorship into this procurement opportunity to explore how strategic partnerships can deliver additional value while supporting the successful delivery of contract outcomes. Whilst this notice is not intended to create a commitment to a contract, it is running alongside a live funded NHS capital project to develop designs and take forward the concept of a regional endoscopy centre. This hybrid procurement and sponsorship model is being piloted by the Department of Health and Social Care (DHSC) and UHS, offering potential suppliers a unique opportunity to play an active role in delivering a best-in-class new facility for patients: supporting improved care, championing innovation and delivering lasting benefits for all parties. To ensure fair and open competition in any future procurement, the developing design and specification will remain supplier-neutral and will not be tailored to any specific manufacturer, supplier or solution.

result.text: Vantaan kaupunki is planning the procurement of a new cultural heritage system to replace the current collection management system (Kirsti), which was implemented in 2014. The current system is technically obsolete, slow, and difficult to develop. The goal is a modern, easy-to-use, and efficient solution that supports museum operations, cultural heritage management, and digital transition. The system must support, among other things, object, image, AV, paper, and cultural environment archives, a reference library, actor information, and press clippings. Integrations are required for Finna, Finto, MapInfo, Matti, the Finnish Heritage Agency's spatial data, and the PAS service. Key features: efficient search, clarity, ease of use, and compliance with GDPR requirements. Users: Museum staff, consultants, authorities, collection service customers, and the public via Finna. Targeted benefits: Better availability of information, increased work efficiency, reduction of unnecessary work, and improvement of processes. Strategic importance: supports the digital transition, has a broad impact, and generates value for over 10 000 residents.

parts.source: Vantaan kaupunki suunnittelee uuden kulttuuriperintöjärjestelmän hankintaa korvaamaan nykyisen kokoelmanhallintajärjestelmän (Kirsti), joka on otettu käyttöön vuonna 2014. Nykyinen järjestelmä on teknisesti vanhentunut, hidas ja vaikeasti kehitettävissä. Tavoitteena on moderni, helppokäyttöinen ja tehokas ratkaisu, joka tukee museotoimintaa, kulttuuriperinnön hallintaa ja digitaalista siirtymää. Järjestelmän tulee tukea mm. esine-, kuva-, AV-, paperi- ja kulttuuriympäristöarkistoja, käsikirjastoa, toimijatietoja ja lehtileikkeitä. Vaaditaan integraatiot Finnaan, Fintoon, MapInfoon, Mattiin, Museoviraston paikkatietoon ja PAS-palveluun. Keskeiset ominaisuudet: tehokas haku, selkeys, helppokäyttöisyys ja GDPR-vaatimusten täyttäminen. Käyttäjät: Museon henkilökunta, konsultit, viranomaiset, kokoelmapalvelujen asiakkaat ja yleisö Finnan kautta. Tavoiteltavat hyödyt: Parempi tiedon saatavuus, työskentelyn tehostuminen, turhan työn väheneminen ja prosessien parantuminen. Strateginen merkitys: tukee digitaalista siirtymää, vaikuttaa laajasti ja tuottaa arvoa yli 10 000 kuntalaiselle.

rejected.text: Establishment, operation and continuous further development of an integrated VoC feedback and analytics system for the entire EUDI Wallet Support Organisation. Includes the collection, evaluation and presentation of B2C and B2B feedback as well as operational support KPIs, trend analyses and automated pattern recognition. Lot LOT-0001: EUDI-Wallet Support Organisation VoC - Feedback & Analytics. The subject of this tender is the award of services for VoC / Feedback & Analytics for the EUDI Wallet Support Organisation (EWSO). The contractor shall build the VoC platform, configure all feedback instruments (post-interaction surveys, IVR-CSAT, NPS, CES, B2B partner reviews, agent feedback loop) and set up the operational KPI dashboard as well as the pattern alerting system. The contractor shall support the closed beta phase (Q4 2026) and the go-live phase (Q1 2027) with hypercare support. Following an orderly knowledge transfer, the contractor shall hand over operational control of the VoC system and the analytics platform to the client's internal team. The services include, in particular, data protection-compliant data collection (GDPR, EU hosting, pseudonymisation), API integration with the ticket system and telephony infrastructure (cf. section 5. of the service description), WCAG 2.1-compliant design of all feedback interfaces, as well as complete system documentation, training of the internal team and a structured handover plan for independent system control.

result.text: This market consultation is aimed at solution providers that can offer the following service portfolio: Security awareness solutions in the form of Software as a Service (SaaS) with - an extensive content library, - a training module, - a phishing test module, - an analysis and reporting module, and - a module for recording, handling and rapidly responding to reported suspicious emails. The solution is to be provided to the company's employees for a longer period of time (preferably 3 years). The aim of the market consultation is to find security awareness solutions as a SaaS service for the project planned by gematik: Provision of a security awareness solution for gematik employees. Furthermore, gematik would like to gain knowledge about the pricing models offered, the technical functions and scope of support offered, as well as the contractual and financial framework conditions.

parts.source: Diese Markterkundung richtet sich an Lösungsanbieter, die das folgende Leistungsportfolio anbieten können: Security Awareness Lösungen in Form einer Software as a Service (SaaS) mit - umfangreicher Content-Bibliothek, - einem Trainings-, - einem Phishing-Test-, - einem Analyse- und Reportingmodul sowie - einem Modul zur Erfassung, Behandlung und schnellen Reaktion auf gemeldete verdächtige E-Mails. Die Lösung soll für die Mitarbeiter des Unternehmens für einen längeren Zeitraum (bevorzugt 3 Jahre) bereitgestellt werden. Das Ziel der Markterkundung ist die Findung von Security Awareness Lösungen als SaaS Leistung für das seitens der gematik geplante Vorhaben: Bereitstellung einer Security Awareness Lösung für gematik Mitarbeiter. result.text: IT services are being awarded. The subject matter of the contract is the design, implementation, quality assurance and support during commissioning and operation of the new reporting platform of WIBank (Wirtschafts- und Infrastrukturbank Hessen), an institution within an institution (Anstalt in der Anstalt - AIDA) within Landesbank Hessen-Thüringen (Helaba). In addition, this includes the ongoing further development of the platform created as part of the project. All services are to be provided on the basis of a framework agreement and therefore only upon separate call-off/individual order. Lot LOT-0001: Award of IT services: WIBank Reporting Platform. The subject matter of the contract is the design, implementation, quality assurance and support during commissioning and operation of the new reporting platform of WIBank (Wirtschafts- und Infrastrukturbank Hessen), an institution within an institution (Anstalt in der Anstalt - AIDA) within Landesbank Hessen-Thüringen (Helaba). In addition, this includes the ongoing further development of the platform created as part of the project. The existing info portal currently forms the central data warehouse and reporting system of WIBank. It consolidates data from various source systems and provides reports based on this as well as returns for funding programmes of the European Union, the Federal Government and the State of Hesse. The subject matter of the project is the provision of a new reporting platform for the finance and accounting, risk management and treasury departments. This includes in particular the connection of SAP WIBank as the initial operational source system, the setup of the "Regulatory Reporting" data mart, the transfer of historical data from the existing info portal and the implementation of the defined target reports. Upon completion of the project, the developed platform will be expanded as part of continuous further development. This includes in particular the connection of further source systems, the setup of additional data marts and the migration of further reports from the existing info portal. In the long term, the existing info portal is to be completely replaced and decommissioned. All services are to be provided on the basis of a framework agreement and therefore only upon separate call-off/individual order. The upper limit for call-offs from the framework agreement amounts to a total of EUR 6,5 million (gross). For further details, reference is made to Appendix I 02 - Appendix 0_Specification of Services.

parts.source: Es werden IT-Leistungen vergeben. Der Leistungsgegenstand ist die Konzeption, Implementierung, Qualitätssicherung sowie die Unterstützung bei Inbetriebnahme und Betrieb der neuen Reporting-Plattform der WIBank (Wirtschafts- und Infrastrukturbank Hessen), einer Anstalt in der Anstalt (AIDA) in der Landesbank Hessen-Thüringen (Helaba). Darüber hinaus umfasst dieser die laufende Weiterentwicklung der im Rahmen des Projekts entstehenden Plattform. Sämtliche Leistungen sind auf Grundlage einer Rahmenvereinbarung und mithin erst auf gesonderten Abruf/Einzelauftrag hin zu erbringen. Lot LOT-0001: Vergabe von IT-Leistungen: WIBank Reporting Plattform. Der Leistungsgegenstand ist die Konzeption, Implementierung, Qualitätssicherung sowie die Unterstützung bei Inbetriebnahme und Betrieb der neuen Reporting-Plattform der WIBank (Wirtschafts- und Infrastrukturbank Hessen), einer Anstalt in der Anstalt (AIDA) in der Landesbank Hessen-Thüringen (Helaba). Darüber hinaus umfasst dieser die laufende Weiterentwicklung der im Rahmen des Projekts entstehenden Plattform. Das bestehende Infoportal bildet derzeit das zentrale Data-Warehouse- und Berichtssystem der WIBank. Es konsolidiert Daten aus verschiedenen Quellsystemen und stellt darauf basierende Berichte sowie Meldungen für Förderprogramme der Europäischen Union, des Bundes und des Landes Hessen bereit. Gegenstand des Projekts ist die Bereitstellung einer neuen Reporting-Plattform für die Fachbereiche Finanz- und Rechnungswesen, Risikomanagement und Treasury. Hierzu zählen insbesondere die Anbindung von SAP WIBank als initialem operativen Quellsystem, der Aufbau des Data Marts „Meldewesen“, die Übernahme historischer Daten aus dem bestehenden Infoportal sowie die Umsetzung der definierten Zielberichte. Nach Abschluss des Projekts wird die entwickelte Plattform im Rahmen einer kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung ausgebaut. Dies umfasst insbesondere die Anbindung weiterer Quellsysteme, den Aufbau zusätzlicher Data Marts sowie die Migration weiterer Berichte aus dem bestehenden Infoportal. Langfristig soll das bestehende Infoportal vollständig abgelöst und außer Betrieb genommen werden. Sämtliche Leistungen sind auf Grundlage einer Rahmenvereinbarung und mithin erst auf gesonderten Abruf/Einzelauftrag hin zu erbringen. Die Obergrenze für Abrufe aus dem Rahmenvertrag beträgt insgesamt EUR 6,5 Mio. (brutto). Für die weiteren Einzelheiten wird auf die Anlage I 02 - Anlage 0_Leistungsbeschreibung verwiesen.

result.text: The procurement to be carried out is classified as an administrative services contract, given that its object consists of performance obligations involving the development of an activity or directed at obtaining a result other than a works contract or supply contract, as established in articles 17 and 25 of Law 9/2017 of 8 November, on Public Sector Contracts (hereinafter, LCSP). In the Canary Islands, GUIRRE is the Canary Islands Waste Information System, an in-house tool of the Department of Ecological Transition and Energy developed to respond to data management in the field of waste and for the communication thereof to the Ministry with competence in the matter. Through the aid proposed in the Sectoral Conference, it is proposed to procure a service to, via GUIRRE:  Improve the exchange of information with eSIR.  Automation and digitalisation of administrative procedures, management and electronic processing of files and databases relating to waste regulations.  Information analysis and data processing. Likewise, the digitalisation of administrative procedures within the competence of the Autonomous Community is sought in order to adapt them to the requirements established in Royal Decree 203/2021 of 30 March, approving the Regulations on the performance and operation of the public sector by electronic means, to guarantee easily usable and accessible digital services, aligned with European interoperability frameworks, and which allow intelligent automation (via Business Process Management and/or Robotic Process Automation) in all or part of them. All of this would lead to:  An improvement in the quality of the public service. Unified management of administrative procedures. Automation and digitalisation of administrative procedures.  Greater ease in the work of professionals.  A monitoring and legality control system.  An electronic administrative management system Said object corresponds to the following codes of the European Commission's Common Procurement Vocabulary (CPV) nomenclature 72200000 Software programming and consulting services 72600000 Computer support and consulting services

parts.source: La contratación a realizar se califica como contrato de servicios de carácter administrativo, en cuanto que su objeto son prestaciones de hacer consistentes en el desarrollo de una actividad o dirigidas a la obtención de un resultado distinto de una obra o suministro, tal y como establece el artículos 17 y 25 de la Ley 9/2017, de 8 de noviembre, de Contratos del Sector Público (en adelante, LCSP). En Canarias, GUIRRE es el Sistema de Información de Residuos de Canarias, una herramienta propia de la Consejería de Transición Ecológica y Energía desarrollada para dar respuesta a la gestión de datos en materia de residuos y para la comunicación de los mismos al Ministerio con competencias en la materia. A través de las ayudas planteadas en la Conferencia Sectorial se propone contratar un servicio para, mediante GUIRRE:  Mejorar del intercambio de información con eSIR.  Automatización y digitalización de procedimientos administrativos, gestión y tramitación telemática de expedientes y bases de datos relativos a la normativa de residuos.  Análisis de la información y procesamiento de datos. Asimismo, se busca la digitalización de los procedimientos administrativos competencia de la Comunidad autónoma con objeto de adaptarlos a los requerimientos establecidos en el Real Decreto 203/2021, de 30 de marzo, por el que se aprueba el Reglamento de actuación y funcionamiento del sector público por medios electrónicos, para garantizar servicios digitales fácilmente utilizables y accesibles, alineados con los esquemas de interoperabilidad europeos, y que permitan la automatización inteligente (a través de Business Process Management y/o Robotic Process Automation) en todo o parte de los mismos. Todo ello conllevaría a una:  Mejora en la calidad del servicio público. Gestión unificada de los procedimientos administrativos. Automatización y digitalización de procedimientos administrativos.  Mayor facilidad en la labor de los profesionales.  Sistema de seguimiento y control de la legalidad.  Sistema telemático de gestión administrativa Dicho objeto corresponde a los siguientes códigos de la nomenclatura Vocabulario Común de Contratos de la Comisión Europea (CPV) 72200000 Servicios de programación de software y de consultoría 72600000 Servicios de apoyo informático y de consultoría

result.text: Conclusion of a framework agreement for hardware in four lots. Lot 1 comprises the conclusion of a framework agreement on the procurement and supply of workstation hardware for BITMARCK GmbH and its customers. The scope of services includes in particular fat clients, thin clients, iMacs, notebooks, tablets, monitors, smartphones as well as keyboards, mice and other compatible peripherals. In addition, the service and warranty options offered for the devices by the respective manufacturers may be called off. Contractors must offer suitable products for all specified product categories and be able to provide several hundred to several thousand devices depending on demand within reasonable delivery times. The specific quantities, technical equipment and respective current product requirements are determined in the downstream individual realisation competitions or call-offs. The scope of services also includes nationwide delivery, the activation of acquired manufacturer warranties and services, proactive advice on product lifecycles and successor products, the take-back of packaging as well as the provision of information on the product carbon footprint of the offered hardware.; Lot 2 comprises the conclusion of a framework agreement on the procurement and supply of server hardware for BITMARCK GmbH and its customers. The scope of services includes in particular x86-based rack servers of various performance classes, blade servers including suitable chassis, AI servers, hyperconverged server systems, server racks and appliances. Furthermore, the lot includes standard and compatible server components, cables, modules, plug-in cards, further server accessories as well as optional service and warranty packages from the respective manufacturers. Contractors must offer suitable products for all specified product categories. The specific quantities, technical equipment, performance parameters and respective current product requirements are determined in the downstream individual realisation competitions or call-offs. This applies in particular to components and accessories whose technical design depends on the server systems used and the respective procurement requirement. The scope of services also includes nationwide delivery, the activation of acquired manufacturer warranties and services, proactive advice on product lifecycles, successor products and new technologies, the take-back of packaging as well as the provision of information on the product carbon footprint of the offered hardware.; Lot 3 comprises the conclusion of a framework agreement on the procurement and supply of network component hardware for BITMARCK GmbH and its customers. The scope of services includes in particular network switches of various performance classes, firewalls, load balancers, hardware security modules (HSMs) as well as standard and compatible network accessories. In addition, the service and warranty options offered for the devices by the respective manufacturers can be called off. Contractors must offer suitable products for all specified product categories. The specific quantities, technical equipment, performance parameters and respective current product requirements are determined in the downstream individual realisation competitions or call-offs. This applies in particular to network cables, network modules, network cards and other peripherals whose technical design depends on the systems used and the respective procurement requirement. The scope of services also includes nationwide delivery, the activation of acquired manufacturer warranties and services, proactive advice on product lifecycles, successor products and new technologies, the take-back of packaging as well as the provision of information on the product carbon footprint of the offered hardware.; Lot 4 comprises the conclusion of a framework agreement on the procurement and supply of storage component hardware for BITMARCK GmbH and its customers. The scope of services includes in particular highly available block storage systems for storage area networks, file storage systems, object storage and associated gateways as well as SAN directors. Furthermore, the lot includes standard and compatible storage components, expansions and accessories as well as optional service and warranty packages from the respective manufacturers. Contractors must offer suitable products for all specified product categories. The specific quantities, storage capacities, technical equipment, performance parameters and respective current product requirements are determined in the downstream individual realisation competitions or call-offs. This applies in particular to expansions, spare parts and accessories whose technical design depends on the storage systems used and the respective procurement requirement. The scope of services also includes nationwide delivery, the activation of acquired manufacturer warranties and services, proactive advice on product lifecycles, successor products and new technologies, the take-back of packaging as well as the provision of information on the product carbon footprint of the offered hardware.

result.text: Provision of the service for temporary installation, production, management, operation, revitalisation and comprehensive exploitation of the digital leisure space, comprising gaming, e-sports, virtual reality and augmented reality activities, for the Alicante 2027 Sailing Round the World Race Departure Port event. The contractual result required does not consist merely in the delivery of equipment, but in obtaining a complete, secure, accessible, coordinated and operational experiential space, with continuous programming and attention to the public. The OBJECTIVES are: To offer an attractive digital leisure programming for a young, family and general audience. To integrate in a coordinated manner gaming, e-sports, virtual reality and augmented reality experiences. To link the contents, whenever appropriate, with sailing, innovation, digital transformation and The Ocean Race. To guarantee safety, universal accessibility, the protection of minors and the appropriate age classification of the contents. To ensure the operational continuity of the space, the unified management of capacity and a single technical and organisational point of contact with SPTD. To promote the efficient use of energy, the reuse of equipment and the proper management of electrical and electronic waste. All of the above, in accordance with the provisions of the PPT.

Westdeutscher Rundfunk Köln (WDR) is advertising a framework agreement on behalf of the following broadcasting corporations and institutions of the broadcasting corporations: ARD-Hauptstadtstudio (ARD-HSB, represented by rbb), ARD ZDF Deutschlandradio Beitragsservice (ZBS), Bayerischer Rundfunk (BR), Deutschlandradio (DLR), Deutsche Welle (DW), Hessischer Rundfunk (HR), Informationsverarbeitungszentrum (IVZ, represented by rbb), Mitteldeutscher Rundfunk (MDR), Norddeutscher Rundfunk (NDR), Radio Bremen (RB), Rundfunk Berlin-Brandenburg (rbb), Saarländischer Rundfunk (SR), Südwestrundfunk (SWR), Westdeutscher Rundfunk (WDR) and Zweites Deutsches Fernsehen (ZDF). Also eligible are all other companies affiliated with the aforementioned broadcasting corporations and institutions, provided that these are "Authorised Institutions" within the meaning of the opening clause of the BMI contract. Affiliated and authorised companies associated with the aforementioned broadcasting corporations and institutions that do not meet the minimum order quantity of 250 qualified devices or users intend, if required, to join together with the affiliated broadcasting corporations and institutions in accordance with the BMI contract, Appendix 1 Section 3, a., (iii) to form a joint accession in order to reach the minimum order quantity. The framework agreement shall enter into force upon the award of contract and shall end upon expiry of the BMI corporate agreement, which entered into force on 01.06.2025, on 31.05.2028 or, taking into account its extension option, on 31.05.2029. During the term of the framework agreement, eligible entities may make accessions to the BMI corporate agreement. In doing so, each eligible entity may, if required and where applicable, also make accessions on the basis of various enrolments (e.g. EA Enterprise, EA SCE, EA Subscription enrolment). The effective date of each accession shall mark the commencement of a separate framework agreement (see template agreement in the appendix) between the respective eligible entity as the client and the commercial partner as the contractor. These individual framework agreements have independent terms, which are presented below, and shall therefore also apply to the respective contracting parties beyond the aforementioned end of the term of the framework agreement where applicable. Each eligible entity that makes an accession / concludes a framework agreement acts under its own responsibility, places orders and pays at its own expense. Joint and several liability between the various eligible entities is excluded. Insofar as individual clients guarantee minimum purchase quantities, these result from the appendix Minimum Purchase Quantities.xlsx of these procurement documents. Purchase quantities going beyond this are not guaranteed. The respective framework agreement shall end after 36 months without the need for termination. The framework agreement partner grants the clients the right to extend the respective framework agreement once by one year under the same conditions. The respective client must declare the exercise of the option in writing to the framework agreement partner before the expiry of the contract. The subsequent further extension option shall serve in particular the purpose of ensuring the possibility of an interruption-free commissioning of Software Assurance as well as operation for the respective client if a procurement procedure for such commissioning cannot be carried out / completed in good time. The framework agreement partner therefore grants the clients the right in each case to extend the respective framework agreement once again by up to 6 further months. The conditions may change for this extension period. An adjustment of the dealer's mark-up or markdown on its purchase prices may be made by mutual agreement in this case. The dealer must explain the circumstances altering the calculation. Insofar as further adjustments to the framework agreement have to be made due to Microsoft licence programme changes, these shall likewise be coordinated by mutual agreement. If and to the extent that valid successor agreements already exist between the Federal Ministry of the Interior and Microsoft at the time the extension option for the further 6 months is exercised - where applicable also on the basis of a different Microsoft licence programme -, these may be selected as the basis. The framework agreement partner further agrees that during this extension term, any client may terminate the framework agreement at any time and without observing a notice period and carry out a change of commercial partner. The currently existing EA accessions expire for all eligible entities on 31.05.2026. It is intended to make accessions to the new BMI corporate agreement on the following dates: 01.06.2026 The clients will announce the products and quantities for their respective initial orders in good time. The contractor will then promptly provide the respective client with the prices valid for the initial order, taking into account the Microsoft price and the discount for the EA commercial partners in accordance with the BMI corporate agreement as well as the mark-up or markdown to be offered.

parts.source: Bei den im Rahmen dieses Vergabeverfahrens angefragten Leistungen handelt es sich um die Fortführung von Software-Assurance sowie den Erwerb von Lizenzen inkl. Software-Assurance für Softwareprodukte der Fa. Microsoft und / oder den Erwerb von Online-Produkten der Firma Microsoft, die Microsoft über das Konzernprogramm anbietet, nach den Bedingungen des Rahmenvertrages (Konzernvertrages) des Bundesministeriums des Inneren (BMI) und der Fa. Microsoft über einen entsprechenden Handelspartner. Die im Rahmen dieses Vergabeverfahrens angefragten Leistungen sind in der Leistungsbeschreibung (Ziffer 6 der Vergabeunterlagen) einschl. der darin aufgeführten Anlagen beschrieben. Die technischen, rechtlichen und organisatorischen Rahmenbedingungen sind in Ziffer 5 enthalten. Der Westdeutsche Rundfunk Köln (WDR) schreibt eine Rahmenvereinbarung im Auftrag folgender Rundfunkanstalten und Einrichtungen der Rundfunkanstalten aus: ARD-Hauptstadtstudio (ARD-HSB, vertreten durch rbb), ARD ZDF Deutschlandradio Beitragsservice (ZBS), Bayerischer Rundfunk (BR), Deutschlandradio (DLR), Deutsche Welle (DW), Hessischer Rundfunk (HR), Informationsverarbeitungszentrum (IVZ, vertreten durch rbb), Mitteldeutscher Rundfunk (MDR), Norddeutscher Rundfunk (NDR), Radio Bremen (RB), Rundfunk Berlin-Brandenburg (rbb), Saarländischer Rundfunk (SR), Südwestrundfunk (SWR), Westdeutscher Rundfunk (WDR) und Zweites Deutsches Fernsehen (ZDF). Bezugsberechtigt sind auch alle weiteren mit den vorgenannten Rundfunkanstalten und Einrichtungen verbundenen Unternehmen, soweit es sich bei diesen um "Berechtigte Einrichtungen" im Sinne der Öffnungsklausel des Vertrages des BMI handelt. Mit den vorgenannten Rundfunkanstalten und Einrichtungen verbundene und berechtigte Unternehmen, die die Mindestbestellmenge von 250 qualifizierten Geräten oder Nutzern nicht aufweisen, beabsichtigen sich bei Bedarf gemäß BMI-Vertrag, Anlage 1 Ziffer 3, a., (iii) mit den verbundenen Rundfunkanstalten und Einrichtungen zu einem gemeinsamen Beitritt zusammenzuschließen, um die Mindestbestellmenge zu erreichen. Die Rahmenvereinbarung tritt mit der Zuschlagserteilung in Kraft und endet mit Ablauf des Konzernvertrages des BMI, der am 01.06.2025 in Kraft getreten ist, zum 31.05.2028 bzw. unter Berücksichtigung dessen Verlängerungsoption zum 31.05.2029. Während der Laufzeit der Rahmenvereinbarung können die Bezugsberechtigten Beitritte zum BMI-Konzernvertrag tätigen. Dabei kann jeder Bezugsberechtigte bei Bedarf ggf. auch Beitritte auf der Basis verschiedener Enrollments tätigen (bspw. EA-Enterprise-, EA-SCE-, EA-Subscription-Enrollment). Mit dem Wirksamkeitsdatum eines jeden Beitritts beginnt jeweils ein separater Rahmenvertrag (siehe Mustervertrag in der Anlage) zwischen dem jeweiligen Bezugsberechtigten als Auftraggeber und dem Handelspartner als Auftragnehmer. Diese einzelnen Rahmenverträge haben eigenständige Laufzeiten, die nachfolgend dargestellt sind, und gelten somit für die jeweiligen Vertragsparteien ggf. auch über das vorgenannte Laufzeitende der Rahmenvereinbarung hinaus. Jeder Bezugsberechtigte, der einen Beitritt tätigt / Rahmenvertrag abschließt, tritt eigenverantwortlich auf, bestellt und zahlt auf eigene Rechnung. Eine gesamtschuldnerische Haftung zwischen den verschiedenen Bezugsberechtigten ist ausgeschlossen. Soweit einzelne Auftraggeber Mindest-Abnahmemengen garantieren, ergeben sich diese aus der Anlage Mindestabnahmemengen.xlsx dieser Vergabeunterlagen. Darüber hinaus gehende Abnahmemengen werden nicht garantiert. Der jeweilige Rahmenvertrag endet nach 36 Monaten, ohne dass es einer Kündigung bedarf. Der Rahmenvertragspartner räumt den Auftraggebern das Recht ein, den jeweiligen Rahmenvertrag einmal um ein Jahr zu gleichen Konditionen zu verlängern. Die Ausübung der Option hat der jeweilige Auftraggeber gegenüber dem Rahmenvertragspartner schriftlich vor Ablauf des Vertrages zu erklären. Die nachfolgende weitere Verlängerungsoption soll insbesondere dem Zweck dienen, die Möglichkeit einer unterbrechungsfreien Beauftragung der Softwareassurance sowie den Betrieb für den jeweiligen Auftraggeber sicherzustellen, falls ein Vergabeverfahren für eine solche Beauftragung nicht rechtzeitig durchgeführt/ abgeschlossen werden kann. Der Rahmenvertragspartner räumt den Auftraggebern daher jeweils das Recht ein, den jeweiligen Rahmenvertrag nochmals um bis zu 6 weitere Monate zu verlängern. Die Konditionen können sich für diesen Verlängerungszeitraum ändern. Eine Anpassung des Händler- Auf- bzw. Abschlages auf seine Einkaufspreise kann in diesem Fall einvernehmlich erfolgen. Der Händler hat die kalkulationsändernden Umstände zu erläutern. Sofern aufgrund lizenzprogrammlicher Änderungen von Microsoft ggf. weitere Anpassungen des Rahmenvertrages erfolgen müssen, werden diese ebenfalls einvernehmlich abgestimmt. Sofern und soweit zum Zeitpunkt der Ausübung der Verlängerungsoption um die weiteren 6 Monate bereits gültige Nachfolgeverträge zwischen dem Bundesministerium des Inneren und Microsoft bestehen - ggf. auch auf der Basis eines anderen Microsoft-Lizenzprogrammes -, können diese als Grundlage gewählt werden Der Rahmenvertragspartner stimmt ferner zu, dass während dieser Verlängerungslaufzeit jeder Auftraggeber jederzeit und ohne Einhaltung einer Frist den Rahmenvertrag kündigen und einen Wechsel des Handelspartners vornehmen kann. Die aktuell bestehenden EA-Beitritte laufen für alle Bezugsberechtigten am 31.05.2026 aus. Es ist beabsichtigt zu folgenden Terminen Beitritte zum neuen BMI-Konzernvertrags zu tätigen: 01.06.2026 Die Auftraggeber werden die Produkte und Mengen für ihre jeweiligen Anfangsbestellungen rechtzeitig bekanntgeben. Der Auftragnehmer stellt dem jeweiligen Auftraggeber daraufhin umgehend die für die Anfangsbestellung gültigen Preise unter Berücksichtigung des Microsoft-Preises und des Rabattes für die EA-Handelspartner gemäß BMI-Konzernvertrag sowie des anzubietenden Auf- oder Abschlags zur Verfügung.

result.text: The goal of the NHLBI Catalyze Program is to provide a comprehensive suite of support and services to facilitate the transition of basic science discoveries into viable diagnostic and therapeutic candidates that have been cleared for human testing, and to develop translational researchers fluent in product development and entrepreneurship. This specific Catalyze Product Definition initiative will provide the early stage translational support needed for the activities required to develop and test device prototypes, identify diagnostic disease targets and develop associated assays, and develop research tools to treat HLBS diseases and disorders. This is a phased initiative for early stage projects. The R61 phase provides support to identify and test initial prototype designs, to identify a disease target and generate experimental design, and to identify, test and pilot research tools. The R33 phase provides support for continued prototype development and testing, in addition to modifying design features and user feedback, diagnostic product generation, exploration of assay components, and characterization of a load design, and research tool improvement, large trial testing and data integration. Following successful completion of the program, it is expected that the potential products will be poised to move forward for in vivo testing (optimization, safety, efficacy) with additional support from NIH and/or other federal and private programs. This initiative has a companion initiative that supports development of therapeutics and combination products and is also part of a suite of innovation grants to advance projects to the point where they can meet the entry criteria for the NHLBI Catalyze Preclinical Program.

result.text: GeodatenProxy-System [GeoProxy] Fraport AG, headquartered in Frankfurt am Main, is a leading global airport operator. The company was founded 1924 and operates Frankfurt Airport, one of the world's most important aviation hubs. In addition, Fraport is involved in the administration and operation of several other airports worldwide. Fraport currently operates the ELDIS III software (SW) from eurofunk at the Frankfurt am Main site as a system relevant to KRITIS (Critical Infrastructure) and LuftSIG (Aviation Security Act) in the security control centre with the service areas works fire brigade, rescue service, and security as an operational control system, and in the integrated passenger flow control centre as a workflow system. The system currently in use is predictably reaching its technical limits, making a replacement necessary. The functions to be replaced by new systems comprise operational control and force dispatch, hazard reporting management, and the provision of geo-information in the form of a geoproxy. Maintenance, upkeep, service, and support are also required for all new systems. Applicants must sign a confidentiality agreement provided by Fraport (see informative documents) and submit it together with the application to participate. Following the procurement competition, an indicative tender round will initially be held as part of the tender phase, which will then be followed by one or more binding tender rounds. Within the indicative tender round, bidders may submit proposed amendments to the contract, specification of services, and annexes. Fraport decides on their acceptance or rejection. The contracting authority points out even at this stage that, in the event of being invited to submit a binding tender, the tenderer must mandatorily provide the following proofs: 1. All persons deployed in the project and in all maintenance, service, and support services are German-speaking at least at level B2 in accordance with the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR) and are provided from a time zone of UTC +0 to +3. 2. Proof of full access to the control of development resources and unrestricted authority to modify and expand the offered software and hardware. Due to the critical path schedule that must be strictly adhered to given the importance of the overall system to be procured here for the maintenance of flight operations, Fraport may withdraw from the entire contract if the contractor culpably fails to provide services designated as "already available" within the meaning of hardware and software functions after contract award, or fails to provide them in accordance with the contract. The scope comprises delivery, agile (additional) development, commissioning with migration of legacy systems of a new geoproxy system, training of Fraport AG employees, as well as maintenance, service, and support services. The geoproxy takes over supplied consolidated geo-data from a geographic information system provided by Fraport AG and makes this available to the new operational control and hazard management system at a required high availability and performance. In this context, additional external geo-data relevant only to the security control centre must also be connected.

parts.source: GeodatenProxy-System [GeoProxy] Die Fraport AG, mit Hauptsitz in Frankfurt am Main, ist ein weltweit führender Flughafenbetreiber. Das Unternehmen wurde 1924 gegründet und betreibt den Flughafen Frankfurt, eines der bedeutendsten Luftverkehrsdrehkreuze der Welt. Darüber hinaus ist Fraport an der Verwaltung und dem Betrieb von mehreren anderen Flughäfen weltweit beteiligt. Der Fraport betreibt am Standort Frankfurt am Main aktuell die Software (SW) ELDIS III der Fa. eurofunk als KRITIS und LuftSIG relevantes System in der Sicherheitsleitstelle mit den Dienstbereichen Werksfeuerwehr, Rettungsdienst sowie Security als Einsatzleitsystem und in der Integrierten Passagierflußleitstelle als Workflowsystem. Das aktuell im Einsatz befindliche System stößt absehbar an seine technischen Grenzen, so dass eine Ablösung notwendig ist. Die mit neuen Systemen abzulösenden Funktionen umfassen dabei die Einsatzleit- und Kräftedisposition, das Gefahrenmeldermanagement und die Bereitstellung von Geoinformationen in Form eines Geoproxy. Für alle neuen Systeme wird auch Wartung, Instandhaltung, Service und Support gefordert. Die Bewerber müssen eine von Fraport bereitgestellte Vertraulichkeitsvereinbarung (siehe informatorische Unterlagen) unterzeichnen und zusammen mit dem Teilnahmeantrag einreichen. Nach dem Teilnahmewettbewerb wird im Rahmen der Angebotsphase zunächst eine indikative Angebotsrunde durchgeführt, auf die dann eine oder mehrere verbindliche Angebotsrunden folgen. Innerhalb der indikativen Angebotsrunde können Änderungsvorschläge an Vertrag, Leistungsbeschreibung und Anhängen durch die Bieter angebracht werden. Fraport entscheidet über deren Annahme oder Ablehnung. Der Auftraggeber weist schon jetzt darauf hin, dass der Auftragnehmer im Falle der Aufforderung zur Abgabe eines verbindlichen Angebots zwingend die folgenden Nachweise zu erbringen hat: 1. Alle im Projekt und allen Wartung, Service und Supportleistung eingesetzte Personen sind deutschsprachig mindestens auf dem Niveau B2 gem. des europäischen Referenzrahmens für Sprachen (GER) und werden aus einer Zeitzone UTC +0 bis +3 zur Verfügung gestellt. 2. Nachweis eines vollumfänglichen Zugriff auf die Steuerung der Entwicklungsressourcen und uneingeschränkte Berechtigung zur Veränderung und Erweiterung der angebotenen Soft- und Hardware. Aufgrund der Bedeutung des vorliegend zu beschaffenden Gesamtsystems für die Aufrechterhaltung des Flugbetriebs zwingend notwendig einzuhaltenden Rahmenterminplan, kann Fraport vom gesamten Vertrag zurückzutreten, wenn der Auftragnehmer zum Vertragsschluss als "bereits verfügbar" gekennzeichnete Leistungen im Sinne von Hard- und Softwarefunktionen schuldhaft nach Vertragsschluss nicht oder nicht vertragsgemäß erbringt. Der Umfang umfasst die Lieferung, agile (Zusatz-)entwicklung, Inbetriebnahme mit Migration der Altsysteme eines neuen Geoproxy-System, die Schulung der Mitarbeiter der Fraport AG sowie Wartungs-, Service- und Supportleistungen. Der Geoproxy übernimmt beigestellte konsolidierte Geodaten aus einem seitens der Fraport AG beigestellten Geoinformationssystem udn stellt diese dem neuen Einsatzleit- und Gefahrenmanagementsystem in einen geforderten Hochverfügbarkeit und Performance zur Verfügung. Dabei sind auch nur für die Sicherheitsleitstelle relevanten zusätzliche externe Geodaten anzubinden.

result.text: The Department for Science, Innovation and Technology (DSIT) intends to create a pathway to link problems identified by large organisations with solutions provided by innovative cyber small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) known as the Cyber Accelerator Programme. If you are interested in this potential opportunity, DSIT would like to engage with you. The Bidder presentation is due to take place Wednesday 23rd September 11:00 ( details at the bottom of the notice, on how to register) The Authority is seeking to engage the market to gather information, insights and feedback, while also providing an opportunity for Suppliers to better understand and discuss our requirements. This activity is not a procurement or a commitment to purchase goods or services. Its purpose is to facilitate open dialogue, improve our understanding of available solutions and supplier capabilities, and help shape the requirement and future approach, ensuring any subsequent procurement activity is informed, proportionate and delivers the best possible outcome. The principal objective of the programme is to create a credible pathway from agreed challenges facing the public sector to the commercial adoption of cyber innovation by public-sector buyers. It is intended to link problems identified by public-sector organisations with solutions provided by innovative cyber small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs). The programme will use structured, pro bono design partnerships between public-sector organisations with identified cyber challenges and innovative cyber SMEs capable of developing and testing solutions. Participation will not provide funding, an assurance of future work or preferential treatment in any subsequent procurement. The appointed supplier will be expected to: - identify and recruit suitable public-sector Challenge Council members; - build a broad pipeline of potential Programme Innovators and select suitable innovators against defined challenges; - support challenge development and match innovators to challenges; - establish, facilitate and oversee at least five design partnerships; - provide programme governance and a light-touch commercial, procurement, data protection and security compliance wrapper; - support routes to adoption or other lawful commercial progression; - organise one Showcase Day and other programme activity; - report on progress and produce a final report; and - create and disseminate a pattern library of repeatable approaches to support public-sector adoption of cyber innovation. Lot 1: . None

result.text: The subject of the framework agreement is the provision, introduction, integration, support and further development of a software solution for permanently operable vulnerability management, including licences, services, interfaces as well as analysis, reporting and control functions. The subject of the tender is the conclusion of a framework agreement for the provision, introduction, integration, support and further development of vulnerability management for the contracting authority's IT landscape. The goal of the procurement is the transition of an already existing basic technical structure into a stable, permanently operable and future-proof regular operation. For this purpose, a suitable software solution including the necessary licences or subscriptions as well as the services required for operation and further development must be provided. The solution should enable the structured identification, analysis, assessment, prioritisation and tracking of vulnerabilities within the contracting authority's IT landscape. The scope of services includes in particular the provision, setup, configuration, integration, optimisation and ongoing support of the solution. This includes integration into the contracting authority's existing system and process landscape, support in establishing and ensuring operational readiness, improvement of scan coverage, optimisation of data quality, and the provision of suitable reporting, analysis and control functions. Furthermore, existing IT service management processes are to be supported and suitable interfaces for the acquisition, processing and transfer of relevant information are to be provided. The framework agreement does not establish any minimum purchase obligation for the contracting authority. The quantities, hourly rates, reference quantities, demand values and maximum quantities specified in the tender documents serve exclusively to determine the contract value, the comparability of the tenders and the award evaluation. There is no entitlement to the actual call-off of these quantities or services.

parts.source: Gegenstand der Rahmenvereinbarung ist die Bereitstellung, Einführung, Integration, Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung einer Softwarelösung für ein dauerhaft betreibbares Schwachstellenmanagement einschließlich Lizenzen, Dienstleistungen, Schnittstellen sowie Analyse-, Reporting- und Steuerungsfunktionen. Gegenstand der Ausschreibung ist der Abschluss einer Rahmenvereinbarung zur Bereitstellung, Einführung, Integration, Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung eines Schwachstellenmanagements für die IT-Landschaft des Auftraggebers. Ziel der Beschaffung ist die Überführung eines bereits vorhandenen technischen Grundaufbaus in einen stabilen, dauerhaft betreibbaren und zukunftsfähigen Regelbetrieb. Hierzu sind eine geeignete Softwarelösung einschließlich der erforderlichen Lizenzen oder Subscriptions sowie die für den Betrieb und die Weiterentwicklung erforderlichen Dienstleistungen bereitzustellen. Die Lösung soll die strukturierte Identifikation, Analyse, Bewertung, Priorisierung und Nachverfolgung von Schwachstellen innerhalb der IT-Landschaft des Auftraggebers ermöglichen. Der Leistungsumfang umfasst insbesondere die Bereitstellung, Einrichtung, Konfiguration, Integration, Optimierung und laufende Betreuung der Lösung. Hierzu gehören die Einbindung in die bestehende System- und Prozesslandschaft des Auftraggebers, die Unterstützung bei der Herstellung und Sicherstellung der Betriebsbereitschaft, die Verbesserung der Scan-Abdeckung, die Optimierung der Datenqualität sowie die Bereitstellung geeigneter Reporting-, Analyse- und Steuerungsfunktionen. Darüber hinaus sind bestehende IT-Service-Management-Prozesse zu unterstützen und geeignete Schnittstellen zur Übernahme, Verarbeitung und Weitergabe relevanter Informationen bereitzustellen. Die Rahmenvereinbarung begründet keine Mindestabnahmeverpflichtung des Auftraggebers. Die in den Vergabeunterlagen angegebenen Mengen, Stundenansätze, Referenzmengen, Bedarfswerte und Höchstmengen dienen ausschließlich der Ermittlung des Auftragswertes, der Vergleichbarkeit der Angebote sowie der Zuschlagswertung.
