result.text: The purpose of this mixed contract is the supply and services for the acquisition, installation, integration with the existing platform, commissioning and maintenance of 43 Traffic Control Points (TCPs) equipped with a total of 97 smart video cameras with artificial intelligence capabilities for traffic management and control (43 fixed DOME type camera and 54 fixed bullet traffic camera with LPR number plate reading). The purpose of the contract includes the supply and commissioning of a dedicated professional system for the management room/CECOM, consisting of a 3x2 video wall of 55 + control PC + keyboard, mouse and necessary cabling. The purpose of the contract also includes comprehensive maintenance services for the existing network comprising a total of 30 cameras (8 Contextual and 22 Number Plate Reading cameras by SOLFIX), starting from 4 December 2027. More specifically, the tasks to be carried out by the contractor are as follows: - Supply of the equipment, reading software and all associated equipment, according to the specifications presented in this same PPT. A permanent licence for the use of the camera reading software shall be supplied. - Installation work for the control points and their equipment, electrical connection, telecommunications connection and fixing of the equipment to public highway fixtures. - Configuration and commissioning of the equipment, with corresponding functionality and endurance tests until full operation. - Development of the software necessary for integration with the management system in operation at the City Council of Sagunto. Possible development requirements for integration with the City Council's own systems and equipment. - Preventive, corrective and evolutionary maintenance of the equipment and systems, including all their components, during the term of the contract. The contractor must verify and check all technical and legal aspects necessary for the execution of the project. Given the mixed nature of this contract, in accordance with the provisions of articles 16, 17, and 18 of the LCSP [Public Sector Contracts Act], the legal regime for preparation and award shall be that of a services contract in view of the nature of the principal service, pursuant to art. 18.1.a) of the LCSP; and that of its effects, performance and termination shall be determined in accordance with the provisions of article 122.2 of the LCSP in the clauses of this Specification, having regard to the rules applicable to the various services merged within them. The aforementioned work shall be carried out in accordance with the powers set out in the Technical Specifications Sheet, which specifies the basic data defining and conditioning the purpose of the contract, the applicable general rules and instructions, and the prescriptions and recommendations which, without having this character, are compulsory.

parts.source: Constituye el objeto del presente contrato de mixto el suministro y los servicios para la adquisición, la instalación, la integración con la plataforma existente, la puesta en marcha y el mantenimiento de 43 Puntos de Control de Tráfico (PCT) equipadas con un total de 97 videocámaras inteligentes con capacidades de inteligencia artificial para la gestión y control del tráfico (43 cámara fija tipo DOMO y 54 cámara fija Bullet de tráfico con lectura de matrículas LPR). El objeto del contrato comprende el suministro y puesta en funcionamiento de un sistema profesional dedicado para sala de gestión/CECOM, compuesto por un video wall 3x2 de 55 + PC de control + teclado, ratón y cableado necesario. El objeto del contrato comprende igualmente los servicios de mantenimiento integral de la red existente que comprende un total de 30 cámaras (8 Contextuales y 22 de Lectura de Matriculas marca SOLFIX), a partir del 4 de diciembre del 2027. Más concretamente, las tareas a ejecutar por el adjudicatario son las siguientes: - Suministro de los equipos, el software de lectura y todo su equipamiento, según las especificaciones presentadas en este mismo PPT. Se suministrará la licencia permanente para el uso del software de lectura de cámaras. - Trabajos de instalación de los puntos de control y sus equipamientos, la conexión eléctrica, la conexión de telecomunicaciones y la fijación de los equipos en el equipamiento de la vía pública. - Configuración y puesta en funcionamiento de los equipos, con las correspondientes pruebas tanto de funcionalidad como de resistencia hasta su plena operación. - Desarrollo del software necesario para integrarse con el sistema de gestión en funcionamiento en el Ayuntamiento de Sagunto. Posibles necesidades de desarrollo para su integración con sistemas y equipamientos propios del Ayuntamiento. - Mantenimiento preventivo, correctivo y evolutivo de los equipos y los sistemas, incluidos todos sus componentes, durante la vigencia del contrato. El adjudicatario deberá verificar y comprobar todos aquellos aspectos de índole técnica y legal necesarios para la realización del proyecto. Dado el carácter mixto del presente contrato, de conformidad con lo establecido en los artículos 16, 17, y 18 de la LCSP, el régimen jurídico de la preparación y adjudicación será el del contrato de servicio en atención al carácter de la prestación principal, según el art. 18.1.a) de la LCSP; y el de sus efectos, cumplimiento y extinción se determinará de acuerdo con lo dispuesto en el artículo 122.2 de la LCSP en el clausulado del presente Pliego, atendiendo a las normas aplicables a las diferentes prestaciones fusionadas en ellos. Los citados trabajos se ejecutarán de conformidad con las atribuciones que figuran en el Pliego de Prescripciones Técnicas que especifica los datos básicos que definen y condicionan el objeto del contrato, las normas e instrucciones de carácter general aplicables y las prescripciones y recomendaciones que, sin tener este carácter, sean de obligado cumplimiento.

result.text: Høje-Taastrup Kommune is considering procuring the purchase and support of AV equipment as well as devices (PCs and tablets) for the schools sector as operational leasing. This means a solution where the supplier undertakes the delivery, assembly, operation, maintenance and support of equipment as a solution where the supplier owns the equipment and the municipality obtains the right of use via payment of an annual fee. Therefore, the municipality wishes to enter into a dialogue with 2 - 3 suppliers of such types of IT equipment to discuss what the municipality should pay attention to in connection with procurement. Some documents are enclosed that describe some of the intended content in a procurement (requirements, wishes, etc.). The dialogue will be based on these documents. Initially, the municipality wishes an indication of whether you will enter into a dialogue with the municipality regarding such a procurement, as well as a response with some initial thoughts that you as a supplier have regarding a procurement of this type of operational leasing. As inspiration for this, here are some initial questions: Is the best way to procure the goods and services via 2 procurement or can both types of services (AV and PC/tablets) advantageously be combined in one procurement? Is there anything we should be aware of that a contract must contain and/or absolutely not contain: e.g. breach of contract, penalty - how do we handle defects in the equipment? Will the fact that the supplier owns, assembles and services e.g. AV equipment provide an advantage e.g. via the supplier's strict control of drivers/software as well as versioning of these components in relation to a more stable, well-functioning and cohesive AV solution across the municipality? Are there other things we should be aware of? Here, consideration is given to advantages the municipality can achieve and the disadvantages that may lie in such a solution. The intention is that equipment is to be replaced in an ongoing process. This means the supplier will take over support on e.g. existing AV equipment. The dialogue is intended as an informal discussion of advantages and disadvantages/risks of establishing such solutions. It is not immediately intended that actual transfer of employees should take place; the intention is to establish another and more efficient way to operate and support the mentioned solution areas.

parts.source: Høje-Taastrup Kommune påtænker at udbyde indkøb og support af AV udstyr samt devices (PC'ere og tablets) til skoleområdet som operationel leasing. Dvs. en løsning hvor leverandøren forestår levering, montering, drift og vedligehold samt support af udstyr som en løsning, hvor leverandøren ejer udstyret og kommunen opnår brugsret via betaling af et årligt vederlag. Derfor ønsker kommunen at komme i dialog med 2 - 3 leverandører af sådanne typer af IT udstyr for at drøfte hvad kommunen bør være opmærksom på i forbindelse med udbud. Der er vedlagt nogle dokumenter der beskriver noget om det påtænkte indhold i et udbud (krav, ønsker osv.). Dialogen vil tage udgangspunkt i disse dokumenter. Indledningsvist ønsker kommunen en tilkendegivelse om man vil indgå i en dialog med kommunen om et sådan udbud samt en besvarelse med nogle indledende tanker som I som leverandør har om et udbud på denne type af operationel leasing. Som inspiration hertil er herunder nogle indledende spørgsmål: Er den bedste måde at udbyde varerne og ydelserne på via 2 udbud eller kan begge typer af ydelser (AV og PC/tablets) med fordel samles i ét udbud? Er der noget vi skal opmærksomme på at en kontrakt skal indeholde og/ eller absolut ikke indeholde: fx misligholdelse, bod - hvordan håndterer vi mangler ved udstyret? Vil det at leverandøren ejer, monterer, og servicere f.eks. AV udstyr give en fordel f.eks. via leverandørens ret stil styring af driver/software samt versionisering af disse komponenter i relation til et mere stabilt, velfungerende og sammenhængende AV løsning på tværs af kommunen? Er der øvrige ting vi skal være opmærksomme på? her tænkes på fordele kommunen kan opnå og de ulemper der kan ligge i en sådan løsning Det er tanken, at udstyr skal udskiftes i en løbende proces. Dvs. leverandøren vil overtage supporten på f.eks. det eksisterende AV udstyr. Dialogen er tænkt som en uformel drøftelse af fordele og ulemper/risici ved at etablere sådanne løsninger. Det er ikke umiddelbart tanken, at der skal indgå egentlig overdragelse af medarbejdere, det er tanken at etablere en anden og mere effektiv måde at drifte og supportere de nævnte løsningsområder på.

result.text: MARKET CONSULTATION The subject of the market consultation is the procurement of a maintenance operations management system for the tracks of Väylävirasto. BACKGROUND AND OBJECTIVES The most central task of the operations management system is to support day-to-day maintenance management by offering various functionalities for equipment and work management ranging from work planning to work reporting, as well as enabling various tracking functions, for example with regard to accumulated work and costs. Another key factor for the system is to support information-driven management, i.e., to provide, inter alia, up-to-date information on maintenance activities carried out on assets and the resulting costs, as well as potential consequential effects over the entire lifecycle of the equipment. The system's functionalities should offer the target organisation the opportunity to implement maintenance operations characteristic of its operations in a process-driven manner, such that the system supports the execution of the process at different stages of the process, in accordance with the functionalities required of it. The efficient implementation of maintenance processes, ensuring both personnel and information security, requires strong support from the operations management system with which operations are managed and monitored. The operations management system should provide an open interface for the target organisation to monitor and manage maintenance operations between different stakeholders, such as in situations where maintenance is procured either partially or entirely as a service. In addition to the primary functionalities of maintenance management, the operations management system should cover a wide range of various functionalities supporting operations. The functionalities of the system can be roughly classified as follows: - Equipment management - Work management - Reports and analysis - Mobile application - User management - Cost tracking - Contract management - Inventory management - Procurement The task of the operations management system is to act in connection with day-to-day maintenance management as part of the broader system architecture of Väylävirasto. For this reason, various integrations with other operational and administrative systems of Väylävirasto will also be necessary. PRELIMINARY SCHEDULE The contracting authority's target schedule for carrying out the market consultation and procurement is: - Market consultation, technical dialogue (commenting on material) September-October 2025 - Market consultation, bilateral negotiations (approx. 3-6 companies) October-early November 2025 - Year 2026 ----- ADDITIONAL INFORMATION ON THE NOTICE This notice is a prior information notice. This notice does not request tenders. The prior information notice is accompanied by an invitation to a market consultation, whereby all suppliers interested in the procurement have the opportunity to engage in a technical dialogue concerning the procurement with Väylävirasto. The purpose of the technical dialogue is to discuss the subject matter of the procurement and its definition at a general level. The technical dialogue does not bind Väylävirasto to carry out the procurement. Nor does the technical dialogue bind the supplier to participate in a potential tendering procedure, nor does it prevent participation if the supplier has not participated in the dialogue. TECHNICAL DIALOGUE AND BILATERAL DISCUSSIONS The market consultation is organised in two phases: 1. As a technical dialogue, where potential suppliers are asked to familiarise themselves with the service description and requirement specification and to answer the contracting authority's preliminary questions (carried out in September-October by email in accordance with registrations) 2. As bilateral discussions, where the contracting authority invites 3-6 suppliers to discussions. The contracting authority will send invitations to the discussions to the selected suppliers as soon as possible. The discussions will take place during October-November 2025 (the following times are preliminarily reserved, participants are requested to reserve the times in their calendars where possible): - Mon 27.10 at 9.30-11 - Mon 27.10 at 14-15.30 - Wed 29.10 at 14.30-16 - Fri 31.10 at 12-13.30 - Mon 3.11 at 14-15.30 - Wed 5.11 at 12-13.30 The times will be confirmed to the suppliers selected for the bilateral negotiations approximately two weeks before the time. In addition to the above, the contracting authority reserves the right for a later scheduled commenting period on draft versions of the final tender documentation and for answering the contracting authority's new questions related to the subject matter of the procurement. INSTRUCTIONS FOR REGISTRATION The supplier must notify its interest in participating in the market consultation by 20.10.2025 at 12.00 by sending a message to tommi.aarnio@vayla.fi and virpi.kukkonen@vayla.fi with the subject heading: "Ratojen kunnossapidon toiminnanohjausjärjestelmä - markkinavuoropuhelu". The supplier is requested to provide the following information in the message: - name, email address and telephone number of the supplier's contact person - a brief description of the supplier (e.g., the company's line of business and main services) - a brief description of the solution offered by the supplier for the procurement subject to the market consultation - information on whether the solution is an already existing solution or a concept under development - the supplier's previous deliveries and references (corresponding to the subject matter of the procurement) The descriptions presented in this prior information notice and the estimated publication date of the contract notice, as well as the dialogue draft materials to be provided later, are preliminary and indicative procurement information. Participating companies will not be paid compensation for responding or participating.

parts.source: MARKKINAVUOROPUHELU Markkinavuoropuhelun kohteena on Väyläviraston ratojen kunnossapidon toiminnanohjausjärjestelmän hankinta. TAUSTAA JA TAVOITTEET Toiminnanohjausjärjestelmän keskeisimpänä tehtävänä on tukea kunnossapidon päivittäisjohtamista tarjoten erilaisia toiminnallisuuksia laitteiden ja töiden hallintaan aina töiden suunnittelusta töiden raportointiin sekä mahdollistaen erilaiset seurannat esimerkiksi kertyneiden töiden ja kustannusten suhteen. Toinen keskeinen tekijä järjestelmälle on tukea tiedolla johtamista eli tarjota mm. ajantasaista tietoa kohteille suoritetuista kunnossapidontoimista ja niistä syntyneistä kustannuksista sekä mahdollisista seurausvaikutuksista laitteen koko elinkaaren ajalta. Järjestelmän toiminnallisuuksien tulisi tarjota kohdeorganisaatiolle mahdollisuus toteuttaa sen toiminnalle ominaisia kunnossapidon prosessinomaisesti toteutettavia toimia, siten että järjestelmä tukee prosessin läpivientiä eri vaiheissa prosessia, siltä edellytettyjen toiminnallisuuksien mukaisesti. Kunnossapitoprosessien tehokas, sekä henkilö- että tietoturvallinen toteutus vaatii vahvaa tukea toiminnanohjausjärjestelmältä, jolla toimintaa hallinnoidaan ja seurataan. Toiminnanohjausjärjestelmän tulisi tarjota avoin rajapinta kohdeorganisaatiolle seurata ja hallinnoida kunnossapitotoimintaa eri sidosryhmien välillä, kuten esimerkiksi tilanteissa, joissa kunnossapito ostetaan joko osittain tai kokonaisuudessaan palveluna. Toiminnanohjausjärjestelmän tulisi kattaa kunnossapidon hallinnan ensisijaisten toiminnallisuuksien lisäksi laaja joukko erilaisia toimintaa tukevia toiminnallisuuksia. Järjestelmän toiminnallisuudet voidaan karkeasti luokitella seuraavasti: - Laitteiden hallinta - Töiden hallinta - Raportit ja analysointi - Mobiilisovellus - Käyttäjien hallinta - Kustannusseuranta - Urakoiden hallinta - Varastonhallinta - Hankinta Toiminnanohjausjärjestelmän tehtävänä on toimia kunnossapidon päivittäisjohtamisen yhteydessä osana laajempaa Väyläviraston järjestelmäarkkitehtuuria. Tästä syystä myös erilaiset integraatiot Väyläviraston muihin operatiivisiin ja hallinnollisiin järjestelmiin tulevat olemaan tarpeen. ALUSTAVA AIKATAULU Tilaajan tavoiteaikataulu markkinavuoropuhelun ja hankinnan toteuttamiselle on: - Markkinavuoropuhelu, tekninen vuoropuhelu (aineiston kommentointi) syyskuu-lokakuu 2025 - Markkinavuoropuhelu, kahdenväliset neuvottelut (noin 3-6 yritystä) lokakuu-marraskuun alku 2025 - Vuosi 2026 ----- ILMOITUKSEN LISÄTIEDOT Tämä ilmoitus on ennakkoilmoitus. Tällä ilmoituksella ei pyydetä tarjouksia. Ennakkoilmoitukseen liittyy kutsu markkinavuoropuheluun, jolloin kaikilla hankinnasta kiinnostuneilla toimittajilla on mahdollisuus käydä hankintaa koskevaa teknistä vuoropuhelua Väyläviraston kanssa. Teknisen vuoropuhelun tarkoituksena on käydä yleisellä tasolla vuoropuhelua hankinnan kohteesta ja sen määrittämisestä. Tekninen vuoropuhelu ei sido Väylävirastoa toteuttamaan hankintaa. Tekninen vuoropuhelu ei myöskään sido toimittajaa mahdolliseen tarjouskilpailuun osallistumiseen, eikä estä osallistumista, jos toimittaja ei ole osallistunut vuoropuheluun. TEKNINEN VUOROPUHELU JA KAHDENKESKISET KESKUSTELUT Markkinavuoropuhelu järjestetään kahdessa vaiheessa: 1. Teknisenä vuoropuheluna, jossa potentiaalisia toimittajia pyydetään tutustumaan palvelukuvaukseen ja vaatimusmäärittelyyn sekä vastaamaan hankintayksikön ennakkokysymyksiin (toteutetaan syys-lokakuussa sähköpostitse ilmoittautumisten mukaisesti) 2. Kahdenkeskisinä keskusteluina, joissa hankintayksikkö kutsuu 3-6 toimittajaa keskusteluihin. Hankintayksikkö lähettää kutsut keskusteluihin valituille toimittajille mahdollisimman pian. Keskustelut käydään loka-marraskuun 2025 aikana (seuraavat ajankohdat alustavasti varattuna, ilmoittautujia pyydetään mahdollisuuksien mukaan varaamaan ajankohdat kalenteriin): - Ma 27.10 klo 9.30-11 - Ma 27.10 klo 14-15.30 - Ke 29.10 klo 14.30-16 - Pe 31.10 klo 12-13.30 - Ma 3.11 klo 14-15.30 - Ke 5.11 klo 12-13.30 Ajankohdat varmistetaan kahdenkeskisiin neuvotteluihin valituille toimittajille noin kaksi viikkoa ennen ajankohtaa. Edellisten lisäksi tilaaja varaa oikeuden myöhemmin järjestettävälle lopullisten tarjouspyyntöaineiston luonnosversioiden kommentoinnille ja tilaajan uusien hankinnan kohteeseen liittyvien kysymysten vastaamiselle. ILMOITTAUTUMISOHJE Toimittajan tulee ilmoittaa kiinnostuksensa osallistua markkinavuoropuheluun 20.10.2025 klo 12.00 mennessä lähettämällä osoitteeseen tommi.aarnio@vayla.fi ja virpi.kukkonen@vayla.fi viesti otsikolla: "Ratojen kunnossapidon toiminnanohjausjärjestelmä - markkinavuoropuhelu". Toimittajaa pyydetään ilmoittamaan viestissä seuraavat tiedot: - toimittajan yhteyshenkilön nimi, sähköpostiosoite ja puhelinnumero - lyhyt kuvaus toimittajasta (esim. yrityksen toimiala ja pääasialliset palvelut) - lyhyt kuvaus toimittajan tarjoamasta ratkaisusta markkinavuoropuhelun kohteena olevaan hankintaan - tieto, onko kyseessä jo olemassa oleva ratkaisu vai kehitteillä oleva konsepti - toimittajan aiemmat toimitukset ja referenssit (hankinnan kohdetta vastaavat) Tässä ennakkoilmoituksessa esitetyt kuvaukset ja hankintailmoituksen arvioitu julkaisupäivämäärä, kuten myös myöhemmin toimitettavat vuoropuhelun luonnosmateriaalit ovat alustavia ja suuntaa antavia hankinnan ennakkotietoja. Osallistuneille yrityksille ei makseta korvausta vastaamisesta tai osallistumisesta.

result.text: KfW requires expert support from an external service provider in the comprehensive analysis and evaluation of market data provision, integrating functional, technical, procedural and commercial aspects. A key focus is on increasing licence compliance, improving the traceability of data usage and increasing audit readiness. KfW estimates the maximum contract volume of this framework agreement at 2.270 days during the term of the contract. For details, please refer to the tender documents, in particular the specification of services.

rejected.text: The National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases (NIAID) seeks to advance its mission by supporting multidisciplinary, consortium-based research using precision systems biology approaches to uncover links among chronic illnesses, infectious diseases and microbiomes. There is an urgent scientific and clinical need to understand the pathways by which infections lead to chronic lifelong health issues or alternatively, how long-term illnesses might predispose or exacerbate acute infections. The objective is to harness cutting-edge technologies along with longitudinal patient cohorts and biobank data for comprehensive analysis of genetic, environmental, and lifestyle factors leading to advances in prevention and treatment strategies for both chronic and infectious diseases. The cutting-edge technologies may include multi-omics, computational modelling, artificial intelligence, organoid-based validation systems, and integration of real-world data, alongside improved access to digital health records and advanced clinical informatics tools. The goal is to generate meaningful insights into disease progression and host-pathogen interactions. Grant authorities that allow NIAID to forecast this opportunity are as follows: Sections 301 and 405 of the Public Health Service Act as amended (42 USC 241 and 284) and under Federal Regulations 42 CFR Part 52 and 2 CFR Part 200.

result.text: The subject of the procurement is the provision of maintenance and support services for telecommunications network devices and related network services (hereinafter the "Service"). The procurement covers comprehensive maintenance, monitoring, support and operational services for VR's telecommunications network environment, including network devices located in datacentres, offices, rolling stock (trains and buses) and other operational locations. The Service also includes the maintenance of certain related network services required for the operation of the telecommunications environment. The Service includes, but is not limited to, the following: - Service transition and implementation; - 24/7 monitoring of the telecommunications network environment; - Incident management and fault resolution; - Replacement of failed network devices in accordance with the agreed service levels; - Device configuration changes and other agreed maintenance activities; - Network monitoring, preventive maintenance and operational support; - Service management and designated service management personnel; - Maintenance of network documentation; - Reporting, including service level, capacity and operational reporting; - Integration with VR's agreed service management and ticketing solutions; - Other maintenance, support and expert services related to the telecommunications network environment, ordered separately where required. The procurement concerns maintenance and support services only. Ownership of the telecommunications network devices, software licences and the overall network architecture shall remain with VR. VR is responsible for the procurement of network devices and strategic network architecture, while the selected Supplier shall provide the Services in accordance with the agreed contractual responsibilities. The Service is intended to support VR Group's operations in Finland, Sweden, Denmark and Latvia. The Service may also be extended to other VR Group companies or countries during the contract period. A more detailed preliminary description of the procurement is set out in Annex 1 – Preliminary Description of the Procurement. The subject of the procurement described herein is preliminary and may be further specified, clarified and supplemented during the negotiated procurement procedure. The final scope of the procurement, the detailed requirements and the contractual terms will be set out in the Final Invitation to Tender and its annexes.

result.text: Performance recording software for Technical Operations (municipal works yard) as Software as a Service (SaaS) The Technical Operations department of the City of Bochum (4, 44793 Bochum) currently maintains and services municipal infrastructure in the areas of urban greenery, road and drainage facilities, and municipal cemeteries with approx. 600 employees. It also operates a crematorium. The department has four divisions: Central Tasks, Greenery Division, Roads and Drainage Division, and Cemeteries and Crematorium Division. Within the divisions, a total of 27 operational units are active in providing these services. In addition, there is the technical administrative department, which awards services externally to third parties. Technical Operations is subject to continuous task review and optimisation, meaning that the organisational structure and workflows must be adapted regularly. New tasks and business processes may be added. This therefore also applies to the regularly required reports and evaluations. The employees work within the scope of the collective agreement for the public service (TVöD-VKA and TVöD-NRW) and provide numerous services. Management and administrative roles are partly filled by civil servants who are subject to the regulations of the North Rhine-Westphalia State Civil Service Act (Landesbeamtenrecht NRW). In order to record the services provided and the associated costs efficiently and purposefully, Technical Operations is looking for recording software for municipal works yards / depots. All services provided ("products") must be recorded, evaluated, and analysed. These services arise from the budget structure of Technical Operations. The services are provided in the area of predefined facilities or georeferenced points. In addition, services provided in connection with vehicles are to be evaluated. In particular, the software solution must be used not only to record performance but also to record hardship allowances in accordance with TVöD. For this purpose, the current regulations from the relevant collective agreements must be observed (in particular TVöD in the area of the Association of Municipal Employers' Associations (TVöD-VKA) and the regional collective agreement for the TVöD in the area of KAV NW (TVöD-NRW)). In this context, Technical Operations is planning the introduction of a cloud solution in which the bidder provides and maintains a software solution and the associated cloud (Software as a Service (SaaS)). The bidder provides a Software as a Service (SaaS), supports the setup, provides the IT infrastructure required for this, and carries out maintenance. The provider takes care of maintenance, upgrades, support, security, and all other aspects of software administration, including the cloud required for operation. A Software as a Service (SaaS) provider undertakes several important tasks to enable customers to use the software smoothly and efficiently: - Provision and maintenance of the infrastructure: The provider provides the necessary hardware and network infrastructure and ensures its maintenance and updating. - Software updates and maintenance: Regular updates and maintenance work are carried out to keep the software up to date and close security gaps. - Security and data protection: The provider implements security measures to protect users' data and ensures that data protection regulations are complied with. - Customer support: Effective customer support is provided to help with technical problems or questions regarding the use of the software. - Scalability: The provider ensures that the software is scalable and meets the growing demands of users. - Accessibility and availability: The software is made available around the clock so that users can access it at any time. This list is not exhaustive. Rather, it is intended to ensure a common understanding of what is generally meant by SaaS. In particular, the client's requirements are specified by this specification of services, the bill of quantities, and the EVB-IT cloud contract. However, the provision of the software solution must imperatively take place as a SaaS / cloud solution. The SaaS or cloud solution must be entirely browser-based and must not require any additional local components on the part of the client for its operation. The software already exists in its basic functions and does not first need to be developed. It must be adapted to the client's requirements (customisation). A service contract will be concluded with a base term of 24 months from the award of contract. Thereafter, the contract is automatically extended by a further 12 months each time, unless the contract is terminated by either party. The offer price is to be calculated for a term of 48 months.

parts.source: Leistungserfassungssoftware für den Technischen Betrieb (kommunaler Bauhof) als Software as a Service (SaaS) Der Technische Betrieb der Stadt Bochum (Obere Stahlindustrie 4, 44793 Bochum) pflegt und unterhält derzeit mit ca. 600 Mitarbeitern die kommunale Infrastruktur in den Bereichen des Stadtgrüns, der Straßen- und Entwässerungseinrichtungen sowie der städtischen Friedhöfe. Zudem betreibt er ein Krematorium. Das Amt hat vier Abteilungen: Zentrale Aufgaben, Abteilung Grün, Abteilung Straßen und Entwässerung sowie Abteilung Friedhöfe und Krematorium. Innerhalb der Abteilungen sind insgesamt 27 Betriebsstellen tätig, die diese Leistungen erbringen. Darüber hinaus gibt es die technische Sachbearbeitung, die Leistungen extern an Dritte vergibt. Der Technische Betrieb unterliegt einer ständigen Aufgabenkritik und -optimierung, sodass Aufbau- und Ablauforganisation regelmäßig anzupassen ist. Neue Auf-gaben und Geschäftsprozesse können hinzukommen. Dies gilt daher auch für die regelmäßig erforderlichen Berichte bzw. Auswertungen. Die Beschäftigten arbeiten im Anwendungsbereich des Tarifvertrags für den öffentlichen Dienst (TVöD-VKA sowie TVöD-NRW) und erbringen zahlreiche Dienstleistungen. In der Führung und Verwaltung sind teilweise Beamte beschäftigt, die den Regelungen des Landesbeamtenrechts NRW unterliegen. Um die erbrachten Leistungen und die damit verbundenen Kosten effizient und zielführend erfassen zu können, sucht der Technische Betrieb nach einer Erfassungssoftware für kommunale Bauhöfe / Betriebshöfe. Dabei sind sämtliche erbrachten Leistungen ("Produkte") zu erfassen, auszuwerten und zu analysieren. Diese Leistungen ergeben sich aus der Haushaltsstruktur des Technischen Betriebs. Die Leistungen werden im Bereich von vordefinierten Anlagen bzw. georeferenzierten Punkten erbracht. Darüber hinaus sind im Zusammenhang mit Fahrzeugen erbrachten Leistungen auszuwerten. Insbesondere muss mit der Softwarelösung neben der Leistungserfassung auch eine Erfassung der Erschwerniszuschläge nach TVöD erfolgen. Hierfür sind die aktuellen Regelungen aus den einschlägigen Tarifverträgen zu beachten (insbesondere TVöD im Bereich der Vereinigung der kommunalen Arbeitgeberverbände (TVöD-VKA) sowie der landesbezirkliche Tarifvertrag zum TVöD im Bereich des KAV NW (TVöD-NRW)). Der Technische Betrieb plant in diesem Zusammenhang die Einführung einer Cloud-Lösung, bei der der Bieter eine Softwarelösung und die dazugehörige Cloud bereitstellt und wartet (Software as a Service (SaaS)). Der Bieter stellt eine Software as a Service (SaaS) bereit, begleitet die Einrichtung, stellt die dafür erforderliche IT-Infrastruktur bereit und führt die Wartung durch. Der Anbieter kümmert sich um Wartung, Upgrades, Support, Sicherheit und alle anderen Aspekte der Softwareverwaltung, einschließlich der für den Betrieb erforderlichen Cloud. Ein Anbieter von Software as a Service (SaaS) übernimmt mehrere wichtige Aufgaben, um seinen Kunden eine reibungslose und effiziente Nutzung der Software zu ermöglichen: - Bereitstellung und Wartung der Infrastruktur: Der Anbieter stellt die notwendige Hardware und Netzwerkinfrastruktur bereit und sorgt für deren Wartung und Aktualisierung. - Software-Updates und -Wartung: Regelmäßige Updates und Wartungsarbeiten werden durchgeführt, um die Software auf dem neuesten Stand zu halten und Sicherheitslücken zu schließen. - Sicherheit und Datenschutz: Der Anbieter implementiert Sicherheitsmaßnahmen, um die Daten der Nutzer zu schützen, und stellt sicher, dass die Datenschutzbestimmungen eingehalten werden. - Kundensupport: Ein effektiver Kundensupport wird bereitgestellt, um bei technischen Problemen oder Fragen zur Nutzung der Software zu helfen. - Skalierbarkeit: Der Anbieter sorgt dafür, dass die Software skalierbar ist und den wachsenden Anforderungen der Nutzer gerecht wird. - Zugänglichkeit und Verfügbarkeit: Die Software wird rund um die Uhr verfügbar gemacht, sodass Nutzer jederzeit darauf zugreifen können. Die Aufzählung ist nicht abschließend. Sie soll vielmehr für ein gemeinsames Verständnis sorgen, was im Allgemeinen unter SaaS zu verstehen ist. Insbesondere werden die Anforderungen des Auftraggebers durch diese Leistungsbeschreibung, das Leistungsverzeichnis und den EVB-IT Cloud-Vertrag konkretisiert. Die Bereitstellung der Softwarelösung muss jedoch zwingend als SaaS- / Cloudlösung erfolgen. Die SaaS- bzw. Cloudlösung muss vollständig browsergestützt sein und darf für den Betrieb keine zusätzlichen lokalen Komponenten seitens des Auftraggebers erfordern. Die Software existiert bereits in den Grundfunktionen und muss nicht erst entwickelt werden. Sie ist an die Erfordernisse des Auftraggebers anzupassen (Customizing). Es wird ein Dienstleistungsvertrag mit einer Grundlaufzeit von 24 Monaten ab Zuschlagserteilung geschlossen. Danach verlängert sich der Vertrag automatisch um jeweils weitere 12 Monate, sofern der Vertrag von keiner Vertragspartei gekündigt wird. Der Angebotspreis ist für eine Laufzeit von 48 Monaten zu kalkulieren.

result.text: The aim of this project is the development and validation of a practical test catalogue / test guideline for evaluating the cyber security of complex autonomous vehicles of level L4 according to SAE J3016. The focus will be on the novel properties of complex systems and their novel technologies. This includes systems such as AI systems for perception, planning or sensor fusion, for example, or end-to-end systems. The interaction between non-AI systems and AI systems will also be examined. At the end of the project, a test guideline or test catalogue will be obtained which describes how complex systems in autonomous vehicles can be tested. In addition, tools and methods will be developed to enable testing. Through an iterative approach, experiences gained with the test catalogue are to be incorporated into a new iteration of the test catalogue. In addition, practical evaluation and a lessons learned part are to ensure that the test catalogue can be used for type approval or can support type approval, as well as generally representing a reference. The positive feedback of relevant stakeholders (other authorities, in particular BMV, KBA and BASt, the automotive industry and technical services) is to ensure that the developed methods and concepts (test catalogue, test tools and test process) prove themselves in practice and that tests can be carried out with them. parts.source: Das Ziel in diesem Projekt ist die Entwicklung und Validierung eines praxistauglichen Prüfkataloges/Prüfleitfaden zur Evaluation der Cyber-Sicherheit von komplexen autonomen Fahrzeugen der Stufe L4 nach SAE J3016. Dabei wird der Fokus auf den neuartigen Eigenschaften der komplexen Systeme und ihrer neuartigen Technologien liegen. Darunter sind Systeme wie KI-Systeme zum Beispiel zu Perzeption, Planung oder Sensorfusion zu verstehen oder auch End-to-End Systeme. Es soll sich ebenfalls das Zusammenspiel zwischen nicht KI-Systemen und KI-Systemen angeschaut werden. Am Ende des Projektes, erhält man einen Prüfleitfaden bzw. Prüfkatalog, der beschreibt, wie man komplexe Systeme in autonomen Fahrzeugen prüfen kann. Außerdem werden Werkzeuge und Methoden entwickelt, die eine Prüfung möglich machen. Durch einen iterativen Ansatz sollen Erfahrungen, die man mit dem Prüfkatalog erhält, in eine neue Iteration des Prüfkataloges miteinfließen. Zudem soll durch eine praktische Evaluation, sowie ein Lessons Learned Part gesichert werden, dass der Prüfkatalog für die Typgenehmigung genutzt werden, bzw. die Typgenehmigung unterstützen kann, sowie allgemein eine Referenz darstellt. Das positive Feedback der relevanten Stakeholder (andere Behörden, insbesondere BMV, KBA und BASt, Autoindustrie und technische Dienste) sollen dabei sicherstellen, dass die entwickelten Methoden und Konzepte (Prüfkatalog, Prüfwerkzeuge und Prüfprozess) sich in der Praxis bewähren und man Prüfungen damit durchführen kann. result.text: The historical chamber of the Federal Administrative Court is to be technically modernised. The plans include the installation of a new acoustic system including matching column loudspeakers and with wired and wireless microphones. Furthermore, all judge and participant seating positions are to be equipped with connections for displaying digital evidence, which can be shown via a media control system in the chamber on large monitors that can be lowered into sideboards. The chamber is also to be equipped with PTZ cameras as well as technology and software for video and streaming control, for video conferences and for video connections of participants. In addition to the purchase of the described components, the tender covers the planning of the acoustic and discussion system, the on-site technical implementation as well as a multi-year maintenance contract for the operation of the technology.

parts.source: Der historische Sitzungssaal des Bundesverwaltungsgerichts soll technisch modernisiert werden. Geplant sind der Einbau einer neuen Akustikanlage inklusive passender Linienstrahllautsprecher und mit Kabel- und Funkmikrofonen. Weiterhin sollen alle Richter- und Beteiligtenplätze mit Anschlüssen zur Anzeige digitaler Beweismittel ausgestattet werden, die über eine Mediensteuerungsanlage im Sitzungssaal auf in Sideboards versenkbaren Großmonitoren angezeigt werden können. Der Sitzungssaal soll außerdem mittels PTZ-Kameras sowie Technik und Software zur Video- und Streaming-Steuerung, für Videokonferenzen und Videozuschaltungen von Beteiligten, ausgestattet werden. Ausgeschrieben wird neben dem Kauf der beschriebenen Komponenten, die Planung der Akustik- und Diskussionsanlage, die technische Umsetzung vor Ort sowie ein mehrjähriger Wartungsvertrag für den Betrieb der Technik.

result.text: The contract is intended to provide a sound basis for energy policy decisions. For this purpose, on the one hand, an analysis is to be carried out as to which developments in relevant climate neutrality scenarios pose a particular challenge, taking into account the resources required for this (e.g. financial resources, skilled workers, land, raw materials, technical components). On the other hand, trend scenarios are to be modelled which project the development of the energy system along achievable pathways into the future.

parts.source: Der Auftrag soll eine fundierte Basis für energiepolitische Entscheidungen liefern. Hierfür soll zum einen analysiert werden, welche Entwicklungen in einschlägigen Klimaneutralitätsszenarien unter Beachtung der hierfür erforderlichen Ressourcen (z.B. Finanzmittel, Fachkräfte, Flächen, Rohstoffe, technische Komponenten) eine besondere Herausforderung darstellen. Zum anderen sollen Trendszenarien modelliert werden, welche die Entwicklung des Energiesystems entlang erreichbarer Pfade in die Zukunft fortschreiben.

As EnBW, we operate not only nationally but also in an international environment and therefore require services not only onshore, but also in nearshore; to establish a common understanding, these classifications are defined below: - Onshore: Germany, Austria - Nearshore: All European states incl. Switzerland, UK and Turkey, but excl. Germany, Austria. Subject of the tender: Security Operations The subject of the tender comprises the further development and optimisation of operational IT security processes with a focus on the analysis and improvement of SOC/CDC structures. This includes the conception and implementation of SIEM use cases, the automation of detection and response measures, and the integration of modern security technologies for the comprehensive monitoring and protection of the IT infrastructure. A detailed service description for this tender can be found in Annex 05_Service Description and 05.1_Annex_Software Development Process. Number of framework agreement partners: The contracting authority intends to award the contract to the most economically advantageous 5 tenders and thus plans with 5 framework agreement partners.

The program advances U.S. foreign policy priorities by positioning the United States as Saudi Arabia's preferred partner for AI innovation and commercialization, strengthening durable relationships between Saudi innovators and American technology, investment, and commercialization networks.

result.text: ITZBund requires services in the area of software lifecycle management (SLM) for software development and project management solutions in use. The aim of this tender is to conclude a framework agreement to ensure the operation as well as the maintenance and (further) development of the existing Cloud software development and project management platform and associated specialist applications of ITZBund. In addition, sovereignty is to be strengthened through the expansion of open source tools to be procured. ITZBund understands open source to be software whose source code is freely available. In principle, everyone is permitted to use, analyse, modify and pass on this software free of charge and without restriction in terms of content regarding the object and source code. Specifications of the respective relevant open source licence, in particular regarding licence texts, copyright notices or copyleft effects, remain unaffected. The services advertised encompass services along the entire software lifecycle, in particular operational services, maintenance and support services, support services in connection with releases and rollouts as well as demand-oriented new developments and further developments of existing software and software-related tools. The contracting authority, who can commission services commissioned by its customers, is authorised to call off services. The operation of the procured software products generally takes place within ITZBund; exceptions in special individual cases permit operation at customers of the contracting authority with their own licensing. The services mentioned at the outset are advertised in five lots: - Lot 1: Ensuring the maintenance and (further) development of the deployed Cloud software development and project management platform - Lot 2: Ensuring the operation and automated rollout of releases of the deployed Cloud software development and project management platform - Lot 3: Provision of Sonatype software products - Lot 4: Provision of an open source issue tracker including in particular training, support, further development and migration services - Lot 5: Provision of an open source wiki including in particular training, support, further development and migration services This specification of services considers the subject matter of Lot 5: The subject matter of this lot is the provision of an open source wiki including associated training, support, further development and migration services. Lot LOT-0000: Provision of an open source wiki including in particular training, support, further development and migration services. For the total contract period of 4 years, an upper limit of 1.450 instances and 162.608 person-hours (ph) or 20.326 person-days (pd) results for the estimated calculatory costs.

parts.source: Das ITZBund benötigt Dienstleistungen im Bereich des Software Lifecycle Managements (SLM) für eingesetzte Softwareentwicklungs- und Projektmanagementlösungen. Ziel dieser Ausschreibung ist der Abschluss eines Rahmenvertrages zur Sicherstellung des Betriebs sowie der Pflege und (Weiter-)Entwicklung der bestehenden Softwareentwicklungs- und Projektmanagementplattform Cloud sowie darauf aufbauender Fachanwendungen des ITZBund. Zudem soll die Souveränität durch die Erweiterung zu beschaffender Open Source Tools gestärkt werden. Unter Open Source versteht das ITZBund Software, deren Quellcode frei verfügbar ist. Grundsätzlich ist es jedermann gestattet, diese unentgeltlich und inhaltlich unbeschränkt im Objekt- und Quellcode zu benutzen, zu analysieren, zu verändern und weiterzugeben. Vorgaben der jeweils einschlägigen Open Source Lizenz, insbesondere zu Lizenztexten, Urhebervermerken oder Copyleft-Effekten, bleiben unberührt. Die ausgeschriebenen Leistungen umfassen Leistungen entlang des gesamten Software Lifecycle, insbesondere Betriebsleistungen, Pflege- und Supportleistungen, Unterstützungsleistungen im Zusammenhang mit Releases und Rollouts sowie bedarfsorientierte Neu- und Weiterentwicklungen bestehender Software und softwarebezogener Werkzeuge. Abrufberechtigt ist der Auftraggeber, der durch seine Kunden beauftragt Leistungen abrufen kann. Der Betrieb der bezogenen Softwareprodukte erfolgt grundsätzlich im ITZBund, Ausnahmen in besonderen Einzelfällen lassen einen Betrieb bei Kunden des Auftraggebers mit eigener Lizenzierung zu. Die eingangs genannten Leistungen werden in fünf Losen ausgeschrieben: - Los 1: Sicherstellung der Pflege und der (Weiter-)Entwicklung der eingesetzten Softwareentwicklungs- und Projektmanagementplattform Cloud - Los 2: Sicherstellung des Betriebs und des automatisierten Rollouts von Releases der eingesetzten Softwareentwicklungsund Projektmanagementplattform Cloud - Los 3: Bereitstellung Sonatype Softwareprodukte - Los 4: Bereitstellung eines Open Source Issue Tracker einschließlich insbesondere Schulungs-, Support-, Weiterentwicklungs- und Migrationsleistungen - Los 5: Bereitstellung eines Open Source Wikis einschließlich insbesondere Schulungs-, Support-, Weiterentwicklungs- und Migrationsleistungen Diese Leistungsbeschreibung betrachtet den Leistungsgegenstand des Los 5: Gegenstand dieses Loses ist die Bereitstellung eines Open Source Wikis einschließlich zugehöriger Schulungs-, Support-, Weiterentwicklungs- und Migrationsleistungen. Lot LOT-0000: Bereitstellung eines Open Source Wikis einschließlich insbesondere Schulungs-, Support-, Weiterentwicklungs- und Migrationsleistungen. Für die Vertragslaufzeit von insgesamt 4 Jahren ergibt sich für die geschätzten kalkulatorischen Kosten eine Obergrenze von 1.450 Instanzen und 162.608 Personenstunden (PS) bzw. 20.326 Personentage (PT).

Markkinavuoropuheluun ilmoittautuvan yrityksen nimi, yhteyshenkilön nimi ja sähköpostiosoite. 2. result.text: The European Centre for Medium Range Weather Forecasts (ECMWF) is an independent intergovernmental organisation supported by 35 states. ECMWF is both a research institute and a 24/7 operational service, producing and disseminating numerical weather predictions to its Member States. This data is fully available to the national meteorological services in the Member States. The Centre also offers a catalogue of forecast data that can be purchased by businesses worldwide and other commercial customers. The supercomputer facility (and associated data archive) at ECMWF is one of the largest of its type in Europe and Member States can use 25% of its capacity for their own purposes. The organisation was established in 1975 and now employs around 500 staff from more than 30 countries. A description of ECMWF’s activities and infrastructure can be found at: https://www.ecmwf.int/en/about/whatwedo. The purpose of this Prior Information Notice (PIN) is for ECMWF to provide advance notice that an Invitation to Tender (ITT) is being prepared for the future acquisition of an Advanced Hierarchical Data Storage Management System. The ITT will seek proposals from Tenderers for licensing and support services for an advanced hierarchical data storage Management system and related consultancy services. The aim is to enter into a long-term contract for the procurement of these services, include commissioning, training of ECMWF staff and supporting the solution over the lifetime of the contract. At this stage neither expression of interest nor questions regarding the future ITT are possible and full and equal information will be published on ECMWF’s eProcurement Portal which will be accessible via https://procurement.ecmwf.int/. Further information for suppliers is available via https://www.ecmwf.int/en/about/suppliers including information about registering for the Portal, where prospective tenderers can register free of charge and receive updates on procurement opportunities.

result.text: The Norwegian Ministry of Justice and Public Security needs multi-disciplinary and cross-sectoral knowledge connected to our areas of responsibility. The Ministry is responsible for the judiciary, correctional facilities, the police and prosecution authorities, the rescue service, public security, immigration authorities and the polar regions. The Ministry currently needs analyses, evaluations, and summaries of research/knowledge. Occasionally, the Ministry also needs knowledge on development in other sectors of the Norwegian society, with consequences for our own sector. This can be relevant for all of our responsible areas and it can vary from small analyses to more comprehensive evaluations, where relevant research-based knowledge is used. The framework agreement period is 2 years from contract signing. The contracting authority has the right to extend the framework agreement for a further 2 years (a maximum of 4 years altogether). The framework agreement’s financial extent is estimated to be a minimum of NOK 800,000 excluding VAT and a maximum of NOK 6.4 million excluding VAT (NOK 8 million including VAT) per annum. The Ministry would like a flexible contract, with the scope each year based on the Ministry’s actual need for analysis from year to year. The framework agreement is not exclusive.

result.text: The purpose of this PIN is to inform market operators of a potential future exercise to procure services supporting the marketing and communications for a new nationwide programme to increase physical activity and reduce inactivity. Health Innovation North East and North Cumbria (HI NENC) is commissioning an agency partner to design and deliver the marketing, PR, and communications strategy for a national behaviour change programme designed to increase physical activity and reduce inactivity across England. The Programme responds directly to the Government's 10 Year Health Plan commitment to motivate millions to walk - and where possible run - regularly. Sir Brendan Foster has convened expert partners to support this. The Programme aims to reframe movement as personal, cumulative and achievable through the core proposition: The Programme is not a traditional sports campaign. It is a long-term national behaviour change movement designed to: - • Increase movement among inactive adults • Address health inequalities • Build a recognisable, inclusive national movement brand • Enable sustainable habit formation through digital tools and rewards • Advertising - including advertising investment to launch and sustain the campaign within the first year. The associated marketing campaign must inspire participation at scale, whilst remaining grounded in behavioural science and public health evidence. The appointed agency will be responsible for developing and delivering a full set of campaign materials, frameworks, strategies, activation plans, toolkits, digital assets, evaluation reports, and all content needed to deliver the programme end to end. This must be aligned to the overall narrative framework. This will include planning major PR and press moments, building momentum towards launch dates and engaging with key stakeholders to strengthen partnerships. Additional information: HI NENC would like to invite potential providers of Marketing and Communications services to apply to our Dynamic Purchasing System (DPS) DN670401 as a supplier. You can do this by following this link: https://procontract.due-north.com/SupplierPostLoginHome/ActivityDashboard?projectId=c1881153-e6f3-ed11-8122-005056b64545&callingPage=Home This opportunity will be developed as a further competition under Lot 5 of our DPS. You should therefore ensure you apply to Lot 5 to be able to bid to provide this service. You are also welcome to apply for any other Lots on our DPS that you feel are relevant to your organisation. We are expecting to put out the Invitation to Quote (ITQ) to our Lot 5 suppliers by the end of March 2026. This timeline is subject to change. Interested suppliers are advised to apply to the DPS promptly to ensure they have been accepted to the framework and receive the competition notification. Failure to be accepted to the framework ahead of the ITQ publication will mean that you will be unable to bid to supply. This notice is for information and engaging with the supply market only. It is not a binding statement of intent or call for competition. HI NENC reserves the right not to enter a formal process and not award a contract. The information contained in this notice, including information relating to the nature and scope of the requirements, the service classification of this requirement from the list of CPV codes, is only indicative of the HI NENC's current thinking and is neither exhaustive nor binding. HI NENC reserves the right at its absolute discretion to amend it at the time of issue of any further notices or at any other time. HI NENC will not be liable for any bid cost, expenditure, work or effort incurred by a potential supplier in acting on the basis of this PIN

result.text: With this tender, the contracting authority intends to implement, supply, maintain and license a Customer Relationship Management (CRM) system for the market area of the Westfalen Weser Group (Energieservice Westfalen Weser GmbH). Westfalen Weser Energiespeicher GmbH & Co. KG also intends to implement, supply and maintain a CRM system. The implementation effort will be requested separately and possibly at a later date. The licence costs, hourly rates and special conditions shall apply to both companies. The subject of this procurement procedure is the procurement of a CRM system for the market area of the Westfalen Weser Group. The goal is to bundle customer information from the various business divisions in order to obtain a holistic view of customer interactions. The contracting authority expects a future contractor to provide a powerful and user-friendly solution that can be flexibly adapted to future requirements. Furthermore, the contractor shall provide comprehensive support during implementation, user training and technical integration into the contracting authority's existing system landscape. The software solution to be procured is to be integrated into the contracting authority's existing system landscape. The CRM is to be offered and integrated as a cloud-based SaaS solution. Integration will take place on the network side into the Corporate Network (CN), in which the contracting authority's users also work with their clients.

parts.source: Der AG beabsichtigt mit dieser Ausschreibung die Implementierung, Lieferung, Wartung und Lizenzen eines Customer-Relationship-Managements (CRM) Systems für den Marktbereich der Westfalen Weser Gruppe (Energieservice Westfalen Weser GmbH). Die Westfalen Weser Energiespeicher GmbH & Co. KG beabsichtigt ebenfalls die Implementierung, Lieferung und Wartung eines CRM-Systems. Der Implementierungsaufwand wird separat und ggf. zu einem späteren Zeitpunkt angefragt. Die Lizenzkosten, Stundensätze und Sonderkonditionen sollen für beide Gesellschaften gelten. Gegenstand des vorliegenden Vergabeverfahrens ist die Beschaffung eines CRM-Systems für den Marktbereich der Westfalen Weser Gruppe. Das Ziel ist die Kundeninformationen der unterschiedlichen Geschäftsbereiche zu bündeln, um einen ganzheitlichen Blick auf die Kundeninteraktionen zu bekommen. Von einem zukünftigen AN erwartet der AG eine leistungsfähige und benutzerfreundliche Lösung, die flexibel an zukünftige Anforderungen angepasst werden kann. Der AN soll darüber hinaus umfassende Unterstützung bei der Implementierung, Schulung der Anwender sowie bei der technischen Integration in die bestehende Systemlandschaft des AG leisten. Die zu beschaffende Softwarelösung soll in die bestehende Systemlandschaft des AG integriert werden. Das CRM soll als Cloud-basierte SaaS-Lösung angeboten und integriert werden. Die Integration erfolgt netzwerkseitig in das Corporate Network (CN), in dem auch die Benutzer des AG mit ihren Clients arbeiten.

result.text: Glasgow City Council (GCC) manages a framework for the delivery of consultancy services in the area of Business Growth. The consultancy services are delivered to SMEs with growth potential across the city, to help deliver sustainable and inclusive growth and improve business start-up and survival rates in the city. With the current framework concluding in March 2027, GCC is now looking to establish a new framework. These services are delivered under a multi-Lot framework, through a mix of 1-2-1, both face to face and online, and group consultancy sessions related to an anticipated 10 specific specialist areas. The council encourage bids from businesses of all sizes, including sole traders, and encourage a diverse and competitive supplier base. The procurement process has been designed to be proportionate, transparent and accessible, with requirements focused on capability and delivery rather than organisational size. Sole traders are encouraged to engage where they can demonstrate their ability to meet the specified requirements. Lot 1: Business Structuring Business Governance, Legal and IP. The Business Governance, Legal and IP Lot will provide support to help determine the assignment and coordination of roles, power and responsibilities within a business. It also defines how information flows between the different levels of management. Introducing a formal organisational structure can help put your business in a better position to achieve its objectives. Services for this Lot should include, but not be limited to, the following: Board Development Company Structuring Franchising Business Succession Company Governance Ethical Management Intellectual Property Lot 2: Business Growth, Sustainable Growth and Productivity. The Sustainable Growth and Productivity lot will provide support to identify areas of improvement processes which help with improving some measure of an enterprise's success. Business growth can be achieved either by boosting the top line or revenue of the business with greater product sales or service income, or by increasing the bottom line or profitability of the operation by minimizing costs. Business growth is a function of the business lifecycle and can be influenced by industry growth trends. Services for this Lot should include, but not be limited to, the following: Strategic Planning Sales & Marketing Change Management Pitching & Procurement Procurement Operations Management Turnaround Mergers & Acquisitions Lot 3: Upskilling, Leadership and Resources. The Upskilling, Leadership and resources lot will provide support to involve reviewing existing Leadership Development processes and preparing a report on their future suitability and/or making recommendations for future actions. It will also provide a range of support across leadership and management as well as capacity building and comprehensive HR support. Services for this Lot should include, but not be limited to, the following: Organisational Development and Succession Planning Leadership and Management Capacity Building and HR Support Lot 4: Financial Readiness and Planning. The Finance Lot will allow support to be provided across a range of areas which will help with the efficient and effective management of money / funds in such a manner as to accomplish the objectives of the organisation. Strategic financial management not only manages a company's finances but allows them to be managed with the intention to succeed. Services for this Lot should include, but not be limited to, the following: Financial Management Financial Readiness Preparing for Investment Alternative Finance Company Valuation Taxation Lot 5: Design and System processing. The Design and System Processing Lot will integrate design thinking principles into a range of organisations across different industry sectors. Promoting the use of design principles and educating SMEs on the benefits directly linked to innovation, sustainability and resilience, this Lot will see an increase in available support that creates design-led companies who can improve effective strategy and product/service development and manage organisational change. Services for this Lot should include, but not be limited to, the following: Problem Solving Development Testing and validation Lot 6: Sales and Digital Marketing. Sales and marketing share two key roles within businesses: attracting more customers and developing and retaining the existing customer base. They also share the collective underlying goal of bringing in more revenue. When sales and marketing work together a substantial improvement is seen on important performance metrics. Variations persist between Business to Consumer (B2C) and Business to Business (B2B) and as a result of differing routes to market (particularly considering the impact of digital) but the above holds fairly true irrespective of the business model. Expert services under this Sales and Digital Marketing Lot assist businesses with the practical approach to marketing, including writing a marketing plan and establishing a marketing communications plan for integrating traditional and digital communications. Sustainability expert support topics span core pillars like environmental compliance, carbon accounting, circularity, and ESG reporting. They also encompass strategic organisational needs, including Leadership & Culture, Carbon Accounting & Carbon Baseline Assessment, Supply Chain Engagement and Regulatory Compliance & Climate Risk Services for this Lot should include, but not be limited to, the following: Leadership and Culture Carbon Accounting and Carbon Baseline Assessment Regulatory Compliance and Climate Risk Sustainability and Sustainable Marketing Circular Economy Lot 10: Business Acceleration. This Lot will provide support in a different, shorter, more targeted, and innovative way for organisations at various stages of growth. Since the pandemic feedback from businesses has shown that most are now looking for shorter, sharper more focussed interventions. These interventions could focus on emerging themes and could target the key and emerging sectors. It is envisaged that these interventions will be demand driven and will be required on an as needed basis. They could combine traditional teaching methodologies with guidance and mentorship. These programmes could include expert support from Lots 1-9 Business Growth; Business Structuring; Leadership and Skills; Financial Management; Design Thinking and Innovation; Sales and Marketing; Internationalisation; Digital Development and Innovation and Green Business Support. Suppliers will be contacted by the Council when a specific intervention is required, Evidence suggests that organisations who engage with business accelerators benefit from the opportunity presented, leading to greater collaboration with other entrepreneurs and businesses that can yield benefits that allow the business to grow at an accelerated rate. An overview of the objections and intentions of Accelerator programmes is; Acceleration: Learning-by-doing is vital to the process of scaling any venture, and the point of any type of acceleration programme is to accelerate that process. In this way, businesses are able to compress a large amount of learning into a shorter period of time. Our Accelerator programmes will deliver relevant, accessible and practical learning for the leaders of ambitious businesses in the city looking to scale up. It will equip participants with the skills and tools to shape their own learning. It could encourage participants to take ownership of their own development and assume responsibility for coaching their own management teams to embed learning throughout the organisation. It may also help to address organisational, operational, and strategic challenges that the business may face It could also include access to experienced entrepreneurs and mentors, business model refinement, advice on start-up capital, and the opportunity to pitch to potential investors. Any Accelerator programmes required under this Lot will require to be delivered over a specified period. Most programmes will accommodate between 12 – 15 eligible organisations, with a maximum of 15 participating in any programme. Smaller cohorts may be required on occasion. Lot 7: Preparing for Global Growth. The Internationalisation Lot will support businesses access overseas markets, offering an opportunity to increase sales to a much wider customer base. Exporting can be profitable for businesses of all sizes and lead to new job opportunities. Scottish businesses trading internationally have high productivity rates and are often more competitive, with research suggesting that SMEs who export perform better financially and grow more than twice as fast as those that do not. There is already a comprehensive support structure nationally through SDI for exporting support, therefore this Lot aims to fill the gaps in expertise or support businesses unable to leverage other public sector support. Services for this Lot should include, but not be limited to, the following: Support for Exporting , including tariffs and taxes Market Analysis and Development Structuring for Internationalisation

result.text: Huoltovarmuuskeskus invites market operators interested in the procurement to respond to a request for information and to register for the market dialogue. The subject of the procurement is an on-premises project portfolio tool that enables the management of programme and project activities. The objective of the procurement is to tender for software that: • supports current and developing project portfolio and programme management, and • reduces the amount of manual work related to processes and reporting. • The system solution to be procured and the supplier's operations must meet the security requirements for security-classified information. • In addition, the system also supports the work of an external project manager during the project planning, implementation, monitoring and closing phases. The aim is, in principle, to procure off-the-shelf software that can be configured according to the requirements and needs of HVK. REQUEST FOR INFORMATION AND BILATERAL MARKET DIALOGUE SESSIONS With this request for information, Huoltovarmuuskeskus (hereinafter HVK) is launching a market survey for the procurement. The purpose of the request for information is to identify potential market operators, collect information on solution alternatives available on the market, and compile insights regarding the subject of the procurement and its implementation. Furthermore, the goal of the request for information is to collect information from market operators and ensure that the procurement planning is based on the current market situation. In the request for information, service providers are asked to present preliminary alternatives for project implementation models. In addition to the request for information, the contracting authority may, if necessary, organise market dialogue sessions. Bilateral discussions on other matters related to the implementation of the project can also be held during the market dialogue. More detailed descriptions of the subject of the procurement, the request for information questions, and instructions can be found as an attachment to this notice. INSTRUCTIONS FOR RESPONDING TO THE REQUEST FOR INFORMATION We ask market operators to: a) Respond to the questions in the attached questionnaire in a free-form manner no later than 21.1.2026 at 16. - Message subject/heading: "Huoltovarmuuskeskus/ project portfolio - Request for information" - Responses are to be sent by email to anni.partanen@kpmg.fi b) In connection with responding, the market operator may register for a more detailed market dialogue session to be held via Teams. MARKET DIALOGUE The contracting authority reserves the right to organise an oral market dialogue session and the possibility to limit the number of candidates invited to the oral market dialogue section. The session requires the signing of a non-disclosure agreement. Potential market dialogue sessions will be held via Teams on 28.1.2026. The estimated duration of the session is 60-90 minutes. The contracting authority reserves the right to change and refine the schedule. Supplier-specific market dialogue invitations will be delivered to the registered market operators after the deadline for the request for information. The discussions will be held in Finnish. Participation in the market dialogue is not a condition for participating in the procurement process to be carried out later.

parts.source: Huoltovarmuuskeskus kutsuu hankinnasta kiinnostuneita markkinatoimijoita vastaamaan tietopyyntöön ja ilmoittautumaan mukaan markkinavuoropuheluun. Hankinnan kohteena on projektisalkku työkalu paikallisesti asennettuna (On Premises), joka mahdollistaa ohjelma- ja projektitoiminnan johtamisen. Hankinnan tavoitteena on kilpailuttaa ohjelmisto: • tukee nykymuotoista ja kehittyvää projektisalkun ja ohjelmien johtamista sekä • vähentää prosesseihin ja raportointiin liittyvää manuaalisen työn määrää. • Hankittava järjestelmäratkaisu ja toimittajan toiminnan tulee täyttää turvallisuusluokitellun tiedon tietoturvavaatimukset. • Lisäksi järjestelmä tukee myös ulkopuolisen projektipäällikön työskentelyä projektin suunnittelu, toteutus- ja seuranta- sekä lopetusvaiheissa. Tavoitteena on lähtökohtaisesti hankkia valmisohjelmisto, jota on mahdollista konfiguroida HVK:n vaatimusten ja tarpeen mukaisesti. TIETOPYYNTÖ JA KAHDENVÄLISET MARKKINAVUOROPUHELUTILAISUUDET Tällä tietopyynnöllä Huoltovarmuuskeskus (jäljempänä HVK) käynnistää hankinnan markkinakartoituksen. Tietopyynnön tarkoituksena on kartoittaa potentiaalisia markkinatoimijoita, kerätä tietoa markkinoilla saatavilla olevista ratkaisuvaihtoehdoista sekä koostaa näkemyksiä hankinnan kohteeseen ja sen toteutukseen liittyen. Lisäksi tietopyynnön tavoitteena on kerätä markkinatoimijoilta tietoa ja varmistaa, että hankinnan suunnittelu perustuu ajantasaiseen markkinatilanteeseen. Tietopyynnössä palveluntarjoajia pyydetään esittelemään projektin toteutusmallien alustavia vaihtoehtoja. Tietopyynnön lisäksi hankintayksikkö voi tarvittaessa järjestää markkinavuoropuhelutilaisuuksia. Markkinavuoropuhelussa myös voidaan käydä kahdenvälisiä keskusteluja muista projektin toteuttamiseen liittyvistä seikoista. Tarkemmat kuvaukset hankinnan kohteesta, tietopyyntökysymyksistä sekä ohjeistuksesta löytyvät tämän ilmoituksen liitteenä. OHJEET TIETOPYYNTÖÖN VASTAAMISEEN Pyydämme markkinatoimijoita: a) Vastaamaan oheisen kyselylomakkeen kysymyksiin vapaamuotoisesti viimeistään 21.1.2026 kello 16. - Viestin aihe/otsikko: "Huoltovarmuuskeskus/ projektisalkku - Tietopyyntö" - Vastaukset lähetetään sähköpostitse osoitteeseen anni.partanen@kpmg.fi b) Vastaamisen yhteydessä markkinatoimija voi ilmoittautua mukaan Teamsin välityksellä toteutettavaan tarkempaan markkinavuoropuhelutilaisuuteen. MARKKINAVUOROPUHELU Hankintayksikkö varaa oikeuden järjestää suullisen markkinavuoropuhelutilaisuuden sekä mahdollisuuden rajata suulliseen markkinavuoropuheluosioon kutsuttavien ehdokkaiden määrää. Tilaisuus edellyttää vaitiolositoumuksen allekirjoittamista. Mahdolliset markkinavuoropuhelutilaisuudet järjestetään Teamsin välityksellä 28.1.2026. Arvioitu kesto tilaisuudelle on 60-90 minuuttia. Hankintayksikkö varaa oikeuden muuttaa ja tarkentaa aikataulua. Toimittajakohtaiset markkinavuoropuhelukutsut toimitetaan ilmoittautuneille markkinatoimijoille tietopyynnön määräajan jälkeen. Keskustelut käydään suomen kielellä. Osallistuminen markkinavuoropuheluun ei ole ehto myöhemmin toteutettavaan hankintaprosessiin osallistumiselle.

result.text: At the BWB sewage treatment plants and sewage pumping stations, the PI System from the company AVEVA (formerly OSIsoft) is used for the long-term archiving of process data. The Berliner Wasserbetriebe currently operate 9 PI Data Archive Servers. These are supplied with data via approx. 50 OPC Interfaces. In total, the measured values, up to 40.000 - 50.000 data points, are collected and archived in the smallest possible resolution (> 1 second). They serve as a data source for the Asset Framework, PI Vision, a simulation server, as well as for external customers who need to access live and historical data. For this purpose, the API interface of the PI System is also required. The retention of historical data goes back to the year 1999. It includes all existing measured values and data points. These are permanently mapped in the PI Data Archive and are therefore available for retrieval within milliseconds at any time. The following questionnaire is intended to evaluate whether a migration to an alternative system is possible and economically viable.

In Summe werden die Messwerte, bis zu 40.000 - 50.000 Datenpunkte, in kleinstmöglicher Auflösung (> 1 Sekunde) gesammelt und archiviert. Sie dienen als Datenquelle für das Asset Framework, PI Vision, eines Simulationsservers, wie auch für externe Kunden, die auf Live- und historische Daten zugreifen müssen. Dazu wird auch die API-Schnittstelle des PI Systems benötigt. Die Vorhaltung von historischen Daten reicht bis ins Jahr 1999 zurück. Sie umfasst alle vorhandenen Messwerte und Datenpunkte. Diese sind dauerhaft im PI Data Archive gemappt und stehen somit jederzeit zum Abruf innerhalb von Millisekunden bereit. Anhand des folgenden Fragenkataloges soll evaluiert werden, ob eine Migration auf ein Alternativsystem möglich und wirtschaftlich sinnvoll ist.
